papers.title: Representation Forcing for Bottleneck-Free Unified Multimodal Models
papers.abstract_en: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) aim to handle perception and generation in a single model. Yet existing UMMs still rely on a frozen, separately pretrained VAE for image generation, imposing a structural bottleneck. Naively removing it introduces a quality gap, as the model must learn both high-level structure and low-level details from raw pixels. In this paper, we propose Representation Forcing (RF), a technique that closes this gap by making representation prediction a native capability of the model. Concretely, RF forces the decoder to autoregressively predict visual representations as intermediate tokens before pixels; these tokens then stay in context to guide pixel diffusion within the same backbone. By turning representations from perception outputs into generation targets, RF eliminates the need for any external generative latent space. We find that RF benefits both understanding and generation. On image generation, our pixel-space model with RF matches state-of-the-art VAE-based unified models. On image understanding, pixel-space RF generally outperforms its VAE-based variant. Together, these results offer an effective step toward end-to-end, bottleneck-free UMMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Representation Forcing (RF)技术，用于消除统一多模态模型中外部VAE的瓶颈。RF使解码器自回归预测视觉表示作为中间token，再引导像素扩散，从而无需外部生成潜空间。实验表明，基于像素空间的RF模型在图像生成上匹配基于VAE的最先进模型，在图像理解上更优。
Motivation: 现有统一多模态模型依赖冻结的预训练VAE进行图像生成，造成结构瓶颈。直接移除VAE会导致质量下降，因为模型必须从原始像素同时学习高级结构和低级细节。
Method: 提出Representation Forcing (RF)，强制解码器自回归预测视觉表示作为中间token，这些token保留在上下文中指导同一骨干网络内的像素扩散，将表示从感知输出变为生成目标。
Result: 在图像生成上，像素空间RF模型匹配基于VAE的最先进统一模型；在图像理解上，像素空间RF一般优于VAE变体。
Conclusion: RF为迈向无瓶颈的端到端统一多模态模型提供了有效一步。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Lumos-Nexus: Efficient Frequency Bridging with Homogeneous Latent Space for Video Unified Models
papers.abstract_en: Connector-based video unified models have demonstrated strong capability in instruction-grounded video synthesis, but integrating a large high-fidelity generator into the unified training loop is computationally prohibitive, limiting achievable visual quality. We therefore propose Lumos-Nexus, a training-efficient unified video generation framework that facilitates the development of strong reasoning-driven generation capabilities while significantly enhancing visual fidelity. Lumos-Nexus adopts a two-stage design: 1) During training, only a lightweight generator is aligned with the understanding block to learn to take in reasoning-driven semantic control. 2) During inference, we introduce Unified Progressive Frequency Bridging (UPFB) to progressively hand off generation to a high-capacity pretrained generator in the shared latent space, enabling coarse-to-fine refinement and producing high-fidelity videos without compromising reasoning quality. To fill the gap in reasoning-driven video generation benchmarks, we introduce VR-Bench, which assesses a model's capability to translate inferred intent into coherent and semantically aligned video content. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Lumos-Nexus achieves substantial gains in visual realism and temporal coherence on VBench, while exhibiting strong reasoning-based generative performance on VR-Bench. Code and models are available at https://jiazheng-xing.github.io/nexus-lumos-home/.
papers.comment: Project page (https://jiazheng-xing.github.io/nexus-lumos-home/) and Code (https://github.com/alibaba-damo-academy/Lumos-Custom/) are available
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Lumos-Nexus，一种训练高效的统一视频生成框架，采用两阶段设计：训练阶段仅对齐轻量生成器与理解块学习推理控制；推理阶段使用统一渐进式频率桥接（UPFB）在共享潜在空间渐进式将生成任务转移给高容量预训练生成器，实现粗到细精炼，从而提升视觉保真度。同时引入VR-Bench基准评估推理驱动视频生成。实验在VBench上提升视觉真实感和时间连贯性，在VR-Bench上展示强推理生成性能。
Motivation: 现有基于连接器的视频统一模型将大型高保真生成器集成到统一训练循环中计算成本极高，限制了可达到的视觉质量。
Method: 两阶段设计：训练时仅对齐轻量生成器与理解块，使其学习接收推理驱动的语义控制；推理时引入统一渐进式频率桥接（UPFB），在共享潜在空间逐步将生成任务移交给高容量预训练生成器，进行粗到细精炼。
Result: 在VBench上取得视觉真实感和时间连贯性的显著提升，在VR-Bench上展现出强推理驱动生成性能。
Conclusion: Lumos-Nexus通过两阶段解耦训练与推理，有效提高了视频统一模型的生成保真度和推理能力，代码与模型已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Linear Scaling Video VLMs for Long Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Video vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used in long-horizon and streaming settings, yet most video encoders still rely on spatiotemporal self-attention, causing compute and latency to grow quadratically with the number of frames. Existing efficiency methods improve scalability but often lose accuracy relative to full self-attention, for example through aggressive frame/token dropping or coarse attention approximations. We introduce StateKV, an inference-time method that adapts pretrained long-video VLMs to linear-time video prefill by carrying cross-frame context in a fixed-capacity, importance-based recurrent state, paired with a second full per-frame cache used for decoding. Across three long-video benchmarks and seven models spanning three families and multiple scales, StateKV remains close to full self-attention and consistently outperforms dominant sliding-window / recency-based streaming approximations, without fine-tuning or architectural changes. StateKV also reduces video-prefill cost measured FLOPs, enabling stronger accuracy at a fixed compute budget by running larger models. These results suggest a practical step toward scalable long-video understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 StateKV，一种无需微调或架构修改的推理时方法，通过固定容量的基于重要性的循环状态携带跨帧上下文，配合第二个全帧缓存进行解码，将预训练的长视频 VLM 的视频预填充计算复杂度从二次降为线性。在三个长视频基准和七个模型上，StateKV 接近完整自注意力性能，优于滑动窗口等流式近似方法，并可通过运行更大模型在固定计算预算下提升准确率。
Motivation: 现有视频 VLM 的视频编码器依赖时空自注意力，计算和延迟随帧数二次增长，而现有效率方法如帧/令牌丢弃或粗糙注意力近似会损失准确率。
Method: StateKV 是一种推理时方法，包含两个缓存：一个固定容量的循环状态（基于重要性权重更新）用于跨帧上下文传递，另一个全帧缓存用于解码；视频预填充时仅需线性计算。
Result: 在三个长视频基准上，StateKV 在七个模型（涵盖三个家族和多种规模）中保持接近完整自注意力的性能，并一致优于滑动窗口/基于 recency 的流式近似；同时降低了视频预填充的 FLOPs，允许在固定预算下使用更大模型。
Conclusion: StateKV 提供了一种实用的步骤，无需微调即可实现可扩展的长视频理解，表明线性时间预填充在长视频 VLM 中是可行的。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SOCO: Benchmarking Semantic Object Correspondence in Vision Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Measuring structured object understanding in vision foundation models remains challenging due to inconsistent evaluation protocols and limited part-level supervision. Semantic correspondence (SC) evaluates this capability by testing whether object parts can be matched across instances and categories under large variations in appearance, viewpoint, and geometry. To enable a systematic SC evaluation, we introduce SOCO, a new benchmark for Semantic Object Correspondence that introduces a taxonomy of correspondence types and provides consistent, functionally meaningful keypoint annotations across 100 categories and over 1M correspondence pairs. In addition, SOCO includes keypoint language descriptions, enabling the evaluation of large vision-language models (LVLMs) and their fine-grained part-level understanding. Comprehensive experiments reveal that (i) vision foundation backbones encode strong semantic structure but transfer correspondences poorly across related categories and only partially capture object-part position, (ii) LVLMs are stronger at text-prompted part localization than at visual-reference cross-image matching, exposing a gap between language-grounded localization and fine-grained visual correspondence, and (iii) correspondence performance predicts performance on dense downstream tasks, including segmentation, tracking, 3D pose estimation, and 3D detection, more strongly than ImageNet classification. Together, these findings position SOCO as a benchmark for structured, part-level representation quality in vision and multimodal foundation models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SOCO，一个用于评估视觉基础模型中语义对象对应的新基准。该基准引入了对应的分类体系，包含100个类别和超过100万个对应对的、功能上有意义的关键点标注，并包含关键点语言描述以评估大型视觉语言模型。实验发现视觉基础骨干网络编码了强语义结构但跨类别对应迁移差，LVLM在文本提示定位强于跨图像视觉匹配，且对应性能强于ImageNet分类预测密集下游任务性能。
Motivation: 测量视觉基础模型中的结构化对象理解因评价协议不一致和部分级监督有限而具有挑战性。语义对应通过测试对象部分能否跨实例和类别匹配来评估此能力，但缺少系统性的基准。
Method: 引入SOCO基准，包含对应类型分类、100个类别和超过100万对的关键点标注，并包含关键点语言描述以评估LVLM的部分级理解。
Result: 实验表明视觉基础骨干网络编码强语义结构但跨类别迁移差；LVLM在文本提示定位强于视觉参考跨图像匹配；对应性能比ImageNet分类更强地预测密集下游任务（分割、跟踪、3D姿态估计、3D检测）。
Conclusion: SOCO可作为视觉和多模态基础模型中结构化部分级表示质量的基准。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: KLIP: localized distribution shift detection via KL-divergence with diffusion priors in Inverse Problems
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have shown promising performance as data-driven priors for computational imaging, as well as some capacity to detect out-of-distribution (OOD) images. However, existing approaches to OOD detection often require some knowledge of the shifted distribution, fail to detect subtle or localized distribution shifts, and operate on full images, rather than the indirect measurements available in inverse problems. We propose an OOD detection metric based on the Kullback-Leibler divergence between the diffusion prior and the posterior distribution, that (i) does not require any calibration data or knowledge of the shifted distribution, and (ii) can detect whole images as OOD as well as localize OOD patches within an image. Experimentally, we show that this metric can detect subtle yet semantically meaningful distribution shifts, such as the shift from healthy liver CT scans to those with tumors, and generalizes across different types of diffusion models, datasets, and inverse problems. Our code can be found at https://github.com/voilalab/KLIP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于扩散先验与后验之间KL散度的OOD检测指标KLIP，无需校准数据或已知转移分布，既能检测整张图像的分布偏移，也能定位图像中的局部偏移区域。实验表明该方法可检测细微的语义偏移（如健康肝脏CT与肿瘤CT的差异），并泛化至不同扩散模型、数据集和逆问题。
Motivation: 现有OOD检测方法通常需要校准数据或已知转移分布，难以检测局部或微妙的分布偏移，且多针对全图像而非逆问题中的间接测量。
Method: 基于扩散先验与后验之间的Kullback-Leibler散度设计OOD检测指标，无需任何校准数据或对偏移分布的预先了解，支持整图OOD检测与局部OOD区域定位。
Result: 在肝脏CT肿瘤检测等任务上验证了该指标能有效检测细微语义分布偏移，并展示了跨扩散模型、数据集和逆问题的泛化能力。
Conclusion: 该方法是一种通用且无需校准的分布偏移检测与定位工具，适用于多种逆问题场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning Global Motion with Compact Gaussians for Feed-Forward 4D Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic scene reconstruction from monocular video remains a fundamental challenge in computer vision. Existing feed-forward methods predict 3D Gaussians pixel-wise for each frame, suffering from duplicated Gaussians and view-dependent biases that hinder effective learning of scene motion. We present C4G, a feed-forward 4D reconstruction framework built upon a compact set of timestamp-conditioned learnable Gaussian query tokens. Each token aggregates corresponding features across the full temporal context and decodes a 3D Gaussian whose position is modulated by the target timestamp, enabling globally coherent motion modeling without per-scene optimization. To capture fine-grained details, we further introduce a video diffusion model-based rendering enhancement module. Since our framework effectively aggregates features into Gaussians, we extend this capability to feature lifting, producing a 4D feature field that supports point tracking and dynamic scene understanding. C4G achieves strong novel-view synthesis performance using significantly fewer Gaussians and without requiring camera poses, while exhibiting stronger motion modeling and robustness to large temporal gaps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出C4G，一个前馈4D重建框架，使用紧凑的、时间戳条件化的可学习高斯查询令牌聚合全局时间特征，实现无需逐场景优化的连贯运动建模。进一步引入视频扩散模型增强渲染细节，并将特征提升为4D特征场以支持点跟踪和动态场景理解。在无需相机位姿的情况下，C4G用显著较少的高斯数实现了强的新视角合成性能，并对大时间间隔表现出鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有前馈方法逐帧预测3D高斯，导致重复高斯和视图依赖偏差，难以有效学习场景运动。
Method: 提出C4G框架，基于紧凑的时间戳条件化可学习高斯查询令牌，每个令牌跨完整时间上下文聚合对应特征，解码出位置由目标时间戳调制的3D高斯。引入视频扩散模型渲染增强模块，并扩展特征提升为4D特征场。
Result: C4G在无需相机位姿的情况下，使用显著更少的高斯数实现强的新视角合成性能，展现出更强的运动建模能力和对大时间间隔的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 摘要未明确强调局限性，但指出该方法在高效运动建模和鲁棒性方面优于现有方法。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出C4G，一个前馈4D重建框架，使用紧凑的、时间戳条件化的可学习高斯查询令牌聚合全局时间特征，实现无需逐场景优化的连贯运动建模。进一步引入视频扩散模型增强渲染细节，并将特征提升为4D特征场以支持点跟踪和动态场景理解。在无需相机位姿的情况下，C4G用显著较少的高斯数实现了强的新视角合成性能，并对大时间间隔表现出鲁棒性。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有前馈方法逐帧预测3D高斯，导致重复高斯和视图依赖偏差，难以有效学习场景运动。
summary_sections.method: 提出C4G框架，基于紧凑的时间戳条件化可学习高斯查询令牌，每个令牌跨完整时间上下文聚合对应特征，解码出位置由目标时间戳调制的3D高斯。引入视频扩散模型渲染增强模块，并扩展特征提升为4D特征场。
summary_sections.result: C4G在无需相机位姿的情况下，使用显著更少的高斯数实现强的新视角合成性能，展现出更强的运动建模能力和对大时间间隔的鲁棒性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要未明确强调局限性，但指出该方法在高效运动建模和鲁棒性方面优于现有方法。

papers.title: A Tight Theory of Error Feedback Algorithms in Distributed Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Communication costs are a major bottleneck in distributed learning and first-order optimization. A common approach to alleviate this issue is to compress the gradient information exchanged between agents. However, such compression typically degrades the convergence guarantees of gradient-based methods. Error feedback mechanisms provide a simple and computationally cheap remedy for this issue, but numerous variants have been proposed, and their relative performance remains poorly understood. This paper provides tight convergence analyses for two of the main error-feedback algorithms from the literature, the classic Error Feedback method (EF) and Error Feedback 21 (EF21), by identifying optimal step-size choices and constructing optimal Lyapunov functions tailored to each method. The results hold independently of the number of agents and recover the known best guarantees possible in the single-agent regime.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对分布式优化中的梯度压缩通信瓶颈，为两种主流错误反馈算法EF和EF21提供了紧收敛分析。通过识别最优步长选择和构造最优Lyapunov函数，证明了其收敛界独立于代理数量，并恢复了单代理情况下的已知最优保证。
Motivation: 分布式学习和一阶优化中通信开销是主要瓶颈，梯度压缩会降低收敛性。尽管错误反馈机制被广泛使用，但多种变体的相对理论性能仍不清晰，缺乏紧的上界分析。
Method: 为经典EF和EF21两种错误反馈算法分别构造了最优Lyapunov函数，并通过识别最优步长选择得到紧收敛上界。
Result: 获得的收敛界与代理数量无关，且在单代理情形下匹配已知最优保证。
Conclusion: 本文从理论上证明了EF和EF21在分布式优化中的最优性，提供了设计高效压缩通信算法的理论指导。

papers.title: Stateful Online Monitoring Catches Distributed Agent Attacks
papers.abstract_en: Language models can find thousands of severe software vulnerabilities, and agents are increasingly being misused for cyberattacks. To avoid detection, attackers frequently distribute their misuse, splitting a harmful task across many user accounts so each individual transcript looks benign. Because safety monitors score only one agent context at a time, they are structurally blind to misuse that is only visible in aggregate, across many accounts. We show this gap is real by building, to our knowledge, the first distributed agent attack, a multi-agent scaffold that completes hard cybersecurity tasks while hiding the harmful objective across subagents with limited contexts, evading a standard monitor that catches it only a fifth as often as prior agent attacks. Towards a defense, we develop an online stateful monitor that uses real-time clustering to collect weak suspiciousness signals across many agent transcripts, and escalates only rarely to a language model that flags misuse across user accounts. In evaluations with large-scale simulated datacenter traffic, our monitor Pareto dominates standard monitors, catching distributed attacks 30% earlier and flagging cyber misuse before it reaches the most harmful stages. Crucially, this comes at negligible additional latency for ~99% of user traffic. This detection advantage persists but narrows as the benign background traffic grows very large. After an extensive red-teaming exercise, we improve the defense and surprisingly also find that it catches standard jailbreaks, since adaptive attackers reuse attack variants across accounts. Our results point toward a new class of safety monitors which reason over groups of users rather than isolated transcripts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次构建了分布式智能体攻击（distributed agent attack），将有害任务分散到多个用户账户以逃避单上下文安全监控器，并提出一种在线有状态监控器（stateful monitor），通过实时聚类跨账户的弱可疑信号来检测此类攻击。实验表明，该监控器在捕捉分布式攻击时比标准监控器早30%，且对约99%的用户流量无额外延迟。
Motivation: 现有安全监控器仅独立评估单个代理上下文，无法检测跨多个账户分布的恶意行为，导致对分布式智能体攻击的结构性盲区。
Method: 开发一个在线有状态监控器，利用实时聚类聚合多个代理转录中的弱可疑信号，仅在必要时升级到语言模型进行跨账户标记，从而在低延迟下检测分布式攻击。
Result: 在大规模模拟数据中心流量中，该监控器帕累托优于标准监控器，捕捉分布式攻击早30%，能在攻击达到最有害阶段前发出警报，且对约99%的用户流量无额外延迟；优势在背景流量很大时缩小。
Conclusion: 论文提出了一类新的安全监控器，基于用户群体而非孤立转录进行推理，并能意外捕捉标准越狱攻击，但检测优势在大规模良性流量下有所减弱。

papers.title: CoFiDA-M: Concept-Aware Feature Modulation for Cross-Domain Adaptation with Image-Only Inference
papers.abstract_en: Models for AI-based skin cancer screening suffer a severe performance drop when shifting from expert dermoscopic (source) images to consumer-grade clinical (target) images, hindering real-world deployment. Existing domain adaptation methods often ignore crucial semantic invariants, such as clinical concepts. While new foundation models like MONET can provide this semantic information as dense, probabilistic scores, this metadata is unavailable at test time, creating a deployment paradox for practical image-only screening tools. We address this gap by proposing CoFiDA-M, a privileged information framework that learns from concepts at training time but deploys as an image-only model. Our method trains a teacher network that uses MONET concept probabilities to guide a FiLM modulator, transforming visual features into a semantically ``edited" feature space. A lightweight, image-only student is then trained to reproduce this edited representation, not just the teacher's final predictions. This distillation ``bakes" the clinical reasoning into the student's weights. On a challenging multi-dataset benchmark, our image-only student significantly outperforms state-of-the-art approaches, especially in melanoma recall. Our work provides a practical and generalizable framework for leveraging noisy, probabilistic metadata as privileged information, demonstrating strong cross-dataset robustness and potential for real-world deployment beyond dermatology. Implementation code is available at: https://github.com/mmu-dermatology-research/CoFiDA.git
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CoFiDA-M框架，利用MONET模型提供的概念概率作为特权信息，训练时引导特征调制（FiLM）产生语义编辑的特征空间，并通过知识蒸馏将临床推理编码到轻量级学生网络，实现仅图像推理的跨域适应。在皮肤镜到临床图像的皮肤癌筛查任务上，学生网络显著优于现有方法，特别是在黑色素瘤召回率上表现突出。
Motivation: 现有跨域适应方法忽略临床概念等语义不变量，且MONET等基础模型提供的概念概率在测试时不可用，导致实际部署困难。
Method: 提出特权信息框架：教师网络使用MONET概念概率指导FiLM调制器，将视觉特征转换为语义编辑特征空间；轻量级图像仅学生网络通过蒸馏学习再现该编辑表示，而非仅教师最终预测。
Result: 在多个数据集基准上，图像仅学生网络在黑色素瘤召回率等指标上显著优于现有域适应方法，展现出强跨数据集鲁棒性。
Conclusion: CoFiDA-M提供了一种通用框架，利用噪声概率元数据作为特权信息，实现仅图像推理的跨域适应，具有实际部署潜力，可推广至皮肤病学之外的领域。

papers.title: TunerDiT: Training-free Progressive Steering of Diffusion Transformer for Multi-Event Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-video (T2V) generation faces challenging questions when generating videos with long horizons containing multiple events. Inspired by the intrinsics of the diffusion process, we probe video diffusion transformers (DiTs) and uncover intrinsic turning points in the DiT denoising trajectory where conditioning text affects generation from global layout to fine-grained details. Building on this finding, we present TunerDiT, a simple yet effective progressive steering method that requires no additional training for multi-event generation. TunerDiT comprises two steering handles: (1) Event-Partitioned Masking that enforces event boundaries while allowing cross-event transition bands; (2) Cross-Event Prompt Fusion that injects neighboring event semantics for late-stage refinement. We contribute a self-curated prompt suite for benchmarking multi-event generation, i.e., Meve. TunerDiT achieves state-of-the-art performance across 8 metrics and offers a tunable trade-off between video consistency and event separation, compared with other training-free methods. The improvement in text alignment increases with the event count, indicating a scaling possibility with increasing event count.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多事件长视频生成中文本条件与去噪轨迹的耦合问题，提出无需额外训练的渐进式引导方法 TunerDiT。该方法包含事件分区掩码（Event-Partitioned Masking）和跨事件提示融合（Cross-Event Prompt Fusion）两个手柄，并在自建的多事件基准 Meve 上取得8项指标的最优结果。
Motivation: 现有文本到视频生成模型在处理包含多个事件的长时间视频时，难以协调全局布局与局部细节，且训练成本高昂。
Method: 基于扩散变换器（DiT）去噪轨迹中的内在转折点，设计事件分区掩码强制事件边界并允许过渡带，以及跨事件提示融合注入邻居事件语义进行后期细化。
Result: 在 Meve 基准上，TunerDiT 相较于其他无训练方法在视频一致性与事件分离之间取得可调权衡，文本对齐随事件数量增加而提升，表明存在缩放可能性。
Conclusion: 无需额外训练即可实现多事件视频生成，并揭示了 DiT 去噪过程中文本条件影响从全局到细节的转变。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Recognizing Co-Speech Gestures in-the-Wild
papers.abstract_en: While humans naturally gesture during speech, only a sparse subset of these movements are visually depictive and semantically linked to specific spoken words. Current multimodal models struggle to capture these semantic co-speech gestures, heavily bottlenecked by a lack of precisely annotated training data. To address this, we introduce the Gesture Recognition in the Wild (GRW) dataset, the first large-scale benchmark designed to map unconstrained human gestures to specific words with frame-accurate temporal boundaries. Comprising 156,688 manually annotated video clips, GRW spans a highly diverse 150-word taxonomy of physical actions, spatial descriptors, and abstract concepts. We leverage GRW to train video models to (a) classify gestures as semantic or not, (b) recognize the word corresponding to a co-speech gesture, and (c) temporally localize the gesture. We also use GRW to establish benchmarks for these three tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出大规模自然场景下的共语手势识别基准GRW数据集，包含156,688个手工标注的视频片段，覆盖150个词类的手势。利用该数据集训练视频模型完成手势语义分类、词识别和时间定位三个任务。
Motivation: 现有多模态模型难以捕捉与特定词语语义相关的共语手势，主要受限于缺乏精确标注的训练数据。
Method: 构建GRW数据集，包含156,688个帧精确标注的视频片段，涵盖150个词类的手势。基于该数据集训练视频模型，进行手势语义分类、对应词识别和时间定位。
Result: GRW数据集为共语手势识别提供首个大规模基准，支持三个任务的评测。
Conclusion: 该数据集和基准有助于推动共语手势识别研究，但仅关注视觉识别，未涉及其他模态融合。

papers.title: Language Models Learn Constructional Semantics, Not To Mention Syntax: Investigating LM Understanding of Paired-Focus Constructions
papers.abstract_en: Grasping the semantics of rare constructions (form-meaning pairings) has been shown to be a challenging problem that has currently only been solved by the largest LLMs. It remains an open question if open-source models have robust constructional understanding, and if so, what learning dynamics underlie the acquisition of this knowledge. Focusing on a set of rare Paired-Focus constructions in English (e.g. "let alone", "much less"), we construct a novel dataset to test their meanings using both scalar adjectival semantics and general world knowledge. Testing a wide range of models differing in parameter count, architecture, and pretraining dataset size, we find that several modestly sized models are sensitive to both the forms and the meanings of Paired-Focus constructions, though models trained on human-scale data fail at all meaning evaluations. Turning to training dynamics for a set of open-checkpoint models, we find that Paired-Focus understanding emerges later in training than Paired-Focus syntactic knowledge, and that learning of Paired-Focus semantics is correlated with gains in some domains of world knowledge. Overall, our empirical results support the conclusion that modestly sized open-source models can grasp the rare Paired-Focus constructions, and demonstrate a connection between knowledge of Paired-Focus constructions and other meaning domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型对英语中罕见的“配对焦点结构”（Paired-Focus constructions，如“let alone”“much less”）的语义理解能力。作者构建了一个新数据集，利用标量形容词语义和世界知识测试模型，发现中等规模的开源模型能同时捕捉此类结构的形式和意义，但仅使用人类规模数据训练的模型在所有意义评估中失败。训练动态分析表明，配对焦点结构的语义理解出现晚于其句法知识，且与某些领域的世界知识获取相关。
Motivation: 大型语言模型已能理解罕见构式的语义，但开源模型是否具备类似能力以及其学习机制尚不明确。本文聚焦于英语中罕见的配对焦点结构，旨在检验开源模型的理解水平并探究知识获取的动态过程。
Method: 构建一个专注于配对焦点结构的新数据集，结合标量形容词语义和通用世界知识进行测试。选用参数规模、架构和预训练数据量各异的模型进行评估，并对部分开放检查点模型分析训练动态。
Result: 多个中等规模的模型（如特定参数量的开源模型）对配对焦点结构的形式和意义均表现出敏感，而仅用人类规模数据训练的模型在所有语义测试中失败。语义理解在训练后期才出现，晚于句法知识，且其学习与某些世界知识领域的提升相关。

papers.title: LongTraceRL: Learning Long-Context Reasoning from Search Agent Trajectories with Rubric Rewards
papers.abstract_en: Long-context reasoning remains a central challenge for large language models, which often fail to locate and integrate key information in extensive distracting content. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has shown promise for this task, yet existing methods are limited by low-confusability distractors and sparse, outcome-only reward signals that cannot supervise intermediate reasoning steps. To address these issues, we introduce \textsc{LongTraceRL}. For data construction, we generate multi-hop questions via knowledge graph random walks and leverage search agent trajectories to build \emph{tiered distractors}: documents the agent read but did not cite (high confusability) and documents that appeared in search results but were never opened (low confusability), producing training contexts that are far more challenging than those built by random sampling or one-shot search. For reward design, we propose a \emph{rubric reward} that uses the gold entities along each reasoning chain as fine-grained, entity-level process supervision. This rubric reward is applied only to responses with correct final answers (positive-only strategy), distinguishing the reasoning quality among correct responses and preventing reward hacking. Experiments on three reasoning LLMs (4B--30B) across five long-context benchmarks demonstrate that \textsc{LongTraceRL} consistently outperforms strong baselines and encourages comprehensive, evidence-grounded reasoning. Codes, datasets and models are available at \href{https://github.com/THU-KEG/LongTraceRL}{https://github.com/THU-KEG/LongTraceRL}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LongTraceRL，一种通过搜索智能体轨迹和 rubric 奖励来提升大语言模型长上下文推理能力的方法。方法利用知识图谱随机游走生成多跳问题，并构建包含高混淆度干扰项（智能体读过但未引用的文档）和低混淆度干扰项（搜索结果中未被打开的文档）的训练上下文。奖励设计上，提出基于推理链中实体的细粒度过程监督 rubric 奖励，仅应用于最终答案正确的响应，以区分推理质量并防止奖励破解。在多个长上下文基准上，该方法在 4B-30B 规模的语言模型中一致优于强基线。
Motivation: 现有长上下文推理方法中，强化学习基于可验证奖励（RLVR）受限于低混淆度干扰项和稀疏的仅结果奖励信号，无法监督中间推理步骤。
Method: 数据构建：通过知识图谱随机游走生成多跳问题，利用搜索智能体轨迹构建层级干扰项（高混淆度：智能体读过但未引用的文档；低混淆度：搜索结果中未打开的文档）。奖励设计：提出 rubric 奖励，基于推理链中黄金实体提供细粒度过程监督，并采用仅对正确响应施加奖励（positive-only strategy）的策略。
Result: 在五个长上下文基准上，LongTraceRL 在 4B-30B 规模的语言模型中一致优于强基线，并促进了全面、有证据支持的推理。
Conclusion: 通过构建高混淆度干扰项和细粒度过程奖励，可以有效提升长上下文推理能力，防止奖励破解，但方法依赖搜索智能体轨迹和知识图谱。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Choosing the Lens: Strategic Perspective Activation in Context-Dependent Argumentation
papers.abstract_en: The same arguments often need to be evaluated under different external regimes. An agent with influence over the regime has a strategic lever that standard formalisms do not directly capture. We introduce context-dependent argumentation frameworks (CDAFs), an extension of Dung's theory in which a defeat function determines, per context, which attacks succeed. A perspective-labeled specialisation derives the defeat function from a relevance set $ρ$ and a priority $π$. The relevance set is the agent's action space. In a small worked example, the agent's target argument is rejected under every full-relevance injective priority, yet accepted under partial activations, one of which no VAF audience can mirror. We define the corresponding decision problem, ACTIVATION-MANIPULATION, and record baseline complexity bounds. Tight bounds and multi-agent variants are left open.
papers.comment: Accepted to LAMAS&SR workshop at FLoC 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出上下文依赖的论辩框架（CDAFs），扩展Dung理论，通过一个击败函数（defeat function）确定每个上下文中哪些攻击成功。引入视角标记的特殊化，从相关集ρ和优先级π导出击败函数。在小型工作示例中，代理的目标参数在完全相关单射优先级下被拒绝，但在部分激活下被接受。定义了ACTIVATION-MANIPULATION决策问题并给出基础复杂度界限。
Motivation: 标准论辩形式化方法无法直接捕捉代理通过影响外部体制（regime）来操控论证评估的策略杠杆。
Method: 引入上下文依赖的论辩框架（CDAFs），其中击败函数按上下文决定攻击是否成功。通过视角标记，从相关集ρ（代理动作空间）和优先级π导出击败函数。
Result: 在小型示例中，代理目标参数在完全相关单射优先级下被拒绝，但在部分激活下可被接受，且某些激活无法被VAF（值论辩框架）受众镜像。
Conclusion: 定义了ACTIVATION-MANIPULATION决策问题，给出了基础复杂度界限，而紧界限和多代理变体留待未来工作。

papers.title: Giving Sensors a Voice: Multimodal JEPA for Semantic Time-Series Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Transformer-based architectures have advanced sequence modeling in language and vision, yet general-purpose representation learning for heterogeneous multivariate time series remains underexplored. We introduce CHARM (Channel-Aware Representation Model), which incorporates channel-level textual descriptions into a Transformer encoder equivariant to channel order. CHARM is trained with a Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) and a novel loss promoting informative, temporally stable embeddings; latent-space prediction encourages robustness to sensor noise while description-aware gating provides interpretability through learned inter-channel relationships. Across anomaly detection, classification, and short- and long-term forecasting, the learned embeddings achieve strong performance using only a linear probe. Performance is driven primarily by the JEPA objective and conditioning architecture, with text descriptions serving as channel identifiers for cross-dataset generalization.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, accepted at ICML 2026. arXiv admin note: substantial text overlap with arXiv:2505.14543
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML), PMLR 306, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CHARM模型，利用通道级文本描述和Transformer编码器（通道顺序等变），通过联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）学习异构多元时间序列的语义嵌入。在异常检测、分类和短期/长期预测任务中，仅使用线性探测即可获得强性能。
Motivation: 基于Transformer的序列建模在语言和视觉中取得进展，但通用表示学习在异构多元时间序列中尚未充分探索。
Method: CHARM结合通道级文本描述到Transformer编码器中，采用JEPA训练和新型损失函数以促进信息丰富且时间稳定的嵌入，并通过描述感知门控实现可解释性。
Result: 在异常检测、分类和预测任务中，学习到的嵌入仅使用线性探测即取得强性能。性能主要来自JEPA目标和条件架构，文本描述作为跨数据集泛化的通道标识符。
Conclusion: 性能驱动因素是JEPA目标和条件架构，文本描述作为通道标识符帮助跨数据集泛化。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: SurGe: Improved Surface Geometry in Point Maps
papers.abstract_en: Recent feedforward 3D reconstruction methods predict point maps and estimate global 3D geometry remarkably well. However, their predictions still exhibit inaccurate local surface geometry, which is clearly visible qualitatively but only weakly reflected in common metrics. To make these errors more explicit in evaluation, we introduce a point map normal metric that evaluates the local surface orientation induced by neighboring 3D predictions. To reduce these errors, we propose two complementary components: a point gradient matching loss that supervises depth-normalized 3D finite differences, and a Neighborhood Attention Decoder (NAD) that progressively upsamples features and uses Neighborhood Attention for local feature mixing. Across eight zero-shot monocular geometry benchmarks, our model, SurGe, achieves the best average rank for global point map AbsRel and consistently improves local point map and point map normal evaluations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文针对前馈3D重建方法中局部表面几何不准确的问题，提出点图法向度量来评估局部表面方向，并引入点梯度匹配损失和邻域注意力解码器（NAD）来改进局部表面几何。在8个零样本单目几何基准上，SurGe在全局点图AbsRel和局部点图评估上取得了最优平均排名。
Motivation: 现有前馈3D重建方法在全局几何上表现良好，但局部表面几何不准确，且现有指标对此不敏感，需要更好的评估方法和改进技术。
Method: 提出点图法向度量（point map normal metric）来显式评估局部表面方向误差；提出点梯度匹配损失（point gradient matching loss）监督深度归一化的3D有限差分；以及邻域注意力解码器（Neighborhood Attention Decoder, NAD）逐步上采样特征并用邻域注意力进行局部特征混合。
Result: 在8个零样本单目几何基准上，SurGe在全局点图AbsRel指标和局部点图/法向评估中均取得最佳平均排名。
Conclusion: 所提度量和方法有效改善了局部表面几何精度，且可推广到多种单目几何任务。

papers.title: Joint Multi-Camera LiDAR Extrinsic Calibration via Learned Pairwise Initialization and Geometric Refinement
papers.abstract_en: Most learning-based camera-LiDAR calibration methods treat each camera-LiDAR pair independently, ignoring the rigid geometric coupling in multi-camera platforms. As a result, per-camera estimates may be individually accurate yet inconsistent at the system level. We present a two-stage framework for joint multi-camera LiDAR extrinsic calibration that combines learned pairwise matching with geometric refinement. First, CMRNext is applied independently to each camera to produce initial extrinsic estimates and dense 2D-3D correspondences. These predictions are then jointly refined through a multi-frame bundle adjustment with reprojection, per-camera prior, and relative-pose prior terms. This approach converts pairwise predictions into a globally consistent multi-camera calibration. Experiments on KITTI (in-domain for CMRNext) and Walkley (out-of-domain) datasets show improved per-camera accuracy and inter-camera consistency. On KITTI, the method achieves 0.89 cm translation error and 0.038 rotation error. On Walkley, it reduces translation error from 108.6 cm to 3.1 cm, highlighting the benefit of explicit multi-camera coupling when single-camera predictions are less reliable.
papers.comment: Paper is accepted in CVPR 2026 Workshop URVI: Unified Robotic Vision with Cross-Modal Sensing and Alignment
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个两阶段框架，用于联合多相机-LiDAR外参标定，结合了学习的成对初始化与几何优化。首先对每个相机独立应用CMRNext得到初始外参和稠密2D-3D对应，然后通过多帧光束法平差、每相机先验和相对位姿先验项联合优化。在KITTI和Walkley数据集上，该方法提升了单相机精度和相机间一致性，尤其在跨域场景下将平移误差从108.6 cm降至3.1 cm。
Motivation: 现有基于学习的相机-LiDAR标定方法独立处理每对相机-LiDAR，忽略了多相机平台的刚性几何耦合，导致系统级不一致。
Method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段对每个相机独立运行CMRNext产生初始外参和对应点；第二阶段通过多帧光束法平差，联合优化重投影误差、每相机先验和相对位姿先验，将成对预测转化为全局一致的多相机标定。
Result: 在KITTI上达到0.89 cm平移误差和0.038旋转误差；在Walkley（跨域）上将平移误差从108.6 cm降至3.1 cm。
Conclusion: 显式建模多相机耦合可显著提升标定精度，尤其在单相机预测不可靠的跨域场景下。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SPECTRA: Synthetic IR Test Collections with Relevance Oracles and Controlled Distractor Diagnostics
papers.abstract_en: Scalable information retrieval testing needs corpora that are large enough to stress index construction, ranking latency, query routing, and evaluation tooling, yet human-judged test collections remain expensive and may be unavailable when documents are private or still under design. This paper introduces SPECTRA, a reproducible framework for generating synthetic text corpora and retrieval test collections through a separation of latent topical structure, surface text realization, metadata controls, query intent generation, and deterministic relevance oracles. The framework is intended as a diagnostic complement to Cranfield-style and TREC-style evaluation, not as a replacement for human assessment. A single-process Python prototype generated corpora up to 60,000 documents and 9.61 million tokens while preserving controllable long-tail vocabulary growth and producing graded relevance labels for 96 queries. In the local simulation study, generation remained close to linear at roughly 12K to 14K documents per second, estimated Zipf slopes stayed near 0.86 in absolute value, and increasing cross-topic distractor text reduced BM25 nDCG@10 from 1.00 at 2% distractors to 0.43 at 36% distractors. These results show that lightweight synthetic corpora can expose retrieval-system scaling and failure modes before costly collection construction begins.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SPECTRA框架，用于生成可复现的合成文本语料和检索测试集合，通过分离潜在主题结构、文本生成、元数据控制、查询意图和确定性相关性判据，作为Cranfield/TREC评估的诊断补充。原型系统能生成最高6万文档、961万token的语料，支持可控长尾词汇增长，并为96个查询提供分级相关性标签；实验中生成速度约1.2-1.4万文档/秒，Zipf斜率接近0.86，且增加干扰文本使BM25 nDCG@10从1.00降至0.43。
Motivation: 人工判断的测试集合成本高昂，且在文档私有或设计阶段不可得，需要一种低成本、可扩展且能暴露系统失效模式的合成评估工具。
Method: SPECTRA框架采用模块化设计，分别管理潜在主题结构、表面文本实现、元数据、查询意图和确定性相关性判据，通过可控参数生成多样化的检索测试集合。
Result: 单进程Python原型在约12K-14K文档/秒的速度下线性扩展，生成96个查询的评级标签；干扰文本比例从2%增至36%时，BM25 nDCG@10由1.00降至0.43。
Conclusion: 轻量合成的检索语料可作为真实评估的廉价诊断工具，在投入成本构建人工集合前，帮助发现检索系统的扩展瓶颈和失效模式。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: nuReasoning: A Reasoning-Centric Dataset and Benchmark for Long-Tail Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning is essential for autonomous driving (AD) in long-tail scenarios, where vehicles must apply commonsense knowledge, understand spatial relations, infer agent interactions, and make safe decisions. However, existing AD datasets and benchmarks mainly target perception, prediction, or planning, and provide limited supervision for reasoning over realistic long-tail driving scenes. We introduce nuReasoning, a large-scale real-world dataset and benchmark for reasoning-centric AD. Following the lineage of nuScenes and nuPlan, nuReasoning advances real-world AD datasets and benchmarks toward reasoning in long-tail driving scenarios. The dataset contains 20,000 clips, each 20 seconds long, collected across multiple cities, with synchronized multi-camera images, LiDAR data, HD maps, object annotations, and human-verified reasoning annotations spanning Spatial Reasoning, Decision Reasoning, and Counterfactual Reasoning. Unlike prior datasets that focus primarily on visual question answering, nuReasoning supports both reasoning evaluation and planning evaluation, enabling a direct study of how reasoning supervision affects driving performance. Experiments show that fine-tuning VLMs on nuReasoning substantially improves driving-specific question answering, while incorporating reasoning supervision into VLA training improves planning performance even when textual reasoning outputs are disabled at inference time. These results establish nuReasoning as a foundation for evaluating and improving robust, interpretable, reasoning-driven AD systems in realistic long-tail settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 nuReasoning，一个面向长尾自动驾驶场景的大规模真实世界推理数据集与基准。数据集包含 20,000 个 20 秒片段，覆盖多城市，提供多相机图像、LiDAR、高精地图、目标标注以及空间推理、决策推理和反事实推理的人类验证标注。实验表明，在该数据集上微调 VLM 能显著提升驾驶特定问答，而将推理监督融入 VLA 训练可改善规划性能，即使推理时禁用文本推理输出。
Motivation: 现有自动驾驶数据集和基准主要关注感知、预测或规划，缺乏对长尾真实场景中推理（如常识、空间关系、交互推断、安全决策）的监督。
Method: 构建 nuReasoning 数据集，包含 20k 个 20 秒片段，采用与 nuScenes/nuPlan 一致的传感器配置，提供三类人工验证的推理标注：空间推理、决策推理和反事实推理，并支持推理与规划的双重评估。
Result: 微调 VLM 在驾驶特定问答上取得显著提升；在 VLA 训练中引入推理监督能改善规划指标，且推理时移除文本推理输出后仍有收益。
Conclusion: nuReasoning 为评估和改进鲁棒、可解释的推理驱动自动驾驶系统提供了基础，在真实长尾场景中具有重要价值。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: What Gets Unmasked First? Trajectory Analysis of Diffusion Models for Graph-to-Text Generation
papers.abstract_en: We present the first systematic study of masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) for graph-to-text generation. We analyze MDLM generation trajectories -- the order in which tokens are unmasked during iterative decoding -- and find that, unlike autoregressive LLMs which generate text linearly, MDLMs naturally prioritize entities first, followed by relational and function words, with structural tokens resolved last. We further identify a previously undocumented failure mode of supervised fine-tuning: SFT disrupts this strategy by prematurely anchoring structural sentence-ending tokens early in the decoding trajectory, effectively fixing the output length which can lead to omitted or hallucinated information. To address this, we propose lambda-scaled structural decoding, a training-free inference-time modification that downweights structural token confidence and recovers +9.4 BLEU-4. Finally, we introduce Graph-LLaDA, which integrates a Graph Transformer encoder into LLaDA's decoding process to explicitly incorporate relational graph structure. Cross-dataset evaluation on LAGRANGE reveals that previous baselines overfit to dataset-specific patterns, while LLM- and MDLM-based approaches generalize significantly better.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究掩码扩散语言模型（MDLM）在图到文本生成中的生成轨迹，发现MDLM优先解码实体，然后是关系和功能词，最后是结构标记。监督微调会破坏这一策略，导致过早锚定句尾结构标记，造成信息遗漏或幻觉。提出lambda缩放结构解码，无需训练即可恢复+9.4 BLEU-4。引入Graph-LLaDA，将图Transformer编码器集成到LLaDA解码过程中，显式融入关系图结构。跨数据集评估表明，基于LLM和MDLM的方法泛化能力更强。
Motivation: 现有图到文本生成方法多基于自回归模型，掩码扩散语言模型的解码轨迹尚未被分析，监督微调在MDLM上的失败模式未被记录。
Method: 分析MDLM生成轨迹，提出lambda缩放结构解码（训练无关推理时修改），降低结构标记置信度；并提出Graph-LLaDA，结合图Transformer编码器与LLaDA解码。
Result: lambda缩放结构解码在BLEU-4上恢复+9.4；跨数据集评估显示MDLM方法泛化优于传统基线。
Conclusion: 论文揭示了MDLM的解码顺序特性及SFT的破坏性，提出的简单推理时修改有效提升性能，且图结构融合进一步改善生成质量。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Effective Biological Representation Learning by Masking Gene Expression
papers.abstract_en: RNA sequencing produces rich and diverse datasets of gene expression, offering compelling insights into cellular state and function that have many applications in drug discovery. Modeling such data is challenging due to inherent technical noise and experimental batch effects, as evidenced by many existing transcriptomic foundation models (FMs) underperforming relative to linear baselines. Such results raise the question of whether deep representation learning provides a distinct advantage over the direct use of raw transcript counts. Our work explores this by developing a new self-supervised model, TxFM, with a focus on inductive representation learning evaluations. TxFM employs a masked autoencoding approach tailored to diverse RNA-seq count data, and our ablation study empirically identifies crucial architecture configurations required for strong transfer performance. Additionally, we curate a public training corpus, DiverseRNA-1.4M, and find that TxFM trained on this curated dataset yields high-fidelity gene representations that outperform FMs trained on atlas-scale corpora over 100x larger. Overall, our results indicate that inductive self-supervised learning is a viable modeling approach for transcriptomics representation, provided a careful synthesis of model architecture and training data curation.
papers.comment: 31 pages, 11 figures. Preprint; presented at ICLR 2026 2nd Workshop on Foundation Models for Science: Real-World Impact and Science-First Design
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出TxFM，一种针对RNA-seq数据的掩码自编码模型，用于基因表达表示学习。在诱导表示学习评估中，TxFM优于线性基线，且在小规模数据集上训练比超大语料库上的基础模型表现更好。
Motivation: 现有转录组基础模型在技术噪声和批次效应下表现不佳，甚至不如线性基线，引发深度表示学习是否有效的问题。
Method: 自监督掩码自编码方法TxFM，针对多样RNA-seq计数数据设计，通过消融研究确定关键架构配置。
Result: TxFM在诱导表示学习评估中生成高保真基因表示，在小规模数据集（DiverseRNA-1.4M）上训练优于100倍大的图谱语料库上的基础模型。
Conclusion: 结果表明，通过精心设计的模型架构和训练数据整理，归纳式自监督学习是转录组表示学习的可行方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Functional Attention: From Pairwise Affinities to Functional Correspondences
papers.abstract_en: Learning mappings between infinite-dimensional function spaces, or operator learning, is essential for many machine learning applications. Although transformer-based operators are popular, they often rely on token-wise attention. These methods treat continuous fields as discrete tokens and usually ignore the global functional structure. We introduce \emph{Functional Attention}, which reinterprets attention as a functional correspondence between adaptive bases. Inspired by geometric functional maps, our method replaces softmax affinities with structured linear operators. This yields a compact, generalizable, resolution-invariant representation that explicitly captures global dependencies. Experiments demonstrate that \emph{Functional Attention} can match state-of-the-art performance in many operator learning tasks, including solving PDEs, 3D segmentation, and regression, while remaining robust to varying discretizations. Project page is available at https://github.com/xjffff/FUNCATTN.
papers.comment: 26 pages, 12 figures. Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出功能注意力（Functional Attention），将注意力机制重新解释为自适应基之间的函数对应关系，受几何功能映射启发，用结构化线性算子替代softmax亲和度，从而得到紧凑、泛化、分辨率不变的表示，显式捕捉全局依赖。在求解PDE、3D分割和回归等算子学习任务上达到当前最优水平，并对不同离散化具有鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有基于Transformer的算子学习通常依赖token-wise注意力，将连续场视为离散token，忽略了全局函数结构。
Method: 提出Functional Attention，将注意力视为自适应基之间的函数对应，采用结构化线性算子替代softmax亲和度，得到紧凑且分辨率不变的全局表示。
Result: 在多个算子学习任务（求解PDE、3D分割、回归）上匹配当前最优性能，并对不同离散化保持鲁棒。
Conclusion: 实验表明Functional Attention能有效捕捉全局依赖，提供一种泛化性强、分辨率不变的算子学习方法。
Relevance: 25

papers.title: Positional versus Symbolic Attention Heads: Learning Dynamics, RoPE Geometry, and Length Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Transformer-based language models are widespread in today's society. As such, understanding the mechanisms by which they solve structured tasks and predicting how they may behave in novel scenarios is of great importance for safe deployment. We study the learning dynamics of attention heads in a controlled setting by training a decoder-only Transformer (GPT-J) on two structurally equivalent multi-hop reasoning tasks: a number task requiring positional reasoning and a letter task requiring symbolic reasoning. Using a recently introduced metric that classifies attention-head behavior as positional or symbolic for a given prompt, we show that successful learning is associated with the emergence of pure heads, i.e., heads that express themselves as either positional or symbolic. Despite the tasks' structural equivalence, they impose different mechanistic demands: the number task requires both positional and symbolic heads, whereas the letter task requires only symbolic heads. We then identify the computational roles of these heads, characterize the basic functions they implement, and give theoretical constructions showing how single-layer RoPE-based attention can realize these functions through geometrically interpretable query, key, and value operations. This analysis yields a quantitative separation between positional and symbolic mechanisms in their robustness to longer sequences, formalized through a novel notion of discrepancy. We empirically validate the resulting predictions in both controlled and real-world models, showing that symbolic mechanisms extrapolate more reliably to longer sequences while positional mechanisms face sharper limitations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过训练GPT-J在两种结构等价的多跳推理任务（数字任务需位置推理，字母任务需符号推理）上，研究注意力头的学习动态。利用新指标将注意力头分类为位置性或符号性，发现成功学习与纯位置或纯符号头的出现相关。进一步给出单层RoPE注意力实现这些功能的几何构造，并定义discrepancy概念，理论及实验表明符号机制在长序列外推上更可靠，而位置机制面临更尖锐的限制。
Motivation: 理解Transformer解决结构化任务的机制及在新场景中的行为对安全部署至关重要，但目前对注意力头在位置性与符号性上的区分及长度泛化差异缺乏系统研究。
Method: 在可控环境下训练decoder-only Transformer（GPT-J）于数字和字母推理任务，使用新指标分类注意力头行为；给出单层RoPE注意力实现位置/符号功能的几何构造，并引入discrepancy概念量化两种机制在长序列鲁棒性上的差异。
Result: 成功学习伴随纯头出现；数字任务需要位置和符号头，字母任务仅需符号头；符号机制在长序列外推上更可靠，位置机制面临更尖锐限制。
Conclusion: 符号机制比位置机制更鲁棒地泛化到更长序列，这一分离可通过discrepancy概念形式化，并在控制实验和真实模型中得到验证。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 在可控环境下训练decoder-only Transformer（GPT-J）于数字和字母推理任务，使用新指标分类注意力头行为；给出单层RoPE注意力实现位置/符号功能的几何构造，并引入discrepancy概念量化两种机制在长序列鲁棒性上的差异。
summary_sections.result: 成功学习伴随纯头出现；数字任务需要位置和符号头，字母任务仅需符号头；符号机制在长序列外推上更可靠，位置机制面临更尖锐限制。
summary_sections.conclusion: 符号机制比位置机制更鲁棒地泛化到更长序列，这一分离可通过discrepancy概念形式化，并在控制实验和真实模型中得到验证。

papers.title: EGOSTREAM: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Streaming Episodic Memory in Egocentric Vision
papers.abstract_en: Continuous episodic memory is a core capability for autonomous agents operating in dynamic, real-world environments, yet current streaming video benchmarks provide limited tools for diagnosing what models remember and for how long. We introduce \egostream, a diagnostic benchmark for streaming episodic memory evaluation in egocentric vision. \egostream organizes 2,250 curated questions along seven cognitive dimensions: detail, spatial, temporal, event, social, causal, and prospective memory. We introduce the Answer Validity Window (AVW), which specifies the temporal span an answer remains valid as the observed scene evolves. This allows us to expand the questions into 8,528 recall-conditioned evaluations, enabling controlled testing from instant to ultra-long-term recall while separating genuine model forgetting from natural world-state changes. We rigorously establish baseline performance through a unified streaming MLLM framework that compares several state-of-the-art memory-management mechanisms, covering sliding windows, attention sinks, KV-cache pruning, merging, and offloading. Experiments within a unified Qwen3-VL backbone reveal that comparable aggregate accuracies mask starkly different memory profiles. For instance, token pruning preserves fine-grained details and temporal structure significantly better than token merging, while quantized offloading rescues ultra-long-term recall. Ultimately, all mechanisms operate well below real-time (>1s per frame), and top performing methods ceil at about 45\% accuracy, exposing critical gaps in current architectures. \egostream provides the diagnostic testbed needed to close these gaps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍EGOSTREAM，一个用于评估第一人称视觉中流媒体情景记忆的诊断基准。基准包含2,250个问题，涵盖七种认知记忆维度，并引入答案有效性窗口(AVW)概念以区分模型遗忘和自然场景变化。通过统一的多模态大语言模型框架测试多种记忆管理机制，发现所有机制均远低于实时处理速度，最高准确率约45%.
Motivation: 现有流媒体视频基准缺乏对模型记忆内容及时长的诊断工具，无法准确评估自主智能体在动态环境中的连续情景记忆能力。
Method: 构建EGOSTREAM基准，包含2,250个问题，覆盖细节、空间、时间、事件、社会、因果和预期记忆七个维度。引入答案有效性窗口(AVW)将问题扩展为8,528个召回条件评估。通过统一Qwen3-VL骨干框架比较滑动窗口、注意力池、KV缓存剪枝、合并和卸载等记忆管理机制。
Result: 所有记忆机制均未达到实时处理速度（>1秒/帧），最佳方法准确率约45%。标记剪枝在保留细节和时间结构上优于标记合并，量化卸载改善了超长期召回。
Conclusion: EGOSTREAM揭示了当前流媒体视觉架构在连续情景记忆上的关键缺陷，为改进提供了诊断测试平台。

papers.title: Vision-Language Models Suppress Female Representations Under Ambiguous Input
papers.abstract_en: Alignment teaches vision-language models (VLMs) to avoid expressing demographic biases, and when gender is clearly visible they largely succeed. Far less is known about ambiguous inputs (a worker in full gear, a figure seen from behind) cases common in practice yet rarely studied. We find that minimal prompting pressure exposes occupation-gender defaults when prompting ambiguous input images, with models collapsing to male even for strongly female-stereotyped occupations. But do these outputs reflect what models actually encode internally? We introduce LALS (Latent Association Leaning Score), a zero-shot metric that projects visual-token activations into the model's text-embedding space to measure concept associations per token and layer. Across 15 occupations, over 800 gender-ambiguous images, and four VLMs, internal representations and outputs are systematically decoupled: models often encode a female association internally yet output male. Layer-wise analysis reveals an asymmetric filter -- male signal amplifies end-to-end while female signal peaks mid-network and is suppressed before generation -- and a color ablation shows that culturally loaded visual cues such as clothing color further modulate these internal associations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉语言模型（VLM）在模糊输入（如背面、全副武装的人物）下的性别表征偏差。发现最小提示压力即可使模型对模糊图像输出男性默认，即使对女性刻板职业也是如此。提出LALS (Latent Association Leaning Score)指标，揭示模型内部编码与输出之间存在系统性解耦：内部可能编码女性关联，但最终输出男性。层分析显示男性信号从网络到端到端放大，而女性信号在中间层达到峰值后受抑制。
Motivation: 现有对齐方法主要处理性别明显可见的情况，但实际中大量输入是模糊的（如工人全副装备、背影），这些情况下的偏差尚未被充分研究。
Method: 引入LALS（潜在关联倾斜分数），一种零样本指标，通过将视觉token激活投影到模型文本嵌入空间，逐token和逐层测量概念关联。分析了15个职业、800多张性别模糊图像和4个VLM。
Result: 模型内部表征与系统输出存在解耦：内部可能编码女性关联，但输出往往偏向男性。层分析发现男性信号从网络到端到端放大，而女性信号在中间层达到峰值后受抑制；颜色消融实验显示文化负载视觉线索（如服装颜色）进一步调节内部关联。
Conclusion: 该研究揭示了VLM在模糊输入下的性别偏差机制，表明即使内部编码中性，输出层仍可能产生性别刻板印象。

papers.title: SMART: SMPLest-X Mesh Adaptation and RAFT Tracking for Soccer Pose Estimation
papers.abstract_en: We present our approach to the FIFA Skeletal Tracking Challenge 2026, which requires estimating 3D world-space poses of soccer players from broadcast video. Our method finetunes SMPLest-X (ViT-H, 687 M parameters) via a stratified clip split, multi-task depth supervision, and broadcast augmentation, paired with a RAFT dense optical flow camera tracker, foot-plane anchoring, and two-pass temporal smoothing. Against the FIFA baseline score of 1.053 on the validation set, SMART achieves 0.647, a 38.6% improvement; on the held-out test set, SMART scores 0.593 (Global MPJPE: 0.324 m, Local MPJPE: 0.054 m).
papers.comment: CVPR 2026 SoccerNet FIFA Skeleton Tracking Light Challenge, Rank 6
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SMART方法，针对广播视频中足球运动员的3D世界空间姿态估计任务，通过微调SMPLest-X（ViT-H，687M参数）并采用分层片段分割、多任务深度监督和广播增强，结合RAFT密集光流相机跟踪、脚平面锚定和两遍时间平滑。在FIFA骨骼跟踪挑战赛验证集上，从基线1.053降至0.647（提升38.6%），测试集得分为0.593（全局MPJPE 0.324m，局部MPJPE 0.054m）。
Motivation: 广播视频中足球运动员的3D姿态估计在遮挡、快速运动和复杂场景下精度不足，现有方法难以满足挑战赛要求。
Method: 微调SMPLest-X模型，使用分层片段分割训练数据、多任务深度监督和广播增强；推理时采用RAFT密集光流相机跟踪、脚平面锚定和两遍时间平滑后处理。
Result: 验证集上FIFA基线为1.053，SMART达到0.647（改善38.6%）；测试集SMART得分0.593，全局MPJPE为0.324m，局部MPJPE为0.054m。
Conclusion: SMART通过结合SMPLest-X微调与RAFT光流跟踪及脚平面锚定，显著提升了足球运动员3D姿态估计的精度。

papers.title: The Dynamic-Probabilistic Consistency Gap in Chaotic Surrogate Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Dynamical systems reconstruction (DSR) aims to learn surrogate models that capture the dynamics underlying time-series data. Reliably deploying these surrogates requires uncertainty estimates consistent with the learned dynamics. We expose a dynamic-probabilistic consistency (DPC) gap: the pursuit of finite-horizon probabilistic objectives can degrade dynamics or decouple predictive uncertainty from the local tangent dynamics it ought to reflect. We isolate three mechanisms behind this gap: core collapse, noise masking, and blind uncertainty. Specifically, we show that open-loop Gaussian rollout objectives can penalize Jacobian-generated covariance growth in chaotic systems, encouraging optimization shortcuts that weaken physical expansion or decouple uncertainty from it. To mitigate this gap, we propose KAFFEE (Kalman-Aware Framework For Ergodic Emulation), a differentiable extended Kalman filter-based training framework that evaluates likelihood on local predictive residuals (innovations) while transporting covariance through learned local Jacobians. On stochastic hyperchaotic Lorenz-96, KAFFEE reduces the identified failure modes, improves reconstruction of dynamical invariants relative to open-loop objectives, and maintains competitive predictive scores. We further show that the DPC gap appears when probabilistically adapting a DSR foundation model across 13 chaotic systems, where KAFFEE enables in-context Bayesian filtering while largely preserving zero-shot dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示了混沌代理建模中的动态概率一致性差距（DPC gap），即有限时域概率目标可能损害动力学或使预测不确定性与局部切向动力学脱钩。提出KAFFEE框架，基于可微扩展卡尔曼滤波训练，在随机超混沌Lorenz-96上减少失败模式并改善动力学不变量重建。
Motivation: 当前动力学系统重建中，使用概率目标（如高斯开环滚动）可能导致不确定性估计与真实动力学不一致，影响代理模型的可靠部署。
Method: 提出KAFFEE框架，利用可微扩展卡尔曼滤波计算局部预测残差（innovations）的似然，并通过学习的局部雅可比矩阵传递协方差，替代标准开环滚动目标。
Result: 在随机超混沌Lorenz-96系统上，KAFFEE降低了核心坍缩、噪声掩蔽和盲目不确定性等失败模式，改善了动力学不变量重建，同时保持竞争性预测得分。在13个混沌系统上对基础模型进行概率适应时，DPC gap出现，而KAFFEE实现了上下文贝叶斯滤波并保留零样本动力学。
Conclusion: KAFFEE缓解了DPC gap，提升了混沌代理模型中概率一致性与动力学保真度的兼容性。

papers.title: Automated Prediction of Postoperative Pancreatic Fistula Using Preoperative Computed Tomography
papers.abstract_en: Postoperative pancreatic fistula (POPF) is a serious complication after pancreatic resection, increasing morbidity, hospital stay, and healthcare costs. We present an automatic, end-to-end deep learning pipeline-from pancreatic segmentation to classification-for preoperative POPF risk estimation and stratification using preoperative CT scans. A data set with auto-segmented pancreas volumes and surgical outcomes was used to evaluate multiple architectures, including a custom lightweight 3D CNN baseline (CNN3D), R(2+1)D ResNet-18, and ResNet-MC3-18 models. Evaluation across multiple 3D architectures demonstrated promising predictive performance. This approach offers a clinically valuable tool and a methodological benchmark for pancreas-specific CT classification, supporting improved preoperative decision-making in pancreatic surgery.

TL;DR: 本文提出一个自动端到端深度学习流水线，从胰腺分割到分类，用于术前CT扫描的术后胰瘘风险估计和分层。评估了多种3D架构，包括自定义轻量级3D CNN、R(2+1)D ResNet-18和ResNet-MC3-18模型，展示了有前景的预测性能。

Method: 采用自动分割胰腺体积和手术结果的数据集，评估多种3D卷积网络架构（CNN3D、R(2+1)D ResNet-18、ResNet-MC3-18）进行端到端预测。
Result: 在多个3D架构上展示了有前景的预测性能。
Conclusion: 该方法为胰腺特异性CT分类提供了临床有价值的工具和方法学基准，支持术前决策。

papers.title: RayDer: Scalable Self-Supervised Novel View Synthesis from Real-World Video
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised novel view synthesis (NVS) remains challenging to scale, despite the abundance of video data, largely due to the brittleness of training on realistic videos and the hard-to-predict scaling behavior of multi-network system designs. We introduce RayDer, a unified, feed-forward transformer that consolidates camera estimation, scene reconstruction, and rendering into a single backbone, turning self-supervised NVS into a well-posed single-model scaling problem. A minimal dynamic state, treated as a nuisance factor, absorbs time-varying content and enables stable training on unconstrained real-world video. Importantly, RayDer keeps static-scene NVS as its target task: dynamic content is leveraged purely as scalable supervision, not reconstructed as in dynamic-scene (4D) NVS. Across multiple model sizes and orders of magnitude in data, RayDer exhibits clean power-law scaling with data and compute, and outperforms static-scene data mixtures. On a large number of benchmarks, RayDer achieves strong zero-shot open-set performance competitive with state-of-the-art supervised approaches. Project Page: https://compvis.github.io/rayder

papers.title: Feature-Optimized Vision for Adaptive 3D Scene Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Three-dimensional scene reconstruction depends on local image evidence that is both visually discriminative and geometrically useful. Fixed feature thresholds and uniform feature budgets are easy to deploy, but they can waste computation on repeated texture, low-parallax regions, or unstable points. This paper proposes an adaptive feature-optimized vision front end for 3D reconstruction. The method scores candidate features by texture, repeatability, distinctiveness, expected triangulation angle, and spatial coverage, then allocates a per-view feature budget to maximize useful tracks under a fixed reconstruction pipeline. A small synthetic multi-view prototype evaluates four selection policies across corridor, facade, object-table, and cluttered scenes. Compared with random, texture-only, and uniform-grid baselines, the adaptive policy obtains the best quality-aware completeness and the lowest aggregate reconstruction RMSE while preserving broad image coverage. The result is not a replacement for modern learned matching or neural reconstruction systems; it is a modular front-end policy that can make classical and learned 3D pipelines more deliberate about which visual evidence they spend compute on.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种自适应特征优化前端用于3D场景重建，通过评分候选特征的纹理、可重复性、区分性、期望三角测量角度和空间覆盖度，为每视图分配特征预算以最大化有用轨迹。在小合成多视图数据集上，与随机、仅纹理和均匀网格基线相比，自适应策略获得最佳质量感知完整性和最低重建RMSE。
Motivation: 固定特征阈值和统一特征预算容易部署，但可能在重复纹理、低视差区域或不稳定点上浪费计算资源，需要更智能的特征选择。
Method: 提出自适应特征优化视觉前端，对候选特征按纹理、可重复性、区分性、期望三角测量角度和空间覆盖度评分，然后分配每视图特征预算以最大化有用轨迹，使用固定重建管线。
Result: 在走廊、立面、物体桌面和杂乱场景的小合成多视图数据集上，与随机、仅纹理和均匀网格基线相比，自适应策略获得最佳质量感知完整性和最低聚合重建RMSE，同时保持广泛图像覆盖。
Conclusion: 该方法不是一个替代现代学习匹配或神经重建系统的方案，而是模块化前端策略，可以使经典和学习的3D管线更审慎地选择投入计算的视觉证据。

papers.title: Discovering Thermodynamically Admissible Dissipation Potentials via Grammar-Based Symbolic Regression
papers.abstract_en: Constitutive laws for inelastic materials must satisfy strict thermodynamic admissibility requirements, yet current data-driven approaches sacrifice interpretability, even when formal guarantees are provided by physics-encoded architectures. We propose a symbolic regression framework for the data-driven discovery of dissipation potentials governing the evolution of internal variables within the Generalized Standard Materials (GSM) formalism. Starting from the Clausius--Duhem inequality, we enforce the thermodynamic requirements, convexity and non-negativity, that the dual dissipation potential must satisfy to guarantee non-negative mechanical dissipation. These requirements are formulated in the general subdifferential setting, encompassing rate-dependent (viscoelastic) and viscoplastic dissipative mechanisms, including potentials with genuine elastic domains, within a unified framework. Candidate potentials are generated by a composition-extended convexity-preserving grammar that guarantees thermodynamic admissibility \emph{by construction}. The framework is validated on synthetic datasets spanning Newtonian, power-law, and Bingham viscoplastic ground truths under process and measurement noise, and on experimental oscillatory shear measurements of a synthetic elastomer across multiple strain amplitudes and frequencies, where the discovered potentials reproduce the amplitude-dependent softening of the dynamic moduli and outperform a calibrated linear Zener baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于语法的符号回归框架，用于发现广义标准材料（GSM）框架内控制内变量演化的耗散势。通过Clausius-Duhem不等式确保热力学可容许性，并利用凸性保持语法自动生成满足热力学约束的候选势函数。在合成数据集和实验数据上验证了该方法，发现耗散势能够复现动态模量的振幅依赖性软化，并优于校准的线性Zener基线。
Motivation: 当前数据驱动的本构模型在保证热力学可容许性时往往牺牲可解释性，缺乏一种能够自动发现满足严格热力学约束的耗散势的符号回归方法。
Method: 提出一种扩展组合的凸性保持语法，通过语法引导的符号回归在广义标准材料框架下生成耗散势候选，确保势函数满足非负性和凸性等热力学要求。
Result: 在包含牛顿、幂律和Bingham粘塑性本构的合成数据集以及合成弹性体的实验振荡剪切数据上，该方法发现的耗散势准确再现了动态模量的振幅依赖性软化，且优于线性Zener基线。
Conclusion: 该框架为发现热力学可容许的耗散势提供了一种可解释的数据驱动途径，适用于率相关和率无关的耗散机制，包括具有弹性域势的情况。

papers.title: SVI-Bench: A Dynamic Microworld for Strategic Video Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: True video intelligence demands more than recognizing what is visible: it requires reasoning about why events unfold, predicting what would change under different conditions, and deciding what to do next. We refer to this progression, from perception through causal reasoning and simulation to strategic planning, as Strategic Video Intelligence (SVI). No existing benchmark evaluates this capability stack: in-the-wild videos lack verifiable ground truth for causal and strategic questions, while synthetic environments sacrifice the complexity of real multi-agent systems. To bridge this gap, we introduce SVI-Bench, a large-scale benchmark that leverages team sports as a dynamic microworld, combining the complexity of real-world multi-agent interaction (10-22 agents making coordinated decisions under adversarial pressure) with the verifiability of explicit rules and definitive outcomes. SVI-Bench comprises approximately 35K hours of broadcast video, 15M annotated actions, 15K hours of expert commentary, 23K game reports, and 103K structured statistical records across basketball, soccer, and hockey, all constructed via a data engine that transforms raw game data into a dense, cross-referenced corpus. We organize evaluation into 9 tasks spanning a progressive four-pillar hierarchy: Dynamic Scene Understanding, Causal Reasoning, Strategic Simulation, and Agentic Synthesis. Evaluating strong multimodal and agentic baselines, we find a capability cliff: models perform competently on perceptual tasks, achieving approximately 73% on fine-grained action QA, but degrade sharply at each successive cognitive level. Agentic tasks prove hardest: the strongest model achieves only 5% accuracy when required to autonomously gather and integrate evidence across a corpus of 1.8M clips.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SVI-Bench基准，用于评估从感知到因果推理、模拟和策略规划的递进式视频智能能力。该基准利用团队运动（篮球、足球、冰球）作为动态微世界，包含大量广播视频、注释动作、专家评论和比赛报告。评估显示，模型在感知任务上表现尚可（动作QA约73%），但在因果、模拟和智能体任务上急剧下降，最强者在智能体任务中仅达5%准确率。
Motivation: 现有视频基准缺乏对因果推理和策略规划等高级视频智能的评估：真实视频无法提供因果问题的可验证答案，合成环境又缺乏真实多智能体系统的复杂性。
Method: 构建基于团队运动的大规模基准SVI-Bench，包含约3.5万小时广播视频、1500万动作注释、1.5万小时专家评论、2.3万份比赛报告和10.3万结构化统计记录，并通过数据引擎将原始数据转化为密集交叉引用的语料库。评估分为9个任务，涵盖动态场景理解、因果推理、策略模拟和智能体合成四个递进层次。
Result: 强多模态和智能体基线在感知任务上表现良好（动作QA约73%），但逐级退化，智能体任务中最强模型仅达5%准确率。
Conclusion: 现有视频模型在感知层面以外的高级视频智能方面存在显著能力悬崖，SVI-Bench为探索这一方向提供了具有挑战性的测试平台。

papers.title: Value Functions as Supermartingale Certificates
papers.abstract_en: Certification methods for stochastic systems provide sufficient proof rules, based on real-valued supermartingale certificates, to determine the almost-sure satisfaction of $ω$-regular properties (and therefore of linear temporal logic) over general state spaces, encompassing both countably infinite and continuous state spaces. Conversely, reinforcement learning (RL) methods for $ω$-regular tasks have received considerable attention, but they typically lack formal guarantees that the learned policy satisfies the specification, except possibly for finite state and action spaces. We bridge these two lines of research by establishing a novel theoretical connection: under an appropriate reward, the value function associated to a policy that almost surely satisfies an $ω$-regular property encodes a Streett supermartingale certificate for that specification. Our results, validated experimentally on finite Markov decision processes, hold for finite, countably infinite, and continuous state spaces, suggesting a principled route to certificate synthesis via RL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文建立了值函数与超鞅证书之间的理论联系：在适当奖励下，几乎必然满足 ω-正则属性的策略对应的值函数编码了一个Streett超鞅证书，从而为通过强化学习综合证书提供了理论依据。实验验证在有限马尔可夫决策过程上进行，结果适用于有限、可数无限和连续状态空间。
Motivation: 现有随机系统认证方法基于超鞅证书提供充分证明规则，但强化学习方法缺乏形式化保证，特别是对于无限状态空间。本文旨在桥接这两个研究领域。
Method: 通过理论推导证明，在适当奖励下，满足ω-正则属性的策略的值函数构成一个Streett超鞅证书，并在有限MDP上进行了实验验证。
Result: 摘要表明该方法适用于有限、可数无限和连续状态空间，并在有限MDP上得到实验支持。
Conclusion: 本文为通过强化学习综合超鞅证书提供了理论路线，但具体性能指标未在摘要中给出。

papers.title: Chem-PerturBridge: a harmonized compendium of small molecule perturbation transcriptomic effects
papers.abstract_en: Large perturbation models require training data encompassing chemical, cellular, and assay diversity. Current transcriptomic resources for small-molecule modeling, however, are fragmented across technologies, metadata conventions, controls, doses, and preprocessing pipelines. We introduce Chem-PerturBridge, a harmonized multi-dataset resource comprising over 37k compounds, 136 cellular contexts, and 1.25M transcriptomic samples across eight assay types, with standardized identifiers, metadata, and replicate-aware condition-level effects. We use the resource to evaluate matched-condition agreement across datasets and replicate agreement within datasets. Matched same-compound conditions generally show weak agreement in fine-grained logFC rankings and magnitudes across most dataset pairs, often falling below same-context different-compound baselines. In contrast, logFC direction agreement is substantially more stable and usually exceeds these baselines. We further evaluate Chem-PerturBridge as a pretraining resource for compound representation learning. Under a compound-held-out OP3 evaluation split, embeddings pretrained on Chem-PerturBridge improve over L1000-only embeddings, Morgan fingerprints, and the descriptor-free OP3 baseline across metrics. An extensive molecule-holdout evaluation across 11 datasets further shows that models trained on Chem-PerturBridge outperform or match those that are not. Chem-PerturBridge therefore supports both diagnostic evaluation of cross-dataset signature agreement and model-oriented reuse of heterogeneous perturbation transcriptomic data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 Chem-PerturBridge，一个整合了超过 37k 化合物、136 种细胞环境、125 万个转录组样本的多数据集资源，采用标准化标识符和处理流程。摘要显示，跨数据集的相同条件匹配通常表现出较弱的精细 logFC 排序和大小一致性，但方向一致性更稳定。该资源还作为化合物表示学习的预训练数据，在化合物留出评估中改善性能。
Motivation: 现有小分子建模的转录组资源在技术、元数据、对照、剂量和预处理流程上分散，缺乏统一标准，限制了大规模扰动模型训练和跨数据集比较。
Method: 构建一个包含 37k+ 化合物、136 种细胞环境、125 万样本、8 种测定类型的统一数据集，采用标准化标识符、元数据和重复感知的条件水平效应。
Result: 跨数据集相同条件匹配在精细 logFC 排序和幅度上一致性弱，但方向一致性稳定且超过不同化合物基线。作为预训练资源，在化合物留出评估中优于 L1000-only 嵌入、Morgan 指纹和 OP3 基线。

papers.title: Separating Secrets from Placeholders: A Hybrid CNN-CodeBERT Framework for Three-Class Credential Leakage Detection
papers.abstract_en: Credential leakage in public source code repositories poses a critical security threat, with over 23.8 million secrets exposed in 2024 alone. Existing detection tools suffer from high false-positive rates because rigid pattern matching and binary classification schemes fail to distinguish genuine credentials from placeholder or weak credentials. We propose a three-class classification framework that explicitly models placeholder or weak credentials as a distinct class, leveraging CodeBERT-based semantic understanding combined with character-level pattern recognition. We evaluate our approach on a newly constructed dataset of 9,426 samples spanning 10 programming languages. Our model achieves a Matthews Correlation Coefficient of 0.86 and a macro F1-score of 0.90, achieving 93% recall and 89% precision for genuine credential leaks while reducing high severity alerts by 33.0% (from 373 to 250) without sacrificing security coverage. Compared to prior character-level approaches, our method improves placeholder or weak credential detection from 54% to 81% F1-score while maintaining strong cross language generalization, with 9 of 10 languages achieving F1 above 0.80 under leave-one-language-out evaluation.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICSME 2026 (International Conference on Software Maintenance and Evolution)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对源码仓库中凭证泄露检测的高误报问题，提出一个混合CNN-CodeBERT的三类分类框架，将占位符/弱凭证作为独立类别。在新构建的9426样本数据集（10种编程语言）上，模型取得MCC 0.86、宏F1 0.90，真实凭证泄露的召回率为93%、精度为89%，同时将高严重告警减少33%。
Motivation: 现有检测工具因刚性模式匹配和二元分类无法区分真实凭证与占位符/弱凭证，导致高假阳性率，造成安全人员告警疲劳。
Method: 提出一个三类分类框架，结合CodeBERT的语义理解与字符级CNN模式识别，明确将占位符/弱凭证建模为独立类别，而非二元的真实/非真实凭证。
Result: 在9,426样本上达到MCC 0.86、宏F1 0.90；占位符/弱凭证检测F1从先前方法的54%提升至81%；10种编程语言中有9种在留一语言评估下F1超过0.80。
Conclusion: 将占位符/弱凭证作为独立类别可显著降低误报率（高严重告警减少33%）而不牺牲安全覆盖率，且具有良好的跨语言泛化能力。

papers.title: On the Relationship Between Activation Outliers and Feature Death in Sparse Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) decompose neural network activations into interpretable features, but many learned features never activate, a problem called feature death that wastes dictionary capacity and can reintroduce superposition. Death rates vary dramatically between models: near-zero on GPT-2, over 70% on AlphaFold3 with identical configurations. We find that dimension-level activation outliers (dimensions whose mean magnitude is large relative to per-token variation) cause this by shifting pre-activations at initialization based on each feature's alignment with the activation mean. Features anti-aligned with the mean receive permanently negative pre-activations and never fire. We formalize outlier severity as $γ= \|μ\|/\|σ\|$; it predicts initial death rates (Spearman $ρ= 0.89$ for dead-by-TopK, $0.82$ for dead-by-ReLU) across 454 model-layer combinations spanning language, vision, protein, and genomic models. Dead features can revive during training, but recovery requires the SAE bias to learn the activation mean, a process that is prohibitively slow at high $γ$. Mean-centering (subtracting the activation mean) sidesteps this and eliminates outlier-induced death across all tested models, confirming the mechanism and providing a principled basis for when and why this preprocessing step is necessary.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究稀疏自编码器（SAE）中特征死亡（feature death）与激活异常值（activation outliers）之间的关系。作者发现维度级别的激活异常值（即平均幅度远大于逐token变化的维度）会导致特征在初始化时就获得永久负预激活而永不激活，从而引起特征死亡。他们形式化异常严重程度γ=‖μ‖/‖σ‖，该指标在454个模型-层组合上预测初始死亡率的Spearman ρ达到0.89（TopK）和0.82（ReLU）。均值中心化（mean-centering）预处理可以消除异常值引发的特征死亡，为这一预处理步骤的必要性提供了理论依据。
Motivation: SAE中大量特征从未激活（特征死亡）浪费字典容量且可能重新引入叠加（superposition），但不同模型之间死亡率差异巨大（GPT-2接近0%，AlphaFold3超过70%），其原因不明。
Method: 识别出激活异常值（维度级）是特征死亡的直接原因：特征与激活均值的对齐方向决定预激活符号。提出度量γ=‖μ‖/‖σ‖，并在454个模型-层组合上验证其与初始化死亡率的相关性。
Result: γ与初始死亡率高度相关（Spearman ρ=0.89 for TopK, 0.82 for ReLU）。死亡特征可在训练中复活，但需要SAE偏置学习到激活均值，在高γ时极其缓慢。均值中心化可完全消除异常值引发的死亡，在所有测试模型上均有效。
Conclusion: 特征死亡主要由激活异常值引起，均值中心化是一种简单有效的预防措施。该工作为何时以及为何需要对SAE输入进行均值中心化提供了理论依据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: If LLMs Have Human-Like Attributes, Then So Does Age of Empires II
papers.abstract_en: Much research has been carried out on large language models (LLMs) and LLM-powered agentic workflows. However, many works within the field state emergence of, ascribe to, or assume, generalised anthropomorphic attributes to them (e.g., morality or understanding of natural language). Our goal is not to argue in favour or against the existence of these attributes, but to point out that these conclusions could be incorrect. For this we build and train a simple neural network on the videogame Age of Empires II, and note that any entity in a sufficiently-powerful substrate, such as LEGO or the Greater Boston Area, could also present such attributes. Hence, the purported anthropomorphic attributes of LLMs are empirically non-unique: although some properties (e.g., responses to prompts) could remain constant, others, such as the interpretation of their perceived behaviour, might change with the substrate. Thus, any empirically-grounded discussion requires explicit measurement criteria; otherwise the interpretation is left to the representation. We then show that assuming that these attributes exist or not in a system, independent of the substrate and in a generalised way, leads to either circular or uninformative conclusions, regardless of the experimenter's viewpoint on the subject. Finally we propose a 'null' assumption, where one assumes LLM non-uniqueness instead of assuming anthropomorphic attributes to set up an experiment, along with examples of it. We also discuss potential objections to our work, briefly survey the field, and prove that \textit{Age of Empires II} is functionally- and Turing-complete.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出当前许多研究默认或隐含地赋予大型语言模型（LLM）类人属性（如道德、自然语言理解），但这些属性在经验上并非LLM独有。作者通过在游戏《帝国时代2》中训练一个简单神经网络，证明任何足够强大的基底（如乐高、大波士顿地区）中的实体都可能呈现类似属性，因此关于LLM类人属性的讨论需要明确的测量标准，否则结论可能是循环或非信息性的。论文进一步提出一个“空假设”（null assumption）作为实验设置的基础，并证明《帝国时代2》是函数完备且图灵完备的。
Motivation: 当前许多研究默认或暗示LLM具有类人属性，但缺乏经验唯一性验证，可能导致错误结论。
Method: 在视频游戏《帝国时代2》上构建并训练一个简单神经网络，论证任何足够强大基底中的实体都能呈现类似LLM的类人属性。
Conclusion: 任何关于LLM类人属性的经验讨论都需要明确的测量标准；默认假设应设为LLM的非唯一性而非类人属性，否则结论可能循环或非信息化。

papers.title: Personalize Your Large Vision-language Models With In-context Prompt Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have demonstrated strong general multimodal capability and are increasingly deployed in downstream systems. This trend has driven growing interest in LVLM personalization, which aims to enable models to quickly and effectively learn out-of-distribution multimodal concepts to meet user-specific needs. However, many existing methods rely on inference-time training, which reduces efficiency. They also struggle to maintain accuracy in complex multi-image, multi-concept settings. These limitations restrict the broader deployment of LVLM-based systems. Therefore, this paper proposes in-context prompt tuning (ICPT). Specifically, ICPT employs a lightweight projection module capable of operating in complex scenarios to extract fine-grained visual semantics from multiple reference images, seamlessly transforming these features alongside identity-label mappings into continuous prompts. To maximize computational efficiency, this module adaptively determines the prompt length based on the intrinsic visual complexity of each concept. Crucially, to overcome the environmental biases and cross-concept interference prevalent in real-world applications, we introduce two novel geometric regularizations. These constraints refine prompt representations by decoupling key identities from transient environmental states and separating concepts to avoid semantic confusion. Extensive experiments show that ICPT achieves state-of-the-art personalization accuracy across diverse tasks and LVLM backbones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出上下文提示调优（ICPT），通过轻量级投影模块提取多参考图像的细粒度视觉语义，并将其与身份标签映射为连续提示，结合几何正则化消除环境偏差和概念间干扰，实现了无需推理时训练的高效LVLM个性化。实验表明ICPT在多种任务和LVLM骨干上达到最先进个性化精度。
Motivation: 现有LVLM个性化方法依赖推理时训练，效率低下，且在复杂多图像多概念场景中准确率不足，限制了系统部署。
Method: 提出ICPT，包含轻量级投影模块，可自适应决定提示长度，并引入两种几何正则化：解耦关键身份与短暂环境状态、分离概念以避免语义混淆。
Result: 在多种任务和LVLM骨干上，ICPT取得最先进个性化精度，且无需推理时训练。
Conclusion: ICPT通过提取多参考图像视觉语义并应用几何正则化，高效实现了LVLM个性化，克服了环境偏置和跨概念干扰。

papers.title: Skill Reuse as Compression in Agentic RL
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents trained with reinforcement learning (RL) often learn brittle, task-specific shortcuts. We hypothesize that agents generalize better when their successful trajectories are structurally compressible, decomposed into a small set of reusable abstract patterns. To formalize this, we introduce ReuseRL, which grounds agentic RL in the Minimum Description Length (MDL) principle. ReuseRL extracts a shared skill dictionary from successful trajectories and augments the RL objective with a segmentation cost, explicitly penalizing idiosyncratic behaviors that encode poorly. We prove a PAC-Bayes generalization bound for this compression penalty. Across ALFWorld, TextWorld-Cooking, and Countdown-Stepwise, ReuseRL improves in- and out-of-distribution success over vanilla GRPO and strong round-length baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ReuseRL，将最小描述长度（MDL）原理引入智能体强化学习，通过从成功轨迹中提取可复用的技能字典并增加分段代价来惩罚编码低效的个体行为，从而提升泛化能力。在ALFWorld等任务上，ReuseRL在分布内和分布外场景均优于GRPO等基线。
Motivation: 基于LLM的RL智能体常学到脆弱、任务特定的捷径，导致泛化差。论文假设智能体在成功轨迹结构可压缩（分解为少量可复用抽象模式）时泛化更好。
Method: 提出ReuseRL，将智能体RL建立在MDL原则上：从成功轨迹中提取共享技能字典，并用分段代价增强RL目标函数，显式惩罚编码效率低的行为。还提供了该压缩惩罚的PAC-Bayes泛化界。
Result: 在ALFWorld、TextWorld-Cooking和Countdown-Stepwise上，ReuseRL在分布内和分布外场景下均优于vanilla GRPO和强回合长度基线。
Conclusion: 论文通过压缩正则化提升了智能体RL的泛化能力，并在多个任务上验证了效果。工作仍在进行中，需更多分析。

papers.title: Internalizing Temporal Consistency in Video Object-Centric Learning without Explicit Regularization
papers.abstract_en: Video Object-Centric Learning (OCL) aims to represent objects as \textit{slot} vectors and maintain their consistency across frames. Slot-Slot Contrastive (SSC) loss has become the cornerstone for state-of-the-art (SOTA) video OCL methods. While highly effective, SSC relies on one-to-one object correspondence across frames and introduces an extra loss. Following Occam's Razor, we propose a paradigm shift: temporal consistency is better enforced as an implicit model design rather than an explicit loss. To elegantly exclude SSC (\textbf{xSSC}), we introduce two quasi-zero-overhead synergistic mechanisms: (\textit{i}) Chrono-Channel Decomposition (CCD) structurally disentangles slot representations along the channel dimension into \textit{static} and \textit{dynamic} sub-spaces, serving as an empirically unified information bottleneck; (\textit{ii}) Cross-Temporal Reconstruction (CTR) stochastically reconstructs target features of either the current or previous time step by fusing current slots' static channels and target slots' dynamic channels, using a single standard OCL decoder with minor training adaptation. Thereby, the slot sets inherently learn temporal consistency by minimizing the standard reconstruction error alone. Extensive experiments show that integrating xSSC into leading baselines not only improves training efficiency but also establishes new SOTAs on video object discovery and recognition tasks. Furthermore, our PCA and gradient analyses confirm that objects' time-invariant semantics and time-variant kinematics are encoded into the proposed sub-spaces. Our source code, model checkpoints and training logs are provided on https://github.com/Genera1Z/xSSC.

Motivation: 现有视频对象中心学习（OCL）方法依赖显式的SSC损失来维持对象的时间一致性，这需要帧间的一一对应关系，且引入额外损失。作者希望遵循奥卡姆剃刀原则，将时间一致性作为隐式模型设计而非显式损失来强制实现。

Result: 集成xSSC到多个基线方法中，不仅提高了训练效率，还在视频对象发现和识别任务上建立了新的SOTA。PCA和梯度分析验证了对象的时间不变语义和时间变化运动学分别被编码到静态和动态子空间中。
Conclusion: 作者强调时间一致性可以更优雅地通过隐式模型设计实现，而无需显式正则化。代码、模型和训练日志已开源。

papers.title: When Are Multimodal Predictions Biologically Supported? A Diagnostic Evaluation Framework
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal models in oncology can produce accurate predictions, but accurate prediction does not reveal whether the model has learned biology that is shared across modalities, biology confined to one modality, or spurious correlations that reflect confounders rather than genuine biology. We introduce DECAT, a model-agnostic post-hoc evaluation framework that classifies multimodal representations into four diagnostic scenarios for a given task and modality, using five null-referenced metrics and a rule-based decision procedure. The framework operates on learned representations, requires no knowledge of which specific confounder is present, and returns indeterminate when the evidence is insufficient. We validate DECAT on synthetic data across four multimodal model classes (over 2,500 trained representations) and on real data from 8,979 TCGA patients, evaluating both multimodal embeddings and five pretrained pathology foundation models. Entangled models (e.g., CLIP) achieve near-perfect shared biology detection but falsely claim shared biology in the majority of cases where it is absent on real foundation model embeddings. This false claim rate increases with confound strength so that larger cohorts and stronger representations produce more confident but still incorrect diagnoses. Applied to both multimodal TCGA embeddings and five pathology foundation models without paired RNA, DECAT detects confounding invisible to AUROC without requiring the confounder labels, as confirmed by post-hoc stratification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DECAT，一个模型无关的后验评估框架，用于诊断多模态预测是否真正学到了跨模态共享生物学、单模态生物学或虚假相关。在合成数据（2500+表示）和真实TCGA数据（8979名患者）上验证，发现纠缠模型（如CLIP）在无共享生物学时频繁错误宣称共享生物学，且错误率随混淆强度增加而增加。DECAT能检测AUROC无法发现的混淆，无需混淆标签。
Motivation: 多模态模型在肿瘤学中预测准确，但无法辨别预测是基于跨模态生物学、单模态生物学还是虚假相关（如混淆因素）。现有方法难以诊断模型是否学到真实生物学。
Method: DECAT：后验评估框架，将多模态表示分类为四种诊断场景，基于五个空参照指标和规则决策过程，无需知道具体混淆因素，证据不足时返回不确定性。
Result: 在合成和真实数据上，CLIP等纠缠模型在共享生物学检测上近乎完美，但在真实基础模型嵌入中，无共享生物学时错误宣称共享生物学的比例高，且随混淆增强而增加。DECAT应用于TCGA嵌入和五个病理基础模型，检测到AUROC不可见的混淆。
Conclusion: DECAT提供了一种不依赖混淆标签的诊断工具，揭示多模态模型可能过度自信地错误归因于共享生物学，尤其在大规模数据或强表示下。
