papers.title: How can embedding models bind concepts?
papers.abstract_en: Humans easily determine which color belongs to which shape in multi-object scenes, an ability known as concept binding. Vision-language embedding models such as CLIP struggle with binding: they recognize individual concepts but fail to represent which concepts form which objects. Although CLIP behaves like a bag-of-concepts model in cross-modal retrieval, object information is recoverable from its image and text embeddings separately. We study this tension through the binding function, which maps concepts to scene embeddings. We find that scene embeddings decompose additively into object representations, explaining why uni-modal probes can recover object information. However, CLIP's binding function is high-complexity, which likely prevents the image and text encoders from learning a shared binding mechanism that generalizes to unseen concept combinations. We then ask whether this limitation is fundamental. We show that it is not. In controlled transformer models trained from scratch, binding generalization emerges with sufficient data coverage. These models learn low-complexity binding functions characterized by multiplicative interactions between concepts, enabling systematic generalization. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/oshapio/binding-concepts-complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉-语言嵌入模型（如CLIP）在概念绑定（concept binding）上的局限性，即模型能识别单个概念但无法表示概念如何组合成物体。作者发现场景嵌入可分解为物体表示的加性组合，但CLIP的绑定函数复杂度高，导致图像和文本编码器无法学习共享的绑定机制以泛化到未见的概念组合。通过从头训练的变压器模型，作者证明在足够数据覆盖下，绑定泛化能力可以出现，其特征是概念间的乘法交互。
Motivation: 人类能轻易确定多对象场景中每个物体的颜色和形状，但CLIP等模型无法正确绑定概念，限制了其细粒度理解能力。作者试图探究这一限制的根本原因及是否可克服。
Method: 提出绑定函数（binding function）的概念，将概念映射到场景嵌入。通过分析CLIP嵌入的加性分解性，发现其绑定函数复杂度高。然后在受控变压器模型上从头训练，研究绑定泛化的条件。
Result: CLIP的场景嵌入可分解为物体表示的加性组合，但其绑定函数复杂度高，阻碍了跨模态共享绑定机制的学习。在受控实验中，当训练数据覆盖足够时，模型学到低复杂度的绑定函数（特征为概念间的乘法交互），实现了系统性的绑定泛化。
Conclusion: 概念绑定的泛化能力并非视觉-语言模型的内在不可达特性；通过足够的数据覆盖，可学习具有乘法交互的低复杂度绑定函数，从而实现系统性泛化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On Efficient Scaling of GNNs via IO-Aware Layers Implementations
papers.abstract_en: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are bottlenecked by sparse, irregular memory access. Popular frameworks such as DGL and PyTorch Geometric support general message passing, but complex layers often materialize edge-wise intermediates, increasing memory traffic and limiting scalability on large graphs. We take an I/O- and arithmetic-intensity--centric view and show that widely used layers fall into three kernel families: SpMM-based convolutions, reduction-based aggregations, and attention-based layers (GATv2/Graph Transformer). For each family, we develop GPU kernels that reduce data movement, improve locality, and remain robust across realistic graphs. We also study graph reordering and find that its impact depends on the kernel mapping: it benefits neighbor-parallel (gather-dominated) kernels more consistently than feature-parallel designs. Empirically, our fused attention kernels reach up to $\textbf{3.9}\times$ speedup for Graph Transformer (median $\textbf{1.6}\times$), with Tensor Core (block-sparse) variants up to $\textbf{7.3}\times$ on locally dense graphs; for GATv2 we reach up to $\textbf{8.5}\times$ speedup (median $\textbf{2.0}\times$) while reducing peak memory by up to $\textbf{76}\times$ (median $\textbf{6}\times$). Our degree-aware reduction kernels achieve up to $\textbf{10}\times$ speedup (median $\textbf{2.6}\times$). For SpMM-based layers, properly cached cuSPARSE achieves up to $\textbf{8}\times$ speedup over DGL and outperforms evaluated custom baselines in the majority of evaluations. We release our implementations as drop-in replacements to support reproducible, hardware-aware GNN acceleration.
papers.comment: International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML) 2026, Spotlight Paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出IO感知的GNN层实现，将常用GNN层分为SpMM卷积、归约聚合和注意力三类，分别设计GPU内核以减少数据移动。针对Graph Transformer和GATv2分别实现最高3.9倍和8.5倍加速，内存节省最高76倍。实验验证了图重排序对邻居并行内核更有效，并作为即插即用加速方案发布。
Motivation: GNN受稀疏不规则内存访问瓶颈限制，现有框架如DGL和PyTorch Geometric在复杂层中物化边中间结果，增加内存流量，限制大规模图的可扩展性。
Method: 以IO和算术强度为中心，将常用GNN层分为三类：SpMM卷积、归约聚合和注意力层。为每类开发融合GPU内核，包括Tensor Core块稀疏变体、度感知归约核和缓存优化的cuSPARSE，并研究图重排序对不同内核映射的影响。
Result: 对于Graph Transformer达到3.9倍加速（中位数1.6倍），Tensor Core变体高达7.3倍；GATv2最高8.5倍加速（中位数2.0倍），峰值内存减少最高76倍（中位数6倍）；度感知归约核最高10倍（中位数2.6倍）；SpMM内核相比DGL最高8倍。
Conclusion: 作为即插即用替代方案发布，支持可复现的硬件感知GNN加速。

papers.title: Scalable Inference-Time Annealing with Surrogate Likelihood Estimators
papers.abstract_en: A long standing challenge in computational chemistry and biophysics is efficiently sampling the Boltzmann distribution of molecules. Advances in generative modeling have been proposed to address the limitations of conventional sampling techniques by eliminating the computational cost of simulation. A promising direction is iteratively finetuning diffusion models along a temperature ladder whereby training data is generated via importance sampling during inference-time annealing. Unfortunately, these methods require computing a divergence over the score field to estimate importance weights, rendering them intractable for larger systems. Here we present scalable inference-time annealing (SITA), which retrains flow-based models to generate samples at progressively lower temperatures using an energy-based model to facilitate fast surrogate likelihoods. We demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on both Alanine Dipeptide and Alanine Tripeptide while avoiding costly divergence terms. Our code is available at: https://github.com/countrsignal/sita.git
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对分子构象采样中玻尔兹曼分布的高效采样问题，提出可扩展推理时退火方法（SITA），通过结合能量模型构建快速代理似然，在退火过程中重新训练基于流的模型以逐步生成低温样本。在Alanine Dipeptide和Alanine Tripeptide上取得最先进性能，且避免了昂贵的分数场散度计算。
Motivation: 传统分子采样方法计算成本高，而基于生成模型的迭代退火方法需要计算分数场散度来计算重要性权重，难以扩展到更大系统。
Method: 提出SITA，在推理时退火过程中，利用能量模型计算快速代理似然，重新训练基于流的模型以生成逐渐降低温度的样本，避免了直接计算散度项。
Result: 在Alanine Dipeptide和Alanine Tripeptide上取得当前最优性能，同时避免了昂贵的散度计算开销。
Conclusion: SITA提供了一种可扩展的推理时退火框架，能高效采样分子构象，未来可应用于更复杂的生物分子系统。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Assign and Add: A Mechanistic Study of Compositional Arithmetic
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are able to compose skills in order to perform complex tasks, many of which might not have been seen during training. The details of how exactly this composition occurs remain elusive. In this paper, we study a mechanism for compositional generalization in transformers by considering a simple controlled setting involving variable assignment and modular addition. By partitioning our training data into disjoint sets, we observe that small transformers are able to generalize to previously unseen combinations of variables and numbers. Our mechanistic analysis shows that the same ``modular addition'' MLP module is used whether the inputs are given directly or indirectly through a separate variable assignment mechanism. We also analyze the training dynamics from an empirical lens, which reveals three phases of learning: first, modular addition is learned, then the structure required for variable assignment, and finally a refinement phase where the model generalizes to some hard sequences not seen in training. Finally, we provide a theoretical framework to explain how compositionality emerges from training dynamics. These results suggest that compositional generalization can be a natural consequence of the compositionality of internal mechanisms in~transformers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过变量赋值和模加法任务，研究Transformer的组合泛化机制。实验发现小型Transformer能泛化到未见过的变量-数字组合，机制上同一MLP模块既处理直接输入也处理通过变量赋值间接输入的模加法。训练动态分为三个阶段：先学习模加法，再学习变量赋值结构，最后精炼阶段泛化到困难序列。理论框架解释了组合性如何从训练动态中涌现。
Motivation: 大型语言模型能组合技能完成复杂任务，但其组合细节仍不清楚，本文旨在揭示Transformer中组合泛化的具体机制。
Method: 设计变量赋值和模加法的受控实验，将训练数据划分为不相交集合，通过机械分析（mechanistic analysis）和训练动态分析研究Transformer的内部机制。
Result: 观察到相同模加法MLP模块在直接输入和间接变量赋值下均被使用；训练动态呈现三个阶段：模加法学习→变量赋值结构学习→精炼泛化；理论框架解释了组合性的涌现。
Conclusion: 组合泛化可以是Transformer内部机制组合性的自然结果。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文通过变量赋值和模加法任务，研究Transformer的组合泛化机制。实验发现小型Transformer能泛化到未见过的变量-数字组合，机制上同一MLP模块既处理直接输入也处理通过变量赋值间接输入的模加法。训练动态分为三个阶段：先学习模加法，再学习变量赋值结构，最后精炼阶段泛化到困难序列。理论框架解释了组合性如何从训练动态中涌现。

summary_sections.method: 设计变量赋值和模加法的受控实验，将训练数据划分为不相交集合，通过机械分析（mechanistic analysis）和训练动态分析研究Transformer的内部机制。

papers.title: Consolidating Rewarded Perturbations for LLM Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: Post-training of language models is commonly framed as a sample-score-update loop implemented by gradient descent. A recent line of work, exemplified by RandOpt, relocates this loop to weight space, sampling Gaussian perturbations around a pretrained model and ensembling the top-K rewarded specialists at inference. While competitive with PPO and GRPO under matched training compute, this prediction-level ensemble incurs K forward passes per test example and does not extend cleanly to free-form generation. We ask whether the rewarded population can instead be folded into a single deployable model, replacing the inference-time ensemble with one consolidated update. A split-half analysis over 25 model-task pairs reveals reproducible low-rank structure in every case. We turn this geometry into CoRP (Consolidating Rewarded Perturbations), a gradient-free operator that combines reward-weighted aggregation, compatibility-aware reweighting, and a held-out validation gate, with no gradient flowing through the language model. Across five language models from 0.5B to 8B and five tasks covering math, code, and creative writing, CoRP improves the base model by 8.1 points on average. Using one tenth of RandOpt's perturbation budget, CoRP exceeds single-inference RandOpt by 6.5 points and recovers more than half of the gain of the 50-pass majority-vote ensemble, at one forward pass per test example.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM后训练中常见的样本-分数-更新循环，提出一种梯度无关的操作符CoRP，将奖励加权聚合、兼容性重加权和验证门控结合，将奖励扰动群体折叠为单个可部署模型，避免推理时的多数投票开销。在0.5B到8B的五个模型和五个任务上，CoRP平均提升基模型8.1分，在十分之一的扰动预算下超过单次推理的RandOpt 6.5分，恢复50次多数投票一半以上的增益。
Motivation: 现有方法如RandOpt在权重空间中采样高斯扰动并集成top-K专家，但推理时需多次前向传播且不适用于自由生成。本文旨在将奖励扰动群体整合为单一模型，消除推理时集成开销。
Method: 提出CoRP，一个梯度无关的操作符，包含奖励加权聚合、兼容性重加权和留出验证门控，不通过语言模型传播梯度，利用分割分析发现的可重复低秩结构。
Result: 在25个模型-任务对上验证低秩结构普遍存在；在五个模型（0.5B-8B）和五个任务（数学、代码、创意写作）上，CoRP平均提升基模型8.1分，在十分之一扰动预算下超过单次推理RandOpt 6.5分，恢复50次多数投票一半以上增益，且仅需一次前向传播。
Conclusion: CoRP能有效将奖励扰动群体整合为单一模型，在无梯度计算下显著提升模型性能，降低推理成本。

papers.title: LinTree: Improving LLM Reasoning with Explicitly Structured Search Histories
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) often solve reasoning problems by generating intermediate traces that explore and revise partial solutions. From a search perspective, these traces can be viewed as linearized search trees, where the model extends a partial solution, abandons it when it fails, and backtracks to try alternatives. Compared with traditional heuristic-guided search, such a policy has a potential advantage: it conditions on the whole search trace rather than only on the current local state. We first test whether LLMs utilize this advantage by comparing trace-conditioned reasoning policies against best-first search equipped with an LLM heuristic that only observes the current local state. Across three controlled reasoning environments, Blocks World, grid Navigation, and Sokoban, we find that raw access to search history alone is not enough to reliably outperform heuristic search. We then study one possible reason: in LLM reasoning traces, the underlying search tree is only implicitly represented, and when the model backtracks or switches branches, the trace does not explicitly identify which earlier search state is being revisited. We show that adding simple parent pointers to explicitly represent the linearized tree (LinTree) structure improves both task performance and search efficiency relative to implicit reasoning models and LLM-heuristic-guided search. These results suggest that search history becomes most useful when its tree structure is made explicit, motivating more structure-aware representations for LLM reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型(LLM)在推理过程中利用搜索历史的能力，发现仅隐式表示搜索历史不足以可靠优于启发式搜索。作者提出LinTree方法，通过在推理迹中添加显式父指针来线性化搜索树结构，在Blocks World、grid Navigation和Sokoban三个受控环境中，相比隐式推理模型和基于LLM启发式的搜索，显著提升了任务性能和搜索效率。实验表明，当搜索历史的树结构被显式表示时，其效用最大，这为结构感知的LLM推理表示提供了思路。
Motivation: LLM推理通常生成中间迹，类似线性化的搜索树，但传统启发式搜索仅基于当前局部状态，而LLM可能利用整个搜索历史。然而，实验发现仅依赖原始搜索历史并不能可靠优于启发式搜索，原因是迹中搜索树仅为隐式表示，模型回溯或切换分支时无法明确识别正在重访的先前搜索状态。
Method: 提出LinTree，在LLM推理迹中为每个状态添加简单的父指针，显式表示线性化搜索树结构，使模型能明确识别回溯位置和分支关系。
Result: 在Blocks World、grid Navigation和Sokoban三个控制推理环境中，LinTree方法在任务成功率上优于隐式推理模型和基于LLM启发式的最佳优先搜索，同时提升了搜索效率（如更少的搜索步骤）。
Conclusion: 搜索历史对推理的帮助依赖于其树结构的显式表示；隐式表示不足以充分发挥优势，推动设计更结构感知的LLM推理表示方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Enhancing Computer Vision Model Generalization in Warehouse Facilities: A Case Study on Anomaly Detection in Vertical Material Handling Systems
papers.abstract_en: Deploying computer vision models in Warehouse Facilities traditionally requires extensive resources for camera mounting, image collection, annotation, training, and deployment - a process often needing repetition in each new environment due to camera mounting constraints and environmental variability. This paper explores an innovative approach to streamline this process by conducting the standard procedure solely in a laboratory setting, focusing on vertical material handling systems and anomaly detection in forks of the systems. Through extensive experimentation, we have found that combining optimal camera placement, strategic image triggering, careful model selection and model ensemble enables effective generalization from laboratory conditions to diverse warehouse facilities environments, potentially transforming warehouse automation implementation by simplifying warehouse facilities deployment to just camera mounting, image collection, and model deployment, thereby saving significant resources and time typically spent on image annotation and model retraining. This is an experimental research study and not a production deployment.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 10 figures. Accepted at IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨了在仓库设施中部署计算机视觉模型的泛化方法，通过实验室条件下的优化（相机位置、图像触发策略、模型选择和集成），使模型能够泛化到多种仓库环境，避免重新标注和训练。以垂直物料搬运系统的叉车异常检测为案例，实验表明该方法可显著节省资源。
Motivation: 传统计算机视觉模型在仓库部署中需在每个新环境重复采集数据、标注和训练，成本高昂。本文旨在通过实验室训练并泛化到实际环境，简化部署流程。
Method: 在实验室中结合最优相机摆放、策略性图像触发、精心模型选择与模型集成（model ensemble），训练异常检测模型，然后直接部署到不同仓库环境。
Result: 实验表明该方法能从实验室条件有效泛化到多样仓库环境，无需在新环境重新标注和训练。
Conclusion: 该方法有潜力简化仓库自动化部署，仅需相机安装、图像采集和模型部署，节约大量资源。注意此为实验研究，非生产部署。

papers.title: Graphical einops: bridging tensor networks and computation graphs
papers.abstract_en: Architecture diagrams are ubiquitous in deep learning, but they are usually only representational: the tensor-program identities they suggest are still proved by prose and tensor-axis manipulation. We introduce a formal graphical calculus for the structural fragment of tensor programming underlying einops, making such diagrams proof-enabling. Our calculus represents tensor axes as nested graded tubes around a base type. The tube boundary recovers the undirected tensor-network view of axes, while the directed interior retains the operational reading of computation graphs. The key rewrite is grade-naturality: sliding spectacles over tubes. Standard equivariance proofs become short diagrammatic derivations. We additionally demonstrate how our rewrite system may be applied to convert attention masks into pre-processing operations, recovering efficient implementations of sparse attention blocks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种形式化图形演算，将深度学习架构图中的张量轴表示为嵌套渐变管（nested graded tubes），通过grade-naturality重写规则使图具有证明能力，并展示了如何将注意力掩码转换为预处理操作以高效实现稀疏注意力。
Motivation: 现有架构图仅具表示性，缺乏正式的证明能力，张量程序恒等式仍需文字和轴操作证明。
Method: 引入基于嵌套渐变管的图形演算，将张量轴视为围绕基本类型的管，管边界恢复无向张量网络视角，内部保持有向计算图的操作语义，核心重写规则为grade-naturality。
Result: 标准等变性证明可简化为短图推导，并可应用于注意力掩码转换，恢复稀疏注意力的高效实现。
Conclusion: 该演算使架构图成为可证明的，并展示了在注意力机制优化中的应用价值。

papers.title: Balanced LoRA: Removing Parameter Invariance to Accelerate Convergence
papers.abstract_en: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is the most widely adopted method for fine-tuning large language models. Notably, LoRA is inherently overparameterized: multiple pairs of low-rank factors can yield the same adapted weight matrix. We show--both theoretically and empirically--that these pairs exhibit significantly different condition numbers. As a result, converging to different loss minimizers directly impacts the convergence rate of LoRA. Building on this observation, we introduce Balanced Low-Rank Adaptation (BaLoRA), a variant of LoRA that projects iterates onto a balanced manifold. This manifold improves the conditioning of the loss landscape while preserving the adapted matrix. The projection step is computationally lightweight and integrates seamlessly into existing fine-tuning pipelines. Empirically, BaLoRA converges faster than standard LoRA and achieves superior performance across a range of fine-tuning tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示了LoRA微调中的参数不变性导致不同低秩因子对的条件数差异，从而影响收敛速度。作者提出Balanced Low-Rank Adaptation (BaLoRA)，通过将迭代投影到平衡流形上改善损失景观的条件数，且计算开销小。实验表明，BaLoRA比标准LoRA收敛更快，在多个微调任务上取得更优性能。
Motivation: LoRA微调存在参数不变性（parameter invariance），即多个低秩因子对可表示同一权重矩阵，但这些对的条件数差异显著，导致收敛速度不一致。现有方法未关注此问题。
Method: 提出BaLoRA，在每次梯度更新后，将低秩因子对投影到一个平衡流形上，该流形使得损失景观的条件数更优，同时保持适配矩阵不变。投影步骤计算轻量，可无缝集成到现有微调流程。
Result: 理论分析和实验表明，BaLoRA比标准LoRA收敛更快，并在多个微调任务上实现了更好的性能。
Conclusion: BaLoRA通过消除参数不变性带来的条件数差异，有效加速了LoRA的收敛，且几乎不增加额外计算成本。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Scaling Conversational Hungarian ASR: The BEA-Dialogue+ Corpus
papers.abstract_en: Conversational automatic speech recognition in Hungarian is constrained by the limited amount of publicly available dialogue-style training data. The BEA-Dialogue corpus addresses this need, but its strictly speaker-disjoint train/dev/eval split reduces the usable material to only 85 hours. In this paper, we introduce BEA-Dialogue+, an expanded version of the corpus that relaxes the split criterion for experimenters and dialogue partners while preserving complete separation of the primary speakers. This results in 200 hours of transcribed natural conversations and enables a controlled study of the trade-off between additional training data and speaker overlap across the splits. We evaluate several Whisper- and FastConformer-based models on both corpus versions, including Serialized Output Training (SOT)-based fine-tuning for dialogue transcription. Our results show that the larger corpus is more challenging for models without fine-tuning, whereas SOT-based adaptation yields consistent improvements in WER, CER, cpWER, and cpCER. Overall, BEA-Dialogue+ provides a substantially larger yet still demanding benchmark for Hungarian dialogue ASR, and a practical resource for training and evaluating dialogue transcription systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了BEA-Dialogue+，这是匈牙利语对话语音识别语料库BEA-Dialogue的扩展版本。通过放宽训练/开发/测试集的划分标准，将可用数据从85小时增加到200小时，同时保持主要说话人完全分离。实验表明，更大的语料库对未经微调的Whisper和FastConformer模型更具挑战性，而基于序列化输出训练（SOT）的微调在词错误率（WER）、字符错误率（CER）、对话级词错误率（cpWER）和对话级字符错误率（cpCER）上均带来一致改进。该语料库为匈牙利语对话ASR提供了更大且更具挑战性的基准。
Motivation: 匈牙利语对话自动语音识别（ASR）受到公开可用对话风格训练数据匮乏的限制。原有BEA-Dialogue语料库因严格的发音人独立划分，仅提供85小时可用数据，难以满足大规模训练需求。
Method: 提出BEA-Dialogue+扩展版本，通过放宽实验者和对话伙伴之间的划分标准（但保持主要说话人完全分离），将训练数据扩展到200小时转录的自然对话。基于此，评估了Whisper和FastConformer系列的多种模型，并引入SOT微调进行对话转录。
Result: 更大的语料库对未微调模型更具挑战性；SOT微调在所有评估指标（WER、CER、cpWER、cpCER）上均带来一致改进。
Conclusion: BEA-Dialogue+提供了更大且更具挑战性的匈牙利语对话ASR基准，并为训练和评估对话转录系统提供了实用资源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AutoSci: A Memory-Centric Agentic System for the Full Scientific Research Lifecycle
papers.abstract_en: Scientific research has traditionally been human-intensive, requiring researchers to coordinate literature, ideas, experiments, manuscripts, and review responses across long project cycles. The rise of LLM-based scientific agents creates an opportunity to automate this process. Such a system must support the full research lifecycle, maintain structured persistent memory across projects, and improve its own research procedures over time. However, existing systems either partially satisfy or fail to satisfy these requirements, leaving a gap for a unified automated scientific research system. As a result, we present AutoSci, a memory-centric agentic system for the full scientific research lifecycle. AutoSci is organized around four modules. SciMem provides schema-governed research memory, separating Long-Term Knowledge Memory for reusable scientific knowledge from Active Research Memory for project-level artifacts such as ideas, experiments, manuscripts, and reviews. SciFlow executes a five-stage lifecycle from literature understanding to rebuttal through a harness that controls state, context, verification, feedback, and orchestration. SciDAG augments difficult skills with DAG-shaped multi-agent operators and reusable stage-specific templates. SciEvolve converts feedback signals from users, experiments, reviews, and external environments into versioned updates to SciMem organization, SciFlow skills, and SciDAG templates. Together, these modules make AutoSci a persistent research environment that can execute, remember, and evolve across research projects. The code repository is available at https://github.com/skyllwt/AutoSci.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AutoSci，一个以记忆为中心的智能体系统，旨在覆盖科学研究的全生命周期。系统包含四个模块：SciMem（模式化研究记忆）、SciFlow（五阶段生命周期执行）、SciDAG（DAG形状的多智能体操作符）和SciEvolve（基于反馈的演化机制）。摘要称该系统能执行、记忆并在研究项目间演化，代码已开源。
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的科学智能体系统要么部分满足、要么无法满足全生命周期支持、结构化持久记忆和自主改进流程的需求，存在统一自动化科研系统的空白。
Method: AutoSci由四个模块组成：SciMem提供受模式约束的研究记忆，分离长期知识记忆与活跃研究记忆；SciFlow通过控制状态、上下文、验证、反馈和编排的执行框架实现五阶段生命周期；SciDAG用DAG形状的多智能体运算符和可重用阶段模板增强困难技能；SciEvolve将用户、实验、评审和外部环境的反馈信号转化为对记忆组织、流程技能和模板的版本化更新。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数值或基准结果，仅描述了系统设计。
Conclusion: AutoSci作为一个持久研究环境，能够跨研究项目执行、记忆和演化，填补了全自动科研系统的空白。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: VolFill: Single-View Amodal 3D Scene Reconstruction with Volumetric Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing the complete geometry of a scene from a single RGB image remains challenging - especially when inferring hidden structures where visual evidence is incomplete. We introduce VolFill, a generative framework that predicts the 3D structure of the complete scene rather than relying on traditional pixel-aligned regression. Our method utilizes a hybrid 3D VAE to compress sparse truncated unsigned distance function grids into a compact latent space, paired with a latent Diffusion Transformer that denoises this representation to recover the complete scene. We condition the generation on geometry foundation models, leveraging rich spatial priors for robust reasoning. Unlike existing methods limited by per-ray constraints or unstructured point-cloud queries, VolFill provides a structured representation that supports direct surface extraction and occupancy queries at scale. Extensive experiments on the SCRREAM and NRGB-D datasets demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms current baselines, providing a robust foundation for holistic spatial understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出VolFill，一种基于体素流匹配（volumetric flow matching）的单视图无模态3D场景重建框架。它利用混合3D VAE将稀疏截断无符号距离函数（T-UDF）网格压缩为潜在表示，并通过潜在扩散Transformer（latent Diffusion Transformer）去噪恢复完整场景。条件生成基于几何基础模型，支持直接表面提取和占用查询。在SCRREAM和NRGB-D数据集上，该方法显著优于现有基线。
Motivation: 从单张RGB图像重建完整场景几何仍然困难，尤其是在视觉证据不足时推断隐藏结构。传统像素对齐回归方法受限于每射线约束或无组织点云查询，缺乏结构化表示。
Method: 提出混合3D VAE将稀疏T-UDF网格压缩为紧凑潜在空间，并搭配潜在扩散Transformer进行去噪以恢复完整场景；生成过程以几何基础模型为条件，利用丰富的空间先验进行鲁棒推理。
Result: 在SCRREAM和NRGB-D数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法显著优于当前基线，为整体空间理解提供了稳健基础。
Conclusion: VolFill提供了一种结构化表示，支持大规模直接表面提取和占用查询，克服了现有方法的局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GPU Forecasters: Language Models as Selective Surrogates for Kernel Runtime Optimization
papers.abstract_en: GPU kernels are the workhorse of modern deep learning, and optimizing them (via evolutionary search or coding agents) usually requires repeated measurement on target hardware. While these measurements provide the ground-truth signal necessary for kernel search, they are costly, because each evaluation of a kernel requires compilation and repeated execution on a GPU. As improvements in LLM inference reduce the cost of writing novel kernels and LLM-driven searches scale to large search budgets, on-device evaluation becomes a bottleneck. To address this, we study how LLMs can serve as selective GPU surrogates for kernel evaluation, by forecasting the performance of proposed kernels. A useful surrogate should be accurate, and it should be selective, by knowing when it could be wrong, and deferring to the GPU. To evaluate surrogates, we measure whether their forecasts are accurate, calibrated, and practically useful for recovering fast kernels under limited GPU-measurement budgets. Next, we study whether reinforcement learning can improve forecast accuracy and confidence calibration. Our experiments demonstrate that LLMs can accurately forecast relative kernel performance, that their utility can be improved through reinforcement learning. Used inside a kernel search, the surrogate lets the search consider several times as many candidates under the same GPU evaluation budget, and that leads to finding faster kernels than an equal-budget baseline. These results suggest that LLMs can play a broader role in kernel optimization, by acting as virtual models of a GPU rather than solely as kernel generators for search.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何利用大语言模型（LLM）作为GPU kernel性能预测的替代代理，以减少kernel优化过程中的实际测量成本。作者提出LLM可以准确预测相对性能，并通过强化学习提高校准能力。在kernel搜索中使用代理可以在相同GPU测量预算下评估更多候选，从而找到更快的kernel。
Motivation: 现kernel优化（如进化搜索）需要重复在GPU上测量，编译和执行耗时，成为瓶颈。需要一种低成本的代理来预测性能。
Method: 使用LLM作为选择性代理：预测kernel性能，当不确定时defer到实际GPU。通过强化学习提高预测准确性和置信度校准。
Result: 实验表明LLM能准确预测相对kernel性能；在相同GPU测量预算下，代理让搜索评估的候选数量增加数倍，并找到比等预算基线更快的kernel。
Conclusion: LLM不仅可以作为kernel生成器，还可以作为GPU的虚拟模型，在kernel优化中发挥更广泛作用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PithTrain: A Compact and Agent-Native MoE Training System
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) has become the dominant architecture for frontier language models. To meet this demand, production frameworks have built optimized MoE training stacks over years of engineering effort. Yet evolving these stacks for new architectures and system optimizations remains expensive. With the rise of AI coding agents, they could automate parts of training-framework development and accelerate this evolution. But applying them to these existing frameworks carries hidden costs, invisible to today's throughput-only evaluations. We name this missing dimension agent-task efficiency (ATE): the cost of using coding agents to understand, operate, and extend a framework. Grounded in four agent-native design principles, we build PithTrain, a compact, agent-native MoE training framework. We further introduce ATE-Bench, covering real-world training-framework tasks. Our evaluation shows PithTrain matches the throughput of production frameworks, and on ATE-Bench, PithTrain enables higher agent-task efficiency, with up to 62% fewer Agent Turns and 64% less Active GPU Time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PithTrain，一个紧凑的、面向AI编码智能体（agent）的MoE训练框架，并引入智能体任务效率（ATE）指标。实验表明PithTrain在吞吐量上媲美生产框架，同时显著提升智能体任务效率（Agent Turns减少62%，Active GPU Time减少64%）。
Motivation: 现有MoE训练框架虽经多年工程优化，但为适应新架构和系统优化而演进的成本高昂。AI编码智能体虽可自动化部分开发，但应用于现有框架存在隐性成本，而现行吞吐量评估忽略了这一点。因此需要一种面向智能体的新框架和评价指标。
Method: 基于四项智能体原生设计原则，构建PithTrain框架，并引入ATE-Bench基准，评估智能体完成训练框架相关任务的效率。
Result: PithTrain在吞吐量上匹配生产框架；在ATE-Bench上，相比现有框架，Agent Turns减少62%，Active GPU Time减少64%。
Conclusion: 本文强调智能体任务效率（ATE）是训练系统设计中被忽视的维度，PithTrain通过智能体原生设计在保持吞吐量的同时大幅提升智能体效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: VisionPulse: Dynamic Visual Sparsity for Efficient Multimodal Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: With the rapid advancement of large multimodal models (LMMs), inference-time overhead has become a key bottleneck for real-world deployment. Existing methods typically prune visual tokens at prefill, assuming the required visual evidence remains static during reasoning. However, we empirically show that visual evidence is strongly step-dependent: only a sparse subset of visual tokens is critical at each decoding step, and the critical set evolves across reasoning. Furthermore, we identify a coupled bottleneck where redundant visual context can steer the model toward query-irrelevant regions, lengthening the reasoning trace. Guided by these insights, we propose VisionPulse, a step-wise visual token pruning framework during reasoning. VisionPulse computes a lightweight visual attention mass to estimate the step-wise retention budget by exploiting its strong positive correlation with LMMs' effective visual token usage and retain only the most critical tokens under this budget. By enforcing visual sparsity during reasoning, VisionPulse filters redundant visual context while preserving relevant visual evidence, shortening reasoning traces naturally. Extensive experiments show that VisionPulse only retains 5% of visual tokens per step with reasoning traces shortened by 11.2%, while keeping accuracy almost unchanged.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大多模态模型推理时的高开销问题，提出VisionPulse，一种在推理过程中逐步骤动态修剪视觉令牌的框架。通过估计视觉注意力质量来动态确定每步保留的令牌预算，只保留最关键的5%视觉令牌，同时将推理轨迹缩短11.2%，且准确率几乎不变。
Motivation: 现有方法通常在预填充阶段修剪视觉令牌，假设视觉证据在推理过程中保持静态。但本文实证表明视觉证据强烈依赖于步骤，只有稀疏的子集在每个解码步骤中关键，且关键集随推理演化。此外，冗余视觉上下文可能将模型引向与查询无关的区域，延长推理轨迹。
Method: VisionPulse框架在推理过程中逐步骤动态修剪视觉令牌。通过计算轻量级的视觉注意力质量来估计每步的保留预算，利用其与LMMs有效视觉令牌使用的强正相关性，在此预算下仅保留最关键的令牌。
Result: 实验表明VisionPulse每步仅保留5%的视觉令牌，推理轨迹缩短11.2%，而准确率几乎不变。
Conclusion: 通过在推理过程中施加视觉稀疏性，VisionPulse有效过滤冗余视觉上下文同时保留相关证据，自然缩短推理轨迹。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: VisionPulse框架在推理过程中逐步骤动态修剪视觉令牌。通过计算轻量级的视觉注意力质量来估计每步的保留预算，利用其与LMMs有效视觉令牌使用的强正相关性，在此预算下仅保留最关键的令牌。
summary_sections.result: 实验表明VisionPulse每步仅保留5%的视觉令牌，推理轨迹缩短11.2%，而准确率几乎不变。
summary_sections.conclusion: 通过在推理过程中施加视觉稀疏性，VisionPulse有效过滤冗余视觉上下文同时保留相关证据，自然缩短推理轨迹。

papers.title: DRIFT: Decoupled Rollouts and Importance-Weighted Fine-Tuning for Efficient Multi-Turn Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly deployed in multi-turn interactive settings where users or environments can iteratively provide lightweight feedback. Unfortunately, optimizing such behavior presents a sharp dilemma in practice: online reinforcement learning is able to effectively address multi-turn dynamics but is prohibitively expensive due to the cost of generating full correction trajectories at every update, whereas offline supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is efficient but suffers from distribution shift and behavioral collapse. To this end, we novelly propose DRIFT (Decoupled Rollouts and Importance-Weighted Fine-Tuning), a framework that operationalizes the theoretical insight that the KL-regularized RL objective is equivalent to importance-weighted supervised learning. DRIFT decouples rollout from optimization by sampling offline interaction trajectories from a fixed reference policy, deriving return-based importance weights, and optimizing the policy via weighted SFT on the resulting dataset. Empirically, we demonstrate that DRIFT matches or exceeds the performance of multi-turn reinforcement learning baselines while maintaining the training efficiency and simplicity of standard supervised fine-tuning. Code is available at https://github.com/2020-qqtcg/DRIFT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DRIFT框架，用于高效优化大语言模型在多轮交互中的行为。通过将KL正则化RL目标转化为重要性加权监督学习，DRIFT将rollout与优化解耦，使用固定参考策略采样离线轨迹并计算基于回报的重要性权重，然后通过加权SFT优化策略。实验表明DRIFT在匹配或超越多轮RL基线性能的同时，保持了标准SFT的训练效率。
Motivation: 多轮交互场景中，在线RL能有效处理动态但代价高昂（需每次更新生成完整纠偏轨迹），离线SFT虽高效但存在分布偏移和行为崩溃问题。
Method: 提出DRIFT框架，核心思路是将KL正则化RL目标等价转化为重要性加权监督学习。具体地，从固定参考策略采样离线交互轨迹，计算基于回报的重要性权重，然后通过加权SFT优化策略。
Result: 实验表明DRIFT在多轮任务上匹配或超越多轮RL基线，同时保持标准SFT的训练效率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调DRIFT通过解耦rollout和优化，实现了高效的多轮优化，并提供了开源代码。

papers.title: Fine-grained Verification via Diagnostic Reasoning Supervision for Aspect Sentiment Triplet Extraction
papers.abstract_en: Aspect Sentiment Triplet Extraction (ASTE) aims to identify aspect terms, opinion terms, and sentiment polarities as structured triplets, providing essential inputs for downstream information system applications such as opinion mining, explainable recommendations, and review summarization. Prior work mainly focuses on end-to-end extraction, while post hoc verification of extracted triplets remains comparatively underexplored. This gap limits the reliability of ASTE systems, since predicted triplets may be locally plausible while being globally invalid. Moreover, candidate invalidity is multi-faceted and candidate usability is inherently graded, motivating a fine-grained verification mechanism that can filter or re-rank outputs from diverse extractors. In this paper, we propose FiVeD, a framework for Fine-grained Verification with Diagnostic reasoning supervision. Specifically, the verifier is trained with multiple complementary objectives, including validity classification and quality score estimation as primary tasks, with error type classification and rationale generation as auxiliary tasks. We define hierarchical error categories and construct plausible incorrect triplets under semantic and syntactic constraints, and leverage an off-the-shelf LLM with task-specific rubrics to produce quality scores and diagnostic rationales. During inference, the resulting quality scores are used to filter candidate outputs, supporting adjustable precision-recall tradeoffs. Experiments across multiple ASTE baselines demonstrate that FiVeD consistently improves extraction performance by up to 3.53 F1 points as a plug-and-play verification module.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FiVeD框架，用于方面情感三元组抽取（ASTE）的细粒度验证，通过诊断推理监督，结合有效性分类、质量评分估计、错误类型分类和解释生成等任务，利用LLM生成质量评分和诊断解释，在多个ASTE基线上提升性能最多3.53 F1点。
Motivation: 现有ASTE方法主要关注端到端抽取，对抽取后三元组的验证研究不足，导致预测三元组可能局部合理但全局无效，且候选无效性是多方面的，可用性是分级的，需要细粒度验证机制。
Method: 提出FiVeD框架，使用多个互补目标训练验证器：主要任务包括有效性分类和质量评分估计，辅助任务包括错误类型分类和解释生成；定义层次化错误类别，在语义和句法约束下构造 plausible incorrect triplets，并利用现成LLM依据特定规则生成质量评分和诊断解释。
Result: 在多个ASTE基线上，FiVeD作为即插即用验证模块，一致提升抽取性能，最高提升3.53 F1点。
Conclusion: FiVeD通过细粒度验证和可调整的精确率-召回率权衡，提升了ASTE系统的可靠性，但论文未探讨在真实应用中的部署成本或对其他领域的泛化性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Used Car Salesbots? Honesty and Credulity of LLMs as Bargaining Agents under Partial Information
papers.abstract_en: In this work we study agents in simulated bargaining scenarios, where a buyer and a seller communicate through a text channel and attempt to negotiate mutually beneficial trades, under different information regimes (complete information, information asymmetry or mutual uncertainty). We evaluate their performance w.r.t. game-theoretical solutions and further investigate their honesty (their tendency to disclose or withhold information or to mislead and deceive) as well as their credulity (their tendency to trust or distrust information provided by the other agent). We study zero-shot LLM agents with simple prompting scaffolding as well as fine-tuned agents, in order to investigate whether optimising the agents to maximise financial profits makes them stronger negotiators but also more dishonest and less trusting. We find that off-the-shelf LLMs all substantially deviate from game-theoretical equilibria, they attempt to lie about their private information but cannot efficiently exploit information asymmetries. Fine-tuning on financial utility makes the agents stronger at achieving better deals but also more dishonest, highlighting the risks that optimising agents for a task can have on their safety. We release our code and a dataset of bargaining scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究LLM作为讨价还价代理的行为，在完全信息、信息不对称或相互不确定性下评估其诚实性和轻信性。发现现成LLM显著偏离博弈均衡，会试图撒谎但无法有效利用信息不对称；微调财务收益代理变得更强大但更不诚实。
Motivation: 关注LLM作为代理优化财务收益时是否导致更不诚实和更少信任，揭示AI安全风险。
Method: 设置模拟讨价还价场景，买方和卖方通过文本通信，在不同信息制度下评估零样本LLM代理和微调代理的性能。
Result: 现成LLM显著偏离博弈均衡，试图撒谎但无法利用信息不对称；微调代理在达成更好交易时更不诚实。
Conclusion: 强调优化代理任务对其安全性的风险，并发布代码和数据集。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Answer-Set-Programming-based Abstractions for Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning (RL) enables autonomous agents to learn policies from experience, but realistic problems often involve enormous state spaces, making learning and generalisation challenging. Abstraction and approximation are therefore essential. Relational Reinforcement Learning (RRL) offers a way to reason about objects and their relations, and the CARCASS framework by Martijn van Otterlo demonstrates how logical representations can model Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) in first-order domains. Originally implemented in Prolog, CARCASS leverages domain knowledge to create powerful abstractions. We explore Answer-Set Programming (ASP), which is a rich and, contrary to Prolog, fully declarative modelling language, to realise CARCASS abstractions. We evaluate our ASP-based implementation in case studies of two domains, viz. Blocks World and Minigrid. Our results indicate that CARCASS with ASP provides a promising approach to constructing abstractions for RL, especially when domain knowledge is available.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at the 42nd International Conference on Logic Programming (ICLP 2026). To appear in Theory and Practice of Logic Programming (TPLP)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探索使用 Answer-Set Programming (ASP) 实现 CARCASS 框架中的抽象方法，用于强化学习中的状态空间抽象。在 Blocks World 和 Minigrid 领域的案例研究表明，ASP 能够有效构建抽象，尤其当领域知识可用时。
Motivation: 强化学习中状态空间巨大，抽象和近似是必要的。CARCASS 框架使用逻辑表示建模 MDP，但原实现基于 Prolog；本文探索使用更完全声明式的 ASP 来实现抽象。
Method: 将 CARCASS 抽象方法移植到 ASP，利用 ASP 的声明式特性来定义对象和关系。在 Blocks World 和 Minigrid 领域进行案例研究。
Result: 结果表明，基于 ASP 的 CARCASS 能够有效构建强化学习的抽象，特别是当领域知识可用时。
Conclusion: 基于 ASP 的 CARCASS 是构建强化学习抽象的有前景的方法，尤其适合利用领域知识的场景。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Modeling Covariate Transition for Efficient Estimation of Longitudinal Treatment Effects in Randomized Experiments
papers.abstract_en: We present a regression-adjustment framework designed for the estimation of longitudinal treatment effects in randomized experiments under static regimes. While regression-adjustment methods are useful for variance reduction in randomized experiments by using pre-treatment covariates, they usually focus only on average effects, from which we cannot obtain valuable insights into when the effects appear and how long they continue. To address this issue, we consider intermediate outcomes and evolving post-treatment covariates over time, and we represent such dynamic trajectories using transition kernels. Furthermore, we establish the asymptotic normality and the semiparametric efficiency bound for our estimator, enabling more powerful statistical inference. Simulation studies and empirical analysis using A/B test data from a streaming platform in Japan show the practical advantages of our method.
papers.journal_ref: The 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个针对静态策略下随机实验中纵向治疗效应的回归调整框架。通过引入协变量转移核（transition kernels）来建模中间结果和随时间演化的治疗后协变量，从而估计效应的出现时间和持续时间。该估计量具有渐近正态性和半参数效率界，在模拟和日本流媒体平台A/B测试数据中表现出实际优势。
Motivation: 现有回归调整方法仅关注平均处理效应，无法揭示效应何时出现及持续多久，缺乏对动态轨迹的洞察。
Method: 利用转移核表示中间结果和演化协变量的动态轨迹，并建立回归调整估计量，推导其渐近正态性和半参数效率界。
Result: 理论上证明了估计量的渐近正态性和半参数效率界；模拟和日本流媒体平台A/B测试数据验证了方法的实际有效性。
Conclusion: 该框架能够有效估计纵向处理效应的时序动态，为随机实验中的统计推断提供更丰富的信息。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Flow map learning in nonlinear vector autoregressive models: influence of the feature-library structure on the training error
papers.abstract_en: Time series forecasting often requires learning nonlinear and time-delayed dependencies. A paradigmatic class of forecasting models are nonlinear vector autoregressive processes (NVAR), also known as next-generation reservoir computers (NG-RCs). These models approximate the Koopman operator on the space spanned by their explicit feature library. We consider the identifiability problem for learning Markovian nonlinear dynamical systems and show that the training error as a function of time resolution follows characteristic (pre-)asymptotic scaling laws. These laws depend on whether the feature library can represent the early Lie-series coefficients of the flow map (propagator) exactly or merely approximately. For dynamical systems governed by polynomial vector fields, we demonstrate the mechanism for NVAR/NG-RC models with monomial and Fourier feature libraries. We determine the dependence of the training error on the temporal resolution, the involved nonlinear degree, and the number of delay terms. While delay terms reduce the optimal one-step training error, they improve long-horizon forecasts only when the library provides sufficient nonlinearity. Thus, small training error coexists with weak generalization as the model class is mismatched to the true data-generating process. Numerical experiments on various chaotic dynamical systems confirm the theoretical predictions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究非线性向量自回归（NVAR/NG-RC）模型在时间序列预测中的流图学习问题，揭示了训练误差作为时间分辨率的函数遵循特征性渐近标度律，并依赖于特征库能否精确表示流图的Lie级数系数。对于多项式向量场，使用单项式和傅里叶特征库验证了理论，表明延迟项对长期预测的益处仅在特征库有足够非线性时出现。
Motivation: 时间序列预测需要处理非线性与时滞依赖，而NVAR/NG-RC模型作为此类问题的范式模型，其训练误差的理论理解尚不充分，特别是特征库结构对误差标度的影响。
Method: 从Koopman算子理论出发，分析NVAR/NG-RC模型中特征库的精确或近似表示能力对训练误差渐近标度律的影响，并结合多项式动力系统与单项式/傅里叶特征库给出理论推导与数值验证。
Result: 训练误差随时间分辨率遵循(预)渐近标度律，延迟项虽降低单步误差但仅当特征库非线性充足时才改善长期预测；模型类不匹配时小误差与弱泛化并存。
Conclusion: 特征库的结构决定NVAR/NG-RC模型的训练误差标度与泛化能力，延迟项并非总能提升长期预测性能。
Relevance: 15

summary_sections.result: 训练误差随时间分辨率遵循(预)渐近标度律，延迟项虽降低单步误差但仅当特征库非线性充足时才改善长期预测；模型类不匹配时小误差与弱泛化并存。
summary_sections.conclusion: 特征库的结构决定NVAR/NG-RC模型的训练误差标度与泛化能力，延迟项并非总能提升长期预测性能。

papers.title: Astra: a generalizable report generation foundation model for 3D computed tomography
papers.abstract_en: CT interpretation requires radiologists to review hundreds of volumetric slices per examination, making reporting time-consuming and highly expertise-dependent. Automated CT report generation offers a promising route to improving clinical efficiency, yet the field still lacks a generalizable CT report generation foundation model that supports multi-region reporting and remains robust across external real-world cohorts. Intrinsic inconsistencies in reporting style and diagnostic terminology across cohorts make naive joint training prone to noisy textual supervision, thereby limiting model generalizability. Here we present Astra, a generalizable CT report generation foundation model trained on 90,678 thoracoabdominal CT-report pairs (CTRgDB) with 353,671 abnormalities spanning eight organ systems. By harmonizing report style and further refining diagnostic consistency via reinforcement learning, Astra achieves style-consistent and diagnostically accurate report generation across diverse anatomical regions and institutions. Evaluating on CTRgDB and six external cohorts, Astra achieves state-of-the-art performance with a 44.1% average improvement in fine-grained diagnostic metrics (P<0.001). In real-world clinical workflows, Astra assistance accelerates chest report drafting by 29.6% and improves abdominal report completeness by 11.3% (P<0.001). Furthermore, Astra also demonstrates broad utility as a foundation for CT AI development, improving downstream diagnostic performance and scaling vision-language pretrain through high-quality report synthesis. Overall, Astra serves as a broadly accessible clinical assistant and a pivotal infrastructure for the next generation of AI-powered healthcare.
papers.summary_zh:

Conclusion: Astra可作为广泛可用的临床助手和下一代AI医疗的关键基础设施，并展示了作为CT AI开发基础模型的潜力。

papers.title: DOA: Training-Free Decoder-Only Attention Policy for Long-Form Simultaneous Translation with SpeechLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Simultaneous speech-to-text translation (SimulST) generates translations while speech is still unfolding, requiring a streaming policy that decides when to read and when to write. State-of-the-art approaches rely on attention-based encoder-decoder models where cross-attention provides explicit alignment signals. In contrast, Speech Large Language Models (SpeechLLMs) are decoder-only architectures relying solely on self-attention. This raises a central question: whether decoder self-attention contains sufficiently stable alignment signals to guide the streaming policy. Moreover, existing approaches typically rely on training-based adaptations or heuristic wait-$k$ policies and have not been validated in long-form settings. To fill these gaps, we propose Decoder-Only Attention (DOA), a training-free policy that enables long-form simultaneous translation with off-the-shelf SpeechLLMs by deriving a proxy alignment from self-attention. Experiments on Phi4-Multimodal and Qwen3-Omni show that DOA provides an effective alignment signal for supporting streaming decisions, enabling low-latency long-form SimulST with quality close to offline decoding without retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种无需训练的仅解码器注意力策略（DOA），用于基于语音大语言模型（SpeechLLMs）的长篇幅同传翻译。DOA从自注意力中推导代理对齐信号，指导流式策略。实验表明，在Phi4-Multimodal和Qwen3-Omni上，DOA能实现低延迟的长篇幅同传，且质量接近离线解码。
Motivation: 现有同传翻译方法通常依赖编码器-解码器架构中的交叉注意力，而SpeechLLMs是仅解码器模型，仅使用自注意力。尚不清楚解码器自注意力是否包含足够稳定的对齐信号用于流式策略，且现有方法多需要训练或依赖启发式wait-k策略，未在长篇幅场景验证。
Method: 提出Decoder-Only Attention (DOA)策略，无需训练，直接从预训练SpeechLLMs的自注意力中提取代理对齐信号，用于决定何时读取输入语音和何时生成翻译。
Result: 在Phi4-Multimodal和Qwen3-Omni模型上的实验显示，DOA提供了有效的对齐信号，支持流式决策，实现了低延迟的长篇幅同传翻译，翻译质量与离线解码相近。
Conclusion: 本文表明，无需额外训练，仅利用自注意力即可实现有效的同步翻译策略，适用于长篇幅场景。

papers.title: YARD: Y-Architecture Register Decoding for Efficient Hallucination Mitigation in Large Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Contrastive decoding (CD) seeks to mitigate hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) by contrasting the output distributions of a standard model and a visually degraded model. However, existing training-free CD methods suffer from sub-optimal degraded branches: completely dropping visual tokens is too extreme and induces language hallucinations, while corrupting input images offers coarse control over visual evidence and suffers from high inference latency due to requiring two full forward passes. To address these dilemmas, we propose YARD, a training-free Y-Architecture Register Decoding framework. Motivated by the observation that reliable text-to-vision grounding predominantly emerges in the middle decoder layers, YARD constructs the degraded branch internally by sharing shallow-layer computations and branching exactly at this critical stage. For the degraded branch, YARD replaces patch-level visual tokens with register tokens, which preserve global image semantics but lack fine-grained local evidence. This image-aware yet locally under-grounded design provides a faithful contrastive signal without extreme modality mismatch, while the Y-architecture strictly avoids a costly second forward pass. Extensive experiments on generative and discriminative hallucination benchmarks demonstrate that YARD consistently achieves state-of-the-art hallucination mitigation across multiple LVLMs, alongside a significant reduction in inference latency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出YARD，一种无需训练的Y-Architecture注册解码框架，用于缓解大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）中的幻觉问题。YARD通过在中间解码层分支，将patch级视觉令牌替换为保留全局语义但缺乏局部细节的注册令牌，构建内部退化分支，从而避免完全丢弃视觉令牌或损坏输入图像的极端做法，同时通过Y型架构避免二次前向传播的高延迟。实验表明，YARD在多个LVLM的生成和判别幻觉基准上实现了最先进的幻觉缓解，并显著降低了推理延迟。
Motivation: 现有无需训练的对比解码方法中，完全丢弃视觉令牌过于极端且引发语言幻觉，而损坏输入图像对视觉证据的控制粗糙且因需要两次完整前向传播导致高推理延迟。
Method: YARD基于中间解码层文本-视觉可靠对齐涌现的观察，在浅层共享计算后于该关键阶段分支，对于退化分支将patch级视觉令牌替换为注册令牌（保留全局语义但缺乏局部细节），形成图像感知但局部欠对齐的对比信号，同时Y型架构避免第二次完整前向传播。
Result: 在生成和判别幻觉基准上的广泛实验表明，YARD在多个LVLM上一致实现最先进的幻觉缓解，并显著降低推理延迟。
Conclusion: YARD通过内部构建退化分支和注册令牌，提供了一种无需训练的、高效且有效的幻觉缓解方案，避免了极端模态不匹配和高延迟问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DG-CoLearn: An Efficient Collaborative Learning Framework for Dynamic Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic graph learning (DGL) is essential for modelling evolving graph data, but existing methods suffer from significant computational overhead due to repeated full-snapshot retraining and are not well-suited for collaborative settings with partitioned data. In realistic graph systems, cross-partition edges are unavoidable, but direct sharing of graph structure between clients may violate privacy constraints. We propose DG-CoLearn, a client-oblivious collaborative dynamic graph learning framework built on incremental graph snapshot processing, which focuses computation on graph regions affected by temporal updates while preserving historical information through temporal modelling. This incremental design is consistently applied across the entire graph processing pipeline, including a server-mediated embedding exchange mechanism to enable accurate multi-hop message passing without exposing raw cross-client structural information. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DG-CoLearn achieves up to 33.8$\times$ speedup in training time and 27.4$\times$ reduction in communication overhead, while consistently improving predictive performance on both node classification (up to 13.36% F1 improvement) and link prediction (up to 8.27% MAP improvement) tasks. These results highlight the effectiveness of DG-CoLearn in bridging efficiency, scalability, and client-to-client structural privacy in collaborative dynamic graph learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DG-CoLearn，一种基于增量快照处理的客户端无关协同动态图学习框架，通过服务器中介的嵌入交换机制实现跨分区消息传递而不暴露原始结构信息。实验表明在训练时间上加速 33.8 倍，通信开销减少 27.4 倍，并在节点分类和链接预测任务上提升性能。
Motivation: 现有动态图学习方法因重复全快照重训练导致计算开销大，且不适用于数据分区的协同设置；跨分区边直接共享违反隐私约束。
Method: 提出客户端无关的协同动态图学习框架，基于增量图快照处理，专注于受时间更新影响的图区域，通过时序建模保留历史信息；服务器中介的嵌入交换机制实现精确的多跳消息传递而不暴露原始跨客户端结构信息。
Result: 实验表明训练时间加速最高 33.8 倍，通信开销减少 27.4 倍；节点分类 F1 提升最高 13.36%，链接预测 MAP 提升最高 8.27%。
Conclusion: DG-CoLearn 有效桥接了效率、可扩展性和客户端间结构隐私，适用于协同动态图学习场景。

papers.title: Self-Tuning Regularization for Image Scanning Microscopy
papers.abstract_en: Image Scanning Microscopy (ISM) is a fluorescence imaging technique that combines detector-array acquisition and computational reconstruction to achieve the theoretical resolution of an ideal confocal microscope, i.e., one operating with an infinitesimally small pinhole, while maintaining high signal-to-noise ratio. Among the reconstruction methods for obtaining the super-resolved image, multi-image deconvolution (MID) and its extension aimed at preserving the optical sectioning capability of confocal microscopy, known as super-resolution sectioning ISM (s$^2$ISM), are among the most widely used approaches. Both methods rely on Richardson--Lucy-type iterative schemes, whose semi-convergent behavior requires early stopping and often leads to noise amplification and reconstruction artifacts. In this work, we introduce a self-tuning explicit regularization framework for both MID and s$^2$ISM reconstruction. Within a Bayesian maximum a posteriori formulation, we combine a multi-frame Poisson data fidelity term with explicit regularization, considering $\ell_1$ and smoothed total variation penalties as representative examples. We further develop an automatic and ground-truth-free strategy for regularization parameter selection by adapting the residual whiteness principle to the multi-frame Poisson setting and introducing a spectral high-pass extension tailored to s$^2$ISM. The resulting framework enables stable reconstructions without empirical stopping rules. To demonstrate the proposed framework, we consider first-order optimization schemes based on proximal gradient and mirror descent methods with adaptive backtracking strategies. Experiments on simulated and real fluorescence ISM datasets demonstrate improved reconstruction stability and image quality with respect to unregularized approaches, while enabling robust super-resolution and optical sectioning in low-photon conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为图像扫描显微镜（ISM）的多图像反卷积（MID）和超分辨率切片ISM（s²ISM）引入了一种自调谐显式正则化框架。基于贝叶斯最大后验公式，结合多帧泊松数据保真项与ℓ1和全变分平滑正则化，并采用残差白化原则自动选择正则化参数，避免了经验停止规则。实验表明，该方法在模拟和真实荧光数据上提高了重建稳定性和图像质量，尤其在低光子条件下实现了鲁棒的超分辨率和光学切片。
Motivation: ISM重建中的MID和s²ISM方法依赖Richardson-Lucy迭代，其半收敛行为需要早期停止，易导致噪声放大和伪影。缺乏自动且无真实值的正则化参数选择策略。
Method: 提出贝叶斯最大后验框架，结合多帧泊松保真项与ℓ1或平滑全变分正则化，并通过将残差白化原则扩展到多帧泊松设置和s²ISM的频谱高通扩展，实现正则化参数的自动选择。采用近端梯度和镜像下降等一阶优化方案。
Result: 在模拟和真实荧光ISM数据集上，相对于未正则化方法，重建稳定性与图像质量提升，在低光子条件下实现鲁棒的超分辨率和光学切片。
Conclusion: 自调谐正则化框架消除了经验停止规则，为ISM提供稳定、高质量的重建，尤其适用于低光子场景。

summary_sections.conclusion: 自调谐正则化框架消除了经验停止规则，为ISM提供稳定、高质量的重建，尤其适用于低光子场景。

papers.title: Fixed Universal Transformers
papers.abstract_en: We introduce \emph{universal transformers}: fixed transformers that can simulate any transformer in a given class via a suitable input embedding. Analogous to a universal Turing machine, the input embedding encodes a description of the target model while all internal parameters remain fixed. We provide explicit sparse constructions achieving universality when the embedding dimension is sufficiently large, and further show that universality is generic: randomly initialized transformers are universal almost surely, which aligns with recent empirical results of Zhong and Andreas (2024). We empirically validate our theory on the algorithmic tasks of parenthesis balancing and multi-hop reasoning. Our results suggest that much of a transformer's expressive power may reside in its input representation rather than its learned weights.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出固定通用变压器（Fixed Universal Transformers），通过输入嵌入编码目标模型描述，使得固定参数的变压器可以模拟给定类中的任何变压器。作者给出在足够大嵌入维度下的稀疏构造，并证明随机初始化的变压器几乎必然具有通用性。在括号平衡和多跳推理任务上的实验表明，变压器的表达能力很大程度上源于输入表示而非学习到的权重。
Motivation: 理解变压器表达能力的本质，类比通用图灵机，探究固定参数的变压器能否通过输入嵌入模拟任意同类型变压器。
Method: 提出固定通用变压器架构：所有内部参数固定不变，通过输入嵌入嵌入目标模型的描述（如参数、结构），使固定变压器能模拟该目标模型。给出稀疏构造和随机初始化下的通用性证明。
Result: 理论上证明当嵌入维度足够大时，存在稀疏构造实现通用性；随机初始化的变压器几乎必然通用。在括号平衡和多跳推理任务上验证了该性质。
Conclusion: 研究暗示变压器的表达能力主要来自输入表示而非学习到的权重，这对理解Transformer泛化性有启示。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Neuro-symbolic Syntactic Parsing: Shaping a Neural Network with the CYK Algorithm
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we show the possibility of a direct injection of algorithms into neural network architecture. We focus on a complex algorithm, that is, Cocke-Youger-Kasami (CYK) for parsing context-free grammars in Chomsky Normal Form and we propose CYKNN, a simple recurrent neural network architecture for encoding the CYK algorithm in trainable matrix-vector multiplications.We experimented with a very simple grammar with 4 variations showing that our approach outperforms existing LLMs with more than 20B parameters with an in-context learning setting and smaller LLMs of the Qwen family fine-tuned with LoRA. Our attempt paves the way to a different approach to neuro-symbolic methodologies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种将经典CYK句法解析算法直接注入神经网络架构的方法，设计了CYKNN循环神经网络，通过可训练的矩阵-向量乘法实现算法编码。在简单语法变体上，该方法超越了200亿参数的大语言模型（上下文学习）及LoRA微调的Qwen模型，为神经符号方法探索了新途径。
Motivation: 探索将复杂算法直接编码到神经网络中的可能性，以CYK算法为例，挑战神经符号方法的融合方式。
Method: 提出CYKNN，一种简单的循环神经网络架构，通过可训练的矩阵-向量乘法直接编码CYK算法。
Result: 在4个简单语法变体上，CYKNN超越了超过200亿参数的大语言模型（上下文学习）以及通过LoRA微调的较小Qwen模型。
Conclusion: 为神经符号方法提供了不同的途径，展示了算法直接注入神经网络的可行性。

papers.title: Triangle Splatting SLAM
papers.abstract_en: We present a dense RGB-D SLAM system using differentiable triangles as the 3D map representation. While 3D Gaussian Splatting has emerged as the leading method for novel-view synthesis, triangles remain the standard primitive for traditional rendering hardware, game engines, and downstream tasks requiring explicit geometry such as simulation, collision, and editing. Recent offline methods have demonstrated that an unstructured 'triangle soup' can be optimised into a photorealistic mesh via Delaunay triangulation across a set of posed images. Building upon this insight, we present the first dense SLAM system to employ Triangle Splatting to perform both tracking and mapping through online differentiable rendering of a triangle soup. The map can be converted into a connected mesh on-the-fly via restricted Delaunay triangulation, enabling new online capabilities such as mesh deformation and collision checking. On Replica and TUM-RGBD, our system outperforms baselines on 3D geometry, matches the camera-tracking accuracy, and enables online mesh-based scene editing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个使用可微三角形（triangle soup）进行在线可微渲染的稠密RGB-D SLAM系统，实现跟踪与建图。地图可通过受限Delaunay三角化实时转换为连通网格，支持网格变形和碰撞检测。在Replica和TUM-RGBD数据集上，该方法在3D几何指标上优于基线，相机跟踪精度相当，并支持在线网格场景编辑。
Motivation: 现有3D高斯泼溅（Gaussian Splatting）在新视角合成中表现优异，但三角形仍是传统渲染硬件、游戏引擎和需要显式几何的下游任务（如模拟、碰撞、编辑）的标准基元。目前缺乏一个能在SLAM中通过在线可微渲染同时进行跟踪和建图的三角形泼溅系统。
Method: 采用无结构的三角形汤（triangle soup）作为3D地图表示，通过在线可微渲染进行跟踪和建图；同时利用受限Delaunay三角化将地图实时转换为连通网格，支持在线网格变形和碰撞检测。
Result: 在Replica和TUM-RGBD数据集上，该方法在3D几何指标上优于基线，相机跟踪精度与现有方法相当，并展示了在线网格场景编辑的能力。
Conclusion: 三角形泼溅作为一种可微的显式几何表示，能够有效用于稠密SLAM，既保证了跟踪精度又提供了可编辑的网格输出。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Improved Guarantees for Langevin Monte Carlo with Average Smoothness
papers.abstract_en: We establish improved nonasymptotic bounds for Langevin Monte Carlo in the strongly log-concave setting, when the error is measured by the Wasserstein distance. The main result shows that the discretization error is governed by an average coordinate-wise smoothness constant, rather than by the usual global smoothness constant. The proof is short and probabilistic, and relies on a refined use of the synchronous coupling. We further show that the same ideas lead to improved bounds for variable step sizes, for potentials whose Laplacian is Lipschitz-continuous, and for finite-sum problems sampled by stochastic-gradient Langevin dynamics with fixed point control variates. In the Laplacian-smooth case, the usual Hessian-Lipschitz contribution is replaced by a weaker trace-type third-order smoothness quantity. In the finite-sum setting, the resulting SGLD bound improves the dependence on the root mean square smoothness of the component functions. Applications to generalized linear models with Gaussian design show that these refinements can yield substantial, dimension-dependent improvements over previously known bounds, especially for correlated covariates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在强对数凹背景下，建立了朗之万蒙特卡洛方法（Langevin Monte Carlo）的非渐近误差界，其中离散化误差由平均坐标光滑常数而非全局光滑常数控制。证明简洁且基于概率，通过同步耦合的精化使用实现。
Motivation: 现有Langevin Monte Carlo的误差界依赖全局光滑常数，在非各向同性分布时可能过于保守，需要更精细的界以反映实际计算效率。
Method: 提出利用平均坐标光滑常数（average coordinate-wise smoothness）替代全局光滑常数，并通过同步耦合（synchronous coupling）技术分析Wasserstein距离下的离散化误差。该方法还扩展到变步长、Laplacian光滑势能以及有限和问题。
Result: 摘要报告的主要结果是离散化误差受平均坐标光滑常数控制，并在Laplacian光滑情形下用迹型三阶光滑量替代通常的Hessian-Lipschitz项，有限和SGLD界改进了对分量函数均方根光滑性的依赖。应用于高斯设计的广义线性模型时，可获得维度相关的改进。
Conclusion: 论文强调平均光滑性概念能获得更紧的误差界，尤其在高维相关协变量下，优于已知结果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FAM-Bench: A Multimodal Benchmark for Condition-Aware Food-as-Medicine Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Food-as-Medicine requires models to reason beyond what a dish is or what nutrition it contains: they must decide whether a concrete food choice is appropriate for a specific health condition. Existing food AI benchmarks primarily evaluate dish recognition, recipe understanding, nutrient estimation, or general nutrition question answering, leaving this health-aware decision layer largely untested. We introduce FAM-Bench, a multi-modal Food-as-Medicine benchmark with 2500 nutrition-expert-verified instances across 13 diet-related health conditions. The benchmark contains two complementary tasks: dish-level suitability assessment, where models judge whether a dish is suitable for a condition from its image and ingredient list, and comparative dish analysis, where models rank four candidate dishes by condition-specific suitability. Both tasks require integrating ingredient evidence, visual preparation cues, and clinical nutrition constraints, providing a standardized testbed for grounded health-aware reasoning in language and vision-language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FAM-Bench 是一个多模态基准测试，包含 2500 个营养专家验证的实例，涵盖 13 种饮食相关的健康条件，用于评估模型在食物与医学推理中的条件感知能力，包括菜肴级别适宜性评估和比较性菜肴分析。
Motivation: 现有食物 AI 基准主要集中于菜肴识别、配方理解或营养估计，缺乏对健康条件感知的决策层评估，因此需要一个新的基准来测试模型是否能为特定健康状况选择合适的食物。
Method: 构建了 FAM-Bench，包含菜肴级别适宜性评估（判断一道菜是否适合某种健康状况）和比较性菜肴分析（对四道候选菜按健康状况适宜性排序），结合图像、配料表和临床营养约束。
Result: 基准包含 2500 个营养专家验证的实例，覆盖 13 种饮食相关健康条件，为语言和视觉-语言模型提供标准化测试。
Conclusion: FAM-Bench 填补了食物 AI 中健康条件感知推理的空白，可作为未来模型在 grounded health-aware reasoning 方面的评估工具。

papers.title: Skill Availability and Presentation Granularity in Large-Language-Model Agents: A Controlled SkillsBench Study
papers.abstract_en: Skill documents provide procedural knowledge to large-language-model agents at inference time. This article studies whether the presentation granularity of controlled skill knowledge changes downstream task success. The experiment uses a pinned SkillsBench version, a 30-task domain-balanced subset validated by official oracle runs, two reasoning-enabled model configurations, six skill conditions, and five trials per task-condition-model cell. Skill availability is the clearest empirical signal. Relative to no skill, skill conditions increase task-mean pass rate by 26.7 to 36.0 percentage points for GPT-5.5 and by 18.0 to 26.0 percentage points for DeepSeek V4-Flash. The final data contain 1,800 rows, with 900 rows for each model. The task is the inference unit. Five trials are aggregated within each task-condition-model cell before paired contrasts are estimated over 30 tasks. The primary presentation contrasts are smaller and uncertain. Low-abstraction guidance differs from high-abstraction guidance by +0.7 percentage points for GPT-5.5 and -6.7 percentage points for DeepSeek V4-Flash, with both 95% bootstrap confidence intervals crossing zero. Adding one worked example to medium-abstraction guidance differs from the no-example variant by +0.7 and +1.3 percentage points. Mean-reward robustness checks preserve the same substantive conclusion. In this controlled subset, skill availability is associated with higher success than no skill, while the tested presentation-granularity changes yield small, uncertain, and model-dependent effects.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在大型语言模型（LLM）智能体（agent）中，技能文档（skill document）的呈现粒度（presentation granularity）如何影响下游任务成功率。实验采用控制变量法，使用SkillsBench固定版本（30个任务、6种技能条件、5次试验），测试两种推理模型（GPT-5.5和DeepSeek V4-Flash）。结果表明，技能可用性（skill availability）是提升任务成功率的最明显因素：相比无技能条件，任务平均通过率提升18-36个百分点。而呈现粒度的变化（如抽象级别、示例数量）带来的效果较小且统计上不显著，置信区间跨越零。结论是，在受控子集中，技能可用性显著提升成功率，但呈现粒度的调整仅带来微小且模型依赖的不确定影响。
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏对LLM智能体中技能文档呈现粒度如何影响任务成功率的系统性控制实验，特别是抽象级别和示例数量的影响尚不清楚。
Method: 使用固定的SkillsBench子集（30个域平衡任务），设计6种技能条件（包括无技能、低/中/高抽象指导、有无示例等），对GPT-5.5和DeepSeek V4-Flash两种推理模型进行5次试验，通过配对对比分析呈现粒度变化的效果。
Result: 技能可用性相比无技能条件，GPT-5.5任务平均通过率提升26.7-36.0个百分点，DeepSeek V4-Flash提升18.0-26.0个百分点。低抽象指导与高抽象指导的差异分别为+0.7%（GPT-5.5）和-6.7%（DeepSeek V4-Flash），两者95%置信区间均穿过零。添加一个工作示例对中抽象指导的变化为+0.7%和+1.3%。
Conclusion: 技能可用性是提升LLM智能体任务成功率的强信号，而呈现粒度的变化（抽象级别、示例数量）仅产生微小、不确定且模型依赖的效果。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究在大型语言模型（LLM）智能体（agent）中，技能文档（skill document）的呈现粒度（presentation granularity）如何影响下游任务成功率。实验采用控制变量法，使用SkillsBench固定版本（30个任务、6种技能条件、5次试验），测试两种推理模型（GPT-5.5和DeepSeek V4-Flash）。结果表明，技能可用性（skill availability）是提升任务成功率的最明显因素：相比无技能条件，任务平均通过率提升18-36个百分点。而呈现粒度的变化（如抽象级别、示例数量）带来的效果较小且统计上不显著，置信区间跨越零。结论是，在受控子集中，技能可用性显著提升成功率，但呈现粒度的调整仅带来微小且模型依赖的不确定影响。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有研究缺乏对LLM智能体中技能文档呈现粒度如何影响任务成功率的系统性控制实验，特别是抽象级别和示例数量的影响尚不清楚。
summary_sections.method: 使用固定的SkillsBench子集（30个域平衡任务），设计6种技能条件（包括无技能、低/中/高抽象指导、有无示例等），对GPT-5.5和DeepSeek V4-Flash两种推理模型进行5次试验，通过配对对比分析呈现粒度变化的效果。
summary_sections.result: 技能可用性相比无技能条件，GPT-5.5任务平均通过率提升26.7-36.0个百分点，DeepSeek V4-Flash提升18.0-26.0个百分点。低抽象指导与高抽象指导的差异分别为+0.7%（GPT-5.5）和-6.7%（DeepSeek V4-Flash），两者95%置信区间均穿过零。添加一个工作示例对中抽象指导的变化为+0.7%和+1.3%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 技能可用性是提升LLM智能体任务成功率的强信号，而呈现粒度的变化（抽象级别、示例数量）仅产生微小、不确定且模型依赖的效果。

papers.title: The Sword, Shield, and Achilles' Heel: Characterizing the Linguistic Inductive Bias of Large Language Models for Spatial Reasoning in Navigation Planning
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM)-based navigation systems commonly construct explicit spatial representations (e.g., topological graphs, semantic raster maps) and translate them into textual descriptions as LLMs' inputs. However, the linguistic structures of such text-based spatial representations and the choices of contextual features (e.g., topology, geometry) they contain are often treated as neutral engineering decisions rather than key factors that shape LLMs' behavior. To fill the gap, we propose a dual-interventional framework that disentangles linguistic structures from different contextual cues to evaluate the linguistic inductive bias of LLMs for navigation planning. In the framework, representation intervention varies the linguistic format and the degree of linguistic compression, clarifying when linguistic representations support or inhibit navigation planning. Context intervention, combined with contextual feature combination and conflict probing, explicitly clarifies the preferences and weaknesses of LLMs when processing different contextual cues. Experiments across diverse spatial reasoning tasks and multiple model scales reveal a consistent pattern: topological information is a sturdy shield and the backbone of robust planning; linguistic format is a double-edged sword whose effect depends on model size, task demands, and the compression level; and semantic information is a fatal Achilles' heel -- incorrect semantic cues can systematically derail the planning process. Overall, our study shows that effective text-based spatial representations in LLM-based navigation should preserve topological integrity, calibrate representational compression to model capacity, and ensure semantic correctness, rather than simply adopting a single representation. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/jonesdong150/LLM-Navigation-Inductive-Bias.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出双干预框架，系统评估大型语言模型（LLM）在导航规划中处理文本化空间表示时的语言归纳偏置。通过表示干预和上下文干预实验，发现拓扑信息是稳健规划的坚实屏障，语言格式的效果取决于模型规模和任务需求，而语义信息（特别是错误语义）是致命弱点。研究建议基于LLM的导航系统应保持拓扑完整性、根据模型能力校准表示压缩程度，并确保语义正确性。
Motivation: 现有LLM导航系统常将文本空间表示的格式和上下文特征视为中性工程决策，忽略了语言结构对LLM行为的实质性影响。
Method: 提出双干预框架：表示干预改变语言格式和压缩程度；上下文干预结合特征组合与冲突探测，明确LLM处理不同上下文线索时的偏好和弱点。
Result: 实验一致显示：拓扑信息是可靠支柱；语言格式是双刃剑；错误语义信息会系统性破坏规划，是致命弱点。
Conclusion: 有效文本空间表示应保持拓扑完整性、校准压缩程度、确保语义正确，而非简单采用单一表示。

papers.title: FSM-Net: An Efficient Frequency-Spatial Network for Real-World Deblurring
papers.abstract_en: Real-world image deblurring demands both high-fidelity restoration and computational efficiency, a balance existing methods often struggle to achieve. In this paper, we propose FSM-Net (Frequency-Spatial Multi-branch Network), a highly efficient solution that secured 2nd place in the NTIRE 2026 Challenge on Efficient Real-World Deblurring. FSM-Net pioneers a dual-domain approach: a novel Frequency Attention module explicitly recovers high-frequency structural details via FFT, while a Cross-Gated Vision E-Branchformer at the bottleneck captures global dependencies with linear complexity. To ensure robust convergence, we employ a progressive curriculum training strategy guided by a composite loss function (Multi-Scale Charbonnier, Structural Edge, and Frequency). Evaluated on the RSBlur benchmark, FSM-Net achieves an outstanding 33.144 dB PSNR with only 4.94M parameters and 159.35 GMACs (at 1920x1200 resolution). By effectively pushing the Pareto frontier of efficiency and quality, FSM-Net establishes a strong baseline for resource-constrained image restoration.
papers.comment: Accepted to NTIRE Workshop at CVPR 2026. Project page: https://efficient-deblurring-fsmnet.vercel.app
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FSM-Net（频率-空间多分支网络），一种高效的真实世界图像去模糊方法，在NTIRE 2026挑战赛中获得第二名。网络采用频率注意力模块（FFT）恢复高频细节，并通过Cross-Gated Vision E-Branchformer在瓶颈处以线性复杂度捕获全局依赖。结合渐进式课程训练与复合损失函数，在RSBlur基准上达到33.144 dB PSNR，仅4.94M参数和159.35 GMACs（1920×1200分辨率）。
Motivation: 现有真实图像去模糊方法难以同时实现高保真恢复和计算效率，需要更高效的平衡方案。
Method: 提出双域网络：频率注意力模块利用FFT显式恢复高频结构细节；Cross-Gated Vision E-Branchformer以线性复杂度建模全局依赖。采用渐进式课程训练策略与多尺度Charbonnier、结构边缘和频率复合损失函数。
Result: 在RSBlur基准上取得33.144 dB PSNR，参数量4.94M，计算量159.35 GMACs，在效率与质量间取得良好平衡。
Conclusion: FSM-Net有效推动了真实图像去模糊的效率-质量帕累托前沿，为资源受限场景下的图像恢复建立了强基线。

papers.title: Target-Side Paraphrase Augmentation for Sign Language Translation with Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Sign language translation (SLT) remains constrained by limited paired sign-video/text corpora and heavy-tailed target vocabularies. We study target-side augmentation in which GPT-4o generates controlled paraphrase variants of reference sentences while the sign input remains unchanged. A Signformer-style pose-based Transformer is trained under a two-stage schedule: pre-training on the augmented corpus followed by fine-tuning on the original references. We evaluate on three datasets spanning complementary challenges: PHOENIX14T (German Sign Language), with moderate lexical diversity; GSL (Greek Sign Language), with highly ontrolled, repetitive recordings; and LSA-T (Argentinian Sign Language), with severe long-tail sparsity. On PHOENIX14T, augmentation improves BLEU-4 from 9.56 to 10.33. The near-saturated GSL baseline and extremely sparse LSA-T setting reveal the limits of the approach. To our knowledge, this is the first study to apply LLM-generated target-side araphrases and LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation to SLT. The semantic evaluation reveals gains in fidelity that lexical overlap metrics understate.
papers.comment: Accepted at GenSign (https://genai4sl.github.io/) at CVPR 2026. Non proceedings track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对手语翻译（SLT）中配对语料稀缺和目标词汇长尾的问题，提出利用GPT-4o生成参考句子的释义变体进行目标端数据增强，而手语输入保持不变。采用Signformer风格的姿态Transformer，在增强语料上预训练后再在原始参考上微调。在PHOENIX14T（德国手语）上BLEU-4从9.56提升至10.33，但在GSL（希腊手语）和LSA-T（阿根廷手语）数据集上效果有限。这是首次将LLM生成的目标端释义和LLM-as-a-Judge评估应用于手语翻译。
Motivation: 手语翻译受限于有限的配对视频-文本语料库和长尾目标词汇，现有的数据增强方法多集中在源端（手语视频）或直接复制目标端，缺乏对目标端语义多样性的利用。
Method: 使用GPT-4o对参考句子生成受控的释义变体（paraphrase variants），保持手语输入不变；采用Signformer风格的基于姿态的Transformer，两阶段训练：先在增强语料上预训练，再在原始参考句子上微调。
Result: 在PHOENIX14T上，BLEU-4从9.56提升至10.33；在近乎饱和的GSL和极度稀疏的LSA-T上，方法效果有限。语义评估显示忠实性提升，但词汇重叠指标（如BLEU）低估了这些改进。
Conclusion: 目标端释义增强在词汇多样性适中的数据集上有效，但在数据饱和或极稀疏场景下受限。这是首个将LLM生成的目标端释义和LLM-as-a-Judge评估应用于手语翻译的工作，提示未来应结合更丰富的语义评估指标。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Deep-learning-based low-energy trigger algorithms for the Hyper-Kamiokande experiment
papers.abstract_en: Modern machine learning techniques have become increasingly important in particle physics because of their powerful pattern-recognition capabilities, including in real-time data acquisition where stringent runtime constraints apply. This paper details the performance of deep-learning-based trigger algorithms for a large water Cherenkov detector such as Hyper-Kamiokande aimed at low-energy neutrino events (below 7 MeV). The performance of custom neural-network supervised classifiers is shown alongside two anomaly-detection approaches trained solely on detector noise: a pure autoencoder and an energy-based model based on Manifold Projection--Diffusion Recovery (MPDR). The supervised model shows signal identification efficiencies of 76.7% for single electrons of 3 MeV kinetic energy, significantly exceeding signal efficiencies obtained from a traditional hit-count-based trigger of 26.4%, as does the MPDR approach with 31.8%. Runtime evaluations on GPU yield per-window inference latencies well below the millisecond scale, indicating that real-time operation is feasible.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为 Hyper-Kamiokande 水切伦科夫探测器设计基于深度学习的低能触发算法，针对 7 MeV 以下中微子事件。监督分类器对 3 MeV 单电子信号效率达 76.7%，远超传统 hit-count 触发的 26.4%；异常检测方法中 MPDR 达 31.8%。GPU 推理延迟低于毫秒，满足实时运行要求。
Motivation: 传统 hit-count 触发算法对低能中微子事件效率低下，需要利用深度学习模式识别能力提升触发性能。
Method: 提出三种方法：自定义神经网络监督分类器、纯自编码器异常检测、以及基于流形投影-扩散恢复 (MPDR) 的能量模型。
Result: 监督模型对 3 MeV 单电子信号效率 76.7%，MPDR 效率 31.8%，均高于传统触发的 26.4%。
Conclusion: 深度学习触发算法在低能中微子事件上显著优于传统方法，且 GPU 推理延迟满足实时约束，适合实际部署。

papers.title: Constrained Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning with Max-Min Criterion
papers.abstract_en: Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning (MORL) extends standard RL by optimizing policies with respect to multiple, often conflicting, objectives. While max-min MORL has emerged as an effective approach for promoting fairness, its applicability remains limited, particularly when constraints must be incorporated. In this paper, we propose a MORL framework that integrates the max-min criterion with explicit constraint satisfaction. We establish a theoretical foundation for the proposed framework and validate the resulting algorithm through convergence analysis and experiments in tabular settings. We further demonstrate the practical relevance of our approach in simulated building thermal control, multi-objective locomotion control, and greenhouse-gas-emission-aware traffic management. Across these domains, our method effectively balances fairness and constraint satisfaction in multi-objective decision-making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合最大最小准则与显式约束满足的多目标强化学习（MORL）框架，从理论上建立基础并通过表格设置下的收敛分析验证。实验涵盖建筑热控制、多目标运动控制和温室气体排放感知交通管理，表明该方法能有效平衡公平性和约束满足。
Motivation: 现有最大最小MORL方法难以处理约束，限制了其在需要显式约束满足的实际问题中的应用。
Method: 提出一个整合最大最小准则与约束满足的MORL框架，推导理论保证并在表格环境中进行收敛分析。
Result: 在建筑热控制、多目标运动控制和温室气体排放感知交通管理等模拟任务中，该方法有效实现了公平性与约束满足的平衡。
Conclusion: 最大最小准则结合约束满足为多目标决策提供了一种可行方案，未来可扩展到更复杂环境。

papers.title: DynaTree: Dynamic Agentic Retrieval Tree for Time-Sensitive News Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation improves retrieval by integrating planning, tool use, and iterative reasoning, but existing agentic RAG methods often couple semantic expansion with retrieval decisions in short-horizon inference loops, leading to high inference cost and limited suitability for time-sensitive news retrieval. We propose DynaTree, a two-stage framework for efficient and adaptive news retrieval. In the offline stage, DynaTree uses coordinated agents to construct a reusable retrieval tree that materializes the semantic space of a query topic. In the online stage, DynaTree performs lightweight daily subtree selection over a time-localized evaluation proxy, without further agentic reasoning, tree modification, or retraining. Experiments on a multi-day Syft news benchmark and multiple BEIR datasets show that DynaTree achieves strong recall and ranking performance, consistently outperforming standard RAG and prior agentic baselines. We further deploy DynaTree in the Syft production system and evaluate it through online A/B testing from Jan. 28 to Feb. 6, 2026. The dynamically adapted variant improves survival rate from 0.32-0.53 to 0.59-0.73 over a fixed offline-selected subtree and outperforms existing production recallers on every evaluation day. These results show that persistent, structure-aware semantic expansion can translate offline agentic reasoning into practical improvements in coverage, freshness, and relevance for real-world news retrieval.

papers.title: LiftNav: Path Planning via Semantic Lifting in TSDF-Guided Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous robots in unknown indoor environments require both reliable collision avoidance and object-level understanding. Classical representations such as TSDF support safe planning but lack semantics, while photorealistic methods like Gaussian Splatting (GS) provide rich appearance yet suffer from soft geometry, limiting precise obstacle avoidance. We present LiftNav, a hybrid navigation framework built on GSFusion's TSDF+GS dual map, augmented with a real-time pipeline of YOLO-based detection, TSDF-based 3D lifting, and B-spline trajectory optimization. This design enables flexible semantic navigation without dense 3D embeddings. We further introduce a hinge-loss-based collision penalty that improves trajectory smoothness and safety. We evaluate our approach in a simulation using the Replica dataset. Compared against a state-of-the-art radiance field baseline we show a 100% feasibility rate and shorter trajectories.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LiftNav，一个混合导航框架，结合 TSDF 与 Gaussian Splatting 双地图，通过 YOLO 检测、TSDF 3D 提升和 B 样条轨迹优化实现语义导航。在 Replica 数据集仿真中，与最先进的辐射场基线相比，实现了 100% 的可行性率和更短的轨迹。
Motivation: 现有室内导航方法要么缺乏语义信息，要么几何精度不足（如 GS 软几何），难以同时实现安全避障和物体级理解。
Method: 基于 GSFusion 的 TSDF+GS 双地图，集成实时 YOLO 检测、TSDF 3D 提升和 B 样条轨迹优化，并引入铰链损失碰撞惩罚以提高轨迹平滑性和安全性。
Result: 在 Replica 数据集仿真中，与最先进辐射场基线相比，实现了 100% 的可行性率和更短的轨迹。
Conclusion: LiftNav 通过语义提升在 TSDF 引导的高斯泼溅中实现了灵活、安全的路径规划，无需密集 3D 嵌入。

papers.title: Scaling Higher-Order Graph Learning with Maximal Clique Complexes
papers.abstract_en: Graph neural networks (GNNs) are limited to modeling pairwise interactions, while higher-order models based on cell complexes achieve greater expressivity but often suffer from poor scalability. We introduce simplified and factored cellular Weisfeiler Leman tests (sCWL and fCWL), which preserve the expressivity of the CWL test while improving computational efficiency. We further introduce the maximal clique complex, enabling scalable CWNs with reduced time and memory complexity while retaining strong empirical performance. To avoid explicit clique enumeration, we propose CliqueWalk, a biased random walk that samples maximal cliques and scales linearly with graph size. These contributions yield a scalable topological learning framework for higher-order graph representation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对图神经网络局限于成对交互的问题，提出了基于极大团复形的高阶图学习框架。通过简化细胞Weisfeiler-Leman测试和CliqueWalk随机游走，实现了可扩展的高阶图表示。
Motivation: 图神经网络仅能建模成对交互，而基于胞腔复形的高阶模型虽然表达能力更强，但可扩展性差。
Method: 引入简化与分解的细胞Weisfeiler-Leman测试（sCWL和fCWL），保留表达能力的同时提升计算效率；提出极大团复形以降低时间和空间复杂度；设计CliqueWalk偏置随机游走，线性采样极大团。
Result: 在保持强经验性能的同时，显著降低了时间和内存复杂度，且CliqueWalk的复杂度与图大小呈线性关系。
Conclusion: 本文贡献了一个可扩展的拓扑学习框架，用于高阶图表示。

papers.title: Softsign: Smooth Sign in Your Optimizer For Better Parameter Heterogeneity Handling
papers.abstract_en: Sign-based and LMO-inspired optimizers have recently attracted substantial attention in deep learning due to their strong performance and low memory footprint. However, their fixed-magnitude updates can hurt terminal convergence: they decouple update mechanisms from gradient magnitudes and fail to account for parameter heterogeneity, often leading to oscillation rather than convergence. We propose SoftSignum, a smooth relaxation of sign-based optimization that replaces the hard sign map with a temperature-controlled soft-sign transformation, enabling a parameter-wise transition from sign-like updates to magnitude-sensitive SGD-like steps. We complement it with an adaptive quantile-based temperature schedule and extend the same principle to matrix-valued optimizers, obtaining SoftMuon. We also develop a generalized geometry-relaxation framework based on strongly convex regularizers and Fenchel conjugates, proving convergence in stochastic non-convex setting. Experiments on diverse deep learning tasks, including LLM pretraining, show that SoftSignum and SoftMuon consistently improve over their hard sign-based counterparts and standard AdamW.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SoftSignum 和 SoftMuon，作为符号优化器（sign-based optimizer）的平滑变体，用温度控制的 soft-sign 函数替代硬符号映射，实现从类符号更新到幅度敏感 SGD 更新的参数级过渡，并引入自适应分位数温度调度。作者还基于强凸正则化和 Fenchel 共轭建立了广义几何松弛框架，证明了随机非凸收敛性。实验涵盖 LLM 预训练等任务，表明该方法在性能上优于硬符号优化器和标准 AdamW。
Motivation: 符号优化器虽有低内存和强性能优势，但其固定幅度更新机制与梯度幅度解耦，忽略参数异质性，导致终端收敛阶段振荡而非收敛。
Method: 提出温度控制的 soft-sign 变换 SoftSignum，实现从符号更新到类似 SGD 幅度敏感更新的平滑过渡；配合自适应分位数温度调度；将相同原理扩展到矩阵值优化器得到 SoftMuon；并基于强凸正则化和 Fenchel 共轭构建广义几何松弛框架，给出非凸随机收敛证明。
Result: 在多种深度学习任务（包括 LLM 预训练）上，SoftSignum 和 SoftMuon 一致地优于对应的硬符号优化器及标准 AdamW。
Conclusion: 通过平滑符号函数并自适应调节温度，能更好地处理参数异质性，改善终端收敛，且理论上有收敛保证。
