papers.title: HypoAgent: An Agentic Framework for Interactive Abductive Hypothesis Generation over Knowledge Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Abductive reasoning over knowledge graphs aims to generate logical hypotheses that explain observed entities or facts. Existing controllable hypothesis generation methods allow users to guide this process with explicit conditions, but they remain limited in interactive settings: they struggle to ground evolving natural-language intents across multi-turn dialogues and provide little fine-grained diagnosis when generated hypotheses fail. To address these limitations, we propose HypoAgent, an Agentic framework for interactive abductive Hypothesis Generation over knowledge graphs. HypoAgent integrates three agents: an Intent Recognition Agent that grounds user utterances and dialogue history into executable KG conditions, a Hypothesis Generation Agent that performs controllable hypothesis generation according to the extracted user intention, and a Root Cause Analysis Agent that diagnoses unreliable hypothesis fragments and leverages KG neighborhood probing to identify supported refinements. Experiments on commonsense and biomedical domain-specific knowledge graphs demonstrate that HypoAgent achieves state-of-the-art semantic similarity under single-turn, multi-turn, and unconditional settings. Our code is available at https://github.com/HKUST-KnowComp/HypoAgent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HypoAgent，一个基于智能体（agentic）的框架，用于在知识图谱上进行交互式溯因假设生成。框架包含三个智能体：意图识别、假设生成和根因分析，能够处理多轮对话中的自然语言意图并诊断失败的假设。在常识和生物医学知识图谱上取得了最先进的语义相似度。
Motivation: 现有知识图谱溯因假设生成方法在交互设置中受限，难以在多轮对话中跟踪演化中的自然语言意图，且无法提供细粒度的失败诊断。
Method: 提出HypoAgent框架，集成三个智能体：意图识别智能体将用户话语和对话历史转换为可执行的知识图谱条件；假设生成智能体根据提取的用户意图执行可控假设生成；根因分析智能体诊断不可靠的假设片段，并通过知识图谱邻域探测识别支持的改进。
Result: 在常识和生物医学领域知识图谱上的实验表明，HypoAgent在单轮、多轮和无条件设置下均达到最先进的语义相似度。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架有效解决了交互式溯因假设生成中的意图跟踪和失败诊断问题，代码已开源。

papers.title: A Unifying View of Variational Generative Wasserstein Flows
papers.abstract_en: Many modern generative models can be viewed as minimizing divergences between probability distributions, yet they rely on different algorithmic and geometric principles. Wasserstein gradient flows provide a continuous-time formulation for optimizing over distributions, and can be approximated through their implicit discretization via the Jordan-Kinderlehrer-Otto (JKO) scheme. In this work, we present a unified theoretical framework for generative modeling based on Wasserstein gradient flows, which we refer to as Generative Wasserstein Flows (GWF). We show that a broad class of existing methods can be derived as instances of parametric JKO schemes for $f$-divergence objectives, and we establish equivalences between several recently proposed algorithms. We extend this framework beyond f-divergence to Integral Probability Metrics and squared Maximum Mean Discrepancy, deriving new JKO-based generative algorithms, and clarifying their connections with GANs. We study empirically the impact of the JKO regularization for a wide set of objectives. Finally, we analyze parametric Wasserstein flows, where the dynamics are restricted to distributions induced by parametrized maps.
papers.comment: Accepted as a spotlight at ICML2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一的生成模型理论框架——生成式Wasserstein流 (GWF)，将多种现有方法视为f-散度目标的参数化JKO格式实例，并扩展到积分概率度量与最大均值差异，建立与GAN的联系。实验分析了JKO正则化的影响，并探讨了参数化Wasserstein流。
Motivation: 许多现代生成模型依赖不同的算法和几何原则，缺乏统一视角，限制了方法间的比较与扩展。
Method: 基于Wasserstein梯度流与JKO格式，推导出参数化生成模型的统一框架，覆盖f-散度、积分概率度量与最大均值差异，并提出新的JKO生成算法。
Result: 从理论上建立多种现有算法的等价关系，并给出与GAN的明确联系；实验上评估了不同目标下JKO正则化的效果。
Conclusion: 该框架为生成模型提供统一视角，有助于理解已有方法并设计新算法；参数化流的分析进一步拓展了应用范围。

papers.title: Trading Complexity for Expressivity Through Structured Generalized Linear Token Mixing
papers.abstract_en: Token mixing layers play a key role in how language models can learn and generate long-range dependencies. Their efficiency relies on the necessary trade-off between decoding speed and the memory requirements, along with the cache size. Considering causal generation, this paper explores new trade-offs thanks to a unified framework which separates two crucial features: (i) the direct influence of inputs on outputs in one generation step; (ii) the recurrent propagation of information through past outputs. This framework encompasses major architectures such as attention and state-space models, but also generalizes the recurrence equations by allowing each state to depend on multiple past states rather than only the immediate predecessor. By introducing structure, we design new recurrence patterns that provably achieve the desired complexity, while providing theoretical insights on their expressivity -- trading runtime for expressivity in a principled way. Empirical validation is performed on synthetic tasks, along with language modeling. Together, these results provide a unified toolkit for the understanding and design of efficient and expressive token mixers across model families.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个统一框架，将token混合层分解为输入对输出的直接影响和通过过去输出的循环传播。通过引入结构，设计了新的循环模式，在理论上实现了复杂度与表达性的权衡，并在合成任务和语言建模上进行了验证。
Motivation: 现有token混合层（如注意力、状态空间模型）在解码速度、内存需求和缓存大小之间存在权衡，但缺乏一个统一的框架来系统性地探索新的权衡。
Method: 提出了一个统一框架，将token混合层分解为两个关键特征：直接影响和循环传播，并允许每个状态依赖于多个过去状态而非仅直接前驱。通过引入结构，设计了新的循环模式，并提供了表达性的理论分析。
Result: 在合成任务和语言建模上进行了实证验证，展示了所提模式在复杂度与表达性之间的权衡。
Conclusion: 该框架为理解和设计高效且表达性强的token混合器提供了统一工具，有助于跨模型家族的设计。

papers.title: Learning to Adapt: Self-Improving Web Agent via Cognitive-Aware Exploration
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have led to promising progress in web agents. However, existing web agents often rely on handcrafted execution pipelines or expensive expert trajectories, limiting their adaptability to complex, dynamic environments. To address these challenges, we propose SCALE (Self-Cognitive-Aware Learning and Exploration), which leverages three adversarial roles, Selector, Predictor, and Judger to autonomously discover the agent's limitations and expand its cognitive boundaries through environmental exploration. Moreover, we propose SCALE-Hop, a graph exploration strategy that facilitates global planning and helps agents avoid local exploration traps. To further support learning, we construct SCALE-20k, a large-scale dataset collected from 19 real-world websites, containing diverse task types and structured demonstrations generated from SCALE's exploration traces. Experimental results show that our approach significantly improves the performance and generalization of multiple MLLMs in various web environments. Our framework offers a scalable and generalizable solution for building truly autonomous and adaptive web agents.

papers.title: Dreaming Of Others: Latent Teammate Modeling In World Models For Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: In cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), agents must coordinate with partners whose internal policies and intentions are not directly observable. While world models such as Dreamer have demonstrated strong generalization and sample efficiency in single-agent settings, their application to MARL remains limited by an inability to handle teammate-induced uncertainty. We propose a new perspective: treat teammates as structured, learnable components within the agent's world model. We introduce an architecture that factorizes the latent state of a Dreamer-style recurrent state-space model (RSSM) into environment and teammate components, and learns an auxiliary Theory-of-Mind (ToM) head to infer latent embeddings of partner behavior such as character, intent, and predicted actions from partial trajectories. These teammate latents condition the actor and critic, enabling the agent to imagine and adapt to diverse collaborators. We outline how this approach can support zero-shot and few-shot coordination in partially observable settings and propose a set of benchmarks and evaluation protocols to assess its impact. This work positions world models as not only predictors of environmental dynamics, but as simulators of social behavior, opening new directions for generalizable, human-compatible AI.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 2 figures. Accepted as a poster at the 2026 World Modeling Workshop. Conceptual workshop paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种将队友建模融入世界模型（如Dreamer）的多智能体强化学习方法。通过将循环状态空间模型（RSSM）的潜在状态分解为环境和队友两部分，并学习心智理论（ToM）头来从部分轨迹中推断队友的潜在特征（如角色、意图和预测动作），使智能体能够想象并适应不同的协作伙伴。该方法旨在支持部分可观测环境中的零样本和少样本协调，并提出了相应的基准和评估协议。
Motivation: 合作多智能体强化学习（MARL）中，智能体需要与内部策略和意图不可直接观测的队友协调，而现有世界模型（如Dreamer）无法处理队友带来的不确定性，限制了其在MARL中的应用。
Method: 提出一种架构，将Dreamer风格的RSSM潜在状态分解为环境分量和队友分量，并学习辅助的ToM头来从部分轨迹中推断队友行为的潜在嵌入（如角色、意图和预测动作），用这些队友潜变量来调节actor和critic。
Result: 摘要未提供具体实验结果，仅概述了架构设计、零样本/少样本协调的潜在能力，并提议了一组基准和评估协议。
Conclusion: 该工作将世界模型定位为不仅是环境动态的预测器，更是社会行为的模拟器，为可泛化、与人类兼容的AI开辟新方向。

papers.title: dashi: A Python library for Dataset Shift Characterization to Support Trustworthy AI Development and Deployment
papers.abstract_en: The Artificial Intelligence (AI) life cycle requires a thorough understanding of the underlying data dynamics for robust, safe and cost-effective AI development and use. Dataset shifts are defined as changes between train and test data distributions. Whether occurring over time (temporal) or across different sites (multi-source), they can severely degrade model performance and compromise data quality. This is particularly important in health AI, where the safety and fundamental rights of patients can be severely affected by uncontrolled shifts both at training and operational stages. While the theoretical foundations of covariate, prior, and concept shifts are well established, there is a lack of accessible and comprehensive software tools to perform their analysis. We introduce dashi, an open-source Python library designed for the exploration, quantification, and characterization of dataset shifts. dashi provides a dual approach: an unsupervised approach that leverages information geometry and non-parametric statistical manifolds to data variability characterization and analysis (e.g., Information Geometric Temporal plots and Multi-Source Variability metrics like Global Probabilistic Deviation and Source Probabilistic Outlyingness), and a supervised approach that quantifies and characterizes model performance degradation. Both unsupervised and supervised approaches work across user-defined temporal and domain/source batches. We demonstrate the utility of dashi on three simulated and real-world health AI case studies on gestational diabetes mellitus, COVID-19 and emergency medical dispatch. By providing interactive visual analytics and variability metrics, dashi supports trustworthiness of AI life cycle stages enabling robust and safe machine learning pipelines through the assessment of data coherence and AI performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: dashi 是一个开源的 Python 库，用于探索、量化和表征数据集偏移 (dataset shift)，提供无监督方法（基于信息几何和非参数统计流形）和有监督方法（量化模型性能退化），支持时间维度和多源批次分析。在三个健康 AI 案例（妊娠期糖尿病、COVID-19、紧急医疗调度）上展示了其效用。
Motivation: 尽管协变量偏移、先验偏移和概念偏移的理论基础已很完善，但缺乏易于使用且全面的软件工具来执行偏移分析，尤其在健康 AI 领域，非受控偏移会严重影响患者安全和权利。
Method: 提出 dashi 库，包含两种途径：无监督途径利用信息几何和非参数统计流形进行数据变异性表征（如信息几何时间图、全局概率偏差和源概率离群度）；有监督途径量化模型性能退化。两者均可跨用户定义的时间/域批次工作。
Result: 在三个健康 AI 模拟和真实案例（妊娠期糖尿病、COVID-19、紧急医疗调度）中展示了 dashi 的实用性，提供交互式视觉分析和变异性指标，支持通过评估数据一致性和 AI 性能来增强机器学习管道的鲁棒性和安全性。
Conclusion: dashi 通过提供数据集偏移的探索和量化工具，支持 AI 生命周期各阶段的可信度，有助于构建鲁棒且安全的机器学习管道。

papers.title: Diagnosing Failure Modes of Shared-State Collaboration in Resource-Constrained Visual Agents
papers.abstract_en: Modular visual reasoning systems increasingly rely on shared working memory for multi-step collaboration, yet the failure dynamics of intermediate state evolution in low-capacity regimes remain underexplored. We study failure modes of collaborative reasoning with weak learners (4B--8B models) through the lens of noise accumulation. We introduce CoSee, an auditing framework that formalizes the read-write-verify loop to trace information flow in document visual question answering. Across multi-page, chart, and web-based benchmarks, we find a counter-intuitive degradation: naive shared workspaces often amplify hallucinations rather than resolve them. We identify two dominant failure modes: Noise Reinforcement, where ungrounded notes are reused as evidence, and Policy Collapse, where added context shifts the model toward under-specified, short-form answers. Using cost-accuracy Pareto frontiers, we show that increased compute can correlate negatively with performance without explicit verification. Our findings suggest that for resource-constrained agents, the bottleneck lies not in reasoning depth but in communication fidelity, providing trace-level diagnostics and a mechanistic baseline for reliable modular design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究资源受限的视觉智能体在共享状态协作下的失败模式，重点分析弱学习器（4B-8B模型）在文档视觉问答中的噪声累积问题。通过提出CoSee审计框架，形式化读写-验证循环以追踪信息流，发现朴素共享工作空间会放大而非解决幻觉，并识别出两大类失败模式：噪声强化（错误笔记被当作证据重用）和策略崩溃（额外上下文导致模型产生短形式答案）。成本-准确率帕累托前沿表明，在没有显式验证的情况下，增加计算量可能与性能负相关。
Motivation: 现有模块化视觉推理系统依赖共享工作记忆进行多步协作，但在低容量场景下中间状态演化的失败动力学尚未被充分探索。
Method: 引入CoSee审计框架，形式化读写-验证循环来追踪文档视觉问答中的信息流；基于多页、图表和网页基准测试进行实验，并使用成本-准确率帕累托前沿分析。
Result: 发现朴素共享工作空间会放大幻觉而非解决，识别出噪声强化和策略崩溃两种主导失败模式，且增加计算量可能在没有显式验证时与性能负相关。
Conclusion: 对于资源受限的智能体，瓶颈在于通信保真度而非推理深度，研究提供了追踪级诊断和用于可靠模块化设计的机制基线。

papers.title: A Visually Impaired Assistance Benchmark for VLM-as-a-Judge Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: AI-based Visually Impaired Assistance (VIA) remains challenging, largely due to the high cost of human evaluation. The VLM-as-a-Judge paradigm may offer a promising alternative, although it has mostly been studied in general domains. We therefore ask whether such judges can be trusted for VIA tasks. To investigate this question, we introduce VIABLE (Visually Impaired Assistance Benchmark for VLM-as-a-Judge Evaluation), the first benchmark for VLM-as-a-Judge evaluation in VIA. VIABLE contains over 300K judgment samples across three scenarios and introduces an Effectiveness--Impartiality--Stability framework with a 12-mode failure taxonomy. Based on VIABLE, our systematic study of seven judges across different model scales shows that existing models are largely unreliable across all evaluation axes. The strongest judge, GPT-5.4, achieves only 52.6% single-failure diagnostic accuracy, yet exhibits the highest self-preference rate at 94.2%; while open-source judges are strongly biased and adversarially fragile. To address these issues, we propose VIA-Judge-Agent, a model-agnostic inference-time harness that augments judges with visual evidence extraction and a taxonomy-guided workflow. It enables positive improvements in diagnostic accuracy and downstream VIA responses more preferred by BLV users. Data and code are available at: https://github.com/YiyiyiZhao/VIABLE
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VIABLE，首个针对视障辅助（VIA）任务的 VLM-as-a-Judge 评估基准，包含超过30万条判断样本和12种失败模式的分类体系。系统评估7个不同规模的裁判模型后，发现现有模型在多数评估轴上不可靠，最强的 GPT-5.4 诊断准确率仅52.6%且自偏好率高达94.2%。作者提出 VIA-Judge-Agent，一种模型无关的推理时增强框架，通过视觉证据提取和分类引导工作流提升诊断准确性和下游响应偏好。
Motivation: AI辅助视障任务的人类评估成本高昂，VLM-as-a-Judge 范式在通用领域有潜力，但在 VIA 任务中尚未被验证可信度。
Method: 构建 VIABLE 基准，包含三个场景的判断样本和 Effectiveness-Impartiality-Stability 评估框架；提出 VIA-Judge-Agent，通过视觉证据提取和分类引导工作流增强裁判模型。
Result: 7个裁判模型在 VIABLE 上表现不可靠：GPT-5.4 单故障诊断准确率仅52.6%，自偏好率94.2%；开源模型存在强偏见和对抗脆弱性。VIA-Judge-Agent 能提升诊断准确率和 BLV 用户偏好的下游响应。
Conclusion: 现有 VLM 裁判在 VIA 任务中不可靠，VIA-Judge-Agent 提供了一种模型无关的推理时增强方案，但仍需进一步改进。

summary_sections.result: 7个裁判模型在 VIABLE 上表现不可靠：GPT-5.4 单故障诊断准确率仅52.6%，自偏好率94.2%；开源模型存在强偏见和对抗脆弱性。VIA-Judge-Agent 能提升诊断准确率和 BLV 用户偏好的下游响应。
summary_sections.conclusion: 现有 VLM 裁判在 VIA 任务中不可靠，VIA-Judge-Agent 提供了一种模型无关的推理时增强方案，但仍需进一步改进。

papers.title: FBHM: Functional Benchmarking and Steering of VLMs for Hateful Meme Detection
papers.abstract_en: Hateful meme detection remains a formidable challenge for vision-language models, as existing benchmarks are structurally observational - confounding rhetorical hate mechanisms with target community features and preventing causal evaluation of model vulnerabilities. To address this, we introduce FBHM, a systematically curated benchmark of Functionality Based Hateful Memes constructed along two orthogonal axes: 25 distinct rhetorical functionalities and 10 target communities (5,000 memes total). Benchmarking state-of-the-art VLMs reveals a severe generalization gap: models highly accurate on standard datasets catastrophically drop to near-random performance on FBHM, proving they exploit dataset-specific heuristics rather than robust multimodal reasoning. To efficiently close this gap, we propose LSV (learnable steering vectors), an ultra-low data regime strategy that applies a causal intervention objective on as few as 500 steering samples (50 unique base memes), boosting FBHM performance by ~30 Macro-F1 points while outperforming in-context learning and PEFT without degrading source-domain performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现有仇恨梗图检测基准的因果混淆问题，提出FBHM基准（按25种修辞功能和10个目标社区构建的5,000个梗图），并揭示当前视觉语言模型在该基准上性能骤降为接近随机水平，证明模型依赖数据集特定的启发式而非稳健的多模态推理。为高效弥补这一差距，提出LSV（可学习引导向量），一种超低数据策略，仅用500个引导样本（50个独特基础梗图）即可在FBHM上提升约30个Macro-F1点，且不降低源域性能。
Motivation: 现有仇恨梗图检测基准在结构上是观察性的，混淆了修辞仇恨机制与目标社区特征，无法对模型漏洞进行因果评估。
Method: 构建功能导向的FBHM基准；提出LSV（learnable steering vectors），一种超低数据策略，对仅500个引导样本应用因果干预目标。
Result: 现有顶级VLM在FBHM上性能骤降为接近随机；LSV在FBHM上提升约30个Macro-F1点，优于上下文学习和PEFT，且不降低源域性能。
Conclusion: 模型依赖数据集特异性启发式；LSV可有效修复因果混淆导致的泛化差距，且数据效率极高。

papers.title: Wall-Clock Complexity for Zeroth-Order Optimization with Tunable Oracle Fidelity
papers.abstract_en: Zeroth-order (black-box) optimization is applied when gradients are unavailable and objective evaluations rely on expensive simulations. In many such applications, the oracle fidelity is tunable: higher-accuracy queries reduce noise but incur higher computational costs. To capture this trade-off, we study an accuracy-aware wall-clock model where each query with fidelity $δ$ has a cost $c(δ)$, and we minimize the total time $T_{\mathrm{total}} = \sum_{k=1}^{N} c(δ_k)$, subject to a target accuracy constraint. We show how the choice of oracle type, noise model, and optimization scheme induces explicit wall-clock-optimal choices for the algorithmic parameters. For instance, we demonstrate that accelerated methods can be wall-clock inferior to non-accelerated schemes. Furthermore, we characterize the conditions under which a constant fidelity strategy is optimal in the Big-O sense. Our framework provides a unified methodology to translate convergence guarantees into practical fidelity and batching recommendations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究零阶优化（zeroth-order optimization）中可调保真度（tunable oracle fidelity）对墙钟复杂度的影响。通过建立精度感知的墙钟模型，将每次查询保真度δ与成本c(δ)关联，并最小化总时间T_total。理论分析表明，加速方法可能比非加速方案在墙钟时间上更差，并给出了恒定保真度策略在Big-O意义下最优的条件。
Motivation: 实际应用中，目标函数评估依赖昂贵模拟，且保真度可调：高精度查询代价高但噪声小。现有理论未充分刻画这种权衡对优化总时间的影响。
Method: 提出精度感知墙钟模型，将每次查询保真度δ的成本c(δ)纳入总时间目标，结合不同优化算法（如加速与非加速方法）分析最优参数选择。
Result: 理论表明加速方法在墙钟时间上可能劣于非加速方法；并给出恒定保真度策略在Big-O意义上最优的条件。
Conclusion: 该框架为将收敛保证转化为实际保真度与批处理建议提供了统一方法论。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Log-Ratio Propagation on the Simplex: A Theory of Cellwise Contamination for Compositional Data
papers.abstract_en: Compositional data must be analysed through log-ratios: scale invariance, the defining axiom of the field, leaves no alternative. The centred log-ratio divides by the geometric mean of every part, so a single contaminated component shifts every centred-log-ratio coordinate at once, displacing the log-ratio vector by a fixed amount that no choice of coordinates can reduce. We develop a theory of cellwise contamination on the simplex around this observation. A scale-invariant contamination model built from multiplicative perturbation combines with a propagation theorem showing that corruption of a single raw part induces a rank-one shift of the log-ratio vector, with direction determined by the contrast matrix. The resulting perturbation pattern is not equivalent to any independent cellwise contamination model in log-ratio coordinates -- so standard Euclidean cellwise methods applied to log-ratios are ill-posed under the simplex contamination mechanism. For estimators whose Euclidean cellwise breakdown is witnessed by a column-concentrated configuration -- a class including MCD, $S$-, $τ$-, and coordinate-wise $M$-estimators of location and scatter -- the cellwise breakdown value on the simplex is reduced by the factor $(D-1)/D$ relative to its Euclidean counterpart, a reduction that is tight and arises purely from the normalisation mismatch between $nD$ raw cells and $n(D-1)$ ilr cells. The cellwise influence function for the variation matrix carries a diagnostic fingerprint: contamination of a single part inflates exactly one row and column, identifying the responsible component. These results form the theoretical foundation for cellwise-robust methods on the simplex; a companion paper develops a cellwise-robust PCA estimator that exploits the propagation geometry and demonstrates it on simulated and geochemical data.
papers.comment: 50 pages, no figures; 11-page supplement included as an ancillary file. A companion methods paper (cellPcaCoDa: cellwise-robust PCA for compositional data) is forthcoming
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对成分数据（compositional data）的细胞污染（cellwise contamination）问题，提出对数比传播理论。中心化对数比（centred log-ratio）变换中单个分量的污染会导致所有坐标移位，作者建立了基于乘法扰动的尺度不变污染模型，并证明单一原始部分的污染会引发对数比向量的秩1移位，且该扰动模式不能用独立细胞污染模型等价表示。对于欧几里得空间中细胞崩溃由列集中配置（column-concentrated configuration）刻画的一类估计量（如MCD、S-、τ-、坐标M估计），在单纯形上的细胞崩溃值相对于欧几里得情形减少了因子(D-1)/D。变差矩阵的细胞影响函数具有诊断特征：污染单个部分仅膨胀一行和一列，从而识别责任分量。
Motivation: 成分数据的对数比分析中，单个原始分量的污染会通过中心化对数比变换传播到所有坐标，但现有欧几里得细胞稳健方法直接应用于对数比坐标时，在单纯形污染机制下是病态的。
Method: 提出基于乘法扰动的尺度不变污染模型，结合传播定理证明单一原始部分污染导致对数比向量的秩1移位；分析欧几里得细胞崩溃值在单纯形上的退化因子；推导变差矩阵的细胞影响函数。
Result: 细胞崩溃值在单纯形上相对于欧几里得情形严格减少(D-1)/D；变差矩阵的细胞影响函数中污染仅膨胀一行和一列。
Conclusion: 该理论为单纯形上的细胞稳健方法提供了基础，伴随论文开发了细胞稳健PCA估计器并展示了模拟和地球化学数据的应用。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: Appropriateness of Empathy in AI: A Signal-Cost Perspective
papers.abstract_en: The appropriateness of empathy in AI has emerged as a critical concern, as excessive empathy risks seeming manipulative while insufficient empathy appears dismissive. While prior research has explored how to quantify empathy in AI, few studies examine whether such empathy is contextually appropriate. This paper introduces an economic perspective by applying signaling theory to human-AI conversations. We propose Signal Cost Proxies (emotional richness, perspective-taking, and contextual tailoring) mapped to affective, cognitive, and associative empathy. This multidimensional framework enables systematic evaluation of empathy not just by presence, but by its appropriateness relative to user demand.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从经济学信号理论角度探讨AI移情的适当性，提出信号成本代理（情感丰富度、视角采择和上下文定制）映射到情感、认知和关联移情，用于评估AI移情是否适合情境。
Motivation: 现有研究多关注如何量化AI移情，但很少考察移情是否情境适当；过度移情显得操纵，不足则显得冷漠。
Method: 引入信号理论，提出信号成本代理框架，将情感丰富度、视角采择和上下文定制分别映射到情感、认知和关联移情，实现多维度的适当性评估。
Conclusion: 该框架可以系统评估AI移情不仅是否存在，而且是否相对于用户需求适当。

papers.title: DecMem: Towards Minute-Long Consistent World Generation with Decoupled Memory
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in video generative models have promoted rapid progress in controllable world models. However, maintaining fine-grained spatio-temporal consistency under long-horizon reasoning remains a key challenge. In this work, we move beyond explicit 3D memory and coarse frame-level implicit modeling, and propose a fine-grained, learnable, and scalable memory for consistent world generation. We first identify two fundamental limitations of naïve learnable memory architectures in long-horizon extrapolation, namely computational inefficiency and attention dispersion. Through a systematic analysis of attention dispersion, we propose DecMem, a decoupled memory architecture that employs Sparse Global Memory for efficient fine-grained access to global history and Anchored Local Memory for stable and high-quality extrapolation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DecMem significantly outperforms current state-of-the-art methods. By ensuring precise and efficient long-term memory and achieving superior extrapolation capabilities, DecMem enables minute-level controllable long video generation with high fidelity and consistency.
papers.comment: Project page is available at https://jeffreyyzh.github.io/DecMem-Page
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对长视频生成中的时空一致性问题，提出了一种解耦记忆架构DecMem，包括稀疏全局记忆和锚定局部记忆，以实现分钟级可控长视频的高保真生成。实验表明，DecMem显著优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有显式3D记忆和粗粒度帧级隐式建模在长时程推理下难以维持精细的时空一致性，而朴素可学习记忆架构存在计算效率低和注意力分散的问题。
Method: 提出DecMem解耦记忆架构：稀疏全局记忆（Sparse Global Memory）用于高效细粒度访问全局历史，锚定局部记忆（Anchored Local Memory）用于稳定高质量外推。
Result: 广泛实验表明，DecMem显著优于当前最先进方法，实现了分钟级可控长视频生成，具有高保真度和一致性。
Conclusion: DecMem通过精确高效的长时记忆和优越的外推能力，推动了长时程可控世界生成的发展。

papers.title: Social welfare optimisation under institutional reward and punishment
papers.abstract_en: Institutional incentives are widely used to promote cooperation among autonomous, self-regarding agents, from human societies to multi-agent and AI systems. Existing work typically treats incentive design as a bi-objective problem: minimise institutional cost while achieving a high long-run frequency of cooperation. Whether such schemes also maximise social welfare - total population payoff net of institutional expenditure - has remained largely unexplored. We develop a welfare-centric framework for institutional incentives in finite, well-mixed populations playing a social dilemma (Donation Game and Public Goods Game), considering both rewards for cooperators and punishments for defectors. For each mechanism, we derive explicit expressions for expected social welfare and characterise how it depends on incentive efficiency and selection intensity. Analytically, we identify parameter regimes where social welfare has a single optimal incentive level and regimes with qualitative phase transitions, in which welfare becomes non-monotonic with multiple local optima. We prove that any welfare-maximising incentive is either zero or concentrated around a simple closed-form target, and we provide an efficient algorithm to compute these optima. Comparing reward and punishment, we further derive close-formed conditions under which reward outperform punishment in terms of social welfare for any given budget. Overall, our results reveal a systematic gap between incentives optimised for cost or cooperation frequency and those that maximise welfare.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了有限、充分混合的社会困境（捐赠博弈和公共物品博弈）中，机构奖励合作与惩罚背叛这两种激励措施对社会福利的影响。推导出社会福利的显式表达式，并刻画了其随激励效率和选择强度的变化规律，发现社会福利最大化的激励要么为零，要么集中在简单闭式目标附近，且存在多个局部最优的非单调区域。还推导出在给定预算下奖励优于惩罚的条件。
Motivation: 现有工作通常将激励设计视为双目标问题（最小化成本同时实现高合作频率），但未系统研究这些方案是否最大化社会福利（总人口收益扣除机构支出）。本文填补这一空白。
Method: 建立以福利为中心的机构激励框架，针对捐赠博弈和公共物品博弈，分别考虑奖励合作者和惩罚背叛者两种机制，通过解析推导得到期望社会福利表达式，并使用演化博弈论方法分析其依赖关系。
Result: 识别出社会福利具有单一最优激励水平的参数区间，以及存在定性相变、福利呈非单调且多局部最优的区间。证明任何福利最大化的激励要么为零，要么集中在简单闭式目标附近，并给出高效算法。同时推导出奖励优于惩罚的闭式条件。
Conclusion: 优化成本或合作频率的激励与最大化社会福利的激励之间存在系统性差距，因此福利应作为独立优化目标。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究了有限、充分混合的社会困境（捐赠博弈和公共物品博弈）中，机构奖励合作与惩罚背叛这两种激励措施对社会福利的影响。推导出社会福利的显式表达式，并刻画了其随激励效率和选择强度的变化规律，发现社会福利最大化的激励要么为零，要么集中在简单闭式目标附近，且存在多个局部最优的非单调区域。还推导出在给定预算下奖励优于惩罚的条件。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有工作通常将激励设计视为双目标问题（最小化成本同时实现高合作频率），但未系统研究这些方案是否最大化社会福利（总人口收益扣除机构支出）。本文填补这一空白。

papers.title: Inconsistency-Aware Minimization: Improving Generalization with Unlabeled Data
papers.abstract_en: Estimating the generalization gap and developing optimization methods that improve generalization are crucial for deep learning models, for both theoretical understanding and practical applications. Leveraging unlabeled data for these purposes offers significant advantages in real-world scenarios. This paper introduces a novel generalization measure, local inconsistency, derived from an information-geometric perspective on the parameter space of neural networks. A key feature of local inconsistency is that it can be computed without explicit labels. We establish theoretical underpinnings by connecting local inconsistency to the Fisher information matrix and the loss Hessian. Empirically, we demonstrate that local inconsistency correlates with the generalization gap. Based on these findings, we propose Inconsistency-Aware Minimization (IAM), which incorporates local inconsistency into the training objective. We demonstrate that in standard supervised learning settings, IAM enhances generalization, achieving performance comparable to that of existing methods such as Sharpness-Aware Minimization. Furthermore, IAM exhibits efficacy in semi- and self-supervised learning scenarios, where the local inconsistency is computed from unlabeled data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从信息几何视角提出一种新的泛化度量——局部不一致性 (local inconsistency)，该度量无需标签即可计算。理论上将其与Fisher信息矩阵和损失Hessian关联，实证表明其与泛化差距相关。基于此提出不一致性感知最小化 (IAM)，将局部不一致性纳入训练目标，在监督学习中达到与锐度感知最小化 (SAM) 相当的性能，并在半监督和自监督场景中有效。
Motivation: 利用无标签数据估计泛化差距并开发提升泛化的优化方法，对深度学习的理论和实际应用都具有重要意义。
Method: 从神经网络参数空间的信息几何角度导出局部不一致性度量，并将其与Fisher信息矩阵和损失Hessian建立理论联系；进一步提出IAM，将局部不一致性作为正则项加入训练目标。
Result: 局部不一致性与泛化差距存在相关性；在标准监督学习设置中IAM提升了泛化性能，与SAM可比；在半监督和自监督学习中，由于局部不一致性可由无标签数据计算，IAM也表现出有效性。
Conclusion: IAM能够利用无标签数据提升模型泛化能力，为半监督和自监督学习提供了新的优化手段。

papers.title: Generalized Intention Modeling in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Modeling an opponent's intent is critical for effective decision-making in non-cooperative, competitive, and general-sum multi-agent reinforcement learning. Existing opponent modeling methods encode intent using an embedding derived from episode information chosen a priori, such as the opponent's next action or a future environment state, and use this to guide the ego-agent's behavior. These approaches assume that the chosen information is universally representative of intent; however, we show empirically that this is not the case as intentions are often task- and environment-dependent. To address this, we introduce a task-adaptive opponent modeling framework that learns a performance-driven mixture of multiple intent representations. We further introduce a new intention representation that maximizes mutual information with the ego-agent's future returns, thereby capturing opponent information that is most directly relevant to performance. Our approach consistently matches or exceeds the performance of state-of-the-art baselines across diverse tasks and yields insights into when and why different opponent modeling strategies succeed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多智能体强化学习中对手意图建模的局限性，提出一种任务自适应的对手建模框架。该框架动态混合多种意图表征，并引入一种新的意图表征，通过最大化与智能体未来回报的互信息来捕捉最相关的对手信息。实验表明，该方法在多种任务上匹配或超越现有基线。
Motivation: 现有对手建模方法预先固定意图表征（如对手下一动作或未来环境状态），但实验显示这种固定假设并非通用，意图往往依赖于任务和环境。
Method: 提出任务自适应的对手建模框架，学习基于性能驱动的多种意图表征的混合。同时引入新的意图表征，通过最大化与智能体未来回报的互信息来捕捉对手信息。
Result: 该方法在多种任务上持续匹配或超越最先进基线，并揭示了不同对手建模策略何时及为何成功。
Conclusion: 自适应混合多种意图表征和最大化互信息的方法能更有效地建模对手意图，提升多智能体强化学习性能。

papers.title: Forgetting Has Neighbors: Localized Collateral Forgetting in Machine Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Machine unlearning aims to remove the influence of selected training examples without full retraining. Standard evaluations often summarize unlearning quality with aggregate metrics, such as accuracy- and forgetting-based scores, which can hide localized failures. We study this failure mode at the example level by comparing the predictions of an unlearned model to those of the model retrained after deletion. We show that this pointwise discrepancy can be highly non-uniform: for gradient-ascent and random-labeling methods, with and without retain-set fine-tuning, it grows with geometric proximity to the forget set. We call this phenomenon localized collateral forgetting. Our analysis identifies a mechanism behind the effect: surrogate targets used during unlearning can be inconsistent with the local prediction structure induced by retraining, and this inconsistency propagates through shared representations to nearby examples. Motivated by this mechanism, we propose Local Teacher Distillation, a simple mitigation strategy that replaces random targets with soft labels from a small teacher trained only on retained neighbors of the forget set. On CIFAR-100 partial-class deletion, this local teacher brings the unlearned model substantially closer to retraining, especially near the forget set, while maintaining competitive aggregate unlearning metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了机器遗忘中的局部化附带遗忘现象：对于梯度上升和随机标签方法，遗忘样本附近点的预测偏差随几何邻近度增大。提出局部教师蒸馏（Local Teacher Distillation）缓解策略，在CIFAR-100部分类删除任务上使遗忘模型更接近重新训练。
Motivation: 标准评估使用聚合指标可能隐藏局部失败，需要研究逐点不一致性，即遗忘模型与重训练模型预测差异的非均匀性。
Method: 通过比较遗忘模型与重训练模型的逐点预测差异，识别机制为替代目标与重训练局部预测结构不一致；提出局部教师蒸馏，用仅在遗忘集保留邻居上训练的小教师产生的软标签替换随机目标。
Result: 在CIFAR-100部分类删除上，局部教师蒸馏显著降低了接近遗忘集的预测偏差，同时保持聚合遗忘指标竞争力。
Conclusion: 强调关注局部化遗忘效应，并提供有效的缓解方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Graph Neural Networks Are Not Continuous Across Graph Resolutions
papers.abstract_en: We show that contrary to conventional wisdom in the community, graph neural networks (GNNs) are not continuous with respect to all natural modes of graph convergence. As a result, GNNs may generate substantially different latent representations for graphs that are very similar. In particular they assign vastly different latent embeddings to graphs that represent the same underlying object at different resolution scales. We trace this failure of continuity back to a structural obstruction arising from commonly used information-propagation schemes. Building on this insight we then derive a principled modification to standard GNN architectures which equips models with continuity across scales. The proposed modification enables consistent integration of distinct resolutions and reliable generalization between them. We systematically validate our theoretical findings in a wide range of numerical experiments.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明图神经网络（GNN）在自然图收敛模式下并非连续，导致相似图（尤其是不同分辨率下的同一对象）可能产生显著不同的潜在表示。作者将这种不连续性归因于常用信息传播方案的结构性障碍，并提出一种原则性修改，赋予模型跨尺度连续性，从而支持多分辨率的一致集成和泛化。数值实验验证了理论发现。
Motivation: 现有观点认为GNN具有连续性，但本文挑战这一观点，指出GNN在分辨率变化等自然图收敛模式下不连续，这限制了模型处理多尺度图数据的能力。
Method: 通过理论分析揭示GNN不连续性的根源——信息传播方案的结构性阻塞，并基于此提出一种修改标准GNN架构的方法，以恢复跨分辨率连续性。
Result: 理论证明了不连续性的存在，实验验证了修改后模型在跨尺度任务上具有更好的连续性和泛化能力。
Conclusion: GNN的连续性并非天然保证，需要针对特定收敛模式进行架构调整；本文的修改为多分辨率图分析提供了可靠基石。

papers.title: Learning from Fine-Grained Visual Discrepancies: Mitigating Multimodal Hallucinations via In-Context Visual Contrastive Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal hallucination remains a persistent challenge for Vision-Language Models (VLMs). Standard textual Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) often fails to mitigate it due to a lack of explicit visual supervision. While existing works introduce visual preference DPO by contrasting original images against negative ones, they suffer from a theoretically inconsistent objective caused by partition function mismatches and rely on coarse-grained negatives that could enable shortcut learning. In this work, we propose In-Context Visual Contrastive Optimization (IC-VCO). By placing contrastive images within a shared multi-image context, IC-VCO ensures a mathematically rigorous objective. We further introduce Visual Contrast Distillation (VCDist), an auxiliary reliability-gated regularizer that encourages consistency between multi-image contrastive training and single-image inference. Finally, we propose a contrastive sample editing strategy that generates hard negatives via precise semantic perturbations. Experiments on five benchmarks demonstrate IC-VCO's best overall performance and the effectiveness of our sample editing strategy. Code and data are available at https://github.com/OPPO-Mente-Lab/IC-VCO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态大模型的幻觉问题，提出基于上下文的视觉对比优化（IC-VCO）方法。通过将对比图像置于共享的多图上下文中，IC-VCO保证了数学上严谨的目标函数。此外引入视觉对比蒸馏（VCDist）作为可靠性门控正则化器，并设计对比样本编辑策略生成硬负样本。在五个基准上取得最佳总体性能。
Motivation: 现有视觉偏好DPO方法存在理论目标不一致（由于配分函数不匹配）和依赖粗粒度负样本导致捷径学习的问题。
Method: 提出IC-VCO，将对比图像置于共享多图上下文以解决目标不一致；提出VCDist正则化器以保持多图训练与单图推理的一致性；提出对比样本编辑策略通过精确语义扰动生成硬负样本。
Result: 在五个基准上取得最佳总体性能，并验证了样本编辑策略的有效性。
Conclusion: IC-VCO通过上下文视觉对比优化有效缓解多模态幻觉，且样本编辑策略能进一步提升性能。

papers.title: S$^3$LDBO: A Snapshot Single-Loop Algorithm for Decentralized Bilevel Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Networked AI systems increasingly rely on multiple agents that collaboratively learn and adapt models over communication networks. In such systems, bilevel formulations naturally arise in hyperparameter optimization, data cleaning, and meta-learning, but the repeated evaluation of gradients, Jacobians, and Hessians can impose a substantial computational burden on individual agents. To address this challenge, we propose Snapshot-SLDBO (S$^3$LDBO), an efficient single-loop decentralized bilevel optimization algorithm that enables agents to intermittently skip expensive derivative evaluations through a snapshot mechanism. This mechanism can be interpreted as an autonomous computation-adaptation strategy for networked AI, where agents selectively perform costly local updates while maintaining global collaborative learning. We establish the ergodic iteration complexity and the high probability nonergodic iteration complexity of the proposed algorithm within a deterministic setting. Experimental results on hyperparameter optimization with synthetic and MNIST datasets, data hyper-cleaning on Fashion-MNIST, and decentralized meta-learning on miniImageNet demonstrate that the proposed algorithm improves computational efficiency while maintaining competitive learning performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种快照单环去中心化双层优化算法（S$^3$LDBO），允许智能体间歇跳过昂贵的导数评估，在保持全局协作学习的同时降低计算负担。在超参数优化、数据超清洗和去中心化元学习任务上，实验表明该算法提高了计算效率且保持了竞争力。
Motivation: 去中心化AI系统中，双层优化问题（如超参数优化）的梯度、雅可比和海森矩阵重复评估给单个智能体带来巨大计算负担。
Method: 提出S$^3$LDBO，一种单环去中心化双层优化算法，通过快照机制使智能体选择性跳过昂贵的局部更新，实现自主计算适应策略。
Result: 在确定性设置下建立了遍历迭代复杂度和高概率非遍历迭代复杂度；在超参数优化（合成数据和MNIST）、数据超清洗（Fashion-MNIST）和去中心化元学习（miniImageNet）上，提高了计算效率并保持了竞争力。
Conclusion: 该算法通过快照机制降低了计算负担，适用于网络化AI中的双层优化问题。

summary_sections.result: 在确定性设置下建立了遍历迭代复杂度和高概率非遍历迭代复杂度；在超参数优化（合成数据和MNIST）、数据超清洗（Fashion-MNIST）和去中心化元学习（miniImageNet）上，提高了计算效率并保持了竞争力。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该算法通过快照机制降低了计算负担，适用于网络化AI中的双层优化问题。

papers.title: Non-Asymptotic Convergence of Stochastic Iterative Algorithms: A Lyapunov Framework
papers.abstract_en: We survey Lyapunov-based techniques for the finite-time analysis of stochastic iterative algorithms, also known as stochastic approximation (SA) algorithms, for solving fixed-point equations $\bar{F}(x)=x$, where the operator $\bar{F}(\cdot)$ can only be accessed through a noisy oracle. We first focus on the standard setting in which $\bar{F}(\cdot)$ is contractive with respect to some norm and the noise is i.i.d., and explain how generalized Moreau envelopes serve as universal Lyapunov functions, regardless of the underlying norm. We then show how this framework yields mean-square convergence guarantees and applies to stochastic gradient descent, linear SA, and value-based reinforcement learning algorithms such as Q-learning and temporal-difference learning. Finally, we discuss extensions to Markovian noise, seminorm-contractive operators, dissipative operators, and high-probability bounds, and conclude with open problems. The goal is to present a unified and self-contained roadmap for the finite-time analysis of SA and its applications, especially in reinforcement learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文综述了基于李雅普诺夫（Lyapunov）方法的随机迭代算法（即随机逼近）的有限时间分析，重点介绍了广义Moreau包络作为通用李雅普诺夫函数，在算子收缩且噪声独立同分布的标准设定下，给出了均方收敛性保证，并应用于随机梯度下降、线性随机逼近以及Q学习和时序差分学习等强化学习算法。此外，还讨论了向马尔可夫噪声、半范数收缩算子、耗散算子以及高概率界的扩展，并指出了开放问题。
Motivation: 随机逼近算法的有限时间分析缺乏统一框架，现有结果分散且依赖特定假设，本文旨在提供一个自包含的路线图，统一分析各种设定下的收敛速度。
Method: 利用广义Moreau包络构造通用李雅普诺夫函数，适用于不同范数下的收缩算子，通过分析该函数的期望下降得到均方收敛界，并扩展到非独立同分布噪声和更一般的算子类别。
Result: 建立了随机逼近算法在标准设定下的均方收敛率，并展示了该框架统一覆盖了SGD、线性SA、Q-learning和TD学习等经典算法。
Conclusion: 本文为随机迭代算法的非渐近分析提供了系统性的李雅普诺夫框架，并指出进一步扩展（如考虑耗散算子和高概率界）是未来研究方向。

papers.title: TraceGraph: Shared Decision Landscapes for Diagnosing and Improving Agent Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: Agent benchmarks increasingly record rich interaction trajectories, yet evaluation often reduces each rollout to a pass rate or reward score. We introduce TraceGraph, a graph-based framework that turns released multi-model agent trajectories into shared decision landscapes. For each task, TraceGraph builds a graph over observable action-observation states from pooled rollouts before model identity is introduced. It then overlays outcome-informed productive cores and trap regions, and summarizes each rollout with three events: Access, Trap exposure, and Repair. Across trajectories spanning five benchmark splits, TraceGraph profiles reveal navigation differences hidden by aggregate scores and show that splits differ in whether they reward avoiding traps or recovering from them. The same TraceGraph landscape also motivates a trap-aware recovery pipeline for SWE-bench: aruntime detector fires on states matching historical trap regions, then lightweight continuation policies are evaluated from the same prefix. On fired states, the best pooled single-factor policy raises official resolved rate from 40.4% to 43.5% on the per-provider fired subset and from 41.0% to 44.8% on common-fired instances, with provider-specific active components. Overall, TraceGraph provides a process vocabulary for asking what agent benchmarks test, where models diverge on a shared landscape, and how failure regions can guide downstream improvement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TraceGraph，一个基于图的框架，将多个智能体（agent）在任务中的轨迹（interaction trajectories）转化为共享的决策景观（shared decision landscapes）。TraceGraph 从轨迹池中构建动作-观测状态图，标识出高产核心区和陷阱区域（trap regions），并用三种事件（Access、Trap exposure、Repair）总结每条轨迹。在五个 benchmark split 上的分析显示，aggregate scores 掩盖了导航差异，且不同 split 在奖励避免陷阱还是从陷阱恢复上存在区别。此外，基于 TraceGraph 的陷阱感知恢复流程在 SWE-bench 上，对触发状态使用轻量级延续策略，将官方解决率从 40.4% 提升至 43.5% 及 41.0% 至 44.8%。
Motivation: 现有 agent benchmark 通常仅用 pass rate 或 reward score 评估轨迹，忽视了轨迹过程中的行为差异和失败模式，缺乏对模型行为差异及任务本质的诊断工具。
Method: TraceGraph 首先收集多个模型在任务中的轨迹，构建基于可观察动作-观测状态的图结构，并在引入模型身份前，从合并轨迹中挖掘出 outcome-informed 的高产核心区和陷阱区域。每个轨迹被总结为三类事件：进入高产区域（Access）、暴露于陷阱（Trap exposure）以及修复（Repair）。
Result: 在五个 benchmark split 上，TraceGraph 的分析揭示了 aggregate scores 无法显示的导航差异，并发现不同 split 对避免陷阱和从陷阱恢复的奖励不同。在 SWE-bench 上，基于陷阱区域的检测和轻量级延续策略，官方解决率在触发子集上从 40.4% 提升至 43.5%（per-provider fired subset）以及从 41.0% 提升至 44.8%（common-fired instances）。
Conclusion: TraceGraph 提供了一个过程词汇表（process vocabulary），用于探究 agent benchmark 测试了什么、模型在共享决策景观上何处存在分歧，以及失败区域如何指导下游改进。

papers.title: Interpretability Without Tradeoffs: Disentangling Polysemanticity At Equal Predictive Performance
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks (DNNs) are widely used, but interpreting what they actually learn remains difficult. A major obstacle is that individual neurons often encode multiple unrelated concepts, obscuring the decision process of the network. While prior work, such as sparse autoencoders, can separate these mixed signals into more meaningful, "monosemantic" features, this typically requires altering the model in ways that can degrade downstream performance. To overcome this, we introduce ELUDe (explicit, lossless, unsupervised disentanglement), a method for improving the interpretability of DNNs while preserving their functional equivalence. ELUDe breaks latent representations into clear, inspectable sub-units that behave like interpretable features, while guaranteeing that the model's outputs remain exactly the same. It requires no explicit training, no labels, and can be applied to pretrained models. ELUDe works by reorganizing how information flows between layers, re-routing concept-specific contributions while preserving the original computation by construction. Across several vision models, including DINOv2 and supervised ViT-B/16, ELUDe improves interpretability, keeps downstream accuracy unchanged, runs efficiently, and supports practical uses such as steering model representations. In short, ELUDe offers interpretability (almost) without a tradeoff: clearer, scalable, and actionable model insights with no loss in performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ELUDe（显式、无损、无监督解缠）方法，用于在不改变神经网络输出的前提下提高其可解释性。ELUDe通过重新组织层间信息流，将多语义神经元分解为可检查的单语义子单元，无需训练或标签即可应用于预训练模型。在DINOv2和ViT-B/16等视觉模型上，ELUDe保持下游准确率不变，同时提升可解释性并支持模型操控。
Motivation: 深度神经网络神经元常编码多个不相关概念（多语义性），阻碍模型解释。现有方法如稀疏自编码器虽能分离信号，但可能降低下游性能，亟需一种不牺牲性能的解缠方法。
Method: ELUDe通过对预训练模型进行显式、无损、无监督的信息流重组，将潜在表示分解为清晰的可检查子单元，保证输出函数完全等价，且无需额外训练或标签。
Result: 在包括DINOv2和有监督ViT-B/16的多个视觉模型上，ELUDe在保持下游任务准确率不变的同时，显著提升可解释性，运行高效，并支持表示操控等实用功能。
Conclusion: ELUDe提供了一种几乎无权衡的可解释性增强方案，在保持性能的前提下实现清晰、可扩展且可操作的模型洞察。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MoE-dqINR: A Unified Mixture-of-Experts Implicit Neural Representation Framework for Scan-Specific Dynamic and Quantitative MRI Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Undersampled magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) reconstruction seeks to recover temporally or contrast-varying image series from incomplete multicoil k-space data while preserving state-dependent fidelity for dynamic and quantitative MRI (qMRI). Existing scan-specific implicit neural representations (INRs) often use monolithic spatiotemporal coordinate fields, explicit subspaces, motion or deformation models, calibration variables, or sequence-specific quantitative signal models. These design choices can limit flexibility in sharing spatial information while adapting image synthesis across acquisition states. Moreover, many INR-based baselines remain computationally demanding, typically requiring per-scan optimization times on the order of hundreds to thousands of seconds. We propose MoE-dqINR, a scan-specific multicoil MRI reconstruction framework that factorizes the image-domain representation into shared spatial experts and a state-conditioned routing pathway. Spatial experts encode reusable coordinate-dependent image content, whereas routing weights, conditioned on ordered acquisition states, synthesize each dynamic frame or contrast state from a common expert bank. The representation is coupled to a multicoil MRI forward model, uses the normalized state index to drive routing in both dynamic and quantitative MRI. By separating shared spatial representation from state-dependent synthesis, the framework provides an image-first architecture for dynamic and quantitative MRI while reducing scan-specific INR optimization to approximately 30 s per scan in our experiments. The proposed formulation establishes state-conditioned mixture-of-experts INR as a scan-specific multicoil MRI reconstruction prior that unifies shared spatial representation, dynamic- and qMRI-specific synthesis, and practical per-scan efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出MoE-dqINR框架，用于扫描特定多线圈动态和定量MRI重建。通过将图像域表示分解为共享空间专家（spatial experts）和状态条件路由（state-conditioned routing），结合多线圈MRI前向模型，实现了高效重建。实验中将优化时间缩短至每扫描约30秒。
Motivation: 现有扫描特定隐式神经表示（INR）方法采用整体时空坐标场、显式子空间或运动模型，缺乏灵活性且计算开销大（每扫描数百至数千秒）。
Method: 提出MoE-dqINR，将图像域表示分解为共享空间专家和状态条件路由。空间专家编码可复用的坐标相关图像内容，路由权重根据有序采集状态动态合成每个动态帧或对比状态。与多线圈MRI前向模型耦合，使用归一化状态索引驱动路由。
Result: 实验表明，该框架将扫描特定INR优化时间减少至每扫描约30秒。
Conclusion: 建立了状态条件混合专家INR（MoE-dqINR）作为扫描特定多线圈MRI重建先验，统一了共享空间表示、动态与定量MRI合成及实际每扫描效率。

papers.title: mRNAutilus: Multi-Objective-Guided Discrete Generation of mRNA with Optimized Therapeutic Properties
papers.abstract_en: Therapeutic mRNA design requires coordinating multiple interacting sequence features across the full transcript, where codon usage, untranslated regions (UTRs), and their coupling jointly determine stability, translation efficiency, and protein expression. Here, we present mRNA generation via unrolled trajectories and informed latent updates (mRNAutilus), a framework for simultaneous codon optimization and de novo UTR design directly from sequence. mRNAutilus combines a masked discrete diffusion model trained on millions of full-length mRNAs with Monte Carlo Tree Guidance to generate Pareto-efficient sequences under multiple functional objectives, using lightweight regressors over model embeddings to predict half-life, translation efficiency, and protein abundance. Unlike recent methods that design coding sequences and UTRs separately or rely on post hoc assembly and screening, mRNAutilus generates complete transcripts in a single process optimized across properties. Across diverse targets, zero-shot mRNAs encoding P. pyralis luciferase achieve over 400-fold higher expression than wild-type and outperform commercial and machine learning-designed baselines, including zero-shot generative approaches. Zero-shot SARS-CoV-2 Spike mRNAs exceed clinically used and commercial constructs and match or surpass lab-optimized designs with improved durability. We further demonstrate generality in therapeutic settings, including prime editing (PEMax) and programmable proteome modulation, where mRNAutilus-designed constructs enhance expression of peptide-guided E3 ligases (uAbs) for beta-catenin degradation. These results establish a sequence-based, multi-objective framework for generating functional mRNAs tailored to diverse biological applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出mRNAutilus，一个基于掩码离散扩散模型和蒙特卡洛树引导的多目标优化框架，用于同时进行密码子优化和从头设计UTR，以生成具有优化治疗特性的完整mRNA转录本。摘要显示，零样本生成的荧光素酶mRNA表达比野生型高400倍以上，SARS-CoV-2 Spike mRNA优于临床和商业设计，并在prime editing和蛋白降解等治疗场景中验证了通用性。
Motivation: 现有mRNA设计方法通常分别优化编码序列和UTR，或依赖事后组装和筛选，无法同时协调多个相互作用的序列特征。
Method: 结合掩码离散扩散模型（在数百万全长mRNA上训练）与蒙特卡洛树引导（Monte Carlo Tree Guidance），使用基于模型嵌入的轻量级回归器预测半衰期、翻译效率和蛋白丰度，直接生成Pareto高效的完整转录本。
Result: 零样本P. pyralis荧光素酶mRNA表达比野生型高400倍以上，SARS-CoV-2 Spike mRNA优于临床和商业设计，并匹配或超越实验室优化设计。在prime editing和uAbs介导的β-catenin降解中，mRNAutilus设计的构建体增强了蛋白表达。
Conclusion: 该框架展示了基于序列的多目标优化可直接生成功能mRNA，无需后处理，适用于多种生物应用。

summary_sections.method: 结合掩码离散扩散模型（在数百万全长mRNA上训练）与蒙特卡洛树引导（Monte Carlo Tree Guidance），使用基于模型嵌入的轻量级回归器预测半衰期、翻译效率和蛋白丰度，直接生成Pareto高效的完整转录本。
summary_sections.result: 零样本P. pyralis荧光素酶mRNA表达比野生型高400倍以上，SARS-CoV-2 Spike mRNA优于临床和商业设计，并匹配或超越实验室优化设计。在prime editing和uAbs介导的β-catenin降解中，mRNAutilus设计的构建体增强了蛋白表达。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架展示了基于序列的多目标优化可直接生成功能mRNA，无需后处理，适用于多种生物应用。

papers.title: Latent Space Disentanglement via Activation Steering for Interpretable Attribute Control in Symbolic Music Generation
papers.abstract_en: Transformer-based architectures have significantly advanced the generation of complex symbolic sequences, yet a significant gap remains in achieving fine-grained, interpretable control over discrete signal attributes. This paper investigates the mechanistic interpretability of the Multitrack Music Transformer (MMT) and proposes a framework for deterministic attribute modulation without retraining to bridge this gap via inference-time activation steering. Utilizing the Difference-in-Means (DiffMean) methodology, we isolate latent directions for signal attributes, specifically Pitch and Duration, within the residual stream. We validate the Linear Representation Hypothesis in this domain, achieving high correlation between steering magnitude and attribute shift. To address the inherent feature entanglement in multi-attribute steering, we introduce a Dual Steering framework utilizing Gram-Schmidt Orthogonalization. Experimental results demonstrate that this geometric decoupling reduces conceptual interference and signal degradation compared to naive vector addition, enabling independent deterministic control even against strong autoregressive conditioning.
papers.comment: Accepted at EUSIPCO 2026 (34th European Signal Processing Conference), 5 pages, 2 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于Transformer的符号音乐生成中缺乏细粒度、可解释属性控制的问题，提出了一种推理时激活操控框架。通过对Multitrack Music Transformer的残差流应用DiffMean方法，分离出音高和时值等属性的潜方向，并引入基于Gram-Schmidt正交化的双重操控策略实现多属性解耦。实验表明该方法能在强自回归条件下实现独立确定性控制，减少概念干扰和信号退化。
Motivation: 现有Transformer架构在符号音乐生成中虽然性能优越，但难以实现细粒度、可解释的离散信号属性控制，且多属性操控时存在特征纠缠问题。
Method: 基于机械可解释性的DiffMean方法提取属性方向，并利用Gram-Schmidt正交化构建双重操控框架，在推理时对残差流进行几何解耦的激活操控。
Result: 摘要报告了操控幅度与属性偏移之间的高相关性，且相比朴素向量加法，Gram-Schmidt正交化显著降低了概念干扰和信号退化，实现了独立确定性的多属性控制。
Conclusion: 论文表明无需重新训练即可通过推理时激活操控实现符号音乐生成中可解释的属性调制，为后续可解释控制研究提供了几何解耦思路。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TokTalk: Expressive Real-time Facial Animation from Audio-LLM Tokens
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Audio-LLMs like GPT-4o have ushered in an era of conversational interaction with language models. Conversational avatars however, still seem robotic in facial expression and conversational flow, in part due to sequential stages of speech recognition, text generation, turn-based text response, speech synthesis, and audio driven facial animation. Based on our insight that audio-tokens produced by current Audio-LLMs carry sufficient information to reconstruct a plausible facial performance, we present TokTalk, a system that directly outputs expressive facial animation in real-time from streaming audio-tokens. We construct a novel audio-token to 3D facial motion dataset, on which TokTalk is trained using a Chunk-based Conditional Flow Matching model. A lightweight adaptation strategy allows our trained model to seamlessly connect to any token-based Audio-LLM at minimal computational overhead. Our chunk-based processing further enables parametric trade-off between latency and facial quality, shown through ablation studies. We further show that the real-time performance of TokTalk is comparable in latency to prior art solutions, and significantly favorable (via a perceptual study) in terms of quality, expressivity and control of the 3D facial performance. We showcase TokTalk's flexibility using a chatbot Avatar, a voice-driven user Avatar, and an animation Director's interface, as diverse audio-visual face applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TokTalk，一种从音频-LLM标记流式生成实时3D面部动画的系统。通过构建音频标记到3D面部运动数据集，并采用基于块的连续条件流匹配模型训练，实现了低延迟和高表达力的面部动画。实验表明，TokTalk在延迟上与先前方法相当，而在质量、表现力和控制性上显著优于现有方案，并展示了在聊天机器人、语音驱动用户头像和动画师界面中的应用。
Motivation: 当前对话式头像在面部表情和对话流程上显得机械，部分原因是需要依次进行语音识别、文本生成、语音合成和音频驱动动画等多个阶段。作者认为音频-LLM标记已包含足够信息来重建合理面部表演，因此希望跳过中间步骤直接生成动画。
Method: 构建音频标记到3D面部运动数据集，并采用Chunk-based Conditional Flow Matching模型进行训练。通过轻量级适应策略，模型可无缝连接到任何基于标记的音频-LLM，并实现延迟与面部质量之间的参数化权衡。
Result: 实时性能在延迟上与先前方法相当，而在质量、表现力和控制性上通过感知研究显著更优。消融研究验证了块处理带来的延迟-质量权衡。
Conclusion: TokTalk展示了直接从音频-LLM标记生成实时面部动画的可行性，为对话式头像提供了一种更高效、表达力更强的方案，并具备多种音频-视觉面部应用的灵活性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Authentication of Copy Detection Patterns via Cross-Camera Dual-Synthetic Referencing
papers.abstract_en: Copy Detection Patterns (CDPs) are structures printed on physical objects to enable cost-effective authentication. Verification is achieved by comparing a captured image with the digital template from which the CDP was printed. In practice, printer stochasticity and camera distortions hinder this comparison, limiting robustness against counterfeiting. Prior work addressed camera effects by synthesising reference images in the verification camera domain, but it ignored printing variability. We introduce an enrolment-based cross-camera dual-synthetic referencing framework. Each printed CDP is first captured by a controlled enrolment camera, and a deep-learning-based translator jointly exploits the digital template and the enrolled capture to generate a high-quality reference for the verification image. We provide an information-theoretic justification showing that the dual reference is more informative than template-based references. Experiments on heterogeneous mobile cameras demonstrate improved authentication performance, robustness to machine-learning-based copy attacks, and reliable verification from small CDP regions and on low-end devices.
papers.comment: To appear in Proc. ICIP2026, September 13-17, 2026, Tampere, Finland
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于注册的跨相机双合成参考框架，用于复制检测模式（CDP）的认证。通过受控注册相机捕获每个印刷CDP，利用深度学习翻译器结合数字模板和注册捕获生成高质量的验证参考图像。信息论分析表明双参考比基于模板的参考更具信息量。实验在异构移动相机上展示了改进的认证性能和对机器学习复制攻击的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有CDP认证方法受限于打印机随机性和相机畸变，仅考虑相机效应而忽略了打印可变性，限制了防伪鲁棒性。
Method: 提出注册式跨相机双合成参考框架：先用受控注册相机捕获印刷CDP的数字图像，再通过深度学习翻译器结合原始数字模板和注册捕获生成验证域的高质量参考。
Result: 摘要报告在异构移动相机上认证性能提升，对基于机器学习的复制攻击具有鲁棒性，并且能从小的CDP区域和低端设备上实现可靠验证。
Conclusion: 摘要未明确说明局限性，但强调双参考框架的信息论优势及其实际部署潜力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Contextual Scalarisation Thompson Sampling for multi-objective decisions in public media
papers.abstract_en: Recommender systems may operate under multiple, competing objectives. For example, audience reach, cultural values, public service mandate, and operational constraints must be balanced in editorial decisions of public service media. Existing approaches relying on fixed combinations of objectives or Pareto-based optimisation do not adapt to changing priorities across situations. In this paper, we propose Contextual Scalarisation Thompson Sampler (CSTS), a multi-objective contextual bandit method that learns to weight objectives as a function of the observed context. We evaluate CSTS on real programming data from Radio Télévision Suisse, the Swiss national broadcaster, showing improved contextual relevance and better alignment with expert curation practices compared to fixed weight and standard contextual bandit approaches.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Submitted-manuscript version of a paper accepted at ICPR 2026. The Version of Record will be published in the Springer Lecture Notes in Computer Science series; DOI will be added when available
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对公共媒体推荐系统中多目标权衡问题，提出上下文标量化汤普森采样器（CSTS），一种学习根据上下文动态加权目标的多目标上下文赌博机方法。在瑞士广播公司实际节目数据上评估，相比固定权重和标准上下文赌博机方法，CSTS提升了上下文相关性和与专家策展实践的一致性。
Motivation: 现有推荐系统使用固定目标组合或基于帕累托优化的方法无法适应不同情境下优先级的动态变化，尤其不适合需要平衡受众覆盖、文化价值、公共服务使命和运营约束的公共媒体编辑决策。
Method: 提出Contextual Scalarisation Thompson Sampler (CSTS)，一种多目标上下文赌博机算法，将目标加权作为观测上下文的函数进行学习，通过汤普森采样平衡探索与利用。
Result: 在Radio Télévision Suisse实际节目数据上，CSTS相比固定权重和标准上下文赌博机方法，在上下文相关性和与专家策展对齐方面取得改进。
Conclusion: CSTS能够根据上下文动态调整目标权重，更适合公共媒体中多变的多目标决策需求。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Terminal Representation in Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Representation learning is a powerful tool for spatio-temporal abstraction within reinforcement learning (RL). Two well established approaches are through the successor representation (SR) and the default representation (DR). The SR encodes states by the future trajectories they induce, capturing information flow decoupled from reward. The DR builds on this by weighting trajectories with reward, integrating credit-assignment structure into the representation. Eigenvectors of both representations have been used to support a range of downstream tasks -- including option discovery, reward shaping, transfer learning, and exploration. We introduce a structurally distinct formulation: the terminal representation (TR). The TR encodes reward-weighted trajectories similarly to the DR, but can be learned as a lower-dimensionality object, and can be used directly for the mentioned applications without eigenvector computations. Eigendecomposition also imposes the assumption of symmetric transition dynamics, which the TR can bypass. In this work we develop the theoretical foundations of the TR: its derivation, convergence of two learning algorithms, its use for zero-shot compositionality, and equivalences between alternative reward formulations. We further show the TR is embedded in the top DR eigenvector, allowing it to capture the same underlying knowledge without eigendecomposition. Additionally, we provide empirical evidence of the TR as a viable alternative to existing representations in subsidiary applications, while requiring less computational overhead to learn, store, and use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出强化学习中一种新的状态表示——终端表示（TR），它编码奖励加权轨迹，无需特征分解即可直接用于选项发现、奖励塑形、迁移学习和探索等下游任务。理论部分包括推导、学习算法收敛性、零样本组合性以及与其他表示的关系，实验表明TR在降低计算开销的同时可作为现有表示的可行替代。
Motivation: 现有的后继表示（SR）和默认表示（DR）依赖特征分解，假设对称转移动力学，计算开销较大。本文旨在设计一种更高效的表示，避免特征分解且保持相同的下游任务适用性。
Method: 定义终端表示（TR）为奖励加权轨迹的编码，可直接通过两个学习算法（如基于TD学习）收敛获得；无需特征分解，且与DR的最大特征向量等价。
Result: 摘要报告TR在理论性质上与DR等价，但维度更低、无需特征分解；实验显示在辅助应用中学习、存储和使用开销更小。
Conclusion: TR是强化学习中一种新的、计算高效的表示，可替代SR和DR进行多种下游任务，但摘要未提及在复杂环境中的性能极限或与大规模任务的兼容性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Neither Replacement nor Panacea: Comparing LLM-Based Conversational and Graphical Decision Support in Industrial Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Managers in manufacturing settings rely on digital interfaces to interpret operational data for decision-making, but growing data volume and complexity can make relevant insights difficult to identify efficiently. While dashboards remain dominant in industrial contexts, Large Language Model (LLM)-based conversational agents (CAs), accessed through conversational user interfaces (CUIs), may provide more direct access to such data. However, their effectiveness may depend on the information-processing demands of the task. This study compares an LLM-based CA delivered through a CUI with a dashboard in a manufacturing decision-support scenario. In a mixed factorial experiment with a 2x3 design, 134 industrial decision-makers were assigned to one interface condition and completed three tasks of increasing complexity. We examined perceived Mental Workload (MWL), decision accuracy, completion time, and intended reliance, and tested self-reported data literacy as a moderator. Results showed that the CUI reduced perceived MWL overall and supported faster completion in less demanding tasks, but both advantages diminished as task complexity increased. Neither interface produced a consistent overall advantage in decision accuracy, and the CUI was not preferred as a sole basis for subsequent decisions. Furthermore, data literacy did not reliably moderate interface effects. These findings indicate that conversational interaction offers conditional rather than universal benefits for industrial decision support. LLM-based CAs may reduce information-access effort, whereas complex decisions continue to benefit from persistent, inspectable visual representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过 134 名工业决策者的混合因子实验，比较了基于 LLM 的对话式界面 (CUI) 与传统仪表盘在制造决策支持中的效果。实验发现，CUI 在低复杂性任务中降低了感知心理负荷并加快了完成时间，但随着任务复杂性增加，优势消失；在决策准确性上两者无一致优势，CUI 未被偏好作为后续决策的唯一依据。
Motivation: 制造管理者依赖数字界面解读运营数据，但数据量和复杂性增长使洞察难以高效获取。仪表盘仍占主导，而基于 LLM 的对话式代理可能提供更直接的数据访问，但其有效性可能取决于任务的信息处理需求。
Method: 采用 2×3 混合因子设计，134 名工业决策者被分配至对话式界面 (CUI) 或仪表盘条件，完成三个复杂度递增的任务。测量感知心理负荷 (MWL)、决策准确性、完成时间、预期依赖，并测试数据素养作为调节变量。
Result: CUI 在低复杂度任务中显著降低感知 MWL 并加快完成时间，但这些优势随任务复杂度增加而消失。两种界面在决策准确性上无一致差异，且 CUI 未被选择作为后续决策的唯一基础。数据素养未可靠地调节界面效应。
Conclusion: 对话式交互在工业决策支持中提供的是条件性而非普遍性优势：LLM 代理可降低信息获取努力，但复杂决策仍需持久、可检查的视觉表示。

papers.title: DeMaVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Foundation Model for Generalizable Deformable Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Real-world household robots require Vision-Language-Action (VLA) foundation models that can acquire reusable manipulation skills across diverse objects, task conditions, and household environments. Deformable-object folding is a representative challenge, requiring robots to handle clothing items from random initial states across varying categories, geometries, materials, and scenes. However, existing VLA systems commonly train separate policies for different object categories, while naively mixed multi-task training often suffers from task interference and degraded performance. To move beyond category-specific folding policies, we introduce DeMaVLA, a VLA foundation model for generalizable Deformable Manipulation. DeMaVLA adopts a VLM backbone with an action expert and formulates continuous action generation using flow matching. To improve efficiency, the action expert is constructed by pruning every other transformer layer while preserving layer-wise alignment with the VLM backbone, reducing training and inference cost. DeMaVLA is first pre-trained on approximately 5,000 hours of selected real-world dual-arm demonstrations to acquire general manipulation priors. It is then post-trained on mixed folding data that aggregates self-collected demonstrations and corrective trajectories from real-robot failures across multiple folding tasks through a human-in-the-loop Data Aggregation~(DAgger) pipeline. Experiments show that DeMaVLA achieves competitive performance on RoboTwin and strong real-world results on our household folding benchmark. These results highlight the value of scalable real-world data, efficient action generation, and corrective learning for general-purpose VLA policies in deformable-object manipulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DeMaVLA，一个视觉-语言-动作（VLA）基础模型，用于可变形物体操作（如折叠衣物）。该模型采用 VLM 骨干网络和基于流匹配（flow matching）的连续动作生成，通过剪枝一半 Transformer 层构建高效动作专家，并在约5000小时的真实双手机器人演示数据上预训练，再通过人类参与的 DAgger 数据聚合进行后训练。实验在 RoboTwin 和家庭折叠基准上取得有竞争力的结果，展示了大规模真实数据、高效动作生成和纠正学习对通用 VLA 策略的价值。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 系统通常为不同物体类别训练独立策略，而混合多任务训练会遭遇任务干扰和性能下降。需要超越类别特定的折叠策略，实现可泛化的可变形物体操作。
Method: 采用 VLM 骨干网络与动作专家（action expert）架构，动作专家通过每隔一层 Transformer 层进行剪枝并与 VLM 骨干保持层对齐来构建，降低训练和推理成本。动作生成使用流匹配（flow matching）进行连续动作建模。先在约5000小时的真实双手机器人演示数据上预训练，再在混合折叠数据上通过人类参与的 DAgger 管道进行后训练。
Result: 在 RoboTwin 和家庭折叠基准上取得具有竞争力的实验结果。
Conclusion: 展示了大规模真实数据、高效动作生成和纠正学习对于通用 VLA 策略在可变形物体操作中的价值。

papers.title: SAM for Robust Mitochondria Instance Segmentation in Fluorescence Microscopy
papers.abstract_en: The morphological analysis of mitochondria in fluorescence microscopy (FM) is crucial for understanding cellular health, energy production, and metabolic regulation. While foundation models like the Segment Anything Model (SAM) have revolutionized natural image segmentation, their direct application to FM is hindered by a significant domain shift characterized by diffraction-limited resolution, low contrast, and complex overlapping organelle networks. Furthermore, the development of robust models is bottlenecked by a severe lack of high-quality, manually annotated instance segmentation datasets for mitochondria. In this paper, we propose a scalable solution to this data scarcity by finetuning SAM exclusively on synthetically generated FM data. We simulate realistic mitochondria data and emulate the optical properties of fluorescence microscopes to create a large-scale annotated dataset. We evaluate our fine-tuned model on a curated dataset of real, manually annotated FM images. Qualitative and quantitative analyses demonstrate that our synthetically fine-tuned model improves precision and average dice score over strong baselines. This work establishes the potential of simulation-assisted training for FM instance segmentation.

papers.title: Topologically Consistent Multi-view 3D Head Reconstruction via Coarse-Guided Layered Surface Sampling
papers.abstract_en: We present SHELLS (Semantic Head Estimation via Layered Local Sampling), an efficient feed-forward framework for 3D head reconstruction in dense semantic correspondence from multi-view images. Existing methods typically refine vertices independently via localized feature volumes. This approach couples memory-intensive feature sampling to mesh resolution, which limits scalability for dense topologies (> 10k vertices) and introduces surface noise. In contrast, SHELLS decouples feature extraction from mesh resolution via a hierarchical sampling strategy. We extract multi-view features using a DINOv2 backbone with LoRA adaptation, projectively sample a sparse global feature cloud, and predict an intermediate coarse mesh. This coarse prior guides the construction of layered, surface-aware sampling shells that serve as a discrete search space for the final reconstruction. SHELLS maintains surface consistency while using 88% less inference GPU memory (2.4GB vs. 20GB) than volumetric baselines. It reduces median registration error by 21% to 29% with a 3.5x inference speedup (0.08s vs. 0.29s) for 18k-vertex meshes. Notably, our model is trained exclusively on synthetic data yet generalizes effectively to real-world captures, eliminating the need for the costly, pre-registered multi-view datasets common in prior work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了SHELLS，一个前馈框架，用于从多视图图像重建具有密集语义对应的3D头部。通过层级采样策略解耦特征提取与网格分辨率，利用DINOv2和LoRA提取多视图特征，预测粗糙网格，然后构建分层表面感知采样壳进行精细重建。相比体积基线，GPU内存减少88%，注册误差降低21-29%，推理速度提升3.5倍。模型仅用合成数据训练，能泛化到真实数据。
Motivation: 现有方法将特征采样与网格分辨率耦合，导致内存消耗大，难以扩展到密集拓扑（>10k顶点），并引入表面噪声。需要一种可扩展且高效的3D头部重建方法。
Method: 提出层级采样策略：先用DINOv2+LoRA提取多视图特征，投影采样稀疏全局特征云预测中间粗糙网格；然后基于粗糙先验构建分层表面感知采样壳，作为最终重建的离散搜索空间。
Result: 在18k顶点网格上，SHELLS使用2.4GB GPU内存（vs 20GB），推理时间0.08s（vs 0.29s），中值注册误差降低21%-29%。
Conclusion: SHELLS通过层级采样解耦特征提取与网格分辨率，在内存和速度上显著提升，并且仅用合成数据训练即可泛化到真实场景。

papers.title: Practical Cross-Band Channel Prediction for AI-RAN via Physics-Guided Deep Unfolding
papers.abstract_en: To make cross-band channel prediction practical for AI-native RAN, algorithms must generalize across diverse environments and support real-time inference. Existing approaches achieve one but not both. To bridge this gap, we introduce GUIDE, a physics-guided deep unfolding framework that embeds wireless channel physics into differentiable layers. Without retraining in unseen environments, GUIDE achieves 2.75x beamforming gain than the deep learning-based baseline FIRE with only a slight increase in inference time, and 1.39x beamforming gain than the strongest model-based baseline R2F2 while running over 1610x faster.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GUIDE，一种物理引导的深度展开框架，用于AI-RAN中的跨频段信道预测。通过将无线信道物理嵌入可微层，GUIDE无需在未知环境中重新训练即可实现跨环境泛化，并支持实时推理。在实验中，GUIDE相比深度学习基线FIRE获得2.75倍波束赋形增益，仅略微增加推理时间；相比最强模型基线R2F2获得1.39倍增益，同时运行速度快1610倍。
Motivation: 现有跨频段信道预测方法要么无法跨环境泛化，要么推理速度慢，难以同时满足AI-RAN的实际部署需求。
Method: 提出物理引导的深度展开框架GUIDE，将无线信道传播的物理模型嵌入网络的可微分层，使得模型能在未见环境中直接泛化，无需微调。
Result: 在跨频段信道预测任务中，GUIDE的波束赋形增益比深度学习基线FIRE高2.75倍，推理时间仅略有增加；比模型基线R2F2高1.39倍，推理速度快1610倍。
Conclusion: GUIDE证明了将物理知识融入深度展开网络可以在保持实时推理能力的同时实现跨环境泛化，为AI-RAN中的信道预测提供了实用方案。

papers.title: Industrializing Prediction-Powered Inference: The GLIDE Library for Reliable GenAI and Agentic Systems Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Reliable evaluation of agentic systems requires unbiased estimates with valid uncertainty, but standard practice navigates between costly human annotation and biased LLM-as-judge proxies. Prediction-powered inference (PPI) combines both into debiased estimates with valid confidence intervals, yet its various methods remain scattered across papers under partial implementations. We introduce GLIDE, an open-source Python library that unifies state-of-the-art PPI estimators (PPI++, Stratified PPI, Predict-Then-Debias and its stratified variants, Active Statistical Inference) and samplers (uniform, stratified, active, cost-optimal) under a scipy-style API specialized to mean estimation. GLIDE ships with a reproducible Monte Carlo validation suite, an empirically grounded decision tree for method selection, and an agentic evaluation case study showing substantial annotation savings at equivalent precision. The GLIDE package is available at this URL: https://github.com/EmertonData/glide
papers.comment: 8 pages, accepted at the ICML 2026 workshop Agentic Uncertainty
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍GLIDE，一个开源的Python库，统一了多种预测驱动推断（PPI）估计器和采样器，用于可靠地评估基于GenAI和智能体系统。GLIDE提供scipy风格的API，专注于均值估计，包含可复现的蒙特卡洛验证套件、方法选择决策树和智能体评估案例研究，显示在同等精度下减少标注成本。
Motivation: 智能体系统的可靠评估需要无偏估计和有效不确定性，但实践中要么依赖昂贵的人工标注，要么使用有偏的LLM代理。预测驱动推断（PPI）结合两者得到去偏估计，但各种方法分散在不同论文中，缺乏统一实现。
Method: GLIDE库统一了多种PPI估计器（PPI++、分层PPI、预测-然后去偏及其分层变体、主动统计推断）和采样器（均匀、分层、主动、成本最优），采用scipy风格API，专注于均值估计。
Result: 摘要报告GLIDE在智能体评估案例研究中显示了显著的标注节省，同时保持同等精度。库包含可复现的蒙特卡洛验证套件和经验决策树。
Conclusion: GLIDE为PPI方法提供一个统一、开源、生产就绪的实现，有助于工业级评估。论文强调库的设计和案例研究结果。

summary_sections.motivation: 智能体系统的可靠评估需要无偏估计和有效不确定性，但实践中要么依赖昂贵的人工标注，要么使用有偏的LLM代理。预测驱动推断（PPI）结合两者得到去偏估计，但各种方法分散在不同论文中，缺乏统一实现。
summary_sections.method: GLIDE库统一了多种PPI估计器（PPI++、分层PPI、预测-然后去偏及其分层变体、主动统计推断）和采样器（均匀、分层、主动、成本最优），采用scipy风格API，专注于均值估计。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告GLIDE在智能体评估案例研究中显示了显著的标注节省，同时保持同等精度。库包含可复现的蒙特卡洛验证套件和经验决策树。
summary_sections.conclusion: GLIDE为PPI方法提供一个统一、开源、生产就绪的实现，有助于工业级评估。论文强调库的设计和案例研究结果。

papers.title: GETA: Generalized Encrypted Traffic Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Traditional traffic analysis is being fundamentally challenged by the rapid adoption of encryption, tunnelling, and privacy-preserving protocols, which increasingly obscure packet payloads and limit the usefulness of Deep Packet Inspection (DPI). Although machine learning has advanced encrypted traffic analysis, existing approaches often remain tied to protocol-specific header features, depend on large labelled datasets, and degrade when deployed across heterogeneous network environments. We present GETA, a protocol-agnostic framework for encrypted traffic analysis that models network flows as multivariate time series using only traffic metadata, thereby avoiding reliance on packet payloads or header semantics. GETA combines meta-learning, embedding refinement, and self-attention to support few-shot adaptation to previously unseen domains with minimal labelled data. Across nine public datasets spanning application identification, VPN traffic classification, IoT device fingerprinting, and attack detection, GETA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. These results show that GETA offers a practical and generalisable foundation for robust traffic analysis in modern encrypted networks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GETA，一个协议无关的加密流量分析框架，将网络流建模为多变量时间序列，仅使用流量元数据，避免依赖负载或头部语义。结合元学习、嵌入细化和自注意力机制，支持小样本适应新领域。在九个公开数据集（应用识别、VPN分类、IoT设备指纹、攻击检测）上一致超越现有基线。
Motivation: 传统流量分析因加密、隧道和隐私协议的广泛采用而面临根本挑战，现有方法依赖协议特定头部特征、大量标注数据，且在不同网络环境中性能下降。
Method: GETA框架：协议无关，将网络流作为多变量时间序列建模，仅使用流量元数据；采用元学习、嵌入细化和自注意力机制，实现少量样本适应未见领域。
Result: 在九个涵盖应用识别、VPN流量分类、IoT设备指纹识别和攻击检测的公共数据集上，GETA一致优于当前最优方法。
Conclusion: GETA为现代加密网络中鲁棒的流量分析提供了实用且可泛化的基础。

papers.title: Learning Parametric Nitrogen Fertilizer Response Curves Using Neuro Symbolic Regression
papers.abstract_en: Accurately modeling crop response to Nitrogen (N) fertilization is a fundamental challenge in precision agriculture, as it impacts both economic returns and environmental sustainability. Existing approaches either rely on predefined parametric forms or opaque machine learning models, limiting their ability to interpret or discover site-specific functional relationships from data. In this work, we propose a neuro symbolic regression (SR) approach to learn parametric N-response curves without assuming a predefined functional form. Our approach integrates a transformer-based Multi-Set Symbolic Skeleton Prediction strategy, enabling the discovery of shared functional structures across multiple subdomains or management zones (MZs). By constructing diverse input subsets and enforcing consistency across them, the method recovers robust symbolic skeletons that are subsequently fitted to observed data using a genetic algorithm. This framework was first evaluated on synthetic one-dimensional problems to assess its robustness under varying levels of epistemic uncertainty. The results demonstrate the ability of the proposed SR approach to recover correct expressions even in data-scarce regimes. In this work, we present the results of applying our method to real-world winter wheat data, learning distinct parametric N-response curves for different MZs within a field. The results show that the discovered expressions not only achieve lower fitting errors than traditional models such as quadratic-plateau and exponential functions, but also capture diverse functional behaviors across spatial regions. This demonstrates the potential that neuro SR has to enable the discovery of site-specific agronomic relationships and support informed decision-making in precision agriculture.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Workshop on Symbolic Regression and Equation Discovery, part of the 2026 IEEE World Congress on Computational Intelligence (WCCI) and the IEEE Congress on Evolutionary Computation (CEC)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种神经符号回归（neuro symbolic regression, SR）方法，用于学习氮肥响应曲线，无需预设参数形式。该方法结合基于Transformer的多集符号骨架预测策略，能在多个管理区域间发现共享的符号骨架，并用遗传算法拟合观测数据。在合成一维问题和真实冬小麦数据上的实验表明，该方法即使在数据稀缺时也能恢复正确表达式，且拟合误差低于传统二次平台和指数模型。
Motivation: 现有氮肥响应建模要么依赖预设参数形式，要么使用黑箱机器学习模型，难以解释或发现特定地点的函数关系。
Method: 提出神经符号回归方法，集成基于Transformer的多集符号骨架预测，通过构造多样输入子集并强制一致来恢复稳健的符号骨架，最后用遗传算法拟合数据。
Result: 在合成问题中，该方法能在高认知不确定性下恢复正确表达式；在真实冬小麦数据上，发现的不同管理区域响应曲线拟合误差低于二次平台和指数模型，并捕获不同的空间行为。
Conclusion: 神经符号回归有潜力发现特定地点的农学关系，支持精准农业中的决策。

papers.title: Personalized to Persuade: The Effects of Contextualization and Warmth on Trust and Reliance in Conversational AI
papers.abstract_en: Artificial Intelligence (AI) agents personalize their responses by tailoring explanations to users' backgrounds, interests, and prior interactions, referred to as contextualization. Personalization has been identified as a persuasive strategy in politics or in marketing. However, the persuasive effect of contextualization in everyday tasks, where users often lack prior knowledge, remains unclear. We conducted a $2\times2$ between-subjects experiment ($N = 380$) examining how contextualization, combined with conversational warmth, shapes reliance and persuasiveness of an AI assistant arguing against expert recommendations. Our findings reveal that contextualization reduces the persuasive power of AI, but its combination with warmth restores persuasiveness through a crossover interaction. Reliance on AI is present across conditions and is invariant to the conversational design. Trust strongly predicts both persuasion and reliance, yet neither contextualization nor warmth operates through trust. AI literacy decouples trust from behavior: more literate users report lower trust in the assistant, yet are more persuaded and more reliant on its advice. These results suggest that users are prone to deferring to AI agents over human expert judgment; however, interface-level conversational design choices have a limited role in shaping the behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文通过一个2x2受试者间实验（N=380），研究情境化（contextualization）和对话温暖度（warmth）如何影响用户对AI助手的信任和依赖。结果表明，情境化降低了AI的说服力，但与温暖度结合时通过交叉交互恢复了说服力。信任强烈预测说服和依赖，但情境化和温暖度不通过信任起作用。AI素养较高的用户对助手信任较低，但更易被说服和依赖。
Motivation: 个性化（即情境化）在政治或营销中已被认为是说服策略，但在日常任务中对用户的影响尚不清楚，尤其当用户缺乏先验知识时。
Method: 作者进行了2x2受试者间实验，操作了情境化（有/无）和温暖度（有/无），测量用户对AI助手反驳专家建议的依赖和说服力。
Result: 情境化降低说服力，但与温暖度组合时恢复说服力（交叉交互）。依赖在所有条件下都存在且不变。信任是强预测因子，但设计操作不通过信任起作用。AI素养更高的用户信任更低但更易被说服和依赖。
Conclusion: 用户倾向于服从AI而非人类专家判断；界面级对话设计选择对行为影响有限。

papers.title: Survival Reinforcement Learning: Toward Scalable Self-Supervised RL
papers.abstract_en: While self-supervised Contrastive Reinforcement Learning (CRL) has shown remarkable depth-scaling capabilities, successfully using networks over 64 layers, scaled CRL still struggles with long-horizon goal-conditioned planning due to the uniformity-tolerance dilemma inherent in contrastive losses. We introduce Survival Reinforcement Learning (SRL), an online classification-based alternative that extends the survival value learning framework by maximizing the agent's dwell time at target goals. SRL bypasses the structural constraints of CRL and mitigates the "bang-bang" control solutions inherent to survival frameworks, which often induce undesirable behavior in complex dynamical systems. Evaluated across diverse robotic benchmarks, scaled SRL matches state-of-the-art CRL on manipulation tasks and outperforms it by 2x to 8x on stable, long-horizon locomotion tasks. Our results provide strong additional evidence that classification-based methods may serve as a key primitive in the broader effort to scale reinforcement learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出生存强化学习（Survival Reinforcement Learning, SRL），一种基于在线分类的强化学习方法，扩展了生存价值学习框架，通过最大化智能体在目标状态下的停留时间来解决对比强化学习（CRL）在长时域目标条件规划中的均匀性-容忍性困境。SRL避免了CRL的结构性约束，并缓解了生存框架固有的“bang-bang”控制问题。在多种机器人基准测试中，SRL在操作任务上与最先进的CRL相当，在稳定的长时域运动任务上性能提升2到8倍。
Motivation: 对比强化学习（CRL）在深层网络缩放上表现出色，但在长时域目标条件规划中受限于对比损失固有的均匀性-容忍性困境，需要新的替代方法。
Method: 提出生存强化学习（SRL），一种基于在线分类的框架，通过最大化智能体在目标状态下的停留时间（dwell time）来学习价值，避免了CRL的结构约束并缓解生存框架中的bang-bang控制问题。
Result: 在多种机器人基准上，SRL在操作任务上与最先进的CRL相当，在稳定的长时域运动任务上性能提升2到8倍。
Conclusion: 本文结果表明基于分类的方法可能是大规模强化学习的关键原语。
