papers.title: Algorithmic Recourse of In-Context Learning for Tabular Data
papers.abstract_en: As predictive models are increasingly deployed in high-stakes settings such as credit approval, there is a growing need for post-hoc methods that provide recourse to affected individuals. Many such models operate on tabular data, where features correspond to real-world attributes. Recently, in-context learning (ICL) has enabled large language models to perform tabular prediction by conditioning on labeled examples at inference time, without explicit training. However, algorithmic recourse for tabular decision-making under ICL remains largely unexplored. In this work, we present the first study of algorithmic recourse for tabular data under ICL. We carry out a theoretical analysis, showing that recourse remains well-defined and bounded, and we characterize how recourse converges toward classical solutions as the context size increases. In practice, we propose a novel zeroth-order recourse framework, Adaptive Subspace Recourse for In-Context Learning (ASR-ICL), that efficiently generates actionable and sparse recourse for black-box ICL models. The proposed framework naturally extends to multi-class tabular tasks. Experiments across multiple real-world datasets and models demonstrate that ASR-ICL achieves recourse quality comparable to existing methods with fewer queries and empirically confirm the predicted convergence behavior, supporting our theoretical analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究表格数据下上下文学习（ICL）的算法归因问题。理论分析表明归因是良定义且有界的，且随上下文增大趋近经典解。实践提出零阶归因框架ASR-ICL，高效生成可操作且稀疏的归因，并自然扩展到多类任务。实验在多个数据集上验证了其归因质量和查询效率。
Motivation: 高风险场景（如信贷审批）中预测模型需要事后归因，但ICL用于表格预测的归因未被探索。
Method: 提出自适应子空间归因框架ASR-ICL，基于零阶优化为黑盒ICL模型生成稀疏且可操作的归因，并给出理论保证。
Result: ASR-ICL在多个真实数据集上以更少查询达到与现有方法相当的归因质量，并实证验证了理论预测的收敛行为。
Conclusion: 该工作为表格数据ICL的算法归因提供了首次理论与实验研究，框架高效且可扩展。

papers.title: DriveMA: Driving Vision-Language-Action Models with verifiable Meta-Actions
papers.abstract_en: Driving Vision-Language-Action Models (Driving VLAs) aim to use language to improve end-to-end planning, but the language-action gap limits this promise. We propose DriveMA, a Driving VLA framework built on verifiable meta-actions, which summarize future ego motion into compact language-domain intentions and can be constructed from expert trajectories with a trajectory-grounded annotation pipeline and can be verified against generated trajectories through rule-based projection. DriveMA exploits this verifiability with action-centric supervised training and a data-efficient turn-level credit assignment reinforcement learning framework, explicitly aligning high-level decisions with low-level trajectory planning through dense rewards and precise credit assignment. DriveMA sets a new state of the art on the Waymo Open Dataset Vision-based E2E Driving, achieving a Rater Feedback Score of 8.060 with a 2B model and further improving it to 8.079 with a 4B model; it also obtains competitive closed-loop planning performance on NAVSIM. These results show that even a simple meta-action interface can achieve state-of-the-art planning when made verifiable and optimized for language-action alignment. Code, data, and models will be released to facilitate future research.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DriveMA，一种基于可验证元动作（verifiable meta-actions）的驾驶视觉-语言-动作模型，通过轨迹级标注和规则投影实现元动作的可验证性，并利用动作中心监督训练和回合级信用分配强化学习对齐高层决策与底层轨迹规划。在Waymo Open Dataset上，2B模型达到8.060 Rater Feedback Score，4B模型提升至8.079，同时在NAVSIM上取得竞争性闭环规划性能。
Motivation: 现有驾驶VLA模型存在语言-动作差距，限制了语言提升端到端规划的效果，亟需一种可验证的接口来对齐语言意图与实际动作。
Method: 提出可验证元动作，通过轨迹级标注管道从专家轨迹构建语言域意图，并利用规则投影验证生成轨迹；采用动作中心监督训练和回合级信用分配强化学习框架，通过密集奖励和精确信用分配对齐高层决策与低层轨迹规划。
Result: 在Waymo Open Dataset上，2B模型Rater Feedback Score达8.060，4B模型提升至8.079，刷新SOTA；在NAVSIM上获得竞争性闭环规划性能。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出DriveMA，一种基于可验证元动作（verifiable meta-actions）的驾驶视觉-语言-动作模型，通过轨迹级标注和规则投影实现元动作的可验证性，并利用动作中心监督训练和回合级信用分配强化学习对齐高层决策与底层轨迹规划。在Waymo Open Dataset上，2B模型达到8.060 Rater Feedback Score，4B模型提升至8.079，同时在NAVSIM上取得竞争性闭环规划性能。

summary_sections.method: 提出可验证元动作，通过轨迹级标注管道从专家轨迹构建语言域意图，并利用规则投影验证生成轨迹；采用动作中心监督训练和回合级信用分配强化学习框架，通过密集奖励和精确信用分配对齐高层决策与低层轨迹规划。

papers.title: Envisioning Beyond the Few: Disentangled Semantics and Primitives for Few-Shot Atypical Layout-to-Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: The layout-to-image (L2I) task enables fine-grained control over image generation via object categories and spatial layouts. However, existing L2I methods yield fragmented and distorted generations under few-shot atypical settings. We term this failure as representation fragmentation, arising from a granularity mismatch that entangles semantic identity with visual details. To address this issue, we propose a representation-driven framework that disentangles semantics from primitives for robust few-shot adaptation. Specifically, Semantic Anchoring aggregates categorical semantics into anchors for stable identity, while Primitive Imbuing models recomposable primitives for robust local detail modeling. Conceptual Steering further regulates optimization with a saliency-aware objective to preserve foreground semantic consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements in the 5-shot regime over state-of-the-art L2I methods in both visual fidelity and alignment across diverse atypical domains. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/iCVTEAM/DSP.
papers.comment: Accepted to ICML 2026; code available at https://github.com/iCVTEAM/DSP
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种表示驱动的框架，用于解决小样本非典型布局到图像生成（Layout-to-Image, L2I）中的表示碎片化问题。该框架通过语义锚定（Semantic Anchoring）聚合类别语义以保持身份稳定，通过原语注入（Primitive Imbuing）建模可重组的原语以增强局部细节鲁棒性，并引入概念引导（Conceptual Steering）以保持前景语义一致性。实验表明，在5-shot设置下，该方法在视觉保真度和对齐度上均优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有布局到图像方法在小样本非典型场景下生成结果碎片化、扭曲，作者将失败归因于语义身份与视觉细节纠缠导致的粒度不匹配（representation fragmentation）。
Method: 提出三个组件：1) Semantic Anchoring——将类别语义聚合成锚点以稳定身份；2) Primitive Imbuing——建模可重组的原语以增强局部细节建模；3) Conceptual Steering——使用显著性感知目标优化，保持前景语义一致性。
Result: 在5-shot设置下，多个非典型领域的视觉保真度和对齐度一致优于现有布局到图像方法。
Conclusion: 通过解耦语义与原语，能够提升小样本非典型布局到图像生成的鲁棒性。

papers.title: COLLEAGUE.SKILL: Automated AI Skill Generation via Expert Knowledge Distillation
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents are increasingly expected not only to complete isolated tasks, but also to carry bounded representations of human expertise, judgment, and interaction style. Building such person-grounded agents remains difficult because actionable knowledge associated with a person or role is usually embedded in heterogeneous traces rather than written as clean instructions. Existing memory and persona systems capture fragments of this evidence, while skill frameworks provide portable packaging formats; however, there is no end-to-end workflow for distilling these traces into inspectable, correctable, and agent-usable skills. We present an automated trace-to-skill distillation system for generating person-grounded AI skills via expert knowledge distillation. Given materials from a target person or role, COLLEAGUE.SKILL produces a versioned skill package with two coordinated tracks: a capability track for practices, mental models, and decision heuristics, and a bounded behavior track for communication style, interaction rules, and correction history. The package can be inspected, invoked, updated through natural-language feedback, rolled back, installed across agent hosts, and optionally prepared for controlled distribution. We describe the artifact contract, generation workflow, correction lifecycle, deployment surface, and domain presets implemented in the open-source system. At the time of writing, the public repository has approximately 18.5k GitHub stars; the gallery lists 215 skills from 165 contributors and more than 100k cumulative stars across listed skill cards. The system illustrates how person-grounded skills can be represented as portable, correctable packages rather than opaque prompts or hidden memories.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出COLLEAGUE.SKILL系统，用于从人物或角色的异构痕迹中自动蒸馏出可检查、可修正、可被AI智能体使用的个性化技能包。技能包包含能力轨道（实践、心智模型、决策启发）和有界行为轨道（沟通风格、交互规则、修正历史），支持自然语言反馈更新、版本回滚、跨宿主部署和受控分发。系统开源，已有约18.5k GitHub星标，社区贡献215个技能、超过10万累计星标。
Motivation: 现有智能体系统缺乏端到端流程，将嵌入在异构痕迹中的人类专业知识转化为可检查、可修正、可复用的技能包，限制了人物基智能体的构建。
Method: 设计自动化痕迹到技能蒸馏流程，包括工件契约定义、生成工作流、基于自然语言反馈的修正生命周期、部署面以及领域预设模板，最终输出版本化的双轨道技能包。
Result: 开源系统已积累约18.5k GitHub星标，技能库包含215个技能（来自165位贡献者），累计星标超过10万，表明社区采用度较高。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了以可移植、可修正的包而非不透明提示或隐藏记忆来表征人物基技能的系统级实现，为知识蒸馏提供新范式。

papers.title: Why Linear Recurrent Memory Works in Partially Observable Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: The family of linear recurrent neural networks has shown strong performance as recurrent memory units in partially observable reinforcement learning. We provide a theoretical justification for their empirical effectiveness by constructing and studying two linear filters: (i) the first exactly reproduces the pre-softmax logits of the belief vector in a hidden Markov model (HMM) under a deterministic transition matrix, thereby serving as a sufficient statistic for optimal policy learning, (ii) the second achieves vanishing state-decoding error under a nearly deterministic transition matrix, thus reducing state ambiguity to near zero. The results extend to action-controlled HMMs, where the corresponding linear filters become time-varying with action-dependent dynamics. We illustrate our main results through numerical experiments and further show that the constructed linear filter serves as a strong feature extractor in a small reinforcement learning game.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为线性递归神经网络在部分可观测强化学习中的有效性提供理论解释，通过构建两个线性滤波器，证明其在隐马尔可夫模型下能近似最优信念状态，并实现状态解码误差趋于零。结果扩展到动作控制的隐马尔可夫模型，数值实验验证了滤波器作为特征提取器的能力。
Motivation: 线性递归网络在部分可观测强化学习中表现优异，但缺乏理论理解。论文旨在揭示其为何能有效记忆并处理部分可观测性。
Method: 构造两个线性滤波器：第一个在确定性转移矩阵下精确再现隐马尔可夫模型信念向量的softmax前logits；第二个在近确定性转移矩阵下使状态解码误差趋近于零。并扩展到动作控制情形，滤波器变为时变且依赖动作。
Result: 理论表明线性滤波器可作为最优策略学习的充分统计量，数值实验在小型强化学习游戏中验证了其作为强特征提取器的性能。
Conclusion: 线性递归网络在部分可观测强化学习中的成功可归因于其能近似最优信念状态，理论框架为设计更高效的递归记忆单元提供了指导。

papers.title: Lightweight CNN-Based Anomaly Detection for High Voltage Converter Modulators in the Spallation Neutron Source
papers.abstract_en: Unscheduled trips of high-power pulsed converters are a leading source of downtime at large accelerator facilities. At the Spallation Neutron Source (SNS), the High Voltage Converter Modulators (HVCMs) are consistently the second-largest contributor to lost beam time. Each HVCM pulse is recorded across sensor channels spanning currents, voltages, and magnetic fluxes, whose mutual interactions encode the operating state of the system. Fault precursors do not manifest uniformly across these channels: depending on fault type, they may alter the temporal structure of individual signals, change the statistical dependencies among channels, or both. Existing deep-learning approaches typically process multi-channel signals with standard convolutional pipelines that entangle temporal and cross-channel operations from the first layer, giving the model no explicit mechanism to represent channel independence or structured inter-channel interaction. We hypothesise that architectural inductive bias, specifically the ordering of temporal filtering and cross-channel mixing, plays a central role in detection performance on this class of data. To test this, we vary the order in which these two operations are applied, and examine whether per-pulse adaptive channel reweighting further improves sensitivity. Evaluated on the public HVCM dataset across all four SNS subsystems (RFQ, DTL, CCL, SCL), our best variant achieves a pooled AUC-PR of 0.816 and AUC-ROC of 0.934, outperforming the state of the art on most subsystems and five of the six fault families. Ablations identify three dominant input channels and link per-fault-family performance to whether precursors manifest as amplitude shifts in individual channels or as subtler patterns requiring joint channel representations to surface.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对散裂中子源（SNS）高压转换调制器（HVCM）的异常检测问题，提出一种轻量级CNN架构，通过改变时间滤波与跨通道混合的顺序来引入归纳偏置，并加入逐脉冲自适应通道重加权。在公开HVCM数据集上，最佳变体在四个子系统上达到池化AUC-PR 0.816和AUC-ROC 0.934，优于现有方法。消融实验识别出三个主导输入通道，并表明不同故障家族的前兆模式差异。
Motivation: 高功率脉冲转换器的不定时跳闸是加速器设施停机的主要来源，而现有深度学习方法从第一层就纠缠时间和跨通道操作，缺乏显式的通道独立性与交互建模机制。
Method: 系统性地改变卷积网络中时间滤波与跨通道混合的先后顺序，并引入逐脉冲自适应通道重加权（channel reweighting），以测试架构归纳偏置对异常检测性能的影响。
Result: 在SNS四个子系统（RFQ, DTL, CCL, SCL）的公共HVCM数据集上，最佳模型取得池化AUC-PR 0.816、AUC-ROC 0.934，在多数子系统和五个故障家族上超越现有技术。
Conclusion: 架构中时间滤波与跨通道混合的顺序显著影响检测性能；自适应通道重加权能进一步提升灵敏度；不同故障家族的前兆模式（幅度偏移 vs. 联合通道模式）对应不同的最优架构选择。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fraud Type Decomposition and the Observation-Mechanism Taxonomy:Class-Specific Detection Limits in Payment Networks
papers.abstract_en: Fraud detection in payment networks relies on labels generated through heterogeneous and imperfect observation processes, yet existing approaches treat fraud as a homogeneous binary variable. We show that this assumption is structurally incorrect and leads to provable inefficiency. We introduce an observation-mechanism taxonomy that partitions fraud into five classes, each defined by a distinct censorship and labeling pipeline. We prove that estimating fraud rates separately by class and aggregating strictly dominates pooled estimation, with the efficiency gap characterized as a Jensen penalty arising from heterogeneous observation rates. For each class, we derive the binding theoretical constraint on detection, including endogenous label corruption, structural non-observability, and feature non-informativeness. These results establish that fraud detection is fundamentally a collection of distinct estimation problems, each governed by its own observation structure and detection limit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出支付网络欺诈检测中常见的将欺诈视为同质二元变量的假设存在结构性错误，并引入一个基于观察机制的欺诈分类学，将欺诈分为五类，每类对应不同的审查和标注流程。作者证明按类分别估计欺诈率并聚合显著优于池化估计，效率差距由Jensen惩罚刻画。针对每类欺诈，推导了理论上的检测极限，包括标签内生污染、结构不可观测性和特征非信息性等约束，表明欺诈检测本质上是多个不同估计问题的集合。
Motivation: 现有欺诈检测方法将欺诈视为均匀的二元变量，忽略了异构且不完美的观察过程，导致可证明的低效性。
Method: 提出观察机制分类法，将欺诈分为五类，每类由不同的审查和标注管道定义；证明按类估计欺诈率并聚合严格优于池化估计，并用Jensen惩罚刻画效率差距；对每类导出检测的理论约束。
Result: 证明了按类估计并聚合相比池化估计具有严格优势，效率差距由Jensen惩罚量化；每类欺诈均存在特定的检测极限，如标签内生污染、结构不可观测性和特征非信息性。
Conclusion: 欺诈检测本质上是多个不同估计问题的集合，每个问题受自身的观察结构和检测极限约束。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 证明了按类估计并聚合相比池化估计具有严格优势，效率差距由Jensen惩罚量化；每类欺诈均存在特定的检测极限，如标签内生污染、结构不可观测性和特征非信息性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 欺诈检测本质上是多个不同估计问题的集合，每个问题受自身的观察结构和检测极限约束。

papers.title: Formalizing and falsifying causal pathways of rare events
papers.abstract_en: Building on recent formalizations of root cause analysis for rare events (``outliers'') in structural equation models, we propose a formal definition of a causal pathway and discuss its testable implications. We identify conditions under which these implications depend only on a causal abstraction defined by the pathway of rare events, rather than on the full causal graph of the underlying system. Accordingly, we introduce an abstraction of causal structure to pathways of rare events that bridges simple verbal causal explanations and detailed causal modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于结构方程模型中罕见事件（异常值）根因分析的现有形式化工作，提出了因果路径的形式化定义并讨论了其可检验的含义。作者识别出这些含义仅依赖于由罕见事件路径定义的因果抽象，而非整个因果图，进而引入了一种将简单口头因果解释与详细因果建模联系起来的因果结构抽象。
Motivation: 现有方法缺乏对罕见事件因果路径的严格形式化，导致口头因果解释与因果模型之间存在鸿沟。
Method: 在结构方程模型框架内，定义罕见事件的因果路径，并证明其可检验含义仅依赖于路径本身的因果抽象，而非完整因果图。
Result: 理论结果：因果路径的可检验含义可以仅基于路径的抽象结构，无需完整系统图。
Conclusion: 该抽象桥接了非形式化的因果解释与详细的因果建模，为罕见事件的因果分析提供了更简洁的工具。

papers.title: ERGeoBench:A Comprehensive Benchmark for Embodied Reasoning and Geo-localization in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong potential as embodied agents, yet embodied geo-localization remains underexplored due to the lack of fine-grained evaluation. We introduce ERGeoBench, a diagnostic benchmark for vision-driven embodied geo-localization. ERGeoBench evaluates models under three progressive settings -- single-view, panorama-view, and embodied-view -- where agents may actively acquire observations through sequential changes in yaw, pitch, and zoom. The benchmark contains 2,207 globally distributed street-view panoramas and measures four complementary capabilities: foundational perception, spatial awareness, common sense reasoning, and geo-localization reasoning. Evaluations of leading proprietary and open-source MLLMs show that current models can infer high-level geographic semantics, but still struggle with fine-grained perceptual operations, metric localization, and spatial consistency across views. We further observe that geo-localization is strongly correlated with the other capability dimensions, suggesting that accurate localization depends on integrated perception, spatial reasoning, and commonsense inference rather than isolated visual recognition. Overall, ERGeoBench provides a unified framework for diagnosing and advancing human-like embodied geo-localization. Project Page: https://kaixuewen.github.io/ERGeoBench/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ERGeoBench，一个用于多模态大语言模型在视觉驱动的具身地理定位中的诊断基准。该基准包含2207张全球分布的街景全景图，评估模型在单视图、全景视图和具身视图三种设置下的能力，测量基础感知、空间意识、常识推理和地理定位推理四个维度。实验表明现有模型能推断高层地理语义，但在细粒度感知、度量定位和跨视图空间一致性上仍有困难。
Motivation: 具身地理定位在多模态大语言模型中尚未被充分探索，缺乏细粒度评估基准来诊断模型能力。
Method: 构建ERGeoBench基准，包含2207张全球街景全景图，设计单视图、全景视图和具身视图三种渐进式测试设置，并评估四个互补能力维度：基础感知、空间意识、常识推理和地理定位推理。
Result: 领先的闭源和开源MLLM能推断高层地理语义，但在细粒度感知操作、度量定位和跨视图空间一致性上表现不佳；地理定位与其他能力维度强相关。
Conclusion: ERGeoBench为诊断和推进类人具身地理定位提供了统一框架，并揭示了当前模型在集成感知、空间推理和常识推理方面的主要局限。

papers.title: Entropic Projection Alignment: Estimating, Explaining, and Improving Model Performance Under Distribution Shift
papers.abstract_en: We propose a unified framework for addressing three key challenges of distribution shift: (1) estimating a model's performance on an unlabeled target domain, (2) explaining the shift by identifying the features responsible, and (3) improving the target domain performance. Our method, Entropic Projection Alignment (EPA), aligns the source distribution to the target by matching carefully selected moments while simultaneously minimising the KL divergence from the source. This formulation yields a unique closed-form solution for importance weights, achieving robustness through implicit variance control. Drawing on domain adaptation theory, we establish that moment matching is sufficient for reliable estimation and adaptation, avoiding the need for full density ratio recovery. Extensive experiments, together with strong theoretical guarantees, demonstrate that EPA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines while offering substantial computational efficiency.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 29th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Statistics (AISTATS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出熵投影对齐（EPA）框架，用于统一解决分布漂移下的三个关键问题：估计无标签目标域上的模型性能、解释漂移原因以及提升目标域性能。EPA通过对齐源分布和目标分布的精选矩，同时最小化与源分布的KL散度，得到重要性权重的闭式解，并通过隐式方差控制实现鲁棒性。基于域适应理论，证明矩匹配足以进行可靠估计和适应。大量实验表明EPA在计算效率上显著优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有方法在处理分布漂移时通常分别处理性能估计、解释和适应，缺乏统一框架；同时全密度比率估计计算成本高且不稳定。
Method: 提出Entropic Projection Alignment (EPA)，通过匹配源和目标分布的关键矩并最小化KL散度，得到重要性权重的闭式解，隐式控制方差，避免了全密度比估计。
Result: 实验显示EPA在性能估计、特征归因和域适应任务上一致优于现有基线，同时具有显著的计算效率优势。
Conclusion: 矩匹配足以实现可靠的分布漂移估计和适应，无需完整密度比恢复；EPA提供了一个统一且高效的框架。

papers.title: Learning Cardiac Latent Representations in Vectorcardiogram Space
papers.abstract_en: Electrocardiography (ECG) is a cornerstone of cardiac assessment, making the learning of informative ECG representations fundamental to tasks ranging from disease diagnosis to clinical report generation. However, existing methods operate almost exclusively in the observable ECG signal space. In practice, the standard twelve-lead ECG represents multiple projections of the same underlying cardiac electrical activity from different spatial orientations. Therefore, representation learning in the ECG space inevitably introduces substantial redundancy, which may lead to spurious correlations and increased risk of overfitting. To address this and motivated by the Frank vectorcardiogram (VCG) model, we propose learning a unified latent representation of cardiac electrical activity directly in the VCG space. We introduce LVCG, the first general self-supervised representation learning framework designed to operate in this physically grounded latent space. By learning view-invariant latent VCG representations rather than lead-specific artifacts, VCG minimizes redundancy and improves generalization. LVCG generally outperforms ECG-space baselines across tasks, demonstrating enhanced robustness and generalization, especially in domain shift settings.

TL;DR: 本文提出LVCG，一种在向量心电图（VCG）空间中学习统一心脏电活动潜在表示的自监督学习框架，旨在减少标准12导联ECG的冗余，提高泛化能力。实验显示优于ECG空间基线，尤其在领域转移场景下。

Method: 提出LVCG框架，基于Frank向量心电图模型，在VCG空间中学习视角不变的潜在表示，减少冗余。
Result: 摘要报告LVCG在多种任务上优于ECG空间基线，增强了鲁棒性和泛化能力，尤其在领域转移设置下。
Conclusion: 在VCG空间学习表示能减少冗余并改进泛化，但未明确说明局限性。

papers.title: BadBone: Backdoor Attacks Against Backbone Models in Visual Prompt Learning
papers.abstract_en: Prompt learning is a new machine learning paradigm that has attracted ample attention due to its simplicity and proven efficacy. Despite its growing adoption, the security vulnerabilities associated with this paradigm remain underexplored. In this work, we take the first step to propose BadBone, a stealthy and adaptive backdoor attack against prompt learning using bi-level optimization. Instead of backdooring the prompt learning process, we aim to compromise a backbone model such that only target downstream tasks employing prompt learning inherit the backdoor vulnerability. Extensive experiments on three different models and three datasets from various domains show that our targeted/untargeted backdoored models achieve high attack performance while maintaining utility on both pre-training and downstream tasks. Moreover, we evaluate our approach against six state-of-the-art model-level defenses, including Neural Cleanse, ABS, MNTD, NAD, CLP, and D-BR. The results demonstrate that these defenses are largely ineffective against our backdoored models and thus leave the effective defense as an important direction for future work.
papers.comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics & Security
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BadBone，一种针对视觉提示学习中骨干模型的后门攻击方法。通过双层优化，攻击者在不破坏提示学习过程的情况下，仅使采用提示学习的目标下游任务继承后门漏洞。实验表明攻击有效且现有防御手段难以检测。
Motivation: 提示学习范式广泛采用但其安全漏洞尚未充分探索，现有后门攻击多针对提示学习过程本身，而未关注骨干模型可能被植入后门的问题。
Method: 采用双层优化（bi-level optimization）对骨干模型进行后门植入，使得仅使用该骨干进行提示学习的下游任务会继承后门行为，而保持预训练和下游任务的正常效用。
Result: 在三种模型和三个跨领域数据集上，目标/非目标后门攻击均达到高攻击成功率，同时保持上游和下游任务效用；六种防御方法（Neural Cleanse、ABS、MNTD、NAD、CLP、D-BR）基本无效。
Conclusion: 提示学习范式面临严重的后门威胁，现有防御对此类攻击失效，有效防御是未来重要研究方向。

papers.title: Toward Identifiable Sparse Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: Recently, sparse autoencoders (SAEs) have emerged as an attractive tool for interpreting and interacting with representations in practical neural networks. While it is common empirical folklore, we also show theoretically that SAEs are highly unstable: different training runs are likely to produce different concept dictionaries and sparse codes. We characterize the model properties that hinder the stability of real-world SAEs, and address each of these problems through minimal changes to the architecture and training procedure. Together, these changes yield two versions of an \textbf{i}dentifiable SAE (iSAE), a variant of the standard TopK SAE with lower reconstruction error and improved stability. We explain this improvement theoretically by connecting SAEs with traditional dictionary learning approaches, and show that the dictionaries learned in practice satisfy an approximate restricted isometry condition, rendering the corresponding sparse codes in those models near-identifiable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了稀疏自编码器（SAE）的可识别性问题，理论上和实验上证明标准 SAE 在不同训练中产生不稳定的概念字典和稀疏码。通过最小架构和训练改动，提出两种可识别 SAE（iSAE），在降低重构误差的同时提升稳定性。理论将 SAE 与传统字典学习联系，发现实际学习的字典满足近似受限等距条件，使稀疏码接近可识别。
Motivation: 稀疏自编码器虽被广泛用于神经网络表示解释，但其高度不稳定：不同训练运行产生不同概念字典和稀疏代码，影响解释的可靠性和可重复性。
Method: 分析导致 SAE 不稳定性的模型属性，并对每个问题通过架构和训练过程的最小改动予以解决，提出两种 iSAE 变体（基于 TopK SAE）。
Result: 摘要表明 iSAE 相比标准 TopK SAE 具有更低重构误差和改进的稳定性。理论证明实际学习的字典满足近似受限等距条件，从而使稀疏码接近可识别。
Conclusion: 通过连接 SAE 与传统字典学习，本文为 SAE 不稳定性提供了理论解释，并通过最小改动实现可识别性，提升了 SAE 作为解释工具的可靠性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Spectral Reach: Understanding Neural Scaling as Progress into the Spectral Tail
papers.abstract_en: Neural scaling laws describe predictable power-law relationships between model size, dataset size, compute, and performance. While these laws guide the development of modern foundation models, the mechanisms underpinning them remain poorly understood, in part due to the absence of scalable analysis tools. To close this gap, we introduce "spectral position": a scalable measure of which eigenvalues of the empirical neural tangent kernel (eNTK) currently drive loss reduction. Applying this measure to scaling experiments, we find that spectral position decreases throughout training: learning shifts from dominant eigenmodes into the spectral tail. Larger models reach further into the tail than smaller models, revealing a size-dependent capacity we call "spectral reach". This suggests why larger models achieve lower losses: they sustain learning on weak spectral signals inaccessible to smaller models. We further identify feature learning as a key enabler of spectral reach. It adaptively amplifies gradient magnitudes as learning advances, sustaining progress where frozen representations stall. This points to concrete interventions through architecture and optimizer design.

TL;DR: 本文提出“谱位置”（spectral position）这一可扩展度量，用于刻画经验神经正切核（eNTK）的特征值中哪些主导损失下降。通过缩放实验发现，训练过程中谱位置持续下降，学习从主导特征模进入谱尾；更大模型能到达谱尾更深处，这种规模依赖的能力称为“谱到达”（spectral reach）。这解释了为什么大模型损失更低——它们能在弱谱信号上持续学习。此外，特征学习（feature learning）通过自适应放大梯度幅度来维持谱到达，而冻结表示则停滞。该发现为通过架构和优化器设计进行干预提供了方向。
Motivation: 神经缩放定律在经验上有效，但其根本机制尚不清晰，缺乏可扩展的分析工具。
Method: 定义谱位置，度量训练中驱动损失下降的eNTK特征值范围；通过缩放实验分析谱位置动态，并识别特征学习对谱到达的关键作用。
Result: 谱位置随训练下降；更大模型能到达谱尾更深处，从而获得更低损失；特征学习是维持谱到达的必要条件。
Conclusion: 谱到达机制表明，通过架构和优化器设计可增强模型利用弱谱信号的能力，为改进缩放行为提供具体干预点。

papers.title: Bifurcated Remaining Useful Life Prediction: A Hybrid Approach for Realistic Uncertainty Characterization
papers.abstract_en: This study presents a novel hybrid prognostic framework for uncertainty-aware Remaining Useful Life (RUL) estimation in turbofan engines using the NASA C-MAPSS dataset. The framework employs a state-aware strategy that bifurcates the engines operational lifespan into "healthy" and "degraded" regimes. An LSTM-based autoencoder, trained strictly on nominal data (RUL > 150 cycles), monitors reconstruction error to act as a robust state classifier. For the healthy regime, a Conditional Weibull Survival Analysis is used for Mean Residual Life estimation. For the degraded regime, a Probabilistic Neural Network with Monte Carlo Dropout captures both aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties. Rather than using rigid binary labels, a calibrated sigmoid function converts the autoencoders output into continuous state probabilities, dynamically weighting the final ensemble prediction. The primary strength of this framework is its generation of physically consistent uncertainty bands, yielding high-confidence predictions near end-of-life while accurately reflecting the inherent variance of early operation, providing a robust tool for risk-informed maintenance.
papers.comment: Submitted to 9th European Conference of the Prognostics and Health Management Society 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合预测框架，用于涡轮风扇发动机的剩余使用寿命（RUL）估计，并显式建模不确定性。框架将运行寿命分为“健康”和“退化”阶段，健康阶段使用条件威布尔生存分析，退化阶段使用概率神经网络和蒙特卡洛Dropout，通过LSTM自动编码器重构误差进行状态分类，并用校准sigmoid函数动态加权集成。在NASA C-MAPSS数据集上验证，能生成物理一致的不确定性带，在寿命末期附近给出高置信度预测，同时反映早期操作的固有方差。
Motivation: 现有RUL预测方法未能充分处理不同运行阶段的不确定性特征，尤其缺乏在早期高方差和末期高置信度间物理一致的不确定性表征，亟需一种混合框架来改善风险知情维护。
Method: 提出状态感知混合框架：1）LSTM自动编码器仅在标称数据（RUL>150 cycles）上训练，监测重构误差作为鲁棒状态分类器；2）健康阶段采用条件威布尔生存分析估计平均剩余寿命；3）退化阶段采用概率神经网络结合蒙特卡洛Dropout捕获偶然和认知不确定性；4）用校准sigmoid函数将自动编码器输出转化为连续状态概率，动态加权两部分预测。
Result: 在NASA C-MAPSS数据集上，框架生成物理一致的不确定性带，在寿命末期附近获得高置信度预测，同时准确反映早期运行的固有方差，有效支持风险知情维护决策。
Conclusion: 该框架的主要优势是能产生物理一致的不确定性区间，为涡轮风扇发动机的RUL预测提供更可靠的工具，尤其适用于维护决策中的风险评估。

papers.title: Correcting Split Selection in Online Decision Trees via Anytime-Valid Inference
papers.abstract_en: Bagging-based ensembles, most notably Adaptive Random Forests, are among the strongest performers for learning from data streams. A common denominator across these methods is their reliance on Hoeffding Trees as base learners, which grow decision trees incrementally by testing whether a candidate split is significantly better than its alternatives using concentration inequalities. Despite their empirical success, existing variants lack valid statistical guarantees. Current analyses rely on fixed-sample concentration bounds, while split decisions are made using data-dependent stopping rules, which invalidates their guarantees and can drive the probabilty of incorrect splits to one. We introduce a principled alternative based on anytime-valid inference. Our method provides: (i) anytime-valid control of false splits under arbitrary data streams, including non-stationary settings; (ii) finite commitment time under a predictive advantage; and (iii) under stationary i.i.d. data, risk is monotone decreasing and strictly improves at every split. Empirically, we evaluate both standalone trees and their use within Adaptive Random Forests on non-stationary streams. Our method improves performance while producing substantially smaller trees.
papers.comment: Accepted as a Spotlight at the Forty-Third International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出基于装袋的集成方法（如自适应随机森林）中使用的Hoeffding树存在统计保证失效的问题，因为分割决策依赖数据依赖的停止规则，导致固定样本浓度不等式不再有效。作者提出基于随时有效推断（anytime-valid inference）的替代方法，能够任意数据流（包括非平稳设置）下控制虚假分割，在预测优势下有限承诺时间，并在平稳独立同分布数据下风险单调递减且每次分割严格改善。实验表明，该方法在非平稳流上提升了性能并生成更小的树。
Motivation: 现有基于Hoeffding树的在线决策树方法在分割选择时依赖固定样本浓度不等式，但由于采用数据依赖的停止规则，统计保证失效，可能使错误分割概率趋近于1。
Method: 引入随时有效推断（anytime-valid inference）来校正分割选择，提供对虚假分割的随时有效控制，并保证在预测优势下的有限承诺时间以及平稳数据下的风险单调递减。
Result: 实验评估了独立树和自适应随机森林在非平稳流上的性能，结果显示所提方法提升了性能，同时生成了显著更小的树。
Conclusion: 本文提出的基于随时有效推断的分割选择方法为在线决策树提供了有效的统计保证，并在非平稳数据流上表现出更好的性能与更小的模型复杂度。

papers.title: Scaling Multi-Hop Training Data via Graph-Constrained Path Selection
papers.abstract_en: Endowing large language models with compositional reasoning over specialized documents requires multi-hop training data at scale, where such data rarely exists outside of curated benchmarks built on structured sources. To construct it directly from plain, unannotated text, existing methods ask a single teacher model to jointly discover an evidence path through a document and verbalize it as a question-answer pair. However, these methods degrade sharply when documents are structured around repetitive templates and densely cross-referencing clauses, conditions that characterize most real-world specialized corpora. In this work, we decouple the two operations: reasoning paths are enumerated offline over a graph of contextual keyword centroids, and the teacher is invoked only to verbalize pre-validated paths. The graph enforces five geometric admissibility constraints, for which we provide Gram-matrix arguments establishing that local similarity bounds alone admit endpoint drift up to ${\sim}91^{\circ}$, and that an upper similarity bound is necessary to exit dense embedding cliques formed by boilerplate text. A matched-size ablation isolates the mechanism: at equal training scale, constrained and unconstrained chains yield indistinguishable downstream performance, and the gain at full scale comes from a 4.4$\times$ expansion of the usable corpus rather than from higher per-chain quality -- reframing the role of graph constraints, in this setting, as raising teacher synthesizability rather than improving chain content. Fine-tuning Qwen3-32B on 80K examples constructed from the CUAD legal contract corpus improves closed-book Token F1 from 21.66% to 38.58%. We have released our codes at https://github.com/hkgai-official/GCSCS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出图约束路径选择（Graph-Constrained Path Selection）方法，用于从纯文本中规模化构建多跳训练数据。该方法将推理路径枚举与教师模型口头化解耦：先通过上下文关键词质心图离线枚举路径，并施加五个几何可允许约束（包括端点漂移上限等），再调用教师模型对预验证路径进行口头化。实验在CUAD法律合同语料上构建80K示例微调Qwen3-32B，Token F1从21.66%提升至38.58%，消融实验表明增益主要来自可用语料4.4倍扩展，而非单链质量提升。
Motivation: 现有方法在结构化重复模板和密集交叉引用文本中退化，而这类文本在真实专业语料中普遍存在；同时，单教师模型联合发现证据路径并口头化的方式在复杂文档中效果受限。
Method: 解耦推理路径发现与口头化。首先构建文档的历史上下文关键词质心图，然后离线枚举所有满足五个几何约束（如端点漂移上限、避免密集嵌入团等）的路径，最后仅对通过约束的路径调用教师模型生成问答对。约束通过Gram矩阵论证保证。
Result: 在CUAD法律合同语料上微调Qwen3-32B，封闭书Token F1从21.66%提升至38.58%；等规模消融表明约束与非约束链性能无显著差异，全规模增益来自可用语料4.4倍扩展。
Conclusion: 本文强调图约束在本设置中的角色是提升教师模型的可合成性（教师口头化成功率），而非提高链内容质量；同时指出局部相似度约束不足以防止端点漂移，需要上界约束退出密集嵌入团。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A holomorphic neural network framework for 3D boundary value problems governed by harmonic potentials
papers.abstract_en: We present a neural-network-based framework for the solution of three-dimensional boundary value problems where the solution is expressible in terms of harmonic potentials. The approach leverages the Whittaker integral formula, which allows representing the solution through functions that are holomorphic with respect to a suitable complex variable. These functions are subsequently approximated using holomorphic neural networks, which guaranty fulfillment of the holomorphicity requirement. A key feature of the proposed formulation is that the governing partial differential equations (PDEs) are satisfied exactly by construction. Therefore, in contrast to standard physics-informed neural networks, no residual minimization of PDEs is required in the interior of the domain, and training is based exclusively on boundary collocation points. The method is validated against three-dimensional Laplace and linear elasticity problems, where, in the latter case, displacement and stress fields are expressed via the Papkovich-Neuber potentials. The numerical results show an accurate approximation of both scalar and vector fields, with errors remaining controlled throughout the domain. Overall, the work demonstrates that the incorporation of analytical structures into neural network architectures provides a natural and effective framework for the meshless approximation of three-dimensional boundary value problems while preserving the underlying properties of the governing equations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于神经网络的框架，用于求解解可由调和势（harmonic potentials）表达的3D边界值问题。方法利用Whittaker积分公式，通过全纯神经网络（holomorphic neural networks）近似解析函数，从而精确满足控制PDE，仅需边界配置点训练。在3D Laplace和线性弹性问题上的验证显示标量和矢量场近似精度高，误差在全域可控。
Motivation: 传统物理信息神经网络（PINNs）需要在内部进行残差最小化，计算成本高且可能不精确。本文旨在通过构造满足PDE的表示来避免内部残差，仅依赖边界条件训练。
Method: 利用Whittaker积分公式将解表示为关于复变量的全纯函数，然后用全纯神经网络近似这些全纯函数，从而保证全纯性要求。通过构造，控制PDE被精确满足，训练仅需边界配置点。
Result: 在3D Laplace和线性弹性（使用Papkovich-Neuber势）问题上验证，标量和矢量场近似误差小，且误差在全域受控。
Conclusion: 将分析结构融入神经网络架构为无网格近似3D边界值问题提供了自然有效的框架，同时保留了控制方程的性质。

summary_sections.conclusion: 将分析结构融入神经网络架构为无网格近似3D边界值问题提供了自然有效的框架，同时保留了控制方程的性质。

papers.title: Beyond Classification: Dynamic Adapter Routing for Continual Multimodal Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: While retrieval is a core function of vision-language models, continually updating these models for retrieval tasks remains critically underexplored. Existing work often approaches continual retrieval through the lens of class-incremental learning (CIL), evaluating both standard CIL methods and retrieval-oriented adaptations in settings that may not fully capture the retrieval-specific dynamics. To address this, we introduce a new, principled evaluation framework for continual multimodal retrieval (CMR) spanning diverse visual domains, and systematically evaluate common approaches within this setting. Our empirical analysis shows that standard CIL methods fail to yield meaningful gains in our more challenging scenario. Therefore, we propose Dynamic Adapter Routing (DAR), a novel approach based on adapters selected through prototype-based routing and combined via model merging.DAR achieves superior performance over the previous baselines and demonstrates strong generalization under out-of-distribution evaluation. Our results highlights the unique challenges of CMR and encourages further research in this direction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种针对连续多模态检索（CMR）的评估框架，并发现标准的类增量学习方法在此场景下效果有限。作者进一步提出了动态适配器路由（DAR）方法，通过基于原型的路由和模型合并来提升性能，在多个视觉域上取得了优于基线的结果，并展现了良好的分布外泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有研究多从类增量学习角度处理连续检索，但未能充分捕捉检索任务的动态特性。本文旨在建立更合理的连续多模态检索评估框架，并探索有效方法。
Method: 提出动态适配器路由（DAR），使用基于原型的路由选择适配器，并通过模型合并技术整合多个适配器，以适应不断变化的数据分布。
Result: DAR在多个视觉域上的连续多模态检索任务中超越了现有基线，并在分布外评估中表现出强泛化能力。
Conclusion: 连续多模态检索具有独特挑战，DAR作为一种有效策略可推动该方向进一步发展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EchoRL: Reinforcement Learning via Rollout Echoing
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards is an effective route for post-training to strengthen the reasoning capability of large language models. However, as training proceeds, the learning signal can collapse thus makes the training gain become marginal and ineffective. Specifically, a growing fraction of prompts' rollouts become advantage-degenerated: all the self-generated rollouts show verified-success, making the standard deviation over their rewards be zero; accordingly each rollout's advantage becomes degenerated (zero) as well. Given such rollouts' advantages, the policy-gradient for model optimization eventually vanishes, capping the training performance. We argue that some of these rollouts still contain valuable learning signals but unfortunately omitted with the existing RLVR methods. In this paper, inspired through analyzing the entropy pattern behind golden trajectories produced by external expert models, we propose EchoRL for better exploiting the advantage-degenerated rollouts to further improve the training performance. EchoRL is a lightweight module that first identifies an EchoClip from verified-success rollouts based on their step-level entropy values, and then feeds this clip back as an auxiliary supervision signal in the RL objective. Extensive experiments across 10 benchmarks, 5 LLM backbones, and 4 popular RLVR post-training methods demonstrate that EchoRL consistently improves RLVR post-training with minimal overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对强化学习中优势退化导致学习信号消失的问题，提出EchoRL方法，通过从成功rollout中提取EchoClip作为辅助监督信号，提升RLVR后训练效果。
Motivation: 现有RLVR方法在训练后期，大量rollout的优势退化（advantage-degenerated），导致策略梯度消失，训练收益边际化。
Method: 提出EchoRL轻量模块，通过分析外部专家模型生成的金色轨迹的熵模式，从验证成功的rollout中识别EchoClip，并将其作为辅助监督信号加入RL目标。
Result: 在10个基准、5种LLM骨干、4种流行的RLVR方法上，EchoRL一致地提升了RLVR后训练效果，且开销极小。
Conclusion: 摘要强调EchoRL能够利用被现有方法忽略的优势退化rollout中的有价值信号，进一步提升训练性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HiERO-StepG @ Ego4D Step Grounding Challenge: hierarchical activity understanding enables zero-shot step grounding
papers.abstract_en: Procedural activities follow well-defined structures: whether we consider a cooking recipe or a mechanic repairing a car, these activities naturally decompose in a hierarchy of steps and sub-steps. Traditional approaches for step grounding require extensive annotations and scale poorly. Instead, we argue that such hierarchical structure can emerge naturally from uncurated videos of human activities through recurring patterns of co-occurring actions and activities. Our approach builds on HiERO, a weakly-supervised representation learning approach that maps close in the feature space actions that are functionally related to each other, leveraging only fine-grained action-level narrations. In this feature space, procedure steps can be detected by a simple clustering, with no additional task-specific fine-tuning. For the Ego4D Step Grounding challenge, we augment this approach by ensuring fine and coarse level agreement in step assignments, enforcing strict temporal monotonicity of the grounded steps and post-processing the detected steps to reduce the impact of noisy predictions. We call this approach HiERO-StepG and it achieves 56.27 % on the R@1 (IoU = 0.3) metric on the global leaderboard at submission time, ranking second while being completely zero-shot and not requiring procedure-specific annotations. Project page: https://github.com/andreazenotto/HiERO-StepG.
papers.comment: Technical report for the Ego4D Goal Step - Step Grounding challenge at CVPR 2026, derived from arXiv:2505.12911
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HiERO-StepG方法，用于Ego4D Step Grounding挑战，基于层次活动表示实现零样本步骤定位。方法利用弱监督学习从细粒度动作叙述中学习特征空间，通过聚类检测步骤，无需任务特定微调。在排行榜上以R@1 (IoU=0.3) 56.27%排名第二。
Motivation: 传统步骤定位方法需要大量标注且扩展性差，而程序性活动（如烹饪、修理）具有自然层次结构，可以从无标注视频中通过共现模式自动涌现。
Method: 基于HiERO的弱监督表示学习，将功能相关的动作映射到相近特征空间；通过聚类检测步骤，并增加粗细粒度一致性约束、严格时间单调性后处理来提升准确性。
Result: 在Ego4D Step Grounding挑战全局排行榜上达到56.27% R@1 (IoU=0.3)，排名第二，且完全零样本，无需过程特定标注。
Conclusion: 层次活动结构可以从无标注视频中自然学习，实现零样本步骤定位，但依赖动作叙述质量，且当前仅在单一基准上验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: What changes after deployment? A survey on On-device Learning in TinyML
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning models on microcontroller-class devices (TinyML) face a fundamental challenge: post-deployment distribution change undermines static models. On-device learning (ODL) addresses this by running the learning process directly on the device. The existing literature has not characterized how distribution change occurs or how different change types require different solutions. Approximately 70 ODL works are surveyed under one principle: the distribution change regime. The survey analyzes how different types of distribution change influence the applications addressable on-device, the hardware employed, and the structure of the solutions. A persistent gap between methodological benchmarks and real-world deployment scenarios is also identified.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文调查了TinyML中设备上学习（On-device Learning）的挑战，重点在于部署后的分布变化对静态模型的影响。综述了约70篇相关工作，按照分布变化的不同类型进行分析，并指出现有方法基准与实际部署场景之间存在差距。
Motivation: 微控制器类设备上的机器学习模型（TinyML）在部署后面临分布变化的问题，而现有文献未系统表征分布变化如何发生以及不同变化类型需要不同解决方案。
Method: 对约70篇设备上学习（ODL）工作进行综述，按照分布变化类型这一原则进行分析，考察不同类型变化对可应用设备、硬件和解决方案结构的影响。
Result: 论文识别出方法基准与实际部署场景之间的持续差距。
Conclusion: 强调了分布变化类型对TinyML设备上学习解决方案设计的重要性，并指出现有评估与实际应用之间的脱节。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Comparing LLM-Based Conversational and Graphical Interfaces for Industrial Decision Tasks: An Exploratory Mixed-Methods Study
papers.abstract_en: The use of Generative AI Conversational User Interfaces (CUI) as a new way to access and analyze data is growing in all sectors, and the industrial one is no exception. There, large amounts of data produced by IoT devices are flowing through user interfaces and may require them a new adaptation to the new analyses needs of decision-makers. LLM-based CUIs are promising a new way to directly interact with those data through the directness of natural language and without the learning costs that every GUI design has. Moreover, the capabilities of LLMs and their agency open up the possibility to automate some tasks and help with the reasoning during decision-making activities. But are this promises well founded? We try to scope this general question with a mixed-approach study comparing a state-of-the-art dashboard with a conversational agent. A total of 20 participants used both interfaces to complete four simulated industrial decision tasks of varying complexity. We combined measures of mental workload, completion time, and decision accuracy with a post-study questionnaire and semi-structured interviews analyzed through thematic analysis. The findings suggest that the conversational agent can reduce interactional effort by supporting more direct access to information, while the dashboard remains valuable for overview and verification. However, these benefits may vary across tasks and require validation through larger-scale studies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过混合方法研究比较了基于LLM的对话界面和图形界面在工业决策任务中的表现。20名参与者使用两种界面完成四个不同复杂度的模拟任务，测量了心理负荷、完成时间和决策准确性，并结合问卷和半结构化访谈进行分析。结果表明，对话界面能减少交互努力、提供更直接的信息访问，而仪表盘在概览和验证方面仍有价值，但效果因任务而异，需更大规模研究验证。
Motivation: 工业中大量IoT数据通过界面流动，决策者需要新的分析方式。LLM对话界面承诺通过自然语言直接交互且无需学习成本，但缺乏实证比较，本文旨在检验这些承诺是否成立。
Method: 采用混合方法研究，比较最先进的仪表盘与对话代理。20名参与者完成四个模拟工业决策任务，测量心理负荷、完成时间和决策准确性，并通过问卷和半结构化访谈进行定性分析。
Result: 对话界面能减少交互努力、支持更直接的信息访问；仪表盘仍适合概览和验证。但效果因任务复杂度而异，需大规模验证。
Conclusion: LLM对话界面在减少交互努力方面有潜力，但不应取代图形界面；两者互补，且效果依赖具体任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multivariate Distributional Reinforcement Learning Using Sliced Divergences
papers.abstract_en: Distributional reinforcement learning (DRL) models the full return distribution rather than expectations, but extending it to multivariate settings remains challenging. Many common metrics do not naturally generalize beyond one dimension or lose computational tractability, and the multivariate case introduces additional difficulties such as general matrix discounting, for which no contraction results are available. We introduce Sliced Distributional Reinforcement Learning (SDRL), which lifts tractable one-dimensional divergences to multivariate return distributions via projections. We prove Bellman contraction for uniform slicing under shared scalar discounting, and introduce a maximum-slicing variant with contraction under general dense discount matrices. SDRL supports a broad class of base divergences; we analyze Wasserstein, Cramér, and Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD), and characterize which SDRL variants suit the standard single-sample Bellman update used in distributional RL. We evaluate SDRL on a toy chain problem and a gridworld image-based environment as well as a subset of Atari games.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出切片分布强化学习（Sliced Distributional Reinforcement Learning, SDRL），通过将可计算的一维散度投影到多元回报分布来解决多变量分布强化学习中的挑战。证明均匀切片下共享标量折扣的贝尔曼收缩，并引入最大切片变体以支持一般密集折扣矩阵。在玩具链问题、基于图像的网格世界环境和部分Atari游戏上进行了评估。
Motivation: 分布强化学习向多元设置扩展时存在困难：常用度量难以自然泛化到一维以上或失去计算可处理性，且多元情况下通用矩阵折扣缺乏收缩结果。
Method: 利用切片散度（sliced divergence）将一维散度通过线性投影提升到多维分布，论证均匀切片下的贝尔曼收缩及最大切片变体在一般折扣矩阵下的收缩性质。分析Wasserstein、Cramér和最大均值差异（MMD）等基散度，区分适合标准单样本贝尔曼更新的变体。
Result: 在玩具链、基于图像的网格世界和部分Atari游戏上评估SDRL，验证其有效性。
Conclusion: SDRL支持多种基散度，为多元分布强化学习提供了一种可处理且具有收缩保证的框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Shared Doubt: Zero-shot Cross-Lingual Confidence Estimation for Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Confidence estimation (CE), i.e. quantifying the reliability of a model's prediction, has attracted great interest in the context of large language models (LLMs). However, most studies focus on English, ignoring the multilingual reality of LLM usage, while many CE methods degrade or require retraining across languages. To address this gap, we investigate whether multilingual LLMs encode shared, language-transferable confidence features. We use a lightweight linear probe that predicts answer correctness directly from intermediate representations. Trained monolingually, the probe generalizes zero-shot to unseen, typologically diverse languages without target-language supervision. Learned layer weights and multiple ablations reveal that confidence features concentrate in middle layers across languages, suggesting a shared confidence subspace. While zero-shot cross-lingual performance depends on similarity to the source language, the probe provides a strong baseline without any retraining and compares favorably to other popular confidence estimation methods.
papers.summary_zh:

Method: 使用线性探针从多语言LLM的中间层表示直接预测答案是否正确。探针仅用单语数据训练，然后零样本应用于其他语言。

Conclusion: 多语言LLM存在共享的置信度子空间，使得零样本跨语言置信度估计成为可能；探针是无需重训的强基线。

papers.title: Latent Geometric Chords for Query-Efficient Decision-Based Adversarial Attacks
papers.abstract_en: While decision-based black-box adversarial attacks present a severe security threat, current methodologies suffer from fundamental limitations. Pixel-wise attacks frequently introduce unnatural, high-frequency visual artifacts, while latent-space frameworks are confined by the limited search space of low-dimensional manifolds and inherent reconstruction flaws. To resolve these limitations, we propose Latent Geometric Chords (LGC) for Query-Efficient Decision-Based Adversarial Attacks alongside a variant, LGC-H. At its core, LGC navigates decision boundaries by executing a curvature-aware geometric search within a compressed semantic manifold. To guarantee high visual fidelity and circumvent dimensionality bottlenecks, we introduce a Residual-based Adversarial Generation (RAG) mechanism. RAG isolates semantic perturbations as geometric chords and superimposes them directly onto the original source image. RAG substantially resolves baseline reconstruction flaws and effectively doubles the permissible search space dimensions. Experimental results demonstrate that LGC achieves robust cross-dataset transferability and substantially outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. Notably, our method, LGC, minimizes perturbation magnitudes while achieving state-of-the-art visual fidelity--with a Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM) exceeding 0.99 and a Learned Perceptual Image Patch Similarity (LPIPS) below 0.01 at 5000 queries--and sustaining high attack success rates under stringent perceptual constraints, successfully compromising adversarially trained robust models. The source code is available at: https://github.com/eihmuekhine/Latent-Geometric-Chords.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 9 figures, 7 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security. The source code is available at https://github.com/eihmuekhine/Latent-Geometric-Chords
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对决策型黑盒对抗攻击中像素级攻击引入高频伪影、潜空间方法受限于低维流形和重建缺陷的问题，提出Latent Geometric Chords (LGC)方法。LGC在压缩语义流形上执行曲率感知的几何搜索，并引入残差对抗生成（RAG）机制，将语义扰动作为几何弦叠加到原始图像，有效加倍搜索空间。实验表明，LGC在5000次查询下实现SSIM>0.99、LPIPS<0.01的视觉保真度，同时保持高攻击成功率，并具备跨数据集迁移性。
Motivation: 现有决策型黑盒攻击存在像素级攻击产生不自然高频伪影，以及潜空间方法搜索空间受限和重建缺陷的根本限制。
Method: 提出LGC，核心是在压缩语义流形上执行曲率感知的几何搜索；并引入RAG机制，将语义扰动隔离为几何弦并直接叠加到原始图像，从而消除重建缺陷并加倍有效搜索空间维度。
Result: 实验显示LGC在最小化扰动的同时达到前沿视觉保真度（SSIM>0.99, LPIPS<0.01 at 5000 queries），且攻击成功率在苛刻感知约束下仍保持高位，能成功突破对抗训练鲁棒模型。
Conclusion: LGC通过几何搜索与残差生成机制显著提升了决策型攻击的视觉质量和效率，并展示了强跨数据集迁移性。

papers.title: TALON: Token-Aligned Lightweight Adapters for 6-DoF Spacecraft Pose Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Monocular 6-DoF spacecraft pose estimation methods predominantly process individual frames, discarding the temporal information present in an image sequence acquired during spacecraft manoeuvres. Few temporal approaches require full backbone fine-tuning or auxiliary optical flow networks, risking catastrophic forgetting or increasing computational cost, respectively. We propose TALON (Token-Aligned Lightweight adapters for Orbital Navigation): spatiotemporal 3D adapters injected before the self-attention layers of a frozen ViT vision transformer, combined with a patch-token alignment loss that geometrically grounds the adapted features to keypoint structure through a prototype-conditioned KL-divergence objective. Pre-attention placement allows the frozen attention to reason over temporally enriched tokens, achieving stronger performance with a single adapter per block than post-attention alternatives. The alignment loss shapes the intermediate representations so that each keypoint induces a spatially precise activation in the token field, while the framework adds less than 5% parameters to the frozen backbone. On SPADES dataset, TALON reduces the pose error by 50% over the prior state-of-the-art, and on SwissCube dataset it surpasses the prior best by 21.8% in ADD-0.1d accuracy. Zero-shot cross-domain evaluation from sim-to-real on SPARK real data reduces pose error by 4.7x, and ablations characterise the role of adapter depth across in-domain and cross-domain settings.
papers.comment: 13 pages paper with 3 figures in total
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TALON，一种在冻结的 ViT 视觉 Transformer 注意力层前注入时空 3D 适配器的方法，用于单目 6 自由度航天器姿态估计。适配器结合 patch-token 对齐损失，通过原型条件 KL 散度将特征几何地锚定到关键点结构。在 SPADES 数据集上，姿态误差较先前最优降低 50%，在 SwissCube 上 ADD-0.1d 准确率提升 21.8%，零样本跨域模拟到真实场景误差降低 4.7 倍。
Motivation: 现有单目航天器姿态估计方法大多处理单帧，忽略了序列中的时间信息。少数时序方法需要微调整个骨干网络或使用辅助光流网络，存在灾难性遗忘或计算成本高的问题。
Method: 在冻结 ViT 的自注意力层前注入轻量级时空 3D 适配器，并引入 patch-token 对齐损失，通过原型条件的 KL 散度目标函数使适配后的特征在几何上与关键点结构对齐。每块仅用一个适配器，参数量增加少于 5%。
Result: 在 SPADES 数据集上姿态误差降低 50%，在 SwissCube 数据集上 ADD-0.1d 准确率提升 21.8%，在 SPARK 真实数据上零样本模拟到真实姿态误差降低 4.7 倍。
Conclusion: 预注意力放置的适配器能利用冻结注意力处理时间增强的 token，对齐损失塑造中间表示使每个关键点在 token 场中产生空间精确的激活。

papers.title: Fixed-Point Masked Generative Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Masked Generative Models (MGMs) enable parallel decoding and achieve strong performance across modalities, but require full-sequence bidirectional transformers at every step, making training costly and degrading quality under low sampling budgets. Existing work improves efficiency via better samplers or cheaper fixed-depth denoisers, but they still allocate a fixed amount of denoiser computation to each refinement step. We introduce Fixed-Point Masked Generative Models (FP-MGMs), which replace part of the denoiser with a fixed-point solver over shared attention layers to enable adaptive depth with fewer parameters. To make it more effective for masked generation, we first introduce a cross-step consistency loss, which aligns hidden representations at neighboring denoising steps and, second, three-state reuse (3SR) which warm-starts the solver using the previous solution by treating differently unchanged, still-masked, and newly revealed tokens respectively. Together, these components define our complete training-to-inference framework for fixed-point masked generation, \emph{CoFRe}. We also show that pre-trained MGMs can be converted into FP-MGMs with short fine-tuning, avoiding full retraining. Across modalities, CoFRe improves the quality and cost trade-off. On OpenWebText, CoFRe reduces parameters by 38.8\%, training time by 11.5\%, and VRAM by 16.9\%, while improving generative perplexity from 830.8 to 101.8 at a budget of $96$ transformer-block forward passes, compared to MDLM. In ImageNette, CoFRe reduces training time by 48.6\% and VRAM by 50.7\%, while improving FID in all sample budgets tested. Overall, CoFRe offers a practical framework for cheaper training and stronger low-budget masked generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Fixed-Point Masked Generative Models (FP-MGMs)，用固定点求解器替换部分去噪器，通过共享注意力层实现自适应深度和更少参数。引入跨步一致性损失和三状态重用（3SR）策略，形成CoFRe框架。在OpenWebText和ImageNette上，CoFRe在减少参数、训练时间和显存的同时，提升了生成质量（困惑度降低、FID改善）。
Motivation: 现有掩码生成模型（MGMs）每一步都需要完整序列双向Transformer，训练成本高且低采样预算时质量下降。尽管有更高效的采样器或固定深度去噪器，但每步计算量固定。
Method: 提出FP-MGM，用固定点求解器在共享注意力层上迭代，实现自适应深度。引入跨步一致性损失对齐相邻去噪步的隐表示，以及三状态重用（3SR）利用前一步解对未变、仍掩码和新揭示token分别热启动。整体框架为CoFRe。
Result: 在OpenWebText上，与MDLM相比，参数减少38.8%，训练时间减少11.5%，显存减少16.9%，在96个Transformer块前向传播预算下生成困惑度从830.8降至101.8。在ImageNette上，训练时间减少48.6%，显存减少50.7%，所有采样预算下FID均有改善。
Conclusion: CoFRe提供了更廉价训练和更强低预算掩码生成的实用框架，且可将预训练MGM通过短微调转换为FP-MGM，避免完整重训练。

papers.title: Benchmarking and Enhancing Text-to-Image Models for Generating Visual Representations in Early Arithmetic Education
papers.abstract_en: AI systems are increasingly used to support educational content creation, yet it remains unclear whether they can generate outputs that faithfully represent the pedagogical concepts they are intended to teach. Thus, we introduce equation-to-visual generation, a task that, in contrast to conventional image generation, requires producing pedagogically meaningful visuals from arithmetic equations while precisely preserving their numerical and relational structure. Informed by interviews with teachers and an analysis of educational materials, we construct E2V-Bench, a benchmark spanning four pedagogically grounded visual types, along with automatic metrics for evaluating visual correctness. Our evaluation reveals that recent text-to-image (T2I) models frequently fail on this task, with errors dominated by incorrect object counts and broken relational structure. Building on this, we explore benchmark-guided enhancement strategies. These strategies improve representative models, while the remaining gap calls for stronger numerical and relational grounding in future T2I models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了方程到视觉生成任务，要求从算术方程生成具有教学意义的图像，并精确保留数值和关系结构。通过教师访谈和教材分析构建了E2V-Bench基准，涵盖四种教学视觉类型及自动评估指标。评估显示当前文本到图像模型频繁失败，错误主要源于对象计数错误和关系结构断裂。研究探索了基准引导的增强策略以改进模型，但仍有较大差距，呼吁未来模型加强数值和关系 grounding。
Motivation: 现有文本到图像模型在教育内容生成中能否忠实表达教学概念尚不明确，缺乏针对算术方程生成教学视觉的评估基准和增强方法。
Method: 通过教师访谈和教材分析构建E2V-Bench基准，包含四种教学视觉类型和自动评估指标，并基于基准探索增强策略以改进文本到图像模型。
Result: 当前文本到图像模型在方程到视觉生成任务中频繁失败，主要错误为对象计数错误和关系结构断裂；增强策略能改进部分模型，但仍有显著差距。
Conclusion: 未来文本到图像模型需更强的数值和关系 grounding 能力，才能胜任教育内容生成中的方程到视觉任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Simulation of collision avoidance behavior in crowd movement by data-driven approach
papers.abstract_en: Crowd movement simulation is essential for pedestrian safety management and facility layout optimization. Data-driven models enhance trajectory prediction accuracy under Euclidean metrics, yet they suffer from excessively high collision rates, especially in bidirectional and multidirectional flows. In this paper, we establish a novel data-driven crowd simulation model that incorporates the pedestrian collision mechanism into the loss function to reduce collisions. A new lateral-acceleration-based collision loss function and a Voronoi-based motion feature extraction approach are proposed. The model is based on a Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) architecture and is termed CPGAN (Collision-Penalized GAN). We evaluate CPGAN in bidirectional flow scenarios, which involve frequent collision avoidance behaviors. Results show that the proposed lateral-acceleration-based collision loss significantly reduces opposite-direction pedestrian collision rates to levels comparable with controlled experiments. CPGAN effectively simulates bidirectional flow, reproducing lane formation and N-t curves. The research outcomes can provide inspiration for integrating pedestrian dynamics mechanisms into loss functions in data-driven crowd simulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种数据驱动的人群运动模拟模型 CPGAN（Collision-Penalized GAN），通过引入基于横向加速度的碰撞损失函数和 Voronoi 特征提取，将行人碰撞机制融入损失函数，从而减少双向流中的碰撞。实验表明，CPGAN 显著降低了反向碰撞率，达到与受控实验相当的水平，并成功再现了车道形成和 N-t 曲线。
Motivation: 现有数据驱动的人群模拟模型在欧氏度量下轨迹预测准确，但碰撞率过高，尤其在双向和多向流中，需要引入显式的碰撞惩罚机制来降低碰撞。
Method: 基于生成对抗网络（GAN）架构，提出 CPGAN 模型，包含一个基于横向加速度的碰撞损失函数和一个基于 Voronoi 图的运动特征提取方法，从而在训练中惩罚碰撞行为。
Result: 在双向流场景中，CPGAN 的反向行人碰撞率显著降低，达到与受控实验相似的水平；模型有效模拟了双向流中的车道形成和 N-t 曲线。
Conclusion: 本文展示了将行人动力学机制（如碰撞）融入损失函数可以有效提升数据驱动人群模拟的真实性，为该领域提供了新思路。

papers.title: Probabilistic Precipitation Nowcasting with Rectified Flow Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Accurate weather forecasts are essential across various domains and are safety-critical in extreme weather conditions. Compared to simulation-based forecasting, data-driven approaches show greater efficiency, enabling short-term, high-resolution nowcasting. In particular, diffusion models proved effective in weather nowcasting due to their strong probabilistic foundation. However, existing methods rely on deterministic compression to reduce the complexity of high-dimensional weather data, limiting their ability to capture uncertainty in the decoding process. In this work, we introduce $\textbf{FREUD}$, a $\textbf{Fr}$ame-wise $\textbf{E}$ncoder and $\textbf{U}$nited $\textbf{D}$ecoder model based on rectified flow transformers for efficient compression of spatio-temporal weather data. Frame-wise encoding enables continuous forecast updates, while the unified video decoder ensures temporal consistency. Our uncertainty-preserving first stage allows us to capture aleatoric uncertainty via ensembling, which is particularly beneficial for extreme weather events with high decoding variability. We achieve state-of-the-art performance in precipitation nowcasting with a compact latent-space rectified flow transformer on the SEVIR benchmark and show further performance gains by model and test-time scaling. Code available here: https://github.com/CompVis/weather-rf
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FREUD 模型，基于整流流变压器（rectified flow transformers）实现概率降水临近预报。通过逐帧编码和统一视频解码器，有效压缩时空天气数据并保留不确定性，在 SEVIR 基准上达到最先进性能，尤其适用于极端天气事件。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型临近预报方法依赖确定性压缩，限制了捕获解码过程中不确定性的能力，尤其在极端天气条件下。
Method: 提出 FREUD 模型，包含逐帧编码器（frame-wise encoder）和统一视频解码器（unified video decoder），基于整流流变压器。通过不确定性保留的第一阶段和集成（ensembling）捕捉 aleatoric uncertainty，使用紧凑的潜空间整流流变压器。
Result: 在 SEVIR 基准的降水临近预报任务上达到最先进性能，并通过模型和测试时缩放进一步提升。
Conclusion: 方法在降水临近预报中取得优异性能，强调了不确定性保留和缩放策略的有效性。

papers.title: Beyond Additive Decompositions: Interpretability Through Separability
papers.abstract_en: Interpretable machine learning requires models that are accurate and structurally faithful to the data.Existing explainability methods rely heavily on additive representations (e.g., Generalized Additive Models (GAMs), SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP), functional ANOVA), which can suffer from signal cancellation and off-support extrapolation in the presence of strong interactions. We propose Tensor Separation Learning (TSL), a regression model that learns a sum of rank-1 products of univariate per-feature functions via a stagewise greedy procedure with orthogonal refitting. By enforcing separability, TSL avoids the information loss inherent in additive projections caused by marginalizing higher-order interactions. The learned TSL model can be fully reconstructed from first-order partial dependence functions, up to constant factors. This stage-wise correspondence ensures that the resulting visualizations are faithful to the fitted components. We establish approximation-rate guarantees for functions with bounded mixed $p$-th order partial derivatives and demonstrate that TSL competes with black-box models on regression benchmarks.
papers.comment: To appear in Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出张量分离学习（Tensor Separation Learning, TSL），一种回归模型，通过逐阶段贪婪过程和正交重构学习单变量逐特征函数的秩-1乘积之和。TSL避免了加性投影中由于忽略高阶交互导致的信息损失，其学习到的模型可以从一阶偏依赖函数中完全重构（至多常数因子），保证可视化忠实于拟合成分。在回归基准上，TSL与黑盒模型竞争，并给出了有界混合p阶偏导数函数的逼近率保证。
Motivation: 现有可解释方法（如GAM、SHAP、functional ANOVA）依赖加性表示，在强交互下会出现信号抵消和支持外推，导致信息损失。
Method: 提出TSL模型，学习形如和项为单变量函数乘积的秩-1分解，通过逐阶段贪婪过程与正交重构拟合，强制可分离性以避免加性投影的信息损失。
Result: 在回归基准上，TSL与黑盒模型性能相当；理论上提供了有界混合p阶偏导数函数的逼近率保证。
Conclusion: TSL通过可分离性避免了加性分解的缺陷，提供了忠实的一阶可视化，并具有理论保证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MAECO-Lite: Modular Ontology for Dynamic Malware Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Capturing dynamic malware behavior in a practical but still semantically precise manner remains a significant challenge in cyber threat intelligence. While standards such as MAEC and STIX provide widely adopted vocabularies for describing malware artifacts and observations, they represent data with considerable complexity in structures that often obscure important ontological distinctions. In particular, they tend to conflate enduring malware artifacts with the events generated during execution, thereby flattening distinctions that are central in foundational standards for ontology design. In this paper, we conduct a foundational ontological analysis of core MAEC and STIX constructs relevant to dynamic malware analysis relying on Unified Foundational Ontology (UFO) as a theoretical lens. Our analysis reveals some ontological mismatches arising from the conflation of artifacts, dispositions, and runtime events in MAEC and STIX that complicate coherent representation of dynamic malware behavior and, from a practical perspective, limit the ability to reason about execution traces. Based on these insights, we propose MAECO-Lite, a lightweight ontology designed to represent data and operationalize their processing for dynamic malware analysis. The ontology adopts a modular structure centered on samples, processes, actions, system artifacts, and MITRE ATT&CK Techniques, while maintaining a clear separation between enduring entities and runtime events. An initial evaluation using description logic concept learning algorithms shows that the simplified ontology significantly improves learning performance, demonstrating that ontologically grounded modelling can enhance both semantic clarity and computational usability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文对MAEC和STIX标准进行基础本体分析，指出它们在恶意软件动态行为表示中的本体论问题，并提出MAECO-Lite轻量级本体，以清晰分离持久实体和运行时事件。实验证明其提升概念学习性能。
Motivation: 现有标准（如MAEC、STIX）在描述动态恶意软件行为时存在本体论混淆，将持久的人工制品与运行时事件混为一谈，限制了执行轨迹的推理能力。
Method: 基于统一基础本体论（UFO）进行本体分析，提出MAECO-Lite模块化本体，围绕样本、进程、动作、系统工件和MITRE ATT&CK技术构建，明确区分持久实体和事件。
Result: 使用描述逻辑概念学习算法的初始评估显示，简化本体显著提高了学习性能，表明本体论建模可以增强语义清晰性和计算可用性。
Conclusion: 论文强调了本体论建模在动态恶意软件分析中的重要性，并指出MAECO-Lite有助于改善语义清晰性和计算可用性。

papers.title: Probing Collision Grounding in Vision-Language Models for Safe Human-Robot Collaboration
papers.abstract_en: Safe human--robot collaboration requires more than visual description: a monitor must determine whether the robot body is safely separated, already colliding with the scene or a person, or about to collide. We call this capability collision grounding: binding visual observations to robot body geometry, camera viewpoint, scene layout, human proximity, and temporal motion in order to infer present and imminent contact. We introduce TouchSafeBench, a physics-grounded benchmark for evaluating collision grounding in vision-language models (VLMs). Built in Habitat~3.0, TouchSafeBench contains 2,940 simulated indoor co-presence episodes across social navigation and social rearrangement, with synchronized multi-view RGB-D observations, top-down trajectory maps, calibrated camera metadata, and simulator-derived contact labels. We study two deployment-facing tasks: classifying the current safety state and warning about imminent collision before contact. Across three frontier or robotics-oriented VLMs and nine visual representations, current models remain far from reliable: the best average Macro-F1 stays below 50\%, explicit depth is not automatically transformed into robot-body collision evidence, and robot--scene contact is consistently harder than human-contact risk. TouchSafeBench reveals a central limitation of embodied VLMs: visual fluency does not imply physical accountability. Reliable robot safety monitors will need representations that explicitly bind viewpoint, robot morphology, metric geometry, and future collision. We will release the benchmark upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出碰撞接地（collision grounding）概念，即视觉语言模型（VLM）需判断机器人是否安全分离、正在碰撞或即将碰撞。作者构建TouchSafeBench基准，基于Habitat 3.0模拟环境，包含2940个室内协作场景，提供多视角RGB-D观测、轨迹图、相机标定和接触标签。实验表明，当前VLM在分类安全状态和预警即将碰撞任务上表现不佳，最佳平均Macro-F1低于50%，深度信息未自动转化为碰撞证据，机器人-场景接触比人机接触更难检测。
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型缺乏对机器人自身几何、视角、场景布局、人类接近度和时间运动的综合推理能力，无法可靠判断机器人与环境或人的实际接触状态。
Method: 构建TouchSafeBench基准，包含2940个模拟共处场景，分为社交导航和社交重排任务，提供多视图RGB-D、轨迹地图、相机元数据和地面真实接触标签。定义两个部署任务：当前安全状态分类和即将碰撞预警。
Result: 在三个前沿或机器人导向的VLMs和九种视觉表示上，最佳平均Macro-F1低于50%，显式深度未自动转化为碰撞证据，机器人-场景接触比人机接触更难。
Conclusion: 当前VLM在碰撞接地方面远不可靠，需要能显式绑定视角、机器人形态、度量几何和未来碰撞的表示，才能构建可靠的安全监控。

papers.title: Geometry-based Schrödinger Bridges for Trustworthy Multimodal Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Real-world multimodal systems must be robust against low-quality data, such as sensor noise, incomplete multimodal data and conflicting inputs. However, existing trustworthy fusion methods rely on the model's own prediction confidence to judge data quality. This creates a circular dependency: when a model is confident but wrong, these methods fail to detect the error. To break this loop, we propose Geometry-based Multimodal Fusion (GMF). Instead of relying on predictions, we evaluate reliability by measuring how much transport correction the input needs in latent space. We implement Diffusion Schrödinger Bridge transport with Rectified Flow, where the squared initial velocity gives an efficient learned correction score. Valid data has low squared velocity magnitude, while noisy, incomplete data or conflicting data requires stronger transport correction. This geometry-based reliability signal acts as an independent judge, effectively flagging unreliable inputs even when the classifier is fooled. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GMF significantly improves robustness against severe sensor noise and semantic conflicts compared to confidence-based baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态融合中数据质量评估依赖模型自身置信度导致的循环依赖问题，提出基于几何的多模态融合（GMF）。该方法利用扩散薛定谔桥传输和整流流，通过测量输入在潜在空间中所需的传输校正量来独立评估数据可靠性，有效数据矫正量小，噪声或不完整数据矫正量大。实验表明，GMF 在传感器噪声和语义冲突场景下显著优于基于置信度的基线。
Motivation: 现有可信融合方法依赖模型自身的预测置信度来判断数据质量，形成循环依赖：当模型自信但错误时，这些方法无法检测错误。
Method: 提出 GMF，不依赖预测，而是通过测量输入在潜在空间中所需的传输校正量评估可靠性。实现采用扩散薛定谔桥传输与整流流，其中初始速度的平方给出高效的学习校正分数。
Result: 大量实验表明，GMF 在应对严重传感器噪声和语义冲突方面，相比基于置信度的基线显著提升了鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 基于几何的可靠性信号可作为独立评估器，即使在分类器被欺骗时也能有效标记不可靠输入。

papers.title: The Regularizing Power of Language-Training Deepfake Detectors
papers.abstract_en: Recently, thanks to the advent of Multimodal-LLMs, deepfake detectors are striving not only to be generalizable but also interpretable. We propose that these two challenges can effectively be tackled jointly, since describable artifacts typically generalize better, opening the possibility to use language as a regularization mechanism. Since deepfake detection generally suffers from overfitting to low-level domain-specific artifacts, our intuition is that an LLM that has been pretrained on language would prefer high-level artifacts that can be described better. This way, we can use high-level features where possible, while training the model to use low-level features where necessary. We utilize a dual-encoder architecture, pairing a frozen specialist detector with a LoRA-tuned MLLM encoder, and a two-stage training curriculum: first, a binary alignment phase demonstrates that the intrinsic capability of MLLMs can effectively combine features to mitigate overfitting to dataset-specific artifacts. To further bolster generalization and achieve interpretability, we employ a reinforcement learning stage that encourages the model to generate descriptive reasoning before classifying, using only binary labels. By rewarding this "explain-then-classify" behavior, we explicitly incentivize the model to prioritize high-level, robust features. Crucially, this process yields both interpretable descriptions and a further boost in cross-dataset performance, even when reasoning chains are omitted at inference. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets validate our approach, outperforming state-of-the-art methods by a large margin.

papers.title: Student Capacity Moderates Knowledge Distillation Effectiveness: A Systematic Study Across ResNet Teacher-Student Pairs on CIFAR-10
papers.abstract_en: We investigate how teacher-student capacity relationships modulate knowledge distillation (KD) effectiveness in ResNet-based image classification on CIFAR-10. Across three teacher-student pairs -- R50->R18, R34->R18, and R50->R34 -- we compare Logit-KD and Feature-KD under controlled, reproducible conditions (3 seeds, mean+/-std reported throughout). We report three main findings. First, student capacity is a key moderating factor in distillation gain: R34 students benefit substantially more from KD than R18 students even when teacher-student accuracy gaps are comparable, with the strongest gain of +0.30pp observed for R50->R34 Feature-KD versus +0.18pp for R34->R18 Feature-KD and +0.00pp for R34->R18 Logit-KD. Second, implementation correctness critically affects Feature-KD: a gradient clipping bug that excluded projection layers suppressed Feature-KD performance and produced misleading comparisons with Logit-KD. After correction, Feature-KD matches or outperforms Logit-KD in two of three pairs, reaching 95.55% on R50->R34 against a baseline of 95.25%. Third, input-resolution-aware architecture is a prerequisite for effective distillation: correcting the ResNet stem for 32x32 inputs raises teacher accuracy by over 5pp -- an order of magnitude larger than any KD gain. All code and results are available at github.com/umutonuryasar/kd-capacity-gap.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. Code available at https://github.com/umutonuryasar/kd-capacity-gap
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了学生容量对知识蒸馏效果的影响，在CIFAR-10上使用ResNet师生对进行实验。主要发现：学生容量是蒸馏增益的关键调节因素，R34学生比R18学生受益更大；修复梯度裁剪错误后，特征蒸馏匹配或优于logit蒸馏；输入分辨率感知架构是有效蒸馏的前提。
Motivation: 现有研究对师生容量关系如何影响知识蒸馏效果的理解不够系统，缺乏在可控条件下的对比分析。
Method: 在CIFAR-10上使用三组ResNet师生对（R50->R18, R34->R18, R50->R34），比较Logit-KD和Feature-KD，报告3个种子的均值和标准差，并修复实现中的梯度裁剪错误。
Result: Feature-KD在R50->R34上取得最强增益+0.30pp（基线95.25%→95.55%），而R34->R18的Feature-KD增益为+0.18pp，Logit-KD增益为0.00pp；修复后的Feature-KD在两组中匹配或优于Logit-KD。

papers.title: FlagGAM: Rule-Based Generalized Additive Modeling for Explainable Tabular Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Tabular prediction in high-stakes domains requires models that are accurate, transparent, and robust to imperfect inputs. We propose FlagGAM, a rule-defined basis framework that separates feature-level rule construction from prediction. A Flag Core Module converts numerical and categorical variables into sparse, human-readable univariate bases, including threshold flags, category-level flags, tail-deviation bases, and categorical step functions; a default additive head then combines these bases as a restricted GAM-style predictor. Rather than reducing triggered rules to compact count summaries, FlagGAM retains a sparse rule-basis matrix that supports mixed-type classification and regression, feature-specific weighting, and optional flexible prediction heads. Across tabular benchmarks, default FlagGAM remains close to EBM in transparent additive mode, improves substantially over ridge regression on mixed-type regression, and shows smaller AUROC degradation than common baselines under missing and noisy perturbations. Flexible heads further improve accuracy and approach strong tree-based baselines, with the caveat that the resulting model should be interpreted as a rule-basis representation followed by a nonlinear predictor rather than as a fully additive GAM. Overall, FlagGAM provides a practical middle ground for tabular settings that require competitive accuracy, communicable rules, and robustness to imperfect inputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出FlagGAM，一种基于规则基函数的广义加性模型框架，用于可解释的表格预测。核心模块将数值和类别变量转化为稀疏、可读的单变量基函数（如阈值标志、类别标志、尾部偏差基和类别阶梯函数），默认加性头作为受限GAM风格预测器。在表格基准上，默认FlagGAM在透明加性模式下接近EBM，混合回归上优于岭回归，并在缺失和噪声扰动下AUROC下降小于常见基线。灵活头进一步提高精度，接近强树基线，但此时模型应解释为规则基表示后接非线性预测器。
Motivation: 高风险领域中的表格预测需要准确、透明且对不完美输入鲁棒的模型，现有方法在可解释性和鲁棒性上存在不足。
Method: 提出FlagGAM框架，通过Flag核心模块将数值和类别变量转换为稀疏、可读的单变量基函数，包括阈值标志、类别级标志、尾部偏差基和类别阶梯函数，并保留稀疏规则基矩阵以支持混合类型分类与回归、特征特定权重和灵活预测头。
Result: 在表格基准上，默认FlagGAM在透明加性模式下保持与EBM接近的性能；在混合类型回归上显著优于岭回归；在缺失和噪声扰动下AUROC下降幅度小于常见基线。灵活头进一步提高精度，接近强树基线。
Conclusion: FlagGAM提供了一个实用折中方案，适用于需要竞争精度、可沟通规则和对不完美输入鲁棒性的表格设置，但使用灵活头时模型应解释为规则基表示后再接非线性预测器，而非完全加性GAM。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: From Local Geometry to Global Pseudo Labeling for Robust Positive Unlabeled Learning under Covariate Shift
papers.abstract_en: Detecting covariate shift is critical for building reliable vision systems. While most prior work focuses on improving robustness to shift, explicitly detecting covariate shift remains underexplored. Existing approaches typically rely on fully supervised training, requiring labeled examples from both original and shifted distributions, which is often impractical. In this paper, we show that covariate shift detection can be effectively addressed with weaker supervision using Positive Unlabeled (PU) learning. However, under covariate shift, in distribution and shifted data overlap significantly, making classical PU methods unstable and sensitive to noise. To overcome this challenge, we introduce Spectral PU Neighborhood Annotation (SPUNA), a geometry aware framework that progressively discovers shifted data by leveraging the local manifold structure of visual features. Extensive experiments show that SPUNA achieves state of the art performance in PU settings and remarkably matches the performances of fully supervised methods. Moreover, our approach transfers robustly across different types of shifts, demonstrating strong generalization capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SPUNA框架，利用局部流形结构逐步发现协变量偏移数据，在正无标签学习设置下达到与全监督方法匹配的性能，并具有良好的泛化能力。
Motivation: 协变量偏移检测对可靠视觉系统至关重要，但现有方法通常需要全监督训练，标注成本高；而正无标签学习在偏移下不稳定且对噪声敏感。
Method: 基于局部几何的谱PU邻域标注（SPUNA），通过分析视觉特征的局部流形结构，逐步发现偏移数据，利用正无标签学习框架进行弱监督检测。
Result: 实验表明SPUNA在PU设置中达到最先进性能，并且与全监督方法性能相当；在不同偏移类型下鲁棒迁移，展现强泛化能力。
Conclusion: 协变量偏移检测可以通过正无标签学习有效解决，利用数据局部几何结构可提升鲁棒性，并接近全监督方法的表现。

papers.title: How well does Classification Accuracy capture Concept Drift Detection Quality? An overview of Concept Drift Detection evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Data streams are nowadays among the most frequently analyzed data structures, with the concept drift posing a major challenge encountered by processing systems. Despite the proposition of numerous solutions to counteract the accuracy degeneration due to concept drift, the scientific community has not yet established a unified framework for evaluating the concept drift detection task. Existing research often relies on classification quality metrics, but these can be affected by multiple factors and may not reliably reflect drift detection quality. In this work, we present an in-depth overview of the relationship between metrics for quantifying drift detection quality and classification performance in synthetic nonstationary data streams. The proposed research studies eight drift detection quality metrics in relation to the classifier's performance across seven synthetic data stream generation tools, additionally considering drift dynamics as a factor. The studies aim to identify the most informative set of drift detection quality metrics and provide a deep understanding of the method's evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文综述了分类准确率在评估概念漂移检测质量中的适用性，指出分类质量指标受多因素影响，不能可靠反映漂移检测质量。研究在合成非平稳数据流上比较了八种漂移检测质量指标与分类器性能的关系，分析了七种数据流生成工具和漂移动态的影响，旨在找出最具信息量的评价指标。
Motivation: 概念漂移检测领域缺乏统一的评估框架，现有研究常依赖分类准确率来评估漂移检测质量，但这种做法可能不可靠，因为分类准确率受多种因素影响，不能单独反映检测能力。
Method: 通过合成数据流实验，系统比较了八种漂移检测质量指标与分类器性能之间的关系，考虑了七种数据流生成工具和不同的漂移动态参数。
Result: 研究表明分类准确率不能充分反映概念漂移检测质量，需结合多种专用指标进行综合评价。
Conclusion: 本文强调需要更全面的评估框架，推荐使用一组特定的漂移检测质量指标来替代单一的分类准确率。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: On public and private binary classification with metric space valued predictors
papers.abstract_en: We consider the problem of binary classification in a framework where the predictor $X$ takes values in an arbitrary separable metric space $\mathcal X$ and the label $Y$ values in $\{ \pm 1 \}$. In the first part of this work, we assume that one has direct access to an i.i.d. sample $(X_1,Y_1),\ldots,(X_n,Y_n)$ from the unknown distribution of the pair $(X,Y)$. We derive a convergence rate for the Proto-NN classifier which was recently introduced as a classifier in the presence of metric space-valued predictors. In the second part of the paper, we reconsider the same problem under an additional privacy constraint. More precisely, we work in the framework of local differential privacy where one assumes that the data $(X_1,Y_1),\ldots,(X_n,Y_n)$ cannot be directly observed but only a privatised surrogate obtained through a suitable mechanism satisfying the privacy constraint is available. The statistician should select an optimal privacy mechanism from the class of all mechanism that guarantee local differential privacy. Our method of choice is to add Laplace distributed noise to both a set of in Proto-NN classifier using the privatised data only is universally consistent. Finally, a rate of convergence for the privatised Proto-NN classifier is derived.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究度量空间取值预测变量下的二元分类问题。第一部分针对无隐私约束的独立同分布样本，推导了Proto-NN分类器的收敛速度。第二部分在局部差分隐私框架下，通过添加Laplace噪声实现隐私保护，证明了私有化Proto-NN分类器的通用一致性，并给出了其收敛速度。
Motivation: 现有分类方法在度量空间预测变量场景下缺乏收敛速度的理论保证，且隐私保护下的分类器一致性尚未充分研究。
Method: 第一部分直接使用Proto-NN分类器；第二部分通过向Proto-NN分类器的一组统计量添加Laplace噪声来实现局部差分隐私，并分析私有化分类器的性质。
Result: 推导出非私有Proto-NN分类器的收敛速度；证明了私有化Proto-NN分类器是通用一致的，并给出了其收敛速度。
Conclusion: 本文为度量空间预测变量下的二元分类提供了理论收敛性保证，并拓展至隐私保护场景。
