papers.title: Riemannian Diffusion Models on General Manifolds via Physics-Informed Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Riemannian diffusion models generalize score-based generative modeling to manifold-supported data via stochastic diffusion equations on the manifold. However, training requires sampling from and differentiating the manifold heat kernel, which is rarely available in closed form beyond a few highly symmetric manifolds. We propose a general approach that approximates the heat kernel by directly solving the manifold heat equation with a physics-informed neural network (PINN). Given an explicit manifold specification, we choose a coordinate system, derive the corresponding heat (Fokker--Planck) equation and a short-time asymptotic approximation, and then train a PINN to learn the log heat kernel. The resulting surrogate enables both forward noising (heat-kernel sampling) and conditional-score evaluation for denoising score matching. We demonstrate the method on diverse manifolds including $S^2$, $SO(3)$, $\mathrm{SPD}(n)$, and permutation-quotiented point clouds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种通用的Riemannian扩散模型方法，通过物理信息神经网络（PINN）近似流形上的热核，从而避免了热核解析形式的需求。在S^2、SO(3)、SPD(n)和排列商点云等多种流形上验证了方法的有效性。
Motivation: 现有Riemannian扩散模型训练需要流形热核的封闭形式，但除少数高度对称流形外，热核难以解析表达。
Method: 方法包括选择坐标系、推导流形上的热（Fokker-Planck）方程、利用短时渐近近似，并训练PINN学习对数热核，以支持前向加噪和条件分数评估。
Result: 在S^2、SO(3)、SPD(n)和排列商点云等流形上成功实现了扩散模型生成。
Conclusion: 该方法为一般流形上的Riemannian扩散模型提供了一种通用训练框架，避免了热核封闭形式的需求。

papers.title: Model-Agnostic Signal Discovery with Machine Learning: Bridging the Gap Between Theory and Practice
papers.abstract_en: Searches for new phenomena in complex scientific data are predominantly model-dependent, optimized for specific hypotheses, and therefore limited in their coverage of the space of possible signals. Recently, new AI-based model-agnostic search strategies, many of which have been pioneered in high-energy physics, have been proposed which provide a complementary paradigm, prioritizing broad exploration over tailored analyses. These techniques offer an opportunity to enhance the overall discovery potential of modern experiments, especially in regimes where theoretical guidance is scarce. In this document, we review the conceptual framework behind the main classes of AI-based model-agnostic strategies. We discuss the potential pitfalls of these methods, and strategies for their validation and interpretation. We aim for this document to serve as a useful reference both for practitioners and for researchers interested in learning more about these model-agnostic search strategies.
papers.comment: 37 pages, 7 figures. Part of the VERaiPHY initiative
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文综述了基于AI的模型无关信号发现策略，主要在高能物理中发展，旨在弥补理论驱动搜索的盲区。讨论了这些方法的原理、潜在陷阱及验证与解释策略，旨在为实践者和研究者提供参考。
Motivation: 传统模型依赖的搜索仅针对特定假设，可能遗漏未理论化的新信号，需要模型无关策略以扩大发现潜力。
Method: 本文是综述性文章，梳理了基于机器学习的模型无关搜索策略的分类框架，包括异常检测、弱监督学习等技术，并讨论了验证与解释的方法。
Result: 文章总结了模型无关方法在增强实验发现能力方面的潜力，特别是在理论指导不足的领域，但未提供具体定量结果。
Conclusion: 模型无关搜索策略为复杂科学数据中的新现象发现提供了互补范式，但需要谨慎处理潜在偏差，并建立系统的验证与解释流程。

papers.title: Vector Linking via Cross-Model Local Isometric Consistency
papers.abstract_en: We study Vector Linking: given two embedding clouds produced by different black-box encoders over partially overlapping datasets, recover cross-model object correspondences using only vectors. Empirically and theoretically, we show that independently trained contrastive encoders exhibit local geometric consistency: short-range distances are approximately preserved up to a scale factor, while long-range distances are not due to model-specific distortion. Building on this, we propose an iterative, reference-based geometric embedding hashing that recovers vector links from a tiny seed set of paired anchors. It represents each vector by distances to sampled paired anchors, proposes candidate links via hash-space matching, and aggregates evidence across views in a Beta-Bernoulli posterior to bootstrap high-confidence links as new anchors. Experiments across multiple benchmarks and embedding model pairs demonstrate accurate and robust linking under varying overlap, seed budgets, and out-of-domain anchors, with applications to vector database integration and cross-model clustering. Code is available at https://github.com/DBgroup-Edinburgh/VecLinking.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究向量链接问题：给定两个由不同黑箱编码器生成的嵌入云（embedding clouds），且数据集部分重叠，仅利用向量恢复跨模型的对象对应关系。实验和理论表明，独立训练的对比编码器具有局部几何一致性：短距离近似保持（缩放因子），长距离因模型特异失真而不保。基于此，提出迭代的参考几何嵌入哈希方法，从少量种子锚点开始，通过距离哈希和贝塔-伯努利后验逐步引导高置信度链接。在多个基准和嵌入模型对上验证了准确性和鲁棒性，应用于向量数据库集成和跨模型聚类。
Motivation: 不同嵌入模型独立训练导致嵌入空间扭曲，直接匹配困难。现有方法依赖大量标注对应或模型访问，而实际中常只有黑箱编码器输出的向量。
Method: 基于局部几何一致性，提出迭代的参考几何嵌入哈希：用采样锚点距离表示向量，在哈希空间匹配候选链接，并通过Beta-Bernoulli后验跨视图聚合证据，自举生成新锚点。
Result: 在多个基准和嵌入模型对上，方法在不同重叠率、种子数量和域外锚点下均能准确鲁棒地恢复链接，并成功应用于向量数据库集成和跨模型聚类。
Conclusion: 局部等距一致性是跨模型向量链接的有效先验，基于哈希和后验自举的方法无需模型内部信息即可实现鲁棒链接。

papers.title: KnowledgeGain: Evaluating and Optimizing Science News Generation for Reader Learning
papers.abstract_en: Science news is an important medium to communicate discoveries between the research communities and the public. Yet, most metrics for generated or summarized text evaluate semantic similarity and factual consistency, but do not measure how much knowledge readers learn from the news. We introduce KnowledgeGain, a metric that evaluates the quality of science news by measuring how much knowledge readers gained after reading it. To evaluate the metric, we first performed a controlled human study and showed that the metric successfully captures the differential knowledge gained by human readers reading different types of science media. The data allowed us to calibrate a prompt-only LLM reader simulator. We use it to rank and filter candidate articles before human evaluation. A second human study shows that articles selected with this simulator improve post-reading accuracy and normalized KnowledgeGain over a strong generation baseline. Our work is a step toward generating science news that better meets the knowledge and comprehension goals of Bloom's Taxonomy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 KnowledgeGain 指标，用于评估科学新闻帮助读者获取知识的程度，并基于 LLM 模拟读者选择文章，提升读者知识获取效果。
Motivation: 现有文本生成评估指标只关注语义相似性和事实一致性，未衡量读者实际学到的知识，科学新闻生成缺乏以学习效果为导向的优化目标。
Method: 通过受控人类实验验证 KnowledgeGain 指标的有效性，并用实验数据校准仅使用提示的 LLM 读者模拟器，利用该模拟器排序和筛选候选文章。
Result: 人类实验表明该指标能捕捉读者阅读不同科学媒体后的知识差异；第二次人类实验显示，经模拟器筛选的文章提高了读者读后准确率和归一化 KnowledgeGain。
Conclusion: 该工作是朝着生成符合 Bloom 认知分类中知识与理解目标的科学新闻迈出的一步。

papers.title: SpecDB: LLM-Generated Customized Databases via Feature-Oriented Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Mainstream relational databases ship a uniform feature set across deployments, although individual workloads exercise only a fraction of the available subsystems. We investigate whether a database can instead be generated on demand with a feature set matched to the target workload. We present SpecDB, a system that uses large language models (LLMs) to synthesize customized relational databases. We survey 9 production systems and decompose them into 10 functional modules, each further divided into implementation variants. To capture cross-module dependencies, including cases where implementations in disjoint subtrees must be co-designed, we adopt the FODA feature model and extend it with a cooperate edge, yielding a dependency graph DBGraph. SpecDB operationalizes DBGraph through a layered module-construction pipeline in which each module is generated, validated, and integrated by a dedicated subagent (driven by three inner agents: Main, Tester, Architect), and a Refining Agent that iteratively repairs and tunes the assembled database against a user-supplied refining harness with read-only access to existing database source code. A companion selection component translates a natural-language workload description into a set of implementation variants, providing an end-to-end pipeline from workload description to deployable database. We evaluate SpecDB on TPC-C with BenchmarkSQL. The generated database (23,779 lines of Rust) completes 60-minute TPC-C at 1 and 10 warehouses with zero errors. At 10 warehouses it reaches tpmC=130, compared to 128 for PostgreSQL and 127 for MySQL, with comparable latency at ~3% of their code size. Because the agent operates at module-specification level rather than product source, it can in principle combine techniques across system boundaries. Paired with falling LLM costs, generating a purpose-built database for a target workload is becoming straightforward.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SpecDB，利用大语言模型（LLM）根据自然语言工作负载描述自动生成定制化关系数据库。该系统将9个生产系统分解为10个功能模块，每个模块有多种实现变体，并通过扩展FODA特征模型定义跨模块依赖关系（DBGraph）。采用分层模块构建管道，由子代理（含Main、Tester、Architect三个内部智能体）生成、验证和集成模块，再由Refining Agent迭代修复和调优。在TPC-C基准上，生成的Rust数据库（23,779行）在1和10个仓库下60分钟无错误运行，10仓库时tpmC=130（PostgreSQL为128，MySQL为127），延迟相当，代码量仅为其3%。
Motivation: 传统关系数据库在所有部署中提供统一功能集，但单个工作负载通常只用到其中一小部分子系统。本文探索能否按需生成功能集匹配目标工作负载的数据库，以减少冗余并提高效率。
Method: SpecDB包含两部分：1）DBGraph——基于FODA特征模型并扩展合作边（cooperate edge）的依赖图，用于表示功能模块及其实现变体间的依赖关系；2）分层模块构建管道，每个模块由专用子代理（含Main、Tester、Architect）生成、验证和集成，再由Refining Agent迭代修复和调优。同时，选择组件将自然语言工作负载描述转化为实现变体集合，实现端到端流水线。
Result: 在TPC-C基准测试中，生成的Rust数据库（23,779行）在1和10个仓库下60分钟内无错误完成TPC-C测试。10仓库时tpmC=130（PostgreSQL为128，MySQL为127），延迟相当，代码量约为后两者的3%。
Conclusion: 实验表明，通过LLM驱动的模块级生成，可以为特定工作负载构建定制化数据库，且性能与通用数据库相当而代码量大幅减少。随着LLM成本下降，这种方式变得实用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: iVGR: Internalizing Visually Grounded Reasoning for MLLMs with Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: While visually grounded Chain-of-Thought (CoT) has emerged as a promising paradigm to enhance fine-grained perception in multimodal large language models (MLLMs), its efficacy during the inference phase remains underexplored. In this work, we empirically find that mandating explicit object boxes in visually grounded CoT during inference often degrades performance compared to standard textual CoT, which reasons without explicit visual grounding. We hypothesize that the visual localization capability can be internalized into the textual CoT and that the mandatory explicit grounding introduces unnecessary interference with the model's primary objective of answer prediction. To address this problem, we propose Internalizing Visually Grounded Reasoning (\textbf{iVGR}), a novel reinforcement learning framework that transfers localization capabilities into the textual reasoning process. We employ a dual-stream training strategy, where a textual stream is aligned with a high-quality visually grounded stream via a proposed consistency reward, enabling the model to localize accurately without explicit grounding during inference. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms existing baselines on fine-grained benchmarks, while maintaining the flexibility to support tool-assisted inference workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现多模态大语言模型（MLLM）中使用显式视觉定位的思维链（Visual Grounding CoT）在推理时反而降低性能，因为定位框干扰了答案预测。为此提出iVGR框架，通过强化学习和双流训练策略，将定位能力内化到文本推理中，在不显式定位的情况下提升细粒度感知。实验在多个细粒度基准上显著优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有视觉定位CoT在推理时性能不如纯文本CoT，作者假设定位能力可以内化，且显式定位引入不必要干扰。
Method: 提出iVGR强化学习框架，采用双流训练策略：一个文本流与一个高质量的视觉定位流通过一致性奖励对齐，使模型在不显式定位时也能准确推理。

papers.title: Redefining Instance Matching: A Unified Framework for Part-Aware Matching in Panoptic Segmentation Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: The Panoptic Quality (PQ) metric is the standard for jointly evaluating instance and semantic segmentation. However, its original definition relies on a One-to-One matching between predicted and ground truth segments, which is only straightforward when the IoU threshold exceeds 0.5. Below 0.5, multiple matching strategies emerge in a poorly explored problem space. We systematically elucidate this space by recasting segment matching as a constrained bipartite assignment problem. Independently bounding the prediction- and ground-truth-side degrees yields four matching strategies: One-to-One, Many-to-One, One-to-Many, and Many-to-Many. We show that the first three are well-defined within the PQ framework, while Many-to-Many falls outside it. These strategies become relevant when instances are fragmented, adjacent objects are difficult to delineate, or annotations are noisy. Central to our framework is a vertex-based accounting of TP, FN, and FP, anchored to ground truth and predicted segments rather than to matching edges. We further show that the framework extends naturally to part-aware panoptic segmentation, and we explore part-aware evaluation on biomedical data. Across configurable case studies we report how different combinations of thresholds and matching strategies behave in practice. We release a unified open-source package built on Panoptica. It exposes Voronoi-based region-wise analysis, part-aware evaluation, and Area Under Threshold Curve computations as configurable options.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视全景分割评估中的实例匹配问题，将片段匹配建模为约束二分图分配问题，提出四种匹配策略（One-to-One、Many-to-One、One-to-Many、Many-to-Many），并基于顶点进行TP/FN/FP计数。该框架扩展到部分感知全景分割，在生物医学数据上进行了实验，并开源了基于Panoptica的统一包。
Motivation: 原始全景质量（PQ）指标依赖IoU阈值>0.5时的One-to-One匹配，但低于0.5时出现多种未充分探索的匹配策略，导致评估不一致。
Method: 将片段匹配重新定义为约束二分图分配问题，独立限制预测和真实侧度数，得到四种匹配策略；引入顶点级TP/FN/FP计数方法，并扩展到部分感知全景分割。
Result: 通过可配置的案例研究，报告了不同阈值和匹配策略组合的实际表现；在生物医学数据上展示了部分感知评估。
Conclusion: 该框架统一了多种匹配策略，提供了更灵活的全景分割评估工具，尤其适用于实例碎片化或标注噪声的场景，但Many-to-Many策略不在PQ框架内。

papers.title: Cross-Modal Clinical Knowledge Integration for Mammography Report Generation
papers.abstract_en: Breast cancer is a major global health concern, and mammography screening plays a central role in early detection. The large volume of screening examinations creates a substantial workload for radiologists, making accurate and consistent report generation a critical clinical challenge. Existing automated mammography report generation methods primarily focus on direct visual-to-text mapping, while overlooking the structured clinical reasoning process followed by radiologists in real-world practice. To address this limitation, we propose MammoRG, a mammography report generation framework that explicitly simulates the clinical reporting workflow by following the BI-RADS guideline and incorporating prior clinical knowledge to produce diagnostic reports. Specifically, MammoRG adopts a two-stage training framework. In the first stage, the model learns to integrate clinically relevant prior knowledge from a patient's four-view mammograms through classification-based supervision. In the second stage, a terminology-aware supervised fine-tuning strategy is introduced to model mammography-specific clinical terms as atomic semantic units, enabling the generation of high-quality reports with improved clinical consistency. To facilitate clinical efficacy evaluation of generated reports, we further develop MammoRGTool, a dedicated mammography report parsing tool that extracts structured clinical information from free-text reports. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MammoRG consistently outperforms existing methods across multiple clinical efficacy metrics, particularly in diagnosis-related BI-RADS F1, where it surpasses the second-best model by 2.73%, 2.04%, 1.90%, and 3.27% on the internal, external 1, external 2, and VinDr-Mammo datasets, respectively.

TL;DR: 本文提出 MammoRG，一种基于 BI-RADS 指南并融入临床先验知识的乳腺X线摄影报告生成框架。该框架采用两阶段训练：第一阶段通过分类监督学习四视图先验知识，第二阶段引入术语感知的监督微调将专业术语建模为原子语义单元。同时开发 MammoRGTool 工具从自由文本中提取结构化临床信息。实验表明，MammoRG 在多个临床效能指标上优于现有方法，在诊断相关的 BI-RADS F1 上分别超出第二名 2.73%、2.04%、1.90% 和 3.27% 在内部、外部1、外部2和 VinDr-Mammo 数据集上。
Motivation: 现有自动乳腺X线摄影报告生成方法主要直接进行视觉到文本的映射，忽略了放射科医生在实际工作中遵循的结构化临床推理过程。
Method: 提出 MammoRG 两阶段框架：第一阶段通过分类监督学习四视图先验知识；第二阶段采用术语感知的监督微调，将乳腺摄影专业术语作为原子语义单元建模。同时开发 MammoRGTool 工具进行结构化临床信息抽取。
Result: 在内部、外部1、外部2和 VinDr-Mammo 数据集上，MammoRG 在诊断相关的 BI-RADS F1 上分别超出第二名 2.73%、2.04%、1.90% 和 3.27%。
Conclusion: 模拟临床工作流程并融入先验知识可提升乳腺X线摄影报告生成的临床一致性。

papers.title: On Revisiting Entropy for Identifying Mislabeled Images
papers.abstract_en: Mislabeled samples in training datasets severely degrade the performance of deep networks, as overparameterized models tend to memorize erroneous labels. We address this challenge by proposing a novel approach for mislabeled data detection that leverages training dynamics. Our method is grounded in the key observation that correctly labeled samples exhibit consistent entropy decrease during training, while mislabeled samples maintain relatively high entropy throughout the training process. Building on this insight, we introduce a signed entropy integral (SEI) statistic that captures both the magnitude and temporal trend of prediction entropy across training epochs. SEI is broadly applicable to classification networks and demonstrates particular effectiveness when integrated with contrastive language-image pretraining (CLIP) architectures. Through extensive experiments on four medical imaging datasets -- a domain particularly susceptible to labeling errors due to diagnostic complexity -- spanning diverse modalities and pathologies, we demonstrate that SEI achieves state-of-the-art performance in mislabeled data identification, outperforming existing methods while maintaining computational efficiency and implementation simplicity. Our code is available at https://github.com/MedAITech/SEI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于训练动态的误标注样本检测方法，核心发现是正确标注样本的熵在训练过程中持续下降，而错误标注样本的熵始终较高。基于此，作者设计了一个有符号熵积分（SEI）统计量，同时捕捉预测熵的大小和时间趋势。该方法在四个医学影像数据集上取得最先进性能，尤其适用于对比语言-图像预训练（CLIP）架构，且计算高效、实现简单。
Motivation: 训练数据中的误标注样本会严重降低深度网络性能，因为过参数化模型容易记忆错误标签。现有方法检测效率或准确性不足，尤其在医学影像等标注难度高的领域。
Method: 提出有符号熵积分（SEI）统计量，利用训练过程中每个样本的预测熵的时序变化：正确样本熵持续下降，错误样本熵保持高位。SEI整合了熵的大小和趋势，适用于各类分类网络，并特别适配CLIP架构。
Result: 在四个涵盖多种模态和病理的医学影像数据集上，SEI在误标注检测任务中超越了现有方法，达到了最先进的性能，同时保持计算效率和实现简单性。
Conclusion: SEI通过捕捉训练过程中熵的时序变化，有效识别误标注样本，尤其在医学影像领域表现突出。方法通用且高效，适合实际应用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On couplings for kinetic Langevin diffusions
papers.abstract_en: For the kinetic Langevin diffusion and its splitting discretizations, the hypoelliptic noise structure makes the relationship between couplings and total variation (TV) bounds more subtle than in the elliptic case. We establish that, for the kinetic Langevin equation with quadratic potential, no Markovian coupling (continuous or discrete) captures the asymptotic decay rate of the TV distance between two solutions with different initial values; the canonical iterated one-shot (or sticky) coupling, for which we derive an exact contraction formula, saturates this lower bound. On the constructive side, we show that the recent sharp TV bounds obtained by Chak and Monmarché admit a natural interpretation through an explicit non-Markovian coupling, built from an optimal coalescence trajectory characterized by a classical minimum-energy control problem. For the OBABO splitting scheme, this approach additionally eliminates the Hessian-Lipschitz, step-size, and final-time assumptions in the work of Chak and Monmarché.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究动能朗之万扩散及其分裂离散化中的耦合与全变差界的关系。对于二次势能的动能朗之万方程，证明任何马尔可夫耦合都无法捕捉TV距离的渐近衰减率，而规范的单步耦合（sticky coupling）可达到该下界。在构造方面，通过显式的非马尔可夫耦合（基于最优控制问题的最优合并轨迹）解释了Chak-Monmarché的TV界，并消除了OBABO分裂方案中的Hessian-Lipschitz、步长和最终时间假设。
Motivation: 动能朗之万扩散的亚椭圆噪声结构使得耦合与TV界的关系比椭圆情形更微妙，需要澄清是否存在马尔可夫耦合能达到TV距离的渐近衰减率，并改进已有的TV界。
Method: 通过反例证明无马尔可夫耦合达到渐近衰减率，并利用最优控制理论构造非马尔可夫耦合来饱和下界；对分裂方案则直接构造显式耦合。
Result: 证明二次势能下无马尔可夫耦合达到TV距离的渐近衰减率，而规范耦合可达到该下界；非马尔可夫耦合自然解释了Chak-Monmarché的TV界，并移除了一些假设。
Conclusion: 揭示了动能朗之万扩散中耦合与TV衰减率的基本限制，并提供了构造性改进。

papers.title: A Pilot Study on Curator-Guided Multilingual Art Description for Blind and Low-Vision Audiences with Small Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Blind and low-vision (BLV) audiences remain underserved by visual art descriptions, particularly across languages and in museum settings where privacy and intellectual-property constraints may favour small on-premise vision-language models (VLMs). This pilot study investigates curator-guided multilingual art description with Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct for German, Romanian, and Serbian. We construct a parallel BLV-oriented caption corpus from artwork images and metadata, and compare language-specific LoRA adapters with a single multilingual adapter under a fixed backbone and training budget. Evaluation combines automatic lexical and embedding-based metrics with an LLM-as-Judge protocol calibrated against a small Romanian BLV pilot study. Under our pilot setup, language-specific adapters show more stable controllability and visually grounded description quality for Romanian and Serbian, while multilingual adaptation remains competitive in German. We frame these findings as deployment-oriented evidence for small on-premise VLMs, and highlight the need for larger BLV user studies and broader language coverage before drawing general conclusions about multilingual accessibility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对盲人和低视力（BLV）观众在视觉艺术描述中的多语言需求，使用小型视觉语言模型 Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct 进行策展人引导的多语言艺术描述研究。构建了面向 BLV 的平行描述语料库，比较了语言特定 LoRA 适配器与单一多语言适配器在德语、罗马尼亚语和塞尔维亚语上的表现。评估结合自动指标和基于大语言模型的评判，发现语言特定适配器在罗马尼亚语和塞尔维亚语上更稳定可控，而多语言适配器在德语上仍有竞争力。
Motivation: BLV 观众在视觉艺术描述方面长期未被充分服务，尤其在跨语言场景和博物馆环境中，隐私和知识产权限制要求使用小型本地 VLM，因此需要探索有效的多语言描述方法。
Method: 采用 Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct 模型，构建面向 BLV 的平行描述语料库，在固定骨干和训练预算下比较语言特定 LoRA 适配器与单一多语言适配器的效果。
Result: 语言特定适配器在罗马尼亚语和塞尔维亚语上展现出更稳定的可控性和视觉基础描述质量，而多语言适配器在德语上具有竞争力。
Conclusion: 该初步研究为小型本地 VLM 的部署提供了证据，但强调需要更大规模的 BLV 用户研究和更广的语言覆盖才能得出普遍结论。

summary_sections.motivation: BLV 观众在视觉艺术描述方面长期未被充分服务，尤其在跨语言场景和博物馆环境中，隐私和知识产权限制要求使用小型本地 VLM，因此需要探索有效的多语言描述方法。
summary_sections.method: 采用 Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct 模型，构建面向 BLV 的平行描述语料库，在固定骨干和训练预算下比较语言特定 LoRA 适配器与单一多语言适配器的效果。
summary_sections.result: 语言特定适配器在罗马尼亚语和塞尔维亚语上展现出更稳定的可控性和视觉基础描述质量，而多语言适配器在德语上具有竞争力。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该初步研究为小型本地 VLM 的部署提供了证据，但强调需要更大规模的 BLV 用户研究和更广的语言覆盖才能得出普遍结论。

papers.title: Forecasting threshold exceedance of atmospheric variables at a specific location
papers.abstract_en: This study compares two methodological approaches for predicting, at a given site, threshold exceedances of atmospheric variables such as temperature and wind speed: (i) direct probabilistic methods, which treat exceedance as a binary classification problem, and (ii) full distribution probabilistic methods, which model the complete conditional probability law of the target variable. Using theoretical analysis and numerical simulations on a toy model, alongside real-world data from the MeteoNet dataset (2016--2018) for southeastern France, we demonstrate that the full distribution approach consistently outperforms the direct method for rare, extreme events. This advantage arises because the full distribution approach effectively learns the parameters of the conditional distribution from moderate and mild intensity events, thereby achieving better calibration and discrimination in the tails. We find that the specific parametric shape of the chosen distribution plays a secondary role compared to accurately capturing predictable shifts in its bulk properties (i.e., mean and variance). This empirical indistinguishability is also informative about the physical mechanics driving atmospheric extremes, suggesting that extreme exceedances are primarily driven by significant conditional displacements of the entire distribution rather than by unpredictable, fat-tailed anomalies within a static climatology. Our results are validated for both strong surface wind speeds and intense hourly rainfall, with performance evaluated using proper scoring rules (Brier score, logarithmic score) and deterministic skill scores (Peirce Skill Score, CSI, HSS). These findings highlight the critical importance of modeling the full probability distribution for rare-event forecasting and provide practical guidance for improving extreme weather prediction in operational meteorology.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文比较了预测特定地点大气变量（温度、风速）阈值超越的两种方法：直接概率法（二分类）和全分布概率法。通过理论分析和MeteoNet数据集（2016-2018年法国东南部）的模拟与真实数据验证，发现全分布方法在稀有极端事件上持续优于直接方法，因其能从温和事件中有效学习条件分布的参数。该优势对强地表风速和强小时降雨均成立，且分布的具体形状次要，关键是对分布整体性质（均值、方差）的准确捕捉。
Motivation: 极端天气事件的准确预测对防灾减灾至关重要，但现有方法在稀有事件上校准和区分能力不足。本文旨在系统比较直接二分类方法与全分布概率方法在阈值超越预测中的表现，以确定更优策略。
Method: 采用两种框架：(i) 直接概率法，将超越视为二分类问题；(ii) 全分布概率法，建模目标变量的完整条件概率律。通过玩具模型的理论分析与数值模拟，以及MetetoNet数据集上风速和降雨的真实数据，使用Brier评分、对数评分等评分规则评估性能。
Result: 全分布概率法在稀有极端事件上始终优于直接法；条件分布的具体参数形式作用次要，而准确捕捉分布整体特征（均值和方差）是关键。该方法在强地表风速和强小时降雨预测中均表现更优，且结果表明极端超越主要由条件分布的整体位移驱动，而非静态气候中的肥尾异常。
Conclusion: 全分布概率建模对极端事件预测至关重要，为业务气象中的罕见事件预报提供了实用指导。

papers.title: Task-Focused Memorization for Multimodal Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory is essential for multimodal agents to build coherent experience, accumulate world knowledge, and achieve continual learning. However, constructing effective memory goes beyond memory module design and basic requirements such as accuracy and fidelity; the key challenge lies in determining what to memorize. Multimodal agents, such as embodied agents, continuously perceive, reason, and act in real or virtual environments, receiving an unbounded stream of multimodal observations. From this combinatorial explosion of information, an agent must selectively retain content that is relevant to its role in the environment and valuable for future tasks. To bridge this gap, we frame memory generation as a learnable memorization policy and introduce TaskMem (Task-focused Memorization Policy Learning), a reinforcement-learning-based framework that enables the policy to dynamically adjust its focus to the demands of real tasks encountered in the environment. TaskMem adopts a two-phase training paradigm: Phase One learns how to memorize by optimizing memory quality under fundamental fidelity requirements; Phase Two occurs after deployment, where the agent learns what to memorize by tuning an adapter on its base MLLM, using recent environment tasks to define a reward model that guides the memorization policy toward task-relevant content. To evaluate our approach, we reformulate VideoMME, EgoLife, and EgoTempo into streaming benchmarks that simulate a realistic setting in which an agent processes streaming observations and handles tasks arriving online. To isolate memory assessment, the questions must be answered using only the agent's memory, without access to raw video. Built on Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B, TaskMem improves VQA accuracy by 6.3%, 7.0%, and 5.3% on these benchmarks, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TaskMem，一种基于强化学习的任务聚焦记忆策略学习框架，用于多模态智能体（如具身智能体）在无限的多模态观测流中选择性记忆与未来任务相关的内容。TaskMem采用两阶段训练范式：第一阶段在基本保真度要求下优化记忆质量，第二阶段在部署后通过基于环境任务的奖励模型调优适配器，引导记忆策略聚焦任务相关的内容。在重新定义的VideoMME、EgoLife和EgoTempo流式基准上，基于Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B的TaskMem将VQA准确率分别提升6.3%、7.0%和5.3%。
Motivation: 多模态智能体面临无限的多模态观测流，现有记忆模块主要关注准确性和保真度，但关键挑战在于确定哪些内容值得记忆，即如何从信息组合爆炸中选择性保留对角色和未来任务有价值的内容。
Method: 将记忆生成建模为可学习的记忆化策略，提出TaskMem，采用两阶段训练：阶段一通过强化学习优化记忆质量满足保真度要求；阶段二在部署后，利用环境中的近期任务定义奖励模型，调优基础多模态大语言模型上的适配器，使记忆策略聚焦任务相关内容。
Result: 在重新定义的VideoMME、EgoLife和EgoTempo流式基准上，TaskMem（基于Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B）将VQA准确率分别提升6.3%、7.0%和5.3%。
Conclusion: TaskMem通过学习任务聚焦的记忆策略，有效提升了多模态智能体在流式环境中的记忆质量和任务性能，但评估依赖于重新定义的流式基准，且仅基于Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B架构。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning to Bid in FCR Markets: A Best-of-Both-Worlds Approach
papers.abstract_en: Bidding in the European Frequency Containment Reserve (FCR) market is challenging for flexibility providers because competing offers are hidden and bidders observe only partial feedback form the market, such as, clearing price and awarded quantity. For a participant active in a single country, we show that the multi-country FCR clearing problem can be recast as a repeated multi-unit uniform-price auction against an endogenous vector of opposing bids. This reformulation yields an online learning problem and allows us to adapt a Best-of-Both-Worlds combinatorial semi-bandit algorithm implementable from this standard market feedback. The resulting bidder achieves logarithmic pseudo-regret in stochastic environments and $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T})$ regret in adversarial ones. Synthetic experiments confirm the expected scaling, and backtests on historical European FCR data show competitive performance in practice: the method performs especially well on stable products, while EXP3-type baselines can be safer under stronger non-stationarity. Overall, the results show that learning-based bidding in FCR markets is theoretically grounded and practically useful when the learning rule matches product-level market stability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究欧洲频率备用（FCR）市场中的竞价问题，将多国FCR出清问题转化为重复的多单位统一价格拍卖，并采用Best-of-Both-Worlds组合半赌博机算法，利用标准市场反馈实现出价。算法在随机环境下获得对数伪遗憾，在对抗环境下获得O(√T)遗憾，合成实验验证了标度行为，历史回测表明方法在稳定产品上表现良好，而EXP3基线在强非平稳性下更安全。
Motivation: FCR市场中竞争对手报价隐藏，参与者仅获得部分反馈（出清价格和分配量），现有竞价方法缺乏理论保障和实际有效性。
Method: 将多国FCR出清问题重构为重复的多单位统一价格拍卖，并将竞价建模为在线学习问题，采用Best-of-Both-Worlds组合半赌博机算法，仅利用标准市场反馈（出清价格和分配量）进行更新。
Result: 在随机环境下实现对数伪遗憾，在对抗环境下实现O(√T)遗憾；合成实验验证了理论标度；在历史欧洲FCR数据回测中，方法在稳定产品上表现优异，而EXP3基线在强非平稳环境下更安全。
Conclusion: 基于学习的FCR竞价方法具有理论根基和实际价值，但效果依赖于市场产品的稳定性，建议根据产品稳定性选择学习规则。

papers.title: Towards Effective Long-Video Event Prediction via Multi-Level Event Semantics Mining
papers.abstract_en: Accurately predicting future events is fundamental to content understanding and decision-making across various domains. While prior research has primarily focused on text or short-video scenarios, long-video event prediction, characterized by vast multimodal context and more complex narratives, remains underexplored. Meanwhile, although recent Long-Video Language Models (LVLMs), built on Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs), have shown promise in long-video question answering and summarization, they struggle to generalize to event prediction, as they can neither precisely extract event-related details nor perform fine-grained analysis of event development. To address this gap, we propose VISTA, a multi-level event semantics mining framework for long-video event prediction. Initially, VISTA applies a character-centric visual prompt to precisely extract event-related visual details, enhancing detail-level semantics; subsequently, it employs a knowledge-enhanced iterative retrieval strategy, guiding the LLM to progressively construct logically coherent event chains, thereby improving event-level narratives; ultimately, VISTA adopts a human-like propose-then-retrieve strategy to generate diverse future-oriented proposals and integrate multi-level clues, producing robust and accurate predictions. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets validate the effectiveness of VISTA for long-video event prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对长视频事件预测任务中现有模型难以准确提取事件细节和进行细粒度分析的问题，提出多级事件语义挖掘框架VISTA。该框架通过角色为中心的视觉提示提取细节语义，利用知识增强的迭代检索构建事件链，并采用类人的提议-检索策略生成多样化预测。实验结果表明VISTA在真实数据集上有效提升长视频事件预测性能。
Motivation: 长视频事件预测面临海量多模态上下文和复杂叙事，现有长视频语言模型在事件预测方面能力不足，无法精确提取事件相关细节和进行细粒度分析。
Method: 提出VISTA框架，包含三部分：1) 角色中心的视觉提示提取事件相关视觉细节；2) 知识增强的迭代检索策略构建逻辑一致的事件链；3) 类人的提议-检索策略生成多样化未来预测并整合多级线索。
Result: 在真实数据集上的实验验证了VISTA对长视频事件预测的有效性。
Conclusion: VISTA通过多级事件语义挖掘能够提升长视频事件预测的准确性和鲁棒性，但未提及局限性与未来工作。

papers.title: HQ-JEPA: Hybrid Quantum Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for Cross-Modal Remote Sensing Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: We introduce HQ-JEPA, a hybrid quantum-classical joint-embedding predictive architecture for cross-modal remote sensing representation learning. The proposed framework extends JEPA-style masked latent prediction to paired Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 imagery by predicting masked target representations from visible context regions while aligning heterogeneous modality features in a shared embedding space. To improve representation quality, HQ-JEPA combines four complementary objectives: latent token prediction, cross-modal token alignment, SIGReg-based Gaussian regularization in the fused latent space, and a differentiable SWAP-test-based Fidelity Quantum Similarity (FQS) loss. Unlike pixel reconstruction methods, HQ-JEPA learns semantic representations directly in latent space and uses quantum state-overlap-based similarity as an additional regularization signal. We evaluate the pretrained encoder on GeoBench classification and segmentation tasks under linear probing and fine-tuning settings. Results show that HQ-JEPA achieves competitive and often superior performance over strong self-supervised and remote sensing foundation-model baselines, demonstrating the benefit of integrating predictive self-supervision, cross-modal geometric regularization, and quantum fidelity-based representation learning for remote sensing applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HQ-JEPA，一种混合量子-经典联合嵌入预测架构，用于跨模态遥感表征学习。该方法将JEPA风格的掩码潜在预测扩展到配对的Sentinel-1和Sentinel-2图像，通过预测掩码目标表示并对齐异构模态特征，结合四种互补损失进行训练。在GeoBench分类和分割任务上，HQ-JEPA在线性探测和微调设置下取得了优于强自监督和遥感基础模型基线的性能。
Motivation: 现有遥感表征学习方法多依赖像素重建或单模态自监督，难以有效融合异质模态（如SAR和光学）并学习语义丰富的表示。
Method: 提出混合量子-经典架构，包含四个目标：潜在令牌预测、跨模态令牌对齐、基于SIGReg的融合潜在空间高斯正则化，以及基于可微SWAP测试的保真度量子相似性（FQS）损失。
Result: 在GeoBench基准上，HQ-JEPA在分类和分割任务中达到与强基线竞争甚至更优的性能，证明了预测自监督、跨模态几何正则化和量子保真度表示学习的结合优势。
Conclusion: HQ-JEPA展示了量子-经典混合方法在遥感多模态表示学习中的潜力，但摘要未提及局限性或未来工作。

papers.title: DRIFT: Joint Channel Estimation and Prediction Towards Pilotless 6G Non-Terrestrial Networks
papers.abstract_en: Non-terrestrial networks (NTNs) are expected to play a pivotal role in sixth-generation (6G) systems by enabling ubiquitous connectivity and massive communication. In this context, channel prediction emerges as a key technique to improve the spectrum utilization efficiency by limiting the pilot overhead. However, many proposed predictors based on artificial intelligence (AI) are characterized by high inference complexity, posing challenges to onboard implementation. In this paper, we address the challenge of designing accurate yet computationally efficient channel prediction techniques tailored to low Earth orbit (LEO) NTNs, where strict power constraints limit model complexity, to enable spectral efficiency gains. We propose an iterative joint channel estimation and prediction framework in the context of 6G NTNs that significantly reduces pilot overhead by transmitting pilots only in the initial slot and relying on data-driven processing for subsequent slots. We introduce Data-driven Refinement and Iterative Forecast for wireless channel Tracking (DRIFT), a lightweight architecture that refines data-aided channel estimates and predicts future channel frequency responses with low computational cost and reduced error propagation. Two predictor variants based on convolutional and long short-term memory layers are investigated. Simulation results in an end-to-end simulation of an uplink LEO NTN scenario show that the proposed approach achieves up to 12% spectral efficiency gain compared to conventional pilot-based systems, with robustness to training-test mismatches and consistent performance across different channel models. Moreover, DRIFT requires fewer than 200k multiply-accumulate operations, making it suitable for on-board satellite implementation under stringent power constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向6G非地面网络（NTN），提出DRIFT——一种联合信道估计与预测的轻量级架构，通过仅初始时隙发送导频、后续依赖数据驱动处理来大幅降低导频开销。仿真表明，在低地球轨道（LEO）上行场景中，该方法相比传统导频方案可获得最高12%的频谱效率增益，且计算成本低于20万次乘累加操作，适合星载实现。
Motivation: NTN中信道预测可提升频谱利用率，但现有AI预测器复杂度高，难以在功率严格受限的卫星上部署。
Method: 提出迭代式联合信道估计与预测框架DRIFT，先利用初始导频获得信道估计，再通过轻量级数据驱动处理（卷积或LSTM层）对后续时隙进行信道细化与预测，仅需极少量导频。
Result: 端到端仿真表明，在LEO NTN上行场景中，DRIFT相比传统导频系统实现最高12%的频谱效率增益，对训练-测试失配鲁棒，并可在不同信道模型下保持稳定性能。
Conclusion: DRIFT以低于20万次乘累加操作的计算开销实现显著频谱效率提升，证明在功率约束严格的卫星上部署高效的AI信道预测是可行的。

papers.title: Fighting Numerical Hallucinations via Data-centric Compilation for Online Financial QA
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have significantly advanced online data services, particularly in the domain of financial question answering (FinQA). However, such systems remain susceptible to numerical reasoning hallucinations, which critically undermine reliability in high-stakes financial applications. Although retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has been widely adopted to ground responses in external knowledge, it introduces three persistent challenges: noise sensitivity, calculation fragility, and an auditability crisis. Existing model-centric approaches, which primarily focus on optimizing either the retriever or generator in isolation, still struggle to address these issues in an integrated manner. In this work, we pioneer a data-centric paradigm and propose a novel framework, the Data-centric Reasoning Compiler (DCRC). The framework operates through three cohesive phases: (1) adversarial data construction, which synthesizes training examples with controlled noise to teach robustness; (2) multi-stage training that cultivates a Data-centric Structuring Agent (DSA) capable of explicit evidence auditing and program synthesis; and (3) a compile-and-execute inference process, where the DSA transforms user queries and retrieved documents into verifiable, executable reasoning programs. This data-driven framework ensures faithful numerical reasoning by design. We conduct extensive experiments on established offline benchmarks and further validate our framework through deployment in a real-world online financial QA system.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对金融问答（FinQA）中LLM的数值推理幻觉问题，提出数据中心的编译框架DCRC。该框架通过对抗性数据构建、多阶段训练培养数据中心结构化代理（DSA），并在推理时将查询和文档编译为可执行程序，从而确保数值推理的忠实性。离线基准和实际在线金融问答系统的实验验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有RAG在金融问答中面临噪声敏感、计算脆弱和审计危机三类挑战，而模型中心方法（优化检索器或生成器）难以整体解决。
Method: 提出Data-centric Reasoning Compiler (DCRC)，包含三个步骤：1) 对抗性数据构建，生成含受控噪声的训练样本；2) 多阶段训练培养Data-centric Structuring Agent (DSA)，使其具备证据审计和程序合成能力；3) 编译并执行的推理过程，DSA将用户查询和检索文档转化为可验证、可执行的推理程序。
Result: 摘要称在离线基准和实际在线金融问答系统中进行了广泛实验，验证了框架的有效性，但未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 该工作开创数据中心范式解决金融推理幻觉，但未讨论计算开销或泛化到其他领域的局限性。

papers.title: Free energy Estimation on Any State Space
papers.abstract_en: Free energy estimation is a fundamental yet challenging problem, from physics to statistics. Classical approaches rely on thermodynamic transformations, ranging from direct estimation, quasistatic integration, to finite-time averaging. Recent work [He and Du et al., 2025] learns neural transports to significantly accelerate the efficiency in the finite-time regime. In this paper, we generalize this framework to arbitrary state spaces. Building on this view, we develop a generalized neural transport learning approach for efficient estimation. Experiments validate the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed method beyond continuous settings, extending to discrete and multimodal spaces as well as autoregressive settings. Beyond free energy estimation, we establish algebraic identities and reveal a group-theoretic structure linking infinitesimal time reversal and generalized Doob's $h$-transforms, showing that their compositions form a generalized dihedral group.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文推广了自由能估计的神经传输框架到任意状态空间，提出了广义神经传输学习方法，并在离散、多模态和自回归设置下验证了其有效性。此外，建立了时间反转与广义Doob h-变换之间的代数恒等式，揭示了它们构成广义二面体群的群论结构。
Motivation: 自由能估计是物理学和统计学中的基本难题，经典方法（如准静态积分、有限时间平均）效率有限，而近期基于神经传输的方法仅适用于连续空间。本文旨在将该框架推广到任意状态空间。
Method: 在已有神经传输学习框架的基础上，将其推广到任意状态空间，开发了广义的神经传输学习方法，适用于离散、多模态及自回归等非连续设置。
Result: 实验表明，所提方法在连续设置之外（离散、多模态空间及自回归设置）均能有效且高效地进行自由能估计。
Conclusion: 本文不仅提供了任意状态空间上的高效自由能估计方法，还揭示了时间反转与广义Doob h-变换之间的代数恒等式，并证明其组成广义二面体群，具有理论意义。

papers.title: STEP: Learning STructured Embeddings for Progressive Time Series
papers.abstract_en: We present a novel method for learning interpretable representations of progressive time series, that is, data capturing irreversible state transitions such as degradation or task completion. Our approach uses a self-supervised contrastive objective to learn a low-dimensional latent space whose geometry is itself the interpretation: each observation becomes a point on a manifold anchored between two fixed orthogonal prototype vectors, and a trajectory becomes a path across that manifold. From this structure we read a latent compass, the polar coordinates (θ, r) of the latent vector, in which θ tracks the progression of the underlying state (e.g., from healthy to failed) and r identifies the active mode (e.g., the operating condition), without any proxy labels. We evaluate the approach against the state of the art on diverse domains, including industrial degradation, robotic tasks, and neural activity, validating three key capabilities: (1) end-state prediction, (2) multi-step forecasting, and (3) interpretable phase separation. Our method matches or improves over black-box counterparts on all of these while providing transparency about the underlying mechanisms. A simple linear regressor on top of the latent compass coordinates is competitive with deep architectures, direct quantitative evidence that the underlying state is encoded in a geometrically accessible form.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出STEP方法，用于学习渐进式时间序列（如退化或任务完成）的可解释表示。通过自监督对比学习，将每个观测点映射到两个固定正交原型向量锚定的低维流形上，其极坐标(θ, r)分别追踪状态进展（如从健康到故障）和识别活动模式（如运行条件），无需代理标签。在工业退化、机器人任务和神经活动等多个领域，该方法在最终状态预测、多步预测和可解释阶段分离方面匹配或优于黑盒模型，且线性回归器在潜在指南针坐标上即可达到与深度架构竞争的性能。
Motivation: 现有时间序列方法在渐进式序列（不可逆状态转换）上缺乏可解释性，尤其是如何在不依赖代理标签的情况下同时捕捉进程和模式信息。
Method: 提出自监督对比学习框架，将时间序列嵌入到由两个正交原型向量确定的流形上，每个观测点用极坐标(θ, r)表示，其中θ角度跟踪状态进展，r半径标识活跃模式。训练目标使正样本对接近、负样本对远离，并通过几何约束确保θ的单向进展性质。
Result: 在工业退化、机器人操作和神经活动数据集上，STEP在最终状态预测、多步预测和阶段分离任务上匹配或超越了LSTM、TCN等黑盒基线，且线性回归器在极坐标上的预测性能与深度架构相当。
Conclusion: STEP通过几何化的潜在空间实现了对渐进式时间序列的可解释表示，极坐标分解直接对应进程和模式，无需额外标签。该方法为需要透明度的退化监测和任务进度估计提供了有效工具。

papers.title: LVSA: Training-Free Sparse Attention for Long Video Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Dense self-attention is the compute and quality bottleneck of long-video diffusion inference: cost grows quadratically with the sequence length, and beyond the training horizon the model converges to near-static output, that is, "frozen" repetitive video. State of the art approaches are either too costly, e.g., they require retraining, or fail to satisfy both performance and quality objectives in a scalable manner. To this end, we introduce Long Video Sparse Attention (LVSA), a training-free model-agnostic block-sparse attention for video diffusion transformers that combines a structured window pattern with rotating global anchors, thus removing the fixed-grid bias which causes long-range temporal artifacts. LVSA, combined with a FlashInfer kernel, reduces compute up to 3.17x on Wan 2.1 1.3B at a 6x horizon, 2.98x on Wan 2.1 14B at a 6x horizon, and 3.33x on HunyuanVideo 1.5 at a 1.5x horizon, compared to dense attention. Beyond reducing compute, LVSA enables HunyuanVideo 1.5 generation at a 2x horizon, which is otherwise out-of-memory on a single GPU. Moreover, LVSA provides speedups up to 2.41x compared to RIFLEx and 3.27x compared to UltraViCo on Wan 2.1 1.3B. To demonstrate applicability across diverse platforms, we apply LVSA on NPUs and achieve speedups up to 2.71x on Wan 2.2 A14B and 3.24x on Wan 2.1 1.3B compared to dense attention. To evaluate quality in a fair way, we introduce VQeval, a tool properly scoring loopy video failures, which instead are rewarded in state of the art evaluators like VBench-Long. LVSA is quality-neutral for generation at training horizon length and quality-positive at extended lengths.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LVSA是一种无需训练的、模型无关的块稀疏注意力机制，用于长视频扩散Transformer。它结合结构化的窗口模式与旋转全局锚点，消除固定网格偏差，从而在保持视频质量的同时显著降低计算成本。在Wan 2.1和HunyuanVideo等模型上，相比密集注意力，计算量减少至1/3以下，并支持更大时间跨度生成。
Motivation: 长视频扩散推理中，密集自注意力的计算成本随序列长度二次增长，且超出训练范围时生成趋于静态重复；现有方法或需要重训练，或无法同时满足性能和可扩展性。
Method: 提出LVSA，一种基于结构化窗口和旋转全局锚点的块稀疏注意力模式，无需重新训练；结合FlashInfer内核实现高效计算。

papers.title: AnchorSteer: Self-Discovered Concept Injection for Structure-Preserving Music Editing
papers.abstract_en: Controllable music editing is to modify high-level attributes while strictly preserving rhythmic and melodic structures. However, this task is challenged by a semantic-structural entanglement: steering methods often degrade structure to achieve editing performance, while structural adaptors suppress semantic responsiveness. We propose AnchorSteer, a framework that disentangles this tension by coupling structural anchoring with self-discovered semantic steering. The proposed approach probes internal representations to extract interpretable, label-free concept vectors via a self-supervised reconstruction objective, isolating attributes without curated data. During editing, these portable, plug-and-play concept vectors are injected into diffusion hidden manifolds while a structural adaptor enforces consistency. Variants for unconditioned and conditioned injections are provided to balance robustness and semantic strength. Experiments on ZoME-Bench and subjective tests show that the proposed framework outperforms both steering-only and anchoring-only baselines, enabling significant semantic transformations with high-fidelity structural preservation.
papers.comment: Accepted by the 32nd ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining (KDD 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AnchorSteer 提出一种自发现概念注入（self-discovered concept injection）框架，用于结构保持的音乐编辑，通过解耦语义与结构，实现高保真结构保持下的显著语义变换。
Motivation: 可控音乐编辑中，语义与结构存在纠缠：现有方法在编辑属性时会破坏结构，而结构保持方法会抑制语义响应，亟需一种能同时兼顾两者的方法。
Method: 提出 AnchorSteer 框架，包含结构锚定（structural anchoring）和自发现语义引导（self-discovered semantic steering）。通过自监督重建目标探测内部表征，提取可解释、无需标签的概念向量，并在编辑时注入扩散隐空间，同时使用结构适配器保持一致性。提供无条件与有条件注入两种变体。
Result: 在 ZoME-Bench 和主观测试中，AnchorSteer 优于纯引导和纯锚定基线，实现了显著语义变换并保持高保真结构。
Conclusion: 该框架有效解耦了音乐编辑中的语义与结构，且概念向量无需标签数据、可即插即用。

papers.title: Linear Ordering Problem: Time for a Change
papers.abstract_en: The Linear Ordering Problem (LOP) is a fundamental combinatorial optimization problem with important applications in areas such as economics, social choice, and machine learning. Its most prominent use is the triangulation of economic input-output tables, which helps identify critical industries in an economy. Most existing algorithms have been evaluated on benchmarks derived from outdated macroeconomic data, which no longer reflect the structure of contemporary economies. Furthermore, LOP instances often exhibit many distinct global optima that can differ substantially from one another, creating challenges for applications that rely on a single solution. To address these limitations, we introduce a novel benchmark suite derived from up-to-date real-world economic data and an algorithmic scheme that leverages state-of-the-art LOP metaheuristics to generate diverse sets of high-quality solutions, together with metrics for assessing both quality and diversity. Experiments were conducted to report results on the proposed benchmark suite under both the traditional single-solution setting and the newly introduced multi-solution scenario
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出线性排序问题（LOP）现有基准基于过时经济数据，且忽视多最优解问题；为此提出基于最新经济数据的基准套件和一种生成多样化高质量解的算法框架，并在单解和多解场景下报告实验结果。
Motivation: 现有LOP基准基于过时宏观经济数据，不再反映当代经济结构；且LOP实例常含多个差异显著的全局最优解，依赖单一解的应用面临挑战。
Method: 引入基于最新真实经济数据的新基准套件，并设计一种算法框架，利用最先进LOP元启发式生成多样化高质量解集，同时提出评估质量和多样性的指标。
Result: 在传统单解和新引入的多解场景下进行实验，报告了所提基准套件上的结果。
Conclusion: 本文强调需要更新LOP基准以适应现代经济，并提出了多解视角和相应算法/指标。

papers.title: Best-Arm Identification-Based Trust Region Selection for Bayesian Optimization on Multimodal Functions
papers.abstract_en: Gaussian process-based Bayesian optimization (BO) is a popular approach for expensive black-box optimization, but its performance often degrades on complex multimodal or high-dimensional problems. Trust region-based BO mitigates this issue by focusing on local regions, and recent studies suggest that selecting an effective region can be formulated as a multi-armed bandit problem. We propose a trajectory-aware framework that integrates best-arm identification (BAI) with trust region-based BO to efficiently solve multimodal optimization problems. Our method extrapolates the optimization trajectories of multiple locally initialized optimizers to predict their final performance and progressively eliminates suboptimal candidates via BAI. We theoretically show that the proposed BAI-guided BO converges faster to the global optimum than conventional BO under mild assumptions, and demonstrate its effectiveness through extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个轨迹感知框架，将最佳臂识别（BAI）与基于信任区域的贝叶斯优化结合，用于高效求解多模态黑盒函数优化问题。方法通过外推多个局部初始化优化器的轨迹并利用BAI逐步淘汰次优候选，理论证明收敛速度优于传统BO，实验验证有效。
Motivation: 高斯过程贝叶斯优化在处理复杂多模态或高维问题时性能退化，现有信任区域方法虽然局部聚焦但区域选择仍有改进空间。
Method: 集成最佳臂识别（BAI）与信任区域选择：外推多个局部优化器的优化轨迹以预测最终性能，通过BAI机制逐步剔除表现较差的候选区域。
Result: 理论上在温和假设下证明收敛到全局最优的速度快于传统贝叶斯优化；通过合成与真实基准实验展示有效性。
Conclusion: 该方法扩展了贝叶斯优化在多模态问题上的适用性，但摘要未提及其局限性或适用范围。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning to Solve and Optimize by Evolving Code
papers.abstract_en: Combinatorial and optimization problems are fundamental to many industrial AI applications. Solving large-scale real-world instances of such problems typically requires careful problem formalization, specialized solvers, and expert-designed heuristics. Thus, experts need to specify not only what solutions are, but also how they are derived. By introducing the tool CHECKMATE, we show that algorithm generation via code evolution represents a paradigm shift by eliminating the need to formulate the how. CHECKMATE solely relies on the what. Specifically, a formal specification ensures solutions' correctness and enables systematic performance evaluation of the generated programs, while a natural language description guides the evolutionary process. The effectiveness of our method is demonstrated on selected problems from two industrial domains: configuration and scheduling. In all cases, the evolved algorithms consistently outperform state-of-the-art solvers. This underscores the potential of formal methods in guiding code evolution for automatically solving complex real-world problems.
papers.comment: Preprint of a paper accepted to IJCAI26
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CHECKMATE 工具，通过代码进化自动生成求解组合优化问题的算法，用户只需提供形式化规范（what）而无需设计求解过程（how）。在配置和调度领域的测试中，进化出的算法持续超越现有最优求解器，展示了形式化方法引导代码进化解决复杂真实问题的潜力。
Motivation: 大规模组合优化问题需要专家形式化、专用求解器和启发式设计，人力成本高。论文旨在消除对求解过程（how）的依赖，仅凭问题规范（what）自动生成高性能算法。
Method: CHECKMATE 利用形式化规范确保生成程序的正确性并系统评估性能，同时用自然语言描述指导进化过程，通过代码进化（code evolution）自动演化出求解算法。
Result: 在配置和调度两个工业领域的选定问题上，进化出的算法在所有测试实例中均一致优于现有一流求解器（state-of-the-art solvers）。
Conclusion: 论文认为形式化方法引导代码进化有望成为自动解决复杂真实问题的新范式，但未讨论局限性与泛化边界。

papers.title: Rethinking Efficient Crack Segmentation with Task-Aligned Structural-Directional Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Recent crack segmentation methods often follow generic semantic segmentation designs, using stronger backbones, hybrid CNN-Transformer-Mamba encoders, and auxiliary enhancement branches. Although effective, this raises whether stronger generic feature mixing is the most suitable direction for crack segmentation. We instead formulate crack segmentation as sparse structural recovery. Cracks have limited category-level semantics but strong morphological regularities, being thin, sparse, anisotropic, locally fragmented, and easily confused with textures or shadows. Thus, the key bottleneck lies in preserving weak structural evidence, recovering directional continuity, and suppressing background coupling. We propose RIFT, a compact family of morphology-aligned crack segmentation models. Rather than compressing a complex generic architecture, RIFT is simple by design, preserving local evidence, aggregating cooperative directional continuity, and restoring crack structures through lightweight multi-scale fusion. Experiments on four public benchmarks show that RIFT achieves the best or tied-best results across the 16 main metrics against reproduced representative baselines. RIFT-B gives the strongest overall accuracy, while RIFT-T provides the best deployment efficiency with only 0.47M parameters and high inference speed. Topology-aware evaluation, ablations, transfer experiments, and visualizations further verify that task-aligned simplicity can match or surpass complex hybrid architectures when its inductive bias fits crack morphology. Code: https://github.com/xauat-liushipeng/RIFT
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新思考裂缝分割问题，提出RIFT系列模型，将裂缝分割形式化为稀疏结构恢复任务。相比通用语义分割设计，RIFT通过轻量级多尺度融合保留局部证据、聚合方向连续性并恢复裂缝结构。在四个公开基准上的16项主要指标中，RIFT达到最优或并列最优，其中RIFT-B取得最佳准确率，RIFT-T仅0.47M参数且推理速度快。实验验证了任务对齐的简单设计可以匹配或超越复杂混合架构。
Motivation: 现有裂缝分割方法多采用通用语义分割设计（更强的骨干、混合编码器、辅助分支），但裂缝具有有限的类别语义和强烈的形态规律（细、稀疏、各向异性、局部断裂、易与纹理/阴影混淆），关键瓶颈在于保持弱结构证据、恢复方向连续性、抑制背景耦合，因此需要针对性设计而非通用特征混合。
Method: 提出RIFT，一种紧凑的形态对齐裂缝分割模型族。核心设计包括：保持局部证据、聚合合作方向连续性、通过轻量级多尺度融合恢复裂缝结构，避免压缩复杂通用架构。
Result: 在四个公开基准上，RIFT在16项主要指标中达到最佳或并列最佳。RIFT-B在总体准确率上最强，RIFT-T仅0.47M参数且推理速度高。拓扑感知评估、消融、迁移实验和可视化进一步验证了任务对齐的简单性可以匹配或超越复杂混合架构。
Conclusion: 摘要强调任务对齐的简单性在裂缝分割中有效，当归纳偏置与裂缝形态匹配时，简单设计可媲美复杂混合架构。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Challenges of Using Reinforcement Learning for Controlling Industrial Energy Systems
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning has shown promising results for optimizing the control of industrial energy systems, yet most existing studies remain limited to the application in simulation environments. We investigate the challenges of deploying reinforcement learning in a real-world industrial energy system, considering a thermal heating network as a use case. We formulate the task as a Markov Decision Process and systematically analyze the associated challenges along the structure of the formal description, including partial observability, action space design, reward design, and the simulation-to-reality gap. The challenges are grounded in an existing real-world deployment, where reinforcement learning achieves operational stability but shows a significant performance gap compared to simulation.
papers.comment: Submitted to Finding the Frame Workshop at RLC 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨了在真实工业能源系统（热力供暖网络）中部署强化学习的挑战。作者将任务形式化为马尔可夫决策过程，系统分析了部分可观测性、动作空间设计、奖励设计以及仿真到现实差距等挑战。实际部署结果表明，强化学习虽然能够实现运行稳定性，但性能与仿真相比存在显著差距。
Motivation: 现有强化学习优化工业能源系统的研究大多局限于仿真环境，缺乏对真实部署挑战的系统分析。
Method: 以热力供暖网络为案例，将控制任务建模为MDP，逐项分析部分可观测性、动作空间、奖励设计及仿真到现实差距等挑战。

papers.title: Routing on the Stiefel Manifold: When Does Adaptive Subspace Selection Help for Cross-Domain EEG Decoding?
papers.abstract_en: Cross-domain EEG decoding remains challenging despite advances in Riemannian deep learning: covariance matrices from different subjects occupy systematically distinct regions of the SPD manifold, yet existing domain adaptation methods either require target-domain calibration data or learn subject-specific components that cannot generalise across domains. We propose dynamic Stiefel routing: a pool of $K$ expert projection filters on the Stiefel manifold, each specialised for a different region of the SPD manifold, with each input covariance routed to the most appropriate filter via cross-attention, adapting the subspace projection per sample. A central finding is that this approach, implemented naively, provably collapses to ensemble averaging: when routing weights are uniform, the adaptive filter reduces exactly to an equal-contribution combination of experts, indistinguishable from a single fixed filter. Three structural properties break this degeneracy: a symmetric anchor $W_{\mathrm{base}} \in \mathrm{St}(n,k)$ that removes proximity bias among experts; a frozen domain-discriminative query encoder that decouples routing from task optimisation; and a decoupled key alignment loss that trains expert keys toward stable domain attractors. Together they produce the first genuinely committed and domain-structured routing on SPD manifolds, with consistent gains across three datasets: balanced accuracy improves from $0.773\to 0.823$, $0.757\to 0.809$, and $0.801\to 0.839$, with the alignment strategy determined automatically by a single data-driven rule and no dataset-specific hyperparameter search.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对跨域脑电图解码中协方差矩阵分布偏移的问题，提出动态Stiefel流形路由：在Stiefel流形上维护K个专家投影滤波器，通过交叉注意力为每个样本自适应选择子空间投影。摘要证明朴素实现会退化至集成平均，并引入三个结构特性（对称锚点、冻结域判别查询编码器、解耦的关键对齐损失）来打破退化，在三个数据集上平衡准确率提升约0.04-0.05。
Motivation: 跨域脑电图解码中，不同受试者协方差矩阵在SPD流形上分布偏移，现有域适应方法要么需目标域校准数据，要么学习无法跨域泛化的特定成分。
Method: 提出动态Stiefel路由，利用K个在Stiefel流形上的专家投影滤波器和交叉注意力进行样本级自适应子空间投影。为防止退化为集成平均，引入对称锚点W_base∈St(n,k)、冻结域判别查询编码器和解耦的关键对齐损失。
Result: 在三个数据集上，平衡准确率分别从0.773→0.823、0.757→0.809、0.801→0.839，且无需数据集特定超参数搜索，对齐策略由单一数据驱动规则自动确定。
Conclusion: 该方法首次在SPD流形上实现具有域结构的路由，通过三个结构特性保证了路由的承诺性和领域结构化。

papers.title: From Prompt Injection to Persistent Control: Defending Agentic Harness Against Trojan Backdoors
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents are evolving from conversational chatbots to operational tools in real-world workspaces. In local agentic harnesses, an LLM can read and write files, call tools, and reuse workspace state across sessions. While such capabilities enhance utility, they also expose a new attack surface for attackers. Attackers can embed a prompt injection within a file or tool output. Agents may read this hidden instruction, store it, and execute it later. In this multi-step trojan attack paradigm, no individual step appears malicious on its own, but these steps can collectively turn untrusted text into persistent control content. However, existing defenses often inspect each step in isolation. As a result, they can block a clear harmful action, but fail to detect the earlier write operation that plants the backdoor. To reveal this threat, we introduce ClawTrojan, a benchmark designed to identify multi-step trojan attacks in local agentic harnesses. In an OpenClaw-style simulated workspace with GPT-5.4, ClawTrojan reaches a 95.5% attack success rate (ASR), while existing single-turn prompt-injection attacks produce near-zero ASR on the same model. To address this threat, we propose DASGuard, which scans control-like text in sensitive local files, traces its origin, and removes control content that does not originate from a trusted source. Our results show that DASGuard achieves strong dynamic defense by combining runtime attack blocking with sanitized commits to the workspace.
papers.comment: Code and data are available at https://github.com/RUC-NLPIR/ClawTrojan
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示了一种针对本地LLM agent的多步木马攻击范式：攻击者通过文件或工具输出嵌入提示注入，agent在后续会话中读取并执行，形成持久控制。现有防御因孤立检查单步操作而无法阻断。作者提出ClawTrojan基准测试，在GPT-5.4模拟工作区中实现95.5%的攻击成功率；并提出DASGuard防御方法，通过扫描敏感文件中的控制文本并追溯来源，结合运行时拦截与工作区清理实现动态防御。
Motivation: LLM agent在本地工作区中具备读写文件、调用工具等能力，攻击者可通过多步提示注入实现持久控制，而现有防御仅检查单步操作，无法发现早期植入后门的写入操作。
Method: 提出ClawTrojan基准测试，以OpenClaw风格模拟工作区，评估多步木马攻击；提出DASGuard防御方法，扫描敏感文件中类似控制指令的文本，追溯其来源，移除非可信源的控制内容，并运行时拦截攻击与提交清理后的工作区。
Result: 在GPT-5.4上，ClawTrojan达到95.5%的攻击成功率，而现有单轮提示注入攻击成功率接近零；DASGuard实现强动态防御。
Conclusion: 多步木马攻击对本地agent构成严重威胁，DASGuard通过组合运行时阻断与工作区清理提供了有效防御。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Does Visual Information Play a Decisive Role in Vision-Language-Action Model Driving Behavior?
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated promising capability in autonomous driving, highlighting the potential of unified multimodal architectures for jointly modeling perception and planning. However, how current VLA-based driving behavior is grounded in visual information remains poorly understood. Existing evaluation protocols mainly focus on aggregate performance metrics, lacking structured and practical diagnostics to quantify visual-behavior dependency. In this work, we introduce a structured multi-level visual perturbation framework to analyze visual-behavior dependency in VLA-based driving models systematically. The framework organizes controlled visual perturbations along three complementary dimensions: channellevel degradation, information-level disruption, and structurelevel modification. We apply it to VLA-based driving systems and evaluate behavioral responses under both open-loop trajectory prediction and interactive closed-loop safety evaluation. Experimental results reveal evaluation-dependent dependency patterns and uneven visual grounding across abstraction levels. These findings call for more structured analyses and principled design of VLA driving models to better understand how visual information shapes behavior and develop safer, more robust systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个多级视觉扰动框架，用于系统分析VLA自动驾驶模型中视觉信息对驾驶行为的影响。实验发现，行为对视觉信息的依赖程度随评估方式（开环轨迹预测 vs. 闭环安全评估）和视觉抽象层级而变化。
Motivation: 当前VLA驾驶模型的行为如何依赖于视觉信息尚不明确，现有评估仅关注聚合指标，缺乏结构化的诊断工具。
Method: 构建一个多级视觉扰动框架，沿通道退化、信息层破坏和结构层修改三个维度施加受控扰动，并在VLA驾驶系统上进行开环和闭环评估。
Result: 发现视觉依赖模式因评估方式而异，且视觉信息在不同抽象层级的利用不均衡。
Conclusion: 需要更结构化的分析和更审慎的模型设计来理解视觉信息如何塑造驾驶行为，以提升系统安全性和鲁棒性。

papers.title: UniRTL: Unifying Code and Graph for Robust RTL Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Developing effective representations for register transfer level (RTL) designs is crucial for accelerating the hardware design workflow. Existing approaches, however, typically rely on a single data modality, either the RTL code or its associated graph-based representation, limiting the expressiveness and generalization ability of the learned representations. For RTL, the control data flow graph (CDFG) offers a comprehensive structural representation that preserves complete information, while the code modality explicitly encodes semantic and functional information. We argue that integrating these complementary modalities is essential for a thorough understanding of RTL designs. To this end, we propose UniRTL, a multimodal pretraining framework that learns unified RTL representations by jointly leveraging code and CDFG. UniRTL achieves fine-grained alignment between code and graph through mutual masked modeling and employs a hierarchical training strategy that incorporates a pretrained graph-aware tokenizer and staged alignment of text (i.e., functional summary) and code prior to graph integration. We evaluate UniRTL on two downstream tasks, performance prediction and code retrieval, under multiple settings. Experimental results show that UniRTL consistently outperforms prior methods, establishing it as a more robust and powerful foundation for advancing hardware design automation.
papers.comment: Forty-Third International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出UniRTL，一个多模态预训练框架，通过联合利用RTL代码和控制数据流图（CDFG）来学习统一的RTL表示。该框架采用互掩码建模实现代码与图的细粒度对齐，并采用分层训练策略，先对齐文本（功能摘要）与代码，再融入图信息。实验表明，UniRTL在性能预测和代码检索两个下游任务上持续优于现有方法，为硬件设计自动化提供了更鲁棒的基础。
Motivation: 现有RTL表示学习方法通常仅依赖单一模态（RTL代码或图），限制了表示的表达能力和泛化能力。对于RTL，CDFG提供完整结构信息，而代码显式编码语义和功能，融合这两种互补模态对于全面理解RTL设计至关重要。
Method: UniRTL通过互掩码建模实现代码与CDFG的细粒度对齐，并采用分层训练策略：先使用预训练的图感知分词器，然后分阶段对齐文本（功能摘要）与代码，最后融入图信息。
Result: 在性能预测和代码检索两个下游任务上，UniRTL在多种设置下均持续优于先前方法，展现出更鲁棒和强大的性能。
Conclusion: UniRTL作为统一的多模态预训练框架，为硬件设计自动化建立了更强大的基础，但摘要未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: GGT-100K: Generative Ground Truth for Generalizable Real-World Image Restoration
papers.abstract_en: Real-world image restoration (IR) is bottlenecked by the scarcity of high-quality paired training data. Synthetic datasets are abundant but often fail to model real-world degradations, while real-world paired datasets are expensive and difficult to capture. As a result, IR models trained on these datasets show limited generalization in real-world scenarios. In this work, we propose Generative Ground Truth (GGT) by using generative multimodal foundation models (MFMs) to produce high-quality (HQ) targets from real-world low-quality (LQ) images. We first conduct a systematic evaluation of nine state-of-the-art MFMs, including Nano-Banana-2 and GPT-Image-2, on images of various scenes and degradation types. The results demonstrate that Nano-Banana-2 with VLM-based adaptive prompting shows the highest capability to synthesize perceptually realistic and content-faithful HQ targets, which can serve as the GGT for the LQ input. We then employ Nano-Banana-2 to build a GGT synthesis pipeline, which involves multi-stage quality control to ensure data reliability, and construct GGT-100K, an LQ-HQ paired dataset comprising 103,707 training pairs and covering diverse scenes and complex real-world degradations. A test set of 500 image pairs is also established. Extensive experiments show that GGT-100K consistently improves the real-world generalization of a wide range of IR models, with particularly strong benefits for finetuning generative models for IR tasks. Our results suggest that MFMs can serve as practical tools for restoration-oriented data generation, and GGT-100K is a useful resource to expand the generalization boundaries of real-world IR models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出利用生成式多模态基础模型（MFM）为真实世界低质量图像生成高质量目标（GGT），构建了GGT-100K数据集（103,707对训练对，500对测试集），涵盖多种场景和退化。实验表明该数据集能提升多种图像恢复模型的泛化能力。
Motivation: 真实世界图像恢复因缺乏高质量配对数据而受限，合成数据集无法模拟真实退化，真实配对数据昂贵且难以获取。
Method: 系统评估9种先进MFM，选用Nano-Banana-2结合VLM自适应提示来合成感知真实且内容忠实的高质量目标；构建多阶段质量控制的数据集生成流水线，形成GGT-100K。
Result: GGT-100K能一致地提升多种图像恢复模型的真实世界泛化能力，尤其对生成式模型微调受益显著。
Conclusion: MFM可作为面向恢复的数据生成实用工具，GGT-100K是扩展真实世界IR模型泛化边界的有用资源。

papers.title: Model Monotonicity in Autobidding Auctions: When Do Better Predictions Lead to Better Outcomes?
papers.abstract_en: Online advertising platforms rely on machine learning models to predict click-through rates (pCTR) and conversion rates (pCVR) for auction mechanisms. We introduce a novel framework to study the interaction between recommender system model quality, auction format, and autobidder behavior. We formalize when model improvements -- defined via a refinement relation inspired by filtrations in probability theory -- lead to improvements in platform-level Evaluation Criteria Metrics (ECM) such as revenue, welfare, or liquid welfare. Our main contributions are: (1) a formal definition of model improvement based on cluster refinement, and (2) a systematic characterization of ECM monotonicity across different combinations of bidder types (tCPA, max-CPA), auction formats (first-price, second-price, VCG), and budget constraints. We show that first-price auctions with uniform bidding guarantee revenue monotonicity for tCPA bidders without budgets (via Jensen's inequality), while second-price auctions and budget constraints can break this property. We provide full numerical constructions for the non-monotonicity results. Our findings have practical implications for advertising platforms seeking to align model improvements with business outcomes.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在线广告拍卖中，推荐系统模型质量（通过聚类细化的模型改进）如何影响平台级评价指标（如收入、福利）的单调性。作者定义了基于聚类细化的模型改进，并系统刻画了在不同投标人类型（tCPA、max-CPA）、拍卖格式（一价、二价、VCG）和预算约束下评价指标的单调性。结果表明，一价拍卖在无预算的tCPA投标人下保证收入单调性，而二价拍卖和预算约束可能破坏该性质。
Motivation: 在线广告平台依赖ML模型预测点击率和转化率，但模型改进是否必然带来平台收入等指标提升？现有研究缺乏系统性理论框架。
Method: 提出基于聚类细化（从概率论过滤概念启发）的模型改进定义，并理论分析不同拍卖设置下评价指标单调性的充分条件。
Result: 一价拍卖在无预算tCPA投标人下保证收入单调性（通过Jensen不等式）；二价拍卖和预算约束可导致非单调性，并给出数值构造。
Conclusion: 研究结果对广告平台有实际意义，提示模型改进与业务目标的对齐需考虑拍卖格式等机制细节。

papers.title: Annealed Softmax Greedy in Many-Armed Bayesian Bandits
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) and group-based policy optimization methods such as GRPO update a stochastic policy by sampling multiple completions per prompt and increasing the policy's probability on those with higher reward, regularized by a KL penalty toward a reference policy. These updates do not include explicit mechanisms that track epistemic uncertainty. This paper studies a stylized explanation for why such uncertainty-agnostic updates can nevertheless be effective. We analyze an annealed softmax (Boltzmann) policy that selects actions according to a softmax of empirical mean rewards in a many-armed Bayesian Bernoulli bandit. Under a linear upper-tail condition on the prior (the $β=1$ case of $β$-regularity), which implies an abundance of near-optimal arms, we prove that annealed softmax greedy achieves Bayes regret $\tilde{O}(m + T/m)$, and in particular $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ when the number of arms scales as $m = Θ(\sqrt{T})$. This is the near-optimal Bayes regret rate in this regime, attained also by empirical-mean greedy. Under $β$-regularity, many arms maintain empirical means close to the optimum throughout learning, so when softmax samples an arm other than the empirically best, that arm tends to be another near-optimal one rather than a clearly inferior one. By contrast, with a small number of arms, the same kind of softmax policy can suffer linear regret. The result also provides a structural analogy to RLVR, where a base policy with a non-negligible probability of producing a correct completion plays the role of $β$-regularity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析了退火softmax（Boltzmann）贪心策略在多臂贝叶斯伯努利赌博机中的表现。在β-正则性先验（线性上尾条件）下，证明该方法在臂数m=Θ(√T)时达到O~(√T)的Bayes后悔，接近最优率；而臂数少时则可能线性后悔。该结果为无显式不确定性追踪的RLVR/GRPO类更新提供了风格化解释。
Motivation: 现有RLVR和GRPO等策略更新方法不显式建模认知不确定性，本文通过分析退火softmax策略，为这类不确定性无关更新为何有效提供理论解释。
Method: 考虑贝叶斯伯努利多臂赌博机，策略按经验均值奖励的softmax选择动作，并引入退火温度。在β-正则性（β=1）条件下推导Bayes后悔上界，证明其达到O~(m+T/m)的后悔界。
Result: 当臂数m=Θ(√T)时，退火softmax贪心实现O~(√T)的Bayes后悔，这是该设定下的近最优率；臂数较少时则可能遭受线性后悔。
Conclusion: 该结果指出，当存在大量近最优臂时（类似β-正则性），软max策略可接近贪心性能，并与RLVR方法形成结构类比：基策略非零正确概率相当于β-正则性。

papers.title: SlotMemory: Object-Centric KV Memory for Streaming Long-Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Streaming video generation models typically rely on temporal-centric memory, which organizes historical context as raw frames, chunk segments, or unclustered tokens. This organization frequently leads to identity drift and semantic inconsistency when entities exit the frame or during interactive prompt transitions. To address these limitations, we propose SlotMemory, an object-centric Key-Value memory mechanism for streaming video diffusion. Our approach shifts the memory abstraction from "when" an event occurred to "what" is being represented by decomposing the transformer's key-value manifold into discrete, reusable semantic slots. By utilizing these slots as routing addresses to index and store high-fidelity key-value tokens, we enable entity-level persistence and prompt-aware retrieval across long horizons. Evaluated on 60-second interactive narratives using the Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B backbone, SlotMemory achieves a state-of-the-art quality score of 81.61 and a 22.8 percent relative improvement in dynamic consistency over the strongest existing streaming baseline. Our results demonstrate that structured semantic representation, rather than raw temporal capacity, is the essential primitive for persistent long-form video synthesis. Our codes and checkpoints are available at https://tj12323.github.io/SlotMemory/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SlotMemory，一种面向对象的键值记忆机制，用于流式长视频生成。该方法将 Transformer 的键值流形分解为离散、可复用的语义槽，以实体级持久化和提示感知检索，在 60 秒互动叙事生成上达到 SOTA。
Motivation: 现有流式视频生成模型使用基于时间的记忆组织（原始帧、片段或未聚类 token），导致实体离开画面或提示切换时出现身份漂移和语义不一致。
Method: 提出 SlotMemory，通过将键值流形分解为离散语义槽作为路由地址，存储高保真键值 token，实现实体级持久化和提示感知检索。
Result: 基于 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 骨干，在 60 秒互动叙事上达到 81.61 的质量分数，动态一致性相对现有最强基线提升 22.8%。
Conclusion: 结构化语义表示而非原始时间容量是持久长视频合成的关键原语。

papers.title: GraphARC: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Graph-Based Abstract Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Relational reasoning lies at the heart of intelligence, but existing benchmarks are typically confined to formats such as grids or text. We introduce GraphARC, a benchmark for abstract reasoning on graph-structured data. GraphARC generalizes the few-shot transformation learning paradigm of the Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus (ARC). Each task requires inferring a transformation rule from a few input-output pairs and applying it to a new test graph, covering local, global, and hierarchical graph transformations. Unlike grid-based ARC, GraphARC instances can be generated at scale across diverse graph families and sizes, enabling systematic evaluation of generalization abilities. We evaluate state-of-the-art language models on GraphARC and observe clear limitations. Models can answer questions about graph properties but often fail to solve the full graph transformation task, revealing a comprehension-execution gap. Performance further degrades on larger instances, exposing scaling barriers. More broadly, by combining aspects of node classification, link prediction, and graph generation within a single framework, GraphARC provides a promising testbed for future graph foundation models.
papers.comment: Accepted at KDD 2026 Datasets and Benchmarks Track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GraphARC，一个基于图结构数据的抽象推理基准，泛化了Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus (ARC)的少样本变换学习范式。每个任务要求从少数输入-输出对中推断变换规则并应用于新测试图，涵盖局部、全局和层次图变换。评估表明当前语言模型能回答图属性问题但无法完成完整图变换任务，存在理解-执行差距，且性能随实例规模增大而下降。
Motivation: 现有抽象推理基准通常局限于网格或文本格式，缺乏对图结构数据的标准化评估，难以系统衡量模型的图推理与泛化能力。
Method: GraphARC基准通过抽象语法树（AST）表示生成图实例，定义局部（如节点添加/删除）、全局（如图同构）和层次（如子树替换）变换任务，支持大规模自动生成不同图族和尺寸的实例。
Result: 在GraphARC上评估的语言模型在简单图属性问答上表现良好，但在完整图变换任务中失败率较高，揭示出理解与执行之间的差距；性能随着图实例变大而显著下降，暴露出缩放障碍。
Conclusion: GraphARC将节点分类、链接预测和图生成结合为统一框架，为未来图基础模型提供了有前景的测试平台。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PEEK: Picking Essential frames via Efficient Knowledge distillation
papers.abstract_en: Video-language models can process only a limited number of frames, making frame selection a key bottleneck for efficient video captioning. Most captioning pipelines still rely on uniform sampling, which is computationally cheap but agnostic to visual content. Adaptive frame sampling has recently emerged as a promising approach for selecting the most informative frames from a video; however, existing methods remain computationally expensive. We introduce PEEK, an efficient dynamic frame sampling method that distills caption-conditioned frame relevance rankings from a stronger teacher model into a lightweight temporal model that operates only on visual content. We find that, overall, on ActivityNet Captions and MSR-VTT, our method outperforms state-of-the-art methods across all evaluated downstream vision language models, especially when only one or two frames are selected for captioning, obtaining the best CIDEr for most frame budgets. On ActivityNet Captions, PEEK is particularly strong, winning 14 out of 16 configurations. Zero-shot evaluation on MSR-VTT shows that our model transfers best at low frame budgets, while results at four and eight frames are more mixed as temporal coverage and visual diversity become increasingly competitive. Compared with recent adaptive baselines, PEEK is both more accurate in the low-budget regime and more efficient: it adds only $5.2\%$ to the captioning time, compared with $65.4\%$ for CSTA and $211.9\%$ for MaxInfo. We release our code and pre-trained checkpoint at https://github.com/momentslab/peek.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PEEK，一种高效的动态帧采样方法，用于视频描述任务。它通过知识蒸馏将基于字幕的帧相关性排序从强教师模型迁移到轻量级时序模型，该模型仅依赖视觉内容。在 ActivityNet Captions 和 MSR-VTT 上的实验表明，PEEK 在低帧预算下优于现有方法，尤其在 1-2 帧时取得最佳 CIDEr，且仅增加 5.2% 的描述时间，而对比方法增加 65%-212%。
Motivation: 现有视频描述管道多采用均匀采样，忽略了视觉内容的重要性；自适应采样方法虽有潜力但计算开销大。
Method: PEEK 通过知识蒸馏，从字幕条件化的帧相关性排序教师模型学习，得到一个仅基于视觉内容的轻量级时序模型，用于动态选择关键帧。
Result: 在 ActivityNet Captions 上，PEEK 在 16 个配置中赢得 14 个；在 MSR-VTT 上，低帧预算下迁移效果最佳。相比 CSTA 和 MaxInfo，PEEK 仅增加 5.2% 的描述时间，而后者分别增加 65.4% 和 211.9%。
Conclusion: PEEK 在低帧预算下兼顾准确率和效率，适合资源受限的视频描述场景；但帧数增加后时空覆盖和视觉多样性成为竞争因素，表现较混合。

papers.title: Multi-Scale Separable Fourier Neural Networks for Solving High-Frequency PDEs
papers.abstract_en: We propose a novel neural network architecture, termed Multi-Scale Separable Fourier Neural Networks (MS-SFNN), for the accurate and efficient solution of linear and nonlinear high-frequency partial differential equations (PDEs). MS-SFNN exploits a separable representation: given a $d$-dimensional input, it employs $d$ independent subnetworks -- each acting on a single coordinate -- and constructs basis functions via element-wise multiplication of their outputs. The PDE solution is approximated as a linear combination of these basis functions, with coefficients determined by least squares. Critically, all network weights and biases are randomly initialized once, from a uniform distribution with unit variance, and remain fixed thereafter. To enhance expressivity, a tunable scaling factor is introduced in each subnetwork to modulate the frequency content of the resulting basis functions. Fourier features are explicitly embedded through cosine activations, endowing the method with strong spectral approximation capabilities. To mitigate the memory bottleneck associated with dense collocation in high-frequency or three-dimensional problems, we replace automatic differentiation with analytically derived basis function derivatives and develop a memory-efficient batched QR decomposition algorithm for solving large-scale least-squares systems. Numerical experiments demonstrate that MS-SFNN achieves unprecedented accuracy across a range of challenging PDEs, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art methods such as Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINN) and Separated-Variable Spectral Neural Networks (SV-SNN).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多尺度可分离傅里叶神经网络（MS-SFNN），用于高效求解线性和非线性高频率偏微分方程（PDE）。该方法利用d个独立子网络分别处理每个坐标，通过元素乘法构造基函数，并使用最小二乘线性组合逼近解。所有网络权重随机初始化后固定，通过余弦激活引入傅里叶特征，并通过可调缩放因子调节频率。为缓解高维问题中的内存瓶颈，采用解析导数和批处理QR分解算法。数值实验表明，MS-SFNN在多个高频率PDE上显著优于PINN和SV-SNN等方法。
Motivation: 高频率PDE数值求解面临精度和效率挑战，现有神经网络方法（如PINN）在处理高频或三维问题时存在精度不足和内存瓶颈。
Method: 提出MS-SFNN架构：对d维输入使用d个独立子网络，每网络对单个坐标作用，输出通过元素乘构造可分离基函数；使用余弦激活嵌入傅里叶特征，子网络引入可调缩放因子控制频率；权重均匀随机初始化后固定，系数通过最小二乘求解；自动微分替换为解析导数，并设计内存高效的批处理QR分解。
Result: 摘要报告MS-SFNN在多个高频率PDE上取得前所未有的精度，显著优于PINN和SV-SNN等现有方法。
Conclusion: MS-SFNN通过可分离表示和固定随机权重，结合解析导数和批处理QR分解，实现了高频率PDE的高效高精度求解。

papers.title: HADT: A Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Differential Transformer for Autonomous Earth Observation Satellite Cluster
papers.abstract_en: This work addresses the problem of autonomous resource management in heterogeneous satellite cluster conducting Earth Observation (EO) missions including optical and Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) satellites. In autonomous operation mode, satellites are equipped with intelligent capabilities enabling real-time decision-making based on the latest conditions, while requiring minimal interaction with ground operators. Traditional scheduling approaches typically rely on mathematical models to represent satellite mission and resource management. Then, this problem is solved by using optimization algorithms. However, such solutions become less effective when the underlying models are not available, over complex, and inaccurate due to dynamic changes and uncertainties inherent in the space mission environment. A promising alternative is to reformulate the problem as a sequential decision-making process and apply model-free reinforcement learning techniques to enable adaptive and real-time resource management. To this end, we propose a novel transformer-based architecture tailored for heterogeneous satellite cluster autonomous EO Mission with relational observations-actions tokenization and differential attention mechanism. Our experimental results demonstrate significant performance improvements compared to the available baselines. Moreover, the proposed architecture exhibits strong adaptability and transferability with respect to varying numbers of satellite clusters.

Conclusion: 该架构为异构卫星集群自主资源管理提供了一种有效且可扩展的解决方案，但摘要未提及具体数据集、指标数值或实际部署验证。
