papers.title: Augmented Lagrangian Predictive Coding
papers.abstract_en: Predictive coding (PC) is a local-learning alternative to backpropagation (BP), training deep networks via local energy-minimization dynamics rather than a global backward pass. We introduce Augmented Lagrangian Predictive Coding (PC-ALM), which maintains PC's inference budget but aligns each weight update toward BP by accumulating per-layer constraint errors into a layer-local Lagrange multiplier. In linear PC networks, PC-ALM converges to an equilibrium with exact BP gradients distributed across the network via only layer-local updates. We analyze PC-ALM in nonlinear PC networks up to depth 128 and show that it matches BP performance across all width-depth regimes, notably in deep narrow networks where PC underperforms. PC-ALM introduces recurrent dynamics in each layer's activations. Compared to PC's heat flow on a scalar energy, PC-ALM dynamics are driven by dual ascent on the augmented Lagrangian. We observe "ballistic" credit propagation across very deep networks, with credit signals evenly distributed across layers, compared to PC's slow, diffusive credit propagation. Beyond the algorithm itself, the augmented Lagrangian framework offers a generalization of PC, and may yield insights into how distributed systems could compute and propagate BP-like credit signals through purely local dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出增广拉格朗日预测编码（PC-ALM），一种局部学习的反向传播替代方案，通过每层局部拉格朗日乘子累积约束误差，使权重更新对齐BP。在深度达128的非线性网络中，PC-ALM在所有宽度-深度设置下匹配BP性能，尤其改善了深度窄网络中的表现。PC-ALM引入类似对偶上升的动力学，实现“弹道”式信用传播。
Motivation: 预测编码（PC）作为反向传播的局部学习替代，在深度窄网络中性能不如BP，且信用传播缓慢扩散。本文旨在弥合PC与BP之间的性能差距。
Method: 提出PC-ALM，维持PC的推理预算，但通过每层局部拉格朗日乘子累积约束误差，使权重更新朝向BP。在非线性网络中，动力学由增广拉格朗日的对偶上升驱动。
Result: 在深度达128的非线性PC网络中，PC-ALM在所有宽度-深度设置下匹配BP性能，尤其在PC表现不佳的深度窄网络中。实现了“弹道”式信用传播，信号均匀分布。
Conclusion: 增广拉格朗日框架提供了PC的推广，可能为分布式系统通过纯局部动力学计算和传播BP类信用信号提供见解。

papers.title: A Persona-Based Evaluation Framework for Pluralistic Alignment in Generative AI
papers.abstract_en: Current alignment paradigms for generative artificial intelligence rely predominantly on monolithic benchmarking frameworks that reduce the plurality of human judgment to aggregated statistical baselines, thereby obscuring cultural, demographic, and contextual variability in evaluation. We introduce a state-space constrained emulation framework for AI evaluation that replaces singular assessment functions with a structured manifold of synthetic cognitive profiles representing diverse human perspectives. We show that modern generative architectures can instantiate and maintain these evaluative personas with high consistency, enabling a form of pluralistic, perspective-dependent benchmarking that more closely reflects real-world consensus variability. However, we further analyze the stability of these simulated evaluators under sequential inference and stochastic prompt perturbations, revealing systematic degradation in persona coherence that manifests as state-space drift and semantic inconsistency. These findings suggest that static alignment constraints are insufficient for sustaining robust evaluative behavior over time. Instead, we argue for the necessity of embedding dynamic, viability-driven regulatory mechanisms within generative systems to preserve coherent cognitive emulation. By framing persona-based evaluation as a structured dynamical system over latent representation manifolds, this study provides a foundation for more adaptive, human-aligned, and context-sensitive approaches to AI evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于人格（persona）的生成式AI评估框架，通过构建合成认知轮廓（synthetic cognitive profiles）来模拟不同人类视角，替代传统的单一评估函数。实验表明，生成架构能高一致性维持评估人格，但存在状态空间漂移和语义不一致的问题，需嵌入动态调节机制。
Motivation: 当前对齐评估依赖单一基准，掩盖了文化、人口和背景差异，无法反映人类判断的多元性。
Method: 提出状态空间约束仿真框架，用一组合成认知轮廓（评估人格）替代单一评估函数，并通过生成架构实例化与维护这些人格。
Result: 生成架构可高一致性维持评估人格，但顺序推理和随机提示扰动导致人格一致性系统性退化（状态空间漂移和语义不一致）。
Conclusion: 静态对齐约束不足以维持稳定的评估行为，需在生成系统中嵌入动态、生存力驱动的调节机制。

papers.title: An Efficient and Scalable Graph Condensation with Structure-Preserving
papers.abstract_en: Graph condensation (GC) is pivotal for enabling Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) deployment in resource-constrained scenarios by compressing large-scale graphs into compact synthetic counterparts. Existing GC methods commonly suffer from computational inefficiency due to coupled optimization as well as encountering poor generalization across GNN architectures. To address these challenges, this study proposes an Efficient and Scalable Graph Condensation with Structure-Preserving (SP-ESGC), which possesses a decoupled design that separates node condensation from graph structure generation. Specifically, it first employs heat kernel feature propagation to generate node representation via spectral graph theory-inspired diffusion. Further, a novel hybrid clustering strategy is designed to extracts discriminative intra-class centroids from the node representation. Finally, a pre-trained edge predictor infers transferable structural patterns from the original graph, ensuring accurate synthetic graph generation. Extensive experiments on real-world graph datasets demonstrate that the proposed SP-ESGC implementes a precise GC with significantly high computational efficiency. Moreover, SP-ESGC also generalizes well across diverse GNN architectures.

TL;DR: 本文提出一种高效且可扩展的图浓缩方法 SP-ESGC，采用解耦设计将节点浓缩与图结构生成分离。先通过热核特征传播和混合聚类策略提取节点表示，再用预训练边预测器生成可迁移的图结构。实验表明该方法在实现精确图浓缩的同时显著提升计算效率，并在多种 GNN 架构上表现良好。
Motivation: 现有图浓缩方法因耦合优化导致计算效率低下，且在不同 GNN 架构间泛化能力差。
Method: 提出 SP-ESGC：1) 基于谱图理论的热核特征传播生成节点表示；2) 设计混合聚类策略提取判别性类内质心；3) 利用预训练边预测器从原图推断可迁移结构模式，生成合成图。
Result: 在真实图数据集上，SP-ESGC 实现了精确的图浓缩，同时计算效率大幅提升，且跨不同 GNN 架构泛化良好。
Conclusion: 该方法通过解耦设计兼顾了效率和泛化性，但未在摘要中明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: SDM-Q: Cost-Aware Staged Decision-Making for Multi-Omics Classification with Deep Q-Learning
papers.abstract_en: Multi-omics data provide complementary molecular characterizations of disease phenotypes and play an important role in disease diagnosis and subtype classification in precision medicine. However, acquiring complete multi-omics profiles is expensive and time-consuming, while most existing deep learning methods assume full modality availability during inference, resulting in substantial redundancy and limited practicality in clinical settings. To address this issue, we propose SDM-Q, a reinforcement learning framework for adaptive and cost-aware multi-omics classification. Specifically, multi-omics diagnosis is reformulated as a finite-horizon sequential decision problem, where the currently acquired omics modalities define the diagnostic state at each stage. An action--value function determines whether to acquire an additional modality or terminate the decision process and output the final prediction. To balance diagnostic utility and acquisition cost, the reward is defined only at the terminal stage and jointly determined by classification correctness and cumulative modality acquisition cost. A backward stage-wise optimization strategy is introduced to improve policy consistency and training stability. Experiments on four public multi-omics datasets, including ROSMAP, LGG, BRCA, and KIPAN, demonstrate that SDM-Q effectively reduces redundant modality acquisition while maintaining competitive classification performance compared with methods using complete multi-omics inputs. In the BRCA and KIPAN datasets, more than 99\% and 95\% of subjects, respectively, achieve accurate classification using only a single omics modality, while the average number of acquired modalities remains below two for ROSMAP and LGG. These results suggest that cost-aware sequential decision-making provides an effective paradigm for improving the efficiency of precision medicine workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SDM-Q，一个基于深度Q学习的强化学习框架，用于自适应、成本感知的多组学分类。它将多组学诊断重新表述为有限时域序贯决策问题，通过动作值函数决定是否获取额外模态或终止决策并输出预测，在终端阶段根据分类正确性和模态获取成本定义奖励。在四个公开数据集上，该方法在减少冗余模态获取的同时保持了竞争性分类性能，部分数据集上超过99%的受试者仅用单模态即实现准确分类。
Motivation: 多组学数据获取昂贵耗时，现有深度学习方法在推理时假设全模态可用，导致冗余和临床实用性受限。
Method: 将多组学诊断建模为有限时域序贯决策问题，使用深度Q学习中的动作值函数决定获取下一模态或终止；定义终端奖励平衡分类正确性和累积成本；引入后向阶段优化策略提升策略一致性和训练稳定性。
Result: 在ROSMAP、LGG、BRCA、KIPAN四个数据集上，SDM-Q减少冗余模态获取，分类性能与使用完整多组学输入的方法相当。BRCA和KIPAN中超过99%和95%的受试者仅用单模态即准确分类，ROSMAP和LGG平均获取模态数低于两个。
Conclusion: 成本感知的序贯决策为提升精准医疗工作流程效率提供了有效范式。

papers.title: Physics-Informed Coarsening for Multigrid Graph Neural Surrogates
papers.abstract_en: Learning-based surrogates for partial differential equations have recently matched the accuracy of classical solvers while achieving orders-of-magnitude speedups, predominantly in fluid settings and structured geometries. In contrast, robust surrogates for deformable solids remain underexplored, despite the presence of nonlinear elasticity, plasticity, and transient behavior that challenge standard architectures. We introduce a multigrid graph neural network for solid mechanics that couples an encoder-processor-decoder backbone with a physics-informed coarsening strategy. Instead of downsampling via geometric heuristics, our method scores nodes using a residual-based measure of local physical activity and preferentially retains regions of high strain or stress concentration, allocating multiscale capacity where it is most needed. This preserves long-range interactions through hierarchical message passing while improving stability over long rollouts. We evaluate on multiple datasets covering linear, nonlinear, and transient regimes, and observe consistent gains in accuracy and rollout stability compared to standard sampling baselines. Our results highlight the importance of physics-informed coarsening for scalable surrogate modeling in solid mechanics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种物理信息粗化策略的多重网格图神经网络，用于固体力学中的可变形固体代理建模。该方法通过基于残差的局部物理活动评分对节点进行下采样，优先保留高应变或应力集中区域，并通过分层消息传递保留长程交互。在多个线性、非线性和瞬态固体力学数据集上，相比于标准采样基线，该方法在准确性和长期rollout稳定性上取得一致提升。
Motivation: 现有基于学习的偏微分方程代理在流体和结构化几何中表现良好，但针对可变形固体（涉及非线性弹性、塑性和瞬态行为）的鲁棒代理仍未被充分探索，标准架构难以处理这些挑战。
Method: 提出编码器-处理器-解码器主干的图神经网络，融合多重网格结构。粗化阶段不采用几何启发式，而是使用基于残差的局部物理活动度量对节点评分，优先保留高应力/应变区域，从而分配多尺度容量到关键区域。通过分层消息传递实现长程交互并提升长期稳定性。
Result: 在覆盖线性、非线性和瞬态固体力学行为的多个数据集上，该方法相比标准采样基线在准确性和rollout稳定性上获得一致提升。
Conclusion: 物理信息粗化对于固体力学中可扩展的代理建模至关重要，能够有效分配计算资源到关键物理区域并改善长期预测稳定性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: amerta: A Python Library for Idealized 1D Saint--Venant Dam-Break Simulation
papers.abstract_en: The Saint-Venant shallow water equations (SWE) govern depth-integrated free-surface flows arising in dam-break inundation, flood routing, tsunami runup, and estuarine tidal dynamics. Closed-form analytical solutions exist only for highly idealized Riemann configurations, making rigorously verified numerical solvers essential. This work presents amerta, an open-source Python library that solves the one-dimensional frictionless Saint-Venant system on a uniform Cartesian grid using Monotone Upstream-centered Schemes for Conservation Laws (MUSCL) reconstruction with a minmod slope limiter, the Harten-Lax-van Leer-Contact (HLLC) approximate Riemann solver, and two-stage strong-stability-preserving Runge-Kutta (SSP-RK) time integration. Numba just-in-time (JIT) compilation accelerates the performance-critical kernels. The solver is verified end-to-end against the four canonical Riemann configurations: wet-bed dam break, dry-bed dam break, double rarefaction, and double shock. A six-component post-processing pipeline quantifies space-time topology, final-time error norms with empirical quantile decomposition, self-similarity collapse onto the analytical Riemann fan, integral-norm evolution, boundary-flux-corrected mass and energy diagnostics, and phase-plane analysis against analytical wave curves. The implementation conserves discrete mass to floating-point precision, satisfies discrete entropy admissibility identically, and reproduces all four analytical wave-curve geometries to within sub-centimetre accuracy in the depth-velocity phase plane. The complete source code, analytical-solution evaluators, post-processing scripts, and Network Common Data Format (NetCDF) archives are released under the MIT license.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: amerta 是一个开源 Python 库，用于一维无摩擦 Saint-Venant 浅水方程的数值求解。该库采用 MUSCL 重构、minmod 斜率限制器、HLLC 近似黎曼求解器和 SSP-RK 时间积分，并通过 Numba JIT 加速。在四个经典黎曼配置（湿床坝堤溃决、干床坝堤溃决、双稀疏波、双激波）上进行了端到端验证，结果表明质量守恒达到浮点精度，熵容许性满足，波曲线几何精度在亚厘米级。
Motivation: Saint-Venant 方程的解析解仅存在于高度理想化的黎曼问题，因此需要经过严格验证的数值求解器用于洪水模拟等应用。
Method: 开发了 amerta 库，基于 MUSCL-HLLC 格式和 SSP-RK 时间积分，利用 Numba JIT 加速计算核心。
Result: 在四个经典黎曼配置上验证，离散质量守恒达到浮点精度，熵容许性恒等满足，深度-速度相平面中的波曲线几何精度优于亚厘米级。
Conclusion: 该库为水力学模拟提供了经过严格验证的开源工具，可复现分析解，适用于教学和研究。

papers.title: DEM: A Distilled Explanation Model for Interpretable Anomaly Detection in Physiological Sensor Networks
papers.abstract_en: Anomaly detection in physiological sensor data from Wireless Body Area Networks (WBANs) can be caused by sensor faults, network disruptions, or missing data, leading to false alarms. Hence, it demands both high predictive accuracy and clinically interpretable explanations. Existing approaches rely either on black-box models that achieve strong performance but offer no transparency, or on post-prediction explanation methods such as SHAP and LIME. In this paper, we propose the Distilled Explanation Model (DEM), a three-stage glass-box framework that distills the non-linear knowledge of a gradient boosting expert into an interpretable decision tree operating on residuals relative to a linear baseline, so that the explanation is not an approximation but the prediction itself. DEM introduces a novel distillation fidelity metric that quantifies how faithfully the explanation tree captures the expert model's non-linear contribution, providing a principled measure of explanation trustworthiness absent from prior interpretable models. Evaluated across four physiological datasets, including MIMIC-IV, WESAD, eICU, and an in-house SmartNet WBAN corpus, DEM achieves an AUC of 0.9964 on clinical contextual anomaly detection and 0.9047 on wearable stress detection while producing human-readable if-then rules at a controllable depth. Inference requires 0.17ms per 1000 samples, rendering DEM 1235x faster than SHAP-based post-hoc explanation and suitable for real-time physiological monitoring. Ablation studies confirm that the XGBoost distillation step provides measurable gains over naive residual fitting, and depth-sensitivity analysis demonstrates an explicit, user-controlled accuracy-interpretability trade-off unique to DEM among existing intrinsically interpretable models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出蒸馏解释模型（DEM），一种三阶段玻璃盒框架，将梯度提升专家（XGBoost）的非线性知识蒸馏到基于线性基线残差的可解释决策树中，使解释本身即为预测。在MIMIC-IV、WESAD、eICU和自建SmartNet WBAN四个生理数据集上，DEM在临床上下文异常检测上达到AUC 0.9964，可穿戴压力检测上达到0.9047，推理速度比SHAP快1235倍，并支持用户可控的精度-可解释性权衡。
Motivation: 生理传感器网络中的异常检测需要高预测准确性与临床可解释的解释，但现有黑盒模型缺乏透明度，而事后解释方法（如SHAP、LIME）只是近似。需要一种既能提供内在可解释性又不牺牲性能的方法。
Method: DEM采用三阶段：1）训练梯度提升（XGBoost）专家模型；2）构建线性基线模型；3）将专家模型的残差（非线性部分）蒸馏为有限深度的可解释决策树。引入蒸馏保真度指标量化解释树捕捉专家非线性贡献的程度。
Result: 在四个生理数据集上，DEM在临床上下文异常检测上AUC为0.9964，可穿戴应力检测上AUC为0.9047；推理仅需0.17ms/1000样本，比SHAP快1235倍；消融实验证实蒸馏步骤优于朴素残差拟合，深度敏感性分析展示了显式的精度-可解释性权衡。
Conclusion: DEM为生理传感器网络中的异常检测提供了既准确又可解释的解决方案，具有实时推理能力和量化的解释保真度，但框架可能对其他领域需要同样权衡的任务有借鉴意义。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Learning Multi-Agent Coordination via Sheaf-ADMM
papers.abstract_en: We present a differentiable optimization framework for multi-agent coordination. An input is decomposed into overlapping local views, each processed by an agent that solves a convex subproblem parameterized by a neural encoder. Agents coordinate through the Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) with inter-agent constraints specified by a cellular sheaf. The sheaf specifies which aspects of neighboring solutions must agree, allowing for heterogeneous notions of global consensus. Backpropagating through the unrolled optimization jointly trains all components of the multi-agent system. We evaluate on maze pathfinding, image classification, and Sudoku, where agents with individually insufficient local views learn to coordinate to produce correct global outputs. On MNIST, the local-view decomposition yields improved robustness to distribution shifts relative to a standard CNN. On Sudoku, the optimization-derived structure yields markedly higher solve rates than parameter-matched MPNN baselines. Finally, the ADMM structure exposes distinct primal, consensus, and dual state variables, opening the coordination dynamics to direct analysis and intervention -- a property unavailable in standard message-passing architectures.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 8 figures, 6 tables. Accepted at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个可微优化框架用于多智能体协调，将输入分解为重叠的局部视图，每个智能体处理一个由神经编码器参数化的凸子问题。智能体通过交替方向乘子法（ADMM）进行协调，并由细胞层（cellular sheaf）指定智能体间约束，支持异构全局共识。通过反向传播展开的优化过程联合训练整个系统。在迷宫路径规划、MNIST图像分类和数独任务上评估，结果显示局部视图分解提高了对分布偏移的鲁棒性（MNIST），优化结构相比参数匹配的MPNN基线显著提高了数独求解率。ADMM结构暴露了原始、共识和对偶状态变量，便于直接分析和干预。
Motivation: 现有消息传递架构在多智能体协调中缺乏可解释性和干预能力，且难以处理异构全局共识。
Method: 使用ADMM与细胞层约束，每个智能体求解神经编码器参数化的凸子问题，通过展开优化反向传播端到端训练。
Result: 在MNIST上，局部视图分解相比标准CNN提高了对分布偏移的鲁棒性；在数独上，优化结构比参数匹配的MPNN基线显著提高了解答率；在迷宫路径规划上验证了协调能力。
Conclusion: ADMM结构提供了可分析的协调动力学状态变量，且优于标准消息传递方法，但未提及大规模或动态环境下的扩展性。

papers.title: Iterative Framework For Data Augmentation Of Segmented Fingerprints
papers.abstract_en: Infant biometrics presents unique challenges due to the physiological differences between infants and adults, compounded by the scarcity of available data for research that limits the development of robust matching systems. This paper proposes a novel data augmentation method that uses iterative techniques to generate diverse variants of segmented fingerprints by inducing errors in a convolutional neural network trained to extract fingerprint ridges and valleys. Experiments on real infant fingerprints demonstrate the method's effectiveness in expanding fingerprint variability, with augmentations exhibiting significant fluctuations in minutiae counts while still retaining visual similarity to the originals. The study also highlights the method's customizable nature for applying varying levels of changes to fingerprint segmentations. Future research includes training segmentation and matching neural networks using datasets augmented by the proposed framework.
papers.journal_ref: Anais do XV Workshop de Sistemas de Informação 2024
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于迭代技术的数据增强方法，用于分割后的婴儿指纹图像。该方法通过在训练用于提取指纹脊线和谷线的卷积神经网络中引入误差，生成多样化的增强变体。在真实婴儿指纹上的实验表明，增强图像在细节点数上表现出显著波动，但仍保持与原始图像的视觉相似性。
Motivation: 婴儿生物识别因生理差异和数据稀缺性而面临挑战，限制了鲁棒匹配系统的开发，现有数据增强方法不足以解决此问题。
Method: 提出一种迭代数据增强框架，对分割后的指纹图像，通过向训练好的提取脊线和谷线的卷积神经网络中引入误差，生成多样性变体。
Result: 在真实婴儿指纹数据集上的实验证明，该方法能有效扩展指纹变异性，增强图像的细节点数波动显著，但仍保持视觉相似性。
Conclusion: 该方法具有可定制性，可控制变化程度；未来工作将利用所提框架增强的数据集训练分割和匹配神经网络。

papers.title: HetCCL: Enabling Collective Communication For Mixed-Vendor Heterogeneous Clusters
papers.abstract_en: Training Large Language Models (LLMs) on heterogeneous clusters presents significant challenges for collective communication, as hardware from multiple vendors introduces diverse network and computational characteristics. Existing collective communication frameworks (e.g., NCCL, RCCL) designed for homogeneous environments fail to address mixed-hardware setups, while communication libraries with heterogeneous support (e.g., Gloo, OpenMPI) incur heavy overhead in the data path. This paper presents HetCCL, a framework that enables heterogeneous collective communication by efficient P2P transport across heterogeneous devices (e.g., GPUs), eliminating the host-device memory copy overhead while offloading the control to the CPUs. For combining collectives (e.g., AllReduce, ReduceScatter), HetCCL introduces a border-communicator mechanism that achieves vendor independence by using the intrinsic reduction in the combining collectives in vendor collective communication libraries. With efficient heterogeneous P2P transport and portable reduction mechanism, HetCCL proposes a hierarchical topology abstraction for heterogeneous clusters, dissecting collective communication into cluster-level primitives that guarantee optimal cross-cluster data transfer volume and optimal bandwidth utilization. We implement HetCCL with 4 different vendor support and evaluate it in 4 heterogeneous settings with benchmarks and end-to-end LLM tasks. Our evaluation shows that HetCCL achieves 17-19x higher bandwidth than Gloo in heterogeneous communications, and speeds up end-to-end training by up to 16.9% in the per-step-time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HetCCL，一个用于混合厂商异构集群的高效集体通信框架，通过消除主机-设备内存拷贝开销并利用边界通信器机制实现供应商无关的规约操作，并基于层次拓扑抽象实现最优跨集群数据传输。实验显示在异构通信中带宽比 Gloo 高 17-19 倍，端到端训练速度提升最多 16.9%。
Motivation: 现有集体通信库（如 NCCL、RCCL）仅适用于同构环境，而支持异构的库（如 Gloo、OpenMPI）在数据路径上有严重开销，无法高效应对多厂商硬件混合的集群。
Method: 提出 HetCCL 框架，包含高效异构点对点传输（消除主机-设备内存拷贝，控制卸载到 CPU），边界通信器机制（利用厂商库的内置规约实现供应商无关），以及层次拓扑抽象（将集体通信分解为集群级原语，保证最优跨集群数据传输量和带宽利用率）。
Result: 在4种异构设置下，HetCCL 在异构通信中比 Gloo 带宽高 17-19 倍，端到端 LLM 训练每步时间加速最多 16.9%。
Conclusion: HetCCL 通过高效的异构点对点传输和供应商无关的规约机制，显著提升混合厂商异构集群上的集体通信性能，支持多种厂商设备。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hedging on the Frontier: Learning New Tasks with Few Samples
papers.abstract_en: When a learner faces a new task with few samples, it must leverage any available side information. In practice, this often comes in the form of model evaluations on related tasks in public benchmarks. A key question then is how to model task relatedness such that it is both realistic and the benchmark evaluations lead to provable gains. Empirically, we observe that weak monotonicity is often approximately satisfied: if a model dominates another on many benchmarks, it also tends to outperform on the new task. We explore the statistical complexity of learning under (approximate) weak monotonicity, leveraging it within two learning paradigms: transfer learning and model selection aggregation. We show that not only can we prune the model class based on monotonicity, but we can also further adapt to the geometry of the available trade-offs by hedging on the frontier.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究小样本新任务学习中的任务关联性建模，提出利用弱单调性假设（weak monotonicity）降低统计复杂度。基于该性质，在迁移学习和模型选择聚合中剪枝模型类，并通过“前沿对冲”（hedging on the frontier）适应可用权衡的几何结构。
Motivation: 小样本学习需利用基准模型评估等辅助信息，但如何建模任务相关性以实现可证明的提升是关键。实证观察到弱单调性近似成立，但缺乏理论指导。
Method: 在（近似）弱单调性假设下，提出两种学习范式：基于单调性剪枝模型类；以及对前沿进行对冲以适应可用权衡的几何结构。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，主要从理论上分析弱单调性下的统计复杂性。
Conclusion: 弱单调性不仅允许剪枝模型类，还能通过前沿对冲进一步适应可用权衡的几何结构。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Eigenvectors of Experts are Training-free Non-collapsing Routers
papers.abstract_en: Sparse Mixture of Experts (SMoE) architectures improve the training efficiency of Large Language Models (LLMs) by routing input tokens to a selected subset of specialized experts. Despite their remarkable success, both training and inference in SMoE models suffer from the expert collapse issue (Chi et al., 2022), which degrades model performance. Prior studies primarily focus on improving the router; however, such methods rely on training from scratch or fine-tuning, which requires high computational and data-processing costs. Furthermore, we demonstrate that, despite these efforts, the issue persists when advancing well-pretrained SMoE models, as evidenced by both theoretical and empirical results. To fill that gap, we analyze the advanced SMoE models and observe that the eigenvectors of expert weight matrices encode rich semantic information, pointing to an effective alternative to conventional routing strategies. Building on this insight, we propose Singular Value Decomposition SMoE (SSMoE), a novel and training-free framework that leverages spectral properties of the expert weights to address the collapse issue and enhance model performance. Extensive experiments across diverse language and vision tasks, under both clean and corrupt data settings, demonstrate the strong generalization and robustness of SSMoE. Our findings highlight how a deeper understanding of model internals can guide the development of more effective SMoE architectures. Our implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/giangdip2410/SSMoE.
papers.journal_ref: ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SSMoE，一种无需训练的稀疏专家混合（SMoE）路由器方法，通过利用专家权重矩阵的特征向量来解决专家崩溃问题。实验表明在语言和视觉任务上具有良好泛化性和鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有SMoE模型在训练和推理中普遍存在专家崩溃问题，而改进路由器的先前方法依赖从头训练或微调，计算成本高，且无法彻底解决预训练模型中的崩溃。
Method: 提出奇异值分解SMoE（SSMoE）框架，利用专家权重矩阵的谱特性（特征向量）作为路由依据，无需额外训练即可缓解专家崩溃。
Result: 在多种语言和视觉任务（含干净与损坏数据）上，SSMoE展示了强泛化性和鲁棒性，验证了其有效性。
Conclusion: 对模型内部结构的深入理解可指导更有效的SMoE架构设计，SSMoE提供了一种训练免费、可即插即用的路由替代方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Parallel Tempering Initial Sampling in Inference-Time Reward Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Inference-time reward alignment steers pretrained diffusion and flow-based generative models to satisfy user-specified rewards without retraining. Recently, Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) has emerged as a powerful framework for this task by iteratively filtering and propagating multiple particles. However, we show that standard SMC-based methods often suffer from poor performance because they initialize particles from a standard prior, whereas high-reward regions in complex reward landscapes are extremely rare. Further, we show that even recent reward-aware initial sampling approaches remain vulnerable to getting trapped in local modes, as complex reward landscapes are often multi-modal. To overcome these limitations, we propose PATHS (PArallel Tempering for High-complexity reward Sampling), a novel initialization method that couples multiple sampling chains through parallel tempering. PATHS maintains a ladder of reward-tempered chains and periodically performs Metropolis swaps, enabling efficient exploration across flattened reward landscapes, thereby mitigating the mode-trapping issues. Our analysis reveals that this mechanism substantially enhances the finite-budget exploration of rare, high-reward regions that are typically challenging to sample. Experiments on layout-to-image and quantity-aware generation show that PATHS achieves consistent gains in alignment quality, particularly on complex prompts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PATHS (Parallel Tempering for High-complexity reward Sampling) 方法，通过并行回火 (parallel tempering) 耦合多条采样链，解决推理时奖励对齐中标准 SMC 方法因初始化于标准先验而易陷入局部模式的问题。实验表明该方法在布局到图像和数量感知生成任务上一致提升对齐质量。
Motivation: 现有推理时奖励对齐方法依赖标准先验初始化粒子，在复杂多模态奖励景观中难以探索高奖励区域，且易陷入局部模式。
Method: 提出 PATHS，维护一组经奖励温度退火的链，通过定期 Metropolis 交换实现跨链高效探索，从而缓解模式陷阱。
Result: 在布局到图像和数量感知生成任务上，PATHS 相较标准 SMC 方法取得一致的对齐质量提升，尤其对复杂提示效果显著。
Conclusion: 并行回火初始化能有效提升有限预算下对罕见高奖励区域的探索效率，为推理时奖励对齐提供新的初始化范式。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Benchmarking Single-Step Inpainting Methods for Multi-Object 3D Gaussian Splatting Scenes
papers.abstract_en: The tasks of object removal and inpainting 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scenes face challenges such as 3D consistency across camera views. In comparing 2D inpainters and their suitability for the 3D domain, we find that reconstruction-based inpainters outperform generative diffusion models in 3D consistency. Integrating these 2D inpainters into different single-step methods for creating and finetuning 3DGS scenes, our results indicate that initializing the scene from scratch produces higher quality results than finetuning the existing scene. Using a state-of-the-art generative 2D inpainter, we create a straightforward baseline to underline the importance of object removal before inpainting in the 3D setting. Since 360° datasets rarely include real-world ground truths, and challenging occlusion scenarios are equally sparse, we introduce a novel multi-object scene with recorded ground truth data and many views with object occlusions.
papers.comment: Accepted as an extended abstract to the CVEU Workshop at CVPR 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对3D高斯喷溅（3DGS）场景中的物体移除与修复任务，本文系统比较了多种2D修复器在3D一致性上的表现，发现基于重建的修复器优于生成扩散模型。通过将2D修复器集成到不同的单步方法中（从头初始化场景 vs. 微调现有场景），实验表明从头初始化场景能产生更高质量的结果。此外，作者强调了先移除物体再修复在3D场景中的重要性，并引入了一个包含真实地面真值（ground truth）和多视图遮挡的新多物体场景数据集。
Motivation: 3DGS场景中的物体移除和修复面临跨相机视图的3D一致性挑战，现有方法缺乏系统比较和包含真实地面真值的数据集，特别是针对多物体遮挡的复杂场景。
Method: 比较了基于重建的2D修复器（如LaMa）与生成扩散模型（如Stable Diffusion）在3DGS场景中的表现；将最佳2D修复器集成到两种单步方法中：从头初始化3DGS场景与微调已有场景；引入了一个包含真实地面真值记录、多视图遮挡的新基准数据集。
Result: 基于重建的2D修复器在3D一致性上显著优于生成扩散模型；从头初始化3DGS场景比微调现有场景产生更高质量的修复结果；先执行物体移除再进行修复的流程对3D效果至关重要。
Conclusion: 该研究强调了在3D修复任务中优先使用重建型2D修复器并从头初始化场景的有效性，同时提供了一个新的多物体遮挡数据集，以推动该领域的基准测试发展。

papers.title: Generating Reports or Repeating Templates? Measuring and Mitigating Template Collapse in 3D CT Report Generation
papers.abstract_en: Modern 3D medical vision-language models (VLMs) can generate fluent radiology-style text while exhibit critically low pathology detection and output diversity, collapsing to generic templates that under-report rare yet critical findings. We identify this failure mode as Template Collapse. This failure stems from the unique constraints of 3D medical imaging, e.g., limited data, severe label imbalance, and weak signals from volumetric encoders. Under these constraints, text-generation objectives encourage shortcut learning and fluent but weakly grounded reports. We systematically diagnose the Template Collapse through clinical fidelity, output diversity, normal-template bias, and rare-finding survival. To mitigate it, we propose CLarGen, a decoupled framework that separates what to say (clinical detection) from how to say it (language synthesis). CLarGen uses (i) a Latent Query Transformer for multi-label pathology detection, (ii) pathology-guided retrieval for clinically matched exemplars, and (iii) a medical language model to synthesize the final report from detected findings and retrieved context. Across state-of-the-art 3D CT report generation baselines, CLarGen mitigates Template Collapse and substantially improves clinical accuracy (macro-F1 0.487 vs. 0.189; CRG 0.472 vs. 0.368) while maintaining fluent reporting. Our results suggest that explicit, measurable clinical grounding is essential for template-collapse-resistant 3D CT report generation. Code will be released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文识别了3D医学影像报告生成中的“模板坍塌”问题——模型倾向于生成流畅但缺乏病理检测和多样性的模板化报告。通过分析临床保真度、输出多样性等指标，作者提出解耦框架CLarGen，将临床检测与语言生成分离，利用潜在查询Transformer进行多标签病理检测、病理引导检索和医学语言模型生成报告。在多个3D CT报告生成基线上，CLarGen显著缓解了模板坍塌，提升了临床准确性（macro-F1 0.487 vs. 0.189；CRG 0.472 vs. 0.368）。
Motivation: 现有3D医学视觉语言模型生成的报告虽流畅但病理检测能力低、输出多样性差，尤其漏报罕见关键发现，即“模板坍塌”问题。原因包括数据有限、标签不平衡、体素编码器信号弱等，导致文本生成目标鼓励捷径学习。
Method: 提出CLarGen，一种解耦框架，包含三个组件：(i) 潜在查询Transformer用于多标签病理检测，(ii) 病理引导检索获取临床匹配的示例，(iii) 医学语言模型基于检测结果和检索上下文合成最终报告。
Result: 在多个3D CT报告生成基线中，CLarGen缓解了模板坍塌，显著改善临床准确性：macro-F1从0.189提升至0.487，CRG从0.368提升至0.472，同时保持报告流畅性。
Conclusion: 明确的、可量化的临床接地对于抗模板坍塌的3D CT报告生成至关重要。代码将在录用后公开。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在多个3D CT报告生成基线中，CLarGen缓解了模板坍塌，显著改善临床准确性：macro-F1从0.189提升至0.487，CRG从0.368提升至0.472，同时保持报告流畅性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 明确的、可量化的临床接地对于抗模板坍塌的3D CT报告生成至关重要。代码将在录用后公开。

papers.title: Can BEV Perception Gracefully Degrade under Sensor Failures?
papers.abstract_en: Despite the remarkable success of multi-modal bird's-eye view (BEV) perception in autonomous driving, current systems exhibit a critical vulnerability: existing fusion mechanisms are highly brittle to sensor corruptions, often causing catastrophic performance degradation. This vulnerability largely stems from the fact that standard fusion frameworks typically integrate multi-modal representations in a static manner, leading to a precipitous performance collapse under missing or corrupted modalities. In contrast, we show that graceful degradation is achievable through active modality reliability assessment. To this end, we present Grace-BEV, a lightweight and plug-and-play framework that enforces active reliability awareness during multi-modal fusion. Instead of relying on computationally expensive cross-modal interactions, Grace-BEV leverages the aligned BEV space to explicitly assess modality trustworthiness via a TrustGate Router and dynamically recalibrate feature integration using the FailSafe Fusion Block. Furthermore, we devise a Three-Phase Training strategy with Modality Dropout to prevent modality dominance and encourage balanced cross-modal learning under unreliable inputs. Extensive experiments on nuScenes-R and nuScenes-C show that Grace-BEV maintains robust performance across diverse corruption settings. Notably, under catastrophic LiDAR failures where standard baselines collapse to 0.0% mean Average Precision (mAP), Grace-BEV restores performance to as high as 34.7% mAP. Moreover, it improves clean accuracy by up to 1.4%, achieving a strong trade-off between robustness and efficiency.

papers.title: Cognitive Fatigue in Autoregressive Transformers: Formalization and Measurement
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive language models frequently degrade during long-horizon generation, producing repetitive text, losing instruction adherence, and exhibiting unstable entropy. Despite the prevalence of these failures, practitioners lack online diagnostics to detect them in real-time as they occur. We formalize this degradation as cognitive fatigue, a measurable generation-time state characterized by decay in attention to the original prompt, representational drift, and entropy miscalibration. We introduce the Fatigue Index (FI), a lightweight, model-agnostic diagnostic that aggregates these three signals under explicit axioms (monotonicity, boundedness, interpretability) enabling reliable runtime monitoring. Across nine models (1B-13B parameters), FI trajectories exhibit structured temporal dynamics, predict task degradation (AUROC = 0.95) and repetition (Spearman rho = 0.94), and reveal non-monotonic scaling behavior: instruction-tuned models below 3B exhibit faster collapse than base models, with this trend reversing at 7B. Stress analyses further show that FI onset accelerates under longer contexts, middle-positioned evidence, and reduced numerical precision. These results establish cognitive fatigue as a coherent and measurable phenomenon, and position FI as a principled tool for runtime reliability monitoring in production LLM systems.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 7 figures. Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文形式化了自回归语言模型在长序列生成中的退化现象，定义为“认知疲劳”，并提出Fatigue Index (FI)作为轻量级、模型无关的诊断指标，聚合注意力衰减、表征漂移和熵校准三个信号。在9个模型（1B-13B参数）上，FI轨迹展示了结构化时间动态，能预测任务退化（AUROC=0.95）和重复（Spearman rho=0.94），并揭示非单调的规模行为。应力分析表明，长上下文、中间位置证据和低数值精度会加速疲劳。
Motivation: 自回归语言模型在长序列生成中经常出现退化，如重复文本、指令遵循丢失和熵不稳定，但缺乏在线诊断工具在运行时实时检测这些失败。
Method: 形式化“认知疲劳”作为可测量的生成时状态，并提出Fatigue Index (FI)，一种轻量级、模型无关的诊断，聚合注意力衰减、表征漂移和熵校准三个信号，满足单调性、有界性、可解释性公理，支持运行时监控。
Result: 在9个模型（1B-13B参数）上，FI轨迹预测任务退化（AUROC=0.95）和重复（Spearman rho=0.94）；指令微调模型在3B以下比基础模型退化更快，7B时趋势反转；长上下文、中间位置证据和低数值精度加速疲劳。
Conclusion: 本文建立了认知疲劳作为一个连贯且可测量的现象，FI可作为生产LLM系统中运行时可靠性监控的原理性工具。

papers.title: Batched Stochastic Linear Bandits with 1-Bit Communication Constraints
papers.abstract_en: We study stochastic linear bandits under a natural combination of batching and communication constraints: the time horizon is partitioned into batches of equal size $B$, and during each batch the learner sends $B$ requested arm pulls to an agent, who then observes the corresponding $B$ rewards and responds with a single bit of feedback to the learner. For each batch, the learner specifies the 1-bit quantization rule the agent uses, which may depend on all previously received bits but not on any past rewards directly. This setting addresses a significant yet unexplored ``middle ground'' between previous models having per-round quantization only or total bit budgets only. We establish a minimax lower bound showing that $Ω(B\min\{d,\log\lvert \mathcal{A} \rvert\})$ regret is unavoidable due to the 1-bit communication bottleneck, even in the absence of noise. Combined with standard statistical limits, this yields a general lower bound of $\widetildeΩ(B\min\{d,\log\lvert \mathcal{A} \rvert\} + \sqrt{dT \min\{d,\log\lvert \mathcal{A} \rvert\}})$. We develop two phased-elimination algorithms based on $G$-optimal designs and 1-bit mean estimation. The first achieves $\widetilde{O}(dB + d\sqrt{T})$ regret, matching the lower bound up to logarithmic factors when $\lvert \mathcal{A} \rvert = \exp(Ω(d))$, and the second incorporates a safe-arm identification and warm-start procedure to obtain $\widetilde{O}(B\log\lvert \mathcal{A} \rvert + d^{3/2}\sqrt{B} + \sqrt{dT\log\lvert \mathcal{A} \rvert})$ regret, which is near-optimal in broad scaling regimes of $(\lvert \mathcal{A} \rvert, B, d, T)$. Together, our results demonstrate that a single bit of feedback per batch suffices to nearly match the minimax regret of unconstrained linear bandits in broad scaling regimes, even for batch sizes as large as $Θ(\sqrt{T})$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在批次和通信约束下的随机线性老虎机问题：时间划分为大小为B的批次，每个批次中学习者请求B次臂拉取，智能体反馈1比特。作者给出了最小最大下界，并设计了两种基于G-最优设计和1比特均值估计的相位消除算法，其遗憾界在宽泛尺度下接近无约束线性老虎机的最优遗憾。
Motivation: 现有研究要么只考虑每轮量化，要么只考虑总比特预算，缺乏两者结合的中间地带。本文探索批次大小B与每批次1比特反馈的联合约束，这是实际分布式系统中常见但未充分研究的设置。
Method: 提出了两种相位消除算法：第一种基于G-最优设计和1比特均值估计，达到Õ(dB + d√T)遗憾；第二种加入安全臂识别和热启动过程，得到Õ(B log|A| + d^{3/2}√B + √(dT log|A|))遗憾。
Result: 建立了最小最大下界Ω(B min{d, log|A|})，并表明在宽泛尺度下单比特反馈足以近似匹配无约束线性老虎机的最优遗憾，即使批次大小达Θ(√T)。
Conclusion: 证明了在批次学习框架下，每批次仅需1比特反馈即可在宽泛尺度下接近无约束线性老虎机的性能，揭示了通信约束与统计效率之间的权衡。

papers.title: BiSegMamba: Efficient Bidirectional Tri-Oriented Mamba for 3D Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Accurate 3D medical image segmentation requires both long-range volumetric context and fine boundary preservation. CNN-based methods have limited global dependency modeling, while Transformer-based models are often computationally expensive for dense 3D inputs. Recent Mamba-based methods provide an efficient alternative, but existing volumetric designs still depend on repeated high-resolution scanning, forward-only sequential modeling, and fixed directional summation, causing high cost, scan-order bias, and suboptimal directional aggregation. We propose BiSegMamba, an efficient bidirectional tri-oriented Mamba network for 3D medical image segmentation. BiSegMamba follows a compact-to-detail design, where a progressive compacting stem (PCS) enables efficient latent-space reasoning while retaining shallow high-resolution features for reconstruction. A multi-scale spatial mixer (MSSM) captures local anatomical patterns in early stages, and the proposed bidirectional tri-oriented Ortho Mamba (Bi-ToOM) block models long-range dependencies from multiple orthogonal views using jointly processed forward and backward scan sequences. Adaptive directional fusion (ADF) learns input-dependent channel-wise weights across scan orientations, replacing fixed summation with orientation-aware fusion. Experiments on a collected carotid CTA dataset and three public benchmarks, BraTS2023, ACDC, and AMOS-CT, show that BiSegMamba generalizes well across vascular, cardiac, brain tumor, and abdominal multi-organ segmentation tasks. Compared with SegMamba-V2, BiSegMamba achieves slightly better performance on BraTS2023 and clear improvements on ACDC and the carotid dataset, while reducing computational cost by up to 77.9% FLOPs, demonstrating a strong accuracy-efficiency balance for general 3D medical image segmentation.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables. Code is available at: https://github.com/bakhtzadaabshare/BiSegMamba
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BiSegMamba，一种高效的基于Mamba的双向三方向网络，用于3D医学图像分割。通过渐进压缩茎、多尺度空间混合器、双向三方向Ortho Mamba块和自适应方向融合，在颈动脉CTA、BraTS2023、ACDC和AMOS-CT数据集上取得良好性能，相比SegMamba-V2计算量降低77.9%。
Motivation: 现有CNN方法全局依赖建模有限，Transformer方法计算昂贵，Mamba方法存在重复高分辨率扫描、前向顺序建模和固定方向求和问题。
Method: 提出BiSegMamba，包含渐进压缩茎(PCS)实现高效潜在空间推理，多尺度空间混合器(MSSM)捕获局部解剖模式，双向三方向Ortho Mamba(Bi-ToOM)块处理多正交视图的长程依赖，自适应方向融合(ADF)学习输入依赖的通道权重。
Result: 在BraTS2023上略优于SegMamba-V2，在ACDC和颈动脉数据集上显著提升，计算量降低77.9% FLOPs。
Conclusion: 该方法在多种3D医学图像分割任务上实现了准确性与效率的良好平衡。

papers.title: Omni-Supervised Motion Editing: Balancing Change and Invariance through Positive-Negative Learning
papers.abstract_en: Text-based human motion editing aims to modify existing motion sequences according to natural language instructions while maintaining the consistency of the original motion. Existing diffusion-based approaches often rely on heuristic similarity cues or coarse global conditioning, leading to motion distortion and suboptimal semantic alignment. The key challenge lies in balancing change (i.e. precisely editing target regions) and invariance (i.e. preserving unedited parts). To handle such challenge, we propose an Omni-Supervised Positive-Negative Learning framework, named OmniME. Our method integrates three complementary components: (1) retrospective feature supervision that enforces coarse-to-fine consistency across transformer layers,(2) motion preservation mechanism that focuses on subtle variations according to the source-target similarity, and (3) triplet-based semantic alignment that strengthens text-motion correspondence. Together, these components form a unified supervision paradigm that balances change and invariance. Extensive experiments on the MotionFix and STANCE Adjustment datasets demonstrate that OmniME achieves state-of-the-art performance in editing alignment, validating the effectiveness of our unified learning framework. Our source codes and models have been released at: https://github.com/rocket-ycyer/OmniME.git
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OmniME框架，用于文本驱动的人体运动编辑，通过正负学习平衡编辑区域的改变与未编辑部分的保持。框架包含回顾特征监督、运动保持机制和三元组语义对齐三个组件，在MotionFix和STANCE Adjustment数据集上达到最新最优性能。
Motivation: 现有扩散方法依赖启发式相似性或粗全局条件，导致运动失真和语义对齐不佳，难以平衡目标区域的精确编辑与其余部分的保持。
Method: 提出Omni-supervised Positive-Negative Learning框架，包含：(1) 回顾特征监督，在Transformer层间强制粗到细一致性；(2) 运动保持机制，根据源-目标相似性聚焦细微变化；(3) 三元组语义对齐，增强文本-运动对应。三个组件构成统一监督范式。
Result: 在MotionFix和STANCE Adjustment数据集上，编辑对齐指标达到SOTA，验证了框架有效性。
Conclusion: 三个互补组件共同平衡变化与不变性，形成有效的统一学习范式。

papers.title: Variational Adapter for Cross-modal Similarity Representation
papers.abstract_en: The core of vision-language models lies in measuring cross-modal similarity within a unified representation space. However, most image-text matching or multi-class image classification datasets lack fine-grained cross-modal matching annotations, forcing the continuous similarity space into binary classification boundaries. This compression induces false negative samples and significantly impairs the generalization performance of cross-modal tasks. While prior research has attempted to mitigate this by modeling intra-modal ambiguity, it often overlooks inherent annotation flaws, leading to suboptimal uncertainty allocation. To address these challenges, we propose a Variational Adapter for Cross-modal Similarity Representation (VACSR). This approach reformulates image-text matching with fine-grained semantic scarcity as a variational inference problem. It constructs a latent space for cross-modal similarity and uses regularization techniques to mitigate overfitting to binary annotations. Experiments on image-text retrieval, domain generalization, and base-to-novel generalization demonstrate the proposed method's effectiveness and robust generalization ability.

TL;DR: 本文提出一种变分适配器（VACSR），将图像-文本匹配中因稀疏语义标注导致的二值分类问题重新表述为变分推断问题，通过构建跨模态相似性的潜在空间和正则化技术来缓解对二值标注的过拟合。在图像-文本检索、域泛化和基类到新类泛化任务上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有图像-文本匹配数据集缺乏细粒度跨模态标注，迫使连续相似性空间压缩为二值分类边界，导致假负样本和跨模态任务泛化性能下降。
Method: 提出变分适配器（VACSR），将图像-文本匹配建模为变分推断问题，构造跨模态相似性的潜在空间，并采用正则化技术缓解对二值标注的过拟合。
Result: 在图像-文本检索、域泛化和基类到新类泛化实验中，该方法表现出有效性和鲁棒的泛化能力。
Conclusion: 变分推断框架可以缓解细粒度语义稀缺下的标注缺陷，提升跨模态相似性表示的泛化性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reading Between the Citations: A Typed Claim Network for Scientific Literature
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge graphs over corpora of inter-referencing documents - scholarly papers, legal opinions, policy briefs - encode the topology of reference but not its stance. The standard representation collapses a rich evaluative relation into an untyped edge, losing the very content that supports community-level queries about how one document is received by another. We propose the claim network: a representational pattern in which each cross-document reference is reified as a typed claim, carrying source, target, claim text, and a four-class stance label grounded in the citation-intent literature. We give a construction pipeline applicable to any corpus of scholarly inter-referencing documents and instantiate it on a corpus of 127 papers in 3D point cloud semantic segmentation, producing a network of 8,260 typed claims. Three downstream task families demonstrate what the network enables: retrieval signal augmentation, aggregated-stance summarisation, and topological analytics. Head-to-head evaluation against standard Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) baselines shows that the gain over flat retrieval is the gain from the right intermediate representation rather than the wrong one.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种带类型声称网络（claim network），将文献引用关系转化为携带源、目标、声称文本和四类立场标签的有向边，替代传统的无类型引用边。在127篇3D点云语义分割论文上构建了包含8260个类型声称的网络，并在检索增强、立场总结和拓扑分析三个下游任务上展示其有效性。与标准RAG基线对比，作者认为收益来源于正确的中间表示。
Motivation: 现有知识图谱将引用关系编码为无类型边，丢失了引文的评价性立场，无法支持社区级别的细粒度查询。
Method: 提出类型声称网络表示模式，每条引用被具体化为带四类立场标签的声称，并给出适用于任意学术文献语料的构建流水线。在127篇点云语义分割论文上实例化。
Result: 三个下游任务（检索信号增强、立场总结、拓扑分析）表明该网络优于标准RAG基线。
Conclusion: 作者强调正确的中层表示（带类型声称网络）比扁平检索带来实质提升。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ImmersiveTTS: Environment-Aware Text-to-Speech with Multimodal Diffusion Transformer and Domain-Specific Representation Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Recent advancements in text-guided audio generation have yielded promising results in diverse domains, including sound effects, speech, and music. However, jointly generating speech with environmental audio remains challenging due to the inherent disparities in their acoustic patterns and temporal dynamics. We propose ImmersiveTTS, an environment-aware text-to-speech (TTS) model that generates natural speech seamlessly integrated within environmental contexts by explicitly modeling cross-modal interactions. Our model builds on a multimodal diffusion transformer and fuses transcript-aligned speech latent with text-conditioned environmental context via joint attention. To enhance semantic consistency, we introduce a domain-specific representation alignment objective tailored to environment-aware TTS, leveraging complementary self-supervised representations from speech and audio encoders. Experimental results show that ImmersiveTTS achieves higher naturalness, intelligibility, and audio fidelity than existing approaches across objective metrics and human listening tests.
papers.comment: Accepted to ACL 2026 main conference. Code is available at https://github.com/jjunak-yun/ImmersiveTTS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ImmersiveTTS，一种环境感知的文本到语音模型，通过多模态扩散 Transformer 和域特定表示对齐，联合生成语音和环境音频，提升自然度和可懂度。
Motivation: 现有文本引导音频生成在语音与环境音频联合生成时面临声学模式和时间动态差异的挑战，缺乏显式的跨模态交互建模。
Method: 构建多模态扩散 Transformer，通过联合注意力融合文本对齐的语音潜变量与文本条件化的环境上下文，并引入域特定表示对齐目标，利用语音和音频编码器的互补自监督表示增强语义一致性。
Result: 实验表明，ImmersiveTTS 在客观指标和人类听力测试中均优于现有方法，实现了更高的自然度、可懂度和音频保真度。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过显式跨模态交互和域特定表示对齐，可有效提升环境感知 TTS 的生成质量。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: AMix-2: Establishing Protein as a Native Modality in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We present AMix-2, a protein-text foundation model that establishes protein as a native modality in large language models (LLMs), unifying protein understanding and sequence design within a single foundation model. AMix-2 is built upon two key ideas: (1) a unified protein-text formulation that embeds natural language and protein sequence in a shared token space, enabling one model to perform biological reasoning and conditional design instead of separate downstream task-specialized models; and (2) a block-wise diffusion language modeling backbone that combines causal generation across blocks with bidirectional context and iterative refinement within blocks. This scheme better matches the intrinsic nature of proteins than a strict left-to-right factorization. To evaluate protein foundation models under realistic generalization settings, we further introduce ProteinArena, a comprehensive benchmark with time-aware and homology-aware protocols across various understanding and design tasks, and with baselines covering classical bioinformatics tools, protein-specialized models and LLMs. On ProteinArena, AMix-2 outperforms frontier LLMs and demonstrates competitive performance to task-specific protein models. Controlled experiments further show that the diffusion-based paradigm generally surpasses its autoregressive counterpart, highlighting the advantage of flexible generation order for protein sequences. We release both AMix-2 and ProteinArena to facilitate open research in protein foundation models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AMix-2，一个将蛋白质作为原生模态的大语言模型，通过统一的蛋白质-文本标记空间和块状扩散语言建模骨干，实现蛋白质理解与序列设计的统一。作者同时推出包含时间感知和同源感知协议的ProteinArena基准测试，AMix-2在该基准上优于前沿LLM，并与任务专用蛋白质模型性能相当。
Motivation: 现有大语言模型通常将蛋白质视为次要模态，需要多个下游专用模型分别处理不同任务，缺乏统一框架进行生物推理和条件设计。
Method: 提出统一蛋白质-文本标记空间，将自然语言与蛋白质序列嵌入共享词表；设计块状扩散语言建模骨干，在块间进行因果生成，块内进行双向上下文迭代精炼。
Result: AMix-2在ProteinArena基准上优于前沿LLM，与任务专用蛋白质模型性能相当；扩散范式在可控实验中普遍优于自回归范式。
Conclusion: AMix-2将蛋白质作为原生模态整合进LLM，展示了扩散生成顺序对蛋白质序列的灵活性优势，并提供了标准化评估基准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Revisiting Zeroth-Order Hessian Approximation: A Single-Step Policy Optimization Lens
papers.abstract_en: Accurate Zeroth-Order (ZO) Hessian estimation is a cornerstone of derivative-free methods, essential for tasks such as bilevel optimization, Bayesian inference, and uncertainty quantification. However, obtaining a complete suite of low-variance estimators for the Hessian and its inverse in high-dimensional settings remains a significant challenge. To address this, we propose a unified framework that reinterprets ZO Hessian approximation through the lens of single-step Policy Optimization (PO). This perspective establishes a theoretical equivalence between general ZO Hessian estimators and the Hessian of a smoothed PO objective, unifying distinct classical randomized estimators as specific instances of baseline selection. Building on this foundation, we introduce ZoVH, a comprehensive suite of variance-reduced estimators for the full Hessian matrix, its regularized inverse, and the bias-corrected inverse Hessian-gradient product. ZoVH leverages two key techniques: (1) a unique optimal baseline derived to provably minimize variance, and (2) a query reuse strategy that incorporates historical function queries to enhance sample efficiency without inflating costs. Our rigorous theoretical analysis confirms the unbiasedness of the Hessian estimator, validates the variance optimality of our baseline, provides error bounds for the entire ZoVH suite, and establishes convergence guarantees for the resulting curvature-aware ZO algorithm. Extensive empirical results validate our theoretical findings, demonstrating that ZoVH achieves superior estimation accuracy and convergence performance in real-world applications. Code is available at https://github.com/Qjbtiger/ZoVH
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从单步策略优化（Policy Optimization）的角度重新审视零阶（Zeroth-Order, ZO）Hessian近似，提出了一个统一框架，将经典随机化ZO Hessian估计器视为基线选择的特例。基于此框架，作者开发了ZoVH——一套方差缩减的Hessian矩阵、正则化逆以及偏差校正的逆Hessian-梯度积估计器，通过最优基线方差最小化和历史查询复用提高样本效率。理论和实验证明了估计器的无偏性、方差最优性及收敛保证。
Motivation: 在高维设置下获得完整且低方差的Hessian及其逆估计器是零阶方法的核心挑战，现有方法缺乏统一的理论框架和方差最优的估计方案。
Method: 提出ZoVH框架：通过单步策略优化视角统一ZO Hessian估计器，推导解析最优基线以最小化估计方差，并采用历史查询复用策略降低样本开销。
Result: 理论分析证明了Hessian估计器的无偏性、基线方差最优性，并给出了ZoVH全套估计器的误差界和收敛保证；实验表明ZoVH在真实应用中估计精度和收敛性能更优。
Conclusion: ZoVH提供了一套理论完备、方差最优的零阶Hessian估计方案，适用于双水平优化、贝叶斯推断等任务，但论文未讨论其在大规模深度学习以外的具体领域（如气象预报）的适用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Spectral Anatomy of Quantum Gaussian Process Kernels
papers.abstract_en: Two recent results have reshaped quantum Gaussian processes (QGPs). On the one hand, \citet{lowe2025assessing} rule out the exponential speedups claimed by HHL-based QGP regression in the typical, well-conditioned regime; on the other, an independent line of work shows that highly expressive quantum kernels suffer posterior pathologies that break Bayesian optimization. We show that these seemingly unrelated phenomena are governed by the same quantity: the normalized spectral entropy $S(K)/\log n$ of the kernel Gram matrix. We prove a Cauchy--Schwarz tail bound on Nyström approximation error, a finite-sample variance-contraction identity in terms of Bach's degrees of freedom $d_σ(K)$, and a characterization of the \emph{target-dependent} optimal entropy via the intrinsic dimension of the target in the kernel eigenbasis. Empirically, the diagnostic is kernel-agnostic: hardware-efficient, matchgate, IQP \emph{and} RBF/Matérn/RFF/deep-kernel families all collapse onto identical $S/\log n$ curves on dequantization, ECE, and variance-contraction panels. The NLL sweet spot lives at high entropy for smooth targets and at low entropy for band-limited quantum-data targets. The diagnostic transfers from simulator to IBM Heron hardware with median absolute error $3.2\%$ and mean $5.2\%$ in $S/\log n$ across $24$ configurations at $n_q = 4$, with matchgate and IQP within $5\%$ mean and a single HE configuration returning a $30\%$ outlier that drops to $0.5\%$ on rerun (attributed to calibration drift); the same diagnostic transfers to a second Heron backend (mean error $2.7\%$) and to a $n_q = 6$ scale-up on the original backend (mean error $1.7\%$). No error mitigation is applied throughout.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示量子高斯过程（QGP）中的两个看似无关的现象——HHL-based QGP回归的指数加速被否定以及高表达性量子核的后验病态——均受核Gram矩阵的归一化谱熵S(K)/log n控制。作者证明了Nyström近似误差的Cauchy-Schwarz尾界、基于Bach自由度的有限样本方差收缩恒等式，以及通过核本征基中目标的内在维度刻画的目标依赖最优熵。实验表明该诊断与核类型无关：硬件高效、matchgate、IQP以及经典RBF/Matérn/RFF/deep-kernel族在去量子化、ECE和方差收缩面板上均塌缩到相同的S/log n曲线。负对数似然（NLL）最佳点位于光滑目标的高熵和带限量子数据目标的低熵。诊断从模拟器迁移到IBM Heron硬件：在n_q=4的24个配置中，S/log n的中位绝对误差3.2%，平均5.2%；matchgate和IQP在平均5%以内，单个HE配置的30%异常值在重跑后降至0.5%（归因于校准漂移）；第二个Heron后端平均误差2.7%，n_q=6扩展平均误差1.7%。全程未使用错误缓解。
Motivation: 量子高斯过程回归中，HHL-based方法在典型良好条件区域的指数加速被否定，同时高表达性量子核存在后验病态破坏贝叶斯优化，这些现象尚未有统一解释。
Method: 提出归一化谱熵S(K)/log n作为统一诊断量，证明Nyström近似误差的Cauchy-Schwarz尾界和基于Bach自由度的方差收缩恒等式，并刻画目标依赖的最优熵。
Result: 实验显示不同核家族在去量子化、ECE和方差收缩面板上均塌缩到相同的S/log n曲线；NLL最佳点随目标特性变化；诊断从模拟器迁移到IBM Heron硬件，误差在可接受范围内。
Conclusion: 谱熵是量子高斯过程核性能的通用诊断，可解释此前看似无关的负面结果，并指导核选择。

papers.title: Inspectable Neural Markov Models for Non-Stationary Time Series
papers.abstract_en: Modeling non-stationary stochastic systems requires balancing the representational capacity of deep learning with the structural transparency of classical probabilistic models. Markov transition matrices provide such a framework, but traditional frequency-based estimation collapses at high resolutions due to data sparsity. We propose a hybrid approach that parameterizes the manifold of stochastic matrices through a neural network, enabling estimation of time-inhomogeneous Markov chains in sparse-data regimes, and use financial markets as a testbed to investigate the Markov state variable as a critical inductive bias. We show that conditioning on realized volatility produces a more internally consistent Markovian structure than return-based states, achieving a $5.6\%$ reduction in Chapman-Kolmogorov discrepancy and superior held-out likelihood in 9 of 10 assets. Unlike black-box sequence models, our approach generates explicit matrices amenable to direct geometric analysis, surfacing structural findings such as the universal homogenization of transition probabilities under high-volatility regimes.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables. Presented at The 2026 ASA Midwest Regional Conference in Statistics and Data Science
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合方法，用神经网络参数化马尔可夫转移矩阵的流形，用于非平稳时间序列的建模，并以金融市场作为测试床。与基于回报的状态相比，以已实现波动率为条件产生了更一致的马尔可夫结构，将Chapman-Kolmogorov差异降低5.6%，并在10个资产中9个获得更好的留出似然。该方法生成显式转移矩阵，揭示了高波动率下转移概率的均匀化现象。
Motivation: 建模非平稳随机系统需要平衡深度学习的表示能力和经典概率模型的结构透明度，但传统频率估计在高分辨率下因数据稀疏而失效。
Method: 通过神经网络参数化随机矩阵的流形，实现时间非齐次马尔可夫链在稀疏数据场景下的估计。
Result: 以已实现波动率为条件，与基于回报的状态相比，Chapman-Kolmogorov差异降低5.6%，并在10个资产中9个获得更好的留出似然。高波动率下转移概率呈现均匀化。
Conclusion: 该方法兼具结构透明性和表示能力，生成的显式矩阵便于直接几何分析，但当前主要在金融市场中验证。

papers.title: PRISM: Progressive Reasoning through Iterative Slot Memory for Vision
papers.abstract_en: Modern vision models process images in a single feed-forward pass, which limits their ability to recover missing evidence or refine uncertain representations under incomplete observations. Inspired by the iterative nature of human perception, we introduce PRISM (Progressive Reasoning through Iterative Slot Memory), a pyramid vision architecture that reasons over images through iterative refinement. At a high level, PRISM groups visual features into object-centric representations, retrieves relevant patterns from a learned memory, and iteratively refines the representation to resolve ambiguity and recover missing information. This organize-recall-refine process operates recurrently across multiple scales, enabling progressive improvement of visual representations. Across standard vision tasks, including image classification, object detection, and semantic segmentation, PRISM achieves competitive performance while demonstrating improved robustness under incomplete observations such as occlusion. These results suggest that iterative reasoning with structured representations and memory is a promising direction for building more resilient and adaptive vision models. Source code and models will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PRISM (Progressive Reasoning through Iterative Slot Memory) 是一种金字塔视觉架构，通过迭代的“组织-回忆-细化”过程在多个尺度上逐步改进视觉表示，旨在处理不完整观测（如遮挡）下的图像理解。在图像分类、目标检测和语义分割等标准视觉任务上，PRISM 取得有竞争力的性能，并在遮挡条件下展现出更强的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有视觉模型在前馈单次推理中难以恢复缺失证据或细化不确定表示，受人类感知迭代性的启发，需要一种能逐步推理和修复不完整信息的架构。
Method: 提出 PRISM 架构，将视觉特征分组为以物体为中心的表示 (object-centric representations)，从学习记忆中检索相关模式，并迭代细化表示以消除歧义和恢复缺失信息；该过程在多个尺度上循环运作。
Result: 在图像分类、目标检测和语义分割等任务上取得有竞争力的性能，并在遮挡等不完整观测下表现出更好的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 具有结构化表示和记忆的迭代推理是构建更具韧性和适应性的视觉模型的有前景方向。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: IAF-Net: Illumination-Adaptive Fusion for Low-Light Urban Road Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Semantic road segmentation is important for autonomous driving, but existing methods suffer severe performance degradation under low-light conditions. Many existing multi-modal fusion methods do not explicitly adapt to illumination-dependent changes in modality reliability, which can propagate degraded RGB features into the fused representation at night. We propose IAF-Net (Illumination-Adaptive Fusion Network), an end-to-end framework with illumination-adaptive fusion for robust road segmentation across different lighting conditions. It dynamically adjusts fusion weights of RGB and geometric features via the core Illumination-Adaptive Fusion (IAF) module, and enhances low-light feature selection with a brightness-modulated attention decoder. We also construct two dedicated datasets: nuScenes Nighttime Road Segmentation (nuScenes-NRS) and CARLA Multi-Weather Road Segmentation (CARLA-MWRS). Experiments on nuScenes-NRS show state-of-the-art overall performance among the compared methods, while CARLA-MWRS further validates robustness across adverse weather conditions. Ablation studies on a 40% training subset further highlight the importance of the IAF module, which provides the largest individual gain of 0.70% in MaxF.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本论文提出IAF-Net，一种光照自适应融合网络，用于低光照城市道路分割。核心是光照自适应融合(IAF)模块，动态调整RGB和几何特征的融合权重，并通过亮度调制注意力解码器增强低光特征选择。在构建的nuScenes-NRS和CARLA-MWRS数据集上，IAF-Net在低光照条件下达到SOTA性能，消融实验表明IAF模块带来0.70% MaxF增益。
Motivation: 现有多模态融合方法在低光照下无法适应模态可靠性的光照依赖变化，导致夜间退化的RGB特征污染融合表示，影响分割性能。
Method: 提出IAF-Net，通过光照自适应融合(IAF)模块动态调节RGB与几何特征的融合权重，并采用亮度调制注意力解码器增强低光特征的选择。同时构建了两个专用数据集：nuScenes-NRS和CARLA-MWRS，以评估不同光照和天气条件下的性能。
Result: 在nuScenes-NRS上整体性能优于对比方法，在CARLA-MWRS上验证了跨恶劣天气的鲁棒性。在40%训练子集上的消融实验显示，IAF模块带来0.70% MaxF的最大单项增益。
Conclusion: 实验表明，光照自适应融合策略显著提升了低光照和恶劣天气下的道路分割鲁棒性，IAF模块是核心贡献。但摘要未提及方法的局限性。

papers.title: Local linear convergence of gradient methods for overparameterized Gaussian mixtures
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of learning Gaussian mixture models under overparameterization. Prior work has shown that while overparameterization is essential for avoiding spurious local optima and enables global recovery of the ground-truth model using the gradient-EM (expectation-maximization) algorithm, it can dramatically slow down the local rate of convergence. Under certain assumptions on the mixture weights, we show that a standard divergence measure minimized by statistical learning procedures possesses a manifold of slow growth on which the well-known Polyak stepsize reduces the loss geometrically, and design a gradient-based method that converges to minimizers at a locally linear rate. Additionally, we show that our method converges to nearly optimal solutions -- up to a natural misspecification threshold -- for mixtures with arbitrary weights. At a high level, the method alternates between several "short" gradient descent steps that approach the manifold and "long" Polyak steps that contract the distance to minimizers. Our results suggest that slow convergence is not an intrinsic challenge of overparameterization, but can be overcome by exploiting the favorable structure of the loss landscape.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究过参数化高斯混合模型的学习问题，发现虽然过参数化有助于避免坏局部最优，但会显著减慢局部收敛速度。作者证明在权重假设下，一种标准散度度量具有慢增长流形，Polyak步长可在其上几何级降低损失；设计的梯度方法交替短梯度步和长Polyak步，实现局部线性收敛，且对任意权重可达近优解。结论表明慢收敛并非过参数化固有难题，可通过利用损失景观结构克服。
Motivation: 过参数化虽然能避免伪局部最优并保证梯度EM算法全局恢复真实模型，但会严重拖慢局部收敛速率，现有理论对此缺乏有效解决方案。
Method: 提出一种梯度方法，交替执行若干短梯度下降步（逼近慢流形）和长Polyak步（收缩至最小化器的距离），利用损失景观中散度度量的慢增长流形结构。
Result: 在混合权重假设下，标准散度度量的慢流形上Polyak步长使损失几何衰减；该方法局部线性收敛到最小化器，且对任意权重可收敛到近优解（至自然错配阈值）。
Conclusion: 慢收敛不是过参数化的固有挑战，通过挖掘损失景观的有利结构可有效克服。

papers.title: Do Large Language Models Encode Institutional Experience? Evidence from Cross-Linguistic Moral Reasoning Under Ambiguity
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit systematic differences in moral reasoning across languages, yet the source of this variation remains unclear. We test the hypothesis that languages encode aspects of the institutional environments in which they are spoken, allowing LLMs to inherit institution-specific moral priors through training. Across nine languages spanning a broad gradient of institutional quality, six frontier LLMs, and two preregistered studies, we examine moral dilemmas whose acceptability depends on institutional functioning. In Study 1, explicit institutional framing produced uniformly null results: cross-linguistic moral divergence did not increase in institutionally contingent scenarios, nor did it track institutional differences between language communities. In Study 2, we introduced institutionally ambiguous scenarios in which institutional stakes were present but not explicitly stated. Under these conditions, cross-linguistic moral divergence increased relative to institutionally inert controls and, with one theoretically informative exception, was associated with real-world institutional differences between language communities. Explicit framing again attenuated these effects. These findings suggest that institutional experience may leave detectable traces in language that shape LLM moral reasoning, while also indicating that explicit institutional cues can suppress the expression of those differences.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型在不同语言中表现出的道德推理差异是否源于语言编码了制度环境。通过两个预注册实验，使用六种前沿LLM和九种语言，发现当道德困境明确提及制度时，跨语言差异不显著；而在制度模糊场景下，跨语言道德分歧增加，并与现实制度差异相关。
Motivation: 现有研究观察到LLM在不同语言中道德推理存在系统性差异，但差异来源不明。本文假设语言可能编码了使用该语言社区的体制经验，从而通过训练数据使LLM继承特定道德先验。
Method: 采用两个预注册研究：研究1使用明确制度框架的道德困境，研究2使用制度模糊场景（制度相关但不被明确提及）。涉及九种语言、六种前沿LLM，通过比较跨语言道德分歧程度与真实世界制度差异的关联来检验假设。
Result: 研究1中，明确制度框架下跨语言道德差异不显著；研究2制度模糊场景中，跨语言道德分歧显著增加，且除一个理论例外外，与语言社区之间的制度差异相关。明确框架会抑制这种差异表达。
Conclusion: LLM的道德推理可能受到了语言中隐含的制度经验的影响，但明确制度线索会抑制这些差异。这表明训练数据中的语言信息可以传递制度相关的道德先验。

summary_sections.conclusion: LLM的道德推理可能受到了语言中隐含的制度经验的影响，但明确制度线索会抑制这些差异。这表明训练数据中的语言信息可以传递制度相关的道德先验。

papers.title: TUX: Measuring Human--AI Tacit Understanding
papers.abstract_en: As large language models (LLMs) increasingly act as collaborative partners, human--AI alignment is often evaluated through explicit task success, accuracy, or reward optimization. Yet many collaborative settings depend on tacit understanding: whether an agent can align with a human's evaluative stance or representational priors without clear objectives, communication, or feedback. To study this capacity, we develop a spectrum-placement task inspired by the social party game Wavelength, in which humans and agents independently place concepts along subjective spectra. We operationalize the Tacit Understanding Index (TUX) as a pairwise measure of similarity between human and agent judgments, and evaluate it with 241 human participants and 200 profile-conditioned LLM agents across four models. We find that nearest human--agent pairs in trait space achieve significantly higher TUX, suggesting that tacit alignment is structured by person-level characteristics rather than random similarity. Regression analyses show that TUX becomes more explainable as predictor sets become richer, with individual traits, decision-making styles, and confidence improving over aggregate trait-distance baselines. These findings suggest that tacit understanding between humans and LLMs is measurable, while revealing the limits of profile-based conditioning for capturing deeper representational alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种衡量人类与AI之间默契理解（tacit understanding）的方法，基于社交游戏Wavelength设计频谱放置任务，定义默契理解指数（TUX）来量化人类与AI代理在主观频谱上判断的相似性。通过241名人类参与者和200个基于人格条件的LLM代理实验，发现人格空间中最近的人-代理对TUX显著更高，表明默契对齐由人格特征结构化。回归分析显示，随着预测变量集丰富，TUX的可解释性增强。
Motivation: 现有的人机对齐评估多关注显式任务成功或奖励优化，但许多协作场景依赖于默契理解——即代理在没有明确目标、沟通或反馈的情况下与人类评价立场或表征先验对齐的能力。缺乏对这种能力的量化度量。
Method: 开发基于社交游戏Wavelength的频谱放置任务，让人类和代理独立将概念放置在主观频谱上。定义TUX作为人类与代理判断相似性的成对度量，并通过241名人类参与者和200个基于人格条件的LLM代理进行实验。
Result: 人格空间中最近的人-代理对TUX显著更高，表明默契对齐由人格特征结构化。回归分析显示，随着预测变量集丰富（个体特质、决策风格、置信度），TUX可解释性增加，且优于聚合人格距离基线。
Conclusion: 研究表明人类与LLM之间的默契理解是可量化的，但揭示了基于人格条件化方法在捕捉更深层次表征对齐方面的局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MultiAct: Text-to-Motion Generation from Composite Text via Tailored Attention Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-motion generation has progressed rapidly in recent years, offering an expressive interface for animation and human-computer interaction. However, current models remain brittle when handling prompts that describe multiple actions occurring at the same time. Rather than realizing all components of a composite description, models frequently prioritize a single dominant action and neglect the rest, leading to incomplete or ambiguous motion. We present MultiAct, an unpaired, inference-time framework for compositional text-to-motion synthesis that operates directly on pretrained motion generators without retraining or architectural modification. Our method counteracts semantic collapse by adaptively amplifying cross-attention scores associated with underrepresented prompt components. We note that effective modulation depends on prompt-specific choices, such as which tokens and layers to target, and introduce a lightweight auxiliary decision scheme that determines the most effective attention-strengthening parametrization. Extensive quantitative and qualitative evaluations demonstrate that MultiAct consistently outperforms existing baselines on composite prompts, achieving improved semantic coverage while preserving motion realism. Project page: https://natsala13.github.io/multiact.github.io.
papers.comment: Accepted to SIGGRAPH 2026 conference. Project page: https://natsala13.github.io/multiact.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MultiAct，一个不配对、推理时的框架，用于组合式文本到运动合成，直接在预训练的运动生成器上操作，无需重新训练或修改架构。该方法通过自适应放大与欠表示提示组件相关的交叉注意力分数来对抗语义坍塌，并引入轻量级辅助决策方案确定最有效的注意力增强参数化。实验表明，MultiAct在组合提示上持续优于现有基线，实现更好的语义覆盖同时保持运动真实性。
Motivation: 现有文本到运动生成模型在处理描述多个同时发生动作的组合提示时，往往优先处理一个主导动作而忽略其他组件，导致不完整或模糊的运动。需要一种无需重新训练的方法来改善组合提示的语义覆盖。
Method: 提出MultiAct，一个推理时框架，通过自适应放大交叉注意力分数来增强欠表示提示组件的注意力，并引入轻量级辅助决策方案以针对特定提示选择最佳的注意力增强参数化（包括令牌和层的选择）。
Result: 定量和定性评估表明，MultiAct在组合提示上持续优于现有基线，实现了更好的语义覆盖，同时保持了运动真实性。
Conclusion: MultiAct是一种无需重新训练或架构修改的有效框架，能够改善文本到运动生成中组合提示的处理。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Unsupervised Diffusion Solver for Combinatorial Optimization via Combinatorial Adjoint Matching
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based neural solvers have shown strong promise for combinatorial optimization (CO), but existing methods typically rely on supervised training with large collections of near-optimal solutions. In this work, we extend adjoint-based trajectory optimization methods to discrete combinatorial domains. We formulate diffusion-based CO as a stochastic control problem over Continuous-Time Markov Chains and introduce discrete adjoint dynamics for propagating optimization signals through discrete generative trajectories. Building on this formulation, we propose Combinatorial Adjoint Matching (CAM), an unsupervised training framework for discrete diffusion solvers with structured and low-variance trajectory-level optimization signals. Empirically, CAM consistently outperforms existing unsupervised diffusion baselines and achieves performance competitive with strong supervised diffusion solvers and even traditional solvers across diverse combinatorial optimization problems. Our code is available at https://github.com/Shengyu-Feng/CAM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Combinatorial Adjoint Matching (CAM)，一种无监督训练框架，用于基于扩散的组合优化（CO）求解器。通过将扩散CO建模为连续时间马尔可夫链上的随机控制问题，并引入离散伴随动力学来传播优化信号，CAM实现了结构化、低方差轨迹级优化信号。实验表明，CAM在多种CO问题上一致优于现有无监督扩散基线，且性能与强监督扩散求解器甚至传统求解器竞争。
Motivation: 现有基于扩散的CO神经网络求解器通常依赖监督训练，需要大量近优解，限制了实际应用。本文旨在开发无需监督的无训练方法。
Method: 将扩散CO建模为连续时间马尔可夫链上的随机控制问题，引入离散伴随动力学（discrete adjoint dynamics）来传播优化信号，提出Combinatorial Adjoint Matching (CAM)框架，实现无监督训练。
Result: CAM在多种组合优化问题上一致优于现有无监督扩散基线，并取得与强监督扩散求解器及传统求解器竞争的性能。
Conclusion: 所提框架为无监督扩散CO求解器提供了有效的训练方法，通过结构化低方差信号实现竞争性结果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: De-attribute to Forget for LLM Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: The rapid development of large language models (LLMs) has raised concerns on the use of inappropriate data for training, which has led to a growing interest in LLM unlearning. Many existing LLM unlearning approaches rely on optimizing prediction loss(es), such as maximizing the loss on the forget set, but often face critical issues like over-forgetting and poor model utility. To address them, this paper novelly frames the optimization objective for LLM unlearning as one of zeroing out data attribution instead. In particular, we propose the first LLM unlearning framework based on data attribution rewards called DareU that performs reinforcement learning to update the LLM by reducing the attribution score of its generated responses (i.e., de-attributing) to the forget data owners. Empirical evaluation using an LLM classifier as an efficient approximation of attribution shows that DareU outperforms existing baselines by achieving effective unlearning while balancing forget quality and model utility well.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于数据属性奖励的LLM遗忘框架DareU，通过强化学习降低模型输出对遗忘数据的属性分数，以替代传统的损失优化方法，在保持模型效用的同时实现有效遗忘。
Motivation: 现有LLM遗忘方法常依赖优化预测损失（如最大化遗忘集损失），导致过度遗忘和模型效用下降。本文旨在解决这些问题。
Method: 将LLM遗忘的目标重新定义为归零数据属性，提出首个基于数据属性奖励的遗忘框架DareU，使用强化学习通过降低生成响应对遗忘数据所有者的属性分数来更新LLM。采用LLM分类器高效近似属性。
Result: 实证评估表明，DareU优于现有基线，在平衡遗忘质量和模型效用方面表现良好。
Conclusion: 本文表明基于数据属性奖励的遗忘方法可以有效替代传统损失优化方法，为LLM遗忘提供新视角。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Inference-Free Multimodal Learned Sparse Retrieval for Production-Scale Visual Document Search
papers.abstract_en: As large-scale visual-document corpora such as arXiv papers and enterprise PDFs continue to grow, visual-document retrieval has gained increasing attention; yet it still lacks a deployable system that lexically indexes visual documents to serve queries without neural encoding at scale. Existing methods either achieve strong retrieval quality with VLM-based dense or multi-vector models but require neural query encoding at serving time, or avoid query encoding with OCR- or caption-based BM25 at the cost of time-consuming text extraction or generation. To fill this missing serving regime, we present V-SPLADE, an inference-free sparse retriever for visual-document retrieval. However, such inference-free multimodal learned sparse retrieval systems remain underexplored and have not yet shown dense-level effectiveness under high sparsity. We attribute this limitation to a lexical grounding problem: visual sparse representations often fail to capture the lexical content embedded in document images. To address this problem, we introduce caption-gated token supervision, a training-only signal that uses VLM-generated captions as lexical cues to activate retrieval-relevant vocabulary dimensions. With this supervision, V-SPLADE improves average NDCG@5 across six visual-document retrieval benchmarks by +13.8pp over the same-scale dense baseline and by up to +6.3pp over OCR- or caption-based BM25 baselines. On an 18.7M-document corpus, it more than doubles R@5 over the same-scale dense baseline and further improves competing retrievers through score fusion by up to +2.4pp R@5. Code will be released soon at https://github.com/naver/v-splade.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 V-SPLADE，一种推理阶段无需神经编码的多模态稀疏检索器，用于大规模视觉文档检索。通过引入标题门控令牌监督（caption-gated token supervision），利用 VLM 生成的标题作为词汇线索激活检索相关词汇维度，解决了视觉稀疏表示难以捕获文档图像中词汇内容的问题。在六个视觉文档检索基准上，V-SPLADE 的平均 NDCG@5 比同规模稠密基线提升 13.8 个百分点，比基于 OCR 或标题的 BM25 基线提升高达 6.3 个百分点。在 1870 万文档语料库上，R@5 比同规模稠密基线翻倍以上，并通过分数融合进一步改善竞争检索器。
Motivation: 现有视觉文档检索方法要么依赖神经查询编码（导致推理开销），要么依赖 OCR/标题文本提取（耗时且质量不稳定）。缺乏一种可在生产规模下无需推理时神经编码且达到稠密检索效果的词项索引方案。
Method: 提出 V-SPLADE，一种推理免费的多模态学习稀疏检索器。核心创新是标题门控令牌监督（caption-gated token supervision），在训练阶段使用 VLM 生成的标题作为词汇线索，引导模型激活与检索相关的词汇维度，从而缓解视觉稀疏表示的词汇接地问题。
Result: 在六个视觉文档检索基准上，V-SPLADE 平均 NDCG@5 比同规模稠密基线提升 13.8 个百分点，比 OCR/标题 BM25 基线提升高达 6.3 个百分点。在 1870 万文档语料库上，R@5 比同规模稠密基线翻倍以上，并通过分数融合使 R@5 再提升达 2.4 个百分点。
Conclusion: V-SPLADE 展示了推理免费的多模态稀疏检索在生产规模视觉文档搜索中的可行性，其性能超越同等规模的稠密检索和基于文本的 BM25 基线，且无需推理时神经编码。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Welfare, Improvability, and Variance: A Principal-Agent Approach to Optimal Benchmark Item Aggregation
papers.abstract_en: AI benchmarks have well-documented limitations, with prior work examining contamination, saturation, and construct underspecification. Aggregation has received far less attention: benchmarks are typically summarized by uniformly averaging item-level scores, implicitly treating every test item as equally valuable. We model benchmarking as a multitask principal-agent game and show that the welfare loss from a benchmark is determined jointly by three item-level primitives: alignment with normative welfare priorities, marginal improvability, and performance variance. We translate the theory into an audit framework that ranks items along each of these three axes, and apply it to OLMES items using WORKBank for welfare, the EvoLM 4B suite for improvability, and the PolyPythias 410M panel for variance. The framework surfaces items that are Pareto-inferior within OLMES subject to a pro-worker welfare operationalization. All code is available at https://github.com/stair-lab/principal-agent-benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过主-代理人博弈模型研究AI基准测试中项目得分的聚合方式，指出福利损失由三个项目级因素决定：与规范福利优先级的一致性、边际可改进性和性能方差。作者开发了一个审计框架来对项目沿这三个轴排序，并应用于OLMES基准，发现了Pareto劣势项目。
Motivation: 基准测试的聚合问题很少被研究，通常使用均匀平均，忽略项目间的价值差异，导致福利损失。
Method: 将基准测试建模为多任务主-代理人博弈，推导福利损失公式，基于三个项目级因素（一致性、可改进性、方差）构建审计框架，并在OLMES项目上通过WORKBank、EvoLM 4B和PolyPythias 410M进行实证。
Result: 框架成功识别出OLMES中在亲工人福利操作化下Pareto劣势的项目。
Conclusion: 基准项目聚合不应均匀平均，而应考虑福利优先级、可改进性和方差；审计框架可用于改进基准设计。

papers.title: DiTTo: Scalable Order-aware All-in-One Image Restoration Agent
papers.abstract_en: Real-world images rarely suffer from a single degradation, and the order in which degradations are removed substantially affects the final restoration quality, motivating agent-based image restoration (IR), where a vision-language model schedules a pool of pre-built restoration-experts. However, existing training-based agents require $\mathcal{O}((N^{\mathbf{D}})^{2})$ restoration-expert calls per image to construct the Optimal Restoration-action Trajectory Dataset (ORTD), where $N^{\mathbf{D}}$ denotes the number of degradation types in the universe $\mathbf{D}$, and couple agent training to a fixed restoration-expert pool, preventing extension to newly introduced restoration-experts without full retraining. To overcome these efficiency and extensibility bottlenecks, we propose \textbf{DiTTo}, a novel order-aware image restoration agent framework consisting of the DiTTo Simulator and the DiTTo Agent. The DiTTo Simulator combines $\cup$S-IR for single-step restoration-action simulation and AiO-IQA for per-action quality prediction, reducing ORTD construction to $\mathcal{O}(N^{\mathbf{D}})$ simulator calls per image; the DiTTo Agent is trained by SFT on the simulator-generated ORTD, followed by \textbf{Order-aware Restoration Alignment (ORA)} that aligns degradation identification, restoration-action-ordering, and output format along independent axes. This enables \textbf{plug-and-play scalable extensibility}: adding a new restoration-expert requires updating only the lightweight ORA stage. On the MiO-100 evaluation set with up to five concurrent degradations, our DiTTo Agent achieves state-of-the-art multi-degradation restoration quality among previous agent-based IR methods.
papers.comment: Please visit our project page at https://cmlab-korea.github.io/DiTTo/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DiTTo，一个可扩展的、顺序感知的图像恢复智能体框架。它通过DiTTo模拟器将最优恢复动作轨迹数据集的构建复杂度从O(N^D^2)降至O(N^D)，并引入顺序感知恢复对齐（ORA）实现即插即用的可扩展性。在MiO-100基准上，相比之前的基于智能体的方法，DiTTo实现了最先进的多退化恢复质量。
Motivation: 现有基于智能体的图像恢复方法在构建最优恢复动作轨迹数据集时复杂度高（O(N^D^2)），且智能体训练与固定的恢复专家库耦合，无法扩展新专家而不需完全重新训练。
Method: DiTTo包含两部分：DiTTo模拟器，通过∪S-IR单步恢复动作模拟和AiO-IQA每动作质量预测，将数据集构建复杂度降至O(N^D)；DiTTo智能体，通过超微调（SFT）在模拟器生成的轨迹数据集上训练，然后进行顺序感知恢复对齐（ORA），沿独立轴对齐退化识别、恢复动作顺序和输出格式。
Result: 在多达五种并发退化的MiO-100评估集上，DiTTo智能体在以往基于智能体的图像恢复方法中达到了最先进的多退化恢复质量。
Conclusion: DiTTo实现了可扩展的即插即用扩展性：添加新的恢复专家只需更新轻量级的ORA阶段，无需完全重新训练。
