papers.title: Automating Formal Verification with Reinforcement Learning and Recursive Inference
papers.abstract_en: Automated formal verification remains challenging for large language models because data for proof assistants and verification-aware languages is scarce, and correctness depends on satisfying precise machine-checkable specifications rather than producing plausible code. This thesis studies how verifier environments can improve LLM generation of verified programs and proofs through reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) and verifier-guided inference-time search. First, we train open-source models in Dafny with RLVR using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and related variants, assembling generated candidates into complete programs and scoring them with compiler and verifier outcomes. Initial experiments on an APPS-derived Dafny dataset increased verified reward from 2.2% to 58.1%, but revealed specification hacking, where models exploit weak formal specifications instead of implementing the intended solutions. After filtering underspecified and vulnerable tasks, multi-turn RLVR on the refined benchmark improves the verified pass rate from 9.7% to 31.1%. Second, we develop a verifier-guided inference scaffold in Lean that treats proof generation as structured search over decomposed subgoals, verifier feedback, diagnostics, and repair. With a fixed base model, the full scaffold with proof reviser improves pass rate on an initial VeriCoding pilot set from 46.2% under direct repair to 69.2%. On the larger VERINA dataset, whole-task decomposition plus proof reviser solves 7 of 42 previously unsolved tasks. We also introduce Dalek-Bench, a repository-scale Lean benchmark derived from the Rust $\texttt{curve25519-dalek}$ verification project; preliminary results remain weak, indicating that stronger progress evaluation and task-specific tool-use policies are still needed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这篇硕士论文研究了如何利用强化学习从可验证奖励（RLVR）和验证器引导的推理时搜索来提升大语言模型生成验证程序和证明的能力。在Dafny中通过GRPO训练将验证奖励从2.2%提升至58.1%，但发现规范攻击问题；改进后多轮RLVR将验证通过率从9.7%提升至31.1%。在Lean中构建的验证器引导推理框架将初始验证集通过率从46.2%提升至69.2%，并在VERINA数据集上解决了42个任务中的7个。同时引入了仓库级Lean基准Dalek-Bench。
Motivation: 自动形式化验证对LLM仍具挑战，因为验证程序和证明的数据稀缺，且正确性取决于精确的机器可检查规范而非生成合理代码。现有方法难以生成正确代码并满足规范。
Method: 首先，在Dafny中使用RLVR和GRPO训练开源模型，将生成候选程序组合为完整程序并用编译器和验证结果评分。其次，在Lean中开发验证器引导的推理框架，将证明生成视为结构化搜索，结合子目标分解、验证反馈、诊断和修复。
Result: 初始Dafny实验将验证奖励从2.2%提升至58.1%；过滤弱规范后多轮RLVR将验证通过率从9.7%提升至31.1%。Lean框架配合证明修正器将初始验证集通过率从46.2%提升至69.2%，在VERINA数据集上解决了42个未解决任务中的7个。Dalek-Bench初步结果较弱。
Conclusion: 研究表明RLVR和验证器引导推理可显著提升LLM的验证程序生成能力，但存在规范攻击问题，且实际复杂基准仍需更强评估和任务特定工具使用策略。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Toxic HallucinAItions: Perturbing Prompts and Tracing LLM Circuits
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in conversational settings where user tone ranges from polite to adversarial or toxic, yet less is known about whether toxic language in otherwise semantically equivalent prompts can degrade factual reliability. We study how lexical and tone-based prompt perturbations affect the factual reliability of LLMs. Using controlled prompt variations across polite, random, and three toxicity levels, we evaluate five LLMs on ARC-Easy, GSM8K, and MMLU. We find that toxic lexical perturbations consistently reduce factual accuracy and increase uncertainty, while polite phrasing yields limited and inconsistent changes. To examine whether these answer inconsistencies correspond to internal changes, we conduct attribution-graph analyses of model activations and influences. We find that increasing toxicity selectively amplifies perturbation-sensitive variant nodes while relatively stable core reasoning nodes remain more invariant. These findings position prompt tone as a critical dimension of LLM reliability and provide behavioral and mechanistic evidence that surface-level lexical variation can alter factual outputs and internal computation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究有毒语言在语义等价提示中是否影响大语言模型（LLM）的事实可靠性。通过控制提示的词汇和语气变化（礼貌、随机、三种毒性级别），在ARC-Easy、GSM8K和MMLU基准上评估五个LLM，发现有毒词汇扰动一致降低事实准确性并增加不确定性，而礼貌措辞变化有限且不一致。归因图分析表明，毒性增强会选择性放大扰动敏感变量节点，而核心推理节点相对稳定。
Motivation: LLM越来越多地部署在用户语气从礼貌到对抗或有毒的对话场景中，但有毒语言是否会影响事实可靠性尚不清楚。
Method: 通过控制提示变体（礼貌、随机、三个毒性级别）评估五个LLM在ARC-Easy、GSM8K和MMLU上的表现，并使用归因图分析模型激活和影响，以检查答案不一致性与内部变化的对应关系。
Result: 有毒词汇扰动一致降低事实准确性并增加不确定性；礼貌措辞变化有限且不一致。归因图分析显示，增加毒性选择性放大扰动敏感变量节点，而核心推理节点相对稳定。
Conclusion: 提示语气是LLM可靠性的关键维度；表面词汇变化能改变事实输出和内部计算，为理解LLM可靠性提供了行为学和机制证据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Attend to Evidence: Evidence-Anchored Spatial Attention Supervision for Multimodal RLVR
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves vision-language models (VLMs) by optimizing outcome rewards derived from final answers. However, such outcome-only rewards do not tell the model which image regions justify an answer. For questions that require visual grounding, these rewards cannot distinguish responses supported by relevant visual evidence from those produced by language-prior shortcuts or lucky guesses. We introduce EASE (Evidence-Anchored Spatial Attention), which augments multimodal RLVR with visual-evidence process supervision. EASE converts annotated evidence regions into a smoothed visual-token target and uses it to guide response-to-image attention during RL training, but only on high-reward trajectories. The annotations are used solely as privileged training labels, while inference requires only the original image and question. Across Qwen2.5-VL-7B, Qwen3-VL-4B, and Qwen3-VL-8B, EASE raises average scores over DAPO by 2.5 to 3.1 points on perception, hallucination, visual math, and multimodal reasoning benchmarks. Diagnostics and ablations show that EASE better aligns visual attention with annotated evidence regions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EASE（Evidence-Anchored Spatial Attention），一种在多模态强化学习（RLVR）中引入视觉证据过程监督的方法。EASE将标注的证据区域转化为平滑的视觉标记目标，在RL训练中引导响应到图像的注意力，仅在奖励高的轨迹上使用。在Qwen2.5-VL-7B、Qwen3-VL-4B和Qwen3-VL-8B上，相比DAPO平均提升2.5-3.1分，覆盖感知、幻觉、视觉数学和多模态推理基准。
Motivation: 现有RLVR只使用最终答案的可验证奖励，无法区分基于视觉证据的响应和基于语言捷径或幸运猜测的响应，尤其对需要视觉定位的问题无效。
Method: EASE：将标注的证据区域转换为平滑的视觉标记目标，在RL训练中仅对高奖励轨迹施加空间注意力监督，使模型注意力与证据区域对齐。标注仅在训练中作为特权标签使用，推理时不需额外标注。
Result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B、Qwen3-VL-4B和Qwen3-VL-8B上，EASE在感知、幻觉、视觉数学和多模态推理基准上平均比DAPO高2.5-3.1分。诊断和消融实验表明EASE能更好地将视觉注意力与标注证据区域对齐。
Conclusion: EASE通过视觉证据过程监督增强了多模态RLVR，提升了模型对视觉证据的利用能力，但依赖训练时的额外标注。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: What Makes LVLMs Hallucinate Less? Unveiling the Architectural Factors Behind Hallucination Robustness
papers.abstract_en: Hallucination remains one of the key challenges undermining the reliability of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs). But what makes an LVLM hallucinate less? Many existing efforts focus on improving internal components of the model. We argue that hallucination fundamentally stems from how the model architecture is designed. To investigate this, we factor the architecture design into three dimensions: Linguistic Foundation (LF), Visual Representation (VR), and Semantic Alignment (SA), and categorize hallucinations into Co-occurrence, Similarity, and previously overlooked Uncertainty types. Building on this formulation, we propose CoSimUE, a benchmark that creates fine-grained hallucination scenarios through controlled textual perturbations and random perturbations, enabling mapping between design choices and hallucination behaviors. Experiments across 7 design aspects show that: 1) the widely emphasized scaling of model parameters has only limited impact on reducing all three types of hallucinations; 2) larger and better-trained language foundations can reduce co-occurrence hallucinations; 3) stronger visual encoders and higher resolutions mitigate similarity errors; 4) effective alignment strategies alleviate uncertainty hallucinations. 5) Furthermore, cross-dimensional analysis reveals that jointly enhancing visual fidelity and alignment quality yields the most comprehensive improvements. This study provides the first systematic exploration linking architecture-level design to hallucination robustness, offering practical guidance for developing reliable and efficient LVLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统性地探讨了大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）的架构设计如何影响其幻觉行为的鲁棒性。作者将架构分解为语言基础、视觉表示和语义对齐三个维度，并将幻觉分为共现型、相似型和不确定性型三类，提出CoSimUE基准通过受控文本扰动和随机扰动生成细粒度幻觉场景。实验表明，参数扩增对减少三类幻觉效果有限，增强语言基础可降低共现幻觉，更强的视觉编码器和更高分辨率可缓解相似性错误，有效的对齐策略可减轻不确定性幻觉，而联合提升视觉保真度和对齐质量带来最全面的改进。
Motivation: 幻觉问题是LVLM可靠性的主要挑战，但现有研究多聚焦于改进模型内部组件，缺乏对架构设计如何影响幻觉鲁棒性的系统性理解。本文旨在从架构层面揭示设计选择与幻觉行为之间的映射关系。
Method: 将架构设计分解为语言基础（LF）、视觉表示（VR）和语义对齐（SA）三个维度，并将幻觉划分为共现型、相似型和不确定性型。提出CoSimUE基准，通过文本扰动和随机扰动构建细粒度幻觉场景，以建立设计选择与各类型幻觉之间的关联。
Result: 在7个设计方面的实验表明：参数扩增对减少三种幻觉效果有限；更大且训练更好的语言基础降低共现幻觉；更强的视觉编码器和更高分辨率缓解相似性错误；有效的对齐策略减轻不确定性幻觉；跨维度分析显示联合增强视觉保真度和对齐质量带来最全面的改进。
Conclusion: 本研究首次系统性地将架构级别设计与幻觉鲁棒性联系起来，为开发可靠高效的LVLM提供了实用指导。

papers.title: PINNs Failure Modes are Overfitting
papers.abstract_en: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) are a common class of machine learning-based partial differential equation (PDE) solvers which train a network to represent a solution by minimizing a residual loss that encodes the PDE. Despite their successes, they are known to fail on certain simple equations, converging to an incorrect solution despite low loss. These failure modes have garnered significant attention in the literature over the past several years, motivating both architectural and optimization based solutions. By directly visualizing the residual, we show that failure modes are the result of overfitting: the loss is minimized on the collocation points, but not elsewhere. Applying regularization causes the failure modes to vanish. Finally, we extend double backpropagation over the full set of residuals, and use it to achieve state-of-the-art performance on four standard failure mode equations with up to $23\times$ fewer collocation points and a vanilla architecture.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过直接可视化残差，证明物理信息神经网络（PINNs）的失败模式是由于过拟合：损失在配点上被最小化，但其他位置不然。应用正则化可消除失败模式。作者还扩展了双反向传播到完整残差集，在四个标准失败模式方程上以最多23倍更少的配点和普通架构取得了最先进性能。
Motivation: PINNs在简单方程上可能收敛到错误解，尽管损失很低，这种失败模式引起广泛关注，需要解释原因并解决。
Method: 直接可视化残差来证明失败模式源于过拟合；应用正则化；扩展双反向传播到完整残差集。
Result: 在四个标准失败模式方程上，以最多23倍更少的配点和普通架构取得最先进性能。
Conclusion: 失败模式是过拟合，正则化可消除，所提方法在更少配点下实现SOTA。

papers.title: BlueFin: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Financial Spreadsheets
papers.abstract_en: We present BlueFin, a benchmark that tasks large language model (LLM) agents with synthesis, manipulation, and comprehension tasks over spreadsheet workbooks in the professional finance domain. Though estimates of the global population of paying users of spreadsheet software range in the hundreds of millions -- an order of magnitude more than the estimated global population of professional developers -- comparatively fewer resources have been devoted to exploring and expanding LLM capabilities in the spreadsheet domain, with fewer still dedicated to mirroring real occupational tasks encountered by those in professional finance roles. In response, we curate a set of 131 challenging, complex tasks with real-world relevance in the domain, containing 3,225 granular rubric criteria; notably, our rubric criteria and LM judge evaluations are validated by a team of expert human annotators, resulting in high-quality, granular evaluations of complex tasks that are difficult to verify programmatically but can be reliably evaluated by an LM judge agent. Our judge achieves parity with expert consensus ($α=0.826$) with a macro-F1 score of 0.839. Frontier LLMs demonstrate poor performance on the challenging benchmark, with the strongest LLMs achieving less than 50\% average scores across tasks -- models exhibit particular weaknesses in dynamic correctness. Our contributions include a dataset of examples across three categories of spreadsheet tasks, an open source harness and agentic evaluation framework, and a characterization of existing frontier models' performance on our benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BlueFin是一个针对专业金融领域电子表格工作簿的LLM代理基准测试，包含131项复杂任务和3,225条细粒度评分标准。前沿LLM在该基准上表现不佳，平均得分低于50%，尤其在动态正确性方面存在明显缺陷。论文还提供了人工验证的评分标准和开源评估框架。
Motivation: 尽管电子表格软件用户量远超专业开发者，但针对电子表格领域的LLM能力探索资源较少，尤其是缺乏反映金融职业真实任务的基准。
Method: 构建包含三类电子表格任务的131个复杂任务，设计3,225条细粒度评分标准，并采用经人类专家验证的LM评判器进行评估，评判器与专家共识一致度α=0.826，宏F1=0.839。
Result: 最强LLM在任务上平均得分低于50%，模型在动态正确性方面表现尤其薄弱。
Conclusion: 现有前沿LLM在金融电子表格任务上能力有限，基准和评估框架可推动该领域研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Unifying View of Anchoring via Operator-Side Tikhonov Regularization
papers.abstract_en: Anchored fixed point and monotone equation methods, including Halpern iteration, extra anchored gradient, and their relatives, add a vanishing pull toward a reference point to obtain last-iterate guarantees. Existing anchored variants often achieve sharp last-iterate guarantees, but from the update-level perspective the placement of the anchor can be algorithm-specific and conceptually opaque. We show that anchoring admits a single operator-side construction: regularize the operator queried by the base method with a vanishing Tikhonov term, then run the unmodified base method. Applied to the Picard iteration, this recipe reproduces the Halpern iteration; applied to the forward step, extragradient (EG), and past extragradient (PEG, also known as Popov's method), it yields three variants whose anchor placements inherit the base method's query pattern. The forward-step instantiation gives a new residual convergence guarantee, while the EG and PEG instantiations give new regularized variants. The four analyses share a residual recurrence, recovering the $O(1/k)$ Halpern residual-norm convergence rate, giving $O(1/\sqrt{k})$ for the regularized forward step, and giving $O(1/k)$ for the regularized EG and PEG variants in the unconstrained monotone Lipschitz setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文统一了不动点方法和单调方程中的锚定 (anchoring) 技术，指出锚定等价于在算子端添加消失的Tikhonov正则化项，然后运行未修改的基础方法。通过将这一构造应用于Picard迭代、前向步、外梯度 (EG) 和过去外梯度 (PEG) 等方法，得到了相应的正则化变体，并给出了剩余范数的收敛速率。
Motivation: 现有的锚定变体虽然能获得最优的末次迭代保证，但锚的放置位置因算法而异，概念上不够透明。本文旨在从算子端给出统一视角。
Method: 提出在基础方法所查询的算子上添加一个消失的Tikhonov正则化项，然后运行未修改的基础方法。这样从Picard迭代得到Halpern迭代，从前向步、EG和PEG得到新的锚定变体。
Result: 四种分析的剩余范数收敛速率：Halpern为O(1/k)，正则化前向步为O(1/√k)，正则化EG和PEG在无约束单调Lipschitz设定下为O(1/k)。
Conclusion: 本文展示了锚定可以通过算子端的Tikhonov正则化统一理解，并提供了新的收敛保证。局限：仅考虑了无约束单调Lipschitz设定。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MergeTok: Unified Continuous and Discrete Visual Tokenization via Token Merging
papers.abstract_en: Most visual tokenizers for image generation are bifurcated into two families with complementary limitations: continuous VAEs offer high-fidelity reconstruction but suffer from dense, entangled latents that are poorly suited for semantic control, whereas discrete VQ-based models enable autoregressive generation yet struggle with gradient sparsity, unstable training, and codebook collapse. In this work, we introduce MergeTok, a unified tokenizer that jointly optimizes continuous (VAE) and discrete (VQ) tokenizers within a encoder-decoder architecture, leveraging token merging techniques as a semantic bridge. By clustering similar tokens during encoding, MergeTok establishes a structural prior that provides dual supervision signals: (i) it imposes merged-token semantic alignment in the VAE branch, regularizing its latent space toward disentangled, semantic-aware representations; (ii) it derives group-wise constraints, promoting intra-group diversity and inter-group exclusivity that stabilize VQ training. MergeTok shows competitive reconstruction and generation performance on ImageNet-256, with substantially lower rFID than strong VAE and VQ models under matched token budgets, while producing semantically-organized token representations compatible with both autoregressive and diffusion generators. This shows that a single architecture can endow visual tokenizers with robust semantic organization and generator-friendly discreteness.
papers.comment: 11 pages (main text), 7 figures. Preprint. Under review at NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MergeTok 是一种统一连续与离散视觉分词器的架构，通过在编码器-解码器中引入 token 合并技术作为语义桥梁，同时优化 VAE 和 VQ 分支。在 ImageNet-256 上，MergeTok 在相同 token 预算下取得了比强 VAE 和 VQ 模型更低的 rFID，并生成了语义组织的词元表示，兼容自回归和扩散生成器。
Motivation: 现有连续 VAE 和离散 VQ 分词器各有互补局限：VAE 重建保真度高但潜在表示密集纠缠不利于语义控制；VQ 适合自回归生成但存在梯度稀疏、训练不稳定和码本崩溃问题。需要一种统一架构同时兼顾两者优势。
Method: 在编码器-解码器框架内联合训练连续 (VAE) 和离散 (VQ) 分词器，通过 token 聚类建立结构先验：对 VAE 分支施加合并 token 的语义对齐正则化，对 VQ 分支导出组内多样性和组间排他性约束以稳定训练。
Result: 在 ImageNet-256 上，MergeTok 在相同 token 预算下实现比强 VAE 和 VQ 模型更低的 rFID，并生成语义组织的词元表示，在自回归和扩散生成器中均表现良好。
Conclusion: 单个架构可以通过 token 合并同时实现鲁棒的语义组织与生成器友好的离散性，为统一视觉分词器提供了新思路。

papers.title: Inverse Reinforcement Learning without an Optimal Demonstrator: A Feasible Reward Set Approach
papers.abstract_en: Inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) typically assumes demonstrations from a single optimal demonstrator, but in many applications data come from multiple imperfect demonstrators with heterogeneous suboptimality levels. We study reward learning in this setting through a feasible-reward-set framework: for each demonstrator, we encode its declared suboptimality level as a linear constraint and intersect the resulting feasible sets across demonstrators. Our theoretical analysis shows that the joint feasible set shrinks monotonically as data are added, and we give an exact characterization of when a new demonstrator strictly tightens it. We further establish two recovery guarantees for the feasible reward set of the ground-truth optimal demonstrator: one bound depends on closeness to the optimal occupancy, while the other requires only sufficient coverage and no near-optimal demonstrator. On the practical side, we introduce strategies to address the inherent reward ambiguity in the obtained reward set and provide an offline algorithm with function approximation for high-dimensional environments. Experiments in tabular grid-world and large language model (LLM) fine-tuning settings are consistent with the theoretical predictions and demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework over baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个可行奖励集（feasible reward set）框架，用于解决逆强化学习中演示数据来自多个非最优、异质性次优级别演示者的问题。理论分析证明联合可行集随数据单调收缩，并给出了新演示者严格收紧可行集的条件，以及恢复真实最优演示者奖励集的两种保证。实验在表格型网格世界和大型语言模型（LLM）微调设置中验证了框架的有效性。
Motivation: 标准逆强化学习假设演示来自单一最优演示者，但实际应用中数据往往来自多个异质性次优演示者，现有方法难以处理这种设置。
Method: 对每个演示者将其宣称的次优级别编码为线性约束，并取所有可行集的交集；开发了处理奖励歧义性的策略，并提供带函数逼近的离线算法用于高维环境。
Result: 摘要报告：理论分析给出了新演示者严格收紧可行集的条件；两种恢复保证分别依赖于接近最优占用度和足够覆盖且无需近最优演示者；实验在表格型和LLM微调设置中优于基线。
Conclusion: 本文框架能有效利用多个异质性次优演示者的数据学习奖励函数，且理论性质清晰、算法可扩展到高维环境。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一个可行奖励集（feasible reward set）框架，用于解决逆强化学习中演示数据来自多个非最优、异质性次优级别演示者的问题。理论分析证明联合可行集随数据单调收缩，并给出了新演示者严格收紧可行集的条件，以及恢复真实最优演示者奖励集的两种保证。实验在表格型网格世界和大型语言模型（LLM）微调设置中验证了框架的有效性。
summary_sections.motivation: 标准逆强化学习假设演示来自单一最优演示者，但实际应用中数据往往来自多个异质性次优演示者，现有方法难以处理这种设置。
summary_sections.method: 对每个演示者将其宣称的次优级别编码为线性约束，并取所有可行集的交集；开发了处理奖励歧义性的策略，并提供带函数逼近的离线算法用于高维环境。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告：理论分析给出了新演示者严格收紧可行集的条件；两种恢复保证分别依赖于接近最优占用度和足够覆盖且无需近最优演示者；实验在表格型和LLM微调设置中优于基线。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文框架能有效利用多个异质性次优演示者的数据学习奖励函数，且理论性质清晰、算法可扩展到高维环境。

papers.title: Density-Guided Robust Counterfactual Explanations on Tabular Data under Model Multiplicity
papers.abstract_en: Counterfactual explanations (CEs) are essential for actionable recourse, yet their reliability is often compromised in low-density regions, where classifiers exhibit high variance. Unlike existing methods that rely on expensive ensemble intersections to define stability, we propose \textit{DensityFlow}, a generative framework that constructs robust CEs by adhering to the high-confidence data manifold. Specifically, we model the counterfactual generation as continuous-time dynamics parameterized by Neural ODE, guided by a differentiable density score to actively avoid uncertain, low-density areas. This density score is learned via Noise Contrastive Estimation, effectively leveraging a $(K{+}1)$-way discriminator to estimate density ratios. For black-box settings, we introduce a local proxy distillation mechanism that aligns a lightweight surrogate with the target model strictly within the trajectory of CE generation, enabling efficient gradient-based optimization with minimal queries. Experiments demonstrate that \textit{DensityFlow} achieves superior validity under model multiplicity while significantly reducing query costs compared to ensemble-based baselines. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/G-AILab/DensityFlow.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DensityFlow，一种基于生成模型的反事实解释（CE）框架，通过神经ODE在连续时间动力学中生成反事实，并利用噪声对比估计学习的可微密度分数引导轨迹避开低密度区域，从而在模型多样性下保持鲁棒性。实验表明，DensityFlow 在有效性上优于基于集成的基线，同时显著降低查询成本。
Motivation: 现有反事实解释在低密度区域易受模型方差影响，而依赖集成交集定义稳定性的方法计算开销大。
Method: 将反事实生成建模为神经ODE参数化的连续时间动力学，通过可微密度分数（噪声对比估计学习）主动避开低密度区域；对黑盒模型引入局部代理蒸馏，仅在CE生成轨迹内对齐代理与目标模型。
Result: 在模型多样性下实现更高的有效性，且查询成本远低于基于集成的基线方法。
Conclusion: DensityFlow 能高效生成鲁棒的反事实解释，代码已开源。论文未讨论对非表格数据或极端类别不平衡场景的适用性。

papers.title: BilliardPhys-Bench: Benchmarking Physical Reasoning and Visual Dynamics of Multimodal LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Current multimodal models handle static image recognition well, but intuitive physical reasoning remains a weakness. Predicting how objects will move and interact from a single image is still difficult for these systems. We present BilliardPhys-Bench, a benchmark for physical reasoning in synthetic billiards environments. Its procedural engine generates randomized scenarios with friction and elastic collisions. The benchmark tests three abilities: (1) predicting ball-to-ball collisions, (2) reasoning about wall bounces, and (3) estimating final ball positions after motion stops. We evaluate recent MLLMs from the GPT, Claude, Gemini, and Qwen families. Performance drops as simulation time increases and scene geometry grows more complex. We also observe a consistent failure mode we call "stasis bias": when the correct physical outcome is harder to infer, models tend to predict no interaction. These findings show where current MLLMs break down on visual dynamics and point toward the need for better physical inductive biases in multimodal architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BilliardPhys-Bench，一个基于合成台球环境的物理推理基准，用于评估多模态大模型（MLLM）在视觉动力学方面的能力。基准测试包含三种任务：预测球-球碰撞、墙壁反弹以及运动停止后的最终位置。实验评估了 GPT、Claude、Gemini 和 Qwen 系列模型，发现性能随模拟时间和场景复杂度增加而下降，并观察到一种称为“停滞偏差”（stasis bias）的失败模式：当正确物理结果难以推断时，模型倾向于预测无交互。
Motivation: 当前多模态模型在静态图像识别上表现良好，但在直观物理推理方面仍然薄弱，缺乏针对视觉动力学的系统性基准。
Method: 构建程序化生成引擎，模拟带摩擦和弹性碰撞的随机台球场景，并定义三类物理推理任务（球-球碰撞、墙壁反弹、最终位置估计）。
Result: 评估显示所有测试模型在更长模拟时间和更复杂场景下性能显著下降，且普遍存在“停滞偏差”现象。
Conclusion: 结果表明当前 MLLM 在视觉动态推理上存在根本性局限，需要引入更好的物理归纳偏置。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Unified and Reproducible Experimentation Framework for Speech Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Speech foundation models and Speech LLMs have advanced speech understanding, yet deployment-oriented model selection is hindered by non-comparable evaluations caused by mismatched post-processing, and by training results that are hard to reproduce across data scales and pipelines. We present SURE, a unified experimentation framework that standardizes prediction formats, normalization, and scoring. SURE evaluates strong systems across paradigms, from conventional pipelines to Speech LLMs, on representative tasks under realistic acoustic and linguistic stressors. Beyond evaluation, SURE introduces an agent-assisted training conversion flow that maps paper and code into versioned, runnable training pipelines under a unified protocol on matched open-data subsets. Overall, SURE improves comparability and reproducibility for deployment-oriented evaluation.
papers.comment: This paper is submitted to INTERSPEECH 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SURE，一个统一且可复现的语音理解实验框架，标准化预测格式、归一化和评分，支持从传统流水线到语音大模型的评估，并引入代理辅助的训练转换流程以提高可比较性和可复现性。
Motivation: 语音基础模型和语音大模型在语音理解方面取得进展，但面向部署的模型选择因后处理不匹配导致评估不可比较，且训练结果在不同数据规模和流水线下难以复现。
Method: SURE 框架标准化预测格式、归一化和评分，评估多种范式（传统流水线到语音大模型）在代表性任务上的表现，并引入代理辅助训练转换流程，将论文和代码映射为版本化、可运行的训练流水线。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但声称 SURE 提高了部署导向评估的可比较性和可复现性。
Conclusion: SURE 通过统一协议和开放数据子集，提升了语音理解系统评估的公平性和可复现性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: UniScale: Adaptive Unified Inference Scaling via Online Joint Optimization of Model Routing and Test-Time Scaling
papers.abstract_en: In real-world deployments of large language models (LLMs), balancing inference quality and computational cost has become a central challenge. Existing approaches tackle this trade-off along two largely independent dimensions: model routing, which switches among models of different scales to match request complexity, and test-time scaling (TTS), which adjusts inference-time compute within a fixed model for fine-grained control. However, this decoupled design introduces inherent limitations. Model routing yields coarse-grained, discrete performance changes due to the sparse set of model scales, while single-model TTS often encounters capacity ceilings and exhibits diminishing returns as compute increases. Moreover, treating the two mechanisms separately restricts adaptability in dynamic inference environments. To overcome these limitations, we introduce Unified Inference Scaling (UIS), which unifies model routing and TTS in a single optimization space. Building on this formulation, we propose UniScale, an online framework that models adaptive UIS as a contextual multi-armed bandit problem and learns inference policies via LinUCB. The framework incorporates efficiency-aware learning and cost modeling to ensure stable and scalable optimization over high-dimensional action spaces. Evaluation shows that UniScale effectively exploits the synergy in the UIS space to deliver a fine-grained and consistently better quality-cost trade-off across diverse, dynamic inference scenarios.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Unified Inference Scaling (UIS)框架，将模型路由和测试时缩放（TTS）统一优化，并基于此构建UniScale在线系统，使用LinUCB求解上下文多臂赌博机问题。摘要指出UniScale能在动态推理场景中实现更细致的质量-成本权衡。
Motivation: 现有方法将模型路由和TTS视为独立维度，路由只能提供粗粒度的离散性能变化，单模型TTS遇到容量上限且收益递减，两者分离限制了动态环境的适应性。
Method: 将模型路由和TTS统一到单一优化空间，建模为上下文多臂赌博机问题，使用LinUCB在线学习推理策略，并引入效率感知学习和成本建模以稳定高维动作空间的优化。
Result: 摘要说明UniScale有效利用UIS空间的协同效应，在各种动态推理场景中实现更细粒度且一致更优的质量-成本权衡。
Conclusion: 摘要强调统一路由和TTS的方式能突破现有独立设计的局限，使得模型在动态环境中自适应调整。

papers.title: Zero Collapse: A Failure Mode of Policy Gradient Methods in Discontinuous Reward Environments
papers.abstract_en: Bidding in repeated auctions is a central challenge for reinforcement learning (RL), combining continuous control with the strategic complexities of digital advertising. While policy gradient and value-based methods seem well-suited for these settings, they often struggle with the discontinuous, "cliff-like" nature of auction reward landscapes. In a first-price auction, for example, a bidder receives zero reward until they cross a specific threshold, after which the reward decreases as the bid increases. This creates a landscape of flat, zero-reward regions separated by sharp boundaries. We identify a fundamental failure mode in this setting termed "zero collapse." We show that stochastic exploration and gradient-based updates can cause policies to overshoot optimal high-reward regions and enter flat, zero-reward regimes. Once there, the lack of an informative gradient signal makes recovery extremely sample-inefficient, effectively trapping the agent. We find that actor-critic methods are particularly susceptible, as biased value estimates can accelerate this movement toward unstable regions. Our contributions include: (1) a mechanistic explanation of how discontinuous rewards lead to vanishing signals and zero collapse; (2) an analysis of the interaction between policy stochasticity and step size; and (3) an empirical demonstration of this phenomenon across REINFORCE and actor-critic variants. We propose practical mitigation strategies involving initialization and architectural choices to improve stability. Finally, we introduce a formal RL framework for auction environments highlighting their unique structural properties.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究重复拍卖竞价中策略梯度方法的失败模式，称为“零塌陷”。由于拍卖奖励函数不连续（如第一价格拍卖中，低于阈值奖励为零，高于阈值奖励随出价增加而下降），随机探索和梯度更新导致策略跳出高奖励区域并陷入平坦的零奖励区域，难以恢复。作者分析了机制，并在REINFORCE和actor-critic变体上进行了实证演示。
Motivation: 拍卖环境中的奖励函数不连续，存在陡峭的边界和平坦零奖励区域，导致策略梯度方法性能不佳。本文试图解释这种失败模式。
Method: 通过理论分析和实验，展示策略随机性和步长如何导致零塌陷，并提出初始化与架构方面的缓解策略。
Result: 发现actor-critic方法尤其易受影响，因为偏差值估计加速向不稳定区域移动。
Conclusion: 识别并分析了零塌陷故障模式，提出了缓解策略，并引入了拍卖环境的形式化RL框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SteerFace: Debiasing Synthetic Face Generation via Adaptive Residue Perturbation
papers.abstract_en: The shortage of legally compliant data for face recognition training has sparked growing interest in using synthetic data as an alternative. While recent diffusion-based methods enable the generation of photorealistic face images with strong identity adherence and data diversity, their downstream recognition performance still exhibits a significant synthetic-real gap. This paper identifies visual tendency as a previously underexplored limitation, whereby synthetic data exhibit an unrealistic prevalence of visual attributes and thus deviate from the real-data distribution. Visual tendency can be attributed to the generator's conditioning on identity embeddings, through which co-occurring residual visual cues are unintentionally absorbed into learned identity semantics. To discourage the generator from exploiting such visual cues, this paper proposes SteerFace, a simple and efficient training framework that perturbs identity embeddings by steering them toward random orthogonal directions on the embedding hypersphere. The perturbation serves as an identity-preserving regularizer that penalizes the generator's reliance on non-identity components, as supported by theoretical analysis. This paper further introduces an adaptive strategy that learns perturbation strengths with both sample-wise preference and favorable overall statistics. Extensive experiments show that SteerFace effectively mitigates visual tendency, outperforms prior methods in downstream face recognition, and generalizes well across different training datasets and generation pipelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对合成人脸数据中的视觉倾向性（visual tendency）问题——即生成图像中视觉属性分布偏离真实数据——提出 SteerFace 框架。该方法通过在身份嵌入（identity embedding）上施加指向超球面随机正交方向的扰动，作为身份保持的正则项，惩罚生成器对非身份视觉线索的依赖。理论分析支持其有效性，自适应策略学习样本级扰动强度。实验表明 SteerFace 能有效缓解视觉倾向性，在多个数据集和生成流程上提升下游人脸识别性能。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型生成的人脸数据虽具身份一致性和多样性，但下游识别仍存在显著的真实-合成差距。本文首次将视觉倾向性（visual tendency）识别为该差距的未被充分探索的原因，即合成数据中视觉属性分布不自然地偏离真实分布。
Method: 提出 SteerFace：在训练时对身份嵌入进行自适应残差扰动，将其向超球面上的随机正交方向推动。扰动作为身份保持的正则项，通过理论分析证明其能减少生成器对非身份视觉线索的利用。同时引入自适应策略，根据样本特性学习扰动强度。
Result: 实验表明 SteerFace 有效缓解视觉倾向性，在多个训练数据集和生成流程上，下游人脸识别性能超过先前方法。
Conclusion: 本文证明通过在身份嵌入上施加正交方向扰动可有效去偏合成人脸生成，且自适应策略进一步提升了效果。该方法简单高效，通用性强。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对合成人脸数据中的视觉倾向性（visual tendency）问题——即生成图像中视觉属性分布偏离真实数据——提出 SteerFace 框架。该方法通过在身份嵌入（identity embedding）上施加指向超球面随机正交方向的扰动，作为身份保持的正则项，惩罚生成器对非身份视觉线索的依赖。理论分析支持其有效性，自适应策略学习样本级扰动强度。实验表明 SteerFace 能有效缓解视觉倾向性，在多个数据集和生成流程上提升下游人脸识别性能。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有扩散模型生成的人脸数据虽具身份一致性和多样性，但下游识别仍存在显著的真实-合成差距。本文首次将视觉倾向性（visual tendency）识别为该差距的未被充分探索的原因，即合成数据中视觉属性分布不自然地偏离真实分布。
summary_sections.method: 提出 SteerFace：在训练时对身份嵌入进行自适应残差扰动，将其向超球面上的随机正交方向推动。扰动作为身份保持的正则项，通过理论分析证明其能减少生成器对非身份视觉线索的利用。同时引入自适应策略，根据样本特性学习扰动强度。
summary_sections.result: 实验表明 SteerFace 有效缓解视觉倾向性，在多个训练数据集和生成流程上，下游人脸识别性能超过先前方法。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文证明通过在身份嵌入上施加正交方向扰动可有效去偏合成人脸生成，且自适应策略进一步提升了效果。该方法简单高效，通用性强。

papers.title: Foundation VAEs for 3D CT Reconstruction, Augmentation, and Generation
papers.abstract_en: Variational autoencoders (VAEs) compress high resolution CT volumes into compact latents while preserving clinically relevant structure. However, training CT-specific VAEs from scratch or heavily fine-tuning them incurs substantial computational and engineering cost, and often degrades under heterogeneous scanners, protocols, and diseases. This paper makes a progressive stride toward training-free medical VAEs by leveraging a critical observation: a single Foundation VAE, pretrained at scale on natural images and videos, can serve as a unified interface for CT Reconstruction, Augmentation, and Generation. With both encoder and decoder frozen, the Foundation VAE reconstructs CT volumes with preserved anatomy while suppressing acquisition noise; training segmentation models on these reconstructions improves surface accuracy by 3.9% NSD on average for pancreatic tumor and lung tumor. Within the same Foundation VAE latent space, a conditional latent diffusion model achieves 3.9% lower average FVD with 36.2% higher CT CLIP score, and improves multi-disease generation faithfulness across 18 types by 2.76% AUC. These results demonstrate Foundation VAEs as a practical interface for scalable CT representation reuse and faithful CT generation. Our code and demo are available at https://github.com/qic999/Foundation-VAE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现一个在自然图像和视频上预训练的Foundation VAE，无需微调即可作为CT重建、增强和生成的统一接口。冻结编码器和解码器后，该VAE能重建CT体积并保留解剖结构、抑制噪声；在其潜空间中，条件潜扩散模型在CT生成上取得更好效果。
Motivation: 从头训练或微调CT专用VAE计算成本高，且在不同扫描仪、协议和疾病下性能退化。需要一个无需训练的通用CT表示方法。
Method: 利用在自然图像和视频上大规模预训练的Foundation VAE，保持编码器和解码器冻结，直接用于CT重建；并在其潜空间中训练条件潜扩散模型进行生成。
Result: 在胰腺肿瘤和肺肿瘤分割任务中，使用重建CT训练的分割模型表面精度平均提升3.9% NSD；条件潜扩散模型在CT生成上FVD降低3.9%，CT CLIP分数提高36.2%，多疾病生成忠实度（18种）AUC提升2.76%。
Conclusion: Foundation VAE可作为可扩展的CT表示复用和忠实生成的实用接口，无需领域微调。

papers.title: Bandwidth Allocation with Device Partitioning for Federated Learning over Industrial IoT networks
papers.abstract_en: We consider a federated learning (FL) system in which Industrial Internet-of-Things (IIoT) devices collaboratively train a global model over wireless channels without sharing local data. In such systems, communication time is a primary bottleneck that constrains overall training efficiency. Unlike conventional networks that prioritize individual quality-of-service requirements, FL systems collectively aim to converge to an optimal global model as efficiently as possible, which calls for a fundamentally different approach to bandwidth allocation. In this paper, we propose a novel bandwidth allocation policy that exploits the heterogeneity of device computing capabilities to minimize total training time. Rather than distributing bandwidth among all selected devices simultaneously, the proposed policy partitions the participating devices into ordered subsets and sequentially grants each subset exclusive access to the full bandwidth. We formally prove that this partitioning-based policy achieves a strictly lower training time than any bandwidth allocation scheme without partitioning, irrespective of the underlying scheduling algorithm. Furthermore, by reducing per-device transmission duration, the proposed policy also minimizes uplink energy consumption, which is particularly beneficial for battery-constrained IIoT devices. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets - including GC10-Det, an industrial surface defect benchmark, and CIFAR-10, a standard image classification benchmark - demonstrate that the proposed policy consistently reduces training time and energy consumption compared to existing bandwidth allocation schemes, approaching the theoretical lower bound on round time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对工业物联网（IIoT）中联邦学习（FL）的通信瓶颈，提出一种基于设备分区的带宽分配策略，将参与设备按计算能力异构性划分为有序子集，每个子集依次独占全部带宽，从而最小化总训练时间。理论证明该策略在任意调度算法下均严格优于无分区方案，并降低上行能耗。在GC10-Det和CIFAR-10数据集上的实验表明，该方法持续降低训练时间和能量消耗，接近轮次时间理论下界。
Motivation: 联邦学习在工业物联网中通信时间成为主要瓶颈，传统带宽分配注重个体服务质量，而FL需要全局高效收敛，亟需针对FL特性的新分配方法。
Method: 提出将参与设备按计算能力排序并划分为有序子集，每个子集独占全部带宽依次进行上行传输，理论证明该分区策略的训练时间严格低于任意无分区方案。
Result: 在GC10-Det和CIFAR-10数据集上，所提策略持续降低训练时间和能量消耗，接近轮次时间理论下界。
Conclusion: 设备分区带宽分配在联邦学习中严格优于传统方案，对电池受限的IIoT设备特别有益。

papers.title: MLIPilot: LLM-Driven Auto-Research for Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials
papers.abstract_en: Constructing production-quality machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) requires balancing accuracy, dynamical stability, and computational throughput under constraints that are not captured by a single training loss. We introduce MLIPilot, an auto-research framework in which tool-calling large language models propose hypotheses, edit MLIP training code, launch HPC jobs, and accept or revert changes using a fixed, physically constrained scorecard. We evaluate MLIPilot on MACE potential optimization using both commercial and open-weight LLM agents, including GPT-5.5, GPT-4.1, Mistral-24B, and Qwen3-32B. The benchmarks span molecular and periodic settings: a QM7-derived dataset for which we generated B3LYP/6-31G(d) energies and forces, and a Cu EMT dataset with periodic copper supercells labeled by ASE's Effective Medium Theory calculator. Across these benchmarks, the strongest agents move initially constraint-violating baselines to accepted models by discovering useful training strategies, including output normalization, loss-function changes, progressive training schedules, and model-capacity adjustments. These results suggest that LLM agents can serve as autonomous operators for scientific machine-learning workflows when their search is constrained by domain-specific validation criteria, shifting part of MLIP development from manual trial-and-error toward auditable, automated experimentation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MLIPilot，一个利用大语言模型（LLM）自动优化机器学习原子间势（MLIP）的框架。该框架通过 LLM 自主修改训练代码、提交 HPC 任务并基于物理约束的评分卡接受或回退修改。在 MACE 势优化任务中，使用 GPT-5.5、GPT-4.1 等模型在 QM7 和 Cu EMT 数据集上测试，展示了从违反约束的基线到可接受模型的自动改进。
Motivation: 构建生产级 MLIP 需要在精度、动力学稳定性和计算吞吐量之间平衡，但这些约束无法被单一训练损失捕捉，传统手动试错效率低。
Method: 提出 MLIPilot 框架，集成工具调用型 LLM 作为智能体，使其能提出假设、编辑训练代码、启动 HPC 任务，并通过固定物理约束评分卡决定是否接受修改。
Result: 最强的 LLM 智能体（如 GPT-5.5）能够通过有用的训练策略（如输出归一化、损失函数更改、渐进训练调度、模型容量调整）将初始违反约束的基线模型改进为可接受模型。
Conclusion: LLM 智能体可以成为科学机器学习工作流的自主操作者，当搜索受领域特定验证标准约束时，能将 MLIP 开发从手动试错转向可审计的自动化实验。

papers.title: GUI-C$^2$: Coarse-to-Fine GUI Grounding via Difficulty-Aware Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Existing agentic reinforcement learning methods for GUI grounding have limitations at two levels. At the data level, current approaches typically treat all training samples equally, although their training value to the baseline model varies with difficulty. Overlooking this can greatly reduce training efficiency or even cause collapse. At the strategy level, existing frameworks struggle to balance the trade-off between cropping larger regions for sufficient context and smaller ones for reduced redundancy, a tension inherent to tool-augmented grounding agents. In addition, overly complex decision-making is difficult for small-parameter models and significantly increases inference time. To address these issues, at the data level, we propose GUI-D, a data mining and difficulty scoring pipeline that identifies the training-worthy samples by proper testing and assigns difficulty scores to guide subsequent training weights. At the strategy level, we propose GUI-C$^2$, which employs an area-gated coarse-to-fine refinement mechanism that progressively narrows the visual field via model-internal uncertainty signals, adaptively reserving context for large targets while amplifying precision for small ones, reinforced by improvement-aware stage rewards that ensure each refinement genuinely advances grounding. Meanwhile, we simplify the decision-making process to greatly reduce additional inference time. Finally, extensive experiments show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance. The code and data will be publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对GUI grounding任务中现有强化学习方法在数据层面忽视样本难度差异、策略层面难以平衡区域大小与冗余的问题，提出了GUI-D数据挖掘与难度评分管道和GUI-C²粗到细精化机制。GUI-D通过测试识别有价值的样本并赋予难度权重，GUI-C²利用区域门控和不确定性信号逐步缩小视野，配合改进感知的阶段奖励提升精度。实验表明该方法达到SOTA性能。
Motivation: 现有代理强化学习方法在GUI grounding上存在两个局限：数据层面，所有样本被平等对待，忽略了不同难度的训练价值差异，导致效率低甚至崩溃；策略层面，工具增强的接地代理难以在裁剪大区域（充分上下文）和小区域（减少冗余）之间权衡，且复杂决策对小模型困难且耗时。
Method: 数据层提出GUI-D，包含数据挖掘与难度评分管道，通过适当测试识别值得训练的样本并分配难度分数以指导后续训练权重。策略层提出GUI-C²，采用区域门控的从粗到细精化机制，通过模型内部不确定性信号逐步缩小视野，自适应保留大目标上下文并增强小目标精度，辅以改进感知的阶段奖励确保每次精化有效。同时简化决策过程以降低推理时间。
Result: 大量实验表明该方法达到了SOTA性能。
Conclusion: 论文提出的数据级和策略级改进有效解决了GUI grounding中的关键难题，并计划公开代码和数据以促进后续研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PatchWorld: Gradient-Free Optimization of Executable World Models
papers.abstract_en: Text-agent environments are typically modeled as partially observable Markov decision processes (POMDPs), assuming that the simulator's latent state and transition dynamics are hidden from the agent. Yet little work has examined whether executable code can be induced to serve as a world model for prediction and planning under partial observability. We introduce PatchWorld, a gradient-free framework that turns offline trajectories into executable Python world models through counterexample-guided code repair. Instead of predicting the next observation with a black-box model, PatchWorld induces symbolic belief-state programs whose action updates can be inspected, replayed, and locally patched. Across seven AgentGym environments, PatchWorld-Simple achieves the highest code-based planning score among evaluated methods, reaching 76.4\% macro success in live one-step lookahead while invoking no LLM calls inside the world-model prediction module itself. We further find that a human-specified residual-memory bias improves surface observation fidelity but weakens decision utility. This exposes a tradeoff in executable world models, since improving observation fidelity can come at the expense of action-discriminative dynamics, and vice versa. Code is available at https://github.com/HKBU-KnowComp/PatchWorld.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PatchWorld框架，将离线轨迹转化为可执行的Python世界模型，通过反例引导的代码修复实现，无需梯度。在七个AgentGym环境中，PatchWorld-Simple达到最高代码规划得分，宏成功率为76.4%，且世界模型预测模块不调用LLM。摘要还揭示了一个权衡：人类指定的残差记忆偏差提高了表面观测保真度但降低了决策效用。
Motivation: 现有文本智能体环境通常建模为POMDP，但很少探索是否可诱导可执行代码作为世界模型进行预测和规划。
Method: 提出梯度自由的PatchWorld框架，通过反例引导的代码修复，将离线轨迹转化为可执行的Python世界模型。诱导符号信念状态程序，其动作更新可检查、重放和本地修补。
Result: 在七个AgentGym环境中，PatchWorld-Simple达到最高代码规划分，宏成功率为76.4%，且世界模型预测模块不调用LLM。
Conclusion: 摘要指出可执行世界模型中存在权衡：提高观测保真度可能牺牲动作判别动力学，反之亦然。

papers.title: Federated Variational Preference Alignment with Gumbel-Softmax Prior for Personalized User Preferences
papers.abstract_en: Federated Learning (FL) offers a privacy-preserving pathway for aligning Large Language Models (LLMs); however, existing frameworks typically enforce a monolithic reward model, inevitably averaging out inherently conflicting user preferences (e.g., helpfulness vs. harmlessness). While Variational Preference Learning (VPL) offers a pathway to personalization, adapting it to decentralized settings presents a fundamental challenge: posterior collapse driven by severe local data scarcity and heterogeneity. In this paper, we propose Federated Variational Preference Alignment with Gumbel-Softmax Prior (FedVPA-GP), a framework designed to disentangle diverse preferences without compromising privacy. To stabilize variational inference, we introduce a Federated Mixture Prior that enables clients to leverage the aggregate population distribution as a dynamic prior. Furthermore, we incorporate an Orthogonal Loss that explicitly enforces the separation of preference prototypes in the latent space. Experiments on the HH-RLHF dataset demonstrate that FedVPA-GP significantly outperforms monolithic baselines, successfully disentangling conflicting user intents and enabling dynamic preference switching.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对联邦学习中单一奖励模型平均化用户冲突偏好的问题，提出FedVPA-GP框架。该框架利用Gumbel-Softmax先验和联邦混合先验稳定变分推理，并引入正交损失强制分离偏好原型。在HH-RLHF数据集上，该方法显著优于单一基线，成功解耦冲突意图并支持动态偏好切换。
Motivation: 现有联邦学习对齐LLM的方法使用单一奖励模型，导致不同用户的冲突偏好（如有用性与无害性）被平均化；而变分偏好学习在去中心化场景中因本地数据稀疏和异构性面临后验坍塌。
Method: 提出FedVPA-GP框架，包括：1) 联邦混合先验，使客户端利用全局聚合分布作为动态先验；2) 正交损失，在隐空间中强制分离偏好原型。
Result: 在HH-RLHF数据集上，FedVPA-GP大幅超越单一基线，成功解耦冲突用户意图并实现动态偏好切换。
Conclusion: FedVPA-GP在保护隐私的同时实现了个性化偏好对齐，证明了联邦混合先验和正交损失的有效性。

papers.title: Generative Quantum Data Embeddings for Supervised Learning
papers.abstract_en: Many practically relevant applications of quantum machine learning involve classical data, for which performance depends critically on how inputs are embedded into quantum states. Yet the use of a fixed embedding circuit ansatz remains standard practice. We propose an energy-based generative learning framework that synthesizes gate sequences to optimize embedding structures and refine data-tailored parameters, using a fidelity-based surrogate objective to guide the search toward improved class distinguishability. Empirically, the method improves classification performance across diverse settings, while also revealing datasets where architecture search within the present embedding family yields only limited additional gains. We explain this saturation by deriving bounds on the achievable empirical risk in terms of the Wasserstein distance in the input space, showing that classical data geometry provides an \emph{a priori} diagnostic for regimes in which substantial gains from embedding optimization are unlikely. The results establish a practically useful and theoretically motivated framework for searching effective quantum data embeddings through generative optimization, with the attainable gains diagnosed through the geometry of the underlying classical data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于能量的生成式学习框架，用于优化监督学习中经典数据嵌入到量子态的方式。通过保真度替代目标搜索门序列，提高类别可分性。实验表明该方法在不同设置下提升分类性能，但在某些数据集上架构搜索的增益有限。论文通过Wasserstein距离推导经验风险边界，解释了嵌入优化收益饱和的原因，为基于经典数据几何的有效量子数据嵌入搜索提供了理论和实用框架。
Motivation: 量子机器学习中经典数据嵌入到量子态的方式对性能至关重要，但固定嵌入电路结构仍是标准做法，缺乏针对数据的优化框架。
Method: 提出能量基生成学习框架，使用保真度替代目标（fidelity-based surrogate objective）指导门序列搜索，优化嵌入结构和参数，以提高类别区分度。
Result: 该方法在多种分类任务中提升性能，同时发现某些数据集上嵌入家族内架构搜索的额外增益有限；通过Wasserstein距离推导经验风险边界，揭示经典数据几何可预先诊断嵌入优化收益是否显著。
Conclusion: 建立了一个实用且有理论依据的生成式优化框架用于搜索有效量子数据嵌入，并通过经典数据几何诊断可获得的增益。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GlucoFM: A Dual-Stream Foundation Model for Continuous Glucose Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: Continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) provides a dense view of daily metabolic physiology, yet existing generic time-series and CGM-specific foundation models often encode glucose traces as entangled single-stream sequences, leaving the distinct temporal structure of glycemic dynamics only implicitly modeled. We present GlucoFM, a lightweight CGM foundation model that aligns irregular recordings to a 24-hour chronological grid, preserves observation masks, and decomposes glucose dynamics into slow physiological state and transient event streams, capturing low-frequency glycemic baselines and short-term deviations that may reflect acute physiological responses or sensor artifacts. GlucoFM is pretrained on 109,066 hours of unlabeled CGM recordings from 477 subjects with two complementary objectives: masked contextual latent prediction over fused daily representations and temporal dynamics prediction over state and event streams. Across four diverse cohorts and seven clinical prediction tasks, GlucoFM achieves the strongest subject-disjoint linear-probing performance among evaluated baselines, improving average PR-AUC by 4.1 points over the best CGM-specific foundation model. Its gains are most pronounced on core metabolic outcomes, leading PR-AUC on all diabetes-risk and $β$-cell dysfunction tasks and on 3 of 4 insulin-resistance tasks. GlucoFM also achieves the best overall cross-dataset transfer performance and strong few-shot adaptation among evaluated methods, and consistent gains when aggregating multiple days for subject-level prediction, highlighting physiology-aware decomposition as an effective inductive bias for transferable CGM representation learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GlucoFM，一个轻量级连续血糖监测（CGM）基础模型，将不规则记录对齐到24小时网格，并通过双流分解分别建模慢速生理状态和快速事件流。模型在109,066小时无标签数据上预训练，使用掩码上下文预测和时序动态预测两个目标。在四个队列、七个临床任务中，GlucoFM 的线性探测性能优于现有基础模型，平均 PR-AUC 提升4.1个点，尤其在糖尿病风险和β细胞功能障碍任务上表现突出。
Motivation: 现有通用时间序列和CGM基础模型常将血糖数据编码为纠缠的单流序列，未能显式利用血糖动态的不同时间尺度结构，限制了表示的可迁移性。
Method: GlucoFM 将CGM数据对齐到24小时时间网格并保留观测掩码，将动态分解为慢速生理状态流和快速事件流，分别建模血糖基线和短期偏差。预训练采用掩码上下文潜在预测和状态-事件流时序预测两个互补目标。
Result: 在四个不同队列、七个临床任务上，GlucoFM 取得了最佳线性探测性能，平均 PR-AUC 比最强CGM基础模型高4.1个点；在所有糖尿病风险及β细胞功能障碍任务上 PR-AUC 领先，并在3/4的胰岛素抵抗任务上领先；同时具有最佳的跨数据集迁移和少样本适应能力。
Conclusion: 论文强调，生理感知的双流分解为可迁移的CGM表示学习提供了有效的归纳偏置。

papers.title: DSD-GS: Dynamic-Static Decomposition of Gaussian Splatting for Efficient and High-Fidelity Dynamic Scene Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic scene reconstruction and novel view synthesis are fundamental to next-generation visual intelligence applications such as virtual reality, robotics, and digital twins. However, high-fidelity reconstruction of complex, time-varying scenes from arbitrary viewpoints remains a significant challenge. Existing dynamic 3DGS methods suffer from computational inefficiency, since they model all Gaussians as dynamic components. While recent decomposition-based approaches address this issue, they still struggle with degraded reconstruction quality and prolonged training time. To mitigate these limitations, we propose a novel dynamic reconstruction framework built upon an efficient static-dynamic decomposition strategy using a Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting encoder and an optical flow model. By eliminating redundant computations on static regions, our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming existing baselines across rendering quality, training and rendering speed, and storage efficiency. Notably, on the Neural 3D dataset, our framework requires only 10 minutes for training and achieves a rendering speed of over 700 FPS on a single NVIDIA RTX 5090 GPU at resolution of 1352x1014. Furthermore, our decomposition strategy eliminates the need for COLMAP preprocessing and enables deterministic initialization, thereby enhancing both efficiency and reproducibility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DSD-GS，一种基于静态-动态分解的高斯点云渲染方法，用于高效高质量动态场景重建。使用前馈高斯点云编码器和光流模型，通过消除静态区域的冗余计算，在Neural 3D数据集上仅需10分钟训练，渲染速度超过700 FPS，且无需COLMAP预处理。
Motivation: 现有动态3DGS方法将所有高斯建模为动态组件导致计算效率低，而分解类方法重建质量差且训练时间长。
Method: 提出基于前馈高斯点云编码器和光流模型的静态-动态分解策略，消除静态区域冗余计算。
Result: 在Neural 3D数据集上，训练仅需10分钟，渲染速度超过700 FPS（单张RTX 5090，分辨率1352×1014），达到SOTA渲染质量、训练/渲染速度和存储效率。
Conclusion: 分解策略无需COLMAP预处理，实现确定性初始化，提升效率和可重复性。

papers.title: Sophrosyne: Agentic Exploration of Relational Data Systems Needs Moderation
papers.abstract_en: Text2SQL agents powered by LLMs translate natural language intent into SQL by exploring the data system through tool calls before formulating the query. However, to ensure secure and scoped access, data systems construct environments with explicit API surfaces. We study and categorize these APIs exposed today as either coarse-grained or fine-grained and posit that choosing between them presents a fundamental tradeoff between cost-efficient exploration and accurate SQL generation. Most data systems expose fine-grained APIs, but this inadvertently disadvantages agents: they over-explore, incorporating irrelevant schema elements into their query formulation and produce inaccurate results. We argue that curbing over-exploration is key to the effective use of these API surfaces, and propose Sophrosyne, a data system environment that augments API responses with directives that guide the agent's exploration process. Initial results show that directives reduce over-exploration by 4.6x and boost accuracy by up to 12.4% (approx. 4 percentage points).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究Text2SQL代理在关系数据系统中的探索行为，指出细粒度API会导致过度探索和查询不准确，提出Sophrosyne系统通过向API响应添加指令来引导代理探索，初始结果表明可减少4.6倍过度探索并提升最多12.4%准确率。
Motivation: 现有数据系统为安全访问提供显式API，但细粒度API导致LLM驱动的Text2SQL代理过度探索无关模式，影响查询准确性。需要在探索效率和SQL生成准确性之间取得平衡。
Method: 提出Sophrosyne，一个数据系统环境，通过向API响应添加指导性指令来约束代理的探索过程，减少无关模式纳入。
Result: 初始实验显示，Sophrosyne将过度探索降低4.6倍，准确率提升最高12.4%（约4个百分点）。
Conclusion: 通过API响应中的指令引导代理探索是提升Text2SQL代理准确性和效率的有效途径，但结果尚属初步。

papers.title: Distilling LLM Feedback for Lean Theorem Proving
papers.abstract_en: Post-training for reasoning models typically combines supervised fine-tuning with reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards, most commonly with GRPO. However, this algorithm suffers from sparse rewards, limited exploration, and mode collapse. Building upon recent works on self-distillation, we propose Feedback Distillation, a training method where the model is trained to match, at the token level, its own distribution conditioned on privileged feedback produced by a language model. Feedback Distillation offers token-level supervision and can inject external knowledge. Evaluating our method for Lean4 theorem-proving, we find that Feedback Distillation maintains greater diversity in generated trajectories than GRPO, yielding higher policy entropy and better pass@k scaling. The two methods are complementary: initializing GRPO from a Feedback Distillation checkpoint outperforms either method alone. All in all, our results suggest a promising avenue to improve post-training for complex reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出反馈蒸馏（Feedback Distillation）方法，用于训练推理模型，通过在token级别匹配模型自身分布和语言模型提供的特权反馈，解决GRPO存在的稀疏奖励、探索不足和模式崩溃问题。在Lean4定理证明任务上，该方法比GRPO保持更高的生成多样性，且两者互补。
Motivation: GRPO等后训练算法存在稀疏奖励、有限探索和模式崩溃问题，需要改进训练方法以提升复杂推理任务性能。
Method: 反馈蒸馏：训练模型在token级别匹配其自身分布与由语言模型提供的特权反馈（privileged feedback）所定义的条件分布，提供token级监督并注入外部知识。
Result: 在Lean4定理证明中，反馈蒸馏相比GRPO维持更高的策略熵和更好的pass@k缩放，生成轨迹多样性更优；用反馈蒸馏检查点初始化GRPO优于任意单一方法。
Conclusion: 反馈蒸馏为复杂推理的后训练提供了有前景的改进方向，与GRPO互补。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Bayesian Inference with Shaped Deep Non-linear MLPs
papers.abstract_en: A central aim of deep learning theory is to characterize how neural networks make predictions in the regime of simultaneously large model and training set size. Since the limits of diverging number of model parameters and dataset size do not commute it is not clear a priori what limits exist. In this work, we shed new light on these questions by studying Bayesian inference in deep non-linear MLPs in the regime where the number of training samples ($P$), the input dimension ($N_0$), the hidden layer width ($N$), and the number of hidden layers ($L$) can all be large. We build on the Neural Covariance SDE (Li et al., 2022) to analyze predictive posteriors in the regime where $LP/N\inΘ(1)$, playing the role of an effective network depth. Our framework covers both smooth and ReLU activation functions and applies to arbitrary temperature. We find to first order in $LP/N$ a simple criterion for which data generating processes benefit from depth in the sense that larger $LP/N$ increases the Bayesian model evidence. We also give a novel derivation of a prior result from the physics literature that at least to first order in $LP/N$, the Bayesian predictive posterior is remarkably simple and is simply equivalent to that of a data-dependent kernel method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究深度非线性MLP在模型参数和训练集大小同时很大时的贝叶斯推断。通过构建神经协方差SDE，分析了大规模极限下的预测后验，发现有效网络深度由LP/N刻画，并给出了深度有益的数据生成过程判据，以及贝叶斯预测后验等价于数据依赖核方法的结论。
Motivation: 深度学习理论的核心问题之一是表征神经网络在大模型和大训练集下的预测方式。由于参数数量和数据集大小发散极限不交换，先验极限不明确，本文旨在阐明这些问题。
Method: 基于神经协方差SDE (Li et al., 2022)，分析深度非线性MLP在LP/N∈Θ(1)（有效网络深度）区域中的预测后验。覆盖平滑和ReLU激活函数，适用于任意温度。
Result: 在一阶近似下，发现如果数据生成过程满足特定简单判据，则更大的LP/N（即更大有效深度）会增加贝叶斯模型证据。此外，贝叶斯预测后验在一阶近似下等价于数据依赖的核方法。
Conclusion: 本文给出了深度有益的条件，并揭示了贝叶斯推断下深度MLP的预测后验与核方法的等价性，为理解深度网络的大规模行为提供了新视角。

papers.title: DARTS: Distribution-Aware Active Rollout Trajectory Shaping for Accelerating LLM Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has become pivotal for improving model capabilities yet suffers from rollout efficiency bottlenecks due to the long-tail response length distribution. While existing works mitigate the impact of long tails via prompt-level tail scheduling, we focus on the root source of inefficiency: the distribution itself. Specifically, we characterize the long-tail distribution at a finer granularity, identifying intra-prompt long tails, and revealing that they frequently consist of ineffective verbosity. To address this, we propose a novel paradigm of active distribution shaping to shape the rollout distribution towards conciseness and certainty, thereby fundamentally resolving tail-induced overheads. We achieve this through a distribution-aware trajectory sampling mechanism, which selects trajectories from a redundant exploration space for each prompt, and an adaptive redundancy allocation scheme to maximize both shaping effectiveness and system efficiency. Experiments demonstrate significant acceleration over state-of-the-art systems by up to 1.77x without compromising model performance.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 14 figures, 5 tables. Accepted to ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 LLM 强化学习中 rollout 效率瓶颈问题，指出长尾响应长度分布的根本来源是 intra-prompt 长尾（即冗余废话），而非仅 prompt 级分布。提出主动分布塑造（active distribution shaping）范式，通过分布感知轨迹采样和自适应冗余分配，将 rollout 分布向简洁和确定方向塑造。实验表明，该方法相比最先进系统加速高达 1.77 倍，且不牺牲模型性能。
Motivation: LLM 强化学习中 rollout 效率受长尾响应长度分布严重制约，现有方法仅从 prompt 级尾部调度缓解，未能解决分布本身导致的开销。
Method: 提出分布感知轨迹采样机制，从每个 prompt 的冗余探索空间中选择轨迹；结合自适应冗余分配方案，最大化塑造效果和系统效率。
Result: 在标准基准上，相比最先进系统实现高达 1.77 倍加速，且模型性能保持稳定。
Conclusion: 主动塑造 rollout 分布（向简洁和确定方向）可从根本上消除长尾带来的开销，是提升 LLM 强化学习系统效率的有效新范式。

papers.title: ForecastCompass: Guiding Agentic Forecasting with Adaptive Factor Memory
papers.abstract_en: Agentic forecasting is important for decision-making in dynamic environments, but it remains challenging because agents must reason from incomplete, time-limited evidence and produce calibrated probabilities before outcomes are resolved. Memory provides a natural mechanism for transferring experience from resolved forecasts to future prediction tasks. However, existing agent-memory methods are not tailored to forecasting, as they typically store past interactions, reflections, or factual associations without explicitly representing reusable predictive factors or calibration knowledge. We propose ForecastCompass (FoCo), an adaptive factor-based memory framework for agentic forecasting. FoCo organizes forecasting experience with a hierarchical forecasting-task taxonomy, enabling retrieval task-relevant forecasting knowledge. It maintains two complementary memory components: factor memory, which captures reusable predictive dimensions, and reasoning memory, which encodes probability updating, uncertainty handling, and calibration principles. Using retrospective analyses as learning signals, FoCo iteratively revises memory through a verbalized memory-revision procedure, enabling the agent to accumulate transferable forecasting knowledge over time. Experiments on Prophet Arena and FutureX with GPT-5-mini and Gemini-2.5-Flash show that FoCo improves both probabilistic accuracy and calibration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ForecastCompass (FoCo) 是一种基于自适应因子记忆的智能体预测框架，通过分层预测任务分类学组织经验，维护因子记忆和推理记忆两个互补组件，并利用回顾分析通过言语化的记忆修订过程迭代更新记忆，以提升概率预测的准确性和校准度。在 Prophet Arena 和 FutureX 基准上使用 GPT-5-mini 和 Gemini-2.5-Flash 的实验表明，FoCo 改善了概率精度和校准。
Motivation: 现有智能体记忆方法未针对预测任务定制，通常存储过去交互或事实关联，缺乏可复用的预测因子表示或校准知识，导致在动态环境中基于不完整时间证据进行校准概率预测的挑战。
Method: 提出 ForecastCompass (FoCo)，一个自适应因子记忆框架，包含：分层预测任务分类学用于检索相关预测知识；因子记忆捕获可复用的预测维度；推理记忆编码概率更新、不确定性处理和校准原则；通过回顾分析作为学习信号，使用言语化的记忆修订过程迭代更新记忆。
Result: 在 Prophet Arena 和 FutureX 上使用 GPT-5-mini 和 Gemini-2.5-Flash 的实验显示，FoCo 提高了概率预测的准确性和校准度。
Conclusion: FoCo 通过组织预测经验和自适应记忆修订，使智能体能随时间积累可迁移的预测知识，提升预测性能。

papers.title: Robust Dreamer: Deviation-Aware Latent Gaussian Memory for Action-Controlled AR Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Frame-wise action-controlled image-to-video generation is a promising paradigm for interactive world simulation, where each control signal should elicit an immediate visual response. However, maintaining visual fidelity and 3D consistency over long autoregressive rollouts remains challenging. Existing 3D-aware methods often suffer from catastrophic drift due to two impediments: information loss from \textit{Latent--RGB Cycling}, where generated latents are repeatedly decoded to RGB and re-encoded for future conditioning, and the training--inference gap induced by the \textit{error-free hypothesis}, where clean training memory fails to match prediction-corrupted inference memory. To address these challenges, we present \textbf{Robust Dreamer}, a memory-augmented framework built around how to design 3D memory and how to use it robustly. First, we introduce \textbf{Latent Gaussian Memory}, which anchors diffusion latents inherited from the generation process to Gaussian primitives and recalls them via latent-space Gaussian splatting. This provides dense, geometry-aware, view-aligned conditioning while avoiding accumulated degradation from repeated VAE conversion. Second, we propose \textbf{Deviation Learning with Dynamic Deviation Archive}, which synthesizes rollout-induced latent deviations through a one-step approximation, stores them by autoregressive stage and denoising timestamp, and injects them into historical memory during training. This exposes the generator to realistic corrupted memory states and teaches internal correction before inference. Experiments on ScanNet, DL3DV, and OmniWorldGame demonstrate state-of-the-art long-horizon performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Robust Dreamer框架，用于动作控制的自回归视频生成，解决长时间生成中的视觉失真和3D不一致问题。通过Latent Gaussian Memory避免Latent-RGB循环中的信息损失，以及Deviation Learning模拟推理时的记忆偏差进行训练。在ScanNet、DL3DV和OmniWorldGame上实现最先进的长时生成性能。
Motivation: 现有动作控制视频生成方法在长自回归过程中存在灾难性漂移，主要由Latent-RGB循环的信息损失和训练-推理记忆不匹配导致。
Method: 提出两个创新：Latent Gaussian Memory，将扩散潜在锚定为高斯原语并通过潜在空间高斯溅射进行召回；Deviation Learning with Dynamic Deviation Archive，通过一步近似合成推理时的潜在偏差并注入训练历史记忆。
Result: 在ScanNet、DL3DV和OmniWorldGame数据集上，该方法在长时生成任务中达到最先进性能。
Conclusion: 该方法通过鲁棒的记忆设计和训练策略有效缓解了自回归视频生成中的漂移问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Safe Equilibrium Policy Optimization for Strategic Agent Policies
papers.abstract_en: Language models fine-tuned with reinforcement learning typically optimize for task reward, ignoring multi-agent strategic structure. Because these agents condition on natural language game-state descriptions and emit actions through free-form generation, strategic failure modes -- exploiting weaker opponents, coordinating on harmful equilibria, and externalizing costs are inseparable from the language interface itself. We propose Safe Equilibrium Policy Optimization (\sepo{}), a training objective that augments expected payoff with explicit penalties for exploitability, collusion risk, and externality cost. We implement \sepo{} as a reward signal for Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), applied to Gemma~4 E4B-it and Qwen~3.5-4B after supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Evaluated across five strategic domains: Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma, repeated auctions, two negotiation variants, and Kuhn Poker. \sepo{} achieves zero exploit-pool advantage in Kuhn Poker for both models, outperforms the base model on safety in four domains, and corrects the over-cooperative behavior introduced by SFT. In negotiation, \sepo{} achieves a positive-safety outcome and only the positive normalized relative advantage of any negotiation configuration. Ablation experiments confirm that per-rollout exploit computation is necessary: a shared constant penalty cancels in GRPO advantage normalization (constant control-variate property), producing zero gradient. To support further research in strategic safety for agents, we release our \href{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/sepo-2668/README.md}{code} and SFT datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对语言模型在多智能体环境中进行强化学习微调时忽略策略结构导致的安全问题，提出Safe Equilibrium Policy Optimization (SEPO)，在期望回报中显式惩罚可剥削性、共谋风险和外部性成本。将SEPO作为GRPO的奖励信号，应用于Gemma 4 E4B-it和Qwen 3.5-4B模型，在迭代囚徒困境、重复拍卖、谈判变体和Kuhn扑克五个策略域中评估。结果显示SEPO在Kuhn扑克中实现零剥削池优势，在四个域中提升安全性，并纠正SFT带来的过度合作行为。
Motivation: 语言模型通过强化学习微调通常仅优化任务回报，忽略多智能体策略结构，导致智能体在自然语言接口中产生利用弱对手、协调有害均衡、外部化成本等失败模式。
Method: 提出SEPO训练目标，在期望回报中加入对可剥削性、共谋风险和外部性成本的显式惩罚，作为GRPO的奖励信号，应用于经过SFT的Gemma 4 E4B-it和Qwen 3.5-4B模型。
Result: SEPO在Kuhn扑克中使两个模型的剥削池优势为零；在五个域中的四个域上安全性优于基模型；纠正了SFT引入的过度合作行为；在谈判中实现正安全结果和唯一正归一化相对优势；消融实验证明逐轨迹剥削计算是必要的。
Conclusion: SEPO通过显式惩罚策略缺陷有效提升多智能体语言模型的安全性，释放了代码和SFT数据集以支持进一步研究。

papers.title: Count Anything
papers.abstract_en: Object counting remains fragmented across domain-specific datasets and task formulations, despite rapid progress in generalist vision models. Existing counting models are often tailored to scenarios such as crowds, vehicles, cells, crops, or remote-sensing objects, and thus struggle to generalize across categories, visual domains, object scales, and density distributions. In this paper, we study text-guided object counting across domains, where a model takes an image and a natural-language query as input and returns an instance-grounded set of target points whose cardinality gives the count. This formulation unifies category-conditioned counting with interpretable spatial localization. To support this setting, we construct CLOC, a Cross-domain Large-scale Object Counting dataset that reorganizes diverse public data sources into a unified benchmark. CLOC covers six visual domains: General Scene, Remote Sensing, Histopathology, Cellular Microscopy, Agriculture, and Microbiology, with about 220K images, 619 categories, and 15M object instances. Based on CLOC, we propose Count Anything, a generalist model for text-guided object counting. Unlike density-map-based methods, which dominate counting models, Count Anything adopts discrete instance points and performs dual-granularity instance enumeration. A Region-level Sparse Counter provides object-level anchors for large and sparse targets, while a Pixel-level Dense Counter handles small, crowded, and weakly bounded targets via dense point prediction. A point-centric supervision strategy enables learning from heterogeneous annotations, and Complementary Count Fusion combines both counters in a parameter-free manner. Extensive experiments show that Count Anything achieves strong accuracy and multi-domain generalization, outperforming existing open-world counting methods. Code is available at: https://github.com/Mengqi-Lei/count-anything.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究文本引导的跨域目标计数，构建了CLOC大规模跨域数据集（涵盖6个视觉领域、约22万图像、619类别、1500万实例），并提出Count Anything通用模型。模型采用双粒度实例枚举（区域级稀疏计数器和像素级密集计数器）和互补计数融合，无需密度图，在跨域泛化上超越现有开放世界计数方法。
Motivation: 现有计数模型局限于特定领域（如人群、车辆、细胞等），难以跨类别、视觉域、目标尺度和密度分布泛化，缺乏统一的文本引导计数方案。
Method: 提出Count Anything，基于离散实例点的双粒度枚举：区域级稀疏计数器提供大而稀疏目标的锚点，像素级密集计数器通过密集点预测处理小、拥挤、弱边界目标；点级监督策略适应异构标注，互补计数融合无参数合并两计数器输出。
Result: 在CLOC基准上，Count Anything在多个视觉域的计数任务中取得强精度，跨域泛化性能优于现有开放世界计数方法。

papers.title: Fine-Tuning Improves Information Conveyance in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning is often believed to reduce uncertainty and diversity in large language models, but existing analyses overlook output length, a key confounder, and therefore fail to capture how uncertainty is distributed across an entire generation rollout. To address this, we propose Canopy Entropy ($\mathrm{CE}^\star$), a measure that views language generation from a tree perspective, where ``canopy'' represents the space of all possible rollouts, making $\mathrm{CE}^\star$ naturally quantify the effective size of the generation space. $\mathrm{CE}^\star$ jointly captures uncertainty in both the output length $N$ and the generated sequence $Y_{1:N}$ -- indeed, we show that it equals to total Shannon entropy $H(N, Y_{1:N}\mid X)$, where $X$ denotes the prompt. This formulation yields interpretable metrics, including a length-entropy correlation term $ρ(N, r_N)$, where $r_N$ is the entropy rate, quantifying information conveyance efficiency by indicating whether longer outputs are more or less informative per token. Empirically, across tasks and model families, we find that fine-tuned models consistently exhibit stronger positive correlation $ρ(N, r_N)$, even when total entropy decreases. Furthermore, after controlling for model family, task, prompt, and output-length effects, we find that fine-tuning nearly triples the correlation strength between entropy rate and semantic diversity, suggesting that aligned models convert token uncertainty into semantic diversity more efficiently. Overall, these results demonstrate that fine-tuning does not simply reduce uncertainty, but fundamentally reorganizes it into more informative and semantically meaningful generations. Our code is available at https://github.com/WeiyiTian/canopy-entropy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Canopy Entropy (CE^*) 度量，从树状生成视角量化语言模型生成空间的有效大小，联合捕捉输出长度和生成序列的不确定性。实验表明微调模型在总熵降低时，长度-熵率相关性更强，且微调几乎使熵率与语义多样性之间的相关性增加三倍，说明微调重组不确定性为更信息丰富的生成。
Motivation: 现有细调分析忽略输出长度作为混杂因素，无法捕捉生成过程中不确定性的分布。
Method: 提出 Canopy Entropy (CE^*) 度量，将语言生成视为树，计算总香农熵 H(N, Y_{1:N}|X)，并引入长度-熵率相关系数 ρ(N, r_N)。
Result: 多个任务和模型上，微调模型表现出更强的正相关 ρ(N, r_N)，且控制模型族、任务、提示和长度效应后，微调使熵率与语义多样性的相关性几乎增加三倍。
Conclusion: 微调并非简单降低不确定性，而是重新组织为更信息丰富、语义有意义的生成。

papers.title: A Lecture Note on Offline RL and IRL, Part II: Foundations of Inverse Reinforcement Learning and Dynamic Discrete Choice Models
papers.abstract_en: In the forward reinforcement-learning problem, the reward is fixed and known; the learner is asked to find a good policy or value function. Here we turn the question around. Given offline data generated by an expert, can we recover the reward the expert was optimizing? This is the inverse reinforcement learning problem, and remarkably, two communities, structural econometricians studying dynamic discrete choice (DDC) and machine learners studying entropy-regularized IRL, have been working on exactly the same probabilistic model under different names. We begin by proving their equivalence. We then develop the classical identification result of Magnac and Thesmar and the classical computational paradigms that grew out of it: Rust's nested fixed-point algorithm, the conditional-choice-probability approach of Hotz and Miller, and the two temporal-difference approaches of Adusumilli and Eckardt: linear semi-gradient TD and approximate value iteration. Each route has its limits: dimensionality, transition-kernel estimation, the deadly triad, or projected fixed-point bias. We then walk through the modern ML/IRL strand: adversarial IRL, occupancy matching, IQ-Learn, and offline ML-IRL, deriving each method's actual objective and stating precisely what it does and does not identify. We close with the empirical-risk-minimization framework of Kang et al., which yields a gradient-based estimator for offline IRL/DDC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是离线强化学习与逆强化学习的讲稿第二部分，重点阐述动态离散选择模型与熵正则化逆强化学习在概率模型上的等价性，并梳理Magnac-Thesmar识别结果、Rust嵌套不动点算法、Hotz-Miller条件选择概率方法以及现代ML/IRL方法（如对抗IRL、占用匹配、IQ-Learn）的理论基础与局限性。
Motivation: 强化学习前向问题中奖励已知，但许多现实场景需要从专家行为推断隐含的奖励函数，逆强化学习问题至关重要。两个领域（计量经济学DDC和机器学习IRL）使用同一模型却缺乏统一认识，本文旨在阐明其联系并系统梳理现有方法。
Method: 证明DDC与熵正则化IRL等价，然后依次介绍Magnac-Thesmar识别条件、Rust嵌套不动点算法、Hotz-Miller条件选择概率方法、Adusumilli和Eckardt的线性半梯度TD与近似值迭代，以及现代ML/IRL中的对抗IRL、占用匹配、IQ-Learn和离线ML-IRL。最后给出Kang等人的经验风险最小化框架。
Result: 本文是讲稿，未报告新实验结果，但系统总结了各方法的识别条件与计算限制，如维度灾难、转移核估计、致命三元组（deadly triad）和投影不动点偏差。
Conclusion: 该讲稿为离线IRL/DDC领域提供了统一的理论视角和全面的方法综述，并指出现有方法在识别性与计算可扩展性之间的权衡。

papers.title: CoMem: Context Management with A Decoupled Long-Context Model
papers.abstract_en: Context management enables agentic models to solve long-horizon tasks through iterative summarization of previous interaction histories. However, this process typically incurs substantial decoding overhead for the extra summarization tokens, which significantly affect the end-to-end response latency at deployment. In this paper, we introduce CoMem, a novel framework that decouples memory management from the primary agent workflow, enabling these processes to execute in parallel. We propose a $k$-step-off asynchronous pipeline that overlaps the memory model's summarization with the agent's inference, effectively masking the latency of context processing. To ensure robustness under this asynchronous setting, we introduce a reward-driven training strategy that aligns the memory model to capture sufficient statistics for the agent's decision-making. Theoretical analysis confirms that CoMem offers a superior efficiency-effectiveness trade-off compared to coupled architectures. Our extensive experimental results on SWE-Bench-Verified show that CoMem provides 1.4x latency improvements upon vanilla long-context solutions while preserving most of the performance. Furthermore, we demonstrate that these latency gains scale favorably with increased system throughput, offering a modular path forward for the independent optimization of agent reasoning and memory compression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoMem 提出了一种将上下文管理（memory management）与主代理工作流解耦的框架，利用 k 步异步流水线使记忆模型的摘要生成与代理推理并行执行，从而掩盖上下文处理的延迟。摘要显示在 SWE-Bench-Verified 上，CoMem 在保留大部分性能的同时实现了 1.4 倍的延迟提升，且延迟优势随吞吐量增加而扩大。
Motivation: 现有上下文管理方法在长周期任务中需要为摘要生成额外 token，导致显著的解码开销和端到端响应延迟。
Method: 提出解耦架构，将内存管理从主代理流程分离，采用 k 步滞后异步流水线使记忆模型摘要与代理推理重叠。引入奖励驱动的训练策略，使记忆模型捕获足够的统计信息以支持代理决策。
Result: 在 SWE-Bench-Verified 上，CoMem 相比普通长上下文方案实现了 1.4 倍延迟改进，且性能几乎不变。延迟优势随系统吞吐量增加而显著扩展。
Conclusion: CoMem 提供了比耦合架构更优的效率-效果权衡，为独立优化代理推理与内存压缩提供了模块化路径。

papers.title: COMPASS: Cognitive MCTS-Guided Process Alignment for Safe Search Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM-powered search agents enable multi-step reasoning and tool use. However, these capabilities introduce retrieval-induced safety degradation, as harmful intents may decompose into seemingly innocuous sub-queries that lead to unsafe outcomes. Existing alignment methods struggle to capture sparse safety signals and fail to supervise diverse violations across multi-step interactions. We propose COMPASS, a Cognitive MCTS-Guided Process Alignment framework designed to achieve robust safety alignment throughout the agent workflow while preserving general utility. COMPASS integrates cognitive tree exploration (CTE) to efficiently synthesize stealthy attack trajectories, and introspective step-wise alignment (ISA) to isolate risky intermediate actions for fine-grained process supervision. Empirical results show that COMPASS achieves a favorable safety-utility trade-off while requiring substantially less training data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: COMPASS 是一个针对 LLM 驱动的搜索代理的安全对齐框架，通过认知树探索（CTE）合成隐蔽攻击轨迹，并结合内省步骤对齐（ISA）对中间动作进行细粒度过程监督，在保证通用性的同时提升安全性，且所需训练数据大幅减少。
Motivation: 现有对齐方法难以捕捉多步交互中稀疏的安全信号，无法有效监督各种违规行为，导致检索引入的安全退化问题。
Method: 提出 COMPASS 框架，包含认知树探索（CTE）高效合成隐蔽攻击轨迹，以及内省步骤对齐（ISA）隔离风险中间动作以实现细粒度过程监督。
Result: 实验表明 COMPASS 在安全-效用权衡上取得优势，且所需训练数据显著减少。
Conclusion: COMPASS 通过过程监督实现了搜索代理的鲁棒安全对齐，同时保持通用效用。

papers.title: Send a SCOUT First: Pre-hoc Reasoning for Adaptive Detector Allocation in Prompt-Injection Defense
papers.abstract_en: Prompt-injection detectors are heterogeneous: each is strong on a different slice of attacks, and none is always reliable. Yet existing systems still treat detection as a fixed single-detector pipeline, committing every request to one detector's blind spots. We reframe defense as detector allocation: given a heterogeneous pool, decide per request which detectors to run and whether to escalate to an LLM judge. Our framework SCOUT (Scalable and Controllable Outcome-prediction for Uncertainty-aware Triage) makes this decision dynamic by predicting each detector's per-sample reliability and latency from how it behaved on similar past inputs, and exposes a single safety-utility threshold to the operator (where utility bundles benign-pass rate and wall-clock). To evaluate this setting, we build SCOUT-450, a benchmark that captures the structurally complex, agent-facing injections that older prompt-injection sets under-represent. On SCOUT-450, a safety-oriented operating point reduces attack-success rate by 46% and total wall-clock by 40% relative to an always-on GPT-4o judge, at a 5.1-point benign-utility drop. SCOUT also transfers to three external benchmarks (BIPIA, IPI, and IHEval), improving the safety-utility frontier.
papers.comment: We propose SCOUT, a detector allocation framework that predicts each detector's accuracy and latency on a given input before running it, letting operators control the safety-utility trade-off with a single threshold and route to an LLM judge only when needed
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SCOUT框架，通过预先预测每个检测器在给定输入上的准确率和延迟，动态分配检测器，并允许操作员通过单一阈值控制安全-效用权衡。在SCOUT-450基准上，安全导向的工作点相比始终启用GPT-4o评判器，将攻击成功率降低46%，总耗时降低40%，仅带来5.1点的良性效用下降。该方法还迁移到三个外部基准。
Motivation: 现有提示注入检测器在攻击类型上表现不均，固定单一检测器管道存在盲区，需要动态分配。
Method: 提出SCOUT框架，通过预测每个检测器在类似历史输入上的表现和延迟，动态决定对每个请求运行哪些检测器以及是否升级到LLM评判器，并暴露单一安全-效用阈值。
Result: 在SCOUT-450上，安全导向工作点相比始终启用GPT-4o评判器，攻击成功率降低46%，总耗时降低40%，良性效用下降5.1点；在BIPIA、IPI、IHEval上改进安全-效用前沿。
Conclusion: 摘要强调SCOUT通过预推理预测实现了自适应检测器分配，有效平衡安全性和效率。

papers.title: Cross-Layer Subspace Coupling for LLM Compression: A Unifying Framework and Its Empirical Limits
papers.abstract_en: Recent SVD based compression methods for large language models like SVD LLM and Basis Sharing can be unified under one optimization problem. While mathematical proofs and tests on Pythia models show this unified approach improves weight reconstruction error by up to 46% percent it fails in practical tasks. Downstream metrics like perplexity and accuracy severely degrade compared to standard per layer SVD LLM. The authors explain this failure mechanistically. Although the bundle method mathematically couples adjacent layers the transformer residual stream actually decouples them during forward passes. Thus per layer optimality matters more than joint cross layer optimization. The paper concludes that weight space reconstruction is a flawed objective for cross layer compression and future methods must focus on per layer activation reconstruction instead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文统一了SVD-LLM和Basis Sharing等基于SVD的LLM压缩方法，证明跨层子空间耦合能改善权重重建误差（最高46%），但在实际下游任务（如困惑度、准确率）中性能严重退化。作者从机制上归因于Transformer残差流在前向传播中实际上解耦了相邻层，因此逐层最优性比联合跨层优化更重要。结论是权重空间重建对跨层压缩是错误的目标，未来应关注逐层激活重建。
Motivation: 现有SVD压缩方法（如SVD-LLM、Basis Sharing）虽能降低模型大小，但缺乏统一框架；尝试通过跨层子空间耦合进一步提升压缩效果，需要验证其有效性。
Method: 提出一个统一优化问题，将SVD-LLM和Basis Sharing视为特例，并通过数学证明和Pythia模型上的实验评估跨层耦合对权重重建误差和下游指标的影响。
Result: 统一方法使权重重建误差降低最高46%，但在下游任务（困惑度、准确率）上性能严重劣于标准逐层SVD-LLM。
Conclusion: 跨层权重重建优化因Transformer残差流的解耦特性而失败，未来压缩应转向逐层激活重建目标。

papers.title: Hide-and-Seek in Trajectories: Discovering Failure Signals for VLA Runtime Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable robots to follow natural language instructions and generalize across diverse tasks, but they remain vulnerable to execution failures that compromise reliability in real-world deployment. Detecting such failures during execution is therefore critical for the robust deployment of embodied systems. Existing failure detection methods either rely on expensive action resampling or external models, while alternatives propagate trajectory-level labels uniformly across every timestep, obscuring localized failure signals. In this paper, we propose \textbf{Hide-and-Seek}, a framework that formulates VLA failure detection as a coarsely supervised learning problem. By combining inter-trajectory and intra-trajectory contrastive objectives, Hide-and-Seek localizes failure-indicative actions and induces temporally structured failure signals from trajectory-level supervision alone, without any step-level annotation. We evaluate Hide-and-Seek on LIBERO, VLABench, and a real-world robotic platform across three representative VLA policies: OpenVLA, $π_0$, and $π_{0.5}$.Our method achieves state-of-the-art multi-task failure detection performance with a practical accuracy--timeliness trade-off under conformal prediction, and generalizes well to both seen and unseen tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Hide-and-Seek框架，将VLA模型执行故障检测表述为粗监督学习问题。通过结合轨迹间与轨迹内对比学习目标，该方法仅利用轨迹级标签即可定位故障指示动作，无需步骤级标注。在LIBERO、VLABench和真实机器人平台上，针对OpenVLA、π₀、π₀.₅三种策略，该方法在保形预测下实现了多任务故障检测的最新性能，并具有良好的精度-时效权衡。
Motivation: 现有VLA故障检测方法或依赖昂贵的动作重采样或外部模型，或将轨迹级标签均匀传播到每个时间步，掩盖了局部故障信号，缺乏高效准确的运行时监测方案。
Method: 提出Hide-and-Seek框架，通过轨迹间对比学习（inter-trajectory）和轨迹内对比学习（intra-trajectory）目标，从轨迹级粗糙监督中诱导出时间结构化的故障信号，自动定位故障指示动作。
Result: 在LIBERO、VLABench和真实机器人平台上，对三种VLA策略（OpenVLA、π₀、π₀.₅）的评估表明，该方法实现了多任务故障检测的最优性能，并在保形预测下取得了实用的精度-时效性平衡。
Conclusion: Hide-and-Seek无需步骤级标注，仅凭轨迹级标签即可有效检测VLA执行故障，且泛化到未见过的任务，为机器人系统鲁棒部署提供了轻量级运行时监控方案。
