papers.title: Your Teacher Can't Help You Here: Combating Supervision Fidelity Decay in On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation transfers reasoning capabilities by training a student model on its own generated trajectories using token-level feedback from a teacher. However, we identify a critical bottleneck, \textbf{Supervision Fidelity Decay (SFD)}: as student-generated prefixes lengthen, the teacher's next-token distribution becomes less confident and less discriminative. Consequently, the teacher-dependent corrective signal in reverse-KL distillation weakens, causing student drift to compound across long reasoning chains. To mitigate SFD, we introduce \textbf{Lookahead Group Reward (\ours{})}. Building on the insight that next-step teacher confidence reflects the discriminative strength of future reverse-KL supervision, \ours{} evaluates the student's top-K candidate tokens by the teacher confidence they induce at the subsequent step and assigns a group-normalized reward. To maintain computational efficiency, we further design an entropy-triggered tree-attention mechanism. Across six math and code benchmarks, \ours{} improves mean@8 by \textbf{2.57} points over OPD for a 7B student, with gains increasing in longer-generation and reaching +\textbf{4.92} points on AIME-26 at 39k tokens.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现教师模型在在线蒸馏中存在监督保真度衰减（SFD）问题，即随着学生生成前缀变长，教师的下一token分布变得不自信和弱判别性。提出Lookahead Group Reward（LGR），基于下一步教师置信度评估学生候选token，并设计熵触发的树注意力机制保持效率。在数学和代码基准上，对7B学生模型提升mean@8 2.57点。
Motivation: 在线蒸馏中，教师反向KL信号随学生生成链变长而减弱，导致学生漂移，称为监督保真度衰减（SFD）。需要解决此问题。
Method: 提出Lookahead Group Reward（LGR），通过评估学生候选token在下一步诱导的教师置信度来给予组归一化奖励，并设计熵触发的树注意力机制保持计算效率。
Result: 在6个数学和代码基准上，LGR对7B学生模型提升mean@8 2.57点，在长生成任务上提升更大，AIME-26上达到+4.92点（39k tokens）。
Conclusion: LGR有效缓解SFD，尤其在长推理链中。

papers.title: SLAT: Segment-Level Adaptive Trimming for Efficient CoT Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Large Reasoning Models have significantly improved chain-of-thought (CoT) capabilities via reinforcement learning (RL). However, generated reasoning chains frequently suffer from structural redundancy (i.e., \emph{overthinking}), incurring high computational overhead without improving answer correctness. Existing mitigation strategies typically rely on token-uniform length penalties, which provide coarse, segment-agnostic pressure toward shorter outputs and can inadvertently suppress useful reasoning alongside redundancy. To address this, we demonstrate that inefficiency concentrates in high-probability segments with low marginal utility. We derive a theoretical characterization of segment suboptimality under the correctness-length trade-off objective and propose \textsc{SLAT} (Segment-Level Adaptive Trimming), an RL framework that selectively suppresses redundant segments based on this criterion. Empirical results on standard benchmarks indicate that \textsc{SLAT} establishes a superior accuracy-efficiency Pareto frontier, reducing reasoning length by $50\%$ relative to uncompressed baselines while maintaining competitive accuracy. Overall, our results suggest that theoretically grounded, segment-aware trimming is a promising direction for efficient CoT reasoning in large language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大推理模型（Large Reasoning Models）在链式思考（CoT）推理中存在的结构冗余（过度思考）问题，提出段级自适应修剪框架SLAT。该方法通过理论分析识别高概率但低边际效用的冗余段落，并在强化学习（RL）中基于正确性-长度权衡目标选择性抑制这些段落。实验表明，SLAT在标准基准上建立了更优的准确性-效率帕累托前沿，可将推理长度减少50%同时保持接近的准确率。
Motivation: 现有CoT推理常产生冗长冗余链，带来高计算开销但未提升答案正确性；已有方法采用token级均匀长度惩罚，粗粒度且可能抑制有用推理，亟需更精细的段级修剪策略。
Method: 提出SLAT框架，首先理论刻画段级次优性（segment suboptimality）在正确性-长度权衡下的特征，然后基于此标准在强化学习中有选择性地抑制冗余段（高概率低边际效用），实现段级自适应修剪。
Result: 在标准基准上，SLAT相比未压缩基线将推理长度减少50%，同时保持竞争性准确率，建立了更优的准确性-效率帕累托前沿。
Conclusion: 作者认为理论指导的段级感知修剪是大语言模型高效CoT推理的有前途方向。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: The Geometry of Activity Cliffs: Representation Dependence and Multi-Scale Characterization of Activity Landscapes
papers.abstract_en: Activity cliffs, structurally similar compounds with large potency differences, are widely treated as intrinsic features of chemical datasets. We argue that apart from target biology, much of our cliff understanding is a consequence of the geometry induced by the chosen molecular representation, not a property of a molecule pair itself. We designed a six-step pipeline to systematically test this hypothesis. The pipeline consists of: assessing pairwise distance geometry, cliff enrichment, activity gradient distribution, persistent homology of the cliff subspace, predictive benchmarking for a chosen pair of an embedding and a metric, and eventually, analysis of the matched molecular pairs and stereoisomers. We applied the pipeline to fifteen configurations of embeddings and metrics to build a benchmark across three distinctive datasets known of activity cliffs challenges. No representation excels on all criteria: Morgan Tanimoto provides the strongest cliff enrichment and cross-scaffold generalization; MolFormer cosine provides the only meaningful stereochemical sensitivity; MACCS and RDKit Dice fingerprints are most sensitive to matched-molecular-pair transformations; ChemBERTa fails uniformly due to embedding collapse. These findings are not a ranking. They reflect the fact that different representations encode different aspects of molecular recognition, and that choosing one implicitly defines what an activity cliff actually is.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨活性悬崖（activity cliffs）的几何特性，认为其很大程度上取决于分子表示（representation）和度量（metric）的选择，而非分子对本身的固有属性。通过一个六步流程，在三个数据集上对十五种嵌入-度量配置进行基准测试，发现不同表示在不同任务上各有优劣。
Motivation: 活性悬崖被广泛认为是化学数据集的固有特征，但论文指出，当前对活性悬崖的理解很大程度上是由分子表示诱导的几何结构所致，而非分子对本身的属性。
Method: 设计了一个六步流程：评估成对距离几何、悬崖富集、活性梯度分布、悬崖子空间的持续同调、嵌入和度量对的预测基准测试，以及匹配分子对和立体异构体的分析。在三个已知活性悬崖挑战的数据集上，对十五种嵌入-度量配置进行了基准测试。
Result: 无单一表示在所有标准上表现优异：Morgan Tanimoto在悬崖富集和跨骨架泛化上最强；MolFormer余弦在立体化学敏感性上唯一有意义；MACCS和RDKit Dice指纹对匹配分子对变换最敏感；ChemBERTa因嵌入塌陷而全面失败。
Conclusion: 不同表示编码了分子识别的不同方面，选择一种表示隐含地定义了活性悬崖是什么，因此这些发现并非排名，而是反映了表示依赖性的本质。

papers.title: LegSegNet: A Public Deep Learning System for Lower Extremity CT Tissue Segmentation and Quantification
papers.abstract_en: Lower extremity computed tomography (CT) contains clinically relevant information for body composition analysis, sarcopenia assessment, and musculoskeletal disease monitoring, but extracting these measurements at scale requires accurate tissue segmentation and an automated quantification workflow. Existing public segmentation tools are not designed for comprehensive lower extremity CT analysis, particularly for clinically important inter/intramuscular adipose tissue, and most public methods only provide mask prediction rather than an end-to-end quantification system. To address this problem, we present LegSegNet, a deep learning system for lower extremity CT tissue segmentation and body composition quantification. Given an input CT scan, LegSegNet segments bone, skeletal muscle, subcutaneous adipose tissue, and inter/intramuscular adipose tissue. It then computes quantitative tissue measurements for downstream analysis. We developed the segmentation model using 1,302 manually annotated CT slices and evaluated it on 900 held-out test slices, with all annotations reviewed by radiologists. We benchmark LegSegNet against a broad set of 2D segmentation methods, including CNN-based models, transformer-based models, and finetuned foundation models, and further evaluate its generalization on an external public CT dataset. LegSegNet achieves the best overall segmentation performance, with an average Dice score of 89.31 on the held-out test set. To our knowledge, LegSegNet is the first publicly available end-to-end system for lower extremity CT tissue segmentation and quantification, providing a practical evaluation tool for future computer vision research in medical image analysis. The code and model weights are available at: https://github.com/mazurowski-lab/LegSegNet
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LegSegNet 是一个用于下肢 CT 组织分割与量化的深度学习系统，能够分割骨骼、骨骼肌、皮下脂肪及肌间/内脂肪。该系统在 1,302 张手动标注切片上训练，在 900 张测试集上达到平均 Dice 89.31，优于 CNN、Transformer 及微调基础模型等 2D 分割方法，并在外部数据集上验证了泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有公共分割工具不适用于下肢 CT 的全面分析，尤其缺少对临床重要的肌间/内脂肪的分割，且多数仅提供掩膜预测而非端到端量化系统。
Method: 基于深度学习，使用 1,302 张经放射科医师审核的手动标注切片训练分割模型，并与多种 2D 分割方法（CNN、Transformer、微调基础模型）对比，系统输出分割掩膜并自动计算定量组织测量值。
Result: 在 900 张测试集上取得最佳分割性能，平均 Dice 为 89.31，并在外部公开 CT 数据集上进一步评估了泛化能力。
Conclusion: LegSegNet 是首个公开可用的下肢 CT 组织分割与量化端到端系统，为医学图像分析领域提供了实用评估工具。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有公共分割工具不适用于下肢 CT 的全面分析，尤其缺少对临床重要的肌间/内脂肪的分割，且多数仅提供掩膜预测而非端到端量化系统。
summary_sections.method: 基于深度学习，使用 1,302 张经放射科医师审核的手动标注切片训练分割模型，并与多种 2D 分割方法（CNN、Transformer、微调基础模型）对比，系统输出分割掩膜并自动计算定量组织测量值。
summary_sections.result: 在 900 张测试集上取得最佳分割性能，平均 Dice 为 89.31，并在外部公开 CT 数据集上进一步评估了泛化能力。
summary_sections.conclusion: LegSegNet 是首个公开可用的下肢 CT 组织分割与量化端到端系统，为医学图像分析领域提供了实用评估工具。

papers.title: Beyond Agreement: Scoring Panel-Surfaced Biomedical Entity Candidates for Curator Triage
papers.abstract_en: Biomedical NER is deceptively simple for modern LLMs: plausible biomedical mentions are easy to surface, but corpus-convention correctness depends on annotation conventions, span boundaries, entity granularity, and type schemas. Multi-LLM agreement is a salience signal, not corpus-convention correctness. We introduce a candidate-level panel-output benchmark for panel-surfaced candidate verification, where the unit is an aligned candidate surfaced by an explicitly defined multi-model panel rather than a standalone extractor output. The benchmark aligns eight LLMs' predictions over five public biomedical NER datasets into a candidate master table. BioConCal is an in-domain supervised scorer that instantiates this layer with inference-time gold-free agreement, mention, surface-availability, and document features for a fixed candidate stream. In domain, BioConCal improves AUROC from 0.753 for raw agreement to 0.910. At a validation-selected 0.95 precision target it selects 1,340 candidates at empirical test precision 0.939, compared with 293 for raw agreement. This corresponds to candidate-level recall 0.592 and corpus-level recall 0.523 against a within-panel row-label ceiling of 0.883. The main benefit is not recovering entities missed by every panel member, but reshaping a noisy panel stream into a higher-yield review queue. Under entity-type shift, thresholds require target-domain validation, and exact character localization remains a separate deterministic post-processing step.

TL;DR: 本文针对生物医学命名实体识别（NER）中多LLM一致性并非语料库公约正确性的问题，提出了一个候选级面板输出基准和名为BioConCal的域内监督评分器。该评分器利用推理时的无金标准一致性、提及、表面可用性和文档特征，将八个LLM在五个公共数据集上的预测对齐到候选主表。域内AUROC从原始一致性的0.753提升至0.910，在0.95精度目标下选择1340个候选（原始一致性为293个），候选级召回率0.592，语料库级召回率0.523。主要收益是将噪声面板流重塑为更高收益的审核队列，而非恢复所有遗漏实体。
Motivation: 生物医学NER中，现代LLM能轻易生成看似合理的提及，但语料库公约正确性受标注规范、边界、粒度和类型模式影响，多模型一致性仅是显著性信号而非正确性。现有方法缺乏对面板级候选验证的专门评估和统一评分框架。
Method: 构建候选级面板输出基准：将八个LLM在五个公开生物医学NER数据集上的预测对齐为候选主表。提出BioConCal评分器，使用推理时无金标准的一致性、提及、表面可用性和文档特征，对固定候选流进行监督评分。
Result: 域内AUROC从原始一致性的0.753提升至0.910。在验证集选择的0.95精度目标下，BioConCal选出1340个候选（原始一致性仅293个），经验精度0.939，候选级召回率0.592，语料库级召回率0.523（面板内行标签上限0.883）。
Conclusion: BioConCal的主要价值在于将噪声面板流重塑为更高收益的审核队列，而非恢复所有面板成员遗漏的实体。在实体类型偏移下需目标域验证，精确字符定位依赖后处理步骤。

papers.title: Unlearning in Diffusion Models: A Unified Framework with KL Divergence and Likelihood Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Unlearning in diffusion models aims to remove undesirable data or concepts while preserving the utility of pretrained models -- two fundamentally conflicting objectives. We propose a principled constrained optimization framework that formulates unlearning as minimizing the deviation from a pretrained model, subject to explicit separation constraints from the unlearning distributions. Specifically, we formulate three constrained optimization problems based on reverse and forward KL divergences, and likelihood constraints. The first two generalize existing approaches for concept and data unlearning, while the third offers a novel and natural formulation for unlearning. Despite the nonconvexity of the KL constraints, we establish strong duality for all three problems, enabling us to explicitly characterize their optimal solutions as unlearning targets and develop primal-dual algorithms for each formulation. Experimental results demonstrate that our KL-constrained approach achieves superior retention-unlearning tradeoffs compared to weight-based baselines for concept and data unlearning, and that our likelihood-based approach matches unlearning effectiveness while better preserving retained concepts compared to baselines.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对扩散模型中的遗忘学习（unlearning）问题，提出了一个基于约束优化的统一框架。通过最小化与预训练模型的偏差，并施加与遗忘分布的显式分离约束，作者推导了基于逆向KL散度、正向KL散度和似然约束的三种优化形式，建立了强对偶性并开发了原-对偶算法。实验表明，该框架在概念和数据的遗忘任务上取得了优于权重基线方法的保留-遗忘权衡。
Motivation: 扩散模型遗忘学习需要同时移除不想要的数据或概念，并保持预训练模型的效用，这两个目标本质冲突。现有方法缺乏统一的理论框架来平衡这一权衡。
Method: 提出一个约束优化框架：目标是最小化遗忘后模型与预训练模型的偏差，约束条件是模型输出分布与遗忘分布分离。具体包括三种形式：基于反向KL散度、基于前向KL散度以及基于似然约束的优化问题。作者证明了强对偶性，从而显式刻画了最优解，并设计了原-对偶算法进行求解。
Result: 在概念遗忘和数据遗忘任务上，KL约束方法在保留-遗忘权衡上优于基于权重的基线方法；似然约束方法在遗忘效果与基线相当的同时，更好地保留了保留概念。
Conclusion: 本文为扩散模型遗忘学习提供了一个理论严谨的框架，通过约束优化统一了多种方法，并验证了其在保留与遗忘之间的有效平衡。

papers.title: Planner-Centric Reinforcement Learning for Deep Research with Structure-Aware Reward
papers.abstract_en: Deep research tasks require LLMs to plan what to investigate, retrieve evidence, and synthesize long-form answers across multiple branches of inquiry. Existing training paradigms either rely on short-form verifiable QA as a proxy or optimize monolithic long trajectories, which makes planning and execution difficult to disentangle and yields weak credit assignment for the planning process. We propose DecomposeR, a planner-centric deep research framework that represents research plans as typed directed acyclic graphs (DAGs), allowing planning to be made explicit, structured, and rewardable. We train a Qwen3-8B model in two stages: planner reinforcement learning (RL) first learns graph structure and query decomposition to improve research planning, and answerer reinforcement learning (RL) then learns branch-level execution and final synthesis conditioned on the learned plan. By assigning rewards to explicit planner tokens and structured components rather than to a flat trajectory, DecomposeR enables finer-grained optimization of planning while reducing the ambiguity of end-to-end training. Experiments show that DecomposeR-8B improves over strong comparable open baselines by 5.1-8.0 points on popular long-form benchmarks due to improved planning and answering capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DecomposeR，一个以规划为中心的深度研究框架，将研究计划表示为类型化有向无环图 (typed DAG)，通过两阶段强化学习 (RL) 训练：先优化规划器学习图结构和查询分解，再训练回答器基于学到的计划执行分支级合成。在长文本基准上，DecomposeR-8B 比强开源基线提升 5.1-8.0 个点。
Motivation: 现有训练范式要么依赖短格式可验证 QA 作为代理，要么优化整条长轨迹，导致规划与执行难以分离，规划过程的信用分配弱。
Method: 将研究计划表示为类型化有向无环图 (typed DAG)，分两阶段 RL 训练：规划器 RL 学习图结构和查询分解，回答器 RL 基于计划学习分支级执行与最终合成。奖励分配给显式的规划令牌和结构组件，而非扁平轨迹。
Result: DecomposeR-8B 在多个长格式基准上比强开源基线提升 5.1-8.0 个点，归因于改进的规划与回答能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调赋予规划过程显式结构和可奖励性，能实现更细粒度的规划优化，减少端到端训练的模糊性。

papers.title: Function2Scene: 3D Indoor Scene Layout from Functional Specifications
papers.abstract_en: Most text-driven 3D indoor scene synthesis methods generate rooms from object-centric prompts, asking what furniture should be placed rather than how the space is used. Yet in real interior design, a layout is judged by how well it supports its occupants, e.g., their activities and physical needs. We introduce Function2Scene, a framework for generating 3D indoor layouts from functional specifications, i.e., natural-language design briefs describing who will use a room and what they need to do there. Given such a specification, our system parses occupant personas and activities, derives a customized set of functional design constraints from a taxonomy of 17 criteria spanning spatial, ergonomic, activity, and environmental considerations, and uses these constraints to guide layout generation. Rather than relying on an LLM to directly produce a final scene, Function2Scene performs iterative evaluation and refinement through a tool-augmented check-and-repair loop, combining geometric measurements, LLM-based contextual reasoning, and VLM-based visual assessment. Experiments on 30 professionally written interior-design cases show that Function2Scene produces layouts that better satisfy functional requirements than recent LLM-based scene synthesis baselines, with our results preferred in 94.3% of pairwise comparisons. Our work reframes text-driven indoor scene synthesis from placing plausible objects to designing spaces that support human use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出 Function2Scene 框架，根据自然语言功能规范（描述使用者及其活动）生成 3D 室内布局。系统解析用户角色和活动，从包含空间、人体工程学、活动、环境等 17 个标准的分类学中派生定制化功能约束，并通过几何测量、LLM 推理和 VLM 评估的迭代检查-修复循环优化布局。在 30 个专业室内设计案例上，比基于 LLM 的基线方法更好地满足功能需求，94.3% 的成对比较中更受青睐。
Motivation: 现有文本驱动场景合成方法以物体为中心，要求放置什么家具而非空间如何支持使用，而真实室内设计应评估布局对居住者活动和物理需求的满足程度。
Method: 从自然语言设计简报解析居住者角色与活动，基于 17 个标准（空间、人体工程学、活动、环境等）派生功能约束，通过结合几何测量、LLM 上下文推理和 VLM 视觉评估的迭代检查-修复循环进行布局生成。
Result: 在 30 个专业室内设计案例上，所提方法相比近期 LLM 基线更满足功能需求，94.3% 的成对比较中偏好本方法。
Conclusion: 该工作将文本驱动室内场景合成从放置合理物体重新定义为设计支持人类使用的空间。

papers.title: GaMi: Geometry-Agnostic Material Identification via Cross-Modal Subtractive Disentanglement
papers.abstract_en: Non-contact material identification enables adaptive interaction for embodied intelligence yet faces challenges from geometry-induced variations (e.g., orientation, shape, distance) and single-modality ambiguities. In this paper, we present GaMi, a multimodal material identification system integrating mmWave and acoustic sensing to robustly operate under unconstrained geometric conditions. By leveraging the insight of shared geometric consistency between co-located bimodal sensors, GaMi employs an intra-sample cross-modal subtractive disentanglement framework. By semantically aligning modalities and subtracting the shared geometric context, it isolates intrinsic material features. Furthermore, GaMi incorporates inter-sample contrastive learning to correct the residual interference caused by cross-modal misalignment. Additionally, a pairing-based adaptation strategy between two modalities enables few-shot generalization across devices. Extensive evaluations on 20 materials show that GaMi achieves 95.2% accuracy, outperforming single-modality baselines across unseen geometric conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GaMi，一种跨模态材料识别系统，结合毫米波和声学传感，在非约束几何条件下鲁棒识别材料。通过跨模态减法解耦框架分离内在材料特征，并利用样本间对比学习和跨设备适配策略。在 20 种材料上达到 95.2% 准确率。
Motivation: 非接触材料识别受几何变化和单模态歧义影响，现有方法难以在未约束几何条件下保持鲁棒性。
Method: 利用共置双模态传感器的共享几何一致性，设计内样本跨模态减法解耦框架，通过对齐语义并减去共享几何上下文来提取材料特征；结合样本间对比学习纠正残留干扰，以及配对适配策略实现跨设备泛化。
Result: 在 20 种材料上，GaMi 达到 95.2% 准确率，在未见几何条件下优于单模态基线。
Conclusion: 跨模态减法解耦方法能有效消除几何干扰，实现几何无关的材料识别，并支持少样本跨设备迁移。

summary_sections.result: 在 20 种材料上，GaMi 达到 95.2% 准确率，在未见几何条件下优于单模态基线。
summary_sections.conclusion: 跨模态减法解耦方法能有效消除几何干扰，实现几何无关的材料识别，并支持少样本跨设备迁移。

papers.title: Learning Permutation-invariant Macroscopic Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Accurately modeling the macroscopic dynamics of high-dimensional microscopic systems is of broad interest across the sciences. Many data-driven approaches learn a low-dimensional latent state through an autoencoder trained for pointwise input reconstruction. These methods typically assume a fixed ordering of microscopic degrees of freedom in the input. However, in many settings, such as particle systems, the microscopic state is inherently unordered. This motivates an autoencoder framework that learns permutation-invariant latent representations. To this end, we adopt a permutation-invariant encoder and design the decoder to reconstruct the mass distribution centered at the observed points rather than per-sample reconstruction. We then jointly learn the macroscopic dynamics of the observables together with the latent states. We demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed method across a range of microscopic settings, including learning the energy dynamics in interacting particle systems, predicting mixing dynamics in Lennard-Jones fluids, and modeling the stretching dynamics from video data of polymers moving in an elongational force field.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种置换不变的自编码器框架，用于学习高维微观系统的宏观动力学。编码器采用置换不变结构，解码器重构观测点处的质量分布而非逐点重构，并联合学习可观测量和潜在状态的宏观动力学。在相互作用粒子系统、Lennard-Jones流体混合动力学及聚合物拉伸视频数据上验证了方法的有效性和鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有数据驱动方法通常假设微观自由度输入有固定顺序，但许多系统（如粒子系统）本质上是无序的，这限制了模型的适用性。
Method: 提出置换不变自编码器，编码器实现置换不变性，解码器重构质量分布（基于观测点中心），并与潜在状态的宏观动力学联合学习。
Result: 在粒子系统能量动力学、Lennard-Jones流体混合动力学和聚合物拉伸动力学视频数据上展示了有效性和鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 置换不变自编码器能够有效学习无序微观系统的宏观动力学，适用于多种科学场景。

papers.title: Non-destructive Identification of Oyster Species is possible from Hyperspectral Images with Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: Differentiating between oyster species is important for developing new commercial oyster species suited to production systems and is critical for traceability in seafood supply chains. Common methods, such as DNA profiling, are destructive and time consuming. The possibility of using hyperspectral imaging (HSI) for discriminating between Black-Lip rock (BL) and Sydney rock (SR) oysters was investigated. Live BL and SR samples (N = 156) were scanned with a HSI camera (950-2515nm). Partial Least Square Discriminant Analysis and Convolutional Neural Networks were trained with Monte Carlo Cross Validation to distinguish BL and SR oysters from the spectral reflectance of their left and rights valves. The PLS-DA model successfully distinguished between the species from both the left and right valves with a median test set classification accuracy of 100%, out performing the CNN with 83% and 96% respectively. Elemental and mineralogical composition in the surface and cross-section of oyster valves were measured with electron microscopy. Analysis of the right valve revealed a greater number of layers in BL compared to SR (4 vs 2). The concentrations of carbon and oxygen varied in the outer layer of the right valves, with BL being rich in carbon and SR being rich in oxygen. The variation in carbon and oxygen concentrations observed between BL and SR right valves may reflect differences in the relative abundance or composition of chitin and glycoproteins. This is supported by model-derived wavelength importance corresponding to vibrational modes of functional groups characteristic of these compounds. Transmittance analysis revealed that light was transmitted through the valves, around the valve edges, indicating that the spectral signatures may have been influenced by the other valve or the meat. Ultimately, the findings highlight an effective rapid, non-destructive methodology for oyster species.

TL;DR: 本文利用高光谱成像（HSI）结合机器学习方法，实现对黑唇岩蚝（BL）与悉尼岩蚝（SR）的非破坏性物种鉴别。PLS-DA模型在左右壳体均达到100%的中位测试准确率，优于CNN模型；元素分析揭示了两类蚝壳在层数和碳氧浓度上的差异，支持了光谱特征的物理化学基础。
Motivation: 传统DNA等物种鉴别方法破坏性强且耗时，亟需一种快速非破坏性技术以支持牡蛎商业化育种和供应链溯源。
Method: 采集156个活体BL和SR样本的HSI光谱（950-2515nm），训练PLS-DA和CNN模型并进行蒙特卡洛交叉验证；同时使用电子显微镜测量壳体表面与截面的元素和矿物组成。
Result: PLS-DA在左右壳体上的中位测试准确率均为100%，CNN分别为83%（左）和96%（右）；BL右壳层数（4层）多于SR（2层），且外层碳含量更高、氧含量更低。
Conclusion: 研究表明HSI结合机器学习可作为一种有效的非破坏性牡蛎物种快速鉴别方法。

papers.title: IRIS: time-structured manifold projections
papers.abstract_en: High-dimensional biomedical data, such as cell-by-gene matrices, are increasingly generated temporally. However, Manifold Learning algorithms, like t-SNE and UMAP, cannot incorporate time-ordering in their layouts, obfuscating the dynamics of cell types or other classes. As a solution, we present IRIS, a new Manifold Learning algorithm that structures layouts both chronologically and by manifold topology. IRIS can visualize a wide range of dynamic biomedical data, including scRNA-seq, comparative metagenomics, and literature.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IRIS是一种新的流形学习算法，能够同时根据时间顺序和流形拓扑结构对高维生物医学数据（如单细胞RNA-seq、比较宏基因组学和文献）进行可视化，解决了t-SNE和UMAP无法纳入时间顺序的问题。
Motivation: 高维生物医学数据（如细胞×基因矩阵）在时间序列上不断增加，但现有流形学习算法（如t-SNE和UMAP）无法在布局中融入时间排序，从而模糊了细胞类型或其他类别的动态变化。
Method: 提出IRIS算法，通过构造时间结构的流形投影，同时考虑时间顺序和流形拓扑，实现动态数据的可视化。
Result: 摘要表明IRIS能够可视化多种动态生物医学数据，包括scRNA-seq、比较宏基因组学和文献，但未提供具体数值结果。
Conclusion: IRIS为解决时间序列高维生物医学数据的可视化问题提供了一种新方案，但摘要未明确其局限性。

papers.title: Differentially Private Preference Data Synthesis for Large Language Model Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Preference alignment is a crucial post-training step for large language models (LLMs) to ensure their outputs align with human values. However, post-training on real human preference data raises privacy concerns, as these datasets often contain sensitive user prompts and human judgments. To address this, we propose DPPrefSyn, a novel algorithm for generating differentially private (DP) synthetic preference data to enable privacy-preserving preference alignment. DPPrefSyn is a principled framework grounded in the Bradley-Terry preference model and the intrinsic geometric structure of pairwise human preference data. It first learns an underlying preference model from private data with formal differential privacy guarantees, and then leverages the learned model together with public prompts to synthesize high-quality preference data. It exploits the shared linear structure of per-cluster reward models to effectively capture heterogeneous human preferences in private datasets, and leverages DP Principal Component Analysis (DP-PCA) to improve learning accuracy. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that DPPrefSyn achieves competitive alignment performance under strong DP guarantees. These findings highlight the potential of synthetic preference data as a practical alternative for privacy-preserving preference alignment across a broad range of applications. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to generate DP synthetic preference data for LLM alignment. Our code is available at https://github.com/gfengyu/Differentially-Private-Preference-Data-Synthesis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DPPrefSyn，一种用于生成差分隐私（DP）合成偏好数据的算法，以实现隐私保护的大语言模型（LLM）偏好对齐。该框架基于Bradley-Terry偏好模型和成对偏好数据的几何结构，先从私有数据中学习具有正式DP保证的偏好模型，再利用该模型与公共提示合成高质量偏好数据。实验表明，在强DP保证下，DPPrefSyn取得了有竞争力的对齐性能。
Motivation: 真实人类偏好数据常包含敏感用户提示和判断，后训练时使用这些数据会引发隐私问题。现有方法缺乏对偏好数据生成过程的隐私保护。
Method: 提出DPPrefSyn，基于Bradley-Terry模型和聚类奖励模型的共享线性结构，利用差分隐私主成分分析（DP-PCA）改进学习精度，生成差分隐私合成偏好数据。
Result: 实验证明，在强差分隐私保证下，DPPrefSyn实现了有竞争力的对齐性能。
Conclusion: 该工作是首个为LLM对齐生成差分隐私合成偏好数据的研究，表明合成偏好数据可作为隐私保护对齐的实用替代方案。

papers.title: Conformal Reliability: A New Evaluation Metric for Conditional Generation
papers.abstract_en: Conditional generative models have recently achieved remarkable success in various applications. However, a suitable metric for evaluating the reliability of these models, which takes into account their inherent uncertainty, is still lacking. Existing metrics, which typically assess a single output, may fail to capture the variability or potential risks in generation. In this paper, we propose a novel evaluation metric called reliability score based on conformal prediction, which measures the worst-case performance within the prediction set at a pre-specified confidence level. However, computing this score is challenging due to the high-dimensional nature of the output space and the nonconvexity of both the metric function and the prediction set. To efficiently compute this score, we introduce Conformal ReLiability (CReL), a framework that can (i) construct the prediction set with desired coverage; and (ii) accurately optimize the reliability score within the constructed prediction set. We provide theoretical results on coverage and demonstrate empirically that our method produces more informative prediction sets than existing approaches. Experiments on synthetic data and the image-to-text and text-to-image tasks further demonstrate the interpretability of our new metric, and the validity and effectiveness of our computational framework. Source code can be found at https://ggc29.github.io/CReL/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对条件生成模型缺乏考虑不确定性的可靠性评估指标，提出基于共形预测（conformal prediction）的可靠性分数（reliability score），衡量预测集在指定置信水平下的最差性能。为了高效计算该分数，作者提出 CReL 框架，可构造满足覆盖率的预测集并优化可靠性分数。实验在合成数据和图像到文本、文本到图像任务上验证了指标的可解释性和框架的有效性。
Motivation: 现有评估指标通常只评估单个输出，未能捕捉条件生成模型的不确定性和潜在风险，缺乏衡量可靠性的合适指标。
Method: 基于共形预测定义可靠性分数，通过优化预测集来最小化最差性能；提出 CReL 框架，包含预测集构造和可靠性分数优化两个步骤，并提供理论覆盖保证。
Result: 实验表明所提方法能产生比现有方法更具信息量的预测集，并在合成数据、图像到文本和文本到图像任务上验证了新指标的可解释性及计算框架的有效性。
Conclusion: 本文提出的可靠性指标和 CReL 框架为条件生成模型提供了一种新的评估方式，目前只验证了图像和文本模态，理论部分提供了覆盖保证。

papers.title: PReMISE: Policy Rubrics as Measurement Specifications for LLM Judges
papers.abstract_en: LLM judges are increasingly used to evaluate open-ended responses, but their scores depend strongly on the rubrics that condition them. A vague rubric asking for a response to be ``helpful and factual'' can reward polished answers that invent facts or violate user intent. We treat reusable rubrics as measurement specifications: changing the rubric changes the response quality measurement induced by a fixed judge. We introduce PReMISE, a framework that, given pairwise human-preference data, (i) discovers a policy-level rubric set, and (ii) audits any rubric set under LLM-judge use along four axes: structural adequacy, reliability, preference fit, and adversarial robustness. Across rubric sources no raw source is simultaneously reliable, preference-predictive, and adversarially robust; and high inter-rater agreement does not imply low exploitability. PReMISE is the only rubric source to score non-trivially on applicability, specificity, and effective dimensionality simultaneously. We contribute two audit-targeted repair operations: preference-rank selection raises judge accuracy on paired responses from $65.0\%$ to $68.6\%$, competitive with the strongest rubric-discovery baselines and leading on two of three judges in our cross-judge sweep; reliability-constrained refinement reduces the rate at which exploit responses receive high scores from $46.4\%$ to $36.0\%$ with little change in inter-judge agreement ($α{=}.531\to.519$).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PReMISE 框架，将可复用的评分标准 (rubric) 视为测量规范，通过成对人类偏好数据发现策略级评分标准集，并从结构充分性、可靠性、偏好拟合和对抗鲁棒性四个维度审计评分标准。实验表明，没有原始评分标准能同时满足可靠、预测偏好和抗对抗性，而 PReMISE 是唯一在适用性、特异性和有效维度上同时达到非平凡水平的评分标准来源。
Motivation: LLM 评判者 (judge) 的评分严重依赖于评分标准 (rubric)，模糊的评分标准可能导致模型奖励编造事实或违背用户意图的回答，需系统性地评估和改进评分标准的质量。
Method: 提出 PReMISE 框架：给定成对人类偏好数据，发现策略级评分标准集；并沿结构充分性、可靠性、偏好拟合和对抗鲁棒性四个轴审计任意评分标准。贡献两种修复操作：偏好排名选择 (preference-rank selection) 和可靠性约束精炼 (reliability-constrained refinement)。
Result: 偏好排名选择将评判者配对响应的准确率从 65.0% 提升至 68.6%，与最强基线相当；可靠性约束精炼将对抗性回复获得高分率从 46.4% 降至 36.0%，评委间一致性几乎不变 (α=0.531→0.519)。
Conclusion: PReMISE 是目前唯一能在适用性、特异性和有效维度上同时达到非平凡水平的评分标准来源，高评分者间一致性并不保证低可利用性。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: 提出 PReMISE 框架：给定成对人类偏好数据，发现策略级评分标准集；并沿结构充分性、可靠性、偏好拟合和对抗鲁棒性四个轴审计任意评分标准。贡献两种修复操作：偏好排名选择 (preference-rank selection) 和可靠性约束精炼 (reliability-constrained refinement)。
summary_sections.result: 偏好排名选择将评判者配对响应的准确率从 65.0% 提升至 68.6%，与最强基线相当；可靠性约束精炼将对抗性回复获得高分率从 46.4% 降至 36.0%，评委间一致性几乎不变 (α=0.531→0.519)。
summary_sections.conclusion: PReMISE 是目前唯一能在适用性、特异性和有效维度上同时达到非平凡水平的评分标准来源，高评分者间一致性并不保证低可利用性。

papers.title: Design and Evaluation of Multi-Agent AI Oracle Systems for Prediction Market Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Prediction markets aggregate collective intelligence to forecast uncertain events, but their utility depends on reliable outcome resolution. Existing oracle systems tradeoff fast but brittle automation against accurate but costly human arbitration. Single-LLM oracles achieve meaningful accuracy but inherit all failure modes of their underlying model with no self-correction mechanism. We evaluate whether multi-agent LLM architectures can improve oracle resolution accuracy over single-model baselines. We compare independent aggregation and deliberative consensus against single-LLM baselines (GPT-5 Nano, DeepSeek V3, and Llama-3.3-70B) on 1,189 resolved prediction market questions from KalshiBench. All agents share a common evidence layer through Exa, with retrieval filtered by publication date to isolate reasoning from retrieval quality. Independent aggregation with confidence-weighted voting achieves the highest accuracy at 83.43 percent, outperforming the best individual model by 1.01 percentage points. Deliberative consensus degrades accuracy to approximately 76 percent, below every single-model baseline, attributed to error propagation during debate where confidently wrong models flip correct ones. Error correlations across models (0.529-0.689) explain why aggregation gains fall short of the theoretical Condorcet ceiling, placing a fundamental limit on ensemble approaches. Many questions resist correction by any multi-agent architecture, motivating escalation to human arbitration. We propose routing criteria for hybrid AI-human oracle systems: auto-resolving only unanimous, high-confidence questions yields 97.87 percent accuracy on 47 percent of the dataset, with inter-agent disagreement flagging the remainder for human review.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估多智能体LLM架构用于预测市场结果裁决，在KalshiBench的1189个问题上，独立聚合置信加权投票达到83.43%准确率，优于最佳单模型1.01个百分点，而协商共识仅约76%。模型间误差相关性（0.529-0.689）限制了集成增益，提出混合AI-人类仲裁系统的路由标准。
Motivation: 预测市场依赖可靠裁决，现有预言机在快速自动化与准确人工仲裁间权衡，单LLM缺乏自纠正机制。
Method: 比较独立聚合（置信加权投票）与协商共识两种多智能体LLM架构，与GPT-5 Nano、DeepSeek V3、Llama-3.3-70B基线对比，所有智能体共享Exa证据层且检索按出版日期过滤。
Result: 独立聚合准确率83.43%，优于最佳单模型1.01百分点；协商共识准确率约76%，低于所有单模型基线。
Conclusion: 误差相关性限制了集成方法，仅对一致高置信问题自动裁决可达97.87%准确率覆盖47%数据，其余转人工。

papers.title: MechVQA: Benchmarking and Enhancing Multimodal LLMs on Comprehensive Mechanical Drawing Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated significant achievements in general visual question answering (VQA) tasks. However, they remain brittle on mechanical engineering drawings, where high annotation density and weak domain knowledge, compounded by unreliable spatial relation reasoning under strict projection rules and geometric constraints, make decisive cues easy to miss and frequently lead to wrong answers. To bridge this gap, we introduce the first comprehensive mechanical drawing understanding dataset, MechVQA, created through a semi-automated construction and quality-control pipeline. MechVQA contains 3.3k high-density pictures with 21K question-answer pairs, spanning 10 different fine-grained tasks across three capability levels: Recognition, Reasoning, and Judging, providing a testbed to evaluate and improve MLLM understanding on real-world mechanical drawings. On top of MechVQA, we then develop the MechVL model through a multi-stage training paradigm, building a strong domain-specialized baseline. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that MechVL outperforms the strongest closed-source baseline by 7.57 percentage points on the MechVQA total score, significantly enhancing mechanical drawing understanding ability and providing a reusable foundation for deploying MLLMs in mechanical design and inspection scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MechVQA，首个全面的机械工程图纸理解数据集，包含 3.3k 高密度图片和 21k 问答对，覆盖三个能力层次的 10 个细粒度任务。基于该数据集，作者开发了 MechVL 多模态大模型，通过多阶段训练，在总得分上超越最强闭源基线 7.57 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有多模态大模型在机械工程图纸理解上表现脆弱，因为高标注密度、弱领域知识以及投影规则和几何约束下的空间关系推理不可靠，容易遗漏关键线索导致错误答案。
Method: 引入半自动构建和质量控制流程，创建 MechVQA 数据集；在此基础上，通过多阶段训练范式开发领域专用模型 MechVL。
Result: MechVL 在 MechVQA 测试集上总得分超过最强闭源基线 7.57 个百分点。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了评估和提升多模态大模型在机械设计/检测场景中图纸理解能力的基础。

papers.title: OpenSTBench: Beyond Semantic Evaluation for Speech Translation
papers.abstract_en: Speech translation systems increasingly span speech-to-text translation (S2TT), speech-to-speech translation (S2ST), offline translation, and streaming generation, producing outputs that differ in modality, speech realization, and timing behavior. Existing evaluation practices assess important aspects such as translation quality, speech quality, and temporal quality, but these aspects are often evaluated under separate protocols, making it difficult to compare heterogeneous systems comprehensively. To address this gap, we present OpenSTBench, a unified multidimensional evaluation framework that organizes heterogeneous speech translation outputs into a shared evaluation format. OpenSTBench supports both S2TT and S2ST systems in offline and streaming settings, and jointly evaluates translation quality, speech quality, speaker preservation, emotion and paralinguistic fidelity, temporal consistency, and latency. Through experiments on representative speech translation systems, we show that systems with strong translation quality can still differ substantially in speech quality, as well as in temporal quality. OpenSTBench provides a reproducible protocol for analyzing these cross-dimensional differences and supporting application-oriented comparison of speech translation systems. The code and datasets are available at https://github.com/sjtuayj/OpenSTBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OpenSTBench是一个统一的多维度评估框架，用于比较异构的语音翻译系统（包括语音到文本翻译、语音到语音翻译、离线与流式生成），综合评估翻译质量、语音质量、说话人保留、情感与副语言保真度、时间一致性和延迟。实验表明，翻译质量强的系统在语音质量和时间质量上仍存在显著差异。
Motivation: 现有语音翻译评估方法对翻译质量、语音质量、时间质量等不同方面分别采用独立协议，难以全面比较异构系统。
Method: 提出OpenSTBench框架，将异构的语音翻译输出组织成共享评估格式，支持S2TT和S2ST系统的离线和流式设置，并联合评估多个维度。
Result: 实验显示，翻译质量强的系统在语音质量和时间质量上仍存在实质性差异。
Conclusion: OpenSTBench提供了可复现的协议，用于分析跨维度差异并支持应用导向的语音翻译系统比较。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On the impact of retrieved content representations in RAG Pipelines
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) supplements a language model's input with retrieved documents, yet most RAG pipelines inherit retrieval components designed for human readers. How retrieved content should be represented when the consumer is a large language model (LLM) rather than a human is less well understood. Recent work has proposed transformations of retrieved content and identified properties that affect generation, but each examines a single transformation or property in isolation, leaving open which features of a document's representation matter most. We address this with a controlled comparison: holding retrieval fixed, we vary only the representation of retrieved documents, comparing an original baseline against thirteen transformations spanning selection, summarisation, and reformulation, in query-dependent and query-independent variants. Across these fourteen representations we measure question-answering accuracy for four generators, and for each representation we also measure answer retention: whether a known answer-bearing document still supports its answer after transformation. We find that answer retention is the primary determinant of generator accuracy; notably, when retention is high, a representation's wording, structure, length, and query-dependence have limited effect. This suggests that accuracy gains attributed to specific mechanisms in prior work may be partly explained by how well those mechanisms preserve answer-bearing content, an attribution that cannot be settled without controlling for retention.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 15 figures, submitted to ACL May 2026 ARR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统比较了检索增强生成（RAG）流水线中检索文档的十四种不同表示（包括原始文档、摘要、查询相关变换等），发现答案保留性（answer retention）是影响生成准确性的主要因素，而表示的措辞、结构、长度和查询依赖性影响有限。
Motivation: 现有RAG流水线通常直接复用为人类读者设计的检索组件，但LLM作为消费者时对内容表示的需求尚不明确。先前研究孤立地考察单一变换或属性，未能全面比较不同表示的影响。
Method: 通过控制检索结果不变，仅改变检索文档的表示（包括原始基线及十三种变换，涵盖选择、摘要和改写，分为查询依赖和查询无关两类），测量四种生成器的问答准确性，并计算每种表示的答案保留性。
Result: 答案保留性是生成准确性的首要决定因素；当保留性高时，表示的措辞、结构、长度和查询依赖性对准确性影响很小。
Conclusion: 先前研究中归因于特定机制的准确性提升可能部分源于这些机制更好地保留答案内容，但若不控制答案保留性则无法确认这种归因。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Smaller Models are Natural Explorers for Policy-Level Diversity in GRPO
papers.abstract_en: We identify a new dimension for enhancing rollout diversity in Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) for LLMs. While GRPO relies on diverse rollouts, prevailing strategies primarily increase diversity by injecting more token-level randomness, which may introduce step-wise noise and lead to incoherent trajectories. We uncover that smaller models within the same model family inherently exhibit higher policy-level diversity, indicated by their superior pass@k relative to larger counterparts as sample counts increase. Unlike token-level noise, this diversity is temporally correlated, preserves logical consistency, and provides structured exploration signals for gradient estimation. We thus propose S2L-PO (Small-to-Large Policy Optimization), a framework that leverages fixed small models as natural explorers to train larger models. To balance exploration and exploitation, we design a progressive annealing strategy that transitions from offline small-model rollouts to the large learner's own sampling. This shift elegantly avoids mid-training performance drops caused by the small model's capacity limits, achieving faster convergence and unlocking a higher performance ceiling. S2L-PO improves accuracy on diverse mathematical reasoning benchmarks (e.g., +8.8% on AIME 24 using a 1.7B explorer to guide the 8B model) while reducing rollout compute.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现同一模型族中的较小模型天然具有更高的策略级多样性（policy-level diversity），并利用这一特性提出了S2L-PO（Small-to-Large Policy Optimization）框架，通过固定小模型作为探索者来训练大模型，结合渐进退火策略平衡探索与利用，在数学推理基准上提升准确率并降低推理计算量。
Motivation: GRPO依赖多样化的rollout，但现有方法主要增加token级随机性，这可能导致步骤噪声和不连贯轨迹。论文想利用小模型固有的策略级多样性来提供结构化探索信号。
Method: 提出S2L-PO框架，使用固定小模型进行离线rollout，然后通过渐进退火策略过渡到大模型自身采样，从而避免中途性能下降并加速收敛。
Result: 在AIME 24上使用1.7B探索者引导8B模型获得+8.8%的准确率提升，同时减少了rollout计算量。
Conclusion: 小模型可作为天然探索者为大模型提供策略级多样性，S2L-PO能有效提升GRPO的性能和效率。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: XLGoBench: Detecting cross-lingual skill gaps with algorithmic tasks
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a set of synthetic algorithmic tasks to detect cross-lingual gaps in the abilities of large language models. Our benchmark is commensurate across languages, since it requires models to perform the same underlying task in different languages; scalable, since each task can be generated at varying levels of complexity allowing it to be adapted to models with different capabilities; quantifiable, since every task admits an objective notion of correctness; and transparent, since tasks are generated from simple templates that can be readily audited for translation errors. Because our benchmark focuses on algorithmic tasks, differential performance is a sufficient -- but not necessary -- indicator of cross-lingual gaps. Nevertheless, we show through extensive experiments that our benchmark exposes persistent cross-lingual gaps in multiple state-of-the-art models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一组合成算法任务（XLGoBench）来检测大语言模型在多种语言之间的能力差距。该基准具有跨语言可比性、可扩展性、可量化性和透明性，通过大量实验揭示了多个最先进模型存在持续的跨语言技能差距。
Motivation: 现有基准难以公平地比较模型在不同语言上的表现，需要一种可跨语言、可量化且透明的评估方法来暴露跨语言能力差距。
Method: 设计了一组从简单模板生成的合成算法任务，任务可跨语言等价执行，并能通过调整复杂度适应不同能力的模型。
Result: 在多个最先进模型上的实验表明，该基准能够稳定检测出跨语言性能差异。
Conclusion: XLGoBench可以作为检测跨语言技能差距的有效工具，其合成任务设计确保了评估的公平性和可审计性。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在多个最先进模型上的实验表明，该基准能够稳定检测出跨语言性能差异。
summary_sections.conclusion: XLGoBench可以作为检测跨语言技能差距的有效工具，其合成任务设计确保了评估的公平性和可审计性。

papers.title: AbstainGNN: Teaching Graph Neural Networks to Abstain for Graph Classification
papers.abstract_en: Graph classification is a core task in graph data mining with widespread real-world applications. Recent advances in graph neural networks (GNNs) have led to substantial performance improvements for graph classification. However, existing GNNs are typically forced to make predictions even under high uncertainty or unknown conditions, resulting in unreliable decisions that can severely impact downstream tasks, particularly in safety-critical scenarios. To address this critical limitation, we propose AbstainGNN, a novel and theory-driven framework for graph classification with abstention, which enables GNNs to reject uncertain predictions instead of producing incorrect decisions. Specifically, AbstainGNN explicitly models both the predictive function and the abstention function, allowing for effective utilization of graph structural information. Moreover, unlike existing heuristic abstention methods, we theoretically characterize the trade-off between classification errors and rejection costs from a PAC-Bayesian generalization perspective, and derive a unified learning objective for model optimization. Guided by this theoretical insight, we further develop an efficient two-stage training strategy consisting of predictive function warm-start and abstention function calibration. Extensive experiments on five benchmark datasets show that AbstainGNN outperforms existing abstention methods, achieving superior classification performance under the same rejection rates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对图分类中GNN在不确定性下被迫预测的问题，提出AbstainGNN框架，显式建模预测函数和弃权函数，并从PAC-Bayesian泛化角度理论刻画分类误差与拒斥成本的权衡，导出统一学习目标，采用两阶段训练策略。在五个基准数据集上，AbstainGNN在相同拒斥率下取得更优分类性能。
Motivation: 现有GNN在高度不确定性或未知条件下仍强制预测，导致不可靠决策，尤其在安全关键场景中影响严重。
Method: 提出AbstainGNN，包含预测函数和弃权函数，利用图结构信息；基于PAC-Bayesian理论导出分类误差与拒斥成本的权衡目标；设计两阶段训练策略：预测函数热启动与弃权函数校准。
Result: 在五个基准数据集上，AbstainGNN优于现有弃权方法，在相同拒斥率下实现更优分类性能。
Conclusion: AbstainGNN从理论到实践为GNN提供可靠的拒斥机制，提升分类可靠性。

papers.title: Learning Agent-Compatible Context Management for Long-Horizon Tasks
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly face long-horizon tasks such as web search and deep research in real-world applications, where accumulated context can cause long-context degradation and reasoning failures. Prior work mitigates this through context management with agent-side context control or fixed strategies such as summarization, which require training the agent itself for adaptation - making it impractical for closed-source agents and ignoring that different agents may require different strategies. We introduce Adaptive Context Management (AdaCoM), which trains an external LLM to manage the context of a frozen agent through flexible modification actions and end-to-end reinforcement learning. Across diverse agents on web search and deep research benchmarks, AdaCoM substantially improves performance by preserving task constraints and progress while pruning stale content. The learned strategies reveal a Fidelity-Reliability Trade-off: agents with higher vanilla ReAct performance benefit from higher-fidelity context preservation, whereas lower-performing agents require more aggressive compression to stay within a reliable reasoning regime. Transfer experiments show that AdaCoM generalizes most effectively across agents with similar capability (measured by vanilla ReAct performance), suggesting a practical path toward reusable context managers for agent systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出自适应上下文管理（AdaCoM），训练外部LLM通过灵活修改动作和端到端强化学习，为冻结的LLM agent管理长程任务中的上下文。在网页搜索和深度研究基准上，AdaCoM显著提升性能，并揭示了保真度-可靠性权衡：高表现agent受益于高保真上下文保留，低表现agent需要更激进压缩。
Motivation: 现有上下文管理依赖agent侧控制或固定策略（如摘要），不适用于闭源agent，且未考虑不同agent需要不同策略。
Method: 训练外部LLM通过灵活修改动作（修剪、保留等）管理冻结agent的上下文，使用端到端强化学习优化。
Result: 在多个agent上，AdaCoM在网页搜索和深度研究基准上显著提升性能，通过保留任务约束和进展同时修剪过时内容。还发现保真度-可靠性权衡：高表现agent受益于高保真上下文保留，低表现agent需要更激进压缩。
Conclusion: AdaCoM跨能力相似的agent泛化最有效，为可重用上下文管理器提供实用路径。

papers.title: Text-guided Feature Disentanglement for Cross-modal Gait Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Gait recognition is a biometric technique that identifies individuals based on their walking patterns, offering advantages in long-range, non-intrusive scenarios. However, real-world scenarios often involve heterogeneous sensing modalities such as LiDAR and RGB cameras, making LiDAR-Camera Cross-modal Gait recognition (LCCGR) a critical yet challenging task due to the substantial modality gap between 2D videos and 3D point cloud sequences. To address this challenge, we propose TCFDNet, a Text-guided Cross-modal Feature Disentanglement Network, which leverages modality-aware textual priors as semantic anchors to guide the learning of disentangled modality-shared representations. Specifically, we construct a Gait Modality Text Dictionary (GMTD) using large language models to generate rich semantic descriptions of gait across modalities and viewpoints. A CLIP-based Multi-grained Feature Encoder then aligns visual and textual features within a unified vision-language space. Furthermore, the Text-guided Feature Disentanglement (TFD) module selects the topk matched textual descriptions to reconstruct modality-specific representations and derive modality-shared features via residual decomposition and orthogonality constraints. To mitigate the fragility of the disentangled shared features, we propose a Feature Stability Enhancement (FSE) module, which models spatial and channel-wise correlations to improve feature robustness. In addition, a cross-modal patch exchange strategy is introduced to further improve generalization. Extensive experiments on SUSTech1K and FreeGait datasets demonstrate that TCFDNet achieves new state-of-the-art results and validate the effectiveness of the proposed modules.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LiDAR-RGB跨模态步态识别中的模态差异问题，提出TCFDNet，利用文本引导的特征解耦学习模态共享表示。该方法构建步态模态文本字典(GMTD)，通过CLIP多粒度特征编码器对齐视觉与文本特征，并采用文本引导特征解耦(TFD)模块和特征稳定性增强(FSE)模块，在SUSTech1K和FreeGait数据集上取得新最优结果。
Motivation: 现有步态识别方法主要针对单模态数据，而真实场景中LiDAR与RGB相机的异构传感导致显著的模态差异，亟需有效的跨模态特征对齐与共享表示学习方法。
Method: 提出TCFDNet，包含：1) Gait Modality Text Dictionary(GMTD)利用大语言模型生成跨模态视角的语义描述；2) CLIP-based多粒度特征编码器对齐视觉与文本特征；3) 文本引导特征解耦(TFD)模块通过topk文本描述重建模态特有特征，并借助残差分解与正交性约束提取模态共享特征；4) 特征稳定性增强(FSE)模块建模空间与通道相关性；5) 跨模态补丁交换策略提升泛化。
Result: 在SUSTech1K和FreeGait数据集上达到新最优结果，各模块有效性通过消融实验验证。
Conclusion: 文本引导的特征解耦方法可有效缓解LiDAR-RGB跨模态步态识别的模态差异。

papers.title: Efficient and Uncertainty-Aware Diffusion Framework for Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning (O2O-RL) leverages an offline, pre-trained policy to minimize costly online interactions. Although data-efficient, O2O-RL is susceptible to shifts between offline and online distributions. Existing work aims to mitigate the harm of this shift by finetuning the policy on trajectory data sampled from a diffusion model. Inspired by this line of work, we propose DUAL: an efficient \textbf{D}iffusion \textbf{U}ncertainty-\textbf{A}ware framework for offline-to-online reinforcement \textbf{L}earning. DUAL utilizes the prior knowledge of the diffusion model to distill a fast-sampling diffusion actor policy and transition model in the offline phase. DUAL also employs a Laplace approximation and distance transition-state-shift detection, thereby using uncertainty quantification to improve exploration versus exploitation in the online phase. We formally show that our actor loss with the Laplace approximation provides a proxy for a principled estimate of epistemic uncertainty. Empirically, DUAL improves the online expected return over O2O-RL baselines across multiple settings and environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对离线到在线强化学习中的分布偏移问题，提出DUAL框架。该框架在离线阶段利用扩散模型先验蒸馏快速采样的扩散actor策略和转移模型，在线阶段通过拉普拉斯近似和距离转移状态偏移检测进行不确定性量化，以改进探索与利用平衡。理论上证明了actor loss结合拉普拉斯近似能提供认知不确定性的估计，实验表明DUAL在多种设置中提升了在线期望回报。
Motivation: 离线到在线强化学习容易受离线与在线分布偏移的影响，现有方法通过在扩散模型采样的轨迹上微调策略来缓解，但仍有改进空间。
Method: 提出DUAL框架，包含离线阶段的扩散actor策略蒸馏和转移模型学习，以及在线阶段的拉普拉斯近似不确定性估计和距离转移状态偏移检测。
Result: 理论上证明了actor loss结合拉普拉斯近似提供了认知不确定性的原则性估计；实验上在多个环境设置中，DUAL相比基线提升了在线期望回报。
Conclusion: 摘要强调DUAL通过不确定性量化有效改善了离线到在线强化学习中的探索与利用平衡。

papers.title: Bayesian Classification with Probit-link Split-and-merge Gaussian Process Prior in EEG-based Brain-Computer Interfaces
papers.abstract_en: A Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) speller systems based on Event-Related Potentials (ERPs) enables users to select characters by detecting brain responses to visual stimuli, recorded through electroencephalogram (EEG). One challenge is to accurately identify target-related responses, such as the P300 component. However, existing methods tend to ignore feature selection, perform feature selection without interpretability, or require large computational effort or data manipulation. To address these limitations, we propose a novel Bayesian generative modeling framework to the binary classification of EEG responses to stimuli. Our approach employs a Probit-link Split-and-merge Gaussian Process (P-SMGP) prior to perform spatial-temporal feature selection, effectively capturing the distinctions between target and non-target ERP responses. Through both simulation studies and real EEG data analysis, our approach can reduce computational complexity and provide statistical interpretations on transformed ERP functions while maintaining comparable prediction accuracy. These findings underscore the value of interpretable, stimulus-level modeling for advancing predictive and personalized BCI systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于事件相关电位（ERP）的脑机接口（BCI）拼写系统中目标响应识别的挑战，提出一种贝叶斯生成建模框架，采用概率链接分裂合并高斯过程（P-SMGP）先验进行时空特征选择。该方法在模拟和真实EEG数据上降低了计算复杂度，提供了可解释的统计推断，同时保持了与现有方法相当的预测精度。
Motivation: 现有EEG分类方法要么忽略特征选择，要么进行特征选择但缺乏可解释性，或需要大量计算或数据操作。
Method: 提出一种基于概率链接分裂合并高斯过程（P-SMGP）先验的贝叶斯生成模型，对刺激诱发的EEG响应进行二分类，同时实现时空特征选择和统计解释。
Result: 在模拟研究和真实EEG数据分析中，该方法降低了计算复杂度，可对变换后的ERP函数提供统计解释，且预测精度与现有方法相当。
Conclusion: 研究表明，可解释的刺激级建模对于推进预测和个性化BCI系统具有价值。

papers.title: CameraNoise: Enabling Faithful Camera Control in Video Diffusion through Geometry-Flow-Guided Noise Warping
papers.abstract_en: Precise camera pose control is critical for video diffusion, yet maintaining geometric consistency remains a challenge. Existing methods that directly inject numerical camera parameters into the diffusion backbone often fail to bridge the gap between abstract coordinates and visual content, leading to structural distortions. To address this issue, we propose CameraNoise, a flow-to-noise warping method that encodes camera motion into a temporally coherent stochastic representation. Unlike conventional conditioning, CameraNoise embeds camera poses directly into the noise space. This decouples motion from scene appearance while faithfully preserving trajectory dynamics. Specifically, we introduce a novel Geometry-guided Reprojection Flow and a noise warping algorithm, which jointly preserve the Gaussian prior of diffusion and ensure consistent noise propagation under camera transformations. By integrating CameraNoise into the diffusion process, our framework delivers stable, high-fidelity videos. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms prior methods in both visual quality and trajectory faithfulness. The project page and code are available at: https://gulucaptain.github.io/CameraNoise/.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the Forty-third International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CameraNoise，通过几何引导重投影流和噪声扭曲算法将相机运动编码到噪声空间，实现视频扩散中的忠实相机控制。该方法解耦运动与场景外观，保持高斯先验，在视觉质量和轨迹忠实度上显著优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有视频扩散方法直接注入数值相机参数，难以桥接抽象坐标与视觉内容，导致结构失真。
Method: 提出几何引导重投影流 (Geometry-guided Reprojection Flow) 和噪声扭曲算法，将相机位姿嵌入噪声空间，保持高斯先验和噪声传播一致性。
Result: 大量实验表明，该方法在视觉质量和轨迹忠实度上显著优于先前方法。
Conclusion: 将相机运动编码到噪声空间可实现稳定、高保真的视频生成，为视频扩散中的相机控制提供新范式。

summary_sections.conclusion: 将相机运动编码到噪声空间可实现稳定、高保真的视频生成，为视频扩散中的相机控制提供新范式。

papers.title: DisPlace: Discriminative Place Projections for Multi-Reference Visual Place Recognition
papers.abstract_en: A key challenge in Visual Place Recognition (VPR) is matching query images against reference maps captured under diverse environmental conditions and viewpoints. While multiple reference traversals improve robustness, existing fusion strategies either aggregate references uniformly or rely on heuristic selection, without distinguishing descriptor variations that preserve stable place identity from those caused by changing conditions or viewpoints. In this paper, we propose DisPlace, a multi-reference VPR framework that fuses multiple reference descriptors into a single compact and discriminative place representation. DisPlace formulates descriptor fusion as a generalized eigenvalue problem that maximizes between-place separability while suppressing within-place variation across references, rather than preserving overall descriptor variance. Unlike existing multi-reference fusion methods, DisPlace exploits variation across reference traversals to identify which linear combinations of descriptor dimensions preserve place identity and which capture condition- or viewpoint-specific variation. We evaluate DisPlace on Oxford RobotCar, Nordland, Pittsburgh30k, and Google Landmarks v2 across six state-of-the-art VPR descriptors. DisPlace outperforms seven multi-reference baselines in 49 out of 54 appearance-varying conditions, consistently improves descriptor-level fusion performance under viewpoint and unstructured settings, and requires less storage during inference than all compared fusion methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DisPlace，一种多参考视觉地点识别（VPR）框架，通过将描述符融合公式化为广义特征值问题，最大化地点间可分离性并抑制地点内变化。在Oxford RobotCar、Nordland、Pittsburgh30k和Google Landmarks v2数据集上，使用六种VPR描述符，DisPlace在54种外观变化条件下49次超越七种多参考基线，且在视点和非结构化设置下表现更优。
Motivation: 现有多参考VPR融合策略要么均匀聚合所有参考，要么依赖启发式选择，无法区分保持稳定地点身份的变体与由环境条件或视点变化引起的变体。
Method: 将多参考描述符融合建模为广义特征值问题，通过最大化不同地点间的描述符距离、最小化同一地点不同遍历间的描述符变异，从而学习一个紧凑且判别性的地点表示。
Result: 在六个先进VPR描述符上，DisPlace在54种外观变化条件下49次优于七种基线，且在视点变化和非结构化场景下一致提升融合性能，同时推理时存储需求更低。
Conclusion: DisPlace利用跨参考遍历的变异性来区分保持地点身份的特征与条件/视点相关的噪声，从而生成更鲁棒的单一地点表示。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Pairwise Reference Alignment as a Model-Level Ordinal Observable
papers.abstract_en: Pairwise preference data is widely used in language-model evaluation and alignment, often for model ranking, reward modeling, or preference optimization. This note formulates a more basic measurement question: given a reference distribution of pairwise preferences, what model-level quantity is estimated when we test whether a model ranks preferred responses above rejected responses? We define pairwise reference alignment as an ordinal observable induced by a model scoring function. Given a reference pair distribution $P_{\mathrm{pair}}$ over triples $(x,y^+,y^-)$, and a scalar model score $S_M(x,y)$, we define the alignment observable as the probability that the model-induced ordering agrees with the reference preference ordering. We further define a centered order-parameter-like statistic and discuss a margin-based extension. The resulting quantities admit simple finite-sample estimators and concentration bounds under independent sampling assumptions. This note does not introduce a new benchmark. It provides a conceptual and statistical formulation for pairwise reference alignment, clarifies the role of the reference pair distribution, and distinguishes the general ordinal observable from scoring choices such as normalized log-probability or energy-based scores. We also provide an initial empirical study on Qwen2.5 models and RewardBench, where the proposed statistics increase with model size and instruction tuning and vary across reference-pair subsets as predicted by the formulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文形式化了成对参考对齐（pairwise reference alignment）作为模型级别的序数观测值，定义了对齐概率、居中序参量统计量及边际扩展，并给出有限样本估计和集中不等式。在Qwen2.5模型和RewardBench上的初步实验显示，该统计量随模型规模增大和指令微调而提升，且在参考对子集间变化符合预期。
Motivation: 成对偏好数据广泛用于语言模型评估和对齐，但缺乏对模型级别对齐量的基本测量公式，现有方法常混同于评分函数选择。本文旨在提供清晰的概念和统计定义。
Method: 给定参考对分布和模型标量评分函数，定义对齐观测值为模型排序与参考偏好排序一致的概率；进一步提出居中统计量和基于边际的扩展，并推导独立抽样下的简单估计量和集中界。
Result: 在Qwen2.5模型和RewardBench上，所提统计量随模型尺寸增大和指令微调而单调增加，且在不同参考对子集上表现出预期差异。
Conclusion: 本文不引入新基准，而是为成对参考对齐提供概念与统计基础，明确区分通用序数观测与具体评分选择（如归一化对数概率或能量分数），并指出参考对分布的关键作用。

papers.title: Chain-of-Thought and Compressed Looped Transformers: A Memory-Budget Separation
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-thought prompting and looped Transformers both give a fixed model more test-time computation, but they differ in what they remember. Chain-of-thought stores intermediate state in generated tokens that remain in the context, whereas a looped Transformer carries state through recurrent hidden activations. We argue that this persistent mutable memory is a central resource for test-time reasoning. We compare three memory regimes, the compressed latent loop, the full sequence-state loop, and the chain-of-thought scratchpad. Our main result shows that a compressed loop is limited by the size of its recurrent state. Running the loop longer adds computation but does not by itself create a growing scratchpad, so a loop with a small recurrent state remains a small-space reasoner even when run for many steps. Under a standard complexity assumption, such loops cannot decide problems that are P-complete under logspace reductions, whereas polynomial-length chain-of-thought can. The separation is specific to compressed loops, as full sequence-state loops carry state at every input position and live in a memory-rich regime closer to explicit scratchpads. Controlled pointer-chasing and associative-recall sweeps illustrate this memory-budget view, with performance sensitive to whether the persistent-state budget matches the task's working-memory demand.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对比了链式思考提示和循环Transformer在测试时计算中的记忆预算差异。链式思考将中间状态存储在生成的token中，而循环Transformer通过循环隐藏激活传递状态。作者区分了三种记忆机制：压缩潜在循环、完整序列状态循环和链式思考暂存器。主要理论结果是压缩循环受固定大小的循环状态限制，增加计算步数无法扩大记忆，因此在标准复杂度假设下无法解决对数空间归约下的P-完全问题，而多项式长度的链式思考可以。实验通过指针追踪和关联召回任务验证了记忆预算观点。
Motivation: 链式思考提示和循环Transformer都通过增加测试时计算来提升性能，但它们存储中间状态的方式不同。理解这种记忆预算的差异对于设计高效的推理模型至关重要。
Method: 理论分析三种记忆机制的计算复杂度，并结合指针追踪和关联召回任务进行实验验证，展示持久状态预算与任务工作记忆需求之间的关系。
Result: 压缩循环在固定循环状态下无论运行多少步都保持小空间推理能力，无法解决某些P-完全问题；完整序列状态循环和链式思考则能提供更大的记忆预算。
Conclusion: 记忆预算分离了不同测试时计算方法的表达能力，实际性能取决于持久状态预算是否满足任务的工作记忆需求。

papers.title: SLAP: The Semantic Least Action Principle for Variational Video-Language Modeling
papers.abstract_en: In the era of Large Video-Language Models (LVLMs), the computational necessity of sparse frame sampling creates a fundamental ``temporal gap'', rendering models blind to critical causal transitions. Existing solutions relying on generative hallucination (e.g., latent diffusion) or autoregressive extrapolation often fail to maintain semantic consistency over long horizons, suffering from object vanishing and energetic instability. We propose a paradigm shift from probabilistic generation to variational mechanics with the \textbf{Semantic Least Action Principle (SLAP)}. Drawing a rigorous isomorphism between classical mechanics and semantic dynamics, we model the latent video trajectory as a path on a Riemannian manifold governed by a Semantic Lagrangian. By formulating the interpolation task as a Boundary Value Problem (BVP) solved via the discrete Euler-Lagrange equations, SLAP naturally enforces object persistence without pixel-level rendering. Extensive experiments show the effectiveness of our proposed SLAP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出语义最小作用量原理（SLAP），将视频-语言模型中的帧间插值问题建模为黎曼流形上的变分路径求解，通过离散欧拉-拉格朗日方程保持对象持久性，避免像素级渲染。该方法在视频语言任务上有效。
Motivation: 现有大型视频语言模型（LVLMs）因稀疏采样导致时间间隙，无法捕捉因果转换；基于生成幻觉或自回归外推的方法在长时域上语义一致性差，存在物体消失和能量不稳定问题。
Method: 从概率生成转向变分力学，建立经典力学与语义动力学的同构，定义语义拉格朗日量，将插值任务转化为边界值问题（BVP），通过离散欧拉-拉格朗日方程求解。
Result: 实验表明SLAP在视频语言建模中有效，具体数值未在摘要中给出。
Conclusion: SLAP通过变分力学原理自然保持对象持久性，为视频语言模型中的时间建模提供了新范式。

papers.title: FLAG: Flow Policy MaxEnt-RL by Latent Augmented Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Maximum entropy reinforcement learning (MaxEnt-RL) enables robust exploration, yet practical implementations often restrict policies to simple Gaussians. While recent approaches incorporate expressive generative policies via importance-weighted supervised learning, they are prone to importance weight collapse, which limits their scalability in high-dimensional action spaces. Our key insight is to mitigate this limitation by localizing the sampling region, avoiding the weight degeneracy induced by importance sampling over the entire action space. To instantiate this insight, we introduce \textbf{FLAG} (\textbf{F}low policy with \textbf{L}atent-\textbf{A}ugmented \textbf{G}uidance). FLAG augments the state space with a flow latent variable and optimizes a provably consistent proxy MaxEnt-RL objective. We empirically demonstrate that FLAG enables expressive policy optimization with limited importance samples and scales to high-dimensional control tasks. Furthermore, FLAG achieves state-of-the-art performance across challenging benchmarks. Our project webpage: https://flag-rl.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对最大熵强化学习中重要性权重坍塌问题，提出 FLAG 方法，通过引入流潜变量扩展状态空间，并优化一致的代理 MaxEnt-RL 目标，实现在高维控制任务上的高性能。
Motivation: 现有 MaxEnt-RL 策略限制为简单高斯分布，而重要性加权监督学习在高维动作空间中易出现权重坍塌，限制可扩展性。
Method: 提出 FLAG，将状态空间与流潜变量 (flow latent) 结合，通过局部化采样区域缓解重要性采样权重退化，并优化一个理论上一致的代理 MaxEnt-RL 目标。
Result: 实验表明 FLAG 在有限重要性样本下实现表达性策略优化，可扩展到高维控制任务，并在多个具有挑战性的基准上达到最先进性能。
Conclusion: FLAG 通过潜增强指导使流策略在 MaxEnt-RL 中有效，为高维控制提供了可扩展的解决方案。

papers.title: Chatterbox-Flash: Prior-Calibrated Block Diffusion for Streaming Zero-Shot TTS
papers.abstract_en: We present Chatterbox-Flash, a zero-shot text-to-speech model obtained by fine-tuning a pretrained autoregressive TTS decoder into a block-diffusion decoder, enabling parallel token generation within each block while retaining block-by-block streaming. We find that naively transferring mainstream block-diffusion decoding to discrete speech tokens degrades quality, as a long-tail token distribution biases parallel position selection toward a few high-frequency tokens. To mitigate this without architectural modification, we introduce two inference-time techniques: prior-calibrated scoring, which subtracts the block-level marginal token distribution, and an early-decoding schedule, which adaptively terminates iteration based on calibrated confidence. On standard zero-shot TTS benchmarks, Chatterbox-Flash attains high-fidelity synthesis comparable to strong autoregressive and non-autoregressive baselines, while supporting streaming inference with time-to-first-packet on par with streaming AR systems and substantially lower real-time factor. Code and audio samples are available at https://github.com/resemble-ai/chatterbox-flash.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Chatterbox-Flash 是一个零样本文本到语音模型，通过将预训练的自回归 TTS 解码器微调为块扩散解码器，实现块内并行令牌生成和块间流式推理。为了解决直接应用块扩散到离散语音令牌导致的质量下降，提出了先验校准评分和提前解码调度两种推理时技术。在零样本 TTS 基准上，该模型达到了与强自回归和非自回归基线相当的高保真合成质量，同时支持流式推理，首次数据包时间与流式 AR 系统相当，实时因子显著降低。
Motivation: 现有的零样本 TTS 模型在流式推理和生成质量之间难以兼顾，尤其是将主流块扩散解码直接应用于离散语音令牌时，长尾令牌分布会导致平行位置选择偏向少数高频令牌，从而降低合成质量。
Method: 通过将预训练的自回归 TTS 解码器微调为块扩散解码器，实现块内并行生成和块间流式推理。提出两种推理时技术：先验校准评分（减去块级边际令牌分布）和早期解码调度（根据校准置信度自适应终止迭代），无需修改架构。
Result: 在标准零样本 TTS 基准上，Chatterbox-Flash 达到与强自回归和非自回归基线相当的高保真合成质量，支持流式推理，首次数据包时间与流式 AR 系统相当，实时因子显著降低。
Conclusion: 通过简单的推理时调整即可将自回归 TTS 解码器高效转换为流式块扩散解码器，同时保持合成质量，适用于要求低延迟的实时语音合成场景。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: Chatterbox-Flash 是一个零样本文本到语音模型，通过将预训练的自回归 TTS 解码器微调为块扩散解码器，实现块内并行令牌生成和块间流式推理。为了解决直接应用块扩散到离散语音令牌导致的质量下降，提出了先验校准评分和提前解码调度两种推理时技术。在零样本 TTS 基准上，该模型达到了与强自回归和非自回归基线相当的高保真合成质量，同时支持流式推理，首次数据包时间与流式 AR 系统相当，实时因子显著降低。

papers.title: Generating Graph-like Rules for Knowledge Graph Reasoning via Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Logical rules constitute a cornerstone of knowledge graph (KG) reasoning, valued for their interpretability and ability to model relational patterns. However, existing rule mining methods predominantly focus on simple chain-like rules and therefore neglect the richer relational information encoded in graph-like structures, such as cycles and branches. This limitation is further exacerbated by computational bottlenecks caused by the combinatorial explosion of the search space, which is especially challenging for graph-like rules. Meanwhile, generative approaches such as diffusion models, despite their success in other domains, can not be directly applied to rule mining because their training objectives are not aligned with the goal of learning high-quality rules, and non-differentiable KG rule quality metrics cannot directly guide model optimization. To address these limitations, we propose GRiD, a framework that reformulates graph-like rule discovery as a discrete generative process conditioned on the target relation. GRiD employs a two-phase training strategy. First, supervised pre-training enables GRiD to capture structural priors from subgraphs sampled from the KG meta-graph. Subsequently, reinforcement learning is applied to fine-tune GRiD through policy gradient optimization guided directly by non-differentiable rule-quality metrics. Experiments on six benchmark datasets show that GRiD achieves competitive performance on KG completion tasks. Ablation studies confirm the efficiency and robustness of GRiD and further show that graph-like rules complement chain-like rules in KG completion. Our codes and datasets are available in https://github.com/Haoxiang-Cheng/GRiD
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GRiD框架，利用扩散模型将知识图谱中的图结构规则（如循环、分支）发现建模为以目标关系为条件的离散生成过程。采用两阶段训练：监督预训练从KG元图捕获结构先验，再通过强化学习（策略梯度）直接优化非可微的规则质量指标。在六个基准数据集上，KG补全任务取得竞争性能，消融实验表明图结构规则能有效补充链式规则。
Motivation: 现有规则挖掘主要关注链式规则，忽略了图结构（循环、分支）中更丰富的语义，且搜索空间组合爆炸导致计算瓶颈；同时扩散模型等生成方法因训练目标与规则质量不匹配、非可微指标无法指导优化，难以直接应用于规则挖掘。
Method: 将图规则发现转化为以目标关系为条件的离散生成过程，使用扩散模型作为生成器。两阶段训练：第一阶段在KG元图采样子图上进行监督预训练以学习结构先验；第二阶段利用强化学习（policy gradient）直接基于非可微的规则质量指标微调模型。
Result: 在六个基准KG完成数据集上取得有竞争力的性能；消融实验验证了方法的效率与鲁棒性，并显示图结构规则能补充链式规则，提升整体推理能力。
Conclusion: GRiD通过扩散模型和两阶段训练有效挖掘图结构规则，弥补了链式规则的不足，为知识图谱推理提供了更具表达力的规则形式。

papers.title: Immuno-VLM: Immunizing Large Vision-Language Models via Generative Semantic Antibodies for Open-World Trustworthiness
papers.abstract_en: Large Vision-Language Models have achieved unprecedented success in zero-shot recognition by aligning visual features with broad semantic concepts. However, this semantic abstraction creates a critical vulnerability in open-world deployment: the ``Hubris of Semantics'', where models force-fit unknown anomalies into known categories with high confidence due to the lack of explicit negative knowledge. To address this \textit{Open-World Trustworthiness Paradox}, we propose \textbf{Immuno-VLM}, a bio-inspired framework that adapts the biological principle of \textbf{Immunological Negative Selection} to high-dimensional latent spaces. Departing from traditional Open-Set Recognition methods that rely on passive density estimation or inefficient pixel-space outlier generation, Immuno-VLM leverages the generative reasoning of Large Language Models to actively hallucinate ``Semantic Antibodies'', textual descriptions of near-distribution outliers (e.g., look-alikes, contextual anomalies) that effectively bound the decision space of known classes.Extensive experiments on ImageNet-1K and four challenging OOD benchmarks reveal that Immuno-VLM establishes a new state-of-the-art.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Immuno-VLM框架，借鉴生物免疫负选择原理，利用大语言模型生成“语义抗体”（即近分布异常的文本描述），主动界定已知类别的决策空间，解决大型视觉语言模型在开放世界部署中因缺乏显式负知识而将未知异常强制分类为已知类别的“语义傲慢”问题。在ImageNet-1K和四个具有挑战性的OOD基准上取得新SOTA。
Motivation: 大型视觉语言模型在开放世界部署中存在“语义傲慢”漏洞：由于缺乏显式负知识，模型会以高置信度将未知异常强制归入已知类别。现有开放集识别方法依赖被动密度估计或像素级异常生成，效率低下。
Method: 基于生物免疫负选择原理，利用大语言模型的生成推理能力主动幻觉（hallucinate）出“语义抗体”——即接近已知类别的异常文本描述（如相似物、上下文异常），从而在潜在空间中有效界定已知类别的决策边界。
Result: 在ImageNet-1K和四个具有挑战性的OOD基准上达到新的SOTA性能。
Conclusion: Immuno-VLM通过生成式语义抗体主动界定决策空间，有效解决了大型视觉语言模型在开放世界中的信任悖论。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Annotations Are Not All You Need: A Cross-modal Knowledge Transfer Network for Unsupervised Temporal Sentence Grounding
papers.abstract_en: This paper addresses the task of temporal sentence grounding (TSG). Although many respectable works have made decent achievements in this important topic, they severely rely on massive expensive video-query paired annotations, which require a tremendous amount of human effort to collect in real-world applications. To this end, in this paper, we target a more practical but challenging TSG setting: unsupervised temporal sentence grounding, where both paired video-query and segment boundary annotations are unavailable during the network training. Considering that some other cross-modal tasks provide many easily available yet cheap labels, we tend to collect and transfer their simple cross-modal alignment knowledge into our complex scenarios: 1) We first explore the entity-aware object-guided appearance knowledge from the paired Image-Noun task, and adapt them into each independent video frame; 2) Then, we extract the event-aware action representation from the paired Video-Verb task, and further refine the action representation into more practical but complicated real-world cases by a newly proposed copy-paste approach; 3) By modulating and transferring both appearance and action knowledge into our challenging unsupervised task, our model can directly utilize this general knowledge to correlate videos and queries, and accurately retrieve the relevant segment without training. Extensive experiments on two challenging datasets (ActivityNet Captions and Charades-STA) show our effectiveness, outperforming existing unsupervised methods and even competitively beating supervised works.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无监督时间句子定位（TSG）任务，提出跨模态知识迁移网络，利用图像-名词和视频-动词任务中的对齐知识，无需任何配对的视频-查询或片段边界标注即可定位相关片段。在ActivityNet Captions和Charades-STA数据集上，该方法优于现有无监督方法，甚至与有监督方法竞争。
Motivation: 现有TSG工作严重依赖大量昂贵的视频-查询配对标注，实际应用中难以获取。本文旨在探索无监督设置，利用其他跨模态任务中易获取的廉价标签知识。
Method: 从图像-名词任务中提取实体感知的对象引导外观知识并适配到视频帧；从视频-动词任务中提取事件感知的动作表示，并通过复制-粘贴方法精炼到复杂现实场景；调制并迁移外观和动作知识到无监督TSG任务，无需训练即可关联视频和查询。
Result: 在ActivityNet Captions和Charades-STA数据集上，该方法在无监督设置下显著优于现有方法，并具竞争力地超越有监督方法。
Conclusion: 验证了跨模态知识迁移在无监督TSG中的有效性，表明利用其他任务的知识可以避免昂贵标注。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Is the Last Layer Sufficient for Uncertainty Quantification?
papers.abstract_en: Epistemic uncertainty quantification (UQ) for deep neural networks (DNNs) is a requirement for safe adoption of AI in mission-critical settings. Several leading methods for UQ linearize DNNs to form Bayesian Generalized Linear Models (GLMs), where epistemic uncertainty is modeled via the predictive posterior distribution. Linearizing around the parameters of the final connected layer of a DNN is a commonly used approximation for reducing the computational burden of such GLMs, though it is often believed to come at the cost of degraded performance. In this work, we compare GLMs arising from full-network and last-layer linearization using both theoretical and empirical approaches. We first employ tools from random matrix theory to conduct a theoretical comparison; this analysis reveals no meaningful improvement in the UQ capabilities of full linearization. Coupled with a large-scale empirical evaluation across a range of modern machine learning tasks, we arrive at the following conclusion: a last-layer approximation yields comparable UQ performance while offering substantially improved computational efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过理论分析和大规模实验比较了深度神经网络在全网络线性化和仅最后一层线性化两种方式下用于不确定性量化（UQ）的广义线性模型（GLM）性能。结果表明，最后一层近似在UQ能力上与全网络线性化相当，但计算效率显著提升。
Motivation: 现有UQ方法常通过线性化DNN形成贝叶斯GLM，但全网络线性化计算负担大，而仅最后一层线性化被普遍认为会降低性能。本文旨在严格检验这一假设。
Method: 使用随机矩阵理论进行理论比较，并在多种现代机器学习任务上进行大规模实证评估。
Result: 理论和实验均显示，全网络线性化相对最后一层线性化在UQ性能上没有显著改进，而后者的计算效率优势明显。
Conclusion: 最后一层近似足以胜任UQ任务，可作为高效替代方案。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: GSAM: A Generalizable and Safe Robotic Framework for Articulated Object Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Articulated object manipulation is a unique challenge for service robots. Existing methods employ end-to-end policy learning, visionmotion planning, and large-language/visual-language model (LLM/VLM), but often overlook the diversity of articulated objects and the complexity of interactions between end-effector and handle, leading to limited generalization and destructive collisions. To address this, we propose GSAM, a generalizable and safe robotic framework for articulated object manipulation. Specifically, a vision-based perceiver generates the kinematic parameters. Considering that pre-trained markers in perceiver yield raw estimations that may deviate from commonsense, we present a f ine-tuned VLM-based refiner, using chain-of-thought (COT) commonsense reasoning to refine perception. To prevent destructive collisions, we design an interaction constraint function generator, integrating articulated object, interaction pose, and obstacle avoidance knowledge into a base. LLM then functionalize these constraints and apply them to trajectory and posture planning. A kinematic-aware manipulation planner verifies reachability for trajectory and posture. Experiments on 50 hinge tasks across 5 object categories and 50 randomly initialized end-effectorhandle configurations show that GSAM reduces standard deviation by 3.1% and improves manipulation success rate by 36.0% compared to the best baseline, respectively demonstrating the superior object generalization and interaction safety of GSAM in practical scenarios.
papers.comment: Accepted by the 19th International Conference on Parallel Problem Solving from Nature (PPSN 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GSAM框架，用于通用且安全的铰接物体操作。该框架结合视觉感知器生成运动学参数，并引入微调的VLM精炼器通过常识推理修正感知偏差，同时设计交互约束函数生成器以集成物体、姿态和避障知识，最后由运动学感知规划器验证轨迹可行性。在50个铰链任务和50种随机初始配置上的实验表明，相比最佳基线，GSAM将标准差降低3.1%，操作成功率提升36.0%，展示了更强的泛化性和安全性。
Motivation: 现有铰接物体操作方法通常忽略物体多样性和末端执行器与手柄交互的复杂性，导致泛化受限和破坏性碰撞。
Method: 提出视觉感知器生成运动学参数，VLM精炼器通过链式思维常识推理修正感知，交互约束函数生成器整合铰接物体、交互姿态和避障知识，LLM将这些约束函数化并用于轨迹与姿态规划，最后运动学感知规划器验证可达性。
Result: 在50个铰链任务和50种随机配置上的实验显示，相比最佳基线，GSAM将标准差降低3.1%，操作成功率提升36.0%。
Conclusion: GSAM通过引入常识推理和交互约束，有效提升了铰接物体操作的泛化性和安全性，但摘要未明确提及局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MAVEN: Improving Generalization in Agentic Tool Calling
papers.abstract_en: Generalization across agentic tool-calling environments remains a central challenge for reliable agentic reasoning systems. Although large language models achieve strong results on individual benchmarks, their ability to compose reasoning strategies, preserve intermediate states, and coordinate tools across domains remains underexplored. We present MAVEN (Modular Agentic Verification and Execution Network), a lightweight symbolic reasoning scaffold for structured decomposition, adaptive tool orchestration, and intermediate verification. We evaluate MAVEN across established tool-calling benchmarks, including BFCL v3, TauBench, Tau2Bench, AceBench, and introduce MAVEN-Bench, a stress-test benchmark for multi-step mathematical and physical reasoning with explicit verification and adversarial task composition. MAVEN-Bench exposes a substantial gap between partial reasoning quality and end-to-end task success; in direct MAVEN-Bench runs, MAVEN improves its GPT-OSS-120b base model from 48% to 71% accuracy without additional training. It also remains competitive with frontier proprietary baselines while using an open-weight backbone with an estimated cost ratio of roughly 1/10, suggesting that lightweight verification-centered scaffolds can strengthen compositional reasoning and motivate more process-aware evaluation of agents in the wild.

papers.title: OrcaRouter: A Production-Oriented LLM Router with Hybrid Offline-Online Learning
papers.abstract_en: The rapid development of large language models, each with distinct capabilities and inference costs, raises a practical deployment question: given an incoming request, which model should handle it? We present OrcaRouter, a production-oriented LLM router that combines a LinUCB-based contextual bandit over lexical and sentence-embedding features with a hybrid offline-online learning protocol. Offline, OrcaRouter obtains full-information feedback by evaluating each candidate model on a curated set of routing prompts, yielding a reward matrix used to fit one ridge regressor per arm. At deployment time, it initializes from these parameters and can optionally continue learning from bandit feedback, updating only the selected model's arm after observing its reward. At the time of our RouterArena submission (May 20, 2026), OrcaRouter-Adaptive ranked second on the public RouterArena leaderboard with an arena score of 72.08, achieving 75.54% accuracy at a cost of USD 1.00 per 1,000 queries.
