papers.title: Beyond Accuracy: Evaluating Efficiency, Robustness and Explainability in Deep Learning for Malaria Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Malaria remains a leading cause of mortality in sub-Saharan Africa, where scarce diagnostic infrastructure makes timely, accurate diagnosis particularly challenging. While deep learning offers a compelling path toward automated malaria screening, clinical adoption is hindered by computational cost and opacity in decision-making. This work benchmarks four deep learning models spanning a wide range of designed design architectures and model capacities on the NLM-Malaria dataset, jointly evaluating predictive performance, robustness, and post-hoc explainability. We find that lightweight, efficient-by-design models match their heavier counterparts in predictive performance, and the Friedman test confirms no statistically significant performance differences. CAM-based XAI methods consistently localize diagnostically relevant regions, while fine-grained attribution methods produce less targeted explanations, particularly with heavier backbones. Robustness evaluation under three types of image corruption further reveals that model confidence degrades faster than accuracy, providing a practical signal for human review. However, no XAI method is robust to corruption, with explanation reliability degrading at noise levels plausible in clinical practice, even when predictions remain accurate. These findings support the deployment of lightweight architectures for malaria diagnosis in resource-constrained settings, while highlighting the vulnerability of post-hoc explanations as an important consideration for responsible clinical deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在NLM-Malaria数据集上对四种深度学习模型进行了基准测试，联合评估了预测性能、鲁棒性和事后可解释性。轻量级高效设计模型在预测性能上与重型模型相当，但更快且更易解释。CAM-based XAI方法能准确定位诊断相关区域，而细粒度归因方法在重型骨干下表现较差。所有XAI方法在图像损坏下都不鲁棒，即使预测准确，解释的可靠性也会下降。
Motivation: 疟疾在撒哈拉以南非洲仍是主要死因，但临床部署深度学习面临计算成本高和决策不透明的问题。现有研究多聚焦于准确性，缺乏对效率、鲁棒性和可解释性的综合评估。
Method: 在NLM-Malaria数据集上基准测试四种架构（轻量级与重型），比较预测性能、鲁棒性（三种图像损坏）和事后可解释性（CAM、细粒度归因等方法），并使用Friedman检验确认统计差异。
Result: 轻量级模型与重型模型性能无统计显著差异；CAM方法定位准确，细粒度归因在重型骨干下不精确；模型置信度比准确率下降更快，可提供人工审查信号；所有XAI方法在损坏下解释可靠性下降，即使预测仍准确。
Conclusion: 支持在资源受限场景部署轻量级架构用于疟疾诊断，但强调事后解释的脆弱性，需要在临床部署中谨慎考虑。

papers.title: SemStruct: Contextualizing Semantic Embeddings with Structural Information for Schema Matching
papers.abstract_en: Schema matching is a fundamental step in integrating heterogeneous data sources. While Pre-trained Language Models (PLMs) have revolutionized this task by capturing linguistic semantics, they typically process tabular data as serialized text sequences of standalone column descriptions. This serialization discards critical structural information -- specifically, the row-level co-occurrences, i.e. the relational context -- forcing models to rely solely on column header semantics or standalone distributions. To bridge this gap, we propose SemStruct, a framework that joins the semantic power of frozen PLMs with the structural inductive bias of Graph Neural Networks (GNNs). We model the table as a heterogeneous graph where columns and values are nodes connected by rows, allowing the GNN to propagate disambiguating context across the structure. Unlike other state-of-the-art methods that require proprietary LLM access and fine-tuning of language models, SemStruct keeps the language model frozen and trains only a lightweight structural encoder. Extensive experiments on the Valentine and SOTAB-SM benchmarks demonstrate that SemStruct achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming fully fine-tuned baselines on complex, semantically joinable datasets. Furthermore, our ablation studies reveal that row representations serve primarily as topological conduits rather than semantic entities, validating the necessity of explicit structural modeling in schema matching.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SemStruct框架，结合冻结的预训练语言模型（PLM）和图神经网络（GNN）的结构归纳偏置，用于模式匹配任务。该框架将表格建模为异构图，通过行连接列和值节点，使GNN能够利用行级共现信息传播消歧上下文。在Valentine和SOTAB-SM基准上达到最先进性能，且仅需训练轻量结构编码器。
Motivation: 现有方法将表格数据序列化为独立列描述文本，丢失了行级共现这一关键结构信息，导致模型仅依赖列标题语义或独立分布进行匹配。
Method: 将表格建模为异构图，列和值作为节点，行作为边；使用冻结的PLM生成语义嵌入，GNN通过消息传递整合结构上下文；仅训练GNN编码器，不微调语言模型。
Result: 在Valentine和SOTAB-SM基准上超越全微调基线，达到最先进性能；消融实验表明行表示主要起拓扑通道作用而非语义实体。
Conclusion: 显式建模表格的拓扑结构（行级共现）对模式匹配至关重要，且轻量结构编码器可有效补充冻结PLM的语义能力。

papers.title: Reducing the GPU Memory Bottleneck with Lossless Compression for ML -- Extended
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning (ML) training and inference often process data sets far exceeding GPU memory capacity, forcing them to rely on PCIe for on-demand tensor transfers, causing critical transfer bottlenecks. Lossy compression has been proposed to relieve bottlenecks but introduces workload-dependent accuracy loss, making it complex or even prohibitive to use in existing ML deployments. We explore lossless compression as an alternative that avoids this deployment complexity. We identify where lossless compression can be integrated into ML pipelines while minimizing interference with GPU execution. Based on our findings, we introduce Invariant Bit Packing (IBP), a novel lossless compression algorithm designed to minimize data transfer time for ML. IBP identifies and eliminates invariant bits across groups of tensors, improving throughput through GPU-optimized decompression that leverages warp parallelism, low-overhead bit operations, and asynchronous PCIe transfers. We provide easy-to-use APIs, showcasing them by adding IBP support to GNN training, as well as DLRM and LLM inference frameworks. IBP achieves, on average, 74% faster GNN training, 180% faster DLRM embedding lookup, and 24% faster LLM inference.

papers.title: Self-Certifying Transport MCMC via Dual Spectral-Gap Certificates
papers.abstract_en: We propose CerT-MCMC, a framework that equips learned-transport Markov chain Monte Carlo with automatic, rigorous convergence certificates. A normalising flow maps a Gaussian reference to an approximation of the target posterior; the same flow then serves as both the independence Metropolis-Hastings proposal and the basis for a computable spectral-gap bound. We develop two complementary certificates. The covering certificate bounds the weight-ratio oscillation over the full proposal support via finite-sample covering arguments, yielding full-support spectral-gap bounds when a conservative gradient bound is available; its correction term scales as O(n^{-1/D}), making it rapidly weak and eventually vacuous as dimension increases. We prove a matching Omega(n^{-1/D}) lower bound, establishing that this barrier is intrinsic to pointwise Lipschitz certification. The quantile-core certificate restricts attention to a high-probability residual core on which the oscillation is controlled by one-dimensional empirical quantiles, with a finite-sample probability slack of O(n^{-1/2}), independent of the ambient dimension. On synthetic targets (D=2-20), structural-engineering posteriors (D=6,8), real-data logistic regression on the Heart Disease data set (D=13), and synthetic Bayesian logistic regression (D=20), the quantile-core certificate delivers non-vacuous spectral-gap bounds where the covering certificate is vacuous, and its spectral-gap proxy tracks empirical effective sample sizes within 7%. A negative control experiment confirms that the certificate discriminates flow quality by a factor exceeding 10x, whereas acceptance rates differ by only 1.15x. To our knowledge, the dual-certificate framework is the first to provide automatic, dimension-aware convergence certificates for learned-transport MCMC, distinguishing genuine transport failure from proof-technique limitations.
papers.comment: 35 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables. Submitted to JASA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CerT-MCMC 框架，为学习型运输 MCMC 提供自动、严格的收敛认证。通过归一化流映射高斯参考分布到目标后验近似，同时作为独立性 Metropolis-Hastings 提议和可计算谱间隙界的基础。开发了覆盖认证和分位数核心认证两种互补证书，后者在高维下仍能给出非平凡谱间隙界，且谱间隙代理与有效样本量误差在 7% 以内。
Motivation: 学习型运输 MCMC 缺乏自动且严格的收敛认证，现有方法在高维下认证界变弱或无效。
Method: 提出 CerT-MCMC 框架，利用归一化流同时作为提议分布和谱间隙计算基础；设计覆盖认证（基于有限样本覆盖论证，但维度诅咒导致高维失效）和分位数核心认证（基于一维经验分位数，维度独立）。
Result: 在合成目标（D=2-20）、结构工程后验（D=6,8）、真实数据 Logistic 回归（D=13）和贝叶斯 Logistic 回归（D=20）上，分位数核心认证给出非平凡谱间隙界，而覆盖认证无效；谱间隙代理与有效样本量误差在 7% 以内；负对照实验显示认证区分流质量因子超过 10 倍，而接受率仅差 1.15 倍。

papers.title: Testing the physical reality of tidal bulges in the world's oceans
papers.abstract_en: Persistent alternation of high and low water in coastal and oceanic regions has attracted human attention for millennia. This movement of water is generally explained through the double water bulge model. Although this model has been widely adopted in the scientific literature on tides since the 18th century, the physical existence of water bulges on the Earth's surface has yet to be verified. Herein, we establish a lunar angle phase-dependent statistical analysis of tide patterns at 362,370 oceanic locations spotted by Jason-3 satellite of AVISO in 2021 to address this issue. We show that during lunar angle phases of 0 degree-45 degree and 135 degree-180 degree, which spatially correspond to the water bulging regions expected in the double water bulge model, the number of low tides consistently exceeds that of high tides. Conversely, during lunar angle phase of 45 degree-135 degree, which spatially correspond to the water-depressing region expected in the model, high tides predominantly outnumber low tides. These findings evidently contradict the physical existence of two water bulges in the world's oceans, suggesting that the scientific community should pay additional attention to alternative explanations for tides, such as gravitational forcing mechanism and oceanic basin oscillation-generated driving mechanism.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过分析2021年AVISO Jason-3卫星在362,370个海洋位置的数据，基于月球角度相位进行潮汐模式的统计分析，检验了双水隆起模型（double water bulge model）的真实性。结果发现，在模型预期为水隆起区的月球角度相位（0°-45°和135°-180°），低潮次数始终多于高潮次数；而在预期为水凹陷区的相位（45°-135°），高潮次数占优，这与双水隆起模型相矛盾。作者认为这些发现质疑了全球海洋存在两个水隆起的物理真实性，并建议关注潮汐的替代解释机制。
Motivation: 双水隆起模型自18世纪以来被广泛用于解释潮汐现象，但其物理存在性从未得到验证。该研究旨在通过大规模卫星数据统计检验该模型的预言，填补这一长期存在的实证空白。
Method: 利用2021年AVISO Jason-3卫星在362,370个海洋地点的潮汐模式数据，建立月球角度相位（lunar angle phase）依赖的统计分析，比较不同相位区间内高潮与低潮的次数比例，并与双水隆起模型的空间预期区域进行对照。
Result: 在模型预测为水隆起区的相位（0°-45°和135°-180°），低潮次数一致超过高潮；而在模型预测为水凹陷区的相位（45°-135°），高潮次数明显超过低潮。这一结果与双水隆起模型的预期完全相反。
Conclusion: 统计证据强烈否定全球海洋中存在两个物理水隆起的双水隆起模型，建议科学界重新审视潮汐的替代解释，如引力强迫机制和洋盆振荡驱动机制。

papers.title: Kalimati Vegetable Price Index Forecasting with a Momentum Corrected Online Stacking Ensemble
papers.abstract_en: Forecasting agricultural commodity prices in emerging economies is difficult due to high volatility, frequent supply disruptions, and strong cultural influences on demand. This study introduces the Kalimati Vegetable Price Index (KVPI), a new inverse-volatility weighted composite index that aggregates 135 daily wholesale commodities from Kathmandu over ten years (2013-2023). By creating a stable macro-level signal, the KVPI reduces the noise inherent in modelling individual crops. A rich set of 64 causally valid features was developed, including festival lead-lag effects, rolling statistics, and calendar variables. Fourteen forecasting models spanning statistical, tree-based, deep learning, hybrid, and transformer architectures were rigorously evaluated across short (7-day), medium (14- and 30-day), and long-term (90-day) horizons. Tree-based ensembles proved notably robust, while classical statistical models and complex transformers struggled with the noisy dataset. The proposed Momentum-Corrected Online Stacking Ensemble achieved the strongest performance, yielding a Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) of 1.771, an exceptionally low Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) of 0.68%, and explaining 84.5% of the variance (R-squared = 0.845) at the 90-day horizon. This open-source pipeline provides policymakers and supply chain actors in Nepal and similar markets with a practical, reliable tool for anticipating price movements and strengthening food security.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Kalimati 蔬菜价格指数 (KVPI)，一种基于逆波动率加权的综合指数，聚合加德满都 135 种日度批发商品十年数据。通过 64 个因果有效特征（包括节日滞后效应、滚动统计和日历变量）和 14 种模型评估，提出的动量校正在线堆叠集成在 90 天预测上取得 RMSE 1.771、MAPE 0.68% 和 R² 0.845，为新兴市场农产品价格预测提供了实用工具。
Motivation: 新兴经济体农产品价格因高波动性、供应中断和文化影响而难以预测，现有模型在噪声数据上表现不佳，需要更稳定的宏观信号和鲁棒建模方法。
Method: 构建 KVPI 指数并设计 64 个因果特征；评估统计、树模型、深度学习、混合和 Transformer 等 14 种模型；提出动量校正在线堆叠集成，结合在线学习和动量修正以提升预测稳定性。
Result: 在 90 天预测窗口上，该方法 RMSE 为 1.771，MAPE 仅 0.68%，解释方差 84.5%（R²=0.845）；树模型表现稳健，而经典统计和 Transformer 模型在噪声数据上表现较差。
Conclusion: 该开源管道可为尼泊尔及类似市场提供实用的价格预测工具，帮助政策制定者和供应链参与者提前应对价格波动，增强粮食安全。

papers.title: When are LLMs Sufficient Policy Optimizers for Sequential RL Tasks?
papers.abstract_en: We study when large language models (LLMs) can serve as effective black-box policy optimizers for reinforcement learning (RL) tasks, i.e., when can we replace classical RL algorithms with an LLM? We explore this question by introducing Prompted Policy Optimization (PromptPO), an iterative method that prompts an LLM with Python descriptions of the state space, action space, and reward function, then has it generate and refine executable policies based on rollout feedback. Across hard exploration environments, Meta-World robotics tasks, and several real-world control problems, PromptPO often matches or exceeds the performance of standard RL baselines while using substantially fewer environment interactions. To maximize expected return, and without further explicit prompting, the policies PromptPO outputs range from tuned proportional controllers or rule-based plans to policies that run planning algorithms like value iteration. Our results demonstrate that LLM-based policy optimization is sufficient when the LLM can leverage prior knowledge about the environment or optimization strategy. PromptPO underperforms standard RL baselines in MuJoCo domains. This demonstrates possible limitations of LLM-based policy optimization to settings that requiring fine-grained continuous control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）能否作为序列式强化学习（RL）任务的有效黑盒策略优化器。作者提出Prompted Policy Optimization (PromptPO)方法，通过向LLM提供状态空间、动作空间和奖励函数的Python描述，并基于rollout反馈迭代生成和优化可执行策略。在硬探索环境、Meta-World机器人任务和多个真实世界控制问题中，PromptPO通常匹配或超越标准RL基线，同时使用更少的环境交互。然而，在MuJoCo领域PromptPO表现不如标准RL，表明基于LLM的策略优化在需要精细连续控制的场景中可能存在局限。
Motivation: 探索LLM能否替代经典RL算法作为策略优化器，以及其适用条件。
Method: 提出Prompted Policy Optimization (PromptPO)方法，迭代地提示LLM生成和优化可执行策略，利用Python描述环境和奖励函数，并通过rollout反馈进行改进。
Result: 在硬探索环境、Meta-World和多个真实世界控制任务中，PromptPO通常匹配或超越标准RL基线，且使用更少的环境交互；但在MuJoCo领域表现较差。
Conclusion: LLM策略优化在LLM能利用环境或优化策略的先验知识时足够有效，但在精细连续控制任务中可能存在局限。

papers.title: Moment-Based Inference for Regression with Latent Dirichlet Covariates
papers.abstract_en: Topic models are often used as dimension-reduction tools before regression, with estimated document-level topic shares treated as observed covariates. This plug-in workflow creates two inferential difficulties: valid inference requires a regular first-stage-to-second-stage expansion that propagates topic-estimation uncertainty, and, at fixed document length, a document's topic mixture cannot be consistently recovered from its own words even when the population topic matrix is known. Corrected spectral moment methods for latent Dirichlet allocation (LDA) offer a starting point: when the total Dirichlet concentration is known, low-order word moments can be corrected to yield operators diagonal in the latent topic basis. We extend this to downstream regression. Under a finite LDA model with response residuals orthogonal to the low-order token moments used for identification, response-weighted word moments admit the same correction, and the resulting supervised operator identifies the regression coefficient $β$ directly, without estimating document-level topic shares. The main obstacle is that the correction depends on the unknown total concentration $α_0$. We show that, for $k\ge3$ topics and under a generic finite-probe condition, $α_0$ is identified by commutativity: at the true value a family of corrected word-moment operators commute, whereas away from it they generically do not. This yields a feasible estimator and lets uncertainty in $\hatα_0$ propagate into inference for $β$. The estimator is asymptotically linear as the number of documents grows with fixed document length, with sandwich standard errors from document-level moment contributions. Simulations show near-nominal coverage where plug-in topic-share regressions can undercover, and an application to top economics journals illustrates contrast inference for latent topic effects.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于矩的推断方法，用于处理包含潜在狄利克雷协变量的回归问题，通过修正词矩估计回归系数β，避免了估计文档级主题份额的步骤。
Motivation: 在回归中使用主题模型时，传统的插件法将估计的主题份额作为协变量，导致推断困难：需要传播主题估计的不确定性，且在固定文档长度下无法一致地恢复文档主题混合。
Method: 扩展了潜在狄利克雷分配（LDA）的修正谱矩方法，利用响应加权词矩，在已知总狄利克雷浓度α₀的条件下，通过修正词矩算子直接识别回归系数β。对于未知α₀，利用k≥3个主题下的交换性条件进行识别。
Result: 模拟实验表明，在插件主题份额回归覆盖不足的情况下，该方法实现了接近名义覆盖率的推断。应用于经济学顶级期刊的示例展示了潜在主题效应的对比推断。
Conclusion: 该方法避免了估计主题份额的步骤，直接推断回归系数，且渐近线性，标准误可通过文档级矩贡献的夹心估计得到。

papers.title: Simple Token-Efficient Vision-Language Model for Case-level Pathology Synoptic Report Generation
papers.abstract_en: Generating clinically useful pathology reports for pathology cases from whole-slide images (WSIs) is challenging due to gigapixel resolution, long visual-token sequences, and the complexity of case-level reasoning, where a single case may contain multiple WSIs with heterogeneous tissues and ambiguous findings. We present a simple token-efficient vision--language model for case-level synoptic report generation that remains practical under constrained GPU memory. Our architecture follows a minimal three-component design: a frozen pathology patch encoder, a lightweight two-layer MLP vision-language aligner, and a large language model decoder, with an explicit WSI marker token to separate slides within a case. Training proceeds in two supervised stages: (1) aligner-only WSI captioning using heterogeneous WSI-text pairs, and (2) case-level supervised fine-tuning on case-report pairs for structured report generation. To reduce sequence length, we represent each slide using $512 \times 512$ patches at $5\times$ magnification, which reduces the average sequence length by up to $64\times$ times compared to the commonly used $20\times$ patches. Combined with efficient training techniques, we enable practical training with only half a NVIDIA H100 GPU. Across both training stages, our approach achieves high ROUGE-L/METEOR/BLEU-4 scores while being substantially more efficient in memory and runtime. In AI-based evaluations, our model is consistently preferred over strong baselines. Extensive ablations characterize performance-efficiency trade-offs and identify simple choices that improve robustness in multi-WSI settings. Overall, this work provides a strong, reproducible baseline for efficient pathology report generation, lowering the barrier to multi-WSI VLM research under limited compute.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种简单、词元高效的视觉-语言模型，用于从全切片图像（WSI）生成病例级结构化病理报告。模型采用冻结的病理图块编码器、轻量双层MLP对齐器和大型语言模型解码器，通过显式的WSI标记词元分隔切片。使用512x512图块在5倍放大下，将平均序列长度减少最多64倍，并仅需半张NVIDIA H100 GPU即可训练。两阶段监督训练后，ROUGE-L/METEOR/BLEU-4得分高，内存和运行时效率显著优于强基线。
Motivation: 生成临床有用的病例级病理报告面临全切片图像分辨率高、视觉词元序列长、多WSI病例推理复杂等挑战，现有方法在有限GPU内存下难以实用。
Method: 采用三部件架构：冻结的病理图块编码器、轻量双层MLP视觉-语言对齐器、以及使用WSI标记词元解码的大语言模型。两阶段训练：先在对齐器上使用异构WSI-文本对进行WSI描述生成，再在病例-报告对上监督微调。通过降低图块放大倍数和尺寸大幅缩短序列长度，结合高效训练技术实现低资源训练。
Result: 在ROUGE-L/METEOR/BLEU-4上取得高分数，内存和运行时间效率显著优于强基线；基于AI的评估中，模型比强基线更受偏好；消融实验揭示了性能-效率权衡及多WSI设置下的鲁棒改进。
Conclusion: 该工作为高效病理报告生成提供了一个强且可复现的基线，降低了多WSI视觉-语言模型在有限计算资源下的研究门槛。

papers.title: Vision-Based Localization in Dense Urban Environments: A Case Study of an Urban Village in China
papers.abstract_en: Urban villages, the widespread informal settlements which have emerged as a result of rapid urbanization, are now major residential hubs for migrant workers in large cities in China. The dense arrangement of buildings in these areas often leads to unreliable GPS signals, while incomplete mapping data further impairs accurate route planning and navigation. These issues not only hinder everyday mobility but also pose significant challenges for emergency response, as confusing road layouts and GPS inaccuracies can complicate evacuation efforts. To address these challenges, we propose a practical vision-based geo-localization solution tailored for dense urban environments. Our approach features a low-cost data collection pipeline utilizing a dual-camera system, comprising a panoramic camera and a smartphone camera, to capture synchronized 360-degree panoramas and query images. Using Shipai Village, a well-known densely populated urban village in Guangzhou, as a case study, we develop a specialized image geo-localization dataset. We then assess and compare the performance of existing models across various scene types to identify their strengths and weaknesses. The findings demonstrate both the potential and limitations of visual-based localization in dense urban-village environments. Our framework aims to enhance pedestrian navigation, last-mile delivery, and emergency management in areas with poor GPS coverage, ultimately supporting the vulnerable populations living within these informal settlements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对中国城中村密集建筑导致GPS信号不可靠的问题，提出一种基于视觉的地理定位方案。采用双摄像头系统（全景相机+智能手机）采集360度全景图和查询图像，以广州石牌村为案例构建图像定位数据集，并评估现有模型的性能。结果表明视觉定位在城中村环境中的潜力与局限性。
Motivation: 城中村建筑密集导致GPS信号不稳定，且地图数据不完整，影响日常出行和紧急响应。现有方法难以低成本解决此问题。
Method: 提出低成本的视觉定位流程，使用双摄像头系统同步采集全景和查询图像，构建专用数据集，并对比多种现有模型在不同场景类型下的表现。
Result: 通过石牌村案例，揭示了视觉定位在密集城中村环境中的可行性与不足。
Conclusion: 视觉定位可作为GPS的补充，支持行人导航、末端配送和应急管理，但需针对复杂场景进一步优化。

papers.title: Diversity Matters: Revisiting Test-Time Compute in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Test-time compute (TTC) strategies have emerged as a lightweight approach to boost reasoning in large language models (LLMs). However, their application and benefits for vision-language models (VLMs) remain underexplored. We present a systematic study of TTC across seven VLMs and six benchmarks, specifically analyzing feature-based scoring and majority voting methods. We find that feature heuristics fail and voting yields only modest gains in single-model settings. We theoretically show that this limitation stems from a lack of prediction diversity: when outputs are highly correlated, voting provides little benefit. In contrast, multi-model ensembles offer richer diversity, yet standard majority voting fails to account for varying model capabilities. To address this, we propose Entropy-based TTC (ETTC), which selects the most confident prediction based on predictive entropy. Our method reduces to majority voting in the single-model case, but in model ensembles, it leverages confidence disparities to prioritize stronger models. We prove that ETTC outperforms majority voting under mild assumptions and empirically demonstrate that it consistently surpasses both voting and the best individual model. Crucially, our results show that smaller models can synergistically enhance larger ones, unlocking ensembling gains not achievable with standard strategies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本论文系统研究了视觉语言模型（VLM）中的测试时计算（TTC）策略。摘要显示，特征启发式方法无效，多数投票在单一模型下收益有限，原因在于输出高度相关、缺乏多样性。作者提出基于熵的TTC（ETTC），通过预测熵选择最自信的预测，在模型集成中能优先利用强模型，并理论证明其优于多数投票。实验结果表明ETTC持续超越投票和最佳单个模型，且小模型可以协同增强大模型。
Motivation: TTC在LLM中有效，但在VLM中应用和收益未被充分探索，且现有投票方法在模型集成中未考虑不同模型能力差异。
Method: 提出Entropy-based TTC（ETTC），使用预测熵作为置信度指标来选择最自信的预测；在单一模型时退化为多数投票，在集成中利用置信度差异优先选择强模型。
Result: 摘要报告ETTC在7个VLM和6个基准上持续超越多数投票和最佳单个模型，并证明在温和假设下理论优于多数投票；小模型可协同增强大模型。
Conclusion: 摘要指出缺乏预测多样性是限制基于投票的TTC的关键因素，而ETTC通过熵选择有效解决此问题，并解锁了标准策略无法实现的集成增益。

papers.title: SAGE: A Novelty Gate for Efficient Memory Evolution in Agentic LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Agentic LLMs must continuously decide whether newly extracted facts should be added, merged with existing memories, or ignored, yet prior work has focused more on retrieval and storage than on principled write-side control. We frame memory evolution as a novelty-detection problem and propose SAGE, a Spherical Adaptive Gate for memory Evolution that scores candidate facts with a von Mises-Fisher-based density estimator over memory embeddings and routes them with an adaptive threshold that tracks memory-store geometry. SAGE resolves clearly novel facts as ADD, clearly redundant facts as NOOP, and sends only uncertain cases to an LLM merge step, reducing expensive write-time reasoning. On LoCoMo, SAGE achieves the best average token-F1 against Mem0 on all seven open-weight backbone comparisons, while on GPT-4o-mini it reduces add-phase API cost by 3.4$\times$ and add-phase latency by 2.5$\times$ with only a small average judge-score gap. As a drop-in binary gate for A-Mem, SAGE skips roughly 16-18% of LLM calls across five models with minimal quality change on open-weight backbones. These results suggest that novelty-aware write control is a practical lever for improving both memory quality and system efficiency in long-term agentic memory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对agentic LLM的记忆写入控制问题，将记忆演化视为新颖性检测，提出SAGE (Spherical Adaptive Gate for Memory Evolution)。该方法利用基于von Mises-Fisher的密度估计器对候选事实打分，并通过自适应阈值决定是添加（ADD）、忽略（NOOP）还是交LLM合并。在LoCoMo基准上，SAGE在7个开源基座上取得最佳平均token-F1，同时显著降低GPT-4o-mini的API成本和延迟。作为A-Mem的即插即用二值门，SAGE跳过了约16-18%的LLM调用。
Motivation: 现有agentic LLM的记忆系统主要关注检索和存储，忽视了写入端的控制。模型需要决定新事实是否加入、合并或忽略，但缺乏原则性的写入控制方法。
Method: 提出SAGE门控机制，使用von Mises-Fisher分布对记忆嵌入进行密度估计，根据候选事实的推演分数（来自密度估计器）与自适应阈值比较，分为ADD、NOOP或不确定（交由LLM合并）。阈值根据记忆存储几何动态调整。
Result: 在LoCoMo上，SAGE在所有7个开源基座上取得最佳平均token-F1；在GPT-4o-mini上，添加阶段API成本降低3.4倍，延迟降低2.5倍，评判得分差距很小。作为A-Mem的即插即用门，在5个模型上跳过约16-18%的LLM调用，质量变化极小。
Conclusion: 新颖性感知的写入控制是提升长期agentic记忆质量和系统效率的实用手段。

papers.title: Equivariant Latent Alignment via Flow Matching under Group Symmetries
papers.abstract_en: Geometry-aware generative models and novel view synthesis approaches have shown strong potential in visual fidelity and consistency. In parallel, equivariant representation learning has emerged as a powerful framework for constructing latent spaces where analytically known group transformations could act directly, capturing geometric structure in data and enhancing both interpretability and generalization in novel view synthesis. However, we identify that existing approaches often suffer from latent misalignment, a discrepancy between the intended group action and the actually required transformations in the latent space. Consequently, the learned latents often fail to consistently preserve the equivariant relations imposed by the underlying group symmetry. To address this, we propose Residual Latent Flow, a flow-based framework that corrects the misaligned latents, thereby improving compliance with the underlying equivariance relation. Our comprehensive experiments show that our method significantly reduces latent misalignment and improves novel view synthesis quality, under rotation groups SO(n).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出在新视角合成中，现有等变表示学习方法常出现潜在不对齐（latent misalignment），即潜在空间中预期的群作用与实际上需要的变换不一致。为此提出Residual Latent Flow，一个基于流匹配的框架，用于纠正不对齐的潜在表示，从而更好地满足等变关系。实验表明，该方法在旋转群SO(n)下显著减少了潜在不对齐，并提升了新视角合成的质量。
Motivation: 现有等变表示学习方法在新视角合成中常遭受潜在不对齐，导致学习到的潜在表示不能一致地保持群对称性所施加的等变关系，从而影响合成质量。
Method: 提出Residual Latent Flow，一种基于流匹配的框架，通过在潜在空间中学习一个残差流来纠正不对齐的潜在表示，使其更符合底层的等变关系。
Result: 在旋转群SO(n)下的新视角合成实验中，该方法显著减少了潜在不对齐，并提升了合成质量。
Conclusion: 作者认为所提出的流匹配框架能有效纠正等变表示学习中的潜在不对齐问题，为几何感知生成模型提供了更一致和可解释的潜在空间。

papers.title: Mathematical Morphology in Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: This work introduces mathematical morphology-an established visual computing theory-into machine learning to exploit shape and density aspects often overlooked by standard techniques. We propose a fast clustering algorithm based on morphological reconstruction that accurately preserves cluster shapes and density. This scheme offers unique features: an intrinsic sense of maximal clusters, cost-free noise removal, and diverse growth patterns controlled by structuring elements.Additionally, we propose a novel distance metric combining Minkowski and Chebyshev distances, highly efficient for morphological dilations. In $Z^2$ discrete neighbourhood iterations, it is roughly 1.3 times faster than Manhattan and 329.5 times faster than Euclidean distances. When evaluated using a k-Nearest Neighbours (k-NN) classifier across 33 UCI datasets against 14 other distances, our metric achieved above-average accuracies most frequently (26 of 33 cases) and the best overall accuracy in 9 cases.Finally, we introduce novel morphological classifiers. Unlike current literature, this proposal uniquely models shape, density, and fractal information in datasets.
papers.journal_ref: sibgrapi 2018
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将数学形态学引入机器学习，以利用标准方法常忽略的形状和密度信息。具体贡献包括一个基于形态学重建的快速聚类算法、一种结合Minkowski与Chebyshev的高效距离度量（在Z^2邻域迭代中比Manhattan快1.3倍，比Euclidean快329.5倍），以及能够同时建模形状、密度和分形信息的新型形态学分类器。在33个UCI数据集上使用k-NN分类器评估，该距离度量在26个案例中高于平均准确率，9个案例取得最佳。
Motivation: 标准机器学习技术常忽略数据的形状和密度信息，数学形态学作为成熟的视觉计算理论，可弥补这一不足。
Method: 提出基于形态学重建的快速聚类算法，具有内在的最大聚类感知、无成本噪声去除和由结构元素控制的多样化增长模式。提出结合Minkowski与Chebyshev的距离度量，适用于形态学膨胀。引入新型形态学分类器，建模形状、密度和分形信息。
Result: 所提距离度量在Z^2邻域迭代中速度快于Manhattan（约1.3倍）和Euclidean（约329.5倍）。在33个UCI数据集上，该度量在26例中达到高于平均的k-NN准确率，并在9例中取得最佳。
Conclusion: 数学形态学可有效扩展机器学习的能力，尤其是对形状、密度和分形特征的建模。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出将数学形态学引入机器学习，以利用标准方法常忽略的形状和密度信息。具体贡献包括一个基于形态学重建的快速聚类算法、一种结合Minkowski与Chebyshev的高效距离度量（在Z^2邻域迭代中比Manhattan快1.3倍，比Euclidean快329.5倍），以及能够同时建模形状、密度和分形信息的新型形态学分类器。在33个UCI数据集上使用k-NN分类器评估，该距离度量在26个案例中高于平均准确率，9个案例取得最佳。

summary_sections.method: 提出基于形态学重建的快速聚类算法，具有内在的最大聚类感知、无成本噪声去除和由结构元素控制的多样化增长模式。提出结合Minkowski与Chebyshev的距离度量，适用于形态学膨胀。引入新型形态学分类器，建模形状、密度和分形信息。

papers.title: A Context-Aware Middleware for Medical Image Based Reports: An approach based on image feature extraction and association rules
papers.abstract_en: This work proposes a context-aware middleware for medical workflow organization and efficiency improvement. In hospitals, laboratories and teleradiology companies, each physician or technician is specialized in a specific kind of diagnosis or analysis. Therefore, certain types of medical images are often forwarded to a certain physician or a certain group. This forwarding is time consuming. That is, repeatedly deciding who would be the best physician, whether he is available at a certain moment given a certain context is exhaustive and may be very inefficient. Thus, the proposed middleware has the ability to process and collect data from images analyzed by each medical staff. Based on the collected data and current clinical context, the middleware is able to infer who would be the best fit staff to receive a certain incoming medical image.
papers.journal_ref: 2015 IEEE/ACS 12th International Conference of Computer Systems and Applications (AICCSA)
papers.summary_zh:

Method: 提出一个上下文感知中间件，能够从每个医疗人员分析的图像中提取特征并收集数据，基于这些数据和当前临床上下文，使用关联规则等方法推断最佳接收者。

Conclusion: 该中间件有望提高医疗工作流程的效率，但摘要未提及实验验证或局限性。

papers.title: Seeing Before Agreeing: Aligning Multi-Agent Consensus with Visual Evidence
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance on visual question answering (VQA). To mitigate individual hallucinations and blind spots, aggregating diverse perspectives via multi-agent collaboration has emerged as a promising paradigm. While this approach has shown great success in textual QA, its potential in the multimodal domain remains under-explored. Existing multi-agent VQA methods predominantly adapt text-centric protocols, focusing on textual discussions while ignoring the alignment of visual information. In this work, we reveal a key insight: answer-level agreement is insufficient for reliable multi-agent VQA; \textit{aligned visual evidence} -- shared support from the image regions agents rely on -- is essential for trustworthy consensus. To leverage this insight, we propose EAGLE (\textbf{E}vidence-\textbf{A}ligned \textbf{G}rounded mu\textbf{L}ti-agent r\textbf{E}asoning), a training-free evidence-centered framework for coordinating multiple VLM agents. EAGLE explicitly exposes each agent's grounding regions as visual evidence, enables mutual verification over the evidence, and uses evidence consistency to guide final decision-making. Experiments on six VQA benchmarks show that EAGLE achieves best average performance across domains while remaining lightweight, interpretable, and practical for deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EAGLE框架，一个无需训练的证据中心多智能体协调方法，通过显式暴露每个VLM智能体的视觉接地区域作为视觉证据，实现证据相互验证，并利用证据一致性指导最终决策。在六个VQA基准上取得最佳平均性能，且轻量、可解释、易于部署。
Motivation: 现有多智能体VQA方法主要沿用文本中心协议，注重文本讨论而忽略视觉信息对齐，而单纯的答案级一致对于可靠的VQA不够，需要对齐的视觉证据。
Method: 提出EAGLE框架，一种无需训练的证据中心方法，协调多个VLM智能体：显式暴露每个智能体的接地区域作为视觉证据，实现证据的相互验证，并利用证据一致性指导最终决策。
Result: 在六个VQA基准上，EAGLE取得了跨领域的最佳平均性能，同时保持轻量、可解释、易于部署。
Conclusion: EAGLE通过视觉证据对齐提升了多智能体VQA的可靠性，且无需额外训练，具有实用性和可解释性。

papers.title: Universal Decision Learners
papers.abstract_en: Many theories of decision making -- planning, reinforcement learning, causal intervention, online learning, and game-theoretic equilibrium -- turn local information into globally coherent behavior. This paper proposes a common categorical formulation: a Universal Decision Learner (UDL) extends a partially specified decision functor from observed contexts to new contexts by a pair of universal constructions. Left Kan extensions express rollout, aggregation, and candidate generation; right Kan extensions express consistency, constraint satisfaction, and fixed-point semantics. The central claim is not that every decision problem has the same algorithm, but that many decision formalisms instantiate the same universal problem: extend local behavioral data canonically, then characterize the globally coherent extensions. We give the abstract UDL construction, prove its universal comparison property, define Kan-invariant behavioral equivalence and minimal abstractions, and show how Bellman equations, planning recursions, causal interventions, online regret, and equilibria arise as special cases. The supplementary material develops the reinforcement-learning specialization in more detail.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个通用决策学习者的范畴论框架，通过左Kan扩展和右Kan扩展将局部决策数据扩展为全局一致行为，并证明许多决策形式（规划、强化学习、因果干预、在线学习、博弈均衡）是该框架的特例。
Motivation: 许多决策制定理论将局部信息转化为全局一致行为，但缺乏统一的数学形式。本文旨在提供一个共同的范畴论表述。
Method: 提出通用决策学习者（UDL），通过一对泛性质构造（左Kan扩展和右Kan扩展）来扩展部分指定的决策函子。
Result: 证明了泛比较性质，定义了Kan不变行为等价和最小抽象，并展示了Bellman方程、规划递归、因果干预、在线遗憾和均衡如何作为特例出现。
Conclusion: 论文强调不是所有决策问题有相同算法，而是许多决策形式例示了同一个泛问题：规范地扩展局部行为数据，然后表征全局一致的扩展。

papers.title: ConTrans: Learning Text-enhanced Local-global Temporal Representations for Zero-shot Temporal Action Localization
papers.abstract_en: Zero-shot Temporal Action Localization (ZS-TAL) aims to detect and locate previously unseen actions in untrimmed videos. However, existing approaches primarily focus on modeling long-range contextual information, often neglecting the critical relative-offset-based local correlations between video frames. Furthermore, their performance is hindered by limited feature representation capabilities due to the shallow nature of their network architectures. In this paper, we address these limitations by introducing a novel local-global multi-scale feature representation module. We propose a novel multi-scale encoder architecture, termed ConTrans, that integrates convolutional (Conv) inductive biases with transformer Self-attention to jointly capture fine-grained local dependencies and long-range global context, leading to more comprehensive feature representations than existing methods. Experimental evaluations on the ActivityNet-1.3 and THUMOS14 datasets demonstrate that ConTrans significantly outperforms existing methods, establishing a new benchmark for ZS-TAL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ConTrans，一种结合卷积和Transformer的多尺度编码器，用于零样本时序动作定位（ZS-TAL）。该方法通过局部-全局多尺度特征表示模块，同时捕捉细粒度局部依赖和长程全局上下文，解决了现有方法忽略局部相关性和网络浅层特征表示能力不足的问题。在ActivityNet-1.3和THUMOS14数据集上的实验表明，ConTrans显著优于现有方法，建立了新的基准。
Motivation: 现有ZS-TAL方法主要关注长程上下文建模，忽略了视频帧之间的相对偏移局部相关性，且网络架构较浅导致特征表示能力有限。
Method: 提出局部-全局多尺度特征表示模块和多尺度编码器ConTrans，集成卷积归纳偏置与Transformer自注意力，联合捕捉细粒度局部依赖和长程全局上下文。
Result: 在ActivityNet-1.3和THUMOS14数据集上，ConTrans显著优于现有方法，建立了零样本时序动作定位的新基准。
Conclusion: 摘要强调ConTrans通过多尺度特征表示和混合架构有效提升了零样本时序动作定位的性能。

papers.title: Depth-Dependent Indirect Prompt Injection in Tool-Calling ReAct Agents: Injection Depth, Payload Framing, and Turn-Budget Sensitivity
papers.abstract_en: ReAct agents that interleave chain-of-thought reasoning with tool calls are increasingly deployed for real tasks such as scheduling, file retrieval, and data access. Their tool observation loop creates a direct attack surface: an adversary who controls any tool's return value can embed instructions that redirect the agent away from the user's goal, a threat known as indirect prompt injection. Existing benchmarks evaluate attack success rate (ASR) at a fixed injection position under fixed conditions, leaving three risk dimensions unexplored: where in the tool sequence the payload appears (injection depth), what rhetorical register it uses (framing), and how many turns the agent is permitted (turn cap). We conduct four controlled studies on 20 scenarios spanning five attack categories, totalling 460 trials against GPT-4o-mini and Claude Haiku at a combined API cost under 0.36 USD. Study 1 shows that ASR against GPT-4o-mini decays from 60% at depth 1 to 0% at depths 4 and 5 (Cramer's V = 0.58, p < 0.001; restricted to within-sequence depths 1-3: V = 0.47, p = 0.0013), driven by model resistance at depth 1 and task completion before payload encounter at deeper positions. Study 2 replicates the depth experiment on Claude Haiku, which achieves 0% ASR at every depth through a combination of conservative tool invocation and genuine instruction resistance. Study 3 shows that framing modulates ASR between 25% (neutral) and 75% (persona) at depth 1, a 50-percentage-point range that does not reach statistical significance at N = 20 per condition. Study 4 confirms that ASR is stable across turn caps of 3, 5, and 7, indicating the turn budget is not a risk factor in this setting. Our results establish injection depth as the dominant variable and show that sanitising only the first tool observation captures 67% of measured injection successes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过控制实验研究ReAct代理中间接提示注入风险随注入深度、提示框架和轮次预算的变化。实验在20个场景、5类攻击、460次试验下进行，使用GPT-4o-mini和Claude Haiku。结果表明注入深度是主导变量：GPT-4o-mini的ASR从深度1的60%衰减至深度4-5的0%，Claude Haiku在所有深度均为0%；轮次预算不影响ASR；框架产生25%-75%的ASR波动但统计不显著。仅清理第一个工具观测可捕获67%的注入成功。
Motivation: 现有基准测试仅评估固定注入位置下的攻击成功率，忽略了注入深度、提示框架和轮次预算等风险维度。
Method: 设计四组控制实验，涵盖20个场景的5类攻击，共460次试验，在GPT-4o-mini和Claude Haiku上测试，API总成本低于0.36美元。实验系统操纵注入深度（工具序列中的位置）、提示框架（修辞语域）和轮次预算（3/5/7）。
Result: GPT-4o-mini的ASR随深度增加从60%（深度1）降至0%（深度4-5），Cramer's V=0.58；Claude Haiku在所有深度均为0%。框架使ASR在25%（中性）到75%（角色框架）间变化但未达统计显著（N=20）。轮次预算3/5/7下ASR稳定。
Conclusion: 注入深度是影响成功率的主导变量，仅在第1个工具观测进行清理即可捕获67%的注入成功。对于Claude Haiku，其保守工具调用和指令抵抗特性保证了零成功率。

papers.title: How Early Adopters Used Generative AI Worldwide: Variation by Country Income and Language
papers.abstract_en: AI is being used by people globally, but not everyone is using it in the same ways. Using a large-scale dataset of anonymized, de-identified, and privacy-scrubbed interactions with a widely available and free AI chatbot, we empirically characterize differences in early adopters' usage across countries. Schooling is the most common domain of use in most countries, particularly low-income countries, with a strong inverse association evident between schooling and country-level GDP. Leisure-related use, by contrast, is positively associated with country-level income. Language, we find, also shapes use: English-language interactions are overrepresented in places where the predominant languages were not well-served by existing models during the period of the study. Improving performance across languages may be a key factor, our work suggests, in whether this technology expands digital divides or enables leapfrogging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用大规模匿名化AI聊天机器人交互数据，分析了不同国家早期采用者使用生成式AI的差异。研究发现，教育是全球最常见的用途，尤其是在低收入国家；娱乐性使用则与收入正相关。语言使用也存在差异：英语交互在现有模型覆盖不足的语言地区过度代表。
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏对全球范围内AI使用模式的实证分析，特别是不同收入水平和语言环境下的差异。本文旨在填补这一空白，为理解AI是否扩大数字鸿沟或促进跨越式发展提供依据。
Method: 使用一个广泛可用免费AI聊天机器人的大规模匿名化交互数据集，进行跨国比较分析。通过统计方法考察用途与GDP、语言等因素的关联。
Result: 教育用途在低收入国家更为普遍，与GDP呈强负相关；娱乐用途与GDP正相关。英语交互在非英语主流语言地区占比过高，说明现有模型在非英语语言上表现不足。
Conclusion: 提升模型在多语言上的表现可能是影响该技术能否缩小数字鸿沟的关键因素。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文利用大规模匿名化AI聊天机器人交互数据，分析了不同国家早期采用者使用生成式AI的差异。研究发现，教育是全球最常见的用途，尤其是在低收入国家；娱乐性使用则与收入正相关。语言使用也存在差异：英语交互在现有模型覆盖不足的语言地区过度代表。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有研究缺乏对全球范围内AI使用模式的实证分析，特别是不同收入水平和语言环境下的差异。本文旨在填补这一空白，为理解AI是否扩大数字鸿沟或促进跨越式发展提供依据。
summary_sections.method: 使用一个广泛可用免费AI聊天机器人的大规模匿名化交互数据集，进行跨国比较分析。通过统计方法考察用途与GDP、语言等因素的关联。
summary_sections.result: 教育用途在低收入国家更为普遍，与GDP呈强负相关；娱乐用途与GDP正相关。英语交互在非英语主流语言地区占比过高，说明现有模型在非英语语言上表现不足。
summary_sections.conclusion: 提升模型在多语言上的表现可能是影响该技术能否缩小数字鸿沟的关键因素。

papers.title: A mathematical framework for dynamic emergent constraints in climate science
papers.abstract_en: Emergent constraints in climate science are empirical relations that link the response to a forcing of a physical observable to the properties of other observables, with the aim of reducing climate change projection uncertainties. Here we use recent results in linear response theory to develop a mathematical framework for dynamic emergent constraints, a class of emergent constraints linking the response of different observables to the same forcing. We show how traditional dynamic emergent constraints are a special case of more general relations, that we call integral dynamic emergent constraints. These relations allow to compute the response of a predictand as the convolution of the response of a predictor and the proxy Green's function of the predictand-predictor pair. The conditions for the existence of integral emergent constraints are related to the causality of the proxy Green's function and the time scales at which the system is observed. We apply this framework to global warming simulations with the MPI-ESM climate model, to study dynamic emergent constraints between different observables. These results allow to put the theory of dynamic emergent constraints on firm mathematical ground, and suggest a protocol to identify necessary conditions for the existence of such relations in climate data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于线性响应理论（linear response theory）为气候科学中的动态涌现约束（dynamic emergent constraints）建立了一个数学框架。作者将传统的动态涌现约束推广为更一般的积分动态涌现约束（integral dynamic emergent constraints），并通过预测因子的响应与代理格林函数的卷积来预测预测量的响应。该框架在MPI-ESM气候模型的全球变暖模拟中得到了验证。
Motivation: 气候科学中的涌现约束是经验关系，旨在通过观测量的性质来减小气候变化预测的不确定性。现有理论缺乏严格的数学基础，本文旨在弥补这一空白。
Method: 利用线性响应理论的最新成果，推导出积分动态涌现约束的一般形式。该约束将预测量的响应表示为预测因子的响应与代理格林函数的卷积，并分析了代理格林函数的因果性和观测时间尺度对约束存在性的影响。
Result: 将框架应用于MPI-ESM气候模型的全球变暖模拟，展示了不同观测量之间的动态涌现约束关系。
Conclusion: 该工作为动态涌现约束提供了坚实的数学基础，并提出了识别气候数据中此类约束存在必要条件的协议。

papers.title: Healthcare Mechanisms from Policy-as-Code Search under Strategic Provider Response
papers.abstract_en: Healthcare mechanisms are inseparable from the strategic provider response they induce: existing healthcare AI benchmarks hold this response fixed and so cannot evaluate mechanisms by the equilibrium they produce. We recast hospital mechanism design as program synthesis for language models: typed, inspectable rule programs are executed and scored by Medi-Sim, a multi-agent simulator with five strategic provider channels (coding, selection, delay, effort, triage). An incentive sweep recovers classical health-economics findings as adjacent regimes -- up-coding and low-complexity-patient selection under profit pressure, and Goodhart-style drift where measured performance becomes anti-correlated with true outcomes -- and a single audit lever exposes pressure migration: closing the coding channel more than doubles low-complexity selection. LLM-guided evolutionary code search over the same rule-program space then synthesizes an inspectable mixed-objective program that eliminates up-coding, halves rejection, and retains most of the profit-oriented baseline's funds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将医院机制设计重新表述为语言模型的程序合成，通过多智能体模拟器Medi-Sim评估提供者策略响应。激励扫描复现了经典健康经济学现象，如利润压力下的编码和患者选择漂移，并利用LLM引导的进化搜索合成可检查的混合目标规则程序，有效消除了上编码、减少了半数拒收，同时保留了大部分利润基线资金。
Motivation: 现有医疗AI基准固定提供者响应，无法评估机制在策略响应下的均衡效果，忽略了提供者博弈行为对机制性能的影响。
Method: 将机制设计转化为类型化、可检查的规则程序，通过Medi-Sim（包含编码、选择、延迟、努力、分诊五个策略渠道）执行和评分，并采用LLM引导的进化代码搜索优化规则程序。
Result: 激励扫描恢复了利润压力下上编码与低复杂性患者选择、Goodhart漂移等经典发现；关闭编码渠道导致低复杂性选择加倍；合成的混合目标程序消除了上编码、将拒收减少一半，并保留了大部分利润基线资金。
Conclusion: 将政策编码为可检查程序，结合多智能体模拟与进化搜索，能够有效发现和缓解医疗机制中因策略响应导致的意外后果。

papers.title: Investigating Detection and Obfuscation of Prompt Injection Attacks Against Software Reverse Engineering AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Agentic software reverse engineering systems are vulnerable to prompt injection attacks placed into the source code of executable binary files. This research demonstrates defensive tactics for detecting the presences of prompt injection strings in the decompiler output of adversarial example programs. Methods for obfuscating these attacks and subsequent methods for defending against these obfuscations are also explored. This research advances the understanding of risk and security of agentic software analysis systems necessary for their deployment into production-level cyber workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究针对智能软件逆向工程系统的提示注入攻击，这些攻击隐藏在可执行文件的源代码中。作者展示了在反编译器输出中检测提示注入字符串的防御策略，并探索了混淆攻击及相应防御方法。研究增进了对智能软件分析系统安全风险的理解，为其在生产级网络工作流中的部署提供支持。
Motivation: 智能逆向工程系统容易受到通过源代码注入的提示注入攻击，需要有效的检测和防御方法以保障部署安全。
Method: 提出防御策略检测反编译器输出中的提示注入字符串，并探索混淆攻击及对应防御方法。
Result: 展示了检测和防御提示注入攻击的可行性，并分析了混淆与反混淆的对抗过程。
Conclusion: 该研究增进了对智能软件分析系统安全风险的理解，为生产级部署提供参考。

papers.title: Human-Alignment, Calibration, and Activation Patterns in Large Language Model Uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: Uncertainty Quantification is a large and growing subfield of large language model behavioral analysis. Primarily to recognize and combat hallucination, the field has largely focused on measuring and improving calibration, the accuracy of uncertainty judgments to task efficacy. In this work, we investigate the relatively underexplored question of how similar large language model uncertainty is to human uncertainty. We investigate the presence and strength of human-similar uncertainty signals, deemed uncertainty alignment, in large language model overt behavior and internal activation patterns. We identify whether the models show evidence of simultaneous alignment and calibration on a variety of datasets covering both multiple choice and open ended factual recall. And we characterize the effect of instruct fine-tuning on each of these facets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探索了大型语言模型的不确定性与人类不确定性的相似性（即不确定性对齐），并考察了模型在多项选择和开放式事实回忆任务中的对齐与校准同时存在的证据，以及指令微调对这些方面的影响。
Motivation: 现有不确定性量化研究主要关注校准（即不确定性判断与任务准确性的匹配），但很少探究模型不确定性是否与人类不确定性相似。本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 通过在多个数据集（涵盖多项选择和开放式事实回忆）上分析模型的外部行为与内部激活模式，识别不确定性对齐信号，并比较校准与其关系。
Result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，但指出发现了模型同时表现出对齐和校准的证据，并表征了指令微调对两者的影响。
Conclusion: 本文强调了不确定性对齐作为LLM行为分析新维度的意义，并揭示了校准与对齐并非互斥，指令微调会改变它们的表现。

papers.title: WristCompass: Kinematic Coupling as a Learnable Visual Concept for Ego-Camera Orientation
papers.abstract_en: Recovering ego-camera orientation from manipulation video is a prerequisite for disentangling hand motion from camera motion, a key step in imitation learning from egocentric demonstrations. The obvious approach, inferring orientation from scene geometry, fails when hands occlude the frame: VGGT, a 1B-parameter scene reconstruction model, scores worse than a constant predictor on the TACO benchmark. We identify an alternative visual concept that is present precisely when scene geometry is absent: kinematic coupling dynamics, the structured physical relationship between wrist motion and camera orientation imposed by the arm-shoulder-head chain. We find that this concept is compact (4D inter-wrist features outperform 126D full hand keypoints), temporal (requiring a GRU over short windows rather than per-frame retrieval), and physically grounded (transferring zero-shot across datasets because it is rooted in anatomy rather than scene appearance). Trained only on tabletop manipulation, WristCompass transfers zero-shot to Epic Kitchens cooking video, achieving 14.3$^\circ$ median geodesic error and approaching the performance of a 1B-parameter scene model at 200K GRU parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出WristCompass，通过手腕运动与相机朝向之间的运动学耦合关系，从自我中心视频中恢复相机朝向。该方法使用4维手腕特征和GRU时序模型，在TACO基准上优于1B参数场景模型，并零样本迁移至Epic Kitchens，达到14.3°中位测地误差。
Motivation: 从自我中心演示视频中分离手部运动与相机运动是模仿学习的关键步骤，但现有基于场景几何的方法在手部遮挡时失效。
Method: 识别出运动学耦合（kinematic coupling dynamics）作为视觉概念，利用4维手腕特征替代完整手部关键点，并通过GRU在短时间窗口内建模时序关系，从而预测相机朝向。
Result: 在Epic Kitchens零样本迁移中取得14.3°中位测地误差，仅用200K参数GRU即接近1B参数场景模型的性能。
Conclusion: 该方法紧凑、时序依赖且物理可迁移，证明运动学耦合可作为遮挡场景下相机朝向恢复的有效线索。

papers.title: CobSeg: Coherence Boundary Modeling for Dialogue Topic Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Dialogue topic segmentation is critical in many human-AI collaborative applications which requires identifying heterogeneous boundary cues, including lexical transitions near utterance edges and semantic discontinuities across utterances. Existing utterance models often dilute these local lexical signals. We propose CobSeg, a novel multi-branch architecture that separates coherence-level semantic continuity from lexical boundary transitions and recovers both through directional boundary prediction. CobSeg further uses boundary informativeness weighting to emphasize high-utility utterance positions, and incorporates a corpus-derived topic coherence cue with learned combination weights. While CobSeg is evaluated as a compact trainable segmenter under supervised gold-boundary training and a pseudo-label setting with automatically induced boundaries, it performs enhanced boundary prediction without LLM calls during inference. Across five benchmarks, it improves $P_k$ and $W_d$ particularly when local lexical cues are prominent: under gold supervision, it reduces $P_k$ by 0.7 points and $W_d$ by 0.6 points on VHF, and reaches $P_k$ of 1.0 on DialSeg711; with induced boundaries, it reduces $P_k$ by 14.8 points on VHF, by 1.5 points on DialSeg711, and by 1.1 points on TIAGE, outperforming prior non-LLM approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CobSeg，一种多分支架构的对话主题分割方法，通过分离语义连续性与词汇边界转换并利用方向性边界预测、边界信息量加权以及语料主题连贯性提示，在五个基准上提升了分割性能，尤其是在局部词汇线索显著的情况下，且推理时不需调用大语言模型。
Motivation: 现有对话分割方法常稀释局部词汇信号，难以同时处理词汇转换和语义不连续性两种边界线索。
Method: CobSeg 采用多分支架构，分别建模语义连续性和词汇边界转换，通过方向性边界预测恢复两者；引入边界信息量加权以突出高信息量位置，并融合语料主题连贯性提示。
Result: 在黄金边界监督下，CobSeg 在 VHF 数据集上将 P_k 降低 0.7 点、W_d 降低 0.6 点，在 DialSeg711 上达到 P_k 1.0；在自动诱导边界下，在 VHF 上降低 P_k 14.8 点，在 DialSeg711 上降低 1.5 点，在 TIAGE 上降低 1.1 点，超越之前非大语言模型方法。
Conclusion: CobSeg 通过显式建模词汇边界和语义连续性，在对话主题分割任务上取得显著改进，尤其在局部词汇线索明显的场景下表现突出。

summary_sections.result: 在黄金边界监督下，CobSeg 在 VHF 数据集上将 P_k 降低 0.7 点、W_d 降低 0.6 点，在 DialSeg711 上达到 P_k 1.0；在自动诱导边界下，在 VHF 上降低 P_k 14.8 点，在 DialSeg711 上降低 1.5 点，在 TIAGE 上降低 1.1 点，超越之前非大语言模型方法。
summary_sections.conclusion: CobSeg 通过显式建模词汇边界和语义连续性，在对话主题分割任务上取得显著改进，尤其在局部词汇线索明显的场景下表现突出。

papers.title: MIRA: Mid-training Rubric Anchoring for Source-Aware Data Selection
papers.abstract_en: Mid-training has become an important stage in modern LLM development, using large-scale curated mixtures to strengthen capabilities before final post-training. Its data selection problem is distinct: the data are optimized under a pretraining-style objective at near-pretraining scale, but are curated toward downstream capabilities and drawn from heterogeneous sources with different formats and training roles. As a result, effective selection requires both scalability and source-adaptive semantic criteria. Existing model-based methods scale well, but provide only implicit quality signals. Semantic selection methods offer stronger judgments, but usually assume fixed rubrics or standardized data formats. To address this mismatch, we propose MIRA, a source-aware filtering framework based on self-anchored rubric discovery. The key idea is to make rubric construction part of data selection: MIRA first discovers what should be evaluated for each source group, then distills those judgments into scalable student scorers for full-corpus filtering. On code-oriented mid-training with 21 sources and 5 source groups, MIRA outperforms selection baselines across nine code benchmarks and matches the full-corpus run while using only half the tokens.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MIRA 提出了一种面向中期训练（mid-training）的源感知数据选择框架，通过自锚定规则发现（self-anchored rubric discovery）为每个源组自动构造评估标准，再将判断蒸馏为可扩展的学生评分器用于全语料过滤。在包含 21 个源和 5 个源组的代码中期训练场景中，MIRA 在 9 个代码基准上超越现有选择基线，且仅用一半 token 即可达到全语料运行的效果。
Motivation: 中期训练中的数据选择面临独特矛盾：数据规模接近预训练、优化目标采用预训练风格，但数据需面向下游能力且来自格式和角色各异的异构源。现有方法要么可扩展但仅提供隐式质量信号，要么语义判断强但依赖固定规则或标准格式，无法适应源间差异。
Method: MIRA 将规则构造纳入数据选择流程：首先对每个源组自动发现应评估的维度（self-anchored rubric discovery），然后利用这些判断训练可扩展的学生评分器（student scorers），再对全语料库进行过滤。
Result: 在代码中期训练实验中（21 个源，5 个源组），MIRA 在 9 个代码基准上优于所有选择基线，且仅使用一半的训练 token 即可匹配全语料库的运行效果。
Conclusion: MIRA 通过源感知的规则发现和蒸馏，实现了可扩展且适应异构源的中期训练数据选择，并验证了其在代码领域的有效性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: GenClaw: Code-Driven Agentic Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Image generation models have evolved from text-conditioned pixel synthesis toward multimodal agents endowed with visual comprehension and tool invocation capabilities. Yet, existing agents remain at the mercy of underlying black-box image models. Their workflow is trapped in a repetitive cycle of prompt rewriting for generation refinement, leaving them with no mechanism to directly manipulate the canvas. In essence, the potential of LLMs to serve as a genuine "brush" for precise visual construction remains largely untapped. In this paper, we propose GenClaw, a code-driven agentic image generation paradigm that empowers the agent to create like a human artist: first conceptualizing, then sketching, and finally coloring. Specifically, the agent first constructs the conceptual knowledge and context through search and reasoning. It then utilizes code (e.g., SVG, HTML, ThreeJS) to render executable visual sketches. Finally, it employs an image generation model to supplement textures, materials, and photorealism. In this workflow, code serves as a controllable intermediate canvas bridging linguistic reasoning and pixel synthesis, seamlessly integrating programmatic logic with the visual expressiveness of generative models. By transforming image generation from a black-box paradigm into a staged process akin to authentic human creation, GenClaw offers a step toward for highly controllable and interpretable visual generation systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GenClaw提出一种代码驱动的智能体图像生成范式，将图像生成从黑盒过程转变为类似人类艺术家的分阶段流程：先通过搜索和推理构建概念知识，然后利用代码（如SVG、HTML、ThreeJS）渲染可执行的视觉草图，最后使用图像生成模型补充纹理和材质，实现高可控性和可解释性的视觉生成。
Motivation: 现有图像生成代理依赖黑盒模型，只能通过重复改写提示来优化，无法直接操作画布，导致缺乏精细控制。
Method: 采用三阶段流程：概念构建（搜索+推理）、代码渲染（SVG/HTML/ThreeJS）可执行草图、图像模型补全纹理和真实感，代码作为可控中间画布连接语言推理和像素合成。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验结果，但声称该范式提供了高度可控和可解释的视觉生成能力。
Conclusion: GenClaw将图像生成从黑盒转变为分阶段的人类创作过程，有望推动可控和可解释的视觉生成系统发展。

papers.title: Déjà View: Looping Transformers for Multi-View 3D Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Recent feed-forward 3D reconstruction transformers have scaled to over a billion parameters, following the broader trend of increasing model capacity in computer vision. Yet emerging evidence suggests that contiguous transformer layers often behave like repeated applications of similar operations, and multi-view reconstruction transformers refine their predictions progressively across decoder depth. We posit that model depth partially buys iteration, paid for inefficiently in unique parameters, and instead make that iteration explicit in architecture. Our model, DéjàView, applies a single looped transformer block recurrently to per-view features for K refinement steps. Trained once, it exposes K as an inference-time compute knob, matching or outperforming substantially larger feed-forward baselines across five reconstruction benchmarks spanning indoor, outdoor, object-centric, and driving scenes, while using a fraction of their parameters and comparable or lower compute. Importantly, the same looped block formulation outperforms an otherwise identical variant with independent per-step parameters under matched training data and compute, suggesting that explicit iteration is not merely a compute-efficient substitute for capacity but a stronger inductive bias for multi-view 3D reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DéjàView，一种循环Transformer架构，通过单个循环块多次迭代更新多视角特征，用于3D重建。该方法在多个基准上匹配或超越更大规模的基线模型，且参数更少。实验表明显式迭代比独立参数更有效，提供了更强的归纳偏置。
Motivation: 现有前馈3D重建Transformer随深度增加参数效率低下，因为连续层常重复类似操作。作者假设模型深度部分购买了迭代，但效率低，因此将迭代显式引入架构。
Method: DéjàView使用单个循环Transformer块对每视角特征进行K步递归细化。训练一次后，K可作为推理时计算调节旋钮。
Result: 在五个重建基准（室内、室外、物体中心、驾驶场景）上，DéjàView匹配或超越更大的前馈基线，使用更少参数和相当或更低的计算量。循环块公式优于具有独立每步参数的相同变体。
Conclusion: 显式迭代不仅是计算高效的容量替代，而且为多视角3D重建提供了更强的归纳偏置。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Neural Network Verification using Partial Multi-Neuron Relaxation
papers.abstract_en: The increasing integration of deep neural networks in critical systems has spawned a theoretical and practical interest in formally guaranteeing safety properties about their behavior. To achieve this, contemporary verification algorithms rely on computing linear relaxations for a network's non-linear activation functions. Existing approaches for linear relaxations typically fall into one of two categories: single-neuron relaxation, in which each activation neuron is bounded in terms of its sources; and multi-neuron relaxation, in which linear bounds involving multiple activation neurons and their sources are calculated. However, existing methods might fail to balance tightness and scalability, as single-neuron bounds might not derive sufficiently tight bounds necessary for verification to complete, whereas generating multi-neuron relaxation for all activation neurons is computationally expensive. In this paper, we present a middle-ground approach featuring partial multi-neuron relaxation, in which we generate multi-neuron bounds for only a small, heuristically selected subset of neurons. To achieve this, we build upon existing branching heuristics for selecting neurons and for optimizing bounding hyper-planes for multi-neuron bounds. We integrated our proposed method within the Marabou verifier, and obtained favorable results in comparison to existing bound tightening methods. Our experiments showcase the potential of our technique for neural network verification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对神经网络验证中的线性松弛方法，提出部分多神经元松弛（partial multi-neuron relaxation），在分支启发式选择的小部分神经元上生成多神经元边界，以平衡紧致性和可扩展性。将方法集成到Marabou验证器后，与现有边界收紧方法相比取得了有利结果。
Motivation: 现有单神经元松弛可能因边界不够紧致导致验证失败，而多神经元松弛对所有神经元生成计算开销大，缺乏兼顾精度与效率的折中方案。
Method: 基于现有分支启发式选择关键神经元，并通过优化多神经元边界的超平面来生成部分多神经元松弛，仅对选中的小部分神经元计算多神经元边界。
Result: 集成到Marabou验证器后，实验表明所提方法在缩短验证时间或提高验证成功率方面优于现有的单神经元和多神经元松弛方法。
Conclusion: 部分多神经元松弛为神经网络验证提供了一条中间路线，能够在不显著增加计算开销的前提下提升边界紧致性，具有实际应用潜力。

papers.title: No More K-means: Single-Stage Sparse Coding for Efficient Multi-Vector Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Multi-vector retrieval (MVR) models, exemplified by ColBERT, have established new benchmarks in retrieval accuracy by preserving fine-grained token-level interactions. However, this granularity imposes prohibitive storage and retrieval efficiency bottlenecks: to manage the immense memory footprint and computational overhead of billion-scale token vectors, state-of-the-art systems are forced to rely on aggressive dimension reduction and complex clustering (e.g., K-means). This compromise introduces two critical limitations: excessive indexing latency of clustering large-scale corpora and semantic information loss inherent to compression. In this paper, we propose Single-stage Sparse Retrieval (SSR}, a paradigm shift that replaces expensive clustering with efficient sparse coding. Instead of compressing features into low-dimensional dense vectors, we utilize Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) to project token embeddings into a high-dimensional but highly sparse representation. This transformation enables us to bypass vector clustering entirely and leverage inverted indexing for precise, high-throughput retrieval. Extensive experiments on the BEIR benchmark demonstrate that SSR achieves a "trifecta" of improvements: it reduces indexing time by 15x compared to ColBERTv2, halves retrieval latency, and simultaneously improves retrieval performance over leading baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出单阶段稀疏检索（SSR）替代K-means聚类，使用稀疏自编码器（SAE）将token嵌入投影到高维稀疏表示，从而避免向量聚类，利用倒排索引实现精确高效检索。在BEIR基准上，索引时间减少15倍，检索延迟减半，同时性能优于现有基线。
Motivation: 多向量检索模型（如ColBERT）虽有高精度，但存储和检索效率低，现有系统依赖降维和K-means聚类，导致索引延迟大和语义信息损失。
Method: 使用稀疏自编码器（SAE）将token嵌入投影到高维稀疏表示，取代聚类，结合倒排索引实现高效精确检索。
Result: 在BEIR基准上，索引时间比ColBERTv2减少15倍，检索延迟减半，检索性能优于领先基线。
Conclusion: SSR是一种范式转变，通过稀疏编码替代聚类，显著提升多向量检索的效率与精度。

papers.title: Towards Consistent Video Geometry Estimation
papers.abstract_en: This work presents ViGeo, a feed-forward foundation model for recovering spatially dense and temporally consistent geometry from video sequences. Built upon a plain transformer architecture without task-specific architectural modifications, ViGeo supports streaming, full-sequence, and long-video inference within a unified model. The key design is dynamic chunking attention, which exposes the model to both bidirectional and causal temporal contexts during training and allows it to adapt its attention pattern at test time without retraining. To improve supervision quality, we further introduce a completion-based data refinement framework. This framework trains a video depth completion teacher that conditions on sparse and noisy annotations and exploits video/multi-view context to produce dense, temporally coherent, and geometrically reliable training targets. Beyond depth and point maps, ViGeo also predicts surface normals within the same framework. Trained solely on public datasets, ViGeo achieves state-of-the-art performance across online, offline, and long-video depth estimation, surface normal estimation, and video point map estimation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ViGeo 是一个前馈基础模型，用于从视频中恢复空间密集且时间一致的几何信息（深度、法线、点图）。它基于纯 Transformer 架构，通过动态分块注意力（dynamic chunking attention）支持流式、全序列和长视频推理，并引入基于补全的数据精炼框架来提升训练监督质量。在公开数据集上训练后，ViGeo 在在线、离线及长视频深度估计、法线估计和点图估计任务上达到了最先进水平。
Motivation: 现有视频几何估计方法在处理时间一致性、长视频以及多种推理模式（在线/离线）时存在局限，需要统一的模型架构。
Method: 提出 ViGeo，基于纯 Transformer 架构，核心是动态分块注意力（在训练中暴露双向和因果上下文，测试时自适应调整注意力模式）和基于补全的数据精炼框架（利用视频/多视图上下文从稀疏标注生成密集、时间一致且几何可靠的训练目标）。
Result: 仅在公开数据集上训练，ViGeo 在在线、离线及长视频深度估计、表面法线估计和视频点图估计上达到最先进性能。
Conclusion: ViGeo 无需任务特定架构修改即可统一多种推理模式，动态分块注意力和数据精炼框架是提升时间一致性和监督质量的关键设计。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有视频几何估计方法在处理时间一致性、长视频以及多种推理模式（在线/离线）时存在局限，需要统一的模型架构。
summary_sections.method: 提出 ViGeo，基于纯 Transformer 架构，核心是动态分块注意力（在训练中暴露双向和因果上下文，测试时自适应调整注意力模式）和基于补全的数据精炼框架（利用视频/多视图上下文从稀疏标注生成密集、时间一致且几何可靠的训练目标）。
summary_sections.result: 仅在公开数据集上训练，ViGeo 在在线、离线及长视频深度估计、表面法线估计和视频点图估计上达到最先进性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: ViGeo 无需任务特定架构修改即可统一多种推理模式，动态分块注意力和数据精炼框架是提升时间一致性和监督质量的关键设计。

papers.title: Domain-Specific Data Synthesis for LLMs via Minimal Sufficient Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models have demonstrated remarkable progress in general-purpose capabilities and can achieve strong performance in specific domains through fine-tuning on domain-specific data. However, acquiring high-quality data for target domains remains a significant challenge. Existing data synthesis approaches follow a deductive paradigm, heavily relying on explicit domain descriptions expressed in natural language and careful prompt engineering, limiting their applicability in real-world scenarios where domains are difficult to describe or formally articulate. In this work, we tackle the underexplored problem of domain-specific data synthesis through an inductive paradigm, where the target domain is defined only through a set of reference examples, particularly when domain characteristics are difficult to articulate in natural language. We propose a novel framework, DOMINO, that learns a minimal sufficient domain representation from reference samples and leverages it to guide the generation of domain-aligned synthetic data. DOMINO integrates prompt tuning with a contrastive disentanglement objective to separate domain-level patterns from sample-specific noise, mitigating overfitting while preserving core domain characteristics. Theoretically, we prove that DOMINO expands the support of the synthetic data distribution, ensuring greater diversity. Empirically, on challenging coding benchmarks where domain definitions are implicit, fine-tuning on data synthesized by DOMINO improves Pass@1 accuracy by up to 4.63\% over strong, instruction-tuned backbones, demonstrating its effectiveness and robustness. This work establishes a new paradigm for domain-specific data synthesis, enabling practical and scalable domain adaptation without manual prompt design or natural language domain specifications.

Result: 在编码基准上，使用DOMINO合成数据微调相比强指令微调基线，Pass@1提升最多4.63%。

papers.title: Latent Performance Profiling of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) frequently achieve impressive scores on standardized benchmarks, yet accuracy alone offers a limited view of their capabilities. Evaluating open-source LLMs through leaderboards faces persistent issues like data contamination, narrow task scope, and weak alignment with real-world reliability. Benchmark-based evaluations such as MMLU PRO, BBH, or IFEval primarily capture what a model outputs on fixed test sets, not how it processes information, calibrates uncertainty, or structures internal knowledge. In this article, we advocate for a shift from benchmark-centric evaluation toward a complementary, state-centered intrinsic assessment of LLMs. To this end, we introduce Latent Performance Profiling (LPP) -- a framework that derives task-agnostic diagnostics from hidden activations and output distributions. LPP defines a set of scalar metrics on a model's latent representations and dynamics, revealing scale-independent traits that enable interpretable comparisons and uncover hidden vulnerabilities. Unlike static accuracy scores, LPP provides stable, architecture-sensitive signatures across models of similar size. With extensive empirical analyses across eight LLMs, spanning a size range of 0.5B-14B, we demonstrate that models with similar benchmark scores can exhibit contrasting latent profiles, such as differences in entropy or adaptability. Guided by these insights, we design synthetic probes for uncertainty and symbolic reasoning that align with intrinsic metrics while decoupling from leaderboard bias. We recommend that reporting LPP alongside benchmarks provides a deeper, interpretable understanding of model behavior, enabling more reliable model selection, safety assessment, and evaluation beyond surface-level accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出潜在性能剖析（Latent Performance Profiling, LPP）框架，通过隐藏层激活和输出分布提取与任务无关的诊断指标，揭示LLM的内部状态和动态特性，以弥补传统基准测试的不足。在8个0.5B-14B参数规模的LLM上实验表明，LPP能发现具有相似基准分数的模型在潜在特征上存在差异，如熵或适应性。建议将LPP与基准测试结合报告，以提供更深入的模型行为理解。
Motivation: 传统基准测试如MMLU PRO、BBH、IFEval主要衡量模型在固定测试集上的输出准确性，但无法揭示模型如何处理信息、校准不确定性或组织内部知识，且存在数据污染、任务范围窄、与真实可靠性对齐弱等问题。需要转向以状态为中心的内在评估。
Method: 提出潜在性能剖析（LPP）框架，从隐藏激活和输出分布中推导与任务无关的诊断指标，定义一组标量度量来描述模型的潜在表示和动态，揭示与规模无关的特征，实现可解释的比较并发现隐藏漏洞。
Result: 在8个LLM（0.5B-14B参数）上的实证分析表明，基准分数相似的模型可能展现出不同的潜在特征，如熵或适应性差异。基于这些洞察设计了不确定性和符号推理的合成探针，与内在指标对齐并脱离排行榜偏差。
Conclusion: 建议将LPP与基准测试一起报告，提供更深入、可解释的模型行为理解，从而实现更可靠的模型选择、安全评估和超越表面准确度的评估。

papers.title: DGSG-Mind: Dynamic 3D Gaussian Scene Graphs for Long-Term Scene Understanding and Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Integrating open-vocabulary semantic information into dynamic 3D scene representations is essential for long-term embodied scene understanding. However, existing methods often suffer from fragile instance association due to incomplete cross-view cues, while their limited ability to handle object-level topological changes restricts long-term robotic task execution. Moreover, current 3D scene understanding methods either rely on simple feature matching without explicit spatial reasoning or assume offline ground-truth 3D geometry. To address these challenges, we present DGSG-Mind, a hybrid instance-aware 3D Gaussian dynamic scene graph system with an embodied reasoning agent. Our system couples a probabilistic voxel grid with explicit 3D Gaussians to enable robust cross-modal instance fusion and incremental semantic mapping. It handles dynamic changes through Gaussian-based visual relocalization and localized masked refinement guided by geometric-semantic consistency. Built on the instance Gaussian map, DGSG-Mind further constructs a hierarchical scene graph and develops the 3D Gaussian Mind, which integrates structural relations, spatial-semantic information, and visually annotated RoI Gaussian renderings for multimodal reasoning. Extensive experiments show that DGSG-Mind achieves the best zero-shot 3DVG performance among methods operating on self-reconstructed maps, while also delivering strong performance in 3D open-vocabulary semantic segmentation and scene reconstruction. We further deploy DGSG-Mind on real-world robots to demonstrate its target-oriented reasoning and dynamic update capabilities. The project page of DGSG-Mind is available at https://icr-lab.github.io/DGSG-Mind
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DGSG-Mind，一个混合实例感知的 3D 高斯动态场景图系统，耦合概率体素网格与显式 3D 高斯，实现跨模态实例融合、增量语义映射和动态变化处理。系统构建层次场景图并开发 3D 高斯思维进行多模态推理。实验在零样本 3DVG、3D 开放词汇语义分割和场景重建上取得最佳性能，并在真实机器人上验证了目标导向推理与动态更新。
Motivation: 现有动态 3D 场景表示方法因不完整跨视角线索导致实例关联脆弱，且难以处理对象级拓扑变化，依赖简单特征匹配或离线真实 3D 几何，限制长期具身任务执行。
Method: 提出 DGSG-Mind，包括：1) 概率体素网格与显式 3D 高斯耦合实现鲁棒跨模态实例融合和增量语义映射；2) 基于高斯的视觉重定位与局部掩码细化处理动态变化；3) 构建层次场景图并开发 3D 高斯思维，集成结构关系、空间语义和 RoI 高斯渲染进行多模态推理。
Result: 在零样本 3DVG 任务上，DGSG-Mind 在所有自重建地图方法中达到最佳性能；在 3D 开放词汇语义分割和场景重建上也表现强劲。真实机器人部署验证了其目标导向推理和动态更新能力。
Conclusion: DGSG-Mind 通过混合实例感知的 3D 高斯动态场景图与多模态推理代理，有效解决了动态场景中的实例关联和拓扑变化问题，为长期具身场景理解提供了可行方案。

papers.title: Parameter-Efficient Subspace Decoupling ViT for Mitigating Multi-Task Negative Transfer in Histological Scoring
papers.abstract_en: Histological scoring is essential for diagnosing Non-Alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease (NAFLD), yet its automation remains challenging due to the high annotation cost and negative transfer among the strongly correlated NAFLD Activity Score (NAS) indicators in multi-task learning. To address this issue, we propose a subspace-decoupled multi-task Vision Transformer (ViT) that integrates lightweight task-specific Adapters with orthogonality-based constraints. This design constructs independent feature subspaces for steatosis, ballooning, and inflammation, effectively reducing task interference while retaining shared representations. We further construct a curated multi-task mouse NAFLD histology dataset with expert annotations for all NAS components. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method improves multi-task stability and generalization with substantially reduced computational cost compared to training separate single-task models. The code and the curated dataset have been prepared and will be made publicly available upon acceptance to support reproducibility.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对非酒精性脂肪肝病（NAFLD）组织学评分中多任务学习存在的负迁移问题，提出一种参数高效子空间解耦的Vision Transformer（ViT）。该方法通过集成轻量级任务特定Adapter和正交性约束，为脂肪变性、气球样变和炎症构建独立特征子空间，减少任务干扰同时保留共享表示。实验基于自建的小鼠NAFLD组织学数据集，结果表明该方法相比单独训练单任务模型，显著改善了多任务稳定性和泛化性，并大幅降低计算成本。
Motivation: NAFLD组织学评分自动化面临标注成本高以及多任务学习中强相关NAS指标间的负迁移问题，现有方法难以平衡任务共享与干扰。
Method: 提出子空间解耦的多任务ViT架构，在共享ViT主干上为每个NAS任务插入轻量Adapter，并通过正交约束强制各任务特征子空间独立，从而减少任务间干扰。
Result: 在自建小鼠NAFLD组织学数据集上，该方法相比单独训练的单任务模型，提升了多任务稳定性和泛化性能，同时显著降低了计算开销。
Conclusion: 该方法有效缓解了多任务负迁移，为组织学评分的自动化提供了一种高效且可扩展的解决方案。

papers.title: OmniMatBench: A Human-Calibrated Multimodal Reasoning Benchmark Across 19 Materials Science Subfields
papers.abstract_en: As multimodal language models play an increasingly important role in scientific research, materials science offers a critical testbed due to its interdisciplinary, multimodal, and application-driven nature. However, existing materials benchmarks mainly focus on property prediction, knowledge QA, or characterization understanding, leaving the broader reasoning process from materials knowledge to application underexplored. To fill this gap, we present OmniMatBench, a human-calibrated multimodal reasoning benchmark for materials science. OmniMatBench contains 3,171 expert-curated QA and calculation problems across 19 materials-science subfields, spanning fundamental materials knowledge, structural and engineering materials, materials processing and manufacturing, and functional and applied materials. We evaluate 13 open-source and closed-source MLLMs and find that the best model achieves only a 0.372 overall score, revealing a substantial gap in current materials-science reasoning. Further analysis shows strong variation across subfields, fixed reasoning heuristics, uneven materials knowledge, and limited high-level knowledge application under formula-, retrieval-, and code-assisted settings. OmniMatBench provides crucial insights into the capabilities and limitations of current MLLMs and establishes a foundation for reliable AI assistants in materials-science research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OmniMatBench，一个由专家精心整理的多模态推理基准，覆盖19个材料科学子领域，包含3171个QA与计算问题。评估13种多模态大语言模型，最佳模型仅得0.372总分，揭示当前模型在材料科学推理中的显著不足。
Motivation: 现有材料科学基准主要聚焦于属性预测、知识问答或表征理解，缺乏从材料知识到应用的整体推理评估。
Method: 构建包含3171个专家精选问题的多模态推理基准，涵盖19个材料子领域，并设计公式、检索和代码辅助设置进行评估。
Result: 最佳模型总分仅0.372，各子领域表现差异大，模型存在固定推理启发式、材料知识不均衡及高级知识应用有限等问题。
Conclusion: OmniMatBench 为评估 MLLM 在材料科学中的能力与局限提供了关键见解，为可靠 AI 助手奠定基础。

papers.title: SAAS: Self-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Over-Search Mitigation in Agentic Search
papers.abstract_en: Agentic search enables LLMs to solve complex multi-hop questions through iterative reasoning and external search. Despite the effectiveness, these systems often suffer from a critical limitation in practice: agents fail to recognize their own knowledge boundaries, blindly triggering searches when internal knowledge suffices and failing to terminate search even when adequate evidence has been collected. The lack of self-awareness leads to severe \textbf{over-search}, incurring substantial inference latency and prohibitive computational cost. To this end, we propose SAAS, a novel RL framework designed to cultivate dynamic self-awareness that precisely regulates search behavior without compromising accuracy. SAAS introduces three key components: (i) a search boundary modeling mechanism, which identifies the search boundary under the evolving policy by contrasting search-disabled and search-enabled rollouts; (ii) a boundary-aware reward module, which translates this boundary awareness into trajectory-level penalties, suppressing unnecessary and redundant searches; and (iii) a stage-wise optimization strategy, which leverages a sequential curriculum to prioritize reasoning over search regularization, thereby avoiding reward hacking. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SAAS substantially reduces over-search, while maintaining accuracy. Our code and implementation details are released at https://github.com/XMUDeepLIT/SAAS.

Motivation: 现有智能体搜索系统在解决复杂多跳问题时，智能体无法识别自身知识边界，导致盲目搜索或过多搜索，造成推理延迟和计算成本高昂。
Method: 提出SAAS框架，包含三个关键组件：(i) 搜索边界建模机制，通过对比有无搜索的轨迹来识别搜索边界；(ii) 边界感知奖励模块，将边界信息转化为轨迹级惩罚以抑制冗余搜索；(iii) 阶段优化策略，采用序列课程优先优化推理再调整搜索正则化，防止奖励破解。
Result: 大量实验表明SAAS在保持准确率的同时大幅减少了过度搜索。代码已开源。
Conclusion: 通过强化学习培养智能体的动态自我感知能力可以有效调节搜索行为，减少不必要的计算开销。

papers.title: SuperVoxelGPT: Adaptive and Ordered 3D Tokenization for Autoregressive Shape Generation
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive multimodal large language models (MLLMs) enable 3D generation but struggle to scale to high-resolution shapes due to inadequate 3D tokenizations. Compact set-based representations discard deterministic spatial ordering, leading to ambiguous sequence prediction, while uniform or octree-based voxel grids preserve ordering at the cost of severe redundancy and excessively long sequences. This structural trade-off limits stable and efficient autoregressive 3D generation. We present SuperVoxelGPT, a representation-first framework that resolves this tension through adaptive and deterministically ordered supervoxel tokenization. Given a prompt, we first predict a coarse geometric saliency distribution and construct a shape-adaptive supervoxel partition using saliency-guided centroidal Voronoi tessellation, allocating fine-grained cells to complex regions and larger cells to smooth regions. Conditioned on the text and ordered supervoxel layout, we introduce a SuperVoxelVAE and fine-tune a pretrained MLLM to autoregressively generate supervoxel tokens. Experiments on Trellis-500K show that SuperVoxelGPT reduces token sequence length to 12.8% of uniform voxel tokenization while achieving state-of-the-art generation quality and an average 10$\times$ speedup over prior methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SuperVoxelGPT，一种基于自适应有序超体素 (supervoxel) 令牌化的自回归 3D 形状生成框架。通过预测几何显著性分布并采用显著性引导的质心 Voronoi 细分，构建形状自适应的超体素分区，从而在保持确定顺序的同时大幅减少序列长度。在 Trellis-500K 数据集上，令牌序列长度仅为均匀体素令牌化的 12.8%，生成质量达到最优，且平均加速 10 倍。
Motivation: 现有 3D 令牌化方法存在结构权衡：紧凑的集合表示丢失空间顺序导致预测歧义，而均匀或八叉树体素网格顺序固定但冗余严重、序列过长，限制了自回归生成的可扩展性和效率。
Method: 首先预测粗略的几何显著性分布，然后利用显著性引导的质心 Voronoi 细分构造形状自适应的超体素分区（复杂区域细粒度单元，平滑区域大单元）；基于文本和有序超体素布局，引入 SuperVoxelVAE 并微调预训练多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 以自回归生成超体素令牌。
Result: 在 Trellis-500K 上，令牌序列长度减至均匀体素令牌化的 12.8%，生成质量达最优，且相比先前方法平均获得 10 倍加速。
Conclusion: 自适应有序超体素令牌化有效解决了 3D 自回归生成中序列长度与空间顺序的冲突，显著提升效率与质量。

papers.title: VikingMem: A Memory Base Management System for Stateful LLM-based Applications
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models have revolutionized interactive applications; however, their finite context windows pose a critical data management challenge for maintaining stateful, long-term interactions. Existing memory approaches often rely on simplistic extraction methods that lead to incomplete memories or use rigid, single-purpose memory extraction prompts tailored to a single use case, such as chatbots. Consequently, they lack generalizability and perform poorly across diverse downstream tasks. To bridge this gap, we introduce the Memory Base, a novel data management paradigm for managing the persistent state of long-term interactions. It is characterized by three core principles: selective extraction of high-value memories from raw information streams; inherent statefulness and evolution, where memory content is progressively summarized, corrected, and temporally weighted to prioritize recent interactions; and a generalizable abstraction paradigm designed for robust transferability across diverse applications, including education, recommendation, and agent memory. Building on this foundation, we present VikingMem, an end-to-end Memory Base Management System implemented on the VikingDB vector engine. VikingMem materializes this paradigm through interconnected event and entity abstractions. It features event-centric memory extraction to selectively handle complex information streams, while entities are dynamically updated by events to achieve stateful evolution. Using temporal compression via a topic-wise timeline and time-weighted recall, the system progressively produces high-level summary memories, prioritizes recent items, and compresses and fades older ones. Extensive evaluations on long-term memory benchmarks demonstrate that VikingMem outperformes baselines by up to 30% in memory retrieval effectiveness while maintaining the low latency essential for interactive applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Memory Base 数据管理范式，用于管理有状态 LLM 应用的持久交互状态，并实现端到端系统 VikingMem。VikingMem 基于 VikingDB 向量引擎，通过事件和实体抽象实现选择性记忆提取、状态演化（事件动态更新实体）以及时间权重压缩，最终在长期记忆基准上检索效果提升最高 30%，同时保持低延迟。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 应用的有限上下文窗口难以支持长期交互的状态管理，已有记忆方法依赖单一用例的简单提取，缺乏泛化性和效果。
Method: 提出 Memory Base 范式，包含选择性提取、状态演化（逐步总结、纠正、时间加权）和可泛化抽象；实现系统 VikingMem，基于事件和实体抽象，通过事件驱动记忆提取和实体动态更新，并采用按主题时间线的时间压缩和加权召回。
Result: 在长期记忆基准上，VikingMem 的检索效果优于基线最高 30%，同时保持低延迟，适合交互式应用。
Conclusion: VikingMem 通过事件和实体抽象实现了通用、高效的长期记忆管理，验证了 Memory Base 范式的有效性。
