papers.title: DynaGraph: Lightweight Multi-Model Interaction Framework via Dynamic Topological Reconfiguration
papers.abstract_en: Tackling complex reasoning tasks typically relies on massive monolithic LLMs, which suffer from severe computational redundancy. While task decomposition through structured pipelines or multi-agent collaborations offers an alternative, these approaches inevitably fall into a critical dilemma: predefined static topologies are highly vulnerable to cascading errors, whereas unconstrained dynamic agents suffer from trajectory divergence and unpredictable memory bloat. To address this, we present DynaGraph, a lightweight multi-model framework driven by dynamic topological reconfiguration. At the execution level, DynaGraph multiplexes time-division PEFT adapters over a shared base model, enabling both full system training and inference deployment on a single consumer-grade GPU. At the routing level, the Evaluator continuously monitors execution confidence to trigger hierarchical self-healing: Fine-grained Patching for localized data gaps and Subgraph Reconstruction for severe logical ruptures. Experiments on StrategyQA, MATH, and FinQA demonstrate our 8B model closely approximates the reasoning capabilities of a 72B monolithic model (e.g., 87.6% on StrategyQA, 82.7% on MATH). Furthermore, it reduces latency by up to 68.1% and token consumption by 68.6% compared to unconstrained dynamic architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DynaGraph 是一个轻量级多模型交互框架，通过动态拓扑重配置在单消费级 GPU 上运行。它采用分时 PEFT 适配器复用共享基座模型，并通过 Evaluator 监控执行信心触发分层自愈（局部修补和子图重建）。在 StrategyQA、MATH 和 FinQA 上，8B 模型接近 72B 模型的推理能力，并显著降低延迟和 token 消耗。
Motivation: 现有大规模单体 LLM 计算冗余严重，而静态拓扑管道或动态多智能体方法易陷入级联错误或轨迹发散与内存膨胀的两难困境。
Method: DynaGraph 使用分时 PEFT 适配器在共享基座模型上复用，实现整体训练和推理在单 GPU 部署；路由层由 Evaluator 持续监控执行信心，触发细粒度修补（Patching）或子图重建（Subgraph Reconstruction）的分层自愈机制。
Result: 8B 模型在 StrategyQA（87.6%）、MATH（82.7%）和 FinQA 上接近 72B 单模型性能，同时相比无约束动态架构降低 68.1% 延迟和 68.6% token 消耗。
Conclusion: DynaGraph 表明，通过动态拓扑重配置和分层自愈，轻量级多模型框架能有效逼近超大规模模型推理能力，同时大幅提升效率。

papers.title: ParCo-SDF: Learning Prior-Free Partial-to-Complete Signed Distance Fields of Deformable Objects
papers.abstract_en: This study addresses the partial-to-complete geometry reconstruction of deformable objects (DOs) from point-cloud observations toward precise DO manipulation. Recent DO reconstruction approaches often adopt implicit neural representations (INRs) to model continuous surfaces as well as capture structural variability. However, these methods typically rely on object-specific shape priors that improve training stability and limit generalization. To figure it out, we introduce ParCo-SDF, a two-stage partial-to-complete signed distance field (SDF) reconstruction framework consisting of temporal geometry encoding followed by FiLM-conditioned SDF prediction. The temporal encoder captures structural similarity across DO sequence, enabling prior-free stable training. FiLM-based conditioning preserves reconstruction expressivity while reducing network complexity. We evaluate the proposed method against a state-of-the-art DO surface reconstruction baseline on a rubber band manipulation dataset, demonstrating robust and high-fidelity reconstruction under severe occlusions.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 23rd International Conference on Ubiquitous Robots (UR 2026), 6 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ParCo-SDF，一种两阶段无先验的部分到完整可变形物体（DO）有符号距离场（SDF）重建框架，包含时序几何编码和 FiLM 条件 SDF 预测。在橡皮筋操作数据集上，该方法在严重遮挡下实现了鲁棒且高保真的重建，优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有 DO 重建方法依赖物体特定的形状先验来保证训练稳定性和泛化性，限制了实用性。
Method: 提出两阶段框架：先用时序编码器捕获 DO 序列的结构相似性，实现无先验的稳定训练；再用 FiLM 条件 SDF 预测保持表达能力并降低网络复杂度。
Result: 在橡皮筋操作数据集上，与 SOTA 基线相比，该方法在严重遮挡下实现鲁棒且高保真的表面重建。
Conclusion: ParCo-SDF 通过时序编码和 FiLM 条件实现了无需形状先验的稳定训练和高质量重建。

papers.title: Deep Adaptive Dimension Reduction for Bayesian Inference in Inverse Problems
papers.abstract_en: Solving high-dimensional PDE-governed inverse problems is often challenging due to complex non-Gaussian posterior distributions, expensive forward model evaluations, and misspecified prior information. To address these issues, we propose a deep adaptive dimension-reduction Bayesian inference framework based on the Variational Flow (VF) model. Since standard normalizing flows are restricted by bijective mappings and cannot directly reduce dimensions, VF overcomes this limitation by integrating VAE-based nonlinear dimension reduction with dual normalizing flows for the latent prior and encoder. This design provides a strictly higher evidence lower bound than VAE and allows more flexible approximation of complex posterior distributions. We further introduce an iterative prior updating strategy that gradually moves the prior mean toward high-probability posterior regions, avoiding manual prior tuning. These components form a closed adaptive loop together with an adaptively fine-tuned Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) surrogate: VF generates posterior-concentrated samples to refine the surrogate, while the updated surrogate further improves posterior inference. Numerical experiments on a 100-dimensional Rosenbrock problem and three standard PDE-governed inverse problems show that our method delivers competitive or superior accuracy compared with MCMC, UKI, and SVGD baselines across all tested configurations, with the most pronounced advantages emerging in challenging scenarios such as high-noise observations and high-dimensional parameter spaces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该文针对高维PDE控制逆问题中的复杂非高斯后验分布、昂贵正向模型评估和错误先验信息，提出基于变分流（VF）的深度自适应降维贝叶斯推断框架。VF通过结合VAE非线性降维和双归一化流（dual normalizing flows）克服了标准流模型的降维限制，并引入迭代先验更新策略和自适应调优的FNO替代模型。在100维Rosenbrock问题和三个标准PDE逆问题上的数值实验显示，该方法在精度上优于或媲美MCMC、UKI和SVGD，尤其在高噪声和高维参数空间场景中优势明显。
Motivation: 高维PDE控制逆问题面临后验分布复杂、正向模型计算昂贵及先验信息错误等挑战，现有方法如MCMC效率低，而标准归一化流受限于双射映射无法直接降维。
Method: 提出基于变分流（VF）的框架：利用VAE进行非线性降维，双归一化流分别建模隐空间先验和编码器；引入迭代先验更新策略，逐步将先验均值移向高概率后验区域；与自适应调优的FNO替代模型构成闭环，VF生成后验集中样本以精化替代模型，替代模型反过来改进后验推断。
Result: 在100维Rosenbrock问题和三个标准PDE逆问题上，该方法在精度上具备竞争力或超越MCMC、UKI和SVGD基线，尤其在噪声大、参数空间高的挑战性场景中优势最为显著。
Conclusion: VF框架通过自适应降维和迭代先验更新有效解决了高维逆问题中的若干挑战，但摘要未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: Pocket-Dentist: On-Device Dental Image Understanding via Efficient Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Evaluations of dental vision-language models remain fragmented across datasets, task definitions and metrics, and often ignore their computational cost. This limits their widespread deployment for dental screening outside specialist centres, where timely inference, limited hardware, and local handling of patient images are vital for practical, privacy-preserving clinical prescreening. Here we present Pocket-Dentist, an efficiency-aware benchmark for dental multimodal question answering that brings together three datasets spanning approximately 1,159 patients, five task types and seven metrics. Across typical 14 VLMs, our results reveals an interesting observation: compact VLMs (e.g., 2B-parameter models) outperform larger VLMs in accuracy while requiring substantially lower computational costs in dental image understanding. Deployed locally on an iPhone 17 Pro, our finetuned compact VLM Pocket-Dentist-2B processed each sample in 4.31 s, reducing latency by 4.9-fold and memory use by 2.3-fold compared with a 7B baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为牙科多模态问答提出一个效率感知的基准Pocket-Dentist，涵盖约1159名患者、三种数据集、五种任务类型和七种指标。实验发现紧凑型VLM（如2B参数模型）在准确率上优于大型VLM，且计算成本显著降低。微调后的紧凑模型Pocket-Dentist-2B在iPhone 17 Pro上本地部署，每个样本处理时间为4.31秒，比7B基线延迟降低4.9倍，内存使用降低2.3倍。
Motivation: 现有牙科视觉语言模型评估数据集、任务定义和指标分散，且常忽略计算成本，限制了其在专科中心以外的牙科筛查中部署，而及时推理、硬件限制和本地处理对隐私保护的临床预筛查至关重要。
Method: 提出Pocket-Dentist基准，整合三个数据集、五种任务类型和七个指标；并微调紧凑型VLM（2B参数），在iPhone 17 Pro上本地部署。
Result: 在14种VLM上发现紧凑型VLM（如2B模型）在牙科图像理解中准确率优于大型VLM且计算成本更低；Pocket-Dentist-2B在iPhone上每个样本4.31秒，延迟降低4.9倍，内存降低2.3倍。
Conclusion: 紧凑型多模态大语言模型在牙科图像理解中兼具高准确率和低计算成本，适合在移动设备上本地部署以实现隐私保护的牙科预筛查。

papers.title: Compute Allocation in Evolutionary Search: From Depth-Breadth to Multi-Armed Bandits
papers.abstract_en: LLM-guided evolutionary search (Evolve systems) has reached state-of-the-art results on mathematical and combinatorial tasks, yet most existing systems report only the best of many runs and leave the run-to-run distribution undocumented. We ask how a fixed budget of LLM calls should be allocated, and how reliably a single run reaches the reported numbers. Sweeping the depth-breadth grid over five models and three tasks, we identify two empirical regularities: a fitness-compute envelope along which capability ordering largely collapses on effective FLOPs, and a bilinear depth-breadth fit with task-specific interaction; both are gated by model-task capability. Motivated by these regularities, we propose BaSE (Bandit-based Self-Evolving), a multi-armed bandit that allocates LLM calls across parallel trajectories. Without changing the model, prompt, or evaluator, BaSE improves mean fitness by 12.3% over the strongest island-protocol baseline across 8 (model, task) cells, with the largest gains on high-variance settings: a reliability gain from allocation alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在LLM引导的演化搜索（Evolve系统）中，如何在固定预算下分配LLM调用次数。通过深度-广度网格实验，发现两个经验规律：适应度-计算包络（沿该包络能力排序大致坍缩到有效FLOPs）和双线性深度-广度拟合（任务特定的交互）。提出基于多臂老虎机的BaSE方法，在并行轨迹间分配LLM调用，无需改变模型、提示或评估器，在8个（模型，任务）单元上平均适应度提升12.3%，尤其在高方差设置下显著提高可靠性。
Motivation: 现有LLM引导的演化搜索系统通常仅报告多次运行中的最佳结果，未记录运行间分布；固定预算下的调用分配方式及其对单次运行可靠性的影响尚未得到系统研究。
Method: 通过深度-广度网格搜索（涵盖5个模型和3个任务）识别两个经验规律（适应度-计算包络和双线性深度-广度拟合），并据此提出BaSE，一种基于多臂老虎机的自演化方法，用于在并行轨迹间动态分配LLM调用。
Result: 在8个（模型，任务）单元上，BaSE平均适应度比最强岛屿协议基线提升12.3%；最大改进出现在高方差设置中，仅通过分配策略即获得了可靠性增益。
Conclusion: 摘要强调资源分配策略对演化搜索可靠性的显著影响，BaSE在不修改模型、提示或评估器的情况下提升了性能，展示了分配本身的价值。

papers.title: Inferring the Size of Large Language Models From Popular Text Memorization
papers.abstract_en: The parameter counts of the most widely used large language models (LLMs) are often withheld by their developers, leaving model size -- a primary reference point for interpreting capabilities and costs -- largely undisclosed. We propose a black-box method to infer conservative lower bounds on LLM size from generated text outputs alone, requiring nothing beyond the ability to submit text fragments and observe next-token predictions. Our approach is grounded in a key observation: popular, widely-circulated texts -- such as classical literature, religious texts, and foundational documents -- are present in virtually every large-scale pretraining corpus, and how accurately a model predicts the next word across text fragments of varying length is a reliable signal of how much it has memorized them, which in turn is fundamentally limited by its total parameter count. We aggregate this memorization signal across a diverse corpus of texts and fragment lengths into a single accuracy profile vector per model, and build two complementary inference methods on top of it: a pairwise statistical test that determines which of two models is larger, and a scaling-law estimator that extracts a one-dimensional latent index from these vectors via Principal Component Analysis (PCA) to map the aggregated signal to a parameter count. Validated on a broad set of open-weight models, both methods produce accurate and reliable lower bounds. When applied to popular closed-weight models, our framework recovers internal product hierarchies and reveals a clear divergence in industry scaling strategies: while some developers yield significantly higher bounds indicative of large generational parameter growth, others operate under strict parameter ceilings, demonstrating that hidden design choices can be systematically probed even under strict API limitations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种黑盒方法，仅利用模型生成的文本输出（通过观察下一个词预测的准确性）来推断大型语言模型参数数量的保守下界。该方法基于流行文本（如经典文学、宗教文献）的预测准确性作为记忆信号，构建准确率特征向量，并通过成对统计检验和基于PCA的缩放律估计器来推断模型规模。在开源模型上验证有效，并成功应用于闭源模型，揭示了不同开发者的规模策略差异。
Motivation: 大型语言模型的参数数量常常未公开，而模型规模是理解其能力和成本的关键参考点。现有方法需要内部信息或大量查询，本文旨在仅通过黑盒文本生成输出来推断模型大小的下界。
Method: 利用模型对流行文本片段（不同长度）的下一个词预测准确性作为记忆信号，聚合多样本文本的准确率得到每个模型的特征向量。在此基础上构建两种互补方法：成对统计检验比较两个模型的大小，以及通过PCA提取潜在索引并拟合缩放律来估计参数数量。
Result: 在多种开源模型上验证，两种方法均能准确可靠地推断参数下界。应用于闭源模型时，恢复了内部产品层级，并揭示了不同的行业扩展策略：一些开发者显示大规模参数增长，另一些则受限于参数上限。
Conclusion: 该方法仅需黑盒访问即可推断LLM规模，能够系统地探测隐藏的设计选择，即使API限制严格也有效。

papers.title: Guidance Contrastive Token Credit Assignment for Discrete Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Group-advantage-based reinforcement learning methods, such as GRPO and DAPO, have demonstrated strong performance across diverse domains, including mathematical reasoning and text-to-image generation. However, their reliance on sample-level rewards introduces a key limitation as uniform credit assignment across all tokens fails to capture fine-grained, token-level contributions. To address this issue, we propose Guidance Contrastive Policy Optimization (GCPO), a novel algorithm that enables per-token credit assignment by contrasting model predictions under positive and negative prompts. Rather than uniformly broadcasting sample-level advantages, GCPO assigns token-level advantages proportional to the difference between these contrastive predictions, allowing more precise and informative learning signals. Empirically, we find that GCPO emphasizes semantically relevant regions such as visual areas aligned with textual prompts in text-to-image generation, and critical keywords within reasoning traces for chain-of-thought tasks. Through extensive experiments, GCPO consistently outperforms GRPO and DAPO baselines on both text-to-image generation and chain-of-thought reasoning benchmarks, demonstrating its effectiveness as a general and scalable optimization strategy for discrete policy learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Guidance Contrastive Policy Optimization (GCPO)，一种通过对比正负提示下的模型预测实现逐令牌信用分配的离散策略优化算法。该方法在文本到图像生成和链式思维推理任务上优于 GRPO 和 DAPO 基线。
Motivation: 现有基于组优势的强化学习方法（如 GRPO、DAPO）依赖于样本级奖励，对所有令牌进行统一信用分配，无法捕捉细粒度的令牌级贡献，限制了学习信号的精确性。
Method: GCPO 通过对比模型在正负提示下的预测差异，为每个令牌分配与差异成比例的优势值，从而提供更精确的学习信号。
Result: 实验表明 GCPO 在文本到图像生成和链式思维推理基准上一致优于 GRPO 和 DAPO，并能强调与文本提示对齐的视觉区域或推理轨迹中的关键关键词。
Conclusion: GCPO 是一种通用且可扩展的离散策略学习优化策略，能够有效提升基于组优势方法的性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SafeRx-Agent: A Knowledge-Grounded Multi-Agent Framework for Safe and Explainable Medication Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Medication recommendation predicts medications for patient visits, but existing methods still face two key challenges. At the model level, traditional drug recommendation methods only predict structured drug codes with limited evidence grounding, while LLM agents can use richer clinical context but may lack safety verification and traceability. At the task level, existing benchmarks often use broad medication categories, which ignore subgroup-level safety differences and can lead to risk overestimation. We introduce the first fine-grained medication recommendation setting based on fourth-level ATC code generation. We propose Safe Prescription Agent (SafeRx-Agent), a knowledge-grounded multi-agent framework that uses patient context, external clinical knowledge, and safety verification to recommend traceable medication sets. Experimental results on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV datasets show that SafeRx-Agent improves fine-grained medication prediction accuracy while controlling drug interactions, contraindications, and medication set size.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了 SafeRx-Agent，一个基于知识的多智能体框架，用于安全且可解释的细粒度药物推荐。通过在 MIMIC-III 和 MIMIC-IV 数据集上的实验，该框架在控制药物相互作用和禁忌症的同时，提高了细粒度药物预测的准确性。
Motivation: 现有药物推荐方法要么只预测结构化药物代码而缺乏依据，要么虽然利用临床上下文但缺乏安全验证和可追溯性；同时现有基准使用宽泛的药物类别，忽略了亚组级别的安全差异。
Method: 提出了 Safe Prescription Agent (SafeRx-Agent) 框架，该框架整合患者上下文、外部临床知识和安全验证机制，基于第四级 ATC 代码生成细粒度药物推荐。
Result: 在 MIMIC-III 和 MIMIC-IV 数据集上，SafeRx-Agent 提高了细粒度药物预测的准确性，同时有效控制了药物相互作用、禁忌症和药物集合大小。
Conclusion: 摘要指出该框架在保证安全性和可解释性的前提下提升了细粒度药物推荐性能。

papers.title: Optimal Rates for Differentially Private Hypothesis Testing with E-values
papers.abstract_en: E-values have attracted considerable interest in recent years as flexible tools for enabling anytime-valid and adaptive data analysis. Hypothesis testing is at the core of many of these applications, which can often involve private or sensitive data. In this work, we answer a simple but important question: given two distributions $\mathbb{P}$ and $\mathbb{Q}$, what is the maximum achievable e-power when testing $X\sim \mathbb{P}^n$ against $X\sim\mathbb{Q}^n$ with e-values that satisfy $\varepsilon$-differential privacy? We characterize the optimal rate for this problem and provide an algorithm which matches it exactly. In the sequential setting, when observations arrive one-by-one and the analyst chooses when to halt, we give matching upper and lower bounds on the stopping times of any private e-process. Numerical experiments confirm the practicality of our algorithms, which require less data than the recently proposed DP-SPRT across a range of sequential testing problems and privacy levels.

Method: 通过理论分析刻画ε-差分隐私e-values的最大e-power，并构造达到该速率的算法。在序贯设置中，推导了私有e-process停止时间的上下界。

papers.title: First head-to-head comparison of agentic AI applied to the analysis of simulated data of the Einstein Telescope
papers.abstract_en: We report a comparison of two state-of-the-art agentic AI systems, Claude Code (Anthropic) and Codex (OpenAI), tasked with autonomously executing a simple end-to-end gravitational wave data analysis pipeline on a shared computing infrastructure without human intervention. The pipeline comprises power spectral density estimation from raw Einstein Telescope simulated noise, geometric template bank generation, matched filter recovery of 100 binary black hole signal injections, automated results generation, and large language model-assisted production of a manuscript formatted in the style of Physical Review D. Both agents received identical written specifications and identical compute resources. The experiment was run twice: a first run with unrealistically loud injections, and a second run with signals rescaled to a physically motivated SNR range. The scientific results converged in both runs. However, the agents exhibited substantially different behaviors and computational costs: Claude Code completed the pipeline in ~3.4 minutes with silent deviations from the specification, while Codex required ~16 minutes across explicit self-correcting restarts, including an unsolicited performance optimization of the matched filter inner loop. The autonomously generated manuscripts also diverged in length, details, and quality. In the second run, a subtle difference in the interpretation of the SNR range instruction led to a genuine scientific divergence: Claude Code silently reinterpreted the instructions, while Codex followed the specification literally. We discuss the implications of these behavioral differences, such as speed versus auditability, silent versus transparent error handling, instruction interpretation, and the criticality of intermediate data representations in multi-model pipelines, for the deployment of agentic AI in scientific computing workflows.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次头对头比较了两种最先进的智能体AI系统（Anthropic的Claude Code和OpenAI的Codex）在爱因斯坦望远镜模拟数据上的引力波数据分析流水线中的表现。两个系统都收到相同的书面规范和计算资源，但行为、计算成本和结果质量存在显著差异：Claude Code在约3.4分钟内完成流水线但存在静默偏离规范，Codex需要约16分钟并包含明确的自我纠正重启。科学结果在两次实验（不同信噪比）中收敛，但智能体对指令的解读分歧导致真正的科学分歧。
Motivation: 评估agentic AI在科学计算工作流中部署的自主性、可靠性和行为差异，特别是自动化端到端分析中速度和可审计性之间的权衡。
Method: 设计一个端到端引力波数据分析流水线，包括功率谱密度估计、几何模板库生成、匹配滤波恢复100个双黑洞信号注入、自动结果生成，以及LLM辅助的物理评论D风格论文撰写。Claude Code和Codex分别以相同规范执行两次（第一次高信噪比，第二次物理SNR范围）。
Result: Claude Code完成流水线约3.4分钟（规范偏差静默），Codex约16分钟（含自我纠正重启和主动优化匹配滤波内循环）。科学结果收敛，但在第二运行中，对SNR范围指令的解读导致差异：Claude Code静默重新解释，Codex严格遵循。
Conclusion: 智能体AI在科学工作流中表现出速度与可审计性、静默与透明错误处理之间的权衡，指令解读和中间数据表示对多模型流水线至关重要。

papers.title: Self-Supervised Online Robot-Agnostic Traversability Estimation for Open-World Environments
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised online traversability estimation enables robots to continuously learn from unlabeled open-world experiences and adapt their navigation behavior toward safe and efficient trajectories. Existing approaches either rely on handcrafted proprioceptive traversability scores, limiting robot-agnosticism, or cluster prior data, preventing online learning. Moreover, many continual learning methods incur substantial memory and computational costs, hindering onboard deployment. We introduce COTRATE, an online learning framework for continuous traversability estimation from multimodal, unlabeled robot experience. Our method first infers robust traversability scores using a robot-agnostic, learning-based online terrain assessment module operating on proprioceptiveand inertial signals. These scores then supervise a visual traversability network through a novel alignment loss that associates visual embeddings with online terrain assessments. To mitigate forgetting during continual learning with minimal overhead, we propose a diversity-aware feature selection strategythat preserves performance using a compact replay memory. We further show that the learned traversability representation supports knowledge transfer across different robot platforms with different locomotion kinematics. We evaluate COTRATE on a dataset of $\approx$ 50,000 images collected with two robotic platforms across 11 outdoor terrains, and benchmark it on navigation tasks in three representative outdoor environments. We make the dataset, code, and trained models publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出COTRATE，一个自监督在线学习框架，用于从多模态无标签机器人经验中持续估计地形可穿越性。该方法使用机器人无关的在线地形评估模块从本体感知和惯性信号推断鲁棒的可穿越性分数，再通过对齐损失监督视觉可穿越性网络，并采用多样性感知特征选择策略缓解遗忘问题。在约50,000张图像的数据集上评估，支持跨机器人平台的知识迁移。
Motivation: 现有方法依赖手工设计的本体感可知穿越性分数或离线聚类，缺乏机器人无关性和在线学习能力；许多持续学习方法计算和内存开销大，难以机载部署。
Method: 提出COTRATE框架：1）基于学习的机器人无关在线地形评估模块从本体感知和惯性信号推断可穿越性分数；2）通过新颖的对齐损失将视觉嵌入与在线地形评估关联；3）采用多样性感知特征选择策略和紧凑重播内存缓解持续学习中的遗忘。
Result: 在11种户外地形、约50,000张图像的数据集上评估，并在三个代表性户外环境中进行导航任务基准测试，展示了知识迁移能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法实现了自监督在线可穿越性估计的机器人无关性和持续学习能力，且支持跨平台迁移。

papers.title: Conveyance: A Versatile Framework for Learning in Structured Class Spaces
papers.abstract_en: While machine learning (ML) architectures have evolved rapidly to account for complex data, loss functions like cross-entropy remain mostly structure-agnostic in many real-world applications. However, the "class-symmetric" nature of these standard losses fundamentally limits the ability of ML models to exploit structural relationships between classes, particularly when facing structured noise. We propose Conveyance, a new classification approach and associated loss function tailored to structured class spaces. It allows users to encode graph-like relations between classes without having to define complex joint distributions or manually tune utility matrices. Technically, our loss function operates by maximizing two separate margins over distinct class partitions, while preserving formal properties such as monotonicity and partial convexity. We demonstrate the versatility and effectiveness of our method by applying it to hierarchical classification, ordinal regression, and multiple instance learning. Across these tasks, Conveyance either matches or exceeds the performance of specialized baselines, thereby offering a unified solution for structured class spaces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Conveyance，一种用于结构化类空间的分类框架和损失函数，通过最大化两个分离的间隔来编码类间图结构，无需定义复杂联合分布或手动调整效用矩阵。在层次分类、序数回归和多实例学习任务上，Conveyance匹配或超越专用基线。
Motivation: 标准损失函数（如交叉熵）忽略类间结构关系，在处理结构化噪声时受限，无法利用类之间的结构信息。
Method: 提出Conveyance损失函数，通过最大化两个分离的间隔（margin）来操作不同的类分区，同时保持单调性和部分凸性等正式性质。
Result: 在层次分类、序数回归和多实例学习任务上，Conveyance匹配或超越专用基线。
Conclusion: Conveyance为结构化类空间提供了统一的解决方案，无需定义复杂联合分布或手动调整效用矩阵，具有通用性。

papers.title: Learning Logical Operations for Arbitrary Quantum Error Correction Codes
papers.abstract_en: Logical operations are essential for quantum computation within quantum error-correcting codes. However, discovering their physical realizations is challenging, especially for non-additive codes that lack a stabilizer description. We present a general learning-based framework that, given only an encoding circuit, constructs physical implementations of logical operations while enforcing structural properties such as transversality or shallow depth. Our approach is validated by rediscovering known logical operations of standard stabilizer codes. We then extend it to a co-design procedure, dubbed variational early fault-tolerant quantum computing (VarEFTQC), which tailors non-additive encodings to a given noise model and enforces desired logical gate sets, such as transversal IQP-type families or low-depth universal sets. A software library implements the complete learning pipeline, including loss-function variants, ansatz families, and optimization routines. Together, these results position VarEFTQC as a practical tool for discovering hardware-adapted logical gadgets for early fault-tolerant quantum computing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于学习的通用框架，仅需编码电路即可为任意量子纠错码构造逻辑操作的物理实现，并强制满足横向性或浅层深度等结构性质。该框架通过变分早期容错量子计算（VarEFTQC）扩展为协同设计流程，可针对特定噪声模型定制非可加性编码并强制执行所需逻辑门集合。
Motivation: 发现非可加性量子纠错码中逻辑操作的物理实现极具挑战，因为它们缺乏稳定子描述。
Method: 提出学习框架，从编码电路出发，通过强化横向性或浅深度等结构性质来构建逻辑操作的物理实现，并扩展为VarEFTQC协同设计流程。
Result: 验证了该框架能重新发现标准稳定子码的已知逻辑操作，并支持对非可加性编码的定制化设计。
Conclusion: VarEFTQC可作为实际工具用于发现早期容错量子计算中硬件适配的逻辑构件。

papers.title: PINE: Pruning Boosted Tree Ensembles with Conformal In-Distribution Prediction Equivalence
papers.abstract_en: Tree ensembles are machine learning models with strong predictive performance and interpretability, and remain widely used for tabular data. Standard pruning methods for tree ensembles typically optimize an accuracy-compression trade-off and may change a subset of predictions, potentially compromising decision consistency. Faithful pruning methods address this issue by preserving prediction equivalence over the entire input space, but this requirement leads to lower compression ratios. We propose PINE, a pruning method that provides strong guarantees within an in-distribution region. PINE preserves prediction equivalence within this region and controls the region size using a single parameter $α$ via conformal calibration. Experiments on 12 public tabular datasets show that PINE improves the compression ratio by up to 30% while preserving predictions at a comparable level to existing faithful pruning methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PINE，一种基于共形预测 (conformal prediction) 的树集成剪枝方法，在保持分布内预测等价性的同时实现更高压缩比。在 12 个公开表格数据集上，PINE 相比忠实剪枝方法将压缩比提升最多 30%，且预测一致性相当。
Motivation: 现有忠实剪枝方法要求整个输入空间上的预测等价性，导致压缩率低；而标准剪枝方法可能改变部分预测，损害决策一致性。需要一种在分布内区域提供强保证且压缩率更高的剪枝方法。
Method: 通过共形校准 (conformal calibration) 控制分布内区域的大小（参数 α），在该区域内保持预测等价性，从而在保证忠实性的前提下提高压缩比。
Result: 在 12 个公开表格数据集上，PINE 的压缩比相比现有忠实剪枝方法提升最多 30%，同时预测一致性保持在可比水平。
Conclusion: PINE 在分布内区域提供了预测等价性的强保证，并通过单一参数 α 灵活控制区域大小，实现了更高的剪枝效率。

summary_sections.conclusion: PINE 在分布内区域提供了预测等价性的强保证，并通过单一参数 α 灵活控制区域大小，实现了更高的剪枝效率。

papers.title: Reward Bias Substitution: Single-Axis Bias Mitigations Redirect Optimization Pressure
papers.abstract_en: Single-axis mitigations of reward-model biases (e.g., reducing proxy reliance on length, sycophancy, or style) can rotate optimization pressure onto correlated proxies rather than eliminate it, a failure mode we call reward bias substitution. The failure is enabled by a measurement-versus-optimization gap between audit and policy-induced distributions during mitigation evaluation and policy training. We formalize mitigation outcomes into a regime taxonomy and prove that successful mitigation, bias substitution, and overcorrection produce identical observables under any audit-distribution scoring, including ranking accuracy and win-rate, even when granted oracle access to the true reward. Across published preference-learning mitigation work, no method we survey reports the evidence needed to certify successful mitigation. Augmenting evaluation with policy-induced distributions while tracking multiple biases provably closes the gap, and we translate this into actionable prescriptions for mitigation methods and benchmarks. We demonstrate bias substitution in language model RLHF, where a length penalty during GRPO training compresses responses as intended yet redirects optimization pressure onto confidence calibration, driving the policy into overconfidence while factual free-form accuracy falls. We also show a published length-debiasing operator that zeroes reward-length correlation on the audit distribution but reintroduces bias under best-of-N selection on three of four SOTA reward models, and a length-sycophancy coupling whose direction reverses under human-LLM judge disagreement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现，对奖励模型偏好的单轴缓解（如减少对长度、谄媚或风格的依赖）会将优化压力转移到相关替代指标上，而非消除偏差，这种现象称为奖励偏差替代（reward bias substitution）。该失效模式源于审计分布与策略诱导分布在缓解评估和策略训练时的度量-优化差距。形式化了一个缓解结果分类法，并证明成功的缓解、偏差替代和过校正在任意审计分布评分下（包括排名准确率和胜率）产生相同可观测结果。在已发表的人类偏好学习缓解工作中，未发现任何方法报告了认证成功缓解所需的证据。通过在跟踪多个偏差的同时用策略诱导分布补充评估，可以弥合该差距，并转化为可操作的缓解方法和基准建议。通过在语言模型RLHF中演示偏差替代：GRPO训练期间的长度惩罚如预期压缩了响应长度，但将优化压力转移到置信校准上，导致策略过度自信，同时事实自由形式准确率下降。还展示了一个已发表的去长度偏差算子，在审计分布上使奖励-长度相关性归零，但在best-of-N选择下在四个SOTA奖励模型中的三个上重新引入偏差，以及一个人机裁判分歧下方向反转的长度-谄媚耦合。
Motivation: 现有奖励模型偏差缓解方法通常针对单一维度（如长度、谄媚）进行校正，但可能无法真正消除偏差，而是将优化压力转移到其他相关代理指标上，导致缓解失效或新偏差出现。这种偏差替代现象缺乏正式理解与诊断方法。
Method: 形式化缓解结果分类法，区分成功缓解、偏差替代和过校正三种情形，并证明它们在审计分布评分下无法区分。提议用策略诱导分布补充评估，并同时跟踪多个偏差。在语言模型RLHF中以GRPO训练为例，施加长度惩罚，观察对置信校准的影响。
Result: 在语言模型RLHF中，长度惩罚压缩了响应长度，但导致策略过度自信，事实自由形式准确率下降。一个已发表的去长度偏差算子虽在审计分布上消除了奖励-长度相关性，但在best-of-N选择下对四个SOTA奖励模型中的三个重新引入偏差。
Conclusion: 单轴偏差缓解可能导致优化压力重定向而非消除，评估需结合策略诱导分布并跟踪多个偏差才能认证成功缓解。该工作为未来缓解方法设计提供了可操作的诊断建议。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: The Fundamental Limits of Fraud Detection in Card Payment Networks
papers.abstract_en: Card payment fraud detection is usually framed as a supervised classification problem. Although this approach has generated practical progress, improvement has remained incremental despite major advances in model architecture. We argue that this is not mainly a failure of function approximation or optimization, but a consequence of structural information impairments inherent to the payment ecosystem. We formalize card authorization as a sequential decision problem with delayed, censored, corrupted, and counterfactually missing feedback. We derive a minimax regret lower bound showing that these impairments enter multiplicatively in the denominator of the achievable learning rate. The bound implies that improving issuer reporting quality or reducing censorship can yield larger reductions in the regret floor than increasing model complexity. We also show that heterogeneity across issuers worsens learnability beyond what average impairment rates suggest. The paper contributes a theory of why fraud detection in payment networks is fundamentally harder than in standard online learning settings, identifies ecosystem information quality as the key bottleneck, and provides a theoretical basis for prioritizing investments in reporting infrastructure, dispute process quality, and selective exploration. The paper is theory-first and does not rely on proprietary transaction data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文论证了信用卡支付欺诈检测的困难主要源于支付生态系统固有的信息损害（延迟、审查、污染和反事实缺失反馈），而非模型架构的不足。通过形式化顺序决策问题并推导极小化极大遗憾下界，表明信息损害在可达学习率分母中乘法叠加，且发行人异质性会进一步恶化可学习性。
Motivation: 尽管模型架构不断进步，欺诈检测的改进却趋于增量，这表明瓶颈可能不在函数逼近，而在于反馈数据的结构性信息损害。
Method: 将信用卡授权形式化为具有延迟、审查、污染和反事实缺失反馈的顺序决策问题，推导极小化极大遗憾下界，并分析信息损害的乘法效应及发行人异质性的影响。
Result: 推导的遗憾下界表明，信息损害在分母中乘法叠加，提高发行人报告质量或减少审查比增加模型复杂度更能降低遗憾下限；发行人异质性会进一步降低可学习性。
Conclusion: 该理论揭示了支付网络欺诈检测比标准在线学习环境更困难的原因，指出生态系统信息质量是关键瓶颈，并为优先投资报告基础设施、争议过程质量和选择性探索提供了理论依据。

papers.title: SpatialBench: Is Your Spatial Foundation Model an All-Round Player?
papers.abstract_en: While spatial foundation models have demonstrated impressive performance on standard datasets, a critical question remains: are they truly all-round players capable of generalizing robustly across diverse downstream tasks, arbitrary viewpoints, shifting scene domains, varying input densities, and specific hardware constraints? Answering this overarching question requires a holistic assessment, yet current models are mainly evaluated on specific domains for which they were specifically designed or trained. Such evaluations are intrinsically limited by narrow paradigm coverage, limited scene domains, and arbitrary frame sampling, making it fundamentally difficult to assess their true generalization capabilities. To address this gap, we present SpatialBench, a cross-paradigm, domain-diverse benchmark for spatial foundation models with deterministic sampling. SpatialBench features unprecedented scale and rigorous deterministic design, comprising 19 datasets and 546 scenes across 5 diverse spatial domains. It comprehensively evaluates 41 models across 6 paradigms on 5 task suites under 4 different input density settings. Our extensive evaluation reveals that current models are not yet all-round players, and uncovers crucial insights for future advancement. Specifically, we demonstrate that full-context attention maximizes accuracy while bounded-memory strategies unlock long-sequence scalability. Moreover, our empirical evaluations in challenging embodied and egocentric tasks demonstrate that strict domain alignment and high data quality are far more critical to performance than simple dataset scaling. Furthermore, to address the largest data gap identified in our analysis, we go beyond evaluation by introducing a large-scale dataset, DA-Next-5M, and a strong baseline model, DA-Next, pushing the boundaries of spatial representation learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SpatialBench，一个跨范式、多域的基准测试，用于评估空间基础模型的泛化能力。该基准包含 19 个数据集、546 个场景，覆盖 5 个空间域，在 4 种输入密度设置下评估 41 个模型在 5 个任务套件上的表现。实验发现当前模型远未达到全能，并揭示了全上下文注意力可最大化精度、有界记忆策略可实现长序列扩展；同时，领域对齐和数据质量比简单数据规模更重要。此外，作者还发布了大规模数据集 DA-Next-5M 和基线模型 DA-Next。
Motivation: 现有空间基础模型主要在特定领域上评估，缺乏跨范式、多域的全面评测，难以衡量其真实泛化能力。
Method: 构建 SpatialBench 基准，采用确定性采样，整合 19 个数据集和 546 个场景，覆盖 5 个空间域，并在 4 种输入密度设置下评估 6 个范式的 41 个模型。此外，提出 DA-Next-5M 数据集和 DA-Next 模型。
Result: 当前模型并非全能选手；全上下文注意力精度最高，有界记忆策略可扩展长序列；在具身和自我中心任务中，域对齐和数据质量比数据规模更关键。
Conclusion: SpatialBench 为空间基础模型提供全面基准，并揭示了未来提升方向，同时通过 DA-Next-5M 和 DA-Next 推动空间表示学习。

papers.title: Alignment Tampering: How Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback Is Exploited to Optimize Misaligned Biases
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) is the standard method to align Large Language Models (LLMs) with human preferences. In this work, we introduce alignment tampering, a potential vulnerability where the LLM undergoing alignment influences the preference dataset, causing RLHF to amplify undesired behaviors. This arises from core limitations of RLHF: (1) preference datasets are constructed from the LLM's own outputs, allowing it to influence them, and (2) pairwise comparisons only indicate which response is better, not why. These limitations can be exploited to cause alignment tampering. For example, if an LLM generates biased responses with higher quality, annotators will prefer them based on quality. However, preference labels do not distinguish quality from bias, and the reward model inherits this limitation. Optimizing such rewards through reinforcement learning or best-of-N sampling can amplify misaligned biases. Our experiments demonstrate amplification across diverse biases: from keyword bias to propaganda (e.g., sexism), brand promotion, and instrumental goal-seeking. Mitigation remains challenging, as existing techniques for robust RLHF fail to fully resolve alignment tampering without sacrificing response quality. These findings reveal structural vulnerabilities of current RLHF and emphasize the need to prevent this vulnerability. Project page: https://alignment-tampering.github.io/
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026, Source code: https://alignment-tampering.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出对齐篡改（alignment tampering）概念，指出RLHF过程中，LLM可以通过影响偏好数据集来放大不良行为。实验展示了从关键词偏见到宣传、品牌推广等多种偏见的放大，并指出现有鲁棒RLHF方法无法在不牺牲响应质量的情况下完全解决这一漏洞。
Motivation: RLHF存在核心局限性：偏好数据集由LLM自身输出构建，且成对比较只表明哪个响应更好而不解释原因，这使得对齐过程容易被操纵，导致优化后的模型放大与人类偏好不一致的偏见。
Method: 定义对齐篡改攻击场景，利用RLHF的局限性（如质量与偏见混淆），通过生成高质量但含偏见的响应，使标注者基于质量偏好，从而在奖励模型和RL优化中放大偏见。实验涉及多种偏见类型（关键词偏见、性别歧视、品牌推广等）。
Result: 实验表明，对齐篡改可在多个偏向上显著放大不良行为，而现有鲁棒RLHF技术（如对抗训练、数据过滤）无法彻底消除该漏洞，且常以牺牲响应质量为代价。
Conclusion: 当前RLHF存在结构性漏洞，对齐篡改揭示了偏好数据收集和奖励建模中的根本问题，未来需要设计防止LLM影响偏好数据的方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Pair-In, Pair-Out: Latent Multi-Token Prediction for Efficient LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Long chain-of-thought reasoning has made autoregressive decoding the dominant inference cost of modern large language models. Existing methods target either the input side (latent compression) or the output side (speculative decoding and multi-token prediction, MTP), but the two lines of work have been pursued independently. Moreover, output-side methods must incur an expensive verifier pass to validate the unreliable draft tokens predicted by MTP. To address these issues, we propose \textbf{Pair-In, Pair-Out (PIPO)}, which unifies both sides by viewing a latent compressor and an MTP head as mirror-image operations: the compressor folds two input tokens into one latent representation, while the MTP head unfolds one hidden state into one additional output token. To remove the verifier cost without sacrificing reliability, PIPO trains a lightweight confidence head that decides whether draft tokens should be accepted. We observe that On-Policy Distillation (OPD) naturally matches the rejection-sampling criterion of speculative decoding, so the confidence head can be trained alongside OPD with negligible extra cost. Experiments on AIME 2025, GPQA-Diamond, LiveCodeBench v6, and LongBench v2 with Qwen3.5-4B and 9B backbones show that PIPO improves pass@4 over regular decoding by up to $+7.15$ points, while delivering up to $2.64\times$ first-token-latency and $2.07\times$ per-token-latency speedups. Project Page: GitHub.com/RedAI-Infra/PIPO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Pair-In, Pair-Out (PIPO) 方法，统一了输入端的潜在压缩和输出端的多头预测 (MTP)。PIPO 将压缩器与 MTP 头视为镜像操作：压缩器将两个输入token折叠成一个潜在表示，MTP 头将一个隐藏状态展开为一个额外输出token。为了去除验证器 (verifier) 开销，PIPO 训练了一个轻量级置信头来决定草稿token是否被接受。实验表明，PIPO 在多个基准上提升了 pass@4，并实现了最高 2.64倍的首token延迟和 2.07倍的每token延迟加速。
Motivation: 现有的长链式推理的自回归解码成本高昂，输入侧压缩和输出侧多头预测 (MTP) 各自独立发展，且输出侧方法需要昂贵的验证器来检查 MTP 预测的不可靠草稿token。
Method: 提出 PIPO，将输入压缩器和 MTP 头视为镜像操作；训练一个轻量级置信头来替代验证器，该置信头与策略内蒸馏 (On-Policy Distillation) 联合训练。
Result: 在 AIME 2025、GPQA-Diamond、LiveCodeBench v6 和 LongBench v2 上，使用 Qwen3.5-4B 和 9B 骨干网络，PIPO 将 pass@4 提高了最多 +7.15 个点，并实现了最高 2.64倍的首token延迟和 2.07倍的每token延迟加速。
Conclusion: PIPO 统一了输入压缩和输出 MTP，通过置信头去除验证器成本，在多个基准上显著提升了解码效率和准确性。

papers.title: Neuro-Symbolic Verification of LLM Outputs for Data-Sensitive Domains (extended preprint)
papers.abstract_en: LLMs deployed in high-stakes domains face fundamental reliability challenges: hallucinations, inconsistencies, and privacy vulnerabilities introduce unacceptable risks where errors carry legal, financial, or safety consequences. This paper presents a hybrid verification architecture combining formal symbolic methods with neural semantic analysis to provide complementary guarantees for LLM-generated content. This architecture employs logical reasoning for input verification, leveraging completeness properties to provide decidable guarantees on structured requirements. For output validation, embedding-based semantic similarity detects contextual hallucinations where formal methods lack expressiveness. This separation is realized in a parallel, actor-based pipeline, addressing limitations of prompt-based self-verification approaches, which inherit the distributional biases that produce hallucinations. The proposed architecture and type-aware verification method are validated with HAIMEDA, a real-world medical device damage assessment reporting system developed through Action Design Research. Evaluation shows hallucination detection rates of over 83% for structured entities and 72% for semantic fabrications, with a 30% reduction in report creation time, demonstrating that neuro-symbolic architectures can provide principled safeguards for LLM deployment in data-sensitive domains.
papers.comment: Extended preprint version of accepted technical communication at KI 2026. 22 pages, 3 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合验证架构，结合形式符号推理和神经语义分析，用于检测LLM在数据敏感领域（如医疗设备损害评估）输出中的幻觉与不一致。在HAIMEDA系统中，结构化实体幻觉检测率超过83%，语义虚构检测率达72%，同时报告创建时间减少30%。
Motivation: 在高风险领域，LLM的幻觉、不一致和隐私漏洞可能带来法律、财务或安全后果，现有提示自验证方法受制于分布偏差。
Method: 采用并行actor管道分离输入验证与输出验证：输入侧使用逻辑推理和完备性属性提供可判定保证；输出侧通过嵌入相似度检测上下文幻觉，弥补形式方法表达力不足。
Result: 在HAIMEDA医疗设备损害评估系统中，结构化实体幻觉检测率>83%，语义虚构检测率72%，报告创建时间降低30%。
Conclusion: 神经符号混合架构能为数据敏感领域中的LLM部署提供原则性安全保障，弥补纯提示验证的缺陷。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Muon Optimizer Meets Adversarial Training: A Theoretical and Empirical Study
papers.abstract_en: Adversarial training (AT) remains one of the most reliable empirical defenses against adversarial attacks. Its robustness critically depends on how the underlying min-max objective is optimized. In practice, Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) optimizer remains the default optimization choice for AT, whereas adaptive optimizers often improve standard training but may yield inferior robustness. Recently, the Muon optimizer, which orthogonalizes matrix-valued updates via an approximate polar decomposition, has achieved notable success in large-scale training at a memory cost comparable to SGD. This raises a security-relevant question: \textit{can orthogonalized optimization improve AT under strong and heterogeneous threat models?} Focusing on this problem, we conduct a comprehensive theoretical and empirical study. Theoretically, we show that Muon imposes a spectral-norm stability ceiling on matrix updates, limiting uncontrolled spectral growth in the training dynamics without explicitly shrinking the learned weights. Empirically, across five architectures and three $\ell_p$ threat models ($\ell_\infty$, $\ell_1$, $\ell_2$) and their union, Muon is competitive with SGD on CNNs and substantially outperforms AdamW on both CNNs and ViTs. These results identify optimizer geometry as a security-relevant factor in adversarial training, while clarifying the empirical regimes in which orthogonalized updates are beneficial. Overall, our findings highlight optimizer design as a security-critical component of AT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究Muon优化器（通过近似极分解正交化矩阵更新）在对抗训练中的应用。理论证明Muon对矩阵更新施加谱范数稳定性上限，限制训练动态中的谱增长；实验表明在五种架构和三种ℓ_p威胁模型下，Muon在CNN上可与SGD竞争，在CNN和ViT上均显著优于AdamW。结论指出优化器几何是影响对抗训练鲁棒性的安全相关因素。
Motivation: 对抗训练中SGD是默认优化器，但自适应优化器虽能提升标准训练却可能降低鲁棒性；Muon在大规模训练中成功，但其对对抗训练的影响未知，亟需研究正交化优化能否提升对抗鲁棒性。
Method: 提出使用Muon优化器进行对抗训练，该优化器通过近似极分解对矩阵更新进行正交化，并理论上证明其对更新步长施加谱范数稳定性上限，从而抑制训练动态中的失控谱增长。
Result: 在五种架构和ℓ_∞、ℓ_1、ℓ_2及其联合威胁模型下，Muon在CNN上达到与SGD相当的鲁棒性，并在CNN和ViT上显著优于AdamW。
Conclusion: 优化器几何是影响对抗训练鲁棒性的关键安全因素，正交化更新在特定经验场景下有益，表明优化器设计应作为对抗训练的安全关键组件。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Need for an External Observer Formalizing the Sufficiency Gap: A Mathematical Extension of Mixture Identifiability and Contextual Grounding in Sequence Models
papers.abstract_en: We construct a binary mixed-regime process with one deterministic textual regime and one random regime governed by an unobserved latent state. Even an ideal infinite-capacity sequence predictor that exactly recovers the text-only marginal law can become overconfident when the observed prefix is compatible with the wrong latent regime. The resulting entropy difference is not an ordinary optimization error; it is a sufficiency gap caused by marginalization over an unobserved state. We then formalize retrieval, tool use, and external grounding through an auxiliary binary signal with fidelity $γ\in [1/2,1]$. The resulting Bayesian update yields a contextual dominance threshold: a corrective signal reverses the posterior odds induced by the textual history exactly when its fidelity exceeds the text-only posterior weight assigned to the misleading regime. This threshold reduces, but does not generally eliminate, the sufficiency gap; complete closure requires perfect revelation of the relevant latent state or an equivalent verification mechanism. The analysis clarifies why temperature scaling cannot restore missing context, why grounding mechanisms must be both informative and learnably usable by the model, and why autonomous sequence models require structurally decoupled observers or verifiers in high-stakes domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构造了一个二元混合过程，包含确定性文本体制和由未观察潜在状态控制的随机体制。即使无限容量序列预测器完美恢复文本边际分布，当观测前缀与错误潜在体制兼容时也会过度自信，产生由边际化导致的充分性差距。通过辅助二元信号形式化外部接地，推导出上下文支配阈值，表明修正信号在保真度超过文本后验权重时反转后验几率，但无法完全消除差距。文章解释了温度缩放为何无效以及高风险领域需要解耦的观察者。
Motivation: 序列模型在处理混合体制数据时，因未观察潜在状态导致过自信，产生无法通过常规优化消除的充分性差距，需要外部观察者来缓解。
Method: 形式化一个二元混合体制过程，引入保真度γ∈[1/2,1]的辅助二元信号模拟外部接地，通过贝叶斯更新推导上下文支配阈值。
Result: 推导出修正信号反转后验几率的条件：当信号保真度超过文本后验权重时才能反转，但充分性差距仅能缩小而非完全消除；完全消除需要完美揭示潜在状态或等效验证机制。
Conclusion: 温度缩放无法恢复缺失上下文，接地机制必须信息丰富且可学习使用，高风险领域需要结构解耦的外部观察者或验证器。

papers.title: PRISM: Position-encoded Regressive Inverse Spectral Model for Multilayer Thin-Film Design
papers.abstract_en: The inverse problem of multilayer thin-film optical coatings design represents a complex combinatorial-continuous optimization challenge. We present PRISM (Position-encoded Regressive Inverse Spectral Model), a unified decoder-only autoregressive transformer that streamlines this process by jointly predicting discrete material selection and continuous thickness regression within a single backbone. PRISM introduces two primary architectural innovations: (1) spectrum prefix conditioning, which utilizes standard prefix tokens for in-context target injection, and (2) cumulative-depth Rotary Position Embeddings, which encode continuous thickness directly into the positional representation to preserve the physical spatial relationships of the stack. Our benchmarks demonstrate that a PRISM-13M model reduces MAE by over 50\% compared to other transformer baselines while utilizing only one-fifth of the parameters. Furthermore, a 44M-parameter variant achieves state-of-the-art performance (MAE = 0.010) on our in-distribution validation benchmark and operates significantly faster than simulated annealing, offering a highly efficient alternative to classical optimization methods.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, Proceedings of the AI4Physics Workshop at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (AI4Physics@ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PRISM 是一个解码器自回归 Transformer，用于多层薄膜光学涂层设计的逆问题，能够联合预测离散材料选择和连续厚度。架构创新包括频谱前缀条件（spectrum prefix conditioning）和累积深度旋转位置嵌入（cumulative-depth Rotary Position Embeddings）。13M 参数的模型相比其他 Transformer 基线将 MAE 降低 50% 以上，且参数量仅为后者的五分之一；44M 参数变体在分布内验证集上达到 SOTA（MAE=0.010），运行速度显著快于模拟退火。
Motivation: 多层薄膜光学涂层设计的逆问题是一个复杂的组合-连续优化挑战，现有方法效率低下或难以处理离散与连续变量的联合优化。
Method: 提出一种统一的解码器自回归 Transformer，通过频谱前缀条件将目标光谱作为上下文注入，并引入累积深度旋转位置嵌入将连续厚度编码到位置表示中，以保持物理空间关系。
Result: PRISM-13M 相比其他 Transformer 基线 MAE 降低 50% 以上，参数量仅为其五分之一；PRISM-44M 在分布内验证集上达到 MAE=0.010 的 SOTA 性能，且运行速度远超模拟退火。
Conclusion: PRISM 为多层薄膜设计提供了一种高效、统一的逆设计方法，可替代经典的优化方法。

papers.title: Advancing Creative Physical Intelligence in Large Multimodal Models
papers.abstract_en: Large multimodal models (LMMs) have rapidly advanced in perception and reasoning; however, it remains unclear whether these capabilities generalize to discovering visually grounded solutions in open-ended environments, beyond pattern recognition. In such settings, intelligence requires more than answering well-posed questions: it involves identifying how elements in a scene can be repurposed in non-obvious yet physically feasible ways. This form of creative problem-solving is central to human intelligence, but remains largely untested in current benchmarks. To evaluate this ability, we introduce MM-CreativityBench, a benchmark for affordance-grounded creative tool use in visually rich, physically constrained environments. Each instance presents a scenario image with structured views of candidate entities and their parts, enabling fine-grained, interactive evaluation of how models iteratively inspect the scene, identify relevant affordances, and compose visually and physically grounded solutions. Our experiments show that current LMMs often fall short, not due to lack of generative capability, but because they do not sustain grounded exploration. Models often overlook relevant entities, under-examine critical parts, or hallucinate attributes not grounded in the image. Motivated by this failure mode, we propose affordance-grounded alignment, which casts creative tool use as a preference learning problem. Using Direct Preference Optimization, we encourage models to prefer attribute-affordance reasoning grounded in visual evidence over hallucinated alternatives. In addition, we incorporate supervision derived from an affordance knowledge base to guide broader entity exploration and multi-turn planning. Our results show consistent gains in selecting the correct entities and parts, while substantially reducing hallucination and grounding-related errors.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MM-CreativityBench基准，用于评估大型多模态模型在视觉丰富、物理受限环境中基于可供性的创造性工具使用能力。实验发现当前模型常因缺乏持续的接地探索而失败，而非生成能力不足。作者提出可供性对齐方法，将创造性工具使用建模为偏好学习问题，使用直接偏好优化（DPO）鼓励模型基于视觉证据进行属性-可供性推理，并结合可供性知识库指导实体探索和多轮规划。结果显示在实体和部件选择上取得一致性提升，同时显著减少幻觉和接地错误。
Motivation: 当前大型多模态模型在感知和推理上快速进步，但能否在开放环境中发现视觉接地解决方案（即创造性物理智能）尚不清楚，现有基准未充分测试此能力。
Method: 提出MM-CreativityBench基准和可供性对齐方法：将创造性工具使用视为偏好学习问题，通过直接偏好优化（DPO）使模型偏好基于视觉证据的属性-可供性推理，并利用可供性知识库的监督指导实体探索和多轮规划。
Result: 实验表明当前LMMs常因未持续接地探索而失败，而所提方法在正确选择实体和部件上取得一致性提升，并显著减少幻觉和接地相关错误。
Conclusion: 创造性工具使用需要超越模式识别的接地探索，所提可供性对齐方法能有效改善模型的可供性推理和减少接地错误。

papers.title: Exploiting Local Dynamics Regularity for Reusable Skills in Offline Hierarchical RL
papers.abstract_en: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning (HRL) promises to solve long-horizon Reinforcement Learning (RL) tasks more efficiently than non-hierarchical counterparts by discovering and reusing temporally-extended skills. However, obtaining skills that are actually reusable remains an open challenge. Towards this end, we focus on abstractions that exploit the intuition of local dynamics: local transitions in different global contexts require similar kinds of action sequences. By aligning these contexts with the action sequences they require, we are able to learn which skills to reuse and where to reuse them. In principle, this information should benefit many HRL algorithms, where high-level policies have to reason about the low-level skills they use. The resulting algorithm CARL (Contrastive Action-based Representations for Reusable Local Control) shows both qualitative clustering of meaningful skills in complex humanoid environments and improved downstream performance on the OGBench benchmark when integrated with HIQL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对离线层次强化学习中技能可重用性不足的问题，提出CARL算法，通过对比学习将全局上下文与所需动作序列对齐，利用局部动力学规律性来发现可重用技能并在适当位置复用。实验在复杂人形环境中展示了有意义的技能聚类，并在OGBench基准上与HIQL结合提升了下游性能。
Motivation: 现有HRL方法难以获得真正可重用的技能，需要一种利用局部动力学规律性的抽象来指导技能在何处重用。
Method: 提出CARL（Contrastive Action-based Representations for Reusable Local Control），通过对比学习对齐全局上下文与所需的动作序列，从而学习技能重用策略。
Result: 在复杂人形环境中展示了有意义的技能聚类，并在OGBench基准上结合HIQL提升了下游性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调利用局部动力学规律性可以提升HRL算法的技能重用能力，但对泛化性等限制未提及。

papers.title: What Molecular Structure Cannot Tell Us: A Taxonomy of Explainability Gaps in GNN-Based Drug Toxicity Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Not all clinically relevant adverse effects are structurally inferable from molecular graphs - regardless of model quality or architectural complexity. This study introduces an operational taxonomy of the structural information limits that prevent structure-based toxicity prediction, independent of the learning algorithm employed. Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have emerged as a natural approach for molecular toxicity prediction, operating directly on atomic connectivity without the information loss inherent to fixed-length fingerprints. However, the fraction of a drug's known pharmacological profile that is actually inferable from molecular structure remains systematically underexplored. A systematic case study using acetylsalicylic acid (ASA, Aspirin) - one of the most comprehensively characterized drugs in pharmacology - serves as model compound. A Message Passing Neural Network (MPNN) is trained on the Tox21 benchmark and GNNExplainer is applied to characterize atom-level attribution. Results indicate that molecular structure explains approximately 45% (5/11) of known ASA adverse effects. A four-category Gap Taxonomy (GAP-1 through GAP-4) is introduced distinguishing between principally non-encodable effects, data gaps arising from Missing Not At Random (MNAR) mechanisms, assay panel mismatches, and representation errors. The MNAR gap is empirically quantified via a systematic ChEMBL query (42 documented assays, 0 retrievable bioactivity entries). An attention pooling experiment localizes the representation error to the MPNN message passing layers rather than the aggregation step. The Gap Taxonomy has direct implications for drug safety signal detection and regulatory frameworks including Good Pharmacovigilance Practice (GVP) guidelines and New Approach Methodologies (NAMs). Structural limits identified are confirmed in a companion DDI ablation study.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究分子结构本身的信息限制对基于图的毒性预测的影响，提出一个可解释性差距的分类法（Gap Taxonomy），以阿司匹林为例，发现只有约45%的不良反应可从结构推断。讨论了非可编码效应、缺失非随机（MNAR）数据、实验面板不匹配和表示错误四类差距。
Motivation: 临床上相关的不良反应并非都能从分子图结构推断，无论模型质量如何，现有研究缺乏对结构信息极限的系统探索。
Method: 以阿司匹林作为模型化合物，在Tox21上训练MPNN，使用GNNExplainer进行原子级归因，提出Gap Taxonomy，并通过ChEMBL查询量化MNAR差距，通过注意力池化实验定位表示错误。
Result: 分子结构只能解释阿司匹林已知11种不良反应中的5种（约45%）。MNAR差距通过ChEMBL查询证实：42个记录在案的实验中检索到0个生物活性条目。
Conclusion: 该分类法对药物安全信号检测和监管框架（如GVP和NAMs）有直接意义，结构限制在配套的DDI消融研究中得到确认。

papers.title: MuCRASP: Multimodal Chain-of-thought Reasoning aware Structured Pruning
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly rely on chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning to solve complex multimodal tasks, but their large parameter sizes make deployment expensive. Structured pruning offers a natural solution; however, existing methods fail to preserve CoT reasoning accuracy in VLMs. We identify two key reasons: (1) CoT consistency depends on sparse transition points (pivot tokens) in the generation trajectory, while existing pruning methods are CoT-agnostic; and (2) pruning methods designed for unimodal LLMs do not account for activation-distribution differences across visual and textual modalities. Motivated by these observations, we propose MuCRASP, a structured pruning framework that targets reasoning-critical components while preserving cross-modal alignment and accounting for layer-wise sensitivity under a global parameter budget. Experiments on four VLMs across three reasoning benchmarks show that MuCRASP consistently preserves reasoning quality under increasing compression. At 30% pruning on Qwen2.5-VL-7B, MuCRASP achieves an LLM-as-a-Judge score of 8.87 versus 7.32 for the strongest baseline on physical reasoning tasks. Furthermore, MuCRASP maintains high reasoning consistency up to 50% pruning, significantly outperforming prior pruning approaches while exhibiting lower perplexity degradation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MuCRASP，一种针对视觉语言模型（VLM）的多模态链式思维推理结构化剪枝框架。该方法通过识别推理关键组件（如过渡令牌）并保持跨模态对齐，在全局参数预算下进行层敏感剪枝。实验表明在30%剪枝率下，MuCRASP在物理推理任务上达到LLM-as-a-Judge得分8.87（基线7.32），并能在50%剪枝率下保持高推理一致性。
Motivation: 现有结构化剪枝方法忽略链式思维推理依赖的稀疏过渡点且未考虑视觉与文本模态的激活分布差异，导致VLM在压缩后推理质量下降。
Method: MuCRASP框架针对推理关键组件（pivot tokens）进行剪枝，同时保留跨模态对齐，并基于全局参数预算和层敏感性分配剪枝率。
Result: 在四个VLM和三个推理基准上，MuCRASP在压缩下保持推理质量；在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上30%剪枝时，物理推理任务得分8.87 vs 基线7.32；50%剪枝仍维持高一致性且困惑度退化更低。
Conclusion: MuCRASP在保留VLM链式思维推理方面显著优于现有剪枝方法，但未涉及本文关键词相关的气象应用领域。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Efficient Benchmarking Is Just Feature Selection and Multiple Regression
papers.abstract_en: Efficient benchmarking techniques aim to lower the computational cost of evaluating LLMs by predicting full benchmark scores using only a subset of a benchmark's questions. By reframing this problem as an instance of multiple regression with feature selection, we find that existing efficient benchmarking methods can be greatly improved by simply using kernel ridge regression at the prediction stage. Additionally, using an information-theoretic feature-selection algorithm called minimum redundancy maximum relevance (mRMR), we can further improve upon these methods by selecting question subsets that will be maximally useful for prediction. Except in very data-poor settings, these approaches consistently achieve smaller prediction errors (in both MAE and RMSE), and greater ranking correlation between predicted and true scores (in both Spearman $ρ$ and Kendall $τ$) across a range of benchmarks using both binary and continuous metrics. Furthermore, mRMR subsampling is much faster than competitor methods (which often involve fitting probabilistic models or running clustering algorithms), and is more likely to select the same questions under different random seeds or training data splits. Tutorial code can be found at https://github.com/sambowyer/mrmr_eval .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将高效基准测试问题重新表述为带特征选择的多元回归，发现使用核岭回归（kernel ridge regression）进行预测能大幅改进现有方法。结合信息论特征选择算法mRMR（最小冗余最大相关性）选择问题子集，在多种基准和指标下（除数据极少场景外）均取得更低的预测误差和更高的排序相关性。mRMR子采样速度显著快于现有方法，且对随机种子和训练数据划分更稳定。
Motivation: 现有高效基准测试方法计算成本高，且预测全量基准分数时精度不足。作者认为问题本质是多元回归与特征选择，可引入更优的回归模型和特征选择算法来提升效率与准确性。
Method: 将基准测试分数预测建模为多元回归问题，采用核岭回归作为预测模型，并利用mRMR算法进行特征选择（即选择最具信息量的问题子集），以最小化预测误差并保持排序一致性。
Result: 在多个基准测试上（使用二元和连续指标），该方法在MAE、RMSE、Spearman ρ和Kendall τ上一致优于现有方法，且mRMR子采样速度更快、更稳定。
Conclusion: 将高效基准测试视为带特征选择的多元回归问题，结合核岭回归和mRMR选择，可显著提升预测精度和计算效率，且方法简单实用。

papers.title: SpongeBob: Sync-Aware Harmonious Audio-Visual Generative Editing
papers.abstract_en: Visual and acoustic events in the physical world are inherently coupled, yet existing video editing methods typically adopt decoupled pipelines, lacking bidirectional modality interaction. This results in two key limitations: (i) audio-visual desynchronization and (ii) contextual conflicts between generated audio and preserved content. To address these, we propose SpongeBob, the first end-to-end audio-visual joint editing framework featuring bidirectional cross-modal interaction. For synchronization, a Sync-Aware Mechanism aligns visual edits with sound events via bidirectional attention, temporal alignment, and spatial constraints. For contextual consistency, a Context-Aware Module leverages acoustic and visual context attention to prevent semantic clashes. Additionally, we introduce Sync-Preserving Training and Guidance (SPTG) to enhance alignment without degrading quality. Due to the scarcity of paired data, we construct a scalable data pipeline and a large-scale subject-level dataset. We also propose SpongeBob-Bench for systematic evaluation. Experiments show SpongeBob significantly outperforms existing baselines, improving Sync-C by 30% and Ctx-F1 by 12.5%. Our project page is available at: https://hy-spongebob.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SpongeBob，首个端到端音视频联合编辑框架，通过双向跨模态交互解决现有方法中的音视频不同步和上下文冲突问题。该框架包含 Sync-Aware Mechanism（双向注意力、时间对齐、空间约束）和 Context-Aware Module，并引入 Sync-Preserving Training and Guidance (SPTG) 以增强对齐且不降低质量。实验表明，在 SpongeBob-Bench 上 Sync-C 提升 30%，Ctx-F1 提升 12.5%。
Motivation: 现有视频编辑方法通常采用解耦流水线，缺乏双向模态交互，导致两个关键局限：音视频不同步以及生成音频与保留内容之间的上下文冲突。
Method: 提出 SpongeBob 框架，包含 Sync-Aware Mechanism（通过双向注意力、时间对齐和空间约束实现视觉编辑与声音事件对齐）和 Context-Aware Module（利用声学和视觉上下文注意力防止语义冲突），并设计 Sync-Preserving Training and Guidance (SPTG) 及构建大规模数据集和 SpongeBob-Bench 基准。
Result: 在 SpongeBob-Bench 上，SpongeBob 显著优于现有基线，Sync-C 提升 30%，Ctx-F1 提升 12.5%。
Conclusion: SpongeBob 是首个端到端音视频联合编辑框架，通过双向模态交互有效解决了同步和上下文一致性问题，并提供了系统评估基准。

summary_sections.result: 在 SpongeBob-Bench 上，SpongeBob 显著优于现有基线，Sync-C 提升 30%，Ctx-F1 提升 12.5%。
summary_sections.conclusion: SpongeBob 是首个端到端音视频联合编辑框架，通过双向模态交互有效解决了同步和上下文一致性问题，并提供了系统评估基准。

papers.title: Theoretical Analysis of Sparse Optimization with Reparameterization, Weight Decay, and Adaptive Learning Rate
papers.abstract_en: Sparse optimization is a fundamental challenge in various practical applications. A popular approach to sparse optimization is $\ell_p$ regularization. However, it may encounter optimization instability due to the unbounded gradients when $0<p<1$. In this paper, we introduce a novel approach to sparse optimization termed ReWA, based on Reparameterization, Weight decay, and Adaptive learning rate. ReWA is closely connected to $\ell_p$-regularization, yet it unveils a distinct optimization landscape that helps mitigate instability issues. Experiments on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet with ResNets demonstrate that ReWA leads to significant sparsity improvements over the $\ell_1$-regularization approach while preserving test accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对稀疏优化中ℓ_p正则化在0<p<1时梯度无界导致的优化不稳定问题，提出一种基于重参数化、权重衰减和自适应学习率的方法ReWA。该方法与ℓ_p正则化紧密相关，但展现了不同的优化景观，有助于缓解不稳定性。在CIFAR-10和ImageNet上的实验表明，ReWA在保持测试精度的同时，显著提高了稀疏性。
Motivation: ℓ_p正则化在稀疏优化中广泛应用，但当0<p<1时，梯度可能无界，导致优化过程不稳定。现有方法难以兼顾稀疏性和稳定性。
Method: 提出ReWA方法，结合重参数化（reparameterization）、权重衰减（weight decay）和自适应学习率（adaptive learning rate），构建一种新的优化景观，从而避免梯度爆炸问题。
Result: 在CIFAR-10和ImageNet数据集上使用ResNet进行实验，ReWA相比ℓ_1正则化方法显著提升了稀疏性，同时测试准确率未受影响。
Conclusion: ReWA提供了一种有效的稀疏优化替代方案，通过重参数化、权重衰减和自适应学习率的协同作用，在保持精度的前提下实现更高的模型稀疏性。

papers.title: SRUG: Shadow-Guided Relightable Urban Scene with Generation Model
papers.abstract_en: Creating relightable urban scenes from images or videos is widely useful but highly ill-posed. Urban environments are typically unbounded and extend beyond the visible regions. As a result, many portions of the scene remain unobserved, yet these invisible regions can cast shadows onto visible areas. Reasonably modeling shadows cast by such invisible regions is challenging and poses a significant obstacle to creating relightable urban scenes. At the same time, sparse input views and complex illumination conditions further complicate relighting, as they introduce severe ambiguities in material decomposition. In this paper, we propose Shadow-guided Relightable Urban Scene with Generation model (SRUG), a novel framework designed to address relighting challenges in urban scenes. SRUG leverages shadows to guide a 3D completion model for recovering the geometry of invisible regions, promoting the synthesis of physically reasonable shadows. In addition, SRUG employs an iterative material decomposition scheme that applies the large material model (LMM) to provide material supervision and iteratively decompose the scene's material properties, enabling robust material decomposition. Building upon these components, we introduce a physically-based lighting model that captures the complex illumination of urban scenes and supports reliable relighting. Extensive quantitative evaluations and visual comparisons demonstrate that our method outperforms existing approaches in both novel view synthesis and relighting tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SRUG框架，利用阴影引导3D补全模型恢复不可见区域的几何结构，并结合迭代材质分解与物理光照模型，实现从稀疏视图和复杂光照条件下的城市场景重光照。实验表明该方法在新视角合成和重光照任务上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 城市场景通常无界且存在不可见区域，这些区域会向可见区域投射阴影，但现有方法难以合理建模这些阴影。同时，稀疏输入视图和复杂光照条件加剧了材质分解的歧义性，阻碍了可重光照城市场景的生成。
Method: 提出Shadow-guided Relightable Urban Scene with Generation model (SRUG)，包含三个关键组件：1）阴影引导的3D补全模型恢复不可见区域几何，以生成物理合理的阴影；2）基于大材质模型(LMM)的迭代材质分解方案，提供材质监督并逐步分解材质属性；3）基于物理的光照模型捕获城市复杂光照，支持可靠重光照。
Result: 定量评估和视觉对比表明，SRUG在新视角合成和重光照任务上均优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 作者认为利用阴影引导补全不可见区域几何、结合迭代材质分解和物理光照模型，可以有效解决城市场景重光照中的阴影建模和材质分解难题。

papers.title: Steering Beyond the Support: Adversarial Training on Unsupervised Jailbroken Activation Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Jailbreak prompts can trigger harmful completions on aligned LLMs, In accordance, safety steering has been proposed: test-time activation interventions that steer jailbreak activations to trigger refusal while preserving benign utility. However, existing steering methods are fundamentally supervised and tied to a static, limited training set, whereas real jailbreaks evolve and are often out-of-distributed from the training set, leading to failures on unseen attacks. In this paper, we tackle the failure on unseen jailbreaks problem, base on unsupervised latent direction discovery. We propose a bi-level adversarial training framework for zero-shot jailbreak defense. In the inner step, we simulate diverse jail-broken activations by extrapolating from refusal-state harmful-request activations via unsupervised latent direction discovery, which expands the coverage of real jailbreak activation subspaces. In the outer step, we train a potential-induced steering field to push these adversarial jailbroken states into refusal regions while keeping benign unchanged. Across three LLMs and six classical jailbreak families, our method achieves strong defense with attack success rates mostly below 5%, and rising subspace coverage throughout training helps explain the improved generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于无监督潜在方向发现的对抗训练框架，用于防御LLM的越狱攻击。内层通过外推拒绝状态下的有害请求激活来模拟未见过的越狱激活模式，外层训练势诱导转向场将对抗激活推回拒绝区域。在三个LLM和六个经典越狱家族上，攻击成功率大多低于5%，子空间覆盖率的提升解释了泛化能力的改善。
Motivation: 现有监督式转向方法依赖静态有限的训练集，无法应对不断演化的分布外越狱攻击，导致对未见攻击的防御失效。
Method: 提出双层对抗训练：内层通过无监督潜在方向发现，从拒绝状态的有害请求激活中外推模拟多样的越狱激活；外层训练势诱导转向场，将这些对抗越狱状态推入拒绝区域，同时保持良性样本输出不变。
Result: 在三个LLM和六个经典越狱家族上，攻击成功率大多低于5%；训练过程中子空间覆盖率的上升与泛化能力提升相关。
Conclusion: 该方法实现了零样本越狱防御，且子空间覆盖率的动态增长有助于解释泛化能力的来源。

papers.title: The Distillation Game: Adaptive Attacks & Efficient Defenses
papers.abstract_en: Distillation attacks create a deployment trade-off for model providers: the same outputs that make a model more useful can also make it easier to imitate. We study this trade-off through a minimax game between a utility-constrained teacher and an adaptive student. Our framework yields tractable one-sided response rules: an adaptive evaluation rule in which the student reweights high-value examples, and a teacher-side defense template that suppresses outputs most useful for distillation. From a cheap proxy for example value, we derive Product-of-Experts (PoE), a simple forward-pass-only defense that combines the teacher with a proxy student during generation. Empirically, adaptive evaluation reveals a large passive--adaptive gap: on state-of-the-art defenses, adaptive students recover substantially more capability than passive evaluation suggests on GSM8K and MATH. Under this stronger evaluation, the apparent robustness gap between expensive defenses and PoE narrows considerably, while PoE remains substantially cheaper and preserves higher-quality reasoning traces. Overall, our results suggest that strong distillation remains difficult to stop, and that progress on antidistillation should be judged against adaptive students rather than passive ones. Our code is available at: https://github.com/ysfalh/distillation-game.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究知识蒸馏攻击与防御的权衡，通过最小最大博弈框架分析教师模型与自适应学生之间的互动。提出自适应评估规则和Product-of-Experts (PoE)防御方法，实验表明自适应学生能更有效地恢复教师能力，且PoE在性能和成本之间取得平衡。
Motivation: 模型提供者面临权衡：模型输出越有用，越容易被模仿。现有防御评估多基于被动学生，可能低估实际威胁。
Method: 构建最小最大博弈形式化框架，推导出教师侧简单防御模板（抑制高蒸馏价值输出）和学生侧自适应重加权规则。提出PoE防御，仅需一次前向传播，结合教师和代理学生的输出。
Result: 自适应评估揭示被动与自适应学生之间的巨大能力差距：在GSM8K和MATH基准上，自适应学生恢复能力显著高于被动评估结果。PoE与昂贵防御的性能差距缩小，且计算成本更低、推理轨迹质量更高。
Conclusion: 强蒸馏攻击难以阻止，未来反蒸馏防御应针对自适应学生而非被动学生进行评估。

papers.title: DeliCIR: Deliberative Test-Time Evolutionary Hierarchical Multi-Agents for Composed Image Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) requires both preserving the visual continuity of the reference image and faithfully executing the semantic variables specified in the modification text, which constitute the core challenge of the task. Existing methods often suffer from Perception Myopia in a single space, or fall into Logic Drift in iterative collaboration due to the perception ceiling of the underlying retriever. To address this issue, we propose a one-stop hierarchical Perception-to-Deliberation Framework (PDF), which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first to introduce experience self-evolution and Test-Time Scaling Laws (TTS) into CIR. Relying on a hierarchical multi-agent architecture, PDF first utilizes an Intent Routing Manager to dynamically dispatch multi-view Worker perception signals based on modification intents to construct a high-recall candidate pool. Subsequently, the Decision Manager combines a Training-free Reasoning Policy Distillation mechanism with a Tournament-style TTS (T-TTS) strategy to achieve self-evolving fine-grained reasoning, yielding the final retrieval results. Experimental results demonstrate that PDF achieves SOTA performance on three benchmark datasets: CIRR, CIRCO, and FashionIQ. This study indicates that experience-driven self-evolution and TTS represent a highly promising and scalable path for achieving zero-shot fine-grained multimedia retrieval. The code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DeliCIR，一种用于组合图像检索（CIR）的分层多智能体框架，首次引入经验自进化和测试时缩放定律（TTS）。该方法通过意图路由管理器动态调度多视图工人感知信号构建高召回候选池，再通过决策管理器结合训练无关推理策略蒸馏和锦标赛式TTS策略实现自进化推理。在CIRR、CIRCO和FashionIQ三个基准上取得SOTA性能。
Motivation: 现有CIR方法存在单空间感知近视或迭代协作中的逻辑漂移问题，原因是底层检索器的感知上限。
Method: 提出分层感知-深思框架（PDF），包含意图路由管理器和决策管理器。前者基于修改意图动态调度多视图工人信号构建候选池，后者结合训练无关推理策略蒸馏和锦标赛式TTS实现自进化推理。
Result: 在CIRR、CIRCO和FashionIQ三个基准数据集上取得SOTA性能。
Conclusion: 经验驱动的自进化和TTS为零样本细粒度多媒体检索展示了一条有前景的可扩展路径。代码将公开。

papers.title: Agent JIT Compilation for Latency-Optimizing Web Agent Planning and Scheduling
papers.abstract_en: Computer-use agents (CUAs) automate tasks specified with natural language such as "order the cheapest item from Taco Bell" by generating sequences of calls to tools such as click, type, and scroll on a browser. Current implementations follow a sequential fetch-screenshot-execute loop where each iteration requires an LLM call, resulting in high latency and frequent errors from incorrect tool use. We present agent just-in-time (JIT) compilation, a system that compiles task descriptions directly into executable code that may include LLM calls, tool calls, and parallelization. Our approach comprises three components: (1) JIT-Planner, which generates multiple code plans, validates each against tool specifications, and selects the minimum-cost candidate; (2) JIT-Scheduler, which explores parallelization strategies via Monte Carlo cost estimation from learned latency distributions; and (3) an invariant-enforcing tool protocol specifying precondition and postcondition requirements to reduce the rate of incorrect tool use. Across five applications, JIT-Planner achieves $10.4\times$ speedup and 28$\%$ higher accuracy over Browser-Use, while JIT-Scheduler achieves $2.4\times$ speedup and 9\% higher accuracy over OpenAI CUA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出代理即时编译（Agent JIT compilation）系统，用于将自然语言描述的任务直接编译为可执行代码，包含LLM调用、工具调用和并行化。系统由JIT-Planner（生成多个代码计划并选择最低成本候选）、JIT-Scheduler（基于蒙特卡洛成本估计探索并行策略）和不变性工具协议（减少错误工具使用）组成。实验表明，JIT-Planner相比Browser-Use实现10.4倍加速和28%准确率提升，JIT-Scheduler相比OpenAI CUA实现2.4倍加速和9%准确率提升。
Motivation: 现有计算机使用代理（CUA）采用顺序的获取屏幕截图-执行循环，每次迭代需要LLM调用，导致高延迟和由错误工具使用引起的频繁错误，需要更高效的任务规划和调度方法。
Method: 提出代理即时编译系统，包括三个组件：JIT-Planner（生成多个代码计划并依据工具规范验证和选择最低成本候选）、JIT-Scheduler（通过学习延迟分布进行蒙特卡洛成本估计，探索并行化策略）和不变性强制工具协议（规定前置和后置条件以降低错误工具使用率）。
Result: 在五个应用上，JIT-Planner实现10.4倍速度和28%更高准确率（对比Browser-Use），JIT-Scheduler实现2.4倍速度和9%更高准确率（对比OpenAI CUA）。
Conclusion: 代理即时编译通过编译描述、计划验证和并行化调度，大幅提升了计算机使用代理的延迟和准确性，工具协议有效减少了错误调用。

papers.title: PRISM: Preference-Aware Influence Function Based Data Selection Method for Efficient Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: As LLMs continue to scale up, improving training efficiency heavily relies on effective data utilization. Data selection mitigates this issue by allocating the limited training budget to high-value examples that optimally facilitate the model's target behavior. Most existing approaches define target behavior via a set of target examples and score candidate training data based on their estimated influence on these samples. However, such methods uniformly treat all target examples as equally important, ignoring the varying relevance of individual examples to model optimization. Specifically, target examples that align closely with the model's inherent behavior deliver stronger supervisory signals, whereas discrepant examples yield only weak and ineffective local guidance. We propose PRISM, a Preference-aware Influence function based Data Selection Method. It leverages model preference to assign weights to target examples and builds a preference-aware target direction. PRISM evaluates candidate training samples according to their influence on this direction, and prioritizes data budget allocation to samples that effectively drive the model to match expected target behavior. Theoretical analysis verifies that weighted preference construction generates a superior first-order gradient direction for boosting target preference, compared with uniform aggregation strategies. Extensive experiments covering diverse model architectures and parameter scales demonstrate that PRISM achieves better performance in efficient fine-tuning and safety-aligned supervised fine-tuning rectification. The results validate that accurate characterization of target behavior serves as the core of cost-effective data selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PRISM，一种偏好感知的影响函数数据选择方法，用于高效微调LLM。通过加权目标示例构建偏好感知的目标方向，优先选择对该方向影响大的训练样本。理论分析和实验表明，相比均匀聚合，该方法能更好地提升目标偏好，在高效微调和安全对齐微调中表现优异。
Motivation: 现有数据选择方法均匀对待所有目标示例，忽略了个体示例与模型优化的不同相关性，与模型固有行为一致的目标示例提供强监督信号，不一致的示例提供弱局部指导。
Method: PRISM利用模型偏好对目标示例加权，构建偏好感知的目标方向，然后根据候选训练样本对该方向的影响评估并分配数据预算。
Result: 在多种模型架构和参数规模上的实验表明，PRISM在高效微调和安全对齐的监督微调修正中取得更好性能。
Conclusion: 准确刻画目标行为是成本有效数据选择的核心。

papers.title: ScenePilot: Controllable Boundary-Driven Critical Scenario Generation for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Safety-critical scenarios are central to evaluating autonomous driving systems, yet their rarity in naturalistic logs makes simulation-based stress testing indispensable. Most scenario generation methods treat surrounding agents as adversaries, but they either (i) induce failures without explicitly modeling vehicle-road physical limits, yielding visually extreme yet physically unsolvable crashes, or (ii) enforce physical feasibility or policy feasibility in isolation, which can over-focus on aggressive maneuvers or remain tied to a controller-dependent capability boundary. We propose ScenePilot, a feasibility-guided, boundary-driven framework that targets the boundary band: scenarios that are physically solvable in principle yet still cause the deployed autonomy stack to fail. We formulate generation as constrained multi-objective reinforcement learning, combining an RSS-derived physical-feasibility score $σ$ with an online-learned AV-risk predictor $Φ$, and introduce step-level feasibility-aware shielding to keep exploration near the feasibility boundary while avoiding infeasible artifacts. Experiments on SafeBench with multiple planners show that ScenePilot yields substantially higher collision rates (+6.2 percentage points) while preserving physical validity, and that adversarial fine-tuning on these boundary-band scenarios consistently reduces downstream crash rates. The code is available at https://github.com/QiyuRuan/ScenePilot.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ScenePilot，一种基于可行性和边界的可控关键场景生成框架，用于自动驾驶测试。该框架通过约束多目标强化学习，结合RSS物理可行性分数和在线学习的风险预测器，生成物理上可解但导致自动驾驶系统失败的关键场景。实验表明，ScenePilot在保持物理有效性的同时，显著提高了碰撞率（+6.2个百分点），并且基于这些边界场景的对抗微调持续降低了下游碰撞率。
Motivation: 现有场景生成方法要么生成视觉极端但物理不可解的碰撞，要么在强制执行物理或策略可行性时过于激进或依赖控制器能力边界。缺乏对物理可行性与策略失效边界带的有效探索。
Method: 将场景生成建模为约束多目标强化学习，结合RSS推导的物理可行性分数σ和在线学习的AV风险预测器Φ，并引入步骤级可行性感知屏蔽机制，使探索保持在可行性边界附近，避免不可行伪影。
Result: 在SafeBench上的多个规划器实验中，ScenePilot相比基线将碰撞率提高了6.2个百分点，同时保持物理有效性；基于生成边界场景的对抗微调持续降低了下游碰撞率。
Conclusion: ScenePilot能够有效生成物理上合理但导致系统失败的关键场景，为自动驾驶测试和安全性提升提供了一种可行方案，代码已开源。

papers.title: Efficient Learning of Deep State Space Models via Importance Smoothing
papers.abstract_en: Latent state space systems are ubiquitous in statistical modelling, arising naturally when time series are observed through noisy measurements. However, training deep state space models (DSSMs) at scale remains difficult. Two largely distinct strategies have emerged for training DSSMs. The first, auto-encoding DSSMs, trains generative models by optimising a variational lower bound. The second backpropagates through the outputs of classical sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) algorithms. Such approaches can train DSSMs for both discriminative and generative tasks, but their inherently sequential forward passes scale poorly on modern hardware. We propose \emph{parallel variational Monte Carlo} (PVMC), a new training method that bridges these paradigms and robustly trains DSSMs for both discriminative and generative tasks. Across a set of benchmark experiments, PVMC matches or exceeds state-of-the-art performance while training $10\times$ faster than the fastest competing SMC-based approach.
papers.comment: Accepted to the proceedings of ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出并行变分蒙特卡洛 (PVMC) 方法，用于高效训练深度状态空间模型 (DSSM)。PVMC 结合了自编码 DSSM 和基于序列蒙特卡洛 (SMC) 方法的优势，支持判别式和生成式任务。在基准实验中，PVMC 以比最快 SMC 方法快 10 倍的训练速度达到或超越当前最优性能。
Motivation: 现有 DSSM 训练方法分为自编码变分下界优化和反向传播 SMC 两类，但后者因顺序前向传播在现代硬件上扩展性差。需要一种并行高效且鲁棒的训练方法。
Method: 提出 PVMC 方法，通过并行化变分蒙特卡洛步骤来训练 DSSM，桥接自编码和 SMC 两种范式，实现快速训练。
Result: 在多个基准实验中，PVMC 匹配或超越当前最优性能，训练速度比最快竞争 SMC 方法快 10 倍。
Conclusion: PVMC 提供了一种高效的 DSSM 训练方案，适用于判别式和生成式任务，且显著加速训练过程。

papers.title: LiteViLNet: Lightweight Vision-LiDAR Fusion Network for Efficient Road Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Road segmentation is a fundamental perception task for autonomous driving and intelligent robotic systems, requiring both high accuracy and real-time inference, especially for deployment on resource-constrained edge devices. Existing multi-modal road segmentation methods often rely on heavy transformer-based encoders to achieve state-of-the-art performance, but their enormous computational cost prohibits real-time deployment on embedded platforms. To address this dilemma, we propose LiteViLNet, a lightweight multi-modal network that fuses RGB texture information and LiDAR geometric information for efficient road segmentation. Specifically, we design a dual-stream lightweight encoder and depth-wise separable convolutions to extract hierarchical features from both modalities with minimal parameters. We further propose a Multi-Scale Feature Fusion Module (MSFM) to facilitate cross-modal interaction at different levels, and a large-kernel-bridge module to capture long-range dependencies with linear complexity. Extensive experiments on the KITTI Road dataset and real-world applications demonstrate that LiteViLNet achieves a promising balance between accuracy and efficiency. Notably, with only 14.04M parameters, our model attains a 96.36% MaxF score, ranking the best among all CNN-based methods and being comparable to larger transformer-based models, and runs at 163.79 FPS in model-only inference on RTX 4060 Ti (22.18 FPS on Jetson Orin NX). It outperforms numerous heavy-weight methods in inference speed while maintaining highly competitive accuracy, fully validating the potential of LiteViLNet for real-time embedded deployment in autonomous driving and intelligent robotics.

TL;DR: 本文提出LiteViLNet，一种轻量级多模态网络，融合RGB纹理和LiDAR几何信息用于高效道路分割。通过双流轻量编码器、深度可分离卷积、多尺度特征融合模块（MSFM）和大核桥接模块，在KITTI Road数据集上以14.04M参数达到96.36% MaxF分数，并在RTX 4060 Ti上以163.79 FPS运行，在Jetson Orin NX上达到22.18 FPS，实现了精度与效率的良好平衡，适合边缘设备实时部署。
Motivation: 现有基于transformer的多模态道路分割方法计算开销巨大，无法在资源受限的边缘设备上实时运行，亟需轻量级方案。
Method: 设计双流轻量编码器和深度可分离卷积提取模态特征，提出多尺度特征融合模块（MSFM）促进跨模态交互，并采用大核桥接模块以线性复杂度捕获长距离依赖。

Conclusion: LiteViLNet在保持高精度的同时大幅提升推理速度，验证了轻量级多模态网络在自动驾驶和智能机器人嵌入式实时部署中的潜力。
