papers.title: PlanningBench: Generating Scalable and Verifiable Planning Data for Evaluating and Training Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Planning is a fundamental capability for large language models (LLMs) because such complex tasks require models to coordinate goals, constraints, resources, and long-term consequences into executable and verifiable solutions. Existing planning benchmarks, however, usually treat planning data as fixed collections of instances rather than controllable generation targets. This limits scenario coverage, ties difficulty to surface-level proxies rather than structural sources, and offers limited support for scalable generation, automatic verification, or planning-oriented training. We introduce PlanningBench, a framework for generating scalable, diverse, and verifiable planning data for both evaluation and training. PlanningBench starts from real planning scenarios and abstracts practical workflows into a structured taxonomy of more than 30 task types, subtasks, constraint families, and difficulty factors. Guided by this taxonomy, a constraint-driven synthesis pipeline instantiates self-contained planning problems with adaptive difficulty control, quality filtering, and instance-level verification checklists. This shifts planning data construction from fixed benchmark collection to controllable generation while preserving realistic task grounding. We use PlanningBench to evaluate open-source and closed-source frontier LLMs, and find that current models still struggle to produce complete solutions under coupled constraints. Beyond evaluation, reinforcement learning on verified PlanningBench data improves performance on unseen planning benchmarks and broader instruction-following tasks. Further analysis suggests that determinate or well-specified optimal solutions provide clearer reward signals and more stable training dynamics. Overall, PlanningBench provides a controllable source of planning data for diagnosing and improving generalizable planning abilities in LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PlanningBench框架，用于生成可扩展、多样化且可验证的规划数据，以评估和训练大型语言模型。该框架从真实规划场景出发，抽象出包含30多种任务类型的结构化分类，并通过约束驱动的合成流水线生成自适应难度的规划问题。评估发现现有LLM在耦合约束下仍难以产生完整解决方案，而基于验证数据的强化学习可提升模型在未见规划基准和指令跟随任务上的性能。
Motivation: 现有规划基准通常将数据视为固定实例集合，缺乏可控制的生成目标，限制了场景覆盖，难以区分难度来源，不支持可扩展生成和自动验证。
Method: 提出PlanningBench框架，包含结构化分类（30+任务类型、子任务、约束族和难度因素）和约束驱动的合成流水线，实现自适应难度控制、质量过滤和实例级验证。
Result: 评估开源和闭源前沿LLM，发现当前模型在耦合约束下仍难以产生完整解决方案；基于验证数据的强化学习可提升未见规划基准和指令跟随任务的性能。
Conclusion: PlanningBench提供了可控的规划数据源，用于诊断和提升LLM的通用规划能力；确定性的最优解可提供更清晰的奖励信号和更稳定的训练动态。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出PlanningBench框架，用于生成可扩展、多样化且可验证的规划数据，以评估和训练大型语言模型。该框架从真实规划场景出发，抽象出包含30多种任务类型的结构化分类，并通过约束驱动的合成流水线生成自适应难度的规划问题。评估发现现有LLM在耦合约束下仍难以产生完整解决方案，而基于验证数据的强化学习可提升模型在未见规划基准和指令跟随任务上的性能。

summary_sections.method: 提出PlanningBench框架，包含结构化分类（30+任务类型、子任务、约束族和难度因素）和约束驱动的合成流水线，实现自适应难度控制、质量过滤和实例级验证。

papers.title: Chunking German Legal Code
papers.abstract_en: This paper investigates chunking strategies for retrieval-augmented generation on German statutory law, using the German Civil Code as a structured benchmark corpus. We implement and compare a range of segmentation approaches, including structural units (sections, subsections, sentences, propositions), fixed-size windows, contextual chunking, semantic clustering, Lumber-style chunking, and RAPTOR-based hierarchical retrieval. All methods are evaluated on a legal question-answering dataset with section-level gold labels, measuring recall, query latency, index build time, and storage requirements. Results show that chunking strategies aligned with the inherent legal structure - particularly section and subsection - based retrieval-achieve the highest recall, while more complex approaches that override this structure perform worse. These simpler methods also offer favorable computational efficiency compared to LLM-intensive techniques such as contextual chunking, RAPTOR, and Lumber. The findings highlight a key trade-off between semantic enrichment and operational cost, and demonstrate that preserving domain-specific structure is critical for effective legal information retrieval.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Eigth Workshop on Automated Semantic Analysis of Information in Legal Texts co-located with the 21th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Law (ICAIL 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究德国成文法（民法典）的文本分块策略，用于检索增强生成（RAG）。比较了结构单元（章节、节、句子、命题）、固定窗口、上下文分块、语义聚类、Lumber风格分块及RAPTOR层次检索等方法。在具有章节级标签的法律问答数据集上评估召回率、查询延迟、索引构建时间和存储需求。结果表明，与法律固有结构对齐的简单分块方法（尤其按章节和节）召回率最高，且计算效率优于依赖LLM的复杂方法。揭示了语义丰富性与操作成本之间的关键权衡。
Motivation: 法律文本检索中，分块策略对RAG性能影响重大，但现有研究缺乏对德国成文法系统的、结构感知的分块比较。
Method: 在德国民法典上实现并比较了七类分块方法：结构单元（章节、节、句子、命题）、固定大小窗口、上下文感知分块（利用LLM生成上下文）、语义聚类（基于句子嵌入）、Lumber风格分块（通过LLM生成摘要及问题）、RAPTOR层次检索。所有方法在具有章节级黄金标签的法律问答数据集上评估召回率、查询延迟、索引构建时间和存储需求。
Result: 基于法律结构的分块（尤其按章节和节）召回率最高；覆盖该结构的复杂方法（如语义聚类、Lumber、RAPTOR）性能更差。简单方法还展现出更优的计算效率（更低的索引时间和查询延迟）。
Conclusion: 保留领域特定结构对于法律信息检索至关重要，语义丰富方法带来的收益不足以抵消其高昂的计算成本。

papers.title: PMF-CL: Pareto-Minimal-Forgetting Continual Learner for Conflicting Tasks
papers.abstract_en: In the literature, many continual learning (CL) algorithms have been proposed to address the issue of catastrophic forgetting in ML models (i.e., learning new tasks leads to the loss of performance on previously learned tasks). Although all CL approaches use some form of memory to retain information about past tasks, a grounded understanding of what information needs to be stored to minimize catastrophic forgetting remains elusive. Recently, it has been recognized that under the strong assumption of the existence of a common global minimizer over all tasks, catastrophic forgetting can be completely avoided. However, in practice, tasks rarely have a common global minimizer, and a certain amount of forgetting is inevitable. In this paper, we propose a foundational framework for principled and systematic CL of conflicting tasks using a multi-task learning (MTL) perspective. The approach is based on finding Pareto-optimal solutions, i.e., the solutions which, by definition, minimally forget the previous tasks in the Pareto sense. We derive Pareto-minimal-forgetting CL algorithms for linear and basis-function regression, and general loss functions which have a quadratic upper bound, e.g., logistic regression. For quadratic problems, PMF-CL uses memory-efficient iterative updates with a static memory footage of $\mathcal{O}(d^2)$ for models with $d$ parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PMF-CL框架，从多任务学习的视角处理冲突任务中的持续学习问题，通过寻找Pareto最优解来最小化遗忘。针对线性回归、基函数回归以及具有二次上界的损失函数（如逻辑回归）推导出Pareto最小遗忘的持续学习算法，在二次问题中实现内存高效的迭代更新，静态内存开销为O(d²)。
Motivation: 现有持续学习方法虽使用记忆机制，但缺乏对存储何种信息以最小化遗忘的理论理解；且实际中任务间通常不存在共同全局最小化器，遗忘不可避免。
Method: 将冲突任务的持续学习转化为多目标优化问题，通过寻找Pareto最优解实现最小遗忘。为线性、基函数回归及二次上界损失函数推导具体算法，利用二次问题的结构实现内存高效迭代更新。
Result: 摘要未提供具体实验数值，但声称PMF-CL在二次问题中具有O(d²)的静态内存开销，且通过Pareto最优性保证最小遗忘。
Conclusion: PMF-CL为冲突任务的持续学习提供了理论基础，但当前推导限于特定函数类，未来需扩展到更一般的损失函数和非线性模型。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Proximal basin hopping: global optimization with guarantees
papers.abstract_en: Global optimization is a challenging problem, with plenty of algorithms displaying empirical success, but scarce theoretical backing. In this work, we propose a new theoretical framework called Proximal Basin Hopping (PBH), carefully tailored to combine proximal optimization and local minimization. We use it to construct a practical algorithm that converges to the global minimizer with high probability, when using a finite amount of samples. Proximal Basin Hopping outperforms well known algorithms with theoretical backing on standard synthetic hard functions, and real problems such as fitting scaling laws for deep learning. Furthermore, the higher the dimension, the better the performance gap.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Proximal Basin Hopping (PBH)理论框架，结合近端优化和局部最小化，构造的算法能以高概率收敛到全局最小。在标准合成硬函数和深度学习缩放律拟合中表现优于有理论保证的已知算法，且维度越高优势越大。
Motivation: 全局优化算法经验成功多但理论保证少，旨在提供具有理论保证的实用算法。
Method: 基于PBH理论框架，结合近端优化（proximal optimization）和局部最小化（local minimization），设计具体算法。
Result: 在标准合成硬函数和实际深度学习缩放律拟合中，PBH优于有理论保证的已知算法，且维度越高性能差距越大。
Conclusion: PBH框架提供了全局优化算法的高概率收敛保证，且实际性能优越。

papers.title: Interaction-Breaking Adversarial Learning Framework for Robust Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Cooperation is central to multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), yet learned coordination can be fragile when external perturbations disrupt inter-agent interactions. Prior robust MARL methods have primarily considered value-oriented attacks, leaving a gap in robustness when interaction structures themselves are corrupted. In this paper, we propose an interaction-breaking adversarial learning (IBAL) framework that takes an information-theoretic view to construct attacks that impede coordination by perturbing agents' observations and actions, and trains agents to perform reliably under such disruptions. Empirically, our approach improves robustness over existing robust MARL baselines across diverse attack settings and yields stronger performance even under agent-missing scenarios. Our code is available at https://sunwoolee0504.github.io/IBAL.
papers.comment: 9 pages for main, 33 pages for total, Accepted to ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多智能体强化学习（MARL）中智能体间交互结构易受外部扰动破坏的问题，提出一种基于信息论的交互破坏对抗学习（IBAL）框架。该框架通过扰动观测和动作来生成破坏协调的攻击，并训练智能体在干扰下可靠执行。实验表明，IBAL在多种攻击设置下提升了鲁棒性，且在智能体缺失场景下表现更强。
Motivation: 现有鲁棒MARL方法主要关注值导向攻击，忽略了智能体间交互结构本身被破坏的情况。本文旨在填补这一空白，提升协调策略对交互扰动的鲁棒性。
Method: 提出交互破坏对抗学习框架，从信息论视角构造攻击，通过扰动智能体的观测和动作来阻碍协调，并训练智能体在这种干扰下保持性能。
Result: 在多种攻击设置下，IBAL相比现有鲁棒MARL基线提升了鲁棒性，且在智能体缺失场景下取得了更强的性能。
Conclusion: 本文强调通过对抗性攻击交互结构并训练鲁棒策略，可以有效提升MARL在现实环境中的可靠性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: DSAA: Dual-Stage Attribute Activation for Fine-grained Open Vocabulary Detection
papers.abstract_en: Open-Vocabulary Object Detection (OVD) models break the limitations of closed-set detection, enabling the identification of unseen categories through natural language prompts. However, they exhibit notable limitations in fine-grained detection tasks involving attributes like color, material, and texture. We attribute this performance bottleneck in OVD models to a core issue: when category signals dominate, OVD models tend to marginalize attribute information during inference. This leads to incorrect binding between attributes and target objects. To address this, we propose the Dual-Stage Attribute Activation (DSAA) framework, which enhances fine-grained detection capabilities by strengthening attribute semantics at two critical stages. In the text embedding stage, we employ Attribute Prefix Adapter (APA) module to generate attribute prefixes that inject explicit attribute priors. To further amplify the influence of these attributes, our Key/Value (K/V) Modulator module then intervenes during the BERT encoding phase, selectively enhancing the Key and Value vectors of the corresponding attribute tokens. In addition, we introduce an attribute-aware contrastive loss to improve discrimination among same-category instances with different attributes during training. Experimental results on the FG-OVD benchmark demonstrate the effectiveness of our method across various mainstream open-vocabulary models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出双阶段属性激活框架（DSAA），以增强开放词汇检测模型在细粒度属性（如颜色、材质、纹理）检测上的能力。通过在文本嵌入阶段使用属性前缀适配器注入显式属性先验，并在BERT编码阶段通过键/值调制器选择性增强属性标记的表示，同时引入属性感知对比损失。在FG-OVD基准上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 开放词汇检测模型在细粒度属性检测上表现不佳，原因是类别信号主导时模型会边缘化属性信息，导致属性与目标对象绑定错误。
Method: 提出双阶段属性激活框架：1）文本嵌入阶段使用属性前缀适配器生成属性前缀；2）BERT编码阶段通过键/值调制器增强对应属性标记的Key和Value向量。额外使用属性感知对比损失提升训练区分度。
Result: 在FG-OVD基准上，该方法在多个主流开放词汇检测模型上均有效提升了细粒度属性检测性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调DSAA框架通过强化属性语义两个关键阶段，解决了开放词汇检测中属性信息被边缘化的问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Covariance Structure and Coordinate Heterogeneity Govern Binary Quantization of Contrastive Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Binary quantization (BQ) compresses high-dimensional embeddings into one or two bits per coordinate, enabling nearest neighbor search at extreme speed. Yet a striking puzzle persists: BQ achieves competitive recall on contrastive embeddings but fails on others -- and two leading systems adopt diametrically opposite strategies (random rotation vs. preserving coordinate axes) without a common theory explaining when each is appropriate. We address this puzzle by connecting the Gaussian structure recently established for InfoNCE-trained representations to a statistical framework for BQ quality. Our analysis reveals two distinct roles of the covariance matrix. First, the full covariance structure -- not merely its diagonal -- determines the absolute level of ranking fidelity, with off-diagonal correlations contributing 30--50% of the signal. Second, coordinate heterogeneity (the non-uniformity of per-coordinate variances) governs key design choices: how much each additional bit contributes, and whether random rotation helps or hurts. We derive approximate expressions for ranking fidelity under a Gaussian model, show that the magnitude bit carries information proportional to heterogeneity, and show that random rotation destroys precisely the signal that one paradigm exploits while creating the isotropy that the other requires. A phenomenological scaling law predicts fidelity across models and dimensions. Experiments on 18 datasets spanning 9 embedding families support the main predictions and provide, to our knowledge, the first principled design guide for binary quantization systems.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过连接InfoNCE训练的嵌入的高斯结构与二值量化的统计框架，揭示了协方差矩阵的两个作用：完整协方差结构决定排序保真度的绝对水平（非对角线相关性贡献30-50%信号），坐标异质性（各坐标方差非均匀性）控制额外比特的贡献以及随机旋转是否有益。推导了高斯模型下排序保真度的近似表达式，并给出一个现象学标度律。在9个嵌入家族的18个数据集上验证了主要预测。
Motivation: 二值量化在对比嵌入上表现优异但在其他嵌入上失败，且两种主流系统（随机旋转vs保留坐标轴）的策略截然相反，缺乏统一理论解释何时适用。
Method: 建立InfoNCE训练嵌入的高斯模型，分析协方差结构对二值量化排序保真度的影响，推导近似表达式，并引入现象学标度律。
Result: 全协方差结构贡献30-50%的信号；坐标异质性决定额外比特增益和随机旋转的效果；随机旋转破坏一个范式依赖的信号同时创造另一个范式所需的各向同性。
Conclusion: 实验支持理论预测，首次为二值量化系统提供了原则性设计指南。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: FML-bench: A Controlled Study of AI Research Agent Strategies from the Perspective of Search Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: AI research agents accelerate ML research by automating hypothesis generation, experimentation, and empirical refinement. Existing agent strategies range from greedy hill-climbing to tree search and evolutionary optimization, yet which strategy choices drive performance remains unclear. Answering this question requires a benchmark that separates agent strategy (e.g., search topology) from execution infrastructure (e.g., code editor), so that performance differences are attributable to strategy rather than infrastructure, and that provides process-level metrics beyond final scores to analyze exploration behaviors. Existing benchmarks offer limited support. We propose FML-Bench, a benchmark of 18 fundamental ML research tasks across 10 domains that separates agent strategy from execution infrastructure and defines 12 process-level behavioral metrics. Evaluating six representative agents, we find that: (1) strategy complexity alone does not guarantee strong performance: a simple greedy hill-climber nearly matches the best-performing tree-search agent, both well above the remaining agents; (2) our analysis suggests this pattern relates to improvement opportunity structure: greedy search tends to be more effective when opportunities are dense, while tree-search and evolutionary strategies tend to be more effective when opportunities are sparse; an adaptive agent built on this insight switches to broader exploration upon detecting improvement stagnation and outperforms the other six agents, lending initial support to this observation; and (3) process-level analysis reveals that early convergence and directionally focused exploration are significantly associated with final performance, while solution diversity and compute cost are not. Our benchmark is available at: https://github.com/qrzou/FML-bench.
papers.comment: Our benchmark is available at: https://github.com/qrzou/FML-bench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FML-Bench，一个将智能体策略与执行基础设施解耦的基准，包含 18 个基础 ML 研究任务和 12 个过程级行为指标。评估六种代表性智能体后发现：简单的贪心爬山几乎匹敌最佳树搜索，二者远超其他智能体；机会密集时贪心搜索更有效，机会稀疏时树搜索和进化策略更有效；基于此构建的自适应智能体超越所有对手。过程级分析表明早期收敛和方向聚焦探索与最终性能显著相关。
Motivation: 现有基准无法区分智能体策略与执行基础设施的影响，且缺乏过程级指标，导致难以分析探索行为与性能的关系。
Method: 构建 FML-Bench，包含 18 个跨 10 个领域的基础 ML 任务，定义 12 个过程级行为指标，并解耦策略与执行基础设施。评估六种智能体（贪心爬山、树搜索、进化优化等），并基于改进机会结构设计自适应智能体。
Result: 贪心爬山与最佳树搜索智能体性能相近，远超其他智能体；自适应智能体在检测到改进停滞时切换探索策略，性能超越所有六种基线。过程级分析显示早期收敛和方向聚焦探索与最终性能显著相关，而解决方案多样性和计算成本不相关。
Conclusion: 策略复杂度不保证性能，改进机会结构决定了不同搜索策略的有效性；自适应策略可提升效率。

papers.title: Multi-task Linear Regression without Eigenvalue Lower Bounds: Adaptivity, Robustness, and Safety
papers.abstract_en: We study the multi-task linear regression problem in the presence of contaminated tasks. We address the setting where the unknown parameters of a majority of tasks are close in the $\ell_2$-norm, while a fraction of tasks are arbitrary outliers. Existing theoretical frameworks for this problem rely heavily on the assumption that the empirical second moment of each task has a minimum eigenvalue bounded away from zero (order $Ω(1)$). Crucially, this assumption fails in many high-dimensional scenarios, rendering prior guarantees vacuous. To overcome this limitation, we propose an estimator based on matrix-weighted norm regularization. We also introduce a relative balancedness condition, quantified by a balancedness constant, that compares each task's second moment with the average inlier geometry and relaxes the need for taskwise second-moment lower bounds. In favorable regimes with moderate balancedness, our prediction MSE bounds match the rate of Duan and Wang (2023) under substantially weaker spectral assumptions; the resulting task-overall MSE is minimax optimal up to logarithmic factors. Furthermore, we demonstrate that our estimator enjoys a safety guarantee: when the relevant balancedness constant is large or infinite, or when tasks are unrelated, the method performs no worse than independent task learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究存在污染任务时的多任务线性回归问题，提出基于矩阵加权范数正则化的估计器，并引入相对平衡条件以放松对每个任务二阶矩最小特征值的有界假设。在适度平衡条件下，预测MSE界达到与Duan and Wang (2023)相同的速率，且任务整体MSE在log因子下达到极小极大最优。同时，该方法在平衡常数较大或任务无关时，性能不低于独立任务学习。
Motivation: 现有多任务线性回归理论框架严重依赖每个任务经验二阶矩的最小特征值远离零的假设，这一假设在高维场景中常不成立，导致理论保证失效。
Method: 提出基于矩阵加权范数正则化的估计器，并引入相对平衡条件（由平衡常数量化），比较每个任务的二阶矩与平均内点几何，从而放松对任务级二阶矩下界的要求。
Result: 在适度平衡条件下，预测MSE界匹配Duan and Wang (2023)的速率，任务整体MSE达到极小极大最优（至多对数因子）。同时方法具有安全保证：平衡常数较大或任务无关时，性能不差于独立任务学习。
Conclusion: 本文通过相对平衡条件有效替代了强特征值假设，使多任务线性回归在更广泛的场景下具有可证明的适应性和鲁棒性，并提供了安全保证。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: SEMA-RAG: A Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Retrieval-Augmented Generation Framework for Medical Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is widely employed to mitigate risks such as hallucinations and knowledge obsolescence in medical question answering, yet its predominantly single-round, static retrieval paradigm misaligns with the multi-stage process of clinical reasoning. This compressed workflow induces two structural deficiencies: question-to-query translation often lacks clinically grounded semantic interpretation, and retrieval lacks iterative sufficiency feedback, making it difficult to form reliable evidence chains. We argue that both issues stem from a deeper cause: overloading a single reasoning chain with heterogeneous tasks of interpretation, exploration, and adjudication. The remedy is to reconstruct the workflow via task decoupling and dynamic multi-round exploration. To this end, we propose SEMA-RAG, a Self-Evolving Multi-Agent RAG framework for medical question answering, which assigns these roles to three specialist agents: the Interpreter Agent for clinical schema interpretation, the Explorer Agent for sufficiency-driven self-evolving retrieval, and the Arbiter Agent for evidence adjudication and answer selection. Across five benchmarks and five LLM backbones, SEMA-RAG improves the strongest baseline by +6.46 accuracy points on average, measured per backbone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SEMA-RAG，一种自进化多智能体检索增强生成框架，用于医学问答。该框架通过任务解耦，将推理过程分配给三个专业智能体：解释器（Interpreter Agent）、探索者（Explorer Agent）和仲裁者（Arbiter Agent），分别负责临床模式解释、充分性驱动的自进化检索以及证据仲裁与答案选择。在五个基准和五个LLM骨干上，SEMA-RAG平均提升最强基线6.46个准确率点。
Motivation: 现有医学RAG采用单轮静态检索范式，与临床推理的多阶段过程不一致，导致查询翻译缺乏临床语义解释，检索缺乏迭代反馈，难以形成可靠证据链。根本原因在于单一推理链过载了解释、探索和裁决等异质任务。
Method: 提出SEMA-RAG框架，采用任务解耦和动态多轮探索，包括三个专用智能体：Interpreter Agent负责临床模式解释，Explorer Agent负责充分性驱动的自进化检索，Arbiter Agent负责证据仲裁和答案选择。
Result: 在五个基准和五个LLM骨干上，SEMA-RAG平均提升最强基线6.46个准确率点（按骨干测量）。
Conclusion: 通过任务解耦和动态多轮探索重构工作流程，能够缓解单推理链过载问题，提升医学问答的可靠性。

papers.title: MAVEN A Multi-Agent Framework for Multicultural Text-to-Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-video (T2V) generation has rapidly progressed in visual fidelity, yet its ability to faithfully represent multiple cultures within a single prompt remains underexplored. We introduce MAVEN, a multi-agent prompt refinement framework designed to improve cultural fidelity in both mono-cultural and cross-cultural T2V generation. MAVEN decomposes prompts into person, action, and location dimensions, handled by specialized agents operating in parallel or sequentially. To support systematic evaluation, we contribute a new benchmark of 243 culturally grounded prompts and 972 corresponding videos, spanning three cultures (Chinese, American, Romanian), three action categories, and both mono-cultural and cross-cultural scenarios. Evaluations combining CLIP-based metrics, VLM-as-judge assessments, and videoquality measures show that multi-agent refinement, particularly parallel specialization, significantly improves cultural relevance while preserving visual quality and temporal consistency. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/AIM-SCU/MAVEN
papers.comment: [14] pages, [6] figures, [11] tables, appendix included. Preprint
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MAVEN，一个多智能体提示精炼框架，旨在提升单文化和跨文化文本到视频生成中的文化保真度。摘要报告了在包含中文、美国、罗马尼亚三种文化的基准上，多智能体并行精炼显著改善了文化相关性，同时保持了视觉质量和时序一致性。
Motivation: 现有文本到视频生成在视觉保真度上进展迅速，但对多种文化忠实呈现的能力未被充分探索。
Method: MAVEN将提示分解为人、动作、位置三个维度，由专门智能体并行或串行处理，实现多文化提示的精炼。
Result: 在包含243个文化提示和972个视频的新基准上，结合CLIP指标、VLM评估和视频质量度量，并行专业化精炼显著提升文化相关性。
Conclusion: 多智能体精炼，尤其并行专业化，能有效提升文化保真度而不牺牲视觉质量。数据集和代码已公开。

papers.title: Fully Open Meditron: An Auditable Pipeline for Clinical LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Clinical decision support systems (CDSS) require scrutable, auditable pipelines that enable rigorous, reproducible validation. Yet current LLM-based CDSS remain largely opaque. Most "open" models are open-weight only, releasing parameters while withholding the data provenance, curation procedures, and generation pipelines that determine model behavior. Fully Open (FO) models, which expose the complete training stack end-to-end, do not currently exist in medicine. We introduce Fully Open Meditron, the first fully open pipeline for building LLM-CDSS, comprising a clinician-audited training corpus, a reproducible data construction and training framework, and a use-aligned evaluation protocol. The corpus unifies eight public medical QA datasets into a normalized conversational format and expands coverage with three clinician-vetted synthetic extensions: exam-style QA, guideline-grounded QA derived from 46,469 clinical practice guidelines, and clinical vignettes. The pipeline enforces system-wide decontamination, gold-label resampling of teacher generations, and end-to-end validation by a four-physician panel. We evaluate using an LLM-as-a-judge protocol over expert-written clinical vignettes, calibrated against 204 human raters. We apply the recipe to five FO base models (Apertus-70B/8B-Instruct, OLMo-2-32B-SFT, EuroLLM-22B/9B-Instruct). All MeditronFO variants are preferred over their bases. Apertus-70B-MeditronFO improves +6.6 points over its base (47.2% to 53.8%) on aggregate medical benchmarks, establishing a new FO SoTA. Gemma-3-27B-MeditronFO is preferred over MedGemma in 58.6% of LLM-as-a-judge comparisons and outperforms it on HealthBench (58% vs 55.9%). These results show that fully open pipelines can achieve state-of-the-art domain-specific performance without sacrificing auditability or reproducibility.
papers.comment: Preprint. 31 pages, 10 figures. Code, models, and data: https://github.com/EPFLiGHT/FullyOpenMeditron
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Fully Open Meditron，这是首个完全开源的临床大语言模型（LLM）构建流程，包括经过临床医生审计的训练语料库、可复现的数据构建和训练框架，以及面向应用的评估协议。该流程将八个公开医疗问答数据集统一为标准化对话格式，并通过三种临床医生验证的合成扩展增强覆盖。评估采用 LLM-as-a-judge 协议，经过 204 名人类评分者校准，并在五个完全开源的基础模型上应用。
Motivation: 当前基于 LLM 的临床决策支持系统（CDSS）大多不透明，即使是所谓的“开源”模型也只开放权重，而隐藏了数据来源、处理流程和生成管线，导致难以进行严格的、可复现的验证。医学领域尚不存在完全开放（Fully Open）的模型，即暴露完整训练栈的模型。
Method: 构建了完全开源的流程，包括：(1) 由临床医生审计的训练语料库，整合八个公开医疗问答数据集并标准化为对话格式，同时增加三类临床医生验证的合成数据（考试式问答、基于临床实践指南的问答、临床病例）；(2) 可复现的数据构建和训练框架，强制全系统去污染、对教师生成进行金标签重采样，并由四名医生进行端到端验证；(3) 使用 LLM-as-a-judge 协议评估，该协议基于专家编写的临床病例，并由 204 名人类评分者校准。
Result: 在五个完全开源的基础模型（Apertus-70B/8B-Instruct、OLMo-2-32B-SFT、EuroLLM-22B/9B-Instruct）上应用该流程，所有 MeditronFO 变体均优于其基础模型。Apertus-70B-MeditronFO 在综合医疗基准上比基础模型提升 6.6 个百分点（从 47.2% 到 53.8%），创下完全开源模型的新最佳水平。Gemma-3-27B-MeditronFO 在 LLM-as-a-judge 比较中以 58.6% 的偏好率优于 MedGemma，并在 HealthBench 上以 58% 对 55.9% 胜出。
Conclusion: 结果表明，完全开源的流程可以在不牺牲可审计性和可复现性的前提下，实现领域特定的最新性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Differentiable Mixture-of-Agents Incentivizes Swarm Intelligence of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have catalyzed the development of multi-agent systems (MAS) for complex reasoning tasks. However, existing MAS typically rely on pre-defined or pre-compiled communication topologies, which limits their flexibility and adaptability to dynamic task requirements. In this work, we propose Differentiable Mixture-of-Agents (DMoA), a self-evolving multi-agent framework that enables elastic and adaptive agent collaboration during inference. Instead of statically constructing workflows, DMoA dynamically routes and activates agents at each reasoning step, allowing the system to implicitly simulate diverse communication topologies and adapt to evolving demands. To achieve this, we design a differentiable, context-aware routing mechanism that leverages recurrent structures to incorporate historical and contextual information, producing sparse agent activations in a step-wise manner. Furthermore, we introduce predictive entropy as self-supervised signals to optimize the routing process, enabling efficient test-time adaptation without external annotations. Extensive experiments across 9 benchmarks demonstrate that DMoA achieves state-of-the-art performance while exhibiting strong efficiency, robustness, and ensembling capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Differentiable Mixture-of-Agents (DMoA)，一种自进化的多智能体框架，通过可微分、上下文感知的路由机制，在推理过程中动态激活和组合大语言模型（LLM）智能体，隐式模拟多样化的通信拓扑，并利用预测熵作为自监督信号优化路由。在9个基准上取得最先进性能，同时保持高效性、鲁棒性和集成能力。
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的多智能体系统通常依赖预定义或预编译的通信拓扑，缺乏灵活性和适应性，难以应对动态任务需求。
Method: 设计可微分、上下文感知的路由机制，结合循环结构以整合历史和上下文信息，逐步产生稀疏智能体激活；引入预测熵作为自监督信号，实现无需外部标注的测试时自适应优化。
Result: 在9个基准上达到最先进性能，同时展现出强效率、鲁棒性和集成能力。
Conclusion: DMoA通过动态路由和自监督优化实现了自适应多智能体协作，在性能和效率上显著优于静态拓扑方法。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Rethinking Neural Network Learning Rates: A Stackelberg Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Neural networks are typically trained with a single learning rate across all layers. While recent empirical evidence suggests that assigning layer-specific learning rates can accelerate training, a principled understanding of the conditions and mechanisms under which non-uniform learning rates are beneficial remains limited. In this work, we investigate non-uniform learning rates through the lens of Stackelberg optimization. Specifically, we demonstrate that training neural networks with a smaller learning rate for the body layers and a larger learning rate for the final layer can be interpreted as a two-time-scale alternating gradient descent algorithm applied to a Stackelberg reformulation of the original objective. We establish finite-time convergence guarantees for the algorithm under broad conditions that accommodate constraint sets and non-smooth activation functions. Beyond convergence, we identify two mechanisms by which non-uniform learning rates can outperform uniform learning rates: (i) we show that certain problem instances induce a Stackelberg objective with stronger optimization structure than the original objective, yielding faster convergence to globally optimal solutions, (ii) our numerical analysis reveals that the Stackelberg objective can exhibit substantially sharper local curvature, especially in early training, which leads to more informative gradients and learning acceleration. Experiments in supervised learning and reinforcement learning support our findings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过Stackelberg优化视角研究神经网络非均匀学习率。作者证明在body层使用较小学习率、最后一层使用较大学习率可视为两层时间尺度交替梯度下降算法，并给出有限时间收敛保证。理论分析揭示两种加速机制：某些问题实例的Stackelberg目标具有更强优化结构，以及Stackelberg目标在训练早期具有更尖锐的局部曲率。监督学习和强化学习实验支持理论发现。
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏对非均匀学习率何时以及为何有效的原则性理解，本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 将非均匀学习率训练建模为原始目标的Stackelberg优化重表述，并提出两层时间尺度交替梯度下降算法，同时处理约束集和非光滑激活函数。
Result: 建立了算法的有限时间收敛保证；理论分析表明非均匀学习率可通过更强的优化结构和训练早期更尖锐的局部曲率两种机制超越均匀学习率，实验验证了加速效果。
Conclusion: 非均匀学习率（body层小、最后一层大）能加速训练，且具有理论收敛保障。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Causal Forcing++: Scalable Few-Step Autoregressive Diffusion Distillation for Real-Time Interactive Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Real-time interactive video generation requires low-latency, streaming, and controllable rollout. Existing autoregressive (AR) diffusion distillation methods have achieved strong results in the chunk-wise 4-step regime by distilling bidirectional base models into few-step AR students, but they remain limited by coarse response granularity and non-negligible sampling latency. In this paper, we study a more aggressive setting: frame-wise autoregression with only 1--2 sampling steps. In this regime, we identify the initialization of a few-step AR student as the key bottleneck: existing strategies are either target-misaligned, incapable of few-step generation, or too costly to scale. We propose \textbf{Causal Forcing++}, a principled and scalable pipeline that uses \emph{causal consistency distillation} (causal CD) for few-step AR initialization. The core idea is that causal CD learns the same AR-conditional flow map as causal ODE distillation, but obtains supervision from a single online teacher ODE step between adjacent timesteps, avoiding the need to precompute and store full PF-ODE trajectories. This makes the initialization both more efficient and easier to optimize. The resulting pipeline, \ours, surpasses the SOTA 4-step chunk-wise Causal Forcing under the \textit{\textbf{frame-wise 2-step setting}} by 0.1 in VBench Total, 0.3 in VBench Quality, and 0.335 in VisionReward, while reducing first-frame latency by 50\% and Stage 2 training cost by $\sim$$4\times$. We further extend the pipeline to action-conditioned world model generation in the spirit of Genie3. Project Page: https://github.com/thu-ml/Causal-Forcing and https://github.com/shengshu-ai/minWM .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Causal Forcing++，一种可扩展的少步自回归扩散蒸馏方法，用于实现实时交互式视频生成。在帧级自回归设置下，通过因果一致性蒸馏（causal CD）初始化少步自回归学生模型，避免了预计算完整 PF-ODE 轨迹的需求，在帧级 2 步设置下优于现有的 4 步块级方法，并将首帧延迟降低 50%，第二阶段训练成本降低约 4 倍。
Motivation: 现有自回归扩散蒸馏方法在块级 4 步设置下表现良好，但响应粒度粗、采样延迟不可忽略，难以满足实时交互视频生成的低延迟需求。本文针对帧级 1-2 步的激进设置，发现少步自回归学生的初始化是关键瓶颈。
Method: 提出因果一致性蒸馏（causal CD），从相邻时间步之间的单个在线教师 ODE 步骤获取监督信号，学习与因果 ODE 蒸馏相同的自回归条件流映射，从而实现高效且易优化的少步自回归初始化。
Result: 在帧级 2 步设置下，Causal Forcing++ 在 VBench Total 上提升 0.1，VBench Quality 提升 0.3，VisionReward 提升 0.335，首帧延迟降低 50%，Stage 2 训练成本降低约 4 倍。
Conclusion: Causal Forcing++ 提供了一种可扩展的少步自回归蒸馏管道，适用于实时交互视频生成和动作条件世界模型生成。

papers.title: Towards a holistic understanding of Selection Bias for Causal Effect Identification
papers.abstract_en: Selection bias is pervasive in observational studies. For example, large scale biobanks data can exhibit ``healthy volunteer bias'' when respondents are healthier and of higher socio-economic status than the population they are meant to represent. Recovering causal effects from such sub-population is an important problem in causal inference, as estimating average treatment effects (ATE) from selected populations can result in a severely biased estimate of the ATE from the whole population. In this paper, we investigate the identifiability of the ATE under selection bias. We provide necessary and sufficient conditions for ATE identifiability, leveraging weak assumptions on probability classes to characterize propensity score and selection probability, . Compared to previous works, our results extend existing graphical identifiability criteria and offer a more comprehensive understanding of causal effect identification with strictly weaker conditions in the presence of selection bias.
papers.comment: 9 pages for the main text, ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究选择偏差（selection bias）下平均处理效应（ATE）的可识别性，提供了ATE可识别的充要条件，利用概率类的弱假设刻画倾向得分和选择概率，扩展了已有的图可识别性准则，在更弱的条件下给出了因果效应识别的更全面理解。
Motivation: 观察研究中选择偏差普遍存在（如生物库的“健康志愿者偏差”），从选择子总体恢复因果效应是重要问题，但现有可识别性条件不够充分或过于严格。
Method: 通过弱假设概率类分析倾向得分和选择概率，推导ATE可识别的充要条件，并与图模型准则对比。
Result: 提供了比已有工作更弱的可识别条件，扩展了图形可识别性准则。
Conclusion: 本文在更弱的假设下统一了选择偏差下ATE可识别的理论，有助于实际因果推断应用。

papers.title: Online Learning-to-Defer with Varying Experts
papers.abstract_en: Learning-to-Defer (L2D) methods route each query either to a predictive model or to external experts. While existing work studies this problem in batch settings, real-world deployments require handling streaming data, changing expert availability, and shifting expert distribution. We introduce the first online L2D algorithm for multiclass classification with bandit feedback and a dynamically varying pool of experts. Our method achieves regret guarantees of $O((n+n_e)T^{2/3})$ in general and $O((n+n_e)\sqrt{T})$ under a low-noise condition, where $T$ is the time horizon, $n$ is the number of labels, and $n_e$ is the number of distinct experts observed across rounds. The analysis builds on novel $\mathcal{H}$-consistency bounds for the online framework, combined with first-order methods for online convex optimization. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that our approach effectively extends standard Learning-to-Defer to settings with varying expert availability and reliability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个在线学习推迟（Learning-to-Defer）算法，用于多类分类，支持流式数据、动态变化的专家池和bandit反馈。方法基于H-一致性界和在线凸优化的一阶方法，实现了O((n+n_e)T^{2/3})和低噪声条件下O((n+n_e)√T)的遗憾界。实验在合成和真实数据集上验证了算法在专家可用性和可靠性变化场景下的有效性。
Motivation: 现有学习推迟方法通常假设批量设置，但实际部署需要处理流式数据、变化的专家可用性和分布，缺少在线算法。
Method: 提出在线L2D算法，结合H-一致性界（H-consistency bounds）与在线凸优化的一阶方法，处理多类分类、bandit反馈和动态专家池。
Result: 遗憾界为O((n+n_e)T^{2/3})，低噪声条件下改进为O((n+n_e)√T)。实验在合成和真实数据集上有效。
Conclusion: 方法有效将标准学习推迟扩展到专家可用性和可靠性变化的在线场景。

papers.title: 3D-Belief: Embodied Belief Inference via Generative 3D World Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in visual generative models have highlighted the promise of learning generative world models. However, most existing approaches frame world modeling as novel-view synthesis or future-frame prediction, emphasizing visual realism rather than the structured uncertainty required by embodied agents acting under partial observability. In this work, we propose a different perspective: world modeling as embodied belief inference in 3D space. From this view, a world model should not merely render what may be seen, but maintain and update an agent's belief about the unobserved 3D world as new observations are acquired. We identify several key capabilities for such models, including spatially consistent scene memory, multi-hypothesis belief sampling, sequential belief updating, and semantically informed prediction of unseen regions. We instantiate these ideas in 3D-Belief, a generative 3D world model that infers explicit, actionable 3D beliefs from partial observations and updates them online over time. Unlike prior visual prediction models, 3D-Belief represents uncertainty directly in 3D, enabling embodied agents to imagine plausible scene completions and reason over partially observed environments. We evaluate 3D-Belief on 2D visual quality for scene memory and unobserved-scene imagination, object- and scene-level 3D imagination using our proposed 3D-CORE benchmark, and challenging object navigation tasks in both simulation and the real world. Experiments show that 3D-Belief improves 2D and 3D imagination quality and downstream embodied task performance compared to state-of-the-art methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种生成式3D世界模型3D-Belief，用于具身智能体的信念推演（belief inference）。与传统的视觉预测模型不同，3D-Belief在3D空间中显式表示不确定性，能够从部分观测中推断并在线更新显式的、可操作的3D信念，支持多假设场景补全和推理。在2D/3D想象质量和下游物体导航任务上，该方法优于现有最先进技术。
Motivation: 现有生成式世界模型多专注于新视角合成或未来帧预测，强调视觉真实性，而忽略了具身智能体在部分可观测环境下所需的结构化不确定性表示。
Method: 3D-Belief是一个生成式3D世界模型，具备空间一致的场景记忆、多假设信念采样、顺序信念更新以及对未见区域的语义预测能力，从部分观测中推断3D信念并在线更新。
Result: 在2D视觉质量（场景记忆和未观测场景想象）、3D想象（新提出的3D-CORE基准）以及模拟和真实世界的物体导航任务上，3D-Belief均优于现有的最先进方法。
Conclusion: 将世界建模视为3D空间中的具身信念推演，可以提升2D/3D想象质量和下游具身任务性能，为部分可观测环境下的智能体提供更结构化的不确定性表示。

papers.title: Block-Based Double Decoders
papers.abstract_en: Encoder-decoder models offer substantial inference-time savings over decoder-only models, but their pretraining objectives suffer from sparse supervision and dynamic sequence lengths, keeping them out of practice at scale. We propose block-based double decoders, a novel transformer architecture that utilizes doubly-causal block-based attention masks to train with full loss supervision and static sequence packing, combining decoder-only training efficiency with encoder-decoder inference efficiency. In scaling law experiments, block-based double decoders strongly outperform encoder-decoders and closely track decoder-only models across scales. At inference time, they cut KV-cache memory and per-token compute by at least 2/3 without sacrificing prefill caching or other existing inference optimizations available to decoder-only models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种新型Transformer架构block-based double decoders，使用双因果块注意力掩码，在预训练中实现全损失监督和静态序列打包，结合了decoder-only的训练效率和encoder-decoder的推理效率。在缩放定律实验中，该架构显著优于encoder-decoder，性能紧密追踪decoder-only模型，同时推理时KV-cache内存和每token计算量减少至少2/3。
Motivation: Encoder-decoder模型在推理时比decoder-only模型节省计算，但其预训练目标存在稀疏监督和动态序列长度问题，限制了其在大规模场景下的应用。
Method: 提出block-based double decoders架构，采用双重因果块注意力掩码，使得训练时可以进行全损失监督并使用静态序列打包，从而结合decoder-only的训练效率与encoder-decoder的推理效率。
Result: 在缩放定律实验中，block-based double decoders的性能显著优于encoder-decoder，且与decoder-only模型接近；推理时KV-cache内存和每token计算量至少减少2/3，且不牺牲预填充缓存等现有优化。
Conclusion: 该架构为模型训练与推理效率的权衡提供了新方案，在保持性能的同时大幅降低推理成本，但摘要未提及在具体下游任务上的验证。

papers.title: PROWL: Prioritized Regret-Driven Optimization for World Model Learning
papers.abstract_en: Modern action-conditioned video world models achieve strong short-horizon visual realism, yet remain unreliable on rare, interaction-critical transitions that dominate downstream planning and policy performance. Because passive demonstration data systematically under-samples these high-impact regimes, improving robustness requires actively eliciting model failures rather than relying on their natural occurrence. We introduce a KL-constrained adversarial curriculum in which a policy is trained to expose high-error trajectories of a diffusion-based world model while remaining close to the behavior distribution. The world model is continuously fine-tuned on these adversarially discovered trajectories, yielding an adversarial training loop that converts rare failures into a stable, near-distribution training signal without drifting into out-of-distribution exploitation. To maintain pressure on unresolved weaknesses as the model improves, we propose a Prioritized Adversarial Trajectory (PAT) buffer that re-ranks trajectories based on prediction error, action fidelity, and learning progress, focusing training on unresolved failure modes rather than repeatedly revisiting solved cases. We implement our approach in the MineRL framework and evaluate it on held-out out-of-distribution trajectories; PROWL improves robustness over models trained on passive data alone, reveals reward-hacking behaviors under weak behavioral constraints, and demonstrates that effective adversarial world-model training critically depends on balancing exploratory failure discovery with explicit behavioral regularization. Our results suggest that scalable world models benefit not only from larger datasets, but also from selectively generating informative training data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PROWL方法，通过KL约束的对抗课程学习改进动作条件视频世界模型在稀有交互关键转换上的鲁棒性。方法包括对抗策略暴露高误差轨迹、优先对抗轨迹缓冲区重排和持续微调。在MineRL框架上的评估表明，该方法相比仅被动数据训练提升了鲁棒性，并揭示了弱行为约束下的奖励黑客行为。
Motivation: 被动演示数据系统性地欠采样高影响区域，导致世界模型在稀有交互关键转换上不可靠，从而影响下游规划和策略性能。
Method: 提出KL约束的对抗课程学习：训练策略生成高误差轨迹但保持近分布，持续微调扩散世界模型；并设计优先对抗轨迹缓冲区，根据预测误差、动作保真度和学习进度重排轨迹，聚焦未解决的失败模式。
Result: 在MineRL框架上，PROWL提升了模型对分布外轨迹的鲁棒性，发现了弱行为约束下的奖励黑客行为，并表明有效训练需平衡探索与行为正则化。
Conclusion: 可扩展世界模型不仅受益于更大数据集，也受益于选择性生成信息性训练数据。

papers.title: Much of Geospatial Web Search Is Beyond Traditional GIS
papers.abstract_en: Web search queries concern place far more often than existing labelling schemes suggest, yet the landscape of geospatial web search queries - what people ask of place, and how often - remains poorly characterised at scale. We apply dense sentence embeddings, a lightweight SetFit classifier, and density-based clustering to the full MS MARCO corpus of 1.01 million real Bing queries without prior filtering for toponyms or spatial keywords, identifying 181,827 geospatial queries (18.0%), nearly threefold the 6.17% labelled as Location in the original annotations. The resulting taxonomy of 88 query categories reveals that geospatial web search is dominated by transactional and practical lookups: costs and prices alone account for 15.3% of geospatial queries, nearly twice the size of the entire physical geography theme. Much of this activity - costs, opening hours, contact details, weather, travel recommendations - falls outside the scope of what traditional GIS and knowledge graphs are built to serve. The categories vary substantially in the kind of answer they admit, from deterministic lookups answerable from spatial databases or knowledge graphs to evaluative or temporally volatile queries that require generative or real-time systems. We discuss implications for hybrid retrieval architectures and for benchmarks of geographic reasoning in large language models. We openly release the labelled dataset, classifier, and taxonomy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用密度句子嵌入、SetFit分类器和密度聚类，对MS MARCO语料库中的101万条真实Bing查询进行无地理先验的标注，发现18.0%的查询具有地理空间性质，是原始标注的3倍。构建了88类地理空间查询分类体系，显示大部分查询（如成本、价格、营业时间、天气）超出传统GIS和知识图谱能力范围，需要混合检索或生成式系统。
Motivation: 现有地理空间搜索查询的标注范围过窄（仅6.17%标记为位置），且缺乏大规模、细粒度的分类体系，限制了搜索系统设计。
Method: 对MS MARCO全部查询使用句子嵌入（sentence embeddings）提取语义特征，用少量标注训练SetFit轻量分类器，再对地理查询进行密度聚类（density-based clustering）生成细粒度类别。
Result: 识别出181,827条地理查询（18.0%），分为88类；成本/价格类占15.3%，是物理地理类（physical geography）的2倍；大量查询（如营业时间、联系方式、天气）需要生成式或实时系统。
Conclusion: 地理搜索需求远超传统GIS和知识图谱的支持范围，建议混合检索架构和面向LLM地理推理的基准测试；公开了数据集、分类器和分类体系。

papers.title: Spurious Correlation Learning in Preference Optimization: Mechanisms, Consequences, and Mitigation via Tie Training
papers.abstract_en: Preference learning methods like Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) are known to induce reliance on spurious correlations, leading to sycophancy and length bias in today's language models and potentially severe goal misgeneralization in future systems. In this work, we provide a unified theoretical analysis of this phenomenon, characterizing the mechanisms of spurious learning, its consequences on deployment, and a provable mitigation strategy. Focusing on log-linear policies, we show that standard preference-learning objectives induce reliance on spurious features at the population level through two channels: mean spurious bias and causal-spurious correlation leakage. We then show that this reliance creates an irreducible vulnerability to distribution shift: more data from the same training distribution fails to reduce the model's dependence on spurious features. To address this, we propose tie training, a data augmentation strategy using ties (equal-utility preference pairs) to introduce data-driven regularization. We demonstrate that this approach selectively reduces spurious learning without degrading causal learning. Finally, we validate our theory on log-linear models and provide empirical evidence that both the spurious learning mechanisms and the benefits of tie training persist for neural networks and large language models.
papers.comment: Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning, 2026, Seoul, South Korea
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning, 2026, Seoul, South Korea
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析了偏好学习方法（如DPO）中虚假相关性学习的机制、后果，并提出了平局训练（tie training）作为缓解策略。作者从理论上证明，偏好学习目标会通过两种渠道导致模型依赖虚假特征，且这种依赖对分布偏移具有不可约的脆弱性。平局训练通过数据增强引入正则化，在不损害因果学习的前提下减少虚假学习。理论在log-linear模型上验证，并在神经网络和大语言模型上提供了经验证据。
Motivation: 偏好学习方法（如DPO）会导致模型依赖虚假相关性，产生谄媚、长度偏差等问题，甚至可能在未来系统中导致目标泛化错误。需要理解其机制并设计可证明的缓解策略。
Method: 聚焦于log-linear策略，理论分析虚假学习的两个渠道：平均虚假偏差和因果-虚假相关性泄漏。提出平局训练（tie training），利用效用相等的偏好对作为数据增强，引入数据驱动的正则化。
Result: 理论表明，标准偏好学习目标导致模型在总体水平上依赖虚假特征，且增加同分布数据不能减少此依赖。平局训练能选择性地减少虚假学习而不损害因果学习。在log-linear模型上验证理论，并在神经网络和大语言模型上提供经验证据。
Conclusion: 本文揭示了偏好学习中虚假相关性的机制和后果，并提供了平局训练这一可证明的缓解方法。该策略有效且不牺牲因果学习。

papers.title: Eulerian Motion Guidance: Robust Image Animation via Bidirectional Geometric Consistency
papers.abstract_en: Recent advancements in image animation have utilized diffusion models to breathe life into static images. However, existing controllable frameworks typically rely on Lagrangian motion guidance, where optical flow is estimated relative to the initial frame. This paper revisits the same optical-flow primitive through a more local supervision design: we use adjacent-frame Eulerian motion fields to guide generation, where the motion signal always describes a short temporal hop. This shift enables parallelized training and provides bounded-error supervision throughout the generation process. To mitigate the drift artifacts common in adjacent frame generation, we introduce a Bidirectional Geometric Consistency mechanism, which computes a forward-backward cycle check to mathematically identify and mask occluded regions, preventing the model from learning incorrect warping objectives. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach accelerates training, preserves temporal coherence, and reduces dynamic artifacts compared to reference-based baselines.

papers.title: Autoregressive Visual Generation Needs a Prologue
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we propose Prologue, an approach to bridging the reconstruction-generation gap in autoregressive (AR) image generation. Instead of modifying visual tokens to satisfy both reconstruction and generation, Prologue generates a small set of prologue tokens prepended to the visual token sequence. These prologue tokens are trained exclusively with the AR cross-entropy (CE) loss, while visual tokens remain dedicated to reconstruction. This decoupled design lets us optimize generation through the AR model's true distribution without affecting reconstruction quality, which we further formalize from an ELBO perspective. On ImageNet 256x256, Prologue-Base reduces gFID from 21.01 to 10.75 without classifier-free guidance while keeping reconstruction almost unchanged; Prologue-Large reaches a competitive rFID of 0.99 and gFID of 1.46 using a standard AR model without auxiliary semantic supervision. Interestingly, driven only by AR gradients, prologue tokens exhibit emergent semantic structure: linear probing on 16 prologue tokens reaches 35.88% Top-1, far above the 23.71% of the first 16 tokens from a standard tokenizer; resampling with fixed prologue tokens preserves a similar high-level semantic layout. Our results suggest a new direction: generation quality can be improved by introducing a separate learned generative representation while leaving the original representation intact.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Prologue方法，通过向视觉token序列前添加一组仅用自回归交叉熵损失训练的prologue tokens，解决自回归图像生成中重构与生成之间的差距。在ImageNet 256x256上，Prologue-Base将gFID从21.01降至10.75，Prologue-Large达到rFID 0.99和gFID 1.46，且prologue tokens展现出涌现语义结构。
Motivation: 现有自回归图像生成方法中，视觉token需要同时优化重构和生成目标，导致二者存在差距。本文旨在通过解耦设计弥合这一差距，不损害重构质量。
Method: 生成一组prologue tokens，预置到视觉token序列之前。prologue tokens仅用自回归交叉熵损失训练，视觉token保持原有的重构损失，实现解耦优化。
Result: 在ImageNet 256x256上，Prologue-Base将gFID从21.01降至10.75；Prologue-Large达到rFID 0.99和gFID 1.46。16个prologue tokens的线性探测Top-1准确率达35.88%，远高于标准tokenizer前16个token的23.71%。
Conclusion: 生成质量可通过引入单独学习的生成表示来提升，同时保持原始重构表示不变，为自回归视觉生成提供了新方向。

papers.title: FreeTimeGS++: Secrets of Dynamic Gaussian Splatting and Their Principles
papers.abstract_en: The recent surge in 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) has achieved impressive dynamic scene reconstruction. While these methods demonstrate remarkable performance, the specific drivers behind such gains remain less explored, making a systematic understanding of the underlying principles challenging. In this paper, we perform a comprehensive analysis of these hidden factors to provide a clearer perspective on the 4DGS framework. We first establish a controlled baseline, FreeTimeGS_ours, by formalizing and reproducing the heuristics of the state-of-the-art FreeTimeGS. Using this framework, we dissect 4DGS along its fundamental axes and uncover key secrets, including the emergent temporal partitioning driven by Gaussian durations and the discrepancy between photometric fidelity and spatiotemporal consistency. Based on these insights, we propose FreeTimeGS++, a principled method that employs gated marginalization and neural velocity fields to achieve superior stability and robust dynamic representations. Our approach yields reproducible results with reduced run-to-run variance. We will release our implementation to provide a reliable foundation for future 4DGS research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对4D Gaussian Splatting（4DGS）中的隐藏因素进行全面分析，通过建立受控基线FreeTimeGS_ours揭示关键原理，包括由高斯持续时间驱动的时序分区以及光度保真度与时空一致性之间的差异。基于这些发现提出FreeTimeGS++，采用门控边缘化和神经速度场方法，实现更稳定的动态场景重建，并降低运行间方差。
Motivation: 尽管4DGS在动态场景重建中表现优异，但其背后的具体驱动因素尚不明确，缺乏对基本原理的系统理解。
Method: 首先形式化并复现当前最先进方法FreeTimeGS的启发式策略，构建受控基线FreeTimeGS_ours；然后沿基本轴解剖4DGS，揭示关键秘密；最后提出FreeTimeGS++，引入门控边缘化和神经速度场。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，但声称FreeTimeGS++实现了更优越的稳定性、鲁棒性动态表示和可重复的结果，运行间方差降低。
Conclusion: 通过揭示4DGS的关键原理并提出FreeTimeGS++，为未来4DGS研究提供可靠基础，实现将开源实现以便复现。

papers.title: FedQueue: Queue-Aware Federated Learning for Cross-Facility HPC Training
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) across multiple HPC facilities faces stochastic admission delays from batch schedulers that dominate wall-clock time. Synchronous FL suffers from severe stragglers, while asynchronous FL accumulates stale updates when queues spike. We propose FedQueue, a queue-aware FL protocol that incorporates scheduler delays directly into training and aggregation, which (i) predicts per-facility queue delays online to budget local work, (ii) applies cutoff-based admission that buffers late arrivals to bound staleness, and (iii) performs staleness-aware aggregation to stabilize heterogeneous local workloads. We prove the convergence for non-convex objectives at rate $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{R})$ under bounded staleness, and show that the admission controls yield bounded staleness with high probability under queue-prediction error. Real-world cross-facility deployment of FedQueue shows 20.5% improvement over baseline algorithms. Controlled queue simulations demonstrate robust improvement over the baselines; in particular, up to 60% reduction in time to reach a target accuracy level under high queue variance and non-IID partitions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FedQueue，一种面向跨HPC设施联邦学习的队列感知协议。通过在线预测每设施的队列延迟来预算本地工作量，应用基于截断的接纳控制以限制陈旧性，并进行陈旧性感知聚合。在非凸目标下证明了收敛率为O(1/√R)。实际跨设施部署显示比基线提高20.5%，高队列方差和非IID分区下达到目标精度的时间减少60%。
Motivation: 跨多个HPC设施的联邦学习面临批调度器带来的随机接纳延迟，同步FL受严重落后节点影响，异步FL在队列高峰时积累陈旧更新。
Method: FedQueue协议：在线预测每设施队列延迟以预算本地工作量；基于截断的接纳控制缓冲迟到者以限制陈旧性；陈旧性感知聚合稳定异构本地工作负载。
Result: 实际跨设施部署显示比基线提高20.5%；模拟显示在高队列方差和非IID分区下，达到目标精度的时间减少高达60%。收敛率证明为O(1/√R)。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将调度器延迟直接纳入训练和聚合可以显著提升跨设施联邦学习的效率，且接纳控制在高概率下保证有界陈旧性。

papers.title: Self-Captioning Multimodal Interaction Tuning: Amplifying Exploitable Redundancies for Robust Vision Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Current vision language models face hallucination and robustness issues against ambiguous or corrupted modalities. We hypothesize that these issues can be addressed by exploiting the shared information between modalities to compensate for the impaired one. To this end, we analyze multimodal interactions -- redundant (shared), unique (exclusive), and synergistic (emergent) task-relevant information provided by the modalities -- to determine their impacts on model reliability. Specifically, amplifying redundant interactions would increase this exploitable shared information to resolve these issues; yet, modern instruction datasets often eliminate redundancies to prioritize visual grounding. We bridge this gap through a self-captioning workflow featuring a \textsc{Multimodal Interaction Gate}: a mechanism to convert unique interactions into redundant interactions. Our findings suggest that increasing redundancy can reduce visual induced errors by 38.3\% and improve consistency by 16.8\%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉语言模型在模态模糊或损坏时的幻觉与鲁棒性问题，提出一种自配文多模态交互微调方法，通过多模态交互门（Multimodal Interaction Gate）将独特交互转换为冗余交互，放大共享信息以补偿受损模态。实验表明，该方法可减少38.3%的视觉引发错误，并提升16.8%的一致性。
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在模态受损时容易出现幻觉和鲁棒性不足，而当前指令数据集倾向于消除冗余以强化视觉定位，限制了利用模态间共享信息来补偿受损模态的能力。
Method: 提出自配文工作流，核心是Multimodal Interaction Gate，该机制将模态间的独特交互信息转化为冗余交互，从而增加可用的共享信息，提升模型对模糊或损坏模态的鲁棒性。
Result: 该方法在实验中减少了38.3%的视觉引发错误，并将模型输出的一致性提高了16.8%。
Conclusion: 增加冗余交互是提升视觉语言模型对受损模态鲁棒性的有效策略，本文通过交互门机制实现了这一目标，为多模态鲁棒性微调提供了新思路。

papers.title: Polaris: Coupled Orbital Polar Embeddings for Hierarchical Concept Learning
papers.abstract_en: Real-world knowledge is often organized as hierarchies such as product taxonomies, medical ontologies, and label trees, yet learning hierarchical representations is challenging due to asymmetric structure and noisy semantics. We introduce Polaris, a polar hyperspherical embedding framework that separates semanticity from hierarchy using angular geometry and radius, enabling the learning of meaning and structure without interference. To map latent representation onto the sphere, we project it to the tangent space at the north pole, apply the exponential map, and learn unit-norm representations using spherical linear layers. Polaris then combines robust local constraints, global regularization that prevents geometric collapse, and uncertainty-aware asymmetric objectives that encourage directional containment. At inference time, Polaris uses structure-guided retrieval to efficiently narrow down candidate parents before final ranking. We evaluate Polaris on different settings of taxonomy expansion - spanning trees, multi-parent DAGs, and multimodal hierarchies, showing consistent improvements of up to ~19 points in top-K retrieval and up to ~60% reduction in mean rank over fourteen strong baselines.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Polaris 是一种极超球面嵌入框架，将语义性和层次性解耦到角度和半径上，用于学习层次化概念表示。它通过指数映射和球面线性层学习单位范数表示，结合局部约束、全局正则化和不确定性感知的对称目标，并在推理时使用结构引导检索。在树、多父DAG和多模态层次结构等分类扩展任务上，Polaris相比14个强基线在top-K检索上提升高达19个点，平均排名降低约60%。
Motivation: 现实世界知识常组织为层次结构（如产品分类、医学本体），但现有表示学习方法难以处理层次结构的不对称性和语义噪声。
Method: Polaris 框架将潜在表示投影到北极点的切空间，通过指数映射映射到超球面，并用球面线性层学习单位范数表示。它结合鲁棒的局部约束、防止几何坍缩的全局正则化以及不确定性感知的非对称目标（鼓励方向包含关系）。推理时使用结构引导检索缩小候选父节点范围。
Result: 在分类扩展任务（树、多父DAG、多模态层次结构）上，Polaris在top-K检索上提升高达19个点，平均排名降低约60%，优于14个强基线。
Conclusion: Polaris 通过解耦语义和层次结构，有效学习了层次化概念表示，并在多种层次结构扩展任务中取得显著提升。

papers.title: Cost-Aware Learning
papers.abstract_en: We consider the problem of Cost-Aware Learning, where sampling different components of a finite-sum objective incurs different costs. The objective is to reach a target error while minimizing the total cost. We propose Cost-Aware SGD, which uses a distribution based on gradient norms and costs to sample components. We provide a thorough analysis of this algorithm, including cost-improvement bounds over baselines, a characterization of distribution proxy sub-optimality, and a lower bound. We apply our theoretical insights to reinforcement learning with language models, where the computational cost of sequence-level policy gradients varies with length. We find that the advantage magnitude serves as a high-fidelity proxy for gradient norms, and use this to introduce Cost-Aware GRPO. Empirical results on 1.5B, 4B, and 8B LLMs demonstrate that this algorithm significantly reduces the tokens used in policy optimization while matching or exceeding baseline accuracy.

papers.title: Robust Lightweight Crack Classification for Real-Time UAV Bridge Inspection
papers.abstract_en: With the widespread application of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) in bridge structural health monitoring, deep learning-based automatic crack detection has become a major research focus. However, practical UAV inspections still face four key challenges: weak crack features, degraded imaging conditions, severe class imbalance, and limited computational resources for practical UAV inspection workflows. To address these issues, this paper proposes a unified lightweight convolutional neural network framework composed of four synergistic components: a lightweight backbone network, a Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) for channel and spatial enhancement, a directed robust augmentation strategy based on inspection-scene priors, and Focal Loss for hard-sample learning under class imbalance. Experiments on the SDNET2018 bridge deck dataset show that the proposed method achieves an inference speed of 825 FPS with only 11.21M parameters and 1.82G FLOPs. Compared with the baseline model, the complete framework improves the F1-score by 2.51% and recall by 3.95%. In addition, Grad-CAM visualizations indicate that the introduced attention module shifts the model's focus from scattered regions to precise tracking along crack trajectories. Overall, this study achieves a strong balance among accuracy, speed, and robustness, providing a practical solution for ground-station assisted real-time deployment in UAV bridge inspections. The source code is available at: https://github.com/skylynf/AttXNet .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无人机桥梁实时巡检中裂缝检测面临的特征弱、成像退化、类别不平衡和计算资源有限四个挑战，提出一个统一的轻量级CNN框架，包含轻量骨干网络、CBAM注意力模块、基于场景先验的定向鲁棒增强策略和Focal Loss。在SDNET2018桥面数据集上，该模型以11.21M参数和1.82G FLOPs达到825 FPS推理速度，相比基线F1提升2.51%、召回率提升3.95%。Grad-CAM可视化表明注意力模块使模型聚焦于裂缝轨迹。
Motivation: 实际无人机桥梁巡检中，基于深度学习的裂缝检测面临弱裂缝特征、成像退化、严重类别不平衡以及计算资源有限等关键挑战，现有方法难以兼顾精度、速度和鲁棒性。
Method: 提出一个统一轻量级CNN框架，由四个协同组件构成：轻量骨干网络、通道与空间增强的CBAM注意力模块、基于检测场景先验的定向鲁棒增强策略，以及用于难样本学习的Focal Loss。
Result: 在SDNET2018数据集上，模型仅11.21M参数和1.82G FLOPs即达到825 FPS推理速度；与基线相比，F1-score提升2.51%，召回率提升3.95%。
Conclusion: 该方法在精度、速度和鲁棒性之间取得强平衡，适用于地面站辅助的无人机桥梁实时巡检部署，且代码已开源。

papers.title: GEM: Geometric Entropy Mixing for Optimal LLM Data Curation
papers.abstract_en: LLM pre-training efficacy increasingly depends on data composition rather than sheer volume. Yet, optimal mixing is hindered by categorization flaws: human taxonomies suffer from ontological misalignment, and Euclidean clustering fails to address embedding anisotropy. We introduce GEM (Geometric Entropy Mixing), a framework reformulating data curation as a variational problem on the hypersphere augmented with a mixing-balance regularizer. By decoupling the generative prior and optimizing the objective via a provable MM (Minorize-Maximize) algorithm, GEM effectively counteracts the cluster collapse to discover balanced semantic structures invisible to Euclidean heuristics. We employ teacher-student distillation to scale this geometric fidelity to web-scale corpora and introduce the Geometric Influence Score (GIS) for interpretable taxonomy generation. Experiments with 1.1B-parameter models demonstrate that GEM establishes a new state-of-the-art when integrated into mixing strategies like DoReMi and RegMix, improving average downstream accuracy by up to 1.2% and offering a robust coordinate system for predictable data mixing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GEM（几何熵混合）框架，将 LLM 预训练数据筛选重新表述为超球面上的变分问题，通过 MM 算法优化混合平衡正则化，并引入几何影响分数（GIS）实现可解释的 taxonomies。在 1.1B 参数模型上，该方法与现有混合策略（如 DoReMi、RegMix）结合后，平均下游准确率提升最高达 1.2%。
Motivation: 现有数据筛选方法受限于人类分类的本体论偏差和欧几里得聚类无法处理嵌入各向异性的问题，导致数据组成次优。
Method: GEM 框架通过将数据筛选视为超球面上的变分问题，加入混合平衡正则化，利用 Minorize-Maximize（MM）算法优化目标，并通过教师-学生蒸馏扩展到大规模语料库，同时引入几何影响分数（GIS）用于可解释的 taxonomy 生成。
Result: 在 1.1B 参数模型上，GEM 与 DoReMi 和 RegMix 等混合策略结合后，平均下游准确率提升高达 1.2%，并提供了鲁棒的坐标系统用于可预测的数据混合。
Conclusion: GEM 建立了新的数据筛选 SOTA，并提供了几何驱动的平衡语义结构发现方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: BoxLitE: A Faithful Knowledge Base Embedding Based on Convex Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge base (KB) embeddings aim at combining the capability of classical knowledge graph embeddings to generalize the information present in facts, the ABox, with conceptual knowledge represented in an ontology language, the TBox. Several authors have recently explored the idea of mapping concepts to convex regions in a vector space. This is useful to represent hierarchies, typically present in TBoxes, since more general concepts can be mapped to larger regions, containing those regions associated with more specific concepts. However, the power of convexity is rarely leveraged during the actual learning tasks. Here, we introduce BoxLitE, a KB embedding model for DL-Lite$^{\mathcal{H}}$ that allows for convex optimization. We show that for any satisfiable DL-Lite$^{\mathcal{H}}$ KB, there is a BoxLitE embedding that is a weakly faithful model. As a proof of concept, we show how to formulate the KB embedding task as a convex optimization problem and how to obtain embeddings with such desirable faithfulness properties.
papers.comment: 28 pages. Full version of paper accepted to KR 2026 (23nd International Conference on Principles of Knowledge Representation and Reasoning). Track: KR meets Machine Learning and Explanation. Added a figure and some minor changes
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BoxLitE，一种基于凸优化的知识库嵌入模型，用于DL-Lite^H。该模型将概念映射到向量空间中的凸区域，并证明对于任何可满足的DL-Lite^H知识库，存在一个弱忠实嵌入。作为概念验证，展示了如何将知识库嵌入任务形式化为凸优化问题，并获得具有理想忠实性属性的嵌入。
Motivation: 现有知识库嵌入方法虽然利用凸区域表示概念层次，但很少在训练中充分利用凸性的优势，且缺乏忠实性保证。
Method: 提出BoxLitE模型，将概念映射到凸区域，并证明对于可满足的DL-Lite^H知识库存在弱忠实嵌入；通过公式化为凸优化问题来学习嵌入。
Result: 理论上证明了对于任何可满足的DL-Lite^H知识库，BoxLitE能生成弱忠实嵌入。
Conclusion: 该工作表明凸优化可用于知识库嵌入并保证忠实性，为结合本体推理与嵌入学习提供了新方向。

papers.title: Progress in Formalizing Sphere Packing in Dimension 8
papers.abstract_en: In 2016, Viazovska famously solved the sphere packing problem in dimension $8$, using modular forms to construct a 'magic' function satisfying optimality conditions determined by Cohn and Elkies in 2003. In March 2024, Hariharan and Viazovska launched a project to formalize this solution and related mathematical facts in the Lean Theorem Prover. A significant milestone was achieved in February 2026: the result was formally verified, with the final stages of the verification done by Math, Inc.'s autoformalization model 'Gauss'. We discuss the techniques used to achieve this milestone, reflect on the unique collaboration between humans and Gauss, and discuss project objectives that remain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告了使用Lean定理证明器形式化验证8维球体填充问题的里程碑进展。2016年Viazovska通过模函数构造了“魔法”函数解决了该问题，2024年发起的项目在2026年2月由人类与Math, Inc.的自动形式化模型Gauss协作完成最终验证。论文讨论了所用技术、人机协作经验及剩余目标。
Motivation: 形式化验证高维球体填充这一经典数学结果，以确保其逻辑完全严格，并探索自动化定理证明工具在复杂数学证明中的应用。
Method: 基于Lean定理证明器，结合人类编写的形式化代码和Math, Inc.'s Gauss模型的自动形式化能力，对Viazovska的证明进行分阶段形式化。
Result: 截至2026年2月，8维球体填充问题的形式化验证已完整完成，Gauss模型参与了最终阶段的验证工作。
Conclusion: 该项目展示了人类与自动形式化模型协作解决重大数学问题的可行性，但仍有其它相关目标有待完成。

papers.title: Inference of Online Newton Methods with Nesterov's Accelerated Sketching
papers.abstract_en: Reliable decision-making with streaming data requires principled uncertainty quantification of online methods. While first-order methods enable efficient iterate updates, their inference procedures still require updating proper (covariance) matrices, incurring $O(d^2)$ time and memory complexity, and are sensitive to ill-conditioning and noise heterogeneity of the problem. This costly inference task offers an opportunity for more robust second-order methods, which are, however, bottlenecked by solving Newton systems with $O(d^3)$ complexity. In this paper, we address this gap by studying an online Newton method with Hessian averaging, where the Newton direction at each step is approximately computed using a sketch-and-project solver with Nesterov's acceleration, matching $O(d^2)$ complexity of first-order methods. For the proposed method, we quantify its uncertainty arising from both random data and randomized computation. Under standard smoothness and moment conditions, we establish global almost-sure convergence, prove asymptotic normality of the last iterate with a limiting covariance characterized by a Lyapunov equation, and develop a fully online covariance estimator with non-asymptotic convergence guarantees. We also connect the resulting uncertainty quantification to that of exact and sketched Newton methods without Nesterov's acceleration. Extensive experiments on regression models demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method for online inference.
papers.comment: 52 pages, 2 tables, 3 figures; accepted at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在线牛顿方法在流式数据中的不确定性量化问题，提出一种结合Nesterov加速的草图投影求解器来近似牛顿方向，将复杂性降至O(d^2)并建立渐近正态性与在线协方差估计器，实验证明其在回归模型上的有效性。
Motivation: 在线一阶方法的推断需要更新协方差矩阵，复杂度O(d^2)且对病态和异质噪声敏感；二阶方法虽稳健但求解牛顿系统需O(d^3)复杂度。本文旨在降低二阶在线牛顿方法的推断成本，同时保持不确定性量化能力。
Method: 提出在线牛顿方法，每一步使用Nesterov加速的草图投影求解器近似牛顿方向，复杂度匹配一阶方法的O(d^2)；并设计完全在线的协方差估计器，具有非渐近收敛保证。
Result: 建立了迭代的全局几乎必然收敛性和渐近正态性，极限协方差由Lyapunov方程刻画；在线协方差估计器有非渐近收敛保证；回归实验表明该方法在在线推断中的优越性。
Conclusion: 本文为在线二阶方法提供了实用的推断框架，在保证效率的同时实现了可靠的不确定性量化，可推广至其他随机优化问题。

papers.title: Aligning Dense Retrievers with LLM Utility via Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Dense vector retrieval is the practical backbone of Retrieval- Augmented Generation (RAG), but similarity search can suffer from precision limitations. Conversely, utility-based approaches leveraging LLM re-ranking often achieve superior performance but are computationally prohibitive and prone to noise inherent in perplexity estimation. We propose Utility-Aligned Embeddings (UAE), a framework designed to merge these advantages into a practical, high-performance retrieval method. We formulate retrieval as a distribution matching problem, training a bi-encoder to imitate a utility distribution derived from perplexity reduction using a Utility-Modulated InfoNCE objective. This approach injects graded utility signals directly into the embedding space without requiring test-time LLM inference. On the QASPER benchmark, UAE improves retrieval Recall@1 by 30.59%, MAP by 30.16% and Token F1 by 17.3% over the strong semantic baseline BGE-Base. Crucially, UAE is over 180x faster than the efficient LLM re-ranking methods preserving competitive performance, demonstrating that aligning retrieval with generative utility yields reliable contexts at scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Utility-Aligned Embeddings (UAE)框架，通过蒸馏LLM的效用信号来训练密集检索器，使嵌入空间与生成式效用对齐，而无需测试时LLM推理。在QASPER基准上，UAE在Recall@1、MAP和Token F1上分别提升30.59%、30.16%和17.3%，且比LLM重排序方法快180倍以上。

Method: 将检索建模为分布匹配问题，通过效用调制InfoNCE目标训练双编码器，使其模仿基于困惑度缩减的效用分布，从而将分级效用信号注入嵌入空间。

Conclusion: 将检索与生成式效用对齐能够可靠地提供大规模上下文，同时保持竞争力性能。

papers.title: SpaMEM: Benchmarking Dynamic Spatial Reasoning via Perception-Memory Integration in Embodied Environments
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have advanced static visual--spatial reasoning, yet they often fail to preserve long-horizon spatial coherence in embodied settings where beliefs must be continuously revised from egocentric observations under environmental change. We introduce SpaMEM (Spatial Memory from Action Sequences), a large-scale diagnostic benchmark that isolates the mechanics of spatial belief evolution via action-conditioned scene transformations (spawn, place, remove) over long interaction horizons. SpaMEM is built on a physically grounded dataset with 10,601,392 high-fidelity images across four modalities (RGB, depth, instance, semantic segmentation), collected from 25,000+ interaction sequences in 1,000 procedurally generated houses. We formalize embodied spatial reasoning as a three-level hierarchy with 15 diagnostic tasks: Level 1 measures atomic spatial perception from single observations; Level 2 probes temporal reasoning with oracle textual state histories to factor out perceptual noise; and Level 3 requires end-to-end belief maintenance from raw visual streams under the same task dimensions. We further evaluate both short-term (step-wise) updates and long-term (episodic) reconstruction. Benchmarking representative open-source VLM families reveals a consistent stacked bottleneck: coordinate-consistent grounding remains a hard ceiling, and the sharp collapse from Level 2 to Level 3 exposes a pronounced symbolic scaffolding dependency, where models succeed with text-based bookkeeping but struggle to sustain robust visual memory. SpaMEM provides a granular diagnostic standard and motivates explicit mechanisms for state representation, belief revision, and long-horizon episodic integration. A subset of SpaMEM is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/mill-ct-liao/SpaMEM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SpaMEM（Spatial Memory from Action Sequences），一个大规模诊断基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在具身环境中通过动作条件场景变换（生成、放置、移除）进行空间信念演化的能力。基准包含四个模态的1060万张高保真图像，涵盖三个层次15个诊断任务：原子空间感知、带文本状态历史的时序推理、从原始视觉流端到端信念维护。评测发现代表性开源VLM存在一致的瓶颈：坐标一致性基础困难，从带文本辅助的Level 2到纯视觉的Level 3性能急剧下降，表明模型依赖符号脚手架而缺乏鲁棒视觉记忆。
Motivation: 现有MLLM在静态视觉-空间推理上有所进展，但在具身环境中需要从自我中心观察持续更新信念时，往往无法保持长程空间一致性。缺乏诊断这种信念演化机制的细粒度基准。
Method: SpaMEM基于1000个程序化生成的房屋中25000+交互序列，构建包含RGB、深度、实例和语义分割四个模态的1060万张图像数据集，并形式化具身空间推理为三个层次15个诊断任务，分别测试原子感知、带文本历史的时间推理和端到端视觉信念维护。
Result: 在代表性开源VLM上的评测揭示一致的堆叠瓶颈：坐标一致性基础是硬天花板；从Level 2到Level 3的急剧性能下降暴露了符号支架依赖，模型在文本辅助下表现良好，但在纯视觉记忆上困难。
Conclusion: SpaMEM提供了细粒度诊断标准，并激发对状态表示、信念修正和长程情节整合的显式机制研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MAPRPose: Mask-Aware Proposal and Amodal Refinement for Multi-Object 6D Pose Estimation
papers.abstract_en: 6D object pose estimation in cluttered scenes remains challenging due to severe occlusion and sensor noise. We propose MAPRPose, a two-stage framework that leverages mask-aware correspondences for pose proposal and amodal-driven Region-of-Interest (ROI) prediction for robust refinement. In the Mask-Aware Pose Proposal (MAPP) stage, we lift 2D correspondences into 3D space to establish reliable keypoint matches and generate geometrically consistent pose hypotheses based on correspondence-level scoring, from which the top-$K$ candidates are selected. In the refinement stage, we introduce a tensorized render-and-compare pipeline integrated with an Amodal Mask Prediction and ROI Re-Alignment (AMPR) module. By reconstructing complete object geometry and dynamically adjusting the ROI, AMPR mitigates localization errors and spatial misalignment under heavy occlusion. Furthermore, our GPU-accelerated RGB-XYZ reprojection enables simultaneous refinement of all $N \times B$ pose hypotheses in a single forward pass. Evaluated on the BOP benchmark, MAPRPose achieves a state-of-the-art Average Recall (AR) of 76.5%, outperforming FoundationPose by 3.1% AR while delivering a 43x speedup in multi-object inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MAPRPose，一个两阶段的多物体 6D 姿态估计框架，通过掩膜感知对应（mask-aware correspondences）生成姿态假设，并利用非模态驱动（amodal-driven）的 ROI 预测进行鲁棒优化。在 BOP 基准上，MAPRPose 的平均召回率（AR）达到 76.5%，比 FoundationPose 高 3.1%，且多物体推理速度提升 43 倍。
Motivation: 复杂场景中严重遮挡和传感器噪声导致 6D 物体姿态估计困难，现有方法在遮挡下性能不足且多物体推理效率低下。
Method: 两阶段框架：第一步 Mask-Aware Pose Proposal (MAPP) 将 2D 对应提升到 3D 空间，建立可靠关键点匹配并基于对应评分生成几何一致的姿态假设，选择 Top-K 候选；第二步引入张量化渲染-比较（render-and-compare）管线，集成非模态掩膜预测与 ROI 重对齐（AMPR）模块，通过重建完整物体几何并动态调整 ROI 减轻遮挡下的定位误差和空间错位，同时使用 GPU 加速的 RGB-XYZ 重投影在单次前向中同时优化所有 N×B 个姿态假设。
Result: 在 BOP 基准上，MAPRPose 的平均召回率（AR）为 76.5%，比 FoundationPose 高 3.1%，多物体推理速度提升 43 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要强调了掩膜感知对应与非模态 ROI 优化的有效性，以及 GPU 加速的并行优化带来的显著速度优势。

papers.title: Conditional Attribution for Root Cause Analysis in Time-Series Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Root cause analysis (RCA) for time-series anomaly detection is critical for the reliable operation of complex real-world systems. Existing explanation methods often rely on unrealistic feature perturbations and ignore temporal and cross-feature dependencies, leading to unreliable attributions. We propose a conditional attribution framework that explains anomalies relative to contextually similar normal system states. Instead of using marginal or randomly sampled baselines, our method retrieves representative normal instances conditioned on the anomalous observation, enabling dependency-preserving and operationally meaningful explanations. To support high-dimensional time-series data, contextual retrieval is performed in learned low-dimensional representations using both variational autoencoder latent spaces and UMAP manifold embeddings. By grounding the retrieval process in the system's learned manifold, this strategy avoids out-of-distribution artifacts and ensures attribution fidelity while maintaining computational efficiency. We further introduce confidence-aware and temporal evaluation metrics for assessing explanation reliability and responsiveness. Experiments on the SWaT and MSDS benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed approach consistently improves root-cause identification accuracy, temporal localization, and robustness across multiple anomaly detection models. These results highlight the practical utility of conditional attribution for explainable anomaly diagnosis in complex time-series systems. Code and models will be publicly released.

papers.title: SVL: Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning as Survival Learning
papers.abstract_en: Standard approaches to goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL) that rely on temporal-difference learning can be unstable and sample-inefficient due to bootstrapping. While recent work has explored contrastive and supervised formulations to improve stability, we present a probabilistic alternative, called survival value learning (SVL), that reframes GCRL as a survival learning problem by modeling the time-to-goal from each state as a probability distribution. This structured distributional Monte Carlo perspective yields a closed-form identity that expresses the goal-conditioned value function as a discounted sum of survival probabilities, enabling value estimation via a hazard model trained via maximum likelihood on both event and right-censored trajectories. We introduce three practical value estimators, including finite-horizon truncation and two binned infinite-horizon approximations to capture long-horizon objectives. Experiments on offline GCRL benchmarks show that SVL combined with hierarchical actors matches or surpasses strong hierarchical TD and Monte Carlo baselines, excelling on complex, long-horizon tasks. Webpage and Code: https://simple-robotics.github.io/publications/survival-value-learning/
papers.comment: Accepted to the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning, Seoul, South Korea
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将目标条件强化学习（GCRL）重新表述为生存学习问题，提出生存价值学习（SVL），通过将每个状态到目标的时间建模为概率分布，推导出目标条件价值函数为生存概率的折扣和，并采用风险模型通过最大似然估计训练。设计了三种实用价值估计器：有限视界截断和两种分箱无限视界近似。离线GCRL基准实验表明，SVL结合分层actor匹配或超越强分层TD和蒙特卡洛基线，在复杂长视界任务上表现优异。
Motivation: 标准GCRL方法基于时序差分学习，因自举而不稳定且样本效率低；现有对比学习和监督公式虽改善稳定性，但本文探索另一种概率替代方案。
Method: 提出SVL框架，将GCRL重构为生存学习，对每个状态到目标的时间建模为分布，得到价值函数为生存概率的折扣和；通过风险模型的最大似然估计训练，并提出有限视界截断和两种分箱无限视界近似作为实用估计器。
Result: 离线GCRL基准上，SVL结合分层actor匹配或超越强分层TD和蒙特卡洛基线，在复杂长视界任务上表现优异。
Conclusion: 概率视角避免了自举不稳定性，提供了结构化分布估计；代码已开源。

papers.title: ClimAgent: LLM as Agents for Autonomous Open-ended Climate Science Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Climate research is pivotal for mitigating global environmental crises, yet the accelerating volume of multi-scale datasets and the complexity of analytical tools have created significant bottlenecks, constraining scientific discovery to fragmented and labor-intensive workflows. While the emergence Large Language Models (LLMs) offers a transformative paradigm to scale scientific expertise, existing explorations remain largely confined to simple Question-Answering (Q&A) tasks. These approaches often oversimplify real-world challenges, neglecting the intricate physical constraints and the data-driven nature required in professional climate science.To bridge this gap, we introduce ClimAgent, a general-purpose autonomous framework designed to execute a wide spectrum of research tasks across diverse climate sub-fields. By integrating a unified tool-use environment with rigorous reasoning protocols, ClimAgent transcends simple retrieval to perform end-to-end modeling and analysis. To foster systematic evaluation, we propose ClimaBench, the first comprehensive benchmark for real-world climate discovery. It encompasses challenging problems spanning 5 distinct task categories derived from professional scenarios between 2000 and 2025. Experiments on ClimaBench demonstrate that ClimAgent significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving a 40.21% improvement over original LLM solutions in solution rigorousness and practicality. Our code are available at https://github.com/usail-hkust/ClimAgent.
papers.comment: It was submitted without the full consent of all co-authors
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 现有气候研究因数据规模大、工具复杂而瓶颈明显，LLM应用多局限于简单问答，忽略物理约束和数据驱动本质。
Method: 提出ClimAgent通用自主框架，通过集成统一工具使用环境和严谨推理协议，实现端到端建模与分析。
Result: 在ClimaBench基准上，ClimAgent相比原始LLM方案在解决方案严谨性和实用性上提升40.21%。

papers.title: Learning to Reason with Insight for Informal Theorem Proving
papers.abstract_en: Although most of the automated theorem-proving approaches depend on formal proof systems, informal theorem proving can align better with large language models' (LLMs) strength in natural language processing. In this work, we identify a primary bottleneck in informal theorem proving as a lack of insight, namely the difficulty of recognizing the core techniques required to solve complex problems. To address this, we propose $\texttt{DeepInsight}$, a unified training framework designed to cultivate this essential reasoning skill and enable LLMs to perform insightful reasoning. Our framework consists of three components: (1) $\texttt{DeepInsightTheorem}$, a hierarchical dataset that structures informal proofs by explicitly extracting core techniques and proof sketches alongside the final proof; (2) a Progressive Multi-Stage SFT strategy that mimics the human learning process, teaching the model proof writing, planning, and insight identification; and (3) $\texttt{InsightPO}$, a policy optimization method that assigns structured rewards over this insight hierarchy. Our experiments on challenging mathematical benchmarks demonstrate that this insight-aware generation strategy significantly outperforms baselines. These results demonstrate that teaching models to identify and apply core techniques can substantially improve their mathematical reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对非形式定理证明中缺乏洞察（insight）这一主要瓶颈，提出统一的训练框架DeepInsight，包括层级数据集DeepInsightTheorem、渐进式多阶段监督微调（SFT）策略以及基于洞察的强化学习优化方法InsightPO。实验表明，该洞察感知生成策略在挑战性数学基准上显著优于基线，证明教会模型识别和应用核心技术能大幅提升数学推理能力。
Motivation: 非形式定理证明的主要瓶颈是缺乏洞察，即难以识别解决复杂问题所需的核心技术，这限制了LLM在该任务上的表现。
Method: 提出DeepInsight框架，包含三个组件：(1) 层级数据集DeepInsightTheorem，显式提取核心技术与证明草图；(2) 渐进式多阶段SFT策略，模拟人类学习过程，依次训练证明写作、规划和洞察识别；(3) InsightPO策略优化方法，在洞察层级上分配结构化奖励。
Result: 在挑战性数学基准上的实验表明，该洞察感知生成策略显著优于基线方法。
Conclusion: 教会模型识别和运用核心技术能够大幅提升其数学推理能力，为改进非形式定理证明提供了新的方向。
