papers.title: Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization via Adaptive \varepsilon-Constraints Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Multi-objective Bayesian optimization (MOBO) provides a principled framework for optimizing multiple expensive black-box functions. However, existing MOBO methods often struggle with coverage, scalability, and handling constraints and preferences. In this work we propose STAGE-BO, Sequential Targeting Adaptive Gap-Filling $\varepsilon$-Constraint Bayesian Optimization: by analyzing the coverage of the surrogate Pareto front, our method identifies the Pareto front point with the largest uncovered gap, and uses its coordinates to define adaptive constraints in $\varepsilon$-constraint method, which transforms the problem into a sequence of inequality-constrained subproblems, efficiently solved via constrained expected improvement acquisition. Our approach provides uniform Pareto coverage without hypervolume computation and naturally handles constraints and preferences. Experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks demonstrate superior coverage and competitive hypervolume performance against state-of-the-art baselines. Our code implementation can be found at https://github.com/YangYaohong1/STAGE-BO.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 22 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at the Forty-Third International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种基于自适应ε约束分解的多目标贝叶斯优化方法STAGE-BO。该方法通过分析代理Pareto前沿的覆盖，识别最大未覆盖间隙并据此定义自适应约束，将多目标优化转化为序列不等式约束子问题，使用受约束的期望改进（CEI）采集函数高效求解。实验表明，STAGE-BO在合成和真实基准上实现了均匀的Pareto覆盖，并取得有竞争力的超体积（hypervolume）性能。
Motivation: 现有MOBO方法在覆盖性、可扩展性以及处理约束和偏好方面存在不足。
Method: STAGE-BO通过分析代理Pareto前沿的覆盖情况，找到具有最大未覆盖间隙的Pareto前沿点，以其坐标为基准定义自适应ε约束，将多目标优化问题分解为一系列不等式约束子问题，并利用受约束的期望改进（CEI）采集函数高效求解每个子问题。
Result: 在合成和真实世界基准测试中，STAGE-BO相比当前最先进基线展现出更优的Pareto覆盖性能，且取得了具有竞争力的超体积结果。
Conclusion: STAGE-BO无需超体积计算即可实现均匀的Pareto前沿覆盖，并能够自然地处理约束和偏好。代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EEG-Based Multimodal Learning via Hyperbolic Mixture-of-Curvature Experts
papers.abstract_en: Electroencephalography (EEG)-based multimodal learning integrates brain signals with complementary modalities to improve mental state assessment, providing great clinical potential. The effectiveness of such paradigms largely depends on the representation learning on heterogeneous modalities. For EEG-based paradigms, one promising approach is to leverage their hierarchical structures, as recent studies have shown that both EEG and associated modalities (e.g., facial expressions) exhibit hierarchical structures reflecting complex cognitive processes. However, Euclidean embeddings struggle to represent these hierarchical structures due to their flat geometry, while hyperbolic spaces, with their exponential growth property, are naturally suited for them. In this work, we propose EEG-MoCE, a novel hyperbolic mixture-of-curvature experts framework designed for multimodal neurotechnology. EEG-MoCE assigns each modality to an expert in a learnable-curvature hyperbolic space, enabling adaptive modeling of its intrinsic geometry. A curvature-aware fusion strategy then dynamically weights experts, emphasizing modalities with richer hierarchical information. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that EEG-MoCE achieves state-of-the-art performance, including emotion recognition, sleep staging, and cognitive assessment. Code is available at https://github.com/zhourunhe/EEG-MoCE.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Forty-third International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EEG-MoCE，一种基于双曲空间的混合曲率专家框架，用于脑电图（EEG）多模态学习。该方法为每种模态分配一个可学习曲率的双曲空间专家，并通过曲率感知融合策略自适应加权，以捕捉多模态数据中的层次结构。在情感识别、睡眠分期和认知评估等基准数据集上达到最优性能。
Motivation: EEG 多模态学习中异质模态的表示学习是关键，但欧几里得嵌入难以表征 EEG 及相关模态（如面部表情）的层次结构，而双曲空间因其指数增长特性天然适合层次结构建模。
Method: 提出 EEG-MoCE 框架，为每个模态分配一个在可学习曲率双曲空间中的专家，并采用曲率感知融合策略动态加权专家，以强调层次信息更丰富的模态。
Result: 在情感识别、睡眠分期和认知评估等基准数据集上，EEG-MoCE 达到最先进性能。
Conclusion: 双曲空间中的可学习曲率专家能够有效适应多模态 EEG 数据的几何结构，提升表示学习效果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Symmetry Reveals Layerwise Dynamics: How Transformers Perform In-Context Classification
papers.abstract_en: Transformers can perform in-context classification from a few labeled examples, yet the inference-time algorithm remains opaque. We study multi-class linear classification in the hard no-margin regime and make the computation identifiable by enforcing feature- and label-permutation equivariance at every layer. This enables interpretability while maintaining functional equivalence and yields highly structured weights. From these models we extract an explicit depth-indexed recursion: an end-to-end identified, emergent update rule inside a softmax transformer, to our knowledge the first of its kind. Attention matrices formed from mixed feature-label Gram structure drive coupled updates of training points, labels, and the test probe. The resulting dynamics implement a geometry-driven algorithmic motif, which can provably amplify class separation and yields robust expected class alignment.
papers.comment: appears in the Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML '26)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过在硬无间隔（hard no-margin regime）下强制特征和标签排列等变性（equivariance），使Transformer进行上下文分类时的计算过程可识别，从中提取出首个端到端可识别的深度索引递归更新规则。该规则利用混合特征-标签Gram结构的注意力矩阵，驱动训练点、标签和测试探针的耦合更新，实现几何驱动的类别分离放大和鲁棒的类别对齐。
Motivation: Transformer能够从少量标注样本中进行上下文分类，但其推理算法不透明，缺乏可解释性。
Method: 在硬无间隔场景下，强制每层特征和标签排列等变性，保持功能等价的同时实现可解释性，从而得到高度结构化的权重，并提取显式的深度索引递归更新规则。
Result: 提取了端到端可识别的涌现更新规则，注意力矩阵由混合特征-标签Gram结构形成，驱动耦合更新，可证明放大类间分离并实现鲁棒的预期类别对齐。
Conclusion: 揭示了Transformer内部基于几何驱动的算法模式，为理解上下文分类的层间动力学提供了理论解释。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: No Reader Left Behind: Multi-Agent Summaries Everyone Can Understand
papers.abstract_en: The Plain Writing Act in the United States requires government documents to be accessible in clear and simple language that the general public can easily understand, yet existing summarization systems struggle to address diverse linguistic and cognitive barriers among general readers. We present NRLB (No Reader Left Behind), a multi-agent framework for plain language summarization that simulates three representative reader groups: elementary school student readers, non-native readers, and readers with attention deficits. NRLB combines template-based planning with iterative, reader-oriented refinement, enabling systematic detection and resolution of difficult terms, missing contexts, and confusing sentences. Evaluations across multiple datasets demonstrate consistent improvements in readability while preserving factual accuracy. Human evaluation further validates NRLB's impact, with annotator preference rates ranging from 55% to 76%, highlighting NRLB's potential to produce plain language summaries that are both faithful to the source and broadly accessible to the general public.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出NRLB多智能体框架，模拟小学生、非母语读者和注意力缺陷读者三类群体，通过模板规划和迭代优化生成通俗易懂的摘要。在多个数据集上，该方法在保持事实准确性的同时一致提升了可读性，人工评估中标注者偏好率达55%-76%。
Motivation: 美国《简明写作法案》要求政府文件通俗易懂，但现有摘要系统难以适应普通读者多样的语言和认知障碍，缺乏针对不同读者群体的个性化处理。
Method: NRLB框架包含三个模拟读者智能体（小学生、非母语者、注意力缺陷者），结合模板式规划与面向读者的迭代优化，自动检测并修复难词、缺失语境和混乱句子。
Result: 在多个数据集上，NRLB在改善可读性的同时维持了事实准确性；人工评估中，标注者对NRLB摘要的偏好率在55%到76%之间。
Conclusion: NRLB能够生成既忠于原文又易于公众理解的平实语言摘要，具有广泛的实用性。

papers.title: Analytical Modeling and Correction of Distance Error in Homography-Based Ground-Plane Mapping
papers.abstract_en: Accurate distance estimation from monocular cameras is essential for intelligent monitoring systems. In many deployments, image coordinates are mapped to ground positions using planar homographies initialized by manual selection of corresponding regions. Small inaccuracies in this initialization propagate into systematic distance distortions. This paper derives an explicit relationship between homography perturbations and the resulting distance error, showing that the error grows approximately quadratically with the true distance from the camera. Based on this model, two simple correction strategies are evaluated: regression-based estimation of the quadratic error function and direct optimization of the homography via coordinate-based gradient descent. A large-scale simulation study with more than 19 million test samples demonstrates that regression achieves higher peak accuracy when the model is reliably fitted, whereas gradient descent provides greater robustness against poor initial calibration. This suggests that improving geometric calibration may yield greater performance gains than increasing model complexity in many practical systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从理论上推导了单目相机中基于单应性矩阵的地面映射距离误差与扰动的关系，发现误差随真实距离近似二次增长。基于此模型，评估了回归估计和坐标梯度下降两种校正策略，大规模仿真表明回归在模型拟合良好时精度更高，而梯度下降对不良初始标定更鲁棒。
Motivation: 单目相机距离估计中，平面单应性初始化的小误差会导致系统性距离失真，需要定量分析误差传播规律并设计简单有效的校正方法。
Method: 推导单应性扰动与距离误差的显式关系，提出基于二次误差函数的回归校正和基于坐标梯度下降的直接优化两种策略。
Result: 在超过1900万样本的大规模仿真中，回归方法在模型可靠拟合时达到更高峰值精度，梯度下降方法在初始标定较差时鲁棒性更强。
Conclusion: 改进几何标定可能比增加模型复杂度带来更大的性能提升，适用于实际监控系统。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在超过1900万样本的大规模仿真中，回归方法在模型可靠拟合时达到更高峰值精度，梯度下降方法在初始标定较差时鲁棒性更强。
summary_sections.conclusion: 改进几何标定可能比增加模型复杂度带来更大的性能提升，适用于实际监控系统。

papers.title: Dual-Exposure Imaging with Events
papers.abstract_en: By combining complementary benefits of short- and long-exposure images, Dual-Exposure Imaging (DEI) enhances image quality in low-light scenarios. However, existing DEI approaches inevitably suffer from producing artifacts due to spatial displacement from scene motion and image feature discrepancies from different exposure times. To tackle this problem, we propose a novel Event-based DEI (E-DEI) algorithm, which reconstructs high-quality images from dual-exposure image pairs and events, leveraging high temporal resolution of event cameras to provide accurate inter-/intra-frame dynamic information. Specifically, we decompose this complex task into an integration of two sub-tasks, i.e., event-based motion deblurring and low-light image enhancement tasks, which guides us to design E-DEI network as a dual-path parallel feature propagation architecture. We propose a Dual-path Feature Alignment and Fusion (DFAF) module to effectively align and fuse features extracted from dual-exposure images with assistance of events. Furthermore, we build a real-world Dataset containing Paired low-/normal-light Images and Events (PIED). Experiments on multiple datasets show the superiority of our method. The code and dataset are available at github.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于事件相机的双曝光成像算法 (E-DEI)，利用事件的高时间分辨率来对齐和融合短曝光与长曝光图像，从而减少动态场景下的伪影。该方法将任务分解为运动去模糊和低光增强两个子任务，并设计了双路径并行特征传播架构和双路径特征对齐融合模块 (DFAF)。在多个数据集上的实验证明了其有效性。
Motivation: 现有双曝光成像方法在场景运动或曝光时间差异下容易产生伪影，因为无法准确处理空间位移和特征差异。
Method: 提出 E-DEI 算法，将双曝光成像分解为事件基运动去模糊和低光增强两个子任务，设计双路径并行特征传播网络，其中的 DFAF 模块利用事件信息对齐和融合双曝光图像特征。并构建了真实世界的低光/正常光图像与事件配对数据集 PIED。
Result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，该方法在图像质量上优于现有双曝光成像方法，有效减少了伪影。
Conclusion: 事件相机的高时间分辨率信息可以有效改善双曝光成像在动态场景下的效果，所提出的分解策略和特征融合模块是有效的。

papers.title: Rays as Pixels: Learning A Joint Distribution of Videos and Camera Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: Recovering camera parameters from images and rendering scenes from novel viewpoints have been treated as separate tasks in computer vision and graphics. This separation breaks down when image coverage is sparse or poses are ambiguous, since each task depends on what the other produces. We propose Rays as Pixels, a Video Diffusion Model (VDM) that learns a joint distribution over videos and camera trajectories. To our knowledge, this is the first model to predict camera poses and do camera-controlled video generation within a single framework. We represent each camera as dense ray pixels (raxels), a pixel-aligned encoding that lives in the same latent space as video frames, and denoise the two jointly through a Decoupled Self-Cross Attention mechanism. A single trained model handles three tasks: predicting camera trajectories from video, generating video from input images along a pre-defined trajectory, and jointly synthesizing video and trajectory from input images. We evaluate on pose estimation and camera-controlled video generation, and introduce a closed-loop self-consistency test showing that the model's predicted poses and its renderings conditioned on those poses agree. Ablations against Plücker embeddings confirm that representing cameras in a shared latent space with video is subtantially more effective.
papers.comment: Accepted to ICML 2026. 9-page main paper plus supplementary material. Project page: https://wbjang.github.io/raysaspixels/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Rays as Pixels，一个视频扩散模型 (VDM)，联合学习视频和相机轨迹的分布。该模型将相机表示为密集光线像素 (raxels)，与视频帧共享潜在空间，通过解耦自交叉注意力机制联合去噪，可同时处理相机轨迹预测、相机控制视频生成以及联合生成。实验表明，该方法在姿态估计和相机控制视频生成上表现有效，且与 Plücker 嵌入相比更优。
Motivation: 传统方法将相机参数恢复和新视角渲染视为分离任务，在图像覆盖稀疏或姿态模糊时，两者相互依赖导致性能下降。
Method: 提出 raxels 表示，将相机编码为像素对齐的密集光线像素，与视频帧在同一潜在空间中进行联合去噪，并使用解耦自交叉注意力机制实现视频和轨迹的协同处理。
Result: 在姿态估计和相机控制视频生成任务上评估，引入闭环自一致性测试，表明模型预测的位姿与条件渲染一致；消融实验证明与视频共享潜在空间比 Plücker 嵌入更有效。
Conclusion: 该模型是首个在单一框架内同时预测相机位姿和生成可控视频的模型，适用于稀疏覆盖或姿态模糊场景。

papers.title: Beyond Augmented-Action Surrogates for Multi-Expert Learning-to-Defer
papers.abstract_en: A learning-to-defer (L2D) system decides, for each input, whether to predict on its own or to hand it to one of several available experts. The very well established recipe trains classifier and router jointly by treating the $K$ classes and $J$ experts as competing actions in one shared $(K{+}J)$-action geometry. Subsequent work has proposed a series of incremental fixes within this geometry; we show that each still suffers, to varying severity, from an optimization-level pathology (target distortion, gradient amplification, winner-take-all starvation, set-mass collapse, or class-expert coupling) even under statistical consistency. We step outside the augmented-action family entirely and propose a decoupled surrogate: a softmax classifier head and an independent sigmoid head per expert, mirroring the two natural objects of the problem. We show that per-sample updates are then coordinatewise and the class-expert Hessian block is identically zero, and prove an excess-risk bound with calibration constant $\max\{2\sqrt{2},\sqrt{2J/λ}\}$ -- to our knowledge the first multi-expert L2D guarantee whose constant does not grow with the expert pool when the per-expert weight is held fixed. On controlled synthetic studies and on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-10H, and Covertype, it is the only method in our comparison that remains stable as the expert pool grows, preserves rare specialists, and improves over a standalone classifier on every real-data benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多专家学习推迟决策（L2D）问题，指出现有的增强动作替代函数族存在目标失真、梯度放大、胜者全拿饥饿、集合质量崩溃和类别-专家耦合等优化病态问题。作者提出一种解耦替代函数：一个softmax分类头加每个专家独立的sigmoid头，使类-专家海森块为零，并证明其过量风险界为max{2√2, √(2J/λ)}，常数不随专家池增长。在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-10H和Covertype上，该方法在专家池增大时保持稳定，保护罕见专家，并在所有真实基准上优于单独分类器。
Motivation: 现有的多专家L2D方法基于增强动作替代函数（将K个类别和J个专家视为竞争动作），即使统计一致，也存在优化层面的病理问题，影响实际性能。
Method: 提出解耦替代函数：一个softmax分类器头和一个独立的sigmoid头（每个专家一个），使得样本更新坐标化，类别-专家海森块为零，并给出了基于校准常数的过量风险界。
Result: 在合成数据和CIFAR-10、CIFAR-10H、Covertype上，该方法在专家池增大时唯一保持稳定，保护罕见专家，并在所有真实基准上优于单独分类器。
Conclusion: 本文跳出增强动作替代函数家族，提出了一个理论上更优、实践中更稳定的解耦替代函数，为多专家L2D提供了首个不随专家池增长而增大的校准常数保证。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Sharp description of local minima in the loss landscape of high-dimensional two-layer ReLU neural networks
papers.abstract_en: We study the population loss landscape of two-layer ReLU networks of the form $\sum_{k=1}^K \mathrm{ReLU}(w_k^\top x)$ in a realisable teacher-student setting with Gaussian covariates. We show that local minima admit an exact low-dimensional representation in terms of summary statistics, yielding a sharp and interpretable characterisation of the landscape. We further establish a direct link with one-pass SGD: local minima correspond to attractive fixed points of the dynamics in summary statistics space. This perspective reveals a hierarchical organisation of minima into discrete families and shows how overparameterisation changes their stability and reachability under gradient-based dynamics. In this overparameterised regime, global minima become increasingly accessible, attracting the dynamics and reducing convergence to spurious solutions. Overall, our results reveal intrinsic limitations of common simplifying assumptions, which may miss essential features of the loss landscape even in minimal neural network models.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 18 figures. Accepted as a conference paper at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究高维两层ReLU神经网络（∑ ReLU(w_k^⊤ x)）在可实现教师-学生设置下的总体损失景观。摘要显示局部极小值可通过总结统计量（summary statistics）获得精确的低维表示，从而得到景观的清晰可解释刻画。进一步建立了与单次SGD的直接联系：局部极小值对应总结统计量空间中的吸引不动点，揭示了极小值分级组织成离散族，以及过参数化如何改变它们在梯度动力学下的稳定性和可达性。在过参数化区域，全局极小值变得愈发可达，吸引动力学并减少收敛至假解。整体上，结果揭示了常见简化假设的内在局限性，即使在最小神经网络模型中也可能遗漏损失景观的关键特征。
Motivation: 理解高维神经网络损失景观的几何结构是深度学习理论的核心挑战之一，现有简化假设可能忽略重要特征，尤其是在最小神经网络模型中。
Method: 采用可实现教师-学生设置与高斯协变量，对两层ReLU网络（∑ ReLU(w_k^⊤ x)）的总体损失景观进行分析，利用总结统计量将局部极小值降维刻画，并建立与单次SGD动力学的联系。
Result: 摘要表明局部极小值可通过总结统计量精确表示，形成分级组织成离散族；过参数化使全局极小值更易吸引动力学，减少假解。
Conclusion: 常见简化假设即使在最小神经网络中也可能遗漏损失景观的关键特征；过参数化有助于全局极小值的可达性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MENO: MeanFlow-Enhanced Neural Operators for Dynamical Systems
papers.abstract_en: Neural operators have emerged as powerful surrogates for dynamical systems due to their grid-invariant properties and computational efficiency. However, Fourier-based variants inherently truncate high-frequency components in spectral space, resulting in the loss of small-scale structures and degraded prediction quality at high resolutions when trained on low-resolution data. While diffusion-based enhancement methods can recover multi-scale features, they introduce substantial inference overhead that undermines the efficiency advantage of neural operators. In this work, we introduce MeanFlow-Enhanced Neural Operators (MENO), a novel framework that achieves accurate all-scale predictions with minimal inference cost. By leveraging the improved MeanFlow method, MENO restores both small-scale details and large-scale dynamics with superior physical fidelity and statistical accuracy. We evaluate MENO on three challenging dynamical systems, including phase-field dynamics, 2D Kolmogorov flow, and active matter dynamics, at resolutions up to 256$\times$256. Across all benchmarks, MENO improves the power spectrum density accuracy by up to a factor of 2 compared to baseline neural operators while achieving up to $14\times$ faster inference than the state-of-the-art Denoising Diffusion Implicit Model (DDIM)-enhanced counterparts, effectively bridging the gap between accuracy and efficiency. The flexibility and efficiency of MENO position it as an efficient surrogate model for scientific machine learning applications where both statistical integrity and computational efficiency are paramount.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MeanFlow增强神经算子(MENO)，通过改进的MeanFlow方法同时恢复小尺度细节和大尺度动力学，解决Fourier神经算子截断高频导致的小尺度结构丢失问题。在相场、2D Kolmogorov流和活性物质动力学三个混沌动力系统上，MENO在256×256分辨率下将功率谱密度精度提升至两倍，同时推理速度比DDIM增强方法快14倍。
Motivation: Fourier神经算子内在截断高频分量，导致小尺度结构丢失和预测质量下降；扩散增强方法虽能恢复多尺度特征但引入巨大推理开销，削弱神经算子的效率优势。
Method: 利用改进的MeanFlow方法作为增强模块，在保持网格不变性和计算效率的同时，同时恢复小尺度细节和大尺度动力学，提升物理保真度和统计精度。
Result: 在三个动力系统基准上，MENO将功率谱密度精度提升至基线神经算子的两倍，推理速度比DDIM增强方法快14倍。
Conclusion: MENO在精度与效率之间取得有效平衡，适合需要统计完整性和计算效率的科学机器学习应用。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: Inversion-Free Natural Gradient Descent on Riemannian Manifolds
papers.abstract_en: The natural gradient method is a central tool for statistical optimisation, but its broader application is hindered by the assumption of a Euclidean parameter space, the repeated estimation of the Fisher information matrix (FIM), and the computational cost of its subsequent inversion. This paper proposes an intrinsic, inversion-free natural gradient method for statistical models whose parameters lie on general Riemannian manifolds. Formulating statistical optimisation in this non-Euclidean setting allows for the natural enforcement of parameter constraints, the elimination of non-identifiable parameters, and the exploitation of geodesic convexity. Our algorithm is based on a moving approximation of the inverse FIM, which is maintained directly on the manifold. This approximation is efficiently updated with new score vectors using low-rank matrix identities. We prove almost-sure convergence rates of $O(\log s / s^α)$ for the sequence of iterates, and a similar rate for the approximate FIM. A limited-memory variant with sub-quadratic storage complexity is further proposed for large-scale applications. We demonstrate the efficacy of our method on variational Bayes within the Bures-Wasserstein manifold, normalising flows on the Stiefel manifold, and reduced-rank logistic regression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无逆自然梯度下降方法，适用于参数位于一般黎曼流形上的统计模型。该方法通过在流形上直接维护逆Fisher信息矩阵的移动近似，并利用低秩矩阵恒等式高效更新，避免了传统自然梯度方法中矩阵求逆的计算瓶颈。理论证明了迭代序列的几乎必然收敛率，并提出了低存储复杂度的有限内存变体以支持大规模应用。在Bures-Wasserstein流形上的变分贝叶斯、Stiefel流形上的归一化流以及降秩逻辑回归中验证了有效性。
Motivation: 自然梯度方法在统计优化中很重要，但其应用受限于欧氏参数空间假设、Fisher信息矩阵的重复估计及其求逆的高计算成本。
Method: 基于移动近似逆Fisher信息矩阵，直接在流形上维护该近似，并使用低秩矩阵恒等式利用新的得分向量进行高效更新；还提出了具有次二次存储复杂度的有限内存变体。
Result: 证明了迭代序列的几乎必然收敛率为$O(\log s / s^{\alpha})$，且近似FIM具有类似速率；实验表明该方法在变分贝叶斯、归一化流和降秩逻辑回归中有效。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了在黎曼流形上无逆计算的自然梯度优化框架，适用于带约束参数模型和大规模统计学习。

papers.title: World Action Verifier: Self-Improving World Models via Forward-Inverse Asymmetry
papers.abstract_en: General-purpose world models promise scalable policy evaluation, optimization, and planning, yet achieving the required level of robustness remains challenging. Unlike policy learning which primarily focuses on optimal actions, a world model needs to be reliable over a vast space of suboptimal actions, which are often underrepresented in action-labeled robot interactions. To address this challenge, we propose World Action Verifier (WAV), a framework that enables world models to identify their own prediction errors and self-improve. The key idea is to decompose action-conditioned state prediction into two independently verifiable factors: state plausibility and action reachability. We show that verifying these factors is significantly more tractable than direct forward prediction due to two underlying asymmetries: the broader availability of action-free data and the lower dimensionality of action-relevant features. Leveraging these asymmetries, we augment a world model with (i) a diverse subgoal generator obtained from video corpora and (ii) a sparse inverse model that infers actions from a subset of state features. By enforcing cycle consistency among proposed subgoals, inferred actions, and forward rollouts, WAV provides an effective verification mechanism in under-explored regimes, where existing methods often fail. Across nine tasks spanning MiniGrid, RoboMimic, and ManiSkill, our method achieves 2x higher sample efficiency while improving downstream policy performance by over 22%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出世界动作验证器 (World Action Verifier, WAV) 框架，通过利用前向-逆不对称性（forward-inverse asymmetry）使世界模型能够自我识别预测错误并自我改进。WAV 将动作条件状态预测分解为状态合理性和动作可达性两个独立可验证因子，并通过视频语料库中的多样化子目标生成器和稀疏逆模型实现循环一致性。在 MiniGrid、RoboMimic 和 ManiSkill 上的九个任务中，该方法实现了 2 倍样本效率提升，下游策略性能提高 22% 以上。
Motivation: 通用世界模型在策略评估、优化和规划中具有潜力，但在大量次优动作空间上的鲁棒性不足，而次优动作在带动作标签的机器人交互数据中往往代表性不足。
Method: 提出 WAV 框架，利用前向-逆不对称性：动作无关数据更广泛可用，动作相关特征维度更低。通过视频语料库训练多样化的子目标生成器，并构建稀疏逆模型从部分状态特征推断动作，通过提议子目标、推断动作和前向推演之间的循环一致性实现验证。
Result: 在 MiniGrid、RoboMimic 和 ManiSkill 的九个任务上，样本效率提升 2 倍，下游策略性能提升超过 22%。
Conclusion: WAV 通过分解预测误差来源并利用数据不对称性，为世界模型在欠探索区域提供有效验证机制，改善了世界模型的可靠性和策略学习效率。

papers.title: A Perturbation Approach to Unconstrained Linear Bandits
papers.abstract_en: We revisit the standard perturbation-based approach of Abernethy et al. (2008) in the context of unconstrained Bandit Linear Optimization (uBLO). We show the surprising result that in the unconstrained setting, this approach effectively reduces Bandit Linear Optimization (BLO) to a standard Online Linear Optimization (OLO) problem. Our framework improves on prior work in several ways. First, we derive expected-regret guarantees when our perturbation scheme is combined with comparator-adaptive OLO algorithms, leading to new insights about the impact of different adversarial models on the resulting comparator-adaptive rates. We also extend our analysis to dynamic regret, obtaining the first guarantees with optimal $\sqrt{P_T}$ path-length dependencies without prior knowledge of $P_T$. We then develop the first high-probability guarantees for both static and dynamic regret in uBLO. Finally, we discuss lower bounds on the static regret, and prove the folklore $Ω(\sqrt{dT})$ rate for adversarial linear bandits on the Euclidean ball, which is of independent interest.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视了Abernethy等人(2008)基于扰动的线性赌博机方法，并将其扩展到无约束设置，证明该方法能将无约束线性赌博机问题简化为标准在线线性优化问题。文章在预期遗憾、动态遗憾和高概率保证方面取得了改进，并证明了关于欧几里得球上对抗性线性赌博机的下界。
Motivation: 现有扰动方法主要针对有界域设置，本文希望将其推广到无约束情形，并解决该设置下遗憾分析、自适应性和高概率保证的空白。
Method: 基于扰动的框架，将无约束线性赌博机问题转化为在线线性优化问题，并结合比较器自适应算法进行理论分析。
Result: 推导出与比较器自适应算法结合的期望遗憾界；首次在无约束设置下获得具有最优√P_T路径长度依赖的动态遗憾界，无需预先知道P_T；首次给出静态和动态遗憾的高概率保证；证明欧几里得球上对抗性线性赌博机的Ω(√dT)下界。
Conclusion: 扰动方法在无约束线性赌博机中有效，产生了新的理论结果和最优下界，但对实际应用（如降水预报等）并无直接关联。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multi-Level Barriers to Generative AI Adoption Across Disciplines and Professional Roles in Higher Education
papers.abstract_en: Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) is rapidly reshaping higher education, yet barriers to its adoption across different disciplines and institutional roles remain underexplored. Existing literature frequently attributes adoption barriers to individual-level factors such as perceived usefulness and ease of use. This study instead investigates whether such barriers are structurally produced. Drawing on a multi-method survey analysis of 272 academic and professional services (PSs) staff at a Russell Group university, we examine how disciplinary contexts and institutional roles shape perceived barriers. By integrating multinomial logistic regression (MLR), structural equation modelling (SEM), and semantic clustering of open-ended responses, we move beyond descriptive accounts to provide a multi-level explanation of GenAI adoption. Our findings reveal clear, systematic differences: non-STEM academics primarily report ethical and cultural barriers related to academic integrity, whereas STEM and PSs staff disproportionately emphasize institutional, governance, and infrastructure constraints. We conclude that GenAI adoption barriers are deeply embedded in organizational ecosystems and epistemic norms, suggesting that universities must move beyond generalized training to develop role-specific governance and support frameworks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该研究通过多方法调查（272名学术和专业人员）分析高等教育中生成式AI（GenAI）采用的结构性障碍，发现非STEM学术人员主要面临学术诚信相关的伦理文化障碍，而STEM和专业服务人员则更强调制度、治理和基础设施限制。结论认为障碍根植于组织生态系统和认知规范，需制定角色特定的治理和支持框架。
Motivation: 现有文献常将GenAI采用障碍归因于个体因素（如感知有用性），但未充分探索学科和机构角色如何结构性产生这些障碍。
Method: 采用多方法调查，对英国罗素集团大学272名学术和专业服务人员进行问卷分析，结合多项逻辑回归（MLR）、结构方程模型（SEM）和开放式回答的语义聚类，提供多层面解释。
Result: 揭示了系统性差异：非STEM学术人员主要报告与学术诚信相关的伦理文化障碍，而STEM和专业服务人员则强调制度、治理和基础设施约束。
Conclusion: GenAI采用障碍深嵌于组织生态系统和认知规范，大学需超越通用培训，制定角色特定的治理和支持框架。

papers.title: TTE-CAM: Self-Explainable Class Activation Maps for Pretrained Black-Box CNNs
papers.abstract_en: Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) achieve state-of-the-art performance in medical image analysis yet remain opaque, limiting adoption in high-stakes clinical settings. Existing approaches face a fundamental trade-off: post-hoc methods provide unfaithful approximate explanations, while inherently interpretable architectures are faithful but often sacrifice predictive performance. We introduce TTE-CAM, a test-time framework that bridges this gap by converting pretrained black-box CNNs into self-explainable models via a convolution-based replacement of their classification head, initialized from the original weights. The resulting model preserves black-box predictive performance while delivering built-in faithful explanations competitive with post-hoc methods, both qualitatively and quantitatively. The code is available at https://github.com/kdjoumessi/Test-Time-Explainability
papers.comment: Accepted at MIDL 2026 in the short paper track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TTE-CAM，一种测试时框架，通过卷积替换分类头将预训练黑盒 CNN 转换为自解释模型，初始化自原始权重，在保持预测性能的同时提供忠实于模型的内生解释，与事后方法竞争。
Motivation: 现有 CNN 可解释性方法面临根本性权衡：事后方法提供不忠实的近似解释，而内在可解释架构忠实但常牺牲预测性能。
Method: 提出 TTE-CAM，在测试时通过卷积操作替换原始分类头，从原始权重初始化，将黑盒 CNN 转换为自解释模型。
Result: 摘要声称该方法在保持黑盒预测性能的同时，提供与事后方法竞争的内生解释，定性和定量均有竞争力。
Conclusion: TTE-CAM 桥接了事后解释与内在可解释架构之间的差距，为高风险的临床医疗等场景提供了忠实且高性能的可解释方案。

papers.title: Identifying Connectivity Distributions from Neural Dynamics Using Flows
papers.abstract_en: Connectivity structure shapes neural computation, but inferring this structure from population recordings is degenerate: multiple connectivity structures can generate identical dynamics. Recent work uses low-rank recurrent neural networks (lrRNNs) to infer low-dimensional latent dynamics and connectivity from observed activity, enabling a mechanistic interpretation of the dynamics. However, standard approaches for training lrRNNs can recover spurious structures irrelevant to the underlying dynamics. We first characterize the identifiability of connectivity structures in lrRNNs and determine conditions under which a unique solution exists. To find such solutions, we develop an inference framework based on maximum entropy and continuous normalizing flows (CNFs), trained via flow matching. Instead of estimating a single connectivity matrix, our method learns a distribution over connection weights that is maximally unbiased over unidentifiable components while matching the observed dynamics. This approach captures complex yet necessary distributions such as heavy-tailed connectivity found in empirical data. We validate our method on synthetic datasets with connectivity structures that generate multistable attractors, limit cycles, and ring attractors, and demonstrate its applicability in recordings from rat frontal cortex during decision-making. Our framework shifts circuit inference from recovering connectivity to identifying which connectivity structures are computationally required, and which are artifacts of underconstrained inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了从神经群体记录中推断连接结构的可辨识性问题，发现低秩循环神经网络(lrRNNs)存在多个连接结构生成相同动力学的简并性。作者基于最大熵和连续归一化流(CNFs)开发了一个推理框架，通过学习连接权重的分布而非单一矩阵，在匹配观测动力学的同时对不可辨识成分保持最大无偏。该方法在生成多稳态吸引子、极限环和环吸引子的合成数据集上验证有效，并应用于大鼠前额叶皮层决策任务记录。
Motivation: 从神经群体活动中推断连接结构是病态的，因为多个连接结构可以生成相同的动力学，标准lrRNN训练可能恢复与底层动力学无关的虚假结构。
Method: 提出基于最大熵和连续归一化流(CNFs)的推理框架，通过流匹配训练，学习连接权重的分布而非单一矩阵，从而对不可辨识成分保持最大无偏。
Result: 在合成数据集上成功恢复生成多稳态吸引子、极限环和环吸引子的连接结构，并在大鼠前额叶皮层决策任务记录中展示了应用潜力。
Conclusion: 该框架将电路推断从恢复单一连接矩阵转变为识别哪些连接结构是计算所必需的，哪些是欠约束推断的伪影。

summary_sections.motivation: 从神经群体活动中推断连接结构是病态的，因为多个连接结构可以生成相同的动力学，标准lrRNN训练可能恢复与底层动力学无关的虚假结构。
summary_sections.method: 提出基于最大熵和连续归一化流(CNFs)的推理框架，通过流匹配训练，学习连接权重的分布而非单一矩阵，从而对不可辨识成分保持最大无偏。
summary_sections.result: 在合成数据集上成功恢复生成多稳态吸引子、极限环和环吸引子的连接结构，并在大鼠前额叶皮层决策任务记录中展示了应用潜力。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架将电路推断从恢复单一连接矩阵转变为识别哪些连接结构是计算所必需的，哪些是欠约束推断的伪影。

papers.title: Beyond Static Uncertainty: Modeling Temporal Uncertainty Dynamics for Probabilistic Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Real-world time series exhibit temporally structured uncertainty: volatility clusters in turbulent regimes, dissipates in stable periods, and shifts abruptly around structural breaks. Yet many probabilistic forecasting methods estimate predictive uncertainty as an independent per-step quantity, leaving the evolution and persistence of volatility regimes under-modeled. We formalize this missing dimension as temporal uncertainty dynamics and instantiate it in the Volatility Dynamics Variational Autoencoder (VolDy-VAE), a non-autoregressive generative forecaster with a location-scale decoder. VolDy-VAE combines a location path for mean prediction with a recurrent scale path that transfers and evolves a volatility hidden state from the look-back window to the forecasting horizon, enabling temporally coherent predictive variances. This design yields an adaptive attenuation mechanism: high-variance observations receive lower influence on the location estimate while their uncertainty is preserved through explicit scale predictions. We further provide a simplified regime-switching analysis showing that, when variances are known or consistently estimated, the volatility-aware objective reduces to inverse-variance weighting, whereas MSE-based estimators remain unbiased but statistically inefficient. Experiments on nine benchmarks show that VolDy-VAE improves forecasting accuracy and uncertainty calibration over competitive probabilistic and point-forecasting baselines while maintaining low inference latency; plug-in studies further indicate that the VolDy principle can benefit GAN, Koopman VAE, and Transformer backbones. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/wangyijunlyy/VolDy-VAE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对概率时间序列预测中不确定性动态建模不足的问题，提出波动动力学变分自编码器（VolDy-VAE），一种非自回归生成式预测模型。该模型结合位置路径进行均值预测和循环尺度路径，从回顾窗口向预测区间传递并演化波动隐状态，从而生成时间上连贯的预测方差。实验表明，VolDy-VAE在九个基准上提升了预测精度和不确定性校准，并具有低推理延迟；其核心思想也可改进GAN、Koopman VAE和Transformer等骨干网络。
Motivation: 现实时间序列中不确定性具有时间结构化特性（如波动聚集、突变），但现有概率预测方法通常将每步不确定性视为独立量，忽略了波动模式的演化和持续性。
Method: 提出VolDy-VAE，包含位置路径（均值预测）和循环尺度路径（从回顾窗口向预测区间传递和演化波动隐状态），实现时间连贯的预测方差；设计自适应衰减机制，高方差观测对位置估计影响更小，同时通过显式尺度预测保留其不确定性。
Result: 在九个基准数据集上，VolDy-VAE在预测精度和不确定性校准方面优于竞争性的概率和点预测基线；插件研究表明其核心思想可提升GAN、Koopman VAE和Transformer等骨干网络。
Conclusion: 摘要强调时间不确定性动态的显式建模对概率时间序列预测的重要性，并指出VolDy-VAE在多种任务和骨干网络上具有通用改进潜力。

papers.title: Circuit-Inspired High-Order Neural Networks with Unified Neural Dynamics Modeling for PDE Solving and Visual Perception
papers.abstract_en: Deep networks often rely on architectural heuristics to shape representation evolution, limiting their ability to model data governed by intrinsic dynamics. We present the Circuit-inspired High-Order Neural Network (CHONN), a modular framework that treats representation evolution as a latent potential process and increases its effective order through Kirchhoff-inspired cascade composition. A single Kirchhoff Neural Cell implements a stable first-order update, while serially composed cells form higher-order dynamical operators within one block. This construction is interpretable, numerically stable and compatible with common neural backbones. Theoretical analysis shows that cascaded cells induce end-to-end high-order operators, and controlled experiments demonstrate that intra-block high-order construction differs from generic depth stacking, especially on derivative-sensitive measures. Across steady-state operator learning, long-horizon physical forecasting and ImageNet-1K recognition, CHONN improves structural fidelity, rollout stability and visual representation learning. These results identify high-order circuit composition as a general principle for neural dynamics modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出电路启发的高阶神经网络(CHONN)，将表征演化视为潜在势过程，通过基尔霍夫启发级联组合提高有效阶数。单个基尔霍夫神经单元实现稳定一阶更新，串联单元在块内形成高阶动力学算子。理论分析表明级联单元产生端到端高阶算子，实验证明块内高阶构造不同于通用深度堆叠。在稳态算子学习、长时物理预测和ImageNet-1K识别上，CHONN改善结构保真度、rollout稳定性和视觉表征学习。
Motivation: 现有深度网络依赖架构启发式塑造表征演化，难以建模受内在动力学支配的数据。
Method: 提出基尔霍夫神经单元及其级联组合形成高阶动力学算子，在单块内实现高阶更新，兼容常见神经骨干网络。
Result: 在稳态算子学习、长时物理预测和ImageNet-1K识别上，CHONN提升结构保真度、rollout稳定性和视觉表征学习。
Conclusion: 高阶电路组合可作为神经动力学建模的通用原则。

papers.title: LH-Bench: Skill-Grounded Evaluation of Long-Horizon Agents on Subjective Enterprise Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Large language models excel on objectively verifiable tasks such as math and programming, where evaluation reduces to unit tests or a single correct answer. In contrast, real-world enterprise work is often subjective and context-dependent: success hinges on organizational goals, user intent, and the quality of intermediate artifacts produced across long, multi-tool workflows. We introduce LH-Bench, a three-pillar evaluation design that moves beyond binary correctness to score autonomous, long-horizon execution on subjective enterprise tasks. The pillars are: (i) expert-grounded rubrics that give LLM judges the domain context needed to score subjective work, (ii) curated ground-truth artifacts that enable stepwise reward signals (e.g., chapter-level annotation for content tasks), and (iii) pairwise human preference evaluation for convergent validation. We show that domain-authored rubrics provide substantially more reliable evaluation signals than LLM-authored rubrics (kappa = 0.60 vs. 0.46), and that human preference judgments confirm the same top-tier separation (p < 0.05), evidence that expert-grounded evaluation can scale without sacrificing reliability. We release public datasets and report results on two environments: Figma-to-code (33 real .fig tasks against the Figma API via MCP) and Programmatic content (41 courses comprising 183 individually-evaluated chapters on a course platform serving 30+ daily users).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对长周期主观企业任务评估中二元正确性指标不足的问题，提出LH-Bench，一个基于专家评分标准、真实标注工件和成对偏好评估的三支柱评测框架。在Figma-to-code和编程内容生成两个企业场景中，专家编写的评分标准比LLM编写的更可靠（kappa 0.60 vs 0.46），且人类偏好判断验证了顶级模型的显著区分（p<0.05）。
Motivation: 现有LLM评估主要依赖客观正确性（如单元测试），但企业任务通常是主观且依赖上下文的，需要评估中间工件的质量，缺乏可扩展且可靠的评测方法。
Method: 提出LH-Bench三支柱设计：专家编写的领域评分标准（为LLM评判提供上下文）、真实标注工件（提供逐步奖励信号）、以及成对人类偏好评估（收敛验证）。
Result: 专家评分标准比LLM自动生成的评分标准更可靠（kappa 0.60 vs 0.46），且人类偏好判断确认顶级模型间存在显著差异（p<0.05），表明专家赋能的评测可在不牺牲可靠性的前提下规模化。
Conclusion: LH-Bench为长周期主观企业任务提供了可靠的评估框架，专家编写评分标准是关键；公开数据集涵盖Figma-to-code和编程内容生成两个环境。

papers.title: ShapDBM: Exploring Decision Boundary Maps in Shapley Space
papers.abstract_en: Decision Boundary Maps (DBMs) are an effective tool for visualising machine learning classification boundaries. Yet, DBM quality strongly depends on the dimensionality reduction (DR) technique and high dimensional space used for the data points. For complex ML data, DR can create many mixed classes which yield DBMs that are hard to use or even misleading. We propose a new technique to compute DBMs by transforming data space into Shapley space and computing DR on it. Compared to DBMs computed directly from data, our maps have similar or higher quality metric values and visibly more compact, easier to explore, decision zones that better agree with measured model performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ShapDBM，一种通过将数据转换到Shapley空间再进行降维来生成分类边界地图的新方法。与传统直接基于数据的边界地图相比，该方法产生更紧凑、可探索性更强的决策区域，并更好地反映模型性能。
Motivation: 传统决策边界地图的质量高度依赖于降维技术和数据所在的高维空间，对于复杂机器学习数据，降维可能导致类别混合，生成难以使用甚至误导性的边界地图。
Method: 将原始数据空间映射到Shapley空间，然后对该空间进行降维，再生成决策边界地图。
Result: 与直接基于数据计算的边界地图相比，新方法在质量度量上达到相似或更高水平，且生成的决策区域更紧凑、更易于探索，与模型性能测量更一致。
Conclusion: Shapley空间中的降维可以改善决策边界地图的可视化效果，为高维分类模型提供更好的解释工具。

papers.title: Counterfactual Credit Policy Optimization for Multi-Agent Collaboration
papers.abstract_en: Collaborative multi-agent large language models (LLMs) can solve complex reasoning tasks by decomposing roles, but reinforcement learning for such systems is limited by credit assignment: shared terminal rewards obscure individual contributions and can encourage free-riding. We introduce Collaborative Credit Policy Optimization (CCPO), an optimizer-agnostic credit assignment layer that converts team-level outcomes into agent-specific learning signals. CCPO provides two complementary allocators. Counterfactual credit estimates an agent's marginal contribution by comparing the realized team outcome with a counterfactual outcome where that agent is removed. Verifier-anchored LLM self-evaluation is an exploratory allocator that uses constrained self- and peer-evaluations to redistribute credit while keeping the external verifier outcome dominant. The resulting role-specific rewards can be consumed by GRPO-style updates or other policy-gradient optimizers such as GSPO and REINFORCE++. We instantiate CCPO in a sequential Think--Solve setting and evaluate it on mathematical reasoning benchmarks. Results show that explicit credit assignment often improves dual-agent reasoning, especially on MATH500 and several out-of-distribution settings, while gains vary across models and datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了协同信用策略优化（CCPO），一种用于多智能体协作LLM的信用分配层，通过反事实信用估计和验证者锚定的LLM自评估两种分配器将团队奖励转化为智能体特定信号。在数学推理基准上测试表明，显式信用分配能改进双智能体推理，但效果因模型和数据集而异。
Motivation: 多智能体LLM协作中共享终端奖励导致信用分配问题，个体贡献难以区分，可能鼓励搭便车行为。
Method: 提出CCPO，包含两种互补分配器：反事实信用估计（移除某智能体后比较结果差异）和验证者锚定的LLM自评估（约束自评与互评，保持外部验证者主导）。该层可与GRPO、GSPO、REINFORCE++等策略梯度优化器结合。
Result: 在数学推理基准（如MATH500）和多个分布外设置上，显式信用分配通常提升双智能体推理性能，但提升幅度因模型和数据集而异。
Conclusion: CCPO提供了一种与优化器无关的信用分配方法，能改善多智能体协作中的角色特定学习信号，但效果依赖具体模型和任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: IsoCLIP: Decomposing CLIP Projectors for Efficient Intra-modal Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models like CLIP are extensively used for inter-modal tasks which involve both visual and text modalities. However, when the individual modality encoders are applied to inherently intra-modal tasks like image-to-image retrieval, their performance suffers from the intra-modal misalignment. In this paper we study intra-modal misalignment in CLIP with a focus on the role of the projectors that map pre-projection image and text embeddings into the shared embedding space. By analyzing the form of the cosine similarity applied to projected features, and its interaction with the contrastive CLIP loss, we show that there is an inter-modal operator responsible for aligning the two modalities during training, and a second, intra-modal operator that only enforces intra-modal normalization but does nothing to promote intra-modal alignment. Via spectral analysis of the inter-modal operator, we identify an approximately isotropic subspace in which the two modalities are well-aligned, as well as anisotropic directions specific to each modality. We demonstrate that this aligned subspace can be directly obtained from the projector weights and that removing the anisotropic directions improves intra-modal alignment. Our experiments on intra-modal retrieval and classification benchmarks show that our training-free method reduces intra-modal misalignment, greatly lowers latency, and outperforms existing approaches across multiple pre-trained CLIP-like models. The code is publicly available at: https://github.com/simomagi/IsoCLIP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究CLIP模型在模态内任务（如图像-图像检索）中的模态内不对齐问题。通过分析投影器的余弦相似度形式及其与对比损失的交互，发现存在一个模态间操作符负责对齐两种模态，以及一个模态内操作符仅施加归一化而不促进对齐。通过模态间操作符的谱分析，识别出一个各向同性子空间，其中两种模态对齐良好，以及各模态特有的各向异性方向。本文演示了可以从投影器权重直接获得该对齐子空间，并去除各向异性方向以改善模态内对齐。实验表明，这种无需训练的方法降低了模态内不对齐，大幅降低延迟，并在多个预训练CLIP类模型上优于现有方法。
Motivation: CLIP在模态内任务（如图像-图像检索）中性能下降，原因是模态内不对齐。本文聚焦于投影器在造成这一不对齐中的作用。
Method: 通过谱分析模态间操作符，识别出对齐良好的各向同性子空间和各模态特有的各向异性方向，然后直接从投影器权重中提取该子空间并去除各向异性方向，从而改善模态内对齐。
Result: 在模态内检索和分类基准上，该方法降低了模态内不对齐，大幅降低延迟，并在多个预训练CLIP类模型上优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 本文提出了一种无需训练的、基于投影器权重谱分析的方法，有效缓解CLIP的模态内不对齐，适用于多种视觉语言模型。

papers.title: From Weak Cues to Real Identities: Evaluating Inference-Driven De-Anonymization in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Anonymization is often assumed to protect privacy once explicit identifiers are removed, because re-identification has historically required specialized expertise, tailored algorithms, and manual corroboration. We show that LLM-based agents weaken this barrier: by combining scattered, individually non-identifying cues with public evidence, they reconstruct real-world identities, sometimes even during benign tasks. We evaluate this risk across three settings -- classical linkage incidents, a controlled benchmark (\emph{InferLink}) that varies fingerprint type, task framing, and attacker knowledge, and open-ended human--AI interaction traces. In the sparsest regime of the Netflix Prize deanonymization setting, agents reconstruct 79.2\% of identities, against 56.0\% for a classical matching baseline; on \emph{InferLink}, they link individuals even without an explicit re-identification request, and more often once one is given. In redacted human--AI interaction traces, agents further resolve anonymized profiles to specific individuals by corroborating contextual cues with public evidence. These findings suggest that privacy evaluations for agentic systems should measure not only what information is accessed or disclosed, but also what identities can be inferred.
papers.journal_ref: ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估LLM代理在缺乏显式标识符时，通过组合零散非标识线索与公开证据重构真实身份的能力。在Netflix Prize去匿名化场景中，代理成功重构79.2%的身份，而传统基线仅为56.0%；在控制基准InferLink中，即使无明确请求也能关联个体。结果表明，匿名化在LLM代理面前可能失效，隐私评估应考虑可推断的身份。
Motivation: 传统匿名化假设去除显式标识符即可保护隐私，但LLM代理可能自动将零散线索与公开证据结合，实现身份重构，威胁现有隐私保护范式。
Method: 在三种设置下评估：经典关联事件（如Netflix Prize）、控制基准InferLink（变化指纹类型、任务框架和攻击者知识）、以及编辑后的人机交互痕迹。
Result: 在Netflix Prize设置中，LLM代理重构79.2%身份，高于传统基线56.0%；在InferLink中，即使无显式重识别请求也能关联个体；在编辑痕迹中，通过上下文线索与公开证据结合解析匿名档案。
Conclusion: 隐私评估应不仅关注信息访问或披露，还应衡量可推断的身份，因为LLM代理能有效利用非标识线索。

papers.title: REAL: Regression-Aware Reinforcement Learning for LLM-as-a-Judge
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as automated evaluators that assign numeric scores to model outputs, a paradigm known as LLM-as-a-Judge. However, standard Reinforcement Learning (RL) methods typically rely on binary rewards (e.g., 0-1 accuracy), thereby ignoring the ordinal structure inherent in regression tasks; for instance, they fail to recognize that predicting 4 is significantly better than predicting 1 when the ground truth is 5. Conversely, existing regression-aware approaches are often confined to Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), limiting their ability to explore optimal reasoning paths. To bridge this gap, we propose \textbf{REAL} (\underline{RE}gression-\underline{A}ware Reinforcement \underline{L}earning), a principled RL framework designed to optimize regression rewards, and also proven to be optimal for correlation metrics. A key technical challenge is that the regression objective is explicitly policy-dependent, thus invalidating standard policy gradient methods. To address this, we employ the generalized policy gradient estimator, which naturally decomposes optimization into two complementary components: (1) exploration over Chain-of-Thought (CoT) trajectory, and (2) regression-aware prediction refinement of the final score. Extensive experiments across model scales (8B to 32B) demonstrate that REAL consistently outperforms both regression-aware SFT baselines and standard RL methods, exhibiting significantly better generalization on out-of-domain benchmarks. On Qwen3-32B specifically, we achieve gains of +8.40 Pearson and +7.20 Spearman correlation over the SFT baseline, and +18.30/+11.20 over the base model. These findings highlight the critical value of integrating regression objectives into RL exploration for accurate LLM evaluation.
papers.comment: Accepted to ICML 2026. The first two authors contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出REAL（Regression-Aware Reinforcement Learning），一个用于LLM-as-a-Judge的强化学习框架，旨在优化回归奖励（如数值评分）而非传统二元奖励。REAL通过广义策略梯度估计器将优化分解为链式思维（CoT）轨迹探索和最终分数的回归感知预测精化，实验表明在8B至32B模型规模上，REAL在相关性和泛化性上均优于回归感知SFT和标准RL方法。
Motivation: 标准RL方法依赖二元奖励（如0-1），忽略了回归任务中的序数结构（例如真实值为5时，预测4远好于预测1），而现有回归感知方法局限于监督微调（SFT），限制了探索最优推理路径的能力。
Method: 提出REAL框架，采用广义策略梯度估计器，将优化分解为两个互补部分：对链式思维（CoT）轨迹的探索，以及对最终分数的回归感知预测精化。
Result: 在Qwen3-32B上，REAL相比SFT基线提升+8.40 Pearson和+7.20 Spearman相关性，相比基模型提升+18.30/+11.20。跨模型规模（8B至32B）实验表明，REAL一致优于回归感知SFT和标准RL方法，且在域外基准上表现出更好泛化。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将回归目标整合到RL探索中对提升LLM评估准确性有重要价值，REAL被证明是优化回归奖励和相关度量的原则性框架。

papers.title: Functorial Neural Architectures from Higher Inductive Types
papers.abstract_en: Neural networks often learn the parts of a task but fail on novel combinations of those parts. We argue that this failure is architectural: a decoder generalizes compositionally only when it respects the algebraic laws of the task, i.e. when it descends from freely generated sequences to the quotient determined by those laws. We make this principle constructive by compiling Higher Inductive Type (HIT) specifications into neural architectures. Basepoints, path constructors, and 2-cells are mapped to base constraints, generator networks, structural concatenation, and learned homotopies. The resulting transport decoders are strict monoidal functors by construction: decoding a concatenated word is concatenation of independently generated loop segments. In contrast, we prove that softmax self-attention cannot simultaneously satisfy strict monoidal composition and descent to any non-trivial compositional quotient. Experiments on the torus, wedge of circles, and Klein bottle validate the predicted hierarchy: functorial decoders outperform non-functorial alternatives by $2$--$10\times$, and a learned 2-cell closes a $46\%$ error gap precisely on words exercising the Klein-bottle relation. These results suggest that compositional generalization should be enforced as functorial structure in the architecture, rather than learned from examples alone.
papers.comment: 26 pages, 10 tables. Code and Cubical Agda formalization: https://github.com/karsar/hott_neuro
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出从高阶归纳类型（Higher Inductive Types）规范编译为神经架构，以强制实现组合泛化。基本点、路径构造子和2-胞腔分别映射为基本约束、生成器网络、结构拼接和学习同伦。得到的传输解码器是严格的幺半函子，解码拼接词即独立生成环段的拼接。实验在环面、圆楔和克莱因瓶上验证，函子解码器优于非函子解码器2-10倍，学习2-胞腔在克莱因瓶关系上缩小46%误差。
Motivation: 神经网络常能学习任务的部分，但在新组合上失败。作者认为这是架构性的：解码器只有尊重任务的代数定律才能组合泛化，即从自由生成的序列下降到由这些定律确定的商。
Method: 将高阶归纳类型（HIT）规范编译为神经架构：基本点→基本约束，路径构造子→生成器网络，结构拼接，2-胞腔→学习同伦。并证明softmax自注意力不能同时满足严格幺半组合和下降到非平凡组合商。
Result: 实验在环面、圆楔和克莱因瓶上，函子解码器比非函子替代品性能好2-10倍。学习2-胞腔在练习克莱因瓶关系的词上关闭了46%的误差缺口。
Conclusion: 组合泛化应作为架构中的函子结构强制实现，而非仅从样本中学习。

papers.title: Learning-to-Defer with Expert-Conditional Advice
papers.abstract_en: Learning-to-Defer routes each input to the expert that minimizes expected cost, but it assumes that the information available to every expert is fixed at decision time. Many modern systems violate this assumption: after selecting an expert, one may also choose what additional information that expert should receive, such as retrieved documents, tool outputs, or escalation context. We study this problem and call it Learning-to-Defer with advice. We show that a broad family of natural separated surrogates, which learn routing and advice with distinct heads, is inconsistent even in the smallest non-trivial setting. We then introduce an augmented surrogate that operates on the composite expert--advice action space and prove an $\mathcal{H}$-consistency guarantee together with an excess-risk transfer bound, yielding recovery of the Bayes-optimal policy in the limit. Experiments on tabular, language, and multi-modal tasks show that the resulting method improves over standard Learning-to-Defer while adapting its advice-acquisition behavior to the cost regime; a synthetic benchmark confirms the failure mode predicted for separated surrogates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究Learning-to-Defer问题，其中每个专家在决策时可能接收额外的建议信息。论文证明自然的分离替代损失（separated surrogates）在最小非平凡设置下是不一致的，并提出一个增强的替代损失，作用在复合的专家-建议动作空间上，并证明其具有$\mathcal{H}$-一致性保证和超额风险传递界。实验在表格、语言和多模态任务上显示所提方法优于标准Learning-to-Defer，并能根据成本调整建议获取行为。
Motivation: 现有Learning-to-Defer假设专家信息固定，但现代系统允许在选择专家后为其提供额外信息（如检索文档、工具输出等），这违反了原假设，导致性能下降。
Method: 提出一种增强的替代损失，作用于复合的专家-建议动作空间，并证明该损失具有$\mathcal{H}$-一致性保证和超额风险传递界，可恢复贝叶斯最优策略。
Result: 在表格、语言和多模态任务上，所提方法优于标准Learning-to-Defer，并能根据成本调整建议获取行为；合成基准证实了分离替代损失的失败模式。
Conclusion: 论文强调了在Learning-to-Defer中考虑建议的重要性，并提供了理论保证和实证验证，表明该方法在多种场景下有效。

papers.title: GradMem: Learning to Write Context into Memory with Test-Time Gradient Descent
papers.abstract_en: Many large language model applications require conditioning on long contexts. Transformers typically support this by storing a large per-layer KV-cache of past activations, which incurs substantial memory overhead. A desirable alternative is compressive memory: read a context once, store it in a compact state, and answer many queries from that state. We study this in a context removal setting, where the model must generate an answer without access to the original context at inference time. We introduce GradMem, which writes context into memory via per-sample test-time optimization. Given a context, GradMem performs a few steps of gradient descent on a small set of prefix memory tokens while keeping model weights frozen. GradMem explicitly optimizes a model-level self-supervised context reconstruction loss, resulting in a loss-driven write operation with iterative error correction, unlike forward-only methods. On associative key--value retrieval, GradMem outperforms forward-only memory writers with the same memory size, and additional gradient steps scale capacity much more effectively than repeated forward writes. We further show that GradMem transfers beyond synthetic benchmarks: with pretrained language models, it attains competitive results on natural language tasks including bAbI and SQuAD variants, relying only on information encoded in memory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GradMem，一种通过测试时梯度下降将上下文写入紧凑记忆状态的方法。在上下文移除设置下，GradMem 利用自监督重建损失进行几步梯度优化，将信息写入前缀记忆词元。实验表明，在关联键值检索任务中，GradMem 优于前向式记忆写入方法，且额外梯度步数能更有效扩展容量。在预训练语言模型上，它在 bAbI 和 SQuAD 变体等自然语言任务上取得有竞争力的结果。
Motivation: Transformer 的长上下文处理依赖逐层 KV 缓存，内存开销大。压缩记忆是一种有希望的替代方案，但现有前向式写入方法缺乏误差校正。
Method: GradMem 在测试时对少量前缀记忆词元执行几步梯度下降，优化模型级别的自监督上下文重建损失，同时冻结模型权重。
Result: 在关联键值检索任务上，GradMem 优于同内存大小的前向式写入器；额外梯度步数比重复前向写入更能有效扩展容量。在 bAbI 和 SQuAD 变体等自然语言任务上取得有竞争力结果。
Conclusion: GradMem 展示了测试时优化作为记忆写入操作的有效性，能从紧凑记忆中恢复上下文信息，且可迁移至真实自然语言任务。

papers.title: Data-driven Progressive Discovery of Physical Laws
papers.abstract_en: Symbolic regression is a powerful tool for knowledge discovery, enabling the extraction of interpretable mathematical expressions directly from data. However, conventional symbolic discovery typically follows an end-to-end, "one-step" process, which often generates lengthy and physically meaningless expressions when dealing with real physical systems, leading to poor model generalization. This limitation fundamentally stems from its deviation from the basic path of scientific discovery: physical laws do not exist in a single form but follow a hierarchical and progressive pattern from simplicity to complexity. Motivated by this principle, we propose Chain of Symbolic Regression (CoSR), a novel framework that models the discovery of physical laws as a chain of symbolic knowledge. This knowledge chain is formed by progressively combining multiple knowledge units with clear physical meanings along a specific logic, ultimately enabling the precise discovery of the underlying physical laws from data. CoSR fully recapitulates the progressive discovery path from Kepler's third law to the law of universal gravitation in classical mechanics, and is applied to three types of problems: turbulent Rayleigh-Benard convection, viscous flows in a circular pipe, and laser-metal interaction, demonstrating its ability to improve classical scaling theories. Finally, CoSR showcases its capability to discover new knowledge in the complex engineering problem of aerodynamic coefficients scaling for different aircraft.
papers.comment: This paper needs to be retracted due to methodological flaws found in RBC case
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Chain of Symbolic Regression (CoSR) 框架，将物理定律的发现建模为符号知识链，逐步组合具有明确物理意义的知识单元，从数据中精确发现潜在物理定律。CoSR 成功复现了从开普勒第三定律到万有引力定律的渐进发现路径，并应用于湍流 Rayleigh-Benard 对流、圆管粘性流和激光-金属相互作用等问题，改进了经典标度理论，还展示了在飞机气动系数标度问题中发现新知识的能力。但该论文因方法论缺陷已被撤回。
Motivation: 传统符号回归的端到端“一步”过程在处理真实物理系统时经常产生冗长且无物理意义的表达式，导致泛化能力差，根本原因是偏离了科学发现的基本路径——物理定律遵循从简单到复杂的层级渐进模式。
Method: 提出 CoSR 框架，将物理定律发现建模为符号知识链，通过逐步组合具有明确物理意义的知识单元，沿着特定逻辑渐进式地组合，最终从数据中发现底层物理定律。
Result: CoSR 成功复现了从开普勒第三定律到万有引力定律的经典发现路径；在湍流 Rayleigh-Benard 对流、圆管粘性流和激光-金属相互作用中改进了经典标度理论；并在飞机气动系数标度问题中展示了发现新知识的能力。
Conclusion: CoSR 框架模拟了物理定律的渐进发现过程，能够从数据中发现具有物理意义的解释性定律。但该论文因在 RBC 案例中发现方法论缺陷已被撤回，读者应谨慎引用。

papers.title: Compile to Compress: Boosting Formal Theorem Provers by Compiler Outputs
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated significant potential in formal theorem proving, yet state-of-the-art performance often necessitates prohibitive test-time compute via massive roll-outs or extended context windows. In this work, we address this scalability bottleneck by exploiting an informative structure in formal verification: the observation that compilers map a vast space of diverse proof attempts to a compact set of structured failure modes. We introduce a learning-to-refine framework that leverages this compression to perform efficient learning and proof exploration. We perform tree search that corrects errors locally conditioned on explicit verifier feedback, thereby circumventing the costs associated with accumulating a long history of proof attempts. Extensive evaluations show that our method consistently amplifies the reasoning capabilities of base provers across varying scales. Notably, our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance on PutnamBench among publicly reported $\sim$8B and $\sim$32B parameter models under comparable test-time budgets, offering a scalable paradigm for next-generation verifier-guided reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种利用编译器输出进行压缩的学习-精炼框架，用于形式化定理证明。该方法通过基于验证器反馈的树搜索局部修正错误，避免累积长历史证明尝试的高成本。实验表明，该方法在不同规模的基证明器上持续提升推理能力，并在PutnamBench上以约8B和约32B参数模型达到最先进性能，同时测试时计算预算相当。
Motivation: 大规模语言模型在形式化定理证明中表现优异，但现有方法需要大量测试时计算（如大规模展开或扩展上下文窗口），存在可扩展性瓶颈。
Method: 利用编译器将大量不同证明尝试映射到少量结构化失败模式这一压缩特性，提出学习-精炼框架，通过显式验证器反馈进行局部错误修正的树搜索，避免累积长历史。
Result: 在PutnamBench上，约8B和约32B参数模型在可比测试时预算下取得最先进性能。
Conclusion: 该方法为下一代基于验证器引导的推理提供了可扩展范式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hybrid Energy-Aware Reward Shaping: A Unified Lightweight Physics-Guided Methodology for Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Deep reinforcement learning for continuous control often suffers from high variance, low energy efficiency, and poor generalization under distribution shift, as purely data-driven exploration ignores available physical structure. This paper proposes Hybrid Energy-Aware Reward Shaping (H-EARS), which encodes dominant energy terms -- assumed known a priori -- directly as reward potentials at O(n) per-step computation. H-EARS decomposes the shaping potential into task-oriented and energy-based components, supplemented by an action regularization term that deliberately modifies the optimization objective to enforce energy-efficient control. A complete theoretical foundation is established: functional independence of shaping and regularization, energy-based gradient enrichment under positive-definite Hessian conditions, convergence guarantees under function approximation, and approximate potential error bounds. Across four continuous control benchmarks and four baseline algorithms, H-EARS achieves consistent gains in convergence speed, policy stability, and final performance. High-fidelity vehicle simulations validate applicability in safety-critical settings under extreme road conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出混合能量感知奖励塑形（H-EARS），将已知主导能量项编码为奖励势函数，结合任务导向和能量基组件以及动作正则化，以提升深度强化学习在连续控制中的收敛速度、策略稳定性和能量效率。理论证明了塑形与正则化的功能独立性、梯度富集性、收敛保证及近似势误差界；在四个连续控制基准和四个基线算法上取得一致增益，并在高保真车辆仿真中验证了安全关键场景的适用性。
Motivation: 纯数据驱动的深度强化学习在连续控制中存在高方差、低能效和分布偏移下泛化差的问题，忽略可用物理结构。
Method: 提出H-EARS，将已知能量项作为奖励势函数（O(n)每步计算），分解塑形势为任务导向和能量基组件，并添加动作正则项以修改优化目标实现节能控制，同时建立完整理论框架。
Result: 在四个连续控制基准和四个基线算法上，H-EARS在收敛速度、策略稳定性和最终性能方面取得一致提升；高保真车辆仿真验证了极端道路条件下的安全关键适用性。
Conclusion: H-EARS通过编码已知能量结构有效提升强化学习性能，理论保证了方法的收敛性和鲁棒性。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: SimulCost: A Cost-Aware Benchmark and Toolkit for Automating Physics Simulations with LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating LLM agents for scientific tasks has focused on token costs while ignoring tool-use costs like simulation time and experimental resources. As a result, metrics like pass@k become impractical under realistic budget constraints. To address this gap, we introduce SimulCost, the first benchmark targeting cost-sensitive parameter tuning in physics simulations. SimulCost compares LLM tuning cost-sensitive parameters against traditional scanning approach in both accuracy and computational cost, spanning 2,947 single-round (initial guess) and 1,931 multi-round (adjustment by trial-and-error) tasks across 13 simulators from fluid dynamics, solid mechanics, and plasma physics. Each simulator's cost is analytically defined and platform-independent. Frontier LLMs achieve 46-65% success rates in single-round mode, dropping to 35-55% under high accuracy requirements, rendering their initial guesses unreliable especially for high accuracy tasks. Multi-round mode improves rates to 72-81%, but LLMs are 1.5-2.5x slower than traditional scanning, making them uneconomical choices. We also investigate parameter group correlations for knowledge transfer potential, and the impact of in-context examples and reasoning effort, providing practical implications for deployment and fine-tuning. We open-source SimulCost as a static benchmark and extensible toolkit to facilitate research on improving cost-aware agentic designs for physics simulations, and for expanding new simulation environments. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Rose-STL-Lab/SimulCost-Bench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SimulCost是首个针对物理模拟中成本敏感参数调优的基准和工具包，跨越流体动力学、固体力学和等离子体物理的13个模拟器。Frontier LLM在单轮任务中成功率46-65%，多轮提升至72-81%，但速度比传统扫描慢1.5-2.5倍，表明在预算约束下LLM并非经济选择。
Motivation: 现有LLM科学任务评估仅关注token成本，忽略模拟时间和实验资源等工具使用成本，使得pass@k等指标在现实预算约束下不实用。
Method: 提出SimulCost基准，包含2947个单轮（初始猜测）和1931个多轮（试错调整）任务，覆盖13个物理模拟器，成本函数解析定义且平台无关。同时提供可扩展工具包。
Result: Frontier LLM在单轮模式下成功率46-65%，高精度要求下降至35-55%；多轮模式下成功率提升至72-81%，但速度比传统扫描慢1.5-2.5倍，LLM初始猜测在高精度任务中不可靠。
Conclusion: 开源SimulCost作为静态基准和可扩展工具包，促进成本感知的智能体设计研究，并支持扩展新模拟环境。

papers.title: G-STAR: End-to-End Global Speaker-Tracking Attributed Recognition
papers.abstract_en: We study timestamped speaker-attributed automatic speech recognition (SA-ASR) for long-form, multi-party speech with overlap. In this setting, chunk-wise inference must preserve meeting-level speaker identity consistency while producing time-stamped, speaker-labeled transcripts. Prior Speech-LLM systems tend to prioritize either local diarization or global labeling, lacking the ability to jointly model fine-grained temporal boundaries and robust cross-chunk identity linking. We propose G-STAR, an end-to-end framework that couples a cache-conditioned speaker-tracking module with a Speech-LLM transcription backbone. The tracker provides structured speaker cues with temporal grounding, and the LLM generates attributed text conditioned on these cues. G-STAR supports component-wise optimization and joint end-to-end training, enabling flexible learning under heterogeneous supervision and domain shift. Under chunk-wise decoding protocols, experiments on both oracle-segmented local evaluation and full-meeting global evaluation show strong speaker-attributed transcription performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出G-STAR，一种端到端框架，用于长时间多说话人重叠语音的带时间戳说话人属性语音识别。该框架结合缓存条件说话人跟踪模块与Speech-LLM转录骨干，在块式解码下实现全局说话人身份一致性，并在局部和全局评估中表现良好。
Motivation: 现有Speech-LLM系统在处理长时间多说话人语音时，难以同时建模精细的时间边界和跨块身份链接，导致本地说话人分类与全局标签不一致。
Method: 提出G-STAR框架，包含一个缓存条件说话人跟踪模块（提供时间定位的结构化说话人线索）和一个Speech-LLM转录骨干（基于线索生成属性文本），支持组件优化和端到端联合训练。
Result: 在oracle分割的局部评估和全会议全局评估下，块式解码协议取得了强说话人属性转录性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架通过灵活训练策略适应异构监督和领域迁移，有效提升了长时间多说话人语音的说话人属性识别一致性。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在oracle分割的局部评估和全会议全局评估下，块式解码协议取得了强说话人属性转录性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调该框架通过灵活训练策略适应异构监督和领域迁移，有效提升了长时间多说话人语音的说话人属性识别一致性。

papers.title: World2Act: Latent Action Post-Training from World Model Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: World Models (WMs) offer a promising mechanism for post-training Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies by providing dynamics priors that improve generalization under task and scene variation. However, most WM-based post-training methods rely on pixel-space supervision, making policies sensitive to visual artifacts introduced by imperfect WM rollouts. We present World2Act, a latent-space post-training framework that transfers WM dynamics to the VLA policy without pixel-space supervision. World2Act operates in two stages: 1) it induces a shared video-action latent space by contrastively aligning WM-dynamics latents with action embeddings, and 2) it post-trains the VLA by guiding policy action representations toward WM-imagined dynamics rather than decoded pixels. Built on GR00T-N1.6, World2Act delivers absolute success-rate gains of up to +2.5% on simulation benchmarks (RoboCasa, LIBERO, Bridge-SIMPLER) and +6.7% on a real robot over finetuned VLA baselines. Notably, it outperforms pixel-space WM supervision by up to +6.0%, including on LIBERO where pixel supervision degrades the baseline, suggesting that latent WM dynamics offer a more stable WM-based post-training alternative to pixel-space transfer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 World2Act，一种在潜在空间中进行后训练 (post-training) 的框架，将世界模型 (World Model) 的动态先验迁移到视觉-语言-动作策略 (VLA)，避免像素空间监督带来的视觉伪影问题。该方法通过对比对齐构建共享视频-动作潜在空间，并指导策略动作表示向世界模型想象的潜在动态靠近。在仿真基准 (RoboCasa, LIBERO, Bridge-SIMPLER) 上取得最高 +2.5% 的绝对成功率提升，在真实机器人上提升 +6.7%，且优于像素空间世界模型监督方法。
Motivation: 现有基于世界模型的后训练方法依赖像素空间监督，使得策略对世界模型滚动输出中的视觉伪影敏感，导致泛化不稳定。
Method: 两阶段框架：1）通过对比学习对齐世界模型动态潜在与动作嵌入，构建共享视频-动作潜在空间；2）在潜在空间中后训练 VLA 策略，使策略动作表示与世界模型想象的动态一致，而非解码后的像素。
Result: 基于 GR00T-N1.6 后训练，在仿真基准上绝对成功率提升最高 +2.5%，真实机器人上 +6.7%；相比像素空间世界模型监督方法最高提升 +6.0%，且避免像素监督在 LIBERO 上的退化。
Conclusion: 潜在空间的世界模型动态迁移为 VLA 策略后训练提供了比像素空间更稳定的替代方案，有助于提升任务与场景变化的泛化能力。

papers.title: Generative Drifting is Secretly Score Matching: a Spectral and Variational Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Generative Modeling via Drifting~\citep{deng2026drifting} has recently achieved state-of-the-art one-step image generation through a kernel-based drift operator, yet its success is largely empirical and its theoretical foundations remain poorly understood. We observe that \emph{under a Gaussian kernel, the drift operator is exactly a score difference on smoothed distributions}. This answers three questions left open in the original work: (1) whether a vanishing drift guarantees equality of distributions ($V_{p,q}=0\Rightarrow p=q$), (2) how to choose between kernels, and (3) why the stop-gradient operator is indispensable for stable training. Our observations position drifting within the score-matching family. By linearizing the McKean-Vlasov dynamics and probing them in Fourier space, we reveal frequency-dependent convergence timescales comparable to \emph{Landau damping} in plasma kinetic theory: the Gaussian kernel suffers an exponential high-frequency bottleneck, potentially explaining the empirical preference for the Laplacian kernel. This suggests a fix: an exponential bandwidth annealing schedule $σ(t)=σ_0 e^{-rt}$ that reduces convergence time from $\exp(O(K_{\max}^2))$ to $O(\log K_{\max})$. Finally, by formalizing drifting as a Wasserstein gradient flow of the smoothed KL divergence, we prove that the stop-gradient operator is not a heuristic but is derived from the frozen-field discretization mandated by the Jordan-Kinderlehrer-Otto (JKO) scheme, and removing it severs training from any gradient-flow guarantee. This variational perspective further provides a general template for constructing novel drift operators, which we demonstrate with a Sinkhorn divergence drift. We validate our analysis on toy datasets and scale it up to ImageNet.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示了生成式漂移（Generative Drifting）在高斯核下等价于平滑分布上的分数差异，将漂移定位为分数匹配家族。通过线性化McKean-Vlasov动力学并在傅里叶空间分析，发现高斯核存在指数高频瓶颈（类似Landau阻尼），并推荐指数带宽退火计划将收敛时间从exp(O(K_max^2))降至O(log K_max)。变分视角证明停止梯度算子来自JKO方案的冻结场离散化，并非启发式。在玩具数据和ImageNet上验证了理论。
Motivation: 原Generative Modeling via Drifting工作取得了经验上的成功，但理论基础薄弱，留下三个开放问题：消失的漂移是否保证分布相等、如何选择核函数、停止梯度算子为何必要。
Method: 证明高斯核下漂移算子为平滑分布上的分数差；线性化McKean-Vlasov动力学进行傅里叶谱分析，揭示频率相关收敛时间；提出指数带宽退火σ(t)=σ_0 e^{-rt}；将漂移形式化为平滑KL散度的Wasserstein梯度流，推导停止梯度算子源于JKO离散化。
Result: 理论分析表明指数退火可将收敛时间从exp(O(K_max^2))降至O(log K_max)；在玩具数据和ImageNet上验证了方法的有效性。
Conclusion: 论文将漂移纳入分数匹配框架，提供构建新漂移算子的通用模板（如Sinkhorn散度漂移），并强调停止梯度算子的理论基础，否则训练将失去梯度流保证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: What is Missing? Explaining Neurons Activated by Absent Concepts
papers.abstract_en: Explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) aims to provide human-interpretable insights into the behavior of deep neural networks (DNNs), typically by estimating a simplified causal structure of the model. In existing work, this causal structure often includes relationships where the presence of a concept is associated with a strong activation of a neuron. For example, attribution methods primarily identify input pixels that contribute most to a prediction, and feature visualization methods reveal inputs that cause high activation of a target neuron - the former implicitly assuming that the relevant information resides in the input, and the latter that neurons encode the presence of concepts. However, a largely overlooked type of causal relationship is that of encoded absences, where the absence of a concept increases neural activation. In this work, we show that such missing but relevant concepts are common and that mainstream XAI methods struggle to reveal them when applied in their standard form. To address this, we propose two simple extensions to attribution and feature visualization techniques that uncover encoded absences. Across experiments, we show how mainstream XAI methods can be used to reveal and explain encoded absences, how ImageNet models exploit them, and that debiasing can be improved when considering them.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示深度神经网络中存在一种被忽视的因果关系：概念的缺失（encoded absences）也会使神经元强烈激活。主流XAI方法（归因与特征可视化）无法直接发现这种关系，因此提出两种简单扩展方法。实验表明ImageNet模型中广泛存在此类缺失概念，考虑它们可以改善模型去偏。
Motivation: 现有可解释性方法主要关注概念存在与神经元激活的关联，而忽略概念缺失也可能导致激活；这种缺失因果关系尚未被系统研究。
Method: 针对归因方法，引入缺失概念掩码；针对特征可视化方法，优化使神经元在缺失特定概念时激活最大化的输入。
Result: 实验发现多种ImageNet模型普遍编码缺失概念，标准XAI方法无法揭示，而所提扩展能有效发现并解释这些缺失。考虑缺失概念后，模型去偏效果得到提升。
Conclusion: 作者强调识别和解释编码的缺失概念对理解DNN行为及公平性至关重要。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: X-GS: An Extensible Framework for Perceiving and Thinking via 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as a powerful technique for novel view synthesis, subsequently extending into numerous spatial AI applications. However, most existing 3DGS methods operate in isolation, focusing on specific domains. In this paper, we introduce X-GS, an extensible framework consisting of two major components. The X-GS-Perceiver unifies a broad range of 3DGS techniques to enable real-time online SLAM with semantic distillation. The X-GS-Thinker accommodates multimodal models, enabling them to seamlessly interface with the Perceiver to complete downstream tasks. In our implementation of X-GS, the Perceiver leverages the latest vision foundation models to improve online SLAM performance and employs three key mechanisms to accelerate semantic distillation. The Thinker can be built upon both contrastive and generative vision-language models and utilizes the Perceiver's semantic Gaussian splats to unlock capabilities such as 3D visual grounding and scene captioning. Experimental results on diverse benchmarks demonstrate the efficiency and newly unlocked multimodal capabilities of the X-GS framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: X-GS 是一个基于 3D 高斯溅射 (3DGS) 的可扩展框架，包含 X-GS-Perceiver 和 X-GS-Thinker 两大组件。Perceiver 统一多种 3DGS 技术，支持实时在线 SLAM 和语义蒸馏；Thinker 集成多模态模型，实现如 3D 视觉定位和场景描述等下游任务。实验表明该框架在多个基准上具有高效性和新的多模态能力。
Motivation: 现有 3DGS 方法通常针对特定领域独立运行，缺乏统一框架来整合不同技术并支持多模态交互。
Method: 提出 X-GS 框架：Perceiver 利用视觉基础模型改进在线 SLAM 性能，并通过三种关键机制加速语义蒸馏；Thinker 基于对比或生成式视觉-语言模型，利用 Perceiver 的语义高斯溅射完成多模态任务。
Result: 在多个基准上验证了框架的效率和新解锁的多模态能力。
Conclusion: X-GS 提供了一个可扩展的统一框架，使 3DGS 不仅能进行高效感知，还能与多模态模型结合实现高级推理。

papers.title: Beyond Test-Time Memory: State-Space Optimal Control for LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Associative memory has long underpinned the design of sequential models. Beyond recall, humans reason by projecting future states and selecting goal-directed actions, a capability that modern language models increasingly require but do not natively encode. While prior work uses reinforcement learning or test-time training, planning remains external to the model architecture. We formulate reasoning as optimal control and introduce the Test-Time Control (TTC) layer, which performs finite-horizon LQR planning over latent states at inference time, represents a value function within neural architectures, and leverages it as the nested objective to enable planning before prediction. To ensure scalability, we derive a hardware-efficient LQR solver based on a symplectic formulation and implement it as a fused CUDA kernel, enabling parallel execution with minimal overhead. Integrated as an adapter into pretrained LLMs, TTC layers improve mathematical reasoning performance by up to +27.8% on MATH-500 and 2-3x Pass@8 improvements on AMC and AIME, demonstrating that embedding optimal control as an architectural component provides an effective and scalable mechanism for reasoning beyond test-time training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出测试时控制层，将推理形式化为最优控制，在推理时执行有限时域LQR规划，并将其作为嵌套目标融入神经网络架构。作为适配器集成到预训练LLM中，TTC层在数学推理任务上取得显著提升。
Motivation: 现有语言模型依赖联想记忆，缺乏规划未来状态和目标导向行动的能力，而强化学习和测试时训练等方法将规划外置于模型架构。
Method: 提出Test-Time Control层，基于辛公式推导高效LQR求解器并实现为融合CUDA内核，将其作为适配器插入预训练LLM，在推理时进行有限时域规划。
Result: 在MATH-500上提升+27.8%，在AMC和AIME上Pass@8提升2-3倍。
Conclusion: 将最优控制嵌入模型架构是一种有效且可扩展的推理机制，超越测试时训练方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Group Entropies and Mirror Duality: A Class of Flexible Mirror Descent Updates for Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a comprehensive theoretical and algorithmic framework that bridges formal group theory and group entropies with modern machine learning, paving the way for an infinite, flexible family of Mirror Descent (MD) optimization algorithms. Our approach exploits the rich structure of group entropies, which are generalized entropic functionals governed by group composition laws, encompassing and significantly extending all trace-form entropies such as the Shannon, Tsallis, and Kaniadakis families. By leveraging group-theoretical mirror maps (or link functions) in MD, expressed via multi-parametric generalized logarithms and their inverses (group exponentials), we achieve highly flexible and adaptable MD updates that can be tailored to diverse data geometries and statistical distributions. To this end, we introduce the notion of \textit{mirror duality}, which allows us to seamlessly switch or interchange group-theoretical link functions with their inverses, subject to specific learning rate constraints. By tuning or learning the hyperparameters of the group logarithms enables us to adapt the model to the statistical properties of the training distribution, while simultaneously ensuring desirable convergence characteristics via fine-tuning. This generality not only provides greater flexibility and improved convergence properties, but also opens new perspectives for applications in machine learning and deep learning by expanding the design of regularizers and natural gradient algorithms. We extensively evaluate the validity, robustness, and performance of the proposed updates on large-scale, simplex-constrained quadratic programming problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于群论和群熵的镜像下降（Mirror Descent）优化算法框架，通过引入群论镜像映射和镜像对偶性，生成无限类灵活的优化更新规则。该方法扩展了Shannon、Tsallis和Kaniadakis等熵族，允许通过调整超参数适应数据几何和统计分布，并在大规模单纯形约束二次规划问题上验证了有效性和鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有镜像下降算法通常基于固定形式的熵函数（如负熵），缺乏适应不同数据几何和统计分布的灵活性。本文旨在通过群熵的统一理论，提供一类可参数化的镜像映射，以增强优化算法的适应性和收敛性。
Method: 利用群熵（满足群合成律的广义熵函数）构造群论镜像映射，即多参数广义对数及其逆（群指数），并引入镜像对偶性，允许在链接函数及其逆之间切换，受学习率约束。通过调整或学习群对数的超参数，使模型适应训练数据的统计特性。
Result: 在大规模单纯形约束二次规划问题上评估了所提更新的有效性、鲁棒性和性能，表明该方法提供了更大的灵活性和改进的收敛特性。
Conclusion: 该框架为机器学习优化提供了新的正则化器和自然梯度算法设计视角，但具体应用领域（如深度学习）的实证结果有待进一步探索。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Rectified flow-based prediction of post-treatment brain MRI from pre-radiotherapy priors for patients with glioma
papers.abstract_en: Brain tumors result in 20 years of lost life on average. Standard therapies induce complex structural changes in the brain that are monitored through MRI. Recent developments in artificial intelligence (AI) enable conditional multimodal image generation from clinical data. In this study, we investigate AI-driven generation of follow-up MRI in patients with intracranial tumors through conditional image generation. This approach enables realistic modeling of post-radiotherapy changes, allowing for treatment optimization. The public SAILOR dataset of 25 patients was used to create a 2D rectified flow model conditioned on axial slices of pre-treatment MRI and RT dose maps. Cross-attention conditioning was used to incorporate temporal and chemotherapy data. The resulting images were validated with structural similarity index measure (SSIM), peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR), Dice scores and Jacobian determinants. The resulting model generates realistic follow-up MRI for any time point, while integrating treatment information. Comparing real versus predicted images, SSIM is 0.88, and PSNR is 22.82. Tissue segmentations from real versus predicted MRI result in a mean Dice-Sørensen coefficient (DSC) of 0.91. The rectified flow (RF) model enables up to 250x faster inference than Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DDPM). The proposed model generates realistic follow-up MRI in real-time, preserving both semantic and visual fidelity as confirmed by image quality metrics and tissue segmentations. Conditional generation allows counterfactual simulations by varying treatment parameters, producing predicted morphological changes. This capability has potential to support adaptive treatment dose planning and personalized outcome prediction for patients with intracranial tumors. Code will be available upon peer-reviewed publication at: https://github.com/SelenaIHuisman/RF-GlioPREDICT

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文研究使用整流流（rectified flow）模型从放疗前MRI和剂量图生成胶质瘤患者治疗后MRI，实现实时、高保真的图像生成，支持治疗优化和反事实模拟。
Motivation: 脑肿瘤患者治疗后MRI可监测复杂结构变化，但获取困难；现有AI方法可生成后放疗图像，但速度慢或保真度不足。本文旨在提出一种快速、高保真的条件图像生成方法。
Method: 使用SAILOR数据集（25名患者）的轴向切片和RT剂量图，训练一个2D整流流模型，通过交叉注意力机制引入时间和化疗信息。

Conclusion: 该模型能实时生成语义和视觉保真度高的随访MRI，支持改变治疗参数进行反事实模拟，有潜力用于适应性治疗计划和个性化预后。

papers.title: 3ViewSense: Spatial and Mental Perspective Reasoning from Orthographic Views in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Current Large Language Models have achieved Olympiad-level logic, yet Vision-Language Models paradoxically falter on elementary spatial tasks like block counting. This capability mismatch reveals a critical ``spatial intelligence gap,'' where models fail to construct coherent 3D mental representations from 2D observations. We uncover this gap via diagnostic analyses showing the bottleneck is a missing view-consistent spatial interface rather than insufficient visual features or weak reasoning. To bridge this, we introduce \textbf{3ViewSense}, a framework that grounds spatial reasoning in Orthographic Views. Drawing on engineering cognition, we propose a ``Simulate-and-Reason'' mechanism that decomposes complex scenes into canonical orthographic projections to resolve geometric ambiguities. By aligning egocentric perceptions with these allocentric references, our method facilitates explicit mental rotation and reconstruction. Empirical results on spatial reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms existing baselines, with consistent gains on occlusion-heavy counting and view-consistent spatial reasoning. The framework also improves the stability and consistency of spatial descriptions, offering a scalable path toward stronger spatial intelligence in multimodal systems.~\footnote{https://github.com/Jasaxion/3ViewSense}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出当前视觉语言模型在基础空间任务（如方块计数）上存在显著能力缺陷，即“空间智能差距”。作者通过诊断分析发现瓶颈在于缺乏视图一致的空间接口，而非视觉特征或推理能力不足。为此提出3ViewSense框架，借鉴工程认知中的正视图投影，设计“模拟-推理”机制，将复杂场景分解为规范正视图以消除几何歧义，并通过对齐自我中心感知与异中心参考来实现显式的心理旋转与重建。实验表明该方法在遮挡计数和视图一致空间推理等基准上显著优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在基础空间推理任务上表现糟糕，暴露出从2D观测构建一致3D心智表征的能力缺失，这一问题被称为“空间智能差距”。
Method: 提出3ViewSense框架，核心是“Simulate-and-Reason”机制：将复杂场景分解为规范正视图投影，利用工程认知中的正交视图消除几何歧义，并通过对齐自我中心感知与异中心参考来实现显式的心理旋转与三维重建。
Result: 在空间推理基准上，该方法显著优于现有基线，在遮挡密集的计数任务和视图一致空间推理上取得一致提升，并改善了空间描述的稳定性与一致性。
Conclusion: 3ViewSense通过将空间推理锚定于正视图投影，提供了一条可扩展的路径来增强多模态系统的空间智能。
Relevance: 0
