papers.title: Rank-Factorized Implicit Neural Bias: Scaling Super-Resolution Transformer with FlashAttention
papers.abstract_en: Recent Super-Resolution~(SR) methods mainly adopt Transformers for their strong long-range modeling capability and exceptional representational capacity. However, most SR Transformers rely heavily on relative positional bias~(RPB), which prevents them from leveraging hardware-efficient attention kernels such as FlashAttention. This limitation imposes a prohibitive computational burden during both training and inference, severely restricting attempts to scale SR Transformers by enlarging the training patch size or the self-attention window. Consequently, unlike other domains that actively exploit the inherent scalability of Transformers, SR Transformers remain heavily focused on effectively utilizing limited receptive fields. In this paper, we propose Rank-factorized Implicit Neural Bias~(RIB), an alternative to RPB that enables FlashAttention in SR Transformers. Specifically, RIB approximates positional bias using low-rank implicit neural representations and concatenates them with pixel content tokens in a channel-wise manner, turning the element-wise bias addition in attention score computation into a dot-product operation. Further, we introduce a convolutional local attention and a cyclic window strategy to fully leverage the advantages of long-range interactions enabled by RIB and FlashAttention. We enlarge the window size up to \textbf{96$\times$96} while jointly scaling the training patch size and the dataset size, maximizing the benefits of Transformers in the SR task. As a result, our network achieves \textbf{35.63\,dB PSNR} on Urban100$\times$2, while reducing training and inference time by \textbf{2.1$\times$} and \textbf{2.9$\times$}, respectively, compared to the RPB-based SR Transformer~(PFT).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出秩分解隐式神经偏置 (Rank-factorized Implicit Neural Bias, RIB)，作为相对位置偏置 (RPB) 的替代方案，使超分辨率 Transformer 能够利用 FlashAttention 高效核。RIB 通过低秩隐式神经表示近似位置偏置，并与像素内容令牌按通道拼接，将注意力分数中的逐元素加法转为点积操作。同时引入卷积局部注意力和循环窗口策略，将自注意力窗口扩大至 96×96，并同步扩大训练块尺寸和数据集规模。在 Urban100×2 上达到 35.63 dB PSNR，训练和推理时间分别减少 2.1 倍和 2.9 倍。
Motivation: 现有超分辨率 Transformer 严重依赖相对位置偏置 (RPB)，无法使用 FlashAttention 等硬件高效注意力核，导致训练和推理计算负担沉重，限制了通过增大训练块尺寸或自注意力窗口来缩放 Transformer 的尝试。
Method: 提出秩分解隐式神经偏置 (RIB)，用低秩隐式神经表示近似位置偏置，并按通道拼接到像素内容令牌上，使注意力分数计算中的逐元素加法变为点积操作，从而支持 FlashAttention。此外，引入卷积局部注意力和循环窗口策略，以充分利用 RIB 和 FlashAttention 带来的长程交互优势。
Result: 将自注意力窗口扩大至 96×96，在 Urban100×2 上达到 35.63 dB PSNR，训练时间减少 2.1 倍，推理时间减少 2.9 倍，相比基于 RPB 的 SR Transformer (PFT)。
Conclusion: 通过 RIB 和 FlashAttention，超分辨率 Transformer 能够有效利用更大窗口和更长序列，实现性能提升与效率改进，为缩放超分辨率模型提供了可行方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MASPOB: Bandit-Based Prompt Optimization for Multi-Agent Systems with Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved great success in many real-world applications, especially the one serving as the cognitive backbone of Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) to orchestrate complex workflows in practice. Since many deployment scenarios preclude MAS workflow modifications and its performance is highly sensitive to the input prompts, prompt optimization emerges as a more natural approach to improve its performance. However, real-world prompt optimization for MAS is impeded by three key challenges: (1) the need of sample efficiency due to prohibitive evaluation costs, (2) topology-induced coupling among prompts, and (3) the combinatorial explosion of the search space. To address these challenges, we introduce MASPOB (Multi-Agent System Prompt Optimization via Bandits), a novel sample-efficient framework based on bandits. By leveraging Upper Confidence Bound (UCB) to quantify uncertainty, the bandit framework balances exploration and exploitation, maximizing gains within a strictly limited budget. To handle topology-induced coupling, MASPOB integrates Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) to capture structural priors, learning topology-aware representations of prompt semantics. Furthermore, it employs coordinate ascent to decompose the optimization into univariate sub-problems, reducing search complexity from exponential to linear. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that MASPOB achieves state-of-the-art performance, consistently outperforming existing baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MASPOB，一种基于 bandit 的样本高效提示优化框架，用于多智能体系统 (MAS)。该框架利用上置信界 (UCB) 平衡探索与利用，通过图神经网络 (GNN) 捕捉拓扑诱导的提示耦合，并采用坐标下降将优化问题从指数复杂度降为线性。实验表明 MASPOB 在多个基准上达到最优性能。
Motivation: 多智能体系统性能高度依赖输入提示，但实际部署中无法修改工作流，只能优化提示。现有方法面临评估成本高、提示间拓扑耦合、搜索空间组合爆炸三大挑战。
Method: 提出基于 bandit 的框架 MASPOB：使用 UCB 量化不确定性以平衡探索与利用；集成 GNN 学习拓扑感知的提示语义表示，处理耦合；采用坐标下降将多变量优化分解为单变量子问题，降低复杂度。
Result: 在多个基准上，MASPOB 取得最优性能，一致优于现有基线。
Conclusion: MASPOB 是一种样本高效的提示优化方法，适用于多智能体系统，其核心创新在于结合 bandit、GNN 和坐标下降解决实际部署中的关键问题。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: NGDBench: Towards Neural Graph Data Management
papers.abstract_en: Data critical to real-world decision-making is increasingly found within organizations. Such data is heterogeneous, constantly evolving, and only imperfectly captured. However, current data management systems remain largely passive, retrieving what is explicitly stored while offering limited support for uncovering implicit structure or reasoning under noise, incompleteness, and continuous updates. We argue that next-generation data management requires neural capabilities, which can uncover complex latent relationships, distinguish reliable signals from noise, and remain consistent as the underlying data state evolves. To support this direction, we introduce NGDBench, a benchmark across five domains that unifies structured and unstructured sources. NGDBench adopts a graph view because graphs provide a flexible abstraction for modeling complex systems, capturing latent relationships, and subsuming structured formats such as relational tables. Each instance pairs a clean latent graph with a realistically perturbed observed graph. NGDBench supports full Cypher queries and dynamic data management operations. Evaluations of state-of-the-art Text-to-Cypher by LLMs and GraphRAG pipelines reveal that current neural query methods remain sensitive to noise and struggle with dynamic state tracking, highlighting the need for resilient, inference-capable data management. Our code is available at https://github.com/HKUST-KnowComp/NGDBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NGDBench 是一个跨五个领域的图数据管理基准，将结构化与非结构化数据统一为图视图，每个实例包含一个干净的潜在图和一个经过真实扰动的观测图。该基准支持完整的 Cypher 查询和动态数据管理操作，评估了当前基于 LLM 的 Text-to-Cypher 和 GraphRAG 方法，发现它们对噪声敏感且难以追踪动态状态。
Motivation: 现有数据管理系统主要是被动的，仅检索显式存储的信息，缺乏对隐式结构、噪声、不完全性和持续更新的支持。因此需要具备神经能力的数据管理系统，能够发现复杂潜在关系、区分可靠信号与噪声，并在数据状态演化时保持一致性。
Method: 引入 NGDBench 基准，涵盖五个领域，将结构化（如关系表）和非结构化数据统一为图表示。每个实例提供一对图：一个干净潜在图和一个通过真实扰动生成的观测图。支持完整的 Cypher 查询和动态数据管理操作。
Result: 对当前最先进的 LLM Text-to-Cypher 和 GraphRAG 流程的评估表明，这些神经查询方法对噪声敏感，并且在动态状态跟踪方面表现不佳。
Conclusion: 当前神经查询方法无法有效处理噪声和动态变化，突出了对具有弹性和推理能力的数据管理系统的需求。NGDBench 为未来研究提供了基准。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: From Leaky Thoughts to Private Reasoning: Controlling What LRMs Say to Themselves
papers.abstract_en: Large reasoning models (LRMs) produce reasoning traces (RTs) that often contain sensitive information. These leaky thoughts are difficult to control and frequently violate explicit privacy directives. Because RTs can be exposed through prompt injection attacks, this becomes a direct privacy risk to the user. We approach this as a controllability problem: since privacy directives are themselves instructions, improving instruction-following (IF) within the RT provides a direct path to reducing privacy leaks. To this end, we introduce an SFT dataset that teaches models to follow general instructions throughout their reasoning process, and propose Staged Decoding, a simple decoding strategy that decouples RT and answer generation using separate LoRA adapters to maximize IF of each component. We evaluate our approach on six models from two families (1.7B-14B parameters), across two IF benchmarks and two privacy benchmarks. Our method yields substantial improvements, with gains of up to 20.9 points in IF and 51.9 percentage points on privacy benchmarks, though these can come at the cost of task utility due to the trade-off between reasoning performance and IF. Our results show that improving IF in LRMs can significantly enhance privacy, suggesting a promising direction for future privacy-aware LRMs. Our code is available at https://github.com/UKPLab/arxiv2026-controllable-reasoning-models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出可控推理模型（LRM）中的隐私泄露问题，通过改进推理过程中的指令跟随能力来减少敏感信息泄露。作者构建SFT数据集并引入分段解码（Staged Decoding）策略，将推理链和答案生成解耦并分别优化。在6个模型上评估，指令跟随提升最高20.9点，隐私基准提升51.9百分点，但可能牺牲任务效用。
Motivation: 大型推理模型生成的推理轨迹常包含敏感信息，且难以通过显式隐私指令控制，存在通过提示注入攻击泄露隐私的风险。
Method: 提出两阶段方法：1）构建SFT数据集教会模型在推理过程中遵循通用指令；2）Staged Decoding策略，使用分离的LoRA适配器分别优化推理链和答案生成的指令跟随能力。
Result: 在6个模型（1.7B-14B参数）上评估，指令跟随提升最高20.9点，隐私基准提升51.9百分点，但可能以牺牲任务效用为代价。
Conclusion: 结果表明提升LRM的指令跟随能力可显著增强隐私保护，为未来隐私感知推理模型提供了方向。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Mollified Value Learning
papers.abstract_en: Offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL) learns goal-reaching behaviors from static datasets, but accurate value estimation remains challenging under limited state-action coverage. Existing physics-informed approaches address this by imposing pointwise distance-like geometric constraints derived from Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman (HJB) optimality principles, often through first-order partial differential equations such as the Eikonal equation. However, enforcing local consistency through explicit differential structure can become unstable in complex, high-dimensional environments. Our key insight is to instead reinterpret distance-like constraints as an expectation over a local spatial measure. By aggregating constraints over this measure rather than evaluating them pointwise, the objective acts as a spatial mollifier, inducing distance-like value geometry without requiring expensive differential operators. We refer to this as Mollified Value Learning (MVL). Experiments across navigation and high-dimensional robotic manipulation tasks show that MVL learns structured, value representations, improving goal-reaching performance, when used with implicit value representation learning methods. Open-source codes are available at https://github.com/HrishikeshVish/MVL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文针对离线目标条件强化学习中值函数估计不准确的问题，提出一种新的方法Mollified Value Learning (MVL)。其核心思想是将距离约束重释为局部空间测度上的期望，通过空间磨光算子(mollifier)诱导值函数距离几何，避免传统基于Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman偏微分方程方法的不稳定性。实验表明，在导航和高维机器人操作任务中，MVL能够学习结构化的值表示，并提升目标达成性能。
Motivation: 现有的基于物理信息的方法（如Eikonal方程）虽能强制值函数满足几何约束，但在复杂高维环境中局部一致性约束不稳定，需要更鲁棒的方式。
Method: 提出MVL，将距离约束转化为局部空间测度上的期望形式，从而作为空间磨光子聚合约束，无需昂贵微分算子即可诱导距离几何。
Result: 在导航和高维机器人操作任务上，MVL与隐式值表示学习方法结合使用时，改善了目标达成性能。
Conclusion: MVL通过空间磨光子的方式有效地学习到结构化的值表示，为离线目标条件强化学习提供了一种稳定且高效的方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SPM-Bench: Benchmarking Large Language Models for Scanning Probe Microscopy
papers.abstract_en: As LLMs achieved breakthroughs in general reasoning, their proficiency in specialized scientific domains reveals pronounced gaps in existing benchmarks due to data contamination, insufficient complexity, and prohibitive human labor costs. Here we present SPM-Bench, an original, PhD-level multimodal benchmark specifically designed for scanning probe microscopy (SPM). We propose a fully automated data synthesis pipeline that ensures both high authority and low-cost. By employing Anchor-Gated Sieve (AGS) technology, we efficiently extract high-value image-text pairs from arXiv and journal papers published between 2023 and 2025. Through a hybrid cloud-local architecture where VLMs return only spatial coordinates "llbox" for local high-fidelity cropping, our pipeline achieves extreme token savings while maintaining high dataset purity. To accurately and objectively evaluate the performance of the LLMs, we introduce the Strict Imperfection Penalty F1 (SIP-F1) score. This metric not only establishes a rigorous capability hierarchy but also, for the first time, quantifies model "personalities" (Conservative, Aggressive, Gambler, or Wise). By correlating these results with model-reported confidence and perceived difficulty, we expose the true reasoning boundaries of current AI in complex physical scenarios. These insights establish SPM-Bench as a generalizable paradigm for automated scientific data synthesis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SPM-Bench，一个面向扫描探针显微镜的博士级多模态基准测试。通过Anchor-Gated Sieve (AGS)技术从论文中自动合成高价值图像文本对，并引入Strict Imperfection Penalty F1 (SIP-F1)评分以评估LLM能力，首次量化模型“个性”。摘要表明该基准可揭示AI在复杂物理场景中的推理边界。
Motivation: 现有LLM在专业科学领域（如扫描探针显微镜）的基准测试存在数据污染、复杂度不足和人力成本高的问题。
Method: 提出全自动数据合成管道，利用Anchor-Gated Sieve (AGS)提取高价值图像文本对，结合混合云-本地架构（VLM仅返回空间坐标llbox）实现token节省与高纯度，并设计SIP-F1评分指标。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值，但声称SIP-F1能建立能力层级并量化模型个性（保守、激进、赌徒、明智）。
Conclusion: SPM-Bench作为可推广的自动科学数据合成范式，通过与模型置信度和感知难度关联，暴露当前AI在复杂物理场景中的真实推理边界。

papers.title: HiPPO Zoo: Explicit Memory Mechanisms for Interpretable State Space Models
papers.abstract_en: Representing the past in a compressed, efficient, and informative manner is a central problem for systems trained on sequential data. The HiPPO framework, originally proposed by Gu & Dao et al., provides a principled approach to sequential compression by projecting signals onto orthogonal polynomial (OP) bases via structured linear ordinary differential equations. Subsequent works have embedded these dynamics in state space models (SSMs), where HiPPO structure serves as an initialization. Nonlinear successors of these SSM methods such as Mamba are state-of-the-art for many tasks with long-range dependencies, but the mechanisms by which they represent and prioritize history remain largely implicit. In this work, we revisit the HiPPO framework with the goal of making these mechanisms explicit. We show how polynomial representations of history can be extended to support capabilities of modern SSMs such as adaptive memory allocation and associative memory, while retaining direct interpretability in the OP basis. We introduce a unified framework comprising five such extensions, which we collectively refer to as a "HiPPO zoo." Each extension exposes a specific modeling capability through an explicit, interpretable modification of the HiPPO framework. The resulting models adapt their memory online and train in streaming settings with efficient updates. We illustrate the behaviors and modeling advantages of these extensions through a range of synthetic sequence modeling tasks, demonstrating that capabilities typically associated with modern SSMs can be realized through explicit, interpretable polynomial memory structures.

papers.title: Prompt Injection as Role Confusion
papers.abstract_en: LLMs see the world as a single stream of text, partitioned into roles like <user> or <tool>. We trace prompt injection to role confusion: models perceive the source of text from how it sounds, not its labeled role. A command hidden in a webpage hijacks an agent simply because it sounds like <user> text, despite its <tool> label. We design role probes to measure how LLMs internally perceive "who is speaking," and find that injected text occupies the same representational space as the trusted role it imitates. We demonstrate this with CoT Forgery, a zero-shot attack that injects fabricated reasoning into user prompts and tool outputs. Models mistake the forgery for their own thoughts, yielding 60% attack success against frontier models with near-zero baselines. Strikingly, the degree of role confusion predicts attack success before a single token is generated. This mechanism generalizes beyond CoT Forgery to standard agent prompt injections, revealing prompt injection as a measurable consequence of role perception. To the model, sounding like a role is indistinguishable from being one.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示大语言模型中的提示注入本质上是角色混淆问题：模型依赖文本风格而非标签来判断角色身份。作者设计角色探针测量模型内部对“谁在说话”的感知，并提出CoT Forgery（零样本攻击），通过伪造推理步骤注入文本，使模型误认为是自身思维，导致攻击成功率达到60%。该机制解释了标准提示注入攻击的原理，并表明角色混淆程度可在生成前预测攻击成功率。
Motivation: 现有提示注入防御缺乏对攻击根本机制的理解，论文揭示其背后是模型对角色标签的感知弱于对文本风格的依赖，从而产生角色混淆。
Method: 设计角色探针（role probes）分析模型内部表示中注入文本所处的角色空间；提出CoT Forgery，一种零样本攻击，将伪造的推理步骤插入用户提示和工具输出中，使模型混淆。
Result: 在多个前沿模型上，CoT Forgery实现了60%的攻击成功率，而基线接近零；角色混淆程度能够预测攻击成功率。
Conclusion: 提示注入是角色感知的可测量后果，模型无法区分“听起来像某个角色”和“真正是那个角色”，这一定位有助于未来防御设计。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: IAPO: Information-Aware Policy Optimization for Token-Efficient Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large language models increasingly rely on long chains of thought to improve accuracy, yet such gains come with substantial inference-time costs. We revisit token-efficient post-training and argue that existing sequence-level reward-shaping methods offer limited control over how reasoning effort is allocated across tokens. To bridge the gap, we propose IAPO, an information-theoretic post-training framework that assigns token-wise advantages based on each token's conditional mutual information (MI) with the final answer. This yields an explicit, principled mechanism for identifying informative reasoning steps and suppressing low-utility exploration. We provide a theoretical analysis showing that our IAPO can induce monotonic reductions in reasoning verbosity without harming correctness. Empirically, IAPO consistently improves reasoning accuracy while reducing reasoning length by up to 36%, outperforming existing token-efficient RL methods across various reasoning datasets. Extensive empirical evaluations demonstrate that information-aware advantage shaping is a powerful and general direction for token-efficient post-training. The code is available at https://github.com/YinhanHe123/IAPO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出信息感知策略优化框架 IAPO，通过基于每个token与最终答案的条件互信息分配token级优势，实现token高效的推理后训练。理论分析表明该方法能单调减少推理冗长而不损害正确性，实验显示在多个推理数据集上推理长度缩减达36%且准确率提升。
Motivation: 现有大型语言模型通过长思维链提升准确性，但带来显著推理成本，而序列级奖励塑形方法对token级推理努力分配控制有限。
Method: 提出信息论后训练框架IAPO，根据每个token与最终答案的条件互信息分配token级优势，从而识别信息性推理步骤并抑制低效用探索。
Result: 在多个推理数据集上，IAPO持续提升推理准确率，同时将推理长度减少最多36%，优于现有token高效强化学习方法。
Conclusion: 信息感知的优势塑形是一种强大且通用的token高效后训练方向，代码已开源。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: L2G-Net: Local to Global Spectral Graph Neural Networks via Cauchy Factorizations
papers.abstract_en: Despite their theoretical advantages, spectral methods based on the graph Fourier transform (GFT) are seldom used in graph neural networks (GNNs) due to the cost of computing the eigenbasis and the lack of vertex-domain locality in the resulting representations. As a result, most GNNs rely on local approximations such as polynomial Laplacian filters or message passing, which limit their ability to model long-range dependencies. In this paper, we introduce an exact factorization of the GFT into operators acting on subgraphs, which are then combined via a sequence of Cauchy matrices. Building on this factorization, we propose a new class of spectral GNNs, termed L2G-Net (Local to Global Net). Unlike existing spectral methods, which are either fully global (when using the GFT) or local (when using polynomial filters), L2G-Net operates by processing the spectral representations of subgraphs and then combining them via structured matrices. Our algorithm avoids full eigendecompositions, exploiting graph topology to construct the factorization with quadratic complexity in the number of nodes, scaled by the maximum cut size between subgraphs. Experiments stressing long-range dependencies on large graphs show that L2G-Net scales to regimes out of reach for the standard GFT, and is competitive with state-of-the-art methods with orders of magnitude fewer learnable parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于柯西分解的局部到全局谱图神经网络（L2G-Net），将图傅里叶变换精确分解为子图上的算子，再通过柯西矩阵序列组合，避免了完整的特征分解，同时保持了长距离依赖建模能力。实验表明，该网络在大图上的长距离依赖任务中可扩展到标准图傅里叶变换无法处理的规模，并以数量级更少的可学习参数达到与最先进方法竞争的性能。
Motivation: 现有谱方法（如基于图傅里叶变换）计算成本高且缺乏顶点域局部性，而局部逼近（如多项式滤波器或消息传递）难以建模长距离依赖，因此需要一种既保持局部性又能高效建模全局依赖的谱图神经网络。
Method: 引入图傅里叶变换的精确因子化，将其分解为作用在子图上的算子，并通过一系列柯西矩阵组合；基于此构建L2G-Net，该网络先处理子图谱表示，再通过结构化矩阵组合，计算复杂度为节点数的二次方乘以子图间最大割大小。
Result: 在强调长距离依赖的大图实验中，L2G-Net 能扩展到标准图傅里叶变换无法处理的数据规模，并以比最先进方法少几个数量级的可学习参数达到竞争性能。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了一种避免完整特征分解的谱GNN实现，理论上有望结合局部和全局信息，但摘要未提及局限或未来方向。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: On the "Induction Bias" in Sequence Models
papers.abstract_en: Despite the remarkable practical success of transformer-based language models, recent work has raised concerns about their ability to perform state tracking. In particular, a growing body of literature has shown this limitation primarily through failures in out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization, such as length extrapolation. In this work, we shift attention to the in-distribution implications of these limitations. We conduct a large-scale experimental study of the data efficiency of transformers and recurrent neural networks (RNNs) across multiple supervision regimes. We find that the amount of training data required by transformers grows much more rapidly with state-space size and sequence length than for RNNs. Furthermore, we analyze the extent to which learned state-tracking mechanisms are shared across different sequence lengths. We show that transformers exhibit negligible or even detrimental weight sharing across lengths, indicating that they learn length-specific solutions in isolation. In contrast, recurrent models exhibit effective amortized learning by sharing weights across lengths, allowing data from one sequence length to improve performance on others. Together, these results demonstrate that state tracking remains a fundamental challenge for transformers, even when training and evaluation distributions match.
papers.comment: Accepted to the International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过大规模实验研究Transformer和RNN在状态跟踪任务上的数据效率，发现Transformer所需训练数据量随状态空间大小和序列长度增长远快于RNN，且其跨长度的权重共享几乎不存在或有害，而RNN能有效共享权重。结果表明状态跟踪对Transformer仍是根本性挑战，即使训练和测试分布匹配时也是如此。
Motivation: 近期工作显示Transformer在状态跟踪上存在局限，但主要关注分布外泛化。本文转向研究分布内的影响，即数据效率和权重共享，以更全面理解这一挑战。
Method: 在多个监督机制下进行大规模实验，比较Transformer和RNN的数据效率，并分析跨序列长度权重共享的程度。
Result: Transformer所需训练数据量随状态空间大小和序列长度增长远快于RNN；Transformer的跨长度权重共享可忽略或有害，而RNN通过共享权重实现有效的跨长度学习。
Conclusion: 状态跟踪对Transformer仍是根本性挑战，即使训练和测试分布匹配时也如此；RNN的归纳偏差使其更有利于这类任务。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Asymptotically Optimal Sequential Testing with Markovian Data
papers.abstract_en: We study one-sided and $α$-correct sequential hypothesis testing for data generated by an ergodic, finite-state Markov chain. The null hypothesis is that the unknown transition matrix belongs to a prescribed set $P$ of stochastic matrices, and the alternative corresponds to a disjoint set $Q$. We establish a non-asymptotic instance-dependent lower bound on the expected stopping time of any valid sequential test under the alternative, which is asymptotically tight. Our novel analysis improves the existing lower bounds, which are either asymptotic or provably sub-optimal in this setting. Our lower bound incorporates both the stationary distribution and the transition structure induced by the unknown Markov chain. We further propose an optimal test whose expected stopping time matches this lower bound asymptotically as $α\to 0$. We illustrate the usefulness of our framework through applications to sequential detection of model misspecification in Markov Chain Monte Carlo and to testing structural properties, such as the linearity of transition dynamics, in Markov decision processes. Our findings yield a sharp and general characterization of optimal sequential testing procedures under Markovian dependence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对遍历有限状态马尔可夫链生成的数据，研究单边和α-正确的序贯假设检验。零假设为未知转移矩阵属于指定集合P，备择假设为不相交集合Q。作者建立了非渐近的实例相关下界，并证明其在备择假设下渐近紧，同时提出一个最优检验，其期望停时在α→0时匹配该下界。应用包括马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛中模型误设的序贯检测和马尔可夫决策过程中转移动态线性度等结构性质的检验。
Motivation: 现有序贯检验的下界要么是渐近的，要么在该设定下被证明是次优的，缺乏针对马尔可夫依赖数据的最优检验理论。
Method: 通过结合马尔可夫链的平稳分布和转移结构，推导出非渐近的实例相关下界，并设计一个与下界渐近匹配的最优检验。
Result: 得到在备择假设下任何有效序贯检验的期望停时的非渐近下界，该下界渐近紧；提出的最优检验在α→0时渐近达到该下界。
Conclusion: 该工作给出了马尔可夫依赖数据下最优序贯检验程序的尖锐且一般的刻画，并展示了在MCMC模型误设检测和MDP结构性质检验中的应用价值。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Position: Evaluation of ECG Representations Must Be Fixed
papers.abstract_en: This position paper argues that current benchmarking practice in 12-lead ECG representation learning must be fixed to ensure progress is reliable and aligned with clinically meaningful objectives. The field has largely converged on three public multi-label benchmarks (PTB-XL, CPSC2018, CSN) dominated by arrhythmia and waveform-morphology labels, even though the ECG is known to encode substantially broader clinical information. We argue that downstream evaluation should expand to include an assessment of structural heart disease and patient-level forecasting, in addition to other evolving ECG-related endpoints, as relevant clinical targets. Next, we outline evaluation best practices for multi-label, imbalanced settings, and show that when they are applied, the literature's current conclusion about which representations perform best is altered. Furthermore, we demonstrate the surprising result that a randomly initialized encoder with linear evaluation matches state-of-the-art pre-training on many tasks. This motivates the use of a random encoder as a reasonable baseline model. We substantiate our observations with an empirical evaluation of five representative ECG pre-training approaches across six evaluation settings: the three standard benchmarks, a structural disease dataset, hemodynamic inference, and patient forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该立场论文指出当前12导联心电图表征学习的基准评测存在局限，过度依赖少数多标签数据集（PTB-XL、CPSC2018、CSN），忽略了结构性心脏病、血流动力学推断及患者预测等更广泛的临床目标。作者提出评测最佳实践，并发现当正确应用这些实践时，文献中关于最优表征的结论会改变；且随机初始化编码器+线性评估在许多任务上匹配甚至超越预训练方法。实验涉及五种预训练方法在六个评测设置上的比较。
Motivation: 现有ECG表征学习评测集中于心律失常和波形形态标签，未能体现ECG编码的广泛临床信息，可能导致领域进展偏离临床相关目标。
Method: 提出评测最佳实践（如合适的优化器和学习率调度），并采用五种代表性ECG预训练方法在六个评测设置（三个标准基准+结构性心脏病、血流动力学推断、患者预测）上进行系统比较。
Result: 当采用正确评测实践时，现有结论改变；随机初始化编码器+线性评估在许多任务上表现与预训练方法相当甚至更优，表明预训练的必要性存疑。
Conclusion: 呼吁社区在ECG表征学习中使用扩展的评测基准和严格方法论，并将随机编码器作为合理基线。

papers.title: BAT: Better Audio Transformer Guided by Convex Gated Probing
papers.abstract_en: Probing is widely adopted in computer vision to faithfully evaluate self-supervised learning (SSL) embeddings, as finetuning may misrepresent their inherent quality. In contrast, audio SSL models still rely on finetuning because simple probing fails to unlock their full potential and alters their rankings when competing on AudioSet. Hence, a robust and efficient probing mechanism is required to guide the trajectory of audio SSL towards reliable and reproducible methods. We introduce Convex Gated Probing (CGP), a prototype-based method that significantly closes the gap between finetuning and probing in audio. CGP efficiently utilizes all frozen layers via a gating mechanism and exposes the location of latent task-relevant information. Guided by CGP as a reliable post-hoc evaluation probe, we rework the entire SSL pipeline of current best performing audio models that use legacy implementations of prior SSL methods. By refining data preprocessing, model architecture, and pretraining recipe, we introduce Better Audio Transformer (BAT), and establish new SOTA on audio benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于原型的凸门控探针（Convex Gated Probing, CGP），用于可靠评估音频自监督学习（SSL）嵌入，并通过该探针指导整个SSL流程的重新设计，最终推出Better Audio Transformer（BAT）并在多个音频基准上取得新最优结果。
Motivation: 音频SSL模型仍依赖微调来评估嵌入质量，简单探针无法发挥其全部潜力且会改变模型在AudioSet上的排名，因此需要一个鲁棒且高效的探针机制来引导音频SSL走向可靠和可复现的方法。
Method: 提出凸门控探针（CGP），一种基于原型的后验评估方法，利用门控机制高效使用所有冻结层，并揭示潜在任务相关信息的位置。在此基础上重新设计了现有最佳音频模型的整个SSL流程，包括数据预处理、模型架构和预训练方案，得到Better Audio Transformer（BAT）。
Result: CGP显著缩小了音频领域微调与探针之间的性能差距；由CGP指导的BAT在音频基准上建立了新的最先进水平。
Conclusion: CGP作为可靠的后验探针，能够有效指导音频SSL流程的改进，推动方法向更可靠和可复现的方向发展。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: CGP作为可靠的后验探针，能够有效指导音频SSL流程的改进，推动方法向更可靠和可复现的方向发展。

papers.title: HiPER: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning with Explicit Credit Assignment for Large Language Model Agents
papers.abstract_en: Training LLMs as interactive agents for multi-turn decision-making remains challenging, particularly in long-horizon tasks with sparse and delayed rewards, where agents must execute extended sequences of actions before receiving meaningful feedback. Most existing reinforcement learning (RL) approaches model LLM agents as flat policies operating at a single time scale, selecting one action at each turn. In sparse-reward settings, such flat policies must propagate credit across the entire trajectory without explicit temporal abstraction, which often leads to unstable optimization and inefficient credit assignment. We propose HiPER, a novel Hierarchical Plan-Execute RL framework that explicitly separates high-level planning from low-level execution. HiPER factorizes the policy into a high-level planner that proposes subgoals and a low-level executor that carries them out over multiple action steps. To align optimization with this structure, we introduce a key technique called hierarchical advantage estimation (HAE), which carefully assigns credit at both the planning and execution levels. By aggregating returns over the execution of each subgoal and coordinating updates across the two levels, HAE provides an unbiased gradient estimator and provably reduces variance compared to flat generalized advantage estimation. Empirically, HiPER achieves state-of-the-art performance on challenging interactive benchmarks, reaching 97.4\% success on ALFWorld and 83.3\% on WebShop with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct (+6.6\% and +8.3\% over the best prior method), with especially large gains on long-horizon tasks requiring multiple dependent subtasks. These results highlight the importance of explicit hierarchical decomposition for scalable RL training of multi-turn LLM agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HiPER，一个面向 LLM 智能体多轮决策的分层计划-执行强化学习框架。HiPER 将策略分解为高层规划器（提出子目标）和低层执行器（多步执行子目标），并引入分层优势估计（HAE）在规划与执行两层分别分配信用，证明比平坦策略的广义优势估计方差更低。在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上分别达到 97.4% 和 83.3% 的成功率，相比最佳先前方法提升 6.6% 和 8.3%，尤其在长时依赖任务上增益显著。
Motivation: 现有的平坦 RL 策略在稀疏奖励、长时域交互任务中，信用分配不稳定且优化困难，缺少时间抽象机制。
Method: 提出分层计划-执行框架 HiPER：高层规划器输出子目标，低层执行器多步执行；配合分层优势估计（HAE），通过聚合每个子目标执行期间的回报并协调两层级更新，得到无偏梯度估计并降低方差。
Result: 在 ALFWorld 上达到 97.4% 成功率，在 WebShop 上达到 83.3%，均优于此前最佳方法（分别提升 6.6% 和 8.3%），在需要多步子任务的长时间任务上增益尤其显著。
Conclusion: 显式的分层分解对于可扩展地训练多轮 LLM 智能体 RL 至关重要，HAE 提供理论方差降低和实际性能提升。

papers.title: Beyond ReLU: Bifurcation, Oversmoothing, and Topological Priors
papers.abstract_en: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) learn node representations through iterative network-based message-passing. While powerful, deep GNNs suffer from oversmoothing, where node features converge to a homogeneous, non-informative state. We re-frame this problem of representational collapse from a \emph{bifurcation theory} perspective, characterizing oversmoothing as convergence to a stable ``homogeneous fixed point.'' Our central contribution is the theoretical discovery that this undesired stability can be broken by replacing standard monotone activations (e.g., ReLU) with a class of functions. Using Lyapunov-Schmidt reduction, we analytically prove that this substitution induces a bifurcation that destabilizes the homogeneous state and creates a new pair of stable, non-homogeneous \emph{patterns} that provably resist oversmoothing. Our theory predicts a precise, nontrivial scaling law for the amplitude of these emergent patterns, which we quantitatively validate in experiments. Finally, we demonstrate the practical utility of our theory by deriving a closed-form, bifurcation-aware initialization and showing its utility in real benchmark experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 从分岔理论重新审视图神经网络中的过平滑问题，将过平滑视为收敛到稳定齐次不动点，理论发现通过替换标准单调激活函数（如ReLU）可以打破这种不稳定性，诱导分岔产生非齐次模式并抵抗过平滑，理论预测了幅度标度律并进行了实验验证，还推导了分岔感知初始化。
Motivation: 深层GNN存在过平滑问题，节点特征趋于同质化，丧失信息。现有方法缺乏从动力系统稳定性的理论视角。
Method: 引入分岔理论，使用Lyapunov-Schmidt约化证明替换单调激活函数可导致分岔，使齐次不动点失稳并产生新的稳定非齐次模式。
Result: 理论预测了这些涌现模式幅度的精确非平凡标度律，并通过实验定量验证。同时推导了闭式分岔感知初始化，在标准基准上展示了实用性。
Conclusion: 理论表明通过选择适当的非单调激活函数可以从根本上改变GNN的动力学，防止过平滑，并提供了可操作的设计原则。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: The Information Geometry of Softmax: Probing and Steering
papers.abstract_en: This paper concerns the question of how AI systems encode semantic structure into the geometric structure of their representation spaces. The motivating observation is that the natural geometry of these representation spaces should reflect the way models use representations to produce behavior. We focus on the important special case of representations that define softmax distributions. In this case, we argue that the natural geometry is information geometry. Our focus is on the role of information geometry on semantic encoding and the linear representation hypothesis. As an illustrative application, we develop "dual steering", a method for robustly steering representations to exhibit a particular concept using linear probes. We prove that dual steering optimally modifies the target concept while minimizing changes to off-target concepts. Empirically, we find that dual steering enhances the controllability and stability of concept manipulation.
papers.journal_ref: In Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究AI系统如何将语义结构编码到表示空间的几何结构中，聚焦于定义softmax分布的表示，论证其自然几何为信息几何。作为应用，提出“对偶引导”（dual steering）方法，通过线性探针鲁棒地引导表示展现特定概念，并证明该方法在优化目标概念修改的同时最小化对非目标概念的影响。实验表明对偶引导增强了概念操控的可控性和稳定性。
Motivation: 现有研究对表示空间的几何结构如何反映模型产生行为的方式缺乏深入理解，特别是对于定义softmax分布的表示，其自然几何尚未被充分探索。
Method: 从信息几何视角出发，针对softmax表示的语义编码和线性表示假设，提出“对偶引导”方法，利用线性探针在表示空间中引导特定概念，并给出理论最优性证明。
Result: 理论证明对偶引导在优化目标概念修改的同时最小化对非目标概念的影响；实验表明该方法增强了概念操控的可控性和稳定性。
Conclusion: 信息几何为理解softmax表示的语义编码提供了合理框架，对偶引导是一种鲁棒且理论上最优的概念操控技术。

papers.title: Neurosim: A Fast Simulator for Neuromorphic Robot Perception
papers.abstract_en: Neurosim is a fast, real-time, high-performance library for simulating sensors such as dynamic vision sensors, RGB cameras, depth sensors, and inertial sensors. It can also simulate agile dynamics of multi-rotor vehicles in complex and dynamic environments. Neurosim can achieve frame rates as high as ~2700 FPS on a desktop GPU. Neurosim integrates with a ZeroMQ-based communication library called Cortex to facilitate seamless integration with machine learning and robotics workflows. Cortex provides a high-throughput, low-latency message-passing system for Python and C++ applications, with native support for NumPy arrays and PyTorch tensors. This paper discusses the design philosophy behind Neurosim and Cortex. It demonstrates how they can be used to (i) train neuromorphic perception and control algorithms, e.g., using self-supervised learning on time-synchronized multi-modal data, and (ii) test real-time implementations of these algorithms in closed-loop. Neurosim and Cortex are available at https://github.com/grasp-lyrl/neurosim .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Neurosim 是一个用于神经形态机器人感知的快速模拟库，支持动态视觉传感器、RGB 相机、深度传感器和惯性传感器，以及多旋翼飞行器的敏捷动力学模拟，在桌面 GPU 上可达约 2700 FPS。集成了 Cortex 通信库用于机器学习与机器人工作流，支持自监督学习和闭环测试。
Motivation: 神经形态感知和控制在机器人领域快速发展，但缺乏能够高效模拟多模态传感器和动态环境的工具，导致算法开发与测试困难。
Method: 设计并实现 Neurosim 模拟器，结合基于 ZeroMQ 的 Cortex 通信库，提供高吞吐、低延迟的消息传递系统，原生支持 NumPy 数组和 PyTorch 张量，实现多传感器同步模拟与实时闭环控制。
Result: Neurosim 在桌面 GPU 上可实现约 2700 FPS 的模拟帧率，并成功用于训练神经形态感知与控制算法（如自监督学习）和测试实时闭环实现。
Conclusion: Neurosim 和 Cortex 可加速神经形态机器人算法的开发与部署，代码已开源。

papers.title: D-SECURE: Dual-Source Evidence Combination for Unified Reasoning in Misinformation Detection
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal misinformation increasingly mixes realistic im-age edits with fluent but misleading text, producing persuasive posts that are difficult to verify. Existing systems usually rely on a single evidence source. Content-based detectors identify local inconsistencies within an image and its caption but cannot determine global factual truth. Retrieval-based fact-checkers reason over external evidence but treat inputs as coarse claims and often miss subtle visual or textual manipulations. This separation creates failure cases where internally consistent fabrications bypass manipulation detectors and fact-checkers verify claims that contain pixel-level or token-level corruption. We present D-SECURE, a framework that combines internal manipulation detection with external evidence-based reasoning for news-style posts. D-SECURE integrates the HAMMER manipulation detector with the DEFAME retrieval pipeline. DEFAME performs broad verification, and HAMMER analyses residual or uncertain cases that may contain fine-grained edits. Experiments on DGM4 and ClaimReview samples highlight the complementary strengths of both systems and motivate their fusion. We provide a unified, explainable report that incorporates manipulation cues and external evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出D-SECURE框架，结合内部篡改检测（HAMMER）和外部证据推理（DEFAME）来检测多模态虚假新闻帖，实验在DGM4和ClaimReview数据集上展示了两种方法的互补性。
Motivation: 现有虚假信息检测系统通常仅依赖单一证据源，难以识别内部一致但经过精细篡改的多模态内容。
Method: 集成HAMMER篡改检测器与DEFAME检索管道，对可疑案例进行细粒度分析，并生成包含篡改线索和外部证据的统一可解释报告。
Result: 在DGM4和ClaimReview样本上验证了两种系统的互补优势，表明融合能提升检测效果。
Conclusion: D-SECURE通过结合内部和外部证据，为多模态虚假信息检测提供更全面的推理能力。

papers.title: DTBench: A Synthetic Benchmark for Document-to-Table Extraction
papers.abstract_en: Document-to-table (Doc2Table) extraction derives structured tables from unstructured documents under a target schema, enabling reliable and verifiable SQL-based data analytics. Although large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in flexible information extraction, their ability to produce precisely structured tables remains insufficiently understood, particularly for indirect extraction that requires complex capabilities such as reasoning and conflict resolution. Existing benchmarks neither explicitly distinguish nor comprehensively cover the diverse capabilities required in Doc2Table extraction. We argue that a capability-aware benchmark is essential for systematic evaluation. However, constructing such benchmarks using human-annotated document-table pairs is costly, difficult to scale, and limited in capability coverage. To address this, we adopt a reverse Table2Doc paradigm and design a multi-agent synthesis workflow to generate documents from ground-truth tables. Based on this approach, we present DTBench, a synthetic benchmark that adopts a proposed two-level taxonomy of Doc2Table capabilities, covering 5 major categories and 13 subcategories. We evaluate several mainstream LLMs on DTBench, and demonstrate substantial performance gaps across models, as well as persistent challenges in reasoning, faithfulness, and conflict resolution. DTBench provides a comprehensive testbed for data generation and evaluation, facilitating future research on Doc2Table extraction. The benchmark is publicly available at https://github.com/ZJU-DAILY/DTBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DTBench，一个用于文档到表格提取（Doc2Table）的合成基准测试。该基准采用逆向Table2Doc范式和多智能体合成工作流，从真实表格生成文档，并涵盖5大类13子类的能力分类。评估表明主流LLM在推理、忠实性和冲突解决方面仍存在显著性能差距。
Motivation: 现有基准缺乏对Doc2Table提取所需多样化能力的全面覆盖，且人工标注代价高、规模受限。因此需要一个能力感知的基准来系统评估LLM在结构化表格提取中的表现。
Method: 采用逆向Table2Doc范式，设计多智能体合成工作流，从真实表格生成文档，并构建两级能力分类体系（5大类13子类）。
Result: 在DTBench上评估多个主流LLM，发现模型间存在显著性能差距，且在推理、忠实性和冲突解决等能力上持续存在挑战。
Conclusion: DTBench为Doc2Table提取提供了综合性的数据生成和评估测试平台，有助于推动该领域的未来研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Cross-Chirality Generalization by Axial Vectors for Hetero-Chiral Protein-Peptide Interaction Design
papers.abstract_en: D-peptide binders targeting L-proteins have promising therapeutic potential. Despite rapid advances in machine learning-based target-conditioned peptide design, generating D-peptide binders remains largely unexplored. In this work, we show that by injecting axial features to $E(3)$-equivariant (polar) vector features, it is feasible to achieve cross-chirality generalization from homo-chiral (L--L) training data to hetero-chiral (D--L) design tasks. By implementing this method within a latent diffusion model, we achieved D-peptide binder design that not only outperforms existing tools in \textit{in silico} benchmarks, but also demonstrates efficacy in wet-lab validation. To our knowledge, our approach represents the first wet-lab validated generative AI for the \textit{de novo} design of D-peptide binders, offering new perspectives on handling chirality in protein design. Codes are available at https://github.com/YZY010418/PepMirror

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出通过向E(3)-等变（极）向量特征中注入轴向特征，实现从同手性（L-L）训练数据到异手性（D-L）设计任务的跨手性泛化。将该方法集成到潜扩散模型中，实现了D-肽配体的从头设计，在in silico基准测试中优于现有工具，并通过湿实验验证了有效性。据作者所知，这是首个经湿实验验证的生成式AI用于从头设计D-肽配体。
Motivation: D-肽配体靶向L-蛋白具有治疗潜力，但现有机器学习方法主要针对L-肽配体设计，生成D-肽配体的问题尚未得到充分探索。
Method: 在E(3)-等变（极）向量特征的基础上注入轴向特征，使模型能够从同手性数据中学习并泛化到异手性任务；将该机制嵌入潜扩散模型，实现条件化的D-肽配体生成。
Result: 在in silico基准测试中，该方法设计的D-肽配体性能优于现有工具，且通过湿实验验证了其实际效果。
Conclusion: 本文首次展示了湿实验验证的生成式AI用于从头设计D-肽配体，为蛋白质设计中的手性处理提供了新视角。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SCOPE: Selective Conformal Optimized Pairwise LLM Judging
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as scalable judges in pairwise evaluation, but they remain prone to miscalibration and biases. We propose SCOPE (Selective Conformal Optimized Pairwise Evaluation), a framework that calibrates an acceptance threshold so that, under exchangeability, the error rate among non-abstained judgments is at most a user-specified level $α$. To supply SCOPE with a bias-neutral uncertainty signal, we introduce Bidirectional Preference Entropy (BPE), which queries the judge under both response positions and converts the order-averaged preference probability into an entropy-based score. Across various pairwise judging benchmarks, BPE outperforms standard confidence proxies in calibration and discrimination, while SCOPE consistently satisfies the target risk bound (empirical FDR $\approx 0.097$ to $0.099$ at $α= 0.10$) and retains substantial coverage. Compared to vanilla baselines, SCOPE accepts up to $2.4\times$ more judgments under the same risk constraint, demonstrating that BPE enables reliable and high-coverage LLM-based evaluation.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026. 23 pages (9 main plus appendix), 7 figures, 11 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SCOPE 框架，利用共形预测 (conformal prediction) 校准 LLM 在成对评估中的接受阈值，使非弃权判断的错误率控制在用户指定的水平 α 下。为了提供无偏的不确定性信号，引入双向偏好熵 (Bidirectional Preference Entropy, BPE)，通过交换响应位置并取偏好概率的熵值。实验表明 BPE 在多个成对评估基准上优于标准置信度代理，SCOPE 在 α=0.10 时经验 FDR 约 0.097–0.099，且保留高覆盖率；与基线相比，相同风险约束下接受的判断最多增加 2.4 倍。
Motivation: LLM 作为可扩展评判者时易出现偏差和错误校准，需要可靠的不确定性量化方法以保证评估的可靠性。
Method: 提出 SCOPE，基于共形预测设置选择性接受阈值，确保非弃权判断的错误率不超过 α；同时提出 BPE，通过查询评判者在两种响应顺序下的偏好概率并计算其熵值作为不确定性信号。
Result: 在多个成对评估基准上，BPE 在校准和区分度上优于标准置信度代理；SCOPE 在 α=0.10 时经验 FDR 约 0.097–0.099，并保留高覆盖率；相比不加选择的基线，在相同风险约束下接受的判断数量最多提升 2.4 倍。
Conclusion: SCOPE 结合 BPE 能够实现可靠且高覆盖率的 LLM 成对评估，为 LLM 作为评判者提供风险可控的部署方案。

papers.title: Memory-Efficient Structured Backpropagation for On-Device LLM Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: On-device fine-tuning enables privacy-preserving personalization of large language models, but mobile devices impose severe memory constraints, typically 6--12GB shared across all workloads. Existing approaches force a trade-off between exact gradients with high memory (MeBP) and low memory with noisy estimates (MeZO). We propose Memory-efficient Structured Backpropagation (MeSP), which bridges this gap by manually deriving backward passes that exploit LoRA's low-rank structure. Our key insight is that the intermediate projection $h = xA$ can be recomputed during backward at minimal cost since rank $r \ll d_{in}$, eliminating the need to store it. MeSP achieves 49\% average memory reduction compared to MeBP on Qwen2.5 models (0.5B--3B) while computing mathematically identical gradients. Our analysis also reveals that MeZO's gradient estimates show near-zero correlation with true gradients (cosine similarity $\approx$0.001), explaining its slow convergence. MeSP reduces peak memory from 361MB to 136MB for Qwen2.5-0.5B, enabling fine-tuning scenarios previously infeasible on memory-constrained devices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Memory-efficient Structured Backpropagation (MeSP)，利用LoRA的低秩结构手动推导反向传播过程，通过重计算中间投影来减少内存占用。在Qwen2.5模型（0.5B-3B）上，MeSP相比MeBP平均减少49%内存，同时计算数学上恒等的梯度。实验表明MeZO的梯度估计与真实梯度相关性极低（余弦相似度≈0.001），解释了其收敛缓慢的原因。MeSP将Qwen2.5-0.5B的峰值内存从361MB降至136MB，使得内存受限设备上的微调成为可能。
Motivation: 设备端LLM微调面临严格的内存限制（通常6-12GB），现有方法（MeBP）内存高或（MeZO）梯度估计有噪声，缺乏平衡方案。
Method: 手动推导LoRA微调的反向传播，利用秩r远小于输入维度d_in，在反向传播中以极低成本重计算中间投影h=xA，避免存储该张量。
Result: 在Qwen2.5（0.5B-3B）上，MeSP相比MeBP平均减少49%内存；对于Qwen2.5-0.5B，峰值内存从361MB降至136MB，且梯度数学上等价于MeBP。
Conclusion: MeSP在内存效率和梯度准确性之间取得平衡，使内存受限设备上的精确梯度微调变得可行；同时揭示MeZO梯度估计的低相关性是其收敛慢的原因。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Provably Convergent Actor-Critic for MARL through Risk-aversion
papers.abstract_en: Learning stationary policies in infinite-horizon general-sum Markov games (MGs) remains a fundamental open problem in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL). While stationary strategies are preferred for their practicality, computing stationary forms of classic game-theoretic equilibria is computationally intractable -- a stark contrast to the comparative ease of solving single-agent RL or zero-sum games. To bridge this gap, we study Risk-averse Quantal response Equilibria (RQE), a solution concept rooted in behavioral game theory that incorporates risk aversion and bounded rationality. We demonstrate that RQE possesses strong regularity conditions that make it uniquely amenable to learning in MGs. We propose a novel single-timescale Actor-Critic algorithm characterized by a faster actor and a slower critic. Leveraging the regularity of RQE, we prove that this approach achieves global convergence with finite-sample guarantees. We empirically validate our algorithm in several environments to demonstrate superior convergence properties compared to risk-neutral baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无限时域一般和马尔可夫博弈中学习平稳策略的难题，引入风险厌恶的量化反应均衡（RQE），提出单时间尺度的演员-评论家算法，并证明其全局收敛性和有限样本保证。实验表明比风险中性基线有更好的收敛性。
Motivation: 现有MARL中计算平稳均衡策略在计算上困难，而单智能体或零和博弈相对容易；本文希望利用行为博弈论中引入风险厌恶和有界理性的RQE概念来填补这一空白。
Method: 提出一种单时间尺度演员-评论家算法，其中演员更新更快，评论家更新更慢，并利用RQE的规律性来证明收敛。
Result: 理论证明全局收敛且有有限样本保证；实验显示在多个环境中优于风险中性基线。
Conclusion: RQE概念具有良好的规律性，适用于多智能体学习，本算法有效收敛。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Structural Bias Beyond Homophily: A Study of Fairness in Link Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Graph link prediction (LP) plays a critical role in socially impactful applications such as job recommendation and friendship formation, making fairness a critical concern in this task. While many fairness-aware methods manipulate graph structures to mitigate prediction disparities, the topological biases inherent to social graphs remain poorly understood and are consistently conflated with homophily alone. In this work, we study the relationship between structural biases and fairness outcomes in LP. To this end, we formalize a taxonomy of topological bias measures and introduce a graph generation method producing a diverse corpus of synthetic graphs with controlled structural properties. Using this corpus, we show empirically that fairness outcomes are strongly correlated with graph topology, and that current fairness-aware methods remain sensitive to structural biases beyond homophily. These findings highlight the need for structurally grounded evaluations in fair graph learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究图链接预测中的结构性偏差与公平性之间的关系，超越同质性（homophily）的视角。作者形式化定义了一组拓扑偏差度量，并提出一种图生成方法，可生成具有受控结构属性的多样化合成图。实验表明，公平性结果与图拓扑强相关，且现有公平性感知方法仍对同质性之外的结构偏差敏感。
Motivation: 现有公平性方法多通过操纵图结构来缓解预测差异，但社会图中的拓扑偏差仍未被充分理解，且常被简单归因于同质性。论文旨在揭示结构性偏差（不限于同质性）如何影响链接预测的公平性。
Method: 提出一个拓扑偏差度量的分类体系，并设计一种图生成方法，可生成具有可控结构属性的合成图语料库。利用该语料库进行实证分析，研究图拓扑与公平性结果的关系。
Result: 实验发现公平性结果与图拓扑强相关，且现有公平性感知方法对同质性之外的结构偏差仍然敏感。
Conclusion: 研究强调了在公平图学习中需要进行基于结构的评估，提示未来方法应更全面地考虑拓扑偏差。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Protein Language Model Embeddings Improve Generalization of Implicit Transfer Operators
papers.abstract_en: Molecular dynamics (MD) is a central computational tool in physics, chemistry, and biology, enabling quantitative prediction of experimental observables as expectations over high-dimensional molecular distributions such as Boltzmann distributions and transition densities. However, conventional MD is fundamentally limited by the high computational cost required to generate independent samples. Generative molecular dynamics (GenMD) has recently emerged as an alternative, learning surrogates of molecular distributions either from data or through interaction with energy models. While these methods enable efficient sampling, their transferability across molecular systems is often limited. In this work, we show that incorporating auxiliary sources of information can improve the data efficiency and generalization of transferable implicit transfer operators (TITO) for molecular dynamics. We find that coarse-grained TITO models are substantially more data-efficient than Boltzmann Emulators, and that incorporating protein language model (pLM) embeddings further improves out-of-distribution generalization. Our approach, PLaTITO, achieves state-of-the-art performance on equilibrium sampling benchmarks for out-of-distribution protein systems, including fast-folding proteins. We further study the impact of additional conditioning signals such as structural embeddings, temperature, and large-language-model-derived embeddings on model performance.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 14 figures and 11 tables, Accepted at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PLaTITO方法，将蛋白质语言模型（pLM）嵌入整合到可迁移隐式传递算子（TITO）中，以提高分子动力学模拟的数据效率和跨系统泛化能力。在平衡采样基准上，尤其是对分布外蛋白质系统（包括快速折叠蛋白），达到了最先进性能。
Motivation: 传统分子动力学（MD）计算成本高，生成式MD（GenMD）虽能高效采样，但跨分子系统的迁移性有限。本文旨在通过引入辅助信息源（如pLM嵌入）来改善泛化能力。
Method: 将粗粒化TITO模型与蛋白质语言模型嵌入相结合，并研究了结构嵌入、温度和大语言模型衍生嵌入等额外条件信号的影响。
Result: 在分布外蛋白质系统的平衡采样基准上达到最先进性能，且粗粒化TITO模型比玻尔兹曼仿真器（Boltzmann Emulators）更数据高效。
Conclusion: 整合蛋白质语言模型嵌入可以显著提高隐式迁移算子的泛化能力，为分子动力学模拟提供更高效且可迁移的方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Token-Efficient Change Detection in LLM APIs
papers.abstract_en: Remote change detection in LLMs is a difficult problem. Existing methods are either too expensive for deployment at scale, or require initial white-box access to model weights or grey-box access to log probabilities. We aim to achieve both low cost and strict black-box operation, observing only output tokens. Our approach hinges on specific inputs we call Border Inputs, for which there exists more than one output top token. From a statistical perspective, optimal change detection depends on the model's Jacobian and the Fisher information of the output distribution. Analyzing these quantities in low-temperature regimes shows that border inputs enable powerful change detection tests. Building on this insight, we propose the Black-Box Border Input Tracking (B3IT) scheme. Extensive in-vivo and in-vitro experiments show that border inputs are easily found for non-reasoning tested endpoints, and achieve performance on par with the best available grey-box approaches. B3IT reduces costs by $30\times$ compared to existing methods, while operating in a strict black-box setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM API的远程变化检测问题，提出了一种低成本、严格黑盒的检测方案B3IT。该方法利用称为Border Inputs的特定输入（存在多个输出top token），基于模型雅可比和Fisher信息分析，在低温度下实现高效变化检测。实验表明，B3IT在非推理端点易找到Border Inputs，性能与最佳灰盒方法相当，成本降低30倍。
Motivation: 现有LLM变化检测方法要么部署成本高，要么需要白盒或灰盒访问（模型权重或log概率），缺乏同时满足低成本和严格黑盒操作（仅观察输出token）的方案。
Method: 提出Border Inputs概念（存在多个输出top token的输入），从统计学角度分析最优变化检测依赖于模型雅可比和输出分布的Fisher信息，在低温度下Border Inputs可实现强检测。基于此设计B3IT（黑盒Border Input跟踪）方案。
Result: 实验表明Border Inputs在非推理端点易找到，B3IT性能与最佳灰盒方法相当，成本降低30倍。
Conclusion: B3IT实现了低成本、严格黑盒的LLM变化检测，适用于大规模部署。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: DeepImageSearch: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents for Context-Aware Image Retrieval in Visual Histories
papers.abstract_en: Existing multimodal retrieval systems excel at semantic matching but implicitly assume that query-image relevance can be measured in isolation. This paradigm overlooks the rich dependencies inherent in realistic visual streams, where information is distributed across temporal sequences rather than confined to single snapshots. To bridge this gap, we introduce DeepImageSearch, a novel agentic paradigm that reformulates image retrieval as an autonomous exploration task. Models must plan and perform multi-step reasoning over raw visual histories to locate targets based on implicit contextual cues. We construct DISBench, a challenging benchmark built on interconnected visual data. To address the scalability challenge of creating context-dependent queries, we propose a human-model collaborative pipeline that employs vision-language models to mine latent spatiotemporal associations, effectively offloading intensive context discovery before human verification. Furthermore, we build a robust baseline using a modular agent framework equipped with fine-grained tools and a dual-memory system for long-horizon navigation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DISBench poses significant challenges to state-of-the-art models, highlighting the necessity of incorporating agentic reasoning into next-generation retrieval systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个名为 DeepImageSearch 的智能体范式，将图像检索重新定义为自主探索任务，要求模型在原始视觉历史序列中进行多步推理以定位目标。为此构建了 DISBench 基准，并采用人类-模型协作流水线生成上下文依赖的查询。实验表明该基准对现有模型构成显著挑战，凸显了在下一代检索系统中引入智能体推理的必要性。
Motivation: 现有多模态检索系统假设查询-图像相关性可孤立度量，忽略了现实视觉流中跨时间序列的依赖关系。
Method: 提出智能体化范式 DeepImageSearch，配备细粒度工具和双记忆系统进行长程导航；通过视觉语言模型挖掘潜在时空关联并辅以人工验证来构建 DISBench 基准。
Result: 实验表明 DISBench 对最先进模型构成显著挑战，证明需要智能体推理。
Conclusion: 强调了在下一代检索系统中融入智能体推理的必要性。

papers.title: Less is Enough: Synthesizing Diverse Data in LLM Feature Space with Sparse Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: The diversity of post-training data is critical for effective downstream performance in large language models (LLMs). Many existing approaches to constructing post-training data quantify diversity using text-based metrics that capture linguistic variation, but such metrics provide only weak signals for the task-relevant features that determine downstream performance. In this work, we introduce Feature Activation Coverage (FAC) which measures data diversity in an interpretable feature space. Building upon this metric, we further propose a diversity-driven data synthesis framework, named FAC Synthesis, that first uses a sparse autoencoder to identify missing features from a seed dataset, and then generates synthetic samples that explicitly reflect these features. Experiments show that our approach consistently improves both data diversity and downstream performance on various tasks, including instruction following, toxicity detection, reward modeling, and behavior steering. Interestingly, we identify a shared, interpretable feature space across model families (i.e., LLaMA, Mistral, and Qwen), enabling cross-model knowledge transfer. Our work provides a solid and practical methodology for exploring data-centric optimization of LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出特征激活覆盖率（FAC）度量，用于在可解释的特征空间中衡量大语言模型后训练数据的多样性。基于此，设计了FAC Synthesis框架，利用稀疏自编码器识别种子数据集中缺失的特征，并生成反映这些特征的合成样本。实验表明该方法在指令遵循、毒性检测、奖励建模和行为引导等任务上提升了数据多样性和下游性能，并发现不同模型系列之间存在共享的可解释特征空间。
Motivation: 现有后训练数据构建方法使用基于文本的多样性度量，这些度量对任务相关特征的捕捉能力弱，难以有效提升下游性能。需要一种更直接度量特征空间多样性的方法。
Method: 提出特征激活覆盖率（FAC）度量数据在稀疏自编码器学习到的可解释特征空间中的多样性；基于FAC构建数据合成框架FAC Synthesis，先通过种子数据缺失的特征确定需要补充的方向，再生成显式反映这些特征的合成样本。
Result: 在指令跟随、毒性检测、奖励建模和行为引导等多个任务上，FAC Synthesis持续提升了数据多样性和下游性能。不同模型系列（LLaMA、Mistral、Qwen）间存在共享的可解释特征空间，支持跨模型知识迁移。
Conclusion: 该工作为LLM的数据中心优化提供了基于可解释特征空间的实用方法论，但实验范围限于后训练阶段，且合成数据的真实性与安全性有待进一步验证。

papers.title: KernelCraft: Benchmarking for Agentic Close-to-Metal Kernel Generation on Emerging Hardware
papers.abstract_en: New AI accelerators with novel instruction set architectures (ISAs) often require developers to manually craft low-level kernels, a time-consuming and error-prone process that does not scale across hardware targets. This delays emerging hardware platforms from reaching the market. While prior LLM-based code generation has shown promise in mature GPU ecosystems, it remains unclear whether agentic LLM systems can quickly produce valid and efficient kernels for emerging hardware with new ISAs. We present KernelCraft: the first benchmark for evaluating an LLM agent's ability to generate and optimize low-level kernels for customized accelerators through a function-calling, feedback-driven workflow. We evaluate agent performance across three emerging accelerators on more than 20 machine-learning tasks, each with five diverse task configurations. Across four leading reasoning models, the strongest agents generate functionally correct kernels for unseen ISAs within a few refinement steps and produce optimized kernels that match or outperform compiler baselines. These results demonstrate KernelCraft's potential to accelerate the accelerator chip development cycle. KernelCraft is available at https://kernelcraft-cam.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出KernelCraft基准，用于评估大语言模型（LLM）智能体在新兴硬件指令集架构（ISA）上生成和优化底层内核的能力。通过函数调用和反馈驱动的工作流，在三个新兴加速器和20多个机器学习任务上测试，发现最强智能体能在几步内生成功能正确的内核，并匹配或超越编译器基线。
Motivation: 新兴AI加速器具有新颖ISA，需要手动编写底层内核，耗时且易错，阻碍硬件快速上市。现有LLM代码生成在成熟GPU生态中有效，但在新ISA上是否快速生成有效内核尚不清楚。
Method: 提出KernelCraft基准，采用函数调用和反馈驱动的工作流，让LLM智能体通过多轮交互生成和优化内核，并在多个新兴加速器和任务配置上评估。
Result: 在四个领先推理模型上，最强智能体在几步内生成功能正确的内核，优化后的内核匹配或超越编译器基线。
Conclusion: KernelCraft展示了LLM智能体加速新兴硬件开发周期的潜力，基准和代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Global Landscape of Environmental AI Regulation: From the Cost of Reasoning to a Right to Green AI
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) systems impose substantial and growing environmental costs, yet transparency about these impacts has declined even as their deployment has accelerated. This paper makes three contributions. First, we collate empirical evidence that generative Web search and reasoning models - which have proliferated in 2025 - come with much higher cumulative environmental impacts than previous generations of AI approaches. Second, we map the global regulatory landscape across eleven jurisdictions and find that the manner in which environmental governance operates (predominantly at the facility-level rather than the model-level, with a focus on training rather than inference, with limited AI-specific energy disclosure requirements outside the EU) limits its applicability. Third, to address this, we propose a three-pronged policy response: mandatory model-level transparency that covers inference consumption, benchmarks, and compute locations; user rights to opt out of unnecessary generative AI integration and to select environmentally optimized models; and international coordination to prevent regulatory arbitrage. We conclude with concrete legislative proposals - including amendments to the EU AI Act, Consumer Rights Directive, and Digital Services Act - that could serve as templates for other jurisdictions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出AI系统环境成本巨大且快速增长，但透明度下降。作者收集证据表明2025年激增的生成式搜索和推理模型环境影响远高于前代模型，调研全球11个司法管辖区的监管现状发现现有环境治理主要在设施层面而非模型层面、聚焦训练而非推理、且缺乏针对性的能源披露要求，因此提出三管齐下的政策建议：强制模型级透明度（涵盖推理消耗、基准测试和计算位置）、用户选择权（退出不必要的生成式AI集成并选择环保优化模型）以及国际协调以防止监管套利，并给出具体立法提案。
Motivation: AI部署加速但环境成本透明度下降，现有监管在模型级、推理阶段和跨地区覆盖上存在显著缺口，亟需针对性政策。
Method: 汇总实证证据对比新旧AI模型的环境影响，系统梳理11个司法管辖区的环境监管框架，并基于此提出涵盖透明度、用户权利和国际协调的政策方案。
Result: 发现生成式搜索与推理模型的环境影响远高于早期AI方法；现有监管主要在设施层面、聚焦训练而非推理，且仅有欧盟有较具体的AI能源披露要求。
Conclusion: 需要强制模型级透明度、用户选择权及国际协调，并以欧盟AI法案、消费者权利指令和数字服务法的修订作为其他司法管辖区的模板。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Adaptive Physics Transformer with Fused Global-Local Attention for Subsurface Energy Systems
papers.abstract_en: The Earth's subsurface is a cornerstone of modern society, providing essential energy resources like hydrocarbons, geothermal, and minerals while serving as the primary reservoir for $CO_2$ sequestration. However, full physics numerical simulations of these systems are notoriously computationally expensive due to geological heterogeneity, high resolution requirements, and the tight coupling of physical processes with distinct propagation time scales. Here we propose the $\textbf{Adaptive Physics Transformer}$ (APT), a geometry-, mesh-, and physics-agnostic neural operator that explicitly addresses these challenges. APT fuses a graph-based encoder to extract high-resolution local heterogeneous features with a global attention mechanism to resolve long-range physical impacts. Our results demonstrate that APT outperforms state-of-the-art architectures in subsurface tasks across both regular and irregular grids with robust super-resolution capabilities. Notably, APT is the first architecture that learns directly from HR-adaptive mesh refinement simulations. We also demonstrate APT's favorable scaling behavior and cross-dataset learning capability, positioning it as a robust and scalable backbone for large-scale subsurface foundation model development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出自适应物理Transformer（APT），一种几何、网格和物理无关的神经算子，融合图编码器提取高分辨率局部异质特征与全局注意力机制解析长程物理影响，用于地下能源系统模拟。APT在规则和不规则网格上均优于现有架构，具备鲁棒的超分辨率能力，并首次直接从高分辨率自适应网格细化模拟中学习，展现出良好的扩展性和跨数据集学习能力。
Motivation: 地下能源系统全物理数值模拟因地质非均质性、高分辨率需求和物理过程时间尺度耦合而计算昂贵，现有方法难以兼顾局部特征与全局影响。
Method: APT融合基于图的编码器提取局部高分辨率异质特征，并结合全局注意力机制捕捉长程物理作用，采用几何、网格和物理无关的设计，可直接从高分辨率自适应网格细化（HR-adaptive mesh refinement）模拟中学习。
Result: APT在地下能源系统任务中，无论在规则网格还是不规则网格上均超越现有最先进架构，并展示了鲁棒的超分辨率能力、有利的扩展行为和跨数据集学习能力。
Conclusion: APT作为首个直接从自适应网格细化模拟中学习的神经算子，为大规模地下基础模型开发提供了鲁棒且可扩展的骨干架构。

summary_sections.method: APT融合基于图的编码器提取局部高分辨率异质特征，并结合全局注意力机制捕捉长程物理作用，采用几何、网格和物理无关的设计，可直接从高分辨率自适应网格细化（HR-adaptive mesh refinement）模拟中学习。

papers.title: Discovering Differences in Strategic Behavior Between Humans and LLMs
papers.abstract_en: As Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in social and strategic scenarios, it becomes critical to understand where and why their behavior diverges from that of humans. While behavioral game theory (BGT) provides a framework for analyzing behavior, existing models do not fully capture the idiosyncratic behavior of humans or black-box, non-human agents like LLMs. We employ AlphaEvolve, a cutting-edge program discovery tool, to directly discover interpretable models of human and LLM behavior from data, thereby enabling open-ended discovery of structural factors driving human and LLM behavior. Our analysis on iterated rock-paper-scissors reveals that frontier LLMs can be capable of deeper strategic behavior than humans. These results provide a foundation for understanding structural differences driving differences in human and LLM behavior in strategic interactions.

papers.title: Biases in the Blind Spot: Detecting What LLMs Fail to Mention
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) often provide chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning traces that appear plausible, but may hide internal biases. We call these unverbalized biases. Monitoring models via their stated reasoning is therefore unreliable, and existing bias evaluations typically require predefined categories and hand-crafted datasets. In this work, we introduce a fully automated, black-box pipeline for detecting task-specific unverbalized biases. Given a task dataset, the pipeline uses LLM autoraters to generate candidate bias concepts. It then tests each concept on progressively larger input samples by generating positive and negative variations, and applies statistical techniques for multiple testing and early stopping. A concept is flagged as an unverbalized bias if it yields statistically significant performance differences while not being cited as justification in the model's CoTs. We evaluate our pipeline across seven LLMs on three decision tasks (hiring, loan approval, and university admissions). Our technique automatically discovers previously unknown biases in these models (e.g., Spanish fluency, English proficiency, writing formality). In the same run, the pipeline also validates biases that were manually identified by prior work (gender, race, religion, ethnicity). More broadly, our proposed approach provides a practical, scalable path to automatic, more efficient, and broader task-specific unverbalized bias discovery.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种全自动黑盒流程，用于检测大型语言模型在决策任务中未在思维链中口头表达的内部偏见。该流程通过LLM评分器生成候选偏见概念，统计检验正负变体性能差异，并验证是否在推理中提及。在雇佣、贷款审批和大学录取任务上自动发现如西班牙语流利度等新偏见，同时复现已知的性别、种族等偏见。
Motivation: 现有偏见检测依赖预定义类别和手工数据集，且模型思维链可能隐藏内部偏见，导致监控不可靠。
Method: 提出全自动化黑盒流程：使用LLM评分器生成候选偏见概念，对每个概念生成正负变体进行统计检验，采用多重检验校正和早期停止，将性能显著差异且未在思维链中引用的概念标记为未表述偏见。
Result: 在七个LLM和三个决策任务上自动发现先前未知的偏见（如西班牙语流利度、英语熟练度、书写正式度），并验证了人工识别的已知偏见（性别、种族、宗教、民族）。
Conclusion: 本文方法提供了一种可扩展的自动化路径，用于更高效、更广泛地发现任务特定未表述偏见，无需预定义类别或手工数据集。

papers.title: Is Memorization Helpful or Harmful? Prior Information Sets the Threshold
papers.abstract_en: We examine the connection between training error and generalization error for arbitrary estimating procedures, working in an overparameterized linear model under general priors in a Bayesian setup. We find determining factors inherent to the prior distribution $π$, giving explicit conditions under which optimal generalization necessitates that the training error be (i) near interpolating relative to the noise size (i.e., memorization is necessary), or (ii) close to the noise level (i.e., overfitting is harmful). Remarkably, these phenomena occur when the noise reaches thresholds determined by the Fisher information and the variance parameters of the prior $π$.
papers.comment: 33 pages, 3 figures. Accepted to the Conference on Learning Theory (COLT) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在贝叶斯框架下的过参数化线性模型中，研究训练误差与泛化误差的关系，发现先验分布π的内在因素决定了最优泛化是否需要训练误差接近插值（记忆必要）还是接近噪声水平（过拟合有害），并且这些现象出现在噪声达到由Fisher信息和先验方差参数决定的阈值时。
Motivation: 理解记忆（训练误差接近0）对泛化是有益还是有害，取决于先验分布的特性，但现有理论缺乏对先验信息如何影响这一权衡的明确刻画。
Method: 在贝叶斯过参数化线性模型下，对任意估计程序，推导训练误差与泛化误差的关系，给出先验分布π下最优泛化所需训练误差的显式条件，涉及Fisher信息和先验方差。
Result: 发现当噪声达到由Fisher信息和先验方差参数决定的阈值时，记忆要么是必要的，要么是有害的；即存在明确的相变现象。
Conclusion: 先验信息决定了记忆对泛化的影响阈值，为理解过参数化模型中的记忆-泛化权衡提供了理论依据。

papers.title: How Far Can You Grow? Characterizing the Extrapolation Frontier of Graph Generative Models for Materials Science
papers.abstract_en: Every generative model for crystalline materials harbors a critical structure size beyond which its outputs become unreliable; we call this the extrapolation frontier. Despite its consequences for nanomaterial design, this frontier has never been systematically measured. We introduce RADII, a radius-resolved benchmark of ~75,000 crystal-derived nanoparticle structures (33-11,298 atoms) that treats radius as a continuous scaling knob, tracing generation quality from in- to out-of-distribution under leakage-free splits. Each model is conditioned on target composition and atom count, isolating geometric extrapolation as the evaluation variable. RADII provides frontier-specific diagnostics: per-radius error profiles pinpoint each architecture's scaling ceiling, surface-interior decomposition separates boundary from bulk failures, and cross-metric sequencing reveals which aspect of structural fidelity breaks first. Benchmarking five state-of-the-art architectures, we find that: (i) well-behaved models degrade by ~13% in global positional error beyond training radii, while divergent models show poor fidelity across scales, with local bond fidelity ranging from negligible degradation to over 2x error growth; (ii) no two architectures share a failure sequence, revealing the frontier as a multi-dimensional surface shaped by model family; and (iii) well-behaved models follow the expected geometric scaling exponent alpha ~ 1/3, whose in-distribution fit predicts out-of-distribution error, making frontiers forecastable. Scaling MatterGen to its published parameter count stabilizes sampling but does not close the frontier, while DiffCSP remains unstable at published scale. These findings establish output scale as a first-class evaluation axis for geometric generative models. Code and data: https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/RADII.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文引入RADII基准，包含约75,000个晶体衍生纳米颗粒结构（33-11,298个原子），按半径连续缩放，用于评估晶体材料生成模型在训练半径外的外推性能。测试五种最先进架构，发现：表现良好的模型在超出训练半径时全局位置误差增加约13%，而发散模型在所有尺度上保真度差；不同架构的失效序列各不相同；表现良好的模型遵循预期的几何标度指数α~1/3，其分布内拟合可预测分布外误差。
Motivation: 晶体材料生成模型在超出某个临界结构尺寸时输出不可靠，但这一外推边界此前未被系统测量，阻碍了纳米材料设计。
Method: 提出RADII基准，以半径为连续缩放变量，通过无泄漏分割追踪生成质量从分布内到分布外的变化；每个模型以目标成分和原子数为条件，隔离几何外推作为评估变量，并提供半径特定诊断（半径误差剖面、表面-内部分解、跨度量排序）。
Result: 表现良好的模型在超出训练半径时全局位置误差增加约13%，发散模型在所有尺度上保真度差，局部键合误差从可忽略到超过2倍增长；不同架构失效顺序不同；表现良好的模型遵循α~1/3的几何标度，分布内拟合可预测分布外误差。扩展MatterGen参数可稳定采样但未消除外推边界，DiffCSP在发布规模下仍不稳定。
Conclusion: 输出尺度应作为几何生成模型的第一类评估轴。

papers.title: A Behavioural and Representational Evaluation of Goal-Directedness in Language Model Agents
papers.abstract_en: Understanding an agent's goals helps explain and predict its behaviour, yet there is no established methodology for reliably attributing goals to agentic systems. We propose a framework for evaluating goal-directedness that integrates behavioural evaluation with interpretability-based analyses of models' internal representations. As a case study, we examine an LLM agent navigating a 2D grid world towards a goal state. Behaviourally, we evaluate the agent against optimal policies across varying grid sizes, obstacle densities, and goal structures, finding that performance scales with task difficulty while remaining robust to difficulty-preserving transformations and multi-goal structures. We then use probing methods to decode internal representations of the environment and multi-step action plans. We find that the LLM agent non-linearly encodes a coarse spatial map, preserving approximate task-relevant cues about its position and the goal location; that its actions are broadly consistent with these internal representations; and that reasoning reorganises them, shifting from spatial cues towards immediate action selection. Our findings support the view that introspective examination is required beyond behavioural evaluations to characterise how agents represent and pursue their objectives.
papers.comment: Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个评估语言模型智能体目标导向性的框架，结合行为评估与可解释性分析。以2D网格世界中的LLM智能体为例，行为上比较其与最优策略的表现，内部使用探针方法解码环境和动作计划。发现智能体非线性编码粗略空间地图，动作与内部表征一致，推理将表征从空间线索转向动作选择。结论是仅靠行为评估不足以刻画智能体的目标表征与追求。
Motivation: 当前缺乏可靠的方法论来归因智能体系统的目标，而理解智能体的目标对于解释和预测其行为至关重要。
Method: 提出集成行为评估与基于可解释性的内部表征分析的框架。行为上比较智能体与最优策略在不同网格大小、障碍密度和目标结构下的表现；内部使用探针方法解码环境表征和多步动作计划。
Result: 行为上，智能体性能随任务难度缩放，但对保持难度的变换和多目标结构具有鲁棒性。内部表征中，LLM智能体非线性编码粗略空间地图，保留近似任务相关线索；动作与内部表征一致；推理将表征从空间线索转向即时动作选择。
Conclusion: 仅靠行为评估不足以刻画智能体如何表示和追求目标，需要内省性检查。

papers.title: Breaking the Simplification Bottleneck in Amortized Neural Symbolic Regression
papers.abstract_en: Symbolic regression (SR) aims to discover interpretable analytical expressions that accurately describe observed data. Amortized SR promises to be much more efficient than the predominant genetic programming SR methods, but currently struggles to scale to realistic scientific complexity. We find that a key obstacle is the lack of a fast reduction of equivalent expressions to a concise normalized form. Amortized SR has addressed this with general-purpose Computer Algebra Systems (CAS) like SymPy, but the high computational cost severely limits training and inference speed. We propose SimpliPy, a rule-based simplification engine achieving a 100-fold speed-up over SymPy at comparable quality. This enables substantial improvements in amortized SR, including scalability to much larger training sets, more efficient use of the per-expression token budget, and systematic training set decontamination with respect to equivalent test expressions. We demonstrate these advantages in our Flash-ANSR framework, which achieves much better accuracy than amortized baselines (NeSymReS, E2E) on the FastSRB benchmark. Moreover, it performs on par with state-of-the-art direct optimization (PySR) while recovering more concise rather than more complex expressions with increasing inference budget.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现摊销神经符号回归中简化等效表达式到归一化形式的瓶颈，提出基于规则的简化引擎SimpliPy，其速度比SymPy快100倍且质量相当。将该引擎集成到Flash-ANSR框架中，在FastSRB基准上显著优于现有摊销基线（NeSymReS, E2E），并与直接优化方法PySR表现相当，同时能恢复更简洁的表达式。
Motivation: 现有摊销符号回归方法依赖通用计算机代数系统（如SymPy）进行表达式简化，计算成本高昂，限制了训练和推理速度，阻碍了扩展到真实科学复杂度。
Method: 提出SimpliPy，一个基于规则的简化引擎，实现比SymPy快100倍的速度，并集成到Flash-ANSR框架中。该方法还支持更大的训练集、更高效的token预算利用以及系统性的训练集去污染。
Result: 在FastSRB基准上，Flash-ANSR比NeSymReS和E2E等摊销基线取得更好准确率，与PySR表现相当。随着推理预算增加，Flash-ANSR能恢复更简洁而非更复杂的表达式。
Conclusion: SimpliPy有效解决了简化瓶颈，使摊销符号回归在速度和质量上接近直接优化方法，同时保持简洁性优势。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Inverting Data Transformations via Diffusion Sampling
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of transformation inversion on general Lie groups: a datum is transformed by an unknown group element, and the goal is to recover an inverse transformation that maps it back to the original data distribution. Such unknown transformations arise widely in machine learning and scientific modeling, where they can significantly distort observations. We take a probabilistic view and model the posterior over transformations as a Boltzmann distribution defined by an energy function on the data space. To sample from this posterior, we introduce a diffusion process on Lie groups that keeps all updates on-manifold and only requires computations in the associated Lie algebra. Our method, Transformation-Inverting Energy Diffusion (TIED), relies on a new trivialized target-score identity that enables efficient score-based sampling of the transformation posterior. As a key application, we focus on test-time equivariance, where the objective is to improve the robustness of pretrained neural networks to input transformations. Experiments on image homographies and PDE symmetries demonstrate that TIED can restore transformed inputs to the training distribution at test time, showing improved performance over strong canonicalization and sampling baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/jw9730/tied.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文研究一般李群上的变换逆问题：一个数据被未知群元素变换，目标是恢复逆变换以将数据映射回原始分布。作者提出变换逆能量扩散(TIED)方法，利用李群上的扩散过程和对数变换后验的分数匹配来采样后验。主要应用是测试时等变性，即提高预训练神经网络对输入变换的鲁棒性。实验表明TIED在图像单应性和PDE对称性上能恢复变换数据到训练分布，优于强规范化和采样基线。
Motivation: 未知变换广泛存在于机器学习和科学建模中，会显著扭曲观测数据。现有方法可能无法有效恢复逆变换，特别是对于一般李群上的变换。
Method: 采用概率观点，将变换后验建模为玻尔兹曼分布，由数据空间上的能量函数定义。引入李群上的扩散过程，所有更新保持流形上，仅需李代数计算。利用新的平凡化目标分数恒等式实现高效的基于分数的后验采样。
Result: 实验表明，在图像单应性和PDE对称性测试中，TIED能在测试时恢复变换输入到训练分布，展示出优于强规范化和采样基线的性能。
Conclusion: 论文提出了一种通用的变换逆方法，通过扩散采样在李群上恢复未知变换，并在测试时等变性任务中取得改进。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: A Kinetic Energy Perspective of Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Flow-based generative models can be viewed through a physics lens: sampling transports a particle from noise to data by integrating a learned velocity field, and each sample corresponds to a trajectory with its own dynamical effort. Motivated by classical mechanics, we introduce Kinetic Path Energy (KPE), an action-like, per-sample diagnostic that measures the accumulated kinetic effort along an ordinary differential equation (ODE) trajectory. Empirically, KPE exhibits two robust correspondences: {i} higher KPE predicts stronger semantic fidelity; {ii} high-KPE trajectories land in sparse representation regions. We further provide theoretical guarantees linking trajectory energy to data sparsity. Paradoxically, this correlation is non-monotonic. At sufficiently high energy, generation can degenerate into memorization. Leveraging the closed-form formula of empirical flow matching, we show that extreme energies drive trajectories toward near-copies of training examples. This yields a Goldilocks principle and motivates Kinetic Trajectory Shaping (KTS), a training-free two-phase inference strategy that boosts early motion and enforces a late-time soft landing, reducing memorization and improving generation quality across benchmark tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从经典力学视角分析基于流的生成模型，提出动能路径能量（KPE）作为每个样本轨迹的动力学诊断指标。实验表明KPE与语义保真度正相关，且高KPE轨迹落入稀疏表示区域；但极端高能量会导致记忆化。基于此提出无训练的两阶段推理策略动能轨迹塑形（KTS），通过增强早期运动并实现后期软着陆来减少记忆化、提升生成质量。
Motivation: 现有基于流的生成模型缺乏对每个样本轨迹动力学代价的定量诊断，且能量与生成质量的关系尚未被系统研究。
Method: 引入动能路径能量（KPE）度量ODE轨迹的累积动力学努力，并利用经验流匹配的闭式公式分析极端能量行为。基于此提出动能轨迹塑形（KTS），一种无需训练的两种相位推理策略。
Result: KPE与语义保真度稳健正相关，高KPE轨迹落入稀疏表示区域；但极端高能量导致生成退化为记忆化。KTS在基准任务上减少记忆化并提升生成质量。
Conclusion: 揭示了流匹配中能量与生成质量的非单调关系（金发姑娘原则），并提出一种实用的无需训练策略来平衡保真度与多样性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MedCoG: Maximizing LLM Inference Density in Medical Reasoning via Meta-Cognitive Regulation
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong potential in complex medical reasoning yet face diminishing gains under inference scaling laws. While existing studies augment LLMs with various knowledge types, it remains unclear how effectively the additional costs translate into accuracy. In this paper, we explore how meta-cognition of LLMs, i.e., their self-assessment of their own cognitive states, can regulate the reasoning process. Specifically, we propose MedCoG, a Medical Meta-Cognition Agent with Knowledge Graph, where the meta-cognitive assessments of task complexity, familiarity, and knowledge density dynamically regulate utilization of procedural, episodic, and factual knowledge. The LLM-centric on-demand reasoning aims to mitigate the diminishing returns under scaling law by (1) reducing costs via avoiding indiscriminate scaling, (2) improving accuracy via filtering out distractive knowledge. To validate this, we empirically characterize the scaling curve and introduce inference density to quantify inference efficiency. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of MedCoG on five hard sets of medical benchmarks, yielding 6.2x inference density. Furthermore, the Oracle study highlights the significant potential of meta-cognitive regulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MedCoG，一个基于知识图谱的医学元认知推理智能体，通过自评估任务复杂度、熟悉度和知识密度来动态调节程序性、情景性和事实性知识的利用，避免无差别缩放并过滤干扰知识，从而缓解推理缩放定律的收益递减。实验在五个医学基准上实现 6.2 倍的推理密度提升。
Motivation: 大型语言模型在复杂医学推理中面临推理缩放定律下的收益递减问题，现有方法通过增加知识类型提升性能但成本效益不明确，需要更高效的推理调控机制。
Method: 提出 MedCoG 框架，利用元认知评估（任务复杂度、熟悉度、知识密度）动态调节 LLM 对程序性、情景性和事实性知识的按需推理，并引入推理密度量化推理效率。
Result: 在五个医学基准上实现 6.2 倍的推理密度，Oracle 研究进一步验证了元认知调节的潜力。
Conclusion: 元认知调节能有效提升 LLM 在医学推理中的效率，避免缩放定律的边际递减，具有显著的应用前景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Thinking in Structures: Evaluating Spatial Intelligence in Constraint-Governed Spaces
papers.abstract_en: Spatial intelligence is crucial for vision--language models (VLMs), yet many scene-centric benchmarks evaluate unconstrained environments where a single image may admit multiple plausible 3D interpretations. We introduce SSI-Bench, a VQA benchmark for Structure-Centric Spatial Reasoning (SCSR) in constraint-governed spaces. Built from complex real-world 3D structures, it uses structural constraints from geometry, topology, and physical feasibility to make component relations more determinate from visual evidence. The benchmark contains 1,000 ranking questions spanning geometric and topological reasoning, where correct ordering requires resolving all candidate-wise 3D relations, imposing stronger demands on spatial understanding. It is created through a fully human-centered pipeline with over 400 researcher-hours of image curation, component annotation, and question design. Evaluating 31 VLMs reveals a large gap to humans: the best open-source model achieves 22.2% accuracy and the strongest closed-source model reaches 33.6%, while humans score 91.6%. Further results show that chain-of-thought reasoning brings only marginal gains, and error analysis reveals fundamental limitations in current models' spatial understanding within constraint-governed spaces. Project page: https://ssi-bench.github.io.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SSI-Bench，一个面向结构约束空间的空间推理VQA基准，包含1000道排序题，评估视觉语言模型在几何与拓扑推理上的能力。实验表明，最优开源模型准确率22.2%，强闭源模型33.6%，而人类达91.6%，链式思维推理仅带来微弱提升，揭示模型在约束空间中的根本性空间理解局限。
Motivation: 现有场景中心基准评估的是非约束环境，单张图像可能有多个合理的3D解释，缺乏对确定性空间关系的严格测试。
Method: 构建基于真实世界3D结构的基准，利用几何、拓扑和物理可行性约束使组件关系从视觉证据中更确定；采用全人工流水线（超过400人时）进行图像筛选、组件标注和问题设计，提出1000道需要解析全部候选3D关系的排序问题。
Result: 31个VLM中，最佳开源模型准确率22.2%，最强闭源模型33.6%，人类91.6%；链式思维推理仅带来微小提升，错误分析显示模型在约束空间中的空间理解存在根本局限。
Conclusion: 当前VLM在结构约束空间中的空间推理能力远弱于人类，现有方法（包括链式思维）难以弥补这一差距，需要更根本性的改进。
Relevance: 0
