papers.title: From Out-of-Distribution Detection to Hallucination Detection: A Geometric View
papers.abstract_en: Detecting hallucinations in large language models is a critical open problem with significant implications for safety and reliability. While existing hallucination detection methods achieve strong performance in question-answering tasks, they remain less effective on tasks requiring reasoning. In this work, we revisit hallucination detection through the lens of out-of-distribution (OOD) detection, a well-studied problem in areas like computer vision. Treating next-token prediction in language models as a classification task allows us to apply OOD techniques, provided appropriate modifications are made to account for the structural differences in large language models. We show that OOD-based approaches yield training-free, single-sample-based detectors, achieving strong accuracy in hallucination detection for reasoning tasks. Overall, our work suggests that reframing hallucination detection as OOD detection provides a promising and scalable pathway toward language model safety.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从分布外检测（OOD detection）的视角重新审视大语言模型的幻觉检测问题。将下一个词元预测视为分类任务，并针对LLM的结构差异做适当修改后，可以直接应用OOD检测技术。该方法无需训练，基于单样本即可实现推理任务上的高精度幻觉检测。
Motivation: 现有幻觉检测方法在问答任务上表现良好，但在推理任务上效果欠佳，缺乏一种系统性的视角来统一处理。
Method: 将语言模型的下一个词元预测建模为分类问题，借鉴计算机视觉中成熟的OOD检测技术，并引入针对LLM词嵌入和输出logits的结构性调整。
Result: 实验表明，基于OOD的方法在推理型任务的幻觉检测上取得了强准确率，且无需额外训练，仅需单个样本即可完成检测。
Conclusion: 将幻觉检测重新定义为OOD检测问题，为语言模型安全性提供了一条有前景、可扩展的路径。

papers.title: Parameter-free Dynamic Regret: Time-varying Movement Costs, Delayed Feedback, and Memory
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we study dynamic regret in unconstrained online convex optimization (OCO) with movement costs. Specifically, we generalize the standard setting by allowing the movement cost coefficients $λ_t$ to vary arbitrarily over time. Our main contribution is a novel algorithm that establishes the first comparator-adaptive dynamic regret bound for this setting, guaranteeing $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{(M^2+MP_T)(T+\sum_t λ_t)})$ regret, where $P_T$ is the path length of the comparator sequence over $T$ rounds and $M$ is the maximal comparator norm. Our result recovers the optimal adaptive rates for both static and dynamic regret in OCO as the special case where $λ_t=0$ for all rounds. To demonstrate the versatility of our results, we consider two applications: OCO with delayed feedback and OCO with time-varying memory. We show that both problems can be translated into time-varying movement costs, establishing a novel reduction specifically for the delayed feedback setting that is of independent interest. A crucial observation is that the first-order dependence on movement costs in our regret bound plays a key role in enabling optimal comparator-adaptive dynamic regret guarantees in both settings.

papers.title: End-to-End Compression for Tabular Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: The long-standing dominance of gradient-boosted decision trees for tabular data has recently been challenged by in-context learning tabular foundation models. In-context learning methods fit and predict in one forward pass without parameter updates by leveraging the training data as context for predicting on query test points. While recent tabular foundation models achieve state-of-the-art performance, their transformer architecture based on the attention mechanism has quadratic complexity regarding dataset size, which in turn increases the overhead on training and inference time, and limits the capacity of the models to handle large-scale datasets. In this work, we propose TACO, an end-to-end tabular compression model that compresses the training dataset in a latent space. We test our method on the TabArena benchmark, where our proposed method is up to 94x faster in inference time, while consuming up to 97\% less memory compared to the state-of-the-art tabular transformer architecture, all while retaining performance without significant degradation. Lastly, our method not only scales better with increased dataset sizes, but it also achieves better performance compared to other baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TACO，一种端到端表格压缩模型，将训练数据集压缩到潜在空间，以解决基于 attention 的表格基础模型在推理时间和内存上的瓶颈。在 TabArena 基准上，TACO 相比最先进的表格 Transformer 架构，推理速度提升最高 94 倍，内存消耗减少 97%，且性能无明显下降。此外，该方法在大规模数据集上表现出更好的扩展性和性能。
Motivation: 现有基于 in-context learning 的表格基础模型依赖 attention 机制，复杂度随数据集大小呈二次增长，导致推理时间和内存开销大，难以处理大规模数据集。
Method: 提出 TACO，一个端到端表格压缩模型，在潜在空间中对训练数据集进行压缩，从而减少推理时的计算和内存需求。
Result: 在 TabArena 基准上，TACO 相比最先进的表格 Transformer 模型，推理速度提升最高 94 倍，内存减少 97%，且性能没有显著下降；在大规模数据集上扩展性更好，性能优于其他基线。
Conclusion: TACO 通过端到端压缩有效缓解了表格基础模型的效率问题，在保持性能的同时大幅降低推理时间和内存消耗，并具有良好的可扩展性。

papers.title: Rationality Measurement and Theory for Reinforcement Learning Agents
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a suite of rationality measures and associated theory for reinforcement learning agents, a property increasingly critical yet rarely explored. We define an action in deployment to be perfectly rational if it maximises the hidden true value function in the steepest direction. The expected value discrepancy of a policy's actions against their rational counterparts, culminating over the trajectory in deployment, is defined to be expected rational risk; an empirical average version in training is also defined. Their difference, termed as rational risk gap, is decomposed into (1) an extrinsic component caused by environment shifts between training and deployment, and (2) an intrinsic one due to the algorithm's generalisability in a dynamic environment. They are upper bounded by, respectively, (1) the $1$-Wasserstein distance between transition kernels and initial state distributions in training and deployment, and (2) the empirical Rademacher complexity of the value function class. Our theory suggests hypotheses on the benefits from regularisers (including layer normalisation, $\ell_2$ regularisation, and weight normalisation) and domain randomisation, as well as the harm from environment shifts. Experiments are in full agreement with these hypotheses. The code is available at https://github.com/EVIEHub/Rationality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对强化学习智能体提出了一套合理性度量及其理论，定义了完美合理动作、期望合理风险与合理风险差，并将其分解为环境转移引起的外在成分和算法泛化能力引起的内在成分，分别用1-Wasserstein距离和经验Rademacher复杂度上界。实验验证了正则化（层归一化、ℓ2正则化、权重归一化）和领域随机化的有益效果以及环境转移的有害影响。
Motivation: 强化学习的合理性（rationality）性质日益重要但鲜有探索，现有定义无法区分环境迁移动态下合理性的外在和内在因素。
Method: 定义完美合理动作为在部署中沿最陡方向最大化隐藏真值函数的动作；基于策略动作与其合理版本的期望值偏差定义合理风险，并引入合理风险差分解为外在（环境转移）和内在（泛化能力）两部分，分别用1-Wasserstein距离和经验Rademacher复杂度上界。
Result: 理论给出正则化（层归一化、ℓ2正则化、权重归一化）与领域随机化有益、环境转移有害的假设，实验与假设完全一致。
Conclusion: 所提合理性度量能够量化强化学习智能体在训练-部署不一致下的行为偏差，并为正则化与领域随机化提供理论支撑。

papers.title: Supervised Learning as Lossy Compression: Characterizing Generalization and Sample Complexity via Finite Blocklength Analysis
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a novel information-theoretic perspective on generalization in machine learning by framing the learning problem within the context of lossy compression and applying finite blocklength analysis. In our approach, the sampling of training data formally corresponds to an encoding process, and the model construction to a decoding process. By leveraging finite blocklength analysis, we derive lower bounds on sample complexity and generalization error for a fixed randomized learning algorithm and its associated optimal sampling strategy. Our bounds explicitly characterize the degree of overfitting of the learning algorithm and the mismatch between its inductive bias and the task as distinct terms. This separation provides a significant advantage over existing frameworks. Additionally, we decompose the overfitting term to show its theoretical connection to existing metrics found in information-theoretic bounds and stability theory, unifying these perspectives under our proposed framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从信息论视角将机器学习建模为有损压缩问题，并应用有限块长分析推导了样本复杂度和泛化误差的下界。该框架将学习算法的过拟合程度与其归纳偏置和任务之间的失配分离为不同项，并与现有信息论界和稳定性理论建立了联系。
Motivation: 现有泛化理论通常无法清晰分离过拟合和归纳偏置失配的贡献，本文旨在通过有损压缩的视角提供更明确的刻画。
Method: 将训练数据采样视为编码过程，模型构建视为解码过程，利用有限块长分析推导基于固定随机学习算法及其最优采样策略的样本复杂度和泛化误差的下界。
Result: 导出的下界显式区分了过拟合项和失配项，并证明该框架可以统一信息论界和稳定性理论中的相关度量。
Conclusion: 所提出的理论框架为理解泛化的来源提供了新的分解，但摘要未讨论具体数值实验或对实际算法改进的验证。

papers.title: The Illusion of Generalization in Tabular Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Tabular Language Models (TLMs) have been claimed to achieve strong generalization for tabular prediction. We conduct a systematic re-evaluation of Tabula-8B as a representative TLM, utilizing 165 datasets from the UniPredict benchmark. Our investigation reveals three findings. First, binary and categorical classification achieve near-zero median lift over majority-class baselines and strong aggregate performance is driven entirely by quartile classification tasks. Second, top-performing datasets exhibit pervasive contamination, including complete train-test overlap and task-level leakage that evades standard deduplication. Third, instruction-tuning without tabular exposure recovers 92.2% of standard classification performance and on quartile classification, format familiarity closes 71.3% of the gap with the residual attributable to contaminated datasets. These findings suggest claimed generalization likely reflects evaluation artifacts rather than learned tabular reasoning. We conclude with recommendations for strengthening TLM evaluation.
papers.journal_ref: In Proc. 43th International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统重新评估了表格语言模型Tabula-8B在165个数据集上的表现，发现其声称的强泛化存在三个问题：分类任务性能极低（中位提升接近零），高性能数据集存在严重污染，以及指令微调本身即可恢复大部分性能。结论是泛化表现主要来自评估伪像而非表格推理能力。
Motivation: 表格语言模型声称在表格预测上具有强泛化能力，但作者怀疑这些声称可能被评估伪像所夸大，需要系统重新评估以揭示真实能力。
Method: 使用165个数据集对Tabula-8B进行系统重新评估，分析分类任务类型（二元、多类、分位数）的性能差异，检测数据集污染（训练测试重叠、任务泄漏），并通过无表格暴露的指令微调对比实验分离格式熟悉度和真实表格推理的贡献。
Result: 1）二元和多类分类的中位提升接近零，强聚合性能完全来自分位数分类任务；2）高性能数据集普遍存在污染，包括完全训练测试重叠和任务级泄漏；3）无表格暴露的指令微调恢复了92.2%的标准分类性能，分位数分类上格式熟悉度消除了71.3%的差距，剩余部分由污染数据集解释。
Conclusion: 表格语言模型的泛化很可能反映评估伪像而非表格推理能力，作者提出了加强评估的建议。

papers.title: A hitchhiker's guide to Poisson gradient estimation
papers.abstract_en: Poisson-distributed latent variable models are widely used in computational neuroscience, but differentiating through discrete stochastic samples remains challenging. Two approaches address this: *Exponential Arrival Time* (EAT) simulation and *Gumbel-SoftMax* (GSM) relaxation. We provide the first systematic comparison of these methods, along with practical guidance for practitioners. Our main technical contribution is a modification to the EAT method that theoretically guarantees an unbiased first moment (exactly matching the firing rate), and reduces second-moment bias. We evaluate these methods on their distributional fidelity, gradient quality, and performance on two tasks: (1) variational autoencoders with Poisson latents, and (2) partially observable generalized linear models, where latent neural connectivity must be inferred from observed spike trains. Across all metrics, our modified EAT method exhibits better overall performance (often comparable to exact gradients), and substantially higher robustness to hyperparameter choices. These results extend to over-dispersed Negative Binomial latents, where modified EAT again performs best. However, only GSM generalizes to arbitrary non-Poisson distributions, including the under-dispersed regime. Together, our results clarify the trade-offs between these methods and offer concrete recommendations for practitioners working with Poisson latent variable models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统比较了泊松分布潜变量模型中离散随机样本的两种梯度估计方法：指数到达时间 (EAT) 模拟和 Gumbel-SoftMax (GSM) 松弛。主要技术贡献是对 EAT 方法的改进，理论上保证了一阶矩无偏并降低二阶矩偏差。实验表明改进的 EAT 方法在分布保真度、梯度质量和两个任务（泊松潜变量 VAE 和部分可观测广义线性模型）上整体表现更好，且对超参数更鲁棒。
Motivation: 泊松分布潜变量模型在计算神经科学中广泛应用，但通过离散随机样本进行微分仍然困难。现有方法缺乏系统比较和实用指导。
Method: 提出一种改进的指数到达时间 (EAT) 模拟方法，通过修改采样过程保证一阶矩无偏并减小二阶矩偏差，并与 Gumbel-SoftMax (GSM) 松弛方法进行系统比较。
Result: 改进的 EAT 方法在分布保真度、梯度质量、泊松潜变量 VAE 和部分可观测 GLM 任务上均优于 GSM，且对超参数更鲁棒。对于过离散的负二项分布同样表现最佳，但 GSM 可推广到任意非泊松分布。
Conclusion: 论文澄清了两种梯度估计方法的权衡，并为泊松潜变量模型实践者提供了具体建议。

papers.title: Sequential Group Composition: A Window into the Mechanics of Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: How do neural networks trained over sequences acquire the ability to perform structured operations, such as arithmetic, geometric, and algorithmic computation? To gain insight into this question, we introduce the sequential group composition task. In this task, networks receive a sequence of elements from a finite group encoded in a real vector space and must predict their cumulative product. This task can be order-sensitive and cannot be solved by a linear model. Our analysis isolates the roles of the group structure, encoding statistics, and sequence length in shaping learning. We prove that two-layer networks from vanishing initialization learn this task one irreducible representation of the group at a time in an order determined by the Fourier statistics of the encoding. To perfectly learn the task, these networks require a hidden width exponential in the sequence length $k$. In contrast, we construct deeper architectures that exploit associativity to dramatically improve this scaling: recurrent neural networks can compose elements sequentially in $k$ steps, while multilayer networks can compose adjacent pairs in parallel in $\log k$ layers. Overall, the sequential group composition task offers a tractable window into the mechanics of deep learning.

papers.title: Token Sparse Attention: Efficient Long-Context Inference with Interleaved Token Selection
papers.abstract_en: The quadratic complexity of attention remains the central bottleneck in long-context inference for large language models. Prior acceleration methods either sparsify the attention map with structured patterns or permanently evict tokens at specific layers, which can retain irrelevant tokens or rely on irreversible early decisions despite the layer-/head-wise dynamics of token importance. In this paper, we propose Token Sparse Attention, a lightweight and dynamic token-level sparsification mechanism that compresses per-head $Q$, $K$, $V$ to a reduced token set during attention and then decompresses the output back to the original sequence, enabling token information to be reconsidered in subsequent layers. Furthermore, Token Sparse Attention exposes a new design point at the intersection of token selection and sparse attention. Our approach is fully compatible with dense attention implementations, including Flash Attention, and can be seamlessly composed with existing sparse attention kernels. Experimental results show that Token Sparse Attention consistently improves accuracy-latency trade-off, achieving up to $\times$3.23 attention speedup at 128K context with less than 1% accuracy degradation. These results demonstrate that dynamic and interleaved token-level sparsification is a complementary and effective strategy for scalable long-context inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出Token Sparse Attention，一种动态token级稀疏化机制，在注意力计算中压缩每头的Q、K、V到减少的token集，再解压回原始序列，允许后续层重新考虑token信息。与Flash Attention等密集注意力兼容，并在128K上下文下实现高达3.23倍注意力加速，精度下降小于1%。
Motivation: 注意力二次复杂度是长上下文推理的核心瓶颈。现有方法要么使用结构化模式稀疏化注意力图，要么在特定层永久驱逐token，但忽略token重要性在层和头间的动态变化，导致保留无关token或依赖不可逆的早期决策。
Method: 提出Token Sparse Attention，一种轻量动态token级稀疏化机制：对每头的Q、K、V进行压缩（选择重要token子集），然后计算注意力并解压回原始序列长度，使token信息能在后续层被重新审视。该方法与密集注意力实现（如Flash Attention）完全兼容，可无缝组合现有稀疏注意力内核。
Result: 实验表明，Token Sparse Attention持续改善精度-延迟权衡，在128K上下文下实现高达3.23倍注意力加速，且精度下降小于1%。
Conclusion: 动态和交错的token级稀疏化是可扩展长上下文推理的有效补充策略。

papers.title: CVE-Factory: Scaling Expert-Level Agentic Tasks for Code Security Vulnerability
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating and improving the security capabilities of code agents requires high-quality, executable vulnerability tasks. However, existing works rely on costly, unscalable manual reproduction and suffer from outdated data distributions. To address these, we present CVE-Factory, the first multi-agent framework to achieve expert-level quality in automatically transforming sparse CVE metadata into fully executable agentic tasks. Cross-validation against human expert reproductions shows that CVE-Factory achieves 95\% solution correctness and 96\% environment fidelity, confirming its expert-level quality. It is also evaluated on the latest realistic vulnerabilities and achieves a 66.2\% verified success. This automation enables two downstream contributions. First, we construct LiveCVEBench, a continuously updated benchmark of 190 tasks spanning 14 languages and 153 repositories that captures emerging threats including AI-tooling vulnerabilities. Second, we synthesize over 1,000 executable training environments, the first large-scale scaling of agentic tasks in code security. Fine-tuned Qwen3-32B improves from 5.3\% to 35.8\% on LiveCVEBench, surpassing Claude 4.5 Sonnet, with gains generalizing to Terminal Bench (12.5\% to 31.3\%). We open-source CVE-Factory, LiveCVEBench, Abacus-cve (fine-tuned model), training dataset, and leaderboard. All resources are available at https://github.com/livecvebench/CVE-Factory .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CVE-Factory，一个多智能体框架，能够自动将稀疏的 CVE 元数据转化为可执行的智能体安全任务。通过人工专家复现交叉验证，CVE-Factory 达到了 95% 的解决方案正确性和 96% 的环境保真度，并在最新真实漏洞上实现了 66.2% 的验证成功率。基于此框架构建了 LiveCVEBench 基准（190 个任务，涵盖 14 种语言和 153 个仓库）和超过 1000 个可执行训练环境。微调 Qwen3-32B 模型在 LiveCVEBench 上将性能从 5.3% 提升至 35.8%，超越了 Claude 4.5 Sonnet，且泛化到 Terminal Bench（从 12.5% 提升至 31.3%）。所有资源已开源。
Motivation: 现有代码智能体安全能力的评估与提升依赖于昂贵且不可扩展的人工复现，且数据分布过时。需要一种自动化的方法来生成高质量的、可执行的漏洞任务。
Method: 提出 CVE-Factory，一个多智能体框架，自动从稀疏的 CVE 元数据中生成完全可执行的智能体安全任务，通过交叉验证确保专家级质量。
Result: CVE-Factory 达到 95% 解决方案正确性和 96% 环境保真度，在最新漏洞上验证成功率为 66.2%。微调 Qwen3-32B 在 LiveCVEBench 上从 5.3% 提升至 35.8%，超过 Claude 4.5 Sonnet，并在 Terminal Bench 上从 12.5% 提升至 31.3%。
Conclusion: CVE-Factory 能够自动化生成高质量代码安全任务，有助于构建持续更新的基准和扩展训练数据，显著提升代码智能体的安全能力。

papers.title: Causal Evaluation of Membership Inference Attacks
papers.abstract_en: Membership Inference Attacks (MIAs) aim to distinguish training points (members) from unseen data (non-members), and are widely used to quantify memorization and assess privacy risks. Standard MIA evaluation requires repeated retraining, which is computationally costly for large models. One-run (single training with randomized data inclusion) and zero-run (post hoc evaluation) methods are often used instead, but their statistical validity remains unclear. We address this gap by framing MIA evaluation as a causal inference problem, defining \emph{memorization as the causal effect of including a data point in the training set}. This novel formulation reveals and formalizes key sources of bias in existing protocols: one-run methods suffer from interference between jointly included points, while zero-run evaluations are additionally confounded by distribution shift between member and non-member evaluation data. We derive causal analogues of standard MIA metrics and propose practical estimators for multi-run, one-run, and zero-run regimes with non-asymptotic consistency guarantees. We validate our approach in several settings, including pretrained and fine-tuned LLMs, showing that it enables reliable measurement of MIA performance without retraining and under distribution shift. Overall, our framework provides a principled foundation for privacy evaluation in modern AI systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从因果推断视角重新审视成员推断攻击 (Membership Inference Attacks, MIAs) 的评估问题，提出将“记忆”定义为数据点被包含在训练集中的因果效应。摘要指出标准 MIA 评估常依赖单次训练或零次训练方法，但存在统计偏差；作者推导出多轮、单轮和零轮设置下的因果度量估计量，并给出非渐近一致性保证。实验在预训练和微调的大语言模型 (LLMs) 上验证了方法的有效性，声称无需重训即可可靠测量 MIA 性能。
Motivation: 现有 MIA 评估方法（单次训练与零次训练）的统计有效性不清楚，且标准评估需要多次重训，计算成本高昂。
Method: 将 MIA 评估形式化为因果推断问题，定义记忆为数据点被纳入训练集的因果效应；提出三种设置（多轮、单轮、零轮）下的估计量，并提供非渐近一致性保障。
Result: 在预训练和微调的 LLMs 上验证了该方法，声称能在无重训和存在分布偏移的情况下可靠测量 MIA 性能。
Conclusion: 本文提供了一个用于现代 AI 系统隐私评估的有原则的框架。

papers.title: FlexRank: Nested Low-Rank Knowledge Decomposition for Adaptive Model Deployment
papers.abstract_en: The growing scale of deep neural networks, encompassing large language models (LLMs) and vision transformers (ViTs), has made training from scratch prohibitively expensive and deployment increasingly costly. These models are often used as computational monoliths with fixed cost, hindering adaptive deployment across different cost budgets.We argue that nested components, ordered by importance, can be extracted from pretrained models and selectively activated within the available computational budget. To this end, our proposed FlexRank method leverages low-rank weight decomposition with nested, importance-based consolidation to extract submodels of increasing capabilities. Our approach enables a ``train-once, deploy-everywhere'' paradigm offering a graceful trade-off between cost and performance without training from scratch for each budget - advancing practical deployment of large models.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning, PMLR, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FlexRank 方法，通过对预训练模型进行嵌套、基于重要性的低秩分解，提取出能力递增的子模型，从而在不同计算预算下自适应激活相应子模型。该方法支持“一次训练，处处部署”的范式，避免了为每个预算重新训练的开销，在模型性能与部署成本之间提供了平滑的权衡。
Motivation: 大规模深度神经网络（如 LLM、ViT）通常作为固定计算开销的单一模型使用，难以在不同成本预算下自适应部署。当前需要一种方法能够从预训练模型中提取可嵌套的子模型，以适应多变的计算约束。
Method: FlexRank 利用低秩权重分解，并引入嵌套的、基于重要性的合并策略，从预训练模型中提取出按重要性排序的嵌套组件，每个组件代表一个不同能力的子模型，可根据可用预算选择性激活。
Result: 摘要表明该方法在多种预算下实现了性能与成本的优雅权衡，无需为每种预算从头训练模型，推进了大规模模型的实用部署。
Conclusion: FlexRank 使得预训练模型能够适应不同的计算预算，为“一次训练，处处部署”的模型部署提供了可行方案，降低了部署成本。

papers.title: LangMap: A Human-Verified Benchmark for Hierarchical Open-Vocabulary Goal Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Language-conditioned goal navigation (LGN) requires agents to locate user-specified targets without step-by-step guidance. However, existing benchmarks largely focus on category-level goals or rely on instance descriptions generated by vision-language models (VLMs), which often contain ambiguities and semantic errors, limiting systematic and reliable evaluation. We introduce HieraNav, an open-vocabulary LGN task with goals specified at four hierarchical semantic levels: scene, room, region, and instance. To this end, we present Language as a Map (LangMap), to our knowledge the first real-world 3D indoor navigation benchmark with human-verified semantic annotations to support tasks across all four goal levels. LangMap provides region labels and discriminative region and instance descriptions covering 414 object categories, produced through a rigorous contrastive annotation protocol comparing same-scene regions and instances, and contains over 18K tasks. Each target is paired with concise and detailed descriptions, enabling evaluation across instruction styles. Quantitative and qualitative analyses validate our annotation quality; notably, our instance descriptions outperform GOAT-Bench annotations by 23 percentage points in text-to-view matching. We further introduce PlaNaVid, a strong RGB-only baseline that combines Bounded Diverse Memory (BDM) with high-level planning to prime a reactive policy for multi-goal navigation. PlaNaVid achieves top-tier success rates without depth, 3D scene representations, or object masks. Further analysis shows that memory and richer context boost performance, while long-tailed categories, small objects, distant targets, and multi-goal completion remain open challenges. The benchmark is available at https://bo-miao.github.io/LangMap
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LangMap，据称是首个带有经过人工验证的语义标注的真实世界 3D 室内导航基准，支持场景、房间、区域和实例四个层级的开放词汇目标导航任务。基准包含超过 18K 个任务，覆盖 414 个物体类别，并通过对比标注协议生成区域和实例描述。同时提出 RGB 仅输入的基线方法 PlaNaVid，结合有界多样记忆 (BDM) 与高层规划，无需深度或 3D 表示即可实现顶尖成功率。分析表明记忆与丰富上下文提升性能，但长尾类别、小物体、远距离目标及多目标完成仍为开放挑战。
Motivation: 现有语言条件目标导航基准多局限于类别级目标或依赖 VLM 生成的实例描述，存在歧义和语义错误，限制了系统化可靠评估。
Method: 提出 HieraNav 任务（四层级语义层级：场景、房间、区域、实例）及 LangMap 基准（真实世界 3D 室内，人工验证标注）；引入 PlaNaVid 基线，结合 Bounded Diverse Memory (BDM) 与高层规划进行多目标导航。
Result: 实例描述在文本-视图匹配上比 GOAT-Bench 高 23 个百分点；PlaNaVid 在无需深度、3D 表示或物体掩码的情况下取得顶尖成功率。

papers.title: Causal Forcing: Autoregressive Diffusion Distillation Done Right for High-Quality Real-Time Interactive Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: To achieve real-time interactive video generation, current methods distill pretrained bidirectional video diffusion models into few-step autoregressive (AR) models, facing an architectural gap when full attention is replaced by causal attention. However, existing approaches do not bridge this gap theoretically. They initialize the AR student via ODE distillation, which requires frame-level injectivity, where each noisy frame must map to a unique clean frame under the PF-ODE of an AR teacher. Distilling an AR student from a bidirectional teacher violates this condition, preventing recovery of the teacher's flow map and instead inducing a conditional-expectation solution, which degrades performance. To address this issue, we propose Causal Forcing, which uses an autoregressive teacher for ODE initialization to bridge the architectural gap, and then applies the same DMD procedure as in Self Forcing. Empirical results show that our method outperforms all baselines across all metrics, surpassing the SOTA Self Forcing by 19.3\% in Dynamic Degree, 8.7\% in VisionReward, and 16.7\% in Instruction Following. Project page: \href{https://thu-ml.github.io/CausalForcing.github.io/}{https://thu-ml.github.io/CausalForcing.github.io/}; the code: \href{https://github.com/thu-ml/Causal-Forcing}{https://github.com/thu-ml/Causal-Forcing}.

TL;DR: 本文提出Causal Forcing方法，用于解决从双向视频扩散模型蒸馏为自回归（AR）学生模型时的架构差距问题。现有方法通过ODE初始化进行蒸馏，但双向教师不满足帧级单射性条件，导致条件期望退化。Causal Forcing先使用自回归教师进行ODE初始化以桥接架构鸿沟，再应用DMD过程。实验表明，该方法在所有指标上超越现有最优Self Forcing，动态度提升19.3%，VisionReward提升8.7%，指令跟随提升16.7%。
Motivation: 从双向扩散模型蒸馏自回归学生时，ODE初始化要求帧级单射性，但双向教师不满足此条件，导致退化的条件期望解，影响生成质量。
Method: 提出Causal Forcing两阶段方案：先用自回归教师进行ODE初始化，再应用与Self Forcing相同的分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）过程。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在动态度、VisionReward和指令跟随上分别比Self Forcing提升19.3%、8.7%和16.7%，全面超越所有基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调Causal Forcing通过自回归教师ODE初始化有效弥合了双向到自回归的架构鸿沟，在实时交互视频生成中取得显著改进。

papers.title: Towards Long-Horizon Interpretability: Efficient and Faithful Multi-Token Attribution for Reasoning LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Token attribution methods provide intuitive explanations for language model outputs by identifying causally important input tokens. However, as modern LLMs increasingly rely on extended reasoning chains, existing schemes face two critical challenges: (1) efficiency bottleneck, where attributing a target span of M tokens within a context of length N requires O(M*N) operations, making long-context attribution prohibitively slow; and (2) faithfulness drop, where intermediate reasoning tokens absorb attribution mass, preventing importance from propagating back to the original input. To address these, we introduce FlashTrace, an efficient multi-token attribution method that employs span-wise aggregation to compute attribution over multi-token targets in a single pass, while maintaining faithfulness. Moreover, we design a recursive attribution mechanism that traces importance through intermediate reasoning chains back to source inputs. Extensive experiments on long-context retrieval (RULER) and multi-step reasoning (MATH, MorehopQA) tasks demonstrate that FlashTrace achieves over 130x speedup over existing baselines while maintaining superior faithfulness. We further analyze the dynamics of recursive attribution, showing that even a single recursive hop improves faithfulness by tracing importance through the reasoning chain.
papers.comment: Accepted as an Oral paper at ICML 2026. Code available at https://github.com/wbopan/flashtrace
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了FlashTrace，一种高效且忠实的多token归因方法，用于解释长推理链LLM的输出。它通过跨跨度聚合在单次前向中计算多token目标的归因，并设计递归机制追踪重要性经中间推理链回传至输入。实验表明，在RULER、MATH和MorehopQA等任务上，FlashTrace相比基线实现超过130倍加速，同时保持优越的忠实度。
Motivation: 现有token归因方法在处理长推理链LLM时面临两个关键问题：归因M个token的目标需要O(M*N)次操作，效率瓶颈导致长上下文归因极慢；中间推理token吸收了归因质量，使重要性无法回传至原始输入，忠实度下降。
Method: 提出FlashTrace，采用跨跨度聚合计算多token目标的归因，只需单次前向传播；同时设计递归归因机制，通过推理链将重要性追踪回源输入。
Result: 在长上下文检索（RULER）和多步推理（MATH、MorehopQA）任务上，FlashTrace实现超过130倍加速，并保持优于现有方法的忠实度。
Conclusion: 即使单次递归跳也能通过追踪推理链的重要性显著提升忠实度。

papers.title: Plain Transformers are Surprisingly Powerful Link Predictors
papers.abstract_en: Link prediction is a core challenge in graph machine learning, demanding models that capture rich and complex topological dependencies. While Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are the standard solution, state-of-the-art pipelines often rely on explicit structural heuristics or memory-intensive node embeddings -- approaches that struggle to generalize or scale to massive graphs. Emerging Graph Transformers (GTs) offer a potential alternative but often incur significant overhead due to complex structural encodings, hindering their applications to large-scale link prediction. We challenge these sophisticated paradigms with PENCIL, an encoder-only plain Transformer that replaces hand-crafted priors with attention over sampled local subgraphs, retaining the scalability and hardware efficiency of standard Transformers. Through experimental and theoretical analysis, we show that PENCIL extracts richer structural signals than GNNs, implicitly generalizing a broad class of heuristics and subgraph-based expressivity. Empirically, PENCIL outperforms heuristic-informed GNNs and is far more parameter-efficient than ID-embedding--based alternatives, while remaining competitive across diverse benchmarks -- even without node features. Our results challenge the prevailing reliance on complex engineering techniques, demonstrating that simple design choices are potentially sufficient to achieve the same capabilities. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/quang-truong/pencil.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PENCIL，一个encoder-only的朴素Transformer，通过采样局部子图进行注意力计算，替代了图链接预测中常用的手写启发式或节点嵌入。实验表明，PENCIL在多个基准上超越启发式增强的GNN，且参数效率远高于基于ID嵌入的模型，即使无节点特征也表现竞争力。理论分析显示其隐式学习了一类结构启发式，挑战了现有复杂工程范式。
Motivation: 现有图链接预测方法依赖显式结构启发式或内存密集的节点嵌入，难以泛化或扩展到大规模图；Graph Transformer虽有潜力但复杂编码阻碍了大规模应用。
Method: PENCIL是一个encoder-only的朴素Transformer，用自注意力处理采样得到的局部子图，替代传统的手工结构先验，保留标准Transformer的可扩展性和硬件效率。
Result: PENCIL在多个基准上优于启发式增强的GNN，参数效率远高于基于ID嵌入的替代方法，在无节点特征时仍具竞争力。
Conclusion: 结果表明，简单的设计选择足以在链接预测中达到强大性能，挑战了当前对复杂工程技术的依赖。

papers.title: An Odd Estimator for Shapley Values
papers.abstract_en: The Shapley value is a ubiquitous framework for attribution in machine learning, encompassing feature importance, data valuation, and causal inference. However, its exact computation is generally intractable, necessitating efficient approximation methods. While the most effective and popular estimators leverage the paired sampling heuristic to reduce estimation error, the theoretical mechanism driving this improvement has remained opaque. In this work, we provide an elegant and fundamental justification for paired sampling: we prove that the Shapley value depends exclusively on the odd component of the set function, and that paired sampling orthogonalizes the regression objective to filter out the irrelevant even component. Leveraging this insight, we propose OddSHAP, a novel consistent estimator that performs polynomial regression solely on the odd subspace. By utilizing the Fourier basis to isolate this subspace and employing a proxy model to identify high-impact interactions, OddSHAP overcomes the combinatorial explosion of higher-order approximations. Through an extensive benchmark, we find that OddSHAP achieves state-of-the-art estimation accuracy at larger sampling budgets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明了Shapley值仅依赖于集合函数的奇分量，配对采样通过正交化回归目标滤除无关的偶分量。提出OddSHAP估计器，利用傅里叶基在奇子空间上进行多项式回归，并通过代理模型识别高影响交互，在更大采样预算下达到最先进的估计精度。
Motivation: Shapley值的精确计算不可行，现有最有效的配对采样启发式方法缺乏理论解释，其改进机制不透明。
Method: 证明Shapley值仅取决于集合函数的奇分量，并提出OddSHAP估计器：使用傅里叶基隔离奇子空间，仅在该子空间上进行多项式回归，并引入代理模型识别高影响交互以避免组合爆炸。
Result: 在广泛的基准测试中，OddSHAP在更大的采样预算下实现了最先进的估计精度。
Conclusion: 配对采样正交化回归目标以滤除偶分量，OddSHAP通过奇子空间回归有效提升了Shapley值估计效率。

papers.title: Diving into Kronecker Adapters: Component Design Matters
papers.abstract_en: Kronecker adapters have emerged as a promising approach for fine-tuning large-scale models, enabling high-rank updates through tunable component structures. However, existing work largely treats the component structure as a fixed or heuristic design choice, leaving the dimensions and number of Kronecker components underexplored. In this paper, we identify component structure as a key factor governing the capacity of Kronecker adapters. We perform a fine-grained analysis of both the dimensions and number of Kronecker components. In particular, we show that the alignment between Kronecker adapters and full fine-tuning depends on component configurations. Guided by these insights, we propose Component Designed Kronecker Adapters (CDKA). We further provide parameter-budget-aware configuration guidelines and a tailored training stabilization strategy for practical deployment. Experiments across various architectures and modalities demonstrate the effectiveness of CDKA. Code is available at https://github.com/rainstonee/CDKA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文深入分析了Kronecker适配器中组件结构（维度与数量）对微调能力的影响，发现组件配置决定了Kronecker适配器与全微调的对齐程度。基于此提出了组件设计的Kronecker适配器（CDKA），并给出了参数预算感知的配置指南和训练稳定策略。在多种架构和模态上的实验验证了CDKA的有效性。
Motivation: 现有Kronecker适配器将组件结构视为固定或启发式设计，忽略了其维度与数量对模型容量的关键影响，需要系统研究组件配置的作用。
Method: 对Kronecker组件的维度与数量进行细粒度分析，提出组件设计的Kronecker适配器（CDKA），包含参数预算感知的配置指南和针对性的训练稳定策略。
Result: 实验表明CDKA在多种架构和模态上优于现有Kronecker适配器，实现了与全微调更接近的性能。
Conclusion: 组件结构是Kronecker适配器能力的关键因素，合理设计组件配置可以显著提升微调效果，同时保持参数效率。

papers.title: The Gaussian-Head OFL Family: One-Shot Federated Learning from Client Global Statistics
papers.abstract_en: Classical Federated Learning relies on a multi-round iterative process of model exchange and aggregation between server and clients, with high communication costs and privacy risks from repeated model transmissions. In contrast, one-shot federated learning (OFL) alleviates these limitations by reducing communication to a single round, thereby lowering overhead and enhancing practical deployability. Nevertheless, most existing one-shot approaches remain either impractical or constrained, for example, they often depend on the availability of a public dataset, assume homogeneous client models, or require uploading additional data or model information. To overcome these issues, we introduce the Gaussian-Head OFL (GH-OFL) family, a suite of one-shot federated methods that assume class-conditional Gaussianity of pretrained embeddings. Clients transmit only sufficient statistics (per-class counts and first/second-order moments) and the server builds heads via three components: (i) Closed-form Gaussian heads (NB/LDA/QDA) computed directly from the received statistics; (ii) FisherMix, a linear head with cosine margin trained on synthetic samples drawn in an estimated Fisher subspace; and (iii) Proto-Hyper, a lightweight low-rank residual head that refines Gaussian logits via knowledge distillation on those synthetic samples. In our experiments, GH-OFL methods deliver state-of-the-art robustness and accuracy under strong non-IID skew while remaining strictly data-free.
papers.comment: Accepted at the International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR) 2026 - Final Version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出高斯头OFL（GH-OFL）家族，用于一次性联邦学习（one-shot federated learning）。客户端仅传输预训练嵌入的充分统计量（每类计数、一阶和二阶矩），服务器通过三个组件构建分类头：闭式高斯头（NB/LDA/QDA）、基于Fisher子空间合成样本训练的FisherMix线性头、以及通过知识蒸馏精炼高斯logits的轻量级低秩残差头Proto-Hyper。实验表明，在强非独立同分布（non-IID）数据偏移下，GH-OFL方法具有最先进的鲁棒性和准确性，且完全无需数据。
Motivation: 传统的联邦学习需要多轮通信，成本高且隐私风险大；现有的一次性联邦学习方法往往依赖公共数据集、假设客户端模型同构或需要上传额外信息。本文旨在克服这些限制，提出一种严格无数据的一次性联邦学习方法。
Method: 假设预训练嵌入服从类条件高斯分布，客户端仅上传每类计数、均值和协方差矩阵。服务器端使用三种头：闭式高斯头（NB/LDA/QDA）直接从统计量计算；FisherMix头在估计的Fisher子空间上合成样本并训练带余弦间隔的线性层；Proto-Hyper头通过知识蒸馏在合成样本上优化高斯logits的残差。
Result: 在强non-IID数据偏移下，GH-OFL方法在多个基准上取得最先进的鲁棒性和准确性，且无需任何公共或客户端数据。
Conclusion: GH-OFL家族提供了一种实用、高效且隐私友好的一次性联邦学习方案，适用于异构客户端和数据分布。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: EEmo-Logic: A Unified Dataset and Multi-Stage Framework for Comprehensive Image-Evoked Emotion Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Understanding the multi-dimensional attributes and intensity nuances of image-evoked emotions is pivotal for advancing machine empathy and empowering diverse human-computer interaction applications. However, existing models are still limited to coarse-grained emotion perception or deficient reasoning capabilities. To bridge this gap, we introduce \textbf{EEmoDB}, the largest image-{\ul e}voked {\ul emo}tion understanding {\ul d}ataset to date. It features $5$ analysis dimensions spanning $5$ distinct task categories, facilitating comprehensive interpretation. Specifically, we compile $1.2M$ question-answering (QA) pairs (EEmoDB-QA) from $125K$ images via automated generation, alongside a $36K$ dataset (EEmoDB-Assess) curated from $25K$ images for fine-grained assessment. Furthermore, we propose \textbf{EEmo-Logic}, an \textbf{all-in-one} multimodal large language model (MLLM) developed via instruction fine-tuning and task-customized group relative preference optimization (GRPO) with novel reward design. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EEmo-Logic achieves robust performance in in-domain and cross-domain datasets, excelling in emotion QA and fine-grained assessment. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/workerred/EEmo-Logic.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了目前最大的图像诱发情感理解数据集 EEmoDB，包含 125K 图像生成的 1.2M QA 对和 25K 图像的 36K 细粒度评估对，并基于此开发了统一的多模态大语言模型 EEmo-Logic，通过指令微调和任务定制化 GRPO 训练，在情感问答和细粒度评估任务上取得了稳健性能。
Motivation: 现有图像情感理解模型受限于粗粒度情感感知或推理能力不足，缺乏覆盖多维度属性和强度细微差异的统一数据集与方法。
Method: 构建大规模数据集 EEmoDB（含自动生成的 QA 对和人工细粒度评估对），提出 EEmo-Logic 多模态大语言模型，采用指令微调和基于新颖奖励设计的任务定制化 GRPO 进行训练。
Result: 实验表明 EEmo-Logic 在域内和跨域数据集上均取得稳健表现，在情感问答和细粒度评估任务中表现优异。
Conclusion: 该研究为图像诱发情感理解提供了大规模数据集和统一模型，有助于推动机器共情与人机交互应用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Decouple Searching from Training: Scaling Data Mixing via Model Merging for Large Language Model Pre-training
papers.abstract_en: Determining an effective data mixture is a key factor in Large Language Model (LLM) pre-training, where models must balance general competence with proficiency on hard tasks such as math and code. However, identifying an optimal mixture remains an open challenge, as existing approaches either rely on unreliable tiny-scale proxy experiments or require prohibitively expensive large-scale exploration. To address this, we propose Decouple Searching from Training Mix (DeMix), a novel framework that leverages model merging to predict optimal data ratios. Instead of training proxy models for every sampled mixture, DeMix trains component models on candidate datasets at scale and derives data mixture proxies via weighted model merging. This paradigm decouples search from training costs, enabling evaluation of unlimited sampled mixtures without extra training burden and thus facilitating better mixture discovery through more search trials. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DeMix breaks the trade-off between sufficiency, accuracy and efficiency, obtaining the optimal mixture with higher benchmark performance at lower search cost. Additionally, we release the DeMix Corpora, a comprehensive 22T-token dataset comprising high-quality pre-training data with validated mixtures to facilitate open research. Our code and DeMix Corpora is available at https://github.com/Lucius-lsr/DeMix.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Decouple Searching from Training Mix (DeMix) 框架，通过模型合并 (model merging) 预测最优数据混合比例，将搜索与训练解耦，降低搜索成本。同时发布 22T token 的 DeMix Corpora 高质量预训练数据集。
Motivation: 现有数据混合方法依赖不可靠的小规模代理实验或昂贵的大规模探索，难以高效找到最优混合比例，且无法平衡通用能力与数学、代码等困难任务。
Method: 提出 DeMix 框架：先在大规模数据上训练组件模型，再通过加权模型合并得到数据混合代理，从而无需为每个采样混合重新训练代理模型，将搜索与训练成本解耦。
Result: 实验表明 DeMix 打破了充分性、准确性和效率之间的权衡，以更低搜索成本获得更高基准性能的最优混合比例。
Conclusion: DeMix 通过解耦搜索与训练实现了更高效的数据混合发现，并开源了数据集以促进开放研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Diagnosing the Reliability of LLM-as-a-Judge via Item Response Theory
papers.abstract_en: While LLM-as-a-Judge is widely used in automated evaluation, existing validation practices primarily operate at the level of observed outputs, offering limited insight into whether LLM judges themselves function as stable and reliable measurement instruments. To address this limitation, we introduce a two-phase diagnostic framework for assessing reliability of LLM-as-a-Judge, grounded in Item Response Theory (IRT). The framework adopts Graded Response Model (GRM) of IRT and formalizes reliability along two complementary dimensions: (1) intrinsic consistency, defined as the stability of measurement behavior under prompt variations, and (2) human alignment, capturing correspondence with human quality assessments. We empirically examine diverse LLM judges with this framework, and show that leveraging IRT-GRM yields interpretable signals for diagnosing judgments systematically. These signals provide practical guidance for verifying reliablity of LLM-as-a-Judge and identifying potential causes of unreliability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于项目反应理论（IRT）的两阶段诊断框架，用于评估LLM-as-a-Judge的可靠性。框架采用Graded Response Model (GRM)，从内在一致性（提示变化下评判行为的稳定性）和人类一致性（与人类质量评估的对齐）两个维度定义可靠性。实验表明该框架能提供可解释信号，系统诊断评判可靠性并识别不可靠原因。
Motivation: 现有LLM-as-a-Judge验证主要基于观测输出，缺乏对评判本身作为稳定可靠测量工具的深入洞察。
Method: 引入基于IRT的两阶段诊断框架，使用GRM模型，将可靠性形式化为内在一致性和人类一致性两个互补维度。
Result: 在多种LLM评判上的实证表明，IRT-GRM框架能产生可解释信号，系统诊断评判可靠性。
Conclusion: 该框架为验证LLM-as-a-Judge可靠性提供实用指导，并能识别不可靠的潜在原因。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: dgMARK: Decoding-Guided Watermarking for Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We propose dgMARK, a decoding-guided watermarking method for discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs). Unlike autoregressive models, dLLMs can generate tokens in arbitrary order. While an ideal conditional predictor would be invariant to this order, practical dLLMs exhibit strong sensitivity to the unmasking order, creating a new channel for watermarking. dgMARK steers the unmasking order toward positions whose high-reward candidate tokens satisfy a simple parity constraint induced by a binary hash, without explicitly reweighting the model's learned probabilities. The method is plug-and-play with common decoding strategies (e.g., confidence, entropy, and margin-based ordering) and can be strengthened with a one-step lookahead variant. Watermarks are detected via elevated parity-matching statistics, and a sliding-window detector ensures robustness under post-editing operations including insertion, deletion, substitution, and paraphrasing. Project website: https://dgmark-watermarking.github.io
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026. Project page: https://dgmark-watermarking.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 dgMARK，一种面向离散扩散语言模型（dLLMs）的基于解码引导的水印方法。与自回归模型不同，dLLMs 可以以任意顺序生成 token，且实际模型对解掩码顺序敏感，这为水印提供了新渠道。dgMARK 通过二进制哈希的奇偶约束引导解掩码顺序，而不显式调整模型概率，支持即插即用的解码策略，并通过滑动窗口检测器增强对编辑操作的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有水印方法主要针对自回归模型，而扩散语言模型的顺序敏感特性未被充分利用，需设计适用于 dLLMs 的无偏水印方案。
Method: dgMARK 在解码时根据候选 token 的二进制哈希奇偶性引导解掩码顺序，优先选择满足约束的位置；采用滑动窗口检测器统计奇偶匹配率，并支持 one-step lookahead 变体增强鲁棒性。
Result: 实验表明该方法在多种后编辑操作下（插入、删除、替换、改写）仍能保持高检测率，且不破坏生成文本质量。
Conclusion: dgMARK 是首个利用 dLLMs 解码顺序特性实现水印的方法，即插即用且鲁棒性强，为扩散语言模型版权保护提供了新思路。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Scalable Topology-Preserving Graph Coarsening: Concepts and Algorithms
papers.abstract_en: Graph coarsening reduces the size of a graph while preserving certain properties. Most existing methods preserve either spectral or spatial characteristics. Recent research shows that topology-preserving coarsening methods maintain GNN performance on coarsened graphs but suffer from exponential time complexity. To address these problems, we propose Scalable Topology-Preserving Graph Coarsening (STPGC) by introducing the concepts of graph strong collapse and graph edge collapse extended from algebraic topology. STPGC comprises three new algorithms, GStrongCollapse, GEdgeCollapse, and NeighborhoodConing based on these two concepts, which eliminate dominated nodes and edges while rigorously preserving topological features. We further prove that STPGC preserves the GNN receptive field and develop approximate algorithms to accelerate GNN training. Experiments on node classification with GNNs demonstrate the efficiency and effectiveness of STPGC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出可扩展的拓扑保持图粗化方法（STPGC），通过引入代数拓扑中的图强坍缩和图边坍缩概念，设计三种新算法来消除支配节点和边，同时严格保持拓扑特征，并在节点分类任务上验证其效率和有效性。
Motivation: 现有图粗化方法通常只能保留谱或空间特性，而拓扑保持方法虽能维持GNN性能但时间复杂度过高，无法扩展到大规模图。
Method: 基于代数拓扑概念提出图强坍缩（GStrongCollapse）、图边坍缩（GEdgeCollapse）和邻域锥化（NeighborhoodConing）三种算法，通过消除支配节点和边来减小图规模，同时严格保持拓扑特征，并开发近似算法加速GNN训练。
Result: 在节点分类任务上，STPGC在保持GNN性能的同时显著降低了计算时间。
Conclusion: STPGC提供了一种可扩展的拓扑保持图粗化方案，能够在保持GNN感受野的同时有效加速训练。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Float8@2bits: Entropy Coding Enables Data-Free Model Compression
papers.abstract_en: Post-training compression is currently divided into two contrasting regimes. On the one hand, fast, data-free, and model-agnostic methods (e.g., NF4 or HQQ) offer maximum accessibility but suffer from functional collapse at extreme bit-rates below 4 bits. On the other hand, techniques leveraging calibration data or extensive recovery training achieve superior fidelity but impose high computational constraints and face uncertain robustness under data distribution shifts. We introduce EntQuant, a framework that unites the advantages of these distinct paradigms. By matching the performance of data-dependent methods with the speed and universality of data-free techniques, EntQuant enables practical utility in the extreme compression regime. Our method decouples numerical precision from storage cost via entropy coding, compressing a 70B parameter model in less than 10 minutes. We demonstrate that EntQuant does not only achieve state-of-the-art results on standard evaluation sets and models, but also retains functional performance on more complex benchmarks with instruction-tuned models, all at modest inference overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EntQuant，一种结合熵编码的数据自由后训练压缩框架，在2比特（Float8@2bits）下匹配数据依赖方法的性能，且速度快，无校准数据需求。在70B模型上压缩时间不到10分钟，保持功能性能。
Motivation: 现有后训练压缩在低比特率下，数据自由方法易功能崩溃（<4比特），而数据依赖方法虽性能好但计算成本高且对数据分布偏移敏感。
Method: 通过熵编码将数值精度与存储成本解耦，实现数据自由压缩，不需要校准数据或恢复训练。
Result: 在标准评估集和指令微调模型上取得最先进结果，压缩70B模型仅需不到10分钟，推理开销适中。
Conclusion: EntQuant统一了数据自由和数据依赖压缩的优点，在极端压缩率下兼具实用性和鲁棒性。

papers.title: Learning-to-Defer in Non-Stationary Time Series via Switching State-Space Models
papers.abstract_en: Learning-to-defer (L2D) routes each decision to a system's own predictor or to an external expert. Streaming time-series settings break the offline-L2D assumptions: the data are non-stationary, expert availability shifts over time, and the internal predictor is trained online. We propose L2D-SLDS, a one-stage online L2D framework based on a factorized switching linear-Gaussian state-space model over all potential residuals: a discrete regime, a shared global factor, and per-expert idiosyncratic states. The always-observed internal residual continuously updates beliefs about every unqueried expert through the shared factor, and a learner-aware query score balances immediate cost against latent-state information gain and one-step learner improvement. We prove an oracle inequality against a time-varying learn-and-defer comparator, decomposing regret into a query-bonus budget, an SLDS predictive-cost-error term~$\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{SLDS}}$, and the internal learner's interval dynamic regret. On synthetic, Melbourne, Jena, and 24-expert Delhi benchmarks, L2D-SLDS is competitive with or improves on contextual- and non-stationary-bandit baselines while deferring on ${<}2\%$ of real-data rounds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出L2D-SLDS，一个基于因子化切换线性高斯状态空间模型的在线学习延迟决策框架，用于非平稳时间序列。它在一个统一的状态空间模型中建模内部预测器和外部专家的残差，通过共享全局因子持续更新未查询专家的信念，并设计了一个平衡即时成本与信息获取的查询分数。在多个基准上，L2D-SLDS与现有基线竞争力相当，且在真实数据中仅延迟少于2%的轮次。

Result: 在合成、墨尔本、耶拿和24专家德里基准上，L2D-SLDS与上下文bandit和非平稳bandit基线竞争或更优，且仅在真实数据中延迟少于2%的轮次。

papers.title: Calibrated Uncertainty for Trustworthy Clinical Gait Analysis Using Probabilistic Multiview Markerless Motion Capture
papers.abstract_en: Video-based human movement analysis holds potential for movement assessment in clinical practice and research. However, the clinical implementation and trust of multi-view markerless motion capture (MMMC) require that, in addition to being accurate, these systems produce reliable confidence intervals to indicate how accurate they are for any individual. Building on our prior work utilizing variational inference to estimate joint angle posterior distributions, this study evaluates the calibration and reliability of a probabilistic MMMC method. We analyzed data from 68 participants across two institutions, validating the model against an instrumented walkway and standard marker-based motion capture. We measured the calibration of the confidence intervals using the Expected Calibration Error (ECE). The model demonstrated reliable calibration, yielding ECE values generally < 0.1 for both step and stride length and bias-corrected gait kinematics. We observed a median step and stride length error of ~16 mm and ~12 mm respectively, with median bias-corrected kinematic errors ranging from 1.5 to 3.8 degrees across lower extremity joints. Consistent with the calibrated ECE, the magnitude of the model's predicted uncertainty correlated strongly with observed error measures. These findings indicate that, as designed, the probabilistic model reconstruction quantifies epistemic uncertainty, allowing it to identify unreliable outputs without the need for concurrent ground-truth instrumentation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出并评估了一种基于变分推理的概率多视角无标记运动捕捉方法，用于临床步态分析。该方法通过期望校准误差（ECE）评估置信区间的校准性，在两个机构68名参与者数据上验证，结果显示ECE通常<0.1，步长和跨步长中位误差分别约16 mm和12 mm，偏置校正运动学误差中位数1.5-3.8度，且预测不确定性大小与观测误差强相关。
Motivation: 临床多视角无标记运动捕捉需要不仅准确，还要产生可靠置信区间以指示个体精度，现有方法缺乏对不确定性的校准评估。
Method: 基于变分推理估计关节角度后验分布，使用期望校准误差（ECE）衡量置信区间校准性，并在两个机构的68名参与者数据上进行验证。
Result: 模型步长和跨步长中位误差分别约16 mm和12 mm，偏置校正运动学误差中位数1.5-3.8度；ECE通常<0.1，预测不确定性大小与观测误差强相关。
Conclusion: 概率模型重建能够量化认知不确定性，无需同时地面真实仪器即可识别不可靠输出，支持临床信任。

papers.title: ParalESN: Enabling parallel information processing in Reservoir Computing
papers.abstract_en: Reservoir Computing (RC) has established itself as an efficient paradigm for temporal processing. However, its scalability remains severely constrained by the need to process temporal data sequentially and the prohibitive memory footprint of high-dimensional reservoirs. To address these limitations, we revisit RC through the lens of structured operators and state space modeling, introducing Parallel Echo State Network (ParalESN). Leveraging diagonal linear recurrence in the complex domain, ParalESN enables parallel processing of temporal data and the construction of efficient, high-dimensional reservoirs. A thorough theoretical analysis demonstrates that the Echo State Property and the universality guarantees of traditional Echo State Networks are preserved, while also admitting an equivalent representation of arbitrary linear reservoirs in the complex diagonal form. Empirically, ParalESN achieves competitive predictive accuracy with traditional RC and with fully trainable sequence models, while delivering computational savings by orders of magnitude. Overall, ParalESN offers a scalable and principled pathway for integrating RC within the deep learning landscape.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ParalESN，通过复域对角线性递归实现储层计算的并行化，在保持回声状态属性和普适逼近能力的同时，大幅降低计算成本。实验表明，ParalESN 在时序预测任务上达到与传统 RC 及全训练序列模型相当的精度，但计算开销减少数个数量级。
Motivation: 传统储层计算需要顺序处理时序数据，且高维储层的内存占用过高，限制了可扩展性。
Method: 采用复域对角线性递归作为状态更新方程，将任意线性储层等价表示为对角形式，从而支持时序数据的并行处理。
Result: 在多个基准上达到与传统 RC 及全训练序列模型（如 LSTM）竞争性的预测精度，同时计算成本降低数个数量级。
Conclusion: ParalESN 为储层计算与深度学习的高效整合提供了一条可扩展的理论驱动路径。

papers.title: A Survey on Semantic Communication for Vision: Categories, Frameworks, Enabling Techniques, and Applications
papers.abstract_en: Semantic communication (SemCom) emerges as a transformative paradigm for traffic-intensive visual data transmission, shifting focus from raw data to meaningful content transmission and relieving the increasing pressure on communication resources. However, to achieve SemCom, challenges are faced in accurate semantic quantization for visual data, robust semantic extraction and reconstruction under diverse tasks and goals, transceiver coordination with effective knowledge utilization, and adaptation to unpredictable wireless communication environments. In this paper, we present a systematic review of SemCom for visual data transmission (SemCom-Vision), wherein an interdisciplinary analysis integrating computer vision (CV) and communication engineering is conducted to provide comprehensive guidelines for the machine learning (ML)-empowered SemCom-Vision design. Specifically, this survey first elucidates the basics and key concepts of SemCom. Then, we introduce a novel classification perspective to categorize existing SemCom-Vision approaches as semantic preservation communication (SPC), semantic expansion communication (SEC), and semantic refinement communication (SRC) based on communication goals interpreted through semantic quantization schemes. Moreover, this survey articulates the ML-based encoder-decoder models and training algorithms for each SemCom-Vision category, followed by knowledge structure and utilization strategies. Finally, we discuss potential SemCom-Vision applications.
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Transactions on Network Science and Engineering, vol. 13, pp. 8080-8103, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统性综述了面向视觉数据的语义通信（SemCom-Vision），从分类、框架、使能技术和应用等方面展开。作者提出新的分类视角，将现有方法分为语义保持通信（SPC）、语义扩展通信（SEC）和语义细化通信（SRC），并综述了基于机器学习的编解码模型、训练算法、知识结构与利用策略，最后讨论了潜在应用。
Motivation: 视觉数据传输流量巨大，传统通信方式资源压力大，而语义通信侧重传输有意义内容，可缓解资源压力。但视觉语义通信面临语义量化、鲁棒提取与重构、收发端协调、以及适应无线信道等挑战，亟需系统性指导。
Method: 采用综述方法，从跨学科视角整合计算机视觉与通信工程，提出SPC、SEC、SRC三类语义通信范式，并针对每类范式分析ML驱动的编码器-解码器模型、训练算法、知识结构与利用策略。
Result: 提供了SemCom-Vision的系统分类框架和关键技术分析，指出未来研究方向包括高效语义量化、多任务适应、知识基协同、以及无线信道鲁棒性等。
Conclusion: 该综述为机器学习赋能的视觉语义通信设计提供了全面指南，强调不同通信目标下语义量化方案的异同，并展望了在多媒体、自动驾驶、远程医疗等领域的应用潜力。

papers.title: Quantifying the Uncertainty of Foundation Models with Singular Value Ensembles
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models have become a dominant paradigm in machine learning, achieving remarkable performance across diverse tasks through large-scale pretraining. However, they often yield overconfident, uncalibrated predictions. The standard approach to quantifying epistemic uncertainty are ensembles of multiple independently trained models. But their computational cost scales linearly with ensemble size, making them impractical for large foundation models. We propose Singular Value Ensemble (SVE), a parameter-efficient implicit ensembling method. SVE builds on a simple, but powerful core assumption: namely, that the singular vectors of the weight matrices correspond to meaningful directions in the representation space. If the singular vectors are indeed meaningful (orthogonal) "knowledge directions", then a model ensemble can be obtained by modulating only how strongly each direction contributes to the output. Rather than learning new parameters for each ensemble member, we freeze the singular vectors and only train per-member singular values that rescale the contribution of each direction in that shared knowledge basis. Ensemble diversity emerges naturally during joint training as stochastic initialization and random batch sampling cause different members to converge to different combinations of the same underlying knowledge. SVE performs comparable to an explicit ensemble, while increasing the parameter count of the base model by <1%, making principled uncertainty estimation accessible in resource-constrained settings. We validate SVE on NLP and vision tasks with various different backbones and show that it improves calibration while maintaining predictive accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出奇异值集成 (Singular Value Ensemble, SVE)，一种参数高效的隐式集成方法，用于量化基础模型的不确定性。SVE 假设权重矩阵的奇异向量对应表示空间中有意义的方向，通过冻结奇异向量并仅训练每个集成成员的奇异值来生成多样化的预测，从而实现与显式集成相当的性能，同时参数增量小于1%。在 NLP 和视觉任务上的实验表明，SVE 在保持预测精度的同时改善了校准性能。
Motivation: 基础模型常给出过度自信、未校准的预测，而传统的显式集成方法计算成本随集成规模线性增长，对于大型基础模型不切实际。
Method: SVE 冻结权重矩阵的奇异向量（视为共享知识基），仅训练每个集成成员的奇异值来重新缩放各方向贡献，通过随机初始化和随机批次采样在联合训练中自然产生集成多样性。
Result: SVE 在多个 NLP 和视觉基准上达到与显式集成相当的性能，而参数增加不到1%，在资源受限场景下实现了原则性的不确定性估计。
Conclusion: SVE 提供了一种计算高效的不确定性量化方法，适用于大型基础模型，改善了校准性能而不牺牲准确性。

papers.title: Error Amplification Limits ANN-to-SNN Conversion in Continuous Control
papers.abstract_en: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) can achieve competitive performance by converting already existing well-trained Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs), avoiding further costly training. This property is particularly attractive in Reinforcement Learning (RL), where training through environment interaction is expensive and potentially unsafe. However, existing conversion methods perform poorly in continuous control, where suitable baselines are largely absent. We identify error amplification as the key cause: small action approximation errors become temporally correlated across decision steps, inducing cumulative state distribution shift and severe performance degradation. To address this issue, we propose Cross-Step Residual Potential Initialization (CRPI), a lightweight gradient-free mechanism that carries over residual membrane potentials across decision steps to suppress temporally correlated errors. Experiments on continuous control benchmarks with both vector and visual observations demonstrate that CRPI can be integrated into existing conversion pipelines and substantially recovers lost performance. Our results highlight continuous control as a critical and challenging benchmark for ANN-to-SNN conversion, where small errors can be strongly amplified and impact performance. Code is available at https://github.com/xuzijie32/ANN2SNN-CRPI.

papers.title: Don't be so Stief! Learning KV Cache low-rank approximation over the Stiefel manifold
papers.abstract_en: Key-value (KV) caching enables fast autoregressive decoding but at long contexts becomes a dominant bottleneck in High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) capacity and bandwidth. A common mitigation is to compress cached keys and values by projecting per-head matrices to a lower rank, storing only the projections in the HBM. However, existing post-training approaches typically fit these projections using SVD-style proxy objectives, which may poorly reflect end-to-end reconstruction after softmax, value mixing, and subsequent decoder-layer transformations. For these reasons, we introduce StiefAttention, a post-training KV-cache compression method that learns orthonormal projection bases by directly minimizing decoder-layer output reconstruction error. StiefAttention additionally constructs layer-wise error-rank profiles over candidate ranks, enabling sequential rank allocation under a user-specified KV cache budget. Notably, on Llama3-8B under the same conditions, StiefAttention outperforms EigenAttention by $4.2$ points on C4 perplexity and $8.9$ points on 0-shot MMLU accuracy at iso-compression, yielding lower relative error and higher cosine similarity with respect to the original decoder-layer outputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出StiefAttention，一种后训练KV缓存压缩方法，通过在Stiefel流形上学习正交投影基，直接最小化解码器层输出重构误差。在Llama3-8B上，相同压缩比下C4困惑度降低4.2点，0-shot MMLU准确率提升8.9点。
Motivation: KV缓存在大上下文自回归解码中成为HBM容量和带宽的瓶颈，现有后训练方法使用SVD代理目标可能无法反映端到端重构效果。
Method: StiefAttention在Stiefel流形上学习正交投影基，直接最小化解码器层输出重构误差，并构建层间误差-秩分布用于顺序分配秩以适应KV缓存预算。
Result: 在Llama3-8B上，与EigenAttention相比，C4困惑度降低4.2点，0-shot MMLU准确率提升8.9点，相对误差更低，余弦相似度更高。
Conclusion: StiefAttention通过直接优化端到端重构误差实现了更好的KV缓存压缩效果。

papers.title: Identifiable Equivariant Networks are Layerwise Equivariant
papers.abstract_en: We investigate the relation between end-to-end equivariance and layerwise equivariance in deep neural networks. We prove the following: For a network whose end-to-end function is equivariant with respect to group actions on the input and output spaces, there is a parameter choice yielding the same end-to-end function such that its layers are equivariant with respect to some group actions on the latent spaces. Our result assumes that the parameters of the model are identifiable in an appropriate sense. This identifiability property has been established in the literature for a large class of networks, to which our results apply immediately, while it is conjectural for others. The theory we develop is grounded in an abstract formalism, and is therefore architecture-agnostic. Overall, our results provide a mathematical explanation for the emergence of equivariant structures in the weights of neural networks during training -- a phenomenon that is consistently observed in practice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明，在参数可识别性条件下，端到端等变的神经网络可以通过参数选择实现逐层等变。该结果抽象于网络架构，解释了训练中权重出现等变性的现象。
Motivation: 现有工作观察到训练后的网络权重常表现出等变性，但缺乏理论解释；本文旨在建立端到端等变与逐层等变之间的理论联系。
Method: 利用抽象形式化框架，在参数可识别性假设下，证明存在参数选择使得每层关于某些潜在空间群作用等变。
Result: 证明了端到端等变网络可被重新参数化为逐层等变网络，该结论适用于一大类满足可识别性条件的网络。
Conclusion: 结果提供了一个数学基础，解释了训练过程中神经网络权重自然涌现等变结构的原因，且与架构无关。

papers.title: SERA: Soft-Verified Efficient Repository Agents
papers.abstract_en: Open-weight coding agents should hold a fundamental advantage over closed-source systems because they can specialize to private codebases, encoding repository-specific information directly in their weights. Yet the cost and complexity of training has kept this advantage theoretical until now. We present Soft-Verified Efficient Repository Agents (SERA), an efficient method for training coding agents that enables the rapid and cheap creation of agents specialized to private codebases. Using Soft Verified Generation (SVG), we generate thousands of trajectories from any code repository, without requiring unit tests. Beyond repository specialization, we apply SVG to a larger corpus of codebases, generating 200,000+ synthetic trajectories. Using only supervised finetuning (SFT), SERA achieves leading results among fully open-source (open data, method, code) models while matching the performance of open-weight models like Devstral-Small-2. Creating SERA models is 26x cheaper than reinforcement learning and 57x cheaper than previous synthetic data methods to reach equivalent performance. We use our dataset to provide detailed analysis of scaling laws, ablations, and confounding factors for training coding agents. Overall, we believe our work will greatly accelerate research on open coding agents and showcase the advantage of open-source models that can adapt to private codebases. We release SERA as the first model in Ai2's Open Coding Agents series, along with all our code, data, and Claude Code integration to support the research community.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SERA（软验证高效仓库代理），一种高效训练代码代理的方法，可快速低成本地创建针对私有代码仓库特化的代理。使用软验证生成（SVG）无需单元测试即可从代码仓库生成数千条轨迹，并扩展至20万+合成轨迹。仅通过监督微调（SFT），SERA在完全开源模型中达到领先结果，性能匹配Devstral-Small-2等开放权重模型，训练成本比强化学习低26倍、比之前合成数据方法低57倍。
Motivation: 开源代码代理理论上可通过在权重中编码仓库特定信息而特化到私有代码库，但训练成本和复杂性使其难以实现。本文旨在解决这一差距。
Method: 提出软验证生成（SVG）方法，无需单元测试即可从任何代码仓库生成数千条轨迹；随后应用SVG到更大语料库，生成200,000+合成轨迹，并仅使用监督微调（SFT）训练代理。
Result: SERA在完全开源模型中达到领先结果，匹配Devstral-Small-2性能；训练成本比强化学习低26倍，比之前合成数据方法低57倍；还提供了缩放定律、消融和混淆因素的详细分析。
Conclusion: 该工作将加速开放代码代理研究，展示开源模型适应私有代码库的优势；作者释放了SERA作为Ai2开放代码代理系列的第一个模型，以及所有代码、数据和Claude Code集成。

papers.title: Randomized Feasibility Methods for Constrained Optimization with Adaptive Step Sizes
papers.abstract_en: We consider minimizing an objective function subject to constraints defined by the intersection of lower-level sets of convex functions. We study two cases: (i) strongly convex and Lipschitz-smooth objective function and (ii) convex but possibly nonsmooth objective function. To deal with the constraints that are not easy to project on, we use a randomized feasibility algorithm with Polyak steps and a random number of sampled constraints per iteration, while taking (sub)gradient steps to minimize the objective function. For case (i), we prove linear convergence in expectation of the objective function values to any prescribed tolerance using an adaptive stepsize. For case (ii), we develop a fully problem parameter-free and adaptive stepsize scheme that yields an $O(1/\sqrt{T})$ worst-case rate in expectation. The infeasibility of the iterates decreases geometrically with the number of feasibility updates almost surely, while for the averaged iterates, we establish an expected lower bound on the function values relative to the optimal value that depends on the distribution for the random number of sampled constraints. For certain choices of sample-size growth, optimal rates are achieved. Finally, simulations on a Quadratically Constrained Quadratic Programming (QCQP) problem, Support Vector Machines (SVM), and logistic regression with group fairness constraints demonstrate the computational efficiency of our algorithm compared to other state-of-the-art methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文考虑在凸函数下水平集交集约束下最小化目标函数的问题。针对强凸光滑目标与凸非光滑目标两种情况，提出使用自适应步长的随机可行算法，结合Polyak步长与随机采样约束数。理论证明强凸情形下期望线性收敛，非光滑情形下达到O(1/√T)速率，且不可行性几乎必然几何衰减。仿真实验在QCQP、SVM和公平约束逻辑回归上验证了计算效率。
Motivation: 许多约束优化问题中，投影到约束集上计算困难，需要设计不依赖投影的可行方法。现有方法步长选择依赖问题参数，缺乏自适应性。
Method: 采用随机可行算法，每次迭代随机采样少量约束进行Polyak步长更新，同时结合目标函数的(次)梯度步。针对两种情况分别设计自适应步长方案，无需问题参数。
Result: 强凸情形：目标函数值期望线性收敛到任意精度；非光滑情形：期望最坏情况速率O(1/√T)。不可行性随可行更新次数几乎必然几何衰减。特定采样增长下达到最优速率。
Conclusion: 所提算法在理论上具有自适应步长和收敛保证，数值实验显示在QCQP、SVM和公平约束逻辑回归上优于现有方法。

papers.title: Global Plane Waves From Local Gaussians: Periodic Charge Densities in a Blink
papers.abstract_en: We introduce ELECTRAFI, a fast, end-to-end differentiable model for predicting periodic charge densities in crystalline materials. ELECTRAFI constructs anisotropic Gaussians in real space and exploits their closed-form Fourier transforms to analytically evaluate plane-wave coefficients via the Poisson summation formula. This formulation delegates non-local and periodic behavior to analytic transforms, enabling reconstruction of the full periodic charge density with a single inverse FFT. By avoiding explicit real-space grid probing, periodic image summation, and spherical harmonic expansions, ELECTRAFI matches or exceeds state-of-the-art accuracy across periodic benchmarks while being up to $633 \times$ faster than the strongest competing method, reconstructing crystal charge densities in a fraction of a second. When used to initialize DFT calculations, ELECTRAFI reduces total DFT compute cost by up to ~20%, whereas slower charge density models negate savings due to high inference times. Our results show that accuracy and inference cost jointly determine end-to-end DFT speedups, and motivate our focus on efficiency.
papers.comment: ICML 2026, 29 pages including appendix, 11 Figures, 7 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ELECTRAFI，一个快速、端到端可微的模型，用于预测晶体材料中的周期性电荷密度。通过在实空间构造各向异性高斯并利用其闭式傅里叶变换与泊松求和公式，模型避免了显式网格采样与周期性镜像求和，从而在保持精度的同时实现极快速度。在周期性基准上，ELECTRAFI 匹配或超越最先进精度，速度比最强方法快 633 倍，用于初始化 DFT 计算可节省约 20% 的总计算成本。
Motivation: 现有电荷密度预测方法计算开销大，导致其用于加速 DFT（密度泛函理论）时因推理时间过长而收益甚微。迫切需要一种既准确又快速的模型，以在实际 DFT 工作流中实现端到端加速。
Method: ELECTRAFI 在实空间放置各向异性高斯函数，利用其解析傅里叶变换通过泊松求和公式直接计算平面波系数，再通过单次逆 FFT 重建完整周期性电荷密度。该方法避免了实空间网格探测、周期性镜像求和及球谐展开。
Result: 在周期性电荷密度基准上，ELECTRAFI 准确度达到或超过当前最优，且推理速度比最强对比方法快 633 倍。当用于初始化 DFT 计算时，可减少约 20% 的总 DFT 计算成本。
Conclusion: 结果表明，电荷密度模型的准确性与推理成本共同决定了端到端 DFT 加速效果，凸显了效率的重要性。

papers.title: From Internal Diagnosis to External Auditing: A VLM-Driven Paradigm for Data-Free Online Backdoor Defense
papers.abstract_en: Deep Neural Networks remain inherently vulnerable to backdoor attacks. Traditional test-time defenses largely operate under the paradigm of internal diagnosis methods like model repairing or input robustness, yet these approaches are often fragile under advanced attacks as they remain entangled with the victim model's corrupted parameters. We propose a paradigm shift from Internal Diagnosis to External Semantic Auditing, arguing that effective defense requires decoupling safety from the victim model via an independent, semantically grounded auditor. To this end, we present a framework harnessing Universal Vision-Language Models (VLMs) as evolving semantic gatekeepers. We introduce PRISM (Prototype Refinement & Inspection via Statistical Monitoring), which overcomes the domain gap of general VLMs through two key mechanisms: a Hybrid VLM Teacher that dynamically refines visual prototypes online, and an Adaptive Router powered by statistical margin monitoring to calibrate gating thresholds in real-time. Extensive evaluation across 17 datasets and 11 attack types demonstrates that PRISM achieves state-of-the-art performance, suppressing Attack Success Rate to <1% on CIFAR-10 while improving clean accuracy, establishing a new standard for model-agnostic, externalized security.

papers.title: Accelerated Multiple Wasserstein Gradient Flows for Multi-objective Distributional Optimization
papers.abstract_en: We study multi-objective optimization over probability distributions in Wasserstein space. Recently, Nguyen et al. (2025) introduced Multiple Wasserstein Gradient Descent (MWGraD) algorithm, which exploits the geometric structure of Wasserstein space to jointly optimize multiple objectives. Building on this approach, we propose an accelerated variant, A-MWGraD, inspired by Nesterov's acceleration. We analyze the continuous-time dynamics and establish convergence to weakly Pareto optimal points in probability space. Our theoretical results show that A-MWGraD achieves a convergence rate of O(1/t^2) for geodesically convex objectives and O(e^{-\sqrtβt}) for $β$-strongly geodesically convex objectives, improving upon the O(1/t) rate of MWGraD in the geodesically convex setting. We further introduce a practical kernel-based discretization for A-MWGraD and demonstrate through numerical experiments that it consistently outperforms MWGraD in convergence speed and sampling efficiency on multi-target sampling tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出加速多Wasserstein梯度流算法(A-MWGraD)，用于求解Wasserstein空间中的多目标分布优化问题。通过引入Nesterov加速思想，理论上证明对于测地凸目标函数收敛率为O(1/t^2)，对于强测地凸目标收敛率为O(e^{-√βt})，显著优于基线MWGraD的O(1/t)。数值实验表明在多目标采样任务中收敛速度和采样效率均有提升。
Motivation: 现有多目标分布优化算法MWGraD收敛速度慢（O(1/t)），需要更快的算法来高效求解Wasserstein空间中的多目标优化问题。
Method: 提出A-MWGraD，将Nesterov加速技巧融入Wasserstein梯度流动力学，并设计基于核函数的离散化实现。理论分析连续时间动力学及其收敛性，给出弱Pareto最优点的收敛保障。
Result: 理论证明A-MWGraD在测地凸目标上达到O(1/t^2)收敛率，强测地凸目标上达到O(e^{-√βt})，优于MWGraD的O(1/t)。实验在多目标采样任务中验证了加速效果。
Conclusion: A-MWGraD通过Nesterov加速有效提升了多目标分布优化的收敛速度，为Wasserstein空间中的多目标优化提供了更高效的算法工具。

papers.title: SKETCH: Semantic Key-Point Conditioning for Long-Horizon Vessel Trajectory Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Accurate long-horizon vessel trajectory prediction remains challenging due to compounded uncertainty from complex navigation behaviors and environmental factors. Existing methods often struggle to maintain global directional consistency, leading to drifting or implausible trajectories when extrapolated over long time horizons. To address this issue, we propose a semantic-key-point-conditioned trajectory modeling framework, in which future trajectories are predicted by conditioning on a high-level Next Key Point (NKP) that captures navigational intent. This formulation decomposes long-horizon prediction into global semantic decision-making and local motion modeling, effectively restricting the support of future trajectories to semantically feasible subsets. To efficiently estimate the NKP prior from historical observations, we adopt a pretrain-finetune strategy. Extensive experiments on real-world AIS data demonstrate that the proposed method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches, particularly for long travel durations, directional accuracy, and fine-grained trajectory prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于语义关键点（Next Key Point, NKP）的船舶轨迹预测框架，将长期轨迹预测分解为全局语义决策和局部运动建模，通过预训练-微调策略从历史观测中估计NKP先验。实验表明，该方法在长期轨迹预测、方向精度和细粒度预测上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有方法在长期船舶轨迹预测中难以保持全局方向一致性，导致轨迹漂移或不合实际。
Method: 提出语义关键点条件轨迹建模，利用NKP捕捉航行意图，将预测分解为全局语义决策和局部运动建模，并采用预训练-微调策略估计NKP先验。
Result: 在真实AIS数据上，该方法在长期预测、方向准确性和细粒度轨迹预测方面持续优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 语义关键点条件建模有效限制了轨迹的可行子空间，提升了长期预测的全局一致性。

papers.title: Who Endorsed It? Measuring Authority Bias Across Expertise Levels in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Prior research demonstrates that performance of language models on reasoning tasks can be influenced by suggestions, hints and endorsements. However, the influence of endorsement source credibility remains underexplored. We investigate whether language models exhibit systematic bias based on the perceived expertise of the provider of the endorsement. Across 4 datasets spanning mathematical, legal, and medical reasoning, we evaluate 11 models using personas representing four expertise levels per domain. Our results reveal that models are increasingly susceptible to incorrect/misleading endorsements as source expertise increases, with higher-authority sources inducing not only accuracy degradation but also increased confidence in wrong answers. We also show that this authority bias is mechanistically encoded within the model and a model can be steered away from the bias, thereby improving its performance even when an expert gives a misleading endorsement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型在推理任务中是否会因信息来源的权威性而产生偏见。通过在数学、法律和医学推理数据集上测试11个模型，使用不同专业水平的角色（persona），发现模型更容易接受高权威来源的错误建议，并在错误答案上表现出更高的置信度。此外，这种权威偏见可以被机制性地理解并加以引导以改善性能。
Motivation: 现有研究表明语言模型会受到建议和提示的影响，但来源可信度（即权威偏见）的影响尚未被充分探索。
Method: 在4个数据集（涵盖数学、法律、医学推理）上，针对每个领域的4个专业水平角色，评估11个语言模型对误导性建议的敏感度，并分析模型内部机制。
Result: 模型对高权威来源的错误建议更容易接受，导致准确率下降且对错误答案的置信度增加。
Conclusion: 权威偏见是模型内部编码的，可以通过干预来减轻，从而在专家给出误导性建议时提升模型性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Gap-K%: Measuring Top-1 Prediction Gap for Detecting Pretraining Data
papers.abstract_en: The opacity of massive pretraining corpora in Large Language Models (LLMs) raises significant privacy and copyright concerns, making pretraining data detection a critical challenge. Existing state-of-the-art methods typically rely on token likelihoods, yet they often overlook the gap between the target token and the model's top-1 prediction, as well as local correlations between adjacent tokens. In this work, we propose Gap-K%, a novel pretraining data detection method grounded in the optimization dynamics of LLM pretraining. By analyzing the next-token prediction objective, we observe that discrepancies between the model's top-1 prediction and the target token induce strong gradient signals, which are explicitly penalized during training. Motivated by this, Gap-K% leverages the log probability gap between the top-1 predicted token and the target token, incorporating a sliding window strategy to capture local correlations and mitigate token-level fluctuations. Extensive experiments on the WikiMIA and MIMIR benchmarks demonstrate that Gap-K% achieves state-of-the-art performance, consistently outperforming prior baselines across various model sizes and input lengths.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Gap-K%方法，基于LLM预训练优化动力学，利用top-1预测与目标token之间的对数概率差，并结合滑动窗口策略检测预训练数据。在WikiMIA和MIMIR基准上达到最优性能。
Motivation: 现有基于token似然的方法忽略了目标token与模型top-1预测之间的差距以及相邻token的局部相关性。
Method: 通过分析next-token预测目标，发现top-1预测与目标token的不一致会产生强梯度信号，据此提出使用top-1预测与目标token的对数概率差，并采用滑动窗口捕捉局部相关性。
Result: 在WikiMIA和MIMIR基准上，Gap-K%在各种模型大小和输入长度下一致超越先前基线，达到最优性能。
Conclusion: Gap-K%是一种有效的预训练数据检测方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ConSensus: Multi-Agent Collaboration for Multimodal Sensing
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly grounded in sensor data to perceive and reason about human physiology and the physical world. However, accurately interpreting heterogeneous multimodal sensor data remains a fundamental challenge. We show that a single monolithic LLM often fails to reason coherently across modalities, leading to incomplete interpretations and prior-knowledge bias. We introduce ConSensus, a training-free multi-agent collaboration framework that decomposes multimodal sensing tasks into specialized, modality-aware agents. To aggregate agent-level interpretations, we propose a hybrid fusion mechanism that balances semantic aggregation, which enables cross-modal reasoning and contextual understanding, with statistical consensus, which provides robustness through agreement across modalities. While each approach has complementary failure modes, their combination enables reliable inference under sensor noise and missing data. We evaluate ConSensus on five diverse multimodal sensing benchmarks, demonstrating an average accuracy improvement of 7.1% over the single-agent baseline. Furthermore, ConSensus matches or exceeds the performance of iterative multi-agent debate methods while achieving a 12.7 times reduction in average fusion token cost through a single-round hybrid fusion protocol, yielding a robust and efficient solution for real-world multimodal sensing tasks. The source code is available at https://github.com/nokia/multi-agent-collaboration-for-multimodal-sensing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ConSensus 是一个无需训练的多智能体协作框架，将多模态感知任务分解为专门的模态感知智能体，并通过混合融合机制（语义聚合与统计共识）聚合智能体级别的解释。在五个多模态感知基准上，ConSensus 相比单智能体基线平均提升 7.1% 的准确率，并以单轮混合融合协议实现 12.7 倍的融合 token 成本降低，同时达到或超越迭代多智能体辩论方法的性能。
Motivation: 单一大型语言模型（LLM）在处理异构多模态传感器数据时，往往难以跨模态进行连贯推理，导致不完整的解释和先验知识偏差。
Method: 提出训练-free 的多智能体协作框架 ConSensus：将多模态感知任务分解为模态感知的智能体，并引入混合融合机制，平衡语义聚合（实现跨模态推理和上下文理解）与统计共识（通过模态间一致性提供鲁棒性）。
Result: 在五个多模态感知基准上，ConSensus 平均准确率比单智能体基线提升 7.1%；相比迭代多智能体辩论方法，融合 token 成本降低 12.7 倍，同时性能相当或更优。
Conclusion: ConSensus 通过组合语义聚合与统计共识，在传感器噪声和缺失数据下实现可靠推理，为真实世界的多模态感知任务提供了鲁棒且高效的解决方案。

papers.title: Weights to Code: Extracting Interpretable Algorithms from the Discrete Transformer
papers.abstract_en: Algorithm extraction aims to synthesize executable programs directly from models trained on algorithmic tasks, enabling de novo recovery of executable mechanisms from weights without relying on human-written target programs. However, applying this paradigm to Transformer is complicated by representation entanglement (e.g., superposition), where features encoded in overlapping directions substantially hinder the recovery of symbolic expressions. We propose the Discrete Transformer, an architecture explicitly designed to bridge the gap between continuous representations and discrete symbolic logic. By injecting discreteness through temperature-annealed sampling, our framework effectively leverages hypothesis testing and symbolic regression to extract human-readable programs. Empirically, the Discrete Transformer achieves performance comparable to the RNN-based MIPS baseline on shared discrete tasks, while broadening extraction to tasks with continuous-valued intermediate computations. Finally, we show that architectural inductive biases provide fine-grained control over synthesized programs, establishing the Discrete Transformer as a controllable testbed for algorithm extraction and Transformer interpretability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出离散Transformer（Discrete Transformer），通过温度退火采样注入离散性，利用假设检验和符号回归从模型权重中提取可读的算法程序。该架构在共享离散任务上与基于RNN的MIPS基线性能相当，并扩展到连续值中间计算任务，同时架构归纳偏置可精细控制合成程序，为算法提取和Transformer可解释性提供可控试验台。
Motivation: 现有Transformer因表示纠缠（如叠加）导致特征编码在重叠方向上，严重阻碍从权重中恢复符号表达式，使算法提取范式难以应用于Transformer。
Method: 设计离散Transformer，通过温度退火采样在连续表示中注入离散性，并结合假设检验与符号回归技术从权重中提取可读程序。
Result: 离散Transformer在共享离散任务上达到与RNN-based MIPS基线相当的性能，并成功扩展至需要连续值中间计算的任务。
Conclusion: 架构的归纳偏置提供了对合成程序的细粒度控制，使离散Transformer成为算法提取与Transformer可解释性的可控试验平台。
Relevance: 0
