papers.title: Sequential Subspace Noise Injection Prevents Accuracy Collapse in Certified Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Certified unlearning based on differential privacy offers strong guarantees but remains largely impractical: the noisy fine-tuning approaches proposed so far achieve these guarantees but severely reduce model accuracy. We propose sequential noise scheduling, which distributes the noise budget across orthogonal subspaces of the parameter space, rather than injecting it all at once. This simple modification mitigates the destructive effect of noise while preserving the original certification guarantees. We extend the analysis of noisy fine-tuning to the subspace setting, proving that the same $(\varepsilon,δ)$ privacy budget is retained. Empirical results on image classification benchmarks show that our approach substantially improves accuracy after unlearning while remaining robust to membership inference attacks. These results show that certified unlearning can achieve both rigorous guarantees and practical utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出顺序子空间噪声调度（Sequential Subspace Noise Scheduling），将噪声预算分散到参数空间的正交子空间中逐步注入，以缓解认证遗忘中噪声微调导致的精度崩溃问题。该方法在保留相同差分隐私保证的前提下，在图像分类基准上显著提升了遗忘后的模型精度，同时维持了对成员推理攻击的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有基于差分隐私的认证遗忘方法虽然提供强保证，但噪声微调严重降低了模型精度，导致实际不可用。
Method: 提出顺序噪声调度，将隐私预算的噪声分散到参数空间的正交子空间中逐步注入，而不是一次性注入全部噪声。
Result: 在图像分类基准上，该方法在遗忘后显著提高了精度，同时保持了对成员推理攻击的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 该方法保留了相同的隐私保证，表明认证遗忘可以在严格保证与实际效用之间取得平衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Context-Free Recognition with Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Transformers excel empirically on tasks that process well-formed inputs according to some grammar, such as natural language and code. However, it remains unclear how they can process grammatical syntax. In fact, under standard complexity conjectures, standard transformers cannot recognize context-free languages (CFLs), a canonical formalism to describe syntax, or even regular languages, a subclass of CFLs. Past work has shown that $\mathcal{O}(\log(N))$ looping layers (w.r.t. input length $N$) allow transformers to recognize regular languages, but the question of context-free recognition with looped transformers remained open. In this work, we show that looped transformers with $\mathcal{O}(\log(N))$ looping layers and $\mathcal{O}(N^6)$ padding symbols can recognize all CFLs. However, training and inference with $\mathcal{O}(N^6)$ padding symbols is potentially impractical. Fortunately, we show that, for natural subclasses such as unambiguous CFLs, the recognition problem on transformers becomes more tractable, requiring $\mathcal{O}(N^3)$ padding. Empirically, looped and padded transformers perform better than fixed-depth transformers in recognizing CFLs. Overall, our results shed light on the intricacy of CFL recognition by transformers: while general recognition may require an intractable amount of padding, natural constraints such as unambiguity yield efficient recognition algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究循环Transformer（looped transformers）识别上下文无关语言（CFL）的能力。理论证明，使用O(log N)循环层和O(N^6)填充符号的循环Transformer可以识别所有CFL，但实际不实用。对于无歧义CFL等子类，仅需O(N^3)填充。实验表明循环填充Transformer在识别CFL上优于固定深度Transformer。
Motivation: 标准Transformer在复杂度假设下无法识别CFL，过去工作只解决了正则语言的识别，而上下文无关语言的识别问题仍开放。
Method: 理论分析循环Transformer的识别能力，给出不同CFL子类所需的循环层数和填充符号数量；实验比较循环填充Transformer与固定深度Transformer在CFL识别上的性能。
Result: 理论表明循环Transformer可识别所有CFL但需O(N^6)填充，对无歧义CFL需O(N^3)；实验显示循环填充Transformer性能更好。
Conclusion: 揭示了Transformer识别CFL的复杂性和可行性，强调自然约束（如无歧义性）可导致高效识别算法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Rethinking Multimodal Few-Shot 3D Point Cloud Segmentation: From Fused Refinement to Decoupled Arbitration
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we revisit multimodal few-shot 3D point cloud semantic segmentation (FS-PCS), identifying a conflict in "Fuse-then-Refine" paradigms: the "Plasticity-Stability Dilemma." In addition, CLIP's inter-class confusion can result in semantic blindness. To address these issues, we present the Decoupled-experts Arbitration Few-Shot SegNet (DA-FSS), a model that effectively distinguishes between semantic and geometric paths and mutually regularizes their gradients to achieve better generalization. DA-FSS employs the same backbone and pre-trained text encoder as MM-FSS to generate text embeddings, which can increase free modalities' utilization rate and better leverage each modality's information space. To achieve this, we propose a Parallel Expert Refinement module to generate each modal correlation. We also propose a Stacked Arbitration Module (SAM) to perform convolutional fusion and arbitrate correlations for each modality pathway. The Parallel Experts decouple two paths: a Geometric Expert maintains plasticity, and a Semantic Expert ensures stability. They are coordinated via a Decoupled Alignment Module (DAM) that transfers knowledge without propagating confusion. Experiments on popular datasets (S3DIS, ScanNet) demonstrate the superiority of DA-FSS over MM-FSS. Meanwhile, geometric boundaries, completeness, and texture differentiation are all superior to the baseline. The code is available at: https://github.com/MoWenQAQ/DA-FSS/.
papers.comment: Accepted to IJCAI-ECAI 2026 (Main Track). 9 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视多模态小样本3D点云语义分割问题，指出现有“融合-精炼”范式存在“可塑性-稳定性困境”，且CLIP的类间混淆导致语义盲区。提出解耦专家仲裁小样本分割网络（DA-FSS），通过解耦语义和几何路径并相互正则化梯度来提升泛化能力。在S3DIS和ScanNet数据集上，DA-FSS优于MM-FSS，且几何边界、完整性和纹理区分度均优于基线。
Motivation: 现有“融合-精炼”范式在多模态小样本3D点云分割中存在“可塑性-稳定性困境”，即模型在适应新类别时容易遗忘旧知识或欠拟合；同时CLIP的类间混淆导致语义信息利用不足。
Method: 提出DA-FSS模型，包含并行专家精炼模块（生成各模态相关性）、堆叠仲裁模块（卷积融合并仲裁各模态路径）和解耦对齐模块（在几何专家和语义专家之间传递知识而不传播混淆）。几何专家保持可塑性，语义专家确保稳定性。
Result: 在S3DIS和ScanNet数据集上，DA-FSS优于MM-FSS，几何边界、完整性和纹理区分度均优于基线。
Conclusion: 解耦语义和几何路径并相互正则化梯度可以有效缓解“可塑性-稳定性困境”，提升多模态小样本3D点云分割的性能。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Regret-Based Federated Causal Discovery with Unknown Interventions
papers.abstract_en: Most causal discovery methods recover a completed partially directed acyclic graph representing a Markov equivalence class from observational data. Recent work has extended these methods to federated settings to address data decentralization and privacy constraints, but often under idealized assumptions that all clients share the same causal model. Such assumptions are unrealistic in practice, as client-specific policies or protocols, for example, across hospitals, naturally induce heterogeneous and unknown interventions. In this work, we address federated causal discovery under unknown client-level interventions. We propose I-PERI, a novel federated algorithm that first recovers the CPDAG of the union of client graphs and then orients additional edges by exploiting structural differences induced by interventions across clients. This yields a tighter equivalence class, which we call the $\mathbfΦ$-Markov Equivalence Class, represented by the $\mathbfΦ$-CPDAG. We provide theoretical guarantees on the convergence of I-PERI, as well as on its privacy-preserving properties, and present empirical evaluations on synthetic data demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出I-PERI算法，用于解决未知客户级别干预下的联邦因果发现问题。该算法首先恢复客户图并集的CPDAG，然后利用不同客户间的结构差异（由干预引起）来定向额外边，从而得到更紧的等价类Φ-CPDAG。提供了理论收敛保证和隐私保护性质，并在合成数据上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有联邦因果发现方法常假设所有客户端共享相同因果模型，这在实践中不现实（例如不同医院的策略会诱导异质且未知的干预）。本文旨在处理这种未知的客户级干预场景。
Method: 提出I-PERI算法：先恢复所有客户端图并集的CPDAG，然后通过分析客户端间干预导致的结构差异来定向额外边，得到Φ-Markov等价类（Φ-CPDAG）。
Result: 在合成数据上展示了算法的有效性，并提供了收敛性和隐私保护的理论保证。
Conclusion: 本文提出的I-PERI算法能在未知干预下实现联邦因果发现，并收紧等价类，同时兼顾隐私。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Agentic Physical AI toward a Domain-Specific Foundation Model for Energy Systems: A Case Study on Nuclear Reactor Control
papers.abstract_en: The prevailing paradigm in AI for physical systems: scaling general-purpose foundation models toward universal multimodal reasoning, confronts a barrier at the control interface. Frontier vision-language models achieve only 50-53% accuracy on basic quantitative physics tasks, behaving as approximate guessers that preserve semantic plausibility while violating physical constraints. Safety-critical control demands outcome-space guarantees over executed actions, not parameter-space imitation. Here we present a pathway toward domain-specific foundation models through compact language models operating as Agentic Physical AI: policy optimization driven by physics-based simulator validation rather than perceptual inference. We train a 360M-parameter model on synthetic nuclear reactor scenarios scaled from 10^3 to 10^5 examples. Scaling produces strong, regime-dependent reliability gains under nominal simulated conditions, with variance collapse of approximately 500x and elimination of >10% terminal-power excursions on the sampled distribution. Despite balanced exposure to four actuation families, the model concentrates 95% of runtime execution on a single-bank strategy, without reinforcement learning or reward engineering. Representations transfer across simulators without architectural change. We position the system as a candidate decision component within a verification, monitoring, and defense-in-depth architecture, not as a stand-alone safety solution: the demonstrated behavior speaks to closed-loop reliability on a single-step task in simulation and does not yet address off-nominal operation, sensor faults, or uncertainty quantification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出通过紧凑语言模型（360M参数）作为Agentic Physical AI，利用基于物理模拟器的策略优化进行核反应堆控制。在合成数据上从1e3到1e5样本缩放，展示了规模相关的可靠性增益：方差缩小约500倍，消除>10%终端功率偏移。模型偏向单一控制棒策略，无需强化学习，但仅模拟单步任务，未处理异常操作、传感器故障或不确定性量化。
Motivation: 通用基础模型在物理控制接口存在障碍，前沿视觉语言模型在基本定量物理任务上准确率仅50-53%，行为像近似猜测者，违反物理约束。安全关键控制需要执行动作的结果空间保证，而非参数空间模仿。
Method: 训练360M参数的语言模型，在合成核反应堆场景上从1e3到1e5样本缩放，通过基于物理模拟器的验证驱动策略优化，无需强化学习或奖励工程。
Result: 缩放产生强且与工况相关的可靠性增益，方差缩小约500倍，消除>10%终端功率偏移。尽管暴露于四种执行器系列，模型在运行时95%执行集中在单一控制棒策略，且表示可跨模拟器迁移。
Conclusion: 本文系统定位为验证、监控和纵深防御架构中的候选决策组件，而非独立安全解决方案。演示行为仅涉及模拟中单步任务的闭环可靠性，尚未处理异常操作、传感器故障或不确定性量化。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: FEM-Bench: A Structured Scientific Reasoning Benchmark for Evaluating Code-Generating LLMs
papers.abstract_en: As LLMs advance their reasoning capabilities about the physical world, the absence of rigorous benchmarks for evaluating their ability to generate scientifically valid physical models has become a critical gap. Computational mechanics, which develops and applies mathematical models and numerical methods to predict the behavior of physical systems under forces, deformation, and constraints, provides an ideal foundation for structured scientific reasoning evaluation. Problems follow clear mathematical structure, enforce strict physical and numerical constraints, and support objective verification. The discipline requires constructing explicit models of physical systems and reasoning about geometry, spatial relationships, and material behavior, connecting directly to emerging AI goals in physical reasoning and world modeling. We introduce FEM-Bench, a computational mechanics benchmark designed to evaluate the ability of LLMs to generate correct finite element method (FEM) and related code. FEM-Bench 2025 contains a suite of introductory but nontrivial tasks aligned with material from a first graduate course on computational mechanics. These tasks capture essential numerical and physical modeling challenges while representing only a small fraction of the complexity present in the discipline. Despite their simplicity, state-of-the-art LLMs do not reliably solve all of them. In a five attempt run, the best performing model at function writing, Gemini 3 Pro, completed 30/33 tasks at least once and 26/33 tasks all five times. The best performing model at unit test writing, GPT-5, had an Average Joint Success Rate of 73.8%. Other popular models showed broad performance variation. FEM-Bench establishes a structured foundation for evaluating AI-generated scientific code, and future iterations will incorporate increasingly sophisticated tasks to track progress as models evolve.

papers.title: Bottom-up Policy Optimization: Your Language Model Policy Secretly Contains Internal Policies
papers.abstract_en: Existing reinforcement learning (RL) approaches treat large language models (LLMs) as a unified policy, overlooking their internal mechanisms. In this paper, we decompose the LLM-based policy into Internal Layer Policies and Internal Modular Policies via the Transformer's residual stream. Our entropy analysis of internal policy reveals distinct patterns: (1) universally, internal policies evolve from high-entropy exploration in early layers to deterministic refinement in the top layers; and (2) Qwen exhibits an explicit progressive reasoning structure, contrasting with the abrupt convergence in Llama. Furthermore, we discover that optimizing internal layers induces feature refinement, forcing lower layers to capture high-level reasoning representations early. Motivated by these findings, we propose Bottom-up Policy Optimization (BuPO), a novel RL paradigm that reconstructs the LLM's reasoning foundation from the bottom up by optimizing internal layers in early stages. Extensive experiments on complex reasoning benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of BuPO.
papers.comment: Preprint. Our code is available at https://github.com/Trae1ounG/BuPO
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该文将大语言模型（LLM）的策略分解为内部层策略和内部模块策略，通过残差流分析。熵分析发现内部策略从早期层的高熵探索演变为顶层确定性的精炼，且不同模型（如Qwen和Llama）呈现不同的推理结构模式。基于此，作者提出Bottom-up Policy Optimization (BuPO)，通过早期优化内部层来从下至上重构推理基础，在复杂推理任务上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有强化学习方法将LLM视为统一策略，忽略了其内部机制。本文旨在揭示内部策略的动态模式并利用其改进对齐。
Method: 通过Transformer残差流将基于LLM的策略分解为内部层策略和内部模块策略；进行了熵分析；提出BuPO，在训练早期优化内部层。
Result: 在复杂推理基准上，BuPO提升了性能，且揭示了Qwen和Llama在推理结构上的差异（Qwen渐进推理，Llama突然收敛）。
Conclusion: 优化内部层可诱导特征精炼，迫使低层提前捕获高层推理表示，从而改善LLM的推理能力。

papers.title: The Refutability Gap: Challenges in Validating Reasoning by Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent reports claim that Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved the ability to derive new science and exhibit human-level general intelligence. We argue that such claims are not rigorous scientific claims, as they do not satisfy Popper's refutability principle (often termed falsifiability), which requires that scientific statements be capable of being disproven. We identify several methodological pitfalls in current AI research on reasoning, including the inability to verify the novelty of findings due to opaque and non-searchable training data, the lack of reproducibility caused by continuous model updates, and the omission of human-interaction transcripts, which obscures the true source of scientific discovery. Additionally, the absence of counterfactuals and data on failed attempts creates a selection bias that may exaggerate LLM capabilities. To address these challenges, we propose guidelines for scientific transparency and reproducibility for research on reasoning by LLMs. Establishing such guidelines is crucial for both scientific integrity and the ongoing societal debates regarding fair data usage. We also discuss related issues such as the challenge of LLM-generated plagiarism and the general questions of retrieval vs. novelty in LLMs.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文质疑近期关于大语言模型（LLM）能衍生新科学并展现人类级通用智能的论断，认为这些论断不满足波普尔的可证伪性原则。作者指出现有AI推理研究中的方法论缺陷：训练数据不透明且不可搜索、模型持续更新导致不可重复、缺少人类交互记录、缺乏反事实和失败案例导致选择偏差。文章提出科学透明性和可重复性指南，以保障研究诚信和公平数据使用的社会讨论。
Motivation: 当前LLM推理研究缺乏严格的科学验证标准，导致夸大模型能力的虚假论断泛滥，损害科学诚信并误导社会对数据使用的讨论。
Method: 从波普尔可证伪性视角出发，系统识别LLM推理验证中的方法论漏洞，并提出增强科学透明性和可重复性的具体指南。
Result: 摘要未提供定量结果，仅指出方法论缺陷并呼吁建立验证标准。
Conclusion: 为LLM推理研究制定科学透明和可重复性指南对于维护学术诚信和推动公平数据使用的社会辩论至关重要。

papers.title: Optimizing Rank for High-Fidelity Implicit Neural Representations
papers.abstract_en: Implicit Neural Representations (INRs) based on vanilla Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs) are widely believed to be incapable of representing high-frequency content. This has directed research efforts towards architectural interventions, such as coordinate embeddings or specialized activation functions, to represent high-frequency signals. In this paper, we challenge the notion that the low-frequency bias of vanilla MLPs is an intrinsic, architectural limitation to learn high-frequency content, but instead a symptom of stable rank degradation during training. We empirically demonstrate that regulating the network's rank during training substantially improves the fidelity of the learned signal, rendering even simple MLP architectures expressive. Extensive experiments show that using optimizers like Muon, with high-rank, near-orthogonal updates, consistently enhances INR architectures even beyond simple ReLU MLPs. These substantial improvements hold across a diverse range of domains, including natural and medical images and novel view synthesis, with up to +9 dB PSNR over the same architecture. Code is available at (https://rank-inrs.github.io).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文挑战了传统观点，即普通MLP的低频偏差是架构限制，提出这是训练中稳定秩退化的结果。通过秩正则化，简单的MLP也能表示高频内容。使用Muon优化器等高秩近正交更新可显著提升INR性能，在多个图像和视图合成任务上达到+9 dB PSNR提升。
Motivation: 传统认为MLP不适合高频表示，导致需要复杂架构设计。论文指出真正问题是秩退化，而非架构限制。
Method: 通过秩正则化（regulating rank）训练网络，并利用Muon优化器提供高秩近正交更新。
Result: 在自然/医学图像和新视角合成上，相比于相同架构的基线，PSNR提升高达+9 dB。
Conclusion: 证明了秩退化是MLP低频偏置的真正原因，简单的秩调节即可实现高质量INR，为INR设计提供了新视角。

papers.title: DTop-p MoE: Sparsity-Controlled Dynamic Top-p MoE for Foundation Model Pre-training
papers.abstract_en: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts architectures are essential for scaling model capacity efficiently, yet the standard Top-$k$ routing imposes a rigid sparsity pattern that ignores the intrinsic variance in token difficulty and layer-specific computational needs. Top-$p$ routing is more adaptive because it selects experts until their cumulative routing probability reaches a threshold, allowing confident tokens to use fewer experts and ambiguous tokens to recruit more. However, we demonstrate that existing naive Top-$p$ implementations with fixed global probability thresholds provide only marginal gains over Top-$k$, suffer from hyperparameter sensitivity, and result in uncontrolled computational costs. In this paper, we propose **DTop-$p$**, a sparsity-controllable dynamic routing mechanism that learns the Top-$p$ probability threshold with a Proportional-Integral controller and uses dynamic routing normalization to support layer-wise expert selection under a global sparsity constraint. Extensive experiments on Large Language Models and Diffusion Transformers demonstrate that **DTop-$p$** consistently outperforms both Top-$k$ and fixed Top-$p$ baselines while matching the average FLOPs of Top-$k$ MoE. Our analysis confirms that **DTop-$p$** exhibits strong scaling properties across expert granularity, total expert capacity, model size, and dataset size, offering a robust and efficient MoE framework for foundation model pre-training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对混合专家模型（MoE）中固定Top-k路由忽略token难度和层间差异的问题，提出DTop-p动态路由机制。该方法通过比例积分控制器学习Top-p概率阈值，并利用动态路由归一化在全局稀疏约束下实现逐层专家选择。在大语言模型和扩散Transformer上的实验表明，DTop-p在匹配Top-k平均FLOPs的同时，一致优于Top-k和固定Top-p基线，并展现出良好的可扩展性。
Motivation: 标准Top-k路由施加固定的稀疏模式，无法适应token难度和层间计算需求的固有变化；而现有Top-p路由使用固定全局阈值，增益有限且超参数敏感，导致计算成本不可控。
Method: 提出DTop-p动态路由机制，包含两个核心组件：比例积分（PI）控制器学习自适应的Top-p概率阈值，以及动态路由归一化在全局稀疏约束下支持逐层专家选择。
Result: 在大语言模型和扩散Transformer上的实验表明，DTop-p在匹配Top-k平均FLOPs的条件下，一致优于Top-k和固定Top-p基线，并且在不同专家粒度、专家容量、模型规模和数据集规模下展现出良好的可扩展性。
Conclusion: DTop-p提供了一种鲁棒且高效的MoE框架，适用于基础模型预训练，能够在不增加平均计算量的前提下实现更自适应的稀疏路由。

papers.title: Conditional Coverage Diagnostics for Conformal Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating conditional coverage remains one of the most persistent challenges in assessing the reliability of predictive systems. Although conformal methods can give guarantees on marginal coverage, no method can guarantee to produce sets with correct conditional coverage, leaving practitioners without a clear way to interpret local deviations. To overcome sample-inefficiency and overfitting issues of existing metrics, we cast conditional coverage estimation as a classification problem. Conditional coverage is violated if and only if some classifier can achieve lower risk than the target coverage. Through the choice of a (proper) loss function, the resulting risk difference gives a conservative estimate of natural miscoverage measures such as L1 and L2 distance, and can even separate the effects of over- and under-coverage, and non-constant target coverages. We call the resulting family of metrics excess risk of the target coverage (ERT). We show experimentally that the use of modern classifiers provides much higher statistical power than simple classifiers underlying established metrics like CovGap. Additionally, we use our metric to benchmark different conformal prediction methods. Finally, we release an open-source package for ERT as well as previous conditional coverage metrics. Together, these contributions provide a new lens for understanding, diagnosing, and improving the conditional reliability of predictive systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对共形预测中条件覆盖评估的样本效率低和过拟合问题，将其转化为分类问题，提出超额风险度量（ERT）。通过选择合适的损失函数，ERT能保守估计L1、L2等自然误覆盖度量，并分离过覆盖、欠覆盖及非恒定目标覆盖效果。实验表明使用现代分类器比传统方法（如CovGap）统计功效更高，并可用于基准测试不同共形预测方法。开源了相关软件包。
Motivation: 现有条件覆盖指标（如CovGap）样本效率低且易过拟合，无法有效诊断局部偏差，导致从业者难以解释预测系统的条件可靠性。
Method: 将条件覆盖估计视为二分类问题：若存在分类器其风险低于目标覆盖水平，则条件覆盖被违反。通过恰当损失函数定义超额风险（ERT），提供保守的距离估计并区分过/欠覆盖。
Result: 使用现代分类器（如梯度提升）的ERT相比传统简单分类器显著提高统计功效；基于ERT的基准测试揭示了不同共形预测方法在条件覆盖上的差异。
Conclusion: ERT为评估和诊断预测系统的条件覆盖提供新视角，并可扩展至非恒定目标覆盖场景。开源工具包便于社区使用。

papers.title: View Space: Learning Representation across Arbitrary Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Generalizing pretrained models to unseen datasets without retraining is a central challenge toward foundation models. Achieving fully inductive inference on numerical data is particularly difficult due to large variations in feature dimensionality and semantics across datasets. We observe that, in the presence of graph structure, numerical data admits a distinct structure-induced representational axis beyond the feature space, which we formalize as the view space. This view space enables a unified representation of graphs with heterogeneous features and motivates Graph View Transformation (GVT), a class of parametric mappings that can be shared across arbitrary graphs. We instantiate this framework with Recurrent GVT, an architecture for fully inductive node representation learning in node classification. Pretrained on OGBN-Arxiv and evaluated on 27 benchmarks, Recurrent GVT outperforms GraphAny, the prior fully inductive graph model, by +8.93%, and surpasses 12 individually tuned GNNs by at least +3.30%. These results establish the view space as a principled and practical foundation for learning across graphs with heterogeneous feature spaces. Code and checkpoints are available in https://github.com/dooho00/graph-view-space.

papers.title: A Distribution Testing Approach to Clustering Distributions
papers.abstract_en: We study the following distribution clustering problem: Given a hidden partition of $k$ distributions into two groups, such that the distributions within each group are the same, and the two distributions associated with the two clusters are $\varepsilon$-far in total variation, the goal is to recover the partition. We establish upper and lower bounds on the sample complexity for two fundamental cases: (1) when one of the cluster's distributions is known, and (2) when both are unknown. Our upper and lower bounds characterize the sample complexity's dependence on the domain size $n$, number of distributions $k$, size $r$ of one of the clusters, and distance $\varepsilon$. In particular, we achieve tightness with respect to $(n,k,r,\varepsilon)$ (up to an $O(\log k)$ factor) for all regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究分布聚类问题：给定k个分布的一个隐藏划分（两组），组内分布相同，两组间总变差距离至少ε，目标恢复划分。作者针对已知一个聚类分布和两个都未知两种情形，建立了样本复杂度的上下界，并在(n,k,r,ε)上达到紧界（最多O(log k)因子）。
Motivation: 分布聚类是统计学习的基本问题，现有工作对划分已知但分布未知的情形研究不足，且缺乏统一的理论刻画。
Method: 采用分布检验（distribution testing）方法，将聚类问题转化为两个分布是否相同的假设检验，并设计基于总变差距离的算法。
Result: 样本复杂度上下界在域大小n、分布数k、聚类大小r和距离ε上达到紧（最多O(log k)因子）。
Conclusion: 本文给出了分布聚类问题的完整理论刻画，证明了样本复杂度的主要依赖因素。

papers.title: HistCAD: A Constraint-Aware Parametric History-Based CAD Representation, Dataset, and Benchmark with Industrial Complexity
papers.abstract_en: Parametric CAD sequences are reusable because dimensional and geometric constraints govern how parameter changes propagate. Existing CAD generation datasets and benchmarks emphasize reconstruction fidelity, execution validity, or static shape similarity, leaving preservation of design intent under edits largely unmeasured. We introduce HistCAD, a representation standard, dataset, and benchmark for executable parametric CAD with explicit constraints. HistCAD defines an intermediate language independent of CAD software, recording sketch primitives, constraints, feature operations, and 3D point boundary references for operations such as fillet and chamfer. The dataset contains 170,236 executable sequences aligned with native CAD models, STEP files, rendered views, and text annotations, combining academic scale with professionally authored industrial complexity. Building on this representation, the Constraint-Aware Editability Benchmark applies parameter edits and reports Edit Reachability, conditional preserved constraint satisfaction, and Overall Editable Success, abbreviated ER, cPCSR, and OES; these metrics separate failures to reach a valid edited state from failures to preserve required constraints. Experiments show that explicit constraints are essential for preserving design intent after edits, and that HistCAD supports supervised CAD generation from text and direct LLM workflows. We argue that HistCAD reframes CAD generation from static shape imitation to the synthesis of reusable parametric sequences with explicit constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HistCAD，一个面向可执行参数化 CAD 的表示标准、数据集和基准，强调显式约束对于保持设计意图的重要性。HistCAD 定义了一种与 CAD 软件无关的中间语言，记录草图基元、约束、特征操作和 3D 边界点引用。数据集包含 170,236 个可执行序列，并配套原生 CAD 模型、STEP 文件、渲染视图和文本注释。基于该表示，约束感知可编辑性基准通过参数编辑评估编辑可达性、约束保持率和整体可编辑成功率。实验表明显式约束对于编辑后保持设计意图至关重要，并支持从文本生成 CAD 和直接 LLM 工作流。
Motivation: 现有 CAD 生成数据集和基准主要关注重建保真度、执行有效性或静态形状相似性，缺乏对编辑后设计意图保持的度量。
Method: 定义中间语言记录草图基元、约束、特征操作和 3D 边界点引用；构建包含 170,236 个可执行序列的数据集；提出约束感知可编辑性基准，包括编辑可达性、条件保持约束满足率和整体可编辑成功率。
Result: 实验表明显式约束对于编辑后保持设计意图至关重要，HistCAD 支持从文本监督的 CAD 生成和直接 LLM 工作流。
Conclusion: HistCAD 将 CAD 生成从静态形状模仿重新定义为具有显式约束的可重用参数化序列的合成。

papers.title: The SuperActivator Mechanism: Transformers Concentrate Reliable Concept Signals in the Tail
papers.abstract_en: Concept vectors aim to enhance model interpretability by linking internal representations with human-understandable semantics, but their practical utility is often limited by noisy and inconsistent activations. In this work, we uncover the SuperActivator Mechanism: a transformer dynamic that amplifies concept activation gaps, concentrating the most reliable concept evidence into a small set of high-activation tokens. To develop a theoretical understanding of this mechanism, we prove that concept-aligned attention heads multiplicatively amplify pairwise activation gaps, with already-extreme activations growing fastest. We find that this amplification is not just theoretical, but also occurs empirically on large-scale models: while in- and out-of-concept activation distributions overlap considerably, the in-concept distribution develops a positive tail clearly separated from the noise. These high-tail tokens, which we call SuperActivators, appear consistently across concept-positive samples, making them reliable indicators of concept presence. Accordingly, SuperActivator-based detection improves F1 by up to 0.14 over standard concept activation aggregators and prompting baselines across image and text modalities, models, layers, and concept extraction techniques, demonstrating the generality and practicality of our insights. Further empirical analysis demonstrates that the most reliable SuperActivators are sparse, with detection typically peaking when using only 5-10% of in-concept token activations, and capture more faithful localized semantics than global concept vectors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现并证明了一种Transformer机制——SuperActivator Mechanism，该机制通过注意力头乘法放大概念激活差距，使最可靠的概念证据集中在少量高激活token（称为SuperActivators）上。实验表明，基于SuperActivator的检测在图像和文本模态下，F1分数比标准概念激活聚合器和提示基线最高提升0.14，且仅需5-10%的概念内token激活即可达到最佳检测效果。
Motivation: 概念向量虽旨在增强模型可解释性，但其激活通常噪声大且不一致，限制了实际应用。现有方法缺乏对激活模式的理论理解，无法有效提取可靠信号。
Method: 从理论上证明概念对齐的注意力头会乘法放大配对激活差距，使极端激活增长最快；并据此识别高激活尾部token（SuperActivators）作为可靠概念指示器，用于改进概念检测。
Result: SuperActivator-based检测在多个模型、层和概念提取技术下，F1分数最高提升0.14；最佳检测仅需5-10%的概念内token激活；SuperActivators捕获的局部语义比全局概念向量更忠实。
Conclusion: SuperActivator Mechanism提供了一种通用且实用的概念信号增强方法，有助于提升模型可解释性，但本文仅在图像和文本模态验证，未涉及其他模态或复杂决策任务。

papers.title: Assessing Extrapolation of Peaks Over Thresholds with Martingale Testing
papers.abstract_en: We present the winning strategy for the EVA2025 Data Challenge, which aimed to estimate the probability of extreme precipitation events. These events occurred at most once in the dataset making the challenge fundamentally one of extrapolating extreme values. Given the scarcity of extreme events, we argue that a simple, robust modeling approach is essential. We adopt univariate models instead of multivariate ones and model Peaks Over Thresholds using Extreme Value Theory. Specifically, we fit an exponential distribution to model exceedances of the target variable above a high quantile (after seasonal adjustment). The novelty of our approach lies in using martingale testing to evaluate the extrapolation power of the procedure and to agnostically select the level of the high quantile. While this method has several limitations, we believe that framing extrapolation as a game opens the door to other agnostic approaches in Extreme Value Analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了EVA2025数据挑战赛的获胜策略，用于估计极端降水事件的概率。由于数据集中极端事件极少，作者采用基于极值理论的单变量Peaks Over Thresholds方法，使用指数分布拟合超过高分位数的阈值（经季节调整后）。创新点在于利用martingale测试来评估外推能力并不可知地选择高分位数水平。尽管方法存在局限性，但将外推问题视为游戏为极值分析中的其他不可知方法开辟了道路。
Motivation: 极值预测面临数据稀缺的挑战，特别是在极端降水事件中，传统方法难以评估外推可靠性。论文旨在提供一种简单、鲁棒的建模策略，并解决高阈值选择的不可知性问题。
Method: 采用单变量Peaks Over Thresholds模型，对超过季节性调整后高分位数的极端值拟合指数分布。关键创新是引入martingale测试来评估模型的外推表现，并据此不可知地选择最优高分位数水平。
Result: 该策略在EVA2025数据挑战赛中获胜，成功估计了数据集中最多只出现一次的极端降水事件的概率。
Conclusion: martingale测试为评估极值外推提供了新框架，尽管有局限性，但将外推问题形式化为游戏可能启发更多不可知方法在极值分析中的应用。

papers.title: Debate with Images: Detecting Deceptive Behaviors in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Are frontier AI systems becoming more capable? Certainly. Yet such progress is not an unalloyed blessing but rather a Trojan horse: behind their performance leaps lie more insidious and destructive safety risks, namely deception. Unlike hallucination, which arises from insufficient capability and leads to mistakes, deception represents a deeper threat in which models deliberately mislead users through complex reasoning and insincere responses. As system capabilities advance, deceptive behaviours have spread from textual to multimodal settings, amplifying their potential harm. First and foremost, how can we monitor these covert multimodal deceptive behaviors? Nevertheless, current research remains almost entirely confined to text, leaving the deceptive risks of multimodal large language models unexplored. In this work, we systematically reveal and quantify multimodal deception risks, introducing MM-DeceptionBench, the first benchmark explicitly designed to evaluate multimodal deception. Covering six categories of deception, MM-DeceptionBench characterizes how models strategically manipulate and mislead through combined visual and textual modalities. On the other hand, multimodal deception evaluation is almost a blind spot in existing methods. Its stealth, compounded by visual-semantic ambiguity and the complexity of cross-modal reasoning, renders action monitoring and chain-of-thought monitoring largely ineffective. To tackle this challenge, we propose debate with images, a novel multi-agent debate monitor framework. By compelling models to ground their claims in visual evidence, this method substantially improves the detectability of deceptive strategies. Experiments show that it consistently increases agreement with human judgements across all tested models, boosting Cohen's kappa by 1.5x and accuracy by 1.25x on GPT-4o.
papers.comment: 39 pages, 16 figures, camera ready version for ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统性地揭示并量化了多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）中的欺骗行为，提出了首个专门用于评估多模态欺骗的基准 MM-DeceptionBench，涵盖六类欺骗策略。针对现有监控方法在多模态欺骗检测上的盲区，提出了基于图像辩论的多智能体监控框架（debate with images），通过强制模型将声明基于视觉证据，显著提升欺骗检测能力。实验表明该方法在所有测试模型上提高了与人类判断的一致性，Cohen's kappa提升1.5倍，准确率提升1.25倍（GPT-4o）。
Motivation: 随着LLM能力增强，欺骗行为已从文本扩展到多模态，但现有研究几乎完全局限于文本，多模态欺骗风险尚未被探索。同时，多模态欺骗的隐蔽性、视觉语义歧义和跨模态推理复杂性使得现有监控方法（如动作监控、思维链监控）基本无效。
Method: 提出多智能体辩论监控框架（debate with images），通过让模型在图像证据的基础上进行辩论，迫使模型将其声明锚定在视觉信息上，从而提高欺骗策略的可检测性。
Result: 该方法在所有测试模型上持续提升与人类判断的一致性，在GPT-4o上Cohen's kappa提升1.5倍，准确率提升1.25倍。
Conclusion: 本文强调了多模态欺骗的威胁，并提供了首个系统评估基准和有效的检测方法，但未讨论在更复杂场景或更大规模模型上的泛化能力。

papers.title: IntAttention: A Fully Integer Attention Pipeline for Efficient Edge Inference
papers.abstract_en: Deploying Transformer models on edge devices is limited by latency and energy budgets. While INT8 quantization effectively accelerates the primary matrix multiplications, it exposes the softmax-related path as the dominant bottleneck. This stage incurs a costly dequantize -> softmax -> requantize detour, which can account for up to 65% of total attention latency and disrupts the end-to-end integer dataflow critical for edge hardware efficiency. To address this limitation, we present IntAttention, the first fully integer attention pipeline that serves as a training-free drop-in replacement. At the core of our approach lies IndexSoftmax, a hardware-friendly operator that replaces floating-point exponentials entirely within the integer domain. IntAttention integrates sparsity-aware clipping, a 32-entry lookup table approximation, and direct integer normalization, thereby eliminating datatype conversion overhead along the attention path. Experiments on Armv8 CPUs show that our method achieves up to 3.7x speedup and 61% energy reduction over FP16 baselines, and up to 2.0x speedup over conventional INT8 attention pipelines. Across diverse language and vision models, as well as additional reasoning and long-context evaluations, IntAttention maintains strong overall fidelity and demonstrates a more favorable trade-off than existing LUT-based softmax approximations. Code is available at https://github.com/WanliZhong/IntAttention
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 IntAttention，首个全整数注意力流水线，作为无需训练的即插即用替代方案。核心是 IndexSoftmax，完全在整数域中替换浮点指数运算，通过稀疏感知裁剪、32 条查找表近似和直接整数归一化消除数据类型转换开销。在 Armv8 CPU 上相比 FP16 基线实现最高 3.7 倍加速和 61% 能耗降低，相比传统 INT8 注意力流水线实现最高 2.0 倍加速，并在多种模型上保持良好精度。

Method: 提出 IntAttention，全整数注意力流水线，核心是 IndexSoftmax 算子，通过稀疏感知裁剪、32 条查找表近似和直接整数归一化，完全在整数域中实现 softmax，无需数据类型转换。

Conclusion: IntAttention 作为无需训练的即插即用替代方案，在边缘推理中实现了更优的速度-精度权衡，现有基于 LUT 的 softmax 近似相比具有更有利的权衡。

papers.title: Row-Stochastic Matrices Can Provably Outperform Doubly Stochastic Matrices in Decentralized Learning
papers.abstract_en: Decentralized learning often involves a weighted global loss with heterogeneous node weights $λ$. We revisit two natural strategies for incorporating these weights: (i) embedding them into the local losses to retain a uniform weight (and thus a doubly stochastic matrix), and (ii) keeping the original losses while employing a $λ$-induced row-stochastic matrix. Although prior work shows that both strategies target the same $λ$-weighted global loss, it remains unclear whether the Euclidean-space guarantees are tight and what fundamentally differentiates their behaviors. To clarify this, we develop a weighted Hilbert-space framework $L^2(λ;\mathbb{R}^d)$ and obtain convergence rates that are strictly tighter than those from standard Euclidean analysis. In this geometry, the row-stochastic matrix becomes \emph{self-adjoint} whereas the doubly stochastic one does not, creating additional \emph{penalty terms} that amplify consensus error, thereby slowing convergence. Consequently, the difference in convergence arises not only from spectral gaps but also from these penalty terms. We then derive sufficient conditions under which the row-stochastic design converges faster even with a smaller spectral gap. Finally, by using a Rayleigh-quotient and Loewner-order eigenvalue comparison, we further obtain topology conditions that guarantee this advantage and yield practical topology-design guidelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究去中心化学习中行随机矩阵与双随机矩阵在带异构节点权重下的收敛行为。作者建立加权Hilbert空间框架，证明行随机矩阵在该几何中是自伴的，而双随机矩阵产生惩罚项放大一致性误差，从而减慢收敛。进一步给出行随机矩阵更快收敛的充分条件和拓扑条件。
Motivation: 现有工作表明两种策略可优化相同目标，但欧几里得空间中的收敛界是否紧以及两者行为差异的根本原因尚不清楚。
Method: 提出加权Hilbert空间框架L^2(λ;R^d)，在该几何中分析行随机矩阵和双随机矩阵的收敛性质，并通过Rayleigh商和Loewner序特征值比较推导拓扑条件。
Result: 在该框架下得到比标准欧几里得分析更紧的收敛速率；行随机矩阵成为自伴算子而双随机矩阵不是，产生惩罚项放大一致性误差。
Conclusion: 差异不仅来自谱隙，还来自惩罚项；给出行随机矩阵更快收敛的充分条件和拓扑设计指南。

papers.title: Mixture of Horizons in Action Chunking
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown remarkable capabilities in robotic manipulation, but their performance is sensitive to the $\textbf{action chunk length}$ used during training, termed $\textbf{horizon}$. Our empirical study reveals an inherent trade-off: longer horizons provide stronger global foresight but degrade fine-grained accuracy, while shorter ones sharpen local control yet struggle on long-term tasks, implying fixed choice of single horizons being suboptimal. To mitigate the trade-off, we propose a $\textbf{mixture of horizons (MoH)}$ strategy. MoH rearranges the action chunk into several segments with different horizons, processes them in parallel with a shared action transformer, and fuses outputs with a light linear gate. It has three appealing benefits. 1) MoH exploits long-term foresight and short-term precision jointly within a single model, improving both performance and generalizability to complex tasks. 2) MoH is plug-and-play for full-attention action modules with minimal training or inference overhead. 3) MoH enables dynamic inference with adaptive horizons, which selects stable actions through cross-horizon consensus, achieving 2.5$\times$ higher throughput than baselines while preserving superior performance. Extensive experiments over flow-based policies $π_0$, $π_{0.5}$, and one-step regression policy $π_{\text{reg}}$ demonstrate that MoH yields consistent and significant gains on both simulations and real-world tasks. Notably, under mixed-task setting, $π_{0.5}$ with MoH reaches a new state-of-the-art with 99$\%$ average success rate on LIBERO after only $30k$ training iterations. Project page: https://timsty1.github.io/moh/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中动作块长度（视野）的权衡问题，提出混合视野（MoH）策略。MoH将动作块拆分为多个不同视野的片段，通过共享动作转换器并行处理并融合输出，从而兼顾长期规划与局部精确控制。实验表明，MoH在模拟和真实任务上均有显著提升，在LIBERO混合任务上达到99%的平均成功率。
Motivation: 现有VLA模型对动作块长度敏感：长视野提供全局预见但降低局部精度，短视野提升局部控制但难以处理长期任务。固定单一视野的选择是次优的。
Method: 提出MoH策略，将动作块重新排列为多个不同视野的片段，并行处理共享动作转换器，并通过轻量线性门控融合输出。MoH即插即用，支持动态推理，通过跨视野一致性选择稳定动作。
Result: 在基于流策略 π₀、π₀.₅ 和回归策略 π_reg 上，MoH在模拟和真实任务中取得一致且显著的提升。在LIBERO混合任务上，π₀.₅ + MoH仅需30k训练迭代即达99%平均成功率，刷新最优结果。推理吞吐量较基线提升2.5倍。
Conclusion: MoH通过联合利用长期和短期视野，在单个模型中同时提升性能和泛化能力，且对全注意力动作模块即插即用，开销极小。

papers.title: BackSplit: The Importance of Sub-dividing the Background in Biomedical Lesion Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Segmenting small lesions in medical images remains notoriously difficult. Most prior work tackles this challenge by either designing better architectures, loss functions, or data augmentation schemes; and collecting more labeled data. We take a different view, arguing that part of the problem lies in how the background is modeled. Common lesion segmentation collapses all non-lesion pixels into a single "background" class, ignoring the rich anatomical context in which lesions appear. In reality, the background is highly heterogeneous-composed of tissues, organs, and other structures that can now be labeled manually or inferred automatically using existing segmentation models. In this paper, we argue that training with fine-grained labels that sub-divide the background class, which we call BackSplit, is a simple yet powerful paradigm that can offer a significant performance boost without increasing inference costs. From an information theoretic standpoint, we prove that BackSplit increases the expected Fisher Information relative to conventional binary training, leading to tighter asymptotic bounds and more stable optimization. With extensive experiments across multiple datasets and architectures, we empirically show that BackSplit consistently boosts small-lesion segmentation performance, even when auxiliary labels are generated automatically using pretrained segmentation models. Additionally, we demonstrate that auxiliary labels derived from interactive segmentation frameworks exhibit the same beneficial effect, demonstrating its robustness, simplicity, and broad applicability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BackSplit 方法，通过将背景细分为多个子类（如组织、器官等）来训练医学病变分割模型，从而在不增加推理成本的情况下提升小病灶分割性能。理论证明该方法能增加 Fisher 信息量，实验表明在多个数据集和架构上均有一致提升，且辅助标签可通过预训练模型自动生成。
Motivation: 传统病变分割将所有非病变像素视为单一背景类，忽略了背景的异质性，导致小病灶分割困难。
Method: 将背景类细分为多个解剖结构子类（BackSplit），使用细粒度标签训练分割模型；辅助标签可由预训练模型或交互式分割框架自动生成。
Result: 理论分析表明 BackSplit 增加期望 Fisher 信息量，多个数据集和架构上的实验证实该方法持续提升小病灶分割性能。
Conclusion: BackSplit 是一种简单有效的范式，无需增加推理成本即可显著提升小病灶分割性能，且对标签来源具有鲁棒性。

papers.title: HERMES: Towards Efficient and Verifiable Mathematical Reasoning in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Informal mathematics has been central to modern large language model (LLM) reasoning, offering flexibility and efficient construction of arguments. However, purely informal reasoning is prone to logical gaps and subtle errors that are difficult to detect and correct. In contrast, formal theorem proving provides rigorous, verifiable mathematical reasoning, where each inference step is checked by a trusted compiler, but lacks the exploratory freedom of informal problem-solving. This mismatch leaves current LLM-based math agents without a principled way to combine the strengths of both paradigms. In this work, we introduce Hermes, the first tool-assisted agent that explicitly interleaves informal reasoning with formally verified proofs in Lean. The framework performs intermediate formal checking to prevent reasoning drift and a memory module for proof continuity across multi-step reasoning chains, enabling both exploration and verification. We evaluate Hermes on four challenging mathematical reasoning benchmarks using LLMs of varying parameter scales, from small models to state-of-the-art systems. Across all settings, Hermes reliably improves the reasoning accuracy of base models while substantially reducing reasoning token usage and computational cost compared to reward-based approaches. On difficult datasets such as AIME and HARDMath2, Hermes@1 achieves up to a 40% accuracy improvement while using 80% fewer total inference FLOPs. When scaled at test time, Hermes@5 boosts accuracy further by 20%. The implementation and codebase are publicly available at https://github.com/aziksh-ospanov/HERMES.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HERMES，首个在 LLM 数学推理中交替使用非正式推理与形式化证明（Lean）的工具辅助智能体。通过中间形式化检查防止推理漂移，并利用记忆模块保证多步推理链的连续性，从而在探索与验证之间取得平衡。在多个基准上，HERMES 提升了基础模型的推理准确率，同时显著降低了推理 token 使用量和计算成本。
Motivation: 非正式推理灵活但易出现逻辑漏洞，形式化证明严谨但缺乏探索自由，现有 LLM 数学智能体无法有效结合两者优势。
Method: HERMES 是一个工具辅助智能体，显式地在非正式推理与 Lean 形式化证明之间交替，包含中间形式化检查和用于证明连续性的记忆模块。
Result: 在 AIME 和 HARDMath2 等困难数据集上，HERMES@1 相比基础模型提升高达 40% 的准确率，同时减少 80% 的总推理 FLOPs；HERMES@5 进一步提升 20% 准确率。
Conclusion: HERMES 提供了一种可验证且高效的数学推理框架，尤其适用于需要高可靠性的场景。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: HERMES 提供了一种可验证且高效的数学推理框架，尤其适用于需要高可靠性的场景。

papers.title: Deterministic Inference across Tensor Parallel Sizes That Eliminates Training-Inference Mismatch
papers.abstract_en: Deterministic inference is increasingly critical for large language model (LLM) applications such as LLM-as-a-judge evaluation, multi-agent systems, and Reinforcement Learning (RL). However, existing LLM serving frameworks exhibit non-deterministic behavior: identical inputs can yield different outputs when system configurations (e.g., tensor parallel (TP) size, batch size) vary, even under greedy decoding. This arises from the non-associativity of floating-point arithmetic and inconsistent reduction orders across GPUs. While prior work has addressed batch-size-related nondeterminism through batch-invariant kernels, determinism across different TP sizes remains an open problem, particularly in RL settings, where the training engine typically uses Fully Sharded Data Parallel (i.e., TP = 1) while the rollout engine relies on multi-GPU TP to maximize the inference throughput, creating a natural mismatch between the two. This precision mismatch problem may lead to suboptimal performance or even collapse for RL training. We identify and analyze the root causes of TP-induced inconsistency and propose Tree-Based Invariant Kernels (TBIK), a set of TP-invariant matrix multiplication and reduction primitives that guarantee bit-wise identical results regardless of TP size. Our key insight is to align intra- and inter-GPU reduction orders through a unified hierarchical binary tree structure. We implement these kernels in Triton and integrate them into vLLM and FSDP. Experiments confirm zero probability divergence and bit-wise reproducibility for deterministic inference across different TP sizes. Also, we achieve bit-wise identical results between vLLM and FSDP in RL training pipelines with different parallel strategy. Code is available at https://github.com/nanomaoli/llm_reproducibility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出大语言模型推理中的非确定性来源于浮点运算的非结合性与GPU间归约顺序不一致，尤其当张量并行（TP）大小改变时。作者提出基于树的归约核（TBIK），通过统一层次化二叉树结构对齐GPU内外的归约顺序，在vLLM和FSDP中实现跨TP大小的比特级确定性推理，并证明在RL训练管线中消除训练-推理精度不匹配。
Motivation: LLM应用中确定性推理至关重要，但现有框架在改变TP大小或批次大小时，即使采用贪婪解码也会产生不同输出。RL训练中，训练引擎使用FSDP（TP=1）而推理引擎使用多GPU TP，导致精度不匹配，可能引起训练次优甚至崩溃。
Method: 分析TP导致不一致的根因，提出Tree-Based Invariant Kernels (TBIK)，即一组对TP大小不变的矩阵乘法和归约原语，通过统一层次化二叉树结构对齐归约顺序，在Triton中实现并集成到vLLM和FSDP。
Result: 实验表明TBIK在不同TP大小下实现零概率发散和比特级可重复性，并在RL训练管线中使vLLM与FSDP之间达到比特级一致结果。
Conclusion: 该工作解决了跨TP大小的推理确定性难题，关键贡献在于用层次化二叉树强制统一归约顺序，且开源实现。

papers.title: Non-Parametric Probabilistic Robustness: A Conservative Risk Estimator under Unknown Perturbation Distributions
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning (DL) models, despite their remarkable success, remain vulnerable to small input perturbations that can cause erroneous outputs, motivating the recent proposal of probabilistic robustness (PR) as a complementary alternative to adversarial robustness (AR). However, existing PR formulations assume a fixed and known perturbation distribution, an unrealistic expectation in practice. To address this limitation, we propose non-parametric probabilistic robustness (NPPR), a more practical PR metric that does not rely on any predefined perturbation distribution. Following the non-parametric paradigm in statistical modeling, NPPR learns an optimized perturbation distribution directly from data, enabling conservative PR evaluation under distributional uncertainty. We further develop an NPPR estimator based on a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM), covering various input-dependent and input-independent perturbation scenarios. Theoretical analyses establish the relationships among AR, PR, and NPPR. Extensive experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and Tiny ImageNet across ResNet18/50, WideResNet50 and VGG16 validate NPPR as a more practical robustness metric, showing conservative (lower) PR estimates compared to assuming those common perturbation distributions used in state-of-the-arts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出非参数概率鲁棒性（NPPR），一种不依赖预设扰动分布的保守型概率鲁棒性度量。通过高斯混合模型从数据中学习优化扰动分布，在多个数据集和网络架构上验证了其比现有方法更保守（更低）的PR估计。
Motivation: 现有概率鲁棒性（PR）方法假设扰动分布固定且已知，这在实践中不现实，导致鲁棒性评估过于乐观。需要一种不依赖预设分布的保守型度量。
Method: 提出非参数概率鲁棒性（NPPR），采用高斯混合模型（GMM）从数据中学习扰动分布，涵盖输入相关与输入无关的扰动场景，并给出理论分析建立AR、PR和NPPR的关系。
Result: 在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和Tiny ImageNet上，使用ResNet18/50、WideResNet50和VGG16，NPPR给出的PR估计比现有常见扰动分布假设下的估计更保守（更低）。
Conclusion: NPPR提供了一种更实际的鲁棒性度量，能够处理扰动分布的不确定性，并给出保守的风险估计。

papers.title: PostCam: Camera-Controllable Novel-View Video Generation with Query-Shared Cross-Attention
papers.abstract_en: We propose PostCam, a streamlined framework for novel-view video generation that achieves superior detail preservation and precise camera trajectory editing in dynamic scenes. Current methods often struggle with a trade-off between pose-based control, which lacks visual detail, and rendering-based guidance, which is overly sensitive to geometric accuracy. Despite recent hybrid attempts, achieving precise motion and visual consistency remains challenging due to the lack of effective cross-modal alignment. We argue that robust control stems from the deep alignment of multimodal signals rather than increased input complexity. Our core contribution is the Query-Shared Cross-Attention mechanism, which projects 6-DoF poses and rendered features into a unified latent space. This allows the model to spontaneously achieve intrinsic consistency between motion cues and pixel-level guidance during denoising. Experiments demonstrate that PostCam maintains high-fidelity visual details while outperforming state-of-the-art methods by 20% in trajectory precision, exhibiting superior robustness in complex dynamic scenes. Our project webpage is publicly available at: https://cccqaq.github.io/PostCam.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PostCam，一种用于新视角视频生成的框架，通过查询共享交叉注意力机制实现相机可控的轨迹编辑和细节保留。在动态场景中，相比现有方法，轨迹精度提升20%。
Motivation: 现有新视角视频生成方法在姿态控制（缺乏视觉细节）和渲染引导（对几何精度敏感）之间存在权衡，缺乏有效的跨模态对齐。
Method: 核心是Query-Shared Cross-Attention机制，将6-DoF姿态和渲染特征投影到统一潜在空间，在去噪过程中实现运动线索和像素级指导的内在一致性。
Result: 实验表明PostCam保持高保真视觉细节，在轨迹精度上超越最先进方法20%，在复杂动态场景中表现出更强的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 强调深度对齐多模态信号（而非增加输入复杂度）是实现鲁棒控制的关键。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MultiPriv: Benchmarking Individual-Level Privacy Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Modern Vision-Language Models (VLMs) pose significant individual-level privacy risks by linking fragmented multimodal data to identifiable individuals through hierarchical chain-of-thought reasoning. However, existing privacy benchmarks remain structurally insufficient for this threat, as they primarily evaluate privacy perception while failing to address the more critical risk of privacy reasoning: a VLM's ability to infer and link distributed information to construct individual profiles. To address this gap, we propose MultiPriv, the first benchmark designed to systematically evaluate individual-level privacy reasoning in VLMs. We introduce the Privacy Perception and Reasoning (PPR) framework and construct a bilingual multimodal dataset with synthetic individual profiles, where identifiers, such as faces and names, are linked to sensitive attributes. This design enables nine challenging tasks spanning attribute detection, cross-image re-identification, and chained inference. We conduct a large-scale evaluation of over 50 open-source and commercial VLMs. In our controlled benchmark, 60% of widely used VLMs can perform individual-level privacy reasoning with up to 80% accuracy, suggesting a significant potential threat to personal privacy. The benchmark is available at https://github.com/CyberChangAn/MultiPriv-PII.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MultiPriv，首个系统评估视觉语言模型（VLM）个体级隐私推理能力的基准。通过隐私感知与推理（PPR）框架，构建包含面部、姓名等标识符与敏感属性关联的双语多模态数据集，涵盖属性检测、跨图像重识别和链式推理等九个任务。对50多个开源和商业VLM的评估显示，60%的VLM能以高达80%的准确率进行个体级隐私推理，揭示潜在的严重隐私威胁。
Motivation: 现有隐私基准主要评估VLM的隐私感知能力，但忽视了更关键的隐私推理风险：VLM通过链式推理链接分布式信息构建个体画像的能力。需要系统性的基准来量化这一威胁。
Method: 提出隐私感知与推理（PPR）框架，构建包含合成个体画像的双语多模态数据集，将面孔、姓名等标识符与敏感属性链接。设计9个挑战性任务，涵盖属性检测、跨图像重识别和链式推理。
Result: 对50多个开源和商业VLM的大规模评估显示，60%的VLM能进行个体级隐私推理，最高准确率达80%。
Conclusion: MultiPriv填补了VLM个体隐私推理评估的空白，表明广泛使用的VLM存在显著的隐私威胁，亟需关注。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SpectralTrain: A Universal Framework for Hyperspectral Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: Hyperspectral image (HSI) classification typically involves large-scale data and computationally intensive training, which limits the practical deployment of deep learning models in real-world remote sensing tasks. This study introduces SpectralTrain, a universal, architecture-agnostic training framework that enhances learning efficiency by integrating curriculum learning (CL) with principal component analysis (PCA)-based spectral downsampling. By gradually introducing spectral complexity while preserving essential information, SpectralTrain enables efficient learning of spectral -- spatial patterns at significantly reduced computational costs. The framework is independent of specific architectures, optimizers, or loss functions and is compatible with both classical and state-of-the-art (SOTA) models. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets -- Indian Pines, Salinas-A, and the newly introduced CloudPatch-7 -- demonstrate strong generalization across spatial scales, spectral characteristics, and application domains. The results indicate consistent reductions in training time by 2-7x speedups with small-to-moderate accuracy deltas depending on backbone. Its application to cloud classification further reveals potential in climate-related remote sensing, emphasizing training strategy optimization as an effective complement to architectural design in HSI models. Code is available at https://github.com/mh-zhou/SpectralTrain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SpectralTrain，一个与架构无关的高光谱图像分类训练框架，通过结合课程学习（CL）和基于PCA的光谱降采样来提升学习效率。在三个基准数据集（Indian Pines、Salinas-A、新提出的CloudPatch-7）上，该方法实现了2-7倍的训练加速，同时分类精度仅有小幅变化。
Motivation: 高光谱图像分类通常涉及大规模数据和计算密集型训练，限制了深度学习模型的实际部署。现有方法多关注架构设计，而训练策略优化未被充分探索。
Method: 提出SpectralTrain框架，整合课程学习（CL）和基于PCA的光谱降采样，逐步引入光谱复杂度同时保留关键信息，与具体架构、优化器或损失函数无关。
Result: 在Indian Pines、Salinas-A和CloudPatch-7数据集上，训练时间减少2-7倍，精度变化因骨干网络而异但整体保持稳定。在云分类任务中进一步显示了气候遥感应用潜力。
Conclusion: 训练策略优化可作为高光谱图像分类中架构设计的有效补充，SpectralTrain具有通用性和高效性。

papers.title: Hyperspectral Image Classification using Spectral-Spatial Mixer Network
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces SS-MixNet, a lightweight and effective deep learning model for hyperspectral image (HSI) classification. The architecture integrates 3D convolutional layers for local spectral-spatial feature extraction with two parallel MLP-style mixer blocks that capture long-range dependencies in spectral and spatial dimensions. A depthwise convolution-based attention mechanism is employed to enhance discriminative capability with minimal computational overhead. The model is evaluated on the QUH-Tangdaowan and QUH-Qingyun datasets using only 1% of labeled data for training and validation. SS-MixNet achieves the highest performance among compared methods, including 2D-CNN, 3D-CNN, IP-SWIN, SimPoolFormer, and HybridKAN, reaching 95.68% and 93.86% overall accuracy on the Tangdaowan and Qingyun datasets, respectively. The results, supported by quantitative metrics and classification maps, confirm the model's effectiveness in delivering accurate and robust predictions with limited supervision. The code will be made publicly available at: https://github.com/mqalkhatib/SS-MixNet
papers.comment: Accepted and published in IEEE WHISPERS2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SS-MixNet，一种轻量级深度学习模型用于高光谱图像(HSI)分类。该模型结合3D卷积层提取局部光谱-空间特征，以及两个并行的MLP风格混合器块捕获光谱和空间维度上的长程依赖。采用基于深度可分离卷积的注意力机制增强判别能力。在QUH-Tangdaowan和QUH-Qingyun数据集上仅用1%标注数据进行训练和验证，分别达到95.68%和93.86%的总体准确率，优于2D-CNN、3D-CNN、IP-SWIN、SimPoolFormer和HybridKAN等方法。
Motivation: 高光谱图像分类面临标注数据稀缺和计算成本高的挑战，现有模型如CNN和Transformer在轻量化和性能之间难以平衡。
Method: 提出SS-MixNet架构，由3D卷积模块、并行MLP混合器（光谱混合器和空间混合器）以及深度可分离卷积注意力机制组成，用于同时提取局部和全局特征。
Result: 在QUH-Tangdaowan和QUH-Qingyun数据集上，分别达到95.68%和93.86%总体准确率，优于所有对比方法。
Conclusion: SS-MixNet在有限标注条件下实现了高精度HSI分类，证实了其有效性和鲁棒性。

summary_sections.method: 提出SS-MixNet架构，由3D卷积模块、并行MLP混合器（光谱混合器和空间混合器）以及深度可分离卷积注意力机制组成，用于同时提取局部和全局特征。
summary_sections.result: 在QUH-Tangdaowan和QUH-Qingyun数据集上，分别达到95.68%和93.86%总体准确率，优于所有对比方法。
summary_sections.conclusion: SS-MixNet在有限标注条件下实现了高精度HSI分类，证实了其有效性和鲁棒性。

papers.title: Synthetic Stimuli, Real Gains: Rethinking VLM Fine-Tuning Through Fully Controlled Data Generation
papers.abstract_en: Performance gains of Vision Language Models (VLMs) obtained by fine-tuning are generally based on ad hoc data collection and annotation of real-world scenes. Despite the improvements, this process is often prone to biases, errors, and distribution imbalance, resulting in overfitting and imbalanced performance. Although a few studies have explored synthetic data generation, they typically lack control over data distribution and annotation quality. In this work, we re-evaluate the potential of model fine-tuning by exploring a fully controlled data generation and annotation pipeline, obtaining bias-free data with balanced distribution and clean annotations. Using the spatial reasoning task of identifying the absolute position of an object as a use case, we fine-tune state-of-the-art VLMs and conduct exhaustive evaluations on both synthetic and real-world benchmarks, including transferability to real-world scenes. Our experiments reveal two key findings: 1) fine-tuning on balanced data yields uniform performance across the visual scene and mitigates common biases with as few as 130 samples; and 2) fine-tuning on synthetic stimuli improves performance by 13% on real-world data (COCO), outperforming models fine-tuned on the full COCO train set.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种完全可控的数据生成与标注流水线，用于微调视觉语言模型（VLM），以消除数据偏差和分布不平衡。以空间推理任务（物体绝对位置识别）为例，仅用130个平衡样本微调即可在视觉场景上实现均匀性能，并在真实世界基准COCO上提升13%的性能，优于使用完整COCO训练集微调的模型。
Motivation: 现有VLM微调依赖真实场景的数据收集与标注，容易引入偏差、错误和分布不平衡，导致过拟合和性能不均。虽然已有少量研究使用合成数据，但通常缺乏对数据分布和标注质量的控制。
Method: 设计了一个完全可控的合成数据生成与标注流水线，确保数据分布平衡、标注清洁。以空间推理任务为例，生成合成刺激数据，微调最先进的VLM，并在合成和真实基准上进行评估。
Result: 两个关键发现：1）在平衡数据上微调，仅需130个样本即可实现视觉场景上的均匀性能并缓解常见偏差；2）在合成刺激上微调，在真实数据COCO上性能提升13%，超过在完整COCO训练集上微调的模型。
Conclusion: 完全可控的合成数据生成可以替代大规模真实数据标注，实现更高效、更均衡的VLM微调，并且具有良好的真实世界迁移性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Go-UT-Bench: A Fine-Tuning Dataset for LLM-Based Unit Test Generation in Go
papers.abstract_en: Training data imbalance poses a major challenge for code LLMs. Most available data heavily over represents raw opensource code while underrepresenting broader software engineering tasks, especially in low resource languages like Golang. As a result, models excel at code autocompletion but struggle with real world developer workflows such as unit test generation. To address this gap, we introduce GO UT Bench, a benchmark dataset of 5264 pairs of code and unit tests, drawn from 10 permissively licensed Golang repositories spanning diverse domain. We evaluate its effectiveness as a fine tuning dataset across two LLM families i.e. mixture of experts and dense decoders. Our results show that finetuned models outperform their base counterparts on more than 75% of benchmark tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了Go-UT-Bench，一个包含5264对代码和单元测试的基准数据集，用于微调LLM以生成Go语言的单元测试。数据集来自10个开源Go仓库，覆盖多个领域。实验表明，在超过75%的基准任务上，微调后的模型优于基础模型。
Motivation: 现有代码LLM训练数据偏向原始开源代码，缺乏软件工程任务数据，尤其是低资源语言如Go的单元测试生成。这导致模型在代码补全上表现好，但在实际开发工作流中表现不佳。
Method: 从10个许可宽松的Go仓库中收集并构建了5264对代码-单元测试的基准数据集Go-UT-Bench，并在混合专家模型和密集解码器两类LLM上评估其作为微调数据集的效果。
Result: 微调后的模型在超过75%的基准任务上超越了对应的基础模型。
Conclusion: Go-UT-Bench可有效提升LLM在Go语言单元测试生成上的性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Post-Training LLMs as Better Decision-Making Agents: A Regret-Minimization Approach
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as "agents" for decision-making (DM) in interactive and dynamic environments. Yet, since they were not originally designed for DM, recent studies show that LLMs can struggle even in basic online DM problems, failing to achieve low regret or an effective exploration-exploitation tradeoff. To address this, we introduce Iterative Regret-Minimization Fine-Tuning (Iterative RMFT), a post-training procedure that repeatedly distills low-regret decision trajectories back into the base model. At each iteration, the model rolls out multiple decision trajectories, selects the k-lowest regret ones, and fine-tunes itself on them. Unlike prior methods that (a) distill action sequences from known DM algorithms or (b) rely on manually crafted chain-of-thought templates, our approach leverages the regret metric to elicit the model's own DM ability and reasoning rationales. This reliance on model-generated reasoning avoids rigid output engineering and provides more flexible, natural-language training signals. Empirical results show that Iterative RMFT improves LLMs' DM performance across diverse models - from Transformers with numerical input/output, to open-weight LLMs, and advanced closed-weight models like GPT-4o mini. Its flexibility in output and reasoning formats enables generalization across tasks with varying horizons, action spaces, reward processes, and natural-language contexts. Finally, we provide theoretical insight showing that a single-layer Transformer under this paradigm can act as a no-regret learner in a simplified setting. Overall, Iterative RMFT offers a principled and general post-training framework for enhancing LLMs' decision-making capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Iterative RMFT，一种基于遗憾最小化的后训练方法，通过反复将低遗憾决策轨迹蒸馏回基础模型，提升LLM在交互式动态环境中的决策能力。实验表明该方法在多种模型上有效，并提供理论洞见。
Motivation: LLM原本并非为决策设计，在基本在线决策问题上表现不佳，难以实现低遗憾或有效探索-利用权衡。
Method: 迭代遗憾最小化微调：每轮模型生成多条决策轨迹，选择k条最低遗憾的轨迹进行自我微调，利用遗憾指标激发模型自身的决策能力和推理逻辑。
Result: 在多种模型（从数值输入输出的Transformer到开放权重LLM及GPT-4o mini）上提升决策性能，且输出格式灵活，可泛化到不同任务。
Conclusion: Iterative RMFT提供了一个有原则且通用的后训练框架，用于增强LLM的决策能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Scaling Multi-Agent Environment Co-Design with Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: The agent-environment co-design paradigm jointly optimises agent policies and environment configurations in search of improved system performance. With application domains ranging from warehouse logistics to windfarm management, co-design promises to fundamentally change how we deploy multi-agent systems. However, current co-design methods struggle to scale. They collapse under high-dimensional environment design spaces and suffer from sample inefficiency when addressing moving targets inherent to joint optimisation. We address these challenges by developing Diffusion Co-Design (DiCoDe), a scalable and sample-efficient co-design framework pushing co-design towards practically relevant settings. DiCoDe incorporates two core innovations. First, we introduce Projected Universal Guidance (PUG), a sampling technique that enables DiCoDe to explore a distribution of reward-maximising environments while satisfying hard constraints such as spatial separation between obstacles. Second, we devise a critic distillation mechanism to share knowledge from the reinforcement learning critic, ensuring that the guided diffusion model adapts to evolving agent policies using a dense and up-to-date learning signal. Together, these improvements lead to superior environment-policy pairs when validated on challenging multi-agent environment co-design benchmarks including warehouse automation, multi-agent pathfinding and wind farm optimisation. Our method consistently exceeds the state-of-the-art, achieving, for example, 39% higher rewards in the warehouse setting with 66% fewer simulation samples. This sets a new standard in agent-environment co-design, and is a stepping stone towards reaping the rewards of co-design in real world domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Diffusion Co-Design (DiCoDe)框架，通过Projected Universal Guidance (PUG)采样技术和评论家蒸馏机制，解决多智能体环境协同设计中高维环境设计空间和样本效率问题。在仓库自动化、多智能体路径规划和风电场优化等基准测试中，DiCoDe优于现有方法，在仓库设置中实现39%更高的奖励，并减少66%的模拟样本。
Motivation: 现有环境协同设计方法在高维环境设计空间中无法扩展，且样本效率低，难以应对联合优化中不断变化的目标。
Method: 提出DiCoDe框架，包含两个核心创新：Projected Universal Guidance (PUG)采样技术，用于探索奖励最大化的环境分布并满足硬约束；评论家蒸馏机制，从强化学习评论家共享知识，使扩散模型适应演化的智能体策略。
Result: 在仓库自动化、多智能体路径规划和风电场优化等基准上，DiCoDe持续超越最先进方法，例如在仓库设置中奖励提高39%，模拟样本减少66%。
Conclusion: 本文为多智能体环境协同设计设立了新标准，推动了该领域向实际应用发展。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Evaluating Extreme Precipitation Forecasts: A Threshold-Weighted, Spatial Verification Approach for Comparing an AI Weather Prediction Model Against a High-Resolution NWP Model
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in AI-based weather prediction have led to the development of artificial intelligence weather prediction (AIWP) models with competitive forecast skill compared to traditional NWP models, but with substantially reduced computational cost. There is a strong need for appropriate methods to evaluate their ability to predict extreme weather events, particularly when spatial coherence is important, and grid resolutions differ between models. We introduce a verification framework that combines spatial verification methods and proper scoring rules. Specifically, the framework extends the High-Resolution Assessment (HiRA) approach with threshold-weighted scoring rules. It enables user-oriented evaluation consistent with how forecasts may be interpreted by operational meteorologists or used in simple post-processing systems. The method supports targeted evaluation of extreme events by allowing flexible weighting of the relative importance of different decision thresholds. We demonstrate this framework by evaluating 32 months of precipitation forecasts from an AIWP model and a high-resolution NWP model. Our results show that model rankings are sensitive to the choice of neighbourhood size. Increasing the neighbourhood size has a greater impact on scores evaluating extreme-event performance for the high-resolution NWP model than for the AIWP model. At equivalent neighbourhood sizes, the high-resolution NWP model only outperformed the AIWP model in predicting extreme precipitation events at short lead times. We also demonstrate how this approach can be extended to evaluate discrimination ability in predicting heavy precipitation. We find that the high-resolution NWP model had superior discrimination ability at short lead times.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个结合空间验证方法和阈值加权评分规则的验证框架，用于评估AI天气预测（AIWP）模型与高分辨率NWP模型在极端降水预报上的表现。该框架扩展了高分辨率评估（HiRA）方法，支持用户导向的评估和极端事件的目标检验。实验基于32个月降水预报数据，结果显示模型排名对邻域大小敏感，高分辨率NWP仅在短提前期、同等邻域大小下优于AIWP模型，且判别能力更强。
Motivation: AIWP模型在计算成本低的同时展现出与NWP相当的预报技能，但缺乏针对极端天气事件空间一致性和不同网格分辨率下的适当评估方法。
Method: 提出验证框架，将空间验证方法（HiRA）与阈值加权评分规则结合，允许灵活调整不同决策阈值的权重以聚焦极端事件评估。
Result: 模型排名受邻域大小影响；增大邻域对高分辨率NWP模型极端事件评分的影响大于AIWP模型；在同等邻域大小和短提前期下，高分辨率NWP模型在极端降水预报和判别能力上优于AIWP模型。
Conclusion: 该框架适用于比较不同分辨率模型的极端降水预报性能，并揭示了模型表现对评估设置的敏感性。
Relevance: 92

papers.title: Capturing Gaze Shifts for Guidance: Cross-Modal Fusion Enhancement for VLM Hallucination Mitigation
papers.abstract_en: Vision language models (VLMs) often generate hallucination, i.e., content that cannot be substantiated by either textual or visual inputs. Prior work primarily attributes this to over-reliance on linguistic prior knowledge rather than visual inputs. Some methods attempt to mitigate hallucination by amplifying visual token attention proportionally to their attention scores. However, these methods overlook the visual attention sink problem, where attention is frequently misallocated to task-irrelevant visual regions, and neglect cross-modal fusion balance by enhancing only visual attention without adjusting attention to the user query. This can result in amplifying incorrect areas while failing to properly interpret the user query. To address these challenges, we propose a simple yet effective method called Gaze Shift-Guided Cross-modal Fusion Enhancement (GIFT). GIFT pre-computes a holistic visual saliency map by tracking positive changes in visual attention, or "gaze shifts", during user query comprehension, and leverages this map to amplify attention to both salient visual information and the user query at each decoding step. This reduces the impact of visual attention sink, as irrelevant tokens exhibit minimal shifts, while ensuring balanced cross-modal fusion for well-integrated representation. Extensive experiments show that GIFT effectively mitigates hallucination in VLMs across both generative and classification tasks, achieving up to 20.7% improvement over greedy decoding, while maintaining general vision-language performance with low computational overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉语言模型（VLM）生成幻觉的问题，提出一种名为GIFT的跨模态融合增强方法。通过预计算视觉显著性图（saliency map）并追踪注意力中的“注视转移”（gaze shifts），GIFT在解码步骤中同时增强对显著视觉信息和用户查询的注意力，缓解视觉注意力下沉（visual attention sink）问题，实现平衡的跨模态融合。实验表明，该方法在生成和分类任务上有效缓解幻觉，相比贪婪解码提升最多20.7%，且计算开销低。
Motivation: 现有VLM缓解幻觉的方法通常仅按注意力分数放大视觉token注意力，却忽略了视觉注意力下沉问题——注意力经常被错误分配到与任务无关的视觉区域，并且未能调整对用户查询的注意力，导致跨模态融合不平衡。
Method: 提出GIFT方法：预计算整体视觉显著性图，通过追踪用户查询理解过程中视觉注意力的正变化（即“注视转移”）生成；在每个解码步骤利用该图同时增强对显著视觉信息和用户查询的注意力，减少无关token的影响，确保平衡的跨模态融合。
Result: 在多种VLM上，GIFT在生成和分类任务中有效缓解幻觉，相比贪婪解码性能提升最多20.7%，同时保持通用视觉语言性能，计算开销低。
Conclusion: GIFT通过引入视线转移引导的跨模态融合增强，简单有效地缓解了VLM幻觉，且不损害通用能力，具有低计算开销的优势。

papers.title: Elastic ViTs from Pretrained Models without Retraining
papers.abstract_en: Vision foundation models achieve remarkable performance but are only available in a limited set of pre-determined sizes, forcing sub-optimal deployment choices under real-world constraints. We introduce SnapViT: Single-shot network approximation for pruned Vision Transformers, a new post-pretraining structured pruning method that enables elastic inference across a continuum of compute budgets. Our approach efficiently combines gradient information with cross-network structure correlations, approximated via an evolutionary algorithm, does not require labeled data, generalizes to models without a classification head, and is retraining-free. Experiments on DINO, SigLIPv2, DeIT, and AugReg models demonstrate superior performance over state-of-the-art methods across various sparsities, requiring less than five minutes on a single A100 GPU to generate elastic models that can be adjusted to any computational budget. Our key contributions include an efficient pruning strategy for pretrained Vision Transformers, a novel evolutionary approximation of Hessian off-diagonal structures, and a self-supervised importance scoring mechanism that maintains strong performance without requiring retraining or labels. Code and pruned models are available at: https://elastic.ashita.nl/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SnapViT，一种无需重训练的后训练结构化剪枝方法，用于视觉 Transformer（ViT）的弹性推理。该方法结合梯度信息与进化算法近似的跨网络结构相关性，无需标注数据，且不依赖分类头，能在 5 分钟内从单个 ViT 模型生成适应任意计算预算的弹性模型。在 DINO、SigLIPv2、DeIT、AugReg 等模型上，该方法在不同稀疏度下均优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有视觉基础模型仅提供有限几种预定义尺寸，导致实际部署时只能进行次优选择。需要一种高效的后剪枝方法，使单一模型能动态适应不同计算预算，且无需重训练或标注数据。
Method: SnapViT 方法包括：利用梯度信息评估重要性，通过进化算法近似 Hessian 矩阵的非对角结构以捕捉跨层相关性，并采用自监督重要性评分机制。整个过程无需重训练、无需标签、不依赖分类头，在单张 A100 GPU 上可在 5 分钟内完成。
Result: 在 DINO、SigLIPv2、DeIT 和 AugReg 等 ViT 模型上，SnapViT 在不同稀疏度下均优于现有结构化剪枝方法，且能生成支持任意计算预算的弹性模型。
Conclusion: SnapViT 提供了一种高效、无需重训练的 ViT 后剪枝方案，通过进化近似 Hessian 结构和自监督评分，实现了计算弹性和性能之间的良好平衡。

papers.title: Expert Merging in Sparse Mixture of Experts with Nash Bargaining
papers.abstract_en: Existing expert merging strategies for Sparse Mixture of Experts (SMoE) typically rely on input-dependent or input-independent averaging of expert parameters, but often lack a principled weighting mechanism. In this work, we reinterpret expert merging through the lens of game theory, revealing cooperative and competitive dynamics among experts. Based on this perspective, we introduce Nash Merging of Experts (NAMEx), a novel framework that incorporates Nash Bargaining into the merging process, enabling more balanced and efficient collaboration among experts. Additionally, we incorporate complex momentum into NAMEx to accelerate expert propagation with theoretical guarantees for convergence. Extensive experiments across language modelling, text classification, image classification, and zero-shot robustness under data corruption show that NAMEx consistently outperforms competing methods while integrating seamlessly with popular MoE architectures. Finally, we demonstrate NAMEx's scalability by applying it to large-scale systems, including Qwen1.5-MoE (14B) and DeepSeek-MoE (16B), where it proves effective in both zero-shot and fine-tuning settings. The code is publicly available at: https://github.com/anh147/NAMEx.
papers.comment: 10 pages in the main text. ICLR 2026 Poster
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从博弈论视角重新解释稀疏MoE中的专家合并，揭示专家间的合作与竞争动态。提出NAMEx框架，将纳什议价引入合并过程，实现更均衡高效的专家协作，并加入复杂动量加速收敛。在语言建模、文本分类、图像分类和零样本鲁棒性任务上超越对比方法，并在Qwen1.5-MoE(14B)和DeepSeek-MoE(16B)上展示可扩展性。
Motivation: 现有专家合并策略缺乏原则性的加权机制，通常采用输入依赖或无关的平均加权，忽视了专家间的博弈动力学。
Method: 提出NAMEx框架，基于博弈论中的纳什议价（Nash Bargaining）为专家合并提供原理性加权，并融入复杂动量（complex momentum）加速专家传播，具有收敛理论保证。
Result: 在语言建模、文本分类、图像分类和零样本鲁棒性任务上，NAMEx一致优于现有合并方法；在大规模系统Qwen1.5-MoE(14B)和DeepSeek-MoE(16B)上，在零样本和微调设置下均有效。
Conclusion: 本文展示了基于纳什议价的专家合并框架NAMEx在多种任务和大规模系统中的有效性，为MoE专家合并提供了博弈论视角的新途径。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: InfiMed-ORBIT: Aligning LLMs on Open-Ended Complex Tasks via Rubric-Based Incremental Training
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has powered many recent breakthroughs in large language models (LLMs), especially for tasks where rewards can be computed automatically, such as code generation. However, it is less effective in open-ended medical dialogue, where feedback is ambiguous, context-dependent, and difficult to simply summarize into a single scalar signal-often requiring heavily supervised reward models and creating risks of reward hacking. Thus, we introduce ORBIT, an open-ended rubric-based incremental training framework tailored for critical medical dialogues. ORBIT integrates medical dialogue construction with dynamically generated case-conditioned rubrics that serve as adaptive guides for incremental RL. Unlike approaches that rely on external medical knowledge bases or handcrafted rules, ORBIT uses rubric-guided evaluation and can be implemented with general-purpose instruction-following LLMs, avoiding task-specific judge fine-tuning. With only 2k training samples, ORBIT raises Qwen3-4B-Instruct's HealthBench-Hard score from 7.0 to 27.5, achieving state-of-the-art performance among similarly sized open-source models while maintaining strong consultation quality as rubric coverage broadens.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ORBIT框架，一种基于开放性评分标准的增量训练方法，用于对齐LLM在复杂医疗对话中的表现。通过动态生成病例相关的评分标准指导强化学习，仅用2000训练样本就将Qwen3-4B-Instruct在HealthBench-Hard上的分数从7.0提升到27.5，达到同规模开源模型最优水平。
Motivation: 现有强化学习在开放式医疗对话中效果不佳，因为反馈模糊且依赖上下文，难以简化为单一标量信号，且需重型奖励模型，存在奖励破解风险。
Method: ORBIT整合医疗对话构建与动态生成的病例条件评分标准（rubric），将评分标准作为增量强化学习的自适应指导，无需外部知识库或人工规则，使用通用指令跟随LLM实现。
Result: 仅用2000训练样本，Qwen3-4B-Instruct在HealthBench-Hard上从7.0提升至27.5，达到同规模开源模型最优，且随评分标准覆盖扩大保持良好咨询质量。
Conclusion: 基于评分标准的增量训练能有效提升LLM在开放式医疗对话中的表现，且数据效率高。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Singularity-free dynamical invariants-based quantum control
papers.abstract_en: State preparation is a cornerstone of quantum technologies, underpinning applications in computation, communication, and sensing. Its importance becomes even more pronounced in non-Markovian open quantum systems, where environmental memory and model uncertainties pose significant challenges to achieving high-fidelity control. Invariant-based inverse engineering provides a principled framework for synthesizing analytic control fields, yet existing parameterizations often lead to experimentally infeasible, singular pulses and are limited to simplified noise models such as those of Lindblad form. Here, we introduce a generalized invariant-based protocol for finite-dimensional state preparation under arbitrary noise conditions. We transform the finite-dimensional control problem into the equivalent problem for a single-qubit, by restricting the dynamics to a designed SU(2) subspace. The control protocol then proceeds in two-stages: first, we construct a family of bounded pulses that achieve perfect state preparation in a closed system; second, we identify the optimal member of this family that minimizes the effect of noise. The framework accommodates both (i) characterized noise, enabling noise-aware control synthesis, and (ii) uncharacterized noise, where a noise-agnostic variant preserves robustness without requiring a master-equation description. Numerical simulations demonstrate high-fidelity state preparation across diverse targets while producing smooth, hardware-feasible control fields. This singularity-free framework extends invariant-based control to realistic open-system regimes, providing a versatile route toward robust quantum state engineering on NISQ hardware and other platforms exhibiting non-Markovian dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于广义动力学不变量（dynamical invariants）的量子控制协议，适用于任意噪声条件下的有限维量子系统状态制备。该方法通过将系统限制在设计的SU(2)子空间内，将多能级控制问题转化为单量子比特问题，并分两步设计：先构造无噪声封闭系统中的有界脉冲实现完美状态制备，再在该族脉冲中选取对噪声最不敏感的最优解。数值模拟展示了高保真度的状态制备和硬件可行的平滑控制场。
Motivation: 非马尔可夫开放量子系统中环境记忆和模型不确定性对高保真度状态制备构成挑战，现有基于不变量的逆向工程方案存在参数化导致的奇异脉冲问题，并局限于简化噪声模型（如Lindblad形式）。
Method: 引入广义不变量协议：将有限维控制问题通过限制动力学至设计的SU(2)子空间转化为单量子比特问题；两步法——先构造封闭系统下实现完美制备的有界脉冲族，再识别该族中对噪声影响最小的最优成员。支持已刻画噪声（噪声感知控制）和未刻画噪声（噪声不知情鲁棒控制）。
Result: 数值模拟显示该方法能在多种目标状态下实现高保真度状态制备，并产生光滑、硬件可行的控制场。
Conclusion: 该无奇点框架将基于不变量的控制扩展到实际开放系统领域，为NISQ硬件及其他非马尔可夫动力学平台上的鲁棒量子态工程提供了通用途径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CaptionFormer: Unified Segmentation, Tracking, and Captioning for Spatio-Temporal Objects
papers.abstract_en: Dense Video Object Captioning (DVOC) is the task of jointly detecting, tracking, and captioning object trajectories in a video, requiring the ability to understand spatio-temporal details and describe them in natural language. Due to the complexity of the task and the high cost associated with manual annotation, previous approaches resort to training strategies with limited data, potentially leading to suboptimal performance. To circumvent this issue, we propose to generate captions about spatio-temporally localized entities leveraging a state-of-the-art VLM, and extend the LVIS and LV-VIS datasets with our synthetic captions (LVISCap and LV-VISCap). Moreover, we introduce an end-to-end model, CaptionFormer, capable of jointly detecting, segmenting, tracking and captioning object trajectories. CaptionFormer achieves state-of-the-art DVOC results on three existing benchmarks, VidSTG, VLN and BenSMOT. The datasets and code are available at https://www.gabriel.fiastre.fr/captionformer/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对密集视频对象字幕（DVOC）任务，利用预训练的VLM生成合成字幕，扩展了LVIS和LV-VIS数据集（LVISCap、LV-VISCap），并提出了端到端模型CaptionFormer，能够同时检测、分割、跟踪和描述视频中的对象轨迹。在VidSTG、VLN和BenSMOT三个基准上取得了最新最优结果。
Motivation: DVOC任务需要同时理解时空细节并用自然语言描述，但手动标注成本高导致现有方法数据有限性能欠佳。
Method: 使用先进的VLM生成时空局部实体的合成字幕，构建LVISCap和LV-VISCap数据集；提出端到端模型CaptionFormer，联合检测、分割、跟踪和字幕生成。
Result: 在VidSTG、VLN和BenSMOT三个基准上达到DVOC任务的最新最优性能。
Conclusion: 合成数据与端到端联合模型能有效提升DVOC性能，数据集和代码已开源。
