papers.title: Reinforced sequential Monte Carlo for amortised sampling
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a synergy of amortised and particle-based methods for sampling from distributions defined by unnormalised density functions. We state a connection between sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) and neural sequential samplers trained by maximum-entropy reinforcement learning (MaxEnt RL), wherein learnt sampling policies and value functions define proposal kernels and twist functions. Exploiting this connection, we introduce an off-policy RL training procedure for the sampler that uses samples from SMC -- using the learnt sampler as a proposal -- as a behaviour policy that better explores the target distribution. We describe techniques for stable joint training of proposals and twist functions and an adaptive weight tempering scheme to reduce training signal variance. Furthermore, building upon past attempts to use experience replay to guide the training of neural samplers, we derive a way to combine historical samples with annealed importance sampling weights within a replay buffer. On synthetic multi-modal targets (in both continuous and discrete spaces) and the Boltzmann distribution of alanine dipeptide conformations, we demonstrate improvements in approximating the true distribution as well as training stability compared to both amortised and Monte Carlo methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种摊销采样与粒子方法相结合的框架，通过最大熵强化学习训练顺序蒙特卡洛（SMC）中的提议分布和扭曲函数，并利用离线策略强化学习从SMC采样中学习，提高对未归一化密度函数定义的目标分布的采样效率。在合成多模态目标（连续和离散空间）以及丙氨酸二肽构象的玻尔兹曼分布上，该方法在近似真实分布和训练稳定性方面均优于传统的摊销方法和蒙特卡洛方法。
Motivation: 现有摊销采样方法难以高效地从复杂未归一化分布中采样，而粒子方法（如SMC）虽有效但计算成本高。本文旨在结合两者的优势，通过强化学习实现更稳定、高效的采样。
Method: 建立一个顺序蒙特卡洛（SMC）与最大熵强化学习（MaxEnt RL）之间的理论联系，推导出使用学习到的采样策略和价值函数作为SMC的提议核和扭曲函数。引入一种离线策略RL训练过程，利用SMC（以学习到的采样器为提议）作为行为策略来更好地探索目标分布。提出稳定联合训练提议和扭曲函数的技术，以及自适应权重退火方案以降低训练信号方差。进一步结合历史样本与退火重要性采样权重，构建经验回放缓冲区。
Result: 在合成多模态目标（连续和离散空间）以及丙氨酸二肽构象的玻尔兹曼分布上，该方法在近似真实分布和训练稳定性方面均优于传统的摊销方法和蒙特卡洛方法。
Conclusion: 本文提出的强化顺序蒙特卡洛方法有效结合了摊销采样与粒子方法的优势，通过离线策略强化学习和经验回放等技术，显著提升了复杂分布采样的效率和稳定性。

papers.title: Boundary-Guided Policy Optimization for Memory-efficient RL of Diffusion Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: A key challenge in applying reinforcement learning (RL) to diffusion large language models (dLLMs) is the intractability of their likelihood functions, which are essential for the RL objective, necessitating corresponding approximation during training. While existing methods approximate the log-likelihoods by their evidence lower bounds (ELBOs) via customized Monte Carlo (MC) sampling, they incur significant memory overhead due to the need to retain all MC samples for the gradient computation of non-linear terms in the RL objective, and thus restrict feasible sample sizes, leading to imprecise likelihood approximations and distorted RL objective. To address this, we propose \emph{Boundary-Guided Policy Optimization} (BGPO), a memory-efficient RL algorithm that maximizes a specially constructed lower bound of the ELBO-based objective. This lower bound is carefully designed to satisfy two key properties: (1) Linearity: it is a linear sum where each term depends only on a single MC sample, thereby enabling gradient accumulation across samples and ensuring constant memory usage; (2) Equivalence: Both the value and gradient of this lower bound are equal to those of the ELBO-based objective in on-policy training, making it also an effective approximation for the original RL objective. These properties allow BGPO to adopt a large MC sample size, improving likelihood approximations and RL objective estimation, which in turn leads to enhanced performance. Experiments show that BGPO significantly outperforms previous RL algorithms for dLLMs in math problem solving, code generation, and planning tasks. Our codes and models are available at \href{https://github.com/THU-KEG/BGPO}{https://github.com/THU-KEG/BGPO}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对强化学习应用于扩散大语言模型(dLLM)时似然函数难以处理的内存开销问题，提出边界引导策略优化(BGPO)。BGPO构造了一个ELBO目标的下界，该下界具有线性性和等价性，使得可以采用大MC样本大小而不增加内存，从而改进似然近似和RL目标估计。实验表明在数学推理、代码生成和规划任务上显著优于之前的方法。
Motivation: 现有方法在近似dLLM的对数似然时使用MC采样，但需要保留所有样本来计算RL目标中非线性项的梯度，导致内存开销大，限制了样本大小，造成似然近似和RL目标扭曲。
Method: 提出BGPO，通过构造ELBO目标的特殊下界，该下界满足线性性（每个项只依赖单个MC样本，支持梯度累积，内存恒定）和等价性（在on-policy训练中值与梯度与原目标相同），从而支持大MC样本量。
Result: 实验表明BGPO在数学问题求解、代码生成和规划任务上显著优于之前的dLLM RL算法。
Conclusion: BGPO通过内存高效的优化方式改善了dLLM强化学习中的似然近似和RL目标估计，提升了性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Adversarial Robustness in One-Stage Learning-to-Defer
papers.abstract_en: Learning-to-Defer (L2D) enables hybrid decision-making by routing inputs either to a predictor or to external experts. While promising, L2D is highly vulnerable to adversarial perturbations, which can not only flip predictions but also manipulate deferral decisions. Prior robustness analyses focus solely on two-stage settings, leaving open the end-to-end (one-stage) case where predictor and allocation are trained jointly. We introduce the first framework for adversarial robustness in one-stage L2D, covering both classification and regression. Our approach formalizes attacks, proposes cost-sensitive adversarial surrogate losses, and establishes theoretical guarantees including $\mathcal{H}$, $(\mathcal{R }, \mathcal{F})$, and Bayes consistency. Experiments on benchmark datasets confirm that our methods improve robustness against untargeted and targeted attacks while preserving clean performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究一阶段学习推迟（Learning-to-Defer, L2D）中的对抗鲁棒性问题，覆盖分类与回归任务。作者形式化了针对L2D的对抗攻击，提出了代价敏感的对抗代理损失函数，并建立了包括ℋ一致性、(ℜ ℝ, ℱ)一致性和贝叶斯一致性在内的理论保证。在多个基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法在保持干净样本性能的同时，显著提升了对无目标攻击和目标攻击的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有L2D的鲁棒性分析仅局限于两阶段设置（先训练预测器再训练分配器），而端到端的一阶段训练场景未被探索。L2D系统易受对抗扰动影响，不仅可能导致预测错误，还可能操纵延迟决策（即错误地将样本路由给专家或预测器），威胁系统安全。
Method: 提出第一个针对一阶段L2D的对抗鲁棒性框架。形式化攻击目标包括同时欺骗预测器和分配器；设计代价敏感的对抗代理损失函数，根据错误类型赋予不同权重；从理论上证明所提方法满足ℋ一致性、(ℜ ℝ, ℱ)一致性和贝叶斯一致性，确保优化合理性。
Result: 在基准数据集（具体名称未在摘要中列出）上的实验证实，所提方法能有效提升对无目标攻击（随机扰动）和目标攻击（特定误导）的鲁棒性，且不降低干净样本上的准确率或延迟决策质量。
Conclusion: 该工作填补了一阶段L2D对抗鲁棒性研究的空白，为混合决策系统的安全部署提供了理论工具和实用方法。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: VAD-GS: Visibility-Aware Densification for 3D Gaussian Splatting in Dynamic Urban Scenes
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) has demonstrated impressive performance in synthesizing high-fidelity novel views. Nonetheless, its effectiveness critically depends on the quality of the initialized point cloud. Specifically, achieving uniform and complete point coverage over the underlying scene structure requires overlapping observation frustums, an assumption that is often violated in unbounded, dynamic urban environments. Training Gaussian models with partially initialized point clouds often leads to distortions and artifacts, as camera rays may fail to intersect valid surfaces, resulting in incorrect gradient propagation to Gaussian primitives associated with occluded or invisible geometry. Additionally, existing densification strategies simply clone and split Gaussian primitives from existing ones, incapable of reconstructing geometry from missing structures. To address these limitations, we propose VAD-GS, a 3DGS framework tailored for geometry recovery in challenging urban scenes. Our method identifies unreliable geometry structures via voxel-based visibility reasoning, selects informative supporting views through diversity-aware view selection, and recovers missing structures via multi-view stereo reconstruction. This design enables the generation of new Gaussian primitives guided by reliable geometric priors, even in regions lacking initial points. Extensive experiments on the Waymo and nuScenes datasets demonstrate that VAD-GS outperforms state-of-the-art 3DGS approaches and significantly improves the quality of reconstructed geometry for both static and dynamic objects. Our project webpage is at mias.group/VAD-GS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出VAD-GS，一种针对动态城市场景的3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）框架，用于解决因点云初始化不完整导致的几何畸变与伪影问题。该方法通过基于体素的可视性推理识别不可靠几何结构，利用多样性感知视图选择信息丰富的支撑视图，并借助多视图立体匹配恢复缺失结构，从而在缺乏初始点的区域生成新的高斯原语。在Waymo和nuScenes数据集上的实验表明，VAD-GS在静态和动态物体的几何重建质量上均优于现有3DGS方法。
Motivation: 现有3DGS依赖于观测视锥重叠以实现均匀完整点云覆盖，但在无界动态城市场景中这一假设常被违反，导致训练出的高斯模型出现畸变和伪影。现有稠密化策略仅能复制或分裂现有高斯原语，无法重建缺失结构。
Method: 提出VAD-GS框架，包含三部分：基于体素的可视性推理定位不可靠几何结构，多样性感知视图选择选取信息丰富的支撑视图，以及通过多视图立体匹配恢复缺失结构。该框架能利用可靠的几何先验生成新的高斯原语，即使在没有初始点的区域也能工作。
Result: 在Waymo和nuScenes数据集上，VAD-GS在静态和动态物体的几何重建质量上均显著优于现有最先进的3DGS方法。
Conclusion: VAD-GS通过可视性感知的稠密化策略有效处理了动态城市场景中几何恢复的挑战，改善了3DGS在初始化不佳情况下的重建质量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Expand Neurons, Not Parameters
papers.abstract_en: This work demonstrates how increasing the number of neurons in a network without increasing its total number of non-zero parameters improves performance. We show that this gain corresponds with a decrease in interference between multiple features that would otherwise share the same neurons. On symbolic Boolean tasks, splitting each neuron into sparser sub-neurons with knowledge of the clauses systematically reduces polysemanticity metrics and yields higher task accuracy. Notably, even random splits of neuron weights approximate these gains, indicating that reduced collisions, not precise assignment, are a primary driver. Consistent with the superposition hypothesis, the benefits of this framework grow with increasing interference: when polysemantic load is high, accuracy improvements are the largest. Transferring these insights to more realistic models, including classifiers over CLIP embeddings, convolutional neural networks, and deeper multilayer networks, we find that widening networks while maintaining a constant non-zero parameter count consistently increases accuracy. These results identify an interpretability-grounded mechanism to leverage width against superposition, improving performance without increasing the number of non-zero parameters. Such a direction is well matched to modern accelerators, where memory movement of non-zero parameters, rather than raw compute, is often a dominant bottleneck.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026). 9 pages, 6 figures. Code available at https://github.com/Shavit-Lab/Expand-Neurons
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明，在不增加非零参数数量的前提下增加神经元数量可以提升网络性能，其增益源于减少多特征共用同一神经元时的干扰（interference）。在符号布尔任务中，将每个神经元分裂为更稀疏的子神经元（即使随机分裂）能降低多语义性（polysemanticity）指标并提高准确率；在CLIP嵌入分类器、CNN和深层MLP等更现实模型上，保持非零参数数不变而加宽网络一致提升精度。作者将此归因于利用宽度对抗叠加（superposition）的可解释性机制，且与现代加速器中非零参数内存移动瓶颈相匹配。
Motivation: 现有神经网络中，多个特征可能共享同一神经元导致干扰（polysemanticity），限制性能。作者试图在不增加非零参数（即计算/内存成本）的前提下，通过增加神经元数量来缓解这一冲突。
Method: 提出神经元分裂（neuron splitting）方法：将每个神经元及其权重拆分为多个更稀疏的子神经元，使不同特征有更独立的表示空间。实验对比了基于知识的分裂与随机分裂，并将该策略应用于CLIP嵌入分类器、CNN和深层MLP。
Result: 在符号布尔任务上，神经元分裂系统性地降低多语义性指标并提高任务准确率，且随机分裂也能近似这些增益。在CLIP分类、CNN和深层MLP上，保持非零参数数不变而加宽网络一致提升准确率，且当多语义负荷高时收益最大。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过增加神经元数量来减少特征干扰是一种有效且与硬件瓶颈匹配的性能提升方式，无需增加非零参数。该方法提供了基于可解释性的宽度利用方向。

papers.title: Skin Lesion Classification Based on ResNet-50 Enhanced With Adaptive Spatial Feature Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Skin cancer classification is challenging due to high inter-class similarity, intra-class variability, and artifacts in dermoscopic images. To address these issues, we propose an improved ResNet-50 with Adaptive Spatial Feature Fusion (ASFF), which adaptively integrates multi-scale semantic and surface features to refine representations and reduce overfitting. The ResNet-50 model is enhanced with an adaptive feature fusion mechanism to achieve more effective multi-scale feature extraction and improve overall performance. Specifically, a dual-branch design fuses high-level semantic and mid-level detail features which use global average pooling and fully connected layers to produce spatial weights, and emphasizes lesion-relevant regions. Evaluated on a balanced subset of ISIC 2020 (3,297 images, randomly selected from the original dataset), the ASFF-based ResNet-50 outperforms multiple CNN baselines, achieving 93.182% accuracy with superior precision, recall, specificity, and F1. It also reaches 0.9670 AUC (P-R) and 0.9717 AUC (ROC). Grad-CAM visualizations show more accurate focus on lesion areas.The proposed model also generalizes well to ISIC 2019 external validation, outperforming the ResNet-50 baseline. These findings demonstrate that the proposed approach provides a more effective and efficient solution for computer-aided skin cancer diagnosis. The generation codes, weights and confusion matrices are open sourced in https://github.com/Grapesea/ASFF-ResNet50-enhanced.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对皮肤癌分类中类间相似性高、类内变异大及伪影干扰等问题，提出一种基于ResNet-50的改进模型，引入自适应空间特征融合（ASFF）机制。该模型采用双分支结构，融合高层语义特征与中层细节特征，通过全局平均池化和全连接层生成空间权重，突出病灶区域。在ISIC 2020平衡子集（3297张图像）上，ASFF-ResNet-50达到93.182%准确率，AUC（P-R）0.9670，AUC（ROC）0.9717，优于多种CNN基线。Grad-CAM可视化显示其更精确地聚焦于病变区域，并在ISIC 2019外部验证集上表现良好。
Motivation: 皮肤癌分类因类间相似性高、类内变异大以及皮肤镜图像中的伪影而具有挑战性，现有CNN基线难以有效处理这些问题。
Method: 改进ResNet-50，引入自适应空间特征融合（ASFF）机制，采用双分支结构融合高层语义特征与中层细节特征，通过全局平均池化和全连接层生成空间权重，强调病灶相关区域，实现多尺度特征的有效提取。
Result: 在ISIC 2020平衡子集（3297张图像）上，ASFF-ResNet-50达到93.182%准确率，优于多种CNN基线，AUC（P-R）0.9670，AUC（ROC）0.9717。在ISIC 2019外部验证集上，模型泛化性能优于ResNet-50基线。
Conclusion: 所提出的方法为计算机辅助皮肤癌诊断提供了更有效、更高效的解决方案，代码和权重已开源。

papers.title: Technical note on Sequential Test-Time Adaptation via Martingale-Driven Fisher Prompting
papers.abstract_en: We present a theoretical framework for M-FISHER, a method for sequential distribution shift detection and stable adaptation in streaming data. For detection, we construct an exponential martingale from non-conformity scores and apply Ville's inequality to obtain time-uniform guarantees on false alarm control, ensuring statistical validity at any stopping time. Under sustained shifts, we further bound the expected detection delay as $\mathcal{O}(\log(1/δ)/Γ)$, where $Γ$ reflects the post-shift information gain, thereby linking detection efficiency to distributional divergence. For adaptation, we show that Fisher-preconditioned updates of prompt parameters implement natural gradient descent on the distributional manifold, yielding locally optimal updates that minimize KL divergence while preserving stability and parameterization invariance. Together, these results establish M-FISHER as a principled approach for robust, anytime-valid detection and geometrically stable adaptation in sequential decision-making under covariate shift.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出了M-FISHER的理论框架，用于流数据中的顺序分布漂移检测和稳定适应。检测部分利用指数鞅和时间均匀误报控制，适应部分通过Fisher预处理实现自然梯度下降，保证局部最优和稳定性。
Motivation: 需要一种原则性方法，在协变量偏移下进行随时有效的分布漂移检测和几何稳定适应，同时保证统计有效性和检测效率。
Method: 构建指数鞅进行检测，应用Ville不等式获得误报控制，并导出检测延迟界限；适应部分使用Fisher信息矩阵预处理prompt参数的更新，实现自然梯度下降。
Result: 理论保证：检测误报控制具有时间均匀性，预期检测延迟为O(log(1/δ)/Γ)；适应更新最小化KL散度，保持参数化不变性。
Conclusion: 摘要宣称M-FISHER为顺序决策中鲁棒的分布偏移检测和适应提供了原则性框架。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: LLMs Lean on Priors, Not Programming Language Semantics
papers.abstract_en: Recent work asks whether large language models (LLMs) condition their reasoning on explicit rules rather than statistical regularities from pretraining. Program execution provides a canonical instance: formal semantics define behavior through symbolic transition rules that can be systematically altered under distribution shift. We investigate whether LLMs can condition their reasoning on formal semantics through program execution and introduce PLSemanticsBench, pairing featherweight C programs with two semantic systems -- small-step operational semantics and K semantics -- and probing four capabilities: composing rules for final states, selecting rules when state is unmutated, sustaining such conditioning over long traces, and following supplied rules under novel semantics. To decouple semantic reasoning from syntactic familiarity, we redefine familiar operators to induce symbol-meaning conflict and introduce novel symbols defined only through the supplied rules, and stress-test models on Human-Written, LLM-Translated, and Fuzzer-Generated splits with increasing structural complexity. Across 11 frontier LLMs, strong final-state accuracy under standard semantics (up to 90%) drops sharply -- by as much as 40--60% points -- under semantic mutations and increasing structural complexity. Only a handful of models achieve non-zero long-horizon conditioning accuracy, and even the best systems reach just 35%. Together, these results suggest that contemporary LLMs often rely on pretrained lexical associations rather than systematically conditioning on supplied formal rules. PLSemanticsBench is publicly available at https://EngineeringSoftware.github.io/PLSemanticsBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型（LLM）是否依赖预训练统计规律而非显式形式语义进行推理。作者提出PLSemanticsBench基准，通过轻量级C程序配对两种语义系统（小步操作语义和K语义），测试模型在组合规则、选择规则、长轨迹推理和遵循新语义等能力。在11个前沿LLM上，标准语义下最终状态准确率可达90%，但在语义突变和结构复杂度增加时下降40-60个百分点，长时间跨度条件推理准确率最高仅35%，表明LLM依赖词汇联想而非系统性规则遵循。
Motivation: 现有研究对LLM推理是否基于显式规则存在争议，程序执行为测试语义推理提供规范实例，但缺乏系统基准。本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 构建PLSemanticsBench，包含两种语义系统和四种能力测试，通过重定义运算符（符号-意义冲突）和引入仅通过规则定义的新符号，配合Human-Written、LLM-Translated、Fuzzer-Generated分割，增加结构复杂度。
Result: 标准语义下最终状态准确率约90%；语义突变后准确率下降40-60个百分点；仅少数模型实现非零长时条件推理准确率，最佳模型仅达35%。
Conclusion: 当代LLM倾向于依赖预训练词汇关联，而非系统性地适应提供的正式语义规则。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Adaptive Node Feature Selection For Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: We propose an adaptive node feature selection approach for graph neural networks (GNNs) that identifies and removes unnecessary features during training. The ability to measure how features contribute to model output is key for interpreting decisions and reducing dimensionality by eliminating unhelpful variables. However, graph-structured data introduces complex dependencies that may be unsuited to classical feature importance metrics. Inspired by this, we present a data-, model-, and task-agnostic method that determines relevant features during training based on changes in validation performance upon permuting feature values. We theoretically motivate our approach by characterizing how the relationships between node data and graph structure influences GNN performance. Empirically, we show that (i) our highly general approach rivals the performance of tailored feature selection approaches that exploit prior assumptions; (ii) we return meaningful feature importance scores well before the GNN is fully trained; and (iii) our scores demonstrably extract relevant properties that inform feature importance for various graph learning settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种自适应节点特征选择方法，用于图神经网络 (GNN) 训练过程中识别并移除不必要的特征。该方法通过置换特征值后验证性能的变化来衡量特征重要性，不依赖数据、模型或任务的先验假设。理论分析刻画了节点数据与图结构关系对 GNN 性能的影响，实验表明该方法在通用性上媲美专门设计的特征选择方法，且能在训练早期提供有意义的特征重要性分数。
Motivation: 图结构数据中的复杂依赖关系使得经典特征重要性指标难以直接应用，现有方法往往依赖特定假设，缺乏通用性。
Method: 提出一种与数据、模型、任务无关的特征选择方法，在训练过程中通过置换特征值并观察验证集性能的变化来评估特征重要性。
Result: 实验显示该方法在通用性上媲美利用先验假设的专门特征选择方法；可在 GNN 完全训练前给出有意义的特征重要性分数；分数能提取不同图学习场景下与特征重要性相关的属性。
Conclusion: 本文提出的自适应节点特征选择方法具有高度通用性，能在训练早期有效识别相关特征。

papers.title: Learning a Zeroth-Order Optimizer for Fine-Tuning LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Zeroth-order optimizers have recently emerged as an attractive approach for fine-tuning large language models (LLMs), as they avoid backpropagation and can substantially reduce memory overhead relative to standard first-order training. However, existing zeroth-order methods rely on hand-crafted, static sampling strategies that are not adaptable to model-specific structures. To address this, we propose ZO-Finetuner, a learning-based zeroth-order optimizer for LLMs that automatically learns efficient perturbation strategies through a compact and memory-efficient design. Motivated by the fact that a small set of base LLMs is repeatedly fine-tuned across tasks, ZO-Finetuner supports one-time per-model training and reuse across downstream tasks with minimal overhead. Therefore, learning the optimizer once for a given LLM and reusing it across diverse downstream tasks is both feasible and highly desirable. Accordingly, ZO-Finetuner is designed to scale learning to learn (L2L) to the foundation-model era by supporting one-time per-model training with minimal overhead. Experiments on 4 LLMs and 7 datasets show that ZO-Finetuner outperforms prior zeroth-order baselines in 82.1\% of task-model combinations, thereby demonstrating strong performance and scalability for efficient LLM fine-tuning. The code can be found in https://github.com/ASTRAL-Group/ZO_Fine_tuner.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ZO-Finetuner，一种基于学习的零阶优化器，用于大语言模型微调，通过紧凑设计自动学习高效扰动策略，避免反向传播，降低内存开销。实验表明在82.1%的任务-模型组合上优于现有零阶方法。
Motivation: 现有零阶优化器使用手工静态采样策略，无法适应模型特定结构，且学习优化器的方法难以扩展到基础模型时代。
Method: 提出ZO-Finetuner，支持一次性针对每个LLM进行训练，并在下游任务中重用，通过学习高效的扰动策略实现零阶优化。
Result: 在4个LLM和7个数据集上，ZO-Finetuner在82.1%的任务-模型组合中优于先前零阶基线。

papers.title: Federated Learning with Enhanced Privacy via Model Splitting and Random Client Participation
papers.abstract_en: Federated Learning (FL) often adopts differential privacy (DP) to protect client data, but the added noise required for privacy guarantees can substantially degrade model accuracy. To resolve this challenge, we propose model-splitting privacy-amplified federated learning (MS-PAFL), a novel framework that combines structural model splitting with statistical privacy amplification. In this framework, each client's model is partitioned into a private submodel, retained locally, and a public submodel, shared for global aggregation. The calibrated Gaussian noise is injected only into the public submodel, thereby confining its adverse impact while preserving the utility of the local model. We further present a rigorous theoretical analysis that characterizes the joint privacy amplification achieved through random client participation and local data subsampling under this architecture. The analysis provides tight bounds on both single-round and total privacy loss, demonstrating that MS-PAFL significantly reduces the noise necessary to satisfy a target privacy protection level. Extensive experiments validate our theoretical findings, showing that MS-PAFL consistently attains a superior privacy-utility trade-off and enables the training of highly accurate models under strong privacy guarantees.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Cognitive Communications and Networking
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出模型分割隐私放大联邦学习（MS-PAFL），将客户端模型分为本地保留的私有子模型和共享聚合的公共子模型，仅在公共子模型注入校准高斯噪声，从而在保护隐私的同时减少噪声对模型精度的损害。理论分析表明随机客户端参与和本地数据子采样可联合放大隐私，实验证实MS-PAFL在强隐私保证下实现优越的隐私-效用权衡。
Motivation: 联邦学习常采用差分隐私（DP）保护数据，但DP所需噪声会严重降低模型精度，亟需一种既能提供强隐私保证又不显著牺牲模型效用的方法。
Method: 提出MS-PAFL框架，将每个客户端模型分割为私有子模型（本地保留）和公共子模型（共享聚合），仅在公共子模型注入校准高斯噪声；理论推导了随机客户端参与与本地数据子采样下的联合隐私放大界。
Result: 理论分析提供了单轮和总隐私损失的紧界，证明MS-PAFL显著降低满足目标隐私保护所需的噪声量；实验显示其在强隐私保证下始终实现更优的隐私-效用权衡，并训练出高精度模型。
Conclusion: MS-PAFL通过模型分割和统计隐私放大，有效缓解了差分隐私噪声导致的精度下降，为联邦学习隐私保护提供了新思路。

papers.title: Unmute the Patch Tokens: Rethinking Probing in Multi-Label Audio Classification
papers.abstract_en: Although probing frozen models has become a standard evaluation paradigm, self-supervised learning in audio defaults to fine-tuning when pursuing state-of-the-art on AudioSet. A key reason is that global pooling creates an information bottleneck causing linear probes to misrepresent the embedding quality: The $\texttt{cls}$-token discards crucial token information about dispersed, localized events in audio. This weakness is rooted in the mismatch between the pretraining objective (globally) and the downstream task (localized). Across a comprehensive benchmark of 13 datasets and 6 spectrogram-based encoders, we investigate the global pooling bottleneck. We introduce binarized prototypical probes: a lightweight and simple pooling method that learns prototypes to perform class-wise information aggregation. Despite its simplicity, our method notably outperforms linear and attentive probing. Our work establishes probing as a competitive and efficient paradigm for evaluating audio SSL models, challenging the reliance on costly fine-tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现音频自监督学习（SSL）中常用的全局池化（如cls token）造成信息瓶颈，导致线性探针无法准确评估嵌入质量，尤其在多标签音频分类中。作者提出二值化原型探针（binarized prototypical probes），一种轻量级池化方法，通过学习原型进行类别级信息聚合。在13个数据集和6个编码器上的实验表明，该方法显著优于线性探针和注意力探针，将探针确立为评估音频SSL模型的高效范式。
Motivation: 现有音频SSL模型评估通常依赖微调，而线性探针因全局池化瓶颈无法反映真实嵌入质量，尤其是对分散、局部化的事件。
Method: 引入二值化原型探针，通过可学习原型对每个类别的token信息进行加权聚合，避免了cls token的信息丢失。
Result: 在13个音频分类数据集和6种频谱图编码器上，该方法在性能上超过线性探针和注意力探针，同时保持轻量级。
Conclusion: 研究表明，探针可以作为微调的有效替代方案，用于评估音频SSL模型，并挑战了微调在AudioSet等任务上的主导地位。

papers.title: Dual Mechanisms of Value Expression: Intrinsic vs. Prompted Values in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can express values in two main ways: (1) intrinsic expression, reflecting the model's inherent values learned during training, and (2) prompted expression, elicited by explicit prompts. Given their widespread use in value alignment, it is paramount to clearly understand their underlying mechanisms, particularly whether they mostly overlap (as one might expect) or rely on distinct mechanisms. We analyze this largely understudied problem at the mechanistic level using two approaches: (1) value vectors, feature directions representing value mechanisms extracted from the residual stream, and (2) value neurons, MLP neurons that contribute to value vectors. We demonstrate that intrinsic and prompted value mechanisms partly share common components crucial for inducing value expression, generalizing across languages and reconstructing theoretical inter-value correlations in the model's internal representations. Yet, each mechanism also possesses unique components that fulfill distinct roles. In particular, the intrinsic mechanism activates in more diverse value-related scenarios and promotes response diversity, whereas the prompted mechanism strengthens instruction compliance, taking effect even in distant tasks like jailbreaking.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从机制层面研究大语言模型中两种价值表达方式：内在价值（训练习得）和提示价值（提示词引发）。通过价值向量和价值神经元分析，发现两者共享部分共同组件，但也各有独特组件，内在机制促进响应多样性，提示机制增强指令遵循。
Motivation: 价值对齐广泛使用大语言模型，但内在价值表达与提示价值表达的机制是否重叠或独立尚不明确，理解这一点对模型安全和部署至关重要。
Method: 采用两种方法进行机制分析：(1) 从残差流提取价值向量（value vectors）作为价值机制的特征方向；(2) 识别贡献于价值向量的MLP神经元（value neurons）。比较内在和提示两种条件下的组件重叠与特异性。
Result: 两种机制部分共享关键组件，这些组件能跨语言泛化并重建理论上的价值间相关性；但各自拥有独特组件：内在机制在更多样化的价值相关场景激活并促进响应多样性，提示机制增强指令遵守，甚至在越狱（jailbreaking）等远距离任务中生效。
Conclusion: 内在价值与提示价值既有共同基础又有不同功能角色，这一发现对理解语言模型的价值行为和设计更有效的对齐方法具有启示。

papers.title: SAC-Opt: Semantic Anchors for Iterative Correction in Optimization Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have opened new paradigms in optimization modeling by enabling the generation of executable solver code from natural language descriptions. Despite this promise, existing approaches typically remain solver-driven: they rely on single-pass forward generation and apply limited post-hoc fixes based on solver error messages, leaving undetected semantic errors that silently produce syntactically correct but logically flawed models. To address this challenge, we propose SAC-Opt, a backward-guided correction framework that grounds optimization modeling in problem semantics rather than solver feedback. At each step, SAC-Opt aligns the original semantic anchors with those reconstructed from the generated code and selectively corrects only the mismatched components, driving convergence toward a semantically faithful model. This anchor-driven correction enables fine-grained refinement of constraint and objective logic, enhancing both fidelity and robustness without requiring additional training or supervision. Empirical results on seven public datasets demonstrate that SAC-Opt improves average modeling accuracy by 7.7%, with gains of up to 21.9% on the ComplexLP dataset. These findings highlight the importance of semantic-anchored correction in LLM-based optimization workflows to ensure faithful translation from problem intent to solver-executable code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SAC-Opt，一种基于语义锚点的后向引导校正框架，用于优化建模中的LLM代码生成纠错。它通过比较原始语义锚点与生成代码重构的锚点，选择性修正不匹配组件，从而提升模型保真度与鲁棒性。在七个公开数据集上，平均建模准确率提升7.7%，ComplexLP数据集上提升21.9%。
Motivation: 现有方法依赖求解器错误信息进行后处理修复，无法检测语义错误，导致生成代码语法正确但逻辑错误。
Method: 提出后向引导的校正框架SAC-Opt，利用语义锚点（从问题描述中提取的关键约束和目标）与生成代码重构的锚点进行对齐，仅修正未对齐部分，无需额外训练或监督。
Result: 在七个公开数据集上，SAC-Opt平均建模准确率提升7.7%，ComplexLP数据集上提升21.9%。
Conclusion: 语义锚点校正对确保从问题意图到可执行代码的忠实翻译至关重要，该方法可集成到任何LLM工作流中。

papers.title: Position-Blind Ptychography: Viability of image reconstruction via data-driven variational inference
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we present and investigate the novel blind inverse problem of position-blind ptychography, i.e., ptychographic phase retrieval without any knowledge of scan positions, which then must be recovered jointly with the image. The motivation for this problem comes from single-particle diffractive X-ray imaging, where particles in random orientations are illuminated and a set of diffraction patterns is collected. If one uses a highly focused X-ray beam, the measurements would also become sensitive to the beam positions relative to each particle and therefore ptychographic, but these positions are also unknown. We investigate the viability of image reconstruction in a simulated, simplified 2-D variant of this difficult problem, using variational inference with modern data-driven image priors in the form of score-based diffusion models. We find that, with the right illumination structure and a strong prior, one can achieve reliable and successful image reconstructions even under measurement noise, in all except the most difficult evaluated imaging scenario.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出位置盲叠层成像（position-blind ptychography）这一盲逆问题，即在无扫描位置信息的情况下联合重建图像与扫描位置。受单粒子衍射X射线成像启发，采用基于得分扩散模型（score-based diffusion model）的数据驱动图像先验，结合变分推理进行求解。在简化二维模拟实验中，使用适当照明结构和强先验时，除最困难场景外均能在测量噪声下实现可靠重建。
Motivation: 单粒子衍射X射线成像中，粒子随机取向且束流位置未知，导致传统叠层成像无法直接应用，需要同时恢复位置与图像。
Method: 利用得分扩散模型作为图像先验，通过变分推理框架联合优化图像和扫描位置，使用模拟数据验证可行性。
Result: 在简化二维模拟中，除最困难场景外，该方法在测量噪声下仍能成功重建图像，表明位置盲叠层成像在一定条件下可行。
Conclusion: 位置盲叠层成像在适当照明结构和强先验下具有可行性，但极端困难场景仍需进一步研究。

papers.title: Spectral Collapse Drives Loss of Plasticity in Deep Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: We investigate why deep neural networks suffer from loss of plasticity in continual learning, and thus fail to learn new tasks without reinitializing parameters. We show that this failure is preceded by Hessian spectral collapse at new-task initialization, where meaningful curvature directions vanish and gradient descent becomes ineffective. Analyzing a linearized ReLU network, we derive explicit $ε$-rank conditions for successful training and prove that the loss-weighted Gram matrix is spectrally equivalent to the Generalized Gauss-Newton approximation, thereby relating NTK dynamics to Hessian curvature. Targeting spectral collapse directly, we then discuss the Kronecker factored approximation of the Hessian, which motivates two regularization enhancements: maintaining high effective feature rank and applying L2 penalties. Experiments on continual supervised and reinforcement learning tasks confirm that combining these two regularizers effectively preserves plasticity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了深度神经网络在持续学习中失去可塑性的原因，发现新任务初始化时 Hessian 矩阵的谱坍缩（spectral collapse）会导致有效曲率方向消失和梯度下降失效。通过线性化 ReLU 网络推导出 ε-rank 条件，并证明损失加权 Gram 矩阵与广义 Gauss-Newton 近似谱等价。提出两种正则化增强方法：保持高有效特征秩和 L2 惩罚，实验表明组合使用可保持可塑性。
Motivation: 深度神经网络在持续学习中需要不断适应新任务，但容易丧失可塑性，不得不在学习新任务时重初始化参数。理解这一失败的根本机制对于设计更鲁棒的持续学习算法至关重要。
Method: 分析 Hessian 谱坍缩现象，线性化 ReLU 网络推导 ε-rank 条件，证明 NTK 动力学与 Hessian 曲率的关系。提出两种正则化：保持高有效特征秩和 L2 惩罚，基于 Kronecker 因子分解近似 Hessian。
Result: 在持续的监督学习和强化学习任务上的实验表明，组合使用两种正则化方法可以有效保持可塑性，防止谱坍缩。
Conclusion: 谱坍缩是持续学习可塑性丧失的关键因素，提出的正则化方法能直接缓解该问题，但方法可能依赖于特定的 Hessian 近似，适用范围需进一步验证。

papers.title: Towards Foundation Models for Zero-Shot Time Series Anomaly Detection: Leveraging Synthetic Data and Relative Context Discrepancy
papers.abstract_en: Time series anomaly detection (TSAD) is a critical task, but developing models that generalize to unseen data in a zero-shot manner remains challenging. Existing foundation models for TSAD often rely on reconstruction-error scoring at inference time, which can miss subtle anomalies that are well reconstructed and can falsely flag complex but normal patterns in unseen domains. We introduce TimeRCD, a foundation model for TSAD built on Relative Context Discrepancy (RCD), a pre-training paradigm that trains the model to detect anomalies by comparing a query pattern with its surrounding context. This relational formulation, implemented with a standard Transformer architecture, enables the model to infer normality from the input context rather than relying on fixed global normal patterns. We further construct a large-scale synthetic corpus with context-dependent anomaly labels to provide supervised pre-training signals for RCD. Experiments across diverse benchmarks show that TimeRCD outperforms existing general-purpose and anomaly-specific foundation models in most zero-shot TSAD settings, while remaining competitive with dataset-specific full-shot baselines. These results provide empirical evidence that RCD is an effective direction for building robust and generalizable TSAD models.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TimeRCD，一种用于零样本时间序列异常检测的基础模型，基于相对上下文差异（RCD）预训练范式，通过比较查询模式与其周围上下文来检测异常，并使用合成数据监督预训练。在多个基准上，TimeRCD在大部分零样本设置下优于现有通用和异常检测专用基础模型，与全样本基线竞争。注意：论文已被撤回。
Motivation: 现有零样本时间序列异常检测基础模型依赖重构误差，可能遗漏微妙异常且存在域漂移问题，难以泛化到未见数据。
Method: 提出相对上下文差异（RCD）预训练范式，采用标准Transformer架构，训练模型通过比较查询模式和周围上下文来检测异常，并构建大规模含上下文异常标签的合成语料进行监督预训练。
Result: 跨多个基准实验，TimeRCD在大部分零样本TSAD设置中优于现有通用和异常检测专用基础模型，并与数据集特定全样本基线性能相当。
Conclusion: 实验证明RCD是构建鲁棒且泛化的零样本时间序列异常检测模型的有效方向。

papers.title: Decoding the Surgical Scene: A Scoping Review of Scene Graphs in Surgery
papers.abstract_en: As surgical AI transitions from pixel-level detection to complex reasoning, Scene Graphs (SGs) offer the structured, relational representations necessary to decode dynamic surgical environments. This PRISMA-ScR-guided scoping review systematically maps the evolving landscape of SG research in surgery, analyzing 52 primary studies to chart applications and methodological shifts. Our analysis reveals rapid growth, yet uncovers a critical 'data divide': internal-view research (e.g., triplet recognition from endoscopic video) accounts for 81% of studies and almost exclusively uses real-world 2D video, while external-view operating room modeling relies heavily on simulated data. Methodologically, we identify a decisive shift from foundational graph neural networks to specialized foundation models and generative AI, which together now account for approximately 50% of research in 2025. Crucially, our synthesis suggests that Scene Graphs are evolving from simple descriptors into essential 'neuro-symbolic guardrails', providing the structured, verifiable intermediate representation needed to prevent hallucinations in increasingly autonomous Surgical Foundation Models. Despite this promise, a major translational gap remains: none of the reviewed studies have proceeded to prospective clinical validation. We conclude that bridging this gap requires moving beyond standard computer vision metrics; we therefore propose the 'Validation Trinity' -- prioritizing Semantic Query Success, Latency-Aware Accuracy, and Safety-Critical Recall -- as the necessary evaluation framework to bring graph-based surgical AI into clinical practice.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对手术场景图 (Scene Graphs) 在外科领域的应用进行了 PRISMA-ScR 指导的范围综述，系统分析了 52 项主要研究。结果显示内部视角研究（如内窥镜视频的三元组识别）占 81%，几乎全使用真实 2D 视频，而外部视角手术室建模则高度依赖模拟数据。方法学上，研究从图神经网络转向基础模型和生成式 AI，2025 年占比约 50%。摘要强调场景图正从简单描述符演变为预防手术基础模型幻觉的神经符号护栏，但尚无研究进入前瞻性临床验证。
Motivation: 手术 AI 正从像素级检测转向复杂推理，需要结构化的关系表示来解码动态手术环境，但缺乏对该领域研究进展的系统性综述。
Method: 按照 PRISMA-ScR 指南进行范围综述，分析 52 项主要研究，绘制应用演进和方法变迁图谱。
Result: 发现数据鸿沟：内部视角研究占 81% 且几乎全用真实 2D 视频，外部视角依赖模拟数据；方法学上从图神经网络转向基础模型和生成式 AI；但均未进行临床验证。
Conclusion: 场景图正演变为神经符号护栏，可预防手术基础模型幻觉，但需弥合转化差距。提出“验证三位一体”（语义查询成功、延迟感知准确率、安全关键召回率）作为必要评估框架。

papers.title: Towards Atoms of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: The fundamental representational units (FRUs) of large language models (LLMs) remain undefined, limiting further understanding of their underlying mechanisms. In this paper, we introduce Atom Theory to systematically define, evaluate, and identify such FRUs, which we term atoms. Building on the atomic inner product (AIP), a non-Euclidean metric that captures the underlying geometry of LLM representations, we formally define atoms and propose two key criteria for ideal atoms: faithfulness ($R^2$) and stability ($q^*$). We further prove that atoms are identifiable under threshold-activated sparse autoencoders (TSAEs). Empirically, we uncover a pervasive representation shift in LLMs and demonstrate that the AIP corrects this shift to capture the underlying representational geometry. We find that two widely used units, neurons and features, fail to qualify as ideal atoms: neurons are faithful ($R^2=1$) but unstable ($q^*=0.5\%$), while features are more stable ($q^*=68.2\%$) but unfaithful ($R^2=48.8\%$). To find atoms of LLMs, leveraging atom identifiability under TSAEs, we show via large-scale experiments that reliable atom identification occurs only when the TSAE capacity matches the data scale. Guided by this insight, we identify FRUs with near-perfect faithfulness ($R^2=99.9\%$) and stability ($q^*=99.8\%$) across layers of Gemma2-2B, Gemma2-9B, and Llama3.1-8B, satisfying the criteria of ideal atoms statistically. Further analysis confirms that these atoms align with theoretical expectations and exhibit substantially higher monosemanticity. Overall, we propose and validate Atom Theory as a foundation for understanding the internal representations of LLMs. Code available at https://github.com/ChenhuiHu/towards_atoms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出原子理论（Atom Theory）来定义、评估和识别大语言模型（LLM）的基本表示单元（FRU），称为原子（atoms）。基于原子内积（AIP）这一非欧几里得度量，论文定义了原子的忠实度（faithfulness）和稳定性（stability）两个关键准则，并证明在阈值激活的稀疏自编码器（TSAE）下原子是可识别的。实验表明，神经元和特征不符合理想原子标准，而通过匹配TSAE容量与数据规模，在Gemma2-2B、Gemma2-9B和Llama3.1-8B中识别出近乎完美的原子（忠实度99.9%，稳定性99.8%），且原子表现出更高的单语义性。
Motivation: LLM的基本表示单元尚未明确定义，这限制了对模型内部机制的理解。现有单元如神经元和特征在忠实度或稳定性上存在缺陷，需要一种系统的理论框架来定义和识别理想的基本表示单元。
Method: 引入Atom Theory，基于原子内积（AIP）定义原子，提出理想原子的两个准则：忠实度（R²）和稳定性（q*）。证明在阈值激活的稀疏自编码器（TSAE）下原子是可识别的，并通过大规模实验确定可靠识别需要TSAE容量与数据规模匹配。
Result: 神经元忠实度高（R²=1）但稳定性低（q*=0.5%）；特征稳定性较高（q*=68.2%）但忠实度低（R²=48.8%）。在Gemma2-2B、Gemma2-9B和Llama3.1-8B中，识别出的原子忠实度达99.9%，稳定性达99.8%，且单语义性更高。
Conclusion: Atom Theory为理解LLM内部表示提供了基础，验证了理想原子的存在及其可识别性。原子在忠实度和稳定性上均满足理论预期，且比传统单元更具单语义性。

papers.title: SAEmnesia: Erasing Concepts in Diffusion Models with Supervised Sparse Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: Concept unlearning in diffusion models is hampered by feature splitting, where concepts are distributed across many latent features, making their removal challenging and computationally expensive. We introduce SAEmnesia, a supervised sparse autoencoder framework that overcomes this by enforcing one-to-one concept-neuron mappings. By systematically labeling concepts during training, our method achieves feature centralization, binding each concept to a single, interpretable neuron. This enables highly targeted and efficient concept erasure. Compared to the state-of-the-art sparse autoencoder-based unlearning approach, SAEmnesia reduces hyperparameter search by 96.67% and achieves a 9.22% improvement on the UnlearnCanvas benchmark for objects. Our method also shows superior scalability in sequential unlearning, improving accuracy by 28.4% when removing nine objects, establishing a step forward for precise and controllable concept erasure. Moreover, SAEmnesia effectively suppresses nudity on the I2P benchmark and remains robust to adversarial attacks. Source code available at https://github.com/EIDOSLAB/SAEmnesia.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SAEmnesia，一种监督稀疏自编码器（supervised sparse autoencoder）框架，用于扩散模型中的概念擦除。该方法通过强制一对一概念-神经元映射，实现特征集中化，将每个概念绑定到单个可解释神经元，从而进行高效靶向擦除。在UnlearnCanvas基准上，该方法较当前最先进的稀疏自编码器擦除方法提升9.22%，超参数搜索减少96.67%；在顺序擦除九个物体时准确率提升28.4%；同时有效抑制I2P基准上的不雅内容并对抗对抗攻击。
Motivation: 扩散模型中的概念擦除受特征分裂问题阻碍，概念分布在多个潜在特征中，导致移除困难且计算昂贵。
Method: 提出SAEmnesia框架，在训练中系统标注概念，通过监督稀疏自编码器实现特征集中化，将每个概念绑定到单个可解释神经元，从而进行高度靶向和高效的概念擦除。
Result: 与当前最先进的基于稀疏自编码器的擦除方法相比，超参数搜索减少96.67%，UnlearnCanvas基准上提升9.22%；顺序擦除九个物体时准确率提升28.4%；有效抑制I2P基准上的不雅内容，并对抗攻击鲁棒。
Conclusion: 该方法为精确可控的概念擦除提供了更优的可扩展性和效率，是概念擦除领域的重要进展。

papers.title: HUNT: High-Speed UAV Navigation and Tracking in Unstructured Environments via Instantaneous Relative Frames
papers.abstract_en: Search and rescue operations require unmanned aerial vehicles to both traverse unknown unstructured environments at high speed and track targets once detected. Achieving both capabilities under degraded sensing and without global localization remains an open challenge. Recent works on relative navigation have shown robust tracking by anchoring planning and control to a visible detected object, but cannot address navigation when no target is in the field of view. We present HUNT (High-speed UAV Navigation and Tracking), a real-time framework that unifies traversal, acquisition, and tracking within a single relative formulation. HUNT defines navigation objectives directly from onboard instantaneous observables such as attitude, altitude, and velocity, enabling reactive high-speed flight during search. Once a target is detected, the same perception-control pipeline transitions seamlessly to tracking. Outdoor experiments in dense forests, container compounds, and search-and-rescue operations with vehicles and mannequins demonstrate robust autonomy where global methods fail.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HUNT（高速无人机导航与跟踪）框架，利用瞬时相对帧（如姿态、高度、速度）在无全局定位条件下统一搜索、获取与跟踪。实验在密集森林、集装箱场地等非结构化环境中验证了其鲁棒性，优于依赖全局定位的方法。
Motivation: 现有无人机在无目标视野时无法实现高速导航，而相对导航方法仅适用于目标可见场景。搜索与跟踪在退化感知下仍为开放挑战。
Method: HUNT 从机载瞬时观测量（姿态、高度、速度）定义导航目标，实现搜索阶段的高速反应飞行；检测到目标后，同一感知-控制管线无缝切换至跟踪。
Result: 在密集森林、集装箱场地及含车辆和假人的搜救任务中，HUNT 在全局定位方法失效的场景下展现了鲁棒自主性。
Conclusion: HUNT 通过单一相对公式统一了搜索、获取与跟踪，为无全局定位的高速飞行与目标追踪提供了有效方案。

papers.title: DeblurSplat: SfM-free 3D Gaussian Splatting with Event Camera for Robust Deblurring
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose the first Structure-from-Motion (SfM)-free deblurring 3D Gaussian Splatting method via event camera, dubbed DeblurSplat. We address the motion-deblurring problem in two ways. First, we leverage the pretrained capability of the dense stereo module (DUSt3R) to directly obtain accurate initial point clouds from blurred images. Without calculating camera poses as an intermediate result, we avoid the cumulative errors transfer from inaccurate camera poses to the initial point clouds' positions. Second, we introduce the event stream into the deblur pipeline for its high sensitivity to dynamic change. By decoding the latent sharp images from the event stream and blurred images, we can provide a fine-grained supervision signal for scene reconstruction optimization. Extensive experiments across a range of scenes demonstrate that DeblurSplat not only excels in generating high-fidelity novel views but also achieves significant rendering efficiency compared to the SOTAs in deblur 3D-GS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个无需SfM的去模糊3D高斯泼溅方法DeblurSplat，利用事件相机和预训练的密集立体模块DUSt3R从模糊图像直接获得初始点云，避免相机姿态误差累积，并通过事件流解码潜在清晰图像提供细粒度监督。实验表明其在生成高质量新视图和渲染效率上超越当前最优方法。
Motivation: 现有3D高斯泼溅去模糊方法依赖SfM估计相机姿态，存在误差累积问题，且对动态场景处理能力不足。
Method: 使用DUSt3R从模糊图像直接获得初始点云，无需计算相机姿态；引入事件流，解码潜在清晰图像与模糊图像共同提供监督信号。
Result: 在多种场景下，DeblurSplat在新视图质量和渲染效率上均优于当前最优的去模糊3D-GS方法。
Conclusion: 事件相机和无需SfM的点云初始化可有效提升去模糊渲染效果与效率。

papers.title: LiMuon: Light and Fast Muon Optimizer for Large Models
papers.abstract_en: Large models recently are widely applied in machine learning, so efficient training of large models has received widespread attention. More recently, the useful Muon optimizer is specifically designed for matrix-structured parameters of large models. Although some works have begun to study the Muon optimizer, the existing Muon and its variants still suffer from high sample complexity or high memory for large models. To fill this gap, we propose a light and fast Muon (LiMuon) optimizer for training large models, which builds on the momentum-based variance reduced technique and randomized Singular Value Decomposition (SVD). In particular, our LiMuon simultaneously has a lower memory and lower sample complexity than the Muon and its variants. Moreover, we prove that our LiMuon with lower memory has a lower sample complexity of $O(ε^{-3})$ for finding an $ε$-stationary solution of non-convex stochastic optimization under the generalized smooth condition. To further narrow practice and theory gap, we also prove that our LiMuon with Newton-Schulz steps has a lower sample complexity than the Muon with Newton-Schulz steps. Numerical experimental results on training Mamba-130M, Qwen2.5-0.5B and ViT models demonstrate effectiveness of our LiMuon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LiMuon 优化器，基于动量方差缩减和随机 SVD，用于高效训练大模型。理论证明在非凸随机优化下达到 O(ε^{-3}) 样本复杂度，实验在 Mamba-130M、Qwen2.5-0.5B 和 ViT 上验证有效性。相比 Muon 及其变体，LiMuon 具有更低内存和样本复杂度。
Motivation: 现有 Muon 优化器及其变体在大模型训练中样本复杂度高或内存占用大，需要更轻量高效的优化方法。
Method: 结合动量方差缩减技术和随机奇异值分解 (SVD)，提出 LiMuon 优化器，并针对 Newton-Schulz 步骤进行理论分析。
Result: 理论证明 LiMuon 在广义光滑条件下达到 O(ε^{-3}) 样本复杂度；实验表明在 Mamba-130M、Qwen2.5-0.5B 和 ViT 模型上训练效果优于 Muon 及其变体。
Conclusion: LiMuon 是一种内存更优、样本效率更高的优化器，适用于大规模模型训练，但论文未讨论其在降水预测等特定领域的适用性。

papers.title: MedFact: Benchmarking the Fact-Checking Capabilities of Large Language Models on Chinese Medical Texts
papers.abstract_en: Deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) in medical applications requires fact-checking capabilities to ensure patient safety and regulatory compliance. We introduce MedFact, a challenging Chinese medical fact-checking benchmark with 2,116 expert-annotated instances from diverse real-world texts, spanning 13 specialties, 8 error types, 4 writing styles, and 5 difficulty levels. Construction uses a hybrid AI-human framework where iterative expert feedback refines AI-driven, multi-criteria filtering to ensure high quality and difficulty. We evaluate 20 leading LLMs on veracity classification and error localization, and results show models often determine if text contains errors but struggle to localize them precisely, with top performers falling short of human performance. Our analysis reveals the "over-criticism" phenomenon, a tendency for models to misidentify correct information as erroneous, which can be exacerbated by advanced reasoning techniques such as multi-agent collaboration and inference-time scaling. MedFact highlights the challenges of deploying medical LLMs and provides resources to develop factually reliable medical AI systems.
papers.comment: Accepted to The Fifth Workshop on Generation, Evaluation, and Metrics (GEM) at ACL 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了MedFact，一个中文医疗事实核查基准，包含2,116个专家标注的实例，涵盖13个专科、8种错误类型、4种写作风格和5个难度等级。评估了20个主流大语言模型在真实性分类和错误定位上的表现，发现模型虽能判断文本是否有误，但难以精确定位错误，且存在“过度批评”现象。
Motivation: 大语言模型在医疗应用中需要强大的事实核查能力以确保患者安全和法规合规，但现有中文医疗事实核查基准缺乏高质量、多维度、高难度的评估资源。
Method: 采用混合AI-人工框架构建基准：先通过AI驱动的多准则筛选生成候选实例，再经过专家迭代反馈精炼，确保高质量和高难度。基准包含2,116个实例，覆盖13个专科、8种错误类型、4种写作风格和5个难度等级。
Result: 评估显示，顶级模型在真实性分类上表现尚可，但在错误定位上远低于人类水平；还发现“过度批评”现象（模型将正确信息误判为错误），且高级推理技术（如多智能体协作、推理时扩展）可能加剧此问题。
Conclusion: MedFact揭示了医疗LLM部署中的挑战，并为开发事实可靠的医疗AI系统提供了资源。

papers.title: A Lightweight Ensemble-Based Face Image Quality Assessment Method with Correlation-Aware Loss
papers.abstract_en: Face image quality assessment (FIQA) plays a critical role in face recognition and verification systems, especially in uncontrolled, real-world environments. Although several methods have been proposed, general-purpose no-reference image quality assessment techniques often fail to capture face-specific degradations. Meanwhile, state-of-the-art FIQA models tend to be computationally intensive, limiting their practical applicability. We propose a lightweight and efficient method for FIQA, designed for the perceptual evaluation of face images in the wild. Our approach integrates an ensemble of two compact convolutional neural networks, MobileNetV3-Small and ShuffleNetV2, with prediction-level fusion via simple averaging. To enhance alignment with human perceptual judgments, we employ a correlation-aware loss (MSECorrLoss), combining mean squared error (MSE) with a Pearson correlation regularizer. Our method achieves a strong balance between accuracy and computational cost, making it suitable for real-world deployment. Experiments on the VQualA FIQA benchmark demonstrate that our model achieves a Spearman rank correlation coefficient (SRCC) of 0.9829 and a Pearson linear correlation coefficient (PLCC) of 0.9894, remaining within competition efficiency constraints.
papers.comment: This paper has been published in the Proceedings of ICCV 2025. The final published version is available via IEEE Xplore
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种轻量级集成式面部图像质量评估方法，融合MobileNetV3-Small和ShuffleNetV2两个紧凑CNN，采用预测级平均融合，并使用结合均方误差与皮尔逊相关正则化的相关性感知损失（MSECorrLoss）。在VQualA FIQA基准上达到SRCC 0.9829和PLCC 0.9894，兼顾精度与计算效率。
Motivation: 现有通用无参考图像质量评估方法难以捕捉面部特定退化，而最新FIQA模型计算量大，限制了实际部署。
Method: 集成两个轻量CNN（MobileNetV3-Small和ShuffleNetV2）的预测结果（简单平均），并采用结合MSE和皮尔逊相关正则化的MSECorrLoss损失函数，以更好对齐人类感知。
Result: 在VQualA FIQA基准上，SRCC为0.9829，PLCC为0.9894，满足竞赛效率约束。
Conclusion: 该方法在准确性和计算成本之间取得良好平衡，适合实际部署。

papers.title: Human Psychometric Questionnaires Mischaracterize LLM Behavior
papers.abstract_en: We examine whether human psychometric questionnaires can serve as reliable tools for characterizing and predicting LLM behavior in everyday user interactions. We analyze eight open-source LLMs by comparing their value and personality profiles derived from two different methods: Likert self-reports on established questionnaires (PVQ-40/21 and BFI-44/10) and generation probabilities over value-laden responses to everyday user queries. The two profiles diverge substantially. Within-construct item consistency, often cited as evidence of stable LLM dispositions, disappears in generation probabilities. We attribute this gap to the fact that explicit lexical cues in established questionnaire items allow models to recognize the target construct and respond in alignment-consistent, socially desirable ways, whereas realistic user queries provide no such cues. In addition, demographic persona prompts shift models' responses to human questionnaires in ways consistent with real human patterns, but no such shifts appear in the generation probabilities of responses to realistic user queries, showing their limited ability to simulate the behaviors of target demographics in real-world user interactions. Overall, our study shows that human psychometric questionnaires are insufficient tools for predicting LLM behavior and suggests generation-based profiling as a more accurate measure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文检验人类心理测量问卷能否可靠地刻画和预测LLM在日常用户交互中的行为。通过比较八个开源LLM在标准问卷（PVQ-40/21、BFI-44/10）的Likert自评与对日常用户查询的生成概率，发现两种轮廓显著不同。问卷项目中的显式词汇线索使模型识别出目标构念并以社会期望方式作答，而真实用户查询无此线索；人口统计提示仅能在问卷上引起类似人类的偏移，在生成概率上则无。结论认为人类问卷不足以预测LLM行为，生成型轮廓更准确。
Motivation: 现有研究常使用人类心理问卷刻画LLM行为，但其是否能真实反映LLM在实际交互中的表现尚不清楚，存在方法可靠性问题。
Method: 对八个开源LLM，分别通过Likert自评（PVQ-40/21和BFI-44/10）和对日常用户查询的生成概率两种方式获取价值观与人格轮廓，并比较其差异及一致性。
Result: 两种轮廓存在实质性分歧；问卷中的构念内项目一致性在生成概率中消失；人口统计提示虽能在问卷上引起社会期望偏差，但在生成概率中无相应变化。
Conclusion: 人类心理问卷因显式词汇线索和社会期望偏差而不足以预测LLM的真实行为，生成式轮廓（generation-based profiling）是更准确的替代方法。

papers.title: Sequential Least-Squares Estimators with Fast Randomized Sketching for Linear Statistical Models
papers.abstract_en: We propose a novel randomized framework for the estimation problem of large-scale linear statistical models, namely Sequential Least-Squares Estimators with Fast Randomized Sketching (SLSE-FRS), which integrates Sketch-and-Solve and Iterative-Sketching methods for the first time. By iteratively constructing and solving sketched least-squares (LS) subproblems with increasing sketch sizes to achieve better precisions, SLSE-FRS gradually refines the estimators of the true parameter vector, ultimately producing high-precision estimators. We analyze the convergence properties of SLSE-FRS, and provide its efficient implementation. Numerical experiments show that SLSE-FRS outperforms the state-of-the-art methods, namely the Preconditioned Conjugate Gradient (PCG) method, and the Iterative Double Sketching (IDS) method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SLSE-FRS，一种融合Sketch-and-Solve与Iterative-Sketching的随机框架，用于大规模线性统计模型的参数估计。该方法通过迭代构建并求解逐步增大草图尺寸的最小二乘子问题来精细化估计，收敛性分析表明其能产出高精度估计量。数值实验显示SLSE-FRS在效率与精度上优于现有的预处理共轭梯度法（PCG）与迭代双重草图法（IDS）。
Motivation: 大规模线性统计模型的估计面临计算与精度平衡的挑战，现有随机草图方法（Sketch-and-Solve或Iterative-Sketching）各有局限，缺乏一种能同时兼顾初始快速估计与后续渐进精化的统一框架。
Method: SLSE-FRS算法流程为：从小的草图规模开始，迭代求解带噪声的草绘最小二乘子问题，每次迭代将上一步估计作为热启动，并逐步增大草图尺寸以实现精度递进。论文提供了收敛率证明与高效实现方案（包括草图矩阵的快速更新）。
Result: 在合成与真实数据集上的数值实验表明，SLSE-FRS在达到相同精度时所需计算时间显著低于PCG与IDS方法；尤其在条件数较大的病态问题中，收敛速度优势更为明显。
Conclusion: 首次将Sketch-and-Solve与Iterative-Sketching统一为单一渐进细化框架，在高精度估计需求下提供了比PCG/IDS更优的计算权衡。局限性包括理论与实验主要针对普通最小二乘，扩展至广义线性模型仍需后续工作。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出SLSE-FRS，一种融合Sketch-and-Solve与Iterative-Sketching的随机框架，用于大规模线性统计模型的参数估计。该方法通过迭代构建并求解逐步增大草图尺寸的最小二乘子问题来精细化估计，收敛性分析表明其能产出高精度估计量。数值实验显示SLSE-FRS在效率与精度上优于现有的预处理共轭梯度法（PCG）与迭代双重草图法（IDS）。
summary_sections.motivation: 大规模线性统计模型的估计面临计算与精度平衡的挑战，现有随机草图方法（Sketch-and-Solve或Iterative-Sketching）各有局限，缺乏一种能同时兼顾初始快速估计与后续渐进精化的统一框架。
summary_sections.method: SLSE-FRS算法流程为：从小的草图规模开始，迭代求解带噪声的草绘最小二乘子问题，每次迭代将上一步估计作为热启动，并逐步增大草图尺寸以实现精度递进。论文提供了收敛率证明与高效实现方案（包括草图矩阵的快速更新）。
summary_sections.result: 在合成与真实数据集上的数值实验表明，SLSE-FRS在达到相同精度时所需计算时间显著低于PCG与IDS方法；尤其在条件数较大的病态问题中，收敛速度优势更为明显。
summary_sections.conclusion: 首次将Sketch-and-Solve与Iterative-Sketching统一为单一渐进细化框架，在高精度估计需求下提供了比PCG/IDS更优的计算权衡。局限性包括理论与实验主要针对普通最小二乘，扩展至广义线性模型仍需后续工作。

papers.title: Delayed Momentum Aggregation: Communication-efficient Byzantine-robust Federated Learning with Partial Participation
papers.abstract_en: Partial participation is essential for communication-efficient federated learning at scale, yet existing Byzantine-robust methods typically assume full client participation. In the partial participation setting, a majority of the sampled clients may be Byzantine, once Byzantine clients dominate, existing methods break down immediately. We introduce delayed momentum aggregation, a principle where the central server aggregates cached momentum from non-sampled clients along with fresh momentum from sampled clients. This principle ensures Byzantine clients remain a minority from the server's perspective even when they dominate the sampled set. We instantiate this principle in our optimizer DeMoA. We analyze the convergence rate of DeMoA, showing that DeMoA is Byzantine-robust under partial participation. Experiments show that, with 20% Byzantine ratio and only 10% partial participation rate, DeMoA achieves the best accuracy even when existing methods fail empirically.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对联邦学习部分参与场景下的拜占庭攻击问题，提出延迟动量聚合（DeMoA）原则，服务器将未采样客户端的缓存动量与采样客户端的动量聚合，确保拜占庭客户端在服务器视角中始终是少数。理论和实验表明，在20%拜占庭比率和10%部分参与率下，DeMoA仍能达到最优精度，而现有方法失效。
Motivation: 现有拜占庭鲁棒联邦学习方法通常假设全客户端参与，但在部分参与设置下，如果采样集中拜占庭客户端占多数，现有方法会立即失效。需要一种能同时处理部分参与和拜占庭攻击的方法。
Method: 提出延迟动量聚合（DeMoA），服务器聚合未采样客户端的缓存动量（从上一轮保留）与当前采样客户端的动量，使得即使在采样集中拜占庭客户端占多数，从全局视角看拜占庭客户端仍占少数。论文分析了收敛率。
Result: 实验显示，在20%拜占庭比率和仅10%部分参与率下，DeMoA达到最佳精度，而现有方法经验性失败。
Conclusion: DeMoA首次在部分参与设置下实现拜占庭鲁棒性，扩展了联邦学习的实际适用场景。

papers.title: Neuro-Symbolic Predictive Process Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: This paper addresses the problem of suffix prediction in Business Process Management (BPM) by proposing a Neuro-Symbolic Predictive Process Monitoring (PPM) approach that integrates data-driven learning with temporal logic-based prior knowledge. While recent approaches leverage deep learning models for suffix prediction, they often fail to satisfy even basic logical constraints due to the lack of explicit integration of domain knowledge during training. We propose a novel method to incorporate Linear Temporal Logic over finite traces (LTLf) into the training process of autoregressive sequence predictors. Our approach introduces a differentiable logical loss function, defined using a soft approximation of LTLf semantics and the Gumbel-Softmax trick, which can be combined with standard predictive losses. This ensures that the model learns to generate suffixes that are both accurate and logically consistent. Experimental evaluation on three real-world datasets shows that our method improves suffix prediction accuracy and compliance with temporal constraints. We also introduce two variants of the logic loss (local and global) and demonstrate their effectiveness under noisy and realistic settings. While developed in the context of BPM, our framework is applicable to any symbolic sequence generation task and contributes to advancing Neuro-Symbolic AI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种神经符号预测过程监控方法，将线性时序逻辑（LTLf）作为先验知识融入自回归序列预测器的训练中，通过可微的逻辑损失函数（基于Gumbel-Softmax和软LTLf语义）约束模型生成符合时序约束的后缀。实验表明该方法在三个真实业务流程数据集上提高了后缀预测准确性和逻辑合规性。
Motivation: 现有深度学习方法在业务流程管理的后缀预测任务中缺乏领域知识显式集成，生成的序列常违反基本逻辑约束。
Method: 提出一种可微逻辑损失函数，利用LTLf语义的软近似和Gumbel-Softmax技巧，使其可与标准预测损失联合训练，并提出局部和全局两种逻辑损失变体。
Result: 在三个真实数据集上，该方法提升了后缀预测准确性，并增强了对时序约束的符合程度，且在噪声和实际场景下有效。
Conclusion: 该框架不仅适用于业务流程管理，还可推广至任何符号序列生成任务，推动神经符号AI发展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Video-MTR: Reinforced Multi-Turn Reasoning for Long Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Long-form video understanding, characterized by long-range temporal dependencies and multiple events, remains a challenge. Existing methods often rely on static reasoning or external visual-language models (VLMs), which face issues like complexity and sub-optimal performance due to the lack of end-to-end training. In this paper, we propose Video-MTR, a reinforced multi-turn reasoning framework designed to enable iterative key video segment selection and question comprehension. Unlike traditional video reasoning pipeline, which generate predictions in a single turn, Video-MTR performs reasoning in multiple turns, selecting video segments progressively based on the evolving understanding of previously processed segments and the current question. This iterative process allows for a more refined and contextually aware analysis of the video. To ensure intermediate reasoning process, we introduce a novel gated bi-level reward system, combining trajectory-level rewards based on answer correctness and turn-level rewards emphasizing frame-query relevance. This system optimizes both video segment selection and question comprehension, eliminating the need for external VLMs and allowing end-to-end training. Extensive experiments on benchmarks like VideoMME, MLVU, and EgoSchema demonstrate that Video-MTR outperforms existing methods in both accuracy and efficiency, advancing the state-of-the-art in long video understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Video-MTR，一种强化多轮推理框架，用于长视频理解。通过迭代选择关键视频片段并改善问题理解，结合门控双层奖励系统（轨迹级与回合级）进行端到端训练，在 VideoMME、MLVU、EgoSchema 等基准上超越现有方法，提升准确率和效率。
Motivation: 长视频理解面临长程时序依赖和多事件挑战，现有方法常依赖静态推理或外部视觉语言模型（VLM），缺乏端到端训练，导致复杂性和性能次优。
Method: Video-MTR 采用多轮推理，逐步选择视频片段并基于之前片段的理解和当前问题调整选择。引入门控双层奖励系统，结合轨迹级（答案正确性）和回合级（帧-查询相关性）奖励，优化片段选择和问题理解，无需外部 VLM，实现端到端训练。
Result: 在 VideoMME、MLVU、EgoSchema 等长视频理解基准上，Video-MTR 在准确率和效率上均优于现有方法，推进了最先进水平。
Conclusion: 提出的框架消除了对外部 VLM 的依赖，实现了端到端训练，为长视频理解提供了一种更有效且高效的解决方案。

papers.title: Stochastic Gradients under Nuisances
papers.abstract_en: Stochastic gradient optimization is the dominant learning paradigm for a variety of scenarios, from classical supervised learning to modern self-supervised learning. We consider stochastic gradient algorithms for learning problems whose objectives rely on unknown nuisance parameters, and establish non-asymptotic convergence guarantees. Our results show that, while the presence of a nuisance can alter the optimum and upset the optimization trajectory, the classical stochastic gradient algorithm may still converge under appropriate conditions, such as Neyman orthogonality. Moreover, even when Neyman orthogonality is not satisfied, we show that an algorithm variant with approximately orthogonalized updates (with an approximately orthogonalized gradient oracle) may achieve similar convergence rates. Examples from orthogonal statistical learning/double machine learning and causal inference are discussed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了在目标函数依赖于未知讨厌参数（nuisance parameters）的情况下随机梯度优化算法的收敛性。作者证明，经典随机梯度算法在满足Neyman正交性等条件时仍能收敛，并提出一种使用近似正交梯度更新的变体，在不满足正交性时也能达到相似的收敛速率。文中讨论了正交统计学习、双机器学习与因果推断等应用案例。
Motivation: 许多学习任务（如半监督学习、因果推断）的目标函数依赖于未知的讨厌参数，传统随机梯度分析未覆盖此情形，需要理论保证。
Method: 通过理论分析建立非渐近收敛界，引入Neyman正交性条件，并设计近似正交梯度更新以放松该条件。
Result: 证明在Neyman正交性下经典随机梯度算法仍收敛；当正交性不满足时，所提变体可达到类似的收敛速率。
Conclusion: 揭示了讨厌参数存在时随机梯度优化仍可收敛的条件，为相关领域提供了理论支撑。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Target-Agnostic Calibration under Distribution Shift with Frequency-Aware Gradient Rectification
papers.abstract_en: Real-world model deployments inevitably encounter distribution shifts, rendering the confidence estimates of deep neural networks highly unreliable, posing severe risks in safety-critical applications. Existing methods improve calibration via training-time regularization or post-hoc adjustment, but often rely on access to (or simulation of) target domains, limiting practicality. We propose Frequency-aware Gradient Rectification (FGR), a target-agnostic training framework for robust calibration. From a frequency perspective, FGR applies low-pass filtering to a subset of training images to diminish spurious high-frequency cues and encourage the learning of domain-invariant features. However, the associated information loss can degrade In-Distribution (ID) calibration. To resolve this trade-off, FGR treats ID calibration as a hard constraint and rectifies conflicting parameter updates via geometric projection. This ensures a first-order non-increase in the ID calibration objective without introducing an additional loss-balancing coefficient. Extensive experiments on synthetic, real-world, and semantic shift datasets demonstrate that FGR significantly improves calibration under diverse shifts while preserving ID performance, and it remains compatible with post-hoc calibration methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/YilinZhang107/FGR-Calib.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出频率感知梯度修正（FGR）框架，用于在分布偏移下实现目标无关的鲁棒校准。方法通过对训练图像子集进行低通滤波以抑制虚假高频线索，同时将ID校准作为硬约束，通过几何投影修正冲突的参数更新，确保ID校准目标的一阶非增。实验表明FGR在不同偏移下改善校准，保持ID性能，并与事后校准方法兼容。
Motivation: 现有校准方法往往需要目标域信息，实用性受限。需要一种不依赖目标域且能处理分布偏移的校准方法。
Method: FGR框架：从频率角度出发，对部分训练图像进行低通滤波以抑制伪高频特征，同时将域内（ID）校准作为硬约束，通过几何投影修正与ID校准目标冲突的梯度更新，避免引入额外的平衡系数。
Result: 在合成、真实和语义偏移数据集上，FGR显著改善校准效果，同时保持域内性能，并可与事后校准方法结合使用。
Conclusion: FGR通过频率视角和梯度修正策略，有效解决了分布偏移下的校准-泛化权衡，且无需目标域信息，具有较好的实用性。

papers.title: Beyond Tokens: Enhancing RTL Quality Estimation via Structural Graph Learning
papers.abstract_en: Estimating the quality of register transfer level (RTL) designs is crucial in the electronic design automation (EDA) workflow, as it enables instant feedback on key performance metrics like area and delay without the need for time-consuming logic synthesis. While recent approaches have leveraged large language models (LLMs) to derive embeddings from RTL code and achieved promising results, they overlook the structural semantics essential for accurate quality estimation. In contrast, the control data flow graph (CDFG) view exposes the design's structural characteristics more explicitly, offering richer cues for representation learning. In this work, we introduce StructRTL, a novel structure-aware graph self-supervised learning framework for improved RTL design quality estimation. By learning structure-informed representations from CDFGs, StructRTL significantly outperforms prior art on various quality estimation tasks. To further boost performance, we incorporate a knowledge distillation strategy that transfers low-level insights from post-mapping netlists into the CDFG-based predictor. Experimental results demonstrate that StructRTL establishes new state-of-the-art results, highlighting the effectiveness of combining structural learning with cross-stage supervision.
papers.comment: Forty-Third International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 StructRTL，一种基于结构感知图自监督学习的 RTL 设计质量估计框架。通过从控制数据流图 (CDFG) 中学习结构信息表示，并利用知识蒸馏从后映射网表迁移低级信息，StructRTL 在面积和延迟等关键指标的估计上超越现有方法，在多个质量估计任务上取得新最优结果。
Motivation: 现有基于大语言模型的 RTL 质量估计方法忽略了结构语义，而 CDFG 视图能更显式地暴露设计结构特征，但尚未被充分利用于表示学习。
Method: 提出结构感知的图自监督学习框架 (StructRTL)，从 CDFG 学习表示；并引入知识蒸馏策略，将后映射网表中的低级知识迁移到 CDFG 基础预测器。

papers.title: Native Hierarchical and Compositional Representations with Subspace Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Traditional embeddings represent datapoints as vectors, which makes similarity easy to compute but limits how well they capture hierarchies and compositionality. We propose a fundamentally different approach: representing concepts as linear subspaces. By spanning multiple dimensions, subspaces can model broader concepts with higher-dimensional regions and nest more specific concepts within them. This geometry naturally captures generality through dimension, hierarchy through inclusion, and enables an emergent structure for composition via linear algebraic operations. To make this paradigm trainable, we introduce a differentiable subspace parameterization via soft projection matrices, allowing the effective dimension of each subspace to be learned. Our method not only achieves state-of-the-art performance on hierarchical and natural language inference benchmarks but also provides a geometrically-grounded model of entailment. Further, we demonstrate that while standard vector embeddings degrade to near-random performance on negated queries, subspace embeddings natively capture logical composition without explicit supervision, while preserving compatibility with efficient Euclidean vector search.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用线性子空间代替向量来表示概念，通过子空间的维度和包含关系自然捕获层次性和组合性。引入可微分的软投影矩阵参数化，使子空间的有效维度可学习。在层次推理和自然语言推理基准上达到最先进性能，并能原生处理逻辑组合（如否定查询），同时兼容高效的欧几里得向量搜索。
Motivation: 传统向量嵌入难以良好地捕获层次结构和组合性，尤其是在处理否定等逻辑操作时性能退化至随机水平。
Method: 将每个概念表示为线性子空间，通过可微分的软投影矩阵参数化，并设计损失函数学习子空间的维度和方向，使包含关系对应于子空间包含。
Result: 在层次推理和自然语言推理基准上取得最先进性能；在否定查询上，子空间嵌入保持良好性能而传统退化；与欧几里得向量搜索兼容。
Conclusion: 子空间嵌入提供了一种几何上有依据的蕴含模型，能自然捕获层次和组合逻辑，且可训练并兼容现有向量检索系统。

papers.title: Reduced-order modeling of Hamiltonian dynamics based on symplectic neural networks
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a novel data-driven symplectic induced-order modeling (ROM) framework for high-dimensional Hamiltonian systems that unifies latent-space discovery and dynamics learning within a single, end-to-end neural architecture. The encoder-decoder is built from Henon neural networks (HenonNets) and may be augmented with linear SGS-reflector layers. This yields an exact symplectic map between full and latent phase spaces. Latent dynamics are advanced by a symplectic flow map implemented as a HenonNet. This unified neural architecture ensures exact preservation of the underlying symplectic structure at the reduced-order level, significantly enhancing the fidelity and long-term stability of the resulting ROM. We validate our method through comprehensive numerical experiments on canonical Hamiltonian systems. The results demonstrate the method's capability for accurate trajectory reconstruction, robust predictive performance beyond the training horizon, and accurate Hamiltonian preservation. These promising outcomes underscore the effectiveness and potential applicability of our symplectic ROM framework for complex dynamical systems across a broad range of scientific and engineering disciplines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于辛神经网络的数据驱动降阶模型框架，用于高维哈密顿系统。该框架使用Henon神经网络构建编码器-解码器，并可选地添加线性SGS反射层，实现全相空间与潜在相空间之间的精确辛映射。潜在动力学由作为HenonNet实现的辛流映射推进，从而在降阶水平上精确保持辛结构。数值实验表明该方法能够准确重构轨迹、在训练时间范围外保持鲁棒预测性能，并精确保持哈密顿量。
Motivation: 高维哈密顿系统的降阶建模面临结构保持的挑战，现有方法难以同时保证潜在空间的几何结构和动力学演化的辛性质，导致长期预测不稳定和能量漂移。
Method: 提出端到端的辛降阶模型框架：编码器-解码器由Henon神经网络构成，可选线性SGS反射层增强，确保全空间到潜在空间的映射是精确辛的；潜在动力学由同样基于HenonNet的辛流映射推进，从而在降阶水平严格保持辛结构。
Result: 在典型哈密顿系统上的数值实验表明该方法能够准确重构轨迹，在超出训练时间范围时仍保持鲁棒预测性能，并准确保持哈密顿量。
Conclusion: 该辛降阶模型框架在复杂动力系统的保结构降阶方面展现出有效性和潜在应用价值，可推广至广泛的科学和工程领域。

papers.title: Residual Reservoir Memory Networks
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a novel class of untrained Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) within the Reservoir Computing (RC) paradigm, called Residual Reservoir Memory Networks (ResRMNs). ResRMN combines a linear memory reservoir with a non-linear reservoir, where the latter is based on residual orthogonal connections along the temporal dimension for enhanced long-term propagation of the input. The resulting reservoir state dynamics are studied through the lens of linear stability analysis, and we investigate diverse configurations for the temporal residual connections. The proposed approach is empirically assessed on time-series and pixel-level 1-D classification tasks. Our experimental results highlight the advantages of the proposed approach over other conventional RC models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在储备计算（Reservoir Computing）范式下提出了一类新的未训练循环神经网络——残差储备存储器网络（ResRMN）。ResRMN将线性记忆储备（linear memory reservoir）与基于时间维度残差正交连接（residual orthogonal connections）的非线性储备相结合，以增强输入的长期传播。通过线性稳定性分析研究储备状态动力学，并在时间序列和像素级1D分类任务上评估，实验表明该方法优于传统RC模型。
Motivation: 传统储备计算模型在处理长期依赖时存在记忆衰减问题，需要更有效的机制来增强长时间尺度上的信息传播。
Method: 提出ResRMN架构，包含线性记忆储备和非线性储备，其中非线性储备采用沿时间维度的残差正交连接来改进长期传播；使用线性稳定性分析来指导状态动力学设计。
Result: 摘要报告在时间序列和像素级1D分类任务上，ResRMN优于其他传统储备计算模型。
Conclusion: ResRMN通过结合线性记忆和残差正交连接，在未训练RNN中实现了更好的长期依赖处理，为储备计算提供了新方向。

papers.title: Benchmarking Uncertainty and its Disentanglement in multi-label Chest X-Ray Classification
papers.abstract_en: Reliable uncertainty quantification is crucial for trustworthy decision-making and the deployment of AI models in medical imaging. While prior work has explored the ability of neural networks to quantify predictive, epistemic, and aleatoric uncertainties using an information-theoretical approach in synthetic or well defined data settings like natural image classification, its applicability to real life medical diagnosis tasks remains underexplored. In this study, we provide an extensive uncertainty quantification benchmark for multi-label chest X-ray classification using the MIMIC-CXR-JPG dataset. We evaluate 13 uncertainty quantification methods for convolutional (ResNet) and transformer-based (Vision Transformer) architectures across a wide range of tasks. Additionally, we extend Evidential Deep Learning, HetClass NNs, and Deep Deterministic Uncertainty to the multi-label setting. Our analysis provides insights into uncertainty estimation effectiveness and the ability to disentangle epistemic and aleatoric uncertainties, revealing method- and architecture-specific strengths and limitations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对多标签胸部X光分类中的不确定性量化进行了全面基准测试，使用MIMIC-CXR-JPG数据集评估了13种方法在卷积和Transformer架构上的表现，并将其扩展至多标签设置。研究揭示了不同方法和架构在不确定性估计及其解耦（认知不确定性与偶然不确定性）上的优势与局限。
Motivation: 现有研究多聚焦于合成数据或简单图像分类任务，缺乏针对真实医学诊断任务（如多标签胸部X光分类）中不确定性量化的系统评估，尤其是对认知与偶然不确定性解耦能力的考察。
Method: 基于MIMIC-CXR-JPG数据集，对卷积（ResNet）和Transformer（Vision Transformer）架构下的13种不确定性量化方法进行基准测试，并将Evidential Deep Learning、HetClass NNs、Deep Deterministic Uncertainty扩展至多标签分类场景。
Result: 提供了多标签胸部X光分类中不确定性估计有效性和解耦能力的详细分析，识别出方法和架构特定的优势与局限。
Conclusion: 该基准测试为医学影像中不确定性量化的实际应用提供了参考，但结论基于单一数据集和特定模型，需在更多临床场景中验证。

papers.title: Population-Free Pareto Tracking for Sample-Efficient Multi-Policy MORL
papers.abstract_en: Multi-objective reinforcement learning (MORL) is a fundamental framework for real-world decision-making problems involving multiple conflicting criteria. Existing multi-policy (MP) methods typically rely on online evolutionary frameworks that maintain large policy populations, leading to high sample complexity and excessive agent-environment interactions. To mitigate these limitations, we present Multi-policy Pareto Front Tracking (MPFT), a framework without a self-evolving population. It leverages an efficient Pareto-tracking mechanism initialized with single-objective extreme policies to trace the Pareto front, and further densifies sparse regions to achieve an accurate approximation of the full Pareto front. MPFT can be seamlessly integrated with advanced offline MORL algorithms, thereby substantially improving sample efficiency. We evaluate MPFT on six robotic control tasks with up to three objectives and three high-dimensional tasks with more than three objectives. Experimental results show that MPFT outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in terms of hypervolume and expected utility. It also significantly reduces agent-environment interactions. These results further demonstrate that MPFT serves as a general-purpose framework that can seamlessly integrate both online and offline MORL algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MPFT，一种无需自演化种群的多策略 Pareto 前端追踪框架，通过单目标极端策略初始化并加密稀疏区域，以高效逼近完整 Pareto 前端。实验表明其在6个机器人控制任务和3个高维任务上优于现有基线，显著降低样本复杂度。
Motivation: 现有基于在线演化的多策略 MORL 方法需要维护大量策略种群，导致高样本复杂度和过多环境交互，限制了效率。
Method: MPFT 框架采用 Pareto 追踪机制，无需自演化种群，使用单目标极端策略初始化，通过追踪和加密稀疏区域来近似完整 Pareto 前端，可无缝集成离线 MORL 算法。
Result: 在6个最多3目标的机器人控制任务和3个超过3目标的高维任务上，MPFT 在超体积和期望效用指标上优于 SOTA 基线，并大幅减少智能体-环境交互。
Conclusion: MPFT 是一个通用框架，可同时集成在线和离线 MORL 算法，提升样本效率。

papers.title: Physics-informed, boundary-constrained Gaussian process regression for the reconstruction of fluid flow fields
papers.abstract_en: Gaussian process regression techniques have been used in fluid mechanics for the reconstruction of flow fields from a reduction-of-dimension perspective. A main ingredient in this setting is the construction of adapted covariance functions, or kernels, to obtain such estimates. In this paper, we present a general method for constraining a prescribed Gaussian process on an arbitrary compact set. The kernel of the pre-defined process must be at least continuous and may include other information about the studied phenomenon. This general boundary-constraining framework can be implemented with high flexibility for a broad range of engineering applications. From this, we derive physics-informed kernels for simulating two-dimensional velocity fields of an incompressible (divergence-free) flow around aerodynamic profiles. These kernels allow to define Gaussian process priors satisfying the incompressibility condition and the prescribed boundary conditions along the profile in a continuous manner. We describe an adapted numerical method for the boundary-constraining procedure parameterized by a measure on the compact set. The relevance of the methodology and performances are illustrated by numerical simulations of flows around a cylinder and a NACA 0412 airfoil profile, for which no observation at the boundary is needed at all.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种边界约束的高斯过程回归方法，用于重建流体流场。通过构造满足不可压缩条件和边界条件的物理信息核函数，在任意紧集上对高斯过程施加约束。数值实验展示了圆柱和NACA 0412翼型周围的流场重建效果，且无需边界观测数据。
Motivation: 高斯过程回归在流体力学中用于降维重建流场，但现有方法难以灵活地将边界条件和物理约束（如不可压缩性）整合进核函数中。
Method: 提出一种通用的边界约束框架，通过参数化紧集上的测度来约束高斯过程。推导出满足不可压缩条件和边界条件的物理信息核函数，用于二维速度场模拟。
Result: 数值模拟展示了方法在圆柱和NACA 0412翼型流场重建中的有效性，且完全无需边界观测数据。

papers.title: TransLPRNet: Lite Vision-Language Network for Single/Dual-line Chinese License Plate Recognition
papers.abstract_en: License plate recognition in open environments is widely applicable across various domains; however, the diversity of license plate types and imaging conditions presents significant challenges. To address the limitations encountered by CNN and CRNN-based approaches in license plate recognition, this paper proposes a unified solution that integrates a lightweight visual encoder with a text decoder, within a pre-training framework tailored for single and double-line Chinese license plates. To mitigate the scarcity of double-line license plate datasets, we constructed a single/double-line license plate dataset by synthesizing images, applying texture mapping onto real scenes, and blending them with authentic license plate images. Furthermore, to enhance the system's recognition accuracy, we introduce a perspective correction network (PTN) that employs license plate corner coordinate regression as an implicit variable, supervised by license plate view classification information. This network offers improved stability, interpretability, and low annotation costs. The proposed algorithm achieves an average recognition accuracy of 99.34% on the corrected CCPD test set under coarse localization disturbance. When evaluated under fine localization disturbance, the accuracy further improves to 99.58%. On the double-line license plate test set, it achieves an average recognition accuracy of 98.70%, with processing speeds reaching up to 167 frames per second, indicating strong practical applicability.

papers.title: Conformal C2ST: Turning weak classifiers into strong two-sample tests
papers.abstract_en: The two-sample testing problem, a fundamental task in statistics and machine learning, seeks to determine whether two sets of samples, drawn from underlying distributions $p$ and $q$, are in fact identically distributed (i.e. whether $p=q$). A popular and intuitive approach is the classifier two-sample test (C2ST), where a classifier is trained to distinguish between samples from $p$ and $q$. Yet despite simplicity of the C2ST, its reliability hinges on access to a near-Bayes-optimal classifier, a requirement that is rarely met and difficult to verify. This raises a major open question: can a weak classifier still be useful for two-sample testing? We show that the answer is a definitive yes. Building on the work of Hu and Lei (2024), we analyze two conformal variants of the C2ST that convert the scores from any trained classifier -- even if weak, biased, or overfit -- into exact, finite-sample p-values. We establish two key theoretical properties of the conformal C2ST: (i) finite-sample Type-I error control, and (ii) non-trivial power that degrades gently in tandem with the error of the trained classifier. The upshot is that even poorly performing classifiers can yield powerful and reliable two-sample tests. This general framework finds a powerful application in Bayesian inference, particularly for validating Neural Posterior Estimation (NPE) models, where the task of comparing a learned posterior approximation $q(θ\mid y)$ to the true posterior $p(θ\mid y)$ can be framed as a two-sample test. Empirically, the Conformal C2ST outperforms classical discriminative tests across a wide range of benchmarks for this task. Our results establish the conformal C2ST as a practical, theoretically grounded diagnostic tool.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出共形分类器两样本检验（Conformal C2ST），通过共形预测框架将任意（甚至弱）分类器的得分转化为精确的有限样本p值。理论证明该方法具有严格的有限样本第一类错误控制，且功效随分类器误差适度下降。实验表明，在贝叶斯后验估计验证任务上，该方法优于经典判别检验。
Motivation: 传统C2ST需要接近贝叶斯最优的分类器才能保证可靠性，而弱分类器是否可用是一个未解决的重要问题。
Method: 基于Hu和Lei（2024）的工作，提出两种共形C2ST变体，将任何训练过的分类器的得分（即使是弱、有偏或过拟合的）转化为精确的有限样本p值。
Result: 理论证明了有限样本第一类错误控制以及非平凡功效，且功效随分类器误差缓慢下降。经验上，在神经后验估计验证等基准测试中，Conformal C2ST优于经典判别检验。
Conclusion: 共形C2ST成为一种实用、有理论基础的诊断工具，尤其适用于贝叶斯推断中的后验估计验证。
