papers.title: Structure-Induced Information for Rerooting Levin Tree Search
papers.abstract_en: Subgoal-based policy tree search, which uses a policy to guide search, is effective for complex single-agent deterministic problems but often relies on explicit subgoal generation that can incur substantial overhead and hinders scalability. In this paper, we overcome these limitations by using a learned ``rerooter'' through the recently-introduced $\sqrt{\text{LTS}}$ algorithm. A rerooter implicitly decomposes the problem into soft subtasks. While previous work focused on the formal guarantees for given or handcrafted rerooters, in this work we propose three rerooter designs: (i) a clustering-based rerooter that exploits global state-space structure, (ii) a heuristic-based rerooter that leverages learned cost-to-go estimates, and (iii) a hybrid that combines both signals. Our framework avoids having to explicitly reconstruct and reason over generated subgoals, thereby enabling scalable allocation of search effort with significantly lower computational overhead. Empirically, our rerooting-based methods scale to complex environments where subgoal-based policy tree search fails, and achieve state-of-the-art online training efficiency on the domains tested.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于子目标的策略树搜索需要显式生成子目标导致计算开销大的问题，提出通过重路由（rerooter）隐式分解问题的方法。在√LTS算法基础上设计了三种重路由方案：基于聚类的全局结构、基于启发式的成本估计以及混合方法。实验表明该方法在子目标策略树搜索失效的复杂环境中达到最先进的在线训练效率。
Motivation: 现有子目标策略树搜索需要显式生成子目标，计算开销大，限制了可扩展性。
Method: 利用学习的重路由隐式分解问题，提出三种重路由设计：聚类利用全局状态空间结构，启发式利用学习到的成本估计，混合两者。
Result: 方法扩展到子目标策略树搜索失效的复杂环境，在测试领域实现了最先进的在线训练效率。
Conclusion: 避免显式重建和推理子目标，以更低的计算开销实现可扩展的搜索分配。

papers.title: Spatio-temporal stochastic graph-based learning for infectious disease forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Spatio-temporal graph-based models have typically been used to forecast new cases of infectious diseases such as COVID-19 and chickenpox outbreaks. However, the use of stochastic modelling into their learning process has been surprisingly under-investigated and rarely considered entire data sets of large countries. As a result, it is unknown whether these models would provide accurate forecasts in real-world disease spread scenarios. In this work, we propose a spatio-temporal stochastic graph-based architecture that integrates a stochastic formulation and uncertainty approximation process to forecast new infectious disease cases. We find that our approach can adapt to encode large and small population geographical networks within a single model architecture. Using two real-world data sets, COVID-19 in the US and chickenpox in Hungary, we report an enhanced effect of the proposed architecture across predictions of the 2022 first wave for COVID-19 in the US and comparative results of chickenpox waves during 2012-2014 in Hungary. By benchmarking with four spatio-temporal graph-based models, quantitative results show competitive overall weekly performance of the proposed approach on forecasting new cases for all 3,218 US counties and all 20 Hungary counties. The proposed approach can represent overall epidemic progression relative to baselines, though with a one-step delay; while exhibiting a reduced sensitivity to high-frequency and low-amplitude variability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种时空随机图模型（spatio-temporal stochastic graph-based architecture），将随机建模和不确定性近似引入传染病预测。在COVID-19（美国3218个县）和水痘（匈牙利20个县）数据集上，与四个时空图模型对比，该模型在周预测上表现有竞争力，能表示整体流行趋势但存在一步延迟，对高频低幅变异不敏感。
Motivation: 现有时空图模型预测传染病时很少采用随机建模，且未在大规模国家数据集上验证，因此不清楚其在真实传播场景中的准确性。
Method: 提出一种集成随机公式和不确定性近似过程的时空随机图架构，能够在一个模型中编码大规模和小规模人口地理网络。
Result: 在COVID-19 2022年第一波预测和水痘2012-2014年波次预测中，该模型与四个时空图基线相比，周预测性能具有竞争力，能表示整体流行趋势但有一步延迟，对高频低幅变异敏感度低。
Conclusion: 该随机图方法在大规模和小规模地理网络中均适用，但存在一步延迟，适合需要总体趋势而非逐周精确值的场景。

papers.title: BOKBO (Best of K Bad Options): Calibrated Abstention for VLA Policies
papers.abstract_en: Test-time scaling for vision-language-action (VLA) policies, methods such as RoboMonkey, SEAL, MG-Select, and V-GPS, samples K candidate action chunks at inference and executes the verifier-best. When all K candidates are unsafe, the system executes a violating action with no warning. We propose BOKBO, the first conformal abstention layer for K-sample VLA inference, providing finite-sample distribution-free guarantees on executed-violation rate. We provide both global and per-task (Mondrian) variants, with the per-task variant closing the conditional gap on the hardest tasks. Our analysis exposes a structural failure of policy-internal nonconformity scores under perturbation-based K-sampling: the base-policy confidence proxy and K-sample disagreement correlate at 0.98 with the action-noise hyperparameter $σ$, while correlating at the noise floor with actual safety violations. We test the failure's scope by replicating the analysis under token-level temperature sampling and find the failure is mechanism-specific and partially mitigated under policy-stochasticity-based sampling. A learned violation predictor conditioned on semantic visual features and task identity supports tight calibration: at $ε$ = 0.05 on libero_object_temp_x0.1 with OpenVLA-OFT, the conditional CRC bound holds on 86% of bootstrap splits with 78% coverage and 70% net task success. Mondrian-BOKBO raises the minimum per-task conditional hold fraction from 0.71 to 0.93. Results are stable across 5 training seeds, replicate within bootstrap noise on $π_0$-FAST, hold on libero_spatial_temp_x0.1 as a co-equal benchmark, and survive four within-suite distribution shifts. We additionally identify and correct a methodological pitfall: globally-set force thresholds well below expert-typical manipulation forces conflate unsafe behavior with normal manipulation, inflating violation rates by $5\times$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BOKBO，首个为 K 采样 VLA（视觉-语言-动作）策略提供有限样本、分布无关保证的共形弃权层。方法包括全局和按任务（Mondrian）变体，并发现基于扰动的 K 采样下策略内非一致性分数与安全违规相关极弱，而与噪声超参数高度相关。实验表明，在 libero_object_temp_x0.1 等基准上，Mondrian-BOKBO 将任务条件保留率从 0.71 提升至 0.93，并在多种分布偏移下保持稳定。
Motivation: 现有 K 采样 VLA 测试时扩展方法（如 RoboMonkey、SEAL）在全部候选动作不安全时仍执行违规动作且无预警，缺乏对执行违规率的可保证控制。
Method: 提出 BOKBO，一种基于共形预测的弃权机制，对 K 个候选动作进行校准，输出一个经调整的拒绝集，使得执行违规率在有限样本下有分布无关的保证；并给出全局和按任务（Mondrian）两种变体。
Result: 在 ε=0.05 条件下，条件 CRC 界在 86% 的 bootstrap 分割上成立，覆盖率达到 78%，净任务成功率 70%；Mondrian-BOKBO 将最小按任务条件保留分数从 0.71 提高到 0.93；结果在 5 个种子下稳定，并在 π₀-FAST 和 libero_spatial_temp_x0.1 上复现。
Conclusion: 论文揭示了基于扰动的 K 采样下非一致性分数的结构失效（与安全违规几乎不相关），并指出全局设置偏低的最大力阈值会高估违规率（5 倍）。Mondrian-BOKBO 有效缩小了条件差距，提高了困难任务上的校准质量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning to Perceive the World Through Control: Empowerment-Based Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: In many practical reinforcement learning environments, observations are far higher-dimensional than the variables that matter for control. In this work, we ask: can we learn representations that capture only control-relevant features of the environment? We study this question through the empowerment objective, which maximizes an agent's influence over the environment and is widely used for unsupervised skill learning. We show that empowerment agents induce two distinct representations -- forward and backward -- that capture complementary aspects of the state, and both of which are invariant to control-irrelevant features. Thus, empowerment maximization leads agents to learn an implicit, control-centric model of the world. Our analysis highlights the importance of learning representations through interaction rather than from passive datasets: interaction aimed at maximizing control is essential for learning useful invariance properties, a perspective that aligns closely with the causal learning literature.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在强化学习中如何学习仅保留控制相关特征的表示。通过 empowerment 最大化目标，展示智能体学习到前向和后向两种互补表示，且都对控制无关特征不变。强调了通过交互学习表示的重要性。
Motivation: 实际强化学习中观测维度远高于控制所需变量，需要学习抓住控制相关特征的表示。
Method: 使用 empowerment 目标（最大化智能体对环境的影响），分析两种表示（前向和后向）互补且对控制无关特征不变。
Result: 证明 empowerment 最大化导致智能体隐式地学习到世界模型，且表示具有不变性。
Conclusion: 通过交互（而非被动数据集）学习表示对于获得有用的不变性至关重要，与因果学习文献一致。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EUDAIMONIA: Evaluating Undesirable Dynamics in AI
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as conversational partners for companionship, emotional disclosure, and interpersonal advice, but the social dynamics of these interactions can create harms that are not captured by capability-oriented or traditional safety evaluations. We introduce the Social AI Design Code, a framework for evaluating whether LLMs align with user welfare in social interactions, including whether they encourage harmful intimacy, dependence, or prolonged engagement. To evaluate these risks in natural and diverse user-LLM interactions, we operationalize the code with EUDAIMONIA, a benchmark of 969 user inputs and 3,147 design-requirement violation checks built from WildChat through weak-to-strong filtration, multi-model relabeling, and controlled rewriting. Evaluating 22 recent LLMs, we find that even the strongest models, Claude-Opus-4.7 and GPT-5.5, violate 30.7% and 27.2% of checks, respectively. Extended thinking does not reduce violation rates, suggesting that these failures are persistent social-alignment problems rather than deficits solvable through test-time reasoning alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出社会AI设计准则，用于评估LLM在社交交互中是否损害用户福祉（如鼓励有害亲密、依赖或过度参与）。构建EUDAIMONIA基准，包含969条用户输入和3147项设计需求违规检查，评估22个近期LLM发现最强模型（Claude-Opus-4.7和GPT-5.5）分别违规30.7%和27.2%，且扩展思考无法降低违规率。
Motivation: 现有评估关注能力或传统安全，但LLM作为社交伙伴可能产生有害社会动态（如过度亲密、依赖）。需要系统评估这些风险。
Method: 提出社会AI设计代码框架，通过弱到强过滤、多模型重标注和受控改写从WildChat构建EUDAIMONIA基准。
Result: 22个LLM中，最强模型Claude-Opus-4.7违规30.7%，GPT-5.5违规27.2%。扩展思考未降低违规率。
Conclusion: 当前LLM存在持续的社交对齐问题，无法通过测试时推理解决。

papers.title: Bridging the Gap Between Natural Language and Market Dynamics via High-Dimensional Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Traditional multi-modal financial forecasting often relies on scalar sentiment scores, which fail to capture the nuances of financial news. To address this information loss, this paper explores high-dimensional representation learning by replacing discrete polarity ratings with dense FinBERT embeddings within a Transformer-based forecasting architecture. We benchmarked various embedding strategies on the FNSPID dataset, including raw embeddings, attention-weighted aggregation, and a custom Siamese network. While the attention-based mechanism struggled with the low signal-to-noise ratio typical of financial data, the integration of Siamese-optimized embeddings outperformed both the scalar baseline and raw embedding approaches, demonstrating that preserving high-dimensional narrative context yields improved predictive accuracy for short-term stock price movements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对金融新闻中传统标量情感分数丢失信息的问题，提出使用高维FinBERT嵌入代替离散情感评分，并在Transformer预测架构中比较了原始嵌入、注意力加权聚合和孪生网络等策略。在FNSPID数据集上，孪生网络优化的嵌入优于标量基线和原始嵌入，表明保留高维叙事上下文可提高短期股价预测精度。
Motivation: 传统多模态金融预测使用标量情感分数，无法捕捉金融新闻的细微语义，导致信息损失。
Method: 将FinBERT高维嵌入集成到Transformer预测架构中，并对比原始嵌入、注意力加权聚合和自定义孪生网络三种策略。
Result: 孪生网络优化的嵌入在FNSPID数据集上优于标量基线和原始嵌入，提高了短期股价预测准确性，而注意力机制因金融数据低信噪比表现不佳。
Conclusion: 保留高维叙事上下文能改善预测性能，但注意力机制在低信噪比金融数据中效果有限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LARK: Learnability-Grounded Trajectory Selection for Efficient Reasoning Distillation
papers.abstract_en: We study trajectory selection for reasoning distillation, where teacher-generated reasoning trajectories are selectively used as supervision for a student model. Existing methods rely on heuristics such as trajectory quality or model confidence, but they often overlook whether a trajectory is learnable by the student. In this paper, we present LARK, a learnability-grounded method for reasoning trajectory selection. LARK selects trajectories that the student can learn efficiently while preserving the generalization of the full training distribution. At the core of LARK is a learnability factor $ρ$, which characterizes the rate at which the student's training loss decreases. To estimate this rate efficiently and maintain generalization, we introduce a learnability proxy and a $χ^2$-regularized selection policy that balances learnability and distributional coverage, both with strong theoretical guarantees on their estimation error. Empirically, LARK consistently outperforms data selection baselines across multiple base models and reasoning tasks. Diagnostic analyses show that the LARK score predicts downstream training utility and that LARK-selected trajectories induce faster supervised fine-tuning loss reduction. Our code is available at https://github.com/Tianrun-Yu/LARK.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LARK，一种基于可学习性（learnability）的推理轨迹选择方法，用于高效推理蒸馏。LARK 通过可学习性因子 ρ 估计学生模型的损失下降速率，并采用 χ² 正则化的选择策略平衡可学习性与分布覆盖。实验表明 LARK 在多个基模型和推理任务上优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有轨迹选择方法依赖启发式规则（如轨迹质量或模型置信度），忽略了学生模型的可学习性，导致蒸馏效率低下。
Method: 提出可学习性因子 ρ 量化学生模型损失下降速率，并引入可学习性代理（learnability proxy）和 χ² 正则化选择策略，同时提供理论保证。
Result: 在多个基模型和推理任务上，LARK 一致优于数据选择基线；诊断分析显示 LARK 得分能预测下游训练效用，且所选轨迹加速 SFT 损失下降。
Conclusion: LARK 通过可学习性驱动的轨迹选择提升了推理蒸馏的效率，其理论框架和实验验证支持其有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Convergence of Steepest Descent and Adam under Non-Uniform Smoothness
papers.abstract_en: Recent work has analyzed the convergence of first-order methods under non-uniform smoothness assumptions that better model the loss landscape in machine learning tasks. We generalize this assumption to objectives whose curvature is an affine function of the objective value. This property is satisfied by a broad class of problems, including logistic regression, generalized linear models with a logistic link function, softmax policy gradient in reinforcement learning, and a class of neural networks. Under this assumption and gradient domination conditions, we establish a general convergence rate for the steepest descent method, and deterministic, diagonal variants of RMSProp and Adam. Our results imply that for logistic regression on separable data and the softmax policy gradient objective, sign GD converges linearly and is provably faster than GD. Furthermore, we show that for a class of two-layer neural networks on separable data, RMSProp and Adam can converge at a linear rate with a constant step-size and momentum parameter. Finally, we present a lower bound demonstrating that, under our assumption, RMSProp and Adam are provably faster than AdaGrad, AMSGrad, gradient descent, and heavy-ball momentum.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在非均匀光滑假设下，将曲率泛化到目标值的仿射函数，覆盖逻辑回归、广义线性模型、softmax策略梯度及一类神经网络。在梯度支配条件下，建立了最速下降法、确定性对角化RMSProp和Adam的收敛率，证明对可分数据逻辑回归和softmax策略梯度，sign GD线性收敛且快于GD；对一类两层神经网络，RMSProp和Adam可线性收敛；下界表明RMSProp/Adam快于AdaGrad、AMSGrad、梯度下降和heavy-ball动量。
Motivation: 现有非均匀光滑假设能更好建模损失景观，但作者将其扩展至更一般的目标函数形式，以分析更广泛问题中一阶方法的收敛性。
Method: 提出曲率为目标值仿射函数的假设，结合梯度支配条件，从理论上推导最速下降法及确定性对角化RMSProp/Adam的收敛率。
Result: 理论结果指出：对可分数据逻辑回归和softmax策略梯度，sign GD线性收敛且快于GD；对一类两层神经网络，RMSProp和Adam以恒定步长和动量参数线性收敛；下界表明RMSProp和Adam比AdaGrad、AMSGrad、GD和heavy-ball动量收敛更快。
Conclusion: 本文从理论上证实了在特定结构（曲率与目标值仿射相关）下，自适应方法（如RMSProp/Adam）相较于普通梯度下降具有加速优势。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Same Patient, Different Words, Different Diagnosis? Evaluating Semantic Stability in Clinical LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in clinical applications. However, their behavior remains highly sensitive to subtle linguistic variations, such as rephrasing or syntactic variation. This sensitivity poses risks in safety-critical healthcare settings, where semantically equivalent inputs should produce consistent predictions. However, a key challenge is to ensure that prompt variations truly preserve clinical meaning, as embedding-based similarity metrics often fail to capture distinctions involving negation, temporality, or severity. To address this limitation, we propose a semantic verification framework based on Natural Language Inference (NLI) to filter meaning-preserving prompt variations, which are further refined using an LLM-as-a-judge and audited by a clinical expert. In addition, we introduce three metrics to quantify model sensitivity: MeaningPreserving Variation Sensitivity (MVS), confidence variation (ΔC), and Worst-Case Instability (WCI). We evaluate 16 open-source general-purpose (GP) and medical LLMs within the same model families and parameter scales, using reformulated prompts derived from the DiagnosisQA and MedQA datasets. Our results demonstrate that robustness differences between domain-specific (DS) models are mixed and highly model-dependent, i.e., domain specialization does not consistently improve or reduce robustness to meaning-preserving prompt reformulations. Several DS models rank among the most robust (when compared with GP counterparts), and strong GP baselines remain competitive as well.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究临床LLM对语义等价但措辞不同的提示的敏感性，提出基于自然语言推理（NLI）的语义验证框架过滤保留意义的变体，并引入三个指标（MVS、ΔC、WCI）量化模型不稳定性。评估16个开源通用和医学LLM在DiagnosisQA和MedQA数据集上的表现，发现领域特化不能一致地改善或降低鲁棒性，多个领域模型和强通用基线表现接近。
Motivation: 临床LLM对微小语言变化敏感，在安全关键的医疗场景中，语义等价的输入应产生一致预测，但现有嵌入相似度指标难以捕捉否定、时态或严重性差异，缺乏可靠的语义验证方法。
Method: 提出基于NLI的语义验证框架，通过NLI过滤保留意义的提示变体，经LLM-as-a-judge和临床专家审核，并定义MVS、ΔC、WCI指标来衡量敏感性。

Conclusion: 领域特化并不稳定地提升对语义等价改写的鲁棒性，强通用基线仍具竞争力，提示需谨慎看待领域专门化的假设。

papers.title: Diffusion Models Preferentially Memorize Prototypical Examples or: Why Does My Diffusion Model Love Slop?
papers.abstract_en: Generative models have a persistent limitation: their tendency to memorize training data can create legal liabilities and erode creative diversity. Understanding which samples are memorized in whole or in part, and under what conditions, therefore remains an important open problem. Here we answer the question "Are atypical or rare samples memorized first?" in the negative. We train diffusion models on strings generated according to the production rules of the Random Hierarchy Model (RHM), and find that samples composed of common substrings are preferentially memorized. This holds true even if the training data consists of entirely unique samples, indicating that deduplication at the data point level does not provide a meaningful privacy guarantee. Correspondingly we predict, then observe, delayed memorization for fat-tailed datasets (i.e., those with more atypical samples). This effect is amplified when fat-tails are introduced into high-level production rules. These together suggest that dataset diversity, particularly at higher levels of abstraction, plays an important role in staving off memorization. Finally, we identify an intermediate regime of partial memorization in which common substrings are learned first and subsequently overproduced during generation. If training is stopped in this regime, models will exhibit the reversion-to-the-mean blandness often derided as "slop".
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过Random Hierarchy Model (RHM) 生成的字符串训练扩散模型，发现模型优先记忆由常见子串组成的原型样本，即便训练数据完全去重也无法防止。肥尾数据集（含更多非典型样本）会延迟记忆。部分记忆阶段中，常见子串被过度生成，导致生成内容趋于平均值（即“slop”）。
Motivation: 生成模型的记忆倾向会引发法律风险并削弱创造性多样性，需明确哪些样本在何种条件下被记忆。
Method: 使用RHM的生成规则产生字符串作为训练数据，训练扩散模型并分析其记忆行为。
Result: 常见子串组成的样本被优先记忆，去重无效；肥尾数据集延迟记忆；部分记忆阶段导致常见子串过度生成，产生“slop”。
Conclusion: 数据集多样性，尤其是高层抽象层面的多样性，是缓解记忆的关键；存在导致生成内容枯燥的中间训练状态。

papers.title: COFT: Counterfactual-Conformal Decoding for Fair Chain-of-Thought Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can reveal and amplify societal biases during chain-of-thought (CoT) generation. We present COFT (Chain of Fair Thought), a training-free decoding method that applies token-level fairness control at decode time, with distribution-free marginal validity guarantees (under exchangeability) for any frozen causal language model. COFT operates in three stages. First, it creates a masked counterfactual prompt by replacing sensitive spans with neutral tokens. Second, it compares the factual and masked logit distributions through lightweight logit fusion to attenuate attribute-driven biases. Third, it uses dual-branch split-conformal calibration to certify per-step candidate token sets at a user-chosen risk level. We evaluate COFT across six models and multiple bias benchmarks. Our method reduces standard bias metrics by 30-55% (median 38%) while preserving task utility and language quality. Reasoning accuracies remain unchanged within run-to-run noise margins. The computational overhead is modest, equivalent to one additional cached forward pass (<=11%). COFT offers a clear, auditable path to safer CoT generation with significant bias reduction, negligible utility loss, and no requirement for retraining, auxiliary classifiers, or weight access.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: COFT提出一种无需训练的链式推理解码方法，通过在解码时进行词级公平性控制、掩码反事实提示和双分支分裂共形校准，在保持任务效用和语言质量的前提下减少大语言模型的社会偏见。实验表明该方法可将标准偏差指标降低30-55%（中位数38%），计算开销仅为一次额外的缓存前向传播（≤11%）。
Motivation: 大语言模型在链式推理生成过程中可能暴露和放大社会偏见，现有方法需要重新训练或额外分类器，成本高且不灵活。
Method: COFT包含三个阶段：1）用中性标记替换敏感跨度生成掩码反事实提示；2）通过轻量级logit融合比较事实和掩码分布以削弱属性驱动偏见；3）使用双分支分裂共形校准认证每步候选词集，提供用户指定风险水平下的分布无关边际有效性保证。
Result: 在六个模型和多个偏差基准上，COFT将标准偏差指标降低30-55%（中位数38%），推理准确率在运行间噪声范围内保持不变，计算开销相当于一次额外缓存前向传播（≤11%）。
Conclusion: COFT提供了一条清晰、可审计的路径，在显著减少偏见、几乎不损失效用且无需重新训练、辅助分类器或权重访问的条件下实现更安全的链式推理生成。

papers.title: CSULoRA: Closest Safe Update Low-Rank Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Low-rank adaptation has become a standard method for parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large language models, but even small amounts of unsafe or adversarial fine-tuning data can substantially weaken the safety behavior of aligned models. Existing safety-preserving LoRA methods often rely on hard interventions such as projection, pruning, thresholding, or additional training objectives. While these methods can suppress unsafe update directions, they may also remove task-relevant information or require extra tuning. We introduce CSULoRA, a post-hoc method for correcting trained LoRA adapters through closest safe update estimation. CSULoRA estimates a safety-aligned subspace from the weight displacement between a safety-aligned model and its corresponding base checkpoint. It then decomposes each LoRA update into fully aligned, partially aligned, and off-subspace components. Instead of discarding components outside the estimated safety subspace, CSULoRA solves a closed-form penalized minimum-change problem that preserves the fully aligned component while smoothly attenuating potentially unsafe directions according to their relative energy. In adversarial fine-tuning experiments, CSULoRA substantially reduces attack success rate while preserving most of the utility gains obtained from standard LoRA fine-tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CSULoRA，一种后处理方法，通过最近安全更新估计来修正已训练的LoRA适配器。该方法从安全对齐模型与基础检查点的权重位移中估计安全对齐子空间，然后将LoRA更新分解为完全对齐、部分对齐和子空间外成分，并通过闭式惩罚最小变化问题保留完全对齐成分并平滑衰减潜在不安全方向。在对抗微调实验中，CSULoRA显著降低了攻击成功率，同时保留了大部分标准LoRA微调带来的效用提升。
Motivation: 现有安全保留LoRA方法常依赖投影、剪枝、阈值或额外训练目标等硬干预，可能移除任务相关信息或需要额外调参。需要一种温和的后处理方法，能在不牺牲任务效用的情况下抑制不安全更新方向。
Method: CSULoRA从安全对齐模型与基础检查点的权重位移中估计安全对齐子空间，将每个LoRA更新分解为完全对齐、部分对齐和子空间外成分，并通过闭式惩罚最小变化问题保留完全对齐成分，同时根据相对能量平滑衰减潜在不安全方向。
Result: 在对抗微调实验中，CSULoRA显著降低了攻击成功率，同时保留了大部分标准LoRA微调带来的效用提升。
Conclusion: CSULoRA提供了一种后处理方式，能在不引入额外训练目标或干预的情况下有效平衡安全性和任务性能。

papers.title: PInVerify: An Offline Embodied Benchmark for Active Instance Verification
papers.abstract_en: Embodied agents have made strong progress in navigating to target objects, but reaching the goal vicinity does not guarantee that the agent has found the correct instance: subtle attribute differences (e.g., "white floral" vs. "white striped") often require close-range, multi-view inspection. We address this gap with Active Instance Verification (AIV), a task in which an agent actively selects viewpoints around a candidate object to decide whether it matches a fine-grained natural-language description. We formalize AIV as a finite-horizon decision process and introduce PInVerify, an offline embodied benchmark for AIV: 3,000 evaluation episodes across 18 object categories, delivered as multi-view captures with a 6-sector navigation topology that exposes trap views (navigable but uninformative) and unreachable sectors. As reference baselines we build a training-free pipeline and a LoRA-fine-tuned end-to-end agent around open-source multimodal large language models (MLLMs) at on-device scale ($\leq$8B parameters), with attribute decomposition, a visibility-weighted multi-view tracker, and three next-best-view (NBV) strategies. In our evaluation across Qwen3-VL (4B/8B), SenseNova-SI-1.2-InternVL3-8B, CLIP, and SigLIP2, the best MLLM-based baseline exceeds the best embedding baseline by 4.9 pp; GT-box ablations show a +3.1 pp detection gap; and we do not observe reliable gains from active viewpoint selection within the tested NBV strategies. A LoRA-fine-tuned agent (SFT+GSPO) reaches 85.6%. PInVerify aims to support further work on active, fine-grained semantic verification in embodied AI. Code: https://github.com/Avalon-S/PInVerify.
papers.comment: Accepted as a poster at the Foundation Models Meet Embodied Agents (FMEA) Workshop, CVPR 2026. 44 pages including appendix. Code: https://github.com/Avalon-S/PInVerify
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对具身智能体在到达目标物体附近后仍需近距离多视角检查细粒度属性差异的问题，提出主动实例验证（AIV）任务和离线基准PInVerify，包含3000个评估场景、18个物体类别、6扇区导航拓扑及陷阱视图。基于≤8B的开源多模态大模型构建无需训练和LoRA微调的基线，在Qwen3-VL、SenseNova等模型上评估，最佳MLLM基线比最佳嵌入基线高4.9个百分点，LoRA微调后达85.6%，但未观察到主动视角选择策略的可靠收益。
Motivation: 现有导航方法在到达目标附近后无法正确识别实例，因为细微属性差异（如“白色花卉” vs “白色条纹”）需要近距离多视角验证，而现有基准未覆盖这一细粒度语义验证场景。
Method: 将AIV形式化为有限时域决策过程，构建PInVerify基准（3000个评估片段，18个类别，6扇区拓扑，含陷阱视图和不可达扇区）。基线包括无需训练的多模态大模型推理流水线和LoRA微调的端到端智能体，采用属性分解、可见性加权多视角跟踪器和三种下一最佳视角策略。
Result: 在Qwen3-VL (4B/8B)、SenseNova-SI-1.2-InternVL3-8B、CLIP、SigLIP2上评估，最佳MLLM基线超过最佳嵌入基线4.9个百分点；GT-box消融显示检测差距3.1个百分点；主动视角选择策略未带来可靠收益。LoRA微调智能体（SFT+GSPO）达到85.6%。
Conclusion: PInVerify旨在支持具身AI中主动细粒度语义验证的进一步研究；当前NBV策略下主动视角选择无可靠收益，表明需要更有效的视角规划方法。

papers.title: Score Broadcast and Decorrelation: A General Framework for Broadcast-Based Credit Assignment
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Score Broadcast and Decorrelation (SBD), a principled framework for broadcast-based credit assignment for general families of differentiable losses. Error broadcast is a biologically plausible alternative to backpropagation that sends output information to hidden layers without weight transport. The Error Broadcast and Decorrelation (EBD) framework, recently introduced for the mean-squared-error (MSE) setting, grounded this mechanism in the stochastic orthogonality of optimal estimators, under which the optimal residual is orthogonal to functions of the input. We generalize that foundation by introducing an orthogonality principle between the output score (the gradient of loss with respect to the final-layer output) and hidden-layer activations, which holds whenever the optimal score has conditional mean zero. This single principle unifies broadcast-based credit assignment across the standard differentiable-loss families, including cross-entropy, Bregman divergences, proper scoring rules, and exponential-family negative log-likelihoods. The framework supplies a theoretical grounding for the three-factor learning rule under general losses, with the neuromodulatory factor derived as the broadcast loss score. We derive the cross-entropy case explicitly, characterize the admissible loss class, and introduce a score vector expansion technique that enriches the broadcast signal while preserving the orthogonality framework. Experiments on CIFAR-10 and Tiny ImageNet show that SBD substantially improves over existing broadcast approaches, with score vector expansion delivering further gains. Overall, this work identifies the loss score as the signal to broadcast, supplies the orthogonality theory and theoretical grounding for the three-factor learning rule from neuroscience, and shows how score vector expansion enriches the decorrelation directions of the resulting objective.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出分数广播与去相关（SBD）框架，为广播式信用分配提供通用理论基础，适用于交叉熵、Bregman散度、适当评分规则和指数族负对数似然等可微损失函数。该框架通过输出分数与隐藏层激活之间的正交性原理统一了多种损失下的信用分配，并导出了三因子学习规则的理论基础。实验表明，SBD在CIFAR-10和Tiny ImageNet上显著优于现有广播方法。
Motivation: 现有广播式信用分配方法（如EBD）仅适用于均方误差损失，缺乏对更常见损失函数（如交叉熵）的理论支撑，且神经科学中的三因子学习规则缺乏统一的理论基础。
Method: 提出输出分数（损失对输出层的梯度）与隐藏层激活之间的正交性原理，该原理在最优分数条件均值为零时成立，从而统一各类可微损失下的广播框架。引入分数向量扩展技术以丰富广播信号同时保持正交性。
Result: 在CIFAR-10和Tiny ImageNet上的实验表明，SBD显著优于现有广播方法，分数向量扩展带来进一步性能提升。
Conclusion: 本文识别了损失分数作为广播信号，提供了广播式信用分配的正交性理论和神经科学中三因子学习规则的理论基础，并展示了分数向量扩展如何丰富目标函数的去相关方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EHRBench: An Automated and Reliable EHR-based Benchmark for Clinical Decision Making with LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Clinical decision-making (CDM) is central to real-world clinical workflows, where clinicians infer diagnoses, select treatments, or anticipate future health outcomes under incomplete evidence. LLMs are increasingly used to support these decisions due to strong language capabilities, broad biomedical knowledge, and efficiency, yet the reliability of LLMs on real-world clinical decision tasks remains insufficiently understood. To evaluate CDM models, especially LLM-based models, an ideal and practical medical decision benchmark should be constructed via an automated yet reliable pipeline to ensure both scale and quality. Moreover, the grounding of a CDM benchmark in real patient EHRs can better support evaluation on practical CDM tasks that require substantive biomedical knowledge and clinical inference. To fill the gaps, we introduce EHRBench, an automated and reliable EHR-grounded benchmark for evaluating LLM-based clinical decision-making at scale. To ensure scalability and reliability, EHRBench is constructed through an EHR-LLM-KB(knowledge-base) interaction pipeline. For efficiency, we use a specialized LLM to automatically convert encounter-level EHR trajectories into structured templates and deterministically instantiate the templates into QA items. In parallel, we apply systematic KB-based verification and enrichment to filter hallucinated or ambiguous relations and to improve reliability. Using this pipeline, we construct nearly 1M (960,067) QA items spanning three core inference-required clinical decision tasks: diagnosis, treatment, and prognosis. We benchmark more than 30 representative LLMs on EHRBench and provide detailed analyses of performance and robustness. The results show consistent capability trends across settings, further validating the reliability of EHRBench and highlighting actionable gaps toward clinically reliable LLM systems.
papers.comment: Proceedings of the 32nd ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining (KDD 2026), Datasets and Benchmarks Track, Oral
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EHRBench是一个基于电子健康记录（EHR）的自动化、可靠的基准测试，用于评估大型语言模型（LLMs）在临床决策中的表现。通过EHR-LLM-KB交互流水线，从真实患者EHR轨迹中生成了近100万个QA项，涵盖诊断、治疗和预后三个核心任务，并基准测试了30多个代表性LLM。
Motivation: 现有临床决策模型评估缺乏一个既自动又可靠、且基于真实EHR的基准测试，以衡量LLM在需要生物医学知识和临床推理的实际任务中的可靠性。
Method: 提出EHR-LLM-KB（知识库）交互流水线：用专用LLM自动将就诊级EHR轨迹转换为结构化模板，再确定性地实例化为QA项；同时应用系统性的KB验证和增强来过滤幻觉或模糊关系，提高可靠性。
Result: 构建了约96万个QA项，涵盖诊断、治疗和预后三个临床决策任务；对30多个代表性LLM进行基准测试，显示了跨设置的一致能力趋势，验证了EHRBench的可靠性，并指出了LLM系统在临床可靠性方面的可行动差距。
Conclusion: EHRBench提供了一个自动化、可靠且大规模的基准，用于评估LLM在真实临床决策中的表现，暴露了当前LLM在临床可靠性方面的不足，并指导未来的改进方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CellBRIDGE: Learning Cellular Trajectories via Interaction-Aware Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Inferring dynamics from population snapshots is a fundamental challenge in machine learning and biology. In scRNA-sequencing (scRNA-seq), destructive measurements preclude direct tracking of individual cells across time, making trajectory inference underdetermined. Optimal Transport (OT) provides a principled framework for snapshot alignment, but a long-standing modeling question is which cost functions yield biologically meaningful couplings. Standard OT approaches rely on gene-expression distances, implicitly treating cells as independent points and neglecting structured cell-cell communication mediated by ligand-receptor signaling. We introduce CellBRIDGE (Cell-Based Regularized Interaction-Driven Gene Expression), which augments feature-based OT with a directed, typed interaction cost derived from ligand-receptor activity. By explicitly modeling cell-cell communication, CellBRIDGE improves cross-snapshot couplings and downstream trajectory estimates across synthetic and real scRNA-seq datasets relative to feature-only baselines. Notably, CellBRIDGE enables mechanistically interpretable in silico perturbations: on lung cancer data, silencing specific ligand-receptor pairs induces trajectory shifts that recapitulate expected effects of targeted pathway inhibition.
papers.journal_ref: ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CellBRIDGE方法，通过引入配体-受体介导的定向交互代价来增强基于特征的OT（最优传输），从而改进单细胞RNA测序数据的跨快照耦合和轨迹推断。在合成和真实数据集上，CellBRIDGE优于仅基于特征的方法，并能在肺癌数据上实现机制可解释的in silico扰动。
Motivation: 单细胞RNA测序的破坏性测量导致无法追踪单个细胞，轨迹推断欠定；标准OT仅依赖基因表达距离，忽略细胞间通信。
Method: 提出CellBRIDGE，在OT中增加基于配体-受体活性的有向、类型化的交互代价，显式建模细胞间通信。
Result: 在合成和真实scRNA-seq数据集上，CellBRIDGE相对于仅特征基准改进了跨快照耦合和轨迹估计；在肺癌数据上，沉默特定配体-受体对可诱导轨迹变化，重现靶向通路抑制的预期效果。
Conclusion: 细胞间通信的正则化有助于生成更有生物学意义的耦合，CellBRIDGE提供了可解释的扰动分析能力。

papers.title: Rationalize: Shared Semantic Reasoning for Human-AI Alignment
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Rationalize, a role-pair framework for shared semantic reasoning between humans and AI models in data-driven sensemaking. Building on ideas in human-machine teaming and critical thinking, we conceptualize human-AI interaction as a series of complementary role pairs (Explorer-Guide, Investigator-Informant, Teacher-Student, Judge-Advocate) operating in a shared reasoning space. In this space, human analysts and AI models (such as LLMs) make purposes, questions, assumptions, evidence, inferences, and implications explicit, facilitating alignment not only at the output level but at the level of rationalization of intent and action by each side. We relate these role pairs to the bidirectional human-AI alignment framework, illustrating how "aligning AI to humans" and "aligning humans to AI" differ by role, and sketch a collaborative research agenda for alignment design and assessment using element-level and role-specific approaches.
papers.comment: Accepted by ACM CHI 2026 BiAlign Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Rationalize角色对框架，用于人类与AI（如LLM）在数据驱动意义构建中的共享语义推理。将人机交互视为互补角色对（探索者-引导者、调查者-信息提供者、教师-学生、法官-倡导者）在共享推理空间中操作，使目的、问题、假设、证据、推理和影响显式化，促进输出层面以及意图和行动合理化层面的对齐。
Motivation: 当前人机对齐主要关注输出层面，缺乏对意图和推理过程的对齐。论文旨在通过角色对框架实现双向对齐，使AI和人类在语义推理层面相互理解。
Method: 基于人机团队和批判性思维，定义四种互补角色对（Explorer-Guide等），构建共享推理空间，将推理元素显式化，并关联到双向对齐框架（对齐AI到人类和对齐人类到AI）。
Result: 摘要提出概念框架和协作研究议程，未报告定量实验结果。
Conclusion: 该框架为对齐设计和评估提供了元素级和角色特定方法，有助于改善人机协作中的理性对齐。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Controllable Lung Nodule Synthesis via Histogram-Regularized Latent Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: While automated diagnosis systems have achieved remarkable success in computed tomography (CT)-based lung cancer screening, their development remains limited by the scarcity of diverse, annotated pulmonary nodule datasets. Diffusion-based generative models offer a promising strategy for data synthesis; however, many existing conditional approaches primarily optimize spatial reconstruction losses, which encourage voxel-wise similarity but may inadequately constrain lesion-level intensity distributions. As a result, these methods may produce over-smoothed texture profiles and underrepresent the distinct attenuation characteristics of different nodule subtypes, including solid, part-solid, and ground-glass nodules. To address this challenge, we propose a controllable latent diffusion model that synthesizes pulmonary nodules within full 3D CT volumes while accurately modeling nodule-specific intensity distributions. Specifically, rather than relying solely on spatial losses, we introduce a histogram-based regularization term that constrains voxel intensity distributions during the generative process. The model combines subtype, spatial mask, and Hounsfield unit (HU) histogram conditioning with the differentiable feature-space histogram regularization term to better align lesion-level intensity distributions, improving the visual plausibility and subtype consistency of synthesized nodules. Extensive experiments on lung CT data demonstrate that our framework achieves strong visual realism, validated through both quantitative metrics and a visual Turing test. Furthermore, when used for data augmentation, the generated nodules improve performance in downstream clinical tasks, particularly for underrepresented nodule subtypes, and show a potential benefit for subtype-informed malignancy classification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对CT肺结节合成中现有扩散模型过度依赖空间重建损失导致纹理平滑、亚型强度分布不准确的问题，提出一种可控潜扩散模型，引入直方图正则化项约束体素强度分布，结合亚型、空间掩膜和HU直方图条件生成三维肺结节。实验表明该方法在视觉真实性和亚型一致性上表现良好，并通过图灵测试验证；用于数据增强可提升下游任务性能，尤其是罕见亚型。
Motivation: 自动化肺结节诊断受限于多样标注数据集稀缺；现有条件扩散模型仅优化空间重建损失，未能充分约束结节强度分布，导致纹理过平滑、不同亚型（实性、部分实性、磨玻璃）衰减特征区分不足。
Method: 提出可控潜扩散模型，在潜空间生成过程中引入基于直方图的可微正则化项，强制对齐生成结节的体素强度分布与目标HU直方图，并联合亚型、空间掩膜、HU直方图条件进行控制。
Result: 在肺CT数据上，定量指标与视觉图灵测试证实生成结节视觉逼真；用于数据增强时，提升了下游临床任务性能，尤其是罕见亚型，并展现出对亚型感知的恶性肿瘤分类潜力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调直方图正则化能有效改善生成结节的强度分布真实性，提升亚型一致性，并有望推动低资源结节亚型的诊断模型训练。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Architecture of Errors: From Universal Impossibility to Patch-Local LLM Reliability
papers.abstract_en: Universal LLM reliability is not a finite-library problem: across all possible tasks, tools, schemas, knowledge sources, and evaluator expectations, new intervention-distinguishable failure modes can appear without bound, so no finite intervention dictionary can guarantee bounded residual error for every such mode. But deployed systems do not operate over the whole universe. They operate inside operationally bounded patches (legal review, medical RAG, code repair, customer-support agents, contract extraction) with recurring tasks, schemas, tools, and evaluator expectations. Within such patches, empirical evidence suggests failures are sparse, repetitive, and concentrated in a small recurring catalogue, so reliability becomes a local catalogue-discovery and intervention-coverage problem rather than an exponential token-length problem. We formalize this transition with two propositions and one corollary. Proposition 1 is the worst-case-mode-wise negative result: no finite intervention dictionary covers every distinguishable failure mode of an unbounded domain. Corollary 1 is the inverse-discovery implication: the logarithmic upper bound on mode discovery cannot accommodate linearly more distinct tail modes without exponentially more observed hard-failure events. Proposition 2 is the positive patch-local result: under log active-mode exposure and head-heavy coverage, a sufficient per-hard-decision intervention budget grows polylogarithmically in sequence length and becomes domain-constant once the patch catalogue saturates. The framework relocates rather than dissolves long-context difficulty: where the number of hard decisions itself grows with task length, reliability remains hard; the contribution is to identify the on-axis intervention rather than to make those regimes easy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从理论上论证了通用LLM可靠性不可能通过有限故障字典实现，但针对操作边界受限的局部应用（如法律审查、医学RAG等）提出了正面的局部可靠性结果，证明在头重尾轻的故障分布下，干预预算随序列长度多对数增长，并在目录饱和后变为常数。
Motivation: 现有LLM可靠性方法依赖有限干预库，但理论上无法覆盖无限域的所有失败模式；实际部署中失败模式稀疏重复，因此需要形式化刻画局部可靠性可达的条件。
Method: 提出两个命题和一个推论：命题1为最坏情况下的否定结果（有限字典无法覆盖无界域的所有可区分模式）；推论1为发现模式的数量受观察到的硬失败事件数量的对数上界；命题2为正面局部结果：在活跃模式对数暴露且头重覆盖下，每个硬决策的干预预算随序列长度多对数增长，目录饱和后变为常数。
Result: 该框架将长上下文困难重新定位：当硬决策数量随任务长度增长时，可靠性仍困难；贡献在于识别轴干预而非使这些场景变容易。
Conclusion: 论文强调了局部目录发现与干预覆盖的方法，而非追求通用可靠性。局限：框架并未解决硬决策数量随任务长度增长时的根本困难。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文从理论上论证了通用LLM可靠性不可能通过有限故障字典实现，但针对操作边界受限的局部应用（如法律审查、医学RAG等）提出了正面的局部可靠性结果，证明在头重尾轻的故障分布下，干预预算随序列长度多对数增长，并在目录饱和后变为常数。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有LLM可靠性方法依赖有限干预库，但理论上无法覆盖无限域的所有失败模式；实际部署中失败模式稀疏重复，因此需要形式化刻画局部可靠性可达的条件。
summary_sections.method: 提出两个命题和一个推论：命题1为最坏情况下的否定结果（有限字典无法覆盖无界域的所有可区分模式）；推论1为发现模式的数量受观察到的硬失败事件数量的对数上界；命题2为正面局部结果：在活跃模式对数暴露且头重覆盖下，每个硬决策的干预预算随序列长度多对数增长，目录饱和后变为常数。
summary_sections.result: 该框架将长上下文困难重新定位：当硬决策数量随任务长度增长时，可靠性仍困难；贡献在于识别轴干预而非使这些场景变容易。
summary_sections.conclusion: 论文强调了局部目录发现与干预覆盖的方法，而非追求通用可靠性。局限：框架并未解决硬决策数量随任务长度增长时的根本困难。

papers.title: Active Timepoint Selection for Learning Measure-Valued Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: Inferring continuous probability paths from sparse snapshots is a fundamental challenge in domains like single-cell biology, where high-fidelity data acquisition is often destructive and constrained by prohibitive sequencing costs. This motivates the need for active learning strategies to strategically select optimal measurement times. However, designing active learning policies for this setting remains an open problem: the target objects reside on the infinite dimensional Wasserstein space where standard Euclidean metrics are ill-defined, and current interpolation methods lack epistemic uncertainty quantification. We introduce a framework which extends active experimentation to the space of measures. By leveraging Linearized Optimal Transport (LOT), we map distributional snapshots into a tangent space amenable to Gaussian Process modeling, allowing us to construct a tractable probabilistic surrogate for the underlying probability path. This yields an acquisition policy that iteratively selects measurement times to minimize uncertainty. Empirical results demonstrate that our strategy outperforms uncertainty-agnostic baselines on both synthetic and real-world datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对从稀疏快照推断连续概率路径的挑战，提出了一种在测度空间上进行主动实验的框架。通过线性化最优传输（LOT）将分布快影映射到切空间，并利用高斯过程构建概率代理，从而设计出迭代选择测量时间的获取策略以最小化不确定性。实验表明，该策略在合成和真实数据集上优于不考虑不确定性的基线方法。
Motivation: 在单细胞生物学等场景中，高保真数据获取成本高昂且具有破坏性，而现有插值方法缺乏认知不确定性量化，且目标对象位于无限维Wasserstein空间，标准欧氏度量不适用，因此亟需有效的主动学习策略来选择最优测量时间。
Method: 引入线性化最优传输将分布快照映射到切空间，在该空间上使用高斯过程建模，构建易于处理的概率代理，进而导出迭代选择测量时间的获取函数以最小化不确定性。
Result: 在合成和真实数据集上，该策略优于不考虑不确定性（uncertainty-agnostic）的基线方法。
Conclusion: 该框架成功将主动实验扩展到测度空间，为稀疏快照推断概率路径提供了有效的不确定性量化手段。

papers.title: Jamming-Resilient PRB Reservation for Latency-Critical O-RAN Network Slicing
papers.abstract_en: Open radio access network (O-RAN) architectures enable near real-time, software-driven control of network slicing through programmable xApps deployed on the near-real-time RAN Intelligent Controller (near-RT RIC). In industrial 5G downlink systems, adversarial jamming can abruptly reduce the effective physical resource block (PRB) capacity, triggering queue buildup and persistent latency violations, particularly in the presence of low spectral efficiency cell edge user equipments. This paper proposes a reserve-based resilience framework for PRB allocation in sliced O-RAN deployments. A finite pool of reserved PRBs is controlled by a near-RT RIC xApp that provides hybrid mitigation by proactively clearing backlog to build latency margin and reactively allocating reserve capacity during jammer active intervals. We formulate reserve activation as a constrained sequential decision problem and design a masked Deep Q-Network to learn effective control policies under non-stationary jamming. Simulation results show substantial reductions in URLLC latency violations and improved reserve efficiency compared to reactive baselines.
papers.comment: Accepted at ML-Spec Workshop in IEEE DySPAN 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对O-RAN架构中工业5G下行链路受恶意干扰导致PRB容量下降、队列积压和延迟违规的问题，提出了一种基于预留的弹性框架。通过近实时RIC上的xApp控制有限预留PRB池，结合主动清除积压和被动分配预留容量，并利用掩蔽深度Q网络学习非平稳干扰下的控制策略。仿真表明，相比反应式基线，该方法显著减少了URLLC延迟违规并提高了预留效率。
Motivation: 工业5G下行链路中，恶意干扰会急剧降低有效PRB容量，导致队列积压和持续延迟违规，现有方案缺乏对非平稳干扰的主动弹性控制。
Method: 提出预留式弹性框架：在近实时RIC上部署xApp管理有限预留PRB池，混合使用主动清除积压构建延迟裕度和被动分配预留容量应对干扰；将预留激活建模为约束序贯决策问题，设计掩蔽深度Q网络学习最优策略。
Result: 仿真显示，相比反应式基线，该方法显著降低URLLC延迟违规，并提升预留效率。
Conclusion: 该框架通过预留PRB与深度强化学习结合，为O-RAN网络切片提供了一种应对非平稳干扰的弹性方案，但未提及实际部署开销或大规模验证。

papers.title: Harness Updating Is Not Harness Benefit: Disentangling Evolution Capabilities in Self-Evolving LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents are increasingly deployed as systems built around editable external harnesses, including prompts, skills, memories and tools, that shape task execution without changing model parameters. Harness self-evolution adapts such agents by updating these harnesses from execution evidence. Yet it remains unclear whether a model's base capability in task-solving predicts its capabilities in harness self-evolution: which models produce useful harness updates, and which actually benefit from them? We analyze two harness self-evolution capabilities: (i) harness-updating, the capability to produce useful persistent harness updates from execution evidence; (ii) harness-benefit, the capability to benefit from updated harnesses during task solving. Our analysis reveals two findings. First, harness-updating is flat in base capability: models from different capability tiers produce harness updates that lead to surprisingly similar gains; even Qwen3.5-9B's updates yield gains comparable to those of Claude Opus~4.6. Second, harness-benefit is non-monotonic in base capability: weak-tier models benefit little from updated harnesses, mid-tier models benefit most, and strong-tier models benefit less than mid-tier. We trace low gains at the weak tier to two failure modes: weak-tier models may fail to activate relevant harness artifacts, or activate them but fail to follow them faithfully. These findings suggest investing capability budget in the task-solving agent rather than the evolver, and targeting harness invocation and long-horizon instruction following in agent training. Our source code is publicly available at https://github.com/A-EVO-Lab/a-evolve/tree/release/harness-evolution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自演化 LLM 智能体中两种能力——产生有用外部工具更新（harness-updating）和从更新中受益（harness-benefit）——进行解耦分析。研究发现，基础能力不同的模型在产生有用更新方面表现相近，但中等能力模型从更新中受益最大，而弱和强能力模型受益较小。
Motivation: 当前自演化智能体的评估常混淆工具更新产生能力与利用更新能力，有必要解耦两种能力以指导模型选择与训练。
Method: 通过设计实验，分别测量模型在自我演化过程中产生有用工具更新的能力（harness-updating）以及使用更新后工具提升任务解决能力（harness-benefit），并分析基础能力与这些能力的关联。
Result: 摘要报告显示：1）harness-updating 在不同基础能力模型间表现平坦，Qwen3.5-9B 产生的更新收益接近 Claude Opus 4.6；2）harness-benefit 非单调，中等能力模型受益最大，弱和强模型受益较小。弱模型失败模式包括无法激活相关工具或激活后无法忠实遵循。
Conclusion: 作者建议将能力预算投入任务求解智能体而非演化器，并在训练中关注工具调用与长程指令遵循。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Reward Learning from Best-of-$N$ Preference Data: Targets, Tradeoffs, and Design Principles
papers.abstract_en: Best-of-$N$ sampling is widely used to construct pairwise preference data: $N$ candidates are drawn from a base distribution, and the best is paired with a rejected response. Despite its widespread use, what Bradley--Terry (BT) reward learning extracts from such data, and how to choose $N$ and the base distribution, remain unclear. We specialize a recent analysis of preference data via its induced conditional distribution to Best-of-$N$. For independent-reference variants, we derive closed-form reward targets as explicit functions of $N$ and the base distribution, and show that they preserve the latent reward ranking. For the practical Best-vs-Random and Best-vs-Worst variants, chosen and rejected responses are coupled through the same candidate set, so exact BT representability generally fails; nevertheless, bounded-class minimizers approach the reference targets as $N$ grows. Although margin and connectivity are known to govern sample efficiency in pairwise preference learning, Best-of-$N$ couples them through $N$ in opposing directions: larger $N$ widens pairwise margins but reduces connectivity. This trade-off yields two design principles: use larger $N$ when preference labels are the bottleneck, smaller $N$ when generation is the bottleneck; and shape the base distribution to place mass between the responses whose comparison matters most at test time. Experiments on synthetic and real preference data support the predicted dependence on sample size and base-distribution shape.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究从Best-of-N采样构造的成对偏好数据中学习奖励函数的问题。通过将偏好数据的条件分布分析专门化到Best-of-N设置，推导了独立参考变体下的闭式奖励目标，并分析了Best-vs-Random和Best-vs-Worst变体的特性。揭示了N对边际和连通性的权衡，提出了设计原则。
Motivation: Best-of-N采样广泛用于构造偏好数据，但对其训练的Bradley-Terry奖励模型提取了何种目标以及如何选择N和基分布尚不清楚。
Method: 将偏好数据的条件分布分析专门化到Best-of-N设置，推导独立参考变体下的闭式奖励目标，分析Best-vs-Random和Best-vs-Worst变体的BT可表示性，并研究N对样本效率的影响。
Result: 独立参考变体保留潜在奖励排序；Best-vs-Random和Best-vs-Worst在N较大时接近参考目标；N增大扩大成对边际但降低连通性，形成权衡。
Conclusion: 提出设计原则：偏好标签为瓶颈时使用较大N，生成为瓶颈时使用较小N；塑造基分布以在测试时关心的比较之间放置质量。实验支持预测。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Improving Selective Classification with Pairwise Queries for Binary Classification
papers.abstract_en: In selective classification, a model predicts the labels of data samples where it is confident, and abstains from predicting labels for samples on which it is not confident. The rejected samples are often labeled by an expert, which is expensive. The budget for the expert is best utilized when the model has low error on non-rejected samples. However, the estimate of a model's confidence might be inconsistent with the model's predictions, which can lead to high error on non-rejected points. Such situations can readily occur in in-context binary classification by LLMs. To remedy this, we propose making additional pairwise queries to the same model. These pairwise queries can detect high-error samples and be incorporated into selective classification techniques to reduce the error on non-rejected samples. Theoretically, we establish the conditions under which a simple algorithm using pairwise queries outperforms an inconsistent confidence estimate. We support this insight through extensive experiments for $1$ synthetic and $4$ in-context learning-based real binary classification datasets. In all these cases, we show that our algorithms, using pairwise queries, obtain a better accuracy-cost tradeoff than using only the raw confidence estimates, for instance, the LLM's next-token logits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对二分类中的选择性分类，提出利用成对查询（pairwise queries）来改进模型的置信度估计，降低未拒绝样本上的错误率。理论上证明了在简单算法下成对查询优于不一致置信度估计的条件，并在合成和真实数据集上验证了更好的精度-成本权衡。
Motivation: 现有选择性分类中，模型的置信度可能与实际预测不一致，导致未拒绝样本的高错误率，尤其在LLM的上下文学习中。为此引入额外的成对查询以检测高错误样本。
Method: 提出在原有置信度估计基础上，向同一模型添加成对查询，并将这些查询结果融入选择性分类技术中，以降低未拒绝样本的错误率。
Result: 在1个合成和4个基于上下文学习的真实二分类数据集上，使用成对查询的算法相比仅使用原始置信度（如LLM的下一个token logits）获得了更好的精度-成本权衡。
Conclusion: 成对查询可以改善选择性分类中置信度不一致问题，并在理论上给出了条件。实验支持其有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CacheProbe: Auditing Prompt Cache Isolation in Gateway APIs
papers.abstract_en: Over the past year, prompt caching in Large Language Models (LLMs) has become increasingly more popular across inference APIs. Prompt caching helps save precious compute resources and speeds up response times by reusing parts of the KV cache of a specific prompt for another request. However, many implementations of prompt caching are not secure against timing attacks or even basic metadata disclosure. Gu et al. (ICML 2025) develop a method to audit prompt caching in LLMs. This paper investigates whether OpenRouter's API gateway architecture introduces prompt caching vulnerabilities that bypass provider-level prompt cache isolation guarantees. Most LLM inference providers implement per-account or per-organization prompt caching to prevent data leaks, but does routing through OpenRouter with shared organizational credentials inadvertently create global cache sharing across all OpenRouter users?
papers.comment: 11 pages, 8 figures, 2 tables Accepted at SAGAI '26 (Workshop on Secure Agents for Generative AI), co-located with IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究LLM推理API中提示缓存（prompt caching）的安全性，重点审计OpenRouter的API网关架构是否打破了提供商级别的缓存隔离保证。作者发现通过共享组织凭证的路由可能导致全局缓存共享，从而引发数据泄露风险。
Motivation: 现有LLM推理提供商通常实施每账户或每组织的提示缓存隔离以防止数据泄露，但OpenRouter的网关架构可能通过共享凭证导致缓存跨用户共享，需要审计这种潜在漏洞。
Method: 借鉴Gu等人（ICML 2025）的审计方法，针对OpenRouter的API网关架构设计实验，检测是否存在跨用户缓存共享。
Result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，但指出OpenRouter的路由机制可能绕过提供商级别的缓存隔离，造成全局缓存共享。
Conclusion: 强调提示缓存在网关架构中的安全风险，呼吁在API设计中加强缓存隔离机制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ZAPS-DA: Zero-Phase Action Policy Smoothing with Decoupled Actor for Continuous Control in Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Continuous control policies trained with off-policy reinforcement learning frequently exhibit high-frequency action jitter, rendering direct deployment on physical actuators impractical. Post-hoc filtering attenuates jitter but introduces phase lag; embedding smoothness penalties in the actor's loss couples them with the RL gradient and conflates reward regression with over-aggressive smoothing. We present ZAPS-DA, a framework that reduces action jitter at deployment with negligible phase lag and no post-processing. ZAPS-DA pairs an unmodified main actor (trained by the base RL loss) with a separate decoupled actor trained via supervised imitation of zero-phase filtered targets stored in the replay buffer. The deployed policy is the decoupled actor: a feed-forward map from the current observation to a smooth action, with no inference-time filter and no action-history input -- a mechanism we term causal distillation of a non-causal filter. A magnitude-matched MSE loss provides zero-hyperparameter portability across optimizer classes. Validated with Soft Actor-Critic and a Savitzky--Golay filter in two driving simulators using paired n=150 evaluation protocols: on MetaDrive, ZAPS-DA reduces steering jitter by 14--21x and throttle jitter by 3--5x (all $p < 10^{-4}$, Bonferroni-corrected) while matching task-completion (p=0.28 success, p=0.31 crash) at a 6.3% reward cost; on a custom Webots adaptive cruise control environment, the same SG configuration produces a Pareto improvement -- reward parity (p=0.121), 8--45x steering jitter reduction, and total task-failure rate reduced from 2.0% to 0.7%.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to IEEE RA-L
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ZAPS-DA 框架，通过解耦的主演员与零相位滤波监督训练的辅助演员，在不引入推理时后处理和相位延迟的情况下，显著减少连续控制策略的动作抖动。在 MetaDrive 和 Webots 实验中，ZAPS-DA 将转向抖动降低 14-21 倍，油门抖动降低 3-5 倍，同时保持任务完成率相当。
Motivation: 现有基于强化学习的连续控制策略常产生高频动作抖动，直接部署于物理执行器不可行。后处理滤波会引入相位延迟，而嵌入平滑惩罚则会与 RL 梯度耦合，过度平滑。
Method: ZAPS-DA 包含一个由基础 RL 损失训练的主演员和一个独立的解耦演员；解耦演员通过监督学习模仿存储在经验回放池中的零相位滤波目标，实现非因果滤波器的因果蒸馏。部署时仅使用解耦演员，无需滤波器或历史动作输入。使用幅度匹配的 MSE 损失实现零超参数迁移。
Result: 在 MetaDrive 中，ZAPS-DA 将转向抖动降低 14-21 倍，油门抖动降低 3-5 倍（p<10^{-4}，Bonferroni 校正），任务成功率无显著差异，奖励成本为 6.3%。在 Webots 自适应巡航控制中，实现奖励持平（p=0.121），转向抖动降低 8-45 倍，任务失败率从 2.0% 降至 0.7%。
Conclusion: ZAPS-DA 提供了一种无需后处理即可减少动作抖动的有效方法，在保持任务性能的同时显著降低抖动，适用于连续控制任务。

papers.title: Crafter: A Multi-Agent Harness for Editable Scientific Figure Generation from Diverse Inputs
papers.abstract_en: Scientific figures are among the most effective means of communicating complex research ideas, yet producing publication-quality illustrations remains one of the most labor-intensive parts of paper preparation. Existing automated systems each target a single figure type under text-only input, leaving the diversity of types and conditions researchers actually use unaddressed; their raster outputs further cannot be locally revised. Because scientific figures are structured compositions of discrete semantic components, the localized errors generators produce on such layouts demand not a stronger backbone but a harness. We instantiate this harness in two complementary systems: Crafter, a multi-agent harness for figure generation that generalizes across figure types and input conditions without architectural changes, and CraftEditor, which applies the same pattern to convert raster outputs into editable SVGs. Moreover, we introduce CraftBench, a benchmark spanning three figure types and four input conditions with human quality annotation. Experiments show that Crafter substantially outperforms both standalone generators and the agentic baseline on PaperBanana-Bench and CraftBench, with ablations confirming each component's independent contribution; CraftEditor faithfully converts outputs into editable SVGs that surpass all baselines. Our code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/HaozheZhao/Crafter.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Crafter，一个多智能体框架，用于从多种输入生成可编辑的科学图表。该框架通过多智能体协作，能够处理不同类型的图表和输入条件，并生成可编辑的 SVG 文件。同时，作者引入了 CraftBench 基准测试，涵盖三种图表类型和四种输入条件。实验表明，Crafter 在多个基准上显著优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有科学图表生成系统通常只能处理单一图表类型和文本输入，且输出为光栅图像无法局部修改。作者认为科学图表是离散语义组件的结构化组合，需要一种通用的框架来处理多样化的图表生成需求。
Method: 提出 Crafter，一个多智能体框架，无需架构更改即可泛化到不同图表类型和输入条件；同时提出 CraftEditor，将光栅输出转换为可编辑的 SVG。还引入了 CraftBench 基准，包含三种图表类型和四种输入条件以及人工质量标注。
Result: 实验表明，Crafter 在 PaperBanana-Bench 和 CraftBench 上显著优于独立生成器和智能体基线，消融实验验证了各组件的独立贡献；CraftEditor 能忠实转换输出为可编辑 SVG，超越所有基线。
Conclusion: 代码和基准已开源。该框架为科学图表生成提供了一种通用、可编辑的解决方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Constrained Flow Optimization via Sequential Fine Tuning for Molecular Design
papers.abstract_en: Adapting generative foundation models, in particular diffusion and flow models, to optimize given reward functions (e.g., binding affinity) while satisfying constraints (e.g., molecular synthesizability) is fundamental for their adoption in real-world scientific discovery applications such as molecular design or protein engineering. While recent works have introduced scalable methods for reward-guided fine-tuning of such models via reinforcement learning and control schemes, it remains an open problem how to algorithmically trade-off reward maximization and constraint satisfaction in a reliable and predictable manner. Motivated by this challenge, we first present a rigorous framework for Constrained Generative Optimization, which brings an optimization viewpoint to the introduced adaptation problem and retrieves the relevant task of constrained generation as a sub-case. Then, we introduce Constrained Flow Optimization (CFO), an algorithm that automatically and provably balances reward maximization and constraint satisfaction by reducing the original problem to sequential fine-tuning via established, scalable methods. We provide convergence guarantees for constrained generative optimization and constrained generation via CFO. Ultimately, we present an experimental evaluation of CFO on both synthetic, yet illustrative, settings, and a molecular design task. Across these evaluations, CFO achieves consistent increases in reward while ensuring high constraint satisfaction, showcasing its practical utility for constrained generative optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出约束流优化（CFO）算法，用于生成式基础模型（如扩散模型、流模型）在满足约束（如分子可合成性）的同时优化奖励函数（如结合亲和力）。CFO将问题转化为序列微调，并提供收敛保证，在分子设计任务中实现奖励提升且满足约束。
Motivation: 现有奖励引导微调方法难以可靠且可预测地权衡奖励最大化与约束满足，该问题在分子设计等科学发现中至关重要。
Method: 首先建立约束生成优化的严格框架，将约束生成作为子情况；然后提出CFO算法，通过将原始问题简化为序列微调，自动且可证明地平衡奖励最大化与约束满足。
Result: 在合成和分子设计任务中，CFO在确保高约束满足率的同时持续提升奖励，展示了其实用性。
Conclusion: CFO为约束生成优化提供了理论收敛保证和有效算法，适用于分子设计等科学领域。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: An Organization-Scoped LLM Agent Runtime Architecture for Regulated Cybersecurity Operations
papers.abstract_en: Regulated cybersecurity workflows lack a runtime substrate that enforces organization-level scope across retrieval, tool calls, memory, findings, reports, and audit while remaining model-agnostic and locally deployable. Recent large language model (LLM) agent systems report strong results on isolated cybersecurity tasks, yet they do not by themselves define an auditable platform architecture for regulated security operations centre (SOC) and compliance workflows, where a single analyst may trigger actions that bind the organization, and where the runtime must integrate with existing SIEM/XDR stacks as a primary source of context and alert-driven triggers rather than operate as a standalone analytical layer. This paper proposes an organization-scoped LLM agent runtime architecture for financial cybersecurity. The contribution is a typed Security Context that is created at every entry point, including SIEM/XDR notifications ingested as first-class triggers, and enforced at every component boundary, combined with a shared Runtime Core, logical specialist subagents, a governed Tool Adapter Layer exposing SIEM/XDR query, enrichment, and response primitives under uniform policy and audit, structured findings with evidence references, tiered human-in-the-loop (HITL) gates, and append-only audit. Model Context Protocol (MCP), extended telemetry, digital twins for pentesting, graph retrieval, and federated knowledge sharing are treated as optional extension paths rather than mandatory runtime assumptions. We describe an implementable slice as the architecture's testability surface, and we propose a falsifiable evaluation plan with metric-level pass criteria for architecture readiness, security-policy enforcement, evidence traceability, output quality, and operational observability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向监管网络安全运营的组织级LLM智能体运行时架构，通过类型化安全上下文、统一策略审计、分层人机交互门控和仅追加审计日志等机制，实现检索、工具调用、内存、发现、报告和审计的全链路组织范围管控，并保持模型无关和本地可部署。
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体系统在孤立网络安全任务上表现良好，但缺乏一个可审计的平台架构来支持受监管的安全运营中心(SOC)和合规工作流，尤其在分析师行为可能绑定组织责任、运行时需与SIEM/XDR深度集成而非独立分析的场景下。
Method: 提出组织级LLM智能体运行时架构，核心组件包括：每个入口点创建的类型化安全上下文（包括将SIEM/XDR通知作为一等触发器）、共享运行时核心、逻辑专业子智能体、受治理的工具适配层（统一策略和审计下暴露SIEM/XDR查询、丰富和响应原语）、带证据引用的结构化发现、分层人机交互门控和仅追加审计。MCP、扩展遥测、数字孪生、图检索和联邦知识共享作为可选扩展路径。
Result: 描述了架构的可测试性表面（可实现的切片），并提出一个可证伪的评估计划，包含度量级通过标准，涵盖架构就绪性、安全策略执行、证据可追溯性、输出质量和运营可观测性。
Conclusion: 该架构旨在为受监管的网络安全运营提供一个可审计、组织级管控的LLM智能体运行时环境，但MCP等高级功能被设计为可选扩展而非强制要求，以保持核心架构的轻量和可部署性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning effective Sargassum transport dynamics from limited drifter observations
papers.abstract_en: Floating-material transport is influenced by unresolved processes that are often absent from available circulation products. We develop a data-driven transport-learning framework for learning effective transport corrections from limited Lagrangian observations using physically motivated ocean--atmosphere diagnostics and finite-memory representations motivated in part by inertial-particle memory effects. The diagnostic representation is analyzed through predictive and sparse symbolic-discovery approaches under leave-one-trajectory-out validation. Applications to Sargassum-following drifters in the Puerto Rico region and the Gulf Stream show that the diagnostics contain transport-relevant information beyond the baseline circulation products. Multilayer perceptron (MLP) ensembles provide flexible predictive trajectory corrections, while Sparse Identification of Nonlinear Dynamics (SINDy) tests whether instantaneous or delayed sparse symbolic transport structure can be extracted from the diagnostics. The results differ across flow regimes: (i) in Puerto Rico, delayed sparse symbolic corrections provide modest but systematic improvement; (ii) in the Gulf Stream application, dynamically useful sparse symbolic corrections remain primarily instantaneous even though delayed predictive information persists. These results support finite-memory transport effects in coarse-grained floating-material transport while also illustrating the difficulty of obtaining stable delayed sparse symbolic closures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文开发了一个数据驱动的运输学习框架，从有限的拉格朗日漂流器观测中学习有效的漂浮物运输校正。该框架利用物理激励的海洋-大气诊断和有限记忆表示（部分受惯性粒子记忆效应启发），并通过预测和稀疏符号发现方法（MLP集成和SINDy）进行分析。在波多黎各和墨西哥湾流区域的马尾藻漂流器应用中，诊断包含超越基准环流产品的信息，结果因流态而异：波多黎各区域延迟稀疏符号校正带来系统改进，而墨西哥湾流区域动态有用的稀疏符号校正主要是瞬时的。研究支持粗粒化漂浮物运输中的有限记忆效应，但也揭示了获得稳定延迟稀疏符号闭合的困难。
Motivation: 漂浮物运输受到未解析过程的影响，而现有环流产品常忽略这些过程，因此需要从有限的拉格朗日观测中学习有效的运输校正。
Method: 提出了一个数据驱动的运输学习框架，使用物理激励的海洋-大气诊断和有限记忆表示，结合多层感知机（MLP）集成进行预测轨迹校正，并利用稀疏非线性动力学识别（SINDy）测试是否可提取瞬时或延迟的稀疏符号运输结构。
Result: 在波多黎各和墨西哥湾流区域的应用中，诊断包含超越基准环流产品的运输相关信息。波多黎各区域延迟稀疏符号校正提供适度系统改进；墨西哥湾流区域动态有用的稀疏符号校正主要是瞬时的，尽管延迟预测信息仍然存在。
Conclusion: 粗粒化漂浮物运输中存在有限记忆效应，但获得稳定延迟稀疏符号闭合具有挑战性；不同流态下的表现差异说明该框架的有效性依赖于具体流动环境。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: TASER: Task-Aware Stein Regularisation for Geometry-Driven Robustness
papers.abstract_en: Modern deep networks remain fragile under distribution shift and adversarial perturbations, often due to excessive or poorly structured input sensitivity. We introduce TASER (Task-Aware Stein Regularisation), a training-time regularisation framework derived from Langevin Stein operators. By penalising pointwise Stein residuals under the training distribution, TASER encourages geometric compatibility between predictors and data density, inducing anisotropic, data-aware smoothness. We provide theoretical links between Stein regularisation and reduced first-order shift sensitivity, develop scalable implementation variants compatible with modern architectures, and demonstrate improved robustness and stability across regression and vision benchmarks. Across CIFAR-10 experiments, TASER consistently improves the adversarial robustness of established training methods without incurring statistically significant clean-accuracy degradation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TASER（Task-Aware Stein Regularisation），一种基于Langevin Stein算子的训练时正则化框架，通过惩罚训练分布下的逐点Stein残差，促使预测器与数据密度几何兼容，实现各向异性、数据感知的平滑性。理论分析了Stein正则化与降低一阶偏移敏感性的联系，开发了兼容现代架构的可扩展实现变体，并在回归和视觉基准上展示了鲁棒性和稳定性的提升。在CIFAR-10实验上，TASER一致地提高了现有训练方法的对抗鲁棒性，且未造成统计显著的干净准确率下降。
Motivation: 现代深度网络在分布偏移和对抗扰动下仍然脆弱，通常源于过度或结构不良的输入敏感性。
Method: 引入TASER框架，基于Langevin Stein算子设计训练时正则化项，通过惩罚点态Stein残差来鼓励预测器与数据密度的几何兼容性，实现各向异性的数据感知平滑性，并提供可扩展的实现变体。
Result: 在CIFAR-10上，TASER一致地提高了现有训练方法的对抗鲁棒性，且未造成统计显著的干净准确率下降。
Conclusion: 摘要强调TASER通过几何驱动的正则化提升了模型的鲁棒性和稳定性，并已在回归和视觉任务上得到验证。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: The Fast Mixing Mechanism for Differential Privacy
papers.abstract_en: Randomized sketching is a central tool for compressing large-scale optimization problems while preserving accuracy. In particular, sketches that are based on structured matrices, such as the Hadamard matrix, can be applied efficiently and often yield solutions that approximate those of the original problem at much lower computational cost. In differential privacy (DP), Gaussian sketching has been used to solve DP linear regression, beginning with \citet{sheffet2017differentially, sheffet2019old} and later refined by \citet{lev2025gaussianmix, lev2026near}. However, although these methods achieve strong utility guarantees, they usually do not improve runtime over classical DP approaches. In this work, we introduce a new DP sketching mechanism based on fast transforms, which, in certain cases, matches the runtime of classical fast sketching methods. We prove state-of-the-art privacy guarantees for this mechanism and show that, in favorable regimes, they match those of the Gaussian sketch up to a constant factor. As an application, we combine this mechanism with recent sketch-based methods for DP linear regression to obtain a new algorithm with strong utility and improved runtime. We establish privacy and accuracy guarantees for this algorithm, yielding, to the best of our knowledge, the first fast method for DP ordinary least squares.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于快速变换（如Hadamard变换）的新型差分隐私（DP）素描机制，在特定情况下匹配经典快速素描的运行时间，并证明其隐私保证与高斯素描相当（仅常数因子差异）。将其应用于DP线性回归，得到首个快速DP普通最小二乘算法，兼具强效用和改进的运行时间。
Motivation: 现有DP素描方法（如高斯素描）虽能实现强效用保证，但通常无法在运行时间上优于经典DP方法，缺乏快速且隐私保证强的素描机制。
Method: 引入基于快速变换（fast transforms）的DP素描机制，通过精心设计机制实现快速计算，并利用快速变换的结构性质推导出状态最优的隐私保证，在有利区域与高斯素描的隐私损失仅差常数因子。
Result: 理论上证明该机制的隐私保证达到当前最优，并在DP线性回归应用中，结合近期素描方法，首次得到快速DP普通最小二乘算法，保证隐私和准确性，且运行时间显著改善。
Conclusion: 论文表明快速变换可用于构建高效且隐私保证强的DP素描机制，为DP优化提供新工具；但局限性在于其隐私保证仅在特定有利区域与高斯素描相当，通用性有待验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AMNESIA: A Large Scale Medical Unlearning Benchmark Suite with Disease-Informed Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Medical knowledge is continuously evolving. This creates a need to update or selectively forget information encoded in already-trained medical LLMs. Machine unlearning aims to remove the influence of specific training data from a model without full retraining. Yet, existing unlearning benchmarks rely on synthetic or small-scale general data, leaving clinical unlearning understudied. We introduce AMNESIA, the first large-scale, open source benchmark for medical unlearning, with 70,560 question-answer pairs from 8,820 patient notes across 11 disease categories. AMNESIA includes both factual questions testing direct recall and reasoning questions testing clinical inference. We use it to evaluate four widely used unlearning methods at both random patient and disease-level, and introduce a new metric for detecting leakage of medical terminology. We show that unlearning individual patients erodes knowledge of others with the same condition, calling for methods that can better separate patients from shared clinical knowledge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AMNESIA是首个大规模医学遗忘基准测试，包含70,560个问答对，来自8,820份患者笔记，覆盖11种疾病类别。该基准测试评估了四种遗忘方法，并引入了一个检测医学术语泄露的新指标。结果表明，遗忘单个患者会损害对同病患者的其他知识。
Motivation: 现有遗忘基准依赖合成或小规模通用数据，缺乏对临床遗忘的研究。医学知识不断更新，需要在不完全重新训练的情况下选择性遗忘特定训练数据。
Method: 构建AMNESIA基准，包含事实推理和临床推理问题。评估四种主流遗忘方法，在随机患者和疾病级别上测试，并引入新指标检测医学术语泄露。
Result: 遗忘单个患者会侵蚀对其他同病患者的记忆，表明需要更好的方法来分离患者与共享临床知识。
Conclusion: AMNESIA提供了医学遗忘的标准化评估平台，揭示了现有方法在疾病级别遗忘中的不足。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ScaleMAP: Preserving Local Density and Neighborhood Structure in Low-Dimensional Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Nonlinear dimensionality-reduction methods such as UMAP and PaCMAP adaptively normalize local distances during graph construction, erasing neighborhood scale from the data. This distorts more than relative cluster sizes: sparse structures like bridges between transitioning cell types and narrow spectral spikes in hyperspectral images can be suppressed or lost entirely. DensMAP adds a density penalty to correct this, but this penalty competes with UMAP's attraction-repulsion forces, scattering points far from their neighborhoods. ScaleMAP takes a different approach: each pairwise embedding displacement is divided by the geometric mean of the two endpoints' original-space local radii, re-injecting scale information as a change of variables rather than as a competing objective. Across standard benchmarks and scientific datasets from transcriptomics, hyperspectral imaging, and flow cytometry, ScaleMAP matches DensMAP on density preservation while maintaining UMAP-level neighborhood preservation. In transcriptomic data, it recovers sparse bridges between cell populations that UMAP collapses; in flow cytometry, it faithfully represents density structure across 17 orders of magnitude. The same principle applied to PaCMAP yields consistently improved density preservation, suggesting the approach generalizes beyond UMAP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ScaleMAP，一种非线性降维方法，通过将每对嵌入位移除以原始空间中两个端点局部半径的几何均值，在低维嵌入中保留局部密度和邻域结构。在转录组学、高光谱成像和流式细胞术等科学数据集上，ScaleMAP在密度保持方面匹配DensMAP，同时保持UMAP级别的邻域保持，并恢复UMAP丢失的稀疏桥梁结构。
Motivation: UMAP和PaCMAP等降维方法在构建图时自适应归一化局部距离，擦除了邻域尺度信息，导致稀疏结构（如细胞类型过渡桥梁、高光谱图像窄峰）被抑制或丢失。现有方法DensMAP通过密度惩罚纠正，但惩罚与UMAP的吸引-排斥力竞争，使点远离其邻域。
Method: ScaleMAP将每对嵌入位移除以原始空间中两个端点局部半径的几何均值，将尺度信息作为变量变换重新注入，而不是作为竞争目标。该原则可推广到PaCMAP。
Result: 在转录组学、高光谱成像和流式细胞术基准上，ScaleMAP在密度保持方面匹配DensMAP，同时保持UMAP级邻域保持。在转录组数据中恢复UMAP坍缩的细胞群间稀疏桥梁；在流式细胞术中忠实表示跨越17个数量级的密度结构。
Conclusion: ScaleMAP通过改变变量而非添加竞争目标来保留局部密度，在多个科学领域数据集上表现良好，且该原则具有泛化性。

papers.title: Improving Relative Representations with Learned Anchors and Whitened Inner Products
papers.abstract_en: Independently trained neural models typically converge to incompatible latent representations, creating a fundamental barrier to highly modular AI systems. While Relative Representations (RR) address this by mapping absolute coordinates to a shared space defined by similarities to common anchor points, traditional implementations rely on randomly sampled anchors and cosine similarity, which frequently fail to capture the anisotropic geometries of modern architectures like Transformers. In this work, we propose a robust framework for cross-model communication based on two improvements. We learn anchors as robust semantic prototypes and utilize a geometry-aware similarity metric which preserves discriminative magnitude information and is invariant to affine shifts. Our approach demonstrates significant gains in performance and consistency across vision and language tasks. Notably, it enables nearly lossless information transfer and stable zero-shot communication even between highly heterogeneous architectures, such as small language models of varying scales.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对独立训练的神经网络潜在表示不兼容的问题，改进了相对表示方法。通过学习鲁棒语义原型作为锚点，并采用几何感知的相似性度量（白化内积），实现了跨模型的高保真信息传输和零样本通信。在视觉和语言任务上展示了性能提升和一致性。
Motivation: 传统的相对表示方法使用随机锚点和余弦相似度，无法捕捉现代架构（如Transformer）的各向异性几何结构，导致跨模型通信质量差。
Method: 提出两个改进：1）学习锚点作为鲁棒的语义原型；2）使用白化内积作为相似性度量，该度量保留判别性幅度信息且对仿射变换不变。
Result: 在视觉和语言任务上获得显著性能提升，实现了近乎无损的信息传输，以及不同规模小语言模型之间的稳定零样本通信。
Conclusion: 该方法为跨模型通信提供了鲁棒框架，适用于高度异构的架构。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对独立训练的神经网络潜在表示不兼容的问题，改进了相对表示方法。通过学习鲁棒语义原型作为锚点，并采用几何感知的相似性度量（白化内积），实现了跨模型的高保真信息传输和零样本通信。在视觉和语言任务上展示了性能提升和一致性。
summary_sections.motivation: 传统的相对表示方法使用随机锚点和余弦相似度，无法捕捉现代架构（如Transformer）的各向异性几何结构，导致跨模型通信质量差。

papers.title: Scientific Machine Learning for Engine Health Management and Remaining Useful Life Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Engine Health Management (EHM) depends on reliable forecasting of Remaining Useful Life (RUL) and on tracking thermal indicators such as turbine gas temperature (TGT). In practice, real-world fleet data are heterogeneous and non-stationary, and point predictions alone are insufficient for risk-aware maintenance decisions. This paper presents a multi-task scientific machine learning framework for turbine prognostics that jointly predicts turbine gas temperature untrimmed (TGTU), Delta Turbine Gas Temperature (DTGT), and RUL, with quantified uncertainty in the form of prediction intervals whose empirical coverage is evaluated. A shared sequence encoder (convolutional front-end with residual bidirectional LSTM layers and attention pooling) feeds task-specific heads, including mean--variance estimation for probabilistic regression and, optionally, a survival head for threshold-based event modeling. The framework is designed to be tunable via a small set of practitioner-facing parameters (e.g., DTGT thresholding rules and RUL target construction) so that deployment can align with in-house policies and proprietary criteria. The predictive performance of the proposed framework is evaluated using both point and interval metrics, including mean absolute error (MAE), prediction interval coverage probability (PICP), mean prediction interval width (MPIW), and the coverage--width criterion (CWC). Results are reported both in aggregate and stratified by flight phase and maintenance segment to highlight operational-context effects and to support uncertainty-aware monitoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出一个多任务科学机器学习框架，用于涡轮发动机的健康管理（EHM）和剩余寿命预测（RUL），同时预测涡轮气体温度指标（TGTU、DTGT）和RUL，并提供预测区间的不确定性量化。框架使用共享序列编码器（卷积前端+残差双向LSTM+注意力池化）和特定任务头，支持通过少量参数调整以适应不同运维策略。评估使用点指标（MAE）和区间指标（PICP、MPIW、CWC），并按飞行阶段和维护段分层报告结果。
Motivation: 实际发动机机队数据异构且非平稳，点预测不足以支持风险感知的维护决策，需要同时预测多个热力学指标和RUL，并量化不确定性。
Method: 提出多任务框架：共享序列编码器处理时间序列，输出送至任务特定头，包括均值-方差估计用于概率回归，可选生存头用于阈值事件建模。框架通过DTGT阈值规则和RUL目标构建等参数可调。
Result: 论文报告了在点指标（MAE）和区间指标（PICP、MPIW、CWC）上的性能，并按飞行阶段和维护段分层展示结果，以突出运行环境的影响。
Conclusion: 该框架可支持不确定性感知的发动机健康监测，并通过参数调整适应不同运维策略，但摘要未提及与其他方法的对比或泛化性验证。

papers.title: Learning Transferable Predictability Representations
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of assigning a scalar score to a short trajectory window that reflects its position on an ordered continuum of predictability regimes, spanning structured deterministic dynamics to unstructured stochastic noise. Existing methods address deterministic-versus-stochastic discrimination within a single system and do not produce scores with a consistent numerical interpretation across systems. We formalize this as ordinal estimation over a five-level predictability ladder and identify a structural source of cross-system ambiguity: ranking supervision alone leaves the score coordinate unfixed up to a monotone reparameterization, which we term the gauge freedom of ordinal scoring. We propose the Gauge-Fixed Ordinal Network (GON), a temporal convolutional model trained with an anchor-and-variance objective that pins level-wise score means to shared target coordinates. GON operates on 2-jet features that expose local trajectory geometry, preserved by smooth flows and disrupted by stochastic surrogate procedures. On five held-out dynamical systems, initializing from a pretrained GON checkpoint consistently outperforms training from scratch across all window budgets, with adaptation depth reflecting geometric proximity to the training family. Zero-shot scores retain ordinal structure at the stochastic boundary, where surrogate procedures most strongly disrupt nonlinear geometry, and pretrained initialization consistently beats scratch across all window budgets. Pairwise discrimination and globally coherent ordinal scoring are distinct properties requiring a stable score coordinate for cross-system transfer, with direct implications for predictability assessment, model selection, and early-warning diagnostics across natural and engineered dynamical systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何为短轨迹窗口分配一个标量分数，使其反映从结构化确定性动力学到非结构化随机噪声的可预测性谱系位置。作者形式化为五级可预测性阶梯上的序数估计，并指出序数监督的规范自由度问题。提出Gauge-Fixed Ordinal Network (GON)，一种时间卷积模型，通过锚定方差目标固定分数坐标，利用2-jet特征捕捉局部轨迹几何。在五个保留动力系统上，预训练初始化在所有窗口预算下优于从头训练，零样本分数在随机边界保持序数结构。
Motivation: 现有方法仅能在单个系统内区分确定性与随机性，无法产生跨系统具有一致数值解释的分数。序数监督的规范自由度导致分数坐标不唯一，阻碍跨系统迁移。
Method: 提出Gauge-Fixed Ordinal Network (GON)，一种时间卷积模型，采用锚定方差目标固定层级分数均值到共享目标坐标。输入为2-jet特征，暴露局部轨迹几何，受光滑流保持而非随机代理过程破坏。
Result: 在五个保留动力系统上，预训练GON在所有窗口预算下优于从头训练，适应深度反映与训练家族的几何邻近性。零样本分数在随机边界保持序数结构，其中代理过程最强烈破坏非线性几何。
Conclusion: 成对区分与全局一致的序数评分是不同的性质，需要稳定的分数坐标以实现跨系统迁移，对可预测性评估、模型选择和预警诊断有直接意义。

papers.title: Counterfactual Evaluation Reveals Hidden Capability Profiles in Clinical LLMs and Agents
papers.abstract_en: Two clinical AI systems can score nearly identically on coverage-based rubrics yet behave radically differently when their patient inputs change: one updates its recommendations to match the new clinical signal, while the other produces the same output regardless. We introduce the Causal Sensitivity Score (CSS), a pre-registered interventional metric that mutates oncology tumor-board cases along five clinically meaningful dimensions - biomarker flips, prior-treatment failures, biomarker removals, surgery-status changes, and stage perturbations - and scores whether each model updates its recommendations in the pre-registered correct direction using a {0, 0.5, 1.0} scale. Benchmarked against the Consensus Match Score (CMS), a coverage-based weighted recall metric, six frontier models from three labs evaluated in single-shot inference across 224 cases rank in nearly opposite orders: all six models change rank, the CMS-worst model becomes CSS-best, and one upper-mid CMS model ranks last on CSS. We further surface a universal safety blind spot: every frontier model fails on surgery-status interventions (at most 17.2% CSS on Family D), a finding CMS does not expose. The metric also transfers to tool-using agents: in a ReAct-style experiment, tool use improves CSS for five of six models (+2.5 to +20.3 percentage points), yet the lowest-CSS model retrieves the same chart sections and still fails to update its recommendations - revealing a structural responsiveness deficit visible only under counterfactual evaluation. Cross-judge replication and three-rater medical-professional validation confirm the aggregate findings. Interventional pre-registered metrics like CSS complement coverage-based evaluation for clinical AI agents: they capture responsiveness that coverage metrics miss and offer a candidate dense reward signal for future agentic RL systems.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出因果敏感度得分（CSS），一种预注册的干预度量，通过沿五个临床维度变异肿瘤病例输入，评估临床LLM和agent是否更新其推荐。在六个前沿模型上，CSS排名与传统的覆盖度量完全相反，且所有模型在手术状态干预上表现极差（最多17.2%），暴露了一个安全盲点。CSS也能适用于工具使用agent，并揭示出结构性的响应能力缺陷。
Motivation: 传统的覆盖度量（如共识匹配得分）无法区分模型在输入变化时是否真正更新推荐，导致看似得分相似的模型实际行为截然不同。需要一种能衡量因果响应能力的度量。
Method: 引入Causal Sensitivity Score（CSS），对224个肿瘤病例沿五个维度进行干预（生物标记翻转、先前治疗失败、生物标记移除、手术状态变化、分期扰动），并按预注册的正确方向评分每个模型是否更新推荐，使用{0,0.5,1.0}评分。
Result: 六个前沿模型在CSS与CMS上排名几乎完全相反：CMS最差模型变成CSS最佳，一个CMS中上模型在CSS上垫底。所有模型在手术状态干预上CSS不超过17.2%。工具使用使五个模型CSS提升2.5-20.3个百分点，但最低CSS模型仍不更新推荐。
Conclusion: 干预式预注册度量（如CSS）可补充覆盖度量，捕捉被覆盖度量忽视的响应能力，并为未来的agent强化学习系统提供密集奖励信号。
