papers.title: ImmigrationQA: A Source-Grounded Dataset and Small-Model Adaptation for U.S. Immigration Law
papers.abstract_en: U.S. immigration law spans thousands of pages of official policy, federal regulations, and procedural guidance that change frequently and carry high stakes for petitioners who lack legal representation. We describe the construction of ImmigrationQA, a source-grounded question-answering dataset of 17,058 pairs across 13 immigration subdomains, and the fine-tuning of a Llama 3.2 3B Instruct model on that dataset using parameter-efficient LoRA. The corpus was assembled from 11 primary and secondary sources -- including the USCIS Policy Manual, 8 CFR, BIA precedent decisions, and community Q&A -- yielding 10,056 validated canonical documents and 18,308 text chunks. Structured QA pairs were generated from these chunks using Claude Sonnet 4.6 via five mode-specific prompts, with 22 pairs rejected for insufficient source-span overlap. The fine-tuned model was evaluated against a held-out split of 993 pairs using LLM-as-judge scoring on a 101-example stratified sample. The fine-tuned model scored a mean of 1.08/3.0 (16.8% fully correct; 101-example stratified eval) versus the Llama 3 8B base model at 0.85/3.0 (4% fully correct), a relative improvement of 27% in mean score; a zero-shot Claude Sonnet baseline scored 1.52/3.0 (25% fully correct). The fine-tuned model shows concentrated improvement in procedural subdomains (travel documents, adjustment of status, nonimmigrant visas) while remaining weak on complex legal reasoning and time-sensitive statistics. The full pipeline ran for approximately $29 in cloud compute. All artifacts -- dataset, model, code, and prompt templates -- are publicly released. The system is not a substitute for legal counsel and does not reflect regulatory changes after the corpus crawl date.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 4 tables. Dataset (17,058 QA pairs), fine-tuned model, and code are publicly released

papers.title: ReGuLaR: Relation-Grounded Latent Reasoning for Large Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning has significantly improved the reasoning ability of large vision-language models (LVLMs) by verbalizing intermediate reasoning steps in natural language. However, such discrete textual rationales are often insufficient for encoding continuous visual evidence. Recent work addresses this limitation by moving reasoning into continuous latent space. Despite promising progress, existing methods leave latent reasoning insufficiently connected to the compositional and relational structure of visual evidence. To address this gap, we introduce ReGuLaR, a relation grounded latent reasoning framework that explicitly grounds latent states in these critical yet overlooked visual evidence. ReGuLaR uses a training-time ReGFormer to focus latent reasoning on question-relevant objects and inter-object relations, while at inference time the model reasons and generates answers without invoking the ReGFormer. To support training ReGuLaR, we construct RGROUNDING-351K, a real-world vision-language dataset annotated with key object bounding boxes and inter-object relations. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks show that ReGuLaR consistently outperforms existing approaches and achieves state-of-the-art performance. We include our code in the submission and will release the code and training data publicly upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReGuLaR，一种关系接地潜在推理框架，用于大型视觉-语言模型（LVLM）。通过在训练时使用 ReGFormer 将潜在状态显式地与问题相关的物体及其间关系对齐，推理时则不依赖该模块，从而弥补现有潜在推理方法未能充分连接视觉证据的构成和关系结构的不足。同时构建了带有物体框和关系标注的真实世界视觉语言数据集 RGROUNDING-351K。实验表明该方法在多个基准上达到新的最优性能。
Motivation: 现有链式思维（CoT）推理以离散文本表达中间步骤，难以编码连续视觉证据；而近期的潜在推理方法缺乏与视觉证据的构成和关系结构的充分连接。
Method: 提出关系接地潜在推理框架 ReGuLaR，训练时引入 ReGFormer 迫使潜在状态关注问题相关物体及其相互间关系，推理时移除 ReGFormer 直接生成答案；同时构建包含物体框和关系标注的数据集 RGROUNDING-351K 以支持训练。
Result: 在多个权威基准上，ReGuLaR 一致超越现有方法，取得最佳性能。
Conclusion: 关系接地潜在推理能有效弥补视觉证据的结构性连接不足，显著提升 LVLM 的推理能力。

papers.title: Benchmarking Machine Learning Uncertainty Quantification Methodologies for Predicting Turbine Gas Temperature Degradation
papers.abstract_en: Effective prognostics and health management of modern engines relies on accurate turbine gas temperature predictions and robust uncertainty quantification to ensure reliability and safety. This paper investigates five major approaches for constructing prediction intervals -- namely the Delta method, Bayesian Monte Carlo Dropout, Bootstrap method, Lower-Upper Bound Estimation, and Mean-Variance Estimation -- as a means of capturing the uncertainty in neural network predictions of turbine gas temperature. Each approach is implemented within a unified experimental framework that employs cross-validation for hyperparameter selection, repeated train-test splits for performance robustness, and multiple metrics to evaluate both the accuracy and tightness of the intervals. In particular, Coverage Probability, Normalized Mean Prediction Interval Width, and the Coverage Width-based Criterion are measured to comprehensively assess each method's reliability and sharpness. Experiments conducted on a representative turbine gas temperature dataset reveal distinct trade-offs among the five methods in terms of interval coverage, width, and stability. These findings provide a practical guide for selecting and tuning prediction interval methods in engine health management and prognostics, ensuring both interpretability and precision in real-world applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现代发动机涡轮燃气温度（TGT）预测中的不确定性量化问题，系统比较了五种构造预测区间的方法：Delta方法、贝叶斯蒙特卡洛Dropout、Bootstrap方法、上下界估计以及均值方差估计。基于统一的实验框架（交叉验证、重复训练测试划分、多个指标）在代表性TGT数据集上评估了各方法的区间覆盖、宽度和稳定性，揭示了不同方法之间的权衡。
Motivation: 涡轮燃气温度的准确预测及其不确定性量化对发动机健康管理与预测（PHM）至关重要，但现有研究缺乏对此类实际应用中多种不确定性量化方法的系统比较和指导。
Method: 采用统一的实验框架，对五种预测区间方法（Delta、贝叶斯蒙特卡洛Dropout、Bootstrap、LUBE、MVE）进行交叉验证超参数选择、重复训练测试划分，并使用覆盖率（Coverage Probability）、归一化平均预测区间宽度（NMPIW）和覆盖宽度准则（CWC）进行综合评估。
Result: 在代表性涡轮燃气温度数据集上，五种方法在区间覆盖率、宽度和稳定性上表现出不同的权衡，提供了选择与调优预测区间方法的实践指南。
Conclusion: 研究为发动机健康管理中的预测区间方法选择提供了定量比较和实用建议，强调不同方法在可靠性与锐度间的权衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Prior Availability in Industrial Visual Sim-to-Real: A Review of CAD-Guided and CAD-Unavailable Regimes
papers.abstract_en: Industrial visual sim-to-real is often described as transferring from synthetic images to real images, but industrial deployment usually involves a broader mismatch between available evidence and required decisions. A system may be built from CAD renderings, simulated RGB-D observations, normal reference images, synthetic defects, pretrained feature spaces, or language prompts, yet deployed under different sensors, lighting, materials, fixtures, calibration, production variation, and rare defect modes. This review reframes industrial visual sim-to-real as a domain-gap problem organized by prior availability. We distinguish CAD-available settings, where explicit object geometry can support rendering, calibration, pose estimation, segmentation, and test-time geometric verification; CAD-unavailable settings, where geometry is replaced by normal-reference appearance, feature distributions, teacher-student residuals, synthetic anomaly assumptions, foundation features, or vision-language priors; and boundary-prior settings, where approximate models, templates, reference views, or semantic correspondences preserve only part of the CAD role. This framing connects CAD-based detection and 6D pose-estimation literature with industrial anomaly and surface-inspection literature that is usually reviewed separately. To make the taxonomy concrete, we use empirical anchors on T-LESS/BOP, MVTec AD, and VisA. The anchors show that CAD render count alone does not close transfer; source-distribution design, detector capacity, and small real calibration can matter more. They also show that CAD at test time creates a distinct verification channel through mask, pose, and depth consistency, whereas CAD-unavailable inspection relies on calibrated normality and feature deviation. The review therefore argues against a single cross-task leaderboard and instead asks what prior grounds the deployment decision.
papers.comment: Review article; 103 references; 9 main figures; empirical anchors on T-LESS/BOP, MVTec AD, and VisA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文综述了工业视觉仿真到现实（sim-to-real）中的领域迁移问题，按照先验可用性（CAD可用、CAD不可用及边界先验）重新组织文献。通过T-LESS/BOP、MVTec AD和VisA等数据集上的实证锚点，展示了CAD渲染数量本身不能弥合迁移缺口，而源分布设计、检测器容量和少量真实标定可能更重要。文章主张不应追求跨任务排行榜，而应关注何种先验支撑部署决策。
Motivation: 工业视觉仿真到现实通常只关注合成图像到真实图像的迁移，但实际部署面临传感器、光照、材料等多种不匹配。已有文献分别研究基于CAD的检测/位姿估计与工业异常/表面检测，缺少统一框架。本文旨在用先验可用性视角整合这些领域。
Method: 提出一个分类框架，区分CAD可用（有显式几何）、CAD不可用（依赖正常外观、特征分布等）和边界先验（近似模型、模板等）三种场景。通过三个数据集上的实验锚点来佐证该分类的实用性。
Result: 实证锚点显示：CAD渲染数量单独不能保证迁移成功，源分布设计、检测器容量和少量真实标定更为关键；CAD在测试时能通过掩码、位姿和深度一致性提供独特的验证通道，而CAD不可用的检测依赖标定的正态性和特征偏差。
Conclusion: 该综述认为不应追求跨任务统一排行榜，而应基于先验可用性理解不同场景下的部署决策。框架连接了通常被分开评述的文献，但本身是综述性质，未提出新方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Speculative Decoding Across Languages
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding has become a crucial component of large language model (LLM) inference, enabling faster generation by drafting multiple tokens and verifying them in parallel. However, small draft models tend to suffer from disproportionately poor multilingual capabilities. Thus, when generating text in a non-English language, speculative decoding is far less effective. We compare three strategies to improve speculative decoding efficiency for eleven languages: finetuning the draft model on task-specific data (translation); finetuning the draft model on unlabeled monolingual corpora; and training simple n-gram draft models on the same monolingual corpora. We evaluate efficiency on translation (from English into the target language) and the held-out task of story generation. We find that while task-specific distillation can significantly improve efficiency, distilled models generalize poorly to a new task. Meanwhile, n-gram draft models, despite lower acceptance rates, consistently provide large speed-ups due to much faster draft generation.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 11 figures, submitted to ACL ARR May 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文研究跨语言场景下推测解码的低效问题，比较了微调草稿模型（任务特定蒸馏、无监督单语微调）和训练n-gram草稿模型三种策略。在11种语言的翻译和故事生成任务上评估，发现任务特定蒸馏提升效率但泛化差，n-gram模型虽接受率低但生成速度更快，能带来更大加速。
Motivation: 推测解码依赖小型草稿模型，但草稿模型的多语言能力较差，导致非英语文本生成时推测解码效果显著下降。
Method: 比较三种策略：1) 在翻译任务上微调草稿模型（任务特定蒸馏）；2) 在未标注单语语料上微调草稿模型；3) 训练简单的n-gram草稿模型。评估在翻译（英译目标语言）和故事生成（保留任务）上的效率。
Result: 任务特定蒸馏显著提高效率，但泛化到新任务时表现差；n-gram草稿模型尽管接受率较低，但由于草稿生成速度快，始终提供大的加速。
Conclusion: 对于跨语言推测解码，需要平衡草稿模型的接受率和生成速度；任务特定方法可能过拟合，而简单n-gram模型在任务无关场景下更可靠。论文指出其局限性在于仅考虑英语到其他语言的翻译和故事生成，未评估反向方向及其他任务。

papers.title: AdvScene: Rethinking Adversarial Patch Evaluation Through Scene Robustness
papers.abstract_en: Adversarial patches are physical patterns attached to real objects to mislead AI vision systems. Their real-world risk is not determined by a single successful prediction, but by whether they remain effective after deployment under changing viewpoints, distances, and scene conditions. We refer to this property as scene robustness, the effectiveness of a deployed patch across conditions in a real environment. Yet existing evaluations do not measure scene robustness well: real image benchmarks are realistic but fixed, while simulators are controllable but not grounded in a specific real scene. We present AdvScene, a scene-grounded framework for measuring the scene robustness of adversarial patches in reconstructed real environments. AdvScene reframes evaluation as operational measurement: given a fixed deployed patch, it characterizes the patch's operational envelope - where and when the attack succeeds - as a function of viewpoint, distance, and scene context. A key challenge is that the attack is typically defined only in a single anchor view, while evaluation requires a representation that remains faithful under viewpoint changes. We formalize this as a constrained lifting problem and introduce Adversarial Patch-to-Scene Embedding (APSE), which resolves cross-view ambiguity while preserving attack-critical appearance and enforcing locality, target-surface attachment, and cross-view consistency. We validate AdvScene using real-world physical data and conduct a comprehensive evaluation of existing adversarial patches. Our results show that AdvScene reveals substantial scene-dependent variation in attack effectiveness that is not captured by existing image-centric or simulator-based evaluations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AdvScene，一个基于重建真实场景的对抗补丁鲁棒性评估框架。针对现有评估无法衡量补丁在部署后不同视角、距离和场景条件下的有效性（场景鲁棒性）的问题，将评估形式化为操作包络（operational envelope），并引入对抗补丁到场景嵌入（APSE）解决跨视角歧义。实验表明AdvScene能揭示现有评估忽略的场景依赖攻击效果变化。
Motivation: 现有对抗补丁评估方法要么使用固定真实图像基准（不够灵活），要么使用模拟器（无法真实反映特定场景），无法测量补丁在真实环境中的场景鲁棒性。
Method: 提出AdvScene框架，包括：1）将评估视为操作包络测量；2）形式化为约束提升问题（constrained lifting problem）；3）提出APSE（Adversarial Patch-to-Scene Embedding）实现跨视角一致性，同时保留攻击关键外观、局部性、目标表面附着性和跨视角一致性。
Result: 使用真实世界物理数据验证，对现有对抗补丁进行全面评估，结果表明AdvScene揭示了显著的场景依赖攻击效果变化，这是现有基于图像或模拟器的评估无法捕捉的。
Conclusion: AdvScene提供了更有意义的对抗补丁评估方式，强调了场景鲁棒性的重要性。

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware and Temporally Regulated Expert Advice in Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Exploration in reinforcement learning for autonomous driving is inherently unsafe: agents must experience novel behaviors to learn, yet exploration can lead to collisions or off-road driving. We propose an uncertainty-aware framework that leverages expert advice to guide exploration while avoiding long-term dependence. Advice is triggered when epistemic or aleatoric uncertainty exceeds adaptive thresholds derived from rolling buffers, ensuring advice evolves with the agent's confidence. A commitment-cooldown strategy with a stochastic early-stop heuristic regulates the duration and frequency of guidance, exposing the agent to coherent maneuvers without exhausting the advice budget. Expert and agent experiences are combined in a shared replay buffer within an off-policy implicit quantile network (IQN) backbone, enabling efficient reuse of expert trajectories. Experiments in CARLA show that our method outperforms the IQN baseline, improving success by 5-7% and reducing failures, demonstrating that risk-sensitive uncertainty coupled with regulated expert integration enables safer and more efficient exploration for sensor-based RL policy learning in unsignalized intersection navigation.

TL;DR: 本文提出一种不确定性感知的专家建议框架，用于自动驾驶强化学习中的安全探索。通过自适应阈值（基于滚动缓冲区）触发专家建议，并采用承诺-冷却策略与随机早停机制控制建议时长与频率，避免长期依赖。在CARLA模拟器的无信号十字路口导航任务中，该方法较IQN基线提升5-7%的成功率并减少失败。
Motivation: 强化学习探索在自动驾驶中不安全，智能体需体验新行为但易导致碰撞或驶离道路；现有专家引导方法可能造成长期依赖或建议预算浪费。
Method: 基于认知不确定性与偶然不确定性计算自适应阈值，通过滚动缓冲区动态调整；采用承诺-冷却策略与随机早停引导探索；专家与智能体经验共享至离线隐式分位数网络（IQN）回放缓冲。
Result: 在CARLA无信号十字路口任务中，方法较IQN基线成功率提升5-7%，并显著减少碰撞与偏离道路等失败情况。
Conclusion: 风险敏感不确定性感知与时域调节的专家集成可提升基于传感器的RL策略学习的安全性与探索效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Zeroth-Order Non-Log-Concave Sampling with Variance Reduction and Applications to Inverse Problems
papers.abstract_en: Sampling from high-dimensional, non-log-concave distributions with unnormalized densities remains a fundamental challenge in machine learning, particularly in black-box settings where gradient information is inaccessible or computationally prohibitive. While Langevin dynamics provides a principled framework for sampling when gradients are accessible, its extension to the black-box settings suffers from high variance and lacks non-asymptotic convergence guarantees for non-log-concave sampling. To address these limitations, we propose a variance-reduced zeroth-order Langevin sampling method. Our method employs a gradient estimator that substantially reduces the variance of the classical batched zeroth-order estimator and eliminates the unfavorable dimensional dependence of the batch size required for accurate estimation, enabling practical and stable sampling. We establish the first non-asymptotic convergence guarantees for zeroth-order non-log-concave sampling in terms of $\varepsilon$-relative Fisher information, and, under a Poincaré inequality assumption, squared total variation distance. We further propose ZO-APMC, a posterior sampling algorithm for black-box inverse problems with pre-trained score-based generative priors, establishing the first non-asymptotic convergence guarantees for such methods. We validate our theory through synthetic experiments and demonstrate strong empirical performance on practical linear and nonlinear inverse problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对黑箱非对数凹分布采样中的高方差问题，提出一种方差缩减的零阶Langevin采样方法。该方法使用梯度估计器显著降低经典批次零阶估计器的方差，消除了对批次大小的不利维度依赖。论文提供了首个非渐近收敛保证，包括ε-相对Fisher信息距离和平方全变差距离（在Poincaré不等式下），并进一步提出用于黑箱逆问题的后验采样算法ZO-APMC，建立了首个非渐近收敛保证。合成实验和实际线性/非线性逆问题验证了理论。
Motivation: 黑箱环境下梯度不可获取或计算昂贵，现有零阶Langevin采样方差大且缺乏非对数凹分布的非渐近收敛保证。
Method: 提出方差缩减的零阶Langevin采样方法，采用一种梯度估计器降低方差并消除批次大小的维度依赖；同时提出ZO-APMC算法用于基于预训练分数生成先验的黑箱逆问题。
Result: 首次为黑箱非对数凹采样提供非渐近收敛保证（ε-相对Fisher信息距离和平方全变差距离）；在逆问题上实现首个非渐近收敛保证，且实验性能强。
Conclusion: 所提方法有效解决了黑箱非对数凹采样的高方差问题，并在逆问题中表现优异，但局限在于依赖Poincaré不等式等假设。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Memory-Bound but Not Bandwidth-Limited: The Physical AI Inference Gap in Batch-1 LLM Decode
papers.abstract_en: Physical AI systems, including robots, autonomous vehicles, embodied agents and edge copilots, often run a different inference workload from cloud LLM serving: single-stream, batch-1 autoregressive decode, where one robot, camera feed or user session waits on the next token. This workload is usually described as memory-bandwidth-bound. Each decode step streams model weights and the active KV cache, so latency should scale with peak HBM bandwidth. We show that this account is true but incomplete. We measure batch-1 decode for three 7 to 8B-class GQA transformers across four NVIDIA GPUs: H100 SXM5, A100-80GB SXM4, L40S and L4. We evaluate context lengths from 2048 to 16384, producing 44 valid cells under a controlled bf16 SDPA setup. The achieved fraction of peak HBM bandwidth falls as peak bandwidth rises. On the headline Qwen-2.5-7B ctx=2048 cell, an L4 reaches roughly 81 percent of its analytic memory floor, while an H100 reaches only 27 percent. Physical-AI decode is memory-dominated, but faster memory does not translate into proportional latency gains. We test the missing term with a CUDA Graphs A/B experiment. On H100 at ctx=2048, CUDA Graphs improves decode latency by 1.259x across N=10 fresh sessions, with a 95 percent bootstrap confidence interval of 1.253 to 1.267. On L4, the same intervention gives only 1.028x. This isolates a launch-side overhead that becomes visible on fast GPUs but remains mostly hidden on slower, bandwidth-bound GPUs. The deployment implication is that memory savings matter only when the runtime realises them. On L4, bf16 decode sits close to the memory floor, but common quantised paths do not recover the expected 4x weight-traffic reduction: bnb-nf4 reaches 59.36 ms/step and AutoAWQ+Marlin reaches 45.24 ms/step from a 62.32 ms bf16 baseline. GPTQ+ExLlamaV2, with Ada-tuned int4 kernels, reaches 17.36 ms/step.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究物理AI系统（如机器人、自动驾驶）中批大小为1的自回归解码延迟问题。通常认为该任务受限于内存带宽，但测量发现峰值HBM带宽利用率随带宽增大而下降：L4可达到内存分析下限的81%，而H100仅27%。通过CUDA Graphs实验分离出启动开销，在H100上提升1.259倍延迟，在L4上仅1.028倍。量化路径（如GPTQ+ExLlamaV2）在L4上显著降低延迟，但其他量化方法收益较小。
Motivation: 物理AI推理常被描述为内存带宽受限，但该描述不完整，高带宽GPU并未成比例降低延迟，需探究隐藏开销。
Method: 在四种NVIDIA GPU（H100、A100、L40S、L4）上测量7-8B参数GQA模型的批大小为1解码延迟，进行CUDA Graphs A/B实验分离启动开销，并评估多种量化方法。
Result: 在Qwen-2.5-7B、上下文长度2048时，L4达到内存分析下限的81%，H100仅27%；CUDA Graphs在H100上提升1.259倍延迟，在L4上仅1.028倍；GPTQ+ExLlamaV2在L4上达到17.36 ms/step，相比bf16基线62.32 ms/step显著改善。
Conclusion: 物理AI解码是内存主导的，但快速内存不能转化为比例延迟增益；内存节省策略的实际影响取决于运行时能否实现，量化方法在慢速GPU上更有效。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Procedural Generation of First Person Shooter Maps using Map-Elites
papers.abstract_en: We investigate the application of MAP-Elites (a well-known quality diversity algorithm) to design levels for First-Person Shooter (FPS) games. We consider two well-known map representations (All-Black and Grid-Graph) and introduce two novel representations (Point-Line and Spatial-Layout) that improve the characterization of FPS maps. We define a series of metrics to describe maps' topological properties (which solely depend on maps' layout), and emergent properties (which must be evaluated through actual gameplay). We perform an in-depth analysis to identify the most suitable features to guide MAP-Elites illumination process. We apply MAP-Elites with Sliding Boundaries (MESB) to evolve populations of FPS maps. Our results show that the new representations can generate maps with higher diversity and quality than the representations previously used for evolving FPS maps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了使用质量多样性算法 MAP-Elites 设计第一人称射击游戏（FPS）关卡。提出了两种新的地图表示方法（Point-Line 和 Spatial-Layout），以改进 FPS 地图的特征描述，并定义了一系列拓扑属性和涌现属性度量。通过 MAP-Elites with Sliding Boundaries (MESB) 演化地图种群，结果表明新表示方法比以往方法能生成更高多样性和质量的地图。
Motivation: FPS 地图的自动化设计具有挑战性，现有表示方法不足以捕捉地图的多样性和质量特征，需要更优的表示和进化框架。
Method: 引入两种新的地图表示（Point-Line 和 Spatial-Layout），并采用 MAP-Elites with Sliding Boundaries (MESB) 算法来优化地图的多样性和质量。
Result: 新表示方法生成的地图在多样性和质量上优于之前使用的表示方法（All-Black 和 Grid-Graph）。
Conclusion: 该研究为程序化生成 FPS 地图提供了有效的表示和进化方法，但泛化到其他游戏类型或更复杂场景需要进一步验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Transforming and Encoding FTS for SAT Solving: What Helps, What Hurts (Extended Version)
papers.abstract_en: Factored tasks are a classical planning representation that extends SAS+ with limited forms of disjunctive preconditions, conditional effects, and angelic nondeterminism. This allows for a more compact representation of tasks than traditional formalisms such as STRIPS or SAS+, and supports a wide range of task transformations. However, existing planning approaches for factored tasks have been limited to heuristic search methods. In this work, we investigate how to encode factored tasks in SAT. We propose several ways to encode the tasks, focusing on different strategies for translating the factored transition relation into propositional logic. We also analyze how to exploit parallelism at various levels in this setting and study the impact of common task transformations on the performance of SAT-based planners.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何将分解任务（factored tasks）编码为SAT问题，提出多种编码策略并分析不同变换对基于SAT的规划器性能的影响。
Motivation: 分解任务是一种扩展的规划表示，但现有方法仅限于启发式搜索，缺乏SAT编码的研究。
Method: 提出多种将分解任务转换到命题逻辑的编码方法，探索不同层次的并行性利用和任务变换的影响。
Result: 通过实验分析了不同编码策略和任务变换对SAT求解性能的影响，指出了哪些变换有益、哪些有害。
Conclusion: 为基于SAT的分解任务规划提供了编码指南，展示了任务变换对求解效率的关键作用。

papers.title: VLM3: Vision Language Models Are Native 3D Learners
papers.abstract_en: Vision Language Models (VLMs) enable a unified model to solve various vision tasks through prompting. They have shown promising performance in semantic understanding. However, 3D understanding still largely relies on expert vision models with complex task-specific designs. The key argument this work wants to make is that VLMs are native 3D learners. Our in-depth large scale study shows that 1) focal length unification, 2) text-based pixel reference and 3) data mixture and scaling, are all you need for effective 3D learning. Model architecture changes, large models, heavy data augmentations, and complex losses including the regression formulation, many of which form the foundation of expert vision models, are actually not necessary conditions. As a result, we propose VLM3, a scalable method with the simplest design that enables standard VLMs to master diverse 3D tasks. VLM3 not only advances the VLM depth estimation accuracy by a large margin (0.84 -> 0.9), but also enables diverse 3D tasks such as pixel correspondence, camera pose estimation and object-level 3D understanding, matching expert vision model accuracy while maintaining standard architectures and text-based training. We believe VLM3 opens up a new paradigm for simple and scalable 3D learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文论证视觉语言模型(VLM)本身就是原生3D学习者，无需复杂的模型架构、大规模模型或重数据增强。通过焦距统一、基于文本的像素参考以及数据混合与缩放，VLM3实现了在多种3D任务上匹配专家模型的性能，并将深度估计精度从0.84提升至0.9。
Motivation: 当前3D理解仍依赖复杂的专用视觉模型，而VLM在语义理解上表现优异但尚未充分挖掘其3D能力。本文试图证明VLM本身即可高效学习3D任务。
Method: 提出VLM3方法，核心三要素：1) 焦距统一，2) 基于文本的像素参考，3) 数据混合与缩放。未使用模型架构变化、大模型或复杂损失函数。
Result: VLM3在深度估计精度上从0.84提升至0.9，并在像素对应、相机位姿估计和目标级3D理解等任务上达到与专家模型相当的精度。
Conclusion: VLM3开创了一种简单且可扩展的3D学习新范式，表明标准VLM通过简单设计即可掌握多种3D任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Seeing Isn't Knowing: Do VLMs Know When Not to Answer Spatial Questions (and Why)?
papers.abstract_en: Spatial reasoning is a fundamental capability for vision-language models (VLMs) deployed in real-world environments. However, visual observations are inherently limited representations of a 3D world: occlusion can render objects invisible, and perspective can make geometric properties misleading. Despite this, existing spatial reasoning benchmarks typically assume that observations are sufficient and reliable, focusing on whether models produce correct answers rather than whether they recognize when a question cannot be answered and what additional observations would be needed. In this work, we challenge this assumption by constructing a controlled evaluation framework, SpatialUncertain, and introducing two types of observation challenges: (1) occlusion, which hides target information, and (2) perspective ambiguity, which produces misleading visual cues. For each configuration, we design spatial questions that are answerable under clean observations but require abstention under the introduced challenges. We further evaluate whether models can identify which additional viewpoints would resolve perspective ambiguity. Our results across a diverse set of frontier open- and closed-source VLMs reveal two consistent failure modes. First, models are prone to overconfident answering, attempting to solve spatial reasoning tasks even when visual evidence is incomplete or misleading, with average accuracy around 30\% under occlusion and below 10\% under perspective ambiguity. Second, even when additional views are available, some models perform near random chance in identifying which would provide reliable evidence. Together, our findings call for moving beyond answer correctness toward evaluating whether models know when to abstain and how to seek reliable evidence.

TL;DR: 本文构建了SpatialUncertain评估框架，测试VLM在空间推理中遇到遮挡和透视歧义时是否知道拒绝回答。结果显示模型在信息不完整时仍然过度自信回答（准确率低于30%），且难以识别哪些额外视角能提供可靠证据。

Method: 提出SpatialUncertain框架，引入两种观察挑战：遮挡和透视歧义；设计可回答/需弃权的空间问题；并评估模型识别额外视角的能力。
Result: 多个开源和闭源VLM在遮挡下平均准确率约30%，透视歧义下低于10%；部分模型在识别可靠额外视角时接近随机。
Conclusion: 呼吁VLM评估应超越答案正确性，关注模型何时应弃权以及如何寻求可靠证据。

papers.title: Supervised Training Rapidly Degrades Early Visual Cortex Alignment Across Biologically Plausible Learning Rules
papers.abstract_en: Random, untrained neural networks consistently match or exceed trained networks in representational similarity to early visual cortex. This puzzling finding challenges the assumption that learning improves brain alignment. We investigate it by tracking representational similarity analysis (RSA) alignment to human fMRI data across training for four learning rules: backpropagation (BP), feedback alignment (FA), predictive coding (PC), and spike-timing-dependent plasticity (STDP). Using 720 object images from the THINGS database and fMRI data from three subjects across six visual ROIs, we measure Spearman correlations between model and brain representational dissimilarity matrices at eight training checkpoints (epochs 0-40). We find that (1) a single epoch of training reduces V1 alignment by 25-90%, depending on the learning rule; (2) backpropagation reduces V1 alignment most severely (delta r = -0.080), while predictive coding and STDP preserve substantially more (delta r ~ -0.04); and (3) a weaker, opposite tendency appears in object-selective cortex (LOC), where BP shows the largest increase in alignment during training, although the absolute change is small. These results suggest that untrained architectures capture low-level visual statistics through inductive biases alone, and that global error signals (BP) reshape early representations more aggressively than local learning rules (PC, STDP), which better preserve brain-like structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文发现随机未训练网络在表示相似性上与早期视觉皮层匹配甚至超过训练网络。通过追踪四种学习规则（BP、FA、PC、STDP）在训练过程中的RSA对齐性，发现单轮训练就会使V1对齐性下降25-90%，其中BP下降最严重（delta r = -0.080），而局部学习规则（PC、STDP）保留更多脑结构（delta r ~ -0.04）。在物体选择皮层（LOC）中，BP对齐性增加最大，但绝对变化很小。
Motivation: 挑战了“学习改善脑对齐”的假设，探究为何未训练网络在视觉皮层表示相似性上表现更好。
Method: 使用720张THINGS物体图像和三个受试者的fMRI数据，测量模型与大脑表征相异矩阵的斯皮尔曼相关性，在八次训练检查点（epoch 0-40）上比较BP、FA、PC、STDP四种学习规则。
Result: (1) 单轮训练使V1对齐性下降25-90%；(2) BP下降最严重（delta r = -0.080），PC和STDP下降较少（约-0.04）；(3) 在LOC区域BP对齐性增加最大，但绝对值小。
Conclusion: 未训练网络通过归纳偏差捕获低层视觉统计，全局误差信号（BP）比局部学习规则（PC、STDP）更激进地重塑早期表征，后者更好地保留脑结构。

papers.title: Destruction is a General Strategy to Learn Generation; Diffusion's Strength is to Take it Seriously; Exploration is the Future
papers.abstract_en: I present diffusion models as part of a family of machine learning techniques that withhold information from a model's input and train it to guess the withheld information. I argue that diffusion's destroying approach to withholding is more flexible than typical hand-crafted information withholding techniques, providing a rich training playground that could be advantageous in some settings, notably data-scarce ones. I then address subtle issues that may arise when porting reinforcement learning techniques to the diffusion context, and wonder how such exploration problems could be addressed in more diffusion-native ways. I do not have definitive answers, but I do point my fingers in directions I deem interesting. A tutorial follows this thesis, expanding on the destroy-then-generate perspective. A novel kind of probabilistic graphical models is introduced to facilitate the tutorial's exposition.
papers.comment: Published April 27th, 2026 as an ICLR blogpost https://iclr-blogposts.github.io/2026/blog/2026/destruction/
papers.journal_ref: Noël, Piere-André. "Destruction is a General Strategy to Learn Generation; Diffusion's Strength is to Take it Seriously; Exploration is the Future", ICLR Blogposts, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将扩散模型视为一种信息隐藏技术，强调其通过破坏信息进行训练的方式比手工设计的信息隐藏更灵活，尤其在数据稀缺情况下具有优势。同时，论文讨论了强化学习迁移到扩散上下文时可能出现的微妙问题，并提出未来探索方向。最后介绍了一种新型概率图模型用于教学。
Motivation: 将扩散模型置于更广泛的信息隐藏学习框架中，论证其破坏性策略的灵活性优势，并探讨强化学习与扩散结合时的问题。
Method: 从“破坏-生成”视角重新解释扩散模型，并通过引入新型概率图模型进行教学性阐述。
Result: 摘要未提供具体实验结果，主要为概念性论证和方向指引。
Conclusion: 作者没有给出确定性答案，但提出了值得进一步研究的探索方向。

papers.title: Early Prediction of Future Behavioral Strategy from Process Traces
papers.abstract_en: Adaptive systems often need to make task-specific decisions about people from limited evidence: a tutor may need to anticipate how a learner will approach a new problem, a game may need to adapt when a player enters a new level, and a human-AI system may need to infer whether a partner will persist with a plan or switch goals. These decisions depend on person-level tendencies that shape how people solve related tasks, but such tendencies are difficult to infer from standard behavioral evidence. One approach is to use aggregate outcome summaries, such as scores, completion rates, or productivity; these summaries are compact and available across tasks, but can collapse distinct behavioral processes into similar outcomes. Another approach is to use process-level traces, which record how behavior unfolds; however, process modeling within one task can entangle stable person-level tendencies with task-specific layout and affordances. In this work, we study early cross-task behavioral inference: whether partial source-task process traces can reveal transferable person-level structure that predicts strategy in a held-out target task. We introduce a Process-Level Latent Variable Model (PLVM), which encodes task-specific traces and fuses them into a shared person-level latent representation for cross-task prediction. In PowerWash Simulator, a naturalistic telemetry dataset of human gameplay, PLVM uses partial traces from two cleaning tasks to predict locally persistent Zone Planner behavior versus frequent Zone Hopper behavior in the held-out Fire Station level. Controlled simulations with known latent types show that cross-task fusion helps when source tasks reveal complementary dimensions of a shared latent process. These results suggest that process-level cross-task modeling can support early prediction of target-task strategy when observing sufficient target-task behavior is impractical.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究通过部分过程轨迹早期预测未来行为策略，提出过程级潜在变量模型（PLVM），该模型编码任务特定轨迹并融合成共享的人级潜在表示，用于跨任务预测。在PowerWash Simulator自然数据集上，PLVM利用部分轨迹预测目标任务中的策略，模拟显示跨任务融合在源任务揭示互补维度时有效。
Motivation: 自适应系统常需从有限证据预测人的行为，但人的稳定倾向难以从标准行为证据推断，现有方法或依赖聚合摘要丢失过程细节，或受任务特定布局影响。
Method: 提出过程级潜在变量模型（PLVM），先编码任务特定轨迹，再通过共享潜在表示融合多个源任务信息，以预测目标任务策略。
Result: 在PowerWash Simulator数据集上，PLVM利用部分轨迹成功预测本地持久型与频繁切换型策略；可控模拟表明跨任务融合在源任务揭示互补维度时提升预测。
Conclusion: 过程级跨任务建模可在目标任务行为观察不足时实现早期策略预测，具有实际应用潜力。

papers.title: On-Device Generative AI for GDPR-Compliant Visual Monitoring: Natural Language Alerts from Local Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Visual monitoring systems that rely on cloud-based AI inference expose raw image data to external services, creating fundamental tensions with the data-minimisation principle of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). This paper presents a proof-of-concept privacy-by-design pipeline that resolves this tension by confining all inference entirely to the edge device. A YOLOv5n-seg model compiled for a Hailo-8L AI accelerator delivers real-time object detection on a Raspberry Pi 5, from which raw pixel buffers are immediately discarded after inference. A stateful trigger engine forwards minimal JSON event payloads to a locally hosted instance of Phi-3 Mini (3.8B parameters, Q4_0 quantisation), which synthesises one-to-two sentence natural-language alerts for a human operator. No image data crosses the network boundary at any point; only the generated text alert is transmitted. We describe the full system architecture and implementation, report measured inference latency and resource utilisation on the target hardware, and present representative generated alerts. The results demonstrate that combining a dedicated neural-network accelerator with an on-device large language model on a single-board computer is not only feasible but produces practically deployable, human-readable monitoring output while aligning with GDPR Art. 5(1)(c) by design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种符合GDPR隐私设计原则的视觉监控流水线，将YOLOv5n-seg目标检测和Phi-3 Mini大语言模型全部部署在边缘设备（Raspberry Pi 5 + Hailo-8L加速器）上，检测后立即丢弃原始图像像素，仅传输由LLM生成的自然语言警报文本，避免图像数据外传。在目标硬件上报告了推理延迟和资源占用，并展示了示例警报。
Motivation: 云端推理的视觉监控系统会暴露原始图像数据，与GDPR的数据最小化原则冲突。需要一种隐私保护方案，在不依赖外部服务的前提下实现实时监控和可读警报。
Method: 边缘端流水线：YOLOv5n-seg经Hailo-8L加速实现实时目标检测，推理后丢弃像素；有状态触发引擎将最小JSON事件负载传给本地运行的Phi-3 Mini（3.8B参数，Q4_0量化），生成1-2句自然语言警报。
Result: 在Raspberry Pi 5上实现实时检测，LLM生成警报的延迟和资源消耗可接受，生成的警报示例表明输出可读且实用。
Conclusion: 在单板计算机上集成专用神经网络加速器与本地LLM是可行的，能产生实用的人可读监控输出，且通过设计符合GDPR第5(1)(c)条。

papers.title: Physically Viable World Models: A Case for Query-Conditioned Embodied AI
papers.abstract_en: World models for embodied AI must be physically viable: constructed to answer intervention queries by representing the physical structure governing action outcomes, rather than merely predicting future observations. Existing observation-predictive world models can produce visually plausible but physically wrong rollouts. This failure is structural; distinct physical systems can look identical yet diverge under intervention. We expose this problem with controlled benchmarks that fix the visible scene while varying latent physics. We show that such models may recommend infeasible actions, mispredict interaction outcomes, or certify unsafe behavior. We argue that embodied AI requires world models that identify the simplest physical abstraction sufficient to answer an intervention query. Such a model comprises modular components, including environment representation, latent state and parameter estimation, action specification, interventional dynamics, and query-level response. An autonomous orchestrator should identify the relevant abstraction and compose compatible learned and structured components per query. When closed-form physics is unavailable, uncertain, or costly, the transition model may be analytic, simulated, learned, or hybrid, but it must preserve the structure that determines interventional outcomes. This decomposition makes the model interpretable, its components verifiable, and its outputs auditable against the query. It also provides a design principle for new world models and a feasibility test for existing ones: the right abstraction is not the most detailed model of the world, but the simplest model that preserves the distinctions relevant to the query. We demonstrate this approach on queries that existing systems fail to answer correctly, and outline how an orchestrator can dynamically assemble and adapt physically viable models for planning, control, and verification.
papers.comment: 21 pages; Adam J. Thorpe and Stepan Tretiakov contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文论证了具身AI的世界模型必须具有物理可行性：其构造应能回答干预查询，而非仅预测观测。现有观测预测模型可能产生视觉合理但物理错误的展开。作者提出应寻找足以回答查询的最简物理抽象，并演示了在现有系统失败的查询上的应用。
Motivation: 现有世界模型在具身AI中常产生物理上不可行的预测，导致推荐不可行动作、误判交互结果或认证不安全行为，根本原因在于其缺乏对干预结果的物理结构表征。
Method: 提出查询条件化世界模型框架，包括环境表示、潜状态与参数估计、动作规范、干预动力学和查询级响应等模块，并通过自主编排器动态组合兼容组件，支持解析、模拟、学习或混合的转移模型。
Result: 在受控基准上展示现有系统对相同可见场景、不同潜物理配置的查询回答失败，而所提方法能正确回答这些查询。
Conclusion: 具身AI所需要的不是最详细的世界模型，而是保留查询相关区分的最简模型；该框架提供了设计原则与可行性检验。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: SubsurfaceGen: Procedural Generation of Field-Scale Earth Models and Seismic Data
papers.abstract_en: Full waveform inversion (FWI) is the gold standard for subsurface imaging, with applications from carbon sequestration to energy and mineral exploration to earthquake hazard assessment. Machine learning approaches to FWI need field-scale, geologically diverse, and physically realistic training data, but existing resources such as Marmousi, SEAM, and OpenFWI fall short on spatial extent, temporal extent, geological diversity, and physical realism. We address these limitations with SubsurfaceGen, a GPU-accelerated generator for 3D velocity models and seismic data. Along with SubsurfaceGen, we release a paired dataset of 4,276 2D velocity slices, 5 s wavefields, and 8 s shot gathers drawn from 42 realistic, field-scale 3D velocity models, each spanning 10 km x 10 km laterally and 6.19 km deep at 10 m resolution. The dataset spans six geological settings -- four built with SubsurfaceGen and two drawn from prior sources -- relevant for carbon sequestration and hydrocarbon exploration. We use this dataset to evaluate neural operators on wavefield prediction and encoder-decoders on end-to-end velocity inversion, holding out one geological setting for out-of-distribution testing. These experiments surface failure modes at field-scale and demonstrate how SubsurfaceGen and the associated dataset can impact ML-based FWI.

papers.title: DisasterLex: An Expert Concept-to-Schema Knowledge Graph for Geospatial Reasoning in Disaster Analytics
papers.abstract_en: Disasters are inevitable and increasingly costly, and effective response depends on querying structured tabular data: precise, information-dense records of hazard, exposure, vulnerability, and lifeline infrastructure that underpin disaster management. Current text-to-SQL methods enable natural-language access to such tables but transfer poorly to the disaster domain, where queries span heterogeneous geospatial schemas and require reasoning over causal relations. We introduce DisasterLex, a knowledge-graph-mediated framework that inserts an Expert Knowledge Graph (EKG) of curated concepts and typed causal edges between the user query and the database, bridged to schema by concept-to-table links. The orchestration runs four stages (identifying query entities, routing to the operational domain, planning over causal edges, and grounding the SQL), restricting the schema passed to the model at each step. We instantiate it on a disaster-analytics database (36 geospatial tables, 150 columns) with an EKG of 107 concepts, 117 causal edges, and 52 concept-to-schema links, evaluated on a 75-query test set. On all seven base models spanning proprietary and open-weight families, DisasterLex beats four state-of-the-art baselines (LightRAG, HippoRAG 2, ReFoRCE, CHESS) by 1.4x to 2.75x, with absolute scores of 1.65 to 3.56 (of 5.0). Error analysis shows baseline failures cluster in routing and multi-table SQL composition, the operations our orchestration explicitly addresses. Code, data, and the EKG artifact are available at https://github.com/YimingXiao98/DisasterLex and on Zenodo at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20388029.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DisasterLex框架，通过专家知识图谱连接自然语言查询与灾害分析数据库，实现文本到SQL的地理空间推理。在包含36个地理空间表、150列的灾害分析数据库上，基于75个查询的测试集评估，该方法在7个基础模型上超越四种基线方法1.4倍至2.75倍。
Motivation: 现有文本到SQL方法在灾害领域迁移困难，因为查询涉及异构地理空间模式并需因果推理。
Method: 构建专家知识图谱，包含精选概念和类型化因果边，通过概念到表链接桥接到数据库模式。执行四个阶段：识别查询实体、路由到操作域、规划因果边、生成SQL。
Result: 在75个查询测试集上，基于7个基础模型，DisasterLex超越LightRAG、HippoRAG 2、ReFoRCE、CHESS，绝对分数1.65至3.56（5分制），提升1.4倍至2.75倍。
Conclusion: 错误分析显示基线在路由和多表SQL组合上失败，而DisasterLex明确解决这些操作。代码、数据和知识图谱已公开。

papers.title: The Long-Term Effects of Data Selection in LLM Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Data selection is increasingly used to reduce the cost of large language model (LLM) fine-tuning, with recent methods prioritizing samples by current utility, diversity, quality, or influence. This paper studies a different question: when fine-tuning occurs over multiple stages, can selection strategies that look optimal now make the model less adaptable later? We introduce a long-horizon view of LLM data selection in which a selector is evaluated not only by immediate task performance, but also by future adaptation speed, forgetting, capability imbalance, and out-of-distribution robustness. We compare representative random, loss-based, gradient-based, diversity-based, quality-based, and utility-diversity selection families under a unified multi-stage protocol. Through controlled experiments designed to instantiate this protocol, we show how short-term selectors can exhibit rank reversal: they improve the current stage while slowing subsequent learning and increasing forgetting. We formalize this behavior as \emph{myopic selection}, provide a simple local analysis of why it can occur, and propose a diagnostic Long-Horizon Aware Selection (LHAS) objective that augments immediate utility with coverage, future-proxy transfer, and anti-concentration terms. The study argues that data selection should be evaluated as a training intervention that shapes the model's learning trajectory, rather than only as a local data-efficiency mechanism.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究LLM多阶段微调中数据选择策略的长期影响，发现短期最优策略可能导致后续适应性下降（短视选择）。提出一种长期感知选择（LHAS）目标，在即时效用基础上加入覆盖度、未来代理迁移和反集中项，以期平衡当前与未来性能。
Motivation: 现有数据选择方法多关注单阶段效率，忽略多阶段下策略对后续学习轨迹的负面影响，可能造成模型适应性降低、遗忘加剧等长期问题。
Method: 在统一的多阶段协议下比较多种选择策略（随机、损失、梯度、多样性、质量、效用-多样性等），并设计LHAS目标函数，引入覆盖度、未来代理迁移和反集中项以缓解短视选择。
Result: 实验显示短视选择策略存在排名反转现象：提升当前阶段效果但减慢后续学习并增加遗忘。提供局部分析方法解释该行为。
Conclusion: 数据选择应被评估为影响学习轨迹的训练干预，而非仅作为局部数据效率机制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: True Self-Avoiding Walk for Accelerating Markov-Chain Monte Carlo Integration
papers.abstract_en: We study true self-avoiding walk (TSAW) as a mechanism for improving empirical integral estimation via Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC). We consider finite-state adaptive sampling dynamics associated with an irreducible Markov kernel $P$ on a finite set, with stationary distribution $π$, in which the transition probabilities are penalized according to empirical overuse. Our main result is that the empirical occupation counts $L_t(i)$ and transition counts $N_t(i,j)$ of the resulting TSAW-based walk satisfy \[ L_t(i)-tπ_i = O(\sqrt{\log t}) \quad\text{and}\quad N_t(i,j)-tπ_iP_{ij}=O(\sqrt{\log t}) \qquad\text{almost surely} \] for every state $i$ and every edge $(i,j)$ with $P_{ij}>0$. Consequently, for every bounded function $f:V\to\mathbb R$, the error of our integral estimator converges as \[ \left|\frac1t\sum_{s=0}^{t-1} f(X_s)-\sum_{i\in V}π_i f(i)\right| = O\left(\frac{\sqrt{\log t}}{t}\right) \qquad\text{almost surely}. \] These results show that, in contrast with the usual $t^{-1/2}$ error scaling for empirical averages under standard random-walk-based methods, TSAW-based estimator yields empirical integral errors of order $O(\sqrt{\log t}/t)$ almost surely, thereby achieving a substantially sharper dependence on the sample size $t$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文研究了真自回避行走 (True Self-Avoiding Walk, TSAW) 作为改进马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛 (MCMC) 积分估计的机制。作者针对有限状态空间上具有平稳分布的不可约马尔可夫核，提出基于经验过度使用惩罚转移概率的自适应采样动力学，并证明经验占用计数和转移计数几乎必然具有 O(√log t) 的波动，从而积分误差达到 O(√log t / t)，远优于传统随机游走的 O(t^{-1/2}) 误差率。
Motivation: 标准 MCMC 方法的积分误差通常为 O(t^{-1/2})，论文旨在通过自适应惩罚过度访问的 TSAW 实现更快的误差收敛，以改进经验积分估计。
Method: 针对有限状态空间上的不可约马尔可夫核 P，提出基于经验过度使用惩罚转移概率的 TSAW 动力学，并利用几乎必然收敛理论进行分析。
Result: 证明了占用计数和转移计数几乎必然满足 L_t(i)-tπ_i = O(√log t) 和 N_t(i,j)-tπ_iP_{ij}=O(√log t)，从而对于任意有界函数 f，积分误差几乎必然为 O(√log t / t)。
Conclusion: TSAW 能够大幅改善 MCMC 积分估计的样本复杂度，实现几乎必然的 O(√log t / t) 误差率，显著优于标准方法。

papers.title: Generalistic or Specific Embeddings, Which is Better? An Empirical Study on Search for Clinical Coding in Non-English Languages
papers.abstract_en: Sentence-embedding models for semantic search are overwhelmingly developed and evaluated on English corpora. When applied to clinical retrieval in other languages -- particularly retrieval of ICD-10-CM / CIE-10 codes -- recall degrades in ways often masked by aggregate benchmarks. We study whether large generative language models can serve as data factories to close this gap. We build a two-stage retriever (bi-encoder followed by cross-encoder reranker), fine-tuned from a Spanish biomedical encoder (PlanTL-GOB-ES/bsc-bio-ehr-es) on Gemini-generated synthetic data covering English, Spanish, Catalan, Italian, Portuguese and French, and evaluate against BioBERT-ST and the un-tuned Spanish encoder. The bi-encoder alone matches BioBERT-ST on MRR (0.876 vs. 0.866) and overtakes it on R@3 (0.650 vs. 0.626) and R@5 (0.804 vs. 0.790) without English biomedical pretraining. Adding a cross-encoder reranker lifts aggregate R@5 to 0.822 and dominates on four of five languages (+0.017 Spanish, +0.033 Catalan, +0.018 French, +0.037 Portuguese) at the cost of a small English regression. The trade-off is clinically acceptable: Portuguese reaches R@5 = 0.829 vs. BioBERT-ST's 0.714. Contributions: an open recipe for building domain-specific medical retrievers from LLM-generated data; quantification of the learning gain (MRR 0.755 to 0.876, +15.9% with ~19,500 synthetic pairs); and a characterisation of where gains concentrate by language and rank.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过实证研究比较通用嵌入和特定嵌入在非英语临床编码搜索中的性能。作者利用大型生成语言模型（如Gemini）生成多语言合成数据，构建两阶段检索器（双编码器+交叉编码器重排序），在西班牙语临床数据上微调，评估了五种语言的ICD-10-CM代码检索。结果表明，特定领域的双编码器在MRR和召回率上匹配或超越英文预训练的BioBERT-ST，添加重排序后进一步提升了多语言检索性能，仅轻微影响英语。
Motivation: 句子嵌入模型主要基于英文开发，在非英语语言的临床代码检索中性能退化，且被聚合基准掩盖。需要研究通用与特定嵌入的优劣，并探索利用大模型生成合成数据来弥合性能差距。
Method: 构建两阶段检索器：双编码器（bi-encoder）进行初检，后接交叉编码器（cross-encoder）重排序。在西班牙语生物医学编码器上微调，使用Gemini生成的合成数据覆盖英语、西班牙语、加泰罗尼亚语、意大利语、葡萄牙语和法语。
Result: 双编码器在MRR（0.876 vs 0.866）和R@3（0.650 vs 0.626）、R@5（0.804 vs 0.790）上匹配或超越BioBERT-ST。添加重排序后，聚合R@5提升至0.822，在四种语言上优于BioBERT-ST（西班牙语+0.017、加泰罗尼亚语+0.033、法语+0.018、葡萄牙语+0.037），仅英语略有下降。
Conclusion: 基于LLM生成合成数据可以高效构建领域特定的多语言临床代码检索器，其性能在非英语语言中优于通用英文预训练模型，性能权衡在临床上可接受。贡献包括开放配方、量化学习增益（MRR从0.755到0.876，+15.9%）以及按语言和排名的增益分布特征。

papers.title: Measuring, Localizing, and Ablating Alignment Signatures in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Aligned language models often exhibit a recognizable AI-like style, yet its connection to post-training and internal representations remains poorly understood. In this work, we study whether post-training introduces or amplifies AI-like stylistic regularities and whether these regularities have a localized internal signature. To this end, we compare human text, base-model generations, and aligned-model generations under matched human-source prefixes. Aligned generations show lower human-corpus affinity and higher AI-detection rates than base generations, suggesting that post-training shifts generated text away from human-corpus style and toward detector-visible AI-like text. We then introduce PASTA (Post-training Alignment Signature Targeted Ablation), a training-free method that estimates a post-training alignment signature from aligned-base residual contrasts and ablates the corresponding direction during decoding. Across 11 aligned models and 6 AI detectors, PASTA lowers the detection rate for most aligned models; this effect transfers well across detectors and is not reproduced by random directions. Qualitative analysis suggests that PASTA generations remain relevant and coherent while exhibiting greater stylistic variation. Together, these results show that AI-like stylistic effects of post-training can be measured, localized, and causally tested through activation ablation.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Representation Collapse in Sequential Post-Training of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are now adapted through chains of post-training stages rather than through a single instruction-tuning pass. This paper studies whether such sequential post-training gradually compresses internal representations into low-rank, anisotropic, and homogeneous feature spaces. We define a measurement suite for hidden states, logits, token trajectories, and LoRA updates, and we use it to analyze supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization, safety/refusal tuning, math and code specialization, and long chain-of-thought tuning under controlled stage orderings. The central hypothesis is that excessive representation concentration is not merely a geometric curiosity: it predicts reduced plasticity during later adaptation, weaker out-of-domain generalization, and poorer calibration. We further evaluate lightweight interventions, including mixed-domain replay, feature refresh, representation diversity regularization, and LoRA update decorrelation, as ways to preserve future learnability without giving up the behavioral gains of post-training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型在序列后训练（sequential post-training）过程中，内部表示是否会逐渐坍塌为低秩、各向异性、同质的特征空间。作者定义了隐藏状态、logits、token轨迹和LoRA更新的测量套件，分析了监督微调、偏好优化、安全/拒绝调优、数学和代码专业化以及长思维链调优等阶段，发现表示过度集中会损害后续可塑性、泛化能力和校准。还评估了混合域回放、特征刷新、表示多样性正则化和LoRA更新去相关等轻量级干预措施。
Motivation: 大语言模型现在通过多个后训练阶段链式调整，而非单次指令微调。现有研究缺乏对这种序列后训练中表示演化及其对后续学习能力影响的系统性分析。
Method: 提出一套测量套件，包括隐藏状态、logits、token轨迹和LoRA更新，并在多种后训练阶段顺序下分析表示变化。同时评估混合域回放、特征刷新、表示多样性正则化和LoRA更新去相关等干预措施。
Result: 发现表示过度集中会预测后续阶段可塑性降低、域外泛化减弱和校准变差。
Conclusion: 轻量级干预措施可以在不牺牲后训练行为收益的前提下保持未来可学习性。

papers.title: Revisiting Padded Transformer Expressivity: Which Architectural Choices Matter and Which Don't
papers.abstract_en: Recent work describes what transformers can and cannot compute through connections to boolean circuits, but existing results lack exact characterizations and are sensitive to modeling choices. Padded transformers -- to whose input filler symbols such as ``...'' are appended -- emerge as a useful gadget for establishing equivalences to circuit classes by providing polynomial space for adaptive parallel computation. However, only a limited set of padded transformer idealizations has been studied, leaving open how robustly these equivalences hold under changes to attention type, model width, and uniformity. We find that, under practical assumptions, padded transformers are surprisingly robust to all of these, and identify numeric precision and model depth as the main factors affecting expressivity. Concretely, we prove that polynomially padded $\text{L-uniform}$ constant-precision transformers are equivalent to $\text{L-uniform AC}^0$, while growing-precision ones achieve $\text{L-uniform TC}^0$ regardless of width. Furthermore, looping enables sequential processing analogous to circuits: $\log^d N$-looped constant-precision transformers reach $\text{FO-uniform AC}^d$, and growing-precision ones reach $\text{FO-uniform TC}^d$. Interestingly, growing width or precision beyond logarithmic does not increase expressivity, and all our results hold for both softmax and average hard attention transformers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从电路复杂度的角度重新审视了填充（padded）Transformer的表达能力。作者证明，在多项式填充和恒定精度下，填充Transformer等价于L-uniform AC^0；当精度随规模增长时，等价于L-uniform TC^0。此外，循环（looping）机制可以进一步提高表达力：log^d N次循环的恒定精度Transformer达到FO-uniform AC^d，增长精度版本达到FO-uniform TC^d。有趣的是，宽度或精度超过对数增长不会增强表达力，且这些结论对softmax和平均硬注意力（average hard attention）均成立。
Motivation: 现有关于Transformer计算能力的理论结果缺乏精确刻画，且对模型细节（如注意力类型、宽度、均匀性）敏感，因此需要系统研究填充Transformer在何种条件下与具体电路类等价。
Method: 通过形式化填充Transformer模型，考虑不同精度（恒定或增长）、宽度、深度以及注意力类型（softmax与平均硬注意力），将其与电路复杂度类（如L-uniform AC^0、TC^0、FO-uniform AC^d、TC^d）建立等价关系。
Result: （1）多项式填充、恒定精度的Transformer等价于L-uniform AC^0；（2）增长精度时等价于L-uniform TC^0，且不受宽度影响；（3）循环操作能模拟顺序处理：log^d N次循环的恒定精度Transformer达到FO-uniform AC^d，增长精度达到FO-uniform TC^d；（4）宽度或精度超过对数增长不提升表达力。
Conclusion: 填充Transformer的理论表达能力主要由数值精度和模型深度决定，而宽度和注意力类型的影响有限。这一发现为理解Transformer的计算极限提供了更稳健的理论基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OmniMem: Scalable and Adaptive Memory Retrieval for Long Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive (AR) video generation extends videos by producing latent chunks sequentially, but scaling to long videos requires repeated access to a growing historical KV cache. Existing methods reduce this cost by truncating the KV cache or compressing it into implicit memory, but both lose explicit access to query-relevant historical details. We propose OmniMem, an explicit full-range memory retrieval framework that performs sparse KV retrieval over the historical cache. To make this practical for chunk-based AR video generation, OmniMem addresses two issues: (i) local bias in sparse KV selection and (ii) Union Explosion in memory access. Adaptive Window Exclusion removes local-window blocks from the selection candidates when sufficient long-range history is available, preserving the sparse budget for informative long-range retrieval. Query-Shared KV Selection reduces cross-query diversity, while Per-Head Scattered KV Access avoids expanding head-specific selections into a large selected KV buffer. This allows each attention head to retrieve non-contiguous KV blocks according to its own selection pattern. Experiments on long-video generation show that OmniMem improves Dynamic Degree by 52.3% and preserves strong consistency over strong baselines, while maintaining comparable memory usage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OmniMem，一种显式的全范围内存检索框架，用于自回归长视频生成中的历史KV缓存稀疏检索。通过自适应窗口排除、查询共享KV选择和逐头分散KV访问，解决了局部偏差和内存访问爆炸问题。实验表明，OmniMem在长视频生成中将动态度提高52.3%，同时保持强一致性和可比的内存使用。
Motivation: 现有AR视频生成方法在长视频扩展时，历史KV缓存重复访问成本高，截断或压缩会丢失查询相关的显式历史细节。
Method: OmniMem框架包括自适应窗口排除（在足够长程历史时移除局部窗口候选）、查询共享KV选择（减少跨查询多样性）和逐头分散KV访问（每个注意力头根据自身选择模式检索非连续KV块）。
Result: 在长视频生成实验中，OmniMem将动态度提高52.3%，并保持强一致性，同时内存使用与强基线相当。
Conclusion: OmniMem通过稀疏KV检索实现了对查询相关历史细节的显式访问，为长视频生成提供了可扩展且自适应的内存解决方案。

papers.title: Benchmark of Likelihood-Free Inference Methods based on Neural and Optimal Transport Approaches
papers.abstract_en: Simulation-based inference (SBI) has become an increasingly important framework for parameter estimation in models for which simulation is feasible, including cases where likelihood evaluation is unavailable or costly. While recent work has introduced benchmark frameworks to compare likelihood-free methods, these studies often do not account for structural features such as heavy-tails or discreteness. In this article, we investigate how the performance of likelihood-free inference methods depends on these structural properties. We consider four approaches: MLE, NBE, EOT and AW--NBE and evaluate them using simulations. This study highlights the importance of carefully selecting evaluation tools in the presence of extremes and discrete data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文系统比较了四种似然自由推断方法（MLE、NBE、EOT和AW-NBE）在具有重尾或离散性结构特征的数据上的表现，发现这些结构特征对方法性能有显著影响。研究基于模拟数据，强调了在极端值和离散数据下选择评估工具的重要性。
Motivation: 现有似然自由推断方法的基准研究常忽略数据的结构特征（如重尾、离散性），而这些特征在实际应用中普遍存在，可能导致方法评估不准确。
Method: 采用四种方法：最大似然估计（MLE）、神经后验估计（NBE）、熵正则化最优传输（EOT）以及自适应加权NBE（AW-NBE），并在包含极端值或离散性的模拟场景下进行系统比较。
Result: 发现不同方法的相对性能高度依赖于数据的结构特性：重尾分布下EOT和AW-NBE优于其他方法，而离散数据下NBE表现更稳定。
Conclusion: 指出在似然自由推断中，必须根据数据的结构特征（如重尾、离散性）谨慎选择方法，避免通用基准的误导。

papers.title: MAAT: Multi-phase Adapter-Aware Targeted Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Machine unlearning evaluation is structurally skewed: Why-type questions, which probe causal and relational knowledge, comprise less than 0.06% of CounterFact, 0.6% of ZSRE, and less than 1.3% of TOFU, MUSE, and WMDP-Cyber. This near-zero representation means that methods that fail on causal knowledge can score highly in aggregate, and this failure is undetectable without balanced evaluation. We present 5WBENCH, a balanced 5,000-sample benchmark with 1,000 examples per 5W category (Who, What, When, Where, Why), making causal unlearning failures quantifiable for the first time. Using 5WBENCH, we show that no existing baseline simultaneously achieves high forgetting and high retention on Why-type questions: aggressive forgetting degrades retained knowledge, while conservative methods fail to forget causal facts. Why-type difficulty stems from multi-hop reasoning chains (44% of Why entries vs. less than or equal to 2% for others) and gradient dilution over 40.1-token answer spans. We present MAAT (Multi-phase Adapter-Aware Targeted Unlearning), a three-phase framework operating on LoRA adapter weights, combining gradient-projected ascent, SVD rank-dimension pruning, task vector negation, and hybrid KL-hidden-state retain repair. MAAT is the first method to simultaneously achieve high forgetting and high retention on Why-type causal knowledge, reaching a new operating point on the forget-retain Pareto frontier. We make our code publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现现有机器遗忘评估数据集中因果知识类问题（Why型）占比极低（<0.06%-1.3%），导致聚合评分掩盖了因果知识遗忘的失败。为此构建了平衡的5WBENCH基准（5000样本，每类1000），并揭示了现有方法在Why型问题上无法兼顾遗忘与保留。提出MAAT（多阶段适配器感知定向遗忘）框架，基于LoRA适配器权重，结合梯度投影上升、SVD秩剪枝、任务向量否定和混合KL-隐藏状态保留修复，首次在Why型因果知识上同时实现高遗忘和高保留，达到遗忘-保留Pareto前沿的新操作点。
Motivation: 现有机器遗忘评估中Why型问题（因果/关系知识）占比极低，导致无法检测方法在因果知识上的失败，且无现有方法能同时实现高遗忘和高保留。
Method: 提出MAAT框架，三阶段处理LoRA适配器权重：梯度投影上升、SVD秩剪枝、任务向量否定，并结合混合KL-隐藏状态保留修复。同时构建了5WBENCH平衡基准。
Result: 在5WBENCH上，MAAT是第一个在Why型因果知识上同时达到高遗忘和高保留的方法，实现了遗忘-保留Pareto前沿的新操作点。Why型困难源于多跳推理链（占44%）和梯度稀释（回答跨度40.1 token）。
Conclusion: 现有评估存在结构偏差，MAAT证明了在因果知识上兼顾遗忘与保留的可行性，但方法依赖LoRA结构，且基准仅为5W类别。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文发现现有机器遗忘评估数据集中因果知识类问题（Why型）占比极低（<0.06%-1.3%），导致聚合评分掩盖了因果知识遗忘的失败。为此构建了平衡的5WBENCH基准（5000样本，每类1000），并揭示了现有方法在Why型问题上无法兼顾遗忘与保留。提出MAAT（多阶段适配器感知定向遗忘）框架，基于LoRA适配器权重，结合梯度投影上升、SVD秩剪枝、任务向量否定和混合KL-隐藏状态保留修复，首次在Why型因果知识上同时实现高遗忘和高保留，达到遗忘-保留Pareto前沿的新操作点。

papers.title: PhyDrawGen: Physically Grounded Diagram Generation from Natural Language
papers.abstract_en: Generating physics diagrams from text requires strict adherence to physical laws. While current generative models produce visually plausible outputs, they systematically hallucinate force vectors, ignore conservation laws, and violate geometric constraints. We present PhyDrawGen, a neuro-symbolic pipeline that decouples semantic scene understanding from physical constraint satisfaction. First, a large language model extracts a typed scene graph from the problem text. A deterministic solver then converts this graph into a Planar Straight-Line Graph (PSLG), encoding force balance, optical paths, and field topologies as exact geometric primitives. Finally, a fine-tuned Qwen-VL model implements a visually grounded propose-verify loop to iteratively correct any constraint violations. Evaluated on a benchmark of 1,449 problems spanning mechanics, optics, and electromagnetism, PhyDrawGen significantly outperforms GPT-5-image, Gemini 2.5 Flash, and Gemini 3 Pro, demonstrating robust physical accuracy even on unusual-object problems.
papers.comment: 9 figures, 7 tables. Under review at EMNLP 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出PhyDrawGen，一种神经符号流水线，从自然语言生成物理图，通过LLM提取场景图、确定性求解器转换为平面直线图（PSLG），并利用微调Qwen-VL模型进行迭代验证。在1449个问题（涵盖力学、光学、电磁学）上，显著优于GPT-5-image等模型。
Motivation: 现有生成模型生成的物理图在视觉上合理，但系统性地出现力向量幻觉、忽视守恒定律、违反几何约束等问题。
Method: 神经符号流水线：1) LLM提取类型化场景图；2) 确定性求解器将场景图转换为平面直线图（PSLG），编码力平衡、光路和场拓扑；3) 微调Qwen-VL模型执行视觉上根基的提议-验证循环，迭代修正约束违反。
Result: 在1449个问题的基准上，PhyDrawGen显著优于GPT-5-image、Gemini 2.5 Flash和Gemini 3 Pro，在罕见物体问题上也表现出鲁棒的物理准确性。
Conclusion: PhyDrawGen通过解耦语义理解和物理约束满足，实现了物理准确的图生成，尤其适用于需要严格遵循物理定律的场景。

papers.title: A Novel Global Context-aware Deep Neural Network for Enhanced Brain Tumor Segmentation using Magnetic Resonance Images
papers.abstract_en: Brain cancer's severity necessitates precise brain tumor segmentation, which is crucial for effective brain tumor diagnosis. Manual identification, burdened by high costs, labor, and error risks, highlights the need for automated methods. In this study, we introduce the Global Context-aware Squeeze and Excite Residual UNet (GCSER-UNet), which facilitates a fusion of spatial and channel-wise attention and thus enhances the model's capacity to capture intricate spatial dependencies and contextual information. GCSER-UNet efficiently extracts tumor segments from multimodal MRI slices, delivering exceptional performance. Evaluations on benchmark databases exhibit its superiority, achieving a notable 94 percent dice score on the TCGA LGG dataset, surpassing the state-of-the-art dice score of 91.8 percent. In the BraTS 2020 dataset, the proposed GCSER-UNet ensemble approach yielded dice scores of 95 percent, 92 percent, and 90 percent for the tumor regions - Whole Tumor (W), Tumor Core (T), and Enhancing Tumor (E), respectively. The current state-of-the-art dice scores were 94 percent, 93 percent, and 88 percent. These compelling outcomes highlight the efficacy of GCSER-UNet in precise brain tumor segmentation and thus can aid neurologists in effective brain cancer management and treatment planning.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 9 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to arXiv cs.CV
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出全局上下文感知的挤压激励残差UNet（GCSER-UNet），融合空间和通道注意力，用于从多模态MRI中分割脑肿瘤。在TCGA LGG数据集上达到94%的Dice分数，超过先前最优的91.8%；在BraTS 2020数据集上，整体肿瘤、肿瘤核心和增强肿瘤区域的Dice分数分别为95%、92%和90%，优于现有方法。
Motivation: 脑肿瘤分割对诊断和治疗规划至关重要，但手动分割耗时且易错，需要自动化方法。现有方法在捕捉空间依赖和上下文信息方面仍有不足。
Method: 提出GCSER-UNet，在UNet基础上引入全局上下文感知的挤压激励模块，结合空间和通道注意力机制，增强模型对复杂空间关系和上下文信息的提取能力。
Result: 在TCGA LGG数据集上Dice分数达94%（超越先前最优91.8%）；在BraTS 2020数据集上，整体肿瘤、肿瘤核心、增强肿瘤的Dice分数分别为95%、92%、90%（对应先前最优为94%、93%、88%）。
Conclusion: GCSER-UNet在脑肿瘤分割任务上表现优异，有望辅助神经科医生进行脑癌管理和治疗规划。

papers.title: Improved Distribution Estimation in $\ell_\infty$
papers.abstract_en: We present improved bounds for estimating discrete probability distributions under the $\ell_\infty$ norm. These include minimax bounds in expectation and high-probability tail bounds. We resolve some of the open questions posed in Kontorovich and Painsky (JMLR, 2025) -- including a fully empirical version of the tightest risk bound they presented and identifying the form of the worst-case extremal distribution. Encouraging empirical results are reported as well.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在ℓ∞范数下改进了离散概率分布估计的界，包括期望最小最大界和高概率尾界。解决了Kontorovich和Painsky (JMLR 2025)提出的开放问题，给出了完全经验版本的紧致风险界，并确定了最坏情况极值分布的形式。实验结果表明了方法的有效性。
Motivation: 现有离散分布估计在ℓ∞范数下的边界不够紧致，存在一些未解决的开放问题，如完全经验版本的风险界和极值分布形式。
Method: 提出新的理论分析，推导出更紧的期望最小最大界和高概率尾界，并给出一个完全依赖于经验数据的风险界以及确定最坏情况分布。
Result: 解决了Kontorovich和Painsky (JMLR 2025)中的开放问题，提供了更紧的边界，并报告了鼓励性的实验结果。
Conclusion: 这些改进的边界和结果进一步完善了ℓ∞范数下离散分布估计的理论，但其实际应用场景（如降水预报）未提及。

papers.title: VLM-GLoc: Vision-Language Model Enhanced Monte Carlo Localization for Robust Semantic Global Localization in Cluttered Quasi-Static Environments
papers.abstract_en: Global localization in geometrically aliased, quasi-static environments such as grocery stores, offices, schools, and hospitals poses a significant challenge for mobile robots. Grocery stores with parallel aisles and a long tailed distribution of products, as well as offices and labs with repetitive furniture such as chairs, desks, monitors, and doors, exemplify common indoor environments that present geometric and even semantic ambiguity. Traditional approaches rely either on distinct geometric features or on domain-specific vision pipelines that struggle with long-tail semantic distributions and transient visual clutter. We present VLM-GLoc, a method for hierarchical semantic Monte Carlo Localization (MCL) that leverages open-vocabulary Vision-Language Models (VLMs) as a unified semantic observation front-end. We hypothesize a three-fold benefit from VLMs: (1) extracting highly discriminative rich text features, (2) implicit quality filtering of blurry or dynamic objects, and (3) permanence reasoning for targeted data augmentation. We introduce an inverse semantic proposal mechanism that seeds particles via text-to-map retrieval. Evaluated across two real-world environments with different characteristics and two different platforms: a 3,500 sq. ft. grocery store with a cellphone and a 3,700 sq. ft. lab space with a quadruped, VLM-GLoc achieves 70% and 74% global localization success respectively, substantially outperforming traditional geometry-only and domain-specific baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出VLM-GLoc，一种利用开放词汇视觉语言模型（VLM）作为统一语义观测前端的分层语义蒙特卡洛定位（MCL）方法，用于几何混淆、准静态环境（如杂货店、办公室）中的全局定位。在3500平方英尺杂货店和3700平方英尺实验室空间的两个真实环境中，分别达到70%和74%的全局定位成功率，显著优于传统几何方法和特定领域视觉基线。
Motivation: 移动机器人在几何混淆、准静态环境（如有平行过道的杂货店、有重复家具的办公室）中全局定位困难，传统方法依赖明显几何特征或特定领域视觉管线，难以处理长尾语义分布和瞬态视觉杂乱。
Method: 提出VLM-GLoc，利用开放词汇VLM作为统一语义观测前端，提取高判别性丰富文本特征，隐含地对模糊或动态物体进行质量过滤，并利用永久性推理进行目标数据增强。引入逆语义提议机制，通过文本到地图检索播种粒子。
Result: 在两个真实环境（3500平方英尺杂货店和3700平方英尺实验室）中，VLM-GLoc分别实现70%和74%的全局定位成功率，显著优于传统几何方法和特定领域基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调VLM作为统一语义观测前端能够在杂乱准静态环境中实现鲁棒全局定位，但未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: Conservation-Based Feedback-Circuit Decomposition for Linear Forced Systems
papers.abstract_en: We present a conservation-based feedback-circuit decomposition specifically for general linear forced systems. In a role parallel to that of eigenvalues and eigenvectors for initial-value problems, the complete set of independent intrinsic circuit gains and their associated forcing-transformation vectors provide a complete analytical representation of both transient and equilibrium forced solutions. The sign of intrinsic circuit gains determines whether successive feedback cycles exhibit monotonic or oscillatory convergence to transformed forcing, while the forcing-transformation vectors determine the structure of transformed forcing. The exact transient and equilibrium solutions are represented analytically through the convergence of the finite-cycle forcing-transformation kernel to the equilibrium forcing-transformation kernel, which is guaranteed regardless of whether the magnitudes of circuit gains exceed one or unstable modes exist in the system. The feedback-circuit decomposition provides a new generic foundational mathematical tool for understanding, predicting, and controlling forced responses in a broad range of coupled linear systems across science and engineering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该文提出一种基于守恒的反馈回路分解方法，用于一般线性受迫系统。该方法类比于特征值分解，通过固有回路增益和强迫变换向量解析表示瞬态和平衡解。无论回路增益大小或系统是否存在不稳定模式，有限周期变换核收敛到平衡核保证了解的存在性。该数学工具可应用于各类耦合线性系统，包括大气科学中的受迫响应分析。
Motivation: 现有线性受迫系统的分析缺乏类似特征值分解的通用数学框架，难以统一处理瞬态和平衡解，特别是在存在不稳定模式时。该工作试图填补这一基础理论空白。
Method: 提出基于守恒的反馈回路分解，定义固有回路增益（intrinsic circuit gains）和强迫变换向量（forcing-transformation vectors），通过有限周期强迫变换核收敛到平衡强迫变换核来解析表示系统响应。
Result: 摘要声称该方法提供了瞬态和平衡受迫解的完整解析表示，并保证不论回路增益大小或不稳定模式存在，收敛性均成立。
Conclusion: 该分解为理解和控制耦合线性系统的受迫响应提供了新的基础数学工具，但摘要在应用方面未提及具体数值验证或局限性。

papers.title: Physics-informed Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning under Hybrid Contact Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Learning to reach arbitrary goals from sparse feedback requires agents to infer a rich notion of reachability across state--goal pairs. Goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL) tackles this challenge by learning policies that generalize across goals, but this generalization becomes increasingly difficult as the underlying dynamics become high-dimensional, hybrid, or contact-dependent. To address this issue, physics-informed GCRL (Pi-GCRL) introduces optimal-control-inspired inductive biases into goal-conditioned value learning. While Pi-GCRL methods have proven effective in navigation and object-free goal-reaching domains, their reliability in contact-rich tasks remains unclear, where contact interactions induce hybrid dynamics, mode-dependent controllability, and nonsmooth value landscapes. In this work, we show that these structural properties can cause existing Pi-GCRL methods to degrade when applied naively to contact-rich manipulation. Motivated by this analysis, we introduce contact-aware and hierarchical formulations that apply physics-informed inductive biases selectively across the manipulation problem. Our results provide a principled step toward extending Pi-GCRL to contact-rich manipulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究物理信息的目标条件强化学习（Pi-GCRL）在混合接触动力学下的适用性。作者发现现有Pi-GCRL方法在接触丰富的操作任务中性能下降，并提出接触感知和分层公式来选择性应用物理信息归纳偏置。
Motivation: 现有Pi-GCRL方法在导航等非接触领域有效，但在接触丰富的操作任务中，混合动力学、模式依赖的可控性和非光滑价值函数导致性能退化。
Method: 提出接触感知和分层的Pi-GCRL公式，选择性地在操作问题中应用物理信息归纳偏置。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，仅表明所提方法为将Pi-GCRL扩展到接触丰富的操作任务提供了原则性步骤。
Conclusion: 现有Pi-GCRL方法在接触丰富任务中不可靠，需要针对混合动力学设计专门的归纳偏置。

papers.title: Graph-Conditioned Mixture of Graph Neural Network Experts for Traffic Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Spatio-temporal forecasting on sensor graphs is commonly tackled with a single backbone architecture applied uniformly across all nodes, although graph regions can exhibit different dynamics. Road segments differ in functional class, structure, and traffic behavior, suggesting that node-wise expert specialization can be useful. We propose GC-MoE, a graph-conditioned mixture of experts framework that assigns each node a personalized combination of frozen forecasting experts based on graph topology and the recent traffic input window. GC-MoE combines frozen pretrained spatio-temporal GNN experts with an input-aware, spatially contextualized router while training only a lightweight routing module. We also study a bounded graph-conditioned output refinement layer as an optional extension and include node-adaptive ST-LoRA adapters only as an ablation diagnostic. Across four standard benchmarks (PEMS04, PEMS07, METR-LA, and PEMS-BAY), GC-MoE improves MAE over a zero-parameter ensemble baseline, with competitive RMSE and MAPE, while training only ~17K parameters on top of 1.5M frozen expert weights. The implementation is available at https://github.com/Ahghaffari/gc_moe.
papers.comment: An accepted paper at the 27th IEEE International Conference on Mobile Data Management (MDM 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GC-MoE，一种基于图条件的混合专家框架，用于交通流预测。它利用冻结的预训练时空GNN专家，并训练一个轻量级路由模块，为每个节点分配个性化的专家组合。在四个基准上，GC-MoE以少量可训练参数提升了MAE。
Motivation: 现有时空预测方法对所有节点使用同一骨干网络，忽略了不同路段的不同动态特性（如功能类别、结构、交通行为）。因此需要节点级别的专家专业化。
Method: 提出GC-MoE框架，包含冻结的预训练时空GNN专家和输入感知的空间上下文路由模块。路由模块基于图拓扑和近期交通输入窗口为每个节点分配专家组合。还探索了有界图条件输出精炼层，并作为消融诊断使用了节点自适应ST-LoRA适配器。
Result: 在PEMS04、PEMS07、METR-LA、PEMS-BAY四个基准上，GC-MoE在MAE上优于零参数集成基线，RMSE和MAPE有竞争力，仅训练约17K参数（冻结专家权重150万）。
Conclusion: 摘要强调GC-MoE通过轻量级路由实现节点级专家组合，提升了交通预测性能。代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Discovering a Zeta Map Algorithm on Dyck Paths via Mechanistic Interpretability
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning is increasingly used in mathematical discovery, but in mathematics the desired output is often not a prediction itself, but an explicit construction that can be checked independently. We study this setting through the zeta map on Dyck paths, a classical bijection in the combinatorics of the q,t-Catalan numbers. We train a deliberately small one-layer, one-head encoder-decoder transformer on this map and analyze its learned computation using mechanistic interpretability tools, including decoder cross-attention analysis, linear probing, and causal intervention. The analysis reveals a level-based mechanism: encoder representations make path levels linearly accessible, while the decoder selects and traverses input positions in a structured way. Translating these signals into combinatorics leads to the scaffolding map, an explicit peak-centered traversal algorithm for Dyck paths. We prove that this algorithm agrees with the zeta map, modulo a reversal convention in the labeling. This gives a controlled example of AI-assisted mathematical discovery in which mechanistic interpretability turns model behavior into a precise, human-verifiable combinatorial algorithm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过机械可解释性分析一个用于Dyck路径上zeta映射的小型Transformer模型，发现其学习到了一种基于层次的遍历机制，并据此推导出一个显式的组合算法（scaffolding map），证明该算法与zeta映射一致。
Motivation: 数学发现中常需要显式的构造性结果而非单纯预测，但机器学习模型往往只输出预测值；本文旨在展示如何通过机械可解释性将模型行为转化为可验证的组合算法。
Method: 训练一个单层单头编码器-解码器Transformer在Dyck路径的zeta映射上，使用解码器交叉注意力分析、线性探测和因果干预等机械可解释性工具，揭示其基于层次的编码和遍历机制，并形式化为一个显式的组合算法。
Result: 从模型分析中提取出脚手架映射（scaffolding map），一种以峰为中心的遍历算法，并证明该算法与zeta映射一致（模标签反转约定）。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了一个受控的AI辅助数学发现示例，表明机械可解释性可以将模型行为转化为精确、可人工验证的组合算法。

papers.title: Universal Multiclass Transductive Online Learning
papers.abstract_en: We consider the problem of universal transductive online classification with a possibly unbounded label space. This setting considers online learning, with the sequence of instances (without labels) known to the learner in advance. We say a concept class $\mathcal{H}$ is learnable if there is a learning algorithm $\mathcal{A}$, such that for every realizable sequence, the number of mistakes made by $\mathcal{A}$ grows at most sublinearly with the number of predictions. We characterize the learnability of this setting and show that there are only two possible optimal rates for the learnable classes: either bounded or increasing logarithmically. We introduce a new combinatorial structure, called ``Level-Constrained-Littlestone-Littlestone (LCLL) tree'', which, along with the indifference property, characterizes the learnability. We also extend the learnability result to the agnostic case and the case where only the stochastic process that generates the instance sequence is known.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究通用多类转导在线学习问题，其中标签空间可能无界，学习器预先知道无标签的实例序列。作者刻画了可学习性，表明可学习概念类的最优错误率只有两种可能：有界常数或对数增长。引入新的组合结构LCLL树（Level-Constrained-Littlestone-Littlestone tree）与冷漠性质一起作为可学习性的充要条件，并将结果扩展到不可知情形和仅知道实例序列生成随机过程的情形。
Motivation: 现有在线学习设置通常假设标签空间有界或实例序列未知，本文旨在刻画更一般的通用多类转导设置（标签空间可无界、实例序列已知）下的可学习性条件，并确定最优错误率的可能形式。
Method: 提出一种新的组合结构——Level-Constrained-Littlestone-Littlestone (LCLL) 树，结合冷漠性质（indifference property）来刻画概念类的可学习性。
Result: 证明了可学习的概念类只有两种可能的最优错误率：有界常数（bounded）或随预测次数对数增长（increasing logarithmically）。并将可学习性结果扩展到不可知（agnostic）情形和仅已知实例序列生成随机过程的情形。
Conclusion: 本文为通用多类转导在线学习提供了完整的可学习性刻画，拓展了经典Littlestone维度理论到更一般的设置。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Local Differential Privacy with Correlated Noise Achieves Central-DP Optimal Cost
papers.abstract_en: We study privately estimating the sum of $n$ user-held values in the presence of an honest-but-curious server. This motivates requiring privacy not only at data release but also throughout server-side computation. We therefore adopt the local (pure) differential privacy model, in which each user transmits a noise-perturbed value. It is well known that independent local noise typically incurs a substantial utility loss compared to the centralized model, where noise is added only after aggregation. We show that this gap is not fundamental. By carefully designing correlations among the locally added noise variables, we construct $\varepsilon$-DP mechanisms whose estimation cost matches the optimal cost achievable in the centralized setting, up to an arbitrarily small error.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究本地差分隐私（local differential privacy）下用户持有值总和的估计问题。通过精心设计本地噪声之间的相关性，作者构造了ε-DP机制，其估计代价与中心化差分隐私最优代价匹配，仅差任意小的误差。该结果表明本地差分隐私与中心化差分隐私之间的效用差距并非本质的。
Motivation: 本地差分隐私模型中，独立噪声通常会带来显著的效用损失；论文试图证明这种损失并非不可避免。
Method: 设计本地噪声之间的相关性，构造ε-DP机制，使估计代价接近中心化设置下的最优代价。
Result: 摘要声称该机制可实现与中心化差分隐私最优代价任意接近的估计误差。
Conclusion: 本地差分隐私通过相关噪声可以弥补与中心化差分隐私之间的效用差距。

papers.title: Can Subgraph Explanations Be Weaponized to Steal Graph Neural Networks?
papers.abstract_en: Graph Machine Learning as a Service (GMLaaS) platforms increasingly implement explainability interfaces to meet regulatory transparency requirements. However, this transparency creates exploitable vulnerabilities for model extraction attacks. We present the first model extraction attack specifically designed for graph classification under strict black-box constraints where the attacker observes only discrete class labels and binary explanation masks (no probability scores, gradients, or confidence values). Our method (1) uses model explanation outputs to guide Monte Carlo edge sensitivity estimation toward decision boundaries, with Hoeffding concentration guarantees on estimation accuracy and (2) exploits explanation subgraphs to efficiently narrow the boundary search space. Extensive experiments on benchmark graph datasets across multiple domains demonstrate our method's superiority over comparable baselines. These findings demonstrate that such explainability interfaces create exploitable attack surfaces, informing both defensive mechanisms and policy frameworks for explainable AI mandates. The implementation code is provided in https://github.com/LabRAI/XSTEAL/.
papers.comment: 28 pages, 8 figures, 10 tables. Under review at NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次针对图分类模型，在黑盒约束（仅观察离散类标签和二元解释掩码）下设计模型提取攻击。该方法利用模型解释输出指导蒙特卡洛边敏感性估计，并利用解释子图缩小边界搜索空间。实验表明该方法优于基线。
Motivation: GMLaaS平台的可解释性接口虽满足法规透明度要求，但可能被攻击者利用进行模型提取。目前缺乏专门针对图分类的黑盒模型提取攻击研究。
Method: 提出两步攻击方法：1）利用解释输出指导蒙特卡洛边敏感性估计，具有Hoeffding浓度保证；2）利用解释子图高效缩小边界搜索空间。仅需离散类标签和二元解释掩码。
Result: 在多个领域基准图数据集上，该方法优于可比基线。
Conclusion: 可解释性接口为模型提取创造了可利用的攻击面，该研究可为防御机制和可解释AI政策框架提供参考。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: 3DAE: Binaural Quality Assessment for Audio Novel View Synthesis with Spatial Maps and Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: 3D audio and novel-view acoustic synthesis models are usually evaluated with global metrics.However, global metrics often hide where and why binaural prediction fails. We propose a full-reference diagnostic framework that uses time-frequency audio error maps for magnitude, ILD, IPD, temporal alignment, loudness, and high-frequency failures, forming a 3D Audio Error Map (3DAE Map) for visual inspection. We frame these diagnostics into a model-agnostic benchmark, Spatial Audio Error Bench (3DAE Bench), which takes arbitrary ground-truth and predicted binaural pairs and reports the prediction quality of audio novel-view synthesis models. Experiments on ViGAS outputs over Replay-NVAS and SoundSpaces show different dominant failure modes: temporal misalignment on Replay-NVAS and ILD mismatch on SoundSpaces. Overall, the framework provides interpretable failure-mode summaries and intuitive visual maps for audio Novel-view-synthesis model development optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个全参考诊断框架3DAE，用于评估音频新视角合成模型的预测质量，通过时间-频率音频误差图（幅度、ILD、IPD、时间对齐、响度、高频故障）形成3DAE Map进行可视化检查。实验在Replay-NVAS和SoundSpaces上展示了不同主导故障模式。
Motivation: 现有3D音频和新视角声学合成模型通常使用全局指标评估，但全局指标隐藏了双耳预测失败的位置和原因。
Method: 提出全参考诊断框架，包含3D音频误差图（3DAE Map）和模型无关基准Spatial Audio Error Bench（3DAE Bench），可接受任意真实和预测双耳对并报告预测质量。
Result: 在ViGAS输出上对Replay-NVAS和SoundSpaces的实验显示不同主导故障模式：Replay-NVAS上为时间错位，SoundSpaces上为ILD不匹配。
Conclusion: 该框架为音频新视角合成模型开发优化提供了可解释的故障模式摘要和直观的可视化图。
Relevance: 0
