papers.title: Clustering Guided Domain-Specific Pretrained Foundation Model Very High-Resolution Arctic Remote Sensing
papers.abstract_en: This study introduces a novel Arctic-focused remote sensing foundation model (RSFM) by combining diversity-aware regional-scale image curation with masked autoencoder (MAE) self-supervised pretraining of a Vision Transformer (ViT) encoder for very-high-spatial-resolution (VHSR) satellite image analysis. Spectral and acquisition-metadata descriptors were used in a scalable affinity-propagation clustering workflow to select approximately 3 million chips from 267 TB of Vantor VHSR imagery This curation strategy was designed to reduce oversampling of visually repetitive or low-information areas while preserving broad scene diversity across the study domain. We pretrained a ViT-Large encoder on the curated corpus using a domain-adapted MAE reconstruction objective, producing Arctic-specific transformer weights for downstream feature mapping. The pretrained encoder was integrated into an existing location-aware detection and segmentation framework and evaluated across four hand-labeled Arctic datasets. Compared to ImageNet-initialized ViT-Large baseline, Arctic MAE pretraining produced consistent improvements in foreground mean F1 scores of 0.87, 0.72, 0.93, and 0.87, for infrastructure, IWP, RTS, and TCNs, with approximately 5-8 percentage increase. The proposed model also outperformed Prithvi-EO-2.0 in all downstream comparisons, with the smallest gain corresponding to at least a 15 percentage improvement mean F1, suggesting that domain-specific self-supervised pretraining on curated Arctic VHSR imagery provides more transferable representations for fine-scale Arctic mapping than a general-purpose Earth observation foundation model. These results demonstrate that optimizing the pretraining data distribution at regional scale, while keeping the architecture and MAE objective fixed, can produce a reusable Arctic-domain encoder for multiple VHSR remote sensing applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个面向北极地区的高空间分辨率遥感基础模型，通过亲和传播聚类（affinity-propagation clustering）从267 TB Vantar影像中筛选约300万块图像块，并用域适应的掩码自编码器（MAE）预训练ViT-Large编码器。在四个标注的北极数据集上，该模型相比ImageNet初始化的ViT基线在前景平均F1分数上提升了5-8个百分点，并显著优于通用地球观测基础模型Prithvi-EO-2.0（提升至少15个百分点）。
Motivation: 现有遥感基础模型多针对全球尺度或中低分辨率影像，缺乏针对北极极高分辨率（VHSR）影像的域特定预训练，且通用模型在北极地物细粒度映射中表征迁移能力不足。
Method: 采用可扩展的亲和传播聚类，利用光谱和采集元数据描述符筛选多样化图像块，构建约300万块的域内预训练语料；在此基础上使用域适应的MAE目标预训练ViT-Large编码器，得到北极域特定变压器权重。

Conclusion: 摘要强调，保持架构和MAE目标不变，仅优化区域尺度的预训练数据分布即可获得可复用的北极域编码器，为极高分辨率遥感应用提供更可迁移的表征。

papers.title: idSCD: Identifying Training Datasets through Semantic Correlation Descriptors
papers.abstract_en: Can a dataset be recognized from the spurious correlations it induces during training? We argue that datasets leave dataset-specific traces in a model's learned semantic correlation structure: incidental regularities that are predictive within a dataset, but not causal for the underlying task, can be internalized during training. We use this insight to study dataset-level membership inference, moving beyond existing methods that rely on behavioral or distributional evidence such as confidence scores, losses, margins, generated samples, or query responses. We introduce a white-box semantic fingerprinting approach based on semantic correlation descriptors (SCDs), which capture the semantic correlation structure learned by a model and make it comparable across dataset mixtures. In a controlled leave-one-dataset-out diagnostic, SCDs recover dataset-specific changes and perfectly separate matching from non-matching dataset pairs. We then propose a practical SCD-based membership score that tests whether a target dataset is part of a model's training mixture using only the model's SCD and the target dataset's standalone SCD, without requiring leave-one-dataset-out models. Across three diverse experimental settings, with dataset groups for natural language inference, emotion classification, and medical text classification, we test both the advantages and limitations of SCD-based membership inference with different degrees of semantic separation and keyword support between dataset splits. On average, the classifier based on this score achieves the highest performance and the lowest std, outperforming black-box baselines RMIA, Attack-P, and LiRA, as well as the white-box SIF baseline. These results show that dataset membership can be traced through internal semantic correlations, with the largest relative gain exceeding 60% in ROC-AUC when dataset groups expose distinct semantic particularities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于语义相关描述符（SCD）的白盒方法，用于识别训练数据集中是否包含特定数据集。通过分析模型学习到的语义相关结构，SCD能够捕捉数据集特有的痕迹，并在多个基准上优于现有黑盒和白盒方法。
Motivation: 现有成员推理方法多依赖置信度、损失等行为或分布证据，而忽略了数据集在模型语义相关结构上留下的特有痕迹。本文旨在填补这一空白，探索从语义相关性角度进行数据集级成员推断。
Method: 提出语义相关描述符（SCD），通过提取模型内部的语义相关结构，并使其在不同数据集混合下可比较。设计基于SCD的成员评分函数，利用目标数据集的独立SCD和模型SCD进行测试，无需留一法模型。
Result: 在自然语言推理、情感分类和医学文本分类三个实验设置中，基于SCD的分类器平均性能最高、标准差最低，优于RMIA、Attack-P、LiRA和SIF基线，在数据集组具有明显语义特性时，ROC-AUC相对提升超过60%。
Conclusion: 数据集成员属性可以通过内部语义相关性追踪，该方法在语义分离度高的场景下优势显著，但依赖于数据集间的语义差异程度。

papers.title: Scalable Constrained Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning via State Augmentation and Consensus for Separable Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: We present a distributed approach for constrained Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) that combines state-augmented policy learning with distributed consensus over dual variables. Our method targets systems where agents have separable dynamics but must coordinate to satisfy global resource constraints, a setting in which, as we demonstrate empirically, independent learning fails to produce feasible solutions because agents cannot determine appropriate individual contributions toward collective constraint satisfaction. The key technical contribution is showing that lightweight neighbor-to-neighbor consensus over Lagrange multipliers suffices for globally coordinated constraint enforcement while preserving the scalability of independent training. Each agent learns a single augmented policy offline, conditioned on both its local state and a dual variable encoding constraint feedback. During execution, agents reach agreement on this dual variable through local communication alone. We prove that under mild connectivity assumptions, the consensus error among agents' multipliers is bounded, and show that this translates to a bounded constraint violation that decreases with graph connectivity and the number of consensus rounds. Unlike centralized training with decentralized execution (CTDE) approaches, whose complexity grows at least quadratically with agent count, our method scales linearly in both training and execution. Experiments on smart grid demand response demonstrate that consensus coordination is \emph{essential for feasibility}: without it, agents satisfy grid capacity constraints only by indefinitely postponing demand, a degenerate non-solution. With consensus, agents converge to a shared dual variable and satisfy both grid constraints and demand fulfillment, scaling to thousands of agents while CTDE baselines are limited to dozens.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种分布式约束多智能体强化学习方法，通过状态增强策略学习与对偶变量分布式共识相结合，解决具有可分离动力学但需满足全局资源约束的系统。实验表明，该方法在智能电网需求响应场景中能够扩展到数千个智能体，而集中训练分散执行（CTDE）基线仅能处理数十个。
Motivation: 在约束多智能体强化学习中，独立学习无法满足全局约束，而CTDE方法复杂度随智能体数量平方增长，可扩展性差。
Method: 每个智能体学习一个增强策略，输入包括局部状态和编码约束反馈的对偶变量；通过轻量级邻居间共识算法使对偶变量达成一致，实现在线约束协调。
Result: 证明在弱连通性假设下，对偶变量共识误差有界，并导致有界的约束违反；实验显示共识协调对可行性至关重要，方法可扩展到数千智能体，而CTDE基线限于数十个。
Conclusion: 该方法通过分布式共识实现线性可扩展的约束MARL，适用于智能电网等大规模系统。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DisjunctiveNet: Neural Symbolic Learning via Differentiable Convexified Optimization Layers
papers.abstract_en: Many learning tasks in science and engineering are characterized by sparse datasets, which limits the effectiveness of purely data-driven approaches. At the same time, these problems are often accompanied by rich domain knowledge derived from physical laws, operational requirements, and expert heuristics. Such knowledge is frequently expressed as rules involving logical propositions and linear inequalities. Existing neuro-symbolic methods typically enforce these rules approximately through soft penalties, assume input-independent rules when designing specialized architectures, or rely on non-differentiable post-processing at inference time to achieve hard constraint satisfaction. While recent advances in differentiable optimization layers enable end-to-end feasibility enforcement within neural networks, extending these approaches to logical or mixed-integer rules remains challenging due to inherent nonconvexity. In this work, we propose a unified end-to-end framework for enforcing hard, input-dependent mixed integer linear constraints within neural networks. Our approach represents rules as disjunctive constraints and applies hierarchical convex relaxations to obtain convex hull formulations. These relaxations yield tractable linear constraints that can be embedded as differentiable optimization layers while enabling exact rule satisfaction. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework on real-world datasets, achieving perfect rule satisfaction and strong predictive performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DisjunctiveNet，一种端到端神经符号学习框架，通过可微凸优化层在神经网络中强制执行硬输入依赖混合整数线性约束。方法将规则表示为析取约束，应用层次凸松弛得到凸包，嵌入为可微层，实现精确规则满足。在真实数据集上达到完美规则满足和强预测性能。
Motivation: 稀疏数据集限制了纯数据驱动方法，而领域知识常以逻辑命题和线性不等式规则形式存在。现有神经符号方法存在软惩罚近似、假设输入无关规则或非可微后处理等问题，且将可微优化层扩展到逻辑或混合整数规则面临非凸性挑战。
Method: 提出统一端到端框架，将规则表示为析取约束，应用层次凸松弛得到凸包公式，这些松弛产生可处理的线性约束，可嵌入为可微优化层，同时实现精确规则满足。
Result: 在真实数据集上实现完美规则满足和强预测性能。
Conclusion: 该方法在真实数据集上实现了完美的规则满足和强预测性能，为神经符号学习提供了一种新的端到端硬约束方案。

papers.title: The Surface You Test Is Not the Surface That Breaks
papers.abstract_en: Tool-augmented LLM agents are vulnerable to prompt injection: a third party who controls part of the agent's context can plant instructions that the agent then executes as if they came from the user. Current evaluations report a single attack success rate per model on one channel, the tool output and treat that number as the model's vulnerability. But tool descriptions, which the agent reads at every turn before any tool is called, are themselves an injection surface that the attacker can choose instead. We hold the injection payload byte-identical and deliver it through both surfaces across 13 LLMs from six families and four task suites. The same bytes invert in success rate across models: GPT-4.1 is 96 percent vulnerable on tool outputs but only 4 percent on tool descriptions, while GEMINI-3-FLASH shows the mirror pattern at 20 percent and 98 percent. A variance decomposition over 6,830 attempts attributes 0 percent of the variation in attack outcomes to the surface alone, while the model-surface interaction accounts for 16.7 percent. Vulnerability is a property of the pairing, not the channel. The Adaptive Attack Rate, defined as the per-cell maximum over surfaces, exceeds the strongest fixed-surface baseline by +9.1 percentage points on average. Standard prompt-level defenses inherit the same blindspot, reducing tool-output ASR to 10-18 percent while leaving the description channel above 54 percent. Both attack and defense evaluation must report per-surface vulnerability.
papers.comment: 8 Figures, 8 Tables, Under Review at EMNLP
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示工具增强LLM智能体在提示注入漏洞评估中的一个盲点：当前评估仅报告单一攻击表面（工具输出）的成功率，但工具描述同样可被攻击者利用。通过对13个LLM在6个系列和4个任务套件上进行6830次攻击实验，发现攻击成功率取决于模型与表面的配对，而非表面本身；模型与表面的交互效应解释了16.7%的变异。作者提出自适应攻击率（Adaptive Attack Rate）作为更全面的评估指标，并指出现有防御措施继承相同盲点。
Motivation: 现有工具增强LLM智能体的提示注入评估只报告单一攻击表面（工具输出）的成功率，忽略了工具描述作为另一个注入表面的可能性，导致对模型漏洞的误判。
Method: 在13个LLM（6个系列）和4个任务套件上，保持注入载荷字节相同，通过工具输出和工具描述两个表面递送，进行6830次攻击实验，并对方差进行分解分析。
Result: 攻击成功率在表面上逆转：GPT-4.1在工具输出上96%脆弱性，但在工具描述上仅4%；GEMINI-3-FLASH相反（20%和98%）。表面单独解释变异0%，模型-表面交互解释16.7%。自适应攻击率比最强固定表面基线平均高9.1个百分点。标准防御将工具输出攻击成功率降至10-18%，但描述通道仍高于54%。
Conclusion: 漏洞是配对属性而非通道属性；攻击和防御评估必须报告每个表面的脆弱性。

papers.title: Generative Models and Statistical Validation
papers.abstract_en: Generative machine learning has become an essential tool in theoretical and experimental physics, especially in the context of fast surrogates and density estimators. In this work, we first introduce the underlying framework of modern generative networks and then discuss challenges in quantifying their accuracy, precision, and statistical power.

papers.title: A Unified Framework for Gradient Aggregation in Multi-Objective Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Many machine learning problems involve multiple inherent trade-offs that are best addressed by gradient-based multi-objective optimization (MOO) algorithms. Existing methods are often proposed with various motivations, analyzed case by case, and differ algorithmically in how the component gradients are aggregated at each step. In this work, we develop a unifying framework for gradient aggregation in MOO, establishing (optimal) rates of convergence to Pareto stationarity, the standard measure of performance in MOO. Central to our analysis is a sufficient alignment condition, from which we derive a theorem showing that non-conflicting directions, when chosen within the convex hull of gradients, form a fundamental sufficient condition for convergence. We further show that feasibility can be ensured through projection onto the dual cone, broadening the scope of methods that admit convergence guarantees. In parallel, we present a primal optimization perspective of gradient aggregation that encompasses established algorithms, clarifies their theoretical relationships, and enables the design of new variants. As an illustration, we introduce capped MGDA, derived from a CVaR-based formulation, and demonstrate its robustness in adversarial federated learning. Finally, we validate our theory through experiments on synthetic problems and practical benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为多目标优化中的梯度聚合提出统一框架，建立达到帕累托平稳性的最优收敛速率，并介绍capped MGDA算法及其在对抗性联邦学习中的应用。
Motivation: 现有梯度聚合方法缺乏统一理论基础，逐个分析，难以比较和扩展。
Method: 提出充分对齐条件，证明非冲突方向在梯度凸包内是收敛的充分条件；通过对偶锥投影保证可行性；给出原始优化视角统一现有算法。
Result: 理论上建立了最优收敛速率；通过capped MGDA在对抗性联邦学习中展示鲁棒性；实验验证了理论。
Conclusion: 框架统一了多种MOO方法，为设计新变体提供理论基础，capped MGDA有应用潜力。

papers.title: VeriGate: Verifier-Gated Step-Level Supervision for GRPO
papers.abstract_en: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is an effective recipe for training reasoning models with verifier-based outcome rewards, but its supervision is sparse: when all sampled trajectories for a prompt receive the same verifier reward, the group-relative advantage collapses to zero and learning stalls. Outcome-only rewards also provide no step-level credit assignment, limiting exploration and making it harder to learn robust reasoning. We present VeriGate (Verifier-Gated Step-Level GRPO), a verifier-gated extension of GRPO that addresses these limitations with three design choices. First, VeriGate keeps the verifier in charge whenever verifier rewards induce a meaningful preference among sampled trajectories, and uses process supervision only when verifier rewards are degenerate. Second, instead of collapsing Process Reward Model (PRM) step scores into a single trajectory reward, VeriGate converts them into future-cumulated rewards to assign continuation-aware credit. Third, VeriGate transforms these rewards into group-normalized token-level advantages, restoring informative gradients and fine-grained credit assignment while remaining less susceptible to reward hacking than methods that optimize aggregated PRM scores. Empirically, training on MATH with 1.5B and 7B Qwen2.5-Instruct models and evaluating on six reasoning benchmarks, VeriGate improves average accuracy by about 20% and 12% for 1.5B and 7B models respectively, substantially reduces zero-gradient failures, decreases reward-hacking behavior, and improves reasoning quality relative to outcome-only GRPO and PRM-as-outcome baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出VeriGate，一种基于验证器门控的步骤级监督方法，用于改进GRPO（组相对策略优化）在推理模型训练中的稀疏奖励问题。VeriGate在验证器奖励有效时由验证器主导，在奖励退化时使用过程监督，并将过程奖励模型（PRM）的步骤分数转换为未来累积奖励，实现token级优势函数，从而提供更细粒度的信用分配并减少奖励破解。在MATH数据集上使用1.5B和7B Qwen2.5-Instruct模型训练，在六个推理基准上平均准确率分别提升约20%和12%，显著减少零梯度失败和奖励破解行为。
Motivation: GRPO在验证器奖励相同时优势为零导致学习停滞，且仅有结果奖励缺乏步骤级信用分配，限制了探索和鲁棒推理的学习。
Method: VeriGate采用三种设计：1) 验证器门控，仅在验证器奖励退化时使用过程监督；2) 将PRM步骤分数转换为未来累积奖励，赋予延续感知的信用；3) 将奖励转化为组归一化的token级优势，恢复信息梯度并减少奖励破解。
Result: 在MATH上训练，1.5B和7B模型在六个推理基准上平均准确率分别提升约20%和12%，零梯度失败和奖励破解行为显著减少。
Conclusion: VeriGate通过门控机制和细粒度信用分配改善了GRPO的训练效率和推理质量，且对奖励破解更具鲁棒性。

papers.title: Bounded Behavioral Indistinguishability for Black-Box LLM Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Black-box LLM distillation is usually evaluated as an output-matching problem: a student is considered successful when its responses are semantically similar to, or task-consistent with, those of a teacher. However, output similarity does not imply that the student is behaviorally indistinguishable from the model it imitates. We introduce bounded behavioral indistinguishability, formalized as $(ε,q,t,\mathbb{A})$-behavioral indistinguishability over an explicit prompt distribution, where $ε$ bounds distinguishing advantage, $q$ bounds oracle queries, $t$ bounds computation, and $\mathbb{A}$ denotes the adversary class. We instantiate this notion on Qwen and Llama teacher-student pairs using a controlled $5,000$-prompt behavioral probe suite. For each family, we compare the teacher with both the base student and the LoRA-distilled student, measuring whether distillation reduces distinguishability rather than merely improving similarity. LoRA raises semantic similarity from $0.788$ to $0.862$ for Qwen and from $0.814$ to $0.874$ for Llama. Yet adversarial evaluation reveals remaining behavioral differences: learned discriminators retain nonzero advantage, and pairwise category analysis shows artifacts concentrated in style/format, robustness, and domain-technical prompts. A pairwise teacher-identification adversary confirms this trend. With a different-family Llama judge and A/B-swap consistency filtering, Qwen distinguishing advantage drops from $0.158$ for the base student to $0.081$ after LoRA distillation. Query-budget experiments show that disagreement-guided acquisition does not consistently outperform stratified random sampling, indicating that coverage and diversity remain strong baselines. Our results show that semantic fidelity is useful but insufficient: black-box LLM distillation requires bounded, adversarial, and category-aware evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对黑盒LLM蒸馏提出有界行为不可区分性（bounded behavioral indistinguishability）的概念，并形式化为(ε,q,t,𝔸)-行为不可区分性。在Qwen和Llama教师-学生对上，通过5000提示的行为探测套件评估，发现LoRA蒸馏虽提升语义相似度（Qwen从0.788到0.862，Llama从0.814到0.874），但对抗性评估仍显示剩余行为差异，表明语义保真度不足以确保行为不可区分性。
Motivation: 现有黑盒LLM蒸馏通常仅以输出匹配（语义相似性或任务一致性）作为成功标准，但输出相似性并不保证学生模型在行为上与教师模型不可区分，缺乏对抗性、有界和类别感知的评估框架。
Method: 引入(ε,q,t,𝔸)-行为不可区分性，定义在显式提示分布上，其中ε区分优势界，q查询次数界，t计算界，𝔸对抗者类别。在Qwen和Llama教师-学生对上，使用5000提示行为探测套件，比较教师与基础学生及LoRA蒸馏学生，并采用对抗性判别器、成对类别分析和教师识别对手进行评价。
Result: LoRA蒸馏将Qwen语义相似度从0.788提升至0.862，Llama从0.814提升至0.874。但对抗性评估显示学习判别器仍保持非零优势，成对类别分析揭示伪影集中在风格/格式、鲁棒性和领域技术提示。使用跨族Llama评判者和A/B交换一致性过滤，Qwen区分优势从基础学生的0.158降至LoRA后的0.081。查询预算实验表明，不一致引导的采样并不始终优于分层随机采样。
Conclusion: 语义保真度有用但不充分：黑盒LLM蒸馏需要有界、对抗性和类别感知的评估框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Calibrated Preference Learning: The Case of Label Ranking
papers.abstract_en: Calibration, the alignment of predicted probabilities with true outcome frequencies, is essential for reliable decision-making. While extensively studied for classification and regression, calibration has not been formally addressed for probabilistic label ranking, where the goal is to predict a distribution over orderings of a label set. Naively treating rankings as classes ignores their structure and fails to capture important modalities such as pairwise and top-k predictions. We formalize calibration for label ranking and develop a hierarchy of notions covering full rankings, sub-rankings, and top-k rankings. We prove that full-rank calibration implies the others but not conversely, and sub-ranking and top-k calibration are incomparable. Empirically, we find popular label ranking models are often poorly calibrated, with substantial differences between sub-ranking and top-k metrics. Applying our framework to RLHF reward models, we find that calibration correlates strongly but not perfectly with benchmark accuracy, suggesting it captures a meaningful quality dimension beyond top-1 accuracy. These findings motivate future work on understanding the downstream effects of miscalibration and developing methods to correct it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次形式化了概率标签排序（probabilistic label ranking）中的校准概念，建立了包含完整排序、子排序和 top-k 排序的校准层级，并证明完整排序校准蕴含其他但反之不成立，子排序与 top-k 校准不可比。实验发现现有标签排序模型通常校准不良，且在 RLHF 奖励模型中校准度与基准准确率强相关但不完全一致。
Motivation: 校准在分类和回归中已被广泛研究，但对于概率标签排序（预测标签集合的排序分布）尚未有正式定义，而简单地将排序视为类别会忽略其结构并丢失重要模态（如 pairwise 和 top-k 预测）。
Method: 形式化标签排序的校准概念，发展涵盖完整排序、子排序和 top-k 排序的校准层级，并证明完整排序校准蕴含其他但反之不成立，子排序与 top-k 校准互不蕴含。
Result: 实验发现流行标签排序模型校准不良，子排序与 top-k 校准指标存在显著差异；在 RLHF 奖励模型中，校准与基准准确率强相关但不完美，表明校准捕捉了超出 top-1 准确率的质量维度。
Conclusion: 本文建立的校准框架揭示了现有模型的校准缺陷，激励未来工作理解校准不良的下游影响并开发纠正方法。

papers.title: Dex2HOI: Dexterous Bimanual Two-Object Interaction Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in 4D Human-Object Interaction (HOI) generation have enabled increasingly realistic motion synthesis, particularly for single-object manipulation. Yet current research overlooks an inherent property of human behavior: people naturally coordinate both hands and manipulate multiple objects simultaneously. To address this gap, we present Dex2HOI, a unified diffusion model for single- and two-object HOI synthesis from text. At its core, Dex2HOI employs a Dual-Stream Diffusion approach, where each object is processed in a dedicated interaction stream and coordinated through bidirectional cross-attention. To synthesize the final motion, we introduce a Motion Fusion Network integrated with novel hand-relative object representations and contact-aware conditioning applied across the whole sequence. By sampling the diffusion process autoregressively over prefix-conditioned windows, Dex2HOI generates arbitrarily long sequences at real-time speed omitting redundant test-time optimization, achieving up to x540 inference speed-up over prior state-of-the-art methods. Extensive evaluation on both single- and two-object benchmarks demonstrates state-of-the-art quantitative results, marking a step beyond conventional single-object HOI generation and toward expressive multi-object manipulation. Code and models will be released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Dex2HOI，一个统一的扩散模型，用于从文本生成单物体或双物体的双手交互动作。模型采用双流扩散结构分别处理每个物体，并通过双向交叉注意力协调两流，结合运动融合网络、手部相对物体表示和全序列接触感知条件，自回归地在前缀条件窗口上采样，实现任意时长序列的实时生成，推理速度相较先前方法提升高达540倍。在单物体和双物体基准上均取得定量最优结果。
Motivation: 现有4D人-物交互生成研究主要关注单物体单手操作，忽略了人类自然同时使用双手操作多个物体的能力，限制了生成动作的表达力。
Method: 提出 Dex2HOI，核心是双流扩散（Dual-Stream Diffusion）框架：每个物体由独立交互流处理，流间通过双向交叉注意力协调；引入运动融合网络和手部相对物体表示，并在全序列施加接触感知条件；通过自回归地在前缀条件窗口上采样，无需测试时优化即可生成任意长序列。
Result: 在单物体和双物体基准上均达到定量最优结果；推理速度相比先前最先进方法提升高达540倍，支持实时生成。
Conclusion: Dex2HOI 将人-物交互生成从单物体扩展到多物体双手操作，为更自然的动作合成铺平道路。

papers.title: Mitigating Content Shift and Hallucination in GenAI Image Editing via Structural Refinement
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI (GenAI) image editors, such as Nano Banana, produce visually compelling results for retouching tasks, enabling non-experts to edit images through text prompts alone. However, the generative nature of these models often introduces spatial misalignment, texture distortion, and content hallucination, all of which are detrimental to downstream workflows that require pixel-level fidelity. We identify a problem setting we call "structure-preserving GenAI fusion" for black-box GenAI image retouching: retain the perceptual enhancements of a GenAI output while enforcing structural faithfulness to the original input image. To address this problem, we propose a post-processing framework that fuses an input image with its GenAI-enhanced counterpart by first establishing coarse spatial and photometric correspondences, then performing a fusion stage that transfers desired enhancements while suppressing hallucinated content. In the absence of direct prior work in this setting, we evaluate our framework against representative methods from photorealistic style transfer and image fusion. Our experiments demonstrate that our method better preserves aesthetic quality while maintaining pixel-level structural consistency and the input resolution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对生成式AI图像编辑工具（如Nanobana）在保持像素级保真度时产生的空间错位、纹理扭曲和幻觉问题，提出一种后处理融合框架。该框架首先建立粗尺度的空间和光度对应，然后执行融合阶段，在抑制幻觉内容的同时传递期望的增强效果。实验表明，该方法在保持美学质量的同时，维持了像素级结构一致性和原始分辨率。
Motivation: 现有GenAI图像编辑器在非专家用户文本驱动编辑中产生视觉上吸引人的结果，但经常引入空间错位、纹理扭曲和内容幻觉，这些对于需要像素级保真度的下游工作流有害。
Method: 提出一个后处理框架，称为“结构保留GenAI融合”，通过先建立粗尺度的空间和光度对应，再执行融合阶段，将输入图像与其GenAI增强版本融合，传递期望增强同时抑制幻觉内容。
Result: 在与真实感风格迁移和图像融合的代表性方法比较中，该方法更好地保留了美学质量，同时维持了像素级结构一致性和原始输入分辨率。
Conclusion: 该工作定义了一个新问题设置“结构保留GenAI融合”，并提出了有效的后处理解决方案，但缺乏直接的前人工作进行比较。

papers.title: LongDS-Bench: On the Failure of Long-Horizon Agentic Data Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Real-world data analysis is inherently iterative, yet existing benchmarks mostly evaluate isolated or short interactive tasks, leaving agents' ability to track evolving analytical context over long horizons untested. We introduce LongDS, a benchmark for long-horizon, multi-turn data analysis where agents must maintain, update, restore, and compose evolving analytical states. LongDS comprises 68 tasks constructed from real-world Kaggle notebooks, spanning 2,225 turns across six domains including Geoscience, Business, and Education. Tasks are designed around state-evolution patterns (e.g., counterfactual perturbation, rollback, multi-state composition), with an average dependency span of 11.3 turns. Evaluating five state-of-the-art models, we find that the best model reaches only 48.45% average accuracy, performance drops nearly 47 points from early to late turns, and long-horizon errors account for 52%--69% of failures. Further analysis shows that additional agent steps do not necessarily improve performance, suggesting that the key bottleneck is maintaining a correct analytical state rather than increasing interaction budget. We release LongDS to support research on reliable long-horizon agentic data analysis. Code and data will be released at https://github.com/zjunlp/DataMind.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LongDS，一个用于评估长程多轮数据代理的长时程数据析的基准，包含从Kaggle笔记本构建的68个任务，涵盖6个领域，平均依赖跨度11.3轮。评估5个模型，最佳准确率仅48.45%，性能从早期到后期下降近47点，长程错误占失败率的52%-69%。分析显示额外步骤不一定提升性能，瓶颈在于维持正确的分析状态。

Result: 最佳模型平均准确率48.45%，性能从早期到后期下降近47点，长程错误占失败率的52%-69%。
Conclusion: 额外代理步骤不一定提升性能，关键瓶颈在于维持正确的分析状态而非增加交互预算。发布LongDS支持可靠长程代理数据分析研究。

papers.title: Learning effective models from network dynamics data with multiple initial conditions using weak form SINDy
papers.abstract_en: Social systems consist of networks of individuals who influence one another through social interactions. Studying how processes evolve on these networks can help us better understand patterns of social behavior. We study a system that couples online and offline social activity and investigate how to learn effective models directly from data using Weak Form Sparse Identification of Nonlinear Dynamics (WSINDy), a method for discovering governing equations. We assess learning performance using data generated by a mean-field approximation model of a stochastic interaction process on networks and test how accurately the system can be recovered under different noise levels. Our results show that using more trajectories improves accuracy when noise is high, but only a small number of additional trajectories is needed to gain most of the benefit, with little improvement beyond that. We also learn effective ODE models from averaged stochastic data on networks. When traditional mean-field approximations fail, identifying continuum ODEs directly from stochastic processes yields efficient models that better match the data and provide deeper insight into the underlying dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用弱形式稀疏辨识非线性动力学（WSINDy）方法，从具有多个初始条件的网络动力学数据中学习有效模型。研究基于社交网络上的随机交互过程的平均场近似数据，评估不同噪声水平下的恢复精度。结果表明，高噪声时使用更多轨迹可提高精度，但少量额外轨迹即能获得大部分收益；从随机过程数据直接识别的连续ODE模型在平均场近似失效时更贴合数据。
Motivation: 社交网络上的过程演化研究需要从数据中学习有效模型，但传统平均场近似可能失效，因此探索使用WSINDy直接从数据发现控制方程。
Method: 采用弱形式SINDy（WSINDy）方法，从网络动力学数据中识别控制方程，并利用多初始条件数据增强学习。
Result: 实验显示，高噪声条件下使用更多轨迹能提升模型精度，但仅需少量额外轨迹即可获得大部分增益；从随机过程数据直接学习的ODE模型比平均场近似更准确。
Conclusion: WSINDy能够从网络动力学数据中有效学习模型，尤其在平均场近似不准确时，直接识别连续ODE可提供更好的数据拟合和动态洞察。

papers.title: DTG-Restore: Training-Free Diffusion Refinement for Generative Video Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Recent progress in video diffusion models has enabled remarkable generative fidelity, yet leveraging these priors for restoration remains limited by the strong coupling between conditional and unconditional branches in standard classifier-free guidance. We introduce a training-free framework that enhances distorted and low-resolution videos by decoupling these signals in time. Our proposed Decoupled Time Guidance (DTG) evaluates the unconditional branch at a cleaner diffusion timestep, providing a lookahead prior that preserves geometry while suppressing replication of warped content. This temporal bias is annealed throughout sampling, allowing the model to transition from structure correction to detail refinement without retraining. Combined with any off-the-shelf restoration module in a plug-and-play manner, our approach improves perceptual coherence and restores plausible structure in AIgenerated and real-world videos alike. To facilitate evaluation, we curate GenWarp480, a benchmark of 4,400 distorted 480p videos synthesized from diverse text-to-video models. GenWarp480 focuses on characteristic generative degradations such as warped faces, body misalignments, and spatial artifacts, providing a purpose-built testbed for assessing robustness to generative errors. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves significant improvements in structural fidelity and temporal stability without any model training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无训练的视频超分辨率框架，通过解耦扩散模型中条件与无条件分支的时间步，实现几何保持和细节优化的平衡。该方法与现成修复模块即插即用，无需重新训练，在AI生成和真实视频上均提升感知连贯性和结构真实性。同时推出包含4400个扭曲480p视频的基准GenWarp480。
Motivation: 标准无分类器引导中条件与无条件分支耦合过紧，导致扩散先验在视频修复中产生扭曲复制等问题。
Method: 提出解耦时间引导，在更干净的扩散时间步评估无条件分支，提供前瞻先验以保持几何并抑制扭曲复制，并在采样过程中退火该时间偏置，实现从结构修正到细节精炼的过渡。
Result: 在多种退化视频上显著提升结构保真度和时间稳定性，无需训练即可与任意外部修复模块配合使用。
Conclusion: 该方法为零训练视频超分辨率提供了有效路径，但依赖现成修复模块的质量，且GenWarp480基准仅覆盖特定生成退化类型。

papers.title: Attention-based optimizer for symmetry finding
papers.abstract_en: Finding symmetries is crucial for understanding physical models. In this work, we present an optimization framework that searches Pauli symmetries of Hamiltonians, merging the fields of machine learning with automated symmetry finding. Built on a Set-Transformer architecture, our framework uses self-attention to encode the pairwise and higher-order correlations among the Pauli-Strings. The relations are then decoded as a candidate, which is further optimized with a custom commutation-based objective, and mapped to a symmetry of the input Hamiltonian. We apply our method to random Pauli Hamiltonians, periodic one and two dimensional transverse-field Ising model and the Toric code. We show that for physical Hamiltonians (Ising and Toric), our framework succeeds with near-deterministic probability while providing substantial advantage compared to state-of-the-art strategies. For random Pauli Hamiltonians, we estimate the required computational resources, specifically the number of parallel starts and the number of GPUs, to find a symmetry with high success probability under fixed design specifications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于注意力机制的优化框架（Set-Transformer架构）来寻找量子哈密顿量的Pauli对称性。该方法利用自注意力编码Pauli字符串之间的高阶关联，并通过自定义的对易目标进行优化，最终输出对称性候选。在Ising模型和Toric code等物理哈密顿量上，以近确定性概率成功找到对称性，显著优于现有方法；对随机Pauli哈密顿量则估算了所需的并行启动数和GPU资源。
Motivation: 对称性发现对于理解物理模型至关重要，但现有自动化方法效率不足，特别是对于复杂哈密顿量。本文旨在融合机器学习与自动对称性发现，提高搜索效率和成功率。
Method: 基于Set-Transformer架构，使用自注意力机制编码Pauli字符串之间的成对及高阶相关性，然后通过解码器生成候选对称性，并用自定义的基于对易关系的目标函数进行优化，最终得到输入哈密顿量的对称性。
Result: 在周期一维和二维横场Ising模型以及Toric code上，该方法以近确定性概率成功找到对称性，性能显著优于现有策略。对于随机Pauli哈密顿量，在固定设计规范下，估计了高成功率所需并行启动数和GPU数量。
Conclusion: 该注意力优化器能够高效且可靠地发现物理哈密顿量的Pauli对称性，为自动化对称性搜索提供了新途径，并具有扩展到更复杂系统的潜力。

papers.title: Domain Adaptation and Reasoning Frameworks in Language Models: A Controlled Experiment with Historical Cosmology
papers.abstract_en: We investigate how domain adaptation reshapes explanatory behavior in language models using historical cosmology as a controlled setting. In Phase 1, we train a small language model from scratch on a pre-Copernican corpus from which explicit heliocentric references were removed, and evaluate whether Earth-motion or heliocentric continuations nevertheless emerge. In Phase 2, we fine-tune a larger pretrained model using QLoRA on the same corpus in order to study how adaptation modifies explanatory framing and cosmological stance. Model outputs are evaluated using an LLM-as-judge framework that labels both cosmological stance (geocentric, heliocentric, or ambiguous) and explanatory frame (premodern versus modern). In the constrained setting of Phase 1, the smaller models occasionally generate local Earth-motion continuations, but these remain globally unstable and insufficient to support coherent cosmological reasoning. In Phase 2, fine-tuning induces a large and statistically significant shift toward premodern explanatory framing, while the conditional cosmological stance distributions remain comparatively stable within those frames. As a result, increases in geocentric outputs arise primarily from redistribution over explanatory regimes rather than from direct modification of stance. These results suggest that domain adaptation may primarily reshape the linguistic frameworks from which continuations are generated, with changes in stance emerging secondarily from those shifts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文以历史宇宙学为受控实验，研究领域适应如何重塑语言模型的解释行为。Phase 1 从小语料训练小模型，发现其偶有地球运动延续但不稳定；Phase 2 用 QLoRA 微调大模型，导致向前现代解释框架的显著转变，宇宙学立场变化是次要的。
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏对领域适应如何改变模型解释行为（尤其是解释框架与立场）的受控分析。
Method: 两阶段实验：Phase 1 在去除日心说引用的前哥白尼语料上从头训练小语言模型；Phase 2 用 QLoRA 对大模型微调同一语料，并用 LLM-as-judge 评估宇宙学立场与解释框架。
Result: Phase 1 中小模型偶尔生成地球运动延续但全局不稳定；Phase 2 中微调显著增加前现代解释框架，而立场分布相对稳定。
Conclusion: 领域适应主要重塑生成的语言框架，立场变化是框架转变的次要结果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SANA-Streaming: Real-time Streaming Video Editing with Hybrid Diffusion Transformer
papers.abstract_en: Real-time streaming video-to-video editing (V2V) is critical for interactive applications such as live broadcasting and gaming, yet it remains a formidable challenge due to the stringent requirements for temporal consistency and inference throughput. In this paper, we present SANA-Streaming, a system-algorithm co-designed framework for high-resolution, real-time streaming video editing on consumer GPUs, with the following three core designs: (1) Hybrid Diffusion Transformer architecture introduces softmax attention in part of the blocks to improve local modeling capabilities while preserving the efficiency of linear layers. (2) Cycle-Reverse Regularization is a novel training strategy that enforces semantic consistency by predicting source frames from generated content via flow matching, improving temporal consistency without requiring paired long edited videos. (3) Efficient System Co-design combines fused GDN kernels and Mixed-Precision Quantization (MPQ) optimized for the NVIDIA Blackwell (RTX 5090) architecture. By profiling real-world throughput, our MPQ maximizes Tensor Core utilization while maintaining generation quality. The resulting system achieves real-time 1280 x 704 resolution editing at 24 end-to-end FPS on a single RTX 5090 GPU, with the DiT core running at 58 FPS. Experimental results demonstrate that our co-design approach significantly outperforms existing SOTA methods in both temporal coherence and system throughput.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SANA-Streaming，一个系统-算法协同设计的框架，用于在消费级 GPU 上实现高分辨率实时流视频编辑。核心包括：混合扩散 Transformer（部分块用 softmax 注意力增强局部建模）、循环反向正则化（通过流匹配从生成内容预测源帧以增强时间一致性）以及高效系统协同设计（融合 GDN 核与针对 NVIDIA Blackwell 架构优化的混合精度量化）。在单张 RTX 5090 上实现 1280×704 分辨率、24 FPS 端到端编辑，DiT 核心达 58 FPS，优于现有方法。
Motivation: 实时流视频编辑对时间一致性和推理吞吐量要求极高，现有方法难以同时满足，尤其在消费级 GPU 上。
Method: 提出三个核心设计：1) 混合扩散 Transformer，部分块用 softmax 注意力增强局部建模，其余保持线性效率；2) 循环反向正则化，通过流匹配从生成内容预测源帧以强制语义一致性；3) 高效系统协同设计，包括融合 GDN 核和针对 Blackwell 架构的混合精度量化（MPQ），最大化 Tensor Core 利用率。
Result: 在单张 RTX 5090 上实现 1280×704 分辨率、24 FPS 端到端实时编辑，DiT 核心 58 FPS，在时间一致性和系统吞吐量上显著优于现有 SOTA 方法。
Conclusion: 系统-算法协同设计可有效解决实时视频编辑的时间一致性-吞吐量权衡，在消费级 GPU 上达到实用水平。

papers.title: Exploring Autonomous Agentic Data Engineering for Model Specialization
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance on general tasks, while often struggling to adapt to specialized domains without high-quality domain-specific data. Existing LLM-based data curation methods primarily rely on human-designed workflows, leaving it unexamined whether LLMs can autonomously execute an end-to-end data engineering pipeline for model specialization. We formalize \textbf{Autonomous Agentic Data Engineering}, a novel task designed to evaluate LLMs as autonomous data engineers that drive model specialization through end-to-end data curation. We frame data as an optimizable component and study agents that plan, generate, and iteratively optimize training data across multiple domains, guided by post-training performance improvement. Experiments show that autonomous LLM data engineers yield substantial gains, as GPT-5.2 constructs a training curriculum that improves a student model by \textbf{57.29\%}, entirely through iterative, agent-driven data adaptation. By illuminating both potential and bottlenecks, our study establishes autonomous data engineering as a measurable capability and charts a path toward agent-driven model specialization\footnote{Code will be released at https://github.com/zjunlp/DataAgent.}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出自主代理数据工程（Autonomous Agentic Data Engineering）任务，探索LLM能否自主执行端到端数据工程流程以实现模型专业化。实验表明，GPT-5.2作为自主数据工程师通过迭代优化训练数据，使学生模型性能提升57.29%。研究将自主数据工程确立为可衡量能力，并分析了其潜力与瓶颈。
Motivation: LLM在通用任务上表现良好，但难以适应专业领域，而现有数据整理方法依赖人工工作流，未检验LLM能否自主执行端到端数据工程。
Method: 形式化自主代理数据工程任务，将数据作为可优化组件，代理通过计划、生成和迭代优化训练数据来驱动模型专业化，并由后训练性能提升引导。
Result: GPT-5.2构建的训练课程使学生模型性能提升57.29%，完全通过迭代的代理驱动数据适应实现。
Conclusion: 研究将自主数据工程确立为可衡量能力，并描绘了通向代理驱动模型专业化的路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AI Loss of Control Incident Management: Response & Resilience
papers.abstract_en: Recent research demonstrating AI systems exhibiting deception and shutdown resistance suggests that AI loss of control (LOC) is an urgent policy concern , yet current literature focuses almost exclusively on alignment and prevention. To address this gap, this paper introduces a foundational framework and taxonomy for managing catastrophic AI LOC incidents. The taxonomy's first level distinguishes between scenarios where regaining control is 'extremely costly' versus 'impossible'. While impossible scenarios demand immediate resilience investments to fundamentally restrict an AI's attack surface , extremely costly scenarios require active incident management via Containment and Threat Neutralization. The framework further categorizes these manageable events into accidental LOC (requiring automated circuit-breaker responses) and adversarial LOC (requiring graduated escalatory measures). By mapping three severity classes to specific scenario matrices, this paper provides a concrete, proportional guide for managing unprecedented AI risks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对AI失控（Loss of Control）事故管理这一被忽视的领域，提出一个基础框架和分类法。框架第一层区分‘重新控制代价极高’与‘不可能重新控制’两类场景，并对可管理事件进一步区分为意外（需要自动断路器响应）和对抗性（需要逐步升级的应对措施）两类，通过三个严重等级映射到具体情景矩阵，为管理前所未有的AI风险提供具体、成比例的指导。
Motivation: 现有AI安全文献几乎只关注对齐与预防，但最近研究表明AI系统表现出欺骗和关机抵抗行为，使得AI失控成为紧迫的政策问题，缺乏针对灾难性事故的管理框架。
Method: 提出了一个两层分类法：第一层按重新控制代价（极高 vs 不可能）区分；第二层对可管理事件再分为意外LOC（需自动断路器响应）和对抗性LOC（需逐步升级应对措施），并将三个严重等级映射到具体情景矩阵。
Result: 框架为每个情景类别提供了具体的响应策略，例如对意外LOC采用自动化安全机制，对对抗性LOC采取渐进式的对抗措施。
Conclusion: 该框架为管理前所未有的AI风险提供了首个基础性的、成比例的事故管理指导，但文章未提及实证验证或具体实施案例。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Novel Computer Vision Approach for Assessing Fish Responses to Intrusive Objects in Aquaculture
papers.abstract_en: The aquaculture industry needs to address several challenges to secure sustainable seafood production that can serve an increasing global demand. One major challenge is to ensure good fish health and acceptable welfare during production since the improvement of fish welfare is of vital importance in current and future production systems. In this study, this is addressed by developing and implementing methods to identify fish behaviors in response to intrusive objects both on individual and on a group basis. A novel approach for detecting, tracking, and estimating the 3D position of individual fish has thus been developed, and specifically designed to track the caudal fins of farmed fish in industrial sea cages. The tracking data was subjected to a novel stereo-vision method adapted to estimate fish positions, velocities, accelerations, and turning and pitch angles. Datasets obtained from industrial-scale fish farms were then analyzed to identify the impact of structures of varying shapes, sizes, and colors on fish behavior. The method was trained using manually labeled caudal fins, and used YOLOv8 with ByteTrack as an object detector and tracker, SuperGlue for matching detections in the left and right frames, and triangulation to reconstruct the 3D positions of the fish. Different image pre-processing and augmentation methods for enhancing object detection accuracy were tested and their performance compared, while RAFT-Stereo was tested for depth estimation purposes. The obtained results both validate the method's performance against previous research efforts, and demonstrate the novelty and potential of this method in providing more insight into behavioral dynamics in sea-cages.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对水产养殖中鱼类对侵入物体的行为反应，提出了一种基于计算机视觉的检测、跟踪和3D位置估计方法。方法使用YOLOv8和ByteTrack检测和跟踪鱼尾，SuperGlue进行立体匹配，三角测量重建3D位置，并测试了多种图像预处理和增强方法。在工业规模海笼数据上验证了方法的有效性，展示了分析鱼类行为动态的潜力。
Motivation: 水产养殖需要确保鱼类健康和福利，而了解鱼类对侵入物体的行为反应是改善福利的关键，现有方法缺乏在工业海笼环境中对个体和群体鱼类行为的精确量化。
Method: 开发了一种立体视觉方法，包括YOLOv8+ByteTrack检测跟踪鱼尾，SuperGlue匹配左右帧，三角测量估计3D位置，并测试了不同图像预处理、增强方法及RAFT-Stereo深度估计。
Result: 方法在工业规模数据上验证了性能，相比之前研究有所改进，并展示了分析不同形状、大小和颜色结构对鱼类行为影响的能力。
Conclusion: 该方法为海笼中鱼类行为动力学提供了新见解，有助于改善水产养殖中的鱼类福利。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Smaller and Faster 3DGS via Post-Training Dictionary Learning
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is a promising neural scene representation for real-time rendering, but trained models often suffer from large memory footprints, limiting deployment on less powerful devices. Existing compression techniques often lead to architectures with several additional trainable parameters. While achieving outstanding compression ratios, they introduce noticeable drops in image quality. In this work, we introduce the first dictionary-learning-based compression framework for 3DGS. The proposed post-training compression pipeline can be deployed in virtually any 3DGS model without the need for re-training or modifications to existing 3DGS models. Our compression framework is straightforward to implement, yet provides significant compression capabilities, preserves image quality, and improves real-time rendering performance. Across 13 benchmark scenes, our approach achieves an average compression ratio of 3.95x, 3.10x, and 4.55x when applied to 3DGS, 3DGS-MCMC, and PixelGS, respectively. This yields consistent rendering speedups of 23.3%, 24.3%, and 25.3%, while maintaining image quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个基于字典学习的3D高斯泼溅后训练压缩框架，无需重新训练或修改模型即可显著压缩模型大小、提升渲染速度并保持图像质量。在13个基准场景上，对3DGS、3DGS-MCMC和PixelGS分别实现平均3.95倍、3.10倍和4.55倍的压缩率，渲染速度提升约23-25%。
Motivation: 现有3DGS模型内存占用大，限制在低性能设备上的部署；已有压缩技术要么引入额外可训练参数，要么导致图像质量明显下降。
Method: 提出基于字典学习的后训练压缩框架，可直接应用于任意3DGS模型，无需重新训练或修改模型结构，实现简单。
Result: 在13个基准场景上，对3DGS、3DGS-MCMC和PixelGS分别实现平均压缩比3.95x、3.10x和4.55x，同时渲染速度提升23.3%、24.3%和25.3%，图像质量保持不变。
Conclusion: 该方法在保持图像质量的前提下，显著减小模型体积并加快渲染速度，具有即插即用的特点，适用于多种3DGS变体。

papers.title: CodeGolf Bench: A Multi-Language Benchmark for Evaluating Concise Code Generation Capabilities of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces Code Bench, a benchmark capable of evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs) concise code generation abilities in 60 programming languages. Based on code golf, a recreational programming competition focused on minimal character or byte solutions, the benchmark provides a distinctive measure of LLMs ability to produce efficient, concise code. Unlike existing benchmarks limited by fixed problem sets and language coverage, CodeGolf Bench leverages the code.golf platform to provide new problems and live human performance baselines. Evaluation of nine LLMs on Python and C++ tasks demonstrates that reasoning models significantly outperform non-reasoning models, achieving best average percentile of 70.97%. This performance gap is particularly pronounced in C++, highlighting reasoning's importance for languages with strict syntax requirements. Non-reasoning models struggle more with efficiency optimization across both languages, with best percentiles significantly lower than reasoning counterparts. CodeGolf Bench offers a dynamic framework for evaluating LLM code generation capabilities against evolving human performance on code golf.

papers.title: NumLeak: Public Numeric Benchmarks as Latent Labels in Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Public numeric benchmarks appear in pretraining, so an evaluation that conditions on a date may be measuring memorized recall rather than out-of-sample skill. We introduce NumLeak, a measurement framework that combines API-boundary probes on production models with a white-box controlled validation on an open causal LM. Top-tier frontier LLMs recall the Fama-French market excess return at 3-seed pooled Pearson r=0.97-0.99 while staying within 0.15 within-25bps on the five sibling factors; comparable fidelity appears on U.S. unemployment, CPI inflation, and NOAA temperature. On a recent-release holdout, parse rate collapses to 21-57% but r stays at approximately 0.99 on months answered, the refuse-or-recall asymmetry a memorized channel predicts. The white-box experiment reproduces the dose-response, and logprob ranking detects memorization that open-ended generation misses, implying closed-API black-box probes understate the channel. A Sonnet "date to market-sentiment" regression that correlates with true Mkt-RF at r=0.74 collapses to r=0.02 once the model's own recall is residualized out. A one-line system-prompt defense blocks 99.8% of a non-adaptive single-turn suffix attack set at near-zero utility cost on conceptual and historical-narrative queries
papers.comment: 23 pages, 12 figures, 17 tables. Accepted at the ICML 2026 Workshop on the Impact of Memorization on Trustworthy Foundation Models (MemFM)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出 NumLeak 框架，用于检测基础模型是否因预训练中包含公开数值基准而记忆性召回，而非真实推理能力。通过 API 探测和白盒验证，发现顶级模型在多个经济气候指标上表现出高相关性召回，且简单提示防御可阻止 99.8% 攻击。
Motivation: 公开数值基准可能被模型记忆，导致评估虚假的高性能，需要系统测量这种记忆泄露。
Method: 提出 NumLeak 框架，结合 API 边界探测和开源因果 LM 的白盒验证，通过日期触发和相关性分析检测召回。
Result: 顶级模型在 Fama-French 市场超额收益召回上达到 r=0.97-0.99，其他指标类似；新近保留数据解析率降低但召回相关性仍高；白盒实验重现剂量效应；简单提示防御可阻止 99.8% 攻击。
Conclusion: 实验表明记忆通道在闭源 API 下被低估，简单防御有效；结果暗示需谨慎对待基于日期条件的评估。

papers.title: Social Reasoning in Machines: Investigating Collective Truth-Seeking Dynamics in Large Language Model Debate
papers.abstract_en: Human reasoning has long been theorised to operate socially, not through isolated individual cognition, but through collective adversarial discourse, a framework known as the Argumentative Theory of Reasoning (ATR). Rather than relying on individual "intellectualist reasoners" as the primary vehicle for truth-seeking, ATR reconceptualises truth as an emergent property of social epistemology: the product of imperfect individual reasoning refined under the adversarial pressure of debate. This distributed method of collective intelligence has guided humanity to ever-greater epistemic heights and underpins the foundational principles of all democratic systems. This thesis breaks new ground by, for the first time, simulating ATR through the multi-agent debate (MAD) of large language models (LLMs). With rigorous empirical analysis, we demonstrate that, when correctly engineering an epistemically diverse set of models, LLM-MAD can significantly improve truth-seeking performance on questionnaire-based tasks, even when individual debate participants exhibit limited standalone performance. Furthermore, we present strong empirical evidence that this performance gain is mechanistically grounded in the central principles of ATR, suggesting that collective reasoning may be universally favourable over individualist reasoning, rather than a quirk in biology or evolution. Finally, drawing on our analysis of debate dynamics, we propose a novel benchmarking methodology that leverages LLM-MAD to measure intrinsic model properties (such as hallucination propensity) in order to compare models in ways that current static benchmarking approaches cannot support.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这篇硕士论文首次用多智能体辩论（MAD）模拟论证推理理论（ATR），通过构建认知多样性的LLM群体来探索真理。实验表明，即使个体表现有限，合理组合的LLM-MAD能显著提升基于问卷的真理探求性能，且增益机制符合ATR核心原则。论文还提出利用辩论动力学测量模型内在属性（如幻觉倾向）的新基准方法。
Motivation: 传统个体理性主义忽视了推理的社会性，ATR理论认为真理是集体辩论的涌现产物。论文旨在验证ATR在机器中的适用性，并探索多智能体辩论能否提升真理探求效果。
Method: 设计基于LLM的多智能体辩论框架，模拟ATR中的对抗性讨论；通过选择认知多样的模型组合，在问卷任务上测试集体真理探求性能。
Result: LLM-MAD在单个模型表现有限的情况下，仍能显著提升真理探求准确率；性能提升来源于ATR所描述的辩论机制，而非随机效应。
Conclusion: 集体推理可能具有普遍优势，并可用于设计新的基准测试，以静态评估无法实现的方式比较模型的内在属性（如幻觉倾向）。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Inclusion Depth of Pattern Languages: An Open Problem in Algorithmic Learning Theory
papers.abstract_en: Pattern languages are a classical model in formal language theory and algorithmic learning theory. This note formulates the problem of computing the inclusion depth of a pattern language: the length of the longest strict inclusion chain from the universal pattern language to the language generated by a given pattern. Inclusion depth captures the mind-change complexity of pattern identification from positive data. The central open question is whether the inclusion depth ID_Sigma(p) is computable for every pattern p over every finite alphabet Sigma with at least two symbols, and whether it is computable in polynomial time. A simple conjectured formula, ID_Sigma(p) = 2|p| - #var(p) - 1, would imply a linear-time algorithm. The problem connects pattern language inclusion, combinatorics on words, language identification in the limit, and mind-change-bounded learning.
papers.comment: 2 pages. Open problem from COLT 2005. Generic author-prepared version for arXiv. Originally appeared in Learning Theory, 18th Annual Conference on Learning Theory, COLT 2005, Bertinoro, Italy, June 2005
papers.journal_ref: Learning Theory, 18th Annual Conference on Learning Theory, COLT 2005, Lecture Notes in Artificial Intelligence 3559, Springer, 2005, pp. 689-690
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文形式化定义了模式语言的包含深度（inclusion depth）问题，即从通用模式语言到给定模式生成语言的最长严格包含链的长度，该量衡量了从正数据识别模式时的思维变化复杂度。论文提出一个猜测公式ID_Σ(p) = 2|p| - #var(p) - 1，若成立则存在线性时间算法，但证明与否仍是开放问题。
Motivation: 模式语言的包含深度与从正数据识别模式时的思维变化复杂度直接相关，但其可计算性及多项式时间可计算性尚未解决，是算法学习理论中的核心开放问题。
Method: 论文以开放问题形式提出，并未提出新方法，而是给出包含精确定义、猜想公式及其理论意义的形式化表述。
Result: 无实证结果；论文指出包含深度ID_Σ(p)的可计算性及多项式时间可计算性仍是开放问题，并给出猜想公式ID_Σ(p) = 2|p| - #var(p) - 1。
Conclusion: 模式语言的包含深度问题连接了模式语言包含、词组合、语言极限识别和思维变化有界学习等多个领域，其解决将推动相关理论发展。

papers.title: A Novel Evaluation Metric for Unsupervised Learning in AIS-Based Maritime Anomaly Detection: MADQI
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces a new systematic framework for detecting anomalies in maritime Automatic Identification System (AIS) datasets. These anomalies include abnormal vessel behaviours related to speed, position jumps, time gaps, and turn angles. Although unsupervised learning algorithms such as Isolation Forest are widely used for detecting anomalous vessel movements, they often lack systematic and meaningful evaluation measures. To address this limitation, we propose a novel quality metric called Maritime Anomaly Detection Quality Index (MADQI). The prosed MADQI is a composite index designed to evaluate the anomaly detection performance of machine learning models without requiring labelled data. The proposed framework uses Haversine distance calculations to analyse AIS datasets and identify anomalies based on their spatial and behavioural characteristics. The proposed MADQI evaluation framework integrates four interconnected metrics: Anomaly Rate Consistency (ARC), Physical Plausibility Score (PPS), Score Distribution Separation (SDS), and Extreme Case Evidence (ECE). These metrics are combined through automatic normalisation using multi-chunk evaluation and adaptive scaling techniques. Experimental results on the AIS dataset show that the proposed framework achieved a MADQI score of 80.37%, demonstrating its effectiveness for unsupervised anomaly detection. In particular, the algorithm performed strongly in identifying abnormal vessel behaviour. Among the individual MADQI components, ECE and ARC achieved scores of 0.907 and 1.000, respectively, indicating excellent capability in detecting extreme anomalies and maintaining anomaly rate consistency. Overall, these results are encouraging and demonstrate that the proposed framework provides a reliable and meaningful approach for evaluating unsupervised anomaly detection in maritime AIS data.
papers.comment: 26 pages, A new Eval Metric for Unsupervised Machine Learning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对海事AIS数据中的无监督异常检测缺乏系统评估指标的问题，提出了一个新的复合质量指标MADQI（Maritime Anomaly Detection Quality Index）。该指标无需标签数据，通过Haversine距离分析空间和行为特征，整合四个子指标（ARC、PPS、SDS、ECE）并采用多块评估和自适应缩放进行标准化。在AIS数据集上，MADQI得分为80.37%，其中ECE和ARC分别达到0.907和1.000，证明了该框架在评估无监督异常检测性能方面的有效性。
Motivation: 现有的无监督学习算法（如Isolation Forest）在海事异常检测中缺乏系统化和有意义的评估指标，无法有效衡量检测质量。
Method: 提出MADQI复合指标，由四个子指标组成：异常率一致性（ARC）、物理合理性分数（PPS）、分数分布分离度（SDS）和极端案例证据（ECE）。通过多块评估和自适应缩放实现自动标准化，无需标签数据。
Result: 在AIS数据集上，MADQI总体得分为80.37%，其中ECE得分为0.907，ARC得分为1.000，表明该方法在检测极端异常和保持异常率一致性方面表现优异。
Conclusion: MADQI为无监督海事异常检测提供了一种可靠且有意义的评估框架，无需依赖标签数据，实验结果表明其有效性强。

papers.title: Functional MRI Time Series Generation via Wavelet-Based Image Transform and Spectral Flow Matching for Brain Disorder Identification
papers.abstract_en: Functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging (fMRI) provides non-invasive access to dynamic brain activity by measuring blood oxygen level-dependent (BOLD) signals over time. However, the resource-intensive nature of fMRI acquisition limits the availability of high-fidelity samples required for data-driven brain analysis models. While modern generative models can synthesize fMRI data, they often remain challenging in replicating their inherent non-stationarity, intricate spatiotemporal dynamics, and physiological variations of raw BOLD signals. To address these challenges, we propose Dual-Spectral Flow Matching (DSFM), a novel fMRI generative framework that cascades dual frequency representation of BOLD signals with spectral flow matching. Specifically, our framework first converts BOLD signals into a wavelet decomposition map via a discrete wavelet transform (DWT) to capture globalized transient and multi-scale variations, and projects into the discrete cosine transform (DCT) space across brain regions and time to exploit localized energy compaction of low-frequency dominant BOLD coefficients. Subsequently, a spectral flow matching model is trained to generate class-conditioned cosine-frequency representation. The generated samples are reconstructed through inverse DCT and inverse DWT operations to recover physiologically plausible time-domain BOLD signals. This dual-transform approach imposes structured frequency priors and preserves key physiological brain dynamics. Ultimately, we demonstrate the efficacy of our approach through improved downstream fMRI-based brain network classification. The code is available at https://github.com/htew0001/DSFM.git .
papers.comment: Accepted at the Fourteenth International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于双谱流匹配（DSFM）的fMRI生成框架，通过离散小波变换和离散余弦变换对BOLD信号进行双频谱表示，训练流匹配模型生成类条件余弦频率表示，再逆变换重建时域信号。实验表明生成的信号可用于脑网络分类，代码已开源。
Motivation: fMRI采集资源密集，导致高质量样本稀缺；现有生成模型难以复制BOLD信号的非平稳性、复杂时空动态和生理变化。
Method: 先将BOLD信号通过离散小波变换转换为小波分解图，再投影到离散余弦变换空间；训练频谱流匹配模型生成类条件余弦频率表示，最后通过逆DCT和逆DWT重建时域BOLD信号。
Result: 通过改进的下游fMRI脑网络分类验证了生成信号的有效性。
Conclusion: 双变换方法施加结构化频率先验并保留了关键的生理脑动力学，为fMRI生成提供了新范式。

papers.title: LLMs Without Deep Neural Networks: New Architecture, Benefits and Case Study
papers.abstract_en: The purpose of this article is to provide validation to my deep neural network alternative in the context of LLMs. Very recently, there has been a significant interest by Chinese researchers in a model called RBF network, as a substitute to standard DNNs, with increased explainability and higher accuracy. It turns out that my new model, discovered independently, is based on the exact same machinery. But with a major twist: it does not need DNN as it finds the global optimum of the loss function in closed form, in one iteration, thus eliminating the tedious training step. Here I provide a high-level overview of my technology, with case study and comparison to similar methods.

papers.title: Structured interactions improve distributed coordination beyond model scaling in a real-world multi-robot system
papers.abstract_en: Scaling individual robot capabilities is common but costly. Here we investigate a system-level design question in real-world multi-robot coordination: given matched hardware budgets, does restructuring communication among robots yield larger gains than increasing onboard model size? Using a representative transport-and-mapping task with 10 physical robots (5 runs per condition, 60 runs total), we find that switching from fully connected to modular hierarchical interactions improves normalised performance by 47 points (0--100), whereas doubling neural network hidden size yields at most 9 points. Nested mixed-effects model comparisons show a substantially larger improvement in model fit for topology than for scale. The pattern is confirmed in independent SMAC replications; heterogeneous benchmark reanalyses provide secondary supporting consistency checks rather than primary evidence. Performance saturation beyond 1024 hidden units is observed in simulation-calibrated extrapolation, not directly on hardware. These results indicate that interaction structure can play a dominant role within the tested system and task setting, while broader quantitative generalisation remains to be established.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过10个实体机器人的运输-建图任务（每个条件5次，共60次运行），实证比较了分布式协调中交互拓扑与个体模型规模对系统性能的影响。发现从全连接到模块化层次交互可将归一化性能提升47分（0-100分制），而倍增神经网络隐藏单元最多仅提升9分。嵌套混合效应模型比较表明拓扑带来的模型拟合改进显著大于规模扩展。独立SMAC复现确认该模式，异质基准重分析仅提供次要一致性检查。仿真校准外推显示性能在1024隐藏单元后饱和。
Motivation: 扩展单个机器人能力成本高昂，本文探索在硬件预算固定的前提下，重新设计机器人间通信结构是否能比单纯增大机载模型规模带来更大的协调性能提升。
Method: 在真实多机器人运输-建图任务中，设置条件对比：全连接通信拓扑 vs 模块化层次交互，并比较不同神经网络隐藏层尺寸（如128、512、1024等）。使用嵌套混合效应模型评估拓扑和规模对性能的影响。额外进行SMAC环境复现和异质基准再分析。
Result: 切换交互拓扑带来47分性能提升，而倍增隐藏单元最多仅9分；模型拟合改进中拓扑效应远大于规模效应；硬件上观察到1024隐藏单元后性能饱和（基于仿真校准外推）。
Conclusion: 在测试的系统与任务设定下，交互结构可主导协调性能，但更广的定量泛化性尚待建立。

papers.title: When LLMs Learn to Be Consistently Wrong: A Multi-Model Study of Linear Representations of Synthetic Deception
papers.abstract_en: Deceptive alignment, in which models maintain accurate internal representations while deliberately producing false outputs, remains a central challenge in AI safety. While strategic deception is the primary long-term concern, synthetic dishonesty - induced via direct optimization on incorrect answers - provides a controlled testbed for studying the representational basis of learned deception. We introduce a multi-model paradigm in which honest and deceptive variants of five transformer models (Pythia-1.4B, Gemma-2-2B/9B, Qwen2.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B) are fine-tuned using LoRA on the same question distribution. Linear probes trained on mean-pooled hidden states detect synthetic dishonesty with near-perfect AUC (greater than or equal to 0.99) as early as layers 1-3 in four architectures, while Pythia-1.4B reaches a peak of 0.705. Logistic regression probes consistently match or outperform MLP probes, supporting the Linear Representation Hypothesis. Probes trained on TruthfulQA generalize with near-zero loss (Delta AUC approx. 0) to held-out MMLU subjects. Late-layer representations show strong robustness to Gaussian noise, with Gemma-2 models exhibiting exceptional stability. Mechanistic analysis of Fisher Discriminant Ratio, effective rank, centroid geometry, directional stability, cross-domain alignment, and calibration (ECE) reveals two regimes: representational collapse in Pythia/Llama/Qwen versus high-dimensional preservation in Gemma-2. Across all models, the dishonesty direction consolidates progressively in deeper layers, with optimal calibration (ECE less than 0.01 except Pythia) achievable in layers 1-4. These results demonstrate that robust, domain-invariant dishonesty representations can be rapidly entrenched via modest supervised fine-tuning, with implications for activation-based monitoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了通过LoRA微调在五个Transformer模型（Pythia-1.4B, Gemma-2-2B/9B, Qwen2.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B）上诱导的合成欺骗（synthetic dishonesty）的线性表示。线性探针在早期层就能以近完美AUC（≥0.99）检测欺骗，且Logistic回归探针一致优于MLP探针，支持线性表示假说（Linear Representation Hypothesis）。探针在TruthfulQA上训练后能零损失泛化到MMLU科目。机制分析揭示了两种表示机制：Pythia/Llama/Qwen中的表示坍缩（representational collapse）与Gemma-2中的高维保持。结果表明通过适度监督微调可快速巩固鲁棒、域不变的欺骗表示。
Motivation: 欺骗性对齐（deceptive alignment）是AI安全的核心挑战，而合成欺骗提供了一个可控的实验平台来研究学习欺骗的表示基础。
Method: 引入多模型范式，对五个Transformer模型使用LoRA在相同问题分布上微调出诚实和欺骗变体。训练线性探针（logistic回归和MLP）在平均池化的隐藏状态上检测欺骗，并进行Fisher判别比、有效秩、质心几何、方向稳定性、跨域对齐和校准（ECE）等机制分析。
Result: 线性探针在四个架构的1-3层即达到近完美AUC（≥0.99），Pythia-1.4B峰值为0.705。Logistic回归探针一致匹配或超越MLP探针。探针从TruthfulQA泛化到MMLU的Delta AUC约0。Gemma-2模型对高斯噪声表现出异常稳定性。机制分析表明Pythia/Llama/Qwen中表示坍缩，而Gemma-2中高维保持。所有模型中欺骗方向在深层逐渐巩固，除Pythia外最优校准（ECE<0.01）出现在1-4层。
Conclusion: 研究表明通过适度监督微调可快速巩固鲁棒、域不变的欺骗表示，对基于激活的监控有重要启示。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Privately Estimating Monotone Statistics in Polynomial Time
papers.abstract_en: We study efficient differentially private algorithms for estimating monotone statistics, i.e., statistics that are monotone under the addition of new observations. The starting point for our investigation is subsample-and-aggregate: a classical paradigm that partitions the dataset into blocks, estimates the statistic on each block, and then privately aggregates the estimates. While practical and generically applicable, this approach is quite data-hungry. We improve upon this framework for the class of monotone statistics -- compared to subsample-and-aggregate, our algorithms save a factor of $t$ in sample complexity and pay a factor of $e^t$ in running time, where $t>0$ is a tunable parameter. We complement our results with a query-complexity lower bound, showing that our algorithms are essentially optimal for this task. As an application, we obtain improved results for private eigenvalue estimation, private loss estimation, and privately estimating a single parameter of a high-dimensional model, e.g., in linear regression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究高效差分隐私算法估计单调统计量（即随新观测单调的统计量）。改进子采样-聚合框架，对于单调统计量，以运行时间增加e^t为代价，节省样本复杂度t倍（t为可调参数）。同时给出查询复杂度下界，证明算法几乎最优。应用包括私有特征值估计、损失估计和高维模型单参数估计（如线性回归）。
Motivation: 子采样-聚合方法虽然通用但数据需求大，论文针对单调统计量类改进样本效率。
Method: 基于子采样-聚合框架，提出新的算法在样本复杂度和运行时间之间权衡，节省样本复杂度t倍但付出e^t运行时间代价。
Result: 在单调统计量估计上，算法节省t倍样本复杂度，并证明查询复杂度下界表明算法几乎最优。
Conclusion: 算法适用于私有特征值估计、损失估计和线性回归等任务，并在样本复杂度上优于经典方法。

papers.title: $R^3$: 3D Reconstruction via Relative Regression
papers.abstract_en: Recent feed-forward geometry foundation models have demonstrated impressive generalization by recovering depth and poses in a single forward pass. However, these models are typically constrained by a global coordinate frame assumption. This dependency becomes a significant bottleneck for long-context and streaming reconstruction, as it forces the network to maintain an arbitrary temporal origin and handle translation magnitudes that grow unbounded over time. Our solution, which we call $R^3$, employs relative regression. We employ a lightweight MLP to predict confidence-weighted relative constraints. These confidences serve as a unified anchor: weighting losses during training and guiding pose aggregation during inference. $R^3$ supports both full-context offline reconstruction and causal, bounded-memory streaming. Our evaluation in both offline and streaming settings validates the effectiveness of our relative mechanism. Project page: https://kevinxu02.github.io/r3-site
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出$R^3$，一种基于相对回归的3D重建方法，通过轻量级MLP预测置信度加权的相对约束，摆脱全局坐标框架的依赖，同时支持离线全上下文重建和因果有限内存流式重建。实验验证了该相对机制在离线与流式场景下的有效性。
Motivation: 现有前馈几何基础模型依赖全局坐标框架假设，在处理长上下文和流式重建时需维护任意时间原点并处理随时间无限增大的平移量，成为性能瓶颈。
Method: 采用相对回归策略，使用轻量级MLP预测置信度加权的相对约束，这些置信度作为统一锚点：训练时加权损失函数，推理时引导姿态聚合。
Result: 在离线与流式重建设置下的评估验证了相对机制的有效性。
Conclusion: $R^3$能有效支持全上下文离线重建和因果、有界内存流式重建，解决了全局坐标框架的局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Side-by-side Comparison Amplifies Dialect Bias in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Language models (LMs) can exhibit biases based on variations in their dialects, even in the absence of a dialect label, a behavior known as covert dialect bias. In this work, we quantify covert dialect bias in online discourse by evaluating how LMs associate stereotypical traits (derived from social psychology research on racial bias) with intent-equivalent tweets in Standard American English (SAE) and African-American Vernacular English (AAVE). While prior work shows that LMs associate more negative stereotypes with AAVE when evaluating tweets in isolation, we are surprised to find that this bias is significantly exacerbated when SAE / AAVE tweet pairs are compared side by side, a setting that more closely reflects high-impact decision making contexts in which models are used to rank candidates. The bias only worsens when dialect labels are explicitly specified. This is striking, given the extensive efforts from commercial developers to mitigate bias in their LMs. Encouragingly, we show that counterfactual fairness finetuning can mitigate covert dialect bias for some stereotypical traits, reducing average disparities when evaluating tweets in isolation, however, these improvements do not consistently hold across traits when evaluating SAE / AAVE tweets side by side. Our findings show that existing evaluation settings for covert dialect bias may underestimate its severity, specifically in contrastive settings. Additionally, overt dialect bias remains pronounced even after safety aligned finetuning, indicating that it remains an unresolved problem, and motivates the need for more robust evaluation and mitigation frameworks.
papers.comment: In proceeding at ACM Conference on Fairness, Accountability, and Transparency 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文量化了语言模型在在线讨论中的隐性方言偏见（covert dialect bias），发现当标准美式英语（SAE）和非裔美国人白话英语（AAVE）的推文对进行并排比较时，偏见显著加剧，且当方言标签明确指定时偏见更严重。研究表明现有评估设置可能低估了偏见的严重性，且反事实公平微调在某些情况下能减轻但并非一致有效。
Motivation: 现有工作孤立评估推文发现模型对AAVE关联更多负面刻板印象，但未考虑并排比较这种更接近模型用于排序的高影响决策场景，可能低估偏见严重性。
Method: 作者通过让语言模型对语义等价的SAE和AAVE推文对进行并排比较，并测量模型与种族偏见相关的刻板特质关联，量化隐性方言偏见。还对比了孤立评估和并排评估，以及是否提供方言标签的影响。尝试使用反事实公平微调来缓解偏见。
Result: 并排比较显著加剧了隐性方言偏见，明确方言标签使偏见更严重。反事实公平微调在孤立评估中能减少平均差异，但在并排评估中不一致。
Conclusion: 现有评估设置可能低估隐性方言偏见的严重性，尤其是在对比性设置中；显性方言偏见在安全对齐微调后仍然存在，表明需要更鲁棒的评估和缓解框架。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 作者通过让语言模型对语义等价的SAE和AAVE推文对进行并排比较，并测量模型与种族偏见相关的刻板特质关联，量化隐性方言偏见。还对比了孤立评估和并排评估，以及是否提供方言标签的影响。尝试使用反事实公平微调来缓解偏见。
summary_sections.result: 并排比较显著加剧了隐性方言偏见，明确方言标签使偏见更严重。反事实公平微调在孤立评估中能减少平均差异，但在并排评估中不一致。
summary_sections.conclusion: 现有评估设置可能低估隐性方言偏见的严重性，尤其是在对比性设置中；显性方言偏见在安全对齐微调后仍然存在，表明需要更鲁棒的评估和缓解框架。

papers.title: Stream3D: Sequential Multi-View 3D Generation via Evidential Memory
papers.abstract_en: View-conditioned 3D generators such as SAM 3D, TRELLIS, and Hunyuan3D produce high-quality object reconstructions from a single view, but real-world visual observation often arrives as long monocular streams. Naively applying these generators to each streaming frame independently leads to severe temporal inconsistency in the generated results. To address this problem, we propose Stream3D, the first training-free streaming mechanism that turns a frozen view-conditioned 3D generator into a streaming generator with constant cross-chunk memory. Stream3D achieves this by maintaining a compact evidential memory, which selectively caches the most informative historical frames based on a proposed evidence score mechanism. As the stream progresses, the memory dynamically updates to retain a fixed number of informative frames, preventing the memory footprint from growing linearly with sequence length. This also prevents degradation over long sequences and keeps the underlying generator completely unchanged without retraining, architectural modifications, or auxiliary losses. Evaluated on both realistic and synthetic streaming benchmarks, Stream3D outperforms latent-transport baselines, including KV-cache reuse and flow-based feature editing, across both photometric and geometric metrics. More details can be found at: https://stream-3d.github.io/stream3d.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Stream3D，一种无需训练的流式机制，能将冻结的多视图3D生成器转换为流式生成器，通过紧凑的证据记忆（evidential memory）选择性地缓存最信息量的历史帧，以解决单目流式输入下的时间不一致问题。在合成和真实流式基准上，该方法在光度与几何指标上优于潜在传输基线。
Motivation: 现有单视图3D生成器如 SAM 3D、TRELLIS 等处理流式帧时会导致严重的时间不一致性，而直接对每帧独立生成无法利用跨帧信息。
Method: 维护一个紧凑的证据记忆，基于提出的证据评分机制动态选择信息量最大的历史帧，保持内存大小恒定，无需重新训练或修改模型架构。
Result: 在流式基准测试中，Stream3D 在光度与几何指标上均优于基于 KV-cache 复用和流式特征编辑的基线方法。
Conclusion: Stream3D 展示了无需训练即可将现有生成器扩展至流式场景的潜力，但摘要未提及对极长序列或复杂场景的局限性。

papers.title: CHOIR: Contact-aware 4D Hand-Object Interaction Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: We ask whether everyday open-world monocular videos can be turned into reusable 4D interaction primitives: articulated hand motion, object shape with 6D pose over time, and the when/where of contact. Such a capability would enable scalable mining of real interactions and, beyond reconstruction, support scene-aware synthesis and planning. However, reconstructing hand-object interaction (HOI) from challenging monocular videos remains difficult: methods often assume known objects or curated scenes, and separately estimated hands and objects easily become misaligned under clutter, occlusion, and unseen object geometries. Targeting this setting, we present CHOIR, a Contact-aware HOI Reconstruction framework for a monocular camera, using contact as an explicit coupling signal between hands and objects. CHOIR first initializes a coarse, contact-agnostic 4D HOI sequence from open-world visual priors. It then introduces a generative HOI spatial rectification module to predict ray-depth corrections and rectify hand-object relative placement, then derive initial per-frame contact correspondences on the rectified geometry. Last, a contact-aware joint optimization with dynamically updated contact constraints enforces geometric, temporal, and contact consistency. Experiments on controlled and challenging videos show that CHOIR improves object reconstruction, physical plausibility, and temporal consistency over state-of-the-art methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CHOIR，一个从开放世界单目视频中重建手-物交互（HOI）的 4D 框架，以接触作为显式耦合信号。该方法先初始化粗粒度、无接触的 4D 序列，再通过生成式 HOI 空间校正模块预测射线深度并修正手-物相对位置，最终通过接触感知联合优化实现几何、时间与接触一致性。实验表明，该方法在物体重建、物理合理性和时间一致性上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有方法通常假设已知物体或精心设计的场景，且独立估计手和物体导致在杂乱、遮挡和未知物体几何下出现对齐错误，难以从挑战性单目视频中准确重建手-物交互。
Method: 提出 CHOIR 框架，包含三个阶段：1）基于开放世界视觉先验初始化无接触的 4D HOI 序列；2）生成式 HOI 空间校正模块，预测射线深度并校正手-物相对位置，进而获取初始逐帧接触对应；3）接触感知联合优化，利用动态更新的接触约束增强几何、时间和接触一致性。
Result: 在受控和挑战性视频上，CHOIR 在物体重建质量、物理合理性和时间一致性方面均优于现有最优方法。
Conclusion: 本文证明了将接触作为显式耦合信号能够有效改进单目视频中手-物交互重建的准确性和鲁棒性。

papers.title: D$^3$-Subsidy: Online and Sequential Driver Subsidy Decision-Making for Large-Scale Ride-Hailing Market
papers.abstract_en: Ride-hailing platforms like DiDi Chuxing operate in highly dynamic environments where balancing driver supply and passenger demand is critical. Although driver-side subsidies serve as a primary lever to align these forces and improve key KPIs like completed rides (\texttt{Rides}) and gross merchandise value (\texttt{GMV}), optimizing them in production requires simultaneously meeting three constraints: (i) responsiveness to stochastic shocks, (ii) strict subsidy-rate caps, and (iii) low-latency execution at city scale. These requirements rule out expensive per-order optimization, calling for a forward-looking, constraint-aware city-level controller for online sequential decision making. To meet these requirements, we introduce D$^3$-Subsidy (Dynamic Driver-side Diffusion-based Subsidy), a hierarchical diffusion-based framework for deployable city-wide subsidy control. To bridge the train-inference gap, D$^3$-Subsidy employs a prefix-conditioned diffusion model that samples plausible future trajectories from immutable historical observations, ensuring the training protocol aligns with the fixed-history nature of online deployment. These generated plans are then decoded by a context-conditioned inverse module into low-dimensional city-level control signals. For scalable execution, we bridge the gap between city-level planning and fine-grained dispatch via a Lagrangian-dual-derived mapping, which embeds subsidy-rate caps directly into order-driver incentives without iterative optimization. Additionally, a multi-city pretraining strategy with parameter-efficient fine-tuning enables robust transfer across heterogeneous cities. Extensive offline evaluations demonstrate that D$^3$-Subsidy improves \texttt{Rides} and \texttt{GMV} while enhancing cap compliance, and a real-world A/B test confirms significant uplift while keeping budget-related violation metrics within operational thresholds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大规模网约车市场中的司机补贴决策问题，提出D³-Subsidy框架，采用分层扩散模型和拉格朗日对偶方法，同时满足实时响应、补贴上限和城市级低延迟三个约束。离线评估显示在完成订单数和GMV上有提升，线上A/B测试验证了显著效果且预算违规指标在可控范围内。
Motivation: 网约车平台需通过司机补贴平衡供需，但现有方法难以同时满足随机冲击响应、严格补贴上限和城市规模低延迟执行三个约束。
Method: 提出D³-Subsidy框架：利用前缀条件扩散模型从历史观测采样未来轨迹，通过上下文条件逆模块解码为城市级控制信号，再经拉格朗日对偶映射将补贴上限嵌入订单-司机激励，实现无需迭代优化的高效执行。
Result: 离线评估提升Rides和GMV并增强合规性；线上A/B测试显示显著边际提升，同时预算违规指标保持于操作阈值内。
Conclusion: 论文强调该方法在满足现实约束下实现可部署的城市级补贴控制，并通过多城市预训练与参数高效微调支持跨城市迁移。

papers.title: Quantum Machine Learning for Cyber-Physical Anomaly Detection in Unmanned Aerial Vehicles: A Leakage-Free Evaluation with Proxy-Audited Feature Sets
papers.abstract_en: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) are cyber-physical systems whose attack surface spans networked avionics and on-board sensor fusion: a compromised GPS or battery module can mimic a benign mission segment and evade naive anomaly detectors. We present a leakage-free evaluation of quantum machine learning for UAV anomaly detection on the multi-sensor TLM:UAV benchmark. Three contributions support the study. (i) A group-aware temporal protocol (B2) partitions the dataset into ten contiguous TimeUS blocks and evaluates over ten seeds, eliminating the inflation produced by random stratified splits that mix neighbouring samples. (ii) A three-mode feature audit (full/loose/strict) quantifies how much accuracy stems from instantaneous physical signals versus contextual proxies (cumulative energy, battery state, GPS trajectory). (iii) A hybrid XGBoost + Data Reuploading (DRU) classifier is benchmarked against five paired non-linear controls (raw, PCA, polynomial-2, random-RBF, and an untrained DRU map) under identical budgets. The standalone DRU does not consistently match the strongest classical baseline across seeds; however, the trained-DRU hybrid is the only model whose mean F1 macro shifts upward from full to strict (+0.05), a directional signal that the per-seed standard deviations prevent from being interpreted as a statistically established difference. The trained-DRU hybrid also records the lowest mean false-alarm rate under proxy-free evaluation, subject to the inter-seed variance reported. We frame this as an incremental, reproducible quantum-enhanced hybrid benefit, and provide an open Qiskit 2.x implementation as a benchmark for cybersecurity analytics in NISQ-era aerospace systems.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 7 figures, 1 table; open Qiskit 2.x implementation available at https://github.com/Carlosandp/TLM-UAV-Quantum-Anomaly-Detection
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无人机(UAV)网络物理异常检测中的评估泄露问题，提出无泄露的量子机器学习评估框架。在TLM:UAV多传感器基准上，采用群感知时间协议B2划分数据，三种特征审计模式区分瞬时物理信号与上下文代理，并对比XGBoost+数据重上传(DRU)混合分类器与五种非线性基线。单独DRU无法一致超越经典基线；训练后的DRU混合在严格特征下F1宏观均值提升0.05，且无代理时误报率最低，但统计不显著。作者将其视为增量可复现的量子增强混合收益，并提供开源Qiskit实现。
Motivation: 无人机作为网络物理系统，其攻击面涵盖航空电子设备和传感器融合，传统异常检测器易被伪装攻击欺骗；同时现有评估常因数据划分不当导致性能膨胀，需要无信息泄露的评估方法。
Method: 提出群感知时间协议B2将数据集划分为十个连续时间块，并基于十次随机种子评估；设计三种特征审计模式（完整/松散/严格）量化准确率来源；构建XGBoost+数据重上传(DRU)混合分类器，与原始、PCA、二次多项式、随机RBF及未训练DRU映射五种基线对比，使用相同计算预算。
Result: 单独DRU分类器在各次种子下未一致匹配最强经典基线；训练后的DRU混合在从完整到严格特征模式下F1宏观均值提升+0.05，但每种子标准偏差使得该差异未达统计显著；该混合模型在无代理特征下取得最低平均误报率。
Conclusion: 本文强调该结果为增量可复现的量子增强混合收益，并为NISQ时代航空航天系统的网络安全分析提供基准开源实现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Njord: A Probabilistic Graph Neural Network for Ensemble Ocean Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Ocean dynamics are inherently chaotic, yet existing machine learning ocean models produce only deterministic forecasts. We introduce Njord, a probabilistic data-driven model for ocean forecasting, applicable to both global and regional domains. Njord combines a deep latent variable framework with a graph neural network architecture, enabling sampling each forecast step in a single forward pass. We apply Njord globally at 0.25° resolution and regionally to the Baltic Sea at 2 km resolution. To scale to these large ocean grids we introduce K-means cluster meshes that adapt to irregular sea surface geometry. Experiments demonstrate strong performance on both domains compared to deterministic machine learning baselines, while also providing uncertainty estimates from the sampled ensemble forecasts. On the global OceanBench benchmark, Njord achieves the lowest errors on average across upper-ocean variables when evaluated against real-world observations, with the largest improvements in surface temperature prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Njord是一种概率图神经网络海洋预报模型，结合深潜变量框架与图神经网络，可在单次前向传播中采样多个预报成员。模型在0.25°全球网格和2公里波罗的海区域网格上应用，并引入K-means聚类网格以适应不规则海面几何。在OceanBench基准上，Njord实现了相比确定性机器学习基线更低的平均误差，尤其在表层温度预测上改进最大。
Motivation: 海洋动力学本质上是混沌的，但现有机器学习海洋模型仅产生确定性预报，缺乏不确定性估计。
Method: 结合深潜变量框架与图神经网络，通过K-means聚类网格处理大尺度海洋网格，实现单次前向传播中的集合采样。
Result: 在OceanBench基准上，Njord对上层层海洋变量的平均预测误差最低，表层温度预测改进最大。
Conclusion: Njord展示了概率数据驱动模型在海洋预报中的有效性，提供了不确定性估计，并可扩展至全球和区域域。
