papers.title: ASH: Agents that Self-Hone via Embodied Learning
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon embodied tasks remain a fundamental challenge in AI, as current methods rely on hand-engineered rewards or action-labeled demonstrations, neither of which scales. We introduce ASH, an agentic system that learns an embodied policy from unlabeled, noisy internet video, without reward shaping or expert annotation. ASH follows a self-improvement loop; when it gets stuck, ASH learns an Inverse Dynamics Model (IDM) from its own trajectories, and uses its IDM to extract supervision from relevant internet video. ASH uses unsupervised learning to identify key moments from large-scale internet video and retains them as long-term memory -- allowing it to tackle long-horizon problems. We evaluate ASH on two complementary environments demanding multi-hour planning: Pokemon Emerald, a turn-based RPG, and The Legend of Zelda: The Minish Cap, a real-time action-adventure game. In both games, behavioral cloning, retrieval-augmented and zero-shot foundation-model baselines plateau, while ASH sustains progression across our 8-hour evaluation. ASH reaches an average of $11.2/12$ milestones in Pokemon Emerald and $9.9/12$ in Legend of Zelda, while the strongest baseline gets stuck in both environments at an average of $6.5/12$ and $6.0/12$ milestones, respectively. We demonstrate that self-improving agents are a scalable recipe for long-horizon embodied learning.

papers.title: Counterfactual Trace Auditing of LLM Agent Skills
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model agents are increasingly augmented with agent skills. Current evaluation methods for skills remain limited. Most deployed benchmarks report only pass rate before and after a skill is attached, treating the skill as a black box change to agent behavior. We introduce Counterfactual Trace Auditing (CTA), a framework for measuring how a skill changes agent behavior. CTA pairs each with skill agent trace with a without skill counterpart on the same task, segments both traces into goal directed phases, aligns the phases, and emits structured Skill Influence Pattern (SIP) annotations. These annotations describe the behavioral effect of a skill rather than only its task outcome. We instantiate CTA on SWE-Skills-Bench with Claude across 49 software engineering tasks. The resulting audit reveals a clear evaluation gap. Pass rate changes by only +0.3 percentage points on average, suggesting little aggregate effect. Yet CTA identifies 522 SIP instances across the same paired traces, showing that the skills substantially reshape agent behavior even when pass rate is nearly unchanged. The audit also separates several recurring effects that pass rate cannot detect, including literal template copying, off task artifact creation, excess planning, and task recovery. Three findings emerge. First, high baseline tasks contain most of the observed skill effects, although their pass rate is already saturated and therefore cannot reflect those effects. Second, tasks with moderate baseline performance show the most recoverable gain, but often at substantially higher token cost. Third, the dominant SIP type can be identified by baseline bucket: surface anchoring is most common on ceiling tasks and edge-case prompting is most common on mid-range and floor tasks. These regularities turn informal failure mode observations into reproducible behavioral measurements.
papers.comment: Code and data are available at https://github.com/WillChow66/CTA.git
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出反事实追踪审计（CTA）框架，用于量化LLM agent技能如何改变行为而非仅改变任务结果。CTA将有无技能的两个agent轨迹配对、分割为阶段并对齐，输出结构化技能影响模式（SIP）注释。在SWE-Skills-Bench上对Claude进行49个软件工程任务的实验表明，技能使通过率仅提升0.3个百分点，但CTA识别出522个SIP实例，揭示技能显著重塑行为，包括模板复制、离题创建、过度规划和任务恢复等效应。
Motivation: 当前评估方法仅报告技能附着前后的通过率，将技能视为黑箱，无法捕捉其对agent行为的具体影响。
Method: 提出Counterfactual Trace Auditing (CTA)：为每个任务配对有技能和无技能的agent轨迹，将轨迹分割为目标导向阶段，跨轨迹对齐阶段，并输出Skill Influence Pattern (SIP)注释以描述技能的行为效应。
Result: 在49个软件工程任务上，通过率平均仅提升0.3个百分点，但CTA识别出522个SIP实例。发现高基线任务中技能效应最多但通过率已饱和；中等基线任务中可恢复增益最大但token成本更高；主要SIP类型随基线变化：天花板任务以表面锚定为主，中低基线任务以边缘案例提示为主。
Conclusion: CTA将非正式的失败模式观察转化为可重复的行为测量，揭示了仅靠通过率无法检测的评估差距。

papers.title: Why DDIM Hallucinates More Than DDPM: A Theoretical Analysis of Reverse Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: We theoretically study the hallucination phenomena in two canonical diffusion samplers: the stochastic Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM) and the deterministic Denoising Diffusion Implicit Model (DDIM). We analyze the reverse ODE (DDIM) and SDE (DDPM) for a Gaussian mixture target, proving that after a critical time $τ$, (a) DDIM can become stuck on the segment connecting the two nearest modes and (b) DDPM *stochasticity* helps it become unstuck from this region, thus avoiding hallucination. Our empirical validation verifies that DDPM has a significantly lower hallucination rate than DDIM when this region is entered. Building on our observations, we exhibit how using additional stochastic steps can help DDIM avoid hallucinations and offer new insights on how to design improved samplers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从理论上研究了随机扩散模型DDPM和确定性扩散模型DDIM在逆向过程中的幻觉现象，以高斯混合目标分布为例，证明了在临界时间后DDIM可能陷入两个最近模式之间的连接段，而DDPM的随机性帮助其脱离该区域从而避免幻觉。实验验证了DDPM幻觉率更低，并展示了增加随机步骤可帮助DDIM避免幻觉。
Motivation: 现有研究观察到DDIM相比DDPM更容易生成幻觉，但缺乏理论解释，本文旨在从逆向动力学角度揭示其根本原因。
Method: 理论分析采用高斯混合目标分布，分别分析DDPM的逆向SDE和DDIM的逆向ODE的动力学行为，证明临界时间后的行为差异。
Result: 证明了在临界时间后DDIM会陷入两个最近模式之间的连线段，而DDPM因随机性可以脱离，实验证实DDPM幻觉率显著低于DDIM。
Conclusion: 揭示了DDIM幻觉的根本原因，并指出在DDIM中引入额外随机步骤可缓解幻觉，为设计更好的采样器提供了新见解。

papers.title: OBLIQ-Bench: Exposing Overlooked Bottlenecks in Modern Retrievers with Latent and Implicit Queries
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval benchmarks are increasingly saturating, but we argue that efficient search is far from a solved problem. We identify a class of queries we call oblique, which seek documents that instantiate a latent pattern, like finding all tweets that express an implicit stance, chat logs that demonstrate a particular failure mode, or transcripts that match an abstract scenario. We study three mechanisms through which obliqueness may arise and introduce OBLIQ-Bench, a suite of five oblique search problems over real long-tail corpora. OBLIQ-Bench exposes an overlooked asymmetry between retrieval and verification, where reasoning LLMs reliably recognize latent relevance whenever relevant documents are surfaced, but even sophisticated retrieval pipelines fail to surface most relevant documents in the first place. We hope that OBLIQ-Bench will drive research into retrieval architectures that efficiently capture latent patterns and implicit signals in large corpora.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出现有检索基准逐渐饱和，但高效搜索仍远未解决，并识别了一类称为“斜向查询”（oblique queries）的查询，它们寻求体现潜在模式（如隐含立场、失败模式、抽象场景）的文档。作者研究了斜向性产生的三种机制，并推出包含五个真实长尾语料库上斜向搜索问题的基准套件 OBLIQ-Bench。该基准揭示了检索与验证之间被忽视的不对称性：推理 LLM 能可靠识别潜在相关性，但最先进的检索流程却无法找出大多数相关文档。
Motivation: 现有检索基准日益饱和，但针对寻求潜在模式和隐含信号的斜向查询（oblique queries）的检索问题尚未被充分研究，导致这类查询在真实应用中效率低下。
Method: 分析斜向性（obliqueness）产生的三种机制，并构建 OBLIQ-Bench，包含五个基于真实长尾语料库的斜向搜索问题，用于评估现代检索器在潜伏和隐含查询下的表现。
Result: 实验表明，推理 LLM 在给定相关文档时能可靠识别潜在相关性，但即使是最复杂的检索流程也无法首先将大多数相关文档召回，暴露了检索与验证之间的显著不对称性。
Conclusion: 作者希望 OBLIQ-Bench 能推动研究发展能够高效捕获大型语料库中潜在模式和隐含信号的检索架构。

papers.title: Bayesian Rain Field Reconstruction using Commercial Microwave Links and Diffusion Model Priors
papers.abstract_en: Commercial Microwave Links (CMLs) offer dense spatial coverage for rainfall sensing but produce path-integrated measurements that make accurate ground-level reconstruction challenging. Existing methods typically oversimplify CMLs as point sensors and neglect line integration relating rainfall to signal attenuation, resulting in degraded performance under heterogeneous precipitation. In this work, we view rain field reconstruction as a Bayesian inverse problem with Diffusion Models (DMs) as high-fidelity spatial priors. We show that diffusion models better preserve key rainfall statistics compared to censored Gaussian processes. Framing rainfall estimation as a Bayesian inverse problem with a DM prior enables training-free posterior sampling using a broad family of methods, including Plug-and-Play, Sequential Monte Carlo, and Replica Exchange methods. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate consistent improvements over established CML-based reconstruction baselines.
papers.journal_ref: ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出利用商用微波链路（CMLs）和扩散模型（DM）先验解决降雨场重建问题。将降雨场重建视为贝叶斯逆问题，采用扩散模型作为高保真空间先验，相比审查高斯过程更能保留关键降雨统计量。通过即插即用、序贯蒙特卡洛和副本交换等方法实现无训练后验采样，在合成和真实数据集上优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有方法常将CML简化为点传感器，忽略路径积分特性，导致异质降水条件下重建性能下降。需要一种能利用CML空间覆盖优势且准确重建降雨场的方法。
Method: 将降雨场重建建模为贝叶斯逆问题，使用扩散模型作为先验。采用一系列无训练后验采样方法（即插即用、序贯蒙特卡洛、副本交换）进行推理，无需额外训练。
Result: 在合成和真实数据集上，该方法相比现有CML重建基线取得一致改进，并更好地保留关键降雨统计量（如极值、空间结构）。
Conclusion: 扩散模型作为先验能有效处理CML路径积分观测，提升降雨场重建质量，且采样方法灵活无需训练。
Relevance: 80

papers.title: To Use AI as Dice of Possibilities with Timing Computation
papers.abstract_en: The dominant noun-based modeling paradigm has fundamentally constrained AI development, precluding any adequate representation of the future as an open temporal dimension. This paper introduces a verb-based paradigm, together with precise definitions of \emph{timing computation} and \emph{possibility}, that enables AI to function as an effective instrument for realizing the grammar of our thought. Applied to longitudinal EHR data from 3,276 breast cancer patients, the framework empirically demonstrates: (1) automatic discovery of clinically significant patient trajectories, and (2) counterfactual timing deduction. Both results are purely data-driven, require no prior domain knowledge, and, to our knowledge, represent the first such demonstrations in the machine learning literature.

papers.title: Semantic Foam: Unifying Spatial and Semantic Scene Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Modern scene reconstruction methods, such as 3D Gaussian Splatting, deliver photo-realistic novel view synthesis at real-time speeds, yet their adoption in interactive graphics applications has been limited. A major bottleneck is the difficulty of interacting with these representations compared to traditional, human-authored 3D assets. While previous research has attempted to impose semantic decomposition on these models, significant challenges remain regarding segmentation quality and consistency. To address this, we introduce Semantic Foam, extending the recently proposed Radiant Foam representations to semantic decomposition tasks. Our approach integrates the natural spatial volumetric decomposition of Radiant Foam's Voronoi mesh with an explicit semantic feature field parameterized at the cell level. This explicit structure enables direct spatial regularization, which prevents artifacts caused by occlusion or inconsistent supervision across views - common pitfalls for other point-based representations. Experimental results show that our method achieves comparable or superior object-level segmentation performance compared to state-of-the-art methods like Gaussian Grouping and SAGA.

Motivation: 现有 3D 场景表示（如 3D 高斯泼溅）在交互式图形应用中难以交互，且语义分解面临分割质量和一致性问题。

papers.title: SpaCeFormer: Fast Proposal-Free Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation is a core capability for robotics and AR/VR, but prior methods trade one bottleneck for another: multi-stage 2D+3D pipelines aggregate foundation-model outputs at hundreds of seconds per scene, while pseudo-labeled end-to-end approaches rely on fragmented masks and external region proposals. We present SpaCeFormer, a proposal-free space-curve transformer that runs in 0.12--0.30 seconds per scene across standard benchmarks, 2--3 orders of magnitude faster than multi-stage 2D+3D pipelines. We pair it with SpaCeFormer-3M, the largest open-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation dataset (3.0M multi-view-consistent captions over 604K instances from 7.4K scenes) built through multi-view mask clustering and multi-view VLM captioning; it reaches 21$\times$ higher mask recall than prior single-view pipelines (54.3% vs 2.5% at IoU$>$0.5). SpaCeFormer combines spatial window attention with Morton-curve serialization for spatially coherent features, and uses a RoPE-enhanced decoder to predict instance masks directly from learned queries without external proposals. On ScanNet200 we achieve 11.1 zero-shot mAP, a 2.8$\times$ improvement over the prior best proposal-free method; on ScanNet++ and Replica, we reach 22.9 and 24.1 mAP, surpassing all prior methods including those using multi-view 2D inputs.

TL;DR: SpaCeFormer 是一种免候选区 (proposal-free) 的空间曲线 Transformer，用于开放词汇 3D 实例分割，在标准基准上每场景仅需 0.12–0.30 秒，比多阶段 2D+3D 流水线快 2–3 个数量级。该工作还贡献了 SpaCeFormer-3M 数据集，通过多视图掩码聚类和 VLM 标注构建了 3.0M 个多视图一致描述，显著提升了掩码召回率。模型结合空间窗口注意力和 Morton 曲线序列化，并使用 RoPE 增强解码器直接预测实例掩码，无需外部候选区域。

papers.title: Do covariates explain why these groups differ? The choice of reference group can reverse conclusions in the Oaxaca-Blinder decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Scientists often want to explain why an outcome is different in two groups. For instance, differences in patient mortality rates across two hospitals could be due to differences in the patients themselves (covariates) or differences in medical care (outcomes given covariates). The Oaxaca--Blinder decomposition (OBD) is a standard tool to tease apart these factors. It is well known that the OBD requires choosing one of the groups as a reference, and the numerical answer can vary with the reference. To the best of our knowledge, there has been no systematic investigation into whether the choice of OBD reference can yield different substantive conclusions and how common this issue is. In the present paper, we give existence proofs in real and simulated data that the OBD references can in fact yield substantively different conclusions. Our empirical exercises find that this sensitivity is more common when the OBD is extended to more complex regression models, including a pretrained transformer. Our theoretical and empirical results together establish that these conclusion reversals are not entirely driven by model misspecification, small data, or adversarial parameter choices. Our results suggest that practitioners should always report both directions of the OBD; that modern machine learning and large datasets do not automatically resolve the conclusion reversal problem; and that further work on this problem is needed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究奥克斯卡-布林德分解（OBD）中选择不同参考组是否会导致实质性结论反转。通过实际数据和模拟数据证明，OBD的参考组选择确实可能产生截然不同的结论，尤其是在扩展到复杂回归模型（包括预训练Transformer）时更常见。理论分析和实验表明，这种反转并非完全由模型误设、小数据或对抗性参数选择导致。建议实践者始终报告两个方向的OBD结果，并指出机器学习和大数据并不能自动解决这一问题。
Motivation: 标准工具OBD需要选择参考组，而数值结果会随参考组变化，但以往缺乏系统研究这种变化是否会导致不同的实质性结论及其普遍性。
Method: 通过真实数据和模拟数据给出存在性证明，并在多个回归模型（包括线性模型、复杂模型和预训练Transformer）上进行实证分析，检验OBD参考组选择对结论方向的影响。
Result: 证明OBD参考组选择确实可能导致结论反转，且该敏感性在复杂模型（如预训练Transformer）中更常见。反转现象并非完全由模型误设、小样本或参数选择驱动。
Conclusion: 实践者应始终报告两个方向的OBD结果；现代机器学习和大数据集不能自动解决结论反转问题，需要进一步研究。

papers.title: Graph Energy Matching: Transport-Aligned Energy-Based Modeling for Graph Generation
papers.abstract_en: Generative modeling of discrete data, such as graphs, underpins many scientific and industrial applications, including molecular discovery and materials design. In these domains, probabilistic inference is particularly valuable, as it enables composable generation and principled incorporation of desired constraints, such as structural or functional properties. Energy-based models naturally support this goal by capturing relative likelihoods and enabling composable inference by directly enforcing constraints during inference. However, discrete energy-based models typically struggle with efficient and high-quality sampling, as off-support regions often contain spurious local minima, trapping samplers and causing training instabilities, resulting in a fidelity gap compared to discrete diffusion models. To address this gap, we introduce Graph Energy Matching (GEM), a discrete generative framework inspired by the Jordan-Kinderlehrer-Otto (JKO) transport-map optimization perspective. GEM learns a permutation-invariant potential energy that simultaneously guides discrete transport from noise toward high-likelihood graph regions and refines samples within these regions. We further introduce a sampling protocol leveraging an energy-based switching strategy, seamlessly bridging rapid, gradient-guided transport and a local mixing regime for effective exploration. On molecular graph benchmarks, GEM matches or surpasses strong discrete diffusion baselines on most reported metrics. Beyond improving generation quality, GEM's relative likelihood modeling enables targeted exploration, facilitating compositional generation, property-constrained sampling, and interpolation between graphs. Project page: https://michalbalcerak.ai/graph-energy-matching/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Graph Energy Matching (GEM)，一种基于Jordan-Kinderlehrer-Otto (JKO)传输映射优化的离散能量模型框架，用于图生成。GEM学习置换不变势能，同时引导噪声向高似然图区域的离散传输并在区域内精炼样本。在分子图基准上，GEM匹配或超越强离散扩散基线，并支持组合生成、属性约束采样和图间插值。
Motivation: 离散能量模型（如图生成）因离支撑区域存在虚假局部极小值，导致采样效率低、训练不稳定，与离散扩散模型存在保真度差距。
Method: 提出Graph Energy Matching (GEM)，基于JKO传输映射优化，学习置换不变势能；引入基于能量的切换采样协议，结合快速梯度引导传输和局部混合探索。
Result: 在分子图基准上，GEM匹配或超越强离散扩散基线的大部分指标，并实现组合生成、属性约束采样和图间插值。
Conclusion: GEM通过能量建模弥合了离散能量模型与扩散模型之间的保真度差距，同时保留了能量模型的可组合推理优势。

papers.title: Reliable Self-Improvement Training by Verifying Reasoning, Not Just Answers
papers.abstract_en: Self-improvement training, where models learn from self-generated solutions, promises sustained capability gains but suffers from a pervasive failure mode: across multiple rounds, compounding reasoning errors cause accuracy to stall or degrade. We trace this drift to standard filtering criteria that retain solutions based solely on final answer correctness, which lets lucky guesses (correct answers with flawed reasoning) contaminate the training data. We propose Verified Self-Improvement (VSI), a framework that conditions data retention on step-level structural integrity rather than just the final output. VSI validates solutions by recomputing arithmetic steps via a computer-algebra library (sympy), checking intermediate consistency, and enforcing domain constraints. Evaluating VSI on GSM8K with Qwen3-4B-Thinking across 5 rounds of self-improvement against four baselines (no verification, outcome verification, majority voting, and VSI with DPO) shows that VSI rejects approximately 34% of correct-answer solutions, successfully isolating lucky guesses. This cleaner training signal drives sustained accuracy gains across all rounds (80.5% to 91.0%), whereas outcome verification plateaus and unverified training collapses. Finally, converting VSI checks into DPO preference pairs trains the model to distinguish sound reasoning from lucky answers, boosting reward accuracy from 46% to 63%. VSI offers a simple, reproducible recipe for robust self-improvement whenever automated reasoning checks are available.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICLR 2026 Workshop LLM Reasoning. 10 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Verified Self-Improvement (VSI) 框架，通过步骤级结构完整性验证而非仅最终答案正确性来筛选自生成训练数据，解决了多轮自我改进中推理错误累积导致精度下降的问题。在 GSM8K 上使用 Qwen3-4B-Thinking 进行5轮实验，VSI 拒绝了约34%的正确答案但推理有缺陷的样本，实现了准确率从80.5%持续提升至91.0%，而仅基于结果验证的方法会停滞，无验证的方法则崩溃。
Motivation: 现有自我改进训练中，仅根据最终答案正确性筛选数据会引入幸运猜测（答案正确但推理有缺陷），导致多轮训练后推理错误累积，精度无法持续提升甚至下降。
Method: 提出 VSI 框架，对自生成解决方案进行步骤级验证：利用计算机代数库 (sympy) 重新计算算术步骤、检查中间一致性并施加领域约束，只有通过所有检查的样本才被保留用于训练。
Result: 在 GSM8K 上使用 Qwen3-4B-Thinking 进行5轮自我改进，VSI 拒绝约34%的正确答案样本，准确率从80.5%持续提升至91.0%；相比之下，结果验证方法停滞，无验证方法退化。将 VSI 检查转换为 DPO 偏好对后，奖励准确率从46%提升至63%。
Conclusion: VSI 提供了一种简单可复现的稳健自我改进方法，适用于具有自动推理检查的场景，通过清洗训练数据实现持续的性能提升。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有自我改进训练中，仅根据最终答案正确性筛选数据会引入幸运猜测（答案正确但推理有缺陷），导致多轮训练后推理错误累积，精度无法持续提升甚至下降。
summary_sections.method: 提出 VSI 框架，对自生成解决方案进行步骤级验证：利用计算机代数库 (sympy) 重新计算算术步骤、检查中间一致性并施加领域约束，只有通过所有检查的样本才被保留用于训练。
summary_sections.result: 在 GSM8K 上使用 Qwen3-4B-Thinking 进行5轮自我改进，VSI 拒绝约34%的正确答案样本，准确率从80.5%持续提升至91.0%；相比之下，结果验证方法停滞，无验证方法退化。将 VSI 检查转换为 DPO 偏好对后，奖励准确率从46%提升至63%。
summary_sections.conclusion: VSI 提供了一种简单可复现的稳健自我改进方法，适用于具有自动推理检查的场景，通过清洗训练数据实现持续的性能提升。

papers.title: Surprised by Attention: Predictable Query Dynamics for Time Series Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Multivariate time series anomalies often manifest as shifts in cross-channel dependencies rather than simple amplitude excursions. In autonomous driving, for instance, a steering command might be internally consistent but decouple from the resulting lateral acceleration. Residual-based detectors can miss such anomalies when flexible sequence models still reconstruct signals plausibly despite altered coordination. We introduce AxonAD, an unsupervised detector that treats multi-head attention query evolution as a short horizon predictable process. A gradient-updated reconstruction pathway is coupled with a history-only predictor that forecasts future query vectors from past context. This is trained via a masked predictor-target objective against an exponential moving average (EMA) target encoder. At inference, reconstruction error is combined with a tail-aggregated query mismatch score, which measures cosine deviation between predicted and target queries on recent timesteps. This dual approach provides sensitivity to structural dependency shifts while retaining amplitude-level detection. On proprietary in-vehicle telemetry with interval annotations and on the TSB-AD multi-variate suite (17 datasets, 180 series) with threshold-free and range-aware metrics, AxonAD improves ranking quality and temporal localization over strong baselines. Ablations confirm that query prediction and combined scoring are the primary drivers of the observed gains. Code is available at the URL https://github.com/iis-esslingen/AxonAD.

papers.title: Variational Routing: A Scalable Bayesian Framework for Calibrated Mixture-of-Experts Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models are increasingly being deployed in contexts where understanding the uncertainty of their outputs is critical to ensuring responsible deployment. While Bayesian methods offer a principled approach to uncertainty quantification, their computational overhead renders their use impractical for training or inference at foundation model scale. State-of-the-art models achieve parameter counts in the trillions through carefully engineered sparsity including Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) layers. In this work, we demonstrate calibrated uncertainty at scale by introducing Variational Mixture-of-Experts Routing (VMoER), a structured Bayesian approach for modelling uncertainty in MoE layers. VMoER confines Bayesian inference to the expert-selection stage which is typically done by a deterministic routing network. We instantiate VMoER using two inference strategies: amortised variational inference over routing logits and inferring a temperature parameter for stochastic expert selection. Across fine-tuning tested foundation models, VMoER improves routing stability under noise by 38\%, reduces calibration error by 94\%, and increases out-of-distribution AUROC by 12\%, while incurring less than 1\% additional FLOPs. These results suggest VMoER offers a scalable path toward robust and uncertainty-aware foundation models.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出变分混合专家路由 (Variational Mixture-of-Experts Routing, VMoER)，一种将贝叶斯推断限制在专家选择阶段的轻量级框架，用于MoE Transformer的校准不确定性量化。VMoER采用摊销变分推断和学习温度参数两种方式，在微调基础模型时，以不到1%的额外FLOPs实现噪声下路由稳定性提升38%、校准误差降低94%、分布外AUROC提升12%。
Motivation: 大型基础模型需要不确定性量化以确保负责任部署，但贝叶斯方法的计算开销使其在模型规模下不可行。现有MoE层使用确定性路由，无法提供校准的不确定性估计。
Method: VMoER将贝叶斯推断局限于MoE层的专家选择阶段：通过摊销变分推断对路由logits进行近似后验，或推断一个温度参数实现随机专家选择。该方法保持架构稀疏性，无需修改预训练权重。
Result: 在微调的基础模型上，VMoER实现：噪声下路由稳定性提升38%，期望校准误差降低94%，分布外AUROC提升12%，且额外计算开销不足1% FLOPs。
Conclusion: VMoER为大规模模型提供了一条可扩展的路径，使其具备鲁棒且感知不确定性的能力，而无需增加显著的计算负担。

papers.title: Targeted Speaker Poisoning Framework in Zero-Shot Text-to-Speech
papers.abstract_en: Zero-shot Text-to-Speech (TTS) voice cloning poses severe privacy risks, demanding the removal of specific speaker identities from trained TTS models. Conventional machine unlearning is insufficient in this context, as zero-shot TTS can dynamically reconstruct voices from just reference prompts. We formalize this task as Speech Generation Speaker Poisoning (SGSP), in which we modify trained models to prevent the generation of specific identities while preserving utility for other speakers. We evaluate inference-time filtering and parameter-modification baselines across 1, 15, and 100 forgotten speakers. Performance is assessed through the trade-off between utility (WER) and privacy, quantified using AUC and Forget Speaker Similarity (FSSIM). We achieve strong privacy for up to 15 speakers but reveal scalability limits at 100 speakers due to increased identity overlap. Our study thus introduces a novel problem and evaluation framework toward further advances in generative voice privacy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出零样本文本转语音（TTS）中的说话者投毒框架，通过修改训练模型阻止特定身份语音生成，同时保持对其他说话者的效用。评估了推理时过滤和参数修改基线，在1、15、100个遗忘说话者场景下权衡效用（WER）与隐私（AUC和FSSIM）。对多达15个说话者实现强隐私，但在100个说话者时因身份重叠出现可扩展性限制。
Motivation: 零样本TTS语音克隆带来严重隐私风险，需要移除特定说话者身份，但传统机器遗忘方法不足以应对动态语音重构。
Method: 形式化为Speech Generation Speaker Poisoning（SGSP）问题，评估推理时过滤和参数修改两种基线方法。
Result: 在1、15个遗忘说话者上实现强隐私（高AUC和低FSSIM），但在100个说话者时因身份重叠导致隐私保护效果下降。
Conclusion: 引入说话者投毒新问题及评估框架，指出当前方法在大规模遗忘时面临可扩展性挑战，推动生成式语音隐私进一步研究。

papers.title: Empirical Characterization of Inference-Time Elicited Probability Transformations in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models increasingly rely on inference-time procedures such as chain-of-thought reasoning, self-refinement, retrieval augmentation, and verifier-guided revision, yet the structure of elicited probability transformations under these procedures remains poorly understood. We study externally elicited probability assignments over candidate answers and observe recurring approximate log-ratio relationships: \[ \log \tilde q_t(i) = α_t \left( \log q_t(i) + \log b_t(i) \right) + c_t, \] where $q_t$ and $\tilde q_t$ are pre- and post-elicitation probabilities, $b_t$ is an externally constructed evidence signal, and $α_t$ is an empirical descriptor of the prompting configuration. Across 4,975 reasoning problems from GPQA Diamond, TheoremQA, MMLU-Pro, and ARC-Challenge, evaluated on multiple instruction-tuned model families, we observe approximate log-ratio relationships with mean $R^2 \approx 0.76$ over about $1.3 \times 10^5$ candidate-level observations. Coefficients vary across elicitation settings, but qualitatively similar relationships persist across evaluated conditions. Robustness analyses using alternative statistical representations, prompting configurations, held-out evaluation, and token-level log-probabilities suggest that the observed structure is not tied to one prompting procedure or probability estimation method. The main contribution is not the algebraic form itself, which is related to generalized Bayesian updating and probability-transformation frameworks, but the empirical observation that diverse inference-time prompting pipelines repeatedly exhibit reproducible log-ratio structure under controlled conditions. The framework provides a protocol-sensitive perspective for analyzing calibration, evidence amplification, uncertainty propagation, and interaction sensitivity in inference-time LLM pipelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对大型语言模型在推理过程中（如思维链、自我修正、检索增强等）产生的概率变换进行实证研究，发现候选答案的概率变换遵循近似的对数比率关系，并通过大量实验验证了其在不同提示设置下的可重复性。
Motivation: 尽管推理时过程被广泛使用，但其对模型输出概率的变换结构尚不明确，缺乏系统性的实证理解。
Method: 提出一个对数比率关系模型来描述推理前后的概率变换，并在多个数据集和模型家族上进行大规模实验，通过统计拟合和鲁棒性分析验证其普遍性。
Result: 基于约13万个候选观测，得到平均R²≈0.76；系数随提示配置变化，但定性关系一致且鲁棒。
Conclusion: 推理时提示管线在受控条件下表现出可重现的对数比率结构，这为分析校准、证据放大、不确定性传播提供了协议敏感的视角。

papers.title: Certified Circuits: Stability Guarantees for Mechanistic Circuits
papers.abstract_en: Understanding how neural networks arrive at their predictions is essential for debugging, auditing, and deployment. Mechanistic interpretability pursues this goal by identifying circuits--minimal subnetworks responsible for specific behaviors. However, existing circuit discovery methods are brittle: circuits depend strongly on the chosen concept dataset and often fail to transfer out-of-distribution, raising doubts whether they capture the concept or merely dataset-specific artifacts. We introduce Certified Circuits, which provide provable stability guarantees for circuit discovery. Our framework wraps any black-box discovery algorithm with randomized data subsampling to certify that inclusion decisions over circuit components--neurons or edges of the model graph, depending on the base algorithm--are invariant to bounded edit-distance perturbations of the concept dataset. Unstable components are abstained from, yielding circuits that are more compact and more accurate. We validate across three architectures (ResNet, ViT, GPT-2) on vision (ImageNet and four OOD datasets) and language (IOI, IOI-Hard, Greater-Than) tasks. Certified circuits achieve up to 56% higher accuracy and up to 80% fewer components, and remain reliable where baselines degrade. Certified Circuits puts circuit discovery on formal ground by producing mechanistic explanations that are provably stable and better aligned with the target concept. Code: https://github.com/AlaaAnani/certified-circuits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出认证电路（Certified Circuits），为机械可解释性中的电路发现提供稳定性保证。该方法通过随机数据子采样，证明电路组件（神经元或边）的包含决策对概念数据集的编辑距离扰动具有不变性，不稳定的组件被弃用，从而得到更紧凑、更准确的电路。在ResNet、ViT、GPT-2上的视觉（ImageNet及四个OOD数据集）和语言（IOI、IOI-Hard、Greater-Than）任务中，认证电路相比基线准确率提升高达56%，组件数量减少高达80%。
Motivation: 现有电路发现方法对概念数据集选择敏感，常捕获数据集特定伪影而非真正概念，导致分布外泛化能力差。需要一种具有可验证稳定性的电路发现方法。
Method: 将电路发现视为一个对概念数据集编辑距离鲁棒的问题，利用随机数据子采样和统计检验来认证每个组件是否稳定，仅保留经过认证的组件。该方法可包装任何黑盒电路发现算法。
Result: 在三个架构（ResNet、ViT、GPT-2）的视觉和语言任务上，认证电路准确率最高提升56%，组件数量减少80%，且在分布外场景下仍保持可靠性。
Conclusion: 认证电路将电路发现置于正式基础上，提供可证明稳定且与目标概念更好对齐的机械解释。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Revisiting the Bertrand Paradox via Equilibrium Analysis of No-regret Learners
papers.abstract_en: We study the discrete Bertrand pricing game with a non-increasing demand function. The game has $n \ge 2$ players who simultaneously choose prices from the set $\{1/k, 2/k, \ldots, 1\}$, where $k\in\mathbb{N}$. The player who sets the lowest price captures the entire demand; if multiple players tie for the lowest price, they split the demand equally. We study the Bertrand paradox, where classical theory predicts low prices, yet real markets often sustain high prices. To understand this gap, we analyze a repeated-game model in which firms set prices using no-regret learners. Our goal is to characterize the equilibrium outcomes that can arise under different no-regret learning guarantees. We are particularly interested in questions such as whether no-external-regret learners can converge to undesirable high-price outcomes, and how stronger guarantees such as no-swap regret shape the emergence of competitive low-price behavior. We address these and related questions through a theoretical analysis, complemented by experiments that support the theory and reveal surprising phenomena for no-swap regret learners.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视离散Bertrand定价博弈中的Bertrand悖论，该悖论指经典理论预测低价，但实际市场常维持高价。作者通过分析无遗憾学习者在重复博弈中的均衡结果，研究不同学习保证（如无外部遗憾、无交换遗憾）下是否会出现高价或低价均衡。理论分析辅以实验，揭示了无交换遗憾学习者的意外现象。
Motivation: 经典Bertrand博弈理论预测竞争导致低价，但现实中企业常维持高价，这一差距尚未被充分理解。本文通过无遗憾学习框架解释这一悖论。
Method: 分析n≥2个玩家在离散价格集{1/k,2/k,…,1}上的重复Bertrand博弈，玩家使用无遗憾学习算法（无外部遗憾、无交换遗憾），刻画不同保证下的均衡结果。
Result: 无外部遗憾学习者可能收敛到不理想的高价结果；无交换遗憾保证则促使竞争性低价行为出现，且实验揭示了令人惊讶的现象。
Conclusion: 更强的无遗憾保证（如无交换遗憾）有利于竞争性均衡，但存在意外行为；理论和实验共同支持分析。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文重新审视离散Bertrand定价博弈中的Bertrand悖论，该悖论指经典理论预测低价，但实际市场常维持高价。作者通过分析无遗憾学习者在重复博弈中的均衡结果，研究不同学习保证（如无外部遗憾、无交换遗憾）下是否会出现高价或低价均衡。理论分析辅以实验，揭示了无交换遗憾学习者的意外现象。

papers.title: SAW-Bench: Learning Situated Awareness in the Real World
papers.abstract_en: A core aspect of human perception is situated awareness, the ability to relate ourselves to the surrounding physical environment and reason over possible actions in context. However, most existing benchmarks for multimodal foundation models (MFMs) emphasize environment-centric spatial relations (relations among objects in a scene), while largely overlooking observer-centric relationships that require reasoning relative to agent's viewpoint, pose, and motion. To bridge this gap, we introduce SAW-Bench (Situated Awareness in the Real World), a novel benchmark for evaluating egocentric situated awareness using real-world videos. SAW-Bench comprises 786 self-recorded videos captured with Ray-Ban Meta (Gen 2) smart glasses spanning diverse indoor and outdoor environments, and over 2,071 human-annotated question-answer pairs. It probes a model's observer-centric understanding with six different awareness tasks. Our comprehensive evaluation reveals a human-model performance gap of 37.66%, even with the best-performing MFM, Gemini 3 Flash. Beyond this gap, our in-depth analysis uncovers several notable findings; for example, while models can exploit partial geometric cues in egocentric videos, they often fail to infer a coherent camera geometry, leading to systematic spatial reasoning errors. We position SAW-Bench as a benchmark for situated spatial intelligence, moving beyond passive observation to understanding physically grounded, observer-centric dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAW-Bench 是一个用于评估多模态基础模型（MFM）在真实世界视频中自我中心情境意识（egocentric situated awareness）的基准。它包含 786 段由 Ray-Ban Meta 智能眼镜录制的视频和 2071 个人工标注的问答对，涵盖六种观察者中心感知任务。评估显示最佳模型 Gemini 3 Flash 与人类表现差距达 37.66%，模型虽能利用部分几何线索但无法推断一致的相机几何，导致空间推理系统性错误。
Motivation: 现有基准多关注环境中心的空间关系（场景中物体间关系），而忽视了需要从智能体视角、姿态和运动推理的观察者中心关系，因此缺乏对自我中心情境意识的评估。
Method: 构建 SAW-Bench 基准，通过智能眼镜录制 786 段室内外真实世界视频，并标注 2071 个问答对，设计六种情境意识任务（如空间关系、可达性等）。
Result: 最佳 MFM（Gemini 3 Flash）与人类差距 37.66%，模型可部分利用自拍视频中的几何线索，但无法推断一致的相机几何，导致系统性空间推理错误。
Conclusion: SAW-Bench 可作为情境空间智能基准，推动模型从被动观察转向理解物理上具身的观察者中心动态。

papers.title: Quantifying Error Propagation and Model Collapse in Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning models are increasingly trained or fine-tuned on synthetic data. Recursively training on such data has been observed to significantly degrade performance in a wide range of tasks, often characterized by a progressive drift away from the target distribution. In this work, we theoretically analyze this phenomenon in the setting of score-based diffusion models. For a realistic pipeline where each training round uses a combination of synthetic data and fresh samples from the target distribution, we obtain upper and lower bounds on the accumulated divergence between the generated and target distributions. Notably, to the best of our knowledge, this is the first lower bound on the divergence between the learned and target distributions, even for standard diffusion models. Our results allow us to characterize different regimes of drift, depending on the score estimation error and the proportion of fresh data used in each generation. In a certain regime, the accumulated divergence after several retraining rounds can be expressed as a discounted sum of score estimation errors made at each generation. We also provide empirical results on synthetic data and images to illustrate the theory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文理论分析了基于分数的扩散模型在递归训练合成数据时出现的模型坍塌现象。给出了生成分布与目标分布之间累积散度的上界和下界，其中下界是首次提出。结果表明，累积散度可以表示为各代评分估计误差的折扣和，并区分了不同的漂移机制。
Motivation: 机器学习模型越来越多地使用合成数据进行递归训练，导致性能显著退化，扩散模型领域缺乏对这一现象的理论理解。
Method: 通过理论分析，对结合合成数据与新鲜样本的训练流程，推导出生成分布与目标分布之间累积散度的上界和下界，并在合成数据和图像上进行实验验证。
Result: 获得了累积散度的上下界，首次给出了下界，并表征了不同漂移机制，其中累积散度可表示为评分估计误差的折扣和。
Conclusion: 本文提供了对扩散模型中误差传播和模型坍塌的理论理解，有助于设计更稳健的训练策略。

papers.title: Weight Decay Improves Language Model Plasticity
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are typically trained in two broad phases: pretraining to produce a base model, followed by further training to improve downstream performance. However, hyperparameter optimization and scaling laws are studied primarily from the perspective of the base model's validation loss, overlooking a crucial model property: downstream adaptability. In this work, we study pretraining from the perspective of model plasticity, that is, the ability of the base model to successfully adapt to downstream tasks upon additional training. We focus on the role of weight decay, a key regularization parameter during pretraining, and show through systematic experiments that larger weight decay increases the plasticity of the pretrained model, resulting in greater performance gains downstream after fine-tuning. This effect can lead to counterintuitive trade-offs where base models that perform worse after pretraining can perform better after further training. Further investigation of weight decay's mechanistic effects on model behavior reveals that it encourages linearly separable representations, regularizes attention matrices, and reduces overfitting on the training data. Together, these findings highlight the importance of pretrained model plasticity, the limits of using cross-entropy loss as the sole metric for hyperparameter optimization, and the multifaceted role that a single optimization hyperparameter plays in shaping model behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究预训练阶段权重衰减（weight decay）对大型语言模型可塑性的影响，发现更大的权重衰减能提高预训练模型在下游任务中的适应能力，导致反直觉的权衡：预训练表现较差的模型在微调后可能表现更好。权重衰减通过促进线性可分表示、正则化注意力矩阵和减少过拟合来实现这一效果。
Motivation: 现有超参数优化和缩放定律研究主要关注基模型的验证损失，忽略了模型的下游适应性（即可塑性）这一关键属性。
Method: 通过系统实验，在预训练中改变权重衰减系数，观察对预训练模型可塑性的影响，并分析权重衰减的机制效应（线性可分表示、注意力矩阵正则化、减少过拟合）。
Result: 更大的权重衰减增加预训练模型的可塑性，使得微调后下游性能提升更大；出现反直觉的权衡：预训练损失更高的基模型在微调后可能表现更好。
Conclusion: 强调预训练模型可塑性的重要性，指出交叉熵损失作为唯一超参数优化指标的局限性，并揭示单个优化超参数（权重衰减）对模型行为的多方面影响。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: What Does Preference Learning Recover from Pairwise Comparison Data?
papers.abstract_en: Pairwise preference learning is central to machine learning, with recent applications in aligning language models with human preferences. A typical dataset consists of triplets $(x, y^+, y^-)$, where response $y^+$ is preferred over response $y^-$ for context $x$. The Bradley--Terry (BT) model is the predominant approach, modeling preference probabilities as a function of latent score differences. Standard practice assumes data follows this model and learns the latent scores accordingly. However, real data may violate this assumption, and it remains unclear what BT learning recovers in such cases. Starting from triplet comparison data, we formalize the preference information it encodes through the conditional preference distribution (CPRD). We give precise conditions for when BT is appropriate for modeling the CPRD, and identify factors governing sample efficiency -- namely, margin and connectivity. Together, these results offer a data-centric foundation for understanding what preference learning actually recovers.
papers.journal_ref: ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从理论研究角度探讨当真实数据不满足 Bradley-Terry (BT) 模型假设时，基于 BT 模型的偏好学习究竟恢复什么。作者引入条件偏好分布 (CPRD) 来形式化三元组比较数据中的偏好信息，给出 BT 模型适用于建模 CPRD 的精确条件，并识别影响样本效率的关键因素——边界 (margin) 和连通性 (connectivity)。
Motivation: 实际偏好数据常违背 BT 模型假设，但标准实践仍直接使用该模型学习潜在分数，导致不清楚学到的结果是否合理。论文旨在从数据层面建立严格的理论理解。
Method: 通过三元组比较数据定义条件偏好分布 (CPRD)，分析 BT 模型拟合该分布的适用条件，并推导样本复杂度与数据中边界和连通性的关系。
Result: 给出了 BT 模型正确恢复 CPRD 的充要条件，并刻画了影响样本效率的数据几何特性（边界和连通性）。
Conclusion: 为偏好学习提供了数据中心的视角，帮助理解在模型假设不匹配时 BT 学习实际恢复的内容，强调数据属性对学习结果的关键影响。

papers.title: Effective Reasoning Chains Reduce Intrinsic Dimensionality
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning and its variants have substantially improved the performance of language models on complex reasoning tasks, yet the precise mechanisms by which different strategies facilitate generalization remain poorly understood. While current explanations often point to increased test-time computation or structural guidance, establishing a consistent, quantifiable link between these factors and generalization remains challenging. In this work, we identify intrinsic dimensionality as a quantitative measure for characterizing the effectiveness of reasoning chains. Intrinsic dimensionality quantifies the minimum number of model dimensions needed to reach a given accuracy threshold on a given task. By keeping the model architecture fixed and varying the task formulation through different reasoning strategies, we demonstrate that effective reasoning strategies consistently reduce the intrinsic dimensionality of the task. Validating this on GSM8K with Gemma-3 1B and 4B, we observe a strong inverse correlation between the intrinsic dimensionality of a reasoning strategy and its generalization performance on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution data. Our findings suggest that effective reasoning chains facilitate learning by better compressing the task using fewer parameters, offering a new quantitative metric for analyzing reasoning processes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出内在维度（intrinsic dimensionality）作为量化推理链有效性的指标。通过固定模型架构、改变推理策略，发现有效的推理链（如CoT）能降低任务的内在维度。在GSM8K上用Gemma-3 1B和4B验证，内在维度与分布内和分布外的泛化性能呈强负相关，表明有效推理链通过更少参数压缩任务来促进学习。
Motivation: 尽管链式推理（CoT）等方法提升了语言模型的推理能力，但其促进泛化的具体机制尚不明确，缺少一致的量化衡量标准。
Method: 固定模型架构，通过不同推理策略改变任务表述，测量达到给定精度所需的最小模型维度数（即内在维度），以此评估推理策略的有效性。
Result: 在GSM8K上使用Gemma-3 1B和4B模型，有效的推理策略显著降低了任务的内在维度，且内在维度越低，模型在分布内和分布外数据上的泛化性能越好，二者呈强负相关。
Conclusion: 有效推理链通过用更少参数压缩任务来促进学习，内在维度可作为分析推理过程的新量化指标。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ParisKV: Fast and Drift-Robust KV-Cache Retrieval for Long-Context LLMs
papers.abstract_en: KV-cache retrieval is essential for long-context LLM inference, yet existing methods struggle with distribution drift and high latency at scale. We introduce ParisKV, a drift-robust, GPU-native KV-cache retrieval framework based on collision-based candidate selection, followed by a quantized inner-product reranking estimator. For million-token contexts, ParisKV supports CPU-offloaded KV caches via Unified Virtual Addressing (UVA), enabling on-demand top-$k$ fetching with minimal overhead. ParisKV matches or outperforms full attention quality on long-input and long-generation benchmarks. It achieves state-of-the-art long-context decoding efficiency: it matches or exceeds full attention speed even at batch size 1 for long contexts, delivers up to 2.8$\times$ higher throughput within full attention's runnable range, and scales to million-token contexts where full attention runs out of memory. At million-token scale, ParisKV reduces decode latency by 17$\times$ and 44$\times$ compared to MagicPIG and PQCache, respectively, two state-of-the-art KV-cache Top-$k$ retrieval baselines, code is available at https://github.com/amy-77/ParisKV/tree/main.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ParisKV，一种基于碰撞候选选择和量化内积重排序的GPU原生KV-cache检索框架，用于长上下文LLM推理。它支持通过统一虚拟地址（UVA）将KV-cache卸载到CPU，实现百万token上下文的按需top-k获取。实验表明，ParisKV在长输入和长生成基准上匹配或超越全注意力质量，解码效率达到最优，在百万token规模下延迟分别比MagicPIG和PQCache低17倍和44倍。
Motivation: 现有KV-cache检索方法在大规模长上下文场景中面临分布漂移和高延迟问题。
Method: 基于碰撞的候选选择（collision-based candidate selection）和量化内积重排序估计器（quantized inner-product reranking estimator）的GPU原生框架，利用统一虚拟地址（UVA）实现CPU卸载。
Result: 在长上下文基准上匹配或超越全注意力质量；在百万token上下文下，解码延迟比MagicPIG和PQCache分别降低17倍和44倍；在全注意力可运行范围内，吞吐量提升高达2.8倍。

papers.title: Pull Requests as a Training Signal for Repo-Level Code Editing
papers.abstract_en: Repository-level code editing requires models to understand complex dependencies and execute precise multi-file modifications across a large codebase. While recent gains on SWE-bench rely heavily on complex agent scaffolding, it remains unclear how much of this capability can be internalised via high-quality training signals. To address this, we propose Clean Pull Request (Clean-PR), a mid-training paradigm that leverages real-world GitHub pull requests as a training signal for repository-level editing. We introduce a scalable pipeline that converts noisy pull request diffs into Search/Replace edit blocks through reconstruction and validation, resulting in the largest publicly available corpus of 2 million pull requests spanning 12 programming languages. Using this training signal, we perform a mid-training stage followed by an agentless-aligned supervised fine-tuning process with error-driven data augmentation. On SWE-bench, our model significantly outperforms the instruction-tuned baseline, achieving absolute improvements of 13.6% on SWE-bench Lite and 12.3% on SWE-bench Verified. These results demonstrate that repository-level code understanding and editing capabilities can be effectively internalised into model weights under a simplified, agentless protocol, without relying on heavy inference-time scaffolding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Clean-PR范式，利用真实GitHub pull request作为仓库级代码编辑的训练信号，通过可扩展的流水线将噪声PR差异转换为Search/Replace编辑块，构建了覆盖12种编程语言的200万PR语料库。结合中间训练和错误驱动数据增强的监督微调，在SWE-bench上取得显著提升，证明仓库级代码编辑能力可通过简化、无智能体协议内化到模型权重中。
Motivation: 现有仓库级代码编辑方法依赖复杂智能体脚手架，尚未明确高质量训练信号能否内化这种能力。本文旨在利用真实世界PR作为训练信号，探索无需推理时复杂智能体的训练范式。
Method: 提出Clean-PR中间训练范式，包括：可扩展流水线将噪声PR差异转换为Search/Replace编辑块并验证；利用该语料进行中间训练；随后进行无智能体对齐的监督微调并采用错误驱动数据增强。
Result: 在SWE-bench上，模型相比指令微调基线在SWE-bench Lite上绝对提升13.6%，在SWE-bench Verified上提升12.3%。
Conclusion: 仓库级代码理解与编辑能力可通过简化、无智能体的协议有效内化到模型权重中，无需依赖推理时复杂脚手架。

papers.title: Fair Decisions from Calibrated Scores: Achieving Optimal Classification While Satisfying Sufficiency
papers.abstract_en: Binary classification based on predicted probabilities (scores) is a fundamental task in supervised machine learning. While thresholding scores is Bayes-optimal in the unconstrained setting, using a single threshold generally violates statistical group fairness constraints. Under independence (statistical parity) and separation (equalized odds), such thresholding suffices when the scores already satisfy the corresponding criterion. However, this does not extend to sufficiency: even perfectly group-calibrated scores -- including true class probabilities -- violate predictive parity after thresholding. In this work, we present an exact solution for optimal binary (randomized) classification under sufficiency, assuming finite sets of group-calibrated scores. We provide a geometric characterization of the feasible pairs of positive predictive value (PPV) and false omission rate (FOR) achievable by such classifiers, and use it to derive a simple post-processing algorithm that attains the optimal classifier using only group-calibrated scores and group membership. Finally, since sufficiency and separation are generally incompatible, we identify the classifier that minimizes deviation from separation subject to sufficiency, and show that it can also be obtained by our algorithm, often achieving performance comparable to the optimum.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在满足充分性（sufficiency）公平约束下的最优二分类问题。作者利用组校准分数（group-calibrated scores）的有限集，给出了可行（PPV, FOR）对的几何刻画，并提出了一个简单的后处理算法，可以同时实现最优分类和充分性。此外，在充分性与分离性（separation）不可兼得时，该算法还能找到最小化偏离分离性的分类器，性能接近最优。
Motivation: 现有的阈值分类方法在独立性（independence）和分离性（separation）约束下可以沿用满足相应条件的分数，但在充分性（sufficiency）约束下即使使用完全组校准的分数（包括真实类别概率），阈值后也会违反预测平权（predictive parity）。因此需要一种在充分性下实现最优分类的通用方法。
Method: 假设有限组校准分数集，对可行分类器（随机二分类）的阳性预测值（PPV）和假阴性率（FOR）进行几何刻画，并据此推导出一个仅需组校准分数和组标签的后处理算法，以得到满足充分性的最优分类器。
Result: 给出了在充分性约束下最优分类器的精确解，并通过合成数据和现实数据集验证了算法能有效实现最优PPV/FOR权衡，且在无法同时满足充分性和分离性时，可最小化对分离性的偏离，性能接近理论最优。
Conclusion: 该工作为充分性约束下的公平分类提供了严格的理论保证和可计算的后处理方案，并展示了在公平性度量冲突时如何折中。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Stop the Flip-Flop: Context-Preserving Verification for Fast Revocable Diffusion Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Parallel diffusion decoding can accelerate diffusion language model inference by unmasking multiple tokens per step, but aggressive parallelism often harms quality. Revocable decoding mitigates this by rechecking earlier tokens, yet we observe that existing verification schemes frequently trigger flip-flop oscillations, where tokens are remasked and later restored unchanged. This behaviour slows inference in two ways: remasking verified positions weakens the conditioning context for parallel drafting, and repeated remask cycles consume the revision budget with little net progress. We propose COVER (Cache Override Verification for Efficient Revision), which performs leave-one-out verification and stable drafting within a single forward pass. COVER constructs two attention views via KV cache override: selected seeds are masked for verification, while their cached key value states are injected for all other queries to preserve contextual information, with a closed form diagonal correction preventing self leakage at the seed positions. COVER further prioritises seeds using a stability aware score that balances uncertainty, downstream influence, and cache drift, and it adapts the number of verified seeds per step. Across benchmarks, COVER markedly reduces unnecessary revisions and yields faster decoding while preserving output quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对并行扩散解码中验证机制导致的翻转振荡问题，提出COVER方法，通过KV缓存覆盖和留一验证，在单前向传播中实现稳定并行解码，减少不必要的重校验并加速推理。
Motivation: 现有可撤销解码（revocable decoding）中，验证机制常导致token反复被掩码又恢复原样（翻转振荡），浪费修订预算，降低解码速度。
Method: COVER采用留一验证（leave-one-out verification）和稳定并行解码（stable drafting），通过KV缓存覆盖构造两种注意力视图：掩码选定种子用于验证，同时注入其KV状态以保留上下文信息，并用闭式对角校正防止种子位置的自泄漏。此外，使用稳定性感知分数排序种子并自适应调整验证数量。
Result: 在多个基准上，COVER显著减少不必要的修订，在保持输出质量的同时实现更快的解码速度。
Conclusion: COVER通过改进验证机制和上下文保留，有效抑制翻转振荡，提升扩散语言模型并行解码效率。

papers.title: Mixture of Concept Bottleneck Experts
papers.abstract_en: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) promote interpretability by grounding predictions in human-understandable concepts. However, existing CBMs typically constrain their task predictor to a single expression whose functional form is set a priori, limiting both predictive accuracy and adaptability to diverse user needs. We propose Mixture of Concept Bottleneck Experts (M-CBE), a framework that generalizes existing CBMs along two dimensions: the number of expressions, referred to as experts, employed by the task predictor to map concepts to the task, and the functional form each expression takes, thus exposing an underexplored region of this design space. We investigate this region by instantiating two novel models: Linear M-CBE, which learns a finite set of linear expressions, and Symbolic M-CBE, which leverages symbolic regression to discover expert functions from data subject to user-specified operator vocabularies. Empirical evaluation demonstrates that varying the number of expressions and their functional form provides a robust framework for navigating the accuracy-interpretability trade-off.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出混合概念瓶颈专家 (M-CBE) 框架，通过使用多个表达式（专家）和灵活的函数形式来泛化现有概念瓶颈模型。具体实例包括线性 M-CBE（学习一组线性表达式）和符号 M-CBE（利用符号回归从数据中发现专家函数）。实验表明，调整表达式数量和函数形式能有效平衡准确性与可解释性。
Motivation: 现有概念瓶颈模型通常使用单个先验设定的函数形式将概念映射到任务预测，限制了预测精度和用户需求的适应性。
Method: 提出 M-CBE 框架，沿两个维度扩展：任务预测器中使用的专家数量（表达式数量）和每个表达式的函数形式。实例包括线性 M-CBE（有限线性表达式集）和符号 M-CBE（基于符号回归的表达式发现）。
Result: 实证评估显示，改变表达式数量和函数形式能稳健地指导准确性与可解释性之间的权衡。
Conclusion: M-CBE 提供了导航准确-可解释权衡的通用框架，但摘要未提及局限性或适用范围。

papers.title: Multi-Agent Teams Hold Experts Back
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent LLM systems are increasingly deployed as autonomous collaborators, where agents interact freely rather than execute fixed, pre-specified workflows. In such settings, effective coordination cannot be fully designed in advance and must instead emerge through interaction. However, most prior work enforces coordination through fixed roles, workflows, or aggregation rules, leaving open the question of how well self-organizing teams perform when coordination is unconstrained. Drawing on organizational psychology, we study whether self-organizing LLM teams achieve strong synergy, where team performance matches or exceeds the best individual member. Across human-inspired and frontier ML benchmarks, we find that -- unlike human teams -- LLM teams consistently fail to match their expert agent's performance, even when explicitly told who the expert is, incurring performance losses of up to 41.1% on ML benchmarks. Decomposing this failure, we show that expert leveraging, rather than identification, is the primary bottleneck. Conversational analysis reveals a tendency toward integrative compromise -- averaging expert and non-expert views rather than appropriately weighting expertise -- which increases with team size and correlates negatively with performance. Interestingly, this consensus-seeking behavior improves robustness to adversarial agents, suggesting a trade-off between alignment and effective expertise utilization. Our findings reveal a significant gap in the ability of self-organizing multi-agent teams to harness the collective expertise of their members.
papers.comment: Accepted at the International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究自组织多智能体LLM团队在无固定角色或工作流下的协作表现。与人类团队不同，LLM团队无法匹配其专家成员的表现，性能损失高达41.1%。主要瓶颈在于专家利用率而非识别，团队倾向于整合性妥协导致性能下降。
Motivation: 现有多智能体系统多通过固定角色或规则实现协调，但自组织团队在无约束交互下能否有效协作尚不清楚。
Method: 基于组织心理学，设计实验比较LLM团队与人类团队在协作任务中的表现，分析专家利用失败的原因。
Result: LLM团队在多个基准上无法达到最佳单个专家成员的表现，性能损失最高41.1%。专家利用而非识别是主要瓶颈，且共识寻求行为在提高对抗鲁棒性的同时降低了性能。
Conclusion: 自组织多智能体LLM团队在利用集体专家知识方面存在显著差距，揭示了协调机制设计的必要性。

papers.title: SALAAD: Sparse And Low-Rank Adaptation via ADMM for Large Language Model Inference
papers.abstract_en: Modern large language models are increasingly deployed under compute and memory constraints, making flexible control of model capacity a central challenge. While sparse and low-rank structures naturally trade off capacity and performance, existing approaches often rely on heuristic designs that ignore layer and matrix heterogeneity or require model-specific architectural modifications. We propose SALAAD, a plug-and-play framework applicable to different model architectures that induces sparse and low-rank structures during training. By formulating structured weight learning under an augmented Lagrangian framework and introducing an adaptive controller that dynamically balances the training loss and structural constraints, SALAAD preserves the stability of standard training dynamics while enabling explicit control over the evolution of effective model capacity during training. Experiments across model scales show that SALAAD substantially reduces memory consumption during deployment while achieving performance comparable to ad-hoc methods. Moreover, a single training run yields a continuous spectrum of model capacities, enabling smooth and elastic deployment across diverse memory budgets without the need for retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SALAAD，一个即插即用的框架，在训练过程中诱导稀疏和低秩结构，通过增广拉格朗日框架和自适应控制器动态平衡训练损失与结构约束，实现模型容量灵活控制。实验表明，该方法在部署时大幅降低内存消耗，性能与特设方法相当，且单次训练产生连续模型容量谱，无需重新训练即可适应不同内存预算。
Motivation: 现有方法依赖启发式设计，忽略层和矩阵异质性，或需要模型特定的架构修改，无法灵活控制模型容量以适应计算和内存约束。
Method: 提出SALAAD框架，基于增广拉格朗日方法进行结构化权重学习，并引入自适应控制器动态平衡训练损失和结构约束，保持标准训练动态稳定性，同时显式控制有效模型容量的演化。
Result: 在不同规模模型上，SALAAD显著降低部署时的内存消耗，性能与特设方法相当，且单次训练可产生连续模型容量谱，支持弹性部署无需重训练。
Conclusion: SALAAD是一个即插即用框架，适用于不同模型架构，能够在训练中诱导稀疏和低秩结构，实现灵活的容量控制，且无需模型特定修改。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: NEMO: Execution-Aware Optimization Modeling via Autonomous Coding Agents
papers.abstract_en: We present NEMO, a system that translates Natural-language descriptions of decision problems into formal Executable Mathematical Optimization implementations using autonomous coding agents (ACAs). Existing approaches rely on specialized large language models (LLMs) or bespoke task-specific agents that are often brittle and frequently generate syntactically invalid or non-executable code. NEMO instead treats ACAs as a first-class abstraction analogous to API-based interaction with LLMs; their sandboxed execution guarantees code is executable by construction and supports automated validation and repair. We introduce novel coordination patterns including asymmetric validation loops between independently generated optimizer and simulator implementations, external memory for experience reuse, and robustness enhancements via minimum Bayes risk (MBR) decoding and self-consistency. Across nine established optimization benchmarks, NEMO achieves state-of-the-art performance on the majority of tasks with substantial margins on several datasets, demonstrating the power of execution-aware agentic architectures for automated optimization modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NEMO 系统，利用自主编码代理将决策问题的自然语言描述转化为可执行的数学优化代码。系统通过沙箱执行保证代码可运行，并引入非对称验证循环、外部记忆和经验复用等协调模式，在九个优化基准上取得最优性能。
Motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的优化建模方法常生成语法无效或不可执行的代码，且缺乏执行反馈和自动化修复能力。
Method: 将自主编码代理作为一等抽象，通过沙箱执行保证代码可运行；采用非对称验证循环（独立生成的优化器与模拟器相互验证）、外部记忆用于经验复用，以及最小贝叶斯风险解码和自我一致性增强鲁棒性。
Result: 在九个优化基准上，NEMO 在多数任务上达到最先进性能，并在部分数据集上大幅领先。
Conclusion: 执行感知的代理架构能有效自动化优化建模，且优于现有专用 LLM 或定制代理方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When More Data Doesn't Help: Limits of Adaptation in Multitask Learning
papers.abstract_en: Multitask learning and related frameworks have achieved tremendous success in modern applications. In multitask learning problem, we are given a set of heterogeneous datasets collected from related source tasks and hope to enhance the performance above what we could hope to achieve by solving each of them individually. The recent work of arXiv:2006.15785 has showed that, without access to distributional information, no algorithm based on aggregating samples alone can guarantee optimal risk as long as the sample size per task is bounded. In this paper, we focus on understanding the statistical limits of multitask learning. We go beyond the no-free-lunch theorem in arXiv:2006.15785 by establishing a stronger impossibility result of adaptation that holds for arbitrarily large sample size per task. This improvement conveys an important message that the hardness of multitask learning cannot be overcame by having abundant data per task. We also discuss the notion of optimal adaptivity that may be of future interests.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了多任务学习的统计极限，证明了即使在每任务样本量无限大的情况下，适应性仍然不可能，克服了之前结果对样本量有界的限制。这个结果强调了多任务学习的内在困难不能通过增加每任务数据量来解决。
Motivation: 以往多任务学习的“没有免费午餐”定理假设每任务样本量有界，本文希望理解在样本量无限大时是否仍存在适应性限制。
Method: 通过理论证明建立更强的适应性不可能性结果，适用于任意大的每任务样本量。
Result: 证明了当样本量每任务任意大时，仍然无法保证最优风险，表明多任务学习的硬性不能通过增加数据克服。
Conclusion: 多任务学习的困难本质上是适应性的限制，而非数据量不足；文章还讨论了未来可能的最优适应性概念。

papers.title: To Grok Grokking: Provable Grokking in Ridge Regression
papers.abstract_en: We study grokking, the onset of generalization long after overfitting, in a classical ridge regression setting. We prove end-to-end grokking results for learning over-parameterized linear regression models using gradient descent with weight decay. Specifically, we prove that the following stages occur: (i) the model overfits the training data early during training; (ii) poor generalization persists long after overfitting has manifested; and (iii) the generalization error eventually becomes arbitrarily small. Moreover, we show, both theoretically and empirically, that grokking can be amplified or eliminated in a principled manner through proper hyperparameter tuning. To the best of our knowledge, these are the first rigorous quantitative bounds on the generalization delay (which we refer to as the "grokking time") in terms of training hyperparameters. Lastly, going beyond the linear setting, we empirically demonstrate that our quantitative bounds also capture the behavior of grokking on non-linear neural networks. Our results suggest that grokking is not an inherent failure mode of deep learning, but rather a consequence of specific training conditions, and thus does not require fundamental changes to the model architecture or learning algorithm to avoid.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在岭回归（ridge regression）中严格证明了grokking现象，即过拟合后泛化突然出现。作者证明在使用梯度下降和权重衰减时，模型会经历过拟合、长期泛化不良、最终泛化误差任意小三个阶段，并给出了泛化延迟（grokking时间）与超参数之间的定量界限。实验表明这些界限也能描述非线性神经网络的grokking行为。
Motivation: grokking现象在深度学习中被观察到但缺乏理论理解，本文旨在通过线性模型的可证明分析揭示其机制。
Method: 在过参数化线性回归中使用梯度下降与权重衰减，理论上推导训练动态的三个阶段，并建立泛化延迟与超参数（如权重衰减强度、学习率）的定量关系。
Result: 严格证明了grokking的三阶段过程，首次给出了grokking时间的定量上界；实验验证了理论结果在非线性神经网络中的适用性。
Conclusion: grokking并非深度学习的固有缺陷，而是特定训练条件（如权重衰减）的后果，无需改变架构或算法即可避免。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Post-Training Neural Network Pruning using Graph Curvature
papers.abstract_en: This paper provides a fresh view of the neural network (NN) pruning problem through the lens of graph theory. To achieve effective pruning, we aim to identify the main NN data flows and the corresponding NN connections that are most and least important for the performance of the full model. Unlike the standard approach to NN data flow analysis, which is based on information theory, we employ the notion of graph curvature, specifically Ollivier-Ricci curvature (ORC). ORC has been successfully used to identify important graph edges in various domains such as road traffic analysis, biological networks, and social networks. In particular, edges with negative ORC are considered bottlenecks and are therefore critical to the graph's overall connectivity, whereas positive-ORC edges are less essential. We use this intuition for NNs to (1) construct a graph induced by the NN structure and introduce the notion of neural curvature (NC) based on ORC; (2) calculate curvatures based on activation patterns for a set of input examples; and (3) demonstrate that NC can be used to rank edges according to their importance for overall NN functionality. We evaluate our method through pruning experiments on a variety of small and medium size models trained on three image datasets: MNIST, CIFAR-10, and CIFAR-100. The results indicate that our method can identify a larger number of unimportant edges compared to existing pruning methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从图论视角出发，利用Ollivier-Ricci曲率（ORC）来识别神经网络中重要和不重要的连接。通过构建神经网络结构诱导的图，定义神经曲率（NC），并基于输入样本的激活模式计算曲率，从而按重要性对边排序。在MNIST、CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上的剪枝实验表明，该方法能比现有方法识别出更多不重要的边。
Motivation: 现有神经网络剪枝方法通常基于信息论分析数据流，但缺乏对图结构重要性的直接度量。本文利用图曲率（ORC）的概念，旨在更有效地识别对模型性能关键和冗余的连接。
Method: 将神经网络结构映射为图，基于Ollivier-Ricci曲率定义神经曲率（NC），通过前向传播激活模式计算每条边的曲率，曲率负值视为瓶颈（重要），正值视为冗余，据此进行剪枝。
Result: 在MNIST、CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100数据集上，对中小型模型进行剪枝实验，该方法能识别出更多不重要的边，优于现有剪枝方法。
Conclusion: 图曲率（特别是ORC）为神经网络剪枝提供了新的有效视角，能够区分重要与冗余连接，且具有跨数据集和模型的适用性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Performance and Complexity Trade-off Optimization of Speech Models During Training
papers.abstract_en: In speech machine learning, neural network models are typically designed by choosing an architecture with fixed layer sizes and structure. These models are then trained to maximize performance on metrics aligned with the task's objective. While the overall architecture is usually guided by prior knowledge of the task, the sizes of individual layers are often chosen heuristically. However, this approach does not guarantee an optimal trade-off between performance and computational complexity; consequently, post hoc methods such as weight quantization or model pruning are typically employed to reduce computational cost. This occurs because stochastic gradient descent (SGD) methods can only optimize differentiable functions, while factors influencing computational complexity, such as layer sizes and floating-point operations per second (FLOP/s), are non-differentiable and require modifying the model structure during training. We propose a reparameterization technique based on feature noise injection that enables joint optimization of performance and computational complexity during training using SGD-based methods. Unlike traditional pruning methods, our approach allows the model size to be dynamically optimized for a target performance-complexity trade-off, without relying on heuristic criteria to select which weights or structures to remove. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method through three case studies, including a synthetic example and two practical real-world applications: voice activity detection and audio anti-spoofing. The code related to our work is publicly available to encourage further research.
papers.comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于特征噪声注入（feature noise injection）的重参数化技术，使随机梯度下降（SGD）方法能够在训练中联合优化语音模型的性能与计算复杂度（如层大小和FLOP/s）。与传统事后剪枝不同，该方法无需启发式规则，可动态调整模型结构。通过合成示例、语音活动检测和音频反欺骗三个案例验证了有效性。
Motivation: 传统语音模型训练中，层大小等影响计算复杂度的因素是非可微的，因此只能通过事后量化或剪枝降低复杂度，无法在训练中同时优化性能和复杂度，导致次优的权衡。
Method: 提出基于特征噪声注入的重参数化技术，将非可微的计算复杂度指标转化为可微形式，从而允许SGD方法在训练过程中联合优化性能与复杂度，无需事后剪枝或启发式选择。
Result: 通过合成示例、语音活动检测和音频反欺骗三个案例展示了方法的有效性，能够动态调整模型大小以达到目标性能-复杂度权衡。
Conclusion: 该方法在训练中直接优化性能-复杂度权衡，避免了事后剪枝的启发式步骤，为语音模型的高效训练提供了新途径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PASTA: A Scalable Framework for Multi-Policy AI Compliance Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: AI compliance is becoming increasingly critical as AI systems grow more powerful and pervasive. Yet the rapid expansion of AI policies creates substantial burdens for resource-constrained practitioners lacking policy expertise. Existing approaches typically address one policy at a time, making multi-policy compliance costly. We present PASTA, a scalable compliance tool integrating four innovations: (1) a comprehensive model-card format supporting descriptive inputs across development stages; (2) a policy normalization scheme; (3) an efficient LLM-powered pairwise evaluation engine with cost-saving strategies; and (4) an interface delivering interpretable evaluations via compliance heatmaps and actionable recommendations. Expert evaluation shows PASTA's judgments closely align with human experts ($ρ\geq .626$). The system evaluates five major policies in under two minutes at approximately \$3. A user study (N = 12) confirms practitioners found outputs easy-to-understand and actionable, introducing a novel framework for scalable automated AI governance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PASTA是一个可扩展的多政策AI合规评估框架，集成了模型卡、政策规范化、基于LLM的成对评估引擎和可解释性界面。专家评估显示其判断与人类专家高度一致（ρ≥0.626），可在约2分钟内评估五项主要政策，成本约3美元。用户研究（N=12）确认输出易于理解和可操作。
Motivation: AI系统日益强大和普及，但政策快速扩展给资源有限的从业者带来沉重负担。现有方法通常一次评估一个政策，多政策合规成本高昂。

papers.title: Flow Equivariant World Models: Memory for Partially Observed Dynamic Environments
papers.abstract_en: Embodied systems experience the world as 'a symphony of flows': a combination of many continuous streams of sensory input coupled to self-motion, interwoven with the dynamics of external objects. These sensory streams and the underlying dynamics of the world obey smooth, time-parameterized symmetries which existing world models ignore. Without a memory that respects this structure, partial observability presents a major obstacle to existing methods: each observation reveals only a fraction of the world, while unobserved regions continue to evolve. In this work, we introduce Flow Equivariant World Modeling, a framework that leverages time-parameterized symmetries within a latent memory for stable and accurate dynamics prediction over long horizons. The latent memory shifts and transforms equivariantly with self-motion and inferred external object motion, keeping information about out-of-view regions aligned as time progresses. We demonstrate the advantage of this framework over state-of-the-art diffusion, memory-augmented, and recurrent world model architectures on 2D and 3D partially observed video world modeling benchmarks. More broadly, our results suggest that predictive representations become more powerful when they are organized in line with the temporal and dynamical structure of the world they model. Project page: https://flowequivariantworldmodels.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出流等变世界建模（Flow Equivariant World Modeling）框架，通过利用时间参数化对称性在潜在记忆中实现长期稳定的动力学预测。该方法在2D和3D部分可观测视频世界建模基准上优于扩散、记忆增强和循环世界模型架构。
Motivation: 部分可观测性对现有方法构成重大障碍，每个观测仅揭示世界的一小部分，而未观测区域持续演化；现有世界模型忽略了时间参数化对称性，缺乏尊重该结构的记忆。
Method: 引入流等变世界建模，使潜在记忆随自运动和推断的外部物体等变地移动和变换，随时间保持视外区域信息对齐。
Result: 在2D和3D部分可观测视频世界建模基准上，性能超过当前最先进的扩散、记忆增强和循环世界模型架构。
Conclusion: 预测表征在按照世界的时间与动力学结构组织时会变得更强大。

papers.title: Softly Constrained Denoisers for Diffusion Models Applied to Partial Differential Equations
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have become a powerful generative prior for solutions of partial differential equations (PDEs). Existing approaches enforce physical constraints either by adding the PDE residuals as loss regularizers or through inference-time adjustments. These methods bias the model away from the true data distribution, which is especially problematic when the governing PDE is misspecified. To circumvent these issues while making the most out of the PDE constraint, we introduce soft inductive biases into the denoiser architecture derived from the PDEs. We show that these softly constrained denoisers exploit constraint knowledge to improve compliance over standard denoisers, while maintaining enough flexibility to deviate from it in case of misspecification with respect to observed data.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对扩散模型在求解偏微分方程（PDE）时，现有方法通过添加PDE残差损失或推理时调整来施加物理约束，但会偏离真实数据分布的问题，提出在去噪器架构中引入源自PDE的软归纳偏置。实验表明，软约束去噪器相比标准去噪器能更好地遵循约束，同时在PDE错误设定时保持灵活性。
Motivation: 现有方法通过损失正则化或推理时调整来强加PDE约束，会偏置模型远离真实数据分布，尤其在PDE错误设定时问题更严重。需要一种既能利用PDE约束又不牺牲模型灵活性的方法。
Method: 在去噪器架构中引入软归纳偏置，该偏置源自PDE，使模型在训练中倾向于遵守物理规律，但允许在数据与PDE不一致时偏离约束。
Result: 软约束去噪器相比标准去噪器提高了对PDE约束的遵守程度，同时在PDE错误设定时仍能保持足够的灵活性以避免偏离数据分布。
Conclusion: 所提方法有效结合了PDE约束与数据驱动灵活性，适用于物理约束不完全准确的应用场景。

papers.title: Reasoning-Aware Multimodal Fusion for Hateful Video Detection
papers.abstract_en: Hate speech in online videos is posing an increasingly serious threat to digital platforms, especially as video content becomes increasingly multimodal and context-dependent. Existing methods often struggle to effectively fuse the complex semantic relationships between modalities and lack the ability to understand nuanced hateful content. To address these issues, we propose an innovative Reasoning-Aware Multimodal Fusion (RAMF) framework. To tackle the first challenge, we design Local-Global Context Fusion (LGCF) to capture both local salient cues and global temporal structures, and propose Semantic Cross Attention (SCA) to enable fine-grained multimodal semantic interaction. To tackle the second challenge, we introduce adversarial reasoning-a structured three-stage process where a vision-language model generates (i) objective descriptions, (ii) hate-assumed inferences, and (iii) non-hate-assumed inferences-providing complementary semantic perspectives that enrich the model's contextual understanding of nuanced hateful intent. Evaluations on two real-world hateful video datasets demonstrate that our method achieves robust generalisation performance, improving upon state-of-the-art methods by 3% and 7% in Macro-F1 and hate class recall, respectively. The source codes and data required to reproduce our results are available at https://github.com/Multimodal-Intelligence-Lab-MIL/RAMF.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个推理感知的多模态融合 (RAMF) 框架用于仇恨视频检测。该方法通过局部-全局上下文融合 (LGCF) 和语义交叉注意力 (SCA) 捕获多模态间的细粒度及全局结构关系，并引入对抗推理三阶段过程（客观描述、假设仇恨推理、假设非仇恨推理）来增强对微妙仇恨意图的理解。在两个真实数据集上，该方法在 Macro-F1 和仇恨类召回率上分别超越现有最佳方法 3% 和 7%。
Motivation: 现有方法难以有效融合多模态间的复杂语义关系，且缺乏对微妙仇恨内容的理解能力。
Method: 提出 RAMF 框架，包含 (i) 局部-全局上下文融合 (LGCF) 捕捉局部显著线索和全局时间结构；(ii) 语义交叉注意力 (SCA) 实现细粒度多模态交互；(iii) 对抗推理三阶段过程，利用视觉-语言模型生成客观描述、仇恨假设推理和非仇恨假设推理，提供互补语义视角。
Result: 在两个真实仇恨视频数据集上，该方法在 Macro-F1 上提升 3%，在仇恨类召回率上提升 7%。
Conclusion: 该框架通过增强对细微仇恨意图的上下文理解，实现了鲁棒的泛化性能。

papers.title: Outcome-Aware Spectral Feature Learning for Instrumental Variable Regression
papers.abstract_en: We address the problem of causal effect estimation in the presence of hidden confounders using nonparametric instrumental variable (IV) regression. An established approach is to use estimators based on learned spectral features, that is, features spanning the top singular subspaces of the operator linking treatments to instruments. While powerful, such features are agnostic to the outcome variable. Consequently, the method can fail when the true causal function is poorly represented by these dominant singular functions. To mitigate, we introduce Augmented Spectral Feature Learning, a framework that makes the feature learning process outcome-aware. Our method learns features by minimizing a novel contrastive loss derived from an augmented operator that incorporates information from the outcome. By learning these task-specific features, our approach remains effective even under spectral misalignment. We provide a theoretical analysis of this framework and validate our approach on challenging benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向结果的谱特征学习方法（Augmented Spectral Feature Learning），用于非参数工具变量回归中的因果效应估计。通过引入一种新的对比损失，从包含结果信息的增广算子中学习任务特定特征，从而在谱错位情况下仍能保持有效性。提供了理论分析并在挑战性基准上验证了方法。
Motivation: 现有基于谱特征的工具变量回归方法学习的特征与结果变量无关，当真实因果函数在主导奇异函数上表示不佳时，方法会失效。因此需要让特征学习过程感知结果，以解决谱错位问题。
Method: 提出Augmented Spectral Feature Learning框架，通过最小化一种新的对比损失来学习特征，该损失来源于一个结合了结果信息的增广算子，从而使得特征学习过程面向结果。
Result: 在挑战性基准上验证了方法的有效性，表明即使在谱错位情况下仍能保持良好性能。
Conclusion: 本文提出的面向结果的谱特征学习方法能够改善工具变量回归中的特征学习，提高因果效应估计的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Physics Enhanced Deep Surrogates for the Phonon Boltzmann Transport Equation
papers.abstract_en: Designing materials with controlled heat flow at the nano-scale is central to advances in microelectronics, thermoelectrics, and energy-conversion technologies. At these scales, phonon transport follows the Boltzmann Transport Equation (BTE), which captures non-diffusive (ballistic) effects but is too costly to solve repeatedly in inverse-design loops. Existing surrogate approaches trade speed for accuracy: fast macroscopic solvers can overestimate conductivities by hundreds of percent, while recent data-driven operator learners often require thousands of high-fidelity simulations. This creates a need for a fast, data-efficient surrogate that remains reliable across ballistic and diffusive regimes. We introduce a Physics-Enhanced Deep Surrogate (PEDS) that combines a differentiable Fourier solver with a neural generator and couples it with uncertainty-driven active learning. The Fourier solver acts as a physical inductive bias, while the network learns geometry-dependent corrections and a mixing coefficient that interpolates between macroscopic and nano-scale behavior. PEDS reduces training-data requirements by up to 70% compared with purely data-driven baselines, achieves roughly 5% fractional error with only 300 high-fidelity BTE simulations, and enables efficient design of porous geometries spanning 12-85 W m$^{-1}$ K$^{-1}$ with average design errors of 4%. The learned mixing parameter recovers the ballistic-diffusive transition and improves out of distribution robustness. These results show that embedding simple, differentiable low-fidelity physics can dramatically increase surrogate data-efficiency and interpretability, making repeated PDE-constrained optimization practical for nano-scale thermal-materials design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种物理增强深度代理模型（PEDS），结合可微傅里叶求解器与神经网络生成器，用于快速求解声子玻尔兹曼输运方程（BTE）。PEDS在仅需300次高保真BTE模拟时达到约5%的分数误差，训练数据需求减少70%，并能高效设计孔隙几何结构（12–85 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹），平均设计误差4%。该方法通过物理归纳偏置提高了数据效率和可解释性，适用于纳米级热材料逆向设计。
Motivation: 纳米尺度热设计中，BTE求解成本过高，而现有代理模型要么精度差（快但误差大），要么数据需求大（如数据驱动算子学习需数千次高保真模拟）。亟需一种快速且数据高效的代理，在弹道和扩散 regime 下均保持可靠。
Method: 提出PEDS，包含一个可微傅里叶求解器（作为物理归纳偏置）和一个生成修正项的神经网络，并耦合不确定性驱动的主动学习。网络学习几何依赖的修正和混合系数，以插值宏观与纳米尺度行为。
Result: 与纯数据驱动基线相比，训练数据减少70%；仅用300次高保真BTE模拟即实现约5%分数误差；设计孔隙几何结构时，导热率范围12–85 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹，平均设计误差4%。学习到的混合参数能恢复弹道-扩散转变，并提升分布外鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 嵌入简单可微的低保真物理模型能显著提高代理的数据效率和可解释性，使重复的PDE约束优化在纳米热材料设计中变得实用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Distilling Counterfactual Reasoning from Language to Vision: Causal Graph Guided Post-Training for Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Vision Language Models (VLMs) have recently shown significant advancements in video understanding, especially in feature alignment, event reasoning, and instruction-following tasks. However, their capability for counterfactual reasoning, inferring alternative outcomes under hypothetical conditions, remains underexplored. This capability is essential for robust video understanding, as it requires identifying underlying causal structures and reasoning about unobserved possibilities, rather than merely recognizing observed patterns. To systematically evaluate this capability, we introduce CounterVQA, a video-based benchmark featuring three progressive difficulty levels that assess different aspects of counterfactual reasoning. Through comprehensive evaluation of both state-of-the-art open-source and closed-source models, we uncover a substantial performance gap: while these models achieve reasonable accuracy on simple counterfactual questions, performance degrades significantly on complex multi-hop causal chains. To address these limitations, we develop a post-training method, CFGPT, that enhances a model's visual counterfactual reasoning ability by distilling its counterfactual reasoning capability from the language modality, yielding consistent improvements across all CounterVQA difficulty levels. Dataset and code will be further released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉语言模型在反事实推理（counterfactual reasoning）方面的不足，提出CounterVQA基准和CFGPT后训练方法。CounterVQA包含三个难度层级，评估模型在假设条件下推断替代结果的能力。实验显示现有模型在简单问题上表现尚可，但在复杂多跳因果链上显著下降。CFGPT通过从语言模态蒸馏反事实推理能力来增强视觉模型，在CounterVQA各难度层级上均取得一致提升。
Motivation: 视觉语言模型在视频理解中反事实推理能力未被充分探索，而该能力对鲁棒理解至关重要，但现有模型在复杂多跳因果推理上表现不佳。
Method: 提出CounterVQA基准和CFGPT后训练方法：通过因果图引导，将语言模态中的反事实推理能力蒸馏到视觉模态，增强模型对未观察可能性的推理。
Result: 在CounterVQA上，现有开源和闭源模型在简单反事实问题上准确率尚可，但在复杂多跳因果问题上显著下降；CFGPT在所有难度层级上带来一致提升。
Conclusion: 本文强调通过跨模态蒸馏可以提升视觉模型的反事实推理能力，并提供了评估基准和方法。数据集和代码将发布。

papers.title: UniMedVL: Unifying Medical Multimodal Understanding and Generation through Observation-Knowledge-Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Medical workflows routinely combine reading images with producing visual and textual outputs, making both image understanding and generation central to medical AI. Most existing systems, however, address these abilities in isolated models, losing the shared knowledge that a unified architecture could exploit. To bridge this gap, we present UniMedVL, the first unified medical model that seamlessly integrates multimodal understanding and generation capabilities within a single model without switching weights. We achieve this via a tailored progressive training pipeline where understanding and generation mutually reinforce each other. To effectively train UniMedVL, we curate UniMedVL-5M, the first large-scale medical dataset comprising over 5.6M instances across 8 medical imaging modalities, tailored for multimodal input-output tasks in unified medical understanding and generation. Experimental results demonstrate that UniMedVL achieves competitive performance on five medical understanding benchmarks. Crucially, UniMedVL natively supports diverse interleaved generation tasks, e.g., virtual staining, super-resolution, cross-modal synthesis, essential for complex medical workflows. Our code and dataset are publicly available.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UniMedVL 是首个统一医学多模态理解与生成的模型，无需切换权重即可同时处理图像理解与生成任务。通过渐进式训练流程和包含 560 万实例的大规模数据集 UniMedVL-5M，该模型在五个医学理解基准上取得竞争性能，并原生支持虚拟染色、超分辨率、跨模态合成等交错生成任务。
Motivation: 现有医学 AI 系统将图像理解和生成能力分离到不同模型中，丢失了统一架构可共享的潜在知识，无法高效支持临床工作流中同时涉及理解与生成的任务。
Method: 提出 UniMedVL，采用定制化的渐进式训练流程，使理解与生成能力相互增强；同时构建 UniMedVL-5M 数据集，包含 8 种医学成像模态、超过 560 万实例，专为统一医学理解与生成中的多模态输入-输出任务设计。
Result: 在五个医学理解基准上达到竞争性能；原生支持虚拟染色、超分辨率、跨模态合成等交错生成任务。
Conclusion: UniMedVL 证明统一医学多模态理解和生成在单一模型中可行，且公开的代码和数据集可促进后续研究。
